rows.original: Kiyoko's cabin is as much part of the cherry blossom tree that it rings. The raw-wood feel of the floor and walls aside, the entire place has little branches, leaves and vines that show themselves from time to time, blurring the line where artifice ends and nature begins — or if there even is a division. The architectural feel of the cabin is lighter and more open than what one might find in the Frost Marches, with a very foreign feel to it. In addition to the above, you get the feeling that the size of the cabin's interior isn't quite the same as its exterior. Sometimes it feels larger, sometimes it feels smaller, but if the Astral Plane itself is mutable in accordance with Kiyoko's desires, the cabin should be similar in nature, right? From the porch, there's a simple hallway that leads in past a living room, a kitchen, and upstairs to the bedrooms... [kiyoko.numKits 2 4 16 |you're pretty sure that there was only the one bedroom up there before, but as you've fathered more and more kitsune children on Kiyoko additional living space has just materialized out of thin air. Best not to question it too deeply. It's small, it's comfortable, it's homely and easily taken care of. The best kind of accommodations a bird in a gilded cage could ask for, really. |yeah, there's no doubt about it. Although there's no change in its exterior, the cabin's interior has grown, the hallways widening, more rooms materializing into existence where there were none before, and so forth. The end result is more living space for Kiyoko's growing brood of kitsune kits. It's probably best not to think too deeply about how the Astral Plane knows to make tweaks to the cabin to better accommodate its occupants — this is an artifact fashioned by a trickster god, after all. All in all, it's a cozy home for a growing family. You really couldn't ask for a better, more peaceful place for your kits to be raised in — minus the whole stuck-in-a-pocket-dimension thing, of course. |with how big it's gotten, though, you're not sure if calling Kiyoko's abode a cabin is the right word for it. Neither would mansion or castle be appropriate, though, since the verdant, rustic charm of growing out of a massive cherry blossom tree pretty much rules that out. Although it's gotten to the point where even the cabin's exterior has changed into something more stately, there's little doubt of the link which exists between cabin and tree. A large home for an equally large family. Now that's something that's fitting. ]
rows.translation: 清子的小屋与那棵樱花树密不可分，仿佛本就是它的一部分。除了地板和墙壁散发出的天然木质气息外，整个空间里还时不时冒出些小树枝、树叶和藤蔓，模糊了人工造物与自然之间的界限——或者说，根本就不存在这样的界限。小屋给人的建筑感比霜冻边境常见的建筑更轻盈、更开阔，带着一种十足的异域风情。 除此之外，你还会觉得小屋内部的面积与外观并不完全相符。有时它显得更大，有时又显得更小，但既然星界本身都能随清子的意愿而变化，那小屋想必也有类似的性质，对吧？从门廊进去，有一条简单的走廊，经过客厅、厨房，再上楼就是卧室…… [kiyoko.numKits 2 4 16 |你很确定，以前楼上只有那一间卧室，但随着你在清子身上生下越来越多的狐妖孩子，额外的居住空间就那么凭空出现了。最好别深究这件事。 它很小，很舒适，很温馨，也很容易打理。对于一只关在金笼子里的鸟来说，这真是再好不过的居所了。 |没错，这一点毫无疑问。虽然外观没有变化，但小屋的内部变大了，走廊变宽了，原本不存在的地方也凭空多出了房间，如此等等。结果就是，清子那一窝越来越多的狐妖幼崽有了更多的生活空间。 最好还是别去深究，星界究竟是怎么知道该对屋子做哪些调整、才能更好地容纳住户的——毕竟这是一件由诡计之神打造的神器。 总的来说，这是一个适合成长中家庭的温馨之家。你实在找不到比这更安宁、更适合抚养孩子们的地方了——当然，要除去那整个“被困在口袋维度里”的麻烦。 |不过，随着它变得这么大，你已经不确定用“小屋”来称呼清子的居所是否还合适了。当然，“豪宅”或“城堡”也不恰当，因为从一棵巨大的樱花树里长出来所自带的那种青翠、质朴的魅力，基本就排除了这种叫法。尽管如今连小屋的外观都变得更为气派，但小屋与那棵树之间的联系却毋庸置疑。 一栋宽敞的住宅，住着一个同样庞大的家庭。这才叫名副其实。 ]

rows.original: On the western side of the hilltop stands a small grove of peach trees, one of Kiyoko's pastimes started in a bid to keep herself sane in her otherworldly prison. Peach trees grow in rows with plenty of spacing, the ground between them carefully picked clean of weeds, and in between each row of trees berry bushes have been planted. You vaguely remember seeing this sort of agriculture before — the trees act as windbreaks for the bushes, and the bushes work together with the trees somehow... but the details don't quite come as readily to mind as you'd like. Either way, the grove is a picture of natural beauty, carefully refined by human — or kitsune, if you will — hands to be even more so. While there don't seem to be seasons here in the Astral Plane, both trees and bushes alike are laden with whole ripe fruit, glistening with morning dew and practically begging to be picked and tasted. Paradoxically, the trees' boughs are also full of pink blossoms at the same time, and no matter where you look, there're always a few petals floating down gently to the ground, carried away by the ever-present gentle breeze. The grove in its entirety is fenced in with a rough-hewn fence, and near the entrance lie in an open-air shed several simple implements for getting at the peaches: large baskets, stepladders, long poles with hooks attached. [kiyoko.numKits 2 8 16 32 |Out in the distance, a duo of your two-tailed kitsune children stand on each other's shoulders, the one at the top reaching to the highest boughs of the trees to get at the best of the fruit. Using a stepladder would be so much simpler, but no doubt this is much more fun. They really do take after their mother, don't they? |The orchard is busy as always, a few of your two-tailed kitsune children moving under the shade of the trees, picking the peaches methodically and fighting over the choicest specimens. They probably don't need to do that, given the bounties of the Astral Plane, so it's likely that they're doing so just to get an excuse to tussle and have a bit of rough and tumble. Ah, the vagaries of youth. |With so much fruit to be picked, it's a good thing there're plenty of hands to spare to the task. Your kitsune children work the boughs in duos, one shaking ripe fruit off the trees with the hooked poles while the other gathers up the fallen fruit. It's a picture of youthful, rambunctious activity — although one wonders just why so much fruit is needed, even with this many mouths to feed. |At this time of day, the voices and laughter of your fox kits in the grove drift through the air. Most are working, picking peaches off the boughs under the watchful eyes of their older siblings, but there're some who're just there for fun and games — chasing each other through the trees, sleeping in the shade, or just gathering the pink peach blossoms as they drift to the ground. With so many of them, the place is just so full of life and energy from the quiet grove you remember it once being. It's a welcome change, that's for sure. ]
rows.translation: 在山顶西侧立着一小片桃树林，这是清子为了在这个超脱尘世的牢笼里保持清醒而开始的消遣之一。桃树成行栽种，行距宽阔，树间的地面被仔细清理得没有杂草，而每一行桃树之间还种着浆果灌木。你隐约记得见过这种农作方式——树木为灌木挡风，灌木又和树木以某种方式相互配合……但具体细节却不像你希望的那样容易回想起来。 不管怎么说，这片林子都是一幅自然美景，又被人类——或者你要说狐妖也行——的双手精心打理得更加美丽。虽然星界这里似乎没有季节之分，但树木和灌木都挂满了熟透的果实，在晨露下闪着光，简直是在乞求你去采摘品尝。说来矛盾，这些树的枝头同时还开满了粉色的花朵，而且无论你望向何处，总有几片花瓣在从不间断的微风中缓缓飘落到地面。 整片林子用一道粗糙的木栅栏围了起来，入口附近的一座露天棚屋里放着几件采摘桃子的简单工具：大篮子、梯子，还有带钩子的长杆。 [kiyoko.numKits 2 8 16 32 |远处，你的一对双尾狐妖孩子正踩着彼此的肩膀叠在一起，站在上面的那个努力伸手去够最高处的枝条，想摘到最好的果子。用梯子明明会简单得多，但毫无疑问，这样要有趣得多。他们还真是像他们的母亲，不是吗？ |果园像往常一样忙碌，几个双尾狐妖孩子穿行在树荫下，有条不紊地摘着桃子，还会为最上等的果子争抢。考虑到星界物产丰饶，他们大概并不需要这样做，所以很可能只是找个借口打闹一番、滚作一团罢了。 啊，少年人的心思真是难以捉摸。 |要摘的果子这么多，幸亏有足够的人手来干这活。你的狐妖孩子们两人一组在枝头忙碌：一个用带钩的长杆把熟果从树上摇下来，另一个则把落下的果子收拢起来。这一幕满是年轻人的喧闹活力——不过人们不禁会想，就算有这么多张嘴要喂，为什么还需要这么多果子呢？ |每到这个时候，林子里你那些小狐狸的声音和笑声就会随风飘荡。大多数都在干活，在哥哥姐姐的注视下从枝头摘桃子，但也有一些纯粹是来玩耍的——在树间互相追逐，在树荫下打盹，或者只是收集飘落地面的粉色桃花。 有这么多孩子在，这里充满了生机与活力，完全不像你记忆中那片安静的林子。这无疑是一个令人欣喜的变化。 ]

rows.original: This large pool graces the eastern side of the hilltop, steaming, slightly milky water contained within a ring-shaped lip of water-smoothed rock. Save for a single channel that serves as drainage, the spring appears to be entirely natural, yet coincidentally shaped just right for perhaps three to five people to relax in the hot waters that well up from beneath the earth. And what waters they are, speaking of warmth, relaxation, and the melting away of one's worries. After all, there's nothing like a good hot bath and perhaps an accompanying snack to make even the most curmudgeonly villain to feel a lot more amiable towards the world at large. [kiyoko.numKits 2 8 16 |The sounds of splashing and laughter come to you at a distance, and as you look closer you spy a happy duo of Kiyoko's little two-tailed fox-children — your children — having a fun time in the spring, dousing each other with warm water in some game you can't quite make out. Unlike their mother's more polite and calm demeanor — one that you know melts away in the bedroom — they seem so energetic and carefree, unburdened by the knowledge of their captivity in this Astral Plane. Ah, innocence. |Is it your imagination, or have the hot springs expanded? It's hard to be sure, but you're pretty sure the pool's bigger than it used to be, steam gently rising from the water's surface as you study it. Well, that and the couple of kitsune kits submerged in the pool, soaking up the heat in a state of happy bliss. It's probably not worth it to interrupt their respite... |There's definitely more activity around the hot springs these days. While still spacious enough to offer some solitude should the situation call for it, your many kitsune children are more than happy to engage in some light play in the water — not enough to bring down their mother or big sister upon them, but plenty lively all the same. The occasional splash or squeal rings out in the air, quickly silenced by the general aura of calm that hangs about the hillside. It's good to see some life about these parts, at least. ] Although you've never seen Kiyoko scrub out the spring, she says she does, keeping the place clean and pristine. Good thing, too — one wouldn't want the outlet channel to get clogged up with fox fur.
rows.translation: 这汪巨大的水池坐落在山顶东侧，蒸腾的水汽中，略带乳白色的池水被一圈被水打磨光滑的岩石围住。除了一条用作排水的沟渠外，这处泉水看起来完全天然，却恰好大小合适，能让三到五个人泡在从地下涌出的热水中放松身心。 这水真是了不得，让人想到温暖、放松，想到烦恼全都融化消散。毕竟，没有什么比好好泡个热水澡、再来点小点心，更能让最脾气暴躁的恶棍都对整个世界和善许多了。 [kiyoko.numKits 2 8 16 |远处传来泼水声和笑声，你走近一看，发现是清子那两个快活的小双尾狐狸孩子——你的孩子——正在泉水里玩得开心，互相泼着温水，玩着你一时看不明白的游戏。与他们母亲那副更文雅、更沉静的模样——你知道那副模样在卧室里会彻底融化——不同，他们显得那么精力充沛、无忧无虑，完全没有因为被囚禁在这个星界而背上任何负担。 啊，天真无邪。 |是你的错觉，还是温泉变大了？很难确定，但仔细打量之后，你相当肯定这水池比以前大了，水面上轻轻升起蒸汽。另外，还有几只狐妖幼崽泡在池子里，幸福地享受着这份温暖。 也许不该去打扰他们的休憩…… |这些天温泉周围确实热闹了许多。这里依然宽敞得足以在需要时提供一份清静，但你那一大群狐妖孩子却非常乐意在水里玩些轻巧的把戏——还不至于把他们的母亲或大姐招来，但同样热闹得很。偶尔会有一声泼水或尖叫响起，很快又被笼罩着山坡的宁静气氛压了下去。 至少，看到这一带有了些生气，总是件好事。 ] 虽然你从没见过清子刷洗这处泉水，但她说她确实会定期清理，让这里保持干净整洁。幸好如此——谁也不想让排水渠被狐狸毛堵住吧。

rows.original:
Standing near the treeline, at the boundary between gentle, trimmed grass and thick stands of trees, one might think it appropriate that this is the place where you find yourself entering and leaving Kiyoko's little pocket dimension. Ahead of you lies a little island of civilisation, behind you, the endless enchanted forest that makes up most of this realm. Warm light beats down upon you from a blue, sunless sky, filling you with sensations of peace and comfort.

    The path at your side slopes gently upwards, leading only in one direction: onward to the peak of the hill where the huge cherry blossom tree waits. As if beckoning you, a breeze finds its way down from the hilltop, bringing with it a faint floral fragrance and a few stray pink petals.
    
    You think that if you concentrated hard enough while in this spot, you could return to the waking world.
rows.translation:
站在林缘处，那片修剪整齐的草地与茂密的树林交界之处，人们会觉得这里正是进入和离开清子的小型异次元空间的最佳地点。前方是一片文明的岛屿，而身后则是构成这片领域大部分区域的无尽魔法森林。来自蓝色无阳光天空的温暖光线洒在你身上，让你感受到宁静与舒适。

    你身旁的道路缓缓向上延伸，只通往一个方向——通往山顶，那里有一棵巨大的樱花树在等待着你。仿佛在召唤你一样，一阵微风从山顶吹下来，带着淡淡的花香和几片零落的粉色花瓣。
    
    你想着，如果在这个地方集中精力，或许就能回到现实世界。

    You think that if you concentrated hard enough while in this spot, you could return to the waking world."

rows.original: Leave Kiyoko's realm and return to the waking world.
rows.translation: 离开清子的领域，回到现实世界吧。
rows.raw: "Leave Kiyoko's realm and return to the waking world."

rows.original:
When you come to, you're lying on your back in a warm field of freshly-trimmed grass, inexplicably covered in a light dusting of pink blossoms. It feels and smells nice — especially with warm morning light beating down on you — but you can't keep lazing about until you wake up, can you?

        Hah, now there's a thought. You pull yourself to your feet, dusting the petals off your person, then make for the path that leads up the hill. Another night, another visit; no doubt your kitsune [flags.KIYOKO_FUCKED|lover|friend] will be more than happy to see you.
rows.translation:
当你醒来时，发现自己正仰躺在一片刚修剪过的柔软草地上，身上不知为何覆盖着一层淡淡的粉色花瓣。这种感觉既舒适又芬芳——尤其是在温暖的晨光照射下——但总不能一直躺着不起来吧，对吧？

        哈，这个想法倒不错。你站起身来，拍掉身上的花瓣，然后朝着通往山丘的小路走去。又一个夜晚，又一次拜访；毫无疑问，你的狐妖[flags.KIYOKO_FUCKED|恋人|朋友]一定会非常高兴见到你。
rows.raw:
"
        When you come to, you're lying on your back in a warm field of freshly-trimmed grass, inexplicably covered in a light dusting of pink blossoms. It feels and smells nice — especially with warm morning light beating down on you — but you can't keep lazing about until you wake up, can you?

        Hah, now there's a thought. You pull yourself to your feet, dusting the petals off your person, then make for the path that leads up the hill. Another night, another visit; no doubt your kitsune [flags.KIYOKO_FUCKED|lover|friend] will be more than happy to see you."

rows.original: Warmth, followed by wetness. You open your eyes to find yourself naked and enjoying a soak in the hot spring on the hill, submerged up to your chin in the steaming water. Looking around for your possessions, you find them neatly folded and stacked on the rim of the spring, safe and sound. Tempting as it is to linger in the spring for the remainder of your stay, you do have other things to attend to here. Stepping out of the water and drying yourself off, you put on your gear and prepare to head on out.
rows.translation: 暖意之后，是湿意。你睁开眼，发现自己赤身裸体地泡在山上的温泉里，热水一直没到下巴。你四下寻找自己的东西，发现它们被整整齐齐地叠放在泉边，安然无恙。 虽然很想在泉里多泡一会儿，但你确实还有别的事要在这里处理。你从水里出来，擦干身体，穿上装备，准备出发。

Looking around for your possessions, you find them neatly folded and stacked on the rim of the spring, safe and sound. Tempting as it is to linger in the spring for the remainder of your stay, you do have other things to attend to here. Stepping out of the water and drying yourself off, you put on your gear and prepare to head on out."

rows.original:
You're jolted to wakefulness by something soft and fleshy landing on your forehead. Your eyes snapping open, you look around for what it was — only to find it an overripe peach falling from the bough.

        Whew. Pushing yourself off the ground and righting yourself, you dust the leaves and dirt off your [pc.armor], then make to leave the grove.
rows.translation:
有什么柔软而多肉的东西落在你的额头上，把你猛然惊醒。你猛地睁开眼，四下寻找那是什么——结果发现是一颗从枝头掉下来的过熟桃子。

        呼。你从地上撑起身子，拍掉[pc.armor]上的树叶和泥土，然后动身离开果园。
rows.raw:
"
        You're jolted to wakefulness by something soft and fleshy landing on your forehead. Your eyes snapping open, you look around for what it was — only to find it an overripe peach falling from the bough.

        Whew. Pushing yourself off the ground and righting yourself, you dust the leaves and dirt off your [pc.armor], then make to leave the grove."

rows.original: Are you done for tonight? Once you leave the Astral Plane, you won't be able to return until you next go to sleep.
rows.translation: 你今晚的事情忙完了吗？一旦离开星界，下次入睡之前就再也无法返回了。
rows.raw: "\n        Are you done for tonight? Once you leave the Astral Plane, you won't be able to return until you next go to sleep."

rows.original: Yeah, you're done here for tonight. The waking world needs you, and your kitsune [kiyoko.numKits 1|lover|companion] isn't leaving her gilded cage. Stopping where the hilltop path winds its way into the woods, you focus your concentration on that strange sensation, that thinness in the air, and step forward...
rows.translation: 对，今晚你在这里的事已经办完了。现实世界需要你，而你的狐妖[kiyoko.numKits 1|恋人|伴侣]也不会离开她那座镀金的牢笼。在山顶的小径蜿蜒进入林中的地方停下脚步，你把注意力集中在那股奇异的感觉上，集中在空气中那片稀薄之处，然后向前迈步……
rows.raw: "\n            Yeah, you're done here for tonight. The waking world needs you, and your kitsune [kiyoko.numKits 1|lover|companion] isn't leaving her gilded cage. Stopping where the hilltop path winds its way into the woods, you focus your concentration on that strange sensation, that thinness in the air, and step forward..."

rows.original: Hmm. Did you forget something, or perhaps there's a matter that needs attending to before you leave? Whatever your reason, you decide against returning to the waking world just yet and turn back along the hilltop path. There's no rush... you can take your time in this place, after all. You have time, if nothing else.
rows.translation: 嗯，你是忘了什么吗？还是说，在离开之前有什么事需要处理？无论出于什么原因，你都决定暂时不回到清醒的世界，而是沿着山顶的小路折返。不用着急……毕竟在这个地方，你可以慢慢来。至少，你还有的是时间。
rows.raw: "\n            Hmm. Did you forget something, or perhaps there's a matter that needs attending to before you leave? Whatever your reason, you decide against returning to the waking world just yet and turn back along the hilltop path. There's no rush... you can take your time in this place, after all. You have time, if nothing else."

rows.original:
Well, if Kiyoko's in no position to entertain you further, then there's no reason to linger; time to leave this place and deal with the waking world.

    Retracing your footsteps, you head for the edge of the Astral Plane, the beginning of the footpath that leads from the forest's edge to the hilltop cabin. One last look at the humongous cherry blossom tree and the cage that it represents, a sad shake of the head, and then you step forward, focusing your concentration.
    
    Yes, there it is, that point in the air where the world feels distinctly thinner. Focusing your mind, you step forward... 
    
    ...And wake up immediately with a quiet gasp of effort. Looks like there's still time to rest, though, so you turn over and try to get some more sleep.
rows.translation:
好吧，如果清子已经没法再陪你玩下去了，那就没有理由继续逗留；该离开这里，去应付现实世界了。

    你沿着来路往回走，朝星界边缘走去，也就是那条从森林边缘通往山顶小屋的小径起点。最后再看一眼那棵巨大的樱花树，以及它所代表的那座牢笼，你难过地摇了摇头，然后向前迈步，集中精神。
    
    对，就是那里，空气中那个世界明显变得稀薄的点。你集中意念，向前迈步……
    
    ……然后立刻伴着一声用力的轻喘醒了过来。不过看来还有时间再休息一会儿，于是你翻了个身，想再睡一阵。
rows.raw:
"
    Well, if Kiyoko's in no position to entertain you further, then there's no reason to linger; time to leave this place and deal with the waking world.

    Retracing your footsteps, you head for the edge of the Astral Plane, the beginning of the footpath that leads from the forest's edge to the hilltop cabin. One last look at the humongous cherry blossom tree and the cage that it represents, a sad shake of the head, and then you step forward, focusing your concentration.

rows.original:
With a sudden groan, your eyes flick open and the waking world rushes forth. Despite you having had your rest, you don't feel as refreshed as you ought to be. There's a painful soreness in your muscles, you feel drained, and perhaps most telling of all, your [pc.cockNoun] is massively erect, drooling a steady trickle of pre in memory of the naughty things little foxy Kiyoko did to you. Your precious bodily fluids aren't the only thing that your kitsune slut-wife received as a present, but a measure of your life-force as well, and you feel the loss very, very keenly.

    Well, you agreed to this, so it's not as if you have anyone but yourself to blame for how absolutely rotten you feel. Heaving a sigh, you rub your joints and force yourself to your feet; hoping the fatigue will pass with a little activity; it is, after all, a relatively small price to pay for the pleasantries of your visit. Shoving your [pc.cockNoun] back in your clothes, you clear the cobwebs from your head with a deep breath and try not to think too hard about the aching in your joints. Maybe you should get some more sleep before trying to take on the day...
rows.translation:
伴随着一声突然的呻吟，你猛地睁开眼，现实世界扑面而来。尽管你已经休息过了，却并没有感到应有的神清气爽。你的肌肉酸痛难忍，整个人像被抽空了一样，而最能说明问题的是，你的[pc.cockNoun]高高挺立，不断淌出一股前液，显然是在回味那个小狐狸清子对你做的那些下流事。你的狐妖婊子老婆收到的礼物可不只是你那点宝贵的体液，还有你一部分生命力，而这份损失你感觉得极其、极其真切。

    唉，这是你自己答应的，所以你现在感觉这么糟糕，也只能怪你自己。你叹了口气，揉了揉关节，强迫自己站起来，希望活动一下能让疲惫消退；毕竟，为了这次拜访的欢愉，这点代价还算相对便宜。你把[pc.cockNoun]塞回衣服里，深吸一口气理清脑中的混沌，尽量不去多想关节里的酸痛。也许在开始这一天之前，你该再多睡一会儿……

"
    With a sudden groan, your eyes flick open and the waking world rushes forth. Despite you having had your rest, you don't feel as refreshed as you ought to be. There's a painful soreness in your muscles, you feel drained, and perhaps most telling of all, your [pc.cockNoun] is massively erect, drooling a steady trickle of pre in memory of the naughty things little foxy Kiyoko did to you. rows.original:
[flags.BERWYN_TOWER_COMMON_VISITED|You re-enter the base of the tower|You enter into the base of the tower]; it seems to be a common area of sorts, with table, chairs, a couple book shelves, a stove, and countertops. This clearly isn't your destination, as there's no "mistress" to be found here. 

    [flags.BERWYN_TOWER_COMMON_VISITED|Berwyn seems frustrated, "What are we doing in here still?! We need to find Mistress Matiha!"|Sure enough, Berwyn speaks up and tells you, "She isn't here, she's probably in her study a couple floors up."]

    Well, it doesn't look like there's anything of interest here, [flags.BERWYN_TOWER_FOUND_LAB|seeing as you've already discovered the Mistress's lab|aside from those bookshelves over in the corner].
rows.translation:
[flags.BERWYN_TOWER_COMMON_VISITED|你再次进入塔楼底层|你进入塔楼底层]；这里似乎算是某种公共区域，有桌子、椅子、几个书架、一个炉子，还有几处台面。这里显然不是你的目的地，因为这里根本找不到“女主人”。

    [flags.BERWYN_TOWER_COMMON_VISITED|贝尔温看起来很烦躁：“我们还待在这里干什么？！我们得找到玛蒂哈女士！”|果然，贝尔温开口告诉你：“她不在这里，大概在上面几层的书房里。”]

    嗯，这里看起来没有什么值得留意的东西，[flags.BERWYN_TOWER_FOUND_LAB|既然你已经发现了女主人的实验室|除了角落里那几个书架之外]。

"

    Well, it doesn't look like there's anything of interest here, [flags.BERWYN_TOWER_FOUND_LAB|seeing as you've already discovered the Mistress's lab|aside from those bookshelves over in the corner].
    "

rows.translation: 你已经调查过那个书架了

rows.original:
You walk over to the bookshelf, and Berwyn follows you to it.

    "Nothing special here," the mage begins to explain, "Not even any spell tomes. It's all just normal books and stuff like that, a lot of really lame romance novels for some reason."

    Curious about this seemingly normal shelf, you ask your companion if there's anything here his mistress herself reads.

    "Uuuhm," he ponders, "I think there's one, something with a guy falling in love with a salamander?"

    Which one of these books could that be?
rows.translation:
你走到书架前，贝尔温也跟着过来了。

    “这里没什么特别的，”法师开口解释道，“连一本法术书都没有。全是些普通的书之类的东西，不知为什么还有很多特别烂的言情小说。”

    你对这个看似普通的书架感到好奇，便问同伴，这里有没有他的女主人自己会读的东西。

    “呃……”他想了想，“我记得有一本，好像是讲一个男人爱上一只火蜥蜴的？”

    这些书里哪一本会是那本呢？
rows.raw:
'
    You walk over to the bookshelf, and Berwyn follows you to it.

    "Nothing special here," the mage begins to explain, "Not even any spell tomes. It's all just normal books and stuff like that, a lot of really lame romance novels for some reason."

    Curious about this seemingly normal shelf, you ask your companion if there's anything here his mistress herself reads.

    "Uuuhm," he ponders, "I think there's one, something with a guy falling in love with a salamander?"

    Which one of these books could that be?
    '

rows.translation: 试读那本名为 %"尼瓦斯深渊" 的书。
奥克索内夫斯赏金任务

rows.original: Try the book entitled %"Oxonef's Bounty," which seems to be a prequel to %"Nivas's Depths."
rows.translation: 试读那本名为 %"奥克索内夫赏金" 的书；它似乎是 %"尼瓦斯深渊" 的前传。
rows.raw: 'Try the book entitled %"Oxonef\'s Bounty," which seems to be a prequel to %"Nivas\'s Depths."'

rows.translation: 试读那本名为 %"阿莎的画布" 的书。

rows.original:
You go to pull the book from the shelf, only to find it stuck to the bookcase. When you give it a tug in an attempt to free it, there's a slight "click" sound that resonates from behind the shelf. Then you hear the sound of stone grinding against stone behind you, and turning to its source, you see the floor beneath you moving to reveal a hidden staircase!

    Berwyn lets out an astonished "What the..." as he watches the spectacle.

    Looks like this tower is more than it seems.
rows.translation:
你伸手去把那本书从书架上抽出来，却发现它粘在书架上。你用力一扯想把它拉下来，书架后面随即传来一声轻微的“咔嗒”声。接着你听到身后石头摩擦石头的声响，转头朝声音的来源看去，只见脚下的地板正在移动，露出一段隐藏的楼梯！

    贝尔温看着这一幕，惊讶地叫了一声：“什么……” 

    看来这座塔并不像表面看上去那么简单。
rows.raw:
'

When you give it a tug in an attempt to free it, there's a slight "click" sound that resonates from behind the shelf. Then you hear the sound of stone grinding against stone behind you, and turning to its source, you see the floor beneath you moving to reveal a hidden staircase!

    '

rows.original: You pull the book from the shelf and flip through its pages, but there doesn't seem to be anything special about it, aside from the amount of minotaurs in the story, so you place it back.
rows.translation: 你从书架上取下那本书，翻动着它的页面，但除了故事中出现了许多弥诺陶洛斯之外，似乎并没有什么特别之处，于是你又把它放了回去。
rows.raw: "\n    You pull the book from the shelf and flip through its pages, but there doesn't seem to be anything special about it, aside from the amount of minotaurs in the story, so you place it back."

rows.original: You pull the book from the shelf and flips through its pages. From what you can tell it's mostly about very well-endowed women, but there doesn't seem to be anything special about the book itself, so you place it back.
rows.translation: 你从书架上取下那本书，翻动着书页。据你所知，内容主要讲的是些身材极其丰满的女人，但这本书本身似乎并没有什么特别之处，于是你又把它放了回去。
rows.raw: "\n    You pull the book from the shelf and flips through its pages. From what you can tell it's mostly about very well-endowed women, but there doesn't seem to be anything special about the book itself, so you place it back."

rows.original:
You head for the tower's front door, only for Berwyn to walk up beside you.

    "Where do you think you're going?" he asks, now moving ahead to step in front of you, "You said you were going to help me! Not to mention you can't get through that gate without my help."

    [pc.isDK|Scowling at the wolfboy|Looking to the wolfboy], you tell him you were just going to head out into the courtyard.

    "Don't bother," Berwyn says, his pale eyes narrowing, "Most of the plants out there are poisonous by themselves, and Miss Matiha put runes along the walls to prevent thieves from scaling the tower."

    If there's really nothing you can do out there, you figure you should stick to helping Berwyn deal with his mistress, and turn back into the commons.
rows.translation:
你朝塔楼的前门走去，贝尔温却走到了你身边。

    “你以为你要去哪儿？”他问道，同时绕到前面挡在你身前，“你说过要帮我的！再说，没有我帮忙，你根本过不了那道门。”

    [pc.isDK|你皱着眉看向那个狼男孩|你看向那个狼男孩]，告诉他你只是打算去院子里走走。

    “别费那个劲了，”贝尔温说，他那双苍白的眼睛眯了起来，“外面那些植物大多本身就有毒，而且玛蒂哈女士还在墙上布了符文，防止小偷攀爬塔楼。”

    如果外面确实没什么可做的，你觉得还是该留下来帮贝尔温处理他女主人那档子事，于是转身回到了公共区域。

rows.original:
You're in Mistress Matiha's secret lab. There's all sorts of expensive and strange looking alchemical equipment, enchanting tools, and various tomes scattered across multiple workbenches. 

        A well hidden place like this would hold many secrets for a mage of Berwyn's Mistress's calibre, but it seems you've done all you can here.
rows.translation:
你现在位于玛蒂哈女士的秘密实验室里。这里摆满了各种昂贵而奇形怪状的炼金设备、附魔工具，还有散落在好几张工作台上的各种典籍。 

        像这样一个隐藏得如此巧妙的地方，对贝尔温的女主人这种水准的法师来说肯定藏着许多秘密，但看来你在这里能做的都已经做完了。
rows.raw:
"
        You're in Mistress Matiha's secret lab. There's all sorts of expensive and strange looking alchemical equipment, enchanting tools, and various tomes scattered across multiple workbenches. 

        A well hidden place like this would hold many secrets for a mage of Berwyn's Mistress's calibre, but it seems you've done all you can here."

rows.original:
You move cautiously down the hidden stairwell, at the ready for any magical trickery. 

        Berwyn's eyes widen as you make your way into the hidden room, his mouth hanging agape.

        It's some sort of hidden laboratory that you've stumbled into. There's all sorts of alchemical equipment, enchanters tools, tomes, and all sorts of dangerous things. The walls and floors are covered in runes and equations beyond your understanding, and beyond your summoner comrade's it seems.

        "I..." he stutters, looking all around the room, "I didn't know about this place... why was she keeping all this hidden?" 

        The half-breed continues to inspect the various projects lining multiple workbenches throughout the room.

        "Look at this!" Berwyn exclaims, taking notice of a large, alchemical setup.

        You follow him over, watching as the girly mage bends himself over the table to get a closer look at everything, tail wagging excitedly as he inspects the various liquids and runes.

        "It looks like she's trying to infuse something with... liquid ley-crystal," he says, stroking his chin, "I'm surprised she could do that all here, normally you'd need a whole college of scholars to do something like this." He stands up straight and hurriedly looks around the room. "Ah, here!" he says, walking over to another table and picking something up, "It looks like she was trying to treat these weapons."

        Berwyn turns to reveal a sword and a staff; both of them bear an intricate spiral, either in the blade of the sword or the haft and crux of the staff.

        "See the spirals?" he asks, "They would naturally amplify the power of latent magic in the ley-crystal." Turning back to the alchemical set up, his brow furrows, "It looks like there's only enough to infuse one of these though. I couldn't make liquid ley-crystal myself, but I know enough about alchemy and enchanting to enhance one of these weapons for you... it'd definitely be better off in your hands than my mistress's."

        Magically infused weapons would be a boon, but the question is, which one do you want?
rows.translation:
你小心翼翼地沿着隐蔽的楼梯向下走去，随时准备应对任何魔法伎俩。 

        当你走进那个隐蔽的房间时，贝尔温的眼睛瞪得大大的，嘴巴张得老大。

        你误打误撞闯进来的是一间隐藏的实验室。这里有各种各样的炼金设备、附魔师工具、典籍，还有各种危险的东西。墙壁和地板上布满了你和你的召唤师同伴都看不懂的符文与方程式。

        “我……”他结结巴巴地说，环视着整个房间，“我根本不知道还有这个地方……她为什么要把这些都藏起来？” 

        这个混血儿继续检查着房间里摆在多张工作台上的各种项目。

        “看这个！”贝尔温惊呼道，注意到了一套大型的炼金装置。

        你跟着他走过去，看着这位女气的法师弯腰凑到桌前细看那些东西，尾巴兴奋地摇来摇去，一边检查着各种液体和符文。

        “看起来她想用……液态雷晶给什么东西注入魔力，”他摸着下巴说，“我很惊讶她能在这种地方做出这种事，通常你得有一整个学院的学者才办得到。”他直起身，急忙环顾房间。“啊，这里！”他说着走到另一张桌前拿起一样东西，“看来她是在试着处理这些武器。”

        贝尔温转过身，露出了一把剑和一根法杖；两件武器上都带着精细的螺旋纹，一个在剑刃上，另一个在法杖的杖身与杖头交接处。

        “看到那些螺旋了吗？”他问，“它们会自然地放大雷晶中潜藏魔力的力量。”他又转向那套炼金装置，眉头皱起，“不过看起来量只够给其中一件注入魔力。我自己做不出液态雷晶，但对炼金术和附魔我懂得够多，能帮你强化其中一件武器……它放在你手里肯定比在我女主人手里要好得多。”

        被魔法注入的武器确实是件好事，但问题在于，你想要哪一件？
rows.raw:
'
        You move cautiously down the hidden stairwell, at the ready for any magical trickery. 

        Berwyn's eyes widen as you make your way into the hidden room, his mouth hanging agape.

        It's some sort of hidden laboratory that you've stumbled into. There's all sorts of alchemical equipment, enchanters tools, tomes, and all sorts of dangerous things. The walls and floors are covered in runes and equations beyond your understanding, and beyond your summoner comrade's it seems.

        "I..." he stutters, looking all around the room, "I didn't know about this place... why was she keeping all this hidden?" 

        The half-breed continues to inspect the various projects lining multiple workbenches throughout the room.

        "Look at this!" Berwyn exclaims, taking notice of a large, alchemical setup.

        You follow him over, watching as the girly mage bends himself over the table to get a closer look at everything, tail wagging excitedly as he inspects the various liquids and runes.

        "It looks like she's trying to infuse something with... liquid ley-crystal," he says, stroking his chin, "I'm surprised she could do that all here, normally you'd need a whole college of scholars to do something like this." He stands up straight and hurriedly looks around the room. "Ah, here!" he says, walking over to another table and picking something up, "It looks like she was trying to treat these weapons."

        Berwyn turns to reveal a sword and a staff; both of them bear an intricate spiral, either in the blade of the sword or the haft and crux of the staff.

        "See the spirals?" he asks, "They would naturally amplify the power of latent magic in the ley-crystal." Turning back to the alchemical set up, his brow furrows, "It looks like there's only enough to infuse one of these though. I couldn't make liquid ley-crystal myself, but I know enough about alchemy and enchanting to enhance one of these weapons for you... it'd definitely be better off in your hands than my mistress's."

        Magically infused weapons would be a boon, but the question is, which one do you want?'

rows.translation: 让贝尔温为这根法杖注入魔力。
让贝尔温为这把剑注入魔力。

rows.original:
Berwyn nods at your decision and quickly gets to work treating your weapon of choice with the ley-crystal. The summoner works fast under the given time-constraints, and soon turns from the vast alchemical equipment to present you with your new staff. 

    "Here you go," he says, "I hope it helps."

    You take the magically-infused staff, able to feel the power pulsing through it.

    “给你，”他说，“希望它能有帮助。”

    你接过这根注入了魔法的法杖，能感受到其中的力量在脉动。

rows.original:
Moving upward past some storage rooms and libraries, you enter what appears to be some living quarters. There's two rooms separated by movable dividers that keep a little privacy between the two beds in the room. Speaking of, it's pretty easy to tell which bed belongs to the lady of the tower, with it being much bigger than what looks to be Berwyn's tiny cot. Still, it doesn't look like the Mistress keeps much of value here besides clothes and some light reading.

    "Miss Matiha's study is right above us," Berwyn whispers, "You should be ready before we head up there."
rows.translation:
向上走过几间储藏室和图书室，你进入了一片似乎是起居区的地方。有两个房间被可移动的隔板分开，为房里的两张床隔出一点私密空间。说起来，很容易看出哪张床属于这座塔的女主人——它比旁边那张一看就是贝尔温睡的小窄床大得多。不过，除了衣服和几本消遣读物之外，这位女主人似乎并没有在这里存放多少值钱的东西。

    “玛蒂哈女士的书房就在我们正上方，”贝尔温低声说，“上去之前，你最好先做好准备。”

rows.original: Try to look for something valuable while you're here.
rows.translation: 趁你在这里，试着找找有没有什么值钱的东西。
rows.raw: "Try to look for something valuable while you're here."

rows.original:
Determined to find something worth your time here, you begin rifling through a nearby dresser, pulling out drawers and clothes. 

    "What are you doing?!" Berwyn exclaims as quietly as he can, "Those're my clothes!"

    Grinning, you find something you think is at least somewhat valuable, and pull out a pair of panties that seem about your summoner comrade's size, especially with the amount of crotch room they have. [pc.dcb|With a devilish smirk|Blushing|Giggling softly], you turn to Berwyn with his undergarments in hand.

    The half-breed grits his teeth before letting out a deep breath and rubbing his temples. "You know what, fine," he says, scowling at you, "I don't care, do whatever you want with those. Let's just keep moving."

    With the femboy's approval, you pocket his panties and get ready to move on.
rows.translation:
你决心在这里找到点值得花时间的东西，于是开始翻找旁边的梳妆台，一个个拉出抽屉，掏出里面的衣物。 

    “你在干什么？！”贝尔温尽可能压低声喊道，“那是我的衣服！”

    你咧嘴一笑，找到了一件你觉得多少还算值钱的东西，抽出一条看起来正合你那位召唤师同伴尺寸的内裤。 [pc.dcb|你露出一个邪气的笑容|你脸红了|你轻声咯咯笑了], 你手里拎着他的内衣转向贝尔温。

    那个混血儿咬了咬牙，然后长出一口气，揉了揉太阳穴。“行吧，”他说，皱着眉看你，“我不在乎，你爱拿它干什么就干什么。我们继续走吧。”

    得到这个伪娘的许可后，你把他的内裤塞进口袋，准备继续前进。

rows.original:
"This way," Berwyn says quietly.

    You follow him up the stairs just one more floor before you come to what must be Miss Matiha's study; a tall, pale skinned human woman stands before a desk, flipping through a large tome, a strange runed stone next to the leather bound book. She's wearing an outfit similar to her apprentice's, and it fits tightly around her womanly body. 

    Berwyn enters first, stepping into the room with a stern look on his face.

    "Ah, Berwyn," the woman speaks up with a voice that sounds halfway regal but fully seductive, not turning to face you or her student, "I almost didn't hear you come in. You should start wearing sandals or something on those paws of yours. How did your training go today?"

    "I didn't train," Berwyn says plainly, tightening his grip on his staff.

    His mistress turns her head just slightly, not enough that you can see her eyes, but just enough to make out a smirk crossing her face, "Oh, but I see you've brought friends. Are they for me?"

    The girly summoner grits his teeth, "No... they're here to help me stop you."

    The woman chuckles and turns around, revealing an impressive bust stretching her robes and a beautiful face with brown eyes and dark lips. "Oh come now, Berwyn," she says, "I don't know what you're going on about, but help me deal with your friends here and then we can have a nice night together..."

    "I saw the map!" Berwyn suddenly shouts out, pointing his staff at his mistress, "I don't know what you're planning on doing, but I know it's not good!"

    Matiha sighs in exasperation at that, she looks down, and then back up, a strange white glow in her previously brown eyes. Her feet lift off the floor and she holds her arms out as she starts levitating! "You continue to disappoint, Berwyn," she says, her voice sounding much different from before, like there was an echo of someone else talking, "I'll have to punish you later once I deal with these interlopers you brought."

    [party.som|You|You and [companion.name]|You and your party] are quick to ready your weapon[party.solo||s]. Your new comrade does the same, standing beside you.

    "Out of the way, Berwyn," his mistress chides. "You're going to get hurt."

    Her apprentice doesn't move, standing his ground. His pale blue eyes narrow, fluffy white tail standing completely still.

    The black-robed woman sighs again. "Fine," she says, "Have it your way, but don't come crying to me later when you get hurt!" 

    With that, she swings her arm, sending a huge bolt of dark energies crackling your way. It barely misses you and instead splits a hole in the stone wall behind you and Berwyn. That seemed to be a warning shot...

    Oh, you're definitely in for a fight.
rows.translation:
“这边走，”贝尔温轻声说道。

    你跟着他又上了一层楼梯，来到那间想必就是玛蒂哈女士书房的地方；一位皮肤苍白的高挑人类女性正站在书桌前翻阅一本厚厚的典籍，那本皮面装订的书旁边放着一块刻着符文的古怪石头。她穿着与她的学徒相似的衣服，紧紧裹住她那丰腴的身材。 

    贝尔温先进了门，脸上带着严肃的神情走进房间。

    “啊，贝尔温，”那女人开口说道，声音一半像贵族，却又十足地勾人，她既没有转身看你，也没有转去看她的学生，“我差点没听见你进来。你该在爪子上穿双凉鞋之类的东西。今天的训练进行得怎么样？”

    “我没有训练，”贝尔温平淡地说，握紧了手中的法杖。

    他的女主人只微微偏了偏头，偏得不足以让你看见她的眼睛，却刚好够让你看清她脸上掠过的一抹笑，“哦，可我看到你带了朋友来。他们是给我的吗？”

    这位女气的召唤师咬着牙，“不……他们是来帮我阻止你的。”

    女人轻笑一声转过身来，露出把长袍撑得紧绷的傲人胸部，以及一张有着棕色眼睛和深色嘴唇的美丽脸庞。“哦，别这样，贝尔温，”她说，“我不知道你在胡说些什么，但先帮我料理了你这些朋友，然后我们就能一起度过一个美妙的夜晚……”

    “我看到那张地图了！”贝尔温突然喊道，用法杖指着他的女主人，“我不知道你打算干什么，但我知道那绝不是什么好事！”

    听到这话，玛蒂哈恼怒地叹了口气。她低下头，又抬起来，原本棕色的眼睛里泛着一种诡异的白光。她的双脚离开地面，双臂张开，开始往上升浮！“你还是这么让人失望，贝尔温，”她说着，声音与先前大不相同，仿佛有另一个人的声音在回荡，“等我收拾了你带来的这些闯入者，回头再来惩罚你。”

    [party.som|你|你和 [companion.name]|你和你的队伍] 迅速拿起武器准备应战[party.solo||们]。你的新同伴也一样，站到了你身边。

    “让开，贝尔温，”他的女主人斥道，“你会受伤的。”

    她的学徒没有动，坚守着位置。他淡蓝色的眼睛眯起，蓬松的白尾巴纹丝不动。

    那位黑袍女人又叹了口气。“好吧，”她说，“随你的便，但等你受伤的时候可别哭着来找我！” 

    说完，她挥动手臂，一道巨大的暗影能量闪电般朝你劈来。它勉强擦过你，在你和贝尔温身后的石墙上轰出一个洞。那看来是一记警告。

    哦，这一仗是躲不掉了。

rows.original:
[lastStanding.resDefeated|Berwyn's mistress falls from the air, gently landing and falling to her knees. She sighs and looks upward, focusing her gaze on her apprentice.|Berwyn's mistress is knocked from the air and falls to her knees. She breathes heavy for a moment before picking her head up, revealing her bloodied lip as she turns her gaze to her apprentice.] The defeated mage smirks at the half-lupine[berwyn.isDefeated|, who's currently rising to his feet and dealing with his [berwyn.resDefeated|mental ]wounds]. "While you lack the ability to harness magic properly, Berwyn," she begins, managing to rise shakily to her feet, "I will say you do know how to pick your allies." 

    Mistress Matiha catches her breath, then reaches to that runed stone adorning her desk. "This isn't the last you'll see of me, my apprentice," she says, taking hold of the marked rock, "You still have much to learn..."

    With that, a bright glow appears from the stone, leading Berwyn's eyes to widen before he shouts, "Stop her! Quick!"

    By then though, it's already too late, and a bright white light engulfs the Mistress, blinding everyone in the room. When the light settles, Berwyn's mistress is gone, along with that runed rock. [berwyn.isDefeated|Despite having fallen in battle earlier, your|Your] summoner comrade rushes over to the spot where that powerful magician once stood, examining the area. All he can muster after his inspection is a simple "She's gone."

    Before [party.som|you|you and [companion.name]|your party] can finish collecting [party.solo|yourself|yourselves] after that fight, the whole tower begins to shake violently. You look around for a moment, worried the whole place might collapse, and look to Berwyn for any help[pc.isDK|, scowling at him, thinking it might be his fault]. It seems the girly mage knows what's happening, and turns to you and yells, "We need to get out of here!"
rows.translation:
[lastStanding.resDefeated|贝尔温的女主人从半空中落了下来，轻轻落地后双膝跪地。她叹了口气，抬头望向自己的学徒。|贝尔温的女主人被从半空中打落，双膝跪地。她剧烈喘息了一会儿才抬起头，露出流血的嘴唇，目光转向自己的学徒。] 落败的法师对着那个半狼人冷笑[berwyn.isDefeated|，而后者此时正爬起来处理自己[berwyn.resDefeated|精神上的 ]创伤]。“虽说你没能学会正确运用魔法，贝尔温，”她一边说，一边勉强颤抖着站起身，“但我得说，你确实很会挑选盟友。” 

    玛蒂哈女士缓了口气，然后伸手去拿放在书桌上的那块符文石。“这不会是你最后一次见到我，我的学徒，”她说着，握住了那块刻着记号的石头，“你还有太多东西要学……”

    话音刚落，石头上亮起一道耀眼的光芒，贝尔温眼睛猛地睁大，大喊道：“拦住她！快！”

    但那时已经太迟了，一道明亮的白光吞没了女主人，把房间里所有人都照得睁不开眼。等光芒平息，贝尔温的女主人已经不见了，那块符文石也一并消失。[berwyn.isDefeated|尽管你先前在战斗中倒下了，但你的|你的]召唤师同伴冲到那位强大法师刚才站立的地方，仔细检查着那片区域。一番查看之后，他能挤出的只有一句简单的“她走了。”

    还没等 [party.som|你|你和 [companion.name]|你的队伍] 从战斗后缓过劲来[party.solo|你自己|你们自己]，整座塔就开始剧烈摇晃。你四下张望，担心整座建筑会塌掉，又看向贝尔温，希望能得到些帮助[pc.isDK|你皱着眉看他，心想这也许都是他的错]。那位女气的法师似乎知道出了什么事，转向你喊道：“我们得赶快离开这里！”

rows.original:
You're not about to stay inside a crumbling tower, so you quickly [party.som|follow Berwyn as he runs down the stairs|help your companion and follow Berwyn as he makes for the stairs|gather your party and help the wounded before Berwyn makes a rush for the stairs, and you follow].
    
        It seems like a long trip back down to the base of the tower, nearly falling several times as the ground shakes beneath you. Luckily, you [party.hasCompanions|all|both] manage to make it out safely, but you don't stop once you're out of the tower. Your summoner ally urges you back out of the fortress' front gate, and then even further past its walls.
    
        Finally, Berwyn comes to a rest, panting after all that sprinting. He tries to catch his breath for a moment before turning back to look at the tower he had lived in these past years as it trembles above the horizon. A high pitched whining pierces your ears as torrents of magical energy flow from the tower, battering [party.som|you and Berwyn|all of you|your exhausted party] and almost knocking you off your feet. "If you're willing to put in a good word for me, [pc.name], I shouldn't lift my nose at that kind of generosity. Let's go to that tavern of yours."

你当然不会待在一座正在崩塌的塔里，于是你立刻[party.som|跟着贝尔温跑下楼梯|帮你的同伴一把，然后跟着贝尔温冲向楼梯|召集你的队伍，先帮伤员处理一下，随后贝尔温冲向楼梯，你们跟在后面]。
    
        回到塔底似乎是一段漫长的路程，脚下的地面不停晃动，你好几次差点摔倒。幸运的是，你[party.hasCompanions|所有人|两个人都]平安逃了出来，但出了塔之后你们并没有停下。你的召唤师盟友催着你们退出堡垒的正门，接着又往墙外退了更远。
    
        终于，贝尔温停下来，一路狂奔之后喘个不停。他试着缓了几口气，才回头望向那座他这些年一直居住的塔楼，它正在地平线上颤动。你随着他的目光一起望向女主人的堡垒，心想它随时都可能倒塌，可取而代之的是一道刺眼的白光吞没了整个地方！一阵尖利的啸声刺穿你的耳朵，汹涌的魔法能量从塔中涌出，冲击着 [party.som|你和贝尔温|你们所有人|你疲惫的队伍]，几乎把你们掀翻在地。你不得不移开视线、捂住耳朵才能站稳。
    
        就在这一切似乎达到顶点时，一道巨大的冲击波在整片区域炸开。随后光芒终于开始消退，你终于能重新睁开眼，却只看到女主人那座塔原本矗立的地方变成了一片空地。你被那番魔法伟力惊得目瞪口呆，转头向贝尔温寻求解释。
        
        这位学徒注意到你在看他，在喘息的间隙挤出了几句话。“她把整座城堡都传送走了……”他说，“我没想到她能做到这种事。我见过她把一些小东西传送进出塔楼……可这个……”
    
        你问他是否知道女主人可能去了哪里。
        
        贝尔温把那双爪一样的手撑在膝盖上弯下腰，仍在努力平复呼吸，一边摇着头，“不知道……但她说那不是我们最后一次见面。我想在我弄清她去了哪里之前，她就会先找到我。”

        “谢谢你，”他轻声说，重新站直了身子。“你本来不必帮我，但你还是帮了，哪怕我之前那样对你。”

        他长叹一口气，目光投向远方的地平线。尽管他就站在你面前，看上去却像是远在千里之外。“现在我没地方可去了，”他终于说道。“那座塔是我唯一的家。我父母的葡萄园离这里远得很。而现在，玛蒂哈随时可能来找我。”贝尔温努力让声音不要发抖，但你能听出他嗓子里的哽咽。
        
        嗯……那儿也许不是他习惯的住处，但如果他想在鹰棘镇的霜犬酒馆长租一间房，你可以为他作保。
        
        “酒馆？”他问，几乎有些难以置信，挑起一根眉毛看着你。
        
        那里不会有他已经习惯享用的图书室，也不会有任何魔法或炼金工具——至少，除非他自己去弄——但安全性比他现在的处境要好得多。也就是说，他现在的处境毫无安全可言。给他几天时间，他就能把那地方变成一个像样的、哪怕是临时的家。
        
        贝尔温又从鼻子里叹了口气。他知道自己别无选择，也没有资格挑三拣四。“好吧，”他说，肩膀垮了下来。“如果你愿意为我说句好话，[pc.name]，我不该对这份慷慨挑鼻子挑眼。咱们就去你说的那家酒馆吧。”

rows.original: You flag down the guards, lining up at the gate and readying yourselves for the pending challenge. "Something wrong?" One of the guards asks. "This is a Jotun fortress, right?" You ask. The guards both nod, waiting for you to enter patiently. There's a strong chance this whole fortress was smashed straight into the ocean by some titanic dragon, back during their old war.] The moment [party.yall] cross the threshold, however, the gate is slammed shut once more and a cloud of debris is kicked up. It's a little unsettling to 'cough' underwater, but still you manage to do so, spitting and frowning at the oceanic equivalent of a throat full of dust. [pc.isCunning |While you're still coughing and clearing your lungs, your hackles rise instinctively; you're not alone. There's just enough fore-warning to [party.som |throw yourself to the side, before a huge form crashes violently into the stone floor you'd occupied only moments ago. |throw yourself to the side with a kick of your feet, pushing [companion1.name] as you go. A massive form smashes violently into the stone floor you'd occupied only moments before, kicking up yet more debris. |throw yourself to the side with a kick of your feet, with arms wrapped around your companions hips as you go. A massive form smashes violently into the stone floor you'd occupied only moments before, kicking up yet more debris. ] |You're still clearing your lungs when an obscene bulk tears into you out of nowhere, smashing flagstones beneath your feet and sending you spinning helplessly through the water clutching your ribs. ] Although ancient dust, clouds of dirt, and chips of stone are still being kicked up into the water, you can finally make out the identity of your titanic foe. A huge eel, with dinner-plate-sized, dead-staring eyes[silly |... like a doll's eyes ], and an array of brutally-long teeth. Its scaled body looks almost greasy, and an obvious lack of light has given it a sickly appearance. At least until the charge begins to flow throughout its body; you can taste as much as feel the change in the water, [pc.hasFur |and despite being waterlogged your fur still manages to grow static-y |and the sensation of static crawls across your [pc.skin] ]. There are plenty of broken pillars, at least; perhaps you can hug them to avoid the shockwave.

rows.original: As the eel finally goes still, you plant your hands on your knees and try to catch your 'breath'... a motion which slowly tips you in a somersault. [party.comp cait |Much to Cait's amusement. Although she seems mostly interested in figuring out how to slice off a haunch of eel for later fish-feasting. ] The eel's body spasms with the last evidence of charge moving throughout its body, [party.comp cait |and Cait lets out a squeal of surprise as a crackling fluid-sac tumbles out of the incision she's made with a fish-knife. "Uh! Oh... that's new." |and a bulging, fleshy, crackling fluid-sac tumbles from its mouth. ] You gingerly pick up the sac as it drifts to the stone floor, struggling to gauge its actual weight. The taste of an acrid thunderstorm finds the back of your throat, and you surmise that it's the source of the eel's shocking power.

rows.original:
Try as you might, the eel's onslaught is unstoppable. It weaves around your attacks, unleashing barrages of electric pain between darting bites, until finally it's too much. Your limbs go numb, refusing to respond to commands, leaving you bleary-eyed and helpless as the monstrosity slithers back and begins charging up the biggest shockwave yet.

    Everything goes white in an instant, and then dark as night.
    
    You died.
rows.translation:
无论你怎么努力，鳗鱼的攻势都无法阻挡。它绕过你的攻击，在窜来窜去的撕咬之间释放出一波又一波电击般的剧痛，直到终于超出你的承受极限。你的四肢麻木，不再听使唤，只能目光昏花、毫无办法地看着这头巨兽滑开，并开始蓄积至今为止最强的一记冲击波。

    刹那间一切都变白了，随即又黑如深夜。
    
    你死了。

rows.original: The door appears to be locked.

One of the pillars on this platform has already collapsed... and this one doesn't look to be in much better condition after the eel's thrashing around. Thinking about it; this pillar does overlook the foyer and the damaged gate, perhaps you could knock it over and smash the way open? [pc.isCunning|That shouldn't be a problem; you can see a number of cracks, and if you wedge something into them you could probably aim the pillar just right. There's more than enough broken stone to wedge in, although it proves difficult while you're mostly weightless.|This is still going to take some serious muscle on your part, but it'll be easier than the door.] You swim up to the ceiling and pull out a dagger, digging a deep furrow for your hands so that you can get a little leverage to push back with. Once you dig your hands in, and set your feet with the top of the pillar, you grunt and shove for dear life. When the pillar finally cracks, the sound of splitting stone is practically deafening, and a cloud of dust and dirt is thrown up into waters that had only just managed to settle. [party.som|You cough and wheeze — again, still a tremendously awkward sensation when you're already breathing water — and spend a few moments regretting your decisions before you finally pull yourself together again.|[companion1.name] was quick enough to cover [companion1.hisHer] mouth, but you're still left to cough and wheeze once more; still an incredibly awkward sensation when it's with lungfuls of water.|Good for your companions; they have the time to cover their mouths and faces, but you're left hacking and wheezing a cloud of thick silty dirt. Your eyes would be watering if not for... well, you know, being underwater.] Once the dust has settled, you can see up ahead that your barrier to access has been broken open by fallen stone.

        |"I... can try and get this." Brienne runs her hands over the door, pausing to adjust her hair as it continues to float aimlessly in the water. "I don't really want us to put our backs out, though."
    ]

rows.original: When you gently knock on one of the drums, you're made aware of a soft humming... not from the drum itself, but from beyond the sturdy eastern door. Almost like a chorus. You look over the dots and dashes inscribed on the wall once more, trying to figure out what they mean; it's clearly music, but the beginning, end, and whether it's multiple songs, or simply one, proves hard to discern. [party.oneComp agni atugia quin |Although she's been uncharacteristically quiet in the water — apart from frustrated grumbles whenever an errant flap makes her drift away — Agni presses against you and makes herself known. "Music? This, this I can do." Your [silly |crispy chimkin |fiery friend ] sighs and takes position at the drums. "The previous room had some murals on them, and it looked like the effects of two different songs. Right?" Sure; you go back down the corridor and double-check. Three large figures with their hands up in the air, holding axes. One smaller figure, with axe in one hand, and a horn in the other, playing into a sunbeam. Three figures sleeping, with a fourth, smaller figure sneaking past. "And it's not three songs?" Agni shakes her head, pointing at the dots and dashes. "I thought so at first, but it really only makes sense as two songs. This one looks big and aggressive." She points out the first series of dots and dashes, indicating there are far more 'dots.' "Those are heavy hits. The other half looks softer, and I don't see where a third song would be." Perhaps the figure playing into a sunbeam means a reward? [pc.isBimbo |Yay! You love rewards! ] "So I guess there's a war-song, or a peace-song. And the war song will reward us somehow... but the peace song will let us sneak by something? Which do you prefer?" | Atugia steps up, running a hand across the dots and dashes on the wall. "I'm no bard, but I get the jist of all of this; the dots are heavy strikes, the dashes are soft ones. And that previous wall I'm pretty sure meant, uh... one second." The dullahan dash-swims down the corridor and back before recounting and double-checking with the song on the wall. Three large figures with their hands up in the air, holding axes. One smaller figure, with axe in one hand, and a horn in the other, playing into a sunbeam. Three figures sleeping, with a fourth, smaller figure sneaking past. "I actually think this is two songs; one aggressive one, and one peaceful one..." "But there are three big pictures?" You ask. Tui shrugs helplessly. "I think it's two distinct songs, perhaps the middle picture is a reward? Do the war song, go in, succeed, get... something? The other looks like we can just sneak by instead. Which should I play?" | Quin grins and rests a hand on your shoulder, leaning over to brush his fingers along the mural of dots and dashes. "If I know my music — and I do — then this is a scoresheet for the drums; dots are hard hits, dashes are soft ones." "That makes sense..." "Furthermore, we just went past a bunch of murals. Could you double-check what's on them while I'm figuring out this song?" Quin smiles apologetically, but his focus is soon stolen by the wall once more. You swim back down the corridor, running a hand along the mural. By the time you return, Quin seems confident. "It's two songs, I'm pretty sure. The first looks harsh and aggressive, the other looks calm and tappy. What was on the wall over there again?" Three large figures with their hands up in the air, holding axes. One smaller figure, with axe in one hand, and a horn in the other, playing into a sunbeam. Three figures sleeping, with a fourth, smaller figure sneaking past. You recount as clearly as you can, but this only leads the two of you to confusion. "You're sure it's just two songs? Because that's three big pictures.[pc.isBimbo | Even I can, like, totally see that. ]" "Yeah... maybe the middle image indicates a reward? If we get... whatever we face in there amped up, we get whatever a horn and a sunbeam means. That sounds reasonable, at least." Quin pauses to fluff up his tail, but the motion is wasted with silt drifting in the water. "Thoughts?" | [var0 |Well, you're no stranger to music yourself... and considering you've no companions who have that particular knack, the solution is all on you. |Unfortunately you aren't a musician, nor have you brought any companions with you who seem to have that particular knack. Instead you've just got to guess... ] When you slam one of the drums hard, the humming on the edge of your perception gets louder. When you hit it gently, the humming goes soft. [var1 |You think back to the murals; Three large figures with their hands up in the air, holding axes. One smaller figure, with axe in one hand, and a horn in the other, playing into a sunbeam. Three figures sleeping, with a fourth, smaller figure sneaking past. Perhaps trying to play along with the beats on the wall will get you different results? One hard, one soft... Although you're uncertain about what the middle mural means; a horn and a sunbeam? Presumably a bunch of armed figures means a full crowd. |Well... there's nothing for it. Perhaps you can just [var0 |freestyle something hard or soft? |wail on them randomly? ] ] ]
rows.translation: 当你轻轻敲响其中一面鼓时，你察觉到一阵轻柔的哼鸣……不是来自鼓本身，而是从那扇坚固的东门之外传来。几乎像是一段合唱。你再次端详墙上刻着的点和划，想弄清它们是什么意思；那显然是乐谱，但哪里是开头、哪里是结尾，以及它是多首曲子还是只有一首，都很难分辨。 [party.oneComp agni atugia quin |尽管她在水中一反常态地安静——只有哪次失误的摆动把她冲走时才会恼火地咕哝——阿格尼还是凑到你身边，让你注意到她。“音乐？这个，这个我在行。” 你那位[silly |脆皮鸡肉 |火热的伙伴 ]叹了口气，站到鼓前。“之前那个房间里有些壁画，看起来像是两首不同曲子的效果。对吧？” 当然，你回到走廊里再核对一遍。 三个高大的身影，双手高举，握着斧头。 一个较小的身影，一手持斧，一手持号角，对着阳光吹奏。 三个身影在沉睡，第四个较小的身影悄悄溜过。 “那就不是三首曲子？” 阿格尼摇了摇头，指着那些点和划。“我一开始也这么想，但它确实只讲得通是两首曲子。这一首看起来宏大而激烈。”她指出第一组点和划，说明其中“点”要多得多。“那些是重击。另一半看起来柔和一些，而且我看不出第三首曲子能放在哪里。” 也许那个对着阳光吹奏的身影意味着奖赏？ [pc.isBimbo |耶！你最喜欢奖赏了！ ] “所以我猜，要么是一首战歌，要么是一首和平之歌。战歌会以某种方式奖赏我们……而和平之歌会让我们能悄悄绕过什么东西？你更想要哪个？” | 阿图吉娅走上前来，一只手抚过墙上的点和划。“我不是什么吟游诗人，但我大致明白这些都是什么；点是重击，划是轻击。至于之前那面墙，我挺确定它指的是，呃……等一下。” 那个无头骑士迅速游过走廊又游回来，然后与墙上的曲子再次核对。 三个高大的身影，双手高举，握着斧头。 一个较小的身影，一手持斧，一手持号角，对着阳光吹奏。 三个身影在沉睡，第四个较小的身影悄悄溜过。 “我其实觉得这是两首曲子；一首激烈的，一首平和的……” “可那里有三幅大图啊？”你问。 图伊无奈地耸了耸肩。“我觉得是两首不同的曲子，也许中间那幅图是奖赏？打完战歌，进去，成功，得到……什么东西？另一幅看起来则是我们可以直接溜过去。我该弹哪一首？” | 昆因咧嘴一笑，一只手搭上你的肩膀，俯身用手指沿着那幅由点和划组成的壁画划过。“如果我对音乐还算了解——而我确实了解——那这就是一份给鼓用的乐谱；点是重击，划是轻击。” “有道理……” “另外，我们刚才路过了一堆壁画。我在琢磨这首曲子的时候，你能再去核对一下上面画的是什么吗？”昆因带着歉意笑了笑，但注意力很快又被那面墙夺了回去。 你游回走廊，一只手沿着壁画抚过。等你回来时，昆因似乎已经很有把握。“是两首曲子，我很确定。第一首听起来刺耳而激烈，另一首听起来平静而轻快。那边墙上又画了什么来着？” 三个高大的身影，双手高举，握着斧头。 一个较小的身影，一手持斧，一手持号角，对着阳光吹奏。 三个身影在沉睡，第四个较小的身影悄悄溜过。 你尽可能清楚地复述了一遍，但这只让你们俩都更糊涂了。“你确定只有两首曲子？那可是三幅大图。[pc.isBimbo | 就连我也完全看得出来啊。 ]” “是啊……也许中间那幅图表示某种奖赏？如果我们……在里面面对的东西被强化了，我们就能得到号和阳光所代表的东西。至少这听起来挺合理。”昆因停下来抖了抖尾巴，但这动作在水中白费力气，只有淤泥随之飘动。“你觉得呢？” | [var0 |嗯，你自己对音乐倒不算陌生……但考虑到你带的同伴里没人有这方面的天赋，解决办法就全落在你身上了。 |可惜你不是音乐家，也没带任何似乎有这方面天赋的同伴来。你只能靠猜了…… ] 当你重重敲响其中一面鼓时，你感知边缘的那阵哼鸣变得更响。当你轻轻敲它时，哼鸣就变弱。 [var1 |你回想起那些壁画； 三个高大的身影，双手高举，握着斧头。 一个较小的身影，一手持斧，一手持号角，对着阳光吹奏。 三个身影在沉睡，第四个较小的身影悄悄溜过。 也许照着墙上的节拍打，会得到不同的结果？一记重，一记轻……只是你不确定中间那幅壁画是什么意思；号角和阳光？一群武装的身影大概意味着人多。 |嗯……也没别的办法了。也许你只能 [var0 |随便即兴来一段重的或轻的？ |胡乱猛敲一通？ ] ] ]

rows.original:
[party.oneComp agnimitra atugia quintillus
            |Agni takes her place at the drums, allowing you to watch some powerful back muscles work as she swings against the water. She barely looks up at the musical score on the wall, pounding out a rhythm that begins to make your chest pound in time, gets your blood rushing in your veins, your pupils dilating, and... well, your mouth would be watering but you're underwater.
            |Atugia confidently takes a place at the drums, giving you a beautiful opportunity to watch her back muscles work as she fights the water itself. With her head locked firmly on the wall, scanning the musical score closely as she pounds you into a frenzy. Blood rushes in your veins, your pupils dilate, your heart hammers in time with the heavier beats... your mouth would be watering if you weren't underwater.
            |Quin takes to the drums with surprising adroitness, showing off some toned and tight back-and-shoulder muscles. He needs only a few cursory glances at the score on the wall, before he's pounding away a powerful rhythm that you can feel right down to your bones. He grins over his shoulders, looking just as pumped up as you feel; your heart is hammering into your throat, your blood is rushing in your veins, and your pupils are dilated.
            |You dig your heels in — as much as you can, at least — and begin to hammer away at the drums, doing your best to follow along to a pattern of aggressive strikes. It takes a few moments to find a rhythm, but once you've lost yourself in it your heart begins to pound, and your blood rushes.
        ]
        
        The ravaging beat fills the corridor, before it echoes off of the wall... and it's not the only sound. The doors behind you begin to vibrate, and a mighty, charged-up hum vibrates hard enough to rattle your teeth. A chorus of feet slamming hard into the stone as though there were no water, a chant, a cheer...
        
        It looks like the way is no longer shut, and you are expected.
rows.translation:
[party.oneComp agnimitra atugia quintillus
            |阿格尼站到鼓前，让你得以看着她强有力的背部肌肉在挥臂击水时如何发力。她几乎不抬头看墙上的乐谱，只是敲出一段节奏，让你胸口也随之怦怦直跳，血液在血管里奔涌，瞳孔放大……嗯，你的嘴本来该流口水的，只可惜你在水下。
            |阿图吉娅自信地站到鼓前，让你有机会好好欣赏她与水搏斗时背部肌肉的运动。她把头稳稳对着墙面，一边细细扫视乐谱，一边敲得你热血沸腾。血液在你血管里奔涌，瞳孔放大，心脏随着那些更重的节拍一起擂动……要不是在水下，你的嘴早就流口水了。
            |昆因出人意料地灵巧地击起鼓来，展现出一身紧实有型的背肌与肩肌。他只匆匆扫了几眼墙上的乐谱，就敲出了一段强劲的节奏，让你从骨头里都能感受到。他扭过头来冲你咧嘴一笑，看上去和你一样亢奋；你的心脏擂到了嗓子眼，血液在血管里奔涌，瞳孔也放大了。
            |你尽力稳住身形——能稳到什么程度就稳到什么程度——开始用力敲鼓，尽力跟上那种充满攻击性的敲击节奏。花了一会儿才找到节奏，但一旦沉浸其中，你的心就开始狂跳，血液也随之奔涌。
        ]
        
        那狂暴的节拍填满了走廊，随后又从墙上回荡开来……而且那并不是唯一的声音。你身后的门开始震动，一阵强劲而充满能量的嗡鸣震得你牙齿发颤。一阵阵脚步声重重砸在石头上，仿佛那里根本没有水；还有吟唱声、欢呼声……
        
        看来这条路已经不再封闭了，而你正被期待着。

rows.original: [party.oneComp agnimitra atugia quintillus |Agni confidently takes her place at the drums, giving them a few gentle test strikes before beating out a gentle, steady rhythm. By the time you've had a chance to truly listen you're feeling incredibly relaxed; your heartbeat slows, your extremities tingle pleasantly, and you could probably curl up for a nap if not for the pending potential danger. |Atugia smiles and takes her place at the drums, before beating a slow and gentle rhythm. By the time you've had a chance to truly listen you're feeling incredibly relaxed; your heartbeat slows, your extremities tingle pleasantly, and you could probably curl up for a nap if not for the pending potential danger. |Quin grins and taps out a couple of test strikes, before finding his pace and beating out a gentle, soothing rhythm. By the time you've had a chance to truly listen you're feeling incredibly relaxed; your heartbeat slows, your extremities tingle pleasantly, and you could probably curl up for a nap if not for the pending potential danger. |You give the drums a few taps, trying to figure out how hard to strike before you surrender to soft tippy-tappying. You needn't have worried; once you've started, your hands move as though they've always known the beat. Soothing waves roll through you, almost earning a yawn before you've finished. Your heartbeat slows, your limbs go weary, and your body sings along with the soothing, gentle rhythm... you could almost curl up for a nap if not for the pending danger. ] The comforting beat fills the corridor, bouncing back off of the wall... otherwise there's nothing but an aching stillness. And then the door clicks, audibly. It looks like the way is no longer shut.
rows.translation: [party.oneComp agnimitra atugia quintillus |阿格尼自信地走到鼓前，先轻轻试敲了几下，然后敲出一段轻柔而平稳的节奏。等你有机会真正聆听时，你感到无比放松；心跳放慢，四肢泛起愉悦的酥麻，要不是还有潜在的危险，你大概能蜷起来睡上一觉。 |阿图吉娅微笑着走到鼓前，敲出一段缓慢而轻柔的节奏。等你有机会真正聆听时，你感到无比放松；心跳放慢，四肢泛起愉悦的酥麻，要不是还有潜在的危险，你大概能蜷起来睡上一觉。 |昆因咧嘴一笑，先试敲了两下，然后找到自己的节拍，敲出一段轻柔舒缓的节奏。等你有机会真正聆听时，你感到无比放松；心跳放慢，四肢泛起愉悦的酥麻，要不是还有潜在的危险，你大概能蜷起来睡上一觉。 |你轻轻敲了几下鼓，想弄清该用多大力气，最后还是任由自己变成轻手轻脚的敲打。你本不必担心；一旦开始，你的双手就像天生熟悉这段节拍一样动了起来。舒缓的波浪涌过你全身，几乎让你在敲完之前就打了个哈欠。你的心跳放慢，四肢发软，整个身体都随着那舒缓轻柔的节奏一起歌唱……要不是还有潜在的危险，你几乎能蜷起来睡上一觉。 ] 那令人安心的节拍填满走廊，又从墙上弹回来……除此之外，只有一片令人难受的死寂。 然后，门发出了一声清晰可闻的咔嗒声。 看来这条路已经不再封闭了。

rows.original: [flags.CHALLENGE_TEMPLE_DRUMS 1 2 3 |When you push on the door, it practically swings open; the source of the stamping, humming, and cheering becomes incredibly apparent, as several-dozen eyes turn to face you. Muscular women and powerful, bearded men clang axes ands words against shields, completely unperturbed by the water's current and moving as though above-ground. Their translucent figures tell you clearly that these are specters, and their eyes bore into you with a war-fervor burning away. Your own heart sings their song too, for confrontation, conquest, and victory... although that isn't to say there isn't a small — just a tiny — tremor in that heart when you see your true foe — [silly |the sheer SIZE of that fucking lad. |a huge man. ] He wears armor of weighty dragon scales laid out across one another, of such a mass that it appears solid... it might actually be solid, actually; magical, compared to the rest of this clearly epic-sized jotun. In fact, all of the jotun is epic; with a massive hammer in one hand, a horn in the other... and no pants. A massive, girthy prick sways free in the open water, just as ready to conquer and crush, by the looks of it. As [party.yall] cross the threshold, the force of giants surge towards you. It's a fight. |When you push open the door, it practically swings open... and you are confronted by the sound of snoring. What would be a horde of angry Jotun is a puddle of sleeping souls, resting against the walls and in mid-air as though on hammocks that have long since rotted away. The room you're in is clearly some kind of chapel, with stone pews worn smooth by undersea currents. What murals may once have covered the walls have similarly worn away to nothing, but it is to the pulpit at the room's terminus that your eyes are drawn. Your heart leaps into your throat, and a chill runs down your spine [silly |at the sheer SIZE of that fucking lad |at the sight of a huge man ]. He wears armor of weighty dragon scales laid out across one another, of such a mass that it appears solid... it might actually be solid, actually; magical, compared to the rest of this clearly epic-sized jotun. In fact, all of the jotun is epic; with a massive hammer in one hand, a horn in the other... and no pants. A massive, girthy prick sways free in the open water, certainly a most sturdy morning wood indeed... and just as at-attention as he is, in a ready-stance for battle. |When you push open the door, you're not sure what you expected... Your heart leaps into your throat, and a chill runs down your spine [silly |at the sheer SIZE of that fucking lad |at the sight of a huge man ]. He wears armor of weighty dragon scales laid out across one another, of such a mass that it appears solid... it might actually be solid, actually; magical, compared to the rest of this clearly epic-sized jotun. In fact, all of the jotun is epic; with a massive hammer in one hand, a horn in the other... and no pants. A hefty, girthy prick sways free in the open water, soft... but not for long judging by the way he readies his stance. He looks... annoyed? Really annoyed. |When you try and haul the weighty doors open, you find some amount of resistance. A hum of expectation builds on the other side, and the sense of otherworldly wrongness assaults you for a moment. On a secondary inspection there's no actual lock, but there's certainly a latch... forcing the door open shouldn't even be that difficult, but you can barely get a budge when you jam your shoulder into it. ]
rows.translation: [flags.CHALLENGE_TEMPLE_DRUMS 1 2 3 |你推门的时候，它几乎是自己荡开的；那些跺脚声、哼唱声和欢呼声的来源变得极其明显，几十双眼睛一齐转向你。肌肉发达的女人和强壮的络腮胡男人用斧头和言语敲击着盾牌，完全不受水流影响，行动起来就像在陆地上一样。 他们半透明的身影清楚地告诉你，这些都是幽灵，而他们眼中的战意熊熊燃烧，直直刺进你心里。 你自己的心也在唱他们的歌，为对抗、征服与胜利而歌唱……不过，当你看到真正的敌人时，那颗心还是有一丝——只是一丝——颤抖—— [silly |那家伙真他妈的大。 |一个巨大的男人。 ] 他穿着层层叠叠的厚重龙鳞铠甲，鳞片堆叠的分量让铠甲看起来像是实心的……说不定它真的是实心的；和这具显然是史诗级体型的约顿巨人相比，它甚至算得上“魔法造物”。 事实上，这整具约顿巨人都堪称史诗级；一只手握着巨锤，另一只手拿着号角……而且没穿裤子。一根粗壮硕大的肉棒在开阔的水中自由摆荡，看样子随时准备征服与碾碎一切。当[party.yall]跨过门槛，巨人的力量便朝你们涌来。 这是一场战斗。 |你推开门时，它几乎是自己荡开的……迎面而来的却是一阵鼾声。本该是一群愤怒约顿巨人的地方，如今成了一滩沉睡的灵魂，有的靠着墙壁，有的悬在半空，仿佛躺在早已腐烂的吊床上。你所在的房间显然是一座礼拜堂，石制长椅被海底水流磨得光滑。墙上或许曾有壁画，如今也同样被侵蚀得荡然无存，但吸引你目光的是房间尽头那座讲坛。 你的心一下子提到了嗓子眼，一股寒意顺着脊背窜下 [silly |因为那家伙真他妈的大 |因为映入眼帘的是一个巨大的男人 ]。他穿着层层叠叠的厚重龙鳞铠甲，鳞片堆叠的分量让铠甲看起来像是实心的……说不定它真的是实心的；和这具显然是史诗级体型的约顿巨人相比，它甚至算得上“魔法造物”。 事实上，这整具约顿巨人都堪称史诗级；一只手握着巨锤，另一只手拿着号角……而且没穿裤子。一根粗壮硕大的肉棒在开阔的水中自由摆荡，确实是一根再硬挺不过的晨勃……而他本人也同样精神抖擞，摆着随时开战的架势。 |你推开门时，也不太确定自己原本期待看到什么…… 你的心一下子提到了嗓子眼，一股寒意顺着脊背窜下 [silly |因为那家伙真他妈的大 |因为映入眼帘的是一个巨大的男人 ]。他穿着层层叠叠的厚重龙鳞铠甲，鳞片堆叠的分量让铠甲看起来像是实心的……说不定它真的是实心的；和这具显然是史诗级体型的约顿巨人相比，它甚至算得上“魔法造物”。 事实上，这整具约顿巨人都堪称史诗级；一只手握着巨锤，另一只手拿着号角……而且没穿裤子。一根粗壮硕大的肉棒在开阔的水中自由摆荡，软着……但看他摆出的架势，这状态应该维持不了多久。他看起来……恼火？非常恼火。 |当你试着把沉重的门拽开时，你感到了一些阻力。门的另一边，一种期待的嗡鸣声渐渐积聚，而那种异界的错位感有一瞬间冲击着你。再次检查后你发现其实并没有锁，但确实有一个门闩……硬把门推开本不该有多难，可当你用肩膀撞上去时，门几乎纹丝不动。 ]

rows.original: [var0 |The sound in the room dies out, but for one, titanic... orgasm. There's no roar, or groan, but there is an unearthly splash. You struggle to wrap your head around that fact; you're underwater right now, if anything he should be shooting floaty-ropes... and you certainly shouldn't be able to hear cum-splatters. This giant clearly exists in a different time, and you suspect he was left with some unfinished business. He collapses to his knees soundlessly, becoming ever-more ethereal. His hammer crumbles away into motes of faint light that slowly scatter, and the glow illuminating his armor phases out with it. When his armor crumples into a heap, the majority of it falls without a sound... but for the chest-piece, which lands with a deafening, echoey crunch that cracks the floor. Eugh, the 'pool' of spunk actually starts flowing across the floor, like a sentient goo. When you swim over to lift the armor, it slowly shrinks itself down to your size[pc.hasBreasts | — even morphing a moment later to accommodate your [pc.breasts] — ] but the density is awe-inspiring even with the water's buoyancy. [var1 |The silence is even more poignant with all of the giant skald's comrades-in-arms having ceased their heart-pounding song. Only one Jotun remains, a 'slender' woman, if such a towering figure could be regarded as such. You must have missed her in the melee, because she's nowhere near as armored, and you're pretty certain you would notice the naked giant woman covered in war-paint. She strides past [party.yall] with a satisfied smile, kicking at a pile of eldritch dust she dredges up the jotun's horn... you'd thought it disintegrated with the rest of his gear, but there it is. Wordlessly the woman stands at the pulpit, placing the horn to her lips and giving it a sharp [silly |doot |blast ]. Maybe you flinched, or blinked, but suddenly the jotun disappears, and in her place is a being of... something shapeless exists in the water. The figure struggles to pull itself together, but you can detect some kind of cat-girl or boy. It takes you a few moments to realize it in earnest; this is a water elemental, and you're underwater. The elemental shrugs helplessly — or you think shrugs, at least — before discorporating. It looks like you can use this horn to summon, or at least learn to summon them. Something to figure out later, you suppose. ] |All at once the sound in the room stops; your foe becomes ever-more ethereal, dropping to his knees. rows.original:
It doesn't take much actual time to produce a volatile combination. The eel's glow-sac is ruptured, a chunk of what looks like metal and salt is pushed into it, a dash of something mercurial that makes the water taste of danger, and then the cauldron is sealed tight. There's a little tap in the top, and when you give it a squeeze there's an abrupt shift in pressure. The contents audibly hiss and steam, and the electrum cauldron grows incredibly hot.
        
        It clanks loudly on contact with the ground, screech-whistling as pressure bleeds from the electrum-cauldron's tap. That probably isn't meant to happen.
        
        You wheel back and give the cauldron on the floor a kick down the hallway before it can explode in your face[party.hasCompanions
            |s
        ], and it barely travels a foot before a bronze bolt hits it and it ruptures. A steaming cloud of hot, glowing goo sprays down the corridor, setting off a couple of bolts before the swirling eddies spread a cloud of motes down the hallway.
        
        Perfect; as the mixture cools, droplets of brightly-glowing goo that are denser than the water begin to cling to what had previously been invisible lines. Some of the cloud has blown back and clung to you as well, but now the corridor is fully lit... and there's just barely a passage large enough for even the biggest siorc warrior to swim through.
rows.translation:
实际上，制作出这种具有危险性的混合物并不需要花费太多时间。只需将鳗鱼的发光囊弄破，然后放入一块看起来像金属和盐的混合物，再加入少量某种会让水散发出危险气味的物质，最后将锅盖严实地盖上即可。顶部有一个小阀门，当你挤压它时，压力会突然发生变化。容器内的物质会发出嘶嘶声并释放蒸汽，同时那个由电银制成的大锅也会变得异常炽热。
        
        当它接触到地面时，会发出巨大的撞击声，同时由于压力从阀门中释放出来，还会伴随着尖锐的啸叫声。这种情况本来就不应该发生。
        
        你猛地转身，趁那口锅还没在你脸上炸开，一脚把它踢向走廊深处[party.hasCompanions
            |s
        ]它才滑出不到一英尺，就被一支青铜弩矢击中，瞬间爆裂。一股炽热、发光的黏稠蒸汽顺着走廊喷涌而下，又触发了几支弩矢。随后，这些旋转的黏稠物在走廊中扩散开来，形成了一片颗粒云。
        
        完美；随着混合物冷却，那些比水更稠、发着明亮光芒的黏液滴开始附着在原本看不见的线条上。有些雾气也被卷了回来，同样粘在你身上，但现在整条走廊都被照亮了……而且刚好留出了一条足够宽大的通道，连最魁梧的希奥克战士都能游过去。

rows.original: [var0 |[party.Yall] very cautiously swim down the corridor, drifting over and under the glowing lines left behind from your little playtime with alchemy. The only downside is that the water you're 'breathing' tastes horrible, but considering how you had to make do with some chunky piece of eel? At least it works at all. By the time you reach the other side, you'd be sweating nervously if not for the fact that you're swimming. Still, it's a pointed relief when your hands rest on the handles to what might be your last destination. Here's hoping you didn't need to go back for anything. |You take a few moments to psych yourself up, trying to figure out the best way to cross quickly and safely... There is no good answer, unfortunately, and so you settle for staying low, setting your [pc.feet] against a crack in the flagstones, and springing forward with as much tension as you can pack into your [pc.thighs]. Bolts don't so much whistle past you as they do swish, and unfortunately for you, you hit far more invisible trigger-strings than you would have hoped. You're unable to rely on twitch reflexes, and the bolts bite deeply... There's nothing for it but to tuck your arm up against the side of your head and neck, and swim for dear life. By the time you've reached the other side and slammed your back up against the doorway, the left side of your body looks to have been given a porcupine covering of bronze bolts. How in the gods' names do jotuns or siorcs make things like this? [party.som |You slump down and begin to slowly pluck bolts from your side, wincing at the puncture wounds left behind. You might not survive a return journey; here's hoping you didn't have to go back for anything. |[companion1.name] was quick to follow on your tail, but even then [companion1.heShe] caught a couple of darts for good measure. "That was..." Words fail [companion1.himHer], and instead [companion1.heShe] settles for plucking the bolts from your side and making sure you aren't going to turn the sea red. |Your companions were quick to follow on your tail, but even that doesn't spare them a few darts of their own; once they catch up to you they're both wincing and plucking barbs free. "I... don't think you should try that again," [companion2.name] murmurs, helping to plug your holes before you end up bleeding out into the sea. ] ] Once you've caught your breath, you place an ear to the door and listen. There's an eerie quiet but for one noise; panting? Heavy breathing, perhaps. Nothing for it but to find out, now.
rows.translation: [var0 |[party.Yall] 你非常谨慎地沿着走廊游下去，穿梭于那些因你的炼金实验而留下的发光痕迹之上之下。唯一的缺点是你“呼吸”的水尝起来糟糕透顶，不过考虑到你只能靠那块粗粗的鳗鱼凑合？至少它还能用。 当你游到对岸时，如果不是因为正在游泳，你肯定已经紧张得满身是汗了。不过，当你的双手终于握住那个可能就是你最终目的地的把手时，那种感觉还是让人感到如释重负。希望你不需要再回去取什么东西吧。 |你花了几秒钟时间调整自己的心态，试图找出最快且最安全的穿越方法……可惜，并没有什么完美的答案，于是你压低身体，用[pc.feet]蹬住石板间的裂缝，向前猛蹿，使出[pc.thighs]所能迸发的全部力量。弩箭掠过时并非尖啸，而是发出嗖嗖的破水声。不幸的是，你触发了远远多于预期数量的那些“隐形触发装置”。你无法依靠快速的反应来躲避，那些箭矢深深地刺入了你的身体……此刻，你只能把手臂紧贴在头部和脖子的旁边，拼命地游动以求生存。 当你终于到达另一边，将后背抵在门框上时，你会发现自己的身体左侧仿佛被覆盖上了一层由青铜螺栓构成的“刺猬皮”。这些约顿巨人和希奥克究竟是怎么造出这种东西的？真是让人费解 [party.som |你瘫倒在地，开始慢慢地拔掉自己身体两侧的螺栓，同时因为那些留下的刺伤而痛苦地皱起眉头。你可能无法在返回的路上活下来；希望你并没有因为什么事情而必须回去。 |[companion1.name]紧随你身后，但即便如此，[companion1.heShe]还是额外中了两支弩矢。“那真是……”[companion1.himHer]一时语塞，反倒[companion1.heShe]动手拔掉你身侧的弩矢，确保你不会把大海染红。 |你的同伴迅速跟了上来，但他们自己也中了几支箭；当他们追上你时，两人都在皱着眉头拔掉箭上的倒钩。“我……觉得你不该再那么做了，”[companion2.name]低声说道，一边帮你堵住伤口，免得你流血过多死在海里。 ] ] 等你缓过气来，就把耳朵贴在门上仔细听。四周一片诡异的寂静，只有唯一的声音——是喘息声吗？或许是急促的呼吸声。现在，唯一的办法就是弄清楚真相。

rows.original: As the door swings open you're hid with a wave of abject terror; six fierce, hateful yellow eyes staring back at you through the water, looking down from a storey of height. The outline of three sets of menacing, sharp teeth glint in the murk, and the heaving of powerful gills carries with it the scent of death... [party.som |You grit your own teeth and ready yourself for a fight to the death. |[companion1.name] looks to you, before readying [companion1.himHer]self for a fight to the death. |Your companions both share a look before readying themselves for a fight to the death, tightening grips and setting stances in the water. ] ...And then you step forwards, triggering some alchemical light that floods the antechamber. Well, it's not... a case for fierceness anymore. Fully illuminated, you can in fact see that the beast before you is the terrifying, ship-consuming, destruction-bringing hydra...
rows.translation: 当门猛地被推开时，一股彻骨的恐惧扑面而来——六只凶狠、充满恨意的黄色眼睛从水面下凝视着你，仿佛来自数层之高的地方。三排狰狞的尖牙在昏暗的光线中闪闪发光，而那些强有力的鳃部不断摆动，散发着死亡的气息…… [party.som |你咬紧牙关，准备进行一场生死搏斗。 |[companion1.name]看了你一眼，随后[companion1.himHer]自做好了决一死战的准备。 |你的两位同伴对视了一眼，随后便做好了决一死战的准备，他们紧握武器，在水中摆好了战斗姿势。 ] 然后你向前迈出一步，触发了某种魔法般的光芒，使得前厅被照得通亮。 嗯，现在已经没有必要再采取激烈的行动了。在光线充足的环境下，你终于能看清眼前的怪物正是那头令人恐惧、吞噬船只、带来毁灭的九头蛇……

...But for the fact that his scales are a bright, cheerful pink, his eyes are bright and blue, and there's a collar around each individual neck with a heart-shaped tag of silver. From here you can't make out it's — their? — names, but the deep, dangerous breathing you'd been hearing is actually just the cheerful panting of a puppy who finally has somebody to play with. This isn't exactly the deadly final battle you'd been expecting, but those teeth are probably still more than powerful enough to bisect you.
            
            You might still be in terrible danger.
rows.translation:
……不过，它的鳞片呈现出鲜艳的粉色，眼睛则是明亮的蓝色，每条脖子上都戴着一条带有银色心形标签的项圈。只是从这里你分辨不出上面刻的名字——是它？还是它们的？不过，你之前听到的那种深沉而危险的呼吸声，其实只是一只终于找到玩伴的小狗在欢快地喘气。这显然不是你原本期待的那种致命的最终决战，但那些牙齿的力量，恐怕仍然足以把你咬成两半。
            
            你仍然可能处于极其危险的境地之中。

rows.original: You rear back, muster all of your strength... And bop the hydra gently on each nose. "Bad puppy." The three heads whimper, and the mighty, fearsome hydra hides them beneath its giant webbed paws, tail going still. "Awooooo..." [party.comp cait |Cait clings to your arms, eyes huge. "Help, I love [silly |he |him ]." ]While you're still making sure there are no further bleeding holes in your body, a massive door at the other end of the foyer cracks open and floods the room with light. The hydra whirls around and barks, loudly enough to make your head ring. It's actually Imora's sing-song voice that calls out, heavy with concern regardless. "Oh noooo chomps! Please tell me you didn't eat the nice [pc.mf |man |lady ]?" "[pc.mf |He's |She's ] fine and right here," you call out. "No need to worry..." Imora lets out a sigh of relief, waiting at the doorway and petting the giant hydra. "Good, good. Congratulations. Now come on out here so that we can do things properly, yes?"
rows.translation: 你向后退了几步，集中全部力量…… 然后轻轻敲了敲那九头蛇的每个鼻子。“坏小狗。” 三个头颅发出呜咽声，那只强大而可怕的九头蛇用它那巨大的带蹼爪子将它们遮盖起来，尾巴也静止不动了。“嗷呜呜呜……” [party.comp cait |凯特紧紧抓住你的手臂，眼睛里充满了惊恐与无助：“救救我，我爱 [silly |他 |他 ]。” ]就在你还在检查自己身上是否还有其他伤口的时候，大厅另一头的一扇巨大的门突然打开了，光芒洒满了整个房间。那个九头蛇立刻转过身来吠叫那声音大得足以让你的耳朵嗡嗡作响。实际上，是伊莫拉那带着关切的、拖长音调的声音在呼唤着：“哦不，小咬咬！请告诉我你没有吃掉那位好心的 [pc.mf |男人 |女士 ]？” “[pc.mf |他 |她 ]没事，就在这儿，”你喊道，“不用操心……” 伊莫拉松了一口气，站在门口，轻轻抚摸着那只巨大的九头蛇。“太好了，恭喜你。现在出来吧，我们得好好把事情办妥，好吗？”
