rows.original: Imora swims with you on the way into the center of a beautiful underwater village; buildings of smooth, regularly-scrubbed marble make up the majority of the space, with long strands of seaweed covered in glowing berries of various blue, red, and golden tones like streetlights. Some other houses look to be covered in a large amount of cold-friendly, colorful coral, with stone dishes of artfully-arranged water-plants much akin to a glorious hanging garden. You're far from the only foreigner down here, by the looks of things, but you're still attracting a large crowd of onlookers as you make your way into the village center. It's a staggering crowd of siorcs of all shapes, sizes, colors, and sexes, with a dense smattering of curious boreal elves — one of them even appears to be a winged, if very pregnant, valkyrie — orcs, wyld elves, and a couple of literal giants. Two of the siorcs in the crowd swim over, excitedly, and begin to babble and hum in the siorc's musical language with Imora, inflecting with hand-gestures until they seem satisfied. One of them gives you a bright, toothy smile. "Welcome [pc.mf |brother |sister ]! My deepest thanks for your great work, we can begin restorations on the temple now." He pauses, trailing off, before looking you up and down. "Well, we will begin after you meet High Shaman Seastone; how can we miss the show?" The show? Of course, horny sharks... The star-smattered shaman tugs you along before the rest of the crowd can take this opportunity to crash into you both for conversation, guiding you along floors you've just noticed are expertly paved. For some reason that stands out as one of the strangest features, considering people can swim everywhere. A lot of the siorcs, and nearly all of the other races present are walking around, actually. Those swimming instead manage to look like they're in a hurry, and when you ask Imora she hums musically and shrugs. "I never gave it much thought, but it's common sense more than anything. We don't move as one like a school of fish, so if we were to swim everywhere we'd likely bump into each other. We're breathing water, so it's not as though we're any lighter than the water, either. As long as you're not holding your breath, you'll get used to the weight." The siorc's explanation keeps you distracted as you walk, but eventually the scenery changes. The rising seaweed 'lanterns' form more of a natural wall here, as though making up a clearing in the midst of a forest that drifts with the ebb and flow of the water. Imora smiles at gestures you through, following behind as you take the lead.
rows.translation: 伊莫拉与你一同游向那座美丽的水下村庄的中心。那里的建筑物大多由光滑的大理石建造，表面定期被清理得一尘不染；长长的海藻上挂满了各种蓝色、红色和金色的发光果实，这些果实就像路边的路灯一样，为整个场景增添了独特的色彩。 其他一些房屋似乎也被覆盖着大量耐寒的、色彩斑斓的珊瑚，而那些用石头制成的盆栽中，精心摆放的水生植物让人联想到一幅美丽的悬挂花园。从周围的情况来看，你在这里绝不是唯一的外国人，但当你走向村庄的中心时，仍然吸引了许多围观者。那里聚集着形形色色、大小不一、肤色各异、性别不同的希奥克人，其中还混杂着不少好奇的北境精灵——其中甚至有一个看起来像是翅膀已经长出，但显然已经怀孕的瓦尔基里……还有兽人、野精灵，以及几个真正的巨人。 人群中的两个希奥克兴奋地游了过来，开始用希奥克特有的语言与伊莫拉叽叽喳喳地交谈着，同时还配合着手势表达自己的意思，直到他们似乎满意为止。其中一个还向你露出了灿烂而露齿的笑容。“欢迎来到 [pc.mf |兄弟 |姐妹 ]！对于你们的辛勤工作，我衷心表示感谢，我们现在就可以开始修复这座神殿了。”他停顿了一下，然后上下打量了你一番，继续说道：“嗯，等你们见过高阶萨满海石之后就可以动工了——这种好戏，我们怎么可能错过呢？” 好戏？当然，这些色欲熏心的鲨鱼…… 那位满身星斑的萨满牵着你往前走，免得其余人群趁机涌上来和你们搭话，并领你走过那些你刚刚才注意到、铺设得极为精巧的地面。 出于某种原因，这一设定显得格外奇怪，尤其是考虑到人们可以在任何地方游泳的情况下。实际上，很多希奥克人，以及这里几乎所有其他种族的成员，都选择步行。那些选择游泳的人倒像是在赶时间。当你问伊莫拉时，她只会哼着曲子，然后耸耸肩。 “我从来没有仔细思考过这个问题，但归根结底，这其实就是常识罢了。我们并不会像鱼群那样整齐地游动，所以如果到处游来游去的话，很可能会互相碰撞。而且我们呼吸的是水，因此我们的体重并不会比水轻。只要你不屏住呼吸，就会逐渐适应这种重量的感觉。” 在行走的过程中，这只希奥克的解释让你暂时分心了，但很快，景色发生了变化。在这里，随着海水的涨落，那些漂浮的海藻仿佛形成了天然的屏障，将一片区域围成了一个仿佛隐藏在森林中的空地。伊莫拉微笑着，跟随在你身后，当你带头前进时，她也会跟着你走。
rows.raw: " Imora swims with you on the way into the center of a beautiful underwater village; buildings of smooth, regularly-scrubbed marble make up the majority of the space, with long strands of seaweed covered in glowing berries of various blue, red, and golden tones like streetlights. Some other houses look to be covered in a large amount of cold-friendly, colorful coral, with stone dishes of artfully-arranged water-plants much akin to a glorious hanging garden. You're far from the only foreigner down here, by the looks of things, but you're still attracting a large crowd of onlookers as you make your way into the village center. It's a staggering crowd of siorcs of all shapes, sizes, colors, and sexes, with a dense smattering of curious boreal elves — one of them even appears to be a winged, if very pregnant, valkyrie — orcs, wyld elves, and a couple of literal giants. Two of the siorcs in the crowd swim over, excitedly, and begin to babble and hum in the siorc's musical language with Imora, inflecting with hand-gestures until they seem satisfied. One of them gives you a bright, toothy smile. "Welcome [pc.mf |brother |sister ]! My deepest thanks for your great work, we can begin restorations on the temple now." He pauses, trailing off, before looking you up and down. "Well, we will begin after you meet High Shaman Seastone; how can we miss the show?" The show? Of course, horny sharks... The star-smattered shaman tugs you along before the rest of the crowd can take this opportunity to crash into you both for conversation, guiding you along floors you've just noticed are expertly paved. For some reason that stands out as one of the strangest features, considering people can swim everywhere. A lot of the siorcs, and nearly all of the other races present are walking around, actually. Those swimming instead manage to look like they're in a hurry, and when you ask Imora she hums musically and shrugs. "I never gave it much thought, but it's common sense more than anything. We don't move as one like a school of fish, so if we were to swim everywhere we'd likely bump into each other. We're breathing water, so it's not as though we're any lighter than the water, either. As long as you're not holding your breath, you'll get used to the weight." The siorc's explanation keeps you distracted as you walk, but eventually the scenery changes. The rising seaweed 'lanterns' form more of a natural wall here, as though making up a clearing in the midst of a forest that drifts with the ebb and flow of the water. Imora smiles at gestures you through, following behind as you take the lead. "

rows.original: Go and speak the garden's corrupted caretaker.
rows.translation: 去和那个被腐蚀的花园看守人谈谈吧。
rows.raw: "Go and speak the garden's corrupted caretaker."

rows.original: You decide that it's time to rest your weary head, and there's no better place in the forest than here in the secluded garden. It's as safe as anywhere, and the pleasant scene of sweet honey [flags.ALRAUNE_KILLED|largely overpowers the lingering musk of the Alraune's former occupancy|mixed with the Alraune's unsubtle pheromones is enough to leave your mind foggy as it is]. You lay your weapon and kit aside and [flags.ALRAUNE_KILLED|find the most comfortable patch of soft grass in the garden to curl up on, letting yourself drift off in short order... |stride over to your submissive flower, telling her that you've got a job for those big, fragrant breasts of hers. The matronly alraune smiles wide and opens her arms, letting you settle yourself into her sinfully succulent chest as petals and tentacles wrap around you. "Sleep tight," she murmurs in your ear as you drift off, content to do just that...]
rows.translation: 你决定是时候让疲惫的头脑得到休息了，而在森林里，没有比这个幽静的花园更合适的地方了。这里和任何地方一样安全，而且周围甜美的花香营造出了令人愉悦的氛围 [flags.ALRAUNE_KILLED|其甜美的气息几乎完全压过了阿尔劳妮先前居住留下的麝香。|再加上阿尔劳妮毫不掩饰的信息素，足以让你的头脑变得昏沉。] 你把武器和装备放在一旁，然后 [flags.ALRAUNE_KILLED|在花园里找到那一片最柔软、最舒适的草地，蜷缩在那里，不久之后，你就会渐渐进入梦乡…… |走到你那温顺的花朵身边，告诉她你正好有份差事要交给她那对丰满芬芳的乳房。这位充满母性的阿尔劳妮露出灿烂的笑容，张开双臂，让你窝进她那罪恶般丰腴的胸膛，花瓣与触手随之将你裹住。 “好好睡吧，”当你渐渐沉入梦乡时，她会在你耳边低语，而你也很乐意就这样睡去……]
rows.raw: " You decide that it's time to rest your weary head, and there's no better place in the forest than here in the secluded garden. It's as safe as anywhere, and the pleasant scene of sweet honey [flags.ALRAUNE_KILLED|largely overpowers the lingering musk of the Alraune's former occupancy|mixed with the Alraune's unsubtle pheromones is enough to leave your mind foggy as it is]. You lay your weapon and kit aside and [flags.ALRAUNE_KILLED|find the most comfortable patch of soft grass in the garden to curl up on, letting yourself drift off in short order... |stride over to your submissive flower, telling her that you've got a job for those big, fragrant breasts of hers. The matronly alraune smiles wide and opens her arms, letting you settle yourself into her sinfully succulent chest as petals and tentacles wrap around you. "Sleep tight," she murmurs in your ear as you drift off, content to do just that...]"

rows.original: Rest your head on the leafbeds in the Alraune's garden in the shade.
rows.translation: 在阿尔劳妮花园的树荫下，把头靠在那些由树叶铺成的床上休息吧。
rows.raw: "Rest your head on the leafbeds in the Alraune's garden in the shade."

rows.original: Exit the Wayfort and enter the Frostwood.
rows.raw: "Exit the Wayfort and enter the Frostwood."

rows.original:
The north-eastern corner of the keep might have been a treasury, or perhaps an armory. The doors are heavy here, but the interior of the vault chamber is empty. There's not even an empty chest or armor rack. Shame.

        Outside the vault, there are doors south and west that lead deeper into the fortress.
rows.translation:
堡垒的东北角可能曾经是储藏财宝的地方，或者是一个军械库。这里的门非常厚重，但地窖内部却空无一物——甚至连一个空箱子或盔甲架都没有。真是可惜。

        在地窖的外面，南面和西面都有门，可以通往堡垒的更深处。
rows.raw:
"
        The north-eastern corner of the keep might have been a treasury, or perhaps an armory. The doors are heavy here, but the interior of the vault chamber is empty. There's not even an empty chest or armor rack. Shame.

        Outside the vault, there are doors south and west that lead deeper into the fortress."

rows.original:
The north-eastern corner of the keep might have been a treasury, or perhaps an armory. The doors are heavy here, but the interior of the vault chamber is almost empty. Only a single chest remains nestled into a corner, though the lock's been busted open and its contents plundered.

        Still a nice chest though... 

        Outside the vault, there are doors south and west that lead deeper into the fortress.

这座堡垒的东北角可能曾经是储藏财宝的地方，或者也是一个军械库。这里的门非常厚重，但地窖内部几乎空无一人，只有一个箱子孤零零地放在角落里——不过锁已经被撬开了，里面的东西也被洗劫一空。

        不过，这个箱子本身还是挺不错的……

        地窖的外面，南面和西面都有门，可以通往堡垒的更深处。

rows.original: Hey, free chest! You could use that back home.
rows.translation: 嘿，免费的宝箱！你回家后肯定能用得上它。
rows.raw: "Hey, free chest! You could use that back home."

rows.original:
You saunter up to the strange idol standing in the ancient fort's courtyard. This must be what Evergreen was referring to... the same place where you first met Etheryn. You remember seeing the blue gem embedded in the chest of the statue when you first passed by, but never thought anything of it... until now. 

        Alright, let's give this a try. You take the leather thong from around your neck and hold up the queer blue stone Kasyrra gave you, aiming it straight for the statue's own brooch. And in that moment, there's a buzz in the air, a crackling of power through the air between your charm and the nameless lord formed of stone. The sensation lasts a mere second, and then the gem in the statue takes on a faint, pulsing glow — like it's awoken from some ageless slumber. Slowly, you lower your charm, and watch as the statue's radiance fades away once more.
rows.translation:
你漫步走向矗立在古堡庭院中的那个奇怪的神像。这应该就是常青女士所说的那个地方……也就是你第一次遇见伊瑟琳的地方。你记得当初路过时，看到那座雕像的胸前镶嵌着一颗蓝色的宝石，但当时并没有多想什么……直到现在。

        好吧，让我们试试看。把你脖子上的那条皮带取下来，拿起卡希拉送给你的那块蓝色宝石，直接瞄准雕像上的胸针。就在那一刻，空气中会传来一阵嗡嗡声，你的宝石与那座由石头构成的无名雕像之间，会迸发出强大的能量。这种感觉仅仅持续一秒钟，随后雕像中的宝石便开始发出微弱而脉动的光芒——仿佛从漫长的沉睡中苏醒了过来。你缓缓放下手中的饰品，看着雕像的光芒再次渐渐消失。

And in that moment, there's a buzz in the air, a crackling of power through the air between your charm and the nameless lord formed of stone. The sensation lasts a mere second, and then the gem in the statue takes on a faint, pulsing glow — like it's awoken from some ageless slumber.         "

rows.original:
You pause a moment, halfway across the old stone bridge. The overpowerful aroma of oversexed flowers is finally starting to fade, washed away by the scent of cold, clear water running under the bridge. 

        A deep breath to collect your thoughts after... everything... doesn't seem unwarranted. You lean onto the stone and set your weapon aside for a moment. [flags.ALRAUNE_KILLED|Gods, you really killed that creature. Corrupted as she was, that was still a life taken. The heaviness of the act weighs on your heart like an anchor. But she won't hurt anyone again, and her daughters have been scattered to the winds. An undeniable victory. ]So this is the corruption Kasyrra is spreading: twisting the life of Savarra into her corrupted playthings, unleashing them on the unsuspecting world. Poor Hawkethorne had no idea what was coming. If you hadn't come along, it's possible the Alraune's progeny would have overrun the town.
        
        [party.has Cait|"You okay, [pc.name]?" Cait asks, hefting herself up onto the railing beside you. One of her hands brushes your shoulder. "You look a million miles away."
        
        "I'm fine," you tell her, [cait.fucked|giving her thigh a little squeeze|squeezing her hand]. "It's just a lot to take in."
        
        She smiles sympathetically. "Take all the time you need. And if you ever need to talk..."]
        
        You take one last breath to clear your head and push off, turning towards the other side of the river. The old fortress on the far bank is crumbling from centuries of neglect. The way Garth told it, nobody from the village has been north of the river since the Godswar, and it's clear that the old wayfort's been abandoned just as long. The roof is falling in on itself, the gates are smashed in... its last owners likely died two, maybe three, hundred years ago. It looks almost mournful in its decay, a sad reminder of Savarra's glory days long faded.
        
        [flags.ALRAUNE_KILLED|A fortress like that, out here in the middle of nowhere and now with plenty of cleansed land to sustain its populace... it could be a bastion again, a place for folk like you that don't have a real home in the civilized parts of the Marches. The term 'warden' comes to mind. The old empire used the term for warrior-lords that protected the roadways from banditry... and for jailers, keeping folk that can't be trusted in civilization from running amok.
        |A fortress like that, out here in the middle of nowhere and connected to your new submissive plant-woman's garden... it could be a bastion for people like her. A place people tainted by Kasyrra and left broken, unable to cope with civilization, could go to find solace. If somebody like you were just around to keep it up, and keep them all under control. The term 'warden' comes to mind. The old empire used the term for warrior-lords that protected the roadways from banditry... and for jailers, keeping folk that can't be trusted in civilization from running amok.]
        
        But that's a thought for another time. For when you've caught up with Kasyrra. She's so close you can practically smell her!
        
        [party.has cait|"Come on," you tell Cait, taking her hand. "Let's go!"
        
        "Right behind you!" she grins, letting you pull her down off the edge.]
rows.translation:
你在那座古老的石桥上停下了脚步。那些浓烈得令人窒息的花香终于开始消退，被桥下流淌的冰冷清水的味道所取代。

        在……经历了这一切……之后，深吸一口气整理一下思绪，似乎并不算多余。你靠在石桥上，把武器暂时放在了一边。 [flags.ALRAUNE_KILLED|天啊，你们真的消灭了那个生物。尽管它已经堕落了，但那仍然是一条生命的终结。这种行为的沉重感像锚一样压在你的心上。不过，它再也不会伤害任何人了，它的后代也四散而去。这确实是一场不可否认的胜利。 ]这就是卡希拉正在散布的邪恶势力：她将萨瓦拉的生命扭曲成自己那些被腐蚀的玩物，然后将它们释放到这个毫无防备的世界中。可怜的鹰棘镇根本不知道即将发生什么。如果你没有出现，阿尔劳妮的后代很可能已经占领了整个小镇。
        
        [party.has Cait|“你没事吧，[pc.name]？”凯特问道，她撑身坐到你身旁的栏杆上，一只手拂过你的肩膀。“你看起来魂不守舍。”
        
        “我没事，”你告诉她，[cait.fucked|轻轻捏了捏她的大腿|握住她的手]。“只是要消化的东西太多了。”
        
        她同情地笑了笑。“你需要多少时间都可以。如果你什么时候需要找人聊聊……”]
        
        你深吸一口气，让头脑清醒一些，然后撑身离开，转向河的另一岸。对岸那座古老的堡垒因为数百年的无人照料而逐渐破败不堪。据加斯所说，自从那场神战之后，村里就再也没有人去过河的北岸，显然，那座古老的堡垒也早已被废弃了。屋顶已经开始坍塌，大门也被撞得粉碎……它的最后主人很可能在两三百年前就已经去世了。这种荒废与破败的场景看起来几乎带有一种哀伤的气息，让人不禁想起萨瓦拉曾经拥有的辉煌岁月，而这些岁月早已消逝无踪。
        
        [flags.ALRAUNE_KILLED|像这样的堡垒，坐落在荒凉之地，而现在又有了充足的肥沃土地来养活居民……它完全可以再次成为一道屏障，成为那些在边境文明地区没有真正家园的人的庇护所。你脑海中浮现出“守卫”这个词——古代帝国用它指那些保护道路免受盗匪侵扰的武士领主，也用来指看守那些在文明社会中无法被信任、防止他们胡作非为的狱卒。
        |像那样的堡垒，坐落在荒凉之地，却与你们那些新建立的、充满顺从与和谐的植物女性花园相连……对于像她这样的人来说，这里完全可以成为一个避难所。那些被卡希拉的影响所扭曲、心灵受到伤害、无法适应文明社会的人们，都可以来到这里寻找慰藉。如果有像你这样的人在场，能够维持秩序，控制住所有人，那么“守卫”这个称呼就再合适不过了。古代帝国就用这个词来指那些负责保护道路免受强盗侵扰的武士领主……同时也用来指那些看守囚犯的人，他们的作用就是防止那些在文明社会中无法被信任的人为非作歹。]
        
        不过，这个话题可以留到以后再讨论。等你们追上卡希拉的时候再聊吧——她已经离你们这么近了，你们几乎都能闻到她的味道了！
        
        [party.has cait|“来吧，”你牵起凯特的手说，“我们走吧！”
        
        “我紧跟在你后面！”她笑着，让你拉她离开边缘。]

rows.original: Beggars can't be choosers, and while you might have missed the real loot by a few hundred years, there's still a mostly-usable chest sitting here ripe for the taking. It's been pillaged already, and its only contents seem to be cobwebs and dust, but even a cursory glance shows that it's of fine quality despite the wear and tear of neglect. Well, this will make a fine addition to your quarters. You [party.has brint|gesture towards the unattended chest, and Brint gets the hint. He stomps over and hefts it up, planting the chest on his shoulder. Next to the huge minotaur, it looks like a child's toy.|roll your shoulders and grab the thing, hefting it up onto your shoulders. Oof, that's heavy!] Best get this back to the Frost Hound as soon as you can! Your storage capacity has increased by 10!
rows.translation: 穷人可没有挑挑拣拣的余地。虽然你可能错过了真正有价值的宝物，但这里还是有一个还算可以用的箱子，等着你去拿走。这个箱子已经被洗劫一空，里面的东西似乎只有蜘蛛网和灰尘，但哪怕只是粗略地看一眼，也能看出尽管它经历了长时间的忽视和破坏，质量依然不错。 嗯，这个箱子一定会为你的住所增添不少光彩。你 [party.has brint|他朝那个无人看管的箱子做了个手势，布林特立刻明白了他的意思。他大步走过去，把箱子抬起来，扛在肩上。在那个巨大的弥诺陶洛斯旁边，这个箱子看起来就像儿童玩具一样。|你耸了耸肩膀，然后抓起那个东西，把它扛到了肩上。哎哟，真重啊！] 你最好尽快把这个送回霜犬酒馆！ 你的存储空间增加了10！

rows.original: Inside the hollow, you see a trio of hideous creatures backed up against the far wall, bearing dagger-like fangs at you beneath snuffling snouts that hang over their faces. Shaggy fur clings to scaled bodies, covered in long, barb-like quills that protrude down their backs like rows of trees in winter. Each of them is as big as a pony, built heavy with muscle and armor, and they're hissing with every belabored breath. They look exhausted and emaciated, despite living right next to a farm, but that doesn't stop them from snapping their jaws and bristling their quills. Eirina glances at you and lifts her shield. "Alright! No escape for them now."
rows.translation: 空洞内部，三只丑陋生物背靠远处墙壁；垂在脸上的鼻吻不断喷着鼻息，下方露出匕首般的尖牙，正对你虎视眈眈。蓬乱毛发紧贴着覆有鳞片的身体，长长的倒钩状尖刺覆盖全身，沿背部突出，犹如一排排冬日枯树。每一只都像小马般庞大，厚重肌肉与天然护甲令其体格壮硕，每次费力呼吸都会发出嘶嘶声。 尽管就住在农场旁边，它们看起来依然精疲力竭、瘦骨嶙峋；可这并不妨碍它们开合利颚、竖起尖刺。 艾瑞娜看了你一眼，举起盾牌。“好！这下它们无处可逃了。”

Shaggy fur clings to scaled bodies, covered in long, barb-like quills that protrude down their backs like rows of trees in winter. Each of them is as big as a pony, built heavy with muscle and armor, and they're hissing with every belabored breath. "Alright! No escape for them now." "

rows.original: The last of the quillocks slumps to the side with a pathetic snufth! from under its long nose, bleeding into the soil. Its chest rises and falls one last time, and then like its kin, it collapses hard onto the ground and goes still. Eirina takes a deep breath, and rips a needle out of her breastplate. "Argh. Little bastards. Glad we got 'em when we did, they were vicious. I don't-" The earth underfoot rumbles, sending cascades of dirt raining down on you both. A crack rips through the ground beneath you, hurtling up the wall and through the stones. You've got just enough time to shout "Run!" before the world splits, and you go plummeting into blackness.
rows.translation: 最后一只刺甲兽从长鼻下发出可怜的呼哧！声，歪倒在一旁，鲜血渗进泥土。它的胸膛最后起伏一次，随后像同类一样重重倒地，再也不动了。 艾瑞娜深吸一口气，从胸甲中拔出一根尖刺。“啊。小混蛋。幸好我们及时找到了它们，它们可真凶残。我不——” 脚下的大地突然轰鸣，成片泥土落在你们身上。一道裂缝撕开你脚下的地面，沿墙面向上疾驰，贯穿层层岩石。你只来得及喊出“快跑！”，世界便骤然裂开，而你也坠入一片黑暗。

Little bastards. Glad we got 'em when we did, they were vicious. I don't-" The earth underfoot rumbles, sending cascades of dirt raining down on you both. rows.original:
You slam into another layer of ground, hard enough to knock the wind out of you. The sound of your own screams are deafening in whatever subterranean hell you've been plunged into, right until Eirina lands ass-first on your face, just about squishing you like a tomato under all that firm meaty backside. Even when you manage to roll the big girl off you, you're still blind as a bat. 
    
    "Ow."
    
    "The hell was that all about?" Eirina gasps. She grunts, and her tail-flame blooms, casting a ghostly auroran light through the...
    
    ... the room. You're in a room, with colorful stone-tile floors and marble pillars — a couple of which have collapsed, leading to the rupture in the ceiling above. There's a splashing sound all around you as stones continue to fall, drawing your gaze to the rippling surface of a pool, shrouded by steam.
    
    "A hot spring?" you murmur, glancing around. It's certainly warm and humid enough for it.
    
    You pick yourself up with a groan. Gods damn, everything hurts. You start to take a look around, searching for— "Shit, what was that!?"
    
    Something slithers in the dark, and beads of red pierce the veil of shadows, staring down at the pair of you. A horrid beak-like nose raises, and it screeches like a hellspawned harpy, blowing you backwards with the sheer sonic force of its cry. 
    
    Eirina rolls onto her feet and brings her shield up. "Wraith-touched!"
rows.translation:
你重重撞上又一层地面，力道大得将肺里的空气全部震了出去。无论你坠入了怎样的地下地狱，自己的尖叫声都震耳欲聋——直到艾瑞娜屁股朝下砸在你脸上，那结实丰满的臀部险些像压番茄般把你碾碎。即使你设法把这个大姑娘从身上滚开，眼前依然黑得伸手不见五指。 
    
    “疼。”
    
    “刚才到底怎么回事？”艾瑞娜喘息道。她闷哼一声，尾焰随之绽放，幽灵般的极光照亮了……
    
    ……这个房间。你们确实身处一间房间，脚下铺着彩色石砖，周围立着大理石柱——其中几根已经倒塌，造成了头顶天花板上的破口。石块仍在不断掉落，四周响起的水花声将你的视线引向一座被蒸汽笼罩、表面泛着涟漪的水池。
    
    “温泉？”你环顾四周，低声说道。这里的确足够温暖潮湿。
    
    你呻吟着站起身。诸神在上，全身没有一处不疼。你开始四下查看，寻找——“该死，那是什么！？”
    
    有东西在黑暗中蜿蜒爬行，一串红色光点刺破阴影帷幕，从上方盯着你们二人。一只可怕的喙状鼻吻抬起，发出地狱鹰身女妖般的尖啸；叫声本身形成的强大冲击力便把你向后吹去。 
    
    艾瑞娜翻身站稳，举起盾牌。“幽魂侵蚀者！”

rows.original: You never imagined the sheer ferocity of three cornered quillocks! The beasts absolutely ravage you, sinking claws into flesh and tearing you apart, limb from bloody limb. They don't even have the decency to make it quick.
rows.translation: 你从未想象过三只被逼入绝境的刺甲兽会如此凶猛！野兽们彻底蹂躏了你，将利爪刺入血肉，撕碎你的身体，把鲜血淋漓的四肢一一扯下。 它们甚至不肯给你一个痛快。
rows.raw: " You never imagined the sheer ferocity of three cornered quillocks! The beasts absolutely ravage you, sinking claws into flesh and tearing you apart, limb from bloody limb. They don't even have the decency to make it quick. "

rows.original:
The creature screeches one last time and tumbles onto its side, flapping its abortive little winglets and thrashing its snout. Chicken-like legs scour the ground, trying and failing to regain its footing.
    
    Eirina takes a step forward and drives her spear into the creature's neck, ending its suffering. Black blood oozes around her blade, pouring into the pool.
    
    "Damn," she says, wiping the sweat from her brow. "I could have used a soak after that."
rows.translation:
那怪物发出最后一声尖啸，翻倒在侧；发育不全的小翅膀胡乱拍打，鼻吻也不停甩动。鸡爪般的双腿刨抓地面，却始终无法重新站稳。
    
    艾瑞娜向前一步，将长矛刺进怪物的脖子，结束了它的痛苦。黑色血液从矛刃周围渗出，流入水池。
    
    “该死，”她擦去额头汗水说道，“打完这一场，我本来真想泡一会儿。”

rows.original:
Barrages of quills rip into your flesh, sending you tumbling backwards beneath the sheer force of impacts. One of them pins you against the wall, leaving you hanging while the beast descends upon Eirina in a flurry of claw and fang. The Astrida parries and retreats, trying to fight it off, but it doesn't look good...
    
    Luckily, the poison saves you from having to watch. The world goes dark.
rows.translation:
密集尖刺撕入你的血肉，冲击的蛮力将你向后掀飞。其中一根把你钉在墙上，让你悬挂在那里；与此同时，怪物以利爪和尖牙形成的狂风暴雨扑向艾瑞娜。阿斯特丽达一边格挡一边后退，努力抵抗它的攻势，但情况看起来并不乐观……
    
    幸运的是，毒素让你不必继续看下去。世界陷入黑暗。

    "

rows.original: What the hell was that thing!?
rows.translation: 刚才那个鬼东西究竟是什么！？

rows.original: So what's the deal with this place? It looks old.
rows.translation: 这里到底是什么地方？看起来很古老。
rows.raw: "So what's the deal with this place? It looks old."

rows.original: Why where the quillocks nesting on top of this thing's lair?
rows.translation: 为什么那些刺甲兽会在这个东西的巢穴上方筑巢？
rows.raw: "Why where the quillocks nesting on top of this thing's lair?"

rows.original: You're ready to get out here.
rows.translation: 你已经准备好离开这里了。

rows.original: The Astrida pulls her spearpoint free. "A Wraith-touched. Leftovers from the Godswar, souls corrupted by the Outer Darkness." She sighs. "We killed most of them after the war, but some slipped through, went into hiding. Started breeding. Most are barely more than animals, like this one. Big, fucked-up, terrifying animals. Hard to believe one was so close to Tychris, though! The balls on him!" "Doesn't look like any animal I've ever seen." She shakes her head. "It wouldn't. Wraiths twist body and soul alike. Rampant mutation, cancers, chimerization, sometimes even elemental infusions... it's chaos. I'll send a team out to autopsy the body later; it'll probably have three spleens and seven lungs or something. You see all sorts of weird shit inside a 'touched. Some, like this one, can even use a kind of magic. Wild magic, tends to cause even more mutation, but for some reason Wraith-touched never blow up like folk-casters do. Like their bodies are catalysts themselves." She frowns. "One of the great mysteries we've yet to peel back. Someday, though!"
rows.translation: 阿斯特丽达拔出长矛尖。“幽魂侵蚀者。诸神战争留下的残余，被外域黑暗腐化的灵魂。”她叹了口气。“战后我们消灭了大部分，但有一些逃过追捕，躲藏起来并开始繁殖。多数几乎和野兽没什么区别，就像这一只。巨大、扭曲、可怕的野兽。真难相信竟有一只离提克里斯这么近！这家伙胆子可真大！” “它可不像我见过的任何动物。” 她摇摇头。“当然不像。幽魂会同时扭曲肉体和灵魂。失控的变异、肿瘤、嵌合，有时甚至还会注入元素力量……完全是一片混乱。之后我会派队伍来解剖尸体；它大概会长着三个脾脏、七个肺之类的东西。侵蚀者体内什么怪东西都能见到。有些就像这一只，甚至还能使用某种魔法。那是荒野魔法，往往会造成更多变异；但不知为何，幽魂侵蚀者从来不会像普通施法者那样爆炸。仿佛它们的身体本身就是催化剂。”她皱起眉头。“这是我们尚未揭开的重大谜团之一。不过总有一天会弄明白！”

rows.original:
Eirina looks around, lifting her tail to shed more light into the darkness of the chamber. "Hot spring, maybe a bath house? Tychris used to be famous for them, back in Belharan days. Back when people used to travel freely."
    
    She casts a particularly hateful look towards the creature's body. "When travel died up, places like this were abandoned. No more rich southern nobles coming up to spread their hawks around. Hells, there were barely Tychrisians left to use the ones in town. And we had it good, out here."
    
    "Strange that Saraxeni didn't mention this place."
    
    "No surprise, really. I doubt she knew. It might've belonged to a distant ancestor, but her family could have been moved here by the princeps generations back. Or she married in, and missed the stories. Who knows. The place is buried, forgotten. Like so much from the old days."
    
    "Is there a way out of here?"
    
    Eirina points up. "How do you feel about [pc.hasWings
        |carrying me back up, huh
        |climbing
    ]?"
rows.translation:
艾瑞娜环顾四周，抬起尾巴，让更多光芒照入房间的黑暗之中。“温泉，也许是座浴场？在贝尔哈兰时代，提克里斯曾以这些地方闻名。那时人们还能自由旅行。”
    
    她以格外憎恶的眼神看向怪物尸体。“旅行断绝后，这类地方就被废弃了。再也没有富裕的南方贵族跑来四处招摇。见鬼，就连提克里斯人都所剩无几，城里的浴场几乎没人使用。而我们在这里曾经生活得很不错。”
    
    “奇怪的是，萨拉克塞尼没有提到这个地方。”
    
    “其实并不意外。我怀疑她根本不知道。这里也许曾属于她的远祖，但她的家族也可能是几代以前被元首迁来的。或者她是嫁进这个家族的，没听过那些故事。谁知道呢。这里已被掩埋、遗忘，就像旧时代的许多事物一样。”
    
    “我们有办法离开这里吗？”
    
    艾瑞娜向上指去。“你觉得[pc.hasWings
        |抱着我飞回去怎么样，嗯
        |爬上去怎么样
    ]？”

rows.original: "Now that's a good question!" Eirina laughs, putting a hand through her hair. "This thing had quills of its own, too. Thing was probably part quillock. And that voice? Maybe they heard it shrieking down here and tried to, I dunno, dig down to it? Maybe that's why they've been turning up her fields — they heard their kin and tried to rescue it?" "Like a siren's song," you murmur. She nods. "Would have eaten them, or corrupted them, the moment they got down here. We saved them from themselves, end of the day. At least they died with their little quillock souls intact." "But they weren't actually trying to hurt the baroness?" "Not intentionally, but their behavior was manic. They probably would have hurt her — or her kids — before long, if they didn't get down here. And if they got down here, well, they'd definitely have been a meal for the 'touched. So job well done in any case."
rows.translation: “这才是个好问题！”艾瑞娜笑着，用手理了理头发。“这东西自己也长着尖刺。它大概有一部分刺甲兽血统。至于那个声音？也许它们听见它在下面尖叫，所以试着……我不知道，挖下来找它？或许这就是它们一直翻毁她田地的原因——它们听见了同类的声音，想把它救出去？” “就像海妖的歌声。”你低声说道。 她点点头。“它们一旦来到下面，那东西就会吃掉或腐化它们。说到底，我们是从它们自己手里救了它们。至少它们死去时，那些小小的刺甲兽灵魂仍然完好。” “但它们其实并不是想伤害女男爵？” “并非有意，可它们的行为已经陷入疯狂。即使没能挖到这里，用不了多久，它们也很可能会伤害她——或者她的孩子。要是真挖到这里，那肯定会变成侵蚀者的食物。所以无论如何，这项工作都完成得不错。”

"I'm with Eirina," you say.

rows.original: Eirina laughs. "Well, I'm not complaining. Happy to have a drinking buddy. Just, ah, don't expect me to be too talkative. My heart's still kinda hammering." "Don't you fight monsters like that all the time?" "Sure! It's an Astrida's calling. We also don't live very long." Another laugh, this one a little less genuine. "No one's more qualified for the work, but that doesn't mean we can take anything for granted." The blackscale flops down onto the grass beneath the tree and pulls the cork of her bottle with a claw. "Every victory against a Wraith-touched is cause for celebration." She takes a deep draught from the battle, sighs, and holds it out to you. [pc.isPregnant |You wave her off and pat your belly. "Oh, shit! Sorry, I didn't- I wasn't thinking." "It's alright," you say, gingerly taking a seat besides the 'mander. |You take the bottle, and a seat beside the 'mander. The drink is cool and sweet over your tongue, with only a hint of alcoholic bite. More like a sweet sherry. You go back for another sip before passing it back to Eirina. ] Your companion leans back against the tree and takes a deep swig, staring up [dayNight |into the clouds |at the stars ]. "Hey, uh. Thanks. For coming with me. You never know, that coulda been my last outing if I was all alone." "You had it handled." Eirina shrugs. "Maybe. Probably. I've come out on top against more dangerous beasts. But still, it's a roll of the dice every time. I'm just saying, it's good to have had somebody to watch my back. [pc.ra astrida |It's so rare I get to work with another Astrida, too. Even a latecomer to the Order. |You'd have made a halfway decent Astrida, you know? ]" She chuckles and drinks again, shaking her hair out. "Ah. To victory over the Dark!" You [pc.isPregnant |give her a salute. |take a drink next. ] "To victory." "May your fight against the demons go as smoothly!"

"
    The great walls of Dracia Castle vault high above the sea below, reaching forty feet from the island plateau and as much again from the waves. Were they in good repair, they would be nigh unassailable from the sea, to say nothing of the frosted white stone's aesthetic quality. In their current state, though, they're barely more than a hindrance for your party's ascent, hewn through to the foundations in several places wide enough to climb through without difficulty. [var0
        |To your eye, this looks much more like battle damage than natural decay. Though you've never seen a siege weapon that slashes downwards like this rather than punching holes. 
    ][pc.bg minstrel scholar arcanist
        |The way the damage scythes down in near-evenly spaced gouges here... it reminds you of a great beast's claws moreso than a man-made weapon. Perhaps this lends some credence to the island being named for dragons, eh?
    ]
    
    The cliffs drop away in a sheer wall to the west; the castle interior lies to the east.
    "

rows.original: You decide to approach the three elves hanging out around the door you came through originally. The conversation seems rather spritely, if hushed, and all three are smiling. The child sees you first, hopping off the side of the table bench and skipping up with a huge grin. "Hi! I'm Amione, but with an E, not an I like oni. I'm nine! We're from the Win- oomph!" she manages before one of the elven women baps her on the head. "Ami, wait till people ask before you start telling your life story. Sorry if she's bothering you, we've never really been to a high-class party like this, so I'm not fully sure how we should act. Lady Iveryn has been helping me with the basics, but I'm afraid it's over my head," she says. She looks a little haggard and overwhelmed, but her eyes are just as full of wonder as the child when regarding the extravagant hall. "It's no trouble at all, honestly. [pc.bg noblescion |I always feel out of place in these things too. |I usually just wing it at these things. ] Do you mind if [party.som |I |we |we ] join you?" you ask, indicating the open banquet seats. "No, I don't mind, and I don't think her ladyship would either. Come on, the food is wonderful! My name is Shyldren, I'm a seamstress in the city. To be honest I'm not even sure how or why we were invited, but I'm very thankful," she explains as you return to the table. The other woman chimes in: "I'm sure you must have repaired or sewn a dress for a noble who was unable to attend and requested your attendance in their stead. I know several who would fit the bill. And no, I don't mind your joining either. The more people to cheer this dreary place up, the better." Now that you're seated at the same table, you can get a good look at everyone. Apart from the exhaustion, Shyldren is quite pretty. She wears a loose dress that swirls around her hips and sparkles like it's studded with gemstones. Her dark hair hangs to the middle of her back, and she moves with more grace than she gives herself credit for. She's hardly touched her food, but seems more interested in the conversation than eating. Her daughter is making up for that. At any opportunity to sneak extra food without her mother noticing, she does so, stuffing it into her mouth before anything is missed. She's a young mirror of Shyldren, though her dress is much more frilly and poofy, and her long hair is done up in two messy balls. She occasionally perks up at the conversation, but is much more interested in the massive variety of food. You can't help but notice that her hair is held up by a straight piece of metal that looks suspiciously like the [var0|ones you've already collected|one you found in the courtyard]. Perhaps you can bribe her with something to get it. Lady Iveryn is dressed in full war regalia. It looks comfortable on her rather than out of place at the banquet. A cloak with a large symbol of Lumia emblazoned on its back covers her shoulders and most of her body. [var1|She bears a strong resemblance to Atheldred, the ghostly elvenqueen you met beneath the palace of ice.|She bears some resemblance to Etheryn, though it isn't a hugely close one.] [party.has etheryn |Ryn struggles not to stare at the woman, as if trying to burn the memory of her into her eyes. |Perhaps the two were related. ] "I was just inviting Shyldren and her wonderful daughter here to the military parade next week. We'll be showing off the newest recruits' discipline and maneuvering. I'm told it ends up looking much like dancing if everything goes as planned. I've tried my best to make sure that's exactly what happens," she says, beaming.[party.has etheryn | "So I've heard," Ryn responds. "I wish I could see one for myself. Lady Daliza tells such stories about the old days..." A wistful smile raises her cheeks as she slips into a fond memory. "And who are you, dear? You have a striking resemblance to consort Synneva. It's almost staggering. I should introduce you to my sister, she might just take a liking to you," the tall general chuckles. Ryn flushes a deep purple at the insinuation that her grandmother would be into her, and struggles to gather her words. "[etheryn.lnhConfidence |I-into me!? I'm n-nobody special though, h-honest, |Oh I couldn't, honestly. I'm not really important enough for that, |Thanks, but I don't think harem life is for me, ]" she says, deflecting as best she can. "[etheryn.highConfidence |You say that like it would be a dishonor, but fairly stated," |Don't say that. You're wonderfully beautiful. Whether it's the queen or someone else, you'll find someone who treats you royally," ] the woman replies, easing off her inquiry. ] You chat for a little longer about the Winter City and its surrounding kingdom, still seemingly in its prime by the elves' reckoning, till you feel you have nothing left to add to the conversation. At that point, you say your goodbyes and leave the table. Based on this interaction, it doesn't seem like there's much of an easily identifiable connection between the people present. There are even non-landholders present among the elves.
rows.translation: 你决定走向最初进入这个地方时站在门边的那三个精灵。他们的谈话声虽然很低，但却显得十分活泼，三个精灵都面带微笑。那个小孩最先看到了你，她从桌子的边缘跳下来，蹦蹦跳跳地跑过来，脸上洋溢着灿烂的笑容。 “嗨！我叫阿米奥内，是带E的那个，而不是像 oni 那样带I。我才九岁呢！我们来自温——哇哦！”她还没说完，就有一位精灵女性轻拍了一下她的头。 “阿米，等别人先问你问题再开始讲你的经历吧。如果她打扰到你了，实在抱歉。我们从来没参加过这种高档派对，所以也不太清楚该怎么做才合适。艾薇琳女士一直在帮助我学习基础知识，但我担心这些内容对我来说实在太难了，”她说。她看起来有些疲惫不堪，似乎被这些知识压得喘不过气来，但当她注视着这座宏伟壮丽的大厅时，她的眼中依然充满了孩童般的惊奇与赞叹。 说实话，这根本不是什么麻烦事。 [pc.bg noblescion |在这些场合里，我总是觉得自己格格不入。 |对于这类事情，我通常都是即兴发挥的。 ] 你介意吗？ [party.som |我 |我们 |我们 “] 要和我一起坐吗？”你问道，同时指向那些空着的宴会座位。 “不用了，我并不介意，而且我觉得那位夫人也不会介意的。来吧，食物真的很美味！我叫希尔德伦，是城里的一名裁缝。说实话，我甚至不明白我们是怎么被邀请来的，也不知道为什么会被邀请，但我真的很感激。”在你回到桌边时，她这样说道。 另一位女士插话说：“我敢肯定，你一定为那些无法出席宴会、却请求你代替他们前往的贵族们修补或缝制过礼服吧。我认识好几位这样的贵族呢。而且，我并不反对你也一起来。越多的人来让这个沉闷的地方变得热闹些，就越好。” 现在大家都坐在同一张桌子旁了，你可以仔细看看每个人了。除了显得有些疲惫之外，希尔德伦其实相当漂亮。她穿着一件宽松的裙子，裙子在她的腰间飘动，仿佛镶嵌了宝石般闪闪发光。她的黑发垂到背部中间，她的动作举止比她自己意识到的要优雅得多。她几乎没怎么动过食物，看起来更感兴趣的是大家之间的谈话，而不是吃饭本身。 她的女儿正在弥补这一点。只要有机会，在母亲没有注意到的时候，她就会偷偷拿些额外的食物吃掉，确保不会有任何东西被浪费掉。她就像小版的希尔德伦，只不过她的裙子更加花哨、蓬松，而她的长发也被扎成了两个凌乱的发髻。她偶尔会参与到谈话中，但对她面前各式各样的食物显然更感兴趣。你不禁注意到，她的头发用一根笔直的金属条固定着，看起来和[var0|你已经收集到的那些金属条|你在院子里找到的那根金属条]十分相像。或许你可以用一些东西贿赂她，从而得到它。 艾薇琳女士穿着一身正式的战袍。这套服装穿在她身上既显得得体，也不会在宴会上显得格格不入。她肩上披着一件背后印有卢米娅标志的斗篷，斗篷几乎遮住了她身体的大部分。 [var1|她与你在冰之宫殿下遇到的那位幽灵般的精灵女王阿瑟德雷德有着惊人的相似之处。|她与伊瑟琳有些相似之处，不过这种相似性并不是非常明显。] [party.has etheryn |瑞恩努力不让自己盯着那个女人看，仿佛想要将她的形象深深地刻进自己的脑海里。 |也许这两者之间存在某种关联。 ] “我只是想邀请希尔德伦和她可爱的女儿来参加下周的军事阅兵。我们会展示新招募的士兵们的纪律性和队列训练成果。据说如果一切按计划进行，那些队列动作看起来会很像跳舞。我已经尽力确保事情确实会那样发展了，”她笑着说。[party.has etheryn | “听说过很多关于这些的事情。真希望能亲眼见到它们呢。达莉莎女士总是会讲很多关于过去的故事……她脸上浮现出怀旧的微笑，仿佛正在回忆那些美好的时光。” “那么，亲爱的，你又是谁呢？你和辛妮瓦王后长得实在太像了，简直让人难以置信。我应该把你介绍给我妹妹认识，说不定她会喜欢上你的。”那位高个子的将军笑着说。听到这种暗示，瑞恩的脸瞬间涨成了深紫色，她努力想要组织好自己的语言来回应。 “[etheryn.lnhConfidence |我……进入我的身体里了！？说实话，我其实什么特别的都没有…… |哦，说实话，我做不到。我还不够重要，不配承担那样的责任。 |谢谢，但我觉得后宫生活并不适合我。 ]” 她说着，尽力回避着这个话题。” “[etheryn.highConfidence |“你说得好像那是一种耻辱似的，但公平地说…” “|别这么说。你实在是美得令人惊叹。无论是成为女王，还是以其他身份，你肯定能找到一个会好好对待你的人。” ] 那位女士回答道，同时放低了询问的语气。 ] 你们又聊了一会儿关于冬城及其周边王国的情况。在精灵们的眼中，那个王国似乎依然处于鼎盛时期。直到你觉得再没有什么可说的了，才道别离开餐桌。从这次交谈来看，在场的人们之间似乎并没有什么明显的共同点或联系。甚至，在精灵们当中也有一些并非土地所有者的人。
rows.raw: " You decide to approach the three elves hanging out around the door you came through originally. The conversation seems rather spritely, if hushed, and all three are smiling. The child sees you first, hopping off the side of the table bench and skipping up with a huge grin. "Hi! I'm Amione, but with an E, not an I like oni. I'm nine! We're from the Win- oomph!" she manages before one of the elven women baps her on the head. "Ami, wait till people ask before you start telling your life story. Sorry if she's bothering you, we've never really been to a high-class party like this, so I'm not fully sure how we should act. Lady Iveryn has been helping me with the basics, but I'm afraid it's over my head," she says. She looks a little haggard and overwhelmed, but her eyes are just as full of wonder as the child when regarding the extravagant hall. "It's no trouble at all, honestly. [pc.bg noblescion |I always feel out of place in these things too. |I usually just wing it at these things. ] Do you mind if [party.som |I |we |we ] join you?" you ask, indicating the open banquet seats. "No, I don't mind, and I don't think her ladyship would either. Come on, the food is wonderful! My name is Shyldren, I'm a seamstress in the city. To be honest I'm not even sure how or why we were invited, but I'm very thankful," she explains as you return to the table. The other woman chimes in: "I'm sure you must have repaired or sewn a dress for a noble who was unable to attend and requested your attendance in their stead. I know several who would fit the bill. And no, I don't mind your joining either. The more people to cheer this dreary place up, the better." Now that you're seated at the same table, you can get a good look at everyone. Apart from the exhaustion, Shyldren is quite pretty. She wears a loose dress that swirls around her hips and sparkles like it's studded with gemstones. Her dark hair hangs to the middle of her back, and she moves with more grace than she gives herself credit for. She's hardly touched her food, but seems more interested in the conversation than eating. Her daughter is making up for that. At any opportunity to sneak extra food without her mother noticing, she does so, stuffing it into her mouth before anything is missed. She's a young mirror of Shyldren, though her dress is much more frilly and poofy, and her long hair is done up in two messy balls. She occasionally perks up at the conversation, but is much more interested in the massive variety of food. You can't help but notice that her hair is held up by a straight piece of metal that looks suspiciously like the [var0|ones you've already collected|one you found in the courtyard]. Perhaps you can bribe her with something to get it. Lady Iveryn is dressed in full war regalia. It looks comfortable on her rather than out of place at the banquet. A cloak with a large symbol of Lumia emblazoned on its back covers her shoulders and most of her body. [var1|She bears a strong resemblance to Atheldred, the ghostly elvenqueen you met beneath the palace of ice.|She bears some resemblance to Etheryn, though it isn't a hugely close one.] [party.has etheryn |Ryn struggles not to stare at the woman, as if trying to burn the memory of her into her eyes. |Perhaps the two were related. ] "I was just inviting Shyldren and her wonderful daughter here to the military parade next week. We'll be showing off the newest recruits' discipline and maneuvering. I'm told it ends up looking much like dancing if everything goes as planned. I've tried my best to make sure that's exactly what happens," she says, beaming.[party.has etheryn | "So I've heard," Ryn responds. "I wish I could see one for myself. Lady Daliza tells such stories about the old days..." A wistful smile raises her cheeks as she slips into a fond memory. "And who are you, dear? You have a striking resemblance to consort Synneva. It's almost staggering. I should introduce you to my sister, she might just take a liking to you," the tall general chuckles. Ryn flushes a deep purple at the insinuation that her grandmother would be into her, and struggles to gather her words. "[etheryn.lnhConfidence |I-into me!? I'm n-nobody special though, h-honest, |Oh I couldn't, honestly. I'm not really important enough for that, |Thanks, but I don't think harem life is for me, ]" she says, deflecting as best she can. "[etheryn.highConfidence |You say that like it would be a dishonor, but fairly stated," |Don't say that. You're wonderfully beautiful. Whether it's the queen or someone else, you'll find someone who treats you royally," ] the woman replies, easing off her inquiry. ] You chat for a little longer about the Winter City and its surrounding kingdom, still seemingly in its prime by the elves' reckoning, till you feel you have nothing left to add to the conversation. At that point, you say your goodbyes and leave the table. Based on this interaction, it doesn't seem like there's much of an easily identifiable connection between the people present. There are even non-landholders present among the elves. "

rows.original: Talk to the group who are still sitting by the entryway and dining on foods. It looks like there are two women and one child.
rows.translation: 去和那些还坐在入口处吃饭的几个人聊聊吧。看起来有两位女性和一个孩子。
rows.raw: "Talk to the group who are still sitting by the entryway and dining on foods. It looks like there are two women and one child."

rows.original: The young girl is in the middle of racing as fast as she can around a banquet table as you approach her. She comes to a skidding stop in front of you when you sit on the opposing bench. "Hey there! Are you [pc.ra elf |a noble too? [var0|I saw the queen during a parade once, but I don't remember seeing you ever!|Your skin looks kinda weird, but mom's told me there are other elf kingdoms in the world!] |a noble from some far off country!? You look [pc.ra human |really plain, but that's ok cause the inside is more important! |kinda weird, but that just makes you more interesting! ] ]" she exclaims. You feel exhausted already and you haven't even gotten a word in yet, but you've gotta push through to get that piece of the sword. "I [var1 |am! Though I'm not surprised you haven't heard of me, |am not! I'm just like you here, none of this really means anything to me. I'm just here for the food, ]" you say, "I was actually wondering where you got that thing in your hair. I happen to be collecting those, and I'd really love to have that one to help complete my collection." The girl watches as you hold up the piece you found in the courtyard, and makes a completely exaggerated show of thinking it over. She rubs her chin. She narrows her eyes. She hems and haws and taps her elbows. After a minute that feels like ten, she gives you the biggest shit-eating grin you've ever seen. "Weeeeeeellll, if it's to complete your collection. BUT! You have to do something for me first! See that HUGE cake over there with all the layers?" she asks, pointing to an elaborate quintuple decker cake on the main table. "Mom said I couldn't just eat the whole thing with my hands, and hasn't let me go over there at all! If you get me the very top layer of the cake, I'll give you this thing." That sounds like an incredibly easy deal, but you play it up a little for her sake. "[pc.dcb |You drive a hard bargain, but I can do that. |Oof. That sounds difficult, but I think I can manage it. |What!? That's, like, the hardest task ever! But don't worry! I'll do it for you, little cutie! I'll get that cake no matter what! ]" you reply, hopping to your feet and waltzing over to the head table. [pc.heightRange 0 56 80 |Given you're about the same size she is, it's a little tougher than you thought, but you can take the top layer off by crawling up onto the table on your knees and slicing the entire topper onto a plate. |You can reach the top of the cake pretty easily if you stretch, and you waste no time in slicing the whole top of the cake off onto a plate. |You can reach the top of the cake with no effort, and effortlessly slice it off onto a plate. ] The frosting is a little mussed from the movement, but you shrug and lick it off your fingers as you bring the plate back to Amione. "Yay!" she cries when you plop the entire thing down in front of her. She unceremoniously tugs the central sword fragment out of her hair, letting her locks tumble down around her shoulders with a bounce before setting it on the table as she digs in. You ruffle her hair a bit in thanks and take it as you leave her to eat. You're glad that was as easy as it sounded.
rows.translation: 当你靠近这个年轻女孩时，她正以最快的速度在宴桌周围奔跑。当你坐在对面的长椅上时，她突然在你面前停了下来。 “嘿，你好！你是[pc.ra elf |也是贵族吗？[var0|我曾经在一场游行中见过那位女王，不过我却不记得曾经见过你！|你的皮肤看起来有点奇怪，不过妈妈告诉我，世界上还有其他的精灵王国呢！] |一个来自遥远国度的贵族？！你看起来[pc.ra human |看起来确实很简单，但没关系，因为里面的内容才更重要！ |有点奇怪，但这样反而让你变得更有趣了！ ] ]”她惊呼道。你都已经感到精疲力竭了，而且到现在还没能插上一句话，但你必须坚持下去，拿到那把剑的碎片。 “我[var1 |是！虽然你没听说过我，我也不感到惊讶。 |不是！我和你一样，这些对我来说其实都没什么意义。我来这里只是为了吃饭而已。 ]”你说道，“我其实一直在想你头上那个东西是从哪里来的。我正好在收集这类东西，如果能得到那一个，我的收藏就完整了。” 女孩看着你举起在院子里找到的那个东西，然后故作夸张地假装在认真思考一番。她摸了摸下巴，眯起了眼睛，犹豫不决地敲打着肘部。过了仿佛长达十分钟的时间，她终于露出了你见过的最灿烂、最得意的笑容。 “嗯……如果这是为了完成你的收藏的话。但是！你得先为我做一件事才行！看到那边那个有好多层的巨大蛋糕了吗？”她指着主桌上那个结构复杂的五层蛋糕问道，“妈妈说不能用手把整个蛋糕都吃掉，所以根本不让我过去拿！如果你能帮我拿到蛋糕最上面的那层，我就把这个东西给你。” 听起来这个交易简直太简单了，但为了哄她开心，你还是稍微夸张了一下。 “[pc.dcb |你讨价还价的能力很强，但我可以满足你的要求。 |哎呀，听起来有点困难，不过我觉得我还是能够应付得来的。 |什么！？这简直是有史以来最困难的任务了！不过别担心，小可爱，我会帮你完成的！无论如何，我都要拿到那块蛋糕！ ]”你答道，说着便一跃而起，大步走向主桌。 [pc.heightRange 0 56 80 |既然你的体型和她差不多，这个任务其实比你想象的要困难一些。不过，你可以通过跪在桌子上，然后将整个顶层食材切下来放到盘子里，这样就能成功完成这个任务了。 |你只要伸伸手就能轻松够到蛋糕顶部，然后毫不耽搁地把整个顶层切下来放到盘子里。 |你可以毫不费力地够到蛋糕顶部，然后轻松地把它切下来放到盘子里。 ] 由于这番动作，糖霜有点被弄乱了，但你耸耸肩，把手指上的糖霜舔掉，然后把盘子端回给阿米奥内。 “太好了！”当你把整个盘子放在她面前时，她高兴地叫了起来。她毫不客气地从自己的头发里拔出那块中央的剑碎片，让长发弹跳着散落在肩头，然后把碎片放在桌上，开始大吃特吃起来。 你轻轻揉了揉她的头发以表感谢，然后离开让她吃饭。你很高兴，整个过程竟然像听起来那么简单。

rows.original: Ask the small child about her hair ornament.
rows.translation: 问问那个小女孩关于她头上的装饰品的事。
rows.raw: "Ask the small child about her hair ornament."

rows.original: You approach the fearful seamstress in the most disarming way you can, putting a gentle hand on her shoulder and giving her your best smile. She's shivering more than her daughter at this point, and Ami seems to be the one doing the actual comforting between the two of them. "It's ok, mom! We'll be ok, right?" she asks. The girl puts on a brave face, but she's still shuddering fearfully. "I'm sure you'll both be just fine," you say, squeezing Shyldren's shoulder. The distraught woman focuses for the first time, rubbing her temples and looking up at you. "You're right. I refuse to believe this is just some kind of sick game. If we're back, it must be because the goddess herself sent us for a reason. To help you slay this demon, perhaps? You're different from the rest of us, right?" she asks, standing up and looking around. She's still afraid, but you hear budding conviction in her tone. "If you feel that way, how would you know that I'm not just the monster in disguise?" you ask. Technically she could be the imposter, but you aren't ready to accuse anyone yet. "Ha, it could be, but I've gotta believe in somebody. I'm just choosing you for now. Maybe it's only because you're the one person I spoke with other than Lady Iveryn, and now that she's gone I'm just thinking wishfully," she says. "Speaking of Iveryn, did she say anything during your conversation that might have given any clues to finding the monster among us?" you ask, hoping for something easy. "No. We only talked about my shop in the city and her latest displays on the ice shelf above the palace. I got so caught up in talking with her that I didn't have much time to chat with anyone else, and I wasn't really paying attention to what they were doing. I'm sorry," she says. "Don't apologize. You didn't really have any way of knowing before now," you reply. It's no use having her get down again after building herself up. You turn back to the center of the hall. "Good luck!" Amione shouts as you walk away. You give her a smile and a thumbs up over your shoulder.
rows.translation: 你以最让人放松的方式走近那位感到恐惧的缝纫女工，轻轻把手放在她的肩上，露出最真诚的笑容。此时，她颤抖得比她的女儿还要厉害，而似乎真正起到安慰作用的人反而是阿米。 “没关系的，妈妈！我们会没事的，对吧？”女孩强装出勇敢的表情，但身体仍在不停地颤抖。 “我相信你们俩都会没事的，”你一边说，一边轻轻拍了拍Shyldren的肩膀。这位心烦意乱的妇女终于集中了注意力，她揉了揉太阳穴，抬头看着你。 “你说得对。我绝不相信这只是一场变态的游戏。如果我们能够回来，那一定是因为女神有她的理由让我们这么做。也许是为了帮助你消灭这个恶魔吧？你和我们其他人不一样，对吧？她站起身来，环顾四周，问道。她仍然感到害怕，但她的语气中已经透露出一些坚定的决心。 “如果你是这么想的，那你怎么能确定我不是个伪装成人类的怪物呢？”你问道。从技术上来说她也许那个人就是冒名顶替者，但我现在还不准备指责任何人。” “哈，确实有可能，但我总得相信某个人。暂时我选择相信你吧。也许只是因为除了艾薇琳女士之外，你是我唯一交谈过的人，而现在她已经离开了，所以我才会这么希望罢了。”她说。 “说到艾薇琳，在你们谈话的过程中，她有没有提到什么可能有助于我们找出藏在我们中间的那个怪物的线索？”你问道，希望能得到一些简单的答案。 “没有。我们只是谈论了我城里的店铺，以及她在宫殿上方冰架上举办的最新展览而已。我和她聊得太投入了，以至于几乎没有时间和其他人聊天，也没有认真注意他们在做什么。真的很抱歉，”她说。 “别道歉。在知道真相之前，你确实无从知晓这些事情的，”你回答道。让她好不容易建立起自信，却又让她再次失望，实在是没有意义。你转身走向大厅的中心。 “祝你好运！”当你离开时，阿米奥内大声喊道。你回头朝她笑了笑，然后竖起了大拇指。
rows.raw: " You approach the fearful seamstress in the most disarming way you can, putting a gentle hand on her shoulder and giving her your best smile. She's shivering more than her daughter at this point, and Ami seems to be the one doing the actual comforting between the two of them. "It's ok, mom! We'll be ok, right?" she asks. The girl puts on a brave face, but she's still shuddering fearfully. "I'm sure you'll both be just fine," you say, squeezing Shyldren's shoulder. The distraught woman focuses for the first time, rubbing her temples and looking up at you. "You're right. I refuse to believe this is just some kind of sick game. If we're back, it must be because the goddess herself sent us for a reason. To help you slay this demon, perhaps? You're different from the rest of us, right?" she asks, standing up and looking around. She's still afraid, but you hear budding conviction in her tone. "If you feel that way, how would you know that I'm not just the monster in disguise?" you ask. Technically she could be the imposter, but you aren't ready to accuse anyone yet. "Ha, it could be, but I've gotta believe in somebody. I'm just choosing you for now. Maybe it's only because you're the one person I spoke with other than Lady Iveryn, and now that she's gone I'm just thinking wishfully," she says. "Speaking of Iveryn, did she say anything during your conversation that might have given any clues to finding the monster among us?" you ask, hoping for something easy. "No. We only talked about my shop in the city and her latest displays on the ice shelf above the palace. I got so caught up in talking with her that I didn't have much time to chat with anyone else, and I wasn't really paying attention to what they were doing. I'm sorry," she says. "Don't apologize. You didn't really have any way of knowing before now," you reply. It's no use having her get down again after building herself up. You turn back to the center of the hall. "Good luck!" Amione shouts as you walk away. You give her a smile and a thumbs up over your shoulder. "

rows.original: Shyldren and Amione are cowered behind you. It might be a good idea to make sure they're ok.
rows.translation: 希尔德伦和阿米奥内正躲在你身后。最好确认一下他们是否安全。
rows.raw: "Shyldren and Amione are cowered behind you. It might be a good idea to make sure they're ok."

rows.translation: 你在这里已经找到了你所需的一切。

rows.original: You approach the jarl, who looks to be maintaining his composure far better than he sounded. He's breathing heavily, but his head is no longer in his hands by the time you reach him, and he's straightened from his slump. "So you were killed by the Wraiths?" you ask. [party.has etheryn |You know the answer, but you figure it's best to let him tell it. |You had some suspicions, but you figure he should say it himself. ] He looks up and eyes you up and down, appraising you from top to bottom. "Aye," he says after a moment of judgement, "Me and my men must have been the first, besides those damned mages. I don't even know how much of a difference we could make. The only reason we were able to begin an evacuation at all was thanks to the sacrifice of our last dragon. Goddess, I hope they choked on us and gave the civilians some time to escape... Laurieth and my children most of all," he says. You aren't sure if it's a good idea, but you feel like he needs to hear some positives. "[var0 |They did, your granddaughter is a bailiff in the Winter City. Lumia descended in person to join the final defense, and the Wraiths were obliterated. |They must have. Lumia descended to stop the Wraiths when they attacked the Winter City, and it still stands to this day. ] At least, most of the Wraiths, it seems," you say, your gaze straying back to the spot where Iveryn disappeared. Talraed looks at you with wide eyed shock, and then his mouth curls into a faint smile. "Ha! Then I would do it all again, and die again without a second's hesitation. If my death bought time for the goddess herself to manifest, then it was all worth it. My being here proves that. I'd been trying to deduce the meaning of this purgatory since I arrived, but I don't think I ever visited Castle Hawkstone. I knew it existed, but I never had the time for foreign visits. My wife handled all that," he says with a genuinely flabbergasted wave of his hand. "I don't know why this place was chosen either. Did you know any of these people?" you ask, Indicating the room. "I knew Iveryn, and her sister. The royal family visited Dracia on occasion, both for matters of state and social visits. As for the others... no, I don't think so. I knew Victor by reputation, like his castle, and I know Iveryn had consulted with him at least a few times on military matters based on stories she told, but I never met the man in person. As for the woman and the girl, I have no idea. They're subjects of Atheldred, that's for sure, but they have no more significance to me than you do," he replies. The connection between these people doesn't seem to be directly relevant, though you're sure there must be something that ties them together. In the meantime you'll need to look for something else. "Thanks. I'll see if I can find out what's going on sooner rather than later," you promise. The jarl nods, taking a drink from the table as you turn back to the middle of the hall.
rows.translation: 你走向那位酋长，他看起来比他刚才说的要镇定得多。他呼吸急促，但当你走到他跟前时，他已经不再把头埋在双手之间了，也站直了身子。 “所以你是被那些幽灵杀死的？”你问道。 [party.has etheryn |你知道答案，但你觉得让他自己说出来会更好。 |你虽然有些怀疑，但觉得应该由他自己来说出真相。 ] 他抬起头，上下打量着你，从头到脚仔细地评估着你。 “嗯，”他沉默了片刻才说道，“除了那些该死的法师之外，我和我的部下应该是第一批（被杀）的人。我甚至不知道我们能起到多大的作用。我们能够开始撤离行动，完全要归功于我们最后那条龙的牺牲。女神啊，但愿它们被我们噎住，从而为平民们争取到一些逃生时间……尤其是劳里埃丝和我的孩子们，”他说。你不确定这是否是个好主意，但你觉得他需要听到一些积极的方面。 “[var0 |他们做到了，你的孙女在冬城担任执法官。卢米娅亲自降临，参与最后的防御战斗，那些幽灵被彻底消灭了。 |他们肯定这么做了。当那些幽灵袭击冬城时，卢米娅降临下来阻止了它们，而那座城市至今依然矗立。 ] 至少，看起来大多数幽灵都是这样的，”你说，目光再次投向艾弗琳消失的地方。塔拉德睁大眼睛，满脸震惊地看着你，然后他的嘴角浮现出一丝淡淡的微笑。 “哈！那么，我会毫不犹豫地再次这么做，再次赴死。如果我的死亡能为女神的降临争取到时间，那么这一切都是值得的。我如今站在这里就是明证。自从来到这里，我就一直在试图弄清楚这个炼狱背后的含义，但我认为自己其实从未到过鹰棘石堡。我知道它的存在，但我一直没时间去国外参观。这些事情都是我妻子处理的，”他一边说，一边一脸目瞪口呆地挥了挥手。 “我也不知道为什么会选择这个地方。你认识这些人中的任何一个吗？”你边问边指向房间里的那些人。 “我认识艾薇琳和她的妹妹。王室成员偶尔会访问达拉西亚，既有公务需要，也有社交目的。至于其他人……不，我不这么认为。我只是听说过维克托的名字，也知道他的城堡；从她讲过的故事中，我也知道艾弗琳至少有几次就军事事务咨询过他，但我从未与他见过面。至于那个女人和那个女孩，我一无所知。她们肯定是阿瑟德雷德的属下，但对我来说，她们和你一样，并没有特别的意义。”他回答道。这些人之间的关系似乎并没有直接的关联，不过你肯定认为其中一定存在某种联系。某个东西正在将他们联系在一起。不过，你现在得另想办法了。 “谢谢。我会尽快弄清楚到底发生了什么。”你这样承诺道。酋长点了点头，一边从桌上拿起饮料喝着，而你则转身走向大厅中央。

rows.translation: 在他发完脾气后，那位酋长瘫坐在长椅上。或许也应该去看看他吧。

rows.translation: 你在这里已经找到了你所需的一切。

rows.original:
Shyldren is still singing when you approach, at the tail end of a verse. Amione is curled up against her, eyes closed and body shaking.
        
        "... and Denizeth's halls will welcome you home, no matter how far or how long you should roam," she finishes, brushing her daughter's hair and noticing you for the first time.
        
        "That's... a nice song. What's it about?" you ask, sitting down on a table bench across from her. She eyes you warily, but still answers after a pause.
        
        "It's a story about a magical island. One of her favorites. It's supposed to show up to sailors lost at sea, and the host lets them stay till their boat is repaired, or till they get their bearings, and then lets them on their way. To be honest I was kind of hoping that's where we were. I know we weren't really lost at sea, but I don't even really remember how I... passed on, as it were. We heard the Wraiths were coming, and that Lady Iveryn had led a charge against them, but it all happened so fast. All I felt was a kind of cold breeze, but then there was an explosion of light and warmth, and everything faded away. The next thing I knew I came too in a carriage leading to this castle. I couldn't see if we were on an island, so I hoped and prayed until we found out it was Castle Hawkstone," she explains. Her countenance fades to sadness.
        
        "Hey, don't worry. I'm sure we will get out of this in a way that isn't nightmarish," you promise. You aren't fully sure you're telling the truth, but it does get her to lighten up a little. Now you just have to keep that promise. Oh boy.
rows.translation:
当你靠近时，Shyldren仍在唱歌，正好唱到了一首歌的结尾部分。Amione蜷缩在她的怀里，双眼紧闭，身体不停地颤抖。
        
        “……无论你走得多远、漂泊了多久，Denizeth的大厅都会欢迎你回家，”她唱完后，轻抚着女儿的头发，这才第一次注意到你的存在。
        
        “那……是一首很美的歌。它是关于什么的呢？”你坐在她对面的长椅上问道。她警惕地注视着你，但还是在停顿片刻后回答道：
        
        “这是关于一个魔法岛屿的故事。那是她最喜欢的故事之一。据说它会出现在海上迷路的水手面前。主人会让他们留下来，直到他们的船得到修理，或者直到他们重新找到方向，之后才会让他们继续上路。说实话，我原本还挺希望我们现在正处于这样的情境中的。我知道我们其实并没有真的在海上迷失方向，但我甚至都不记得自己究竟是怎么……消失的。我们听说那些幽灵正在逼近，而且艾薇琳小姐还率领人们去对抗它们，但这一切发生得太快了。我只感觉到一阵寒冷的风吹过，随后一阵光芒和温暖袭来，然后一切都消失了。接下来，我就发现自己坐在一辆马车里，朝着这座城堡驶去。我当时根本不知道我们是否在岛上，所以只能不断地祈祷，直到后来我们确认这里就是鹰棘石堡。”她解释道。她的脸色顿时变得黯淡下来，充满了悲伤。
        
        “嘿，别担心。我相信我们一定能找到一种不会让事情变得如此糟糕的解决办法，”你这样安慰她。其实你并不完全确定自己说的是实话，但这样的话，她的情绪确实稍微缓和了一些。现在你只需要履行这个承诺罢了……天哪。

rows.translation: 去看看那个精灵一家吧。
仔细观察这个单词锁音乐盒吧。

rows.original:
You take one of the seats next to the end table and scoot the music box to your side. The ornate crafting makes the thing look like a miniature storage chest inlaid with colorful opals. There's a hand crank on the side that turns to produce the music, but it only turns far enough for one iteration of the song. Its tune is soft and lilting, like a pleasant lullaby.
    
    While it looks like the box would slide right open, it's currently locked tight. The mechanism for opening it is a series of sliding letters on the combination lock below its inscribed front plate. [flags.WORD_CHEST|This looks similar to the wordlock chests you've seen before, and sure enough the inscribed plate has a matching rhyme.|Could it be some sort of puzzle? The plate has some writing on it.]
rows.translation:
你选择了靠近边桌的其中一个座位，然后将那个音乐盒拉到自己身边。它那精美的制作工艺让它看起来就像一个镶嵌着彩色欧泊石的微型储物箱。侧面有一个手摇柄，转动它就能播放音乐，不过每次转动只能让歌曲播放一遍而已。它的旋律柔和而悦耳，就像一首动听的摇篮曲。
    
    虽然看起来这个盒子应该可以轻松打开，但实际上它是被牢牢锁住的。打开它的方法是在其前面板上刻有数字的密码锁上，通过滑动一系列字母来解锁。 [flags.WORD_CHEST|这个看起来和你们之前见过的字谜锁箱很相似，果然，上面的铭文也对应着相应的谜语。|这会不会是一种谜题呢？盘子上有一些文字。]

rows.original:
You move the combination lock into the word 'fable' and give the lid a push. It clicks merily, but doesn't open all the way. Puzzled, you spin the crank on the side once. That does the trick, and you smile as the chest pops completely open while the tune plays. Inside is an incredibly intricate rendition of [flags.DHAWK_EXAMINE
            |the castle you saw when you spoke with Count Victor.
            |a tiny island castle.
        ] Even the waves inside are rendered with exquisite detail, but there's something that doesn't fit. Stuck into the box on top of the castle is a long shard of the sword you [var0
            |found a piece of in the courtyard
            |keep finding shards of
        ]. You pocket the sharp length of gray metal, and place the box back in its previous position. The lid closes on its own at the end of the music, leaving the box almost exactly as you found it. The puzzle is still solved, so you give the combination a few spins to mix it up.
rows.translation:
你将这个组合锁移动到“fable”这个词的位置，然后轻轻推了推盖子。它发出“咔嗒”一声，但并没有完全打开。你感到有些困惑，于是又转动了一下侧面的曲柄，这次果然成功了——盖子完全打开了，同时还传来了一段音乐。箱子里装着一件制作得极其精巧的物品 [flags.DHAWK_EXAMINE
            |就是你在与维克托伯爵交谈时看到的那座城堡。
            |一座小小的岛屿城堡。
        ] 就连海浪内部的细节也被渲染得极为精致，但总觉得有些地方不太对劲。在城堡顶部的那个箱子里，卡着一块长长的剑刃碎片 [var0
            |在院子里发现了一块……
            |不断寻找那些碎片……
        ]你将那段锋利的灰色金属收进口袋，然后将盒子放回原来的位置。音乐结束后，盖子会自动关闭，盒子就会恢复到你发现它时的样子。谜题已经解开了，于是你又把那个组合装置转动了几下，让里面的部件重新排列。

        ] Even the waves inside are rendered with exquisite detail, but there's something that doesn't fit. Stuck into the box on top of the castle is a long shard of the sword you [var0
            |found a piece of in the courtyard
            |keep finding shards of
        ]. You pocket the sharp length of gray metal, and place the box back in its previous position. The lid closes on its own at the end of the music, leaving the box almost exactly as you found it. The puzzle is still solved, so you give the combination a few spins to mix it up.

rows.original: You decide to approach the Boer'alvar male still appraising the statues while snacking on a meat-stuffed biscuit. He sees you approaching and swallows, wiping his mouth on one of the many supplied napkins. "Hello! I probably should've involved myself in introductions, but the decoration here is... strangely puzzling. I can't put my finger on why, but I can't shake the feeling either. And so I've been looking things over while I eat. The name's Talraed, Talraed var Dracia. You must be [pc.ra elf |[var0|another of Atheldred's court.|one of the locals.] |one of the locals. ] Would that I could spare more visits to the mainland, but Dracia requires my attention year-round," he says. "Yes, I'm [pc.name]. At least you seem to be in good spirits despite that feeling," you say. You figure it's best to go along with things for now, as [pc.bg scholar |even ]you aren't sure exactly how things worked out back then. It's probably best if he thinks you are who he says you are. "Yes. There's that at least. The food here is quite good. There's this wonderful fruit from the rainforests called a mango, and I just can't get enough of it. I'll have to look into how possible it is to get some shipments to Dracia. Goddess knows there's nothing quite like it that grows in the archipelago," he replies. [party.has etheryn |"[etheryn.lowConfidence |U-um... Excuse me? You mentioned Dracia. Do you know a Daliza var Dracia?" |Excuse me? You said your name was Dracia, Do you know anyone by the name of Daliza?" ] Ryn asks, catching Talraed's attention before you leave. The man looks her up and down, squinting his eyes and rubbing his chin. "Hmm? Have we met? You look familiar, are you a relative of the var Ridells? Regardless, I can't say I've heard of someone by that name. Could it be that you've found an ancestor of mine in a book in your court library? I don't look much into the past, but my daughter is pregnant, and she's been hounding me about helping her pick a name. Maybe I'll offer it up," he says with a guffawing laugh. Ryn follows you as you leave him to his feasting and admiring, leaning to whisper in your ear. "[pc.name]! He was killed during the Godswar, I know it! Dracia was one of the first bastions of defense that held the Wraiths while the citizens fled. He and his soldiers all perished, but I know they at least made a bit of difference. His daughter and son in law survived the war, and [flags.DALIZA_MET|we've met their daughter Daliza,|their daughter is a bailiff in the Winter City,]" she says. Combined with the baron being here, that confirms these people are ghosts at best. |[flags.DALIZA_MET |"You said you were from Dracia? Do you perhaps know a Daliza var Dracia?" you ask. "Hmm. I can't say I have. Did you perhaps read about one of my ancestors? I don't linger much on the past," he says with a chuckle. "Although, my daughter is pregnant and has been hounding me to help her pick a name. Maybe I'll offer that up." You leave the man to his feasting, puzzling over the connection between him and the bailiff you've met in the Wayfort. Judging by his reaction it's possible he's an ancestor of hers, rather than the other way around. In that case it would confirm that these people are ghosts at best. ] ]
rows.translation: 你决定走向那个仍在欣赏那些雕像、同时吃着肉馅饼的布尔阿尔瓦男性。他看到你走过来，连忙咽下嘴里的食物，用旁边提供的纸巾擦了擦嘴。 “你好！其实我应该先自我介绍一下的，不过这里的装饰……实在让人感到有些困惑。我也说不上来为什么，但这种感觉就是挥之不去。所以我在吃东西的时候就一直在观察这些装饰。我叫塔尔拉德，塔尔拉德·瓦·达拉西亚。你一定是 [pc.ra elf |[var0|阿瑟雷德的朝臣之一。|当地人之一。] |当地人之一。 ] 要是我能多去几次大陆就好了，但达拉西亚一年到头都需要我的关注，”他说。 “是的，我是[pc.name]。至少，尽管有那种感觉，你看起来还是心情不错的，”你说。你认为，目前最好的做法就是顺其自然吧。 [pc.bg scholar |甚至 ]你其实并不清楚当时的事情究竟是如何发展的。或许，让他认为你就是他所说的那个人，反而是最好的选择。 “是的，至少这一点是肯定的。这里的食物相当美味。有一种来自雨林的奇妙水果，叫做芒果，我简直爱不释手。我得想办法把一些芒果运到达拉西亚去。天知道，在这个群岛上根本找不到这种水果。”他回答道。 [party.has etheryn |[etheryn.lowConfidence |“呃……不好意思？你提到了达拉西亚，你认识一位名叫达莉莎·瓦尔·达拉西亚的人吗？” |“请问？您说过您的名字是达拉西亚，您认识一个叫达莉莎的人吗？” ] 莱恩在你们离开之前叫住了塔尔拉德。那个男人上下打量了她一番，眯着眼睛，还揉了揉下巴。 “嗯？我们以前见过面吗？你看起来有点面熟，该不会是里德尔家的亲戚吧？不管怎样，我确实没听说过有这个名字的人。难道是你在我宫廷图书馆的书中找到了我的祖先吗？我平时并不太关注过去的事情，不过我的女儿确实怀孕了，一直缠着我帮她选名字。也许我可以提个建议吧，”他哈哈大笑着说道。当你离开他，让他继续享受美食和人们的赞美时，莱恩跟了上来，在你耳边低声说道。 “[pc.name]！他在神战中被杀，这是我知道的！在市民们逃离之际，达拉西亚是那些坚守防线、抵御幽灵入侵的据点之一。他和他的士兵们都牺牲了，但我知道他们至少为阻止这场灾难起到了一定的作用。他的女儿和女婿在战争中幸存了下来， [flags.DALIZA_MET|我们已经见到了他们的女儿达莉莎。|他们的女儿在冬城担任执达员一职。]”她说道。再加上男爵也在这里，这一切都说明这些人至多只是鬼魂罢了。 |[flags.DALIZA_MET |“你说你来自达拉西亚？那么你是否认识某个名叫达莉莎·瓦尔·达拉西亚的人呢？”你问道。 “嗯，我不太清楚。你是不是读过关于我的祖先的资料呢？我并不太关注过去的事情，”他笑着说道，“不过，我的女儿确实怀孕了，一直缠着我帮她挑选名字。也许我可以提个建议吧。” 你让那个男人继续他的宴饮，同时思考着他与你之前在荒废驿堡遇到的那个执达员之间的联系。从他的反应来看，他很可能是她的祖先，而不是相反。如果是这样的话，那就意味着这些人最多也就是些幽灵罢了。 ] ]

rows.original: Talk to the elf man who had been separate from the group before. It looks like he's partaking in the banquet.
rows.translation: 去找之前与队伍分开的那个精灵男子吧，他似乎也在参加这场宴会。
rows.raw: "Talk to the elf man who had been separate from the group before. It looks like he's partaking in the banquet."

rows.original:
[flags.DHAWK_FALSE_ACCUSATION
            |You catch up to Count Victor after he's reached the decorative blade, still yanking on a sword that won't leave its sheath.
            
            "It must be [var0
                |the girl if it isn't the mother!
                |The mother if it isn't the girl!
                |one of them, both of them even!
            ]. Come, use your weapon. I'm sure we can finish them while they're still disguised," he snarls, lost in desperation.
            
            "Hold on, there must be another option. What reasoning do you have?" you ask, trying to calm him a little.
            
            "Well the only other option is that it's me, isn't it? I'm not willing to go down without fighting," he replies, still focused on the other two more than on you. It seems like he's set on his options. You'd better check on the others.
            
            [party.has Arona
                |As you leave Victor to his rambling, Arona pulls you aside.
                
                "Hey, [pc.name]. Something that guy said earlier didn't track. I wasn't sure at first, but it just rubs me the wrong way. He mentioned having that castle as a vacation home? My tribe has been all over the waters between Dracia and here. There's no islands there, let alone ones with castles. Think about it. We'd have looted the shit out of any island with a single dinky castle and no defenses aside from a skeleton crew of maids. Fuck, a defenseless island with a crew of maids sounds like one of my wet dreams," she says, eyeing the party host warily. Interesting.
            ]
            |You approach the count, whose face is creased by a great frown.
            
            "Wonderful party I've put on. I must've died in my sleep if this man is telling the truth. Some part of me believes him, because I don't remember what I was doing before today. It's like a dream, but shared between the lot of us. Surely we can't all have died in my castle, but I at least must have. This blasted demon set me up as the host of its very own party, and now it's traipsing around like it owns the place. And what's your part of this? Some kind of celestial arbiter? I can tell you're different, and I'm sure they can too. At first I thought you were the monster, but that line of thought just seems to slip from my mind like oil in water," he says. 
            
            "I'm not sure, but it's looking more and more like that might be the gist of it," you reply with a sigh. Victor takes a long drink from a nearby tankard before talking again.
            
            "I don't know how long it's been, but it's good to finally have a... chance at justice. We'll find this remnant of the past and kick it back to the abyss," he raises his drink before taking another pull.
            
            "Do you have any ideas?" you ask.
            
            "Hmm. I hesitate to point fingers, because none of us know each other, and therefore I could be just as suspicious. I will say I find it odd that such a small child be included. Also, the elf was among the first to die. It could've subsumed their forms, or even consumed their minds to fool us. I hate to follow that line of thought. I find it's better to have people to trust," he finishes. 
            
            That's not exactly helpful in the end, but at least you know his point of view.
        ]
rows.translation:
[flags.DHAWK_FALSE_ACCUSATION
            |你在维克托伯爵拿到那把装饰性刀刃之后追上了他，而他仍在试图拔出那把始终卡在剑鞘里的剑。
            
            “肯定是 [var0
                |如果不是妈妈，那就是那个女孩！
                |如果不是那个女孩，那就是妈妈！
                |他们中的一个人，甚至是他们两个人！
            ]来，用你的武器吧。我相信只要他们还戴着伪装，我们就一定能解决他们，”他绝望地咆哮道。
            
            “等等，肯定还有其他办法的。你有什么依据吗？”你试图安抚他。
            
            “嗯，那唯一的其他办法就是让我来对付他们，对吧？我可不想不战而败，”他回答道，目光仍然紧盯着那两个人，而不是你。看来他已经下定了决心。你最好去看看那两个人的情况。
            
            [party.has Arona
                |当你让维克托继续他的闲聊时，阿罗娜把你拉到了一边。
                
                “嘿， [pc.name]那个家伙之前说的有些话让我觉得不太对劲。一开始我还不确定，但后来确实觉得那些话很让人不舒服。他说要把那座城堡当作度假屋来使用？可我的族人一直以来都在达拉西亚和这里之间的海域活动啊。那里根本没有什么岛屿，更别说有城堡的岛屿了。你想想看，如果有这么一个岛屿，上面只有一座小城堡，而且除了几个女仆之外没有任何防御设施，我们肯定会把那里的东西洗劫一空。天啊，一个没有任何防御设施、只有几个女仆的岛屿……听起来简直就像是我梦寐以求的东西。”她说着，警惕地盯着派对的主人。有意思。
            ]
            |你走向那位面容因紧锁双眉而布满皱纹的伯爵。
            
            “我举办的这场派对真是太棒了……如果这个人说的是实话，那我肯定是在睡梦中去世的。我内心有一部分相信他，因为我不记得在今天之前自己在做什么。这就像一场梦，但却被我们所有人共同分享。肯定不可能我们所有人都在我的城堡里死了，但至少我肯定是死了。这个该死的恶魔把我当作它自己举办派对的主持人，现在它却在这里横行霸道，仿佛这个地方真的是它的所有物一样。那么，在这件事中，你的角色是什么呢？某种天上的仲裁者吗？我能感觉到你与众不同，我相信他们也能看出来。起初，我以为你就是那个怪物，但这个想法很快就从我脑海中消失了，就像水中的油一样，彻底消散了。”他说。 
            
            “我也不确定，但看起来这很可能就是问题的关键所在，”你叹着气回答道。维克多喝了一大口旁边的酒壶里的酒，然后才继续说道。
            
            “我不知道已经过了多久，但终于有机会追求正义，这真是太好了。我们会找到这个过去的残余，把它重新扔回深渊里去，”他举起酒杯，又喝了一口。
            
            “你有什么想法吗？”你问道。
            
            “嗯，我不太愿意指责任何人，因为我们彼此都不了解，所以我也可能同样受到怀疑。不过，我觉得让这么小的孩子参与进来确实很奇怪。另外，那个精灵也是最早死亡的人之一。它可能利用了他们的形态，甚至控制了他们的思想来欺骗我们。我不太愿意这么想，不过我觉得还是有一些人是可以信任的。”他说道。 
            
            虽然这最终并不能带来太大帮助，但至少你能了解他的观点。
        ]

rows.original:
Lumia said all you had to do was resolve whatever conflict you run into. If the conflict in this case is a murder, then all you have to do is determine which person here is the monster. One of them must have tripped up somewhere, but who. [pc.isDK
        |There aren't enough people here for you to have more than a couple chances, so you'd better make it count
        |You still have a chance to save these people, even if they aren't really alive, so you'd better make it count
    ].
    
    But who do you choose?

        |这里的人数不够多，你也就只有几次机会，所以最好这次一定要成功。

rows.original: You point your accusing finger at Victor himself, setting your stance in case he tries anything. "Come now, you can't be serious. What evidence do you have? This is something utterly terrifying, and wherever it's going, it's dragging you along for the ride. Up and up you go, breaking the facsimile of Hawkstone into pieces as you rocket into the sky held in strands of living darkness. Then the sky itself shatters as well, falling around you in shards till you're shunted out into the hall where all this started. "No!" You watch as the monster drains her very essence, siphoning her godly spark like wine from a glass. As it drinks, you see lines of crimson lightning dance inside the previously featureless black mist. The more it drains, the more solid and real it becomes while the entrapped goddess withers down to a husk. The tendrils that once held you lower you gently to the floor, but you still feel inexorably bound to watch what's happening in front of you. One by one, veins of crimson darkness split open along the length of the egg shaped thing. Bursts of fiery red light spew forth from the openings, bathing the whole chamber as their number grows. rows.original:
You raise a finger into the air, and a tense sense of apprehension fills the quiet room. All the attendees are looking to you with grim anticipation. Without dramatic flare, you bring your finger down to point at [var0
        |Shyldren.
        
        "It must be you. You've hidden in the form of this child's mother to draw attention away from yourself!"
        
        "W-what!? No! I swear I had nothing to do with this," she pleads. That's not the reaction you expected, and your gut sinks even further as the seconds pass. Your accusation should've ousted the monster immediately, so if that's not happening...
        |Amione.
        
        "It must be you, hiding in the place we would least expect it!"
        
        "Huh?" the terrified girl asks, pointing to herself. Her mother pulls her into a hug, shielding her from your accusation.
        
        "No! There's no way that could be the truth!" Shyldren shouts. The more seconds that pass, the more you realize they can only be right. Your callout should've exposed the monster immediately. If that's not happening...
        |Talraed.
        
        "It must be you. You were the first to go before, and you got rid of the only person who knew you!"
        
        "But none of us really knew each other! I'd seen Iveryn but I didn't know her. By your logic it should be you! You seem to have knowledge of our fates," he counters, waving your accusing hand away with his own. He's right, gods damn it. Your callout should've exposed the monster immediately. If that's not happening...
    ] 
    
    This time things happen a lot faster than before. The lights snuff out in a whirling vortex of smoke and darkness, and you hear a pained shout before the entire thing fades from your sight.
rows.translation:
你将手指举向空中，顿时，一股紧张的气氛弥漫在了这个寂静的房间里。在场的所有人都怀着紧张而期待的目光注视着你。你没有做任何夸张的动作，只是将手指放下，指向了 [var0
        |希尔德伦。
        
        “一定是你。你伪装成这个孩子的母亲，就是为了转移别人对你的注意！”
        
        “不、不是这样的！我发誓我和这件事毫无关系，”她恳求道。这种反应完全出乎你的预料，随着时间一分一秒地过去，你的心中越来越不安。你的指责本应该立刻让那个怪物露出原形，但如果事实并非如此……
        |阿米奥内。
        
        “一定是你，躲在我们最不可能想到的地方！”
        
        “啊？”那个惊恐的女孩问道，同时指了指自己。她的母亲立刻把她拉进怀里，保护她免受你的指责。
        
        “不！那不可能是真的！”希尔德伦大声喊道。随着时间的流逝，你越来越意识到他们一定是正确的。你的呼喊本应该立刻揭露那个怪物……但如果事实并非如此……
        |塔拉雷德。
        
        “一定是你。你也是第一个离开的人，而且你把那个唯一认识你的人给除掉了！”
        
        “但我们其实谁也不真正了解彼此！我见过艾薇琳，但并不认识她。按照你的逻辑，应该是你才对！你似乎对我们每个人的命运都了如指掌，”他反驳道，用自己的手挡开了你那指责的手。他说得对，该死的。你之前的提醒本应该立刻揭露那个怪物。但如果事实并非如此……
    ] 
    
    这一次，一切发生得比以前快多了。灯光在一片烟雾与黑暗的旋涡中熄灭了，你在看到这一切从视线中消失之前，还听到了一声痛苦的呼喊。
