rows.original:
You've spoken with everyone in the room, and these sword fragments are the most important feeling clue you've found so far. Still, you don't know what you'll need them for, nor do you have them all. Could there be something you're missing? There aren't any windows for you to see if anything is approaching the castle from afar. Only... 
    
    As you think about this, you see a candle snuff out on the upper floor, and then another, and another. In the places where the light fails, utter darkness takes over, filling the space completely. The light from the other nearby candles does nothing to pierce this dark, and it begins to spread faster and faster. Lady Iveryn is the first to react, noticing the darkness creeping in from the other side as well. She draws her sword, and a warm glow spreads around her as magic floods out from her body.
    
    "What is this? What foul magic seeks to drown our festivities!" Count Victor shouts. The rapidly encroaching shadows wink out more and more lights, covering both the count and Jarl Talraed in seconds. Shyldren cries out, pulling her daughter into a shielding embrace. The two men's shouting is abruptly cut off, and you see a change come over Iveryn as you join her in a protective huddle around the seamstress.
    
    "Not this time, monster. You can have me again, but by the goddess you'll take no others this night," she says, her voice a whisper against the woosh of snuffed candles. She raises her sword again, and you see [var0
        |a familiar hilt for a brief moment.
        |the glistening metal of the blade in its full glory.
    ] The light of her magic pushes back the encroaching gloom with a powerful pulse, but on the backswing a hundred tendrils of needle thin shadow jet from the greater blackness and pierce through her. All of you shout together before it closes in around you completely, and everything is dark.
rows.translation:
你已经和房间里的每个人都谈过了，而这些剑碎片是你目前找到的最重要的线索。不过，你仍然不知道自己要拿它们做什么，而且它们也并不齐全。会不会还有什么你遗漏的东西？这里没有任何窗户能让你看清是否有东西从远处逼近城堡。只有…… 
    
    就在你思忖此事时，你看到楼上的一支蜡烛熄灭了，接着又是一支，再一支。在光线消失的地方，彻底的黑暗接管了一切，将整个空间完全吞没。附近其他蜡烛的光芒完全无法穿透这片黑暗，而它开始以越来越快的速度蔓延。艾薇琳女士是第一个做出反应的人，她注意到黑暗也从另一侧悄然逼近。她拔出剑，随着魔力从她体内涌出，一股温暖的光芒在她周围扩散开来。
    
    “这是什么？是什么邪恶的魔法想要淹没我们的庆典！”维克托伯爵大喊道。迅速蔓延的阴影熄灭了一盏又一盏灯，几秒钟之内就把伯爵和塔尔拉德爵士一起吞没。希尔德伦惊叫着，把女儿拉进怀里护住。那两个男人的喊声突然中断，而当你与艾薇琳一起围在那位女裁缝身边结成防护圈时，你注意到她身上发生了变化。
    
    “这次不行，怪物。你可以再次夺走我，但以女神的名义起誓，今晚你不能再夺走任何其他人，”她说道，声音在蜡烛被熄灭的呼呼声中轻如耳语。她再次举起剑，你看到了 [var0
        |有那么一瞬间，那把剑的剑柄显得如此熟悉。
        |那把剑刃闪烁着耀眼的光芒，展现出它全部的威严与美丽。
    ] 她的魔法之光以一股强大的冲击波逼退了逼近的阴霾，但在挥剑回落的瞬间，上百条细如针尖的暗影触须从更浓重的黑暗中喷射而出，贯穿了她的身体。在黑暗彻底合拢将你们包围之前，所有人一起惊呼出声，随后一切归于黑暗。

rows.original: [easy |In the roiling infinity of darkness, you feel a surprising calm fall over you. A familiar voice jumps to the forefront of your mind, and you get a brief image of several wispy balls of light. Think carefully, hero. Something he said doesn't add up. Where do these people call home? And as swiftly as it came, the light is gone. You're left in the agonizing darkness once again. |[atugia.helpingWithLightPalace |You snap [silly |back to reality |to consciousness ] in the depths of Lumia's palace. The miasma is thicker now than it was before, but your eyes come to focus on a collection of glimmering lights that are moving ever so slightly. You can see the familiar glow of Atugia's tattoos as well! It's good to know she's getting the job done on her end. If only you could communicate what's happening on your end. Before you can think of something, you begin fading back into the darkness... ] ] At least... until the candles begin to flit back on, just as they were put out. It starts off slow, but picks up pace till the whole hall is once again lit. Everything looks the same as it did before, until you hear Shyldren cry out and pull her daughter behind you. Lady Iveryn sits in the same seat she was sitting in minutes ago, but her splendid sword is struck straight through the middle of her chest. A number of smaller superficial scratches cover her body, but the stab is definitely fatal. Despite this, she still clings to her last bits of life. "Pfah, not quite like it went before. Then it was painless, but this time... at least it's only me," she says. Her words start off strained, but as she pauses and looks at the rest of you they fill with relief. After that her head dips one final time, and she slowly fades into a whorl of sparkling lights. Her blade drops, but it too disperses before it can even clink to the floor. A single piece fails to disappear, the very tip of the blade that clatters to the ground and comes to rest right at your feet.[var0 | That's the last piece you needed... If only you could have let her know. ] You lean down to pick up the blade's tip, carefully avoiding the sharp portions as you stow it away. "Impossible. She said 'Like before', didn't she? It wasn't a dream then! Curses, I should've known this was some trick of theirs, but I wanted to believe!" the Jarl shouts. He puts a hand to his head, and scatters an arms worth of dinner plates as he spins in your direction. "You lot too, then!? How did it happen for you? She was from the mainland, but that means nothing. I knew deep down that we wouldn't be able to hold off those monsters, but if so great a paladin died as well... Damn it! We were the only defense they had! There's no place else between Dracia and the mainland. How were we supposed to cause any meaningful delay with one island's worth of men? This madness alone is proof we couldn't hold those monsters," he continues. Despite his words, he seems more genuinely angry than crazy. You'd assumed these to be simple representations, but are they actually people? If that's the case, then which of them is a lie? "Oh gods, I... I think he's right. I can't remember. We were in the Winter City, getting ready to evacuate, and then... oh gods," Shyldren says. She shudders and wraps her arms around her child. Count Victor stares at both of them with defiance, but then deflates into a defeated sadness. You look around at each of them. Perhaps you should talk to them again.
rows.translation: [easy |在那无尽的黑暗中，你突然感到一种奇异的平静降临到自己身上。一个熟悉的声音立刻浮现在你的脑海中，同时你也隐约看到了几个微弱的光点。 仔细想想吧，英雄。他说的话有些地方说不通啊。这些人的家乡到底在哪里呢？ 就像它出现得那样迅速，那光芒也消失了。你又一次被沉闷的黑暗所包围。 |[atugia.helpingWithLightPalace |You snap [silly |back to reality |to consciousness ]，发现自己身处卢米娅宫殿的深处。这里的瘴气比之前更浓了，但你的双眼渐渐聚焦在一组正微微移动的微光上。你还能看到阿图吉娅纹身散发出的熟悉光芒！知道她在自己那边顺利完成任务，真让人欣慰。要是你能把自己这边的情况告诉她该多好。还没等你想出办法，你就开始渐渐沉回黑暗之中…… ] ] 至少……直到那些蜡烛开始像被熄灭时那样一支支重新亮起。起初很慢，但速度越来越快，直到整个大厅再次被照亮。一切看起来都和之前一样，直到你听到希尔德伦的惊呼，并看到她把女儿拉到你的身后。 艾薇琳女士仍坐在几分钟前她坐的那个座位上，但她那把华丽的剑笔直地贯穿了她的胸膛。她身上还有许多较浅的擦伤，但这一剑无疑是致命的。尽管如此，她仍然紧抓着生命最后的余烬。 “唉，和之前那次不太一样。那次毫无痛苦，可这次……至少只有我一个人，”她说道。她的话起初很吃力，但当她停下来看着你们其余人时，语气中满含宽慰。随后她的头最后一次垂了下去，她缓缓化为一团闪烁的光点消散了。她的剑落了下来，但还没碰到地板就同样散开了。只有一小块没有消失——那正是剑的尖端，它叮当一声落在地上，恰好停在你脚边。[var0 | 这就是你所需要的最后一样东西了……要是你能让她知道该多好啊。 ] 你俯身拾起剑尖，小心避开锋利的部分，将它收了起来。 “不可能。她说的是‘和之前一样’，对吧？那这就不是梦！该死，我早该知道这是他们的诡计，可我就是想相信！”爵士大声喊道。他用手捂住头，朝你的方向猛地转过身，甩飞了足有一抱之多的餐盘。 “那你们也是这样吗！？你们是怎么遇到的？她来自大陆，可这什么也说明不了。我内心深处就知道，我们根本挡不住那些怪物，可如果连这样伟大的圣骑士也死了……该死！我们已经是他们仅有的防线了！在达拉西亚和大陆之间再没有别的地方。凭一个岛上的人手，我们怎么可能造成任何有意义的拖延？这场疯狂本身就证明了我们挡不住那些怪物，”他继续说道。尽管话里满是激愤，他看起来更像是真的愤怒而非疯癫。你本以为这些只是简单的象征，但他们真的是活人吗？如果是，那么他们之中哪一个才是谎言？ “哦，神啊，我……我想他说得对。我记不起来了。我们当时在冬城，正准备撤离，然后……哦，神啊，”希尔德伦说道。她颤抖着，用双臂抱住自己的孩子。维克托伯爵挑衅地瞪着她们两人，但随后就泄了气，陷入一种挫败的悲伤。你环视着他们每一个人。也许你应该再和他们谈谈。
rows.raw: " [easy |In the roiling infinity of darkness, you feel a surprising calm fall over you. A familiar voice jumps to the forefront of your mind, and you get a brief image of several wispy balls of light. Think carefully, hero. Something he said doesn't add up. Where do these people call home? And as swiftly as it came, the light is gone. You're left in the agonizing darkness once again. |[atugia.helpingWithLightPalace |You snap [silly |back to reality |to consciousness ] in the depths of Lumia's palace. The miasma is thicker now than it was before, but your eyes come to focus on a collection of glimmering lights that are moving ever so slightly. You can see the familiar glow of Atugia's tattoos as well! It's good to know she's getting the job done on her end. If only you could communicate what's happening on your end. Before you can think of something, you begin fading back into the darkness... ] ] At least... until the candles begin to flit back on, just as they were put out. It starts off slow, but picks up pace till the whole hall is once again lit. Everything looks the same as it did before, until you hear Shyldren cry out and pull her daughter behind you. Lady Iveryn sits in the same seat she was sitting in minutes ago, but her splendid sword is struck straight through the middle of her chest. A number of smaller superficial scratches cover her body, but the stab is definitely fatal. Despite this, she still clings to her last bits of life. "Pfah, not quite like it went before. Then it was painless, but this time... at least it's only me," she says. Her words start off strained, but as she pauses and looks at the rest of you they fill with relief. After that her head dips one final time, and she slowly fades into a whorl of sparkling lights. Her blade drops, but it too disperses before it can even clink to the floor. A single piece fails to disappear, the very tip of the blade that clatters to the ground and comes to rest right at your feet.[var0 | That's the last piece you needed... If only you could have let her know. ] You lean down to pick up the blade's tip, carefully avoiding the sharp portions as you stow it away. "Impossible. She said 'Like before', didn't she? It wasn't a dream then! Curses, I should've known this was some trick of theirs, but I wanted to believe!" the Jarl shouts. He puts a hand to his head, and scatters an arms worth of dinner plates as he spins in your direction. "You lot too, then!? How did it happen for you? She was from the mainland, but that means nothing. I knew deep down that we wouldn't be able to hold off those monsters, but if so great a paladin died as well... Damn it! We were the only defense they had! There's no place else between Dracia and the mainland. How were we supposed to cause any meaningful delay with one island's worth of men? This madness alone is proof we couldn't hold those monsters," he continues. Despite his words, he seems more genuinely angry than crazy. You'd assumed these to be simple representations, but are they actually people? If that's the case, then which of them is a lie? "Oh gods, I... I think he's right. I can't remember. We were in the Winter City, getting ready to evacuate, and then... oh gods," Shyldren says. She shudders and wraps her arms around her child. Count Victor stares at both of them with defiance, but then deflates into a defeated sadness. You look around at each of them. Perhaps you should talk to them again. "

rows.original:
You step closer to the castle painting, examining its full majesty. The fortress looks just as, if not more impressive than, the one you're currently in. Its battlements themselves seem to glisten as if carved from sparkling pearl. You can't see anything otherwise special about them through the medium, but the effect is impressive nonetheless. The painting is massive, easily as tall as a man and as wide as the height of two. A label at the base declares it to be 'Castle [silly
            |Camelthot
            |Denizeth
        ]'.
        
        "Ah! Admiring the painting are you?" Count Victor says, walking up alongside you and joining you in admiration. "It's our summer home just off the east coast. I staff it with a skeleton crew of maids year-round just to keep it from falling to disrepair, but we bring more with us when we visit, usually just as summer starts to beat back the spring rains. Honestly, it might be a good place to stay and lie low for a while, just till this mess I'm hearing about at Estelore settles down."
        
        "It certainly looks regal. What mess would you be talking about?" you ask. You get the feeling this could only be related to the Godswar.
        
        "Huh? You know. New bunch of archmages rotated in. I swear more things go wrong in the first few weeks of each change over than any other time. One time I heard they released a plague of pink rats all over the Sailgraves. Can you imagine if those rats had escaped the islands? I thank the gods the ship quartermasters were so vigilant in their examinations," he says. It's certainly an interesting story.
        
        Unfortunately, it doesn't really do much to tell you how close this is to the Wraiths overtaking everything. Nor does it provide much help in discovering what the conflict here is. Unless the conflict is the Godswar itself, in which case you suddenly feel less confident in your prospects. Perhaps you'd better talk to some other people.
rows.translation:
你走近那幅城堡画作，细细端详它的全部宏伟。这座要塞看起来丝毫不逊于、甚至胜于你目前所处的这座城堡。它的城垛本身仿佛由闪亮的珍珠雕琢而成，熠熠生辉。透过画布，你实在看不出它们还有什么特别之处，但这效果依然令人赞叹。这幅画十分巨大，几乎有一人高、两人高那么宽。底座上的标签写着：“城堡[silly
            |Camelthot
            |Denizeth
        ]”。
        
        “啊！你也在欣赏这幅画吗？”维克托伯爵说着，走到你身旁，也一起欣赏起来。“那是我们位于东海岸外的避暑宅邸。我常年派一小队女仆在那里打理，免得它荒废失修，但我们去的时候会多带些人手，通常是在夏天开始逼退春雨的时候。说实话，那也许是个不错的地方，可以躲一阵子，等我在埃斯特洛尔听说的这摊麻烦平息下来再说。”
        
        “它看起来确实很有王者气派。你说的是什么麻烦？”你问道。你感觉这恐怕只可能与神战有关。
        
        “嗯？你知道的。新一批大法师轮换上任了。我发誓，每次换人的头几周出的岔子比任何时候都多。有一次我听说他们在赛尔格雷夫斯一带放出了一场粉色老鼠的瘟疫。你能想象那些老鼠要是逃出群岛会怎样吗？我感谢诸神，船上的军需官检查得如此仔细，”他说。这确实是个有意思的故事。
        
        可惜，这并没怎么帮你弄清楚这里离幽灵们吞没一切还有多远。它也无助于你查明这里的冲突究竟是什么。除非这场冲突本身就是神战——那样的话，你会突然对自己的前景没那么有信心了。也许你最好去找其他人谈谈。

rows.original:
You head towards Lady Iveryn as she's appraising the painting that looks suspiciously like her. She looks up at your approach, smiling when she recognizes you and turning fully away from her scrutiny.

        "Ah, hello again. Did you want something from me?" she asks, struggling to keep her attention on you. "I was just looking at this painting. I don't recall seeing one like it before, but it feels... strangely familiar."
        
        Iveryn's gaze is drawn back to the painting repeatedly, but she tries to stay invested in your presence.
rows.translation:
你朝着艾薇琳女士走去，此时她正在仔细端详一幅与她本人极为相似的画作。当她看到你走过来时，抬起头笑了笑，随即停止了对那幅画的研究。

        “啊，又见到你啦。你有什么事想找我吗？”她问道，努力让自己的注意力集中在你身上。“我只是在看这幅画而已。我不记得以前见过类似的画，但它给人的感觉……莫名地熟悉。”
        
        艾薇琳的目光不断被那幅画吸引，但她还是努力让自己继续关注你的存在。

rows.original:
"I don't think we were properly introduced the first time we spoke, so I suppose I'll start by asking about you. You're one of the var Ridells, correct? That's the ruling family of the Winter City?" you ask.
        
        "Ah yes! You weren't there when our prior conversation began. It was rude of me to not give you a full introduction. I am Princess Iveryn var Ridell, Duchess of the Rimcrest Plains, sister to Queen Atheldred. That being said, as I told Shyldren when I introduced myself to her, please do not call me 'princess' or 'duchess' or anything like that. A simple 'Lady Iveryn' will do just fine." 
        
        "Of course, Lady Iveryn," you say, laughing at the demand she sounds like she has to make constantly. "Are the plains where the displays you were talking about take place?"
        
        "Partly. Practice happens atop the glacier, on the ice flats where I can oversee every movement. The actual parades begin there, and I start with a salute to the sun that would make the Druid Council balk. From there we travel through the city from the great lift to the city gates. After that, we turn around and make our way to the royal keep," she explains, trying to help you visualize with her hands. You've seen the Winter City, so you have a fairly strong image of what she's describing, but you don't stop her. "At each stop, we perform show maneuvers and practice formations. When the final routines are finished, the soldiers are allowed to disperse for the day. A rotation is in place to allow those normally assigned to the gates or the palace to be included and receive some time to relax."
        
        "It sounds so fascinating. And you sound like you're very on top of it."
        
        "Oh yes. I hope I don't sound too prideful when I say this, but I'm sure Lumia herself would be proud of how well prepared my troops are, and I'm sure the Wyld Trees would as well, if it were possible to curry favor with both," she says with a beaming smile.
        
        At her last statement you're hit with a profound and foreign twang of emotion. It feels like... Sadness? Regret? Longing? A mixed bag of forlorn desires that staggers you. The astute crusader notes the change and places a hand on your shoulder.
        
        "Are you alright? Something about this place feels wrong to me as well, so if you need to stop and sit down, I would understand," she says.
        
        "No. I'm fine, but thank you. It was just an odd sensation," you say. You're telling the truth, as well. The feeling has passed now, and the memory of it feels only half real, like someone else was listening to her story with you.
        
        "I'm glad. In that case, was there anything else you wanted to know?"
rows.translation:
“我想我们第一次交谈时并没有被正式介绍过，所以我想先从了解你开始。你是瓦·里德尔家族的人，对吧？那是冬城的统治家族？”你问道。
        
        “啊，没错！我们上次谈话开始时你并不在场，我没有向你做完整的自我介绍，实在失礼。我是艾薇琳·瓦·里德尔公主，边缘平原的女公爵，阿塞尔德雷德女王的妹妹。话虽如此，就像我向希尔德伦自我介绍时说的那样，请不要称呼我‘公主’或‘女公爵’之类的。简单的‘艾薇琳女士’就可以了。” 
        
        “当然，艾薇琳女士，”你说道，对她似乎不得不反复提出这个要求而笑了起来。“你所说的那些表演是在那片平原上举行的吗？”
        
        “部分是。演练在冰川之上进行，就在那些冰原上，我可以纵览每一个动作。真正的游行从那里开始，我首先会向太阳行一个连德鲁伊议会都会瞠目的敬礼。从那里出发，我们穿过整座城市，从大升降台一直到城门。之后我们掉头，前往王城。”她解释道，一边用手比划着帮你想象。你见过冬城，所以她描述的场景你脑中有相当清晰的画面，但你没有打断她。“每到一处，我们都会表演机动动作和队列演练。最后的套路结束后，士兵们就可以解散去休息一天。我们安排了轮换制，好让平时被派去守城门或驻守宫殿的人也能参与其中，并得到一些放松的时间。”
        
        “听起来真迷人。而且你听起来对此非常在行。”
        
        “哦，是的。希望我说这话时不会显得太自负，但我相信卢米娅本人也会为我的部队准备得如此充分而自豪，荒野之树们也会——如果真的能同时讨得两边的欢心的话，”她带着灿烂的笑容说道。
        
        听到她最后一句话，你被一股深沉而陌生的情感猛然击中。那感觉像是……悲伤？懊悔？思念？种种凄凉渴望混杂在一起，让你一阵恍惚。那位敏锐的十字军战士察觉到你的变化，把手放在你的肩上。
        
        “你还好吗？这个地方也让我觉得有些不对劲，所以如果你需要停下来坐一会儿，我能理解，”她说道。
        
        “不，我没事，不过谢谢你。只是种奇怪的感觉，”你说道。你说的也是实话。那种感觉现在已经过去了，对它的记忆也只像半真半假，仿佛有人和你一起听了她的故事。
        
        “那就好。既然这样，你还有其他想知道的吗？”

        "Ah yes! You weren't there when our prior conversation began. It was rude of me to not give you a full introduction. I am Princess Iveryn var Ridell, Duchess of the Rimcrest Plains, sister to Queen Atheldred. That being said, as I told Shyldren when I introduced myself to her, please do not call me 'princess' or 'duchess' or anything like that. A simple 'Lady Iveryn' will do just fine." 
        
        "Of course, Lady Iveryn," you say, laughing at the demand she sounds like she has to make constantly. "Are the plains where the displays you were talking about take place?"
        
        "Partly. Practice happens atop the glacier, on the ice flats where I can oversee every movement. The actual parades begin there, and I start with a salute to the sun that would make the Druid Council balk. From there we travel through the city from the great lift to the city gates. After that, we turn around and make our way to the royal keep," she explains, trying to help you visualize with her hands. rows.original:
"What's happening in the Winter City these days? Are you faring well?" you ask. This might be a good way to gauge the timeline.

        "To be honest... I'm worried. When the refugees first arrived from Dracia a few years ago, they were followed by monsters the likes of which we had never seen. They weren't overwhelming, and we handled them without issue. But they haven't stopped coming, and the problem has been growing exponentially in the last few months. We no longer receive contact from other kingdoms, and this event is the farthest I've been from the Winter City in weeks," she replies, gripping the hilt of her sword till her knuckles pale.
        
        "Recently I've heard even more disturbing reports. Our outlying villages are being picked off the map, and survivors cry of unspeakable horrors: clouds of darkness that drain the life from anything they touch, formless shadows that pass through walls and armor like it's not even there, some bigger than [silly|your mother|buildings or greater than the largest dragons]. The refugees from Dracia told of similar beings, but I didn't want to believe them then. I can no longer afford to lie to myself like that."
        
        "Morale is low in the city, and the damn druids are trying to sway people into believing that it's because some of us stopped worshiping their damn trees. Maybe if they had looked into what was causing their deaths at all in the last..." As she realizes how much of a huff she's working herself into, Iveryn stops, takes a deep breath, and sighs through her teeth. "I'm sorry. That's getting off topic. I shouldn't let politics mar a party. I'm glad that, at least, those nightmarish things haven't reached us yet." 
        
        "It's alright. I'm happy to hear you say it. It's good that we can have moments of happiness despite the unease," you say. This also brings you a solid feeling epiphany. Perhaps these people were plucked from the moments just before their death. It doesn't explain what they are, but [flags.ARCHWAY_SLEEP
            |maybe they're something like Ander and Ria from Nareva's mind realm. If that's the case then maybe it isn't too late for Lumia to save them after all, in some fashion at least.
            |maybe there's a way they can be saved in some fashion.
        ]
rows.translation:
“这些天冬城怎么样？你过得还好吗？”你问道。这或许是个判断时间线的好办法。

        “说实话……我很担心。几年前难民最初从达拉西亚来到这里时，身后跟着一些我们从未见过的怪物。它们算不上铺天盖地，我们也顺利应付了过去。可它们一直没有停止涌来，而这个问题在过去几个月里呈指数级恶化。我们再也收不到其他王国的联络了，而这次的事是我几周以来离冬城最远的一次，”她回答道，紧握着剑柄，指节都握得发白。
        
        “最近我听到了更令人不安的消息。我们偏远的村庄正一个个从地图上被抹去，幸存者哭诉着难以言说的恐怖：能夺走所触之物生命的黑暗云团、能像根本不存在一样穿墙透甲的无形阴影，还有些比[silly|你妈|建筑物还要庞大、甚至比最大的巨龙还要巨大]。来自达拉西亚的难民也讲述过类似的存在，但当时我不愿相信他们。如今我再也没法这样自欺欺人了。”
        
        “城里的士气很低，而那些该死的德鲁伊还在试图让人相信，这都是因为我们有些人不再崇拜他们那些该死的树木。要是他们当初肯认真查一查究竟是什么害死了他们的人，就在过去……”当她意识到自己越说越上火时，伊薇琳停了下来，深吸一口气，从齿缝间叹了出来。“抱歉。我扯远了。我不该让政治扫了聚会的兴。至少，那些噩梦般的东西还没找上我们，这让我很欣慰。” 
        
        “没关系。我很高兴听你说出来。尽管周遭不安，我们仍能有愉快的时刻，这是件好事，”你说道。这也给你带来一种踏实而清晰的顿悟。也许这些人都是从他们临死前的那一刻被摘取出来的。这解释不了他们究竟是什么，但[flags.ARCHWAY_SLEEP
            |也许他们就像娜瑞瓦意识领域里的安德和莉亚那样的存在。若真是如此，那或许卢米娅终究还来得及以某种方式拯救他们。
            |也许有某种办法能够拯救他们。
        ]

rows.original:
"[etheryn.lowConfidence
            |Um, ma'am.
            |Excuse me, ma'am.
        ] I was wondering if you wouldn't mind talking about the royal family a bit more. I'm, err, curious about that kind of thing, and I like hearing about the lives of royals," Ryn asks, blushing [etheryn.lnhConfidence
            |deeply
            |a ruddy red
            |a little
        ] after her question. Iveryn chuckles, turning to the smaller woman with a smile.
        
        "Of course! I'll enjoy talking about something happy for a change. Where do I begin? Me and my sister get along well, and I'm on good terms with several of her consorts as well. But most of them are more in line with the druids, and I fear my poor sister is being torn in two trying to please both sides. I hate that we're fighting while our people are dying. In my opinion we should leave this petty tension until after these demons have been destroyed. It matters not to me who worships who, but I'll not have them harming my people by inaction," she starts, stopping herself before she can get too heated.
        
        "In happier news, while I don't agree fully with Consort Synneva's beliefs, I can't hate her personally. She brings happiness to my sister, and quite obviously cares deeply for her. On top of that, little Alraince is quite possibly the most adorable child in the Winter City. She's learned to avoid me when I come to visit, unfortunately, because the first time I wouldn't stop showering her with smooches. I'll have to bribe her with something next time, perhaps her favorite candy... Are you alright, dear? You're tearing up," Iveryn asks, putting an arm on Ryn's shoulder.
        
        Your elven companion is indeed on the verge of tears that started when the paladin princess began talking about her mother. She wipes the first round on her sleeve and tries to gather herself enough to talk without sobbing.
        
        "I-I'm sorry. It's just... My mother died in childbirth, so I sometimes get like this, even when I'm happy," she half-fibs. Iveryn takes her in a big hug, holding her tight before continuing.
        
        "Oh, dear one. I'm so sorry. Alraince is actually quite the blessing for my sister. She's also suffered from tragedy, and none of her other children have survived as long. Know that you aren't alone, even in the face of such hardship. Whether it's a god, or your family, or just a friend: someone will be there to support you," she says.
        
        Etheryn stifles more sobs, breathing heavily in her great-aunt's embrace. When the tears stop, she pulls back with a thankful smile.
        
        "Thank you for telling me, I'm [etheryn.lowConfidence
            |s-
        ]sorry I made a mess of things."
        
        "Don't be sorry. Thank you for trusting me enough to tell me something so personal. I'm only sorry that it seems impossible to stay cheery in this place. Is there anything else you wanted to hear about?"
rows.translation:
“[etheryn.lowConfidence
            |嗯，女士。
            |打扰一下，女士。
        ]我在想，你是否愿意再多讲讲王室家族的事。我，呃，对这类事情很好奇，也喜欢听王室成员的生平，”瑞恩问道，问完之后脸红得[etheryn.lnhConfidence
            |厉害极了
            |一片通红
            |一点点
        ]。艾薇琳轻笑了一声，转向那位身材较矮的女性，脸上带着微笑。
        
        “当然可以！换个话题聊点开心的事，我会很享受的。该从哪里说起呢？我和妹妹相处得很好，也和她的几位伴侣关系不错。但他们大多更亲近德鲁伊一派，我怕我可怜的妹妹为了两边都讨好而被撕成两半。我讨厌在我们的人民正在死去的时候还在内斗。在我看来，我们应该把这些琐碎的矛盾放到这些恶魔被消灭之后。谁崇拜谁对我来说无所谓，但我绝不允许他们因无所作为而伤害我的人民，”她开始说道，在情绪过于激动之前及时打住。
        
        “说点高兴的事吧。虽然我并不完全认同伴侣辛妮瓦的信仰，但我没法真的讨厌她。她给我妹妹带来了幸福，而且显然非常在乎她。除此之外，小艾尔兰丝大概是冬城最可爱的孩子了。可惜她学会了在我来访时躲开我，因为第一次见面时我一个劲地亲她，怎么也停不下来。下次我得拿点什么贿赂她，也许是她最喜欢的糖果……你还好吗，亲爱的？你眼眶都湿了，”艾薇琳问道，同时把一只手搭在瑞恩肩上。
        
        你的精灵伙伴确实快要哭出来了——这一切是从那位圣骑士公主开始谈起她的母亲时开始的。她用袖子擦去第一波泪水，努力平复到自己能不出声抽泣地说话。
        
        “对、对不起。只是……我母亲死于难产，所以我有时会这样，即使是在开心的时候，”她半真半假地说道。艾薇琳把她拥进一个大大的拥抱，紧紧抱着她，然后才继续。
        
        “哦，可怜的孩子。我真的很抱歉。艾尔兰丝其实是我妹妹的一大福气。她也经历过悲剧，而她的其他孩子没有一个活得像她这么久。你要知道，即便面对这样的苦难，你也不是孤单一人。无论是神、你的家人，还是仅仅一个朋友：总会有人在你身边支持你，”她说道。
        
        伊瑟琳强忍住更多的抽泣，在曾姑母的怀抱中沉重地呼吸着。当泪水止住时，她退开身子，露出一个感激的微笑。
        
        “谢谢你告诉我，我[etheryn.lowConfidence
            |很抱歉——对不——
        ]对不起，我把事情弄得一团糟，”她说道。
        
        “别说对不起。谢谢你信任我，愿意告诉我这么私人的事。我只是遗憾，在这个地方似乎很难保持愉快。还有其他你想听的吗？”

rows.original: The monster collapses, unable to hold its writhing mass up as it clicks into complete reality. The thing writhes in pain as the dream world dissolves around it. It screams words you can't understand, cycling through rage and fear in equal measure. You've done it! This will be the monster's end. You catch a brief glimpse of [flags.DHAWK_FALSE_ACCUSATION |Shyldren and her daughter, smiling as they too fade to nothingness |the three surviving elves, smiling at you as they too fade into nothingness ]. With the illusory world gone, you can see [atugia.helpingWithLightPalace |Atugia standing on the dias that holds up the glass dome. Flickering blue rune energy flares around her body, pushing back a wall of living darkness that's writhing in what you can only hope are its death throes. She pushes forward, and you see the fragments of the blade from before punch straight through to the other side. The fragments are wreathed in the same power as her body, letting them extend much farther than a regular blade. |the Wraith, now an entirely physical presence, collapsed and struggling to move. Lances of sunlight skewer its body, and it bleeds ichor from wounds you caused in the dream world. You move closer, drawing your real [pc.weapon] and advancing to finish the thing off. ] "That's it! Show this overgrown nightmare that light prevails over despair!" Lumia shouts, raising her sword toward the beast and blasting it with a ray of raw sunlight. With its form solidified, the Wraith has no way to escape the powerful onslaught, and you watch as its edges begin to fray and turn to dust. The effect spreads rapidly, as larger and larger chunks fall away and disappear before they can hit the ground. Between the two of [atugia.helpingWithLightPalace |them |you ], the great dark beast is powerless to prevent itself from dissolving completely. One mote of darkness resists for a scant moment longer than the others, but [atugia.helpingWithLightPalace |Atugia pulls back and twirls the sword fragments like a whip, slicing directly through the tiny shadow ball and eradicating it completely |you strike out at that last sad little blob with [var0 |a simple spell |your [pc.weapon] ] ]. It disappears with a dry pop, and the change in the air is immediate. With the Wraith gone, the miasma over the palace lifts in a blink. You have to cover your eyes at the sudden brightness of everything, so you're caught completely off guard when [atugia.helpingWithLightPalace |Atugia tackles you in a hug. "You did it, [pc.name]! Wait, you look kind of pale, are you ok?" she exclaims, holding your shoulder. |Lumia claps you on the back. "We did it, hero! Oh! Oh dear," she exclaims. You didn't really feel it before, but every muscle feels overexerted, and you stagger in place, falling out of her grip and staggering to the floor. ] [party.som |Exhaustion dims your vision, and makes it hard to get enough air. |You can see [companion1.name] in a similar state, struggling to get enough air. |You can see your companions in a similar state, struggling to get enough air. ] Before you collapse any further, you feel a warm embrace and see the face of the goddess as she picks you up. "Being in mental contact with a Wraith is as taxing on the body as it is on the mind. Come on, great hero. Let's get you somewhere you can sleep and recover. I'll [party.solo |make sure you're safe as long as you're here |make sure your friends get the same treatment ]," she says, turning towards the stairs that return to the upper palace. You doze off in her arms, feeling safe as a child in the arms of its mother.
rows.translation: 怪物瘫倒了，它再也无法支撑自己那不断扭动的身躯，因为它已经完全融入了现实世界。当梦境世界逐渐消散时，它痛苦地扭动着身体，发出一些你根本听不懂的叫声，其中既有愤怒，也有恐惧。你做到了！这就是这个怪物的末日。你短暂地看到了[flags.DHAWK_FALSE_ACCUSATION |希尔德伦和她的女儿微笑着，也渐渐消失在了虚无之中。 |那三个幸存下来的精灵，也对你微笑着，然后渐渐消失在虚无之中。 ]。 当那虚幻的世界消失后，你就能看清一切了。[atugia.helpingWithLightPalace |阿图吉娅站在支撑着玻璃穹顶的基座上。她的身周闪烁着蓝色的符文能量，这些能量正在抵御那股不断蠕动、仿佛正处于死亡挣扎中的黑暗力量。她向前冲去，只见之前那把剑的碎片直接穿透了黑暗，直达另一侧。这些碎片同样被她体内的力量所驱动，因此它们的攻击范围远超普通的剑刃。 |那具如今已完全化为实体的怨灵瘫倒在地，挣扎着想要移动。阳光如长矛般刺穿它的身体，你在梦境世界中造成的伤口正渗出脓血。你走近些，抽出你真正的[pc.weapon]，上前了结这东西。 ] “就是现在！让这团肆意蔓延的噩梦见识一下，光明是如何战胜绝望的！”卢米娅高声喊道，她举剑指向那头怪物，用一束纯粹的阳光轰击它。随着它的形态凝固，怨灵再也无法逃脱这猛烈的攻势，你眼看着它的边缘开始崩解、化为尘土。这种效果迅速蔓延，越来越大的碎块脱落下来，还没落地就消失不见。 在[atugia.helpingWithLightPalace |他们 |你 ]两人夹击之下，那头巨大的暗影巨兽根本无力阻止自己彻底消散。有一粒暗影颗粒比其他颗粒多坚持了片刻，但最终[atugia.helpingWithLightPalace |阿图吉娅后退一步，将那些剑碎片像鞭子一样甩出去，它们直接切穿了那个小小的阴影球，将其彻底消灭了。 |你向那个可怜的小团块发起了攻击[var0 |一个简单的咒语 |你的[pc.weapon] ] ]，随着一声干燥的啪响，它消失了，空气中的变化立竿见影。 随着“幽灵”的消失，宫殿上方的阴霾瞬间消散。突如其来的明亮光线令你不得不闭上眼睛，因此当你[atugia.helpingWithLightPalace |阿图吉娅用一个拥抱扑到了你身上。 “你做到了，[pc.name]！等等，你看起来脸色有点苍白，你没事吧？”她一边说着，一边握住了你的肩膀。 |卢米娅拍了拍你的背。 “我们成功了，英雄！哦，天哪，”她惊呼道。之前你可能没有感觉到，但现在你的每一块肌肉都仿佛被过度使用了，你踉跄着站在原地，最终从她的手中滑落，跌坐在了地上。 ] [party.som |疲惫使你的视线变得模糊，同时也让人难以获得足够的空气。 |你可以看到[companion1.name]处于类似的状况，也在努力获取足够的空气。 |你看到你的同伴们也处于同样的状况，同样喘不过气来。 ]就在你即将彻底崩溃之前，你感受到了一道温暖的怀抱，同时也看到了那位女神的面容——她将你抱了起来。 “与怨灵进行精神上的交流，对身心都是极大的考验。来吧，伟大的英雄，我们带你去一个可以让你休息和恢复的地方吧。我[party.solo |只要你待在这里，就一定能保证自己的安全。 |确保你的朋友们也能得到同样的待遇。 ]，”她说道，转身走向通往上层宫殿的楼梯。你在她的怀抱中渐渐入睡，像孩子躺在母亲怀里一样安心。
rows.raw: " The monster collapses, unable to hold its writhing mass up as it clicks into complete reality. The thing writhes in pain as the dream world dissolves around it. It screams words you can't understand, cycling through rage and fear in equal measure. You've done it! This will be the monster's end. You catch a brief glimpse of [flags.DHAWK_FALSE_ACCUSATION |Shyldren and her daughter, smiling as they too fade to nothingness |the three surviving elves, smiling at you as they too fade into nothingness ]. With the illusory world gone, you can see [atugia.helpingWithLightPalace |Atugia standing on the dias that holds up the glass dome. Flickering blue rune energy flares around her body, pushing back a wall of living darkness that's writhing in what you can only hope are its death throes. She pushes forward, and you see the fragments of the blade from before punch straight through to the other side. The fragments are wreathed in the same power as her body, letting them extend much farther than a regular blade. |the Wraith, now an entirely physical presence, collapsed and struggling to move. Lances of sunlight skewer its body, and it bleeds ichor from wounds you caused in the dream world. You move closer, drawing your real [pc.weapon] and advancing to finish the thing off. ] "That's it! Show this overgrown nightmare that light prevails over despair!" Lumia shouts, raising her sword toward the beast and blasting it with a ray of raw sunlight. With its form solidified, the Wraith has no way to escape the powerful onslaught, and you watch as its edges begin to fray and turn to dust. The effect spreads rapidly, as larger and larger chunks fall away and disappear before they can hit the ground. Between the two of [atugia.helpingWithLightPalace |them |you ], the great dark beast is powerless to prevent itself from dissolving completely. One mote of darkness resists for a scant moment longer than the others, but [atugia.helpingWithLightPalace |Atugia pulls back and twirls the sword fragments like a whip, slicing directly through the tiny shadow ball and eradicating it completely |you strike out at that last sad little blob with [var0 |a simple spell |your [pc.weapon] ] ]. It disappears with a dry pop, and the change in the air is immediate. With the Wraith gone, the miasma over the palace lifts in a blink. You have to cover your eyes at the sudden brightness of everything, so you're caught completely off guard when [atugia.helpingWithLightPalace |Atugia tackles you in a hug. "You did it, [pc.name]! Wait, you look kind of pale, are you ok?" she exclaims, holding your shoulder. |Lumia claps you on the back. "We did it, hero! Oh! Oh dear," she exclaims. You didn't really feel it before, but every muscle feels overexerted, and you stagger in place, falling out of her grip and staggering to the floor. ] [party.som |Exhaustion dims your vision, and makes it hard to get enough air. |You can see [companion1.name] in a similar state, struggling to get enough air. |You can see your companions in a similar state, struggling to get enough air. ] Before you collapse any further, you feel a warm embrace and see the face of the goddess as she picks you up. "Being in mental contact with a Wraith is as taxing on the body as it is on the mind. Come on, great hero. Let's get you somewhere you can sleep and recover. I'll [party.solo |make sure you're safe as long as you're here |make sure your friends get the same treatment ]," she says, turning towards the stairs that return to the upper palace. You doze off in her arms, feeling safe as a child in the arms of its mother. "

rows.original:
You snap to wakefulness from the depths of a warm and relaxing dream about clouds and soft pillows. Confusion takes you at first, because the bed you're lying on is just as soft as that of your dream, and your head is propped on a downy pillow that's even softer. Stretching groggily, you push up onto your elbow and rub the exhaustion out of your eyes. Your whole body feels much better than it did... a few minutes? An hour? A day ago? You have no idea how long you've been sleeping. Any panic is muted by the feeling of safety that pervades this place, but you still fret a little till your eyes settle on Lumia herself, reclined on a couch by the door.
    
    The goddess is wearing a much more casual outfit. A loose cloth garment that leaves one of her sizable breasts completely uncovered. The outfit isn't completely sheer, but you can see the dark imprint of her other nipple through the side that is covered. Her legs are left uncovered as well, though a wide portion of the outfit does cover them from behind, along with her ass. A silver thong covers her crotch, leaving just enough to the imagination. She looks a lot more composed than she did before as well, relaxing on the seat and watching you thoughtfully.
    
    "Good morning, hero. I was honestly expecting you to sleep for longer. You went through something extremely taxing, and it's ok to keep resting," she says, rising to her feet and clasping her hands at her waist. While she's no less regal, it's somehow surreal to see her outside her usual warlike regalia.
    
    "[pc.dcb
        |No. I think I'm fine,
        |I feel fine, thank you,
        |I'll be ok. I'm, like, really bouncy! Err, good at bouncing back,
    ]" you reply. Sitting up, you try to rub the last of your tiredness from your body. It works pretty well, and you're able to stand without feeling woozy or lethargic. "Your bedding really helped, I think. What happened after I passed out? I remember us winning, but after that there's nothing."
    
    "Yes! We won. The effects were immediate too. It's only been one night, but most of the valkyries should return soon. In fact, some of them are waiting to see you right now! I've been in a rush getting caught up on things I was too distracted to change. I'm glad you've recovered so quickly, because most of the news I've been getting today has been heavy," she says, pinching the bridge of her nose. A rush of emotion twists her face into a mask of sadness before she scrunches her eyes shut and shakes it away. Then she sighs shakily and gives you an honest smile.
    
    "But hope is something I always keep close, and it's not too late to right the aftereffects of these wrongs. I'd like to talk more, and I owe you a few things, given you've done so much for my followers and for me. For now, though, I'm sure you're aching to see your friends again, and I won't keep you long. If you need anything while you're in the palace, just ask any of the valkyries," she continues, striding to the door when she finishes. You follow her out, and down a simple flight of steps that leads into the hall near the throne room. 
    
    [flags.DHAWK_TUI_PARTY
        |Atugia and the rest of your allies are waiting for you when you enter the hall, and [party.solo
            |
            |the bright haired dullahan 
        ]rushes into a tackle hug that staggers your forward momentum. 
        
        "Thank the gods you're ok! Or, um, I guess one goddess in particular right now. Thank you, ma'am," she says, bowing her head to Lumia and turning back to you with a burning red flush in her cheeks. "Miss Lumia said I could keep the fragments of the blade. I'm gonna try to use them to commune with the ancient valkyries! I don't know what kind of stories they can tell, but I'm excited to hear them!"
        
        She certainly seems excited!
        
        "Yes. I have no more use for the blade. It's only a reminder of something I couldn't overcome alone. All it would do is bring me down. She expressed enough interest, and she was the one who used it best in our fateful encounter. It's curious, though, girl. Whatever magic shielded you before seems to be gone now. I've no idea what its true purpose was, but if it turns out to be sinister, know that you can turn to me for protection. And be done with 'miss' and 'ma'am' You all have done me a service greater than I'm sure you comprehend at the moment. Call me by my name," Lumia says, crossing her arms in a playful huff.
        
        "Oh, I don't know if I could, um... is Lady Lumia ok?" Tui asks meekly. The goddess sighs and rolls her eyes, but looks mollified.
        
        "I suppose that will do if you must insist on doing it," she replies. "Now then! Shall we go meet some valkyries?"
        |[party.solo
            |"[silly
                |Jeeze. You're really trying to make this lone wolf thing work, aren't you? You know this game was designed for party combat, right?" Lumia asks
                |It's hard to believe you've made it this far alone, brave hero, but you don't have to be alone any longer," Lumia says
            ], putting an arm around your shoulder. "Let's go meet some valkyries, shall we?"
            |Each of your companions is waiting in the hall when you get there, and they tackle you in a group hug. Once you've extricated yourself from the hug, Lumia puts an arm around your shoulder.
            
            "I took the liberty of gathering your friends. Shall we go meet some valkyries and all talk it over? They've been aching to meet you," she says, guiding you to the entryway to the east hall.
        ]
    ]
rows.translation:
你从一场关于云朵与柔软枕头的温暖惬意梦境中猛然醒来。起初你有些困惑，因为你躺着的床和梦中的床一样柔软，头下的羽绒枕头更是柔软得多。你昏昏沉沉地伸了个懒腰，用胳膊肘撑起身子，揉了揉眼睛，驱散残留的倦意。你整个人感觉比……几分钟前？一小时前？一天前？你完全不知道自己睡了多久。弥漫在这地方的安心感压下了你的惊慌，但你心里还是有点不安，直到你的目光落在卢米娅本人身上——她正斜倚在门边的沙发上。
    
    这位女神换了一身随意得多的装束。一件宽松的布衣，将她一边丰满的乳房完全露在外面。这身衣服并非完全透明，但透过遮住的那一侧，你能看见她另一颗乳头深色的轮廓。她的双腿同样裸露在外，不过衣服的很大一部分从身后罩住了双腿和臀部。一条银色丁字裤遮住她的私处，留下的想象空间恰到好处。她看上去也比之前从容了许多，放松地坐在座位上，若有所思地打量着你。
    
    “早上好，英雄。说实话，我本以为你会睡得更久一些。你刚刚经历的事情极其耗费心力，继续休息也没关系，”她说着站起身来，双手交叠在腰前。她依旧威严不减，但看到她没穿那身惯用的战装，总觉得有些不太真实。
    
    “[pc.dcb
        |不。我想我没事，
        |我感觉很好，谢谢你，
        |我不会有事的。我这人，呃，特别有弹性！就是恢复得特别快，
    ]”你回答道。你坐起身，想把身上最后一点倦意揉掉。效果还不错，你站起来时没有头晕，也没有乏力。“我想，你的被褥真的帮了大忙。我昏过去之后发生了什么？我记得我们赢了，但之后就什么都不记得了。”
    
    “是的！我们赢了。效果也是立竿见影。只过了一晚，但大多数女武神应该很快就会回来。事实上，现在就有几位等着见你呢！我一直忙着补上那些我之前分心没顾上的事。我很高兴你恢复得这么快，因为今天我听到的消息大多很沉重，”她说着，捏了捏鼻梁。一阵情绪涌上来，让她的脸扭成悲伤的面具，随后她紧闭双眼，把这情绪甩开。接着她颤抖着叹了口气，给了你一个真诚的微笑。
    
    “但希望是我始终贴身珍视之物，而要弥补这些错误造成的后果，现在也不算太晚。我想和你多聊聊，而且我欠你几样东西，毕竟你为我的追随者、也为我做了这么多。不过眼下，我确信你急着想再见到你的朋友们，我不会占用你太久。你在宫殿里若需要什么，随便找哪位女武神开口就行，”她说完便大步走向门口。你跟着她出去，沿一段简单的台阶走下去，来到王座厅附近的大厅。 
    
    [flags.DHAWK_TUI_PARTY
        |当你走进大厅时，阿图吉娅和你的其余盟友正等着你，而[party.solo
            |
            |那个金发杜拉汉 
        ]冲上来一把抱住你，撞得你往前一趔趄。 
        
        “谢天谢地你没事！或者，嗯，我想现在该特别感谢某位女神。谢谢您，夫人，”她说着向卢米娅低下头，然后转回你这边，脸颊涨得通红。“卢米娅小姐说我可以留下那把剑的碎片。我要试着用它们与古代的女武神们沟通！我不知道它们能讲出什么样的故事，但我很期待听到！”
        
        她看起来确实很兴奋！
        
        “是的。那把剑对我再没有用了。它只会让我想起某件我独自无法克服的事，只会让我消沉。她表现出了足够的兴趣，而在我们那场命中注定的交锋中，也是她把剑用得最好。不过，真奇怪啊，姑娘。之前护住你的那股魔法，如今似乎已经消失了。我不知道它真正的目的是什么，但如果它其实是邪恶的，记住你可以来找我寻求保护。还有，别再叫什么‘小姐’和‘夫人’了。你们为我做的事，远比你们此刻所能理解的更为重大。直接叫我的名字，”卢米娅双臂交叉，故作恼怒地说道。
        
        “哦，我不知道自己能不能做到，嗯……叫卢米娅女士可以吗？”崔怯生生地问道。女神叹了口气，翻了个白眼，但看起来还是消了气。
        
        “如果你非要坚持的话，我想也行吧，”她回答道。“那么！我们去见见女武神们吧？”
        |[party.solo
            |“[silly
                |“天哪。你是真的铁了心要把这种独行侠的路子走到底，是吧？你知道这游戏本来就是为团队作战设计的吧？”卢米娅问道
                |很难相信你竟然独自走到了这一步，勇敢的英雄，但你不必再孤身一人了，”卢米娅说道
            ]，说着用一只手臂搂住你的肩膀。“我们去见见女武神们，怎么样？”
            |等你到那里时，你的每位同伴都在大厅里等着，他们一拥而上给了你一个集体拥抱。等你好不容易从拥抱里脱身出来，卢米娅用一只手臂搂住了你的肩膀。
            
            “我自作主张把你的朋友们都召集来了。我们去见见女武神们，把一切都谈开，怎么样？她们一直盼着见你呢，”她说着，引你走向东侧大厅的入口。
        ]
    ]

rows.original: Before you loom the great doors, and beyond them the slightly-muted hubbub of what sounds like a city's worth of voices. You raise an eyebrow, then look over to Lumia. "How many valkyries did you say were out there again?" "Almost all of them — at least, almost all of the ones who were closest to the palace," she says, smiling. And with a wave of her hand, the doors creak open. What had once been a dark, dusty chamber is now full of light. Thousands of candles flicker around the room, lending it the bright warmth of the morning sun. And beyond that, hundreds of pairs of glowing wings attached to hundreds of women turn that sun-warmth into something soft and magical. Now that it's fully lit, you can see just how massive the hall is from within, how stuffed with paintings and tapestries and frescoes and murals and mosaics and most importantly people. The place is as full as the Winter City's marketplace, but instead of goodmen buying food or craftswomen hawking their wares, it's full of warriors. Most are frost elves, but a sizable minority are human and other women from the south, along with northern mino-women, jotuns, siorcanna, and other natives of the Rift lands. They stand in great crowds of laughing compatriots, small knots of close friends, bonded couples and thruples. They hover in the air to chat, to hug, to fly circles around each other. There are hundreds of them, maybe even more than a thousand, and despite the banged-up armor and injuries many of them sport, there isn't a single one of them that you can see that looks anything but relieved or overjoyed. [pc.dcb |"Damn." You let out a low whistle. "Nice army." "They are far more than that," she says fondly. |You suddenly realize you have to close your mouth before something flies in. Only after doing that do you figure out what to say. "Wow." Not one of your more eloquent moments, but appropriate enough. "Yes." Lumia's tone is that of an unimaginably proud mom. "Wow." |"Gosh," you gasp. "There's so many sun mommies!" "There are," she says delightedly. "And I love them all so much." ] As more and more valkyries become aware of your presence, and that of their goddess, they turn to face you. Clapping ripples back from their front ranks, followed by cheers, rising to a proud, happy roar that thunders through the hall. You remember what these valkyries were doing all this time, see the evidence of damaged armor and damaged bodies, and you can only imagine the frustration and pain that they're all letting out by cheering [party.yall] on. And as for you, well, basking in the praise of an entire holy order of Lumia's chosen would lift anybody's spirits. After a short eternity of basking, Lumia raises her hand and the cheers and claps slowly die down. "I know that there is a lot of gratitude to go around in these halls, [pc.name], so know first and foremost of all that you and your companions remain welcome in this place. Hopefully we will continue to see plenty of you here; I know you will see more of my warriors out there." She stills another incipient cheer and smiles. "Don't worry. You'll have plenty of opportunities to speak in the future... or, perhaps, fight side-by-side."
rows.translation: 在你面前矗立着巨大的门扉，门后传来略显沉闷的喧闹，听起来像是有整整一座城的人在说话。你挑了挑眉，然后看向卢米娅。“你刚才说外面有多少女武神来着？” “几乎全都来了——至少，是离宫殿最近的那些人几乎都来了，”她微笑着说道。她挥了挥手，大门吱呀作响地打开了。 曾经昏暗、积尘的厅堂如今充满了光。成千上万支蜡烛在房间里摇曳，赋予了它清晨阳光般的明亮暖意。而在那之外，数百对发光的翅膀附着在数百位女性身上，把这份阳光般的温暖化为某种柔和而神奇的东西。既然现在已经灯火通明，你便能从内部看出这座大厅有多么巨大，里面塞满了多少画作、挂毯、湿壁画、壁画和马赛克，而最重要的是——人。 这里和冬城的市集一样挤得满满当当，但这里不是在买食物的好汉或兜售货物的女工匠，而是挤满了战士。她们大多是霜精灵，但也有不少来自南方的人类和其他女性，还有北方的米诺女性、约顿女巨人、希奥卡纳人，以及裂谷之地的其他原住民。她们三五成群地站在大笑的同袍之间，或是关系亲密的小圈子、结成伴侣或三人伴侣。她们悬在空中聊天、拥抱，互相绕着圈飞。她们有数百人，甚至可能超过一千，尽管许多人身上带着打仗撞坏的盔甲和伤口，但你看到的每一个人脸上都只有如释重负或欣喜若狂。 [pc.dcb |“该死。”你低声吹了个口哨。“好一支军队。” “她们远不止如此，”她满怀深情地说道。 |你突然意识到，得赶紧把嘴闭上，免得有什么东西飞进去。直到闭上之后，你才想起该说什么。“哇。” 这算不上你最舌灿莲花的时刻，但也足够应景了。 “是啊。”卢米娅的语气就像一位骄傲得难以想象的老妈。“哇。” |“天哪，”你倒吸一口气。“好多太阳妈妈呀！” “确实有，”她欣喜地说道。“而且我特别爱她们每一个。” ] 随着越来越多的女武神注意到你的存在，以及她们的女神的到来，她们纷纷转身面向你。掌声从她们的前排一波波传开，接着是欢呼声，升腾成一阵自豪而快乐的吼声，响彻整座大厅。你记得这些女武神这段时间一直在做什么，也看到了那些受损的盔甲和身体的证据，你只能想象她们通过为 [party.yall] 欢呼释放出了多少挫败与痛苦。 至于你，沐浴在卢米娅所选中的整个神圣骑士团的赞美之中，任谁的士气都会被提振起来。 在漫长的享受之后，卢米娅抬起手，欢呼与掌声渐渐平息。“我知道这些厅堂里有太多感激需要表达，[pc.name]，所以首先你要知道，你和你的同伴在这个地方始终是受欢迎的。希望我们能在这里经常见到你们；我知道你们在外面还会见到更多我的战士。”她再次止住一阵刚起的欢呼，微笑着。“别担心。将来你们会有很多机会发言的……或者，也许还会并肩作战。”

rows.original: A bewildering kaleidoscope of colors and races awaits you in the throng as Lumia leads you over to them. Near the forefront, you see a familiar face: Annika, the blue-skinned valkyrie who got you into this whole mess in the first place. Her armor looks much the same as you remember it, bronze chestplate over white robes, but there's an addition: in one hand, she's holding a large golden sun-flare pendant on a necklace, big enough to be a badge of office[silly | or one of those security badges that media people, government employees, and contractors wear ]. "And there you are," she says proudly, giving you a firm, two-handed handshake. "Didn't I tell you about getting more help?" [pc.dcb |"Who knew, right? Maybe they're everything you say they are." "Guess you'll have to find out. |"That warrior's intuition you mentioned is pretty good. Thanks for getting this whole thing going." "You're welcome. Don't mention it, though. I just gave you a little push. |"You diiiid!" you gush. "This is just so many happy friendly sun mommies!" Not just Annika, but several of the other valkyries around you laugh at that. "Oh, sweetheart. Happy and friendly are pretty easy around you! ] At any rate, here we are! Well, a bunch of us." She makes a face. "There are still a lot of sisters back east holding the passes; the Wraith-touched didn't vanish into thin air. But we could still tell as soon as it happened. They're less coordinated, less focused, easier to fight. We don't need the balance of the Order over there to handle them anymore... which means we can rest, refit, and start flying south to help fight demons and the Cult." "Fighting the Cult, huh? Not before time, either! We could use the change of scenery." An enormous elf, ten feet tall if she's an inch, pushes her way through the crowd to meet you, with a nearly-as-enormous northern minotaur in tow. Beaming, Annika reaches up for a one-armed hug. Gesturing first to the jotun-sized elven woman and then to the minotauress, she says, "[pc.name], Thrud and Hjörr are two of the finest warriors I know. We've served together for a very long time." "A very long time, she says. Anni's one of the only sisters left who remembers when I was still a mentee," chuckles Thrud. Hjörr lifts an eyebrow. "You were her mentee." "Which is why I can call her Anni and you can't!" The enormous blue warrior-maiden turns back to Annika and gestures to the necklace in her hand. "So, does that thing mean you're calling the shots for how we take the fight to the demons?" [pc.dcb |"It's awful shiny, I'll give you that," you allow. "What is it, anyway?" |You crane your head to give the golden pendant a closer look. "I was wondering what that was. Badge of office? Did you get a promotion?" |"Wait wait wait," you interject. "Can I call you Anni, too?" She turns back to you and purses her lips before answering. "We'll talk about it, sweetie. Just Annika for now, okay?" "Okay! Sorry. So, um, yeah! Your super pretty necklace! What's that all about?" ] "Now that the Keep's full again," Lumia puts in, "I need someone to manage it. While you were still asleep, but before we started cleaning everything up, I chose Annika to be that someone. This gathering is actually the aftermath of the ceremony of investiture." Annika lifts up the sun pendant high enough to catch the light from the hundreds of wings and thousands of candles around you. "This says that I'm the Seneschal of the Order of the Argent Wing, defender of the Keep of the Lady of Light, responsible for the well-being of all who dwell within it. I keep everybody organized, keep everybody fed and clothed and trained and sheltered, and most importantly, keep this place safe." "Which is kind of a big deal," says Thrud. "It is indeed. To answer your question, dear, perhaps Annika will be able to take the field again. She is certainly in charge of organizing much of what you and your sisters need to be able to change front.[silly | More of a chief of staff than a field commander, but we don't actually have a general staff yet, so the term would be slightly anachronistic. ]" The goddess spreads her hands. "But the vicissitudes of war are hard to read even for me, and lending her spear is not the most important of services Annika can render for us. For now, the work to be done is less glorious and more complicated, but no less necessary for that." Annika's ears twitch down slightly at the sound of Lumia's last two sentences, but she keeps her proud smile and soft elven singsong tone. "The upshot is that I'll be around here to make sure this place is a safe and comfortable haven for you [party.som |and |both, and for |all, and for ] any of your other heroic companions. You know, so long as I'm not overseeing something. I'll do my best to make time for the hero[pc.mf | |ine ] who battled a Wraith and won!" "That goes for us, too," Hjörr adds, "no less than any other warrior in these halls." "There's also the matter of fair reward for service rendered." Lumia smiles. "Don't forget to find time to speak with me about that. Or about anything else; I am happy to find time for a petition from any of you." [party.oneComp etheryn azyrran arona atugia |She directs a fond glance toward Ryn[party.oneComp azyrran arona atugia | and Azzy | and Arona | and Atugia ] before inclining |She directs a fond glance toward Azzy[party.oneComp arona atugia | and Arona | and Atugia ] before inclining |She directs a fond glance toward Arona[party.oneComp atugia | and Atugia ] before inclining |She directs a curious glance toward Atugia before inclining |She inclines ] her head to you and quietly takes her leave. "Well." Annika directs her golden sunbeam of a smile back in your direction. "Thank you again, [pc.name]. As a final gesture of appreciation... I don't suppose you accept hugs?"
rows.translation: 当卢米娅带你走向人群时，一幅由各种色彩与种族构成的令人眼花缭乱的图景迎面扑来。在人群的最前方，你看到了一张熟悉的面孔：安妮卡，那个蓝皮肤的女武神，正是她最初把你卷进了这堆麻烦里。她的盔甲和你记忆中差不多——白袍外罩着青铜胸甲——但这次多了一样东西：她一只手拿着一枚挂在项链上的巨大金色太阳耀斑吊坠，大到足以当作身份徽章。[silly |或者是那种媒体人士、政府雇员以及承包商都会佩戴的安全徽章之一。 ]“瞧，你在这儿呢，”她自豪地说着，用双手跟你紧紧握了握手。“我不是告诉过你要多找些帮手吗？” [pc.dcb |“谁会知道呢，对吧？也许他们真的就像你说的那样。” “看来你只能自己去弄清楚了。” |“你提到的那位战士的直觉确实很敏锐。多亏了你，这一切才能顺利进行。” “不客气，其实也没什么。我只是稍微帮了你一点忙而已。” |“你太棒了！”你兴奋地喊道，“这些太阳妈妈们都是那么快乐、那么友善啊！” 不只是安妮卡，你身边的其他几位女武神也跟着笑了起来。“哦，亲爱的，在你身边，快乐和友善简直就是理所当然的事情啊！” ]无论如何，我们终于到这儿了！嗯，其实是一群人一起来的。她做了个鬼脸。“不过在东边还有很多姐妹把守着那些要道；那些被怨灵影响的人并没有凭空消失。但事情一发生，我们立刻就察觉到了。他们配合更差、注意力更不集中，打起来更容易。我们不再需要那边秩序教团的力量来压制他们了……这意味着我们可以休整、重新装备，然后开始向南飞去，帮忙对抗恶魔和那个邪教。” “与邪教作战，哈？早就该这么做了！换个环境对我们也有好处。”一个身高足有十英尺的巨型精灵挤过人群来到你面前，身后还跟着一个几乎同样庞大的北方弥诺陶洛斯。 安妮卡满脸笑容地抬起手臂抱了你一下。她先指了指那位巨人体型的精灵女子，又指了指那位弥诺陶洛斯女子，说道：“[pc.name]，瑟拉德和希约尔是我认识的最出色的战士。我们一起服役了很久。” “很长时间，”她说道。“安妮是为数不多的还记得我当初还是个学徒的姐妹之一，”瑟拉德笑着说。 希约尔挑了挑眉毛。“你才是她的学徒。” “这就是为什么我可以叫她安妮，而你不能！”那位高大的蓝色战士少女转回身对安妮卡说，指了指她手中的项链。“那么，那东西是不是意味着，由你来决定我们怎么跟恶魔开战？” [pc.dcb |“确实非常闪亮，这点我得承认，”你说道，“不过这到底是什么东西呢？” |你伸长脖子，仔细端详那枚金质吊坠。“我一直在想那是什么……是职务象征吗？你是获得晋升了吗？” |“等等等等，”你插话说，“我也可以叫你安妮吗？” 她转过身来，抿了抿嘴唇才回答：“我们以后再谈这个吧，亲爱的。现在就先叫安妮卡，好吗？” “好的！对不起。那么，嗯，对了！你那条超级漂亮的项链，它是怎么回事？” ] “现在城堡又满员了，”卢米娅插话道，“我需要有人来管理它。趁你还在睡、我们还没开始清理一切的时候，我选了安妮卡来担任这个职位。这次聚会其实就是授职仪式之后的余兴。” 安妮卡将那枚太阳吊坠举得足够高，以便让周围数百只翅膀和数千支蜡烛散发出的光芒照射到它上面。“上面写着：我是银翼骑士团的管家，是光之女士城堡的守护者，肩负着照顾居住在那里的所有人的责任。我负责确保每个人都有条不紊地生活，让他们有吃有穿，接受训练，也有地方居住。最重要的是，我要保证这个地方的安全。” “这确实是一件非常重要的事情，”斯露德说道。 “确实如此。亲爱的，要回答你的问题，也许安妮卡能够重新上阵。她确实负责安排你和你姐妹们所需的许多事情，好让你们能够转战别处。[silly |她更像是参谋长，而不是前线指挥官。不过事实上，我们目前还没有真正意义上的参谋部，所以这个称呼有点不合时宜。 ]”女神摊开双手。“但战争的变幻莫测连我也难以预料，而让她出借长矛，也并非安妮卡能为我们做的最重要的贡献。眼下要做的事没那么光彩，也更为复杂，但其必要性丝毫不减。” 听到卢米娅最后那两句话，安妮卡的耳朵微微垂了下来，但她仍保持着骄傲的笑容和柔和的精灵吟唱般的语调。“总之，我会留在这一带，确保这个地方成为你[party.som |以及 |两者，以及 |所有人，以及 ]你的其他任何一位英勇同伴也一样。你知道的，只要我没有在忙着别的事，我都会尽力抽时间陪那位英雄[pc.mf | | ]有人与怨灵战斗并取得了胜利！” “我们也是如此，”赫约尔补充道，“不比这些大厅里的任何一位战士差。” “另外，还有一件重要的事：为付出的服务给予公平的回报。”卢米娅微笑着说，“别忘了找时间跟我谈谈这件事。或者其他任何事也行；我很乐意抽出时间听取你们任何人的请求。”[party.oneComp etheryn azyrran arona atugia |她深情地望了瑞恩一眼[party.oneComp azyrran arona atugia |还有阿齐 |还有阿罗娜 |以及阿图吉娅 ]，随后 |她深情地望了阿齐一眼[party.oneComp arona atugia |还有阿罗娜 |还有阿图吉娅 ]，随后 |她深情地望了阿罗娜一眼[party.oneComp atugia |还有阿图吉娅 ]，随后 |她好奇地瞥了阿图吉娅一眼，随后 |她偏过头 ]她把头转向你，静静地告辞离开。 “嗯。”安妮卡把她那如金色阳光般的笑容重新转向你。“再次感谢你，[pc.name]。作为最后的谢意……我想你大概不介意我给个拥抱吧？”

"What is it, anyway?" |You crane your head to give the golden pendant a closer look. "I was wondering what that was. Badge of office? Did you get a promotion?" |"Wait wait wait," you interject. "Can I call you Anni, too?" She turns back to you and purses her lips before answering. "We'll talk about it, sweetie. Just Annika for now, okay?" "Okay! Sorry. So, um, yeah! Your super pretty necklace! What's that all about?" ] "Now that the Keep's full again," Lumia puts in, "I need someone to manage it. While you were still asleep, but before we started cleaning everything up, I chose Annika to be that someone. This gathering is actually the aftermath of the ceremony of investiture." Annika lifts up the sun pendant high enough to catch the light from the hundreds of wings and thousands of candles around you. "This says that I'm the Seneschal of the Order of the Argent Wing, defender of the Keep of the Lady of Light, responsible for the well-being of all who dwell within it. I keep everybody organized, keep everybody fed and clothed and trained and sheltered, and most importantly, keep this place safe." "Which is kind of a big deal," says Thrud. "It is indeed. To answer your question, dear, perhaps Annika will be able to take the field again. She is certainly in charge of organizing much of what you and your sisters need to be able to change front.[silly | More of a chief of staff than a field commander, but we don't actually have a general staff yet, so the term would be slightly anachronistic. ]" The goddess spreads her hands. "But the vicissitudes of war are hard to read even for me, and lending her spear is not the most important of services Annika can render for us. For now, the work to be done is less glorious and more complicated, but no less necessary for that." Annika's ears twitch down slightly at the sound of Lumia's last two sentences, but she keeps her proud smile and soft elven singsong tone. "The upshot is that I'll be around here to make sure this place is a safe and comfortable haven for you [party.som |and |both, and for |all, and for ] any of your other heroic companions. You know, so long as I'm not overseeing something. I'll do my best to make time for the hero[pc.mf | |ine ] who battled a Wraith and won!" "That goes for us, too," Hjörr adds, "no less than any other warrior in these halls." "There's also the matter of fair reward for service rendered." Lumia smiles. "Don't forget to find time to speak with me about that. Or about anything else; I am happy to find time for a petition from any of you." [party.oneComp etheryn azyrran arona atugia |She directs a fond glance toward Ryn[party.oneComp azyrran arona atugia | and Azzy | and Arona | and Atugia ] before inclining |She directs a fond glance toward Azzy[party.oneComp arona atugia | and Arona | and Atugia ] before inclining |She directs a fond glance toward Arona[party.oneComp atugia | and Atugia ] before inclining |She directs a curious glance toward Atugia before inclining |She inclines ] her head to you and quietly takes her leave. "Well." Annika directs her golden sunbeam of a smile back in your direction. "Thank you again, [pc.name]. As a final gesture of appreciation... I don't suppose you accept hugs?" '

rows.original: You reach out for her hand and grin. "[pc.dcb |Not the way I roll. But we're good. This whole thing was a fun enough diversion. |A handshake's fine. It's been a pleasure, Annika. |Maybe later! Hee hee. I was happy to help! ]" The new seneschal takes the hand you proffer and reminds you just how muscular she is. [pc.strengthRange 66 |Damn, her grip's just about equal to your own! |Wow — it's a good thing she doesn't put more of her muscle into it, or you could imagine coming out of this with mangled digits. ] "Likewise. Don't be a stranger! Come by for a chat every so often, and don't forget to [pc.isBimbo |chat |be in touch ] with our warriors about the cult." [pc.dcb |Oh, you'll be doing more than touching, you think. |"Sounds good. I'll see you around." |"I'll try!" you say bravely. "But I might mostly say things like 'they're kinda stinky' and stuff." "It sounds like they are pretty stinky," the elfy sweetheart laughs. "They really really are! Okie-doke! Seeya later, Annika! And congrats again on the new job and stuff!" ]
rows.translation: 你伸出手，咧嘴一笑。“[pc.dcb |这不是我的风格。不过我们没事了。这整件事算是个挺有趣的消遣。 |握个手就行。认识你很荣幸，安妮卡。 |也许以后吧！嘻嘻。我很乐意帮忙！ ]” 新任管家握住你伸出的手，让你再次领教了她有多强壮。[pc.strengthRange 66 |妈的，她的握力几乎跟你自己一样大！ |哇——幸好她没有把更多力气使进去，不然你真能想象自己最后手指都被捏烂。 ] “我也一样。别见外啊！时不时过来聊聊天，还有别忘了跟我们的战士们[pc.isBimbo |聊聊 |保持联系 ]那个教团的事。” [pc.dcb |哦，你接下来要做的事可不止是“碰一碰”，你心想。 |“听起来不错。回头见。” |“我会试试的！”你勇敢地说。“但我可能大多只会说些‘它们有点臭’之类的话。” “听起来它们确实挺臭的，”那个小甜心精灵笑着说。 “它们真的真的特别臭！好啦好啦！回头见，安妮卡！还有，再次恭喜你得到新工作什么的！” ]

Yes please!" ] "Aww. Thank you, sweetie." [pc.heightRange 72 78 |Annika leans into the hug far enough that her elven ear needs to twitch to stay out of your face. |You're big enough that Annika has to turn her head and rest it on your chest as the two of you hug. |The tall valkyrie leans down[pc.heightRange 66 | a bit ] to make sure she hugs you properly. ] Her strong arms fold around you and hold you close, and although she's a frost elf, something, perhaps Lumia's light, keeps her nice and warm. "See you around! I'd love to hang out with you, make you some food, ensure you feel welcome here in the Keep — just let me know when, okay?" [pc.dcb |"Hey, I'll take it." |"That sounds [pc.mascFem |fantastic |lovely ]. I hope it's not too much trouble, though." "Oh, don't worry. Cooking's great stress relief for me! It'll help to decompress from whatever being seneschal means." You squeeze her a little bit tighter. "Well, in that case, how could I say no?" |"Ooooh! Food and hanging out? You're one of the best friendos, Annika. Sure!" ] "Great!" She separates from the hug, then continues, "Don't forget, too, that a lot of my sisters are itching to help you out with this cult. So [pc.isBimbo |make sure you talk to them too. Okay, sweetie? |keep in touch! ]"

rows.translation: 以既适合朋友、也适合那些日后可能想更进一步的人的方式，公开表达亲昵与祝贺。
rows.raw: "Publicly affectionate and congratulatory in a way that's appropriate both for friends and for people who might want to eventually be more than friends."

rows.original: Your sleep doesn't seem to last long. Genuine rest eludes you, instead leaving you in the grasp of unquiet dreams, so that when you finally struggle awake with bleary eyes and plenty of yawning, you barely feel rested at all. It takes you a long time to become fully aware of your surroundings through the haze: completely naked in a soft bed and softer sheets, in a room much more well-appointed than the parts of the Keep you saw before... and much cleaner, without a hint of gloom. Huh. How long were you out? Across the room, the bright-eyed goddess herself reclines idly on a couch, the perfect picture of repose. She's dressed in a simple, comfortable white robe, relatively demure — perfect for relaxing by oneself. How long has she been there? "Ah, [pc.name]. Did you rest well? You didn't sleep nearly as long as I thought you might." Though your mouth is dry, you manage to croak, "[pc.isBimbo |Uhhh... nuh-uh. My sleep was super bad |Not particularly ]." "I'm sorry to hear that," Lumia says with a genuine grimace. "There's water there on the side if you'd like." Gratefully, you accept. It's remarkably cool and refreshing, and it gets rid of the cottony feeling right away. "Thanks[pc.isBimbo |! So, um, did we win? |. So... I'm guessing that this all means we won. ]" The goddess nods. "We did. The foe is vanquished, the miasma gone, the valkyries returned. It was not the easiest victory ever, but it was one, and fairly won, not least by [party.combatNames]. Perhaps you should rest for longer? I cannot imagine that it was easy to endure." "No[pc.isBimbo | way ]," you insist, rolling over in the bed, "I'm fine[pc.isBimbo |! I can keep — hee hee. I can keep going! |. I can keep going. ]" "Well and well, then." Lumia claps her hands. "I hope you don't mind, then, if we transact some business. First things first: you have some interesting items in your possession." Your eyes slide over to the table, where your clothes lie laundered and folded, gear cleaned to a shine, and where the corrupted Dawnsword sits apart from the rest. "[pc.isBimbo |Huh. Uuuum, do you mean the fun swordy thing? |Interesting, huh? You could say that. ]" "It looks as if one of those demons got hold of it," she muses absently. "Did you have trouble cleansing their corruption?" "Something like that," you say diffidently. "Fortunately, I can do that very easily." The Dawn Maiden examines the hilt closely. "It's... you could say it has a great deal of sentimental value to me, and even more to my faithful. I wouldn't want to just leave it in such a state." "[pc.isBimbo |Um. I guess? |That seems... fair. ]" Right, right. Sanders mentioned this. "What if, um, it [pc.isBimbo |doesn't like me anymore |no longer sees me as worthy ]?" Her glowing eyes flick back over to you. "[pc.corruptionRange 25 |You could always work to prove yourself worthy of a cleansed Dawnsword. |I don't think it'll take much to prove worthy again. ] Redemption is something open to all who seek it, not merely to the special. "But," she continues, "the mantle of the true Sunbearer isn't an easy one. While I'd certainly be willing to let you keep the cleansed blade[pc.swornGod keros nareva |, despite serving Keros |, despite serving Nareva ], you don't need to. If you're unsure, I'd be happy to offer something in exchange — perhaps not quite as useful or powerful as this, but fair compensation for rescuing my weapon from the demons and returning it to me and my faithful." The goddess's tone, while warm and friendly, brooks no argument; she's clearly not going to let you keep the corrupted Dawnsword as is. Either you take the cleansed blade[pc.corruptionRange 25 | — with the chance that you won't be able to use it unless you purge your corruption — |, ] or you return it to her and take her consolation prize. Forcing the issue with a goddess is probably a good way to end up smited...
rows.translation: 你的睡眠似乎没持续多久。真正的休息与你无缘，你反倒被困在不安的梦境里，所以当你终于挣扎着醒来时，双眼朦胧、哈欠连天，几乎感觉不到丝毫休息的效果。你在迷雾中花了很久才完全认清周围的环境：赤身裸体地躺在一张柔软的床上、更柔软的床单里，房间比你在堡垒里见过的那些地方考究得多……也干净得多，没有一丝阴郁。唔。你到底昏睡了多久？ 房间另一头，那位双眼明亮的女神正懒散地斜倚在沙发上，活脱脱一幅安详的画卷。她穿着一件简单舒适的白色长袍，相当端庄——最适合独自放松不过了。她在那里待了多久？“啊，[pc.name]。你休息得好吗？你睡的时间远没有我以为的那么长。” 尽管嘴很干，你还是勉强哑着嗓子说：“[pc.isBimbo |呃……不。我睡得超级糟糕。 |不算特别好。 ]。” “听到这个我很难过，”卢米娅真诚地皱起脸说。“要是你想喝水，边上就有一杯。” 你感激地接过来。水清凉得出奇，立刻驱散了那种嘴里像塞了棉花的感觉。“谢谢[pc.isBimbo |！那么，呃，我们赢了吗？ |。那么……我猜这一切都意味着我们赢了。 ]” 女神点点头。“我们赢了。敌人已被击败，瘴气消散，女武神们也都回来了。这算不上有史以来最轻松的一场胜利，但它确实是一场胜利，而且赢得光明正大，尤其要归功于[party.combatNames]。也许你该再多休息一会儿？我实在无法想象那种遭遇能轻松熬过去。” “不[pc.isBimbo |行 ]，”你在床上翻了个身，坚持道，“我没事[pc.isBimbo |！我还能继续——嘻嘻。我还能继续撑下去！ |。我还能继续。 ]” “那好吧。”卢米娅拍了拍手。“希望你不介意我们谈点正事。首先第一件：你手上有些挺有意思的东西。” 你的目光移向桌子，你的衣服洗净叠好放在那里，装备擦得锃亮，而那把被腐化的晨曦剑则与其他东西分开放着。“[pc.isBimbo |唔。呃——你是说那个好玩的带剑的东西吗？ |有意思，是吧？也可以这么说。 ]” “看起来是某个恶魔拿到了它，”她心不在焉地沉吟道。“清除它们的腐化时，你遇到麻烦了吗？” “差不多吧，”你含糊地说道。 “幸运的是，这对我来说很容易。”黎明少女仔细端详着剑柄。“它……可以说，它对我有极重的情感价值，对我的信徒们更是如此。我不想就这样把它放着不管。” “[pc.isBimbo |嗯。我想是吧？ |这似乎……挺公平的。 ]“对，对。桑德斯提过这件事。要是，呃，它[pc.isBimbo |不再喜欢我了 |不再认为我有价值了 ]”呢？”” 她发光的双眼又转回你身上。“[pc.corruptionRange 25 |你随时都可以努力去证明自己配得上那把被净化的晨曦剑。 |我觉得要重新证明自己的价值，应该花不了多少功夫。 ]救赎是向所有寻求它的人敞开的，而不只属于某些特别的人。 “但是，”她继续说道，“真正太阳使者的衣钵并不好担。虽然我当然愿意让你留着那把被净化的剑[pc.swornGod keros nareva |，尽管你曾为凯罗斯效力 |，尽管你曾为娜瑞瓦效力 ]，但你不必如此。如果你拿不定主意，我很乐意用别的东西作为交换——也许不如这把剑有用或强大，但对于你从恶魔手中救出我的武器、把它还给我和我的信徒这件事，算是公平的补偿。” 女神的语气虽然温暖友好，却不容争辩；她显然不会让你就这样留着那把被腐化的晨曦剑。要么你接受被净化的剑[pc.corruptionRange 25 |——但你若不清除自身的腐化，就有可能无法使用它—— |， ]，要么把它还给她、收下她的安慰奖。跟一位女神硬来，大概就是招来天罚的好办法……

rows.original: You nod quietly. "[pc.isBimbo |Weeell, I really like the sword. It's shiny and sexy and suuuper stabby. So could I keep it after you fix it up? Pleeeeeease? |All right. Then I guess I'll have to try and prove myself worthy of it. ]" Lumia inclines her head toward you gently. "[pc.isBimbo |You've earned the right to try to use it, at least. |You have it within you to try. ]" With one hand, she holds the hilt aloft; the other hovers above it. With a slight tensing of her muscles, the goddess seems to pull a gradually-growing ball of pink oil out of the hilt, the crossguard, the blade-shard. As the goo sloughs off of the weapon, you see it slowly return to what must have been its original form, shedding droplet after droplet of the stuff until all that remains is pristine and perfect. The goddess narrows her eyes and gazes critically at the pink oil-ball hovering under her palm. It pulses inky black a few times, then returns to pink, roiling and angry but harmlessly contained by divine power. After several seconds of close examination, Lumia seems to have found all she needed. Her hand closes, and she snaps her fingers — and the ball erupts into blinding white flame. It shines with an actinic glare, burning off the oil and growing smaller and smaller until it fizzles into nothingness, and all that was left of the demon's corruption is completely gone. Briefly, the Dawnsword snaps into existence again, golden blade extended full length and suffusing the already-cozy room with a warm glow. Lumia gently swings it through a few velocities, a satisfied smile growing on her face. Eventually, she murmurs, "There," deactivates the blade, and returns the hilt to its place on the table next to the rest of your possessions. "It should be protected against further corruption, too. As for you, [pc.name], you're welcome to speak to me or to my warriors about worthiness and heroism — and about removing any corruption inside you, should you wish. rows.translation: 你静静地点了点头。“[pc.isBimbo |嗯——我真的很喜欢这把剑。它闪闪发光、又性感，而且刺起人来超级厉害。所以你把它修好之后，能让我留着它吗？求——求你啦？ |好吧。那我想我必须努力证明自己配得上它。 ]” 卢米娅温柔地朝你低下头。“[pc.isBimbo |至少你已经赢得了尝试使用它的权利。 |你本身就有能力去尝试。 ]”她一只手将剑柄高高举起，另一只手悬在它上方。随着肌肉微微一紧，女神仿佛从剑柄、护手和剑刃碎片中拉出一团逐渐变大的粉色油脂球。当那团黏稠物从武器上剥落时，你看到它缓缓恢复成原本应有的模样，一滴接一滴地脱落，直到只剩下光洁无瑕的完美形态。 女神眯起眼，审视着悬在她掌心下的粉色油球。它几次脉动出墨黑色，随后又变回粉色，翻涌着、躁动着，却被神力无害地封住。仔细端详了几秒后，卢米娅似乎已经得到了她需要的一切。她手一握，打了个响指——那团球猛然爆成刺目的白色火焰。它闪耀着灼目的光，烧尽了油脂，越来越小，直到噗地一声化归虚无，那恶魔的腐化残留也就此彻底消失。 短暂地，晨曦剑再次现身，金色刀刃完全展开，为这间本就温馨的房间罩上一层暖光。卢米娅轻轻挥动了几下，脸上浮现出满意的笑容。最终，她低声说了句：“喏，”随即关闭了刀刃，把剑柄放回桌上你其他物品旁边。“它也应该能抵御进一步的腐化了。至于你，[pc.name]，如果你愿意，随时都可以找我或我的战士们谈谈价值与英雄主义——也谈谈如何清除你体内可能存在的腐化。他们中有些人认识过去的太阳使者，包括你的朋友里奥丹。他们大概会急着帮你加入那些战士的行列。” “[pc.isBimbo |嘻嘻。我超想向那些性感的女武神姐姐学习。 |我明白了。 ]” “很好。”她朝桌子示意。“我这就让你去把衣服穿好、把东西收拾好。有些人很想看到你起身活动。再说一次：谢谢你，不仅是为了这件事，也谢谢你帮忙消灭了幽灵。”
rows.raw: ' You nod quietly. "[pc.isBimbo |Weeell, I really like the sword. It's shiny and sexy and suuuper stabby. So could I keep it after you fix it up? Pleeeeeease? |All right. Then I guess I'll have to try and prove myself worthy of it. ]" Lumia inclines her head toward you gently. "[pc.isBimbo |You've earned the right to try to use it, at least. |You have it within you to try. ]" With one hand, she holds the hilt aloft; the other hovers above it. With a slight tensing of her muscles, the goddess seems to pull a gradually-growing ball of pink oil out of the hilt, the crossguard, the blade-shard. As the goo sloughs off of the weapon, you see it slowly return to what must have been its original form, shedding droplet after droplet of the stuff until all that remains is pristine and perfect. The goddess narrows her eyes and gazes critically at the pink oil-ball hovering under her palm. It pulses inky black a few times, then returns to pink, roiling and angry but harmlessly contained by divine power. After several seconds of close examination, Lumia seems to have found all she needed. Her hand closes, and she snaps her fingers — and the ball erupts into blinding white flame. It shines with an actinic glare, burning off the oil and growing smaller and smaller until it fizzles into nothingness, and all that was left of the demon's corruption is completely gone. Briefly, the Dawnsword snaps into existence again, golden blade extended full length and suffusing the already-cozy room with a warm glow. Lumia gently swings it through a few velocities, a satisfied smile growing on her face.
