rows.original: You emerge into a hall suffused with a warm, friendly glow. It shines through the windows from outside, illuminating the befrescoed and cleaned interior of the great open hall with the glow of [dayNight |the sun |a gorgeous northern aurora ]. It shines from the multitude of candles and braziers that give the open space not merely light but warmth enough to keep the whole place comfortably toasty. And it shines from the magical wings of hundreds of valkyries. No longer a shadowy, dusty derelict bereft of life, the Lumian Keep's hall is fully cleaned and filled with sun maidens, all of whom go about their business as if they had never left, flitting across the hall on errands or chatting with their sisters. Lumia herself is off to the side, absorbed in a friendly chat with [party.oneComp etheryn arona azyrran |Etheryn[party.comp arona azyrran | and Arona | and Azzy ]. Your [etheryn.married |elf-wife |elven [etheryn.fucked |lover |companion ] ] still looks a little overwhelmed to be speaking to her goddess's living incarnation, but at least, judging by the adorably irrepressible smile on her face, it's a good kind of overwhelmed, rather than nervousness; the Dawn Maiden's friendly hand on Ryn's shoulder and overall calming and down-to-earth demeanor are probably doing a lot to keep the elf at ease. Next to her, [party.comp arona azyrran |Arona attempts to play off Lumia's presence as no big deal, but the big orc still blushes and shifts on her feet every time the goddess says something to her. [flags.DHAWK_TUI_PARTY |And Atugia, right next to her and holding the shards of the sword from the Wraith encounter, is just as charmingly awkward. ] |Azyrran stands [azyrran.kdb |at proud, blushy attention, melting into adorably shy giggles every time Lumia turns her attention the hornet's way |at attention, proud and gallant and still a little flustered — if only a little — when the goddess favors her with some friendly words |with her hand on her chest, gushing about something in her usual exuberant way and looking as if she's having the time of her life ].[flags.DHAWK_TUI_PARTY | And Atugia, standing next to her with the remains of the sword from your encounter with the Wraith, is even more awkward in the goddess's presence. ] |[flags.DHAWK_TUI_PARTY |Atugia holds the sword-shards from last night's encounter. the other half of [var0 |your restored Dawnsword |the just-cleansed Dawnsword ]. She's much more awkward in the presence of the divine than Ryn is; you hear her call the goddess "Lady Lumia" once, and then you hear the goddess' insistence that no, just Lumia is fine. | ] ] |your orcish [arona.isSub |beta |alpha ]. The brash green amazon's got a little color in her cheeks as she talks to her goddess — [arona.pregStage 1 2 |and from the way her hand keeps moving to her tummy, you have a faint idea about what the topic of conversation is. No wonder she's blushing. |and, Arona being as gravid as she is, it's obvious what, or whom, the two of them are talking about. The Lumian orc must be very pleased indeed to show off her baby bump... and Lumia herself seems to be just as pleased to see it. |[var1 |and from the way she excitedly gestures toward you, it's easy to see why. After all, how better to talk to a deity of fertility than about the family you're starting? |seems like even she can find herself a little lost for words, even if it does take meeting the object of her prayers face-to-face to do it. ] ][party.has azyrran | [azyrran.kdb |Azzy is, if anything, even blushier than Arona about spending time with the goddess. She gesticulates wildly every time she joins the conversation, and every time Lumia speaks to her she digs her boot into the Keep's floor. |Just like Arona, Azzy tries to play it cool and casual for the sun-goddess, and just like Arona, the hornet's normal badass self-assuredness cracks a few times when Lumia has warm words for her. |Next to her, your bimbug companion absolutely gushes with pride and excitement every time she and Lumia exchange words... and considering how often Azzy likes to talk, that's constantly. ] ] As for Atugia, rather overwhelmed by such [party.has azyrran |outsize personalities |an outsize personality ], she stands by quietly with the sword-shards wrapped up neatly in a package, smiling awkwardly every time the conversation moves over to her. |your Hive Knight companion. [azyrran.kdb |Azzy's very blushy, awkward, and shy around her goddess, but you can tell that Lumia's doing her best to sooth the vesparan's natural shyness with friendly words and warm gazes... and, of course, headpats. She loves those. |Normally, Azzy does 'stoic' pretty well; the imposing, confident, gallant hornet feels very much at home amid the valkyries of Lumia's hall. But you can see little hints of awe in the way she stands, the way her wings move, the way her cheeks warm at a divine compliment. |And she is so. Super. Stoked! Azzy goes from excitedly hugging Lumia — and receiving headpats — to babbling about something you can't quite hear with her hand on her chest and her other hand up in the air, to moving up and down on the balls of her feet like she's about to take flight, and maybe she is. Your sweet bimbug is overjoyed to be here, overjoyed to be speaking to the being she worships, and you can't help but smile to see it. ] [flags.DHAWK_TUI_PARTY |Next to her, Atugia's a little more calm, standing quietly and holding the shards of the sword from the dream. But she, too, warms up when Lumia directs attention her way. |Atugia. The little dullahan is absolutely dwarfed by the goddess, even when she's not trying to be imposing, and although Tui doesn't lose her [silly |head about it |sense of poise ], she still adopts a posture of absolute deference. And, you know, fair enough. She is talking to a goddess. For Lumia's part, she seems to be doing her best to keep Tui at ease, keeping the conversation on the sword-shards the dullahan's holding rather than trying to overwhelm her with awesome divine majesty. ] ] They're joined by some other faces, too. Most of the valkyries in the hall are doing their own thing; many of them seem very busy getting the place back into working order, although most of them have plenty of glances to spare for you. There's still something of an honor guard for you, though. One sun maiden is a massive frost elf, [var2 |presumably with some jotun in her ancestry |far taller than even Alissa or Jael'yn ], who leans casually on her spear and offers you a jaunty salute. Another is a nearly-as-huge mino-woman, just as muscular, and thanks to her bovine countenance, even more intimidating. And then there's Annika, the blue-skinned elven warrior you met out in the Rift, dressed this time not in armor but in something approaching frost elven finery... which means she's showing a lot of scarred skin with wiry muscles underneath. She's the one who steps forward to greet you with a friendly smile and outstretched arm. "I think," she says, "I told you I'd have more help to give you." You [pc.isBimbo |rush right past her proffered hand and give her a big friendly hug instead. "Did you? I kind of didn't really remember, but if that's what you said, that's awesome! |clasp her arm above the wrist and exchange the traditional warrior's greeting. "You did. ]" "Well." She grins proudly. "Here we are. Thank you, by the way. Not only did you manage to help vanquish a Wraith, you [flags.DAWNSWORD_RETURNED |returned the Dawnsword to the faithful |saved the Dawnsword from a demon and proved worthy of its power ]. You might be the greatest ally we've had in decades." You conceal whatever you might've genuinely felt about that with a casual grin. "[pc.isBimbo |Hee hee. Goooosh. |What can I say? I'm just that good. ]" The larger elf in the back nods. "[pc.isBimbo |Gosh indeed. W |Then w ]e're going to need to get your thoughts about kicking demon ass." "The more experience," rumbles the minotaur, "the better." Annika points back at the two warriors in turn: first the elf, then the [silly |moo |mino-woman ]. "[pc.name], this is Thrud, and the lady with the horns is Hjörr. They're not the only warriors we'll have flying south to fight demons, but they'll be the tip of the spear, and they'll want to pick your brain." [pc.isBimbo |"Ow. I'm gonna have to warn you, it's super smooth. That might make it tricky!" "Just a figure of speech, dear," the elven valkyrie chuckles. "They'd just like to talk to you." "Oh. Okay! What about you?" |Fair enough. "Sure. What about you?" ] "I'll be spending most of my time back here," she says. Her voice has one of those odd undercurrents of ruefulness, even though her face and body both look very happy. She lifts a strange new addition to her outfit: a large badge of office, a golden sun-winged symbol of the Dawn Maiden. "Now that we have a Keep again, it needs a seneschal — someone to oversee it and the people who live here for Lumia. And since I'm one of the older and more experienced warriors..." "Not just because of that." Lumia walks over, your party in tow, and places a reassuring hand on Annika's shoulder. "You're also one of our finest mentors, and you've been doing this long enough to understand what an army needs both during combat and during the other ninety-nine percent of the year. I couldn't ask for a finer seneschal." The newly-minted seneschal's ears flutter a little bit as she nods in acknowledgment. "At... at any rate," she continues, "I might be able to spend time out there, but mostly I'll be making sure things are all squared away here: keeping this place clean, well-stocked, and defended, training, organizing, figuring out how to supply everybody. And, you know, making sure that our warriors and allies — that you — have a comfortable, secure place to rest and relax whenever you come here." Lumia, her glowing eyes and warm smile turned toward you, picks up the thread. "This is once again a place of sanctity and safety. Annika and the rest of our Order will help me keep it that way for you." "Wow. Thanks[pc.isBimbo |! |. ]" "Of course. That said, we are the ones thanking you." The Dawn Maiden points to the door at the interior end of the Keep. "When you have the time, visit me in my sanctum for something of a more tangible reward. Until then... be well, [party.hasCompanions |all |both ] of you. Welcome back." "Same for me," Annika adds. "For the moment, I'm swamped with managing stuff, getting everybody settled in. Give me a day, though, and I'll be able to make some time, maybe bake you a Keepwarming present. Until then, though, most of the rest of the warriors in the Keep would be very, very happy to meet you." Hjörr raises a hand in salute. "Count me and Thrud in the happy to meet you and not ridiculously busy group. Drop by whenever you've got the time." Gracefully, the three valkyries take their leave of you, following their goddess. You're left with [party.compNames] in the middle of the bustling Lumian hall. Seems like you've got the run of the place. Where to go first?

rows.raw: " You emerge into a hall suffused with a warm, friendly glow. It shines through the windows from outside, illuminating the befrescoed and cleaned interior of the great open hall with the glow of [dayNight |the sun |a gorgeous northern aurora ]. It shines from the multitude of candles and braziers that give the open space not merely light but warmth enough to keep the whole place comfortably toasty. And it shines from the magical wings of hundreds of valkyries. No longer a shadowy, dusty derelict bereft of life, the Lumian Keep's hall is fully cleaned and filled with sun maidens, all of whom go about their business as if they had never left, flitting across the hall on errands or chatting with their sisters. Lumia herself is off to the side, absorbed in a friendly chat with [party.oneComp etheryn arona azyrran |Etheryn[party.comp arona azyrran | and Arona | and Azzy ]. Your [etheryn.married |elf-wife |elven [etheryn.fucked |lover |companion ] ] still looks a little overwhelmed to be speaking to her goddess's living incarnation, but at least, judging by the adorably irrepressible smile on her face, it's a good kind of overwhelmed, rather than nervousness; the Dawn Maiden's friendly hand on Ryn's shoulder and overall calming and down-to-earth demeanor are probably doing a lot to keep the elf at ease. Next to her, [party.comp arona azyrran |Arona attempts to play off Lumia's presence as no big deal, but the big orc still blushes and shifts on her feet every time the goddess says something to her. [flags.DHAWK_TUI_PARTY |And Atugia, right next to her and holding the shards of the sword from the Wraith encounter, is just as charmingly awkward. ] |Azyrran stands [azyrran.kdb |at proud, blushy attention, melting into adorably shy giggles every time Lumia turns her attention the hornet's way |at attention, proud and gallant and still a little flustered — if only a little — when the goddess favors her with some friendly words |with her hand on her chest, gushing about something in her usual exuberant way and looking as if she's having the time of her life ].[flags.DHAWK_TUI_PARTY | And Atugia, standing next to her with the remains of the sword from your encounter with the Wraith, is even more awkward in the goddess's presence. ] |[flags.DHAWK_TUI_PARTY |Atugia holds the sword-shards from last night's encounter. the other half of [var0 |your restored Dawnsword |the just-cleansed Dawnsword ]. She's much more awkward in the presence of the divine than Ryn is; you hear her call the goddess "Lady Lumia" once, and then you hear the goddess' insistence that no, just Lumia is fine. | ] ] |your orcish [arona.isSub |beta |alpha ]. The brash green amazon's got a little color in her cheeks as she talks to her goddess — [arona.pregStage 1 2 |and from the way her hand keeps moving to her tummy, you have a faint idea about what the topic of conversation is. No wonder she's blushing. |and, Arona being as gravid as she is, it's obvious what, or whom, the two of them are talking about. The Lumian orc must be very pleased indeed to show off her baby bump... and Lumia herself seems to be just as pleased to see it. |[var1 |and from the way she excitedly gestures toward you, it's easy to see why. After all, how better to talk to a deity of fertility than about the family you're starting? |seems like even she can find herself a little lost for words, even if it does take meeting the object of her prayers face-to-face to do it. ] ][party.has azyrran | [azyrran.kdb |Azzy is, if anything, even blushier than Arona about spending time with the goddess. She gesticulates wildly every time she joins the conversation, and every time Lumia speaks to her she digs her boot into the Keep's floor. |Just like Arona, Azzy tries to play it cool and casual for the sun-goddess, and just like Arona, the hornet's normal badass self-assuredness cracks a few times when Lumia has warm words for her. |Next to her, your bimbug companion absolutely gushes with pride and excitement every time she and Lumia exchange words... and considering how often Azzy likes to talk, that's constantly. ] ] As for Atugia, rather overwhelmed by such [party.has azyrran |outsize personalities |an outsize personality ], she stands by quietly with the sword-shards wrapped up neatly in a package, smiling awkwardly every time the conversation moves over to her. |your Hive Knight companion. [azyrran.kdb |Azzy's very blushy, awkward, and shy around her goddess, but you can tell that Lumia's doing her best to sooth the vesparan's natural shyness with friendly words and warm gazes... and, of course, headpats. She loves those. |Normally, Azzy does 'stoic' pretty well; the imposing, confident, gallant hornet feels very much at home amid the valkyries of Lumia's hall. But you can see little hints of awe in the way she stands, the way her wings move, the way her cheeks warm at a divine compliment. |And she is so. Super. Stoked! Azzy goes from excitedly hugging Lumia — and receiving headpats — to babbling about something you can't quite hear with her hand on her chest and her other hand up in the air, to moving up and down on the balls of her feet like she's about to take flight, and maybe she is. Your sweet bimbug is overjoyed to be here, overjoyed to be speaking to the being she worships, and you can't help but smile to see it. ] [flags.DHAWK_TUI_PARTY |Next to her, Atugia's a little more calm, standing quietly and holding the shards of the sword from the dream. But she, too, warms up when Lumia directs attention her way. |Atugia. The little dullahan is absolutely dwarfed by the goddess, even when she's not trying to be imposing, and although Tui doesn't lose her [silly |head about it |sense of poise ], she still adopts a posture of absolute deference. And, you know, fair enough. She is talking to a goddess. For Lumia's part, she seems to be doing her best to keep Tui at ease, keeping the conversation on the sword-shards the dullahan's holding rather than trying to overwhelm her with awesome divine majesty. ] ] They're joined by some other faces, too. Most of the valkyries in the hall are doing their own thing; many of them seem very busy getting the place back into working order, although most of them have plenty of glances to spare for you. There's still something of an honor guard for you, though. One sun maiden is a massive frost elf, [var2 |presumably with some jotun in her ancestry |far taller than even Alissa or Jael'yn ], who leans casually on her spear and offers you a jaunty salute. Another is a nearly-as-huge mino-woman, just as muscular, and thanks to her bovine countenance, even more intimidating. And then there's Annika, the blue-skinned elven warrior you met out in the Rift, dressed this time not in armor but in something approaching frost elven finery... which means she's showing a lot of scarred skin with wiry muscles underneath. She's the one who steps forward to greet you with a friendly smile and outstretched arm. "I think," she says, "I told you I'd have more help to give you." You [pc.isBimbo |rush right past her proffered hand and give her a big friendly hug instead. "Did you? I kind of didn't really remember, but if that's what you said, that's awesome! |clasp her arm above the wrist and exchange the traditional warrior's greeting. "You did. ]" "Well." She grins proudly. "Here we are. Thank you, by the way. Not only did you manage to help vanquish a Wraith, you [flags.DAWNSWORD_RETURNED |returned the Dawnsword to the faithful |saved the Dawnsword from a demon and proved worthy of its power ]. You might be the greatest ally we've had in decades." You conceal whatever you might've genuinely felt about that with a casual grin. "[pc.isBimbo |Hee hee. Goooosh. |What can I say? I'm just that good. ]" The larger elf in the back nods. "[pc.isBimbo |Gosh indeed. W |Then w ]e're going to need to get your thoughts about kicking demon ass." "The more experience," rumbles the minotaur, "the better." Annika points back at the two warriors in turn: first the elf, then the [silly |moo |mino-woman ]. "[pc.name], this is Thrud, and the lady with the horns is Hjörr. They're not the only warriors we'll have flying south to fight demons, but they'll be the tip of the spear, and they'll want to pick your brain." [pc.isBimbo |"Ow. I'm gonna have to warn you, it's super smooth. That might make it tricky!" "Just a figure of speech, dear," the elven valkyrie chuckles. "They'd just like to talk to you." "Oh. Okay! What about you?" |Fair enough. "Sure. What about you?" ] "I'll be spending most of my time back here," she says. Her voice has one of those odd undercurrents of ruefulness, even though her face and body both look very happy. She lifts a strange new addition to her outfit: a large badge of office, a golden sun-winged symbol of the Dawn Maiden. "Now that we have a Keep again, it needs a seneschal — someone to oversee it and the people who live here for Lumia. And since I'm one of the older and more experienced warriors..." "Not just because of that." Lumia walks over, your party in tow, and places a reassuring hand on Annika's shoulder. "You're also one of our finest mentors, and you've been doing this long enough to understand what an army needs both during combat and during the other ninety-nine percent of the year. I couldn't ask for a finer seneschal." The newly-minted seneschal's ears flutter a little bit as she nods in acknowledgment. "At... at any rate," she continues, "I might be able to spend time out there, but mostly I'll be making sure things are all squared away here: keeping this place clean, well-stocked, and defended, training, organizing, figuring out how to supply everybody. And, you know, making sure that our warriors and allies — that you — have a comfortable, secure place to rest and relax whenever you come here." Lumia, her glowing eyes and warm smile turned toward you, picks up the thread. "This is once again a place of sanctity and safety. Annika and the rest of our Order will help me keep it that way for you." "Wow. Thanks[pc.isBimbo |! |. ]" "Of course. That said, we are the ones thanking you." The Dawn Maiden points to the door at the interior end of the Keep. "When you have the time, visit me in my sanctum for something of a more tangible reward. Until then... be well, [party.hasCompanions |all |both ] of you. Welcome back." "Same for me," Annika adds. "For the moment, I'm swamped with managing stuff, getting everybody settled in. Give me a day, though, and I'll be able to make some time, maybe bake you a Keepwarming present. Until then, though, most of the rest of the warriors in the Keep would be very, very happy to meet you." Hjörr raises a hand in salute. "Count me and Thrud in the happy to meet you and not ridiculously busy group. Drop by whenever you've got the time." Gracefully, the three valkyries take their leave of you, following their goddess. You're left with [party.compNames] in the middle of the bustling Lumian hall. Seems like you've got the run of the place. Where to go first? "

rows.original:
Despite your best efforts, you find your strength failing you, and you collapse to the ground under the Wraith's powerful onslaught. Even the goddess's powers were not enough to win this fight.
    
    "N-no," you cry out, stabbing the Godslayer into the floor as you struggle to rise. The Wraith looks down with a twisted smile.
    
    "Oh, yes! I think I like you this way. Let's go see if we can't see this reality you've been keeping from me, shall we?" It says, picking you up with one massive hand. You feel the dream dissolve around you, huge chunks crashing into the formless void as you rocket up, up, upwards. Then the sky itself shatters as well, falling around you in shards till you're shunted out into the hall where all this started.
rows.translation:
尽管你竭尽全力，却还是感到体力不支，在怨灵的猛烈攻击下倒在了地上。就连女神的力量也不足以赢得这场战斗。
    
    “不——”你哭喊着，一边将神杀者刺进地面，一边努力想要站起来。幽灵扭曲着笑容俯视着你。
    
    “哦，没错！我觉得这样你反而更可爱。我们一起去看看吧，看看能否揭开你一直瞒着我这个真相……怎么样？”它说着，用一只巨大的手将你抓了起来。你感觉到周围的梦境正在逐渐消散，那些巨大的碎片纷纷坠入无形的虚空中，而你则不断地向上飞去，越来越高…… 紧接着，天空本身也开始破碎，碎片四处飞溅，直到你被抛到了这一切开始的地方——那个大厅里。

rows.original: You ask the voluptuous tanuki witch if she's got any problems you can look into for her. Since she's helping you and all, scratching her back in return sounds like a wise idea. Who knows, it might even motivate her to hand over some new assistance that had previously slipped her mind. Lady Evergreen chuckles at that. "My, my, you know how these things work." You didn't expect to be thrown into the adventuring life when you went out into the blizzard with Cait that night, but you're a quick learner if nothing else. So... is there anything you can do for her? Lady Evergreen thinks a moment, tapping her cheek as she mumbles to herself. "Well... yes... no... hm... ah, you look like you might stand a chance. A couple of other adventurers came before you with similar offers, but I didn't want to send them to their demise, if a very pleasant one. You, though, might have a shot at succeeding." What's the job? "Out in the northwestern neck of the woods is a pretty big tree, one that's foreign to these lands. You'll know it when you see it — it doesn't belong here so badly that it's like a beacon. Inside that place live several hundred specimens of fox-eared soul-suckers, all of them eager to tie you down in their fluffy tails and drain the life out of you." [pc.isBimbo|You don't know about that. Done right, it could be kind of sexy; there are all those fluffy tails to consider, after all. Sure, you might die, but like, what a way to go!|If she was intending to make them sound menacing, she's kind of failed by giving them that kind of description.] Lady Evergreen sniffs and ignores your byplay. "To get to the point, a couple of months ago some of them took something that belonged to me — a small brown linen pouch about this big. I fashion items like the bag all the time — they're very convenient for holding heavy things — but what was in it has considerable sentimental value to my family. I'd like you to poke your nose into that den of foxes and see if you can't retrieve it for me." And she's sure it's the kitsune who did the dastardly deed? "They've been a thorn in my family's collective bums since we settled here, and the matron of that den hasn't been on the best of terms with me for... well, let's just say it's been a long while, and leave it at that. I don't think she's personally responsible for anything, but more likely, some of her numerous descendants decided to play a prank on me and it got out of hand. They wouldn't listen to me if I went personally, but an, ah, independent agent like you might stand a reasonable chance at negotiation. "As to how I know it was them, their particular religion dictates that for everything they take, they're supposed to return something of equivalent value in exchange. Perhaps it's just that my sense of value is off, but a present that turns into a pile of leaves when you open it is not a fair trade, considering what I had in that bountiful bag of mine. As much of a stick in the mud as their Shrine Mother is, she has principles. Maybe if you talk to her and explain the situation nicely, she'll get her brats to cough it up." [pc.isDK|You haven't done this adventuring thing that long compared to some others, but you know that this sort of thing is never that easy. It'll all end in tears and violence before the day is out.|Right. Go in and talk to someone, save the day with a stunning display of social acumen. What could go wrong?] Evergreen waves off your concern and gives you one of her trademark smiles. "Don't worry, I'll compensate you accordingly for your efforts." Is she sure about that? The tanuki witch rolls her eyes and purses her lips in mock offense. "Come now, [pc.name]. What cause would I have to slight you of all people? I'm relying on you to bring that nasty red demon to heel after all." All right, all right. Go into a den of foxes, retrieve her bag of indeterminate treasures, return to her. Sounds like the staple of the adventuring life. "I'm glad we've come to an understanding." A chuckle. "Don't get too caught up in trying to touch their fluffy tails while you're there. That's how they get you. Mine's much nicer anyway. Firm enough to hold like a lover." Does that mean if you succeed, she'll let you touch her fluffy tail? "We'll see about that... but the answer is certainly 'yes.' Now, you need to know how to get there. The foxes have concealed the entrance to their little den with all sorts of glamours, but I know just where it is. Now listen here..." Over the next fifteen or so minutes, Evergreen launches into a lengthy set of rather complicated directions that she has you take down and repeat back to her. It's a little harrowing when she goes into full motherly schoolteacher mode, but it is effective: before long, Lady Evergreen's drilled the route and landmarks into your mind. If you didn't know her better, you might have suspected her of using magic to help her imprint her instructions upon your brain. "That's about it. It's not going to be an easy task; like I said, I've already sent in several groups of questors and all of them either returned empty-handed or not at all. Bring strong friends and a full pack." Got it. "Now that that's over with, is there anything else you'd like to bring up before you set off?"
rows.translation: 你询问那位身材丰满、皮肤黝黑的狸猫女巫，看看她是否有什么问题需要你帮忙解决。既然她一直在帮助你，那么作为回报，为她做一些事情似乎也是个明智的选择。谁知道呢，这样做甚至可能会促使她主动提供一些之前没有想到的帮助。 常青女士听到这个请求后，轻声笑了起来。哎呀，这些事情的运作原理你应该是懂的吧。 那晚你和凯特一起走进暴风雪中，根本没想过自己会陷入这样的冒险生活中，不过至少你学习能力很强。那么……你能不能为她做点什么呢？ 常青女士思考了一会儿，一边轻拍着自己的脸颊，一边自言自语。嗯……是的……也不是……嗯……啊，你看起来有可能成功。之前还有其他几位冒险者带着类似的提议来找过我，但我不想让他们遭遇不幸，当然，也可能是某种‘愉快的不幸’吧。不过你，或许真的有机会成功。 这是做什么的工作呢？ 在森林的西北部，有一棵相当大的树，这棵树属于外来物种。你一看就能认出来——它与这片土地格格不入，简直就像一座信号灯。在那棵树的树干里，生活着几百只狐耳吸魂兽，它们全都迫不及待地想要用自己柔软的尾巴缠住你，然后吸干你的生命之力。 [pc.isBimbo|你可能不知道这一点。如果处理得当，甚至会显得相当性感呢——毕竟，还有那些蓬松的尾巴需要考虑嘛。当然，你可能会因此丧命，但话说回来，这也是一种相当壮烈的死法啊！|如果她本意是让这些描述听起来具有威胁性，那么她这样的表述方式其实有点失败了。] 常青女士闻了闻，然后对你的这些举动置之不理。长话短说，几个月前，他们当中有些人拿走了属于我的东西——一个大概这么大的棕色亚麻袋。我经常自己制作这样的袋子，它们用来装重物非常方便，但袋子里装的那些东西对我的家人来说具有非常重要的纪念意义。我希望你能帮忙去把它们找回来。 她确定就是那只狐妖干下了这种卑鄙的事吗？ 自从我们搬到这里以来，他们就一直是我们家庭的麻烦源。而那个家族的族长，我和她的关系也一直不太好……嗯，这么说吧，已经很久了，就到此为止吧。我不认为她个人应该对这一切负责，但更有可能的是，她那些众多的后代中有人想捉弄我，结果事情就失控了。如果我亲自去跟他们谈，他们是不会听我的，但像你这样的独立第三方，或许有更大的机会进行协商吧。 至于我怎么知道就是他们干的，他们的宗教信仰规定，凡是他们拿走什么东西，就必须归还同等价值的东西作为交换。也许只是我的价值观有所偏差，但那种一打开礼物就变成一堆树叶的礼物不是考虑到我那个装满东西的袋子里有什么，这已经算是公平交易了。虽然他们的圣母院长很固执，但她至少有原则。或许如果你跟她好好谈谈，解释一下情况，她会让那些小鬼把钱还出来的。 [pc.isDK|与其他人相比，你参与这类冒险活动的时间其实并不长，但你也明白，这种事情从来都不会有简单的结局。那个很简单。在一天结束之前，这一切都会以眼泪和暴力告终。|好的。进去跟别人聊聊，用你出色的社交能力来解决这个问题吧。能出什么错呢？] 常青女士淡然地回应了你的担忧，然后露出了她那标志性的微笑。别担心，我会根据你的付出给予相应的补偿。 她真的确定吗？ 那只狸猫女巫翻了个白眼，假装生气地撅起了嘴唇。过来吧， [pc.name]我究竟有什么理由要怠慢你呢？你偏偏是你？毕竟，我可是指望你把那个讨厌的红恶魔彻底制服的。 好吧好吧，进入狐妖的巢穴，取回她那袋价值不明的珍宝，然后再回到她身边。这听起来简直就是冒险生活的标配啊。 我很高兴我们终于达成了共识。一阵轻笑。在他们的面前，可别太拼命想要摸摸他们那柔软的尾巴——那就是他们诱捕你的手段。反正我的尾巴要舒服多了，结实得就像恋人的怀抱一样，可以让你安心依靠。 这是不是意味着，如果你成功了，她就会允许你触碰她？她软软的尾巴？ 这个我们再看看吧……但答案肯定是‘可以’。现在，你需要知道该如何到达那里。那些狐妖用各种障眼法隐藏了它们小洞穴的入口，但我知道它的确切位置。那么，听好了…… 在接下来的大约十五分钟里，常青女士开始一连串相当复杂的指令，要求你把这些指令记下来然后复述给她听。当她完全进入那种母亲般、老师般的指导模式时，确实会有点让人感到压力很大，但是很快，常青女士就把路线和地标都深深地记在了你的脑海里。如果你不更了解她的话，说不定还会怀疑她用了魔法来帮助自己将这些信息植入你的大脑中呢。 差不多就是这样。这不会是一件容易的任务；就像我之前说的，我已经派了几组探查队去了，但他们要么空手而归，要么根本就没有回来。所以，一定要带上实力强大的朋友，并且准备好充足的物资。 明白了。 现在既然那就是事情都安排妥当了，在出发之前，还有什么你想提的事情吗？

rows.original: Swallowing hard and steeling yourself, you draw closer to the opening between the roots of the tree. Evergreen had spoken of concealing glamours and elaborate means of getting entry... and yet here you are. A trick? It smells of fresh sap, old wood, perfume, fur... and something else, you can't place a finger on it. Though your eyes are peeled for any sign of the locals, you don't catch sight of so much as the shadow of a bushy tail. [var0| As you hesitate, the amulet in your possession begins to emit a faint warmth, pressed against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] as it is, and confidence surges through you. Yes... you're so close to where you need to be. No matter what happens to you inside this place, it'll be fine; Kiyoko will grant you what protection she can from where she is. This is the path you chose when you picked up the amulet and its amber orb back in those ruins. It's time to see where it leads. |[var1| As you hesitate, a small thought worms to the fore of your mind: this is a den of kitsune, all right. If anyone can help Kiyoko in her predicament, that person would be presumably found here... not to mention having one of their artifacts on you might change the attitudes of the kitsune towards your presence in their home. While you could forge on ahead and deal with the amulet at a later date, common sense suggests that it would be a smart decision to actually have it on your person when you're trespassing. Who knows, it might save you from a terrible fate. |Well, it's either head on in, or hold back a little longer; you're not about to hang your head in defeat and return to Lady Evergreen in shame, are you? For all its peaceful beauty, the fox-den ahead of you radiates a subtle menace, as if it knows full well you're not supposed to be here. ]] One way or the other, the choice still remains: go in, or not. What will you do? Once you head in, there'll be no turning back.
rows.translation: 你强压住内心的紧张，一步步靠近那棵树根部之间的缝隙。常青女士曾经提到过需要隐藏一些特殊的魔法手段才能进入那里……但你现在就站在这里了。这是某种陷阱吗？空气中弥漫着新鲜树液的气息、陈旧木头的味道、香水的芬芳，还有某种你无法辨别的气味……虽然你密切留意着周围是否有什么当地生物的踪迹，却连一只毛茸茸的尾巴的影子都没有看到。 [var0| 就在你犹豫不决的时候，你手中的护身符开始散发出微弱的热量，紧贴着你的身体 [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] 现状就是如此，而一股信心正涌上你的心头。没错……你已经离目标越来越近了。无论在这个地方发生什么，都不会有事的；清子会从她所在的地方为你提供她所能给予的保护。 这就是你在那些废墟中拿起那个护身符和它那琥珀色的球体时所选择的道路。现在是时候看看这条道路会将你引向何方了。 |[var1| 就在你犹豫不决的时候，一个念头突然浮现在你的脑海中：这里分明是狐狸们的巢穴啊。如果有人能够帮助清子摆脱目前的困境，那么这个人很可能就在这里……更何况，如果你身上带着他们的一件神器，或许会改变这些狐狸们对你出现在他们家园中的态度。可以继续前进吧，以后再处理那个护身符吧。常识告诉我们，在进入禁区的时候随身携带它才是明智之举。谁知道呢，它说不定能让你免于遭遇不幸呢。 |嗯，要么直接冲进去，要么再犹豫一会儿；你总不会羞愧地低下头，然后灰溜溜地回到常青女士身边吧？尽管那片狐狸洞所在的地方看起来宁静而美丽，但它却散发着一种隐秘的危险气息，仿佛在暗示你根本不应该出现在这里。 ]] 无论如何，最终还是得做出选择：进去，还是不进去。你会怎么做呢？一旦你走了进去，就再也无法回头了。

rows.original: You pause a moment longer, trying to decide if you're adequately prepared for this or not. Eventually, you settle for the latter, beating a slow retreat from the cherry blossom tree. [party.hasCompanions|[party.compNames] follow[party.oneCompanion|s] suit, sticking close until you've retreated to a safe distance. ] [party.comp arona berwyn |Arona grunts. "Getting cold feet all of a sudden?" Yes. Why, is she going to march you right around and herd you inside? To your surprise, the burly orc shakes her head. "Nah. That sort of feeling surrounding the place... I recognize it from when Hretha shuts herself away and works on those charms and curses or whatever. I ain't spoiling to go in there if we don't gotta. Magic like that gives me the creeps." |Closing his eyes, Berwyn lets out the huge sigh he'd been holding back and start fanning himself with his hat. Slumping against a nearby tree, the dogboy summoner wipes his brow with the back of a hand and mumbles to himself. Something the matter? "The magic I felt... it's not exactly Mistress Matiha's, but close enough to make me feel ill. I'll be all right in a bit." Does he not want to go in there? "I'll manage." ] You'll come back later when you're more prepared. Reconnaissance is vital, acting on the results of that reconnaissance is even more so. Given that there's no turning back, you want to be at peak form before committing yourself.
rows.translation: 你又停顿了片刻，试图确定自己是否已经为这一切做好了充分准备。最终，你放弃了这个想法，缓缓地从那棵樱花树下退了回来。 [party.hasCompanions|[party.compNames] 跟随[party.oneCompanion|s] 紧跟其后，直到你退到安全距离为止。 ] [party.comp arona berwyn |阿罗娜哼了一声。突然变得胆怯了？ 是的。为什么呢，她难道要牵着你到处走，然后把你赶进去吗？ 令你惊讶的是，那个魁梧的兽人却摇了摇头。不行。那种笼罩在这个地方上的氛围……我以前在赫蕾莎把自己关起来研究那些咒语、诅咒之类的东西时，就经历过这种感觉。如果我们没有必要进去的话，我可不想冒这个险。那种魔法真的让我感到毛骨悚然。 |闭上眼睛，贝尔温终于释放出了那些一直压抑在心中的叹息，然后开始用帽子给自己扇风。那个靠在附近树上的狗人召唤师用手背擦了擦额头，低声自言自语起来。 “”怎么了？ 我感受到的那种魔力……虽然不完全属于玛蒂哈女士，但已经足够让我感到不适了。过一会儿我就会好起来的。 他难道不想进去吗？ 我会处理好的。 ] 等你准备得更充分些，再回来吧。侦察工作至关重要，而根据侦察结果采取行动更是如此。既然已经没有回头路了，那么在做出决定之前，你必须确保自己处于最佳状态。

rows.original: Hold off for now. You still need time to prepare.
rows.translation: 先等等吧。你还需要一些时间来准备。
rows.raw: "Hold off for now. You still need time to prepare."

rows.original: Here you go, then. Stepping past the threshold of the entrance, you're greeted with a curious sight. Walls and floor blend seamlessly with the natural wood, giving a feel that the hallways and rooms are growing out of the tree itself, artifice formed from nature... or maybe it's the other way around. [party.comp cait brint atugia |"Wish we could stop and study this further," Cait muses, putting her free hand on the wood. "Growing your own homes like this... it sounds like more of what Velun would do, not Keros. The tree's immensely magical... it's such a pity." |"It's not too much unlike home when you think about it," Brint muses as he tramps down the hallway after you. "Just with wood instead of stone and dirt. Different material, same atmosphere. It feels kind of wrong, barging into someone's house like this..." |"Can't say I'm likin' the thought of this," Atugia mutters as she follows behind you. "One of Carmen was bad enough... thinkin' about hundreds o' folks like Carmen just ties my stomach in knots." ] [var0| Despite all this, though, you don't feel unnerved by this — quite the opposite, in fact. In a way, this is simply Kiyoko's cabin grown to a much grander scale, and the amulet warms against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] as you pace down the hallway[kiyoko.numKits 1|, reminding you of more wholesome times spent with your beloved kitsune wife]. If you get her out... no, when you get her out... you want to see her face, her joy, her smile. That's the real reason why you're here, isn't it? Not some silly errand, some trivial fetch-quest given by Evergreen? ] You've gone no more than thirty paces down the hallway when the gates slam shut behind you, a palpable thud rushing through the air like the final beat of a drum. Though you already had your suspicions, a glance at the now non-existent entrance tells you all you need to know: you're trapped in here. The only way, then, is forward...
rows.translation: 那么，走吧。跨过入口的门槛，一幅奇特的景象映入你眼帘。墙壁和地板与天然的木质浑然一体，让人感觉走廊和房间都是从这棵树里长出来的，是自然形成的人工造物……又或者，恰好相反。 [party.comp cait brint atugia |“真希望我们能停下来，好好研究研究这个，”凯特把空着的那只手搭在木头上，若有所思地说道。“像这样种出自己的居所……听起来更像是维伦会做的事，而不是凯罗斯。这棵树蕴含的魔力极其庞大……真是太可惜了。” |“仔细想想，这里跟家乡其实差得不算太远，”布林特跟在你身后踏过走廊，若有所思地说。“只不过是用木头代替了石头和泥土。材料不同，气息却一样。像这样闯进别人家里，总让人觉得有点不对劲……” |“我可说不上喜欢这个念头，”阿图吉娅跟在你身后低声嘟囔道。“一个卡门就已经够糟了……一想到还有成百上千个像卡门那样的人，我的胃就拧成一团。” ] [var0| 尽管如此，你并不觉得这地方令你不安——事实上恰恰相反。在某种意义上，这里不过是清子的小屋扩大到了极其宏大的规模，当你沿走廊前行时，那枚护身符贴着你的[pc.skinFurScalesNoun]，微微发热[kiyoko.numKits 1|，让你想起与心爱的狐妖妻子共度的那些更美好的时光]。如果你能把她救出来……不，当你把她救出来的时候……你想看到她的脸、她的喜悦、她的笑容。 那才是你真正来到这里的理由，对吧？而不是什么无聊的跑腿活，也不是常青女士派给你的什么琐碎差事？ ] 你沿走廊还没走上三十步，大门就在你身后砰然合拢，那沉闷的撞击声如鼓点最后一下在空气中荡开。尽管你早已有所怀疑，但瞥一眼如今已不复存在的入口，你就明白了一切：你被困在这里了。那么，唯一的路就只有向前……

rows.original: Invited or not, here you go...
rows.translation: 不管你是否被邀请，这些内容还是会出现在你面前……

rows.original: It doesn't take you long to find signs of life in this den — with as many of the doors and side passageways sealed as they are, the sound of voices reaches you, speaking in a language you don't understand and clearly isn't related to any tongue in use in the Marches. [var0|You've spent enough time with Kiyoko, though, to recognize her mother tongue when it's being spoken. ]These are punctuated by the clink of utensils, and it's not long before the smell of fragrant cooked rice reaches you, amongst other more exotic aromas. A happy mealtime conversation. Given that this is the only way forward, it's really a shame that you'll have to interrupt people while they're eating. No one ever likes that. [party.has arona| Arona grins and hefts her [arona.weapon]. "Hey, I'm not complaining. Better them caught with their pants down than us." ] Well, time to turn the corner and see if it needs to come to blows. What greets your eyes is a rather homely sight: four kitsune sit on cushions around a square low table, a heavy tablecloth draped atop its surface, thick enough to be a blanket. Laid out between them is a simple spread: rice, chilled vegetables in sweet-smelling sauce, several grilled and salted fish — the kind of food that's not exactly tasteful, but intended to put meat on one's bones against the cold. Seated at the head of the table is a five-tailed kitsune who can only be described as wild. Lacking much of the refinement others of her species you've met possess, she wears what looks like work clothes — plenty of room to move, solid wooden clogs, fabric resistant to tearing and staining. Looks like some things don't change across cultures. Your attention, though, is drawn towards the other three at the table, the first thing you notice about them being their coloration — one blonde, one redhead, with the only male in this quartet black from head to tail.
rows.translation: 你没花多久就在这个巢穴里找到了活物的迹象——这里的许多门和侧通道都被封死了，可说话声还是传到了你耳中，那是一种你听不懂的语言，而且显然与边境地区使用的任何语言都毫无关联。[var0|不过你和清子相处得够久，一听到就能认出她的母语。 ]这些声音不时被餐具的叮当声打断，没过多久，喷香的米饭味就飘到了你鼻尖，还夹杂着其他更异域的气息。 一顿愉快的用餐闲谈。既然这是唯一的前进道路，那么不得不在别人吃饭时打断他们，实在令人遗憾。没人喜欢这种事。 [party.has arona| 阿罗娜咧嘴一笑，抄起她的[arona.weapon]。“嘿，我可没意见。他们被逮个措手不及，总比我们强。” ] 好吧，是时候转过拐角，看看是不是非得动手了。映入你眼帘的是一幅相当居家的景象：四只狐妖围坐在一张方形矮桌旁的坐垫上，桌面上铺着厚得可以当毯子的桌布。桌上摆着简单的一餐：米饭、泡在香甜酱汁里的凉拌蔬菜、几条盐烤鱼——算不上精致美味，却是为抵御严寒、长人肉长的吃食。 坐在餐桌首位的是一个五尾狐妖，只能用野来形容。她缺少你见过的同族所具备的那份精致，穿着看起来像干活的衣服——便于活动，结实的木屐，耐撕耐脏的布料。看来有些东西在各种文化里都一样。不过，你的注意力被桌旁另外三只狐妖吸引了，你首先注意到的是她们的毛色——一个金发，一个红发，而这四位中唯一的男性则从头到尾都是黑色。

rows.original: Why, if it isn't good to see old friends again. Silence falls over the room as all four kitsune cease their polite chatter, then breaks as Hinata sets down his bowl, rises to his feet and gives you a deep bow, switching to a language more familiar to you. "Why, [pc.name], this is an unexpected surprise. I was just telling my superior about you." You'd have wished this reunion were under different circumstances, but you're kind of pressed for time at the moment. "At the very least, allow me to make introductions. [pc.name], this is Warden Azami Ishida. She is to me what I am to Yuzu and Kiri. Welcome to our humble lodge. Ishida-Dono, this is [pc.name], our benefactor. [pc.HeShe] was kind enough to feed Yuzu, Kiri and me when we were trapped on the other side of the river. We owe [pc.himHer] a considerable debt, especially since it is highly likely [pc.heShe] is the one who subdued the monster that had taken up residence on the bridge." Ah, shucks. Now he's making you out to be some kind of hero. This is the oddest place to be receiving such flattery... Rolling her shoulders, Azami turns in her seat to face you. Her slitted green eyes study yours for several moments, her tails swishing behind her, then she rises and bows in much the same fashion as Hinata did. "From the bottom of my heart, I thank you on behalf of my subordinates, [pc.name]. You showed them kindness despite them being what most of you outsiders would regard as monsters; this is a debt that will be hard to adequately repay. Although..." Although what? "...Indebted to you as we are, I still have duties that I cannot shirk, foremost amongst them my position as concierge of this den. Do you understand what this entails?" [pc.cunningRange 40| You nod. | What's a concierge? "Someone who is in charge of the entrance to a place or building." Oh. ] "Which is why you're not wrong in wishing this reunion was under different circumstances. Unless you have a suitable reason for being here, you are trespassing; I keep on telling the young ones to shut the entrance after them when they leave, but they never obey with any regularity. Of course, being the kind of person who would show charity to the likes of us, I assume you would have one?" Oh, right, of course. While you're here on an errand for Lady Evergreen, you've never forgotten the true reason for coming all this way. Pulling out the amber orb and its amulet, you hold it out to Azami, who studies it intently. "This treasure is undoubtedly of our make." "It's my fault. I explicitly told [pc.himHer] to come here," Hinata pipes up. "The Shrine Mother might know something about it." "Ah. Well then. Sit back down, Hinata. We have been having a fine meal in our lodge, and have neither seen nor heard anything." Hmm, perhaps you might be asking a little too much, but couldn't she come along with you, explain the situation to anyone else who might raise objections to your presence? "Alas, that is impossible. I am already risking much by placing my trust in you and deliberately being derelict in my duty; even if nothing untoward happens, the burden of shame in my disobedience will still be mine to bear. The Shrine Mother is a reasonable woman and will likely hear you out, but I cannot say the same for some other denizens of this den. Now then, let us proceed." With that, both Azami and Hinata take their seats, and the kitsune quartet proceeds with their meal as if nothing had happened. All four of them are carefully averting their eyes from where you stand... the less they know, the better. "Yuzu, have more of this pickled turnip. Kiri, chew your salted smelt more thoroughly. I don't want you choking on any bones. Now that you've known hunger, I expect you to appreciate your food instead of wolfing it down." She's just like a mother to those girls... now that you think about it, you're practically witnessing a family meal. You actually feel relieved that you didn't have to fight these guys... although by the sound of it, the path ahead isn't going to be as easy.
rows.translation: 哎呀，能再见到老朋友可真不错。 房间里一片寂静，四只狐妖都停下了礼貌的寒暄。随后寂静被打破：日向放下碗，站起身来，向你深深鞠了一躬，换成一种你更熟悉的语言。“哎呀，[pc.name]，这可真是个意外的惊喜。我刚才还在跟我的上级说起你呢。” 你倒是希望这次重逢发生在别的场合，可眼下你实在有点赶时间。 “至少，请允许我先做个介绍。[pc.name]，这位是看守石田阿兹米。她之于我，就如同我之于柚子和桐里。欢迎来到我们简陋的居所。石田大人，这位是[pc.name]，我们的恩人。当初我们被困在河对岸时，[pc.HeShe]好心给柚子、桐里和我提供了食物。我们欠[pc.himHer]一笔不小的人情，尤其是因为很可能正是[pc.heShe]制伏了霸占那座桥的怪物。” 哎呀，真是的。他把你夸得像个英雄似的。在这种地方受到这样的恭维，感觉怪得很…… 阿兹米活动了一下肩膀，在座位上转身面向你。她那双狭长的绿色眼睛打量了你好一会儿，尾巴在身后摆动着，然后她站起身，用和日向几乎一样的方式鞠了一躬。“我由衷地代表我的下属向你道谢，[pc.name]。尽管在你们这些外来者眼中，他们算得上是怪物，你却仍对他们怀有善意；这份恩情实在难以充分报答。不过……” 不过什么？ “……尽管我们欠你人情，我仍有一些无法推卸的职责，其中最重要的就是担任这座巢穴的门房。你明白这意味着什么吗？” [pc.cunningRange 40| 你点了点头。 | 什么是门房？ “就是负责管理某个场所或建筑入口的人。” 哦。 ] “所以，你希望这次重逢发生在别的场合，这想法并没有错。除非你有正当理由待在这里，否则你就是在擅自闯入；我一直叮嘱那些年轻人，出门后要把入口关上，可他们从来都不按时照做。当然，既然你是那种会向我们这样的家伙施以善意的人，我想你应该有正当理由吧？” 哦，对了，当然。你此行是替常青女士办事，从没忘记自己大老远赶来的真正目的。你掏出那颗琥珀宝珠和它的护符，递给阿兹米，她仔细端详起来。 “这件宝物无疑出自我们之手。” “这是我的错。是我明确让[pc.himHer]到这里来的，”日向插嘴道。“神社巫母也许知道些关于它的事。” “啊。那就这样吧。日向，坐回去。我们一直在小屋里好好吃着饭，既没看见也没听见任何事。” 嗯，也许你的要求有点过分，可她能不能陪你走一趟，向那些可能反对你出现的人解释一下情况？ “唉，那不可能。我信任你、故意疏忽职守，已经冒了很大的风险；就算什么坏事都没发生，我违抗职守的耻辱也仍要由我自己承担。神社巫母是个通情达理的女人，多半会听你解释，但这巢穴里其他一些居民我就说不准了。好了，我们继续吧。” 说完，阿兹米和日向都坐回座位，那四只狐妖像什么都没发生过一样继续用餐。他们四个都刻意避开你站着的方向……他们知道的越少越好。 “柚子，多吃点腌萝卜。桐里，咸胡瓜鱼嚼得再仔细些，别让鱼刺噎着。既然你们尝过饥饿的滋味，就该懂得珍惜食物，而不是狼吞虎咽。” 她对那两个女孩简直像母亲一样……细想起来，你眼前这就是一顿家常饭。不必跟这些家伙动手，你其实松了口气……不过听她这么说，前面的路恐怕不会这么轻松。

"From the bottom of my heart, I thank you on behalf of my subordinates, [pc.name]. You showed them kindness despite them being what most of you outsiders would regard as monsters; this is a debt that will be hard to adequately repay. Although..." Although what? "...Indebted to you as we are, I still have duties that I cannot shirk, foremost amongst them my position as concierge of this den. Do you understand what this entails?" [pc.cunningRange 40| You nod. | What's a concierge? "Someone who is in charge of the entrance to a place or building." Oh. ] "Which is why you're not wrong in wishing this reunion was under different circumstances. Unless you have a suitable reason for being here, you are trespassing; I keep on telling the young ones to shut the entrance after them when they leave, but they never obey with any regularity. Of course, being the kind of person who would show charity to the likes of us, I assume you would have one?" Oh, right, of course. While you're here on an errand for Lady Evergreen, you've never forgotten the true reason for coming all this way. Pulling out the amber orb and its amulet, you hold it out to Azami, who studies it intently. "This treasure is undoubtedly of our make." "It's my fault. I explicitly told [pc.himHer] to come here," Hinata pipes up. "The Shrine Mother might know something about it." "Ah. Well then. Sit back down, Hinata. We have been having a fine meal in our lodge, and have neither seen nor heard anything." Hmm, perhaps you might be asking a little too much, but couldn't she come along with you, explain the situation to anyone else who might raise objections to your presence? "Alas, that is impossible. I am already risking much by placing my trust in you and deliberately being derelict in my duty; even if nothing untoward happens, the burden of shame in my disobedience will still be mine to bear. The Shrine Mother is a reasonable woman and will likely hear you out, but I cannot say the same for some other denizens of this den. Now then, let us proceed." With that, both Azami and Hinata take their seats, and the kitsune quartet proceeds with their meal as if nothing had happened. All four of them are carefully averting their eyes from where you stand... the less they know, the better. "Yuzu, have more of this pickled turnip. Kiri, chew your salted smelt more thoroughly. I don't want you choking on any bones. Now that you've known hunger, I expect you to appreciate your food instead of wolfing it down." She's just like a mother to those girls... now that you think about it, you're practically witnessing a family meal. You actually feel relieved that you didn't have to fight these guys... although by the sound of it, the path ahead isn't going to be as easy.'

rows.original: Well, fancy meeting an old friend. Although this is his home, so it's not that surprising when one thinks about it... Awkward silence falls over the room as all four kitsune stop their mealtime chatter, eyes turning towards you. It's nice to be the center of attention every now and then, but this is just getting embarrassing. At length, though, Hinata rises from his seat and gives you a small bow. "Ah, [pc.name]. I... I was not expecting a visit. Speak of the devil — I was just recounting our experiences to my superior." You'd have wished this reunion were under different circumstances, but you're kind of pressed for time at the moment. Hinata looks distinctly uncomfortable at all this, the expression of a man caught between a rock and a hard place. Scratching his twitching ears, he looks between you and the gray-furred kitsune at the head of the table before sighing. "Before we proceed, perhaps I should make introductions. [pc.name], this is Warden Azami Ishida, my superior; she is to me what I am to Yuzu and Kiri. Azami, this is [pc.name], the native I was telling you about. [pc.HeShe] has shown us exceptional kindness in the past, sharing what [pc.heShe] had to offer with Yuzu, Kiri and me when we were in need. Before you make any decisions, I humbly suggest that you should keep in mind we are indebted to [pc.himHer]." Azami says nothing, instead turning in her seat to face you. Slitted gray eyes flicker up and down the length of your body, then she sets down her bowl and chopsticks on the table before rising and bowing. "Thank you for returning my subordinates safely to their home, [pc.name]. From the bottom of my heart, you have my gratitude. They mean a lot to me." Aw, shucks. You just saw someone who needed help and couldn't turn away. "That they had to resort to banditry is reprehensible on its own, and moreover, you showed kindness to creatures most others would consider monsters. Given the circumstances under which you met, I can't say that your forbearance was insignificant. All of us wardens in this lodge are indebted to you." Not bad, not bad. Hmm, if she wants to repay the favor, could she just let you on through, then? That would help greatly. Azami's smile vanishes, and her ears curl downwards. "Ah..." That's a no, then. "Amongst my duties is that of concierge of this den; indebted to you as we are, I cannot just simply neglect my position. You have asked of me something which, alas, is impossible." It's a pity things turned out this way. A true pity, indeed. No, it would simply be too easy if she'd taken all those empty words about indebtedness to heart and been willing to look the other way while you passed them by. Simply too easy. "Unless you have a suitable reason for being here, you are trespassing. I keep on telling the young ones to shut the entrance after them when they leave, but they never obey with any regularity. Of course, being the kind of person who would show charity to the likes of us, I assume you would have one?" You're here on business from Lady Evergreen, retrieve something she lost. That's not going to be an adequate reason, is it? "Mercenary work? No, and doubly so since that tanuki is your client. Her ancestors and mine come from the same lands, and we have history between us, to put it lightly. Yuzu! Kiri!" In a flash, all four kitsune have set aside their meal and grabbed weapons from under the table, although it's clear that their heart isn't in the fight from the way they're carrying themselves. "I'm deeply sorry to have to detain you. We will endeavor to be gentle." It's a fight!
rows.translation: 哎呀，竟然遇到一位老朋友。不过这里本就是他的家，仔细想想也就没那么意外了…… 尴尬的沉默笼罩了房间，四只狐妖都停下了用餐时的闲谈，目光齐刷刷转向你。偶尔成为众人瞩目的焦点倒也不错，可这就有点让人难堪了。终于，日向从座位上站起身，向你微微鞠了一躬。“啊，[pc.name]。我……我没想到会有客人来访。真是说曹操曹操到——我刚才还在向我的上级讲述我们的经历。” 你倒是希望这次重逢发生在别的场合，可眼下你实在有点赶时间。 日向显得很不自在，那副神情像是被夹在石头和硬地之间。他挠了挠抽动不止的耳朵，目光在你和坐在桌首的那只灰毛狐妖之间来回，最后叹了口气。“在继续之前，也许我该先做个介绍。[pc.name]，这位是看守石田阿兹米，我的上级；她之于我，就如同我之于柚子和桐里。阿兹米，这位是[pc.name]，就是我跟你提到过的那位本地人。[pc.HeShe]过去对我们格外仁厚，当初我们陷入困境时，[pc.heShe]把仅有的东西分给了柚子、桐里和我。在你做出任何决定之前，我恳请你记住，我们欠[pc.himHer]一份人情。” 阿兹米什么也没说，只是在座位上转身面向你。她狭长的灰色眼睛上上下下打量了你的全身，然后放下碗筷，站起身鞠了一躬。 “感谢你把我的下属平安送回他们的家，[pc.name]。我由衷地感激你。他们对我意义重大。” 哎呀，真是的。你不过是看到一个需要帮助的人，无法转身走开罢了。 “他们竟沦落到拦路抢劫，这本身就已该受谴责；更何况，你对大多数人视为怪物的生灵施以善意。考虑到你们相遇时的情形，我不能说你的宽容无足轻重。这座小屋里我们所有看守都欠你一份人情。” 不错，不错。嗯，如果她想还这份人情，干脆放你过去不就行了？那可就帮了大忙。 阿兹米的笑容消失了，耳朵也垂了下来。“啊……” 那就是不行了。 “我的职责之一就是担任这座巢穴的门房；尽管我们欠你人情，我也不能就这样玩忽职守。你求我的这件事，唉，恕难从命。” 事情闹成这样，真是可惜。确实可惜。不，要是她真把那些关于欠人情的空话放在心上，愿意在你经过时睁一只眼闭一只眼，那未免也太容易了。实在太容易了。 “除非你有正当理由待在这里，否则你就是在擅自闯入。我一直叮嘱那些年轻人，出门后要把入口关上，可他们从来都不按时照做。当然，既然你是那种会向我们这样的家伙施以善意的人，我想你应该有正当理由吧？” 你是替常青女士办事，来取回她丢失的东西。这算不上正当理由，对吧？ “雇佣兵的活计？不行，而且你的雇主是那只狸猫，就更不行了。她的祖先和我的祖先来自同一片土地，我们之间有些渊源——说得客气点。柚子！桐里！” 眨眼之间，四只狐妖都放下饭菜，从桌下抄起武器，不过从他们的架势看，显然并不热衷于这场打斗。 “非常抱歉不得不扣留你。我们会尽量手下留情。” 这是一场激烈的战斗！

rows.original: Well, fancy seeing them here. You thought you were rid of these fluffballs the last time you sent them packing into the woods. Guess they made it home after all, eh? Silence as all four pairs of slitted eyes turn towards you. Then, with exact and careful deliberation, Hinata wipes his mouth, sets down his bowl and chopsticks, and narrows his gaze. "You." Why yes, it's you. Nice place they've got here. Guess he's finally getting something to eat on his own instead of having to steal it off others, right? More silence. Yuzu and Kiri look torn between whether to scream in rage or burst into tears, and Hinata's fists are balled so tightly his knuckles have turned white, but neither of the make a move towards you. At length, the gray-furred kitsune at the head of the table turns in her seat to face you, studying your person with slitted golden eyes. "Ah. My name is Azami Ishida, and these three are my responsibility. They have spoken much of you, native." Did they leave in the parts where they were engaging in banditry in the Old Forest? "They left nothing out. Banditry is indeed reprehensible, even given the circumstances they found themselves in... I will apologize for any problems they've caused you." She stands and gives you a small bow. Sorry, you're not the kind to be bought off by a sob story. "Of course, of course." Azami's voice is ever so calm and dry, carefully devoid of emotion. "In a world like this, one cannot trust monsters; one needs to be hard-hearted in order to survive. Your actions were perfectly understandable. "Thus, I trust you will extend this same understanding when we are equally hard-hearted in detaining you for your trespass. Our debt to you will be repaid with the exact same coin with which you have been so kind as to bestow upon us." While she was speaking, the other kitsune have set aside their meal and drawn weapons from under the table; Azami herself whistles sharply, and a beautifully carved bow of foreign make materializes in her hands. "Please, allow us to settle all accounts here and now as Lord Keros teaches." It's a fight!
rows.translation: 哎呀，竟然在这儿见到他们。上次把他们赶进树林时，你还以为总算摆脱了这几个毛球。看来他们终究还是回到家了，是吧？ 一片沉默，四双竖瞳齐刷刷转向你。随后，日向不紧不慢、一丝不苟地擦了擦嘴，放下碗筷，眯起眼睛。 是你。 没错，就是你。他们这地方挺不错。看来他终于能自己弄到吃的，不用再从别人手里抢了，是吧？ 又是一阵沉默。柚子和桐里一脸纠结，不知该怒吼还是放声大哭，日向的拳头攥得指节发白，但两人都没有朝你迈出一步。终于，坐在桌首的那只灰毛狐妖在座位上转身面向你，用一双金色的竖瞳打量着你。 “啊。我叫石田阿兹米，这三个由我照管。他们跟我说了不少你的事，本地人。” 他们有没有漏掉自己在古林里拦路抢劫那一段？ “他们什么都没漏。拦路抢劫确实该受谴责，即便他们当时处境艰难……他们给你添的麻烦，我在这里赔个不是。”她站起身，向你微微鞠了一躬。 抱歉，你不是那种会被苦情戏收买的人。 “当然，当然。”阿兹米的声音始终平静而干涩，刻意不带一丝情绪。“在这样的世道里，人不能信任怪物；想活下去就得心硬。你的做法完全可以理解。” “因此，当我们同样心硬地因为你擅自闯入而扣留你时，我相信你也会给予同样的理解。我们欠你的债，就用你慷慨赐予我们的同一种方式来偿还。” 她说话的时候，其他狐妖已经放下饭菜，从桌下抽出了武器；阿兹米自己也吹了一声尖锐的口哨，一张做工精美、异域样式的弓凭空出现在她手中。 “请允许我们按照凯罗斯大人的教诲，就在这里把账一次结清。” 这是一场激烈的战斗！

rows.original: It can't be that bad, right? Just some ordinary people enjoying a perfectly ordinary meal. Engrossed as they are, perhaps you could even sneak by them without anyone noticing... "Ishida-Dono! Look!" All hopes of that are dashed when the blonde in the quartet drops her bowl of rice on the table and points straight at you, shrieking at the top of her lungs as white, fluffy grains scatter all over the dishes. Talk about melodramatic, but it gets the point across beautifully; in a flash, all three of her friends are on their feet and have weapons drawn and readied. With how loud that scream was — and on such a tiny fox-girl, too — you wouldn't be surprised if the entire den heard that. "I keep on telling the young ones to shut the door on their way out,"the gray-furred one amongst them says with a sigh. She's clearly the leader of this little troupe, taking point as the four of them cautiously draw close. "'Something's going to get in someday,' I tell them, and they never listen. Well, it's happened." Look, can't you talk this over? You're simply here on behalf of Mistress Evergreen, trying to find this bag that she lost — "Oh. A mercenary, and in the tanuki's employ to boot. You've gone from not having a legitimate reason to be here, to actually being a menace; if you were hoping to help your case, I'm afraid you've achieved negative results if anything. See, as concierge of this den, I can't just let anyone who wanders in just waltz by, especially when other people are out, and doubly so when I'm eating. "Yuzu! Kiri! Hinata! Assist me in apprehending this trespasser. We'll decide what to do with [pc.himHer] afterwards." With that, the four of them move in on you in earnest. Like it or not, it's a fight!
rows.translation: 应该不会那么糟吧？不过是一群普通人正享用一顿再普通不过的饭。他们吃得那么专注，说不定你还能悄悄从他们身边溜过去，谁都不会发现…… “石田大人！快看！” 这念头在四人中的金发女孩把饭碗摔在桌上、直直指向你并放声尖叫时彻底破灭了，白花花的米粒撒得满桌都是。真是够夸张的，不过效果倒是传达得再清楚不过：转瞬之间，她的三个同伴都站了起来，拔出武器严阵以待。那声尖叫那么响——而且还是那么娇小的一只狐女发出的——就算整个巢穴都听见了，你也不会意外。 “我一直叮嘱那些年轻人，出门时要把门关上，”其中那只灰毛的叹了口气说。她显然是这一小队的头儿，四人小心翼翼地围上来时，她走在最前面。“‘总有一天会有东西溜进来，’我跟他们说，可他们从来不听。好吧，这回真出事了。” 喂，不能好好谈谈吗？你只是替常青女士来这儿，想找回她丢的那个包—— “哦。一个雇佣兵，而且还是那只狸猫雇的。你从‘没有正当理由待在这里’，直接升格成了祸害；你要是想替自己争取点什么，恐怕结果适得其反。你看，作为这座巢穴的门房，我不能让随便闯进来的人就这么大摇大摆地过去，尤其在别人都外出的时候，更别说我还在吃饭。” “柚子！桐里！日向！帮我拿下这个闯入者。之后我们再决定怎么处置[pc.himHer]。” 说完，四人真的向你逼了过来。不管你愿不愿意，这是一场激烈的战斗！

rows.original: [var0|You've done it, bitter as the deed might have been. Yuzu, Kiri, Hinata and Azami lie in crumpled, groaning heaps about the wardens' lodge, laid low by the battle. Miraculously, their simple meal of pickled vegetables and grilled fish has escaped all harm throughout the pitched fighting, as picture-perfect as it was but minutes ago. It was clear... their heart wasn't in it, indeed. They didn't want to fight you; even now, you're not completely sure they aren't feigning injury, creating a situation where you can pass while they keep some semblance of honor intact. [party.has etheryn| "I kind of feel sorry for them," Ryn says as she steps over a whimpering Yuzu, the blonde kitsune lying face-down on the floor. "It'd have been nice if they'd been willing to stand aside and let us pass, but... I understand where they're coming from." You understand, too, but it doesn't make the situation any more palatable. Perhaps... perhaps when you return, you'll be able to even the score with these four. ] With the warden and her underlings out of the way, there's nothing blocking your path further into the tree-den... |With a pained yelp, the last of the foxy wardens goes down, crumpling into a heap on the floor. You whirl around and scan the remainder of the lodge, but there aren't any foes left standing — twitching and moaning, collapsed and down for the count, but not standing. The blonde girl, Yuzu, sniffles quietly with her head in her hands, but that aside there's no further movement from any of them. [party.has etheryn| "I kind of feel sorry for them," Ryn says as she steps over a comatose Azami. "Maybe it's just because we're so similar..." Bah, nonsense. She's nothing like these mangy mutts — they got everything they deserved, and maybe a little more for good measure. It would've been much more pleasant if this whole altercation could've been avoided, but as things stood it was inevitable. ] Miraculously, their simple meal of pickled vegetables and grilled fish has escaped all harm throughout the pitched fighting, as picture-perfect as it was but minutes ago. One way or the other, the warden and her underlings are out of the picture, leaving the path onward into the tree open to you.]
rows.translation: [var0|你做到了，尽管这件事干起来并不好受。柚子、桐里、日向和阿兹米东倒西歪地躺倒在看守小屋各处，呻吟着，被这场战斗打垮了。不可思议的是，他们那顿腌菜配烤鱼的简餐在激战中竟然毫发无损，和几分钟前一样完好如初。 看得出来……他们确实毫无斗志。他们不想和你打；即便现在，你也不完全确定他们不是在装伤，好制造一个让你能够通过、而他们又能保住几分体面的局面。 [party.has etheryn| “我有点替他们难过，”瑞恩跨过呜咽着的柚子时说道，那只金发狐妖脸朝下趴在地上。“要是他们肯让开让我们过去就好了，不过……我明白他们的立场。” 你也明白，可这并不能让局面好受些。也许……也许等你回来时，能跟这四个把账算清。 ] 看守和她的手下都已经倒下，再没有什么挡在你深入树巢的路上了…… |随着一声痛苦的哀叫，最后一只狐妖看守也倒了下去，瘫成一团躺在地上。你转过身扫视小屋剩余的部分，但已经没有还站着的敌人了——抽搐着、呻吟着，全都倒下不起，但没有一个还站着。那个金发女孩柚子双手抱头，小声抽泣着，除此之外再没有任何动静。 [party.has etheryn| “我有点替他们难过，”瑞恩跨过昏迷不醒的阿兹米时说道。“也许只是因为我们太像了……” 呸，胡说八道。她跟这些脏兮兮的杂种狗毫无相似之处——他们得到的一切都是活该，说不定还便宜了他们。要是这场冲突能避免，那当然好得多，但事已至此，这一战无可避免。 ] 不可思议的是，他们那顿腌菜配烤鱼的简餐在激战中竟然毫发无损，和几分钟前一样完好如初。不管怎样，看守和她的手下都已经出局，通往树内的路向你敞开了。]
rows.raw: " [var0|You've done it, bitter as the deed might have been. Yuzu, Kiri, Hinata and Azami lie in crumpled, groaning heaps about the wardens' lodge, laid low by the battle. Miraculously, their simple meal of pickled vegetables and grilled fish has escaped all harm throughout the pitched fighting, as picture-perfect as it was but minutes ago. It was clear... their heart wasn't in it, indeed. They didn't want to fight you; even now, you're not completely sure they aren't feigning injury, creating a situation where you can pass while they keep some semblance of honor intact. [party.has etheryn| "I kind of feel sorry for them," Ryn says as she steps over a whimpering Yuzu, the blonde kitsune lying face-down on the floor. "It'd have been nice if they'd been willing to stand aside and let us pass, but... I understand where they're coming from." You understand, too, but it doesn't make the situation any more palatable. Perhaps... perhaps when you return, you'll be able to even the score with these four. ] With the warden and her underlings out of the way, there's nothing blocking your path further into the tree-den... |With a pained yelp, the last of the foxy wardens goes down, crumpling into a heap on the floor. You whirl around and scan the remainder of the lodge, but there aren't any foes left standing — twitching and moaning, collapsed and down for the count, but not standing. The blonde girl, Yuzu, sniffles quietly with her head in her hands, but that aside there's no further movement from any of them. [party.has etheryn| "I kind of feel sorry for them," Ryn says as she steps over a comatose Azami. "Maybe it's just because we're so similar..." Bah, nonsense. She's nothing like these mangy mutts — they got everything they deserved, and maybe a little more for good measure. It would've been much more pleasant if this whole altercation could've been avoided, but as things stood it was inevitable. ] Miraculously, their simple meal of pickled vegetables and grilled fish has escaped all harm throughout the pitched fighting, as picture-perfect as it was but minutes ago. One way or the other, the warden and her underlings are out of the picture, leaving the path onward into the tree open to you.]"

rows.original: [var0|Damn it. You struggle, trying to will your limbs into moving, but all the fight's left you. The spirit is willing, the flesh is weak and all that — there's a note of sad finality as Hinata grabs you by under the shoulders, disarms you, then starts binding your wrists together. [party.som||[party.compNames] suffers the same fate, similarly disarmed and trussed up in short order, Kiri working with a grim reluctance that only makes this whole thing worse.|[party.compNames] suffer the same fate, similarly disarmed and trussed up in short order, Kiri working with a grim reluctance that only makes this whole thing worse.] "It's over. I wish... I wish you hadn't come here." Yuzu won't look you in the eye, her ears downcast as she watches Hinata tie you up. "So... what do we do with [party.hasCompanions|them|[pc.himHer]], Lady Azami?" "Gods. I..." Azami shakes her head, bites her lip. "We'll take [party.hasCompanions|them|[pc.himHer]] to the Shrine Mother, throw [party.hasCompanions|them|[pc.himHer]] on her mercy. I'll... I'll put in a good word. It's the least I can do." Yuzu doesn't look very happy with this outcome; no one does. You're in no position to complain when Kiri comes up with a makeshift stretcher-cum-palanquin and loads you up on it, [party.hasCompanions|[party.compNames] following after soon enough|either]. As you feel yourself being lifted up and away, something hard and heavy lands on the back of your skull, and the world rapidly blackens and spins; these foxes sure do know their craft. "I'm really sorry," is the last thing you hear Azami say. "On behalf of me and my subordinates, I hope you can find it in yourself to forgive us." Well, damn.|Damn it. You collapse face-first into one of the cushions, and the foxes are immediately upon you, biting, wrestling and pinning you into submission. You struggle and kick, trying to give as good as you're getting, but with you outnumbered the outcome was never in doubt. [party.som||Seeing you go down, [party.compNames] has a go of it, trying to salvage the situation, but is soon similarly overpowered by the sheer ferocity of fluff.|Seeing you go down, [party.compNames] have a go of it, trying to salvage the situation, but are soon similarly overpowered by the sheer ferocity of fluff. ] "That's enough," Azami commands, snapping her fingers. "Restrain [party.hasCompanions|them|[pc.himHer]]. I just want to get this over with and have a bit of peace." As one, Yuzu, Kiri and Hinata stop the brawl, the latter pulling you upright and tying together your wrists and ankles with a length of deceptively thin cord. [party.hasCompanions |Kiri does the same to [party.compNames], her expression set into a mask of grim distaste. ] "Your orders, Ishida-Dono?" "It is not our place to pass judgement when there are those more competent to do so easily at hand; our job is merely to apprehend. We'll throw [party.hasCompanions|them|[pc.himHer]] on the Shrine Mother's mercy...she'll be far more thorough than we could ever be." That satisfies Azami's underlings well enough, and they run off to fetch what looks like a makeshift stretcher-cum-palanquin. The trio are definitely cold and businesslike as they dump you unceremoniously atop it; it would arguably have been much better if they'd been openly gloating about their victory. This... this is just disturbing. [party.has arona| "Damn it!" Arona grunts, tugging at the cord binding her limbs together. You can see her hefty muscles straining at the bonds, bulging with effort; for all her strength, she's unable to break what ought to be no more than simple threads. "Seven-damned soul-sucking brush-tails and their dirty tricks..." ] As you feel yourself being lifted up and away, something hard and heavy lands on the back of your skull, and the world rapidly blackens and spins; these foxes sure do know their craft. "Farewell. Maybe one of these days I'll get to have a meal from start to finish without being interrupted." She's that obsessed with food that she's thinking of it even now? "No, I merely place far more value on my time with my subordinates than I do on time wasted dealing with the likes of you." ]
rows.translation: [var0|该死。你拼命挣扎，试图强迫自己的四肢动起来，但已经没有了力气。意志虽然坚定，身体却已经虚弱不堪——当日向你抓住肩膀，解开你的武装，然后开始将你的手腕绑在一起时，你只觉得一种悲哀的宿命感油然而生。 [party.som||[party.compNames]也遭遇同样的命运，很快便被缴械、捆绑。桐里执行时凝重而不情愿的态度，让这一切更为难受。|[party.compNames]也遭遇同样的命运，很快便被缴械、捆绑。桐里执行时凝重而不情愿的态度，让这一切更为难受。] 一切都结束了。我真希望……真希望你当初没有来到这里。 柚子不敢直视你的眼睛，她低着头，看着日向把你绑起来。那么……该怎么处置[party.hasCompanions|他们|[pc.himHer]]，阿兹米女士？ 天啊，我……阿兹米摇摇头，咬着嘴唇。把[party.hasCompanions|他们|[pc.himHer]]带去见神社巫母，让[party.hasCompanions|他们|[pc.himHer]]听候她发落。我会……我会帮忙说些好话。这是我至少能做的。 柚子对这样的结果似乎并不满意，其实没人会满意。当桐人拼凑出一张临时用的担架，然后把你抬上去的时候，你根本没有任何资格抱怨。 [party.hasCompanions|[party.compNames] 不久之后，他们便跟了上来。|要么]就在你感觉自己被抬离地面的瞬间，有什么坚硬而重型的东西砸在了你的后脑勺上，整个世界立刻陷入了黑暗，开始旋转起来……这些狐狸确实精通它们的“技艺”。 我真的很抱歉。这是你最后听到的阿扎米说的话。我代表我本人以及我的下属们，真心希望您能宽恕我们。 哎呀，真糟糕。|该死。你面朝下摔在其中一个垫子上，那些狐狸立刻扑了上来，又是咬你，又是扭打你，最终把你压倒在地。你拼命挣扎、踢打，试图反击，但由于人数处于劣势，结果早已注定。 [party.som||看着你倒下， [party.compNames] 他尝试着扭转局面，但很快就被那些烦人的琐事彻底压倒了。|看着你倒下， [party.compNames] 他们尝试着扭转局面，但很快就被那些烦人的小麻烦彻底压倒了。 ] 够了。阿扎米打了个响指，发出了命令。绑住[party.hasCompanions|他们|[pc.himHer]]。我只是想尽快把这件事解决掉，然后能过上平静的生活。 柚子、桐和日向三人一起制止了这场斗殴，后者将你扶起来，然后用一根看似细软的绳子将你的手腕和脚踝绑在了一起。 [party.hasCompanions |桐里也把[party.compNames]同样绑了起来，神情凝重而厌恶。 ] 有什么吩咐，石田大人？ 当有更合适的人能够轻易地做出判断时，我们根本没有资格妄加评论；我们的职责仅仅是执行任务而已。把[party.hasCompanions|他们|[pc.himHer]]交给神社巫母发落……她会比我们任何人都处理得更彻底。 这样足以让浅见的手下们感到满意了，他们立刻跑去拿来了一个看起来像是临时拼凑而成的担架。这三个人动作冷淡而高效，毫不客气地将你放到了上面；说实话，如果他们能公开表现出对胜利的得意之情，反而会让人感觉好一些。这种……这种态度实在令人不安。 [party.has arona| 该死！阿罗娜发出低沉的呻吟声，用力拉扯着束缚着她四肢的绳子。你可以看到她那结实的肌肉在绳子的束缚下拼命用力，肌肉因过度用力而凸起；尽管她力气很大，却依然无法挣断这些本应只是普通的绳子。那些该死的吸血蝙蝠和他们的卑鄙手段…… ] 就在你感觉自己被抬离地面的瞬间，有什么坚硬而重型的东西砸在了你的后脑勺上，整个世界立刻陷入了黑暗，开始旋转起来——这些狐狸确实精通它们的本领啊。 再见了。也许有一天，我能够安心地吃一顿饭，而不会被任何事情打扰。 她对食物简直到了痴迷的程度，现在都在想着食物吗？ 不，我更看重与下属共度的时光，而不是浪费时间去应付你们这样的人。 ]
