rows.original: Leaving the wardens' lodge, you follow the maze-like path of hallways further into the depths of the tree. The wood is strangely solid under your feet — hard, but with almost a strange sponginess to its uppermost layer, like cork. Blocked-off sections of hallway mean you have to weave in and out of several rooms that show signs of habitation with recently filled lanterns and trunks full of freshly folded clothes, but the residents are out at the moment, much to your relief. That is, until you reach what immediately strikes you as some kind of workshop. The closest resemblance you can put to the place is Ogrish's smithy, but the orc would never let his workspace descend into such chaos. You almost step on several angular pieces of wood joined together on your way in, kicking more out of the way as you do your best to creep through the large chamber. For some reason, it's rather dark in here compared to even the hallways outside... [party.has cait| Cait wrinkles her nose at the mess and sniffs. "Can't say I approve of this. Calla would throw a fit if she saw a mess as extensive as this one..." ] Through the gloom, you take note of several large shapes lining the walls, furniture of some sort, clearly of a practical bent. Smoothing planes, saws, sandpaper — carpentry tools dominate the racks on the walls, followed closely by ones for metalworking. Guess there's no shortage of wood around these parts, after all... [party.has berwyn| Hugging himself, Berwyn nevertheless follows you resolutely through the gloomy chamber. "Somehow, this reminds me of Mistress' tower." ] Click, click... The quiet, rhythmic sound draws your attention, and you turn your gaze towards its source — a lone workbench against the far wall, lit by a pair of lanterns hanging from its headboard. Seated at it is a lone eight-tailed kitsune, hunched over the workbench's surface and tinkering away at something that's rather fine and intricate. The soft, flickering light from the lanterns doesn't extend very far past his bespectacled face, and his ears twitch every so often as he works, smoothing out the ball-socket joint laid out before him. Your previous experience with Azami and her wardens has left you rather cautious, but — That particular train of thought is interrupted when the kitsune speaks in that strange, lilting mother tongue the fox-people use, tapping an empty spot on the workbench beside him. [silly| 「マイ、私のお茶を出してくれる？」 ] You've absolutely no idea what he wants, if he wants anything, or even if he's noticed you in the first place. Those questions are answered when the kitsune reaches out a hand for the empty spot where he'd expected something to be placed, finds empty space, and after a little dancing around with his delicate fingers realizes that there's nothing there to begin with and turns around to see you, a slight frown on his face. "You're not Mai. Neither do you have my tea." No, and no. "You made all that noise, didn't you, outsider? Thanks to you, I can't think straight, and I have so much work to do! Plus, I was really looking forward to Mai's tea..." [party.has arona| Arona grins a toothy, tusky grin, stepping forward to tower over the diminutive kitsune. "Well then, little fox, why don't you work on playing with your toys? Don't mind us, we're just passing through." | You have an idea. Since he's so busy, why doesn't he work on letting you pass through, then? You'll be out of his fur in no time, and a little fox like him'll have all the peace and quiet he wants to play with his toys. ] You're not sure what exactly it was about those words that provoked the kitsune, but boy is he pissed, his ears turning forward and face turning a rather garish shade of red. Hopping off his stool, the kitsune draws himself to his full height — which can't be an inch above five feet four at best — and plants his balled fists akimbo. "Ohh, those are big words you're slinging about there, [party.has arona|green-skinned muscle-brain|[pc.race]]! I'm not so absent-minded as to know you're not supposed to be here!" [party.has arona| Arona just guffaws at the outburst. "Hey, [pc.name], this one's really cute. You mind if we take him home as a pet or something? I know exactly what to feed him!" ] Yes, you're not supposed to be here, and what is he going to do about it? "Well, for starters, this." The kitsune snaps his fingers, and blue, brilliant-hued foxfire flares into existence, illuminating the workshop. Plain wooden marionettes of the sort Ogrish would use to display his wares line the walls, although you can see hinges and sockets where joints would be if they were human. The little red-headed fox-man concentrates again, and this time there's a definite thrum of power in the air, faint wisps of blue flame threading through the air like gossamer filaments carried by the wind. [party.has cait| Cait's eyes suddenly snap wide, and the gem in her staff flares a radiant pink. "[pc.name]! Don't let him get that spell off! I'll try to hold him while you —" | [pc.cl blackmage whitemage| There's no time to determine exactly what kind of magic he's working, but there's little doubt it's bad news. You've got to stop him before — | While you're not that well-versed in the magical arts, the sheer amount of power sloshing around about the room leaves little doubt what he's doing is bad news for you. You've got to stop him before — ] ] Even as you rush forward with your [pc.weapon] drawn, the little silver-furred kitsune flicks his wrists, and several of the marionettes spring to life, moving jerkily as they rush to defend their master. You can see the strings connecting him to his automatons, tendrils of eerie blue flame that extend from his fingers to the marionettes' limbs. "I will say, I haven't had the chance to really test out the workshop's defenses; I suppose I should thank you [party.som||both |all ]for coming along. Komari was never on board with the whole idea — 'Kazuo, you're just being paranoid. You're perfectly safe here. No one's going to come in and mess with your work.' Well, the joke's on her." So, golems? You swing your [pc.weapon] straight at the little eight-tailed kitsune, but one of the puppets steps in to take the blow for him. There's a satisfying thump as your [pc.weapon] strikes solid wood and the jerky construct flies apart — only for its constituent pieces to start reassembling themselves several seconds later. [party.has berwyn| "Big whoop," Berwyn drawls, a smug smirk plastered all over his face like a kid who's just realized he's got more marbles than anyone else on the playground. "Your golems are wooden. My elementals are stone. Guess what's harder?" Kazuo sniffs, and you can hear the condescension in that single gesture. "I would never create something as crude and unrefined as a golem, northerner, nor be as lazy and barbaric as you to simply rip something from nature and call it your own. These are puppets." "Po-tay-to, po-tah-to, old man." ] "Don't worry, that's not all." Kazuo makes a clasping motion with his hands, and the assorted junk on the benches and floor starts to rise and swirl, joined by the same burning blue threads. Within moments, order's arisen out of the workshop's absolute chaos, seemingly innocuous widgets and gadgets assembling themselves about the kitsune's body into a massive monstrosity of wood and metal. Immense, humanoid — almost like a suit of full armor, but with far more moving parts. Actually, come to think of it, it looks just like a giant puppet... [party.comp brint berwyn |"Careful, now." Eyes not leaving the mechanical puppet housing the artificer, Brint readies his [brint.weapon]. "I've seen enough of the womenfolks' handiwork to know something of their craft. If this is engineering, it isn't just that." |Berwyn's smug smirk has faded ever so slightly as he takes in the beast of wood and steel before him. "Well then, I guess this makes the fight fair. It wouldn't be fun if I kept that overwhelming advantage now, would it, old man?" ] "Now then," Kazuo says, his voice muffled from within his creation, "you outsiders really should have picked on someone your own size." It's a fight!
rows.translation: 离开看守们的小屋，你沿着迷宫般的走廊继续深入树中。脚下的木头硬得古怪——坚硬，但最表层却有种近乎软木的奇异弹性。走廊有些段落被封死，你不得不穿进穿出好几间有人居住的房间，里面点着刚添过油的灯笼，箱子里装着刚叠好的衣服，不过住户此刻都不在，让你松了口气。 直到你走到一个一眼看去像是工坊的地方。你能想到的最接近的地方就是奥格瑞什的铁匠铺，但那个兽人绝不会让自己的工作场所乱成这副样子。进来时你差点踩到几块拼在一起的木头，只好把更多木块踢到一边，尽量轻手轻脚地穿过这间大屋子。不知为何，这里比外面的走廊还要昏暗…… [party.has cait| 凯特对着这堆混乱皱了皱鼻子，嗅了嗅。“这可说不上赞同。要是卡拉看到乱成这个样子，准要大发脾气的……” ] 借着昏暗的光线，你注意到墙边排着几件大家伙，是某种家具，显然偏实用。刨子、锯子、砂纸——墙上的架子上主要是木工工具，紧随其后的便是金属加工的器具。看来这一带果然不缺木料…… [party.has berwyn| 贝尔温抱着自己的胳膊，却还是坚定地跟着你穿过昏暗的屋子。“不知怎的，这让我想起了女主人的塔楼。” ] 咔嗒，咔嗒…… 这轻缓而有节奏的声响引起了你的注意，你循声望去——靠远墙的一张孤零零的工作台，由挂在床头板上的两盏灯笼照亮。台前坐着一只独处的八尾狐妖，弓着身子伏在台面上，摆弄着什么精细复杂的物件。灯笼摇曳的柔光几乎照不出他那张戴眼镜的脸，他工作时耳朵不时抽动，正把面前一副球窝关节打磨平整。 先前与阿兹米和她那些看守打交道的经历让你颇为谨慎，可是—— 这个念头被那只狐妖打断了，他用狐族那种古怪而抑扬顿挫的母语说了句话，同时敲了敲自己身旁工作台上的空处。 [silly| 「マイ、私のお茶を出してくれる？」 ] 你完全不知道他想要什么，也不知道他到底有没有想要什么，甚至不确定他有没有注意到你。这些问题很快就有了答案：那只狐妖伸手去够他以为会放着东西的空处，摸了个空，纤细的手指在那儿摸索了一阵，才意识到那里本来就什么都没有，于是转过身来看见你，脸上浮起一丝不悦的皱纹。 “你不是舞子。你也没带我的茶。” 不是，也没有。 “那些动静都是你弄出来的，对吧，外来人？多亏了你，我脑子都乱了，我还有一大堆活儿要干！再说，我本来还等着喝舞子的茶呢……” [party.has arona| 阿萝娜咧嘴一笑，露出满口獠牙，上前一步，居高临下地俯视着那只矮小的狐妖。“那么，小狐狸，你不如去玩你的玩具？别管我们，我们只是路过。” | 你有了个主意。既然他这么忙，何不想办法放你过去呢？你马上就会从他的毛里消失，而像他这样的小狐狸也能安安静静地玩自己的玩具了。 ] 你不确定究竟是哪句话惹恼了这只狐妖，但他可真是气坏了，耳朵向前竖起，脸涨成一种俗艳的红色。他从凳子上跳下来，挺直身子——顶多也就五英尺四英寸高——双拳握紧叉在腰间。 “哦，你这话说得可真是大口气，[party.has arona|绿皮的肌肉笨蛋|[pc.race]]！我还没那么糊涂，不知道你根本不该待在这里！” [party.has arona| 阿萝娜听了只是哈哈大笑。“嘿，[pc.name]，这一只真可爱。你不介意我们把他带回家当宠物什么的吧？我清楚地知道他该喂什么！” ] 是啊，你不该待在这里，那他打算怎么办？ “嗯，先从这个开始。” 狐妖打了个响指，蓝色而璀璨的狐火骤然亮起，照亮了工坊。墙边排着一排朴素木偶，就是奥格瑞什用来陈列货品的那种，不过你能看出它们本该是人体关节的地方装的是铰链与插槽。这位红头发的小狐男再次凝神，这一次空气中确实有一阵明确的法力嗡鸣，淡蓝色的火丝像随风飘荡的游丝般穿行于空中。 [party.has cait| 凯特的眼睛骤然睁大，法杖上的宝石迸发出耀眼的粉光。“[pc.name]！别让他把这个法术放出来！我尽量拖住他，你——” | [pc.cl blackmage whitemage| 来不及弄清他到底在施展哪种魔法了，但毫无疑问这不是好事。你必须在——之前阻止他 | 虽说你对魔法并不精通，但屋里翻涌的庞大法力足以让你确信，他做的事对你绝无好处。你必须在——之前阻止他 ] ] 你拔出 [pc.weapon] 冲上前去，那只银毛小狐妖手腕一抖，几具木偶立刻活了过来，动作僵直地冲上来护卫主人。你能看见那些连接他与自动傀儡的丝线，一缕缕诡异的蓝色火焰从他的手指延伸到木偶的四肢。 “我得说，我一直没机会真正试试这座工坊的防御；我想我该谢谢你们 [party.som||两位 |各位 ]赏光前来。麻里从来就不赞成这套主意——‘和雄，你就是疑神疑鬼。你在这儿安全得很。没人会闯进来动你的活儿。’哈，这下可打她的脸了。” 所以，是魔像？你挥起 [pc.weapon] 直取那只八尾小狐妖，可一具木偶横身替它挡下了这一击。你的 [pc.weapon] 砸在实木上发出令人满意的一声闷响，那具动作僵硬的造物四分五裂——可几秒钟后，它的碎片又开始自行拼合起来。 [party.has berwyn| “了不起啊，”贝尔温拖长腔调说，脸上挂着得意的笑，活像个刚发现自己在操场上弹珠最多的孩子。“你的魔像是木头做的。我的元素是石头做的。猜猜哪个更硬？” 和雄嗅了一声，单凭这一声你就能听出那股居高临下。“我绝不会造出魔像那样粗糙低劣的东西，北方人，也不会像你那样懒惰野蛮，随手从自然里撕下一块就称作自己的造物。这些是木偶。” “土豆，土豆，老爷子。” ] “别担心，这还不是全部。”和雄双手一合，长凳上和地板上散落的杂物开始升腾旋转，同样被那些燃烧的蓝色丝线牵起。片刻之间，工坊的一片混乱中竟生出了秩序，那些看似无害的小零件自动组装到狐妖身体周围，聚成一具由木头与金属构成的庞然大物。巨大、人形——几乎像一整套全身甲，只是活动部件多得多。 说起来，仔细想想，它看起来简直就像一个巨大的木偶…… [party.comp brint berwyn |“当心点。”布林特的目光没有离开那具容纳着工匠的机械木偶，握紧了 [brint.weapon]。“我见过足够多那些女人的手艺，多少懂点门道。如果这是工程学，那它不只是工程学。” |贝尔温看着眼前这头木与钢的巨兽，那副得意的笑容稍稍褪去了一些。“那么，我想这样一来这场架就公平了。要是我还留着那种压倒性的优势，可就不好玩了，对吧，老爷子？” ] “那么，”和雄说，声音从他的造物内部传出，闷闷的，“你们这些外来人真该去找个跟自己个头相当的人欺负。” 这是一场激烈的战斗！
rows.raw: " Leaving the wardens' lodge, you follow the maze-like path of hallways further into the depths of the tree. The wood is strangely solid under your feet — hard, but with almost a strange sponginess to its uppermost layer, like cork. Blocked-off sections of hallway mean you have to weave in and out of several rooms that show signs of habitation with recently filled lanterns and trunks full of freshly folded clothes, but the residents are out at the moment, much to your relief. That is, until you reach what immediately strikes you as some kind of workshop. The closest resemblance you can put to the place is Ogrish's smithy, but the orc would never let his workspace descend into such chaos. You almost step on several angular pieces of wood joined together on your way in, kicking more out of the way as you do your best to creep through the large chamber. For some reason, it's rather dark in here compared to even the hallways outside... [party.has cait| Cait wrinkles her nose at the mess and sniffs. "Can't say I approve of this. Calla would throw a fit if she saw a mess as extensive as this one..." ] Through the gloom, you take note of several large shapes lining the walls, furniture of some sort, clearly of a practical bent. Smoothing planes, saws, sandpaper — carpentry tools dominate the racks on the walls, followed closely by ones for metalworking. Guess there's no shortage of wood around these parts, after all... [party.has berwyn| Hugging himself, Berwyn nevertheless follows you resolutely through the gloomy chamber. "Somehow, this reminds me of Mistress' tower." ] Click, click... The quiet, rhythmic sound draws your attention, and you turn your gaze towards its source — a lone workbench against the far wall, lit by a pair of lanterns hanging from its headboard. Seated at it is a lone eight-tailed kitsune, hunched over the workbench's surface and tinkering away at something that's rather fine and intricate. The soft, flickering light from the lanterns doesn't extend very far past his bespectacled face, and his ears twitch every so often as he works, smoothing out the ball-socket joint laid out before him. Your previous experience with Azami and her wardens has left you rather cautious, but — That particular train of thought is interrupted when the kitsune speaks in that strange, lilting mother tongue the fox-people use, tapping an empty spot on the workbench beside him. [silly| 「マイ、私のお茶を出してくれる？」 ] You've absolutely no idea what he wants, if he wants anything, or even if he's noticed you in the first place. Those questions are answered when the kitsune reaches out a hand for the empty spot where he'd expected something to be placed, finds empty space, and after a little dancing around with his delicate fingers realizes that there's nothing there to begin with and turns around to see you, a slight frown on his face. "You're not Mai. Neither do you have my tea." No, and no. "You made all that noise, didn't you, outsider? Thanks to you, I can't think straight, and I have so much work to do! Plus, I was really looking forward to Mai's tea..." [party.has arona| Arona grins a toothy, tusky grin, stepping forward to tower over the diminutive kitsune. "Well then, little fox, why don't you work on playing with your toys? Don't mind us, we're just passing through." | You have an idea. Since he's so busy, why doesn't he work on letting you pass through, then? You'll be out of his fur in no time, and a little fox like him'll have all the peace and quiet he wants to play with his toys. ] You're not sure what exactly it was about those words that provoked the kitsune, but boy is he pissed, his ears turning forward and face turning a rather garish shade of red. Hopping off his stool, the kitsune draws himself to his full height — which can't be an inch above five feet four at best — and plants his balled fists akimbo. "Ohh, those are big words you're slinging about there, [party.has arona|green-skinned muscle-brain|[pc.race]]! I'm not so absent-minded as to know you're not supposed to be here!" [party.has arona| Arona just guffaws at the outburst. "Hey, [pc.name], this one's really cute. You mind if we take him home as a pet or something? I know exactly what to feed him!" ] Yes, you're not supposed to be here, and what is he going to do about it? "Well, for starters, this." The kitsune snaps his fingers, and blue, brilliant-hued foxfire flares into existence, illuminating the workshop. Plain wooden marionettes of the sort Ogrish would use to display his wares line the walls, although you can see hinges and sockets where joints would be if they were human. The little red-headed fox-man concentrates again, and this time there's a definite thrum of power in the air, faint wisps of blue flame threading through the air like gossamer filaments carried by the wind. [party.has cait| Cait's eyes suddenly snap wide, and the gem in her staff flares a radiant pink. "[pc.name]! Don't let him get that spell off! I'll try to hold him while you —" | [pc.cl blackmage whitemage| There's no time to determine exactly what kind of magic he's working, but there's little doubt it's bad news. You've got to stop him before — | While you're not that well-versed in the magical arts, the sheer amount of power sloshing around about the room leaves little doubt what he's doing is bad news for you. You've got to stop him before — ] ] Even as you rush forward with your [pc.weapon] drawn, the little silver-furred kitsune flicks his wrists, and several of the marionettes spring to life, moving jerkily as they rush to defend their master. You can see the strings connecting him to his automatons, tendrils of eerie blue flame that extend from his fingers to the marionettes' limbs. "I will say, I haven't had the chance to really test out the workshop's defenses; I suppose I should thank you [party.som||both |all ]for coming along. Komari was never on board with the whole idea — 'Kazuo, you're just being paranoid. You're perfectly safe here. No one's going to come in and mess with your work.' Well, the joke's on her." So, golems? You swing your [pc.weapon] straight at the little eight-tailed kitsune, but one of the puppets steps in to take the blow for him. There's a satisfying thump as your [pc.weapon] strikes solid wood and the jerky construct flies apart — only for its constituent pieces to start reassembling themselves several seconds later. [party.has berwyn| "Big whoop," Berwyn drawls, a smug smirk plastered all over his face like a kid who's just realized he's got more marbles than anyone else on the playground. "Your golems are wooden. My elementals are stone. Guess what's harder?" Kazuo sniffs, and you can hear the condescension in that single gesture. "I would never create something as crude and unrefined as a golem, northerner, nor be as lazy and barbaric as you to simply rip something from nature and call it your own. These are puppets." "Po-tay-to, po-tah-to, old man." ] "Don't worry, that's not all." Kazuo makes a clasping motion with his hands, and the assorted junk on the benches and floor starts to rise and swirl, joined by the same burning blue threads. Within moments, order's arisen out of the workshop's absolute chaos, seemingly innocuous widgets and gadgets assembling themselves about the kitsune's body into a massive monstrosity of wood and metal. Immense, humanoid — almost like a suit of full armor, but with far more moving parts. Actually, come to think of it, it looks just like a giant puppet... [party.comp brint berwyn |"Careful, now." Eyes not leaving the mechanical puppet housing the artificer, Brint readies his [brint.weapon]. "I've seen enough of the womenfolks' handiwork to know something of their craft. If this is engineering, it isn't just that." |Berwyn's smug smirk has faded ever so slightly as he takes in the beast of wood and steel before him. "Well then, I guess this makes the fight fair. It wouldn't be fun if I kept that overwhelming advantage now, would it, old man?" ] "Now then," Kazuo says, his voice muffled from within his creation, "you outsiders really should have picked on someone your own size." It's a fight!"

rows.original: Maybe there's something useful in all this mess...
rows.translation: 也许在这堆混乱的事物中，确实藏着一些有用的东西……
rows.raw: "Maybe there's something useful in all this mess... "

rows.original: The smell of burning embers fills the air. Was it there a moment ago? You don't remember, ducking out of the way as the living suit of strange, full-bodied armor smashes its pincer-like fist in the spot you were standing seconds ago. Whirling around, you have your [pc.weapon] at the ready, but your foe hasn't moved, instead half-crouched as more puppets swarm in from the sidelines to defend their master. What is he doing? Then without warning, something explodes from within the living armor, wisps of foxfire seeping from its joints. Another small explosion rocks the construct, and this time it shatters into so much debris, its creator simply unable to maintain the focus needed to hold it together. Coughing and wheezing, Kazuo's thrown forward out of the wreckage of his invention and face-down onto the floor, his robes still smouldering and spectacles cracked. The eight-tailed kitsune curses and tries to push himself off the ground, only to be stopped short by his marionettes collapsing all about him. Without the ghostly fire sustaining them, the constructs return to their inert state, raining their component pieces onto their creator. [party.has berwyn| Grinning triumphantly, Berwyn steps up and taps the back of the kitsune's head with the base of his staff. "So much for that, old man; despite all appearances, rock still beats paper. I've the better constructs, and you can't deny it now, can you?" Kazuo makes several angry fox noises, barks and yips interspersed with choice phrases from his mother tongue. You don't understand the language, but he nevertheless gets his meaning across just fine. ] The artificer spits soot out of his mouth, the bitter taste of foxfire-charred wood clearly not to his liking. "Beaten by [party.som|a young punk|a couple of young punks|a bunch of young punks]..." [party.has arona| "Young punks, eh?" Arona steps up, lowering her [arona.weapon] so that the business end is mere inches from Kazuo's face. "After all that you said, you're still the one on the ground here amidst your broken toys, soul-sucker. It's adorable." ] That's right. Now that he's brought all that he has to bear against you and still failed, is he going to insist on stopping you? "Don't be so hasty, now." Kazuo raises a hand off the ground and you step back, wondering just what he's got up his sleeve. Bringing it down on the floorboards with a firm smack, you hear the loud snap of a flame sparking into existence — and a large plume of choking dark smoke billows outward to consume him. By the time it's dissipated, there's no sign of the kitsune artificer, and that suits you just fine. You spend a little while longer searching through Kazuo's workshop, checking it over for any sign of Evergreen's little bag, but no luck. Nah, that would have been far too easy... while it would've made sense for something like the bountiful bag to be of interest to an artificer like him, you'll just have to search deeper in this den of foxes.
rows.translation: 空气中弥漫着余烬的气味。刚才有这味道吗？你不记得了——你侧身闪开，那套活生生的怪异全身甲把钳子般的拳头砸在你几秒前站立的地方。你转过身，[pc.weapon] 已经就绪，可你的敌人却一动不动，只是半蹲着，更多的木偶从两侧涌上来护卫它们的主人。 他在做什么？ 紧接着，毫无预兆地，那具活体铠甲内部炸开了，一缕缕狐火从它的关节缝隙里渗出。又一次小爆炸震动了这具造物，这一次它碎成了一大堆残片，它的创造者再也无法维持让它保持完整所需的专注。和雄咳嗽着、喘着粗气，从自己发明的残骸中被抛了出来，脸朝下摔在地板上，长袍还在冒烟，眼镜也碎了。这只八尾狐妖骂了几句，想把自己从地上撑起来，却被四周纷纷崩塌的木偶拦住了。没有那股幽灵般的火焰支撑，这些造物又回到毫无生气的状态，零件雨点般落回创造者身上。 [party.has berwyn| 贝尔温得意地笑着走上前，用法杖的杖底敲了敲狐妖的后脑勺。“这下没戏了吧，老爷子；别看表面那样，石头终究还是赢纸。我的造物更胜一筹，现在你总不能否认了吧？” 和雄发出几声愤怒的狐狸叫声，吠叫与尖啸之间夹杂着他母语里的几句精妙措辞。你听不懂这种语言，但他照样把意思表达得一清二楚。 ] 这位工匠从嘴里吐出烟灰，被狐火烧焦的木头那股苦味显然不合他的口味。“竟然被 [party.som|一个毛头小子|两个毛头小子|一群毛头小子]打败了……” [party.has arona| “毛头小子，是吧？”阿萝娜走上前，放低 [arona.weapon]，让那头离和雄的脸只有几英寸。“说了那么多，到头来躺在地上、身边全是破玩具的还是你，吸魂鬼。真是可爱极了。” ] 没错。既然他已经倾尽全力对付你，却还是失败了，他还要坚持拦住你吗？ “先别这么急。” 和雄从地上抬起一只手，你后退一步，琢磨着他袖子底下还藏着什么。那只手重重拍在地板上，你听见一声响亮的脆响，一簇火焰凭空燃起——紧接着一大团呛人的黑烟翻涌而出，把他整个人吞没。等烟雾散去，那位狐妖工匠已经不见踪影，而这对你来说正合适。 你又花了一阵工夫搜遍和雄的工坊，仔细查看有没有常青女士那个小袋子的踪迹，但一无所获。没有，那样未免太简单了……虽说像丰饶袋这样的东西确实可能引起他这样的工匠的兴趣，但你还是得在这座狐穴更深处继续搜寻。

Arona steps up, lowering her [arona.weapon] so that the business end is mere inches from Kazuo's face. "After all that you said, you're still the one on the ground here amidst your broken toys, soul-sucker. It's adorable." ] That's right. Now that he's brought all that he has to bear against you and still failed, is he going to insist on stopping you? "Don't be so hasty, now." Kazuo raises a hand off the ground and you step back, wondering just what he's got up his sleeve. Bringing it down on the floorboards with a firm smack, you hear the loud snap of a flame sparking into existence — and a large plume of choking dark smoke billows outward to consume him. By the time it's dissipated, there's no sign of the kitsune artificer, and that suits you just fine. You spend a little while longer searching through Kazuo's workshop, checking it over for any sign of Evergreen's little bag, but no luck. Nah, that would have been far too easy... while it would've made sense for something like the bountiful bag to be of interest to an artificer like him, you'll just have to search deeper in this den of foxes."

rows.original: You gasp hard as the living armor's pincer-like hand slams into your chest, cold metal knocking the wind out of you and sending your [pc.weapon] flying. You dart to the side, looking to retrieve your fallen weapon and get back into the fight, but before you know it, the construct's steely grip is upon you, pinning your arms to your sides. "Who's 'little' now, huh? Still think these are mere toys?" Gods, he sure does have an inferiority complex... [party.som|| You look around for [companion1.name], hoping that [companion1.heShe]'s in a position to get you out of this predicament. No such luck; [companion1.name] is caught in the living armor's other hand, struggling against its vice-like grip to little avail. | You look around for [companion1.name], hoping that [companion1.heShe]'s in a position to get you out of this predicament. No such luck; [companion1.name] is caught in the living armor's other hand, struggling against its vice-like grip to little avail. [companion2.name] isn't in much of a better position either, trapped under one of the construct's feet and swarmed by the many puppets Kazuo's summoned to his aid. ] [party.has berwyn| "And as for you," Kazuo continues, smacking Berwyn against the ground and sending the dog-boy yelping in pain, "let that teach you that experience and finesse will outplay sheer strength every time. Power is nothing if you can't direct it to useful ends — a lesson you've learned a little too late, punk. Paper beats rock; let that sink into whatever you natives pass for a brain." ] Before you know it, you find yourself lifted up and in front of what passes for a helmet in this mechanical monstrosity of wood and metal. How the artificer is seeing you from within is anyone's guess, considering there aren't any visor slits in it like a normal full helm would, but he goes through the motions of studying you anyway. "Gods damn it," Kazuo mutters, more to himself than anyone else. "I'm getting too old for this nonsense. I'll let Komari sort you out and be done with it, and maybe, just maybe, Mai will be punctual with my tea for once." With you still in his steely grasp, Kazuo turns and stomps out of his workshop and into the hallways, the footfalls of his living armor echoing ominously. The last thing you see before you lose it is the sight of [party.som |the nightmarish puppet marching along behind you, their strings gleaming in the dim orange light. |[companion1.name], trussed up by a multitude of puppet strings wound about [companion1.hisHer] body. Kazuo's puppet horde has picked [companion1.himHer] up like a sack of meat and is marching behind their master in eerie lockstep, bringing your friends to share your fate. |[companion1.name] and [companion2.name], trussed up in a multitude of glimmering puppet strings wound about their bodies. Kazuo's puppet horde has picked them up and is marching behind their master in eerie lockstep, bringing your friends to share your fate. ]
rows.translation: 活体铠甲那钳子般的手猛地拍在你胸口，冰冷的金属把你的气都打没了，[pc.weapon] 也飞了出去。你向侧面冲去，想捡回掉落的武器重新投入战斗，可还没等你反应过来，那具造物钢铁般的握力已经压了上来，把你的双臂死死夹在身体两侧。 “现在谁才是‘小个子’，嗯？还觉得这些只是玩具吗？”天啊，他这自卑情结还真够重的…… [party.som|| 你四下张望，寻找 [companion1.name]，盼着[companion1.heShe]能有机会把你从这个困境里救出来。可惜运气不佳：[companion1.name] 被活体铠甲的另一只手抓住，正徒劳地在那钳子般的握力下挣扎。 | 你四下张望，寻找 [companion1.name]，盼着[companion1.heShe]能有机会把你从这个困境里救出来。可惜运气不佳：[companion1.name] 被活体铠甲的另一只手抓住，正徒劳地在那钳子般的握力下挣扎。[companion2.name] 的处境也好不到哪里去，被那具造物的一只脚踩在下面，还被和雄召来助阵的大群木偶围住。 ] [party.has berwyn| “至于你，”和雄接着说，把贝尔温往地上狠狠一摔，那狗男孩疼得叫出声来，“让这件事教教你：经验和手法永远能胜过蛮力。要是你不能把力量用到有用的地方，力量就什么都不是——这一课你学得太晚了，小子。纸能赢石头；把这话刻进你们这些本地人当脑子使的那点东西里吧。” ] 还没等你反应过来，你已经被举了起来，悬在这具木与铁的机械怪物勉强算作头盔的部分前面。至于里面的工匠究竟是怎么看见你的，谁也说不准，因为这上面并不像普通全盔那样有观察缝，但他还是煞有介事地把你打量了一番。 “该死的，”和雄嘟囔着，更像是自言自语，“这种事我这把年纪已经受不了了。我让麻里来处理你们，了结这桩事，说不定，只是说不定，舞子这回能准时把我的茶送来。” 和雄仍用那钢铁般的握力夹着你，转身踏出工坊，走进走廊，那具活体铠甲的脚步在回荡，透出不祥的意味。在失去意识之前，你最后看到的是 [party.som |那具噩梦般的木偶跟在你身后行进，它的牵线在昏暗的橙光中闪着微光。 |[companion1.name]，[companion1.hisHer] 身上缠满了无数木偶牵线。和雄的木偶大军把[companion1.himHer]像一袋肉一样提了起来，迈着诡异的齐步跟在主人身后，把你的同伴也带去与你同遭此运。 |[companion1.name] 和 [companion2.name]，身上缠满了无数闪闪发光的木偶牵线。和雄的木偶大军把他们提了起来，迈着诡异的齐步跟在主人身后，把你的同伴也带去与你同遭此运。 ]

rows.original: With how much of a wreck the artificer's workshop is, maybe there's something that you can use here. No, probably because of how messy it is — there might be something missed that isn't hidden away... Aha! Buried beneath a pile of wooden limbs and loose string is a small box with a distinctly antiseptic smell to it. You prise open the lid, and indeed are rewarded with a number of useful tinctures — though you aren't able to read the language on the various jars and bottles, the distinctive scent alone is enough to confirm the identity of several common concoctions in the Marches. The job of artificer must be a rather painful one if he was getting cuts and scrapes that often...
rows.translation: 工匠的工坊乱成这副样子，说不定这里有什么你能用得上的东西。不，也许正因为这么乱——说不定有些东西被漏掉了，并没有被藏起来…… 啊哈！在一堆木头残肢和散落的绳子下面，是一只散发着明显消毒气味的小盒子。你撬开盖子，里面果然有几瓶有用的酊剂——虽然你读不懂那些坛坛罐罐上的文字，但仅凭那股独特的气味就足以辨认出边境地区几种常见药剂。要是他经常割伤擦伤，那工匠这活儿干起来想必相当痛苦……

rows.original: Leaving the artificer's workshop, you're introduced yet again to the maze-like network of hallways that form the interior of the kitsune den. At this point, it's hard to shake off the feeling that the place is alive... but of course it's alive, it's a giant tree. Did you think it wasn't alive? Maybe the den itself is confounding you... This stretch of hallway is long and winding, the smell of sap getting stronger now; do these people live with this all the time? It's not an unpleasant scent, carried by the constant draft that rushes in from behind you, but the floral, perfumy scent makes the mind wander... [var0|come to think of it, you know this fragrance. It's the one Kiyoko wears on her person; the thought is more than a little melancholy.] ...And wandering your mind must have been, because you don't hear the heavy footsteps until they're almost upon you. Snapping out of your thoughts, you look up and down the hallway's length for something to hide behind or a room to duck into, but no such luck. Retreat is a theoretical possibility, but you wouldn't be able to round the last corner you passed to evade whoever's bearing down on you. [party.som| |You're not the only one to be affected by this strange place. [party.compNames] looks around blearily, as if [companion1.heShe]'d just woken up from a pleasant dream. The sound of impending danger is no less pressing, though, and at a sharp glance from you [companion1.heShe] makes ready with [companion1.hisHer] weapon and steels [companion1.himHer]self for the inevitable. |You're not the only one to be affected by the aura of this strange place. [party.compNames] look woozy and bleary, as if they'd just woken up from a pleasant dream. The heavy footsteps snap them back to alertness soon enough, though, and they quickly take up position by your side, ready for what at this point is inevitable. ] When he does appear, though, you're almost disappointed. A single black-furred, five-tailed kitsune rounds the corner, outfitted in full-body armor consisting of what looks like numerous interlocking red-painted plates over a gambeson. He's tall for a kitsune, which means he's merely slightly short by Marches standards, and kind of lanky to boot. The armor's made in a style clearly native to his homeland — the helmet even has little ears on it like those of catfolk make do, instead of folding one's ears under the interior in lupine fashion. But what strikes you about this fellow is how young he looks — not because of his build or anything, but the poor bastard's a pretty boy, with a baby face under an unkempt shock of hair that's in sharp contrast with the military neatness with which he carries himself. [party.comp arona atugia |[silly |Arona just chuckles at the sight. "Lumia's tits, really now? What sick bastard sends a baby like this to fight? This is what passes for a warrior amongst these ginger-tailed soul-suckers?" |"Hey, I didn't know these ginger-tailed soul-suckers actually had warriors!" Arona exclaims without the slightest attempt at subtlety whatsoever. "Wonder if they're any good; I'm already getting a chub just thinking about it. Hope he's less of a pushover than those we've met so far, although I'm not holding out hope for it. You need to eat more meat than what this boy's been getting to build any kind of muscle." ] |"I'm not likin' the looks 'o this," Atugia whispers to you. "We might be in f'r a bit o' trouble." No doubt she's seen some things in her time, but you'd like to hear her reasoning. "Sure, he ain't got much in the way of mass, but the way he carries himself makes my hackles rise. Leastways, he ain't no stranger to shedding blood; muscle ain't much good if y' don't got the will to use it." ] The black-furred kitsune's carrying a curved longsw — no, it's a greatsword in his left hand by the lacquered scabbard, and freezes for a fraction of a second as he spots you, his entire body tensing as his eyes narrow and ears fold back. "Barbarians, in great-great-grandmother's house." [party.has arona |"Damn right you've got one here." Arona smiles, all tusks and teeth. "You going to do something about it with that pretty face of yours? Bet it's pretty good for sucking cock, and I'm already getting a good stiffy just thinking of how much of a fight you'll put up." | [pc.bg barbarian |Suuure. You are a barbarian, but somehow you don't think that's what he meant by it. |Of course. To the likes of him, you would be a barbarian, wouldn't you? Wouldn't have mattered who you were, where you came from or your upbringing... you're just a plain old barbarian. ] ] You briefly consider a parley, then drop the idea as a soft hiss of steel on silk reaches you. The kitsune has drawn his greatsword, letting the scabbard fall to the floor, and is rapidly closing the distance between you in big, easy strides. "I told great-great-grandmother it'd happen someday, and now it has. Maybe she won't dismiss me out of hand any more after I bring your heads to her! Maybe she'll respect me for once!" With that, the black-furred kitsune charges with all the tact and zeal of a hungry glory hound, sword gripped in both hands and poised for a downward strike. [party.manyCompanions |"Is he crazy?" [companion1.name] says, steeling [companion1.himHer]self as your foe bears down on you. "He's outnumbered three to one!" He must be quite skilled to be confident in taking on all of you at once. And if he's crazy... well, that just makes him all the more dangerous. You'll have to be on your toes with this one... ] It's a fight!
rows.translation: 离开工匠的工坊，你再一次走进那张构成狐妖巢穴内部的迷宫般的走廊网。到了这一步，你很难摆脱一种感觉：这地方是活的……可它当然是活的，它是一棵巨树。难不成你以为它不是活的？也许迷惑你的是这座巢穴本身…… 这一段走廊又长又曲折，树液的气味越来越浓了；这些人平时就一直住在这种味道里吗？那气味并不难闻，由身后不断灌入的气流送来，只是那股花香与脂粉气让人心神飘荡…… [var0|细想起来，你认得这股香气。那是清子身上用的那种；这念头实在让人有些惆怅。] ……你的心思果然飘远了，因为直到沉重的脚步声几乎来到跟前，你才听见。你猛地回过神来，沿着走廊上下张望，想找个能藏身的东西或能钻进去的房间，可惜运气不佳。理论上还能撤退，但就算折回刚走过的那个拐角，也躲不开正朝你压过来的人。 [party.som| |被这奇怪地方影响的并不只有你。[party.compNames] 迷迷糊糊地四下张望，仿佛[companion1.heShe]刚从一场美梦中醒来。不过逼近的危险同样紧迫，你一个锐利的眼神过去，[companion1.heShe]便握紧 [companion1.hisHer] 武器，为这无可避免的一战定下心神。 |受这奇怪地方气场影响的并不只有你，也已经为[companion1.himHer]自己做好准备。[party.compNames] 看上去迷迷糊糊、眼神发直，仿佛刚从一场美梦中醒来。不过沉重的脚步声很快让他们清醒过来，他们迅速站到你身侧，准备迎接此刻已无可避免的一战。 ] 不过等他真的现身时，你反倒有点失望。一只黑毛、五尾的狐妖转过拐角，身穿一套全身甲——看上去是在一件武装衣外面覆着许多相互咬合的朱漆甲片。作为狐妖他算高个子，也就是说按边境的标准只是稍矮，而且身材还颇为瘦长。这身盔甲的样式显然源自他的故乡——头盔上甚至带着一对小耳朵，像猫族那样留出来，而不是像狼族那样把耳朵折进盔内。 但最让你在意的是他看起来有多年轻——不是因为他的体格之类，而是这可怜家伙是个俊俏小生，一头乱蓬蓬的头发下是一张娃娃脸，与他举手投足间那种军人般的利落形成鲜明对比。 [party.comp arona atugia |[silly |看到这一幕，阿萝娜只是轻笑。“卢米娅的奶子啊，真的假的？哪个变态会把这么个娃娃派来打仗？这些红尾巴的吸魂鬼所谓的战士，就是这种货色？” |“嘿，我之前可不知道这些红尾巴的吸魂鬼居然还有战士！”阿萝娜毫无掩饰地大声喊道。“不知道他们本事如何；光想想我都开始硬了。希望他别像我们之前遇到的那些一样软脚，不过我也不抱太大指望。想长出肌肉，这孩子得吃比现在多更多的肉才行。” ] |“我不太喜欢这势头，”阿图吉娅低声对你说。“咱们怕是有点麻烦了。” 毫无疑问她这辈子见过些世面，但你想听听她的理由。 “当然，他块头不大，可他站那儿的样子让我后颈的毛都竖起来了。至少，他对流血并不陌生；要是没有动手的意志，肌肉再多也没用。” ] 那只黑毛狐妖左手提着一把弯刃长剑——不对，看那漆鞘，是把巨剑。他一眼看到你，整个人僵了不到一秒，眼睛眯起，耳朵向后贴倒。 “野蛮人，竟闯进曾曾祖母的宅子。” [party.has arona |“没错，你眼前就站着一个。”阿萝娜咧嘴一笑，满口獠牙。“你打算用那张漂亮脸蛋做点什么吗？我打赌它舔起鸡巴来一定很不错，光是想象你能撑多久，我就已经硬起来了。” | [pc.bg barbarian |是啊。你确实是个野蛮人，但不知怎的，你觉得他说的不是这个意思。 |当然。在他这种人眼里，你就是个野蛮人，不是吗？无论你是谁、来自哪里、受过怎样的教养……你就是个普普通通的野蛮人。 ] ] 你短暂地考虑过谈一谈，但一阵钢刃摩擦丝绸的轻响传来，你立刻打消了这念头。狐妖已经拔出巨剑，把剑鞘丢在地上，迈着又大又从容的步子迅速逼近。 “我跟曾曾祖母说过总有一天会出这种事，现在果然出了。等我把你们的脑袋提给她，也许她就不会再随口打发我了！也许她这回能正眼看我一次！” 说罢，这只黑毛狐妖便带着一条饿狗的莽撞与狂热冲了上来，双手握剑，摆出下劈的架势。 [party.manyCompanions |“他疯了吗？”[companion1.name] 说着，一边为[companion1.himHer]自己定下心神迎接压上来的敌人。“他可是一对三啊！” 敢同时挑战你们所有人，他必定相当有本事。而如果他真是疯了……那只会让他更危险。对付这一个，你可得打起十二分精神…… ] 这是一场激烈的战斗！

A single black-furred, five-tailed kitsune rounds the corner, outfitted in full-body armor consisting of what looks like numerous interlocking red-painted plates over a gambeson. He's tall for a kitsune, which means he's merely slightly short by Marches standards, and kind of lanky to boot. The armor's made in a style clearly native to his homeland — the helmet even has little ears on it like those of catfolk make do, instead of folding one's ears under the interior in lupine fashion. But what strikes you about this fellow is how young he looks — not because of his build or anything, but the poor bastard's a pretty boy, with a baby face under an unkempt shock of hair that's in sharp contrast with the military neatness with which he carries himself. [party.comp arona atugia |[silly |Arona just chuckles at the sight. "Lumia's tits, really now? What sick bastard sends a baby like this to fight? This is what passes for a warrior amongst these ginger-tailed soul-suckers?" |"Hey, I didn't know these ginger-tailed soul-suckers actually had warriors!" Arona exclaims without the slightest attempt at subtlety whatsoever. "Wonder if they're any good; I'm already getting a chub just thinking about it. Hope he's less of a pushover than those we've met so far, although I'm not holding out hope for it. You need to eat more meat than what this boy's been getting to build any kind of muscle." ] |"I'm not likin' the looks 'o this," Atugia whispers to you. "We might be in f'r a bit o' trouble." No doubt she's seen some things in her time, but you'd like to hear her reasoning. "Sure, he ain't got much in the way of mass, but the way he carries himself makes my hackles rise. Leastways, he ain't no stranger to shedding blood; muscle ain't much good if y' don't got the will to use it." ] The black-furred kitsune's carrying a curved longsw — no, it's a greatsword in his left hand by the lacquered scabbard, and freezes for a fraction of a second as he spots you, his entire body tensing as his eyes narrow and ears fold back. "Barbarians, in great-great-grandmother's house." [party.has arona |"Damn right you've got one here." Arona smiles, all tusks and teeth. "You going to do something about it with that pretty face of yours? Bet it's pretty good for sucking cock, and I'm already getting a good stiffy just thinking of how much of a fight you'll put up." | [pc.bg barbarian |Suuure. You are a barbarian, but somehow you don't think that's what he meant by it. |Of course. To the likes of him, you would be a barbarian, wouldn't you? Wouldn't have mattered who you were, where you came from or your upbringing... you're just a plain old barbarian. ] ] You briefly consider a parley, then drop the idea as a soft hiss of steel on silk reaches you. The kitsune has drawn his greatsword, letting the scabbard fall to the floor, and is rapidly closing the distance between you in big, easy strides. "I told great-great-grandmother it'd happen someday, and now it has. Maybe she won't dismiss me out of hand any more after I bring your heads to her! Maybe she'll respect me for once!" With that, the black-furred kitsune charges with all the tact and zeal of a hungry glory hound, sword gripped in both hands and poised for a downward strike. [party.manyCompanions |"Is he crazy?" [companion1.name] says, steeling [companion1.himHer]self as your foe bears down on you. "He's outnumbered three to one!" He must be quite skilled to be confident in taking on all of you at once. And if he's crazy... well, that just makes him all the more dangerous. You'll have to be on your toes with this one... ] It's a fight!"

rows.original: The kitsune warrior stumbles back with a yelp, his curved greatsword slipping from his grip and landing on the floor with a clang. Seeing this opening, you move to seize the opportunity and press the attack, [party.hasCompanions|[party.compNames] right behind you as you charge forward|knowing that you might not get another chance]. Even with you throwing him to the ground and raining blows on his helmet and chestpiece with your [pc.weapon], he's incredibly tenacious and simply refuses to submit, almost managing to turn the tables once or twice as he attempts to throttle you with his bare hands. [party.has arona |"Stay down, damn it!" It's hard to tell whether Arona's trying to knock out the kitsune warrior or flat-out kill him, considering how vigorously she's applying her [arona.weapon] to the task. "Just give up already, you little bastard!" ] Eventually, though, you catch the kitsune on the back of his helmet with a solid smack and he stops struggling, falling limp as he rolls over face-down on the ground. Even his tails aren't twitching any more, and it's only then that you allow yourself to relax and catch your breath. [party.comp cait brint |"I-is he dead?" Cait asks in a quiet, subdued voice. There's blood on her staff where she'd been clubbing the kitsune, and her face is more than a little pale. Maybe he is. Maybe he isn't. You really don't want to risk him coming to and launching straight back into that suicidal fury; helping him might actually worsen his chances of survival. Cait doesn't look like she's buying this in the slightest, but nevertheless nods and turns away from the ugly sight. It must be hard for someone schooled since young in the teachings of Mallach to harden her heart like this, no matter how necessary... |On his part, Brint's leaning against a wall, lungs heaving as he wipes the sweat off his brow. "Khaaaak. I feel like I've drunk a whole cask of bloodwine and taken on an entire regiment of Chargers in the colosseum. Little fox guy just didn't know when to give up. Maybe he didn't know how." Hope he's the exception to his kind and not the norm, then. Brint takes a huge pull from his waterskin and exhales a plume of mist. "I kinda like him. Reminds me of some of the gladiators who'd pass through the village when I was growing up — they're the sort who also don't know when to give up, although probably for different reasons. It'd be a real shame if we've ended up killing this little guy." Maybe, but either way you don't want to stick around to find out. ] One way or the other, you don't want to linger here a moment longer than is absolutely necessary. When you feel you've recovered enough to not be completely useless should something surprise you in the hallways, you make like a tree and leave quickly, [party.hasCompanions|[party.compNames] hurrying along behind you|just in case someone comes along to investigate the commotion, amongst other more unsavoury things].
rows.translation: 那位狐妖战士惨叫着踉跄后退，弯曲的巨剑从手中滑落，叮当一声掉在地上。你看到这个破绽，立刻抓住机会继续进攻，[party.hasCompanions|[party.compNames] 紧跟着你一起冲上前去|你知道自己可能不会再有第二次机会]。即便你把他摔倒在地，用 [pc.weapon] 对着他的头盔和胸甲一通猛砸，他的顽强也令人难以置信，就是不肯认输，有两次甚至差点反过身来，赤手空拳地掐住你的喉咙。 [party.has arona |“躺下，该死！”很难判断阿萝娜是想把这位狐妖战士打晕，还是干脆要了他的命——看她挥 [arona.weapon] 的劲头就知道了。“赶紧认输吧，你这个小杂种！” ] 不过最终，你一记结结实实的重击落在他的头盔后部，他不再挣扎，软软地瘫了下去，翻身面朝下趴在地上。连他的尾巴也不再抽动了，直到这时你才敢放松下来，喘口气。 [party.comp cait brint |“他、他死了吗？”凯特压低声音问道。她用来敲打狐妖的法杖上沾着血，脸色也白得厉害。 也许死了。也许没有。你实在不想冒险让他醒过来，又一次扑上来拼命；帮他说不定反而会让他更难活下来。 凯特看起来完全不信这套说辞，但还是点了点头，从那副难看的景象前转过身去。对一个自幼受玛拉赫教义熏陶的人来说，要把心肠硬到这种地步想必很难，无论多么必要…… |布林特则靠在墙上，喘着粗气，擦去额头的汗。“呼……我感觉自己像是灌下了一整桶血酒，又在斗兽场里跟整整一队冲锋兵打了一场。那小狐狸就是不知道什么时候该放弃。也许他根本不知道该怎么放弃。” 但愿他是他族类中的例外，而不是常态。 布林特从水袋里灌了一大口，呼出一团白雾。“我还挺喜欢他的。他让我想起小时候经过村子的那些角斗士——他们也是那种不知道什么时候该放弃的人，虽然原因大概不一样。要是我们最后把这个小家伙弄死了，那可就太可惜了。” 也许吧，但不管怎样，你都不想留在这里弄清楚结果。 ] 无论如何，你都不想在这里多逗留一刻，除非绝对必要。等你觉得自己恢复得差不多，万一走廊里冒出什么意外也不至于完全帮不上忙时，你就赶紧动身离开，[party.hasCompanions|[party.compNames] 匆匆跟在你身后|以防有人过来查看这场骚动，也防着别的更不妙的麻烦]。

rows.original:
When defeated, it's wise to hope that your enemy is an evil man. He'll want to gloat, savour his victory, watch you squirm. Triumph to such a person isn't worth much if his enemy is spared the emptiness and sting of defeat.

        A good man, or at least a self-righteous one, will kill you without another word.
        
        Sensing that you no longer have the strength to resist him, the kitsune warrior raises his greatsword, readying a flamboyant overhead stroke to finish you off. He certainly has a sense for theaterics...
        
        As the keenly honed edge is about to bite deep into your neck, though, a brilliant amber light emerges from the amulet and its orb, shielding you from the killing blow. Sparks scrape from tortured metal as the kitsune grits his teeth, pressing his weight against the magical shield as if willing to penetrate it by sheer force of will alone, but it holds.
        
        Kiyoko just saved your life...
        
        However, the problem of your bruises and bleeding out is far from solved. As you feel your strength ebb from you, your only thought is how ironic it would be for you to be saved by Kiyoko, only to succumb to exsanguination...
rows.translation:
战败之际，明智的做法是希望你的敌人是个恶人。他会想要炫耀，细细品味自己的胜利，看着你挣扎。对这种人来说，如果敌人没有尝到失败的空虚与刺痛，胜利就不值一提。

        而一个好人，或者至少一个自认正义的人，会一言不发地杀了你。
        
        感觉到你再也无力反抗，那位狐妖战士举起巨剑，摆出一个花哨的过顶劈砍姿势，准备结果你。他还真是有戏剧细胞……
        
        然而，就在那磨得锋利的刃口即将深深咬进你脖颈时，一道耀眼的琥珀色光芒从护符与那颗宝珠中迸发出来，替你挡下了这致命一击。狐妖咬紧牙关，把全身的重量压在那面魔法护盾上，仿佛单凭意志力就能将它刺穿，金属被折磨得迸出火花，但它撑住了。
        
        清子刚刚救了你的命……
        
        可是，你身上的伤和失血的问题还远没有解决。当你感到力气一点点流失时，你唯一的念头是：要是被清子救了，最后却因为失血过多而死，那该有多讽刺……

rows.original: When defeated, it's wise to hope that your enemy is an evil man. He'll want to gloat, savour his victory, watch you squirm. Triumph to such a person isn't worth much if his enemy is spared the emptiness and sting of defeat. A good man, or at least a self-righteous one, will kill you without another word. The last thing you feel is the edge of that foreign greatsword biting deep into your neck, and the warmth of blood blossoming outwards as keen metal slices through your spine. Your adventure and your life end here.
rows.translation: 当被击败时，最好希望自己的敌人是个邪恶之徒。他会想要炫耀自己的胜利，享受那种成就感，看着你痛苦挣扎。对于这样的人来说，如果他的敌人没有体会到失败的空虚与痛苦，那么他的胜利也就没什么意义了。 而一个善良的人，或者至少是一个自以为正义的人，会毫不犹豫地杀了你。 你最后感受到的，只会是那把陌生巨剑深深刺入你的脖颈，锋利的金属切穿你的脊椎，鲜血顿时涌了出来。 你的冒险，以及你的生命，都在此终结。

The last thing you feel is the edge of that foreign greatsword biting deep into your neck, and the warmth of blood blossoming outwards as keen metal slices through your spine. Your adventure and your life end here. "

rows.original: Further on into the tree you march — at this point, you're certain that the kitsune den is bigger on the inside than it is on the outside, much like Evergreen's manor. [pc.toughnessRange 60|Despite your hearty constitution|You've walked so far], the soles of your feet are beginning to ache more than a little. Despite searching a number of rooms on your way in — sitting rooms, storage, even a couple of private quarters — you've turned up nothing as immediately out of place as Evergreen's bountiful bag. Perhaps taking a job like this without perhaps asking for some way to home in on the object she's looking for was a bad idea... [var0| Not to mention the real reason you're here, either. You came here to find someone who could help Kiyoko out of her situation, but every single kitsune you've met so far has been either unwilling or unable to tell you very much about the amulet. Come to think about it, for such an expansive den, it's rather sparsely populated, but Azami did say everyone had gone out for a festival or something... What a headache. You'd hoped you could just flash the amulet and the kitsune would be kind enough to step aside and direct you to someone who could help, but no. That would be too easy. If you've learned anything since the night of the blizzard, it's that anything worth doing is always a struggle... ] At this point, you must be pretty close to the heart of this fox den — even the occasional paper lantern on the wall has all but vanished, leaving an eerie orange glow in the air to light your way. [party.has berwyn |"Paper lanterns with candles in them," Berwyn quips as he trundles along behind you. "Paper lanterns with candles in them, lighting up the inside of a tree. Even if the tree itself is more fireproof than most, am I the only one who thinks that's really just asking for it?" ] Eventually, though, the hallway opens up into a wide chamber — no, a garden inside of the tree. The floral scent which you noticed when you stepped into this den of foxes is at its strongest here, wafting upwards from the neat beds of pink blossoms arrayed about the sides. There's even a stone path up to the foot of a — well, you guess it must be a hill, because it's sloping upwards. From that point, it's up a stone stairwell to what looks like an enormous arched gate, and beyond that... well, you'd have to get closer to check it out. [party.has brint |"No way left but forward, then," Brint muses. "Hup!" ] Setting down the stone path at a steady pace, you make for the red-painted gate arch at the top of the slope. It's a little unsettling, the rustle of leaves and gurgling of flowing water within a living tree... at the same time, part of you has come to accept there's more to this place than the eye can see. Passing a couple of decorative boulders on the way, you reach the base of the stairs when a flicker of movement from the top landing catches your eye. [party.has atugia |"My neck's aching again," Atugia mutters as she grabs you by the shoulder and pulls you back. "That's always bad news. Look out!" ] You don't need telling twice. Stepping back and readying a hand at your [pc.weapon], you look up just as two silhouettes detach themselves from either gatepost and start sashaying down the steps. Two female kitsune, each with six tails apiece and golden slitted eyes, begin closing the distance to you, black chokers about their necks and salacious smiles on their lips. That's where the similarity ends. The kitsune to your right, the one with the paper fan in hand — she's an oversexed vixen goddess. Each of her tits is as large as her head, if not bigger, and her hips are blatant to match. Both assets strain at her sleeveless red-and-white clothing, those sinfully short skirts exposing just the right amount of thigh between them and her tall stockings. Her outfit... there's a clear sense of formality here, yet at the same time it's undeniably a temptress' toolkit, allowing her long, orange hair to spill down over her shoulders and join her curling tails. Come to think of it, it's not too much unlike Cait's own passion priestess garb, or at least possessed of the same energy. [party.has cait |"Baaah," Cait spits, sounding more than a little aggrieved as her tail lashes irritably from side to side. "Didn't know any other gods were getting into temple prostitutes too. That's Mallach's domain, and where almost all the Temple's income comes from." Why, checking out the competition? "I'd hardly call this one competition. Look at her strut. She's got no subtlety." ] Conversely, the kitsune to your left is more modestly proportioned with sharper, more delicate features, although that still gives her plenty of room to be voluptuous. The long, flowing sleeves and skirts of her red-and-white uniform are nevertheless altered to strategically show off choice sections of tits and thigh; instead of the full frontal desire of her companion designed to overwhelm, this one wields her sexuality like a knife between the ribs. Her gray hair's been done up in a loose bun, held in place with a couple of golden hairpins save for a couple of tresses that flow down the sides of her head and down her shoulders. What's most prominent about the gray kitsune, though, is the long-stemmed pipe she's carrying. The calming aroma of winterstem smoke clings to her person, an aura of ennui that enshrouds her. Whitish vapour rises from the pipe's bowl, much like what one might find in almost every watering hole in the Marches... guess some things never change. "Oh shucks, sis," the orange-furred kitsune says, her eyes darting [party.som|over your body|between you and [party.compNames]|between [party.combatNames]]. Her voice is high and jovial, almost sing-song and with a strange lilt to it that you haven't heard before even in other kitsune. "I'm guessin' the kids forgot to close th' damn door when they went out for th' festival, didn't they? Look at th' barbarians that came on in... all y'all makin' a right mess o' our home..." Kids? You don't know that much about how kitsune age, but you could swear these two aren't a day above twenty. "I'm really sorry, but we ain't letting the likes o' ya just waltz on through," the gray-furred kitsune sister drawls before taking a long draw on her pipe and blowing out a plume of white smoke. "This here torii gate draws the line between the sacred an' the mundane, an' lettin' someone like ya in just ain't done. Granny, she'd be pre-tty mad... especially since yer ain't supposed to be here in the first place." [var0| Look, look. Perhaps... perhaps you can give your social skills a chance here. Maybe if you just talk to these two, they'll give you a chance to explain, and then you can show them Kiyoko's amulet and that'll open a nice honest discussion and they can take you to someone who can help Kiyoko after you've explained your intentions. But if kitsune are anything like people usually are... "So, if ya'll don't mind none, I think we'll be showin' ya the door. This here place is kinda off-limits to even any ol' kitsune, and I don't wanna hear no excuses from yer lips." Yep, thought as much. Guess that would have been too easy — some things never change, no matter where you go or who you're dealing with. | Look, look. These two have practically been the only ones who've tried to hold a decent conversation with you ever since you entered this place; maybe you can try to give your social skills a chance here. Maybe, just maybe, if you explain, this doesn't have to end up in nastiness. But if kitsune are anything like most other people usually are... Well, you're here on business, and if you finish that business, you can be out of here and out of their hair. Do they know something about a bag that belonged to a certain tanuki known as Oxana Evergreen? You've been hired to retrieve it for her; apparently it has considerable sentimental value for the witch. At that, both sisters just burst out into tittering laughter. "Fancy ya should be bringing up that name. Granny an' the 'nuki don't like each other much." "Not that they hate each other or anythin'. It's more like... more like two ladies tryin' to claim who's th' best cook in town. A friendly rivalry." "Nevertheless, I think all ya'll can see why we ain't really inclined to help ya. That witch does some right creepy things... I'm sure ya've seen her so-called daughters hangin' around her place? Either way, we ain't about to go against granny one way or th' other." Yep, thought as much. Guess that would have been too easy — some things never change, no matter where you go or who you're dealing with. ] The orange-furred kitsune licks her lips and takes a step forward, hips swaying. "I'll say, though. [party.hasCompanions|Y'all|Ya] came at a great time... Mai an' I here were gettin' somewhat peckish on duty here. Usually, we gotta leave the den to feed... it's Keros' providence that [party.hasCompanions|all y'all should offer up yerselves|you should offer up yerself] an' come all th' way here to do it... much appreciated. Spice up our caretakin' duties, as it were." "Don't worry." Mai smiles, revealing sharp fox fangs where human teeth had been moments ago. "Miko an' I... we'll make it up to you. Equivalent exchange, you know?" Damn it, maneaters in both senses of the word. Before you know it, the vixen sisters are pressing in on you, the heat of their soft, supple bodies painfully palpable even at this distance. It's a fight!
rows.translation: 继续深入树中，你一路前行——到了这一步，你已经确信，这座狐妖巢穴的内部比外面还要大，和常青女士的庄园颇为相似。 [pc.toughnessRange 60|尽管你的体格十分健壮|你已经走了这么远的路，]你的脚底开始疼得厉害了。一路上你搜过不少房间——起居室、储藏室，甚至还有几间私人卧房——却始终没发现任何像常青女士的丰饶袋那样一眼就显得格格不入的东西。也许，接下这种活儿却没有先问清楚有没有什么办法追踪她想要的东西，本身就是个糟糕的主意…… [var0| 更别提你来到这里的那真正原因了。你来是为了找一个能帮清子摆脱她眼下处境的人，可你至今遇到的每一只狐妖，要么不愿、要么根本无法告诉你更多关于那枚护符的事。细想起来，这么大的巢穴，住的人却相当稀少，不过阿兹米确实说过大家都出门参加什么庆典去了…… 真是头疼。你本来以为只要亮出护符，狐妖就会好心让开道路，指点你去找能帮忙的人，可并没有。那样未免太简单了。自从暴风雪那一夜以来，你学到的一件事就是：任何值得去做的事，总免不了一番挣扎…… ] 到了这一步，你应该离这座狐穴的核心相当近了——就连墙上偶尔挂着的纸灯笼也几乎全都消失了，只剩空气中那诡异的橙光为你照路。 [party.has berwyn |“里面点着蜡烛的纸灯笼，”贝尔温跟在你身后慢悠悠地走着，打趣道。“里面点着蜡烛的纸灯笼，照亮了一棵树的内部。就算这棵树本身比大多数树都更防火，难道只有我觉得这简直是在自找麻烦吗？” ] 不过，走廊最终豁然开朗，通向一个宽阔的厅堂——不，是树内部的一座庭园。你走进这座狐穴时闻到的花香在这里最为浓烈，从两侧排列整齐的粉色花坛中向上飘散。甚至还有一条石径通向一处的脚下——嗯，你猜那应该是座小丘，因为地势在向上倾斜。从那里再沿石阶而上，就是一扇巨大的拱形大门，而过了那扇门……嗯，你得走近些才能看清楚。 [party.has brint |“那么，除了向前，没有别的路可走了，”布林特沉吟道。“走！” ] 你踏着石径稳步前行，朝坡顶那扇朱漆门拱走去。活树之中竟有落叶的沙沙声与流水的汩汩声，这让人有些不安……但与此同时，你心里已经接受了这样一个事实：这个地方远不止肉眼所见的这些。途中经过几块装饰用的巨石，你刚走到阶梯底部，顶层平台上闪过的一道动静就吸引了你的目光。 [party.has atugia |“我的脖子又开始疼了，”阿图吉娅低声说着，一把抓住你的肩膀把你拉了回来。“这种感觉从来都不是好事。小心！” ] 这话不用她说第二遍。你后退一步，一只手按上 [pc.weapon]，抬头望去，正好看见两个身影从两侧的门柱后走出来，开始沿着台阶婀娜而下。那是两只雌性狐妖，各长着六条尾巴和金色的竖瞳，脖子上戴着黑色颈圈，唇边挂着淫荡的笑容，正一步步向你靠近。 相似之处也就到此为止了。你右边那只手里拿着纸扇的狐妖——她可是个风骚入骨的狐妖女神。她每一只乳房都大得像她的脑袋，甚至更大，臀部也同样毫不掩饰地丰腴。这两处都被她那身无袖的红白衣衫绷得紧紧的，短得离谱的裙摆恰好露出大腿与长袜之间恰到好处的一段肌肤。她这身装扮……明显带着正式场合的意味，却又无疑是一套勾引人的行头，让她长长的橙色头发披散在肩头，与卷曲的尾巴融为一体。细想起来，这和凯特自己那身欢愉女祭司服相去不远，至少散发着同样的气息。 [party.has cait |“呸——”凯特啐了一口，听得出颇为恼火，尾巴也烦躁地甩来甩去。“没想到还有别的神明也搞起了神庙娼妓这一套。那可是玛拉赫的领域，也是神庙几乎全部收入的来源。” 怎么，你是在打探竞争对手的情况吗？ “我可不会把这位当成什么竞争对手。看看她那副招摇的样子，一点技巧都没有。” ] 相反，你左边那只身材更为匀称，五官也更精致纤细，不过这也依然让她有足够的余地显得丰腴动人。她那身红白制服的飘逸长袖与裙摆都被特意改过，巧妙地露出胸前与大腿的关键部位；与同伴那种以直白的暴露来压倒对方的路数不同，这一位把自己的性感当成一把捅进肋间的刀来使。她的灰发松松地挽成一个发髻，用几根金簪固定，只有几缕发丝垂在脸颊两侧，一直落到肩上。 不过这只灰毛狐妖最显眼的，还是她手里那杆长柄烟斗。冬木烟斗那股安神的香气黏在她身上，为她罩上一层倦怠的气息。烟锅里升起白色的烟雾，和你在边境几乎每一家酒馆里都能见到的情景没什么两样……看来有些东西永远都不会变。 “哎呀，姐，”那只橙毛狐妖说道，眼睛飞快地转动着 [party.som|打量着你|在你们之间来回|在 [party.compNames] 和 [party.combatNames] 之间来回]。她的嗓音又高又欢快，几乎像在唱歌，还带着一种你在其他狐妖身上都没听过的奇怪腔调。“我猜那些小崽子出门参加庆典的时候又忘了关上那扇该死的门，对吧？看看这些闯进来的野蛮人……你们把我们家弄得一团糟……” 小崽子？你对狐妖的成长规律了解不多，但你敢发誓这两只绝对没超过二十岁。 “我真的很抱歉，但我们不能让你们这种人就这么大摇大摆地过去，”那位灰毛狐妖姐姐拖着腔调说，然后长长地吸了一口烟斗，吐出一缕白烟。“这道鸟居大门划出了神圣与世俗的界线，放你这种人进去是绝对不行的。姥姥她可是会气坏的……尤其是你本来就不该出现在这里。” [var0| 瞧，瞧。也许……也许你可以在这里试试自己的社交本事。说不定你只要跟这两位聊聊，她们就会给你一个解释的机会，然后你就能拿出清子的护符，那样就能展开一场坦诚友好的谈话，等你说清自己的来意之后，她们还能带你去见能帮清子的人。 可要是狐妖也跟一般人没什么两样…… “所以，要是你们不介意的话，我想我们得请你们出去了。这地方连普通的狐妖都不许进，我也不想听你们嘴里冒出什么借口。” 嗯，果然如此。看来那还是太简单了——有些事永远都不会变，无论你走到哪里、跟谁打交道都一样。 | 瞧，瞧。自从你进了这地方，几乎只有这两位试着跟你正经说上几句话；也许你可以在这里试试自己的社交本事。说不定，只是说不定，只要你好好解释，事情就不必闹到难看的地步。 可要是狐妖也和大多数其他人没什么两样…… 嗯，你是来办事的，只要把事办完，你就能离开这里，也不再碍她们的眼。她们知道一个属于某位名叫奥克萨娜·常青的狸猫的袋子吗？你受雇为她取回那件东西；据说它那位女巫来说有着相当大的情感价值。 听到这话，两姐妹顿时咯咯地笑了起来。 “你居然提起那个名字。姥姥和那只狸猫可不太对付。” “倒也不是说她们彼此憎恨什么的。更像是……更像两位太太在争谁才是镇上最好的厨子。就是那种友好的较劲。” “不过，我想你们都看得出来，我们为什么不太乐意帮你们。那女巫干的事可够瘆人的……你们肯定也见过她那些所谓的‘女儿’在她宅子附近晃悠吧？总之，我们可不想跟姥姥对着干。” 嗯，果然如此。看来那还是太简单了——有些事永远都不会变，无论你走到哪里、跟谁打交道都一样。 ] 那只橙毛狐妖舔了舔嘴唇，向前迈了一步，臀部随之摇摆。“不过我得说一句。 [party.hasCompanions|你们几位|你]来得可真是时候……我和舞在这儿值班，正觉得有点饿了。平时我们得离开巢穴去进食……这是凯罗斯的眷顾，[party.hasCompanions|让你们几位都献上自己|让你献上自己]，还大老远跑到这儿来……真是感激不尽。可以说是给我们的看守差事添了点滋味。” “别担心。”舞微笑着，露出方才还是人类牙齿的地方此刻那锋利的狐牙。“我和米可……我们会补偿你的。等价交换，你懂的。” 该死，名副其实的食人魔——两种意义上都是。还没等你反应过来，这对狐妖姐妹已经向你逼近，她们柔软而富有弹性的身体散发的热量，隔着这点距离也让人清楚地感觉到。 这是一场激烈的战斗！
rows.raw: " Further on into the tree you march — at this point, you're certain that the kitsune den is bigger on the inside than it is on the outside, much like Evergreen's manor. [pc.toughnessRange 60|Despite your hearty constitution|You've walked so far], the soles of your feet are beginning to ache more than a little. Despite searching a number of rooms on your way in — sitting rooms, storage, even a couple of private quarters — you've turned up nothing as immediately out of place as Evergreen's bountiful bag. Perhaps taking a job like this without perhaps asking for some way to home in on the object she's looking for was a bad idea... [var0| Not to mention the real reason you're here, either. You came here to find someone who could help Kiyoko out of her situation, but every single kitsune you've met so far has been either unwilling or unable to tell you very much about the amulet. Come to think about it, for such an expansive den, it's rather sparsely populated, but Azami did say everyone had gone out for a festival or something... What a headache. You'd hoped you could just flash the amulet and the kitsune would be kind enough to step aside and direct you to someone who could help, but no. That would be too easy. If you've learned anything since the night of the blizzard, it's that anything worth doing is always a struggle... ] At this point, you must be pretty close to the heart of this fox den — even the occasional paper lantern on the wall has all but vanished, leaving an eerie orange glow in the air to light your way. [party.has berwyn |"Paper lanterns with candles in them," Berwyn quips as he trundles along behind you. "Paper lanterns with candles in them, lighting up the inside of a tree. Even if the tree itself is more fireproof than most, am I the only one who thinks that's really just asking for it?" ] Eventually, though, the hallway opens up into a wide chamber — no, a garden inside of the tree. The floral scent which you noticed when you stepped into this den of foxes is at its strongest here, wafting upwards from the neat beds of pink blossoms arrayed about the sides. There's even a stone path up to the foot of a — well, you guess it must be a hill, because it's sloping upwards. From that point, it's up a stone stairwell to what looks like an enormous arched gate, and beyond that... well, you'd have to get closer to check it out. [party.has brint |"No way left but forward, then," Brint muses. "Hup!" ] Setting down the stone path at a steady pace, you make for the red-painted gate arch at the top of the slope. It's a little unsettling, the rustle of leaves and gurgling of flowing water within a living tree... at the same time, part of you has come to accept there's more to this place than the eye can see. Passing a couple of decorative boulders on the way, you reach the base of the stairs when a flicker of movement from the top landing catches your eye. [party.has atugia |"My neck's aching again," Atugia mutters as she grabs you by the shoulder and pulls you back. "That's always bad news. Look out!" ] You don't need telling twice. Stepping back and readying a hand at your [pc.weapon], you look up just as two silhouettes detach themselves from either gatepost and start sashaying down the steps. Two female kitsune, each with six tails apiece and golden slitted eyes, begin closing the distance to you, black chokers about their necks and salacious smiles on their lips. That's where the similarity ends. The kitsune to your right, the one with the paper fan in hand — she's an oversexed vixen goddess. Each of her tits is as large as her head, if not bigger, and her hips are blatant to match. Both assets strain at her sleeveless red-and-white clothing, those sinfully short skirts exposing just the right amount of thigh between them and her tall stockings. Her outfit... there's a clear sense of formality here, yet at the same time it's undeniably a temptress' toolkit, allowing her long, orange hair to spill down over her shoulders and join her curling tails. Come to think of it, it's not too much unlike Cait's own passion priestess garb, or at least possessed of the same energy. [party.has cait |"Baaah," Cait spits, sounding more than a little aggrieved as her tail lashes irritably from side to side. "Didn't know any other gods were getting into temple prostitutes too. That's Mallach's domain, and where almost all the Temple's income comes from." Why, checking out the competition? "I'd hardly call this one competition. Look at her strut. She's got no subtlety." ] Conversely, the kitsune to your left is more modestly proportioned with sharper, more delicate features, although that still gives her plenty of room to be voluptuous. The long, flowing sleeves and skirts of her red-and-white uniform are nevertheless altered to strategically show off choice sections of tits and thigh; instead of the full frontal desire of her companion designed to overwhelm, this one wields her sexuality like a knife between the ribs. Her gray hair's been done up in a loose bun, held in place with a couple of golden hairpins save for a couple of tresses that flow down the sides of her head and down her shoulders. What's most prominent about the gray kitsune, though, is the long-stemmed pipe she's carrying. The calming aroma of winterstem smoke clings to her person, an aura of ennui that enshrouds her. Whitish vapour rises from the pipe's bowl, much like what one might find in almost every watering hole in the Marches... guess some things never change. "Oh shucks, sis," the orange-furred kitsune says, her eyes darting [party.som|over your body|between you and [party.compNames]|between [party.combatNames]]. Her voice is high and jovial, almost sing-song and with a strange lilt to it that you haven't heard before even in other kitsune. "I'm guessin' the kids forgot to close th' damn door when they went out for th' festival, didn't they? Look at th' barbarians that came on in... all y'all makin' a right mess o' our home..." Kids? You don't know that much about how kitsune age, but you could swear these two aren't a day above twenty. "I'm really sorry, but we ain't letting the likes o' ya just waltz on through," the gray-furred kitsune sister drawls before taking a long draw on her pipe and blowing out a plume of white smoke. "This here torii gate draws the line between the sacred an' the mundane, an' lettin' someone like ya in just ain't done. Granny, she'd be pre-tty mad... especially since yer ain't supposed to be here in the first place." [var0| Look, look. Perhaps... perhaps you can give your social skills a chance here. Maybe if you just talk to these two, they'll give you a chance to explain, and then you can show them Kiyoko's amulet and that'll open a nice honest discussion and they can take you to someone who can help Kiyoko after you've explained your intentions. But if kitsune are anything like people usually are... "So, if ya'll don't mind none, I think we'll be showin' ya the door. This here place is kinda off-limits to even any ol' kitsune, and I don't wanna hear no excuses from yer lips." Yep, thought as much. Guess that would have been too easy — some things never change, no matter where you go or who you're dealing with. | Look, look. These two have practically been the only ones who've tried to hold a decent conversation with you ever since you entered this place; maybe you can try to give your social skills a chance here. Maybe, just maybe, if you explain, this doesn't have to end up in nastiness. But if kitsune are anything like most other people usually are... Well, you're here on business, and if you finish that business, you can be out of here and out of their hair. Do they know something about a bag that belonged to a certain tanuki known as Oxana Evergreen? You've been hired to retrieve it for her; apparently it has considerable sentimental value for the witch. At that, both sisters just burst out into tittering laughter. "Fancy ya should be bringing up that name. Granny an' the 'nuki don't like each other much." "Not that they hate each other or anythin'. It's more like... more like two ladies tryin' to claim who's th' best cook in town. A friendly rivalry." "Nevertheless, I think all ya'll can see why we ain't really inclined to help ya. That witch does some right creepy things... I'm sure ya've seen her so-called daughters hangin' around her place? Either way, we ain't about to go against granny one way or th' other." Yep, thought as much. Guess that would have been too easy — some things never change, no matter where you go or who you're dealing with. ] The orange-furred kitsune licks her lips and takes a step forward, hips swaying. "I'll say, though. [party.hasCompanions|Y'all|Ya] came at a great time... Mai an' I here were gettin' somewhat peckish on duty here. Usually, we gotta leave the den to feed... it's Keros' providence that [party.hasCompanions|all y'all should offer up yerselves|you should offer up yerself] an' come all th' way here to do it... much appreciated. Spice up our caretakin' duties, as it were." "Don't worry." Mai smiles, revealing sharp fox fangs where human teeth had been moments ago. "Miko an' I... we'll make it up to you. Equivalent exchange, you know?" Damn it, maneaters in both senses of the word. Before you know it, the vixen sisters are pressing in on you, the heat of their soft, supple bodies painfully palpable even at this distance. It's a fight!"

rows.original: Unable to fight on, the kitsune sisters slump against one of the gateposts, clutching each other for support. Flushed, panting and heaving, they've lost much of their assertive demeanour in the face of their defeat, instead replacing it with the cold fury of women scorned. "Waaaah! [party.hasCompanions|All y'all are|Yer] mean!" Sniffling, Miko wipes the tears from her cheeks, her face a frightful mess. Damn, that girl sure knows how to turn on the waterworks... Mai pouts, "Plainly spurnin' two ladies' advances... so bloody cheeky, ain't [party.hasCompanions|ya|the lot of ya]?" As one, both sisters turn tail and take off at a sprint, disappearing into the depths of the garden. For such voluptuous women, they sure can move really fast if they put their mind to it... "GRAAAAANNNNYYYY!!!!!" And that's that. [party.has cait|"Well," Cait muses as the kitsune sisters' footsteps vanish along with them. "That felt really familiar." Did it? A nod. "Back home in the temple, I knew plenty of spoiled brats just like 'em. The high priestess's daughter was just as haughty — and just as curvy, too, now that I think about it — till you pinched her or yanked her hair. Then it's run and cry to mommy. It makes me a little nostalgic, that's all." Are they good memories? "Most of them." ] By the look of things, you're almost at the end of your foray into this den of foxes; one way or the other, things are going to be resolved when you follow the sisters into the shrine gardens. You'd better be prepared...
rows.translation: 这两只狐妖姐妹再也打不动了，瘫靠在其中一根门柱上，互相抱着支撑身体。她们面颊潮红，喘息起伏，战败之后那副咄咄逼人的气势已经所剩无几，取而代之的是受辱女人那种冰冷的怒火。 “哇啊啊啊！[party.hasCompanions|你们全都|你]好坏！”米可抽着鼻子，擦去脸颊上的泪水，那张脸狼狈不堪。啧，这姑娘可真会掉眼泪…… 舞子撅着嘴，“明明白白拒绝了两位女士的示好……真是厚脸皮，是不是啊，[party.hasCompanions|你|你们这帮家伙]？” 两姐妹一齐转身拔腿就跑，转眼消失在花园深处。这么丰满的女人，真下定决心跑起来居然能这么快…… “姥——姥——！！！！！！” 事情就这样了。 [party.has cait|“嗯，”狐妖姐妹的脚步声随人一起消失后，凯特若有所思地说。“那感觉真的很熟悉。” 是吗？ 她点了点头。“在家乡的神庙里，我认识不少跟她们一模一样的娇纵小鬼。大祭司的女儿也那么傲慢——现在想想，身材也一样丰满——可只要你掐她一下或者拽她头发，她就立刻跑去找妈妈哭。我只是有点怀念罢了。” 是些好回忆吗？ “大多是。” ] 看样子，你在这座狐穴里的探索已经接近尾声；不管怎样，等你跟着姐妹俩走进神社庭园，事情就会有个了断。你最好做好准备……

rows.original: You can't take any more of this. With Miko's sensuous body pressing against you and Mai's magic holding your feet to the fire, you crash backwards into a nearby stone lantern, hitting the back of your head on its edge. Snickering, Miko leans over you, the kitsune's gargantuan yet shapely tits filling the entirety of your vision; no matter how you try and look away, your eyes are inexorably drawn to their rise and fall. To be frank, even if her cleavage wasn't pressed against your face, there's simply nowhere safe on Miko's body to rest your eyes on. "I've felt yer eyes on me for quite some time now," she whispers. "Guess my form intrigues ya, doesn't it?" Uh, ah... "Stare all yer want then, ya wicked [pc.mf|man|gal]. I don't mind in th' least." The pillowy mounds loom closer, closer... then snap back as Mai pulls Miko away from you. "Yer such a glutton as always, sis! Granny's always sayin' yer so plump 'cause you feed on all th' best chi..." [party.hasCompanions |"Aah, [pc.heShe]'s got plenty o' friends lyin' about for ya to feed on. Go play with them or somethin'. This one, [pc.heShe]'s shapin' up to be de-li-cious." Mai huffs. "I ain't lettin' ya get all th' good food again." "Fine, fine. We'll share, sis." |"Eeeeh, all right. Ain't often that we get to snack while on duty, though..." "Who cares if it's often enough or not, yer thick enough already." "I dunno if there's an 'enough' where thick is concerned, but if ya want to eat that badly, I already said I'm sharin'!" ] The little spark of hope dims as Miko's heavy tits round on you once more. Weighty and full, they smash right into your face and chin, their warm pressing against you, smothering and glorious. You can't breathe... Miko grins, her mouth full of pointed, vulpine teeth. "Aww, yer jus' so cute. I could eat ya up right now." "Ya know, sis, we should probably take this one to granny...an' have a little nibble on th' way." "Ya wanna share with granny, too?" The world's starting to dim... too much boobage... "I think this one's special." "Well, if ya say so..." Miko leans ever further onto you, and you're utterly smothered by the kitsune shrine maiden's prodigious cleavage. Sure, you might be suffocated by a gigantic pair of foxy boobs... but what a way to go!
rows.translation: 你再也受不了了。米可那性感的身体紧贴着你，舞子的魔法又逼得你退无可退，你向后一撞，撞上旁边一盏石灯笼，后脑勺磕在它的边沿上。米可窃笑着俯身凑近，这只狐妖那硕大而曲线分明的乳房占满了你整个视野；无论你怎么想移开视线，目光还是不由自主地被它们起伏的轮廓吸过去。说句实话，就算她的乳沟没有贴在你脸上，米可身上也实在找不到一处能让你安心落眼的地方。 “我早就感觉到你的眼睛一直在盯着我了，”她低声说。“我猜是我的身段让你着迷了，是不是？” 呃，啊…… “那你就尽管盯着看吧，你这个下流的[pc.mf|男人|姑娘]。我一点都不介意。” 那两团枕头般的软肉越靠越近，越靠越近……随后猛地弹开，因为舞子把米可拉开了。 “姐，你还是这么贪吃！姥姥总说你这么胖，就是因为最好的气都让你吸走了……” [party.hasCompanions |“啊，[pc.heShe]身边躺着那么多朋友，够你吃的。去找他们玩什么的吧。这一个，[pc.heShe]正长成一副可——口——的模样呢。” 舞子哼了一声。“我可不会再让你把好吃的全占了。” “行行行。姐，我们分着吃。” |“呃，好吧。不过值班的时候能加餐的机会可不多啊……” “谁管机会多不多，你已经够肥了。” “我不知道在‘肥’这件事上还有没有个‘够’的说法，但你要是真那么想吃，我都说了我会分你一半的！” ] 米可那沉甸甸的乳房又一次压过来，那一丝希望的火花随之熄灭。饱满、沉实，直直撞上你的脸和下巴，温热的压迫贴着你，令人窒息，又无比美妙。 你没法呼吸了…… 米可咧嘴一笑，满口尖细的狐牙。“哎呀，你真是太可爱了。我现在就想把你吃掉。” “你知道吗，姐，我们该把这家伙带给姥姥……路上顺便啃两口。” “你还想跟姥姥分？” 世界开始变暗……奶子太多了…… “我觉得这一个特别。” “好吧，既然你这么说……”米可又往你身上压了压，你彻底被这位狐妖巫女的惊人乳量埋住了。没错，你可能是被一对巨大的狐妖奶子闷死的……可这死法也太值了！

rows.original: This is it. Following the twins' retreat, the path up the stairs and through the well-tended garden brings you past numerous flowering bushes and beds, decorations of a quaint and obviously foreign make, and an artificial pond with what looks like colorful carp swimming in it. The fragrance in the air only grows stronger as you approach the end of the path as the wooden walls glow ever brighter, and out of the corner of your eye you think you see flower petals twirling through the air as they fall to the ground... but when you try to focus on them, they were never there in the first place. A trick of the mind? But at last, the path ends at a small open-air shrine, wide and tall enough for two, maybe three people to stand in, its roof carefully tiled in that same architectural style you've seen everywhere else in this den of foxes. A gray stone plinth bears a statue of a fox sitting on its haunches, tail curled up about itself; what looks like a bib of red cloth with colorful borders has been tied about its neck. [var0| With a start, you realize that you've seen this exact likeness before: the shrine in the tunnels that led to the chamber where you found the amulet. One way or the other, you're going to get answers here. ] Standing in front of said shrine is a diminutive golden-furred kitsune, her nine tails flicking irritatedly as Miko and Mai grab at her skirts in an attempt to hide behind them. Clothed in white robes on which various colorful sheens have been laid much like oil atop water, you realize that this is the first of her kind you've seen so far who could actually be considered older in appearance, if not outright elderly. Some of the gold in her hair and fur has faded to a bleached blonde, and though not actually infirm, she does walk with the aid of an ornately carved cane. Although she's clearly aged well, or at least better than most, she must have been quite the looker in her prime... "Gra-nny!" Miko wails. "[pc.HeShe]'s comin'!" "Do somethin'!" The golden-furred kitsune looks between both her snivelling descendants, sighs, and smooths out her skirts before stepping forward to meet you. "I am Komari Kurokawa, shrine mother and matron attendant of this den, northerner. Since I'd like to think of myself as a reasonable woman, I'll give you one chance to explain exactly why you've broken into my house, caused such a ruckus, assaulted up several of my charges and made my great-great-granddaughters cry. I've been in these parts long enough to know that this isn't some kind of strange custom you northerners have, so please don't take me for a fool."
rows.translation: 就是这里了。随着双胞胎的退去，你沿阶梯而上，穿过打理得整整齐齐的庭园，一路经过许多开花的灌木与花坛、样式古朴而明显来自异邦的装饰，还有一座人工池塘，里面似乎游着色彩斑斓的鲤鱼。越接近小径尽头，空气中的芬芳就越浓，木墙也愈发亮堂；你眼角余光仿佛看见花瓣在空中打着旋飘落地面……可当你凝神去看，它们从一开始就不在那里。是心神的错觉吗？ 但小径终于在一座小小的露天神龛前到头了。神龛宽而高，足以容两三个人并立，屋顶用瓦片仔细铺成，正是你在这座狐穴里随处可见的那种建筑风格。一座灰石基座上立着一尊狐像，狐端坐着，尾巴盘绕自身，颈上系着一块带彩色滚边的红布，看上去像一条围兜。 [var0| 你猛地一惊，意识到自己见过一模一样的像：那条通往你找到护符的厅堂的隧道里的神龛。无论如何，你都会在这里得到答案。 ] 神龛前站着一只矮小的金毛狐妖，九条尾巴烦躁地甩动着，米可和舞子抓着她的裙摆，想躲到后面去。她身穿白色长袍，袍上覆着层层斑斓的色泽，如同浮在水面上的油光。你意识到，这是你至今见到的第一只外表称得上年长、甚至可说是老迈的同类。她发间的金色已经褪成漂白的浅金，虽说身子并不虚弱，走路却要借助一根雕饰精美的拐杖。她显然保养得不错，至少比大多数人都好，年轻时想必相当标致…… “姥——姥！”米可哀号道。“[pc.HeShe]来了！” “快想个办法！” 金毛狐妖看看自己两个抽着鼻子的后代，叹了口气，理了理裙摆，然后上前来迎你。 “我是黑川麻里，这座巢穴的神社巫母兼当家主母，北方人。既然我愿意自认是个讲道理的女人，我就给你一次机会，好好解释你为何闯进我家、惹出这么大的乱子、打伤我好几个手下，还把我的曾曾孙女弄哭。我在这地方待得够久，知道这不是你们北方人什么奇怪的习俗，所以请别把我当傻子。”

rows.original: [pc.isDK|She wants an explanation? Fine.|You shrug.] It's nothing personal. You're just looking for a small bag on behalf of Oxana Evergreen. Brown cloth, strings on either side, a lot bigger on the inside than it is on the outside. If she knows anything about it and can cough it up for you, you'll take it and be on your merry way out of her house. "Oh, so another mercenary in her employ." Another? "Believe it or not, you're the fourth [party.solo|one|group] in half as many months she's sent in here in search of that stupid thing of hers. Stupid tanuki bitch has it out for me; always has since I showed her what's what couple of centuries ago. Well, now you're the fourth [party.solo|one|group] I'm telling to [party.solo|your face|their faces]: I don't know anything about her stupid bountiful bag going missing, she probably shoved it between her nuts and forgot she'd left it there in the first place." Oh. Komari shakes her cane at you. "Don't you 'oh' me, young [pc.mf|man|woman]. Are you going to go away, or not?" Well, even if she doesn't personally know anything about Lady Evergreen's lost possession, that doesn't mean one of her clan didn't lift it. Maybe if she could let you conduct a search — "Oh, Keros' tails. You really are oblivious." Komari steps forward, rolling up her sleeves in a most unfeminine fashion as she closes the distance between you. "Since you really can't take a hint, [pc.race], I guess I'll just have to evict you myself." It's a fight!
rows.translation: [pc.isDK|她想要个解释？好啊。|你耸了耸肩。]这没什么私人恩怨。你只是在替奥克萨娜·常青找一个棕色布做的小袋子，两边带绳，里头比外头大得多。如果她知道些什么，愿意把东西交出来，你拿了就走，开开心心离开她家。 “哦，原来又是她雇来的雇佣兵。” 又？ “信不信由你，半个月里她先后派了三批人进来找她那件蠢东西，你是第四[party.solo|个|批]。那只没用的狸猫就是跟我过不去；自从几百年前我让她见识了什么叫厉害，她就一直这样。好吧，现在你也是第四[party.solo|个|批]，我要当着[party.solo|你的脸|他们的面]说清楚：我根本不知道她那什么蠢丰饶袋是怎么丢的，多半是她自己塞进裤裆里，然后忘了搁在那儿了。” 哦。 麻里朝你挥了挥拐杖。“别跟我‘哦’，年轻的[pc.mf|小子|姑娘]。你到底走不走？” 嗯，就算她本人对常青女士丢失的东西一无所知，也不代表她的族里没人顺走它。也许她能允许你搜查一下—— “哦，凯罗斯的尾巴啊。你还真是迟钝。”麻里上前一步，用极不女性化的姿势挽起袖子，逼近了你。“既然你连暗示都听不进去，[pc.race]，那我只好亲自动手把你赶出去了。” 这是一场激烈的战斗！
