rows.original: Komari is far more slippery than one might expect for a diminutive older woman, but you manage to overpower the nine-tailed kitsune and [pc.isDK|smack her upside the head with your [pc.weapon]. She scowls, spits blood on the ground|shove her off-balance. She scowls, staggers back], and takes a step back towards the shrine as her great-great granddaughters burst into tears. "Looks like Oxana finally managed to hire some decent help for once. With what skills you have, you'd better make sure you get your full payment from her. Sure, we've never liked each other, but I'd have thought she'd at least personally come if she wanted to finish me off. I've never really wondered about what would happen if someone tried to hack me to pieces, but you might be surprised." Finish her off? What? Look, you've been trying to be reasonable all this time — you just want to be sure Evergreen's bountiful bag isn't around. "And you're going to do that by looking around? Seriously? You're going to try and comb the equivalent of a whole village for something as nondescript as a small brown bag? Did Oxana really think so lowly of you she couldn't come up with a better pretext, or at least a different one than what she gave the other three groups that came before you? Spare me, please; it's too incredulous to be even remotely believable." A lifetime of trickery and pranks has really destroyed this old woman's ability to trust strangers, hasn't it? She's simply projecting her own doubts onto you...
rows.translation: 对于一位身材矮小的老妇人来说，麻里滑溜得出乎意料，但你还是制住了这只九尾狐妖，[pc.isDK|用 [pc.weapon] 敲了她的脑袋。她皱起眉头，把血吐在地上|把她推得失了平衡。她皱起眉头，踉跄后退]，并在她那两个曾曾孙女放声大哭时朝神龛退了一步。 “看来奥克萨娜这次总算雇到了几个像样的帮手。凭你这身本事，你最好确保能从她那里拿到全额报酬。没错，我们俩从来不对付，可要是她想结果我，我还以为她至少会亲自来。我从没认真想过有人想把我剁成碎片会怎样，不过你可能会大吃一惊。” 结果她？什么？喂，你一直都想着讲道理——你只想确认常青女士的丰饶袋不在这里而已。 “你就打算靠四处张望来确认？认真的？你要把相当于一整个村子的地方翻个遍，就为了找一个毫不起眼的小棕袋子？奥克萨娜真这么看不起你，连个像样点的借口都编不出来，至少也该跟你之前那三批人用的借口不一样吧？饶了我吧，这也太荒唐了，根本没法让人相信。” 一辈子的算计和恶作剧，彻底毁掉了这位老太太信任陌生人的能力，是不是？她不过是在把自己的疑虑投射到你身上……

rows.original: Your head swims, and you're feeling more than a little dizzy at this point. Whether it's from blood loss or the loss of something less tangible than that is anyone's guess, but all the strength in your limbs has fled, drained away by this tiny, frail-looking fox-woman. It just isn't fair — it doesn't matter how much you beat on her when all she simply has to do is restore her reserves by tearing at your vitality. [party.comp arona berwyn |"Just stay down!" Arona roars as she struggles to her feet, her flesh searing from the ghostly blue flames clinging to her. The mighty amazonian orcess swings her [arona.weapon] squarely down on Komari, only to have it deflected by the elderly kitsune's walking cane, which by all rights should have been smashed to splinters by such a mighty blow. "I'll turn you into a pelt! A rug!" For how old she is, Komari moves with considerable alacrity. You can't exactly track her movements, but before you know it, she's got the hook of her cane looped around Arona's ankle and is tugging. As impossible as it might seem, the diminutive old kitsune actually manages to trip up the gargantuan orcess, sending her crashing to the grass and dirt with a mighty thump. |You turn to Berwyn, who's clearly having problems of his own. Beads of sweat well up on the dogboy's face as he mutters an incantation, which barely holds against a wave of pale blue foxfire. He's an accomplished wizard, isn't he? Can't he do something about all this nonsense? "I'm trying, I'm trying!" Berwyn growls through gritted teeth. "This stuff isn't so much conjured magic as it's an innate power of hers, and that makes it harder! Maybe if I had a couple hours to study —" Berwyn's words are cut short as a stream of foxfire consumes his hat, leaving it smouldering, and he returns to his incantation. ] Striding up to you, Komari draws back the head of her walking cane, ever the picture of perfect calm. You raise your [pc.weapon], hoping to parry the blow you know is coming, but she strikes low and fast, aiming for your kneecaps. Mumbling to herself in the fashion of an aggrieved grandmother, the little old kitsune stands over you as you clutch your kneecaps in pain. "How would you like it if someone just barged into your home, attacked your family who had every right to protest the intrusion, demand something from you on behalf of a long-feuding rival, and —" Komari makes an exasperated noise. rows.original: Time passes... It's been dark for some time now. You're not sure how long you've been here, or if time has any meaning at all where you are; trapped in your own mind with only yourself for company. It's a strange feeling, that of not having any feeling at all — disembodied, sensationless, numb. You don't dream, either. Pity, that — you vaguely remember that you wish you'd at least be allowed to dream. No such luck, though: all you get is blankness... and a comforting warmth. It's not all bad, you might have actually been lulled to sleep if such a thing existed here, but an eternity of this... ...What would it do, anyway? No thoughts but your own, no sensations other than simple comfort, nothing to see or sense or feel... ...An eternity of this would drive anyone insane. Something whispers in the emptiness, just beyond the edge of hearing; nevertheless, it's easy for you to pick it out in the absolute silence of the void. I was so lonely. Then you came. And then light floods in, brilliant amber light as you finally open bleary eyes and sensation rushes back in. It's soft. There's a pillow under your head, but you're not on a bed or bedroll, but instead a mattress on the ground. Come to think of it, you've felt this kind of material before — up on the verdant balcony in Kiyoko's little cabin, the place where she [kiyoko.numKits 1 2 4|gave birth to Kinu that fateful day...|birthed your kits...|has birthed so many of your kits...|goes to rest when she's feeling unwell...] No. This is not a dream, waking or otherwise. This is all very real, and the numerous pains and aches in your body remind you of that. You glance around, taking in your surroundings; while it's similar to the verdant balcony, it's not exactly the same. For one, it's not a balcony, all four walls hemming you in, and many of the potted plants Kiyoko's so fond of keeping with her there are missing. That, and this is the waking world... Reflexively, you reach about your neck for the amulet, but it's not there. Surprise soon turns to panic as you check yourself over, turning your clothing inside out in search of — "Don't worry. The Lady Ōtomo's with me." You sit up in the futon, ramrod-stiff until you notice someone beside you, sitting cross-legged on a cushion. It's a diminutive, nine-tailed, golden-furred kitsune, and with a small start you realize that she actually looks more advanced in age than others, perhaps a woman in her late fifties if she were human. A walking cane lies on the ground beside her, and she clasps her hands together as your eyes meet. "Relax, northerner. You've come to. My name is Komari Kurokawa, and I am the matron of this den." [pc.isDK|Just what's going on here? Last thing you remember, these fox-eared soul-suckers were trying to kill you despite you trying to help, and now you're — is this some kind of trick?|Relax? Easier said than done. Last thing you remember, you were in pitched, earnest battle with one of hers...] "I'm sorry. We've been having problems recently... the tanuki witch on the other side of the forest has been sending mercenaries at us for a while now. You're the fourth party in half as many months to find their way into my home; I'm sure there're more who were hired but never made it here to begin with. People have been quite skittish and prone to violence as a result. You were brought in to me for, ah... judgement, upon which I noticed your possession and matters flowed from there to your favor." Evergreen? She knows the witch? "She comes from the same land I do, a fellow immigrant, if a somewhat later arrival. We have a... friendly rivalry going. She's never escalated things this far before, though." Right. Evergreen was just a pretext so you could coax her into coughing up the directions to this place. Without them, you may never have found a way in. [party.hasCompanions |"You and your companions could have wandered in circles for weeks and never found the entrance." Speaking of which... hey, where's [party.compNames]? What happened to [party.som||[companion1.himHer]|them]? Komari shakes her head and taps her cane on the ground. "Your [party.som||friend is|friends are] fairly unharmed, if restrained and rather tired in the bargain. I wished to speak with you alone. You will be allowed to rejoin them before you leave." Fine. She wants to have a private chat, well, here you are. What's up? |"This place is difficult to find. You could have wandered the woods for weeks and have never come close to finding the entrance." Well, here you are. If she wants to speak with you privately, you're all ears — what's up? ]
rows.translation: 时间流逝…… 四周已经暗下来一段时间了。你不确定自己在这里待了多久，也不清楚这个地方时间是否还有任何意义；你被困在自己的意识里，只有自己作伴。这是一种奇怪的感觉——完全没有感觉：脱离了肉体，毫无知觉，麻木。 你也不会做梦。真遗憾——你隐约记得自己曾希望至少还能做梦。可惜没这种运气：你得到的只有一片空白……以及一种令人安心的温暖。也不全是坏事，如果这里真有“睡着”这回事，你或许已经真的被哄睡过去了，可是这样永恒地…… ……这样又有什么用呢？除了你自己的念头，没有别的思绪；除了单纯的安逸，没有别的感受；没有可看的、可感的、可觉的…… ……这样永恒下去，任何人都会被逼疯。 有什么东西在空虚中低语，刚好在听力的边缘之外；然而在这片绝对寂静的虚空里，你还是能轻易地把它分辨出来。 我太孤独了。然后你来了。 接着光芒涌入——灿烂的琥珀色光芒，你终于睁开朦胧的双眼，感觉也一股脑回到了身上。身下是柔软的。你的头下有枕头，但你并非躺在床上或睡袋里，而是躺在地上的垫子上。仔细想来，你以前摸过这种材质——在清子的小木屋里的那片苍翠阳台上，就是她 [kiyoko.numKits 1 2 4|在那个命中注定的日子生下小娟……|生下你的幼崽……|生下过你那么多幼崽……|身体不适时休息的地方……] 不。这不是梦，无论醒着还是别的什么状态。这一切都非常真实，而你身上众多的疼痛也在提醒你这一点。你环顾四周，打量着周围；这里虽然和那片苍翠的阳台相似，却并不完全相同。首先，这里根本不是阳台，四面墙把你围在其中，而且清子喜欢放在那里的许多盆栽也不见了。再说，这里是清醒的世界…… 你反射性地伸手去摸脖子上的护符，但它不在那里。惊讶很快变成恐慌，你检查自己全身，把衣服翻来翻去地找—— “别担心。大友夫人和我在一起。” 你在被褥上坐起身，僵得像根棍子，直到你注意到身旁有人，盘腿坐在一个坐垫上。那是一只身形娇小、九条尾巴、金色毛皮的狐妖；你微微一惊，意识到她看上去其实比别的狐妖年长得多，若她是人类，大概是五十多岁的妇人。她身旁的地上放着一根拐杖，当你们的视线相交时，她双手合十。 “放松点，北方人。你醒过来了。我叫黑川麻里，是这个巢穴的女主人。” [pc.isDK|这到底是怎么回事？你记得的最后一件事，是这些狐耳吸魂兽想要杀了你，明明你是在帮她们，而你现在却——这是什么把戏吗？|放松？说得倒轻巧。你记得的最后一件事，就是你正和她手下的一个激烈交战……] “我很抱歉。我们最近一直有些麻烦……森林另一边的狸猫女巫这一阵不断派雇佣兵来对付我们。两个月里，你们已经是第四批摸进我家的人了；我相信还有更多受雇的人从一开始就没能走到这里。因此，这里的人一直相当紧张，也容易动武。你被带到我面前接受，呃……审判，就在那时我注意到了你身上的东西，事情便由此转向了对你们有利的方向。” 常青女士？她认识那个女巫？ “她和我来自同一片土地，同是移民，只是到得稍晚一些。我们之间有一种……友好的竞争关系。不过她以前从没把事情闹到这一步。” 没错。常青女士只是个借口，好让你哄她说出这个地方的位置。没有那些信息，你可能永远也找不到进来的路。 [party.hasCompanions |“你和你的同伴们本来可能在这里绕上好几个星期，也永远找不到入口。” 说起来……嘿，[party.compNames] 呢？[party.som||[companion1.himHer]|他们] 出了什么事？ 麻里摇了摇头，用拐杖敲了敲地面。“你的 [party.som||朋友|朋友们] 基本没受伤，只是被绑着，而且还相当疲惫。我想单独和你谈谈。你离开之前，会获准回到他们身边。” 好吧。她想私聊，那你就来了。什么事？ |“这地方很难找到。你可能在森林里转上好几个星期，也从未接近过入口。” 好了，你在这里了。如果她想私下和你谈，你洗耳恭听——什么事？ ]

rows.original: Komari coughs and fiddles with the amulet in her hands. "I suppose I'll begin, as a gesture of goodwill. This amulet used to be mine; it was the keepsake of my family. Even my name... it means 'little ball' in your tongue, northerner; I suppose my parents thought it funny. A family treasure... I lost it about two hundred and fifty years ago, not long after I arrived in this part of the world on divine orders to aid in this front of the Godswar... "I remember that day, I had been out with the harpies... Sorra's creatures were more civilized back in the day, but they were still insufferable, flighty creatures. Me and mine returned to find the den utterly ruined; the wraiths' minions had struck while we were out. Try as I might, I couldn't find the amulet of transference any more, one of the keys to our Lord's Dream." A dream...? "You know it better as the Astral Plane. The Living Gods each have dreams, realms formed from... well, even I'm not sure myself. But we do know that they are sovereign in that domain; it is where their presence is most real, for lack of a better word to describe it." [flags.ARCHWAY_WAKEUP| You know this to be true — after all, Nareva herself explained it to you, though the explanation was no less cryptic than anything else the serpent goddess said. |Interesting... ] Kiyoko must have escaped into the orb then, and it had lain buried in the debris for centuries until you came along. "With the family heirloom lost, I could not face my relatives. As the Lady Otomo's retainer, allowing her to die from my negligence meant I deserved death. The shame was too great... but my divine lord had other ideas. It would be a waste, he said, for my talents to be lost in such a manner... I would be exiled here with those who would stay alongside me, and keep a foothold for his influence in these foreign lands. By all rights I should have paid for my mistake with my life, but my Lord has seen fit to be magnanimous and give me a second chance. Perhaps this exile was the cowardly option, but today, I think I would have preferred death. Turning me into a yasha and forcing me to watch generations of my descendants age, wither and die while I remain unchanging... each time I perform the funerary rites, I desire more and more to simply be one with the land." Kiyoko was with her? "Kiyoko and I, although our positions in our families were similar, the fact that she came from the twelve divine clans and I did not meant that I was merely fit to be her retainer at best." A small smile appears on Komari's face as her ears fold forward. "While you were out, I had a conversation with her and she has told me much. Tell me, what do you know of Kiyoko's past?" Well... come to think of it... Kiyoko's never told you that much about her life story. Not that she's ever been evasive or anything, but it just never really came up in daily conversation. You know she had a somewhat religious upbringing and something of her education, but the question of her standing in kitsune society never came up, mostly because there weren't any other kitsune around. "You didn't know who she was, had only just met her, and even so, acceded to an unsettling, if not downright disturbing request, wanting no compensation. Ah, such willingness to help... the wicked of this world would be so eager to take advantage of that." Is there a problem? Komari thinks a moment, then shakes her head. "Never mind. If the two of you are content together like this, it's for the better. It's not as if it means anything, not this far from the Old Country. Kiyoko was — I mean, is my friend and liege, and after all these years, I can only wish the best for her if she's found happiness. "In any case, please hold onto the amulet for me for now. I think it'll be safer with you." ...Is there a way to get Kiyoko out of the astral plane? That's what you came here for in the first place, after all. "Very likely, although it's something I'm not able to do under my own power. I'll have to ask my Lord to intercede, and that will probably take a little while. Why don't you return to Oxana and clear up matters? I'll have things ready by the time you come back." Yes... Lady Evergreen. You rub your head, still a little rattled by the fighting you've done since you entered this den of foxes. It's... it's nice to be able to talk things out like reasonable people for once. Ever since you started on this journey, you've had to resolve so many differences with violence; it's a change, if nothing else. Speaking of which, there's the matter of Lady Evergreen's little request... "What exactly is she after, anyway? The sellswords who came before you weren't as keen on divulging information as you are. I may be able to help and put this stupid matter to rest for good." Well, you were here regarding a bountiful bag, as she called it. Small, brown, someone took it and left a pile of leaves in its place, which was certainly no kind of equivalent exchange. Does she know anything? "...As a matter of fact, I think I do. Miko, that lazy girl — I remember seeing something like that amongst her things when I went to rouse her the other day. The girl keeps on picking up odds and ends from her benefactors, so I didn't think much of — that would explain why — ha!" Not even bothering to stand, Komari takes a deep breath and yells. For someone as small as her, she's got quite the voice... not too unlike Kiyoko, come to think of it. "Mikoto! I know you're listening in from behind the door!" Silence. Komari draws another breath, as if to yell again, then there's a quiet, feminine voice from the other side of the door. "Aww, gra-nny! How did ya know?" "I didn't. I just figured you were being your predictable self. No, you still can't come in, you nosy little thing, so don't even think about it. Now, according to the northerner's — I mean, [pc.name]'s — story, Evergreen has been sending sellswords over to our house because she's lost an item of considerable sentimental value. One that I've spotted in the mess you keep around you." There's a sheepish edge to the voice. "So ya figured it out..." "I asked you if you had any idea why that tanuki was bothering us with such a vengeance, and you said no!" "Of course I wouldn't have, granny! I paid th' ol' witch back like what th' law commands! She oughta been satisfied!" "With a pile of leaves?" Miko mumbles something that's neither here nor there. "I said, did you attempt to repay Evergreen for one of her personal treasures with a pile of leaves?" "I thought it was a ratty ol' bag, that's why! If I'd thought it were somethin' actually valuable I wouldn't have gone an' pinched it in the first place! It was a prank!" "A prank that's gotten far out of hand! You thought it was a ratty old bag — so that means at some point you realized it wasn't and she'd been grossly undercompensated?" Miko mumbles some more. "And you didn't tell me this?" Yet more mumbling. "...Get it for us. I can't believe I'm actually taking Evergreen's side, but your stupidity has caused us no end of trouble, girl. I'll deal with you later." A few minutes later, the screen door slides open a crack, and a small brown pouch flies in, landing with a soft flumph by the side of your futon. Sniffing, Komari picks up the worn little thing, turning it over in her hands as she draws back the strings. "Silly girl, that Mikoto. Wonder what's it about this that's got Oxana in a tizzy over losing it... oh." As Komari upends the pouch, all sorts of sex toys flow out of its open mouth — everything from the more common dildoes and fleshlights in various shapes and sizes to more esoteric devices, possibly enchanted, that you have no idea how they might be used or whatever for in the first place. For the first time since you've met her, Komari's stern countenance breaks into a little grin, the Shrine Mother rolling her eyes and shaking her head as she packs the lewd mess back into the little bag. "Oh, Oxana. It's been more than a century, and you never change. Right, [pc.name], I understand perfectly well why Evergreen's so desperate to have this bag of hers back now, and why Mikoto was willing to even try and deceive me about it. If that tanuki bitch wants it that badly, she can have it for all I care. I'll just be all the merrier knowing the old hag needs her toys that badly that she can't go a week without them." "That should settle the score with Evergreen. She'll be chuckling about one-upping me and mine for weeks, if not months, but the law is clear: something of equivalent value was not exchanged for it. Therefore, it has to go back." This law... "It is one of the underpinnings of the way our society works, and frankly, I don't have the energy to elaborate right now. Perhaps later. Are you feeling better? That was a pretty nasty bump you took." To put it lightly, yes, but you're feeling much more clear-headed now. Since you've gotten what you want, perhaps you should make like a tree and leave. You've caused enough trouble here. "And hopefully there won't be any more once Evergreen gets something less constructive with which to occupy her time. Remember, come back here and speak with me after you've delivered the goods to that tanuki witch. We'll see if we can't do something about Kiyoko then." Right, you'll remember that. "Now then, we should be sending you on your way, shouldn't we?" Komari is good to her word. By the time you've pulled on your [pc.armor] and are up, [party.som |she's cleared path for you in the hallway outside, shooing away her nosy great-great-granddaughters. |[party.compNames] is waiting for you in the hallway outside. |[party.compNames] are waiting for you in the hallway outside. ] [party.comp brint cait berwyn einin |Brint greets you with a wave as you step out. "Guess you're finally up, eh? I was really worried for a moment there — even after these fox-folk explained that this was all just a huge misunderstanding, I was pretty leery when they wouldn't let me check in on you." For someone who's been soundly beaten and knocked out, he sure seems cheerful and full of energy. Did something good happen? "You could say that. The girls around these parts are certainly as eager as the heifers back home! Not quite as curvaceous, but you take any cave you can get in a blizzard. Must've gone through three or four of them before I was too beat to go on." My, isn't he just the lady-killer. Brint just grins and flexes. "They were really impressed with my stamina, too. Said my vitality was great, or something like that, I think. Some of them don't speak our language that well..." Oh, you don't have a doubt that he heard them right, but they probably didn't mean what he thinks they did. |Cait bounces up to you as you greet her. "It's about time, [pc.name]! I was about to insist on seeing to you myself! These people have absolutely no idea what they're doing!" Well, you can see how she might be agitated, but you're doing pretty well at the moment. "Not feeling all weak and dizzy? Sort of like when you've slept for way too long and now you're more tired waking up than when you went to bed?" No? Cait thinks a moment, her lips moving as she marshals her thoughts, then gives up trying to make sense of it all. "Well, I'm just glad to see you're okay. Good thing this all turned out well, right? I have the feeling it could have been much, much worse." You're glad that she's up and about, too. |Berwyn gives you a sideways glance as you greet him. "Good thing you're up and about. Let's get out of here." Why the long face? Well, asides from being beaten up, of course, but that hasn't stopped you, especially since everything's turned out for the better. "I just want to get out of here. It's creepy — one moment these fox-people are trying to kill you, next moment they're pinching your cheeks and calling you the most adorable little morsel they've ever seen." But he is the most adorable morsel they've ever seen. It's that charm of his, yeah? "Let's just leave, please. Before someone else tells me they could just eat me all up." |Einin suppresses a wince as you greet her. "Heya..." Right back at her. Why so glum? "We got caught, you know... what's not to be glum about?" Well, you're fine, everything's been settled, and matters have worked out for the best. "It's a point of professional pride, boss." Hey, did she just call you boss? "N-nothing! Never mind!" ] Komari coughs discreetly. "I'll escort [party.hasCompanions|the lot of ]you out of my home, then. That should prevent anyone from attacking you by mistake. Again, let me apologize for the misunderstanding; we're all very glad you've brought the amulet of transference back to us." No problem. At long last, you begin the long trek out through the tree, quite literally tailing along behind Komari herself. While you feel several pairs of curious eyes on you through your walk out, none of the kitsune deign to reveal themselves, and you've but walked a surprisingly short distance — and definitely not the way you came in by — before you're at the entrance once more. Komari claps her hands twice, and the door in the wooden wall materializes, parting to reveal the welcome sight of the Frostwood beyond. "And this is where we part ways for now. Just give Evergreen her due, and tell her to keep things between us in the future, instead of hiring idiots to do her dirty work for her, else I might very well think up a particularly nasty prank or two to send her way." With that, the door slams behind you and melds into the tree once more, leaving you in the forest. Now that was something...
rows.translation: 麻里轻咳了一声，同时摆弄着手中的护身符。我想，作为表示善意的一个举动，我应该先开始讲。这个护身符曾经是我的；它是我们家族的传家宝。甚至我的名字……在你们北方人的语言里，它的意思是‘小球’；我想我的父母觉得这个名字很有趣。这是一个家族的珍宝……大约在250年前，就在我奉神之命来到这个地区，参与这场神战之后不久，我失去了它…… 我记得那天，我和那些女妖们一起外出……索拉创造的生物们当年还算比较‘文明’，但它们依然是一些难以忍受、性格古怪的生物。我和我的同伴们回来时，发现巢穴已经被彻底毁坏了；那些幽灵的爪牙在我们外出期间发动了攻击。无论我怎么努力，都无法找到那枚转移护身符了——那可是我们实现主人的梦想所必需的关键物品之一。 一个梦想……？ 你们更清楚，因为这些领域被称为‘星界’。那些‘活神’们各自拥有自己的梦想，那些由他们的意志形成的领域……嗯，就连我也不太确定具体细节。但我们确实知道，他们在自己的领域里拥有至高无上的权力；那些地方就是他们存在意义最为彰显的地方。真实的，因为实在没有更好的词语来形容它。 [flags.ARCHWAY_WAKEUP| 你深知这是事实——毕竟，娜瑞瓦本人就是这么向你解释的，不过她的解释和其他那位蛇女神说过的话一样，同样令人费解。 |有意思…… ] 那么，清子一定是逃进了那个球体里，而那个球体在废墟中埋藏了几个世纪，直到你的出现。 随着家族传家宝的丢失，我再也无法面对我的亲人。作为大友夫人的侍从，因为我的疏忽而导致她死去，这意味着我活该死。这种羞耻感实在太难以承受了……但我的主人另有打算。他说，让我的才能就这样白白浪费掉，实在是一种可惜……我将会和那些愿意与我并肩作战的人一起被流放到这里，在这些异国他乡为他的势力坚守阵地。按常理来说，我应该用生命来偿还我的过错，但我的主宽宏大量，给了我第二次机会。或许这种流放才是懦弱的选择，但如今，我想我宁愿选择死亡。被变成夜叉，被迫眼睁睁看着自己的后代一代又一代地衰老、枯萎、死去，而自己却始终不变……每次举行葬礼仪式时，我都会越来越渴望能够与大地融为一体。 清子和她在一起吗？ 我和清子虽然在我们家族中的地位相似，但因为她出身于十二个神圣氏族，而我并非如此，这意味着我至多也就只配担任她的随从罢了。麻里的脸上浮现出一丝微笑，她的耳朵也向前耷了下来。你不在的时候，我和她聊了聊，她告诉了我很多事情。告诉我，你对清子的过去了解多少？ 嗯……仔细想想……清子其实从未跟你详细讲过她自己的身世。并不是说她故意回避这个话题，只是日常生活中也从未有人提起过这个内容。你知道她接受的是带有宗教色彩的教育，也了解过她的一些学习经历，但关于她在狐族社会中的地位，却从来没有人问过。主要是因为周围根本没有其他狐族成员，所以这个话题也就自然没有被提起过。 你根本不知道她是谁，才刚认识她而已，却还是答应了那个令人不安、甚至可以说是极其困扰的请求，而且还不要求任何回报。啊，这种乐于助人的精神……这个世界上那些心怀不轨的人肯定会迫不及待地利用这一点。 有什么问题吗？ 麻里思考了一会儿，然后摇了摇头。没关系。如果你们俩这样在一起很开心，那反而更好。反正这也不意味着什么，尤其是在离故国这么远的地方。清子曾经——我是说，现在依然是我的朋友，也是我的主公。经历了这么多年的时光，如果她找到了幸福，我唯一能做的就是祝她安好。 无论如何，请暂时帮我保管这个护身符。我觉得你保管它会更安全。 …有没有办法让清子离开那个星界呢？毕竟，你当初来这里的目的就是这个吧。 很有可能，不过这件事我单凭自己是无法做到的。我需要请我的主人出面干预，大概需要一些时间。你为什么不回去找奥克萨娜把事情解决掉呢？等你回来的时候，我会把一切准备好的。 是的……常青女士。你揉了揉脑袋，显然还在为进入这个“狐妖窝”后发生的那些战斗而感到有些恍惚。能够像正常人一样坐下来好好谈谈，确实是一件让人感到欣慰的事情。自从你开始这段旅程以来，你不得不用暴力来解决太多矛盾；即便只是这种改变，也已经很不错了。 说到这里，还有常青女士的那个小请求…… 什么？她到底想要什么？之前那些受雇而来的佣兵们，可没有你这么乐于透露信息。或许我能帮上忙，把这个蠢问题彻底了结。 嗯，你来这里是为了一个她称作“丰收袋”的袋子。它很小，是棕色的，有人拿走了它，却在原处留下一堆树叶，那显然算不上什么等值交换。她知道些什么吗？ ……其实，我觉得我是知道的。美子那个懒女孩……前几天我去叫她起床的时候，记得在她的东西里看到过类似的东西。那个女孩总是从她的资助者们那里收到各种各样的东西，所以当时我也没太在意——这就解释得通了，哈哈！ 甚至都没有费心站起来，麻里深吸一口气，然后大声喊了出去。对于一个身材如此娇小的人来说，她的嗓音竟然相当洪亮……仔细想想，她的声音和清子还有点相似呢。美子！我知道你正在门后偷听呢！ 寂静。麻里又深吸一口气，似乎准备再次喊叫，就在这时，门另一侧传来一个轻柔的女声。“哎呀，奶——奶！你咋知道的？” 我没有。我只是猜你又在犯你那点老一套的毛病罢了。不行，你还是不能进来，你这个爱管闲事的小东西，想都别想。现在，按这位北方人的——我是说，按 [pc.name] 的说法，常青女士因为丢了一件颇有情感价值的物品，才一直派佣兵到我们家来。而那件物品，我就在你身边那堆乱七八糟的东西里瞧见过。 那声音里带着一丝尴尬。所以你终于弄明白了…… 我之前问过你，知不知道那只狸猫为什么这么不依不饶地缠着我们，你却说不知道！ 当然不会了，奶奶！我是按法律的规定赔给那个老妖婆的！她本该满意才是！ 用一堆树叶？ 美子嘟囔着一些含糊不清的话。 “我是说，你是不是想用一堆树叶来偿还常青女士的一件私人珍宝？” “我以为那只是个破破烂烂的旧袋子，所以才会那么干！要是我早知道那东西真那么值钱，我一开始就不会去偷它了！那只是个恶作剧！” “一个闹到一发不可收拾的恶作剧！你原本以为那是个破破烂烂的旧袋子——也就是说，后来某一刻你意识到它并不是，而她得到的补偿远远不够，对吧？” 美子又嘟囔了几句。 “你居然没告诉我这件事？” 又是些含糊不清的嘟囔声。 “……去把它给我们拿来。真不敢相信我竟然会站在常青女士这一边，但你的愚蠢给我们惹来了没完没了的麻烦，丫头。我回头再收拾你。” 几分钟后，拉门滑开一条缝，一个棕色的小袋子飞了进来，带着一声轻柔的扑通落在你被褥旁边。麻里抽了抽鼻子，捡起那个破旧的小东西，在手里翻来覆去，同时拉开了绳扣。 “傻丫头，那个美子。不知道这东西到底有什么名堂，能让奥克萨娜为了丢掉它急成那样……哦。” 当麻里把袋子倒过来时，各种各样的性玩具从袋口涌了出来——从常见的、形状尺寸各异的假阳具和自慰器，到一些更古怪、可能还被施了魔法的装置，你根本不知道它们该怎么用、又是用来做什么的。自从你认识她以来，麻里那张严肃的面孔第一次露出一丝笑意；这位神社母亲翻了个白眼，摇了摇头，把这堆淫秽的东西重新塞回小袋子里。 “哦，奥克萨娜。都过去一个多世纪了，你还是一点都没变。好吧，[pc.name]，我完全明白常青女士为什么现在这么急着要回她这个袋子，也明白美子为什么甚至愿意为它骗我。如果那个狸猫贱人这么想要它，那就随她拿去好了。想到那老妖婆这么离不开她的‘玩具’，连一个星期都熬不过去，我只会更开心。” “这样应该就能和常青女士算清账了。她准会为自己压过我和我的人一头而得意好几个星期，甚至好几个月，但法律就是这么规定的：没有用等值的东西来交换它。因此，它必须还回去。” 这条法律…… “这是我们社会运转方式的根基之一，坦白说，我现在没精力细讲。也许以后吧。你感觉好些了吗？你刚才撞得可真够狠的。” 说轻点吧，确实是这样，但现在你的头脑已经清醒多了。既然你已经得到了你想要的东西，或许应该像棵树一样离开这里吧。你在这里已经惹够了麻烦。 希望等常青女士找到一些更有意义的事情来打发时间后，这种情况就不会再发生了。记住，你把货物送到那个狸猫女巫那里之后，再回来跟我谈谈。到时候我们再看看能不能为清子做点什么。 没错，你肯定会记得的。 那么，我们现在应该让你继续你的旅程了，对吧？ 麻里确实守信用。等你穿上那身衣服的时候 [pc.armor] 都已经准备好了。 [party.som |她已经为你在外面的走廊里清出了道路，把那些爱管闲事的曾曾孙女们都赶走了。 |[party.compNames] 他正在外面的走廊里等着你。 |[party.compNames] 他们正在外面的走廊里等着你。 ] [party.comp brint cait berwyn einin |当你走出来时，布林特朝你挥手打招呼。“看来你终于醒了，是吧？刚才有一会儿我真的很担心——就算这些狐妖解释过这一切都只是个天大的误会，可他们不让我进去看你的时候，我还是很不放心。” 对于一个刚刚被彻底击败、甚至被打昏的人来说，他看起来却格外开心、充满活力。难道发生了什么好事吗？ “也可以这么说。这一带的女孩们确实和家乡那些小母牛一样热情！身材虽然没那么丰腴，但暴风雪里能碰上哪个雪洞就钻哪个。等我累得实在动弹不得，大概已经钻了三四个了。” 哎呀，他还真是个少女杀手呢。 布林特只是咧嘴一笑，亮了亮肌肉。“她们也都很佩服我的耐力。说我的‘生命力’很棒之类的，大概是这个意思吧。她们有些人不太会说我们的话……” 哦，你一点也不怀疑他听清楚了她们的话，但她们的意思八成不是他以为的那样。 |你向凯特打招呼时，她蹦蹦跳跳地迎上来。“总算醒了，[pc.name]！我都快坚持要亲自去照顾你了！这些人根本不知道自己在干什么！” 嗯，你能理解她为什么会心浮气躁，不过你现在状态还挺不错的。 “没有浑身发软、头晕眼花的感觉？就像你睡得太久，醒来反而比上床时更累那样？” 不？ 凯特想了一会儿，嘴唇微微翕动，像是在整理思绪，最后还是放弃了琢磨这件事。“总之，看到你没事我就放心了。幸好一切都圆满解决了，对吧？我总觉得事情本来可能糟糕得多。” 你也很高兴看到她精神起来了。 |你向贝尔温打招呼时，他斜眼看了你一眼。“幸好你起来了。我们离开这儿吧。” 为什么愁眉苦脸的？嗯，除了被揍了一顿之外——不过那也没能拦住你，尤其是现在一切都往好的方向发展了。 “我只想离开这里。太瘆人了——前一秒这些狐妖还想杀你，下一秒就捏着你的脸说你是他们见过最可爱的小点心。” 可他确实是他们见过最可爱的小点心。都怪他那股魅力，对吧？ “我们走吧，求你了。趁还没人再对我说他能把我一口吃掉。” |你向艾宁打招呼时，她强忍住了皱眉。“嗨呀……” 你也回了她一句。怎么这么闷闷不乐？ “我们被抓了，你知道的……这有什么好高兴的？” 嗯，你没事，事情都了结了，而且结果已经是最好的了。 “这关乎职业尊严，老板。” 嘿，她刚才叫你老板了吗？ “没、没什么！别在意！” ] 麻里轻咳了一声。“那我就送[party.hasCompanions|你们所有人]离开我家吧。这样就不会有人误伤你们了。再次为这场误会向你们道歉，我们都很高兴你把转移护身符带了回来。” 没问题。 终于，你开始了穿过巨树的长长归途，可以说是名副其实地跟在麻里本人身后。走这一路时，你感觉到好几双好奇的眼睛在盯着你，但没有哪个狐妖愿意现身；而且你走的路出奇地短——并且绝对不是你来时的那条——转眼就又回到了入口处。 麻里拍了两次手，木墙上的门随即浮现，分开来，露出外面霜木林那片令人欣喜的景象。 “那么，我们暂时就在这里分道扬镳吧。把该给常青女士的东西交给她，然后告诉她，以后有事直接找我们谈，别再雇些蠢货替她干脏活了，否则我很可能会想出那么一两个特别恶毒的恶作剧送给她。” 话音刚落，门就在你身后砰地关上，重新融入巨树之中，把你留在森林里。刚才那可真是一场……
rows.raw: " Komari coughs and fiddles with the amulet in her hands. "I suppose I'll begin, as a gesture of goodwill. This amulet used to be mine; it was the keepsake of my family. Even my name... it means 'little ball' in your tongue, northerner; I suppose my parents thought it funny. A family treasure... I lost it about two hundred and fifty years ago, not long after I arrived in this part of the world on divine orders to aid in this front of the Godswar... "I remember that day, I had been out with the harpies... Sorra's creatures were more civilized back in the day, but they were still insufferable, flighty creatures. Me and mine returned to find the den utterly ruined; the wraiths' minions had struck while we were out. Try as I might, I couldn't find the amulet of transference any more, one of the keys to our Lord's Dream." A dream...? "You know it better as the Astral Plane. The Living Gods each have dreams, realms formed from... well, even I'm not sure myself. But we do know that they are sovereign in that domain; it is where their presence is most real, for lack of a better word to describe it." [flags.ARCHWAY_WAKEUP| You know this to be true — after all, Nareva herself explained it to you, though the explanation was no less cryptic than anything else the serpent goddess said. |Interesting... ] Kiyoko must have escaped into the orb then, and it had lain buried in the debris for centuries until you came along. "With the family heirloom lost, I could not face my relatives. As the Lady Otomo's retainer, allowing her to die from my negligence meant I deserved death. The shame was too great... but my divine lord had other ideas. It would be a waste, he said, for my talents to be lost in such a manner... I would be exiled here with those who would stay alongside me, and keep a foothold for his influence in these foreign lands. By all rights I should have paid for my mistake with my life, but my Lord has seen fit to be magnanimous and give me a second chance. Perhaps this exile was the cowardly option, but today, I think I would have preferred death. Turning me into a yasha and forcing me to watch generations of my descendants age, wither and die while I remain unchanging... each time I perform the funerary rites, I desire more and more to simply be one with the land." Kiyoko was with her? "Kiyoko and I, although our positions in our families were similar, the fact that she came from the twelve divine clans and I did not meant that I was merely fit to be her retainer at best." A small smile appears on Komari's face as her ears fold forward. "While you were out, I had a conversation with her and she has told me much. Tell me, what do you know of Kiyoko's past?" Well... come to think of it... Kiyoko's never told you that much about her life story. Not that she's ever been evasive or anything, but it just never really came up in daily conversation. You know she had a somewhat religious upbringing and something of her education, but the question of her standing in kitsune society never came up, mostly because there weren't any other kitsune around. "You didn't know who she was, had only just met her, and even so, acceded to an unsettling, if not downright disturbing request, wanting no compensation. Ah, such willingness to help... the wicked of this world would be so eager to take advantage of that." Is there a problem? Komari thinks a moment, then shakes her head. "Never mind. If the two of you are content together like this, it's for the better. It's not as if it means anything, not this far from the Old Country. Kiyoko was — I mean, is my friend and liege, and after all these years, I can only wish the best for her if she's found happiness. "In any case, please hold onto the amulet for me for now. I think it'll be safer with you." ...Is there a way to get Kiyoko out of the astral plane? That's what you came here for in the first place, after all. "Very likely, although it's something I'm not able to do under my own power. I'll have to ask my Lord to intercede, and that will probably take a little while. Why don't you return to Oxana and clear up matters? I'll have things ready by the time you come back." Yes... Lady Evergreen. You rub your head, still a little rattled by the fighting you've done since you entered this den of foxes. It's... it's nice to be able to talk things out like reasonable people for once. Ever since you started on this journey, you've had to resolve so many differences with violence; it's a change, if nothing else. Speaking of which, there's the matter of Lady Evergreen's little request... "What exactly is she after, anyway? The sellswords who came before you weren't as keen on divulging information as you are. I may be able to help and put this stupid matter to rest for good." Well, you were here regarding a bountiful bag, as she called it. Small, brown, someone took it and left a pile of leaves in its place, which was certainly no kind of equivalent exchange. Does she know anything? "...As a matter of fact, I think I do. Miko, that lazy girl — I remember seeing something like that amongst her things when I went to rouse her the other day. The girl keeps on picking up odds and ends from her benefactors, so I didn't think much of — that would explain why — ha!" Not even bothering to stand, Komari takes a deep breath and yells. For someone as small as her, she's got quite the voice... not too unlike Kiyoko, come to think of it. "Mikoto! I know you're listening in from behind the door!" Silence. Komari draws another breath, as if to yell again, then there's a quiet, feminine voice from the other side of the door. "Aww, gra-nny! How did ya know?" "I didn't. I just figured you were being your predictable self. No, you still can't come in, you nosy little thing, so don't even think about it. Now, according to the northerner's — I mean, [pc.name]'s — story, Evergreen has been sending sellswords over to our house because she's lost an item of considerable sentimental value. One that I've spotted in the mess you keep around you." There's a sheepish edge to the voice. "So ya figured it out..." "I asked you if you had any idea why that tanuki was bothering us with such a vengeance, and you said no!" "Of course I wouldn't have, granny! I paid th' ol' witch back like what th' law commands! She oughta been satisfied!" "With a pile of leaves?" Miko mumbles something that's neither here nor there. "I said, did you attempt to repay Evergreen for one of her personal treasures with a pile of leaves?" "I thought it was a ratty ol' bag, that's why! If I'd thought it were somethin' actually valuable I wouldn't have gone an' pinched it in the first place! It was a prank!" "A prank that's gotten far out of hand! You thought it was a ratty old bag — so that means at some point you realized it wasn't and she'd been grossly undercompensated?" Miko mumbles some more. "And you didn't tell me this?" Yet more mumbling. "...Get it for us. I can't believe I'm actually taking Evergreen's side, but your stupidity has caused us no end of trouble, girl. I'll deal with you later." A few minutes later, the screen door slides open a crack, and a small brown pouch flies in, landing with a soft flumph by the side of your futon. Sniffing, Komari picks up the worn little thing, turning it over in her hands as she draws back the strings. "Silly girl, that Mikoto. Wonder what's it about this that's got Oxana in a tizzy over losing it... oh." As Komari upends the pouch, all sorts of sex toys flow out of its open mouth — everything from the more common dildoes and fleshlights in various shapes and sizes to more esoteric devices, possibly enchanted, that you have no idea how they might be used or whatever for in the first place. For the first time since you've met her, Komari's stern countenance breaks into a little grin, the Shrine Mother rolling her eyes and shaking her head as she packs the lewd mess back into the little bag. "Oh, Oxana. It's been more than a century, and you never change. Right, [pc.name], I understand perfectly well why Evergreen's so desperate to have this bag of hers back now, and why Mikoto was willing to even try and deceive me about it. If that tanuki bitch wants it that badly, she can have it for all I care. I'll just be all the merrier knowing the old hag needs her toys that badly that she can't go a week without them." "That should settle the score with Evergreen. She'll be chuckling about one-upping me and mine for weeks, if not months, but the law is clear: something of equivalent value was not exchanged for it. Therefore, it has to go back." This law... "It is one of the underpinnings of the way our society works, and frankly, I don't have the energy to elaborate right now. Perhaps later. Are you feeling better? That was a pretty nasty bump you took." To put it lightly, yes, but you're feeling much more clear-headed now. Since you've gotten what you want, perhaps you should make like a tree and leave. You've caused enough trouble here. "And hopefully there won't be any more once Evergreen gets something less constructive with which to occupy her time. Remember, come back here and speak with me after you've delivered the goods to that tanuki witch. We'll see if we can't do something about Kiyoko then." Right, you'll remember that. "Now then, we should be sending you on your way, shouldn't we?" Komari is good to her word. By the time you've pulled on your [pc.armor] and are up, [party.som |she's cleared path for you in the hallway outside, shooing away her nosy great-great-granddaughters. |[party.compNames] is waiting for you in the hallway outside. |[party.compNames] are waiting for you in the hallway outside. ] [party.comp brint cait berwyn einin |Brint greets you with a wave as you step out. "Guess you're finally up, eh? I was really worried for a moment there — even after these fox-folk explained that this was all just a huge misunderstanding, I was pretty leery when they wouldn't let me check in on you." For someone who's been soundly beaten and knocked out, he sure seems cheerful and full of energy. Did something good happen? "You could say that. The girls around these parts are certainly as eager as the heifers back home! Not quite as curvaceous, but you take any cave you can get in a blizzard. Must've gone through three or four of them before I was too beat to go on." My, isn't he just the lady-killer. Brint just grins and flexes. "They were really impressed with my stamina, too. Said my vitality was great, or something like that, I think. Some of them don't speak our language that well..." Oh, you don't have a doubt that he heard them right, but they probably didn't mean what he thinks they did. |Cait bounces up to you as you greet her. "It's about time, [pc.name]! I was about to insist on seeing to you myself! These people have absolutely no idea what they're doing!" Well, you can see how she might be agitated, but you're doing pretty well at the moment. "Not feeling all weak and dizzy? Sort of like when you've slept for way too long and now you're more tired waking up than when you went to bed?" No? Cait thinks a moment, her lips moving as she marshals her thoughts, then gives up trying to make sense of it all. "Well, I'm just glad to see you're okay. Good thing this all turned out well, right? I have the feeling it could have been much, much worse." You're glad that she's up and about, too. |Berwyn gives you a sideways glance as you greet him. "Good thing you're up and about. Let's get out of here." Why the long face? Well, asides from being beaten up, of course, but that hasn't stopped you, especially since everything's turned out for the better. "I just want to get out of here. It's creepy — one moment these fox-people are trying to kill you, next moment they're pinching your cheeks and calling you the most adorable little morsel they've ever seen." But he is the most adorable morsel they've ever seen. It's that charm of his, yeah? "Let's just leave, please. Before someone else tells me they could just eat me all up." |Einin suppresses a wince as you greet her. "Heya..." Right back at her. Why so glum? "We got caught, you know... what's not to be glum about?" Well, you're fine, everything's been settled, and matters have worked out for the best. "It's a point of professional pride, boss." Hey, did she just call you boss? "N-nothing! Never mind!" ] Komari coughs discreetly. "I'll escort [party.hasCompanions|the lot of ]you out of my home, then. That should prevent anyone from attacking you by mistake. Again, let me apologize for the misunderstanding; we're all very glad you've brought the amulet of transference back to us." No problem. At long last, you begin the long trek out through the tree, quite literally tailing along behind Komari herself. While you feel several pairs of curious eyes on you through your walk out, none of the kitsune deign to reveal themselves, and you've but walked a surprisingly short distance — and definitely not the way you came in by — before you're at the entrance once more. Komari claps her hands twice, and the door in the wooden wall materializes, parting to reveal the welcome sight of the Frostwood beyond. "And this is where we part ways for now. Just give Evergreen her due, and tell her to keep things between us in the future, instead of hiring idiots to do her dirty work for her, else I might very well think up a particularly nasty prank or two to send her way." With that, the door slams behind you and melds into the tree once more, leaving you in the forest. Now that was something... "

rows.original: You've just about had it with everything. Here you are just trying to help Kiyoko, and [flags.FOREST_KITSUNE_OPINION 1 2|save for Azami, ]everyone's been an unreasonable dick. If someone would at least stop long enough for you to get in a word edgewise... ...Well, this is it, right? Komari's asking you to explain. Guess you'll just have to surprise [pc.isDK|the old bitch|her] with what you have. Palming the amulet and its amber orb in your hand, you thrust it out to her wordlessly, trusting it to be all the explanation you'll ever need. Komari leans on her cane, closes her eyes, and sniffs the air. "Where did you find this?" "Gra-nny! Aren't ya gonna drive th' mean barbarian away?" "Shut up, girl." Finally. Finally, someone who's both reasonable and in a position of power in this strange foxy hierarchy to actually have any authority to talk terms. Finally, someone who instead of straight-up hurling themselves at you, can actually talk. Miko wails. "Gra-nny!" Oh for gods' sakes. If she hadn't come onto you like the oversexed vamp she was before you could even try to explain yourself, you wouldn't have had to beat up her and her sister. Perhaps she could learn something from her elders and just shut up for once. "Now, please. The amulet, if you will — I suppose you should know it once belonged to me. I haven't seen it for a little over two centuries, though, so I'm sure there's a good story to be had here, not just in how you found it but how you knew to come here. Mikoto! Miyuki! Make yourselves presentable and get our guest[party.hasCompanions|s] some tea. You can at least make good on some of the trouble you've caused [party.hasCompanions|them|[pc.himHer]]." Miko and Mai sniffle and skulk, but obey. In the meantime, Komari leads [party.som|you|you and [party.compNames]|you, [party.compNames]] to a small stone table and bench to await the tea; she leans her cane against the table's edge, gathers up her skirts, and takes a seat herself. "Now, your explanation please, um..." [pc.name]. "Yes, [pc.name]." With no reason to hold back, you tell her everything. Coming across the ruined shrine in the woods near Hawkethorne, entering the cave in the back beyond the gemmed doors, the mural, the amulet hidden within an age's worth of dust and debris. Kiyoko manifesting in your dreams, speaking of her captivity. [kiyoko.numKits 1|Her asking for your life energy, and eventually bearing your child[kiyoko.numKits 2|ren]. ]Memories that feel as if they were dreams, mostly because they were — dreams that nevertheless were real, perhaps more than real. While you speak, a much more modestly dressed Miko and Mai shuffle up with a tray of tea, set it down, and shuffle away wordlessly. [party.comp arona einin cait berwyn |"Damn, don't they have anything to eat around here?" Arona mumbles as she eyes the tea and steamed buns suspiciously. "I haven't minded the fighting, but a girl's got to have something to fill the appetite she's worked up." "We can have something prepared afterwards. Some of the younger ones know how to prepare food in a style more suited to the natives of these lands." Arona just snorts and shrugs, looking even more impatient than ever. |"I wonder how they move so silently," Einin muses as she watches the twins disappear down the path. "They're like wisps of smoke, their tread so light despite their... assets. Even I hardly noticed them return. Hey, [pc.name], think I could talk to those two later?" After beating them down like that? "Hey, it's all water under the bridge, right? A big misunderstanding?" They might not see it that way, but you'll leave that for later. |"I'm just glad we're talking things out now," Cait says peppily in between sips of tea. "I was kind of worried we'd have to fight again. I'm a bit rusty on some of my history, but I'm pretty sure that wars have been started over less." That's the understatement of the week, if not the month. Still, being able to talk things through is a change from the norm, if nothing else. [pc.isDK|Beating people over the head might be satisfying, but it can also get tiring at times.|It's nice to be able to just sit down and resolve matters peacefully without always having to resort to violence.] |Berwyn just sits down at the table and sips at his tea. He makes a face at the steaming brew at first, but soon relaxes and his tail starts to wag. "I'm kind of glad we're talking things through, to be honest," he says after a little thought. "If you hadn't bothered to hear me out when I needed it, [pc.name]... well, I wouldn't be here with you now. Oh, and this tea is pretty good. What's in it?" "Just water and simple leaves. Nothing more. Mai is more about the preparation rather than the ingredients." "Oh." ] At long last, though, you finish up your tale. Kiyoko believed that she could be helped more concretely if she were to be brought to her own people, and that's why you jumped at the excuse to have Evergreen direct you here in the first place. So, now that you're finally here, can something be done for Kiyoko? "I think that's quite possible. Before that, though, I'd like to ask a question — on what pretext did Evergreen send you here?" Hmm... "Answer the question, please. I may be able to help." Well, you were here regarding a bountiful bag, as she called it. Small, brown, someone took it and left a pile of leaves in its place, which was certainly no kind of equivalent exchange. Does she know anything? "...As a matter of fact, I think I do. Mikoto, that lazy girl — I remember seeing something like that amongst her things when I went to rouse her the other day. The girl keeps on picking up odds and ends from her benefactors, so I didn't think much of — that would explain why you're the fourth bunch of sellswords Evergreen's directed this way in half as many months." Fourth? "You didn't think you were the first, were you? Of course you weren't. Evergreen and I have never liked each other since I showed her what's what more than a century ago, but sending mercenaries was a little more forward than we usually are with each other. She must really want that bag of hers back. Why don't we deal with that now, so I can keep a clear mind for what comes later?" If she so pleases.
rows.translation: 你差不多已经受够了这一切。你只是想帮助清子而已，然而 [flags.FOREST_KITSUNE_OPINION 1 2|除了阿兹米之外，其他的都算。 ]每个人都不讲道理，行为恶劣至极。要是有人能稍微停下来，让你有机会说上几句话就好了…… ……好吧，现在就是这样的局面了，对吧？麻里在要求你做出解释。看来你只能用手里的东西让她大吃一惊了。[pc.isDK|那个老泼妇|她] 你把护身符和那颗琥珀球握在掌中，一言不发地递给她，相信这已经足以解释一切。 麻里倚着手杖，闭上眼睛，嗅了嗅空气。“你是在哪里找到这个的？” “奶——奶！你难道不打算把那个凶恶的野蛮人赶走吗？” “闭嘴，丫头。” 终于，终于有这样一个既通情达理、又在这个奇怪狐妖等级体系里真正握有权柄的人，能够来谈条件了。终于，有这样一个人，她不会直接朝你扑上来，而是能够交谈。 美子哀嚎起来。“奶——奶！” 哦，看在老天爷的份上。要不是她趁你还没来得及解释就像头发情的母狐狸似的扑上来，你本来也用不着揍她和她妹妹一顿。也许她该向长辈们学学，哪怕就这一次，把嘴闭上。 “现在，请把护身符给我吧。你应该知道，它曾经属于我。不过我已经有两百多年没见过它了，所以这里面肯定有个好故事——不只是你怎么找到它的，还有你怎么知道要来这儿。美子！美雪！收拾得体面点，给我们的客人[party.hasCompanions|s] 弄点茶来。你们惹出的麻烦，至少也该[party.hasCompanions|给他们|[pc.himHer]]做点补偿。” 美子和舞抽抽搭搭、磨磨蹭蹭，但还是照办了。与此同时，麻里把 [party.som|你|你和 [party.compNames]|你， [party.compNames]] 领到一张小石桌和石凳旁等茶；她把手杖靠在桌边，拢起裙摆，自己坐了下来。 “那么，请你解释一下吧，嗯……” [pc.name]。 “是的，[pc.name]。” 你没有任何理由隐瞒，于是把一切都告诉了她。你在鹰棘镇附近的森林里发现那座荒废神龛，穿过镶着宝石的门进入后面的洞穴，看到那面壁画，以及那件在积了一个时代的灰尘与杂物之下藏着的护身符。清子会显现在你的梦中，讲述她被囚禁的经过。[kiyoko.numKits 1|她请求吸取你的生命能量，最终还为你生下了孩子[kiyoko.numKits 2|ren]。]这些记忆感觉像是梦，多半也确实就是梦——然而这些梦却是真实的，甚至可能比现实更真实。你说话时，穿着朴素得多的美子和舞端着一盘茶挪了过来，放下茶盘，又一声不响地退了下去。 [party.comp arona einin cait berwyn |“该死，这地方就没点吃的吗？”阿罗娜狐疑地盯着茶和蒸包，嘟囔道。“打斗我倒不介意，可姑娘总得填饱自己折腾出来的胃口吧。” “之后我们可以让人准备些吃的。有几个年轻的很会用更合这些地方当地人口味的方式做菜。” 阿罗娜只是哼了一声，耸了耸肩，显得比以往更加不耐烦。 |“真不知道她们是怎么走得那么悄无声息的，”艾宁望着双胞胎消失在小路尽头，若有所思。“她们就像一缕缕轻烟，明明……身材那么可观，脚步却轻得很。连我都没怎么注意到她们回来。嘿，[pc.name]，你觉得我待会儿能跟那两位聊聊吗？” 就这样把她们打得落花流水之后？ “嘿，都已经是过去的事了，对吧？一场大误会而已。” 她们大概不会这么看，不过这事你留到以后再说吧。 |“我很高兴我们现在能坐下来把事情谈清楚，”凯特一边喝茶一边欢快地说。“我之前还有点担心我们又得打一场。我对某些历史已经有点生疏了，但我很确定，比这更小的事都引发过战争。” 这简直是本周、甚至是本月最轻描淡写的说法了。不过，能坐下来把事情谈开，至少也算是一种变化。[pc.isDK|把人揍一顿或许很痛快，但有时候也会让人觉得累。|能够坐下来和平地解决问题，而不必总是诉诸暴力，这种感觉真好。] |贝尔温只是坐到桌旁，小口喝着茶。起初他对这热气腾腾的茶做了个鬼脸，但很快就放松下来，尾巴也开始摇了起来。 “说实话，我挺高兴我们能把事情谈清楚，”他想了想说道。“当初我需要人听我说话的时候，你要是没耐心听我讲，[pc.name]……那我现在就不会和你在一起了。哦，这茶挺好喝的。里面放了什么？” “只是水和普通的叶子，没别的。关键在泡法，而不在材料。舞更讲究的是手法。” “哦。” ] 终于，你讲完了你的故事。清子相信，如果能被带回到自己族人身边，她就能得到更切实的帮助，所以当初你才抓住常青女士这个借口，让她把你引到这里来。 那么，既然你终于来到这里了，能为清子做点什么吗？ “我认为这很有可能。不过在那之前，我想先问个问题——常青女士是找的什么借口把你派到这儿来的？” 嗯…… “请回答这个问题。我或许能帮上忙。” 嗯，你来这里是为了一个她称作“丰收袋”的袋子。它很小，是棕色的，有人拿走了它，却在原处留下一堆树叶，那显然算不上什么等值交换。她知道些什么吗？ “……其实，我想我是知道的。美子那个懒丫头——前几天我去叫她起床的时候，记得在她那堆东西里见过类似的东西。那丫头总从她的金主们那里捡些零碎回来，所以我当时也没多想——这就说得通了，为什么常青女士在这半个月里往这边派了第四批佣兵。” 第四批？ “你该不会以为自己是第一个来的吧？当然不是。一个多世纪前我让常青女士见识了我的厉害之后，我们就一直互不待见，但派雇佣兵过来，比我们平常的来往要更进一步了。她肯定真的很想拿回那个袋子。我们不如现在就把这件事处理掉，这样我也能腾出心思来应付后面的事。” 如果她愿意的话。
rows.raw: " You've just about had it with everything. Here you are just trying to help Kiyoko, and [flags.FOREST_KITSUNE_OPINION 1 2|save for Azami, ]everyone's been an unreasonable dick. If someone would at least stop long enough for you to get in a word edgewise... ...Well, this is it, right? Komari's asking you to explain. Guess you'll just have to surprise [pc.isDK|the old bitch|her] with what you have. Palming the amulet and its amber orb in your hand, you thrust it out to her wordlessly, trusting it to be all the explanation you'll ever need. Komari leans on her cane, closes her eyes, and sniffs the air. "Where did you find this?" "Gra-nny! Aren't ya gonna drive th' mean barbarian away?" "Shut up, girl." Finally. Finally, someone who's both reasonable and in a position of power in this strange foxy hierarchy to actually have any authority to talk terms. Finally, someone who instead of straight-up hurling themselves at you, can actually talk. Miko wails. "Gra-nny!" Oh for gods' sakes. If she hadn't come onto you like the oversexed vamp she was before you could even try to explain yourself, you wouldn't have had to beat up her and her sister. Perhaps she could learn something from her elders and just shut up for once. "Now, please. The amulet, if you will — I suppose you should know it once belonged to me. I haven't seen it for a little over two centuries, though, so I'm sure there's a good story to be had here, not just in how you found it but how you knew to come here. Mikoto! Miyuki! Make yourselves presentable and get our guest[party.hasCompanions|s] some tea. You can at least make good on some of the trouble you've caused [party.hasCompanions|them|[pc.himHer]]." Miko and Mai sniffle and skulk, but obey. In the meantime, Komari leads [party.som|you|you and [party.compNames]|you, [party.compNames]] to a small stone table and bench to await the tea; she leans her cane against the table's edge, gathers up her skirts, and takes a seat herself. "Now, your explanation please, um..." [pc.name]. "Yes, [pc.name]." With no reason to hold back, you tell her everything. Coming across the ruined shrine in the woods near Hawkethorne, entering the cave in the back beyond the gemmed doors, the mural, the amulet hidden within an age's worth of dust and debris. Kiyoko manifesting in your dreams, speaking of her captivity. [kiyoko.numKits 1|Her asking for your life energy, and eventually bearing your child[kiyoko.numKits 2|ren]. ]Memories that feel as if they were dreams, mostly because they were — dreams that nevertheless were real, perhaps more than real. While you speak, a much more modestly dressed Miko and Mai shuffle up with a tray of tea, set it down, and shuffle away wordlessly. [party.comp arona einin cait berwyn |"Damn, don't they have anything to eat around here?" Arona mumbles as she eyes the tea and steamed buns suspiciously. "I haven't minded the fighting, but a girl's got to have something to fill the appetite she's worked up." "We can have something prepared afterwards. Some of the younger ones know how to prepare food in a style more suited to the natives of these lands." Arona just snorts and shrugs, looking even more impatient than ever. |"I wonder how they move so silently," Einin muses as she watches the twins disappear down the path. "They're like wisps of smoke, their tread so light despite their... assets. Even I hardly noticed them return. Hey, [pc.name], think I could talk to those two later?" After beating them down like that? "Hey, it's all water under the bridge, right? A big misunderstanding?" They might not see it that way, but you'll leave that for later. |"I'm just glad we're talking things out now," Cait says peppily in between sips of tea. "I was kind of worried we'd have to fight again. I'm a bit rusty on some of my history, but I'm pretty sure that wars have been started over less." That's the understatement of the week, if not the month. Still, being able to talk things through is a change from the norm, if nothing else. [pc.isDK|Beating people over the head might be satisfying, but it can also get tiring at times.|It's nice to be able to just sit down and resolve matters peacefully without always having to resort to violence.] |Berwyn just sits down at the table and sips at his tea. He makes a face at the steaming brew at first, but soon relaxes and his tail starts to wag. "I'm kind of glad we're talking things through, to be honest," he says after a little thought. "If you hadn't bothered to hear me out when I needed it, [pc.name]... well, I wouldn't be here with you now. Oh, and this tea is pretty good. What's in it?" "Just water and simple leaves. Nothing more. Mai is more about the preparation rather than the ingredients." "Oh." ] At long last, though, you finish up your tale. Kiyoko believed that she could be helped more concretely if she were to be brought to her own people, and that's why you jumped at the excuse to have Evergreen direct you here in the first place. So, now that you're finally here, can something be done for Kiyoko? "I think that's quite possible. Before that, though, I'd like to ask a question — on what pretext did Evergreen send you here?" Hmm... "Answer the question, please. I may be able to help." Well, you were here regarding a bountiful bag, as she called it. Small, brown, someone took it and left a pile of leaves in its place, which was certainly no kind of equivalent exchange. Does she know anything? "...As a matter of fact, I think I do. Mikoto, that lazy girl — I remember seeing something like that amongst her things when I went to rouse her the other day. The girl keeps on picking up odds and ends from her benefactors, so I didn't think much of — that would explain why you're the fourth bunch of sellswords Evergreen's directed this way in half as many months." Fourth? "You didn't think you were the first, were you? Of course you weren't. Evergreen and I have never liked each other since I showed her what's what more than a century ago, but sending mercenaries was a little more forward than we usually are with each other. She must really want that bag of hers back. Why don't we deal with that now, so I can keep a clear mind for what comes later?" If she so pleases. "

rows.original: Nodding, Komari sets down her cup, then takes a deep breath and yells. For someone as small as her, she's got quite the voice... not too unlike Kiyoko, come to think of it. "Mikoto!" It's not too long before the voluptuous vixen returns, all cowed and polite with her ears turned down. Even you can tell from Komari's tone of voice that Miko's in for a world of hurt. "Mikoto, according to the northerner's — I mean, [pc.name]'s — story, Evergreen has been sending sellswords over to our house because she's lost an item of considerable sentimental value. One that I've spotted in the mess you keep around you." Miko winces. "So ya figured it out..." "I asked you if you had any idea why that tanuki was bothering us with such a vengeance, and you said no!" "Of course I wouldn't have, granny! I paid th' ol' witch back like what th' law commands! She oughta been satisfied!" "With a pile of leaves?" Miko mumbles something that's neither here nor there. "I said, did you attempt to repay Evergreen for one of her personal treasures with a pile of leaves?" "I thought it was a ratty ol' bag, that's why! If I'd thought it were somethin' actually valuable I wouldn't have gone an' pinched it in the first place! It was a prank!" "A prank that's gotten far out of hand! You thought it was a ratty old bag — so that means at some point you realized it wasn't and she'd been grossly undercompensated?" Miko mumbles some more. "And you didn't tell me this?" Yet more mumbling. "...Get it for us. I can't believe I'm actually taking Evergreen's side, but your stupidity has caused us no end of trouble, girl. I'll deal with you later." Awkward silence lingers around the table as Miko departs, and lasts until she returns minutes later, an unassuming brown cloth pouch in her hands. Huffing, she slaps it down on the table by the tea tray, then storms off with clomping big strides; you can practically see the thunderclouds gathering about her head. Komari picks up the bag, inspects it for a moment, then hands it over to you. Evergreen's bountiful bag acquired. "That should settle the score with Evergreen. She'll be chuckling about one-upping me and mine for weeks, if not months, but the law is clear: something of equivalent value was not exchanged for it. Therefore, it has to go back." This law... "It is one of the underpinnings of the way our society works, and frankly, I don't have the energy to elaborate right now. Perhaps later. Don't you have something that you need to do?"
rows.translation: 点了点头，麻里放下杯子，深吸一口气，然后大声喊了出来。对于一个身材如此娇小的人来说，她的声音竟然相当响亮……仔细想想，她的声音和清子还有点相似呢。“美子！” 没过多久，那个身材丰腴的狐女就回来了，一副被训服了的恭顺模样，耳朵也耷拉着。连你都能从麻里的语气里听出来，美子这次要倒大霉了。 “美子，按那位北方人的——我是说，按 [pc.name] 的说法，常青女士因为丢了一件颇有情感价值的物品，才一直派雇佣兵到我们家来。而那件东西，我就在你身边那堆乱七八糟的东西里瞧见过。” 美子缩了一下。“所以你终于弄明白了……” “我问过你，知不知道那只狸猫为什么这么不依不饶地缠着我们，你却说不知道！” “当然不知道了，奶奶！我是按法律的规定赔给那个老妖婆的！她本该满意才是！” “用一堆树叶？” 美子嘟囔着一些含糊不清的话。 “我是说，你是不是想用一堆树叶来偿还常青女士的一件私人珍宝？” “我以为那只是个破破烂烂的旧袋子，所以才会那么干！要是我早知道那东西真那么值钱，我一开始就不会去偷它了！那只是个恶作剧！” “一个闹到一发不可收拾的恶作剧！你原本以为那是个破破烂烂的旧袋子——也就是说，后来某一刻你意识到它并不是，而她得到的补偿远远不够，对吧？” 美子又嘟囔了几句。 “你居然没告诉我这件事？” 又是更多含糊不清的嘟囔。 “……去把它给我们拿来。真不敢相信我竟然会站在常青女士这一边，但你的愚蠢给我们惹来了没完没了的麻烦，丫头。我回头再收拾你。” 美子离开后，桌边萦绕着一阵尴尬的沉默，一直持续到她几分钟后回来——手里捧着一个不起眼的棕色布包。她气呼呼地把它拍在茶盘旁的桌上，然后咚咚地迈着大步冲了出去；你几乎能看见她头顶聚起的雷云。麻里拿起袋子端详了片刻，然后把它递给你。 已获得常青女士的丰收袋。 “这样应该就能和常青女士算清账了。她准会为自己压过我和我的人一头而得意好几个星期，甚至好几个月，但法律就是这么规定的：没有用等值的东西来交换它。因此，它必须还回去。” 这条法律…… “这是我们社会运转方式的根基之一，坦白说，我现在没精力细讲。也许以后吧。你不是还有事要做吗？”
