rows.original: Perhaps it's time you cut to the chase and ask this vixen what she wants...
rows.translation: 也许是时候直接了当地问问这位狐妖到底想要什么了……
rows.raw: "Perhaps it's time you cut to the chase and ask this vixen what she wants..."

rows.original: Kiyoko perks up at the suggestion, her many tails curling about herself. [rand|"You want to talk? I'm good with us talking. It's probably one of my favorite things to do these days... didn't know how much I missed the sound of someone else's voice until I did, you know?" |"Simply enjoying a pleasant conversation with someone whose company you appreciate is a boon to be savoured, Yes, it's indeed one of the simple pleasures of life, one of the many bricks from which fulfilment is built. Now, did you have a particular topic in mind, [pc.name]?" |"I'd like that very much, thank you. In fact, I would be honored to have a simple conversation with you over tea and sweets." That's pushing it a little, isn't it? "Not when you've learned to appreciate another person's company as keenly as I do. Please, steer the conversation however you wish." ]
rows.translation: 听到这个建议，清子立刻兴奋起来，她那许多尾巴都兴奋地围了上来。 [rand|“你想聊天吗？我完全没意见。最近，这大概是我最喜欢做的事情之一了……直到真正开始聊天，我才意识到自己有多么想念别人说话的声音，你知道吗？” |“能够与一个自己欣赏其为人的人进行愉快的交谈，确实是一种值得珍惜的乐趣。没错，这确实是生活中简单的快乐之一，也是构成幸福感的诸多因素之一。那么，你有没有特别想聊的话题吗，[pc.name]？” |“我非常愿意，谢谢你。事实上，能和你边喝茶边吃点心边聊上几句，我会感到非常荣幸。” 这也有点太夸张了吧？ “当你也能像我一样珍惜与他人的相处时光时，就不会这样想了。请随意引导谈话的方向吧。” ]
rows.raw: " Kiyoko perks up at the suggestion, her many tails curling about herself. [rand|"You want to talk? I'm good with us talking. It's probably one of my favorite things to do these days... didn't know how much I missed the sound of someone else's voice until I did, you know?" |"Simply enjoying a pleasant conversation with someone whose company you appreciate is a boon to be savoured, Yes, it's indeed one of the simple pleasures of life, one of the many bricks from which fulfilment is built. Now, did you have a particular topic in mind, [pc.name]?" |"I'd like that very much, thank you. In fact, I would be honored to have a simple conversation with you over tea and sweets." That's pushing it a little, isn't it? "Not when you've learned to appreciate another person's company as keenly as I do. Please, steer the conversation however you wish." ]"

rows.original: [flags.KIYOKO_MEAL_TS |You mention you wouldn't mind settling down to talk with Kiyoko over another hearty meal. The kitsune gives you a thin, genial smile and rises from her seat at the low table. "Of course, [pc.name]; I would be delighted and honored to display my culinary skills. Cooking is much more gratifying when you do it for someone else other than yourself, after all. Please bear with me a moment; I shall return shortly." |You know this might sound odd, given how she's mentioned before that no one actually needs to eat in this pocket dimension, but you'd like to sample some of her food, if she doesn't mind cooking. It'd help you to get to know her better, and having a conversation over a meal has a certain something or the other to it, a relaxing atmosphere that can't quite be matched otherwise. "There's no need to be sheepish about it, [pc.name]. I understand the point you're driving at, and agree wholeheartedly. Of course I would be more than pleased to exercise my culinary skills for your benefit — it's not as if I have anywhere else to be, after all. Please, wait here. I'll return shortly." ] Kiyoko is good to her word. After about half an hour of waiting, the kitsune returns with a large tray balanced in her hands, and sets it down on the low table. Now that you can see what's on it, it appears to be [rand|a large plate on which a lobster has been laid out belly-up. The belly and legs have been cut open and removed, revealing the raw meat in the bowl of its armored back; surrounding it are thinly sliced pieces of salmon and shelled shrimp, just as raw as the lobster is. The entire dish has been garnished with carrot strands, cucumber wedges and lemon slices, all arranged with quite the artistic flair. "Don't worry. Despite being raw, everything is safe to eat as-is. The vinegar and spices do more than just flavor the food, after all." |two bowls full of what appear to be thick, slippery wheat noodles in clear broth. There aren't that many toppings — a sprinkle of herbs for garnish and what looks to be two rectangles of golden-brown fried... things. It's certainly unlike any food you'd ever find up in the Frost Marches. "If you're wondering, that's reputedly the favorite food of Lord Keros himself — he enjoys thin fried tofu a lot, as the stories go. I share the taste, as do a lot of other kitsune — or pretend to in order to flatter the Trickster. The broth, too, that's also something I can get behind." |two large bowls of sliced beef strips, cooked with onions and in some kind of dark sauce. The aroma rising from the steaming rice it's been topped over is heavenly, and you smell just a hint of strong ginger somewhere in the mix. Topped with a raw egg, there's a certain down-to-earth charm to the dish. "I decided to come up with something simple today, something that a northerner might be able to enjoy without worry. Please, tuck in." |a large plate of what looks to be balls of sticky rice dough. As you watch, Kiyoko breaks open one of them to reveal the sweet dark stuffing inside, a warm smile spreading on her face before she gleefully pops both halves into her mouth and chews with utter bliss. "I used to love red bean mochi a lot when I was young. Still do. I'm... I'm hoping you can share that love with me, [pc.name]." |a piping hot pot of broth, around which have been laid several small plates of beef, mushrooms and vegetables. Signaling for you to wait, Kiyoko cooks several pieces of the beef in the charcoal-fired hot pot until the broth begins to turn meaty, then adds in the remaining vegetables one by one until you've got a steaming hot meaty vegetable soup. Aah... "We'd do this a lot when we first arrived on this continent under Keros' orders," Kiyoko explains. "A hot pot is great for warming the skin under one's fur... and even better when shared with other people, the more the merrier. It makes one feel all warm and good inside..." |an enormous pile of golden-brown pouches stuffed to bursting. Through the pouches' open front, you can see their contents: rice, grated carrots, small black seeds and diced vegetables, topped with small portions of scrambled eggs. Kiyoko seats herself across from you, leans forward[kiyoko.pregStage 2| as much as her round, pregnant tummy will allow ], and takes a deep breath to savour the steaming fragrance rising from the food. Even seated where you are, you can smell it too: heated oil, vinegar, and something or the other you can't quite put words to. Looking back up, Kiyoko's face has gone all dreamy, and she heaves a long, trembling sigh. [kiyoko.pregStage 0 1 3|"Ooooooohhhh. Inarizushi. I have such a weakness for this." It does look good, and smells just as heavenly. You can tell the extra love and effort she put into making these. Kiyoko blushes a little, and the kitsune folds her ears forward. "They... they just bring back good memories, you know? When I was little, I would always try and sneak a bite when Mother was making inarizushi. No matter what magic I used to hide myself, she'd always spot me and send me off with a rap of her spoon. "Didn't mean I gave up there, of course. I'd get one of my brothers or sisters to distract her while I helped myself... we'd split the haul later. Haha, it seems all so long ago..." There's a moment of awkward silence as Kiyoko's expression falls, and then she perks up again as if nothing had ever happened. "Enough of that, there's no reason to ruin the flavor of food this good with such talk. Let's dig in!" Now that's something you can agree with! |"What are you waiting for? Let's eat!" Barely have you picked up your utensils that Kiyoko eagerly digs into the small mountain of fried rice pouches, applying herself with a feral, practically gluttonous abandon that would put the most ravenous lupine or minotaur to shame. Kiyoko has been a number of things in the time that you've known her, but this picture of sheer, simple-minded efficiency is something else altogether. "Ehe... it's kind of rude to stare at people when they're eating, you know." Well, you wouldn't think it rude, not when she's so... enthusiastic about it. "I'm pregnant! I need to eat lots! So I made lots!" Even if that were true considering the nature of the Astral Plane, you don't think she's that pregnant to warrant- "I'm not listening!" Kiyoko squeals, pulling her large, foxy ears flat against her hair. "I'm not listening! I'm a growing mother, and growing foxy mothers must have inarizushi! You made me like this, so it's your fault that I'm being a pig!" Fine! If she's going to be so petulant and childish about it, the only way to stop her is to finish all the food before she can overeat! |It's then that the kitsune finally breaks down — not even bothering to pick up the utensils on the tray, Kiyoko grabs three of the stuffed fried pouches and tries to cram them into her dainty little mouth all at once. Wait, isn't she going to choke if she eats that quickly? Can she even choke? Kiyoko swallows, then moves to stuff her face with another one of the fried rice pouches before catching herself, aiming a most petulant, pouty expression directly at you. Seeing her talk with a mouth full of food is something. "I'm huuuungrrrrryy. I'm pregnant. Your kit is making me hungry. I want inarizushi. Your kit wants inarizushi. Don't even try to stop us." You weren't going to, but what she said — doesn't that mean that she's just using your visit as an excuse to- "It's two against one," Kiyoko says, patting her big, round belly with oily fingers. "You're not going to stop us!" [pc.isDK|Oh, you are going to stop her. And the only way to do that is to eat it all before she does. Kiyoko sticks her little pink tongue out at you. "Mine!" Without further ado, she begins to prodigiously scarf down the food as quickly as she can.|Oh no no no no. You're smart enough not to get between someone with that particular look on her face and her food. That's just going to be more trouble than it's worth.] ] Between the two of you, it doesn't take long for the miniature mountain of rice-stuffed pockets to disappear. The food isn't real — no matter how many you chow down on, you never seem to feel any fuller, but Kiyoko's presence is very much there. The kitsune doesn't say anything as she stuffs her face, but the sheer enthusiasm with which she does it and her animated demeanour tell you more than words ever could. "Ooh... ehe... I think I may have overeaten. But even if I have, I don't think I'm going to allow myself to regret a single moment of it." Kiyoko wipes away broken grains of rice from her cheeks and grins stupidly at you. Was all this just an excuse for her to give herself a treat? "Oh, don't be like that. I needed it, and by the looks of you, so did you. I just... this particular dish has special meaning for me, and I wanted to share it with someone I cared for." Pretty words to hide tricky intentions. "Oh, boo." Kiyoko snaps her fingers, and the dirty dishes rise off the low table and settle on the sideboard, out of the way. "Come on, now that I've had a nice meal, I'm feeling much more playful, or anything else you might want to get up to. Got any ideas?" ] [flags.KIYOKO_MEAL_TS||You've got to ask, though, what are those utensils over there? Those sticks, for lack of a better word to describe them? Hope you didn't give offense, but... "Hah, of course. You wouldn't know what chopsticks are. Just feel free to ignore them and use the spoon — I want you to feel comfortable, not cause you distress. The oversight is entirely mine."] The two of you spend a little time together, eating and chatting away the next hour or so as the meal gradually disappears before you. It's delightfully flavorful in quite the exotic way — Kiyoko is clearly an exceptional cook, and you don't think you could ever sample such tastes anywhere in the Frost Marches. However, the nature of the food is quite apparent — no matter how much you eat, you don't seem to feel any fuller. Nevertheless, that wasn't the point, was it? No, the smiling, demure kitsune on the other side of the table was the point, and she seems rather content with the whole exercise as the two of you pick the tray clean and finish up with a bit more tea. "Very satisfactory," Kiyoko says as she clears away the dirty dishes with a snap of her fingers. "It's always a pleasure to share a meal with you, [pc.name]." No, no, the pleasure is yours. A laugh. "If you say so. Come now, then — we've still plenty of time ahead of us. I'll let you take the lead — what would you like to do?"
rows.translation: [flags.KIYOKO_MEAL_TS |你说你很乐意在另一顿美餐之后，坐下来和清子好好聊聊。那只狐妖向你露出了一个友善的微笑，然后从那张矮桌旁的座位上站了起来。 “当然，[pc.name]，能展示我的烹饪技艺，我会感到非常高兴和荣幸。毕竟，为别人做饭带来的满足感要比为自己做饭大得多。请稍等片刻，我马上就回来。” |你知道，她之前说过，在这个口袋维度里其实没有人需要进食，所以这么说可能听起来有点怪——不过你还是想尝尝她做的菜，如果她不介意下厨的话。这能帮你更好地了解她，而且边吃边聊也别有一番意味，那种轻松的氛围是其他方式无法比拟的。 “没必要为此感到害羞，[pc.name]，我完全理解你的意思，也完全同意。当然，能够为你的需要施展我的烹饪技艺，我会感到非常高兴——毕竟我也没有其他地方可去。请在这里稍等，我马上就会回来。” ] 清子确实说到做到了。大约等了半个小时后，那只狐妖手里端着一个大托盘回来了，然后把它放在了矮桌上。现在你能看到上面装着什么了，看起来是 [rand|一块大盘子上，一只龙虾被翻过来摆放着。它的腹部和腿部都被切开并去掉，露出了背部甲壳下的生肉；周围摆着切成薄片的三文鱼和去壳的虾，这些食材也都和龙虾一样是生的。整道菜还用胡萝卜丝、黄瓜片和柠檬片进行了装饰，摆放得相当有艺术感。 “别担心。虽然这些食材都是生的，但直接食用也是安全的。毕竟，醋和香料的作用可不仅仅是调味而已。” |两碗清汤中漂浮着看似浓稠而滑溜的面条。配料并不多——只是撒上一些香草作为装饰，还有看起来像是两块金黄色的炸……东西。这种食物肯定与你在霜冻边境地区能找到的任何食物都不一样。 “如果你好奇的话，据说这正是凯罗斯大人最爱的食物——传说他非常喜欢薄炸豆腐。我和很多其他狐妖一样也有同样的口味——或者说，装作有，好讨好这位欺诈者。至于那汤汁，我也非常认可它的美味。” |两大碗切好的牛肉条，与洋葱一起用某种深色的酱料烹制而成。覆盖在热气腾腾的米饭上的香气令人陶醉，还能隐约闻到其中掺杂着的浓烈姜味。再加上一个生鸡蛋，这道菜便增添了一种朴实而诱人的魅力。 “今天我决定准备一些简单的东西，一些北方人应该能够毫无负担地享受的食物。请开始享用吧。” |一大盘看起来像是粘米团的东西。你看着，清子拆开了其中一个，露出了里面甜美的黑色馅料，她脸上露出了温暖的笑容，然后开心地把两半都放进嘴里，津津有味地咀嚼起来。 “我小时候非常喜欢红豆团子，现在依然喜欢。我……我希望你也能和我一起分享这份喜爱，[pc.name]。” |一锅热气腾腾的高汤，上面摆放着几小盘牛肉、蘑菇和蔬菜。清子示意你稍等，她先将几块牛肉放入炭火火锅中煮，直到高汤开始带有肉香，然后再依次加入剩下的蔬菜，最终就制成了一锅热气腾腾、肉香四溢的蔬菜汤。 啊…… “在凯罗斯的命令下，我们刚来到这片大陆时，经常做这样的事情。”清子解释道。“火锅确实很适合用来温暖身体……而当和别人一起分享时，效果会更加显著，人数越多越开心。吃火锅会让人体内充满温暖与舒适的感觉……” |一大堆金棕色的袋子，被塞得满满当当。透过这些袋子敞开的开口，你可以看到里面的内容：大米、胡萝卜丝、小黑籽以及切块的蔬菜，上面还撒着少量炒鸡蛋。清子坐在你对面，身体微微前倾[kiyoko.pregStage 2| 在她的圆滚滚、隆起的肚子允许的范围内 ]她深吸一口气，尽情享受着从食物中散发出来的热气与香气。即使是你坐在那里，也能闻到这种味道：热油、醋，还有其他一些难以用言语形容的成分。 当她再次抬起头时，清子的脸上浮现出一丝恍惚的神情，然后她长长地叹了口气，声音带着颤抖。 [kiyoko.pregStage 0 1 3|“哦哦哦哦哦哦……稻荷寿司。我对这东西简直毫无抵抗力。” 它看起来确实很漂亮，闻起来也香极了。你能感受到她为制作这些付出了多少额外的心血和努力。 清子微微脸红了，那只狐妖把耳朵向前搭了起来。“它们……它们总能唤起美好的回忆，你知道吗？小时候，每当妈妈在做稻荷寿司的时候，我总会偷偷地想尝上一口。无论我用什么法术隐藏自己，妈妈总能发现我，然后用勺子轻轻敲打我的头，把我赶走。 当然，那并不意味着我就此放弃了。我会让我的某个兄弟姐妹去分散她的注意力，而我就趁机拿走我的那份……之后我们再把东西分掉。哈哈，感觉那些事都已经发生很久很久以前了……” 一阵尴尬的沉默出现了，因为清子的表情瞬间变得黯淡下来，但很快她又恢复了往常的神情，仿佛什么都没发生过一样。 “够了，没必要用这种话破坏这么美味食物的味道。我们开始吃饭吧！” 这点你倒是完全可以同意！ |“还在等什么？我们开始吃饭吧！” 你刚拿起餐具，清子就迫不及待地扑向那一小堆炸饭团，她的动作狂热而近乎贪婪，那副吃相就连最饿的狼人或牛头怪看了都要自愧不如。在你认识她的这段时间里，清子展现出了许多不同的面貌，但这种纯粹而高效的表现方式，确实是一种全新的形象。 “呃……在别人吃饭的时候盯着他们看，其实有点不礼貌吧。” 嗯，当你看到她对这件事如此……热情时，你就不会觉得这有什么不礼貌的地方了。 “我怀孕了！我需要多吃点！所以我就做了很多食物！” 即使考虑到星界本身的特性，这话或许不假，但你也不觉得她怀得那么夸张，至于—— “我才不听呢！”清子尖叫着，把她那对又大又像狐狸的大耳朵贴平在头发上。“我才不听呢！我可是个正在成长的母亲，正在成长的狐狸妈妈必须吃稻荷寿司！都是你把我变成这样的，所以我这么贪吃都是你的错！” 好吧！如果她非得这么任性、这么孩子气地对待这件事，那么唯一的办法就是在她吃太多之前把所有食物都吃完！ |就在这时，那只狐妖终于崩溃了——清子甚至都懒得去拿托盘里的餐具，直接抓起了三个炸馅小包，试图把它们全部塞进自己那小小的嘴里。 等等，她吃得这么快，不会噎到吧？她真的会噎到吗？ 清子咽下食物后，又赶紧拿起另一个炒饭袋子往嘴里塞，然后突然停住动作，冲着你露出一个极其撒娇、嘟着嘴的表情。看到她边吃东西边说话，真是有趣极了。“我好饿好饿好饿啊。我怀孕了。你的孩子让我饿得慌。我想吃稻荷寿司。你的孩子也想吃稻荷寿司。别想拦住我们。” 你本来并不打算这么做，但她说的话——难道不意味着她只是把你的到访当作一个借口而已吗？ “现在是二对一了。”清子用沾满油渍的手指轻轻拍打着自己圆滚滚的大肚子，说道。“你不可能拦住我们！” [pc.isDK|哦，你确实得阻止她。而唯一的办法就是赶在她前面把东西全吃掉。 清子把她那小小的粉红色舌头伸了出来，对着你。“我的！”她没有再犹豫，开始以极快的速度大口吃起食物来。|哦不不不不。你这么聪明，应该知道当一个人露出那种表情时，最好不要去打扰她和她的食物。那样只会惹来更多的麻烦，根本不值得。] ] 你们两个一起，那些装满米饭的小点心很快就全被吃光了。这些食物并非真实的——无论你吃下多少，似乎永远也吃不饱，但清子的存在感却实实在在。那只狐妖一边大口吃东西，一边什么也没说，但她那充满热情的样子以及活泼的神情，所传达的信息远比任何言语都要丰富。 “哦……嘿嘿……我想我可能是吃得太多了。不过就算真的这样，我也绝不会让自己为其中的任何一刻感到后悔。”清子擦去脸颊上沾着的碎米粒，然后傻乎乎地对你笑了笑。 难道这一切，只不过是她想给自己找个借口来享受一番罢了？ “哦，别这样。我需要它，而看你的样子，你也需要它。只是……这道菜对我有着特殊的意义，我想和我在乎的人一起分享它。” 漂亮的话用来掩盖险恶的意图。 “哦，真没劲。”清子打了个响指，那些脏盘子便从矮桌上飘起来，落在了边柜上，不再碍事。“来吧，既然我已经吃了一顿美餐，现在变得心情愉悦多了，什么有趣的事情都愿意尝试。你有什么主意吗？” ] [flags.KIYOKO_MEAL_TS||不过，你肯定想知道，那边那些餐具是什么？那些棍子，实在找不到更好的词来形容它们了……希望我没有冒犯到你，不过…… “哈，当然。你肯定不知道筷子是什么吧。直接忽略它们，用勺子就行——我可是希望你能舒服地用餐，而不是感到不便。这个疏忽完全是我的责任。”] 你们俩一起度过了这段时光，边吃饭边聊天，大约一个小时的时间就这样过去了。食物在你们面前逐渐被吃光，而它的味道却异常美味——显然，清子是一位非常出色的厨师，你觉得自己绝对不可能在霜冻边境的任何地方尝到这样的美味。然而，这种食物的特性其实相当明显——无论你吃多少，似乎都不会感到有任何饱腹感。 不过，这其实并不是重点，对吧？重点在于坐在桌子对面的那个面带微笑、举止端庄的狐妖，她看起来对整个过程相当满意，因为你们俩把盘子里的食物吃得一干二净，还喝了几杯茶。 “非常令人满意。”清子打了个响指清理掉那些脏盘子，说道。“能和你共进一餐，总是件令人愉快的事，[pc.name]。” 不，不，这份荣幸应该属于你。 一阵笑声。“如果你这么说的话。来吧——我们还有很多时间。就由你来带头吧——你想做些什么呢？”
rows.raw: " [flags.KIYOKO_MEAL_TS |You mention you wouldn't mind settling down to talk with Kiyoko over another hearty meal. The kitsune gives you a thin, genial smile and rises from her seat at the low table. "Of course, [pc.name]; I would be delighted and honored to display my culinary skills. Cooking is much more gratifying when you do it for someone else other than yourself, after all. Please bear with me a moment; I shall return shortly." |You know this might sound odd, given how she's mentioned before that no one actually needs to eat in this pocket dimension, but you'd like to sample some of her food, if she doesn't mind cooking. It'd help you to get to know her better, and having a conversation over a meal has a certain something or the other to it, a relaxing atmosphere that can't quite be matched otherwise. "There's no need to be sheepish about it, [pc.name]. I understand the point you're driving at, and agree wholeheartedly. Of course I would be more than pleased to exercise my culinary skills for your benefit — it's not as if I have anywhere else to be, after all. Please, wait here. I'll return shortly." ] Kiyoko is good to her word. After about half an hour of waiting, the kitsune returns with a large tray balanced in her hands, and sets it down on the low table. Now that you can see what's on it, it appears to be [rand|a large plate on which a lobster has been laid out belly-up. The belly and legs have been cut open and removed, revealing the raw meat in the bowl of its armored back; surrounding it are thinly sliced pieces of salmon and shelled shrimp, just as raw as the lobster is. The entire dish has been garnished with carrot strands, cucumber wedges and lemon slices, all arranged with quite the artistic flair. "Don't worry. Despite being raw, everything is safe to eat as-is. The vinegar and spices do more than just flavor the food, after all." |two bowls full of what appear to be thick, slippery wheat noodles in clear broth. There aren't that many toppings — a sprinkle of herbs for garnish and what looks to be two rectangles of golden-brown fried... things. It's certainly unlike any food you'd ever find up in the Frost Marches. "If you're wondering, that's reputedly the favorite food of Lord Keros himself — he enjoys thin fried tofu a lot, as the stories go. I share the taste, as do a lot of other kitsune — or pretend to in order to flatter the Trickster. The broth, too, that's also something I can get behind." |two large bowls of sliced beef strips, cooked with onions and in some kind of dark sauce. The aroma rising from the steaming rice it's been topped over is heavenly, and you smell just a hint of strong ginger somewhere in the mix. Topped with a raw egg, there's a certain down-to-earth charm to the dish. "I decided to come up with something simple today, something that a northerner might be able to enjoy without worry. Please, tuck in." |a large plate of what looks to be balls of sticky rice dough. As you watch, Kiyoko breaks open one of them to reveal the sweet dark stuffing inside, a warm smile spreading on her face before she gleefully pops both halves into her mouth and chews with utter bliss. "I used to love red bean mochi a lot when I was young. Still do. I'm... I'm hoping you can share that love with me, [pc.name]." |a piping hot pot of broth, around which have been laid several small plates of beef, mushrooms and vegetables. Signaling for you to wait, Kiyoko cooks several pieces of the beef in the charcoal-fired hot pot until the broth begins to turn meaty, then adds in the remaining vegetables one by one until you've got a steaming hot meaty vegetable soup. Aah... "We'd do this a lot when we first arrived on this continent under Keros' orders," Kiyoko explains. "A hot pot is great for warming the skin under one's fur... and even better when shared with other people, the more the merrier. It makes one feel all warm and good inside..." |an enormous pile of golden-brown pouches stuffed to bursting. Through the pouches' open front, you can see their contents: rice, grated carrots, small black seeds and diced vegetables, topped with small portions of scrambled eggs. Kiyoko seats herself across from you, leans forward[kiyoko.pregStage 2| as much as her round, pregnant tummy will allow ], and takes a deep breath to savour the steaming fragrance rising from the food. Even seated where you are, you can smell it too: heated oil, vinegar, and something or the other you can't quite put words to. Looking back up, Kiyoko's face has gone all dreamy, and she heaves a long, trembling sigh. [kiyoko.pregStage 0 1 3|"Ooooooohhhh. Inarizushi. I have such a weakness for this." It does look good, and smells just as heavenly. You can tell the extra love and effort she put into making these. Kiyoko blushes a little, and the kitsune folds her ears forward. "They... they just bring back good memories, you know? When I was little, I would always try and sneak a bite when Mother was making inarizushi. No matter what magic I used to hide myself, she'd always spot me and send me off with a rap of her spoon. "Didn't mean I gave up there, of course. I'd get one of my brothers or sisters to distract her while I helped myself... we'd split the haul later. Haha, it seems all so long ago..." There's a moment of awkward silence as Kiyoko's expression falls, and then she perks up again as if nothing had ever happened. "Enough of that, there's no reason to ruin the flavor of food this good with such talk. Let's dig in!" Now that's something you can agree with! |"What are you waiting for? Let's eat!" Barely have you picked up your utensils that Kiyoko eagerly digs into the small mountain of fried rice pouches, applying herself with a feral, practically gluttonous abandon that would put the most ravenous lupine or minotaur to shame. Kiyoko has been a number of things in the time that you've known her, but this picture of sheer, simple-minded efficiency is something else altogether. "Ehe... it's kind of rude to stare at people when they're eating, you know." Well, you wouldn't think it rude, not when she's so... enthusiastic about it. "I'm pregnant! I need to eat lots! So I made lots!" Even if that were true considering the nature of the Astral Plane, you don't think she's that pregnant to warrant- "I'm not listening!" Kiyoko squeals, pulling her large, foxy ears flat against her hair. "I'm not listening! I'm a growing mother, and growing foxy mothers must have inarizushi! You made me like this, so it's your fault that I'm being a pig!" Fine! If she's going to be so petulant and childish about it, the only way to stop her is to finish all the food before she can overeat! |It's then that the kitsune finally breaks down — not even bothering to pick up the utensils on the tray, Kiyoko grabs three of the stuffed fried pouches and tries to cram them into her dainty little mouth all at once. Wait, isn't she going to choke if she eats that quickly? Can she even choke? Kiyoko swallows, then moves to stuff her face with another one of the fried rice pouches before catching herself, aiming a most petulant, pouty expression directly at you. Seeing her talk with a mouth full of food is something. "I'm huuuungrrrrryy. I'm pregnant. Your kit is making me hungry. I want inarizushi. Your kit wants inarizushi. Don't even try to stop us." You weren't going to, but what she said — doesn't that mean that she's just using your visit as an excuse to- "It's two against one," Kiyoko says, patting her big, round belly with oily fingers. "You're not going to stop us!" [pc.isDK|Oh, you are going to stop her. And the only way to do that is to eat it all before she does. Kiyoko sticks her little pink tongue out at you. "Mine!" Without further ado, she begins to prodigiously scarf down the food as quickly as she can.|Oh no no no no. You're smart enough not to get between someone with that particular look on her face and her food. That's just going to be more trouble than it's worth.] ] Between the two of you, it doesn't take long for the miniature mountain of rice-stuffed pockets to disappear. The food isn't real — no matter how many you chow down on, you never seem to feel any fuller, but Kiyoko's presence is very much there. The kitsune doesn't say anything as she stuffs her face, but the sheer enthusiasm with which she does it and her animated demeanour tell you more than words ever could. "Ooh... ehe... I think I may have overeaten. But even if I have, I don't think I'm going to allow myself to regret a single moment of it." Kiyoko wipes away broken grains of rice from her cheeks and grins stupidly at you. Was all this just an excuse for her to give herself a treat? "Oh, don't be like that. I needed it, and by the looks of you, so did you. I just... this particular dish has special meaning for me, and I wanted to share it with someone I cared for." Pretty words to hide tricky intentions. "Oh, boo." Kiyoko snaps her fingers, and the dirty dishes rise off the low table and settle on the sideboard, out of the way. "Come on, now that I've had a nice meal, I'm feeling much more playful, or anything else you might want to get up to. Got any ideas?" ] [flags.KIYOKO_MEAL_TS||You've got to ask, though, what are those utensils over there? Those sticks, for lack of a better word to describe them? Hope you didn't give offense, but... "Hah, of course. You wouldn't know what chopsticks are. Just feel free to ignore them and use the spoon — I want you to feel comfortable, not cause you distress. The oversight is entirely mine."] The two of you spend a little time together, eating and chatting away the next hour or so as the meal gradually disappears before you. It's delightfully flavorful in quite the exotic way — Kiyoko is clearly an exceptional cook, and you don't think you could ever sample such tastes anywhere in the Frost Marches. However, the nature of the food is quite apparent — no matter how much you eat, you don't seem to feel any fuller. Nevertheless, that wasn't the point, was it? No, the smiling, demure kitsune on the other side of the table was the point, and she seems rather content with the whole exercise as the two of you pick the tray clean and finish up with a bit more tea. "Very satisfactory," Kiyoko says as she clears away the dirty dishes with a snap of her fingers. "It's always a pleasure to share a meal with you, [pc.name]." No, no, the pleasure is yours. A laugh. "If you say so. Come now, then — we've still plenty of time ahead of us. I'll let you take the lead — what would you like to do?""

rows.original: "Oh? You're hungry?" Come on. She knows full well that no one actually needs to eat here on the Astral Plane. But that doesn't stop you from enjoying her company over a nice meal, and let's face it — it's always interesting to see what she can cook up from her home culture. Kiyoko stands and bows. "Thank you for the compliment, [pc.name]. It's always gratifying to be appreciated in this way; I have to reciprocate the favor somehow. Actually, I've been considering something now for all that you've been doing for me, and since you were kind enough to bring up the topic of a good meal, I think I can weave these two threads together." Oh? Seriously, though, you don't think it'll be strictly necessary... A playful laugh. "If you must, [pc.name], you can always praise me lots when we're done. It truly warms my heart to hear others speak well of me, although to be frank, who wouldn't?" All righty then. You'll be waiting with bated breath to see what she's going to cook up. "What I had in mind was a rather unique... well, it's not so much a dish, but rather a way of presenting and serving up the meal. The food is important, of course, but it's not just the meal that's important. Amongst us kitsune, it's considered quite an art form in and of itself. "Now, it'll take a little while longer than usual, I imagine. Please, do entertain yourself while I'm making the necessary preparations. I need to make sure the children are out playing and that we won't get walked in upon." Something the kits can't see? Now you're a little curious as to what Kiyoko has up her sleeve, but she clearly wants to keep it a surprise. Nodding, you watch as Kiyoko excuses herself from the room, then settle in for the wait. Shortly after, you hear the pattering of little feet heading for the cabin door, followed by the sounds of splashing water and kitchen utensils. There seems to be a lot of water being sloshed about — is it soup that she's preparing? You're not exactly sure how long you've been waiting; perhaps half an hour, although there are no clocks in the cabin to tell the time by. However, by and large Kiyoko's light footsteps return to the screen door and it slides open to reveal... ...Well. She's not wearing her sandals, for one. Nor does she have her socks on. Or anything else, for that matter. The only thing standing between your eyes and Kiyoko's orange-amber hair and fur is a thin red apron of flimsy fabric, [kiyoko.pregStage 0 1 3|which hugs her form and leaves little to the imagination. The little which is left to the imagination, you suspect, has been tastefully arranged in order to conceal what few flaws are on the kitsune's body — and the imagination is quite adept at filling in the blanks with the flattering. It's dainty, and suiting the stature of someone like Kiyoko. It promises so much more, especially if she were to turn around. It's kind of like a maid outfit, only... less. A lot less in some respects, but a lot more in others. Domestic and alluring. What's not to like? |which struggles to contain the kitsune's increasingly pregnant midriff. Considering that it was already form-fitting to begin with, that's quite a feat, and as a result Kiyoko's motherly curves are outlined plainly for your enjoyment. The bottom of her growing belly peeks out from under the apron's hem, and the barely-covered skin is somehow more alluring than it would've otherwise been had she been completely nude. Given how Kiyoko would've easily been able to find a fitting apron had she the mind to do so, there's no doubt that she's donned this getup on purpose. It is appropriately maternal and domestic, you have to admit, while still reminding you exactly how and why her tummy is growing... |and even that has been pushed up by the kitsune's heavily pregnant belly to the point where it only manages to cover just under half of the full, round dome, leaving her navel and everything below exposed. To be fair, it's not the belly's doing all alone. Kiyoko's engorged, milk-heavy breasts push against the apron from underneath, her fat nipples clearly outlined for you to see. Pressed so tightly together, her lady lumps are starting to leak — very, very slowly, but they still are, enough for two distinctly wet spots to form on the apron's fabric. Maternal, risque and domestic. Can things get even better than this? ] But that's not all. Balanced in Kiyoko's hands is a huge tray of sushi, sashimi, seaweed rolls, and other small finger foods. There're utensils, too, but as you watch Kiyoko set the table, you note that she's only doing so for one, and as she passes you, you catch a whiff of faintly scented soap. Did she take a quick bath to be more presentable? Hmm... she's not setting out the food, either. Wonder what she's got up her sleeve. Setting the tray down on the table, Kiyoko wiggles her large foxy ears playfully and bows. "Does this please you?" Yes, it's been very pleasing so far. It's a surprise, one supposes, and you're content to play along with whatever little game she's got in mind. You get no reply, but Kiyoko looks extremely smug as she, against all expectations, sits down on the table's edge and lies down on her back. Hair and tails alike fan out underneath her as she makes herself comfortable, and [kiyoko.pregStage 3|even though the weight of her kit-filled womb is pressing directly on her, the kitsune doesn't seem in the least bit discomfited. |she gives you an encouraging smile. ] "Would you do the honors of removing the tablecloth?" The tablecloth? Oh, she must mean the apron; you get the feeling you know where this is going, and it's to a good place. Even in Kiyoko's current position, it's not too hard to reach around and undo the apron strings, then rip the flimsy garment off her with a flourish before folding it up and setting it beside the table. "Now, would you please hand me that scroll on the tray?" It's not a very large one, which is why you must've overlooked it amongst the sumptuous spread arrayed on it, but once you start looking for it specifically it's not too hard to find the scroll in question. The rods have been encrusted with little sapphires, with larger ones tipping both ends of each rod, and as Kiyoko unfurls the paper you feel a faint surge of magic being worked... Huh. As one, the various foodstuffs rise off their dishes and clean off the tray. Some have a backing of fragrant leaves, others less so, and like a flock of birds on a tree, they waft through the air and alight on Kiyoko's naked body, perched precariously on her bare skin and fur wherever they can find purchase. The end result is rather artistic, for lack of a better word to put it — the colorful arrangement of sushi, sashimi and rolls against the kitsune's pale skin, complete with candy flowers and decorative herbs speaks of the time and effort that must've been spent in crafting the spell, if nothing else. You like this. It's very exotic, if nothing else; the garland of white flowers — you're not sure what exactly they are — is very fetching on her. Then there's the matter of the strategically placed bits of sushi covering her more delicate lady bits... you're looking forward to seeing how those taste. A flush of deep red creeps into Kiyoko's cheeks. "Really." Yes, indeed. "I spent the entirety of a night just getting the spell I just used correct. There were several mishaps, but here and now, I believe that all that effort was worth it. Please," she says, unable to keep a bright, mischievous smile off her lips. "I would be honored if you'd partake of the meal — and me — however you wish."
rows.translation: “哦？你饿了？” 得了吧，她心里很清楚，在星界这里其实根本没有人需要进食。但这并不妨碍你借着一顿美餐享受她的陪伴，而且说实话，看看她能用自己的家乡文化做出什么美食，总是很有趣的。 清子站起身来，鞠了一躬。“谢谢你的夸奖，[pc.name]。能被人这样欣赏，总是令人愉快；我总得想办法回报这份好意。其实，我一直在考虑该怎么报答你为我做的一切，既然你好心提起了美餐这个话题，我想我可以把这两件事结合起来。” 哦？不过说真的，你觉得这其实没太大必要吧…… 一阵轻松的笑声。“如果你非要这样，[pc.name]，那等我们办完事，你随时可以多夸夸我。听到别人说我的好话，真的很暖心，不过说实话，谁不是这样呢？” 好吧，那么你就等着瞧她会想出什么点子吧。 “我想要的是一种相当独特的……嗯，与其说它是一道菜，不如说它是一种呈现和供应菜肴的方式。当然，食物本身很重要，但重要的并不只是这顿饭。在我们狐族看来，这本身就被视为一门艺术。 现在，我想这个过程会比平时花费更长的时间。请在我就绪之前，先自己找点事情做吧。我需要确保孩子们都出去玩了，这样就不会有人突然闯进来打扰我们了。” 有什么东西是小狐狸们看不到的？现在你有点好奇清子到底藏了什么把戏，但她显然想把这当成惊喜留到最后一刻。你点了点头，看着清子告退离开房间，然后安顿下来等着。没过多久，你听到小脚丫啪嗒啪嗒地朝小屋门口跑去，接着是哗哗的水声和厨房器具的响动。似乎有大量的水被泼来泼去——她是在准备汤吗？ 你不太确定自己等了多久；大概半个小时吧，不过小屋里没有钟可以看时间。不过，清子轻快的脚步声终于回到了纱门前，门被拉开了，露出—— ……嗯，首先，她没穿凉鞋，也没穿袜子。事实上，她什么衣服都没穿。挡在你和清子那橙黄色的头发与皮毛之间的，只有一条薄薄的红围裙。 [kiyoko.pregStage 0 1 3|它紧紧贴着她的身形，几乎没给想象力留下什么空间。还有那么一点点是留给想象力的余地，你猜想，这点余地也被巧妙地安排好了，用来遮掩这只狐妖身上少有的瑕疵——而想象力最擅长用美化的画面填补空白。 它很精致，也很衬清子这样的身段。它许诺的东西要多得多，尤其是当她转过身去的时候。它有点像女仆装，只不过……更少。某些方面少得多，另一些方面却多得多。 既居家又诱人。还有什么不喜欢的呢？ |这条围裙实在难以兜住这只狐妖日渐隆起的腹部。考虑到它本来就贴身，能做到这一点已经相当了不起了，因此清子的母性曲线就这样清晰地展现出来供你欣赏。她逐渐变大的肚子从围裙下摆处探了出来，那若隐若现的皮肤，反而比她完全赤裸时更加诱人。 既然清子只要有心就轻而易举能找到一条合身的围裙，那毫无疑问，她这身打扮是故意的。你不得不承认，它的确既符合母亲的身份，又很有居家气息，同时又无时无刻不在提醒你：她的肚子为什么在变大，又是怎么变大的…… |甚至那东西也被这只狐妖高高隆起的孕肚顶了上去，只能勉强遮住那浑圆穹顶的一半略少，把她的肚脐及以下全都露了出来。 公平地说，这并不全是肚子的功劳。清子的胸部因为充满了乳汁而紧紧地贴在围裙上，那肥大的乳头清晰地显露在眼前。由于被挤压得过于紧密，她的乳房开始渗出乳汁——虽然速度非常慢，但确实有乳汁渗出，因此在围裙的布料上形成了两处明显的湿痕。 既有母性气息，又略带挑逗又很居家。还能有比这更好的事吗？ ] 但还不止这些。清子手中端着一个大盘子，上面堆满了寿司、生鱼片、海苔卷和其他各种小点心。桌上也摆着餐具，但你看着清子摆桌时，会注意到她只摆了一人份。而当她经过你身边时，你会闻到一股淡淡的肥皂香。她是不是匆匆洗了个澡，想让自己看起来更得体些？嗯……她也没有把食物摆出来。不知道她到底在打什么主意。 清子把托盘放在桌上，调皮地晃了晃那对大狐耳，然后鞠了一躬。“这样你满意了吗？” 是的，到目前为止这一切都令人愉悦。这算是个惊喜，而你也很乐意配合她心里那点小游戏。 你没有得到回应，但清子看起来得意极了。出乎所有预料，她在桌边坐下，然后仰面躺了下来。她的头发和尾巴都在身下铺散开来，她就这么舒舒服服地躺好了， [kiyoko.pregStage 3|尽管那装满幼崽的子宫的重量直接压在身上，这只狐妖却似乎丝毫不觉得难受。 |她向你露出了鼓励的微笑。 ] “请你来帮忙把桌布拿开吧？” 桌布？哦，她指的应该是围裙；你大概能猜到接下来会发生什么，而且结果肯定很不错。即便清子现在是这个姿势，要绕过去解开围裙的带子，然后利落地把它从她身上扯下来，再叠好放在桌边，也并不是什么难事。 “现在，请把托盘上的那卷卷轴递给我好吗？” 这只狐妖摆出最无辜的表情，仿佛在说谁，我吗？ [pc.ra lupine catfolk|“哦，我只是得确保你掉的毛不会堵住排水口。真堵了可就麻烦了。” 她以为你会信这套？ “哦，你邋遢得可怕，[pc.name]。这我们就不否认了吧；不过我也不会指望你能达到我打理仪容的标准。这也正是你可爱的地方之一。” |“哦，没什么。我得确保你的安全；总不能让你泡太久，热晕过去。泡个热水澡放松一下是不错，但你也得考虑安全。朋友不会让朋友独自洗澡。” ] [pc.isDK|你也回以同样的狡黠笑容。有没有人告诉过她，她满嘴都是鬼话？|你也回以微笑，然后摇了摇头。哦，得了吧——她该知道别在你面前说这么多废话。 ]她骗不了任何人，她自己也很清楚。 “当然。我本来也没想骗你。不过……”清子以一种极像狐狸的姿态倚在桌上，朝你眨了眨睫毛。“……如果有一只可爱又爱撒娇的狐狸要和你一起泡澡，你会觉得很受冒犯吗？” 不，大概不会。否则你也不会提起这件事，对吧？ 清子眉开眼笑，耳朵向前竖起，有活力地抖动着。“那就请你先去一步。我得先收拾得体面些，过一会儿就来。” 体面。哈。你站起身，离开房间，沿着来路走出小屋，走进温暖的阳光里时不禁眯起眼睛。沿小路走一小段就到了温泉，你不慌不忙地脱掉衣物，把东西整齐堆在一旁，先从温泉里打些水把自己仔细擦洗一遍，然后才踏入水中。也许并不完美，但至少现在你觉得自己足够干净，可以负责任地和别人共浴，而不会把水弄脏。 天啊，这简直是神仙般的享受。水面下轻柔的水流以最美妙的方式摩挲着你的 [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]，你几乎能感觉到旅途中的酸痛与疲惫土崩瓦解，被水流带走。水面升起的蒸汽让你的鼻腔和肺里充满湿润的热气，呼吸也因此顺畅了许多。 啊，这才叫生活。你慢慢把身体浸到下巴，闭上眼睛享受这份至高的愉悦。似乎没过多久，草丛的轻响就吸引了你的注意，接着是清子走近的轻盈脚步声。你抬头看去，只见她除了一条毛巾几乎什么都没穿，皮肤和毛发上闪着水光。清子淡淡一笑，走到水边，任由毛巾飘落在地， [kiyoko.pregStage 0 1 3|懒洋洋地扭着腰走到水边，装模作样地用脚尖点着水面。 “哎呀，我觉得今天比平时热了一点。” 热？你觉得刚刚好啊。她直接进来就是了。 “水温更高我不意外，你觉得刚刚好我也不意外。毕竟，你就在里面，不是吗？” 哎呀。这话真是又好色又下流。或者说，如果周围还有别人在意的话，确实如此……嗯，她为什么不进来，把水烧开呢？ 清子咯咯笑着，露出得意的神情，随后滑入水中；她入水时水面上只泛起最细微的涟漪，然后便舒舒服服地安顿下来。 |露出她哺育你那份……嗯，能量时似乎总会带着的柔和母性光芒。孕肚反而是她最不起眼的资本——清子的头发和毛发湿漉漉地贴在身上时，这只狐妖愈发充满母性的曲线全都展现在你眼前，任你欣赏。 哈，简直就像她天生就是为此而造的。玩笑归玩笑，在温暖的阳光下，清子的头发和毛发确实显得格外光亮润泽——她自己也知道，手指穿过两者，好把它们展示得更清楚。她全部的 [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] 条尾巴在身后飘动，清子优雅地踏入水中，滑入水面之下时只留下一丝最细微的涟漪。无论从哪个意义上说，都真是一位十足的狐妖准妈妈。 |把她那壮观的孕体裸露出来任人观赏。她轻轻呼了口气，摇摇摆摆地走进水里，把身子沉到水面之下，看向你时脸上绽开幸福的笑容。 你也反过来注视着她，看着水波如何轻拍在她饱满沉重的乳房之间的乳沟上，看着她的头发和毛发湿润后如何贴合她身体的轮廓。你们对视了几分钟，然后清子笑起来，把头发从脸前拨开。 “嘿嘿嘿，你一直这么盯着看，我会不好意思的……” 那就更该盯着看了；她慌乱的时候可爱极了。 ] “这真是奢侈得令人愉悦，不是吗？” 是的，这是你有幸体验过的比较好的事情之一。 “在我来的地方，沐浴这件事有更多的礼节和规矩——几乎本身就是一种仪式——但此时此刻，这里只有我们两个。说实话，独自在这里待了这么久之后，实在很难记住所有规矩。我们就专心享受吧，好吗？你看起来很累。” 这话你完全赞同。你闭上眼睛，尽力放松，把烦恼从脑中赶走，哪怕只有一小会儿。在温暖抚过你的 [pc.skin] 和轻柔的流水声的帮助下，你竟然真的能感觉到自己的思绪逐渐放空、平静、静止下来——直到有什么东西搔到了你的脚。 嗯？你睁开一只眼，但似乎没什么异常；清子坐在你对面，头向后仰，肩膀靠在温泉边缘。不，又来了，乳白色的水面下一道一闪而过的影子——她在用尾巴逗你，想激你一下。 好一只调皮的狐狸……不过她是个调皮又爱玩的狐狸。如果你有兴致的话，也许可以加入她的游戏……
rows.raw: " It's been a long day out in the waking world. Even though you're asleep, you can still feel aches and twinges in your muscles from the exertions of the day, ghosts of the physical translated into the spiritual. Perhaps, then, a soak in the hot springs out on the hillside would be in order; while you wouldn't really be having a rejuvenating bath, surely some warming of the soul is in order. Who knows, perhaps some of it might even carry over to your physical form? "Ha!" Kiyoko gives you a sly grin. "You don't mind if I join you, then?" Oh? Any particular reason why? The kitsune puts on her most innocent face, as if to say, who, me? [pc.ra lupine catfolk|"Oh, I just have to make sure that your shed fur doesn't clog up the drain. Lots of trouble if that happens." And she thinks that you're going to do that? "Oh, you're terribly scruffy, [pc.name]. Let's not try and deny that; I wouldn't expect you to stick to my standards of grooming, though. It's part of what makes you so adorable." |"Oh, not much. I should make sure that you're safe and all; wouldn't want you staying in too long and passing out from the heat. Relaxing with a hot bath might be nice, but you've got to consider your safety as well. Friends don't let friends bathe alone." ] [pc.isDK|You return Kiyoko's sly grin with one of your own. Has anyone told her that she's utterly full of bullshit?|You return Kiyoko's grin with one of your own and shake your head. Oh, come on — she knows better than to blow so much hot air in your face. ]She's not fooling anyone, and she knows that full well. "Of course. I wasn't trying to fool you, after all. But..." Kiyoko leans on the table in a very vulpine fashion and flutters her eyelashes at you. "... Would you be very affronted by the idea of an adorable, cuddly fox sharing your bath?" No, probably not. Otherwise, you wouldn't have brought it up, would you? Kiyoko beams, her ears pointed forward and wiggling energetically. "Then please, do go ahead first. I need to make myself presentable and will join you in a short while." Presentable. Hah. Standing, you leave the room and retrace your steps out of the cabin, blinking as you emerge into the warm sunshine. It's a short walk along the path to the hot springs, where you take your time disrobing and stacking your stuff out of the way before drawing a little water from the springs and scrubbing yourself off thoroughly before stepping in. It's not perfect, perhaps, but at least now you feel clean enough to share the bath with others responsibly without getting it all grimy. Gods, this is practically divine. The gentle currents under the water's calm surface rub at your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun] in the most wonderful way, and you can practically feel the pains and aches of travel crumble away to be carried off by the water's flow. The steam that rises from the water's surface fills your nose and lungs with moist heat, and you breathe much easier for it. Ah, this is the life. Slowly, you submerge yourself all the way to your chin, and close your eyes to savour this sublime delight. It doesn't seem like very long before the soft rustle of grass draws your attention, followed by light footsteps as Kiyoko draws close. As you look up, you see her dressed in little but a towel, her skin and fur glistening with a sheen of water. Smiling faintly, Kiyoko approaches the water's edge, and the kitsune lets the towel flutter to the ground, [kiyoko.pregStage 0 1 3|lazily sashaying over to the water's edge where she makes a show of toeing the surface. "Oh my, I do believe it's a little warmer than usual." Warmer? It feels perfectly fine to you. She should just come on in. "I'm not surprised it's warmer, nor that it feels perfectly fine to you. After all, you're in it, aren't you?" Oh my. How salacious and scandalous. Or it would be, if there was anyone else around who cared... well, why shouldn't she get in and set the water to boiling? Kiyoko giggles and smirks, then slips into the water, her entry sending but the barest of ripples across the surface as she makes herself comfortable. |uncovering the soft, maternal glow that she always seems to gain when nurturing your ah, energy within her. The baby bump is the least of her assets — with Kiyoko's hair and fur wet and clinging to her body, all of the kitsune's increasingly motherly curves are laid out for your enjoyment. Hah, it's almost as if she was made for this. Half-joking aside, Kiyoko's hair and fur do look quite glossy and bright like this under the warm sunlight — and she knows it, running fingers through both to show them off better. All [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] of her tails flowing behind her, Kiyoko gracefully steps into the water, leaving the barest of ripples in her wake as she slides beneath the surface. Truly a foxy mama-to-be in every sense. |laying bare her gloriously pregnant body for all to see. With a small exhalation of effort, she waddles in and lowers herself beneath the water's surface, a beatific smile spreading on her face as she regards you. In turn, you regard her, observing the way the water laps at the cleavage of her ripe, heavy breasts, the way her hair and fur cling to the contours of her body when wet. The two of you stare at each other for a few more minutes, then Kiyoko laughs and smooths her hair away from her face. "Ehehe, I'll get embarrassed if you keep on staring..." All the more reason you should stare; she's adorable when flustered. ] "How delightfully decadent this is, isn't it?" It's one of the better things you've had the pleasure of experiencing, yes. "There's a lot more etiquette and decorum to this whole bathing thing where I come from — it's practically a ritual in and of itself — but here and now, it's just the two of us. Frankly, it's hard to remember everything after having been alone in here for so long. Let's focus on enjoying ourselves, all right? You look tired." You can get behind that. Closing your eyes, you do your best to relax and put your worries out of your mind, if only for a little while. Aided by the warmth caressing at your [pc.skin] and gentle trickle of running water, you can actually feel your mind emptying, calming and drawing still — up to the moment where something tickles against your foot. Huh? You open an eye, but nothing seems to be out of the ordinary; Kiyoko is sitting across you, head tilted back and shoulders reclining on the spring's edge. No, there it is again, a dart of a shadow under the milky water — she's teasing you with her tails, trying to get a rise out of you. What a naughty fox... but she's a naughty, playful fox. Maybe you could join in her game, if you felt like it..."

rows.original: Have a soak in the hot springs out on the hill.
rows.translation: 去山坡上的温泉里泡一泡。
rows.raw: "Have a soak in the hot springs out on the hill."

rows.original: Smiling warmly, you stand from your seat and walk over to Kiyoko. She looks up at you questioningly and starts to rise, but you put a firm hand between her ears and tousle her amber hair vigorously. That stops Kiyoko in her tracks as the kitsune instantly softens up under your touch, her large, pointed ears turning to either side of her head, as if trying to get away from you. Let them try all they want. Nothing's getting away from the sheer determination of your petting, not even something as slippery and tricksy as a kitsune! "Hey!" Kiyoko cries out as you chase down her perky ears with your fingers, spreading out your palm wide so there's nowhere for them to escape to. "You've got to give a girl some warning before—" You pet harder, finally pinning down one of Kiyoko's elusive ears between thumb and forefinger. You hear her take a sharp breath, stiffening from head to toe as a jolt runs down her spine, then try to stifle a murmured purr of pleasure. Now, no need to go all the way at once; it's perfectly fine to stop and savour the moment. You have time, after all. With Kiyoko's right ear firmly in your grasp, you take your time rubbing the outside with its glossy amber fur, reveling in the warm softness. At the same time, your thumb commences exploring the fine, sensitive hairs of Kiyoko's inner ear, teasing the soft tufts that sprout from within. "There! Right there! No, higher! Faster!" faced with a full-on assault on her dignity, Kiyoko's trying to remain in control of the situation, but the facade of dominance isn't fooling anyone. She's largely putty in your hands now, leaning forward on the low table with her head and arms on its surface while thrusting her ass out behind her, all [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] of her tails sweeping at the floor. The poor kitsune's other ear is twitching and swivelling like crazy now, so you grab hold of it too; with Kiyoko subdued like this, it's a simple matter to apply the same treatment to her other foxy ear. It's too much for her to bear. What's left of Kiyoko's politeness and propriety breaks down as she pushes her head aggressively against your hands in a clearly demanding gesture, a wordless bark escaping her lips. Not that you needed words to catch her meaning — you move your fingers up and down, back and forth across the foxy mama's forward-pointing ears. Since her ears are unable to twitch and wiggle as they usually do, the rest of Kiyoko is more than happy to pick up the slack, shivering uncontrollably with pent-up energy. Her fluffy tails twitch and curl with a life of their own, her eyes go half-lidded, and as always, she demands more from you by pushing and nuzzling aggressively against your hands. You're more than happy to oblige — after all, it was you who wanted to pet her, right? After a while, you leave one hand at Kiyoko's ears, and set the other to attending to her amber hair. It glides effortlessly through your fingers, flowing like an orange-yellow waterfall and practically impossible to get a good grasp on. "Who's the most beautiful creature of all, hmm?" the kitsune murmurs when she manages to get her thoughts together for a few moments. "Who's the prettiest, the slinkiest, the most slender?" [pc.isDK|You roll your eyes, but humor her anyway. ]She is! Kiyoko practically preens at the praise and sighs happily. Her breath comes short, fast and hard as you pick up the pace of your petting, turning her carefully groomed and styled hair and fur into an utterly and incorrigibly disheveled wreck. "You know, apparently I take very much after my grandmother," Kiyoko murmurs as you continue to stroke her all over. "I never knew her, but I heard she took good care of herself and was exceedingly beautiful, even by kitsune standards. "Isn't that amazing? Wonder if I can be like her one day..." [kiyoko.numKits 16|With how well her body's developed, you can say with certainty that she's already there. Kiyoko idly bats you with one of her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] tails. "Flatterer." ] You slow down a little now, planting the heel of your palm on her forehead and moving your hand in a back-and-forth motion; Kiyoko bobs her head in time with your movements, completely enthralled by the sheer delight of being petted. Her eyes are fully closed now, her mouth forming a small %"o" and opening slightly as she mumbles and murmurs. So it proceeds, your fingers a blur, her face plastered with an expression of supreme satisfaction, until your wrist and fingers get tired and you have to stop despite the kitsune's urgings for more. You finish up with a little shake of your fingers to ruffle the fringes of her hair, then withdraw. "That was fun," Kiyoko says with a satisfied sigh, pushing herself off the table, standing, and smoothing out her clothes back into some semblance of order. "One day I'll pet you, too — it'll be repayment for this!" [pc.ra lupine|You'll be looking forward to it, then. "Are you sure?" Kiyoko grins nastily, then holds out a hand to waggle her fingers in your face. "You may have bitten off more than you can chew with those words. I'll make you squirm and squeal, little doggy, squirm and squeal until you're begging for mercy." Hah. You shall see, won't you? You shall see. |You're not entirely sure that petting would work on you as well as it does on her, but she's welcome to try. Kiyoko gives you a big, confident smile. "Everyone has a weakness. Finding and exploiting it is the fun part, and —" she waggles her fingers and makes grabby hands at you — "I intend to have a lot of fun." Challenge accepted, then. She'll never break you! Almost like an animal, the kitsune shakes herself from head to toe, sending fine droplets of water spraying all over the place, then turns to you with a smile and bows [kiyoko.pregStage 3|as best as her kit-heavy tummy will allow her to ]. rows.original: You raise a hand and waggle it about. Look, normally you'd play with her, but here and now you're a little too drained for that. Perhaps you could just lie back for a bit and enjoy the water together? "Aww, boo. I wanted to play..." While you know time doesn't flow the same way in the Astral Plane that it does on the outside world, by your reckoning she's around two hundred years old. Yet she's still playing so cheerily... "Got to stay young at heart, [pc.name]. It's how I look so pretty and adorable even after so long. So... you really don't want to play?" Not today. Like you said, you're too tired. "Then you'll play with me next time, right?" Maybe? A pout. "I'll be taking that as a yes, then."
rows.translation: 你举起手来，轻轻摇晃着它。看，平时你肯定会和她一起玩耍的，但此刻你实在太累了，实在没有精力去做这些了。或许，你只需要躺下来休息一会儿，然后一起享受这份宁静与清凉吧？ 哎呀，真糟糕。我本来想玩的呢…… 虽然你知道，在星界中时间的流逝方式与外界不同，但按照你的计算，她应该已经有两百岁了。然而，她依然玩得那么开心…… 必须保持一颗年轻的心， [pc.name]这就是为什么即使过了这么长时间，我依然看起来这么漂亮、这么可爱。所以……你真的不想试试看吗？ 今天不行。就像你说的，你太累了。 那下次你就陪我一起玩吧，对吧？ 也许吧？ 撅着嘴。那我就把你的回答理解为‘同意’了。

rows.original: Wading over to Kiyoko, you wrap the foxy kitsune in big hug, arms spread wide and grinning like a madman. The two of you collapse into the steaming water with a splash; Kiyoko squeals in delight as she snuggles into your embrace, her many tails coiling about your legs and feet. Even while wet, they're really ticklish and pleasant to the touch, not unlike a paintbrush, only on a much, much larger scale. "Mm..." Kiyoko purrs as she nuzzles your cheek and gives you an affectionate lick. "This feels really good." You're glad to help. While you don't feel like getting up to any serious hanky-panky today, there's no reason that you can't just cuddle for a bit and bask in each other's presence. "Aww, boo." Kiyoko pouts. "This isn't enough for me... but I'll be magnanimous and cut you some slack, okay? Next time, though, I'm expecting you to play doubly hard!" All right, all right. Slowly, you guide the both of you to the edge of the spring, where Kiyoko cozies up to your side and presses her warm, fuzzy body against yours with a satisfied sigh. [rand|"You know, I always get so sleepy when I linger in the bath for any length of time. Usually, I've to struggle to keep myself awake, but it's so much better having someone around... that way I can doze off." You give Kiyoko's wrist a reassuring squeeze, and let her know that she's more than welcome to take a nap if she wants to. You'll be around to make sure that she doesn't drown or something. "Guess I can rest easy now, can't I?" |"Heehee, I feel so warm and good all over. Not just on the outside, but on the inside, too. Especially the inside, come to think of it." Smiling, you run your fingers along the kitsune's hips until you reach her tummy, and slide your hand along the [kiyoko.pregStage 1|growing curve of her pregnancy. It's so thoughtful of her to keep her oven nice and toasty so your baby batter can cook quickly inside her, isn't it? With all the care and attention she's putting into her pregnancy, you're expecting her to be as big as a house by the end of it all. "Isn't that the truth. I know I'm getting bigger than my own mother used to get, although whether this is a good or a bad thing, I'm not entirely sure..." It's a good thing. Definitely a good thing. "I'm inclined to agree. This is so satisfying." |soft, slender tightness of her midriff. Does this mean she's firing up her oven in preparation for another bun? "Oh? Did you want to put one in there? I was under the impression that you didn't want to play today." No, but if she wants to do it next time... Kiyoko's ears fold forward as she sticks her tongue out at you. "You know full well I always love getting frisky! I'm always willing to play lots; it's you who's the stick in the mud! You know, some days I'm tempted to just play whether you like it or not..." Ah, if only you were possessed of her boundless energy. But since you don't, you have to recuperate. Like this. A sly smile. "I know! I'm waiting very patiently, so that means I'm being a good fox. And good foxes need to be repaid... preferably with plenty of playtime." ] |Did she use to do a lot of this while at home? "Yes. Like I said, there was... there was a whole culture about it. Rules. Etiquette. Formalities. When so many people share a communal place like a bathhouse, rules inevitably are drawn up to ensure that people know what to do, who to defer to and what to avoid." That makes sense. It takes just one person fouling up the bathhouse to make it unusable for everyone. "Here and now, though, it's just the two of us." Kiyoko turns up her lips in a sly smirk. "So there's no need to hold back... we can fool around as much as we'd like. The only etiquette here is what we make on our own, what we agree on, isn't it?" As she says that, one of her tails slithers across your thigh, its tip lightly tickling your [pc.hasCock|[pc.cock]|[pc.vag]]. You feel a mild heat blossom in your chest that has nothing to do with the water about you, and draw Kiyoko a little closer, a little tighter. The kitsune is more than happy to follow, wiggling and pressing her body against yours with heated fervor. ] Ah... steeped in a hot spring with a fluffy girl at your side. This is the life. After a little while longer, though, it becomes apparent that you ought to be leaving — all good things must come to an end, as the saying goes. Reluctantly, you shrug your sleepy muscles into action and drag yourself out of the water, giving Kiyoko a gentle pat between her large, furry ears and encouraging her to follow.
rows.translation: 你走到清子身边，张开双臂，像个疯子一样大笑着，将这只狡猾的狐妖紧紧抱在怀里。你们俩一起扑通一声掉进了冒着热气的水中；清子高兴地尖叫着，紧紧依偎在你的怀里，她那许多条尾巴缠绕在你的腿和脚上。虽然浑身湿透了，但这些尾巴摸起来却非常痒痒的，手感非常舒适，就像画笔一样，只不过规模要大得多罢了。 嗯……清子轻轻蹭着你的脸颊，还亲热地舔了你一下，发出满足的呼噜声。这种感觉真是太棒了。 你很乐意提供帮助。虽然今天你并不想做些什么特别复杂的事情，但你们完全可以一起依偎在一起，享受彼此的陪伴，这并没有什么不妥。 哎呀，宝贝。清子撅起了嘴。这对我来说还不够……但我就大发慈悲，不再为难你了，好吗？不过下次，我可要求你更加努力地表现哦！ 好吧，好吧。慢慢地，你带着你们俩走到泉水的边缘，这时清子会依偎到你的身边，满足地叹了口气，然后将她温暖柔软的身体贴在你的身上。 [rand|你知道吗，每次在浴缸里泡太久，我就会变得特别困。通常我得费很大劲才能保持清醒，但如果有人在旁边的话……我就能够小睡一会儿了。 你轻轻握了握清子的手腕，让她知道如果她想小睡一会儿的话，完全没问题。你会在旁边守着，确保她不会发生什么意外。 我想我现在可以放心了，对吧？ |嘿嘿，我整个人都觉得暖暖的，非常舒服。不只是外表，内心也是这样。尤其是仔细想想，应该是里面吧。 你微笑着，用手指轻轻滑过那只狐妖的臀部，然后继续向下，直到抵达她的腹部。 [kiyoko.pregStage 1|她怀孕后身体逐渐变化的过程，真是令人感慨。她竟然还特意把烤箱保持在一个温暖的状态，这样你的宝宝在肚子里就能更快地发育，真是太贴心了，不是吗？鉴于她对怀孕这件事投入了如此多的关心和精力，估计等到怀孕结束时，她的身体会变得像房子一样庞大吧。 难道不是这样吗？我知道我现在的体型已经超过了我母亲当年的体型，不过这到底是好事还是坏事，我其实也不太确定…… 这是件好事。绝对是件好事。 我倾向于同意。这确实太令人满意了。 |她腹部那柔软而紧致的曲线……这是否意味着她正在为制作另一个面包而准备“烤炉”呢？ 哦？你是想放那个进去吗？我原本以为你今天不想玩呢。 不，但如果她下次还想这么做的话…… 清子的耳朵向前耷拉下来，同时还吐了吐舌头对着你。你明明知道，我就喜欢闹着玩、开心地玩耍！我一直都很乐意参与各种游戏活动，真正固执不肯改变主意的人其实是你啊！有时候，我真的想不管你愿不愿意，就继续玩下去…… 啊，要是你也能拥有她那种无穷的精力该多好。但既然你没有，那就必须好好休息，恢复体力。就像这样。 一个狡黠的微笑。我知道！我正在非常耐心地等待，这说明我是个乖狐狸。而乖狐狸当然是应该得到回报的……最好就是能有多多的玩耍时间。 ] |她在家里的时候也经常做这些事情吗？ 是的。正如我所说，围绕这个主题存在着一种完整的文化体系——规则、礼仪、种种规范。当有那么多人共同使用一个公共场所，比如浴场时，制定规则就成为了必然，这样才能确保大家知道该做什么、该尊重谁、该避免什么。 有道理。只要有一个人把澡堂弄得一团糟，其他人就都无法使用了。 然而，此刻，只有我们两个人在这里。清子狡黠地撇了撇嘴，露出一丝坏笑。所以完全没有必要拘束自己……我们可以随心所欲地玩耍、闹着玩。这里唯一的准则就是我们自己制定的规则，是我们共同同意的那些规则，对吧？ 就在她说话的那一刻，她的一条尾巴滑过你的大腿，它的尾巴尖轻轻触碰着你的皮肤，惹得你一阵痒意。 [pc.hasCock|[pc.cock]|[pc.vag]]你感到胸口有一股轻微的热意涌现，这种感觉与周围的水无关。于是，你将清子拉得更近了一些，抱得更紧了一些。那只狐妖也非常乐意配合，它扭动身体，热情地将自己的身体贴在你的身上。 ] 啊……和一位毛茸茸的女孩一起泡在温泉里，这样的生活真是太惬意了。 不过，过了一会儿后，你就意识到该离开了——正如俗话所说，所有美好的事情终究都会结束。你很不情愿地活动了一下僵硬的肌肉，从水中爬了出来，然后轻轻拍了拍清子的那对大大的、毛茸茸的耳朵，鼓励她跟着自己出来。

rows.translation: 只需紧紧抱着清子，感受她身体的温暖，放松片刻即可。
rows.raw: "Just hold Kiyoko and relax for a bit with the warmth of her body."

rows.original: Yes, yes. You're feeling a little naughty yourself, a little frisky, complete with an itch which needs to be scratched. If she wants to play, you're more than welcome to oblige her. Feeling around in the cloudy spring water, you snake out a foot and gently rub the tip of one of the many tails with your toes. Kiyoko perks up, looking a little shocked, then quickly melts into a big smile when she realizes what you're doing. Good, good. She's letting her guard down, growing drowsy even as you give her the rough equivalent of a tail footjob... Okay, now! Kiyoko squeals as you lunge forward through the water, a huge wave drenching her head and shoulders as you embrace the kitsune in a big hug. [kiyoko.pregStage 3|Her huge pregnant belly threatens to get in the way, but you twist your body and approach from a little off to the side, getting a good grip on her. Of course, poor Kiyoko is weighed down by her belly somewhat, giving you the advantage, but you still feel very satisfied at having caught yourself a pretty little fox. ]Without waiting another moment, you press your lips to hers, taking a long, sweet moment to exult in the delicious taste of perky, playful kitsune. Kiyoko looks shocked for a second or two, then gleefully returns the kiss with all the strength she can muster. Oh, she wants to turn it into a competition, does she? rows.translation: [rand|如今你对精液会给清子的孕期带来何种影响已不陌生，当她的子宫再次以残暴的效率开始运作时，你拍了拍她那骇人鼓起的肚子。那只狐妖的腹中传出轻柔的搏动与咕噜声，你的精液正一点点转化为小狐崽，无疑是在为她腹中怀着的孩子做最后的收尾。 清子的肚子并没有变得那么大多少——真的只是一点点——但那想必就是这次怀孕剩下的部分了。那只狐妖原本恍惚如梦的神情，很快变成了突如其来的震惊，她抱住自己肿胀的肚子，轻声呻吟起来。 “糟糕。” |在等待清子的子宫再次开始运作时，一丝疑虑悄悄爬上你的心头：她本就已经如此庞大，万一—— ——不，不会的。她的身体知道自己在做什么，即使她本人有时并不清楚，它也不会承担超出自己承受能力的东西。 对吧？ 仿佛是为了回应你的担忧，你那位狐狸荡妇妻子的肚子颤动、搏动起来，迫不及待地要把你的生命力转化为更多的小狐崽。而清子本人此刻已经完全魂不守舍，血管里奔涌的荷尔蒙把她彻底搅昏了；连她的耳朵和尾巴都软塌塌地垂着，连抽动一下的力气都攒不出来。她所有的精力都集中在自己腹部那骇人肿胀、鼓胀的圆顶上，那东西此刻已经占据了她身体的相当一部分。 她已经怀孕到了极点，而现在还要更进一步——在你眼前，这最后一次由精华引发的生长冲刺让已怀孕到无可复加的清子又胀大了一圈，为你们共同孕育的小狐崽做完最后的细节，然后就要把这个可怜的、哇哇大哭的小东西送进这个世界。你这位狐妖荡妇妻子感到越来越拥挤的子宫向外撑开，不停呻吟、呜咽，抚摸、揉弄着自己泛红的肚子。小狐崽越滑越低，越来越执拗地顶着母亲变软的子宫颈，想要出生—— ——而当液体从你那位狐狸妻子的阴道中涌出、与她丰满乳房里喷出的乳汁混在一起时，这件事立刻发生了。清子那副恍惚如梦的神情迅速被初生的惊恐取代，她双手抱住自己巨大的孕肚，因为一次强烈的宫缩而紧紧收缩。 “我……我……” ]
rows.raw: " [rand|No stranger by now to the effect your seed has on Kiyoko's pregnancies, you give her luridly bulging belly a pat as her womb starts up once more with brutal efficiency. Soft pulsing and grumbling emanates from the kitsune's baby bag as bit by bit, your seed is converted into baby fox, no doubt putting the finishing touches on the child growing in her. Kiyoko's belly doesn't get that much bigger — just a bit, really — but that must have been all that was left in the pregnancy. The kitsune's expression of addled dreaminess soon changes to one of sudden shock as she clutches her swollen belly and groans softly. "Uh-oh." |A slight flicker of doubt creeps into your mind as you wait for Kiyoko's womb to start up again: she's already so massive, what if — — Nah, won't happen. Her body knows what it's doing, even if she sometimes doesn't, and it won't take on more than it can handle. Right? As if to answer your concerns, your foxy slut-wife's baby bag trembles and pulses, more than eager to get down to the business of turning your life-force into more fox kit. Kiyoko herself is completely out of it at this point, hopelessly addled by the hormone slurry that's coursing through her veins; even her ears and tails have gone limp and slack, unable to work up the strength to even twitch. All her energies are focused on the monstrously swollen and distended dome her midriff's become, now taking up a notable proportion of her body. Massively gravid, and now becoming even more so — before your eyes, this last essence-induced growth spurt swells a hopelessly pregnant Kiyoko even more, putting the final details on the kit you've made together before sending out the poor squalling thing into the world. Your kitsune slut-wife moans and mewls as she feels her increasingly cramped womb stretch outwards, petting and caressing away at her rosy belly. Slipping ever lower, the kit presses ever more insistently against their mother's softening cervix, wanting to be born — — Which happens without delay when fluid comes pouring out of your foxy wife's cunt to mix with the milk gushing from her fat breasts. Kiyoko's expression of addled dreaminess is quickly replaced by one of dawning alarm, her hands clutching her enormous pregnant belly as it squeezes down hard in a powerful contraction. "I... I..." ]"

rows.original: As Kiyoko continues cradling your [var0|son|daughter], the little fox kit wiggles in her grasp and snuffles at her breast, giving the milk-filled mounds a nip and nuzzle. Instinctively, the kitsune raises the little one to her nipple, and sighs happily as the fox kit latches on and begins to nurse. After a few moments, it readily becomes apparent that there's more going on here than the simple nursing of a newborn. Before your eyes, the newborn fox kit begins to grow rapidly, personality and nutrition alike flowing from Kiyoko's breast into your [var0|son|daughter]. In the blink of an eye, Kiyoko is no longer cradling her newest child, but instead is supporting [var0|him|her] on her lap as both of her breasts are drained in quick, hungry succession. At the same time, her leftover pregnant belly slowly shrinks back into nothingness, contracting in steady pulses until Kiyoko's midriff is flat and trim once more. When it's all over and your [var0|son|daughter] pops free, [var0|he|she] looks to be a young child of about six to seven years old — not quite the dramatic growth to maturity that some Wraith-touched races of beastkin go through, but enough for Kiyoko to shake her head in wonder at the whole scene. "I swear, no matter how long I live here, I'll never understand how the Astral Plane works, how it changes even the most mundane of things." You look at the two-tailed kitsune child that your [var0|son|daughter] now is, then back at Kiyoko, who gives you a small smile and shrug before unsteadily easing your [var0|son|daughter] off her lap and pushing herself to her feet. Should she be standing so soon after the birth? "I-I'll be fine. Although I'm sorry, [pc.name]. While I do look forward to your visits, I do think that I won't be feeling up to very much today, for obvious reasons." Her eyes wander down to your child by her side, and the little two-tailed kitsune [var0|boy|girl] gives you an uncertain smile in return, apparently completely unconcerned with being utterly naked save for a towel. You see. "I've got to get our [var0|son|daughter] settled in, then look to taking a long, long nap, followed by some hot broth. [pc.name], could you please see yourself out? Again, I apologize if it looks like I'm shooing you away -" Oh no, that won't be any problem at all. The Astral Plane will provide her with everything she needs, you take it? "Yes. Once again, [pc.name], thank you for doing this for me. For us." She looks down at her new [var0|son|daughter]. "Perhaps we'll play some during your next visit."
rows.translation: 当清子继续怀抱着你的[var0|儿子|女儿]时，小狐崽在她怀里扭动，用鼻子蹭她的胸膛，又啃又拱那对饱含乳汁的乳峰。那只狐妖本能地把小家伙举到自己的乳头前，当小狐崽含住乳头开始吮吸时，她幸福地叹了口气。 过了一会儿，事情很快就变得明显：这里发生的远不止是给新生儿喂奶那么简单。在你眼前，这只新生的狐崽开始迅速成长，性格与营养一同从清子的乳房流进你的[var0|儿子|女儿]体内。转眼之间，清子怀抱的已不再是她的新生儿，而是让[var0|他|她]坐在自己膝上，双乳被接连不断、急切地吸空。与此同时，她产后残余的肚子也慢慢缩回、消失，在一阵阵有规律的收缩中变平，直到清子的腰腹重新变得平坦纤细。 当一切结束，你的[var0|儿子|女儿]从她身上滑落下来时，[var0|他|她]看起来已经是个六七岁左右的幼童了——还比不上某些受怨灵影响的兽族那种一路长到成年的剧变，但也足以让清子对着这一幕惊叹地摇头。 “我发誓，不管我在这里住多久，我都永远搞不懂星界是怎么运作的，又是怎么把最平凡的东西都改变的。” 你看看你的[var0|儿子|女儿]如今这副长着两条尾巴的狐妖小孩模样，又回头看看清子；她朝你微微一笑、耸了耸肩，然后有些不稳地把你的[var0|儿子|女儿]从膝上放下，撑着站起身来。 刚生完孩子，她这么快就站起来合适吗？ “我、我没事的。不过很抱歉，[pc.name]。我确实很期待你来看我，但我想，出于显而易见的原因，我今天恐怕没多少精力招待你了。”她的目光落到身旁你的孩子身上，那只小小的双尾狐妖[var0|男孩|女孩]朝你不安地笑了笑，显然对自己除了一条毛巾之外全身赤裸毫不在意。 你明白了。 “我得先把我们的[var0|儿子|女儿]安顿好，然后好好睡上一大觉，再喝点热汤。[pc.name]，你能自己出去吗？再次抱歉，如果你觉得我是在赶你走——” 哦不，那完全不成问题。星界会为她提供她所需的一切，你觉得呢？ “是的。再一次，[pc.name]，谢谢你为我做这些。为我们。”她低头看着自己新生的[var0|儿子|女儿]。“也许下次你来的时候，我们可以一起玩一会儿。”

rows.original: For a moment, silence falls over the birthing chamber as Kiyoko takes a moment to catch her breath, resting the newborn kit on her slightly smaller belly. Then, on the edge of your hearing, a shuffling noise as the screen door is drawn aside, and - "Mama?" Weakly, Kiyoko rolls her head over to take in the sight of little Kinu peering into the verdant birthing chamber, and her face becomes even paler. "Kinu! You're not —" But it's too late. Kinu's pale blue eyes are as wide as dinner plates as she takes in her mother's panting, naked form, the mess that's the afterbirth, and finally, the little fox kit in Kiyoko's arms. Swallowing hard, the little kitsune focuses furiously on the last, while studiously ignoring the first two. "I-I'm sorry, Mother. I just wanted..." Kiyoko sighs. "Well, you're here now. What did you want?" "I... I wanted to hold the baby. While they're still small. So when I heard that you were indisposed, I snuck in..." Kinu swallows hard again as she looks down at the mess of afterbirth. "Did... did all that come out of your tummy?" "It's what helps the kit grow while they're in my tummy, yes. But now they don't need it anymore." Kiyoko looks unsure for a moment, then beckons Kinu over. "I suppose since I'm teaching you how to care for your siblings, you should learn about this as well. After all, it was how you were born, and you'll have to go through it yourself someday. [pc.name], would you please help clean up?" "I... this looks yucky." "Of course it is," Kiyoko replies, giving you a nod as you move to pick up one of the damp towels and clean up the mess from the birth. "It's also exhausting, painful, and mind-numbing, at least for the first few times it happens. But it's worth it. You don't regret being born, do you?" Kinu says nothing and just looks down at her feet. She stays like that for half a minute or so, then looks up at her mother and sticks out her arms expectantly. Kiyoko considers her, then carefully hands over the newborn kitsune kit, making sure Kinu's grip is secure before letting go completely. The little kit mewls and snuffles about in Kinu's arms, a small, tightly-wrapped bundle of fluff. Kinu practically bounces in place, petting and stroking her newborn sibling all over. "Eeeeee! So cute! I want one of my own!" "Even knowing where they come from and how they come out?" "I can do it!" Kiyoko can't help but laugh weakly at that. "You'll have to be a lot older before you can get started on that, love. That, and babies don't grow up so quickly outside of the astral plane. You'll have to feed and care for a helpless little kit for more than just a few moments, you know. They'll cry, they'll need to be changed, they'll wake you up when you need sleep the most." "I know." Kiyoko smiles and ruffles her eldest daughter's ears. "You need the right temperament to be a den mother, if you want to be like me. Beauty fades, strength weakens, but a well-cultivated temperament and good-natured attitude will last you for the whole of your life." Kinu hugs the newborn close to her for a little while longer, then looks to her mother worriedly as the little kit begins to wail, a tiny, high-pitched screaming ringing in the air. Despite all the cradling and shushing that she's applying to her little sibling, the fox kit's screaming just gets louder. "Mama! Mama! What do I do?" "Improvise, of course. You'll be having to deal with this a lot when you grow up if you want to be like your mama." Kinu pouts. "That's not very useful..." "It's more an art than a science, which is why you're getting started while you're young. Both experience and instruction are important, but the former counts for more than the latter. Now, let me show you how it's done." Kinu looks a little uncertain, but hands back the newborn to her mother. Exhausted but relieved, Kiyoko cradles her child and shushes the little one's wailing with a few gentle earpets, then turns to Kinu. "You need to be a little more gentle. Babies are delicate." Kinu frowns, then looks up at her sibling snuffling at her mother's breast once more. Several moments of silence pass as Kiyoko slowly recovers a little while longer, then Kiyoko gives her daughter a nod. "You should be going." "But..." "If you want additional lessons on child-rearing, dear, I can make some time for that. At the very least, it'll keep your little hands away from the peach grove. But right now, your mother wants some time alone with your new sibling and your [pc.mf|father|mother]." That doesn't quite satisfy Kinu, but at least the little kitsune is wise enough to let it go. She stiffens up, gives Kiyoko a very formal bow, then slips out of the birthing chambers; the last you see of your daughter are her three silvery-white tails vanishing around the corner.
rows.translation: 一时间，产房里安静下来，清子趁机缓了口气，把刚出生的幼崽放在自己稍稍小了一些的肚子上。随后，在你几乎听不见的边缘，传来一阵拉动声——屏风门被拉开了，然后—— “妈妈？” 清子虚弱地转过头，看见小娟正探头往这片翠绿的产房里张望，脸色变得更加苍白。“小娟！你不能——” 但已经太迟了。小娟淡蓝色的眼睛瞪得像盘子一样圆，她看清了母亲喘息着、赤裸着的身体，看清了那一片胎盘残渣，最后又看见了清子怀里的那只小狐崽。那只小狐妖艰难地咽了口口水，拼命把目光集中在最后一样东西上，刻意忽略前两样。 “对、对不起，妈妈。我只是想……” 清子叹了口气。“好吧，你现在已经来了。你想要什么？” “我……我想抱抱宝宝。趁他们还小的时候。所以听说你不舒服时，我就偷偷溜进来了……”小娟再次艰难地咽了口口水，低头看着那堆胎盘残渣。“那些……那些都是从你肚子里出来的吗？” “那是小狐崽在我肚子里时帮助他长大的东西，没错。但现在他们已经不需要它了。”清子犹豫了一下，然后招手让小娟过来。“既然我在教你如何照顾你的弟弟妹妹，你也该了解一下这个。毕竟，你就是这么出生的，总有一天你自己也要经历这些。[pc.name]，你能帮忙清理一下吗？” “我……这个看起来好恶心。” “当然恶心，”清子答道，朝你点了点头，你便去拿起一条湿毛巾，清理分娩留下的狼藉。“而且它还会让人筋疲力尽、痛苦不堪、脑子发木——至少头几次是这样。但这一切都是值得的。你不会后悔自己被生下来吧？” 小娟什么也没说，只是低头看着自己的脚。她就这样站了大约半分钟，然后抬头看着母亲，期待地伸出双臂。清子打量了她一下，然后小心地把那只新生的狐妖幼崽递过去，确认小娟抱稳之后才完全松手。小狐崽在小娟怀里喵喵叫、抽着鼻子，像一个裹得紧紧的小毛团。小娟几乎是在原地跳了起来，把新生的弟弟妹妹上上下下摸了个遍。 “咦——！太可爱了！我也想要一个！” “就算知道了他们是从哪里来、又是怎么出来的？” “我能做到的！” 清子忍不住虚弱地笑了。“要开始做这种事，你还得再长大许多，亲爱的。而且，在星界之外，婴儿可不会长得这么快。你得喂养、照顾一只无助的小狐崽，可不只是短短一会儿，你知道的。他们会哭，需要换尿布，还会在你最需要睡觉的时候把你吵醒。” “我知道。” 清子微笑着揉了揉大女儿的耳朵。“如果你想成为我这样的人，就需要合适的性情才能当一窝之母。美貌会消退，力气会减弱，但修养良好的性情和善良的态度会伴你一生。” 小娟又抱着新生儿依偎了一会儿，然后当小狐崽开始哭号时，她担忧地看向母亲。那细小而尖利的哭声在空气中回响。尽管她不停地摇晃、哄着弟弟妹妹，狐崽的哭叫声却只是越来越响。 “妈妈！妈妈！我该怎么办？” “当然是随机应变。如果你想变得像你妈妈一样，长大后要应付这种情况的时候可多得是。” 小娟撅起嘴。“这根本没什么用……” “这更像是一门艺术，而不是科学，所以我才让你从小开始学。经验和教导都很重要，但前者的分量更重。现在，让我来教你怎么做。” 小娟显得有些犹豫，但还是把新生儿交还给了母亲。清子疲惫却松了口气，抱起孩子，用几下温柔的耳部抚摸哄住了小家伙的哭叫，然后转向小娟。 “你得再温柔一点。婴儿很娇弱。” 小娟皱起眉，然后抬头看着又在母亲胸前拱来拱去的弟弟妹妹。沉默了好一会儿，清子慢慢恢复了一些，随后朝女儿点了点头。“你该走了。” “可是……” “亲爱的，如果你还想多上几堂育儿的课，我可以抽出时间来。至少这样能让你那小手离桃园远一点。但现在，你妈妈想和你的新弟弟妹妹、还有你的[pc.mf|父亲|母亲]单独待一会儿。” 这并没有让小娟完全满意，但至少这只小狐妖够聪明，懂得不再纠缠。她挺直身子，向清子行了一个非常正式的礼，然后溜出了产房；你最后一次看到女儿，是她那三条银白色的尾巴消失在转角。

"You know, Mother would say how she used to get this gloriously relieved feeling every time she made an addition to the family. I never quite understood it before, but I do now."
rows.translation: 你还不至于迟钝到听不出别人在给你台阶下，于是点了点头。好吧，她想让你做什么？ 清子停顿了一下，整理思绪，然后在一波相对——相对——轻微的宫缩袭来时咬着牙开口。“好。厨房里应该有些温水，先给我拿那个来。还有，后面储藏室里那种安神的香，也取一些。[kiyoko.numKits 2|路上要是碰到孩子们，请尽量安抚他们的情绪。他们虽然知道自己很快会多一个弟弟妹妹，但不太清楚那到底意味着什么，所以有时会变得相当……兴奋。 ]” 好的。你很快就回来。 “慢慢来。我哪儿也不去。” 也可以这么说吧。清子端庄得不会尖叫，但毫不夸张地说，这只狐妖确实已经精疲力尽、承受着巨大的压力。不过，既然她不想让你在过程中看到她，而你也愿意用别的方式帮她……最好还是别再多想。你推开屏风门，走进走廊，然后跑了起来。 你花了不少时间才凑齐清子要的那两样东西——它们确实在小屋的两头，你不禁怀疑这只狐妖特意这么要求，是不是因为她知道你会尽可能在外面待久一点。[kiyoko.numKits 4|更麻烦的是，你在走廊里还会撞见自己的几个孩子；他们看着你，什么也不说，但对楼上正在发生的事显然既紧张又兴奋，内心挣扎不已。 ] 等你取来一盆温水和那香时，清子已经生完了；你进门时，她用一个虚弱、疲惫的微笑迎接你，怀里抱着一只裹在毛巾里、喵喵叫的小狐崽。 “来见见你的新[var0|儿子|女儿]，[pc.name]。[kiyoko.numKits 1||她摸起来又软又滑，触手温暖……就像丝绸一样。我就叫她小娟吧。]” 你把水盆和香罐放在她身旁，抱了新生儿一会儿、好一阵疼爱，同时清子用一撮狐火点燃了香。一股锐利却安神的香气飘过阳台，隐约让人联想到柑橘，那只狐妖看起来也因此好受了些。 她没事吧？ “我说过，我完全有能力自己处理这些事，[pc.name]。你这么关心我真的很贴心，但真的没有理由怀疑我的本事。我母亲当年早上生下幼崽，下午就能下地干活了。” 好吧，既然她确定自己没事。你把你的新[var0|儿子|女儿]递还给清子，从架子上拿了一条毛巾，然后用毛巾和温水把地板上最严重的产液和胎盘残渣清理干净。 “你知道吗，母亲总说，每次家里添丁时她都会感到一种无比释然的快乐。以前我一直不太理解，现在明白了。”
rows.raw: " You're not so oblivious as to not know when you're being offered an out, and nod. All right, what does she want you to do? Kiyoko pauses to gather her thoughts for a moment, then speaks through gritted teeth as another set of relatively — relatively — mild contractions hits her. "Right. There should be some warm water in the kitchen. Get that for me, for starters. Also, some of that soothing incense from the storeroom in the back. [kiyoko.numKits 2|And if you run into any of the children while you're on your way, please do your best to soothe their nerves. While they do know that they're going to have another sibling soon, they're not quite sure what's involved and can get quite... excitable. ]" All right. You'll be back soon. "Take your time. I'm not going anywhere." That's one way of putting it. Kiyoko is too dignified to scream, but the kitsune is definitely exhausted and under considerable pressure, to put it mildly. Still, if she doesn't want you to see her during the process, and you're okay with helping her in another way... best not to linger on it. Pushing aside the screen door, you step out into the hallway and break into a run. It takes a little time for you to assemble the two things that Kiyoko asked for — they are on opposite ends of the cabin, and you can't help but wonder if the kitsune specifically asked for them because she knew you'd be out for as long as possible. [kiyoko.numKits 4|It doesn't help that you bump into a few of your children out in the hallways; they look at you, saying nothing, but clearly look torn between tension and excitement at what's going on upstairs. ] By the time you've retrieved both a basin of warm water and the incense, Kiyoko is already done; as you enter, she greets you with a weak, exhausted smile and a mewling fox kit swaddled in a towel. "Come and meet your new [var0|son|daughter], [pc.name].[kiyoko.numKits 1|| She's so soft and smooth, so warm to the touch... just like silk. I'll call her Kinu.]" Setting down the basin of water and jar of incense by her side, you take a moment to hold and fuss over the newborn while Kiyoko lights the incense with a flicker of foxfire. A sharp yet soothing aroma wafts over the balcony, vaguely reminiscent of citrus, and the kitsune looks better for it. She's all right, isn't she? "I told you that I was perfectly capable of handling things on my own, [pc.name]. It's really sweet that you're concerned for me, but there's really no reason to doubt my abilities. My own mother would drop a kit in the morning and be out working the fields in the afternoon." All right, if she's sure she's fine. You hand your new [var0|son|daughter] back to Kiyoko, grab a towel off the rack, then proceed to clean up the worst of the birth fluids and afterbirth from the floor with the towel and warm water. "You know, Mother would say how she used to get this gloriously relieved feeling every time she made an addition to the family. I never quite understood it before, but I do now.""

rows.original: If she's asking you to leave and help in another way, you could take the graceful retreat and avoid the mess.
rows.translation: 如果她其实是希望你离开，然后以另一种方式提供帮助，那你大可以体面地退出，从而避免惹上麻烦。
rows.raw: "If she's asking you to leave and help in another way, you could take the graceful retreat and avoid the mess."

rows.original: You step up to the porch and knock on the cabin door like you always do to announce your presence. However, to your mild surprise, the person who greets you isn't Kiyoko herself, but rather [kiyoko.numKits 1 2|Kinu, your firstborn daughter|one of your children, the little two-tailed kitsune] giving you a respectful bow. "[pc.PapaMama]. Mama's rather preoccupied; she says we'll have another brother or sister soon. She also left a message that if you were to show up, she'd be upstairs on the verdant balcony; no one else is to disturb her." You nod, give the little tyke an affectionate ruffle between the ears, then sprint through the cabin and up the stairs, practically bursting through the door to the balcony before carefully sliding shut the screen door. It doesn't looks like Kiyoko's been here long; the kitsune hasn't even had the opportunity to get her clothes off yet, although you can see the wet stain of her broken waters on her skirts. "How... how fortuitous of you to show up right now, [pc.name]," Kiyoko says through gritted teeth. "It seems that you manage to show up in the nick of time for every birthing. If I were in more of a mood to think, I'd wonder if the two are connected..." Maybe later, when she's not so occupied. Kiyoko winces. "Right, there's not much time left. This should be another textbook birth and I'm no stranger to this, so feel free to go and help the kits make the necessary preparations. I'll be fine here." You have little doubt that Kiyoko's capable of handling popping out a fox kit all by herself, but at the same time there's still value in staying here and making sure that she's not alone in this. Do you want to insist on staying with her?
rows.translation: 你走上游廊，像往常一样敲了敲小屋的门，通报自己的到来。然而让你有些意外的是，来迎接你的并不是清子本人，而是[kiyoko.numKits 1 2|小娟，你的长女|你的一个孩子，那只小小的双尾狐妖]向你恭恭敬敬地行了一礼。 “[pc.PapaMama]。妈妈现在相当忙，她说我们很快会再有一个弟弟或妹妹。她还留了话：如果你来了，她会在楼上那片翠绿的阳台上；其他人都不许去打扰她。” 你点点头，疼爱地揉了揉这个小家伙的两耳之间，然后冲过小屋、跑上楼梯，几乎是一头撞进阳台的门，随后才小心地把屏风门拉上。清子看起来来这里还没多久；那只狐妖甚至还没来得及脱掉衣服，不过你能看到她裙子上羊水破开留下的湿痕。 “你……你来得可真是时候，[pc.name]，”清子咬着牙说。“看来每一次分娩你都能恰好赶上。要是我现在有心思多想，我会怀疑这两件事是不是有什么联系……” 也许等她没那么忙的时候再说吧。 清子皱了下眉。“对，时间不多了。这次应该又是一次教科书式的分娩，我对这种事也不陌生，所以你可以放心去帮孩子们做必要的准备。我在这里没事的。” 你并不怀疑清子有能力独自把一只狐崽生下来，但留在这里、确保她不是独自一人面对这一切，仍然很有价值。你想坚持留下来陪她吗？
