rows.original: Stepping up onto the porch, you rap your knuckles on the cabin door and step back to wait for Kiyoko to greet you like she usually does. However, after a few minutes, it becomes clear that your knock's been left unanswered. Hmm. Maybe she didn't hear you? You knock again and wait some more, only to be faced with the same stony silence. Hmm... now you're getting a little worried, and press your ear against the door. There's definitely something going on inside — you can hear a faint shuffling and scratching from the other side — but either way, it's clear Kiyoko's not going to be answering the door. All right, now that's more than a little worrying. Hopefully, she'll understand if you just enter without her permission. The door is unlocked, of course, and you follow the sound into the back of the cabin, up to the plant-overgrown balcony on the second floor. As you get closer, the shuffling and scratching turns to pained groaning, and it turns out that Kiyoko has collapsed against a wall near the second floor landing, looking distinctly uncomfortable as she clutches her monstrously swollen midriff with both hands. She gazes up at you, all tense and clearly in pain, then turns her eyes to the balcony entryway. "Thank Keros that you're here, [pc.name]. Help me, please." Well, you made her like this, so it'd be rather improper to refuse. Hooking your hands under Kiyoko's arms, you heave the kitsune mother-to-be to her feet and help her through the archway into the balcony, even if the going is a bit unsteady. The soothing aura of all the verdance around you seems to bring some relief to Kiyoko, and she wipes the cold sweat from her brow before directing you to set her down on a nearby futon. "I knew I'd be having the kit soon; little bastard's been kicking me left and right nonstop the last few days. I just didn't expect to be caught unaware, for things to happen so suddenly. Mother always had plenty of warning..." Well, she's not her mother. "Haha... ugh. It started so suddenly and so strongly, that I didn't even get up the stairs in time to be able to make use of my preparations." Kiyoko pauses for a moment and pants, tails instinctively curling about her defensively while she gathers her breath. "Little bastard really wants out, and with no end of energy to make that point." As Kiyoko pauses to catch her breath again, her hands go to her pregnant belly and the air rushes out of her lungs as a contraction hits the kitsune, her entire womb squeezing down on the little fox kit inside her. Noticing you staring, she looks up at you in embarrassment, then growing self-consciousness as a wet stain spread outwards on her skirts. "I fear I don't have that much time left for idle talk, [pc.name]. I'm no stranger to what happens next, so I understand that you probably don't want to watch it play out. Don't worry about me, I can handle this by myself; why don't you instead go and get me the things I prepared down in the kitchen?" Preparations? Kiyoko grimaces as another contraction hits her, more intense than the last. "The cabin will know, damn it!" A pained noise escapes the kitsune's throat, and she fires off a string of expletives in a language you don't understand. What do you do now? Kiyoko appears set on shooing you from the birthing chamber, but if you wanted, you could insist on staying here and seeing her through the ordeal. Is that something you'd like to do?
rows.translation: 你走上游廊，用指节敲了敲小屋的门，然后退后一步，等清子像往常一样来迎接你。然而几分钟过去，你的敲门声显然没有得到回应。 嗯，也许她没听见？你又敲了一次，又等了一会儿，迎来的仍是同样的死寂。嗯……现在你有点担心了，把耳朵贴在门上。里面肯定有什么动静——你能听到另一侧传来轻微的拖擦和刮挠声——但无论如何，清子显然不会来开门了。 好吧，现在这可就不只是有点让人担心了。那希望她不会介意你没经允许就进去。门当然没锁，你顺着声音走进小屋深处，上到二楼那片长满植物的阳台。越靠近，拖擦和刮挠声就越变成了痛苦的呻吟；原来清子瘫倒在二楼楼梯口附近的墙边，双手抱着自己骇人肿胀的腰腹，显得极不舒服。 她抬眼看向你，浑身紧绷、显然很痛，随后目光转向阳台的入口。“感谢凯罗斯，你来了，[pc.name]。请帮帮我。” 嗯，是你让她变成这样的，拒绝也太不像话了。你把双手插到清子腋下，把这位即将临产的狐妖母亲架起来，扶她穿过拱门进入阳台，虽然走得有些不稳。周围郁郁葱葱的草木散发出的安神气息似乎让她舒缓了一些，她擦掉额上的冷汗，让你把她放到旁边的被褥上。 “我知道自己很快就要生了；这个小混蛋这几天一直不停地踢我。只是没想到会被打个措手不及，事情来得这么突然。妈妈当年总是有充足的预兆……” 嗯，她毕竟不是她母亲。 “哈哈……唉。它来得又突然又猛烈，我甚至没来得及爬上楼去用我准备好的东西。”清子停顿片刻，喘着气，尾巴本能地卷起来护住自己，一边缓着呼吸。“这个小混蛋是真想出来，而且有用不完的力气来表明这一点。” 清子再次停下来喘气时，双手抚上自己的孕肚；一次宫缩袭来，她肺里的空气被挤了出去，整个子宫都在向下挤压着里面的小狐崽。注意到你在盯着看，她尴尬地抬头看你，而当一片湿痕在她裙子上洇开时，她越发不自在了。 “恐怕我没多少时间闲谈了，[pc.name]。我对接下来会发生什么并不陌生，所以也明白你大概不想看着它上演。别担心我，我自己能应付；你不如去厨房把我准备好的东西拿来？” 准备的东西？ 又一次宫缩袭来，比上一次更猛烈，清子痛苦地皱起脸。“这小屋会知道的，该死！”一声痛苦的呜咽从她喉间逸出，接着她用你听不懂的语言骂出了一连串脏话。 你现在怎么办？清子似乎执意要把你赶出产房，但如果你想，也可以坚持留在这里陪她熬过这一关。你想这么做吗？

rows.original: Uh-oh? Kiyoko looks at you, both hands cradling her freshly expanded womb — monstrously gravid and bulging by now. "I —" Before the kitsune can get off another word, her waters break. The fluid starts off as a trickle but quickly grows into a gush, pouring out of her pussy and leaving a wet splotch on the ground. The two of you share a pained look, and Kiyoko quickly takes charge of the situation. [kiyoko.numKits 1|"You know what to do," Kiyoko says breathlessly. "We've been through this before." You nod, and prepare to bring Kiyoko upstairs to the balcony that doubles as her birthing room. |"I've prepared the verdant balcony for this," Kiyoko informs you. "Get me there. Do you remember it? Where you found me napping when I first told you I was pregnant?" You nod. "No time in dithering, then. Hurry!" ] [pc.strengthRange 50 |Without wasting another moment, you sling Kiyoko into a princess carry, cradling the naked kitsune in your arms as you hightail it out and up to the second storey of the cabin. With her cradled in your arms, it's very distinct how a good deal of Kiyoko's weight is now in her midsection, a fact that hits particularly home as you climb up the stairs and nudge open the screen door with a foot. |With no time to waste, you let Kiyoko lean on you and guide her out into the hallway and up the stairs. The fact that the both of you are naked... well, it doesn't matter at this point, does it? After what feels like an eternity — although it can't have been more than a handful of minutes — the two of you emerge onto the second storey landing, and you nudge the screen door open with a foot, letting the both of you in. ] As you enter the balcony, Kiyoko says several nasty expletives in her mother tongue, then a powerful contraction knocks the breath out of her lungs all in one go. She gasps, groans and splutters for a second or two, then regains her bearings and gestures to a futon laid out on the ground. "There. Hurry. It's happening really quickly, and I mean really quickly." You wonder. If your seed — well, your energy, to be precise — can actually accelerate Kiyoko's pregnancies, can it speed up the birthing process? That's what might have happened here... but it's probably not the best idea to bring it up now. She might take it the wrong way. Carefully, you set Kiyoko down on her childbed, then ruffle her long hair and fluffy ears. "Look, [pc.name]. I'm pretty sure I'm not going to have any problems with handling this, so you don't need to worry about me. I've made some other preparations beforehand in case the birth caught me unawares — you could go and get those ready, if you'd like." It's clear that Kiyoko here is offering you an out, if you'd rather not stay to watch the birth. Do you want to be here for the whole thing, or not?
rows.translation: 糟糕？ 清子看着你，双手捧着自己刚刚又胀大了一圈的子宫——此刻已经骇人地沉坠、鼓出。“我——” 还没等那只狐妖再说出一个字，她的羊水就破了。液体起初只是一缕细流，但很快化作一股涌流，从她的私处倾泻而出，在地上留下一摊湿痕。你们两人交换了一个痛苦的眼神，清子迅速接管了局面。 [kiyoko.numKits 1|“你知道该怎么做，”清子气喘吁吁地说。“我们经历过这个。” 你点点头，准备把清子带上楼，去那间兼作她产房的阳台。 |“我已经为这件事把翠绿的阳台准备好了，”清子告诉你。“把我带到那里去。你还记得吗？就是我第一次告诉你我怀孕时，你发现我在那儿打盹的地方？” 你点点头。 “那就别磨蹭了。快点！” ] [pc.strengthRange 50 |你一刻也不耽搁，把清子打横抱起，用公主抱的方式搂着这只赤裸的狐妖冲出屋子、奔上二楼。她被抱在你怀里时，你能非常清楚地感到她体重的很大一部分都集中在腰腹，这一点在你爬楼梯、用脚顶开屏风门时格外明显。 |来不及耽搁，你让清子靠在你身上，引她走出走廊、爬上楼梯。你们两人都赤裸着……嗯，到这一步也无所谓了，对吧？感觉像是过了很久——虽然肯定不超过几分钟——你们终于来到二楼的楼梯口，你用脚顶开屏风门，带两人走了进去。 ] 走进阳台时，清子用母语骂了几句难听的话，随后一次强烈的宫缩一口气抽干了她肺里的空气。她喘着气、呻吟着、结结巴巴了一两秒，然后重新稳住神，指了指地上铺好的一床被褥。 “那里。快点。这次来得非常快，我是说真的很快。” 你在想。如果你的精液——准确地说，是你的能量——真的能加速清子的孕期，那它是不是也能加快分娩的过程？这里发生的大概就是这样……但现在提这事恐怕不太合适，她可能会误会。你小心地把清子放到她的产床上，然后揉了揉她长长的头发和毛茸茸的耳朵。 “听着，[pc.name]。我很确定自己处理这件事不会有任何问题，所以你不用担心我。我事先还做了些别的准备，以防分娩突然找上门——如果你愿意，可以去把那些东西备好。” 很明显，清子是在给你一个台阶下，免得你不愿留下观看分娩。你想全程在场，还是不想？
rows.raw: " Uh-oh? Kiyoko looks at you, both hands cradling her freshly expanded womb — monstrously gravid and bulging by now. "I —" Before the kitsune can get off another word, her waters break. The fluid starts off as a trickle but quickly grows into a gush, pouring out of her pussy and leaving a wet splotch on the ground. The two of you share a pained look, and Kiyoko quickly takes charge of the situation. [kiyoko.numKits 1|"You know what to do," Kiyoko says breathlessly. "We've been through this before." You nod, and prepare to bring Kiyoko upstairs to the balcony that doubles as her birthing room. |"I've prepared the verdant balcony for this," Kiyoko informs you. "Get me there. Do you remember it? Where you found me napping when I first told you I was pregnant?" You nod. "No time in dithering, then. Hurry!" ] [pc.strengthRange 50 |Without wasting another moment, you sling Kiyoko into a princess carry, cradling the naked kitsune in your arms as you hightail it out and up to the second storey of the cabin. With her cradled in your arms, it's very distinct how a good deal of Kiyoko's weight is now in her midsection, a fact that hits particularly home as you climb up the stairs and nudge open the screen door with a foot. |With no time to waste, you let Kiyoko lean on you and guide her out into the hallway and up the stairs. The fact that the both of you are naked... well, it doesn't matter at this point, does it? After what feels like an eternity — although it can't have been more than a handful of minutes — the two of you emerge onto the second storey landing, and you nudge the screen door open with a foot, letting the both of you in. ] As you enter the balcony, Kiyoko says several nasty expletives in her mother tongue, then a powerful contraction knocks the breath out of her lungs all in one go. She gasps, groans and splutters for a second or two, then regains her bearings and gestures to a futon laid out on the ground. "There. Hurry. It's happening really quickly, and I mean really quickly." You wonder. If your seed — well, your energy, to be precise — can actually accelerate Kiyoko's pregnancies, can it speed up the birthing process? That's what might have happened here... but it's probably not the best idea to bring it up now. She might take it the wrong way. Carefully, you set Kiyoko down on her childbed, then ruffle her long hair and fluffy ears. "Look, [pc.name]. I'm pretty sure I'm not going to have any problems with handling this, so you don't need to worry about me. I've made some other preparations beforehand in case the birth caught me unawares — you could go and get those ready, if you'd like." It's clear that Kiyoko here is offering you an out, if you'd rather not stay to watch the birth. Do you want to be here for the whole thing, or not?"

rows.original: Stepping up to the door, you knock on it and wait for Kiyoko to arrive. Nothing. After a minute or two, you knock again and settle back — maybe she didn't hear you the first time, or was preoccupied doing something else, or... Still nothing. That's odd. Surely she hasn't escaped the Astral Plane after just one essence transferral, has she? Sure, you're pretty strong, but you didn't think your mojo was that powerful, right? Right? Still, there's only one thing left to do here: reaching out, you try the door's handle and it turns. Unlocked — well, it would make sense for it to be. Who would break into Kiyoko's home when she's trapped all alone in this pocket dimension? Nevertheless, you cautiously make your way down along the corridor, ears strained for any hint of sound — and before too long, a scratching noise makes its way through the cabin's woodwork and to you. It's coming from upstairs, you think, and following your ears, you climb up to the cabin's second level. It feels a little awkward coming up here without permission, but you push aside a couple of shoji screens to find Kiyoko sprawled out on the ground in one of the rooms.
rows.translation: 你走到门前，敲了敲，等着清子来开门。没有动静。过了一两分钟，你又敲了一次，然后退后等着——也许她第一次没听见，或者正忙着别的事，又或者…… 还是没有动静。 这有点奇怪。她总不至于才接受了一次精华转移就逃出星界了吧？当然，你确实很强，但你并不觉得自己的魔力有那么厉害，对吧？ 对吧？ 不过，现在只剩一件事可做了：你伸出手，试着转动门把手，它转动了。没锁——嗯，这也说得通。清子独自被困在这个口袋维度里，谁会闯进她的家呢？ 尽管如此，你还是谨慎地沿着走廊往前走，竖起耳朵捕捉任何一点声响——没过多久，一阵刮擦声穿过小屋的木结构传到你这儿。你觉得声音来自楼上，于是循声爬上小屋的二楼。未经允许就上来让你有点不自在，但你推开几扇障子门，发现清子摊手摊脚地躺在一个房间里。

After a minute or two, you knock again and settle back — maybe she didn't hear you the first time, or was preoccupied doing something else, or... Still nothing. That's odd. Surely she hasn't escaped the Astral Plane after just one essence transferral, has she? Sure, you're pretty strong, but you didn't think your mojo was that powerful, right? Right? Still, there's only one thing left to do here: reaching out, you try the door's handle and it turns. Unlocked — well, it would make sense for it to be. Who would break into Kiyoko's home when she's trapped all alone in this pocket dimension? Nevertheless, you cautiously make your way down along the corridor, ears strained for any hint of sound — and before too long, a scratching noise makes its way through the cabin's woodwork and to you. It's coming from upstairs, you think, and following your ears, you climb up to the cabin's second level. It feels a little awkward coming up here without permission, but you push aside a couple of shoji screens to find Kiyoko sprawled out on the ground in one of the rooms."

rows.original: She's not hurt or harmed, it seems, and judging by the futon she's snuggled in, has made herself very comfortable. Nope, not knocked out, just... sleeping, even if it's a very deep sleep. What strikes you about this particular room, though, is how verdant it is. One of the walls is just a low railing, rendering the room open to the air on one side — perhaps it'd be better called a balcony? Small potted plants, including a variety of herbs and miniature trees, sit in the open; a faint aroma wafts through the air, mingling with the scent of cherry blossoms. What's most important, though, is how the time of day rapidly changes from day to night as you step in through the doorway, sunlight rapidly fading away to be replaced by wan, silvery moonlight — without a moon in the sky at all. Stepping up to Kiyoko, you kneel down beside her and tickle one of the kitsune's large, fluffy ears. She snorts and snuffles, turning on her side; you keep up the stimulation, taking pleasure in petting her perky ears until her steady breathing turns into a small sigh and her eyes flutter open. "Ah... [pc.name]." Yes, it's you. Have you come at a bad time? Kiyoko squeezes her eyes shut and stretches under the duvet, sitting up on the futon and rolling her shoulders with a small sigh of effort. She's wearing silken sleepwear, a much simpler — and skimpier — version of her usual dress, and shakes out the worst of her bed-head as she regards you. "No... I should be up now anyway. I've been rather... um, tired of late, and I thought to get a quick nap in before proceeding with my daily duties. This room isn't exactly a bedroom, it's where I go as and when I need to recuperate. To be honest, I was wondering when you'd show up; there was a matter I was hoping to discuss with you." Oh? What is it? Does it happen to be related to how you finished off your last visit? Kiyoko looks amused for a second or two, then that expression collapses into a sheepish one, rubbing her eyes free of sleep. "It is. Umm..." Now why's she so hesitant? Did everything not work out as she'd foreseen? "No, no, it's not a matter of what didn't happen. It's more a matter of what happened in addition to what I predicted would." Fine, time to stop beating around the bush, then. Just what is the problem? "I think it's better if you saw for yourself." Pushing her covers off, Kiyoko struggles to her feet and pulls her soft sleepwear tight against her body. It's not immediately apparent — you don't see it until you take a second look, but it's there nevertheless. Framed against her delicate form, Kiyoko's tummy is bulging outwards ever so slightly, roughly comparable to a human woman three months along. There's no doubt about it — Kiyoko is going to be a mommy, and by extension, you a [pc.mf|daddy|mommy]. "You see it, don't you?" Yes, you do. Yes, you do. The kitsune looks a little uncertain. "I... I really wasn't expecting this to happen." Not to be an ass, but seriously, what did she imagine would happen? She coaxed you into shooting off a huge load straight into her baby bag; ending up with a little fox kit inside her... well, that's kind of the point, isn't it? It's not as if she's unacquainted with such things as a kitsune, so she knows perfectly well where little fox babies come from. "That is true, but..." Flustered, Kiyoko points at herself with both hands. "This is the Astral Plane! My physicality, was ripped from me — I don't have a body, let alone a womb to be pregnant with! And besides, when we were doing the chi transferral, the sex was just a metaphor for what was happening; you weren't really sticking it into me the same way you would someone on the outside!" Well, if having mind-blowing sex here is only a metaphor for transferring a portion of your essence to her, then growing a little kitsune kit in her tummy is probably a metaphor for something else, too. You'll be damned if you know what, but you can only presume it's rather significant. Taking a deep breath, Kiyoko clenches her fists, squares her shoulders and calms herself. "I... I don't think it's harmful, or at least all the evaluations I've run on myself suggest so. Even so, this isn't normal. I know time doesn't flow in the Astral Plane at the same rate as it does on the outside world, since this is just your second visit after you knocked me up. Even so, it's barely been a week here on the inside, and I'm already beginning to show." The transferral still went off without a hitch at least, right? Kiyoko nods. "I did receive your chi, it's just that I'm nurturing it in a rather different way than I thought I'd be doing, which is making me so tired. It's why I came up here to have a nap in a calming atmosphere and recuperate. "While I don't think that'll be any obstacle towards our goal of me eventually being able to manifest outside of the plane, but it's just rather startling, with me getting so big so fast. Or really, is it perfectly normal for me, since this isn't exactly a physical body I have here? I should really keep notes." There, she's beginning to view this in a more positive light. It can't be so bad, can it? "It's not as if I can't care for a fox kit or two; my mother was a regular participant in the breeding orgies and I got in plenty of practice caring for my many siblings when I was younger. But there's a difference between seeing your mother do it, and doing it yourself, you know?" Yes, indeed. Having said her piece, Kiyoko hesitates for a moment, then sighs and smiles weakly. "You seem to be taking all of this very well." Of course, because it's no cause for concern. Nothing truly untoward has happened yet, right? Returning Kiyoko's smile with one of your own, you close the distance between you two and draw the kitsune into a big hug. Kiyoko practically melts into your embrace, wrapping her arms about you, then makes a happy little noise in the back of her throat as she finally pulls away. "You're right. I should try and feel better about all this — at the very least, having a little kit running around the place should stop me from feeling lonely when you're not around, [pc.name]. Up until recently, I was so upset over being stuck here all by myself, and now I'm complaining that there'll be more people around. It's rather silly, isn't it?" You have no answer for that, save to draw in close and wrap an arm around Kiyoko. She stiffens instinctively, but soon relaxes against you with a quiet whimper, ears curling forward. She stays like that for a few seconds, then starts sniffling. "...My stomach's only going to get bigger from here on out..." It is. "...I make a fine pregnant woman, don't I?" Kiyoko looks down at the ground and laughs nervously. "Look at me... even at this point, I can still make light of myself..." That's one of the things you love her for. Those words seem to cheer Kiyoko up a little, her large ears perking up at your words and touch alike. "At least I know exactly how I got to be this way... it's not as if I did anything sinful." Well, that seems to wrap things up. The only remaining concern you might have is whether this place is a proper one to be raising children in. "It's... adequate. The Astral Plane is like a dream, really; it doesn't have a border, it doesn't stop short at a point. The forest just goes on forever, as far as my previous explorations have taken me. The kits will need to get along with others, but I have the feeling that this won't be the last kit you'll be putting in me." She rests her hands on her small baby bump for emphasis. "And besides... you'll be bringing the orb back to Keros so he can get us all out of here, yes?" That's the plan, yes. "Then there's nothing else to be overly worried about. If anything happens, I'll let you know." She looks around, then down at her sleepwear. "I should probably go and get changed. Why don't you wait for me downstairs?" Oh? Why doesn't she wear this downstairs instead? It's a lot more flattering. "Because it's sleepwear, and one doesn't put on sleepwear in daily life," she replies, sticking her tongue out at you. "Now if you don't mind, I'll go and get changed." Kiyoko is good to her word. Fifteen minutes later, she's down in the sitting room with you, clad in her usual white yukata — although you realize that the cloth has been loosened to accommodate her pregnancy. "Now," she begins as she brings the tea set to the table and begins brewing, "shall we begin?"
rows.translation: 她似乎没有受伤，从她蜷缩着的被褥来看，她把自己安顿得相当舒服。不，不是昏迷，只是……在睡觉，虽然睡得很沉。不过，这个房间让你印象最深的，是它有多么葱翠。其中一面墙只是一道低矮的栏杆，让房间的一侧向空气敞开——也许叫它阳台更合适？一些小型盆栽摆在露天的空间里，包括各种香草和微型树木；一缕淡淡的香气飘在空中，与樱花的气息交织在一起。不过最重要的是，当你跨过门口时，一天中的时辰会迅速由白天变为夜晚，阳光急速褪去，取而代之的是昏淡、银白的月光——而天上根本没有月亮。 你走到清子身边，跪在她旁边，挠了挠这只狐妖一只又大又蓬松的耳朵。她哼了一声、抽了抽鼻子，翻过身去；你继续逗弄她，享受抚摸她这双精神耳朵的乐趣，直到她平稳的呼吸化作一声轻叹，眼睛也颤动着睁开。 “啊……[pc.name]。” 是的，是你。你来得不是时候吗？ 清子紧闭双眼，在被子里伸了个懒腰，坐起身来，轻轻哼了一声使劲，转了转肩膀。她穿着丝绸睡衣，那比她平常的衣裙简单得多——也暴露得多；她甩了甩睡得凌乱的头发，打量着你。 “不……反正我也该起来了。我最近相当……嗯，疲倦，所以想先打个盹，再去做每天的事务。这个房间其实算不上卧室，只是我需要恢复精神时会来的地方。说实话，我一直在想你什么时候会出现；有件事我想和你商量。” 哦？什么事？是不是和你上次离开时最后做的那些有关？ 清子觉得好笑了一两秒，随后那副表情垮成窘迫，她揉揉眼睛，把睡意揉掉。“是的。嗯……” 她为什么这么犹豫？难道一切没有像她预想的那样顺利？ “不，不，问题不在于有什么没发生。问题在于，除了我预料到的事以外，还多发生了什么。” 好吧，那就别再绕弯子了。到底是什么问题？ “我觉得你最好自己看看。”清子掀开被子，挣扎着站起来，把柔软的睡衣往身上拉紧。这事起初并不明显——你要再看一眼才能发现，但它确实在那里。以她纤细的身形为衬，清子的肚子微微向外鼓起，大致相当于一个怀孕三个月的人类女性。毫无疑问——清子要当妈妈了，而推而广之，你也要当[pc.mf|爸爸|妈妈]了。 “你看到了，对吧？” 是的，你看到了。是的，你看到了。 那只狐妖显得有些不安。“我……我真的没想到会发生这种事。” 不是想当个混蛋，但说真的，她到底以为会发生什么？她哄着你把一大股东西直接射进了她的子宫里；结果她肚子里多了一只小狐崽……嗯，那差不多正是重点所在，不是吗？身为狐妖，她对这种事并不陌生，所以她当然很清楚小狐狸宝宝是从哪儿来的。 “这话没错，可是……”清子慌乱地用双手指着自己。“这里是星界！我的肉身已经被剥离了——我没有身体，更别说用来怀孕的子宫了！再说，我们进行气转移的时候，性爱只是对正在发生的事情的一种比喻；你并没有真的像对外界的人那样把它插进我身体里！” 好吧，如果在这里享受令人神魂颠倒的性爱只是把一部分精华转移给她的比喻，那么在她肚子里养出一只小狐崽大概也是别的什么东西的比喻。你完全不知道那是什么，但你只能推测它相当重要。 清子深吸一口气，握紧拳头、挺直肩膀，让自己平静下来。“我……我不觉得这有什么危害，至少我给自己做的所有检查都表明如此。即便如此，这也不正常。我知道星界里的时间流速和外界不一样，因为这不过是你把我肚子搞大之后的第二次来访。可就算这样，里面才过了不到一周，我就已经开始显怀了。” 至少转移本身还是顺利完成了，对吧？ 清子点点头。“我确实接收到了你的气，只是我孕育它的方式和我原本以为的不太一样，这才让我这么累。所以我才上楼来，在安神的环境里小睡一会儿、恢复一下。” “虽然我不认为这会妨碍我最终能在位面之外显形的目标，但只是……我长得这么快、这么大，实在让人吃惊。或者说，这对我来说其实完全正常，毕竟我在这里拥有的并不算真正的肉体？我真该把这些都记录下来。” 瞧，她开始用更积极的角度看待这件事了。总不会那么糟吧？ “我又不是照顾不了一两只狐崽；我母亲当年是繁殖狂欢的常客，我小时候照顾那么多弟弟妹妹也练了不少。但看着你母亲做和亲自去做，完全是两回事，你懂吧？” 是的，确实如此。 说完这些，清子犹豫了一下，然后叹口气，虚弱地笑了笑。“你似乎对这一切接受得相当好。” 当然，因为这没什么可担心的。到目前为止还没有真正出格的事情发生，对吧？你用微笑回应清子的微笑，拉近两人之间的距离，把这只狐妖抱进怀里。清子几乎融化在你的怀抱里，双臂环住你，最后松开时，喉咙深处发出一声快乐的小声音。 “你说得对。我应该试着对这一切感觉好一些——至少，有个小家伙在这里跑来跑去，你不在的时候我应该就不会那么孤单了，[pc.name]。直到最近，我还因为独自被困在这里而难过，现在却抱怨身边会多出几个人。这挺傻的，对吧？” 你对此无话可答，只能靠过去，用一只手臂搂住清子。她本能地绷紧，但很快就在你怀里放松下来，轻轻呜咽了一声，耳朵向前卷起。她这样待了几秒钟，然后开始抽鼻子。 “……我的肚子从现在起只会越来越大……” 是的。 “……我是个挺不错的孕妇，对吧？”清子低头看着地面，紧张地笑了笑。“看看我……都到这种地步了，还能拿自己开玩笑……” 这正是你爱她的原因之一。 这些话似乎让清子振作了些，她那双大耳朵随着你的话语和触碰一同竖了起来。“至少我很清楚自己是怎么变成这样的……我又没做什么罪过的事。” 嗯，看来事情就这样结束了。你唯一还剩下的顾虑，是这个地方到底适不适合养育孩子。 “还算……凑合。星界其实就像一场梦；它没有边界，也不会在某个点戛然而止。就我之前的探索而言，那片森林一直向前延伸。小狐崽们需要和其他人相处，但我有种预感，这不会是你放进我肚子里的最后一只狐崽。”她把手放在微微隆起的小腹上以示强调。“再说……你会把那颗宝珠带回去给凯罗斯，好让他把我们全都弄出去，对吧？” 没错，就是这个计划。 “那就没什么需要过分担心的了。如果出了什么事，我会告诉你。”她环顾四周，又低头看看自己的睡衣。“我大概该去换衣服了。你为什么不在楼下等我呢？” 哦？她为什么不干脆穿着这身到楼下呢？这身要好看得多。 “因为这是睡衣，而日常生活中人们不会穿睡衣，”她答道，朝你吐了吐舌头。“现在，如果你不介意的话，我去换身衣服。” 清子说到做到。十五分钟后，她穿着平常那件白色浴衣来到客厅陪你——不过你注意到，衣料已经被放松，以容纳她的身孕。 “那么，”她一边把茶具端到桌边、开始泡茶，一边开口，“我们开始吧？”
rows.raw: " She's not hurt or harmed, it seems, and judging by the futon she's snuggled in, has made herself very comfortable. Nope, not knocked out, just... sleeping, even if it's a very deep sleep. What strikes you about this particular room, though, is how verdant it is. One of the walls is just a low railing, rendering the room open to the air on one side — perhaps it'd be better called a balcony? Small potted plants, including a variety of herbs and miniature trees, sit in the open; a faint aroma wafts through the air, mingling with the scent of cherry blossoms. What's most important, though, is how the time of day rapidly changes from day to night as you step in through the doorway, sunlight rapidly fading away to be replaced by wan, silvery moonlight — without a moon in the sky at all. Stepping up to Kiyoko, you kneel down beside her and tickle one of the kitsune's large, fluffy ears. She snorts and snuffles, turning on her side; you keep up the stimulation, taking pleasure in petting her perky ears until her steady breathing turns into a small sigh and her eyes flutter open. "Ah... [pc.name]." Yes, it's you. Have you come at a bad time? Kiyoko squeezes her eyes shut and stretches under the duvet, sitting up on the futon and rolling her shoulders with a small sigh of effort. She's wearing silken sleepwear, a much simpler — and skimpier — version of her usual dress, and shakes out the worst of her bed-head as she regards you. "No... I should be up now anyway. I've been rather... um, tired of late, and I thought to get a quick nap in before proceeding with my daily duties. This room isn't exactly a bedroom, it's where I go as and when I need to recuperate. To be honest, I was wondering when you'd show up; there was a matter I was hoping to discuss with you." Oh? What is it? Does it happen to be related to how you finished off your last visit? Kiyoko looks amused for a second or two, then that expression collapses into a sheepish one, rubbing her eyes free of sleep. "It is. Umm..." Now why's she so hesitant? Did everything not work out as she'd foreseen? "No, no, it's not a matter of what didn't happen. It's more a matter of what happened in addition to what I predicted would." Fine, time to stop beating around the bush, then. Just what is the problem? "I think it's better if you saw for yourself." Pushing her covers off, Kiyoko struggles to her feet and pulls her soft sleepwear tight against her body. It's not immediately apparent — you don't see it until you take a second look, but it's there nevertheless. Framed against her delicate form, Kiyoko's tummy is bulging outwards ever so slightly, roughly comparable to a human woman three months along. There's no doubt about it — Kiyoko is going to be a mommy, and by extension, you a [pc.mf|daddy|mommy]. "You see it, don't you?" Yes, you do. Yes, you do. The kitsune looks a little uncertain. "I... I really wasn't expecting this to happen." Not to be an ass, but seriously, what did she imagine would happen? She coaxed you into shooting off a huge load straight into her baby bag; ending up with a little fox kit inside her... well, that's kind of the point, isn't it? It's not as if she's unacquainted with such things as a kitsune, so she knows perfectly well where little fox babies come from. "That is true, but..." Flustered, Kiyoko points at herself with both hands. "This is the Astral Plane! My physicality, was ripped from me — I don't have a body, let alone a womb to be pregnant with! And besides, when we were doing the chi transferral, the sex was just a metaphor for what was happening; you weren't really sticking it into me the same way you would someone on the outside!" Well, if having mind-blowing sex here is only a metaphor for transferring a portion of your essence to her, then growing a little kitsune kit in her tummy is probably a metaphor for something else, too. You'll be damned if you know what, but you can only presume it's rather significant. Taking a deep breath, Kiyoko clenches her fists, squares her shoulders and calms herself. "I... I don't think it's harmful, or at least all the evaluations I've run on myself suggest so. Even so, this isn't normal. I know time doesn't flow in the Astral Plane at the same rate as it does on the outside world, since this is just your second visit after you knocked me up. Even so, it's barely been a week here on the inside, and I'm already beginning to show." The transferral still went off without a hitch at least, right? Kiyoko nods. "I did receive your chi, it's just that I'm nurturing it in a rather different way than I thought I'd be doing, which is making me so tired. It's why I came up here to have a nap in a calming atmosphere and recuperate. "While I don't think that'll be any obstacle towards our goal of me eventually being able to manifest outside of the plane, but it's just rather startling, with me getting so big so fast. Or really, is it perfectly normal for me, since this isn't exactly a physical body I have here? I should really keep notes." There, she's beginning to view this in a more positive light. It can't be so bad, can it? "It's not as if I can't care for a fox kit or two; my mother was a regular participant in the breeding orgies and I got in plenty of practice caring for my many siblings when I was younger. But there's a difference between seeing your mother do it, and doing it yourself, you know?" Yes, indeed. Having said her piece, Kiyoko hesitates for a moment, then sighs and smiles weakly. "You seem to be taking all of this very well." Of course, because it's no cause for concern. Nothing truly untoward has happened yet, right? Returning Kiyoko's smile with one of your own, you close the distance between you two and draw the kitsune into a big hug. Kiyoko practically melts into your embrace, wrapping her arms about you, then makes a happy little noise in the back of her throat as she finally pulls away. "You're right. I should try and feel better about all this — at the very least, having a little kit running around the place should stop me from feeling lonely when you're not around, [pc.name]. Up until recently, I was so upset over being stuck here all by myself, and now I'm complaining that there'll be more people around. It's rather silly, isn't it?" You have no answer for that, save to draw in close and wrap an arm around Kiyoko. She stiffens instinctively, but soon relaxes against you with a quiet whimper, ears curling forward. She stays like that for a few seconds, then starts sniffling. "...My stomach's only going to get bigger from here on out..." It is. "...I make a fine pregnant woman, don't I?" Kiyoko looks down at the ground and laughs nervously. "Look at me... even at this point, I can still make light of myself..." That's one of the things you love her for. Those words seem to cheer Kiyoko up a little, her large ears perking up at your words and touch alike. "At least I know exactly how I got to be this way... it's not as if I did anything sinful." Well, that seems to wrap things up. The only remaining concern you might have is whether this place is a proper one to be raising children in. "It's... adequate. The Astral Plane is like a dream, really; it doesn't have a border, it doesn't stop short at a point. The forest just goes on forever, as far as my previous explorations have taken me. The kits will need to get along with others, but I have the feeling that this won't be the last kit you'll be putting in me." She rests her hands on her small baby bump for emphasis. "And besides... you'll be bringing the orb back to Keros so he can get us all out of here, yes?" That's the plan, yes. "Then there's nothing else to be overly worried about. If anything happens, I'll let you know." She looks around, then down at her sleepwear. "I should probably go and get changed. Why don't you wait for me downstairs?" Oh? Why doesn't she wear this downstairs instead? It's a lot more flattering. "Because it's sleepwear, and one doesn't put on sleepwear in daily life," she replies, sticking her tongue out at you. "Now if you don't mind, I'll go and get changed." Kiyoko is good to her word. Fifteen minutes later, she's down in the sitting room with you, clad in her usual white yukata — although you realize that the cloth has been loosened to accommodate her pregnancy. "Now," she begins as she brings the tea set to the table and begins brewing, "shall we begin?""

rows.original: "Well, there's a little ritual I'd like to introduce you to," Kiyoko says, a twinkle in her eye. "If you wouldn't mind?" A ritual, eh? Oh, you know she's up to something when she's got that mischievous air about her. Guess you don't mind playing along; you know that your foxy friend here would never mean you any actual harm. "Right. Follow me, please." [kiyoko.numKits 1||[pc.isChamp|You hesitate for a moment, turning back to the dirty dishes under the parasol table. She can't just leave them here, right? Then again, you're also smart enough to not break the mood — dirty dishes can be taken care of anytime, but new years' eve only comes once a year. Kiyoko's already started off at a brisk pace, and you have to jog a little to catch up with her before she starts wondering just where you've gone. ] ] The two of you eventually come to the forest's edge, a little way past the fence that marks the end of the peach orchard. You'd never noticed it before — and unsurprisingly so, considering how well hidden it is — but there's a little gazebo-like structure planted squarely on the border between civilization and wilderness. Hanging from rust-flecked chains are a huge bell and a clapper the size and length of a tree trunk; the bell itself is huge, ancient, and covered with all sorts of carvings and patches of greenish patina. "It's one of the first things I ordered the Astral Plane to fashion after I came here, a small piece of the home I lived in as a girl a long time ago. I have no way of being sure, of course, but... I'd like to think it's a pretty faithful replica." You look bell and clapper alike and give the former a rap with your knuckles. Solid bronze, indeed. So, you take it that you're supposed to ring the bell? Kiyoko nods and smiles. "A hundred and eight times, to be precise. One for each of the proscribed mental states which Lord Keros warns leads to unwholesome actions." Unwholesome actions... that's one way of putting it. A hundred and eight times... that's quite a few. [pc.toughnessRange 70|Not that you aren't going to welcome the challenge — if nothing else, it'll be a good exercise in pacing yourself.] "I'll help you, of course. No one said you were doing this alone." [pc.toughnessRange 70 |While you don't think you need the help, this'll be a lot more meaningful with two people instead of one. |Ah, right. It'll be a lot easier with two people instead of one. ] Did she use to do this a lot in the past? "During my captivity? Not so much; there wasn't a reason to observe the new year when time simply blended into a blur, one day flowing into the next like the one that came before it. Before that, though, when I was a girl in the old country... haha, three or four of us would be clamouring to have a go at the clapper under my mother's watchful eye." Sniffling a little, Kiyoko wipes a stray tear from her cheek. "It was a small wonder we ever managed to finish ringing it before the sun came up." ... "Come, now. Shall we get started?" Of course. Stepping over to the large wooden clapper, you take it under an arm and test its weight. This sure is some solid wood, and the chains, though flecked with rust, look sturdy enough. Kiyoko steps back and observes you closely as you take a deep breath to steel yourself, draw back the clapper, and send it crashing into the large bronze bell with all your might. Bong... The sound rings out through the air and out to the forest, loud and clear despite the bell's age. It resonates in your bones, bounces about in your head, and eventually leaves you, but not without leaving you feeling thoroughly rattled — but oddly enough, in a good way. By the time the last echo finally fades, you're tingling from head to toe as if you'd just been zapped with a burst of static. A small smattering of applause. "Not bad, [pc.name]. One hundred and seven more times to go, then." Phew... It's hard at first, especially when you need to stop and recover from the tremendous, clarion ringing each time, but eventually both your muscles and skull get used to it and it's not so bad by the twentieth or so strike of the bell. [pc.toughnessRange 70 |While you don't feel that out of sorts, Kiyoko insists that she take over the job after the forty-second strike and let you rest for a bit before coming back to it. The set of her face and her folded arms strongly suggest that she's not taking no for an answer. |By the forty-second strike, you're starting to feel it in your joints, and Kiyoko offers to take over for a while and let you rest a bit. It's a small mercy you eagerly accept, and you let her have it all to herself while you shake out your shoulders and waist. ] There's a nice mossy beam to one side where you can get a good view of the proceedings, and it's this you lean against while watching Kiyoko go at it. Despite being small and slight, your foxy [kiyoko.numKits 1|lover|friend]'s clearly no stranger to this; where she lacks in strength, she makes up for in technique, moving her body with the natural flow of the clapper as she strikes the bell over and over again. Kiyoko's natural wiggliness and flexibility as a kitsune comes in handy as she leverages her body weight into the equation. "Sixty-three, sixty-four, sixty-five. Phew. It's your turn once more, [pc.name]." Oh, already? She looked like she was having so much fun there. "Oh, I was, no doubt about that. However, as you're the guest tonight, it's important for you to get the best experience you can out of the ceremonies." Ha, since she put it so nicely, you guess you don't have a choice... [kiyoko.numKits 1|Just as you're about to get up and reclaim your old spot, though, you spy a small figure cresting the hilltop in the moonlight. It's not hard to recognize your firstborn daughter at a distance, not when her silvery-white hair and fur glimmer like that when the moonbeams strike them. Coming to a stop just before the gazebo, Kinu announces her presence by way of coughing gently, and gives both Kiyoko and you a small bow. Now, what is she doing here? "Ehe... well, [pc.PapaMama], Mama, I put away the dirty dishes from the new years' soba like you wanted, then I [kiyoko.numKits 2|set everyone else to sleep|made my nightly prayers] like I was supposed to. I'm not sleepy, though, so..." "...So you want to stay up all night with us and watch the sunrise?" Kinu contrives to look adorably sheepish. "That, and I wanna help bang the big bell, too. I'm old enough this year!" You look between the bell clapper, practically the size of a tree trunk, then back at Kinu. Is she sure about that? "Of course I wouldn't be doing it alone, [pc.PapaMama]. With both Mama and you around, it wouldn't be any more dangerous than handling my practice naginata." Kiyoko taps her chin. "Hmm. What do you say, love?" Well, it's only once a year, so if she's grown-up enough to not doze off she's more than welcome to join you. There're only about forty more strikes of the bell to go, and you get the feeling that things would be a lot more fun if you did this as a family. So long as you watch Kinu carefully to ensure that no accidents happen, it should be all right. So it comes to pass that the three of you arrange yourselves about the clapper as a family, with you in front, Kiyoko behind, and Kinu sandwiched between you two. Once more, you draw back the clapper by its chains and strike the bell with all your might. Bong... Kinu squeals, the sound equal parts fear and exhilaration, but your kitsune daughter keeps a tight hold on the clapper itself with her little hands. Bong... Kiyoko sure is putting her back into it, too[kiyoko.pregStage 2|, despite how obviously pregnant she is]. You don't often see her openly sweat, but there it is, beads forming on her soft skin despite the cool night air. Judging by the smile on her face, she's enjoying herself... but who wouldn't, surrounded by family like this? How many years have passed by without her seeing anyone? Bong. Has it been a hundred and eight tolls of the bell already? It doesn't feel like it — [pc.toughnessRange 70|you're still plenty energetic as it is|all that activity was far less tiring than you thought it would be]. But neither your foxy wife nor your fluffy daughter are revving up the clapper for another strike, so it must be over. You wipe the sweat from your brow, take a few deep breaths, and contemplate the matter in silence. Sure, it was a lot of hard work, and this isn't part of your own culture... but by being here with Kiyoko and Kinu, there's no doubt it's been worth your while. Kinu squirms up against you and tugs at your [pc.armor]. "Look, [pc.PapaMama], look! We made it just in time for the first sunrise of the new year!" She's not wrong. From where you stand, you can see a dull orange glow cresting the treetops, slowly pushing away the inky darkness of the starry night sky. As you watch, transfixed, Kiyoko comes up to your side and melts against your shoulder, draping herself on you with a smile. "Happy new year, [pc.name]. May it be a successful and prosperous one for you." The same for her — and of course, Kinu as well. You reach down and find the spot on Kinu's brow where she likes to be petted, then plant the heel of your palm squarely on it while chasing her ears with your fingers. |"It's just the last stretch; I have perfect confidence in your ability to finish up all one hundred and eight strikes." Well, instead of you taking over wholesale, why don't the two of you ring the bell together? It'd be more fun that way. "Hmm?" So long as it's not dangerous, why not? It's just the last stretch, isn't it? You came here to spend time with your foxy friend here, after all; this'll be better than just staring at each other taking turns at the clapper, right? Kiyoko makes a show of considering the prospect, planting a finger on her chin as she pretends to think deeply. Then, with a small smile, "I guess it can't hurt." So it comes to pass that the both of you return to the bell once more with you taking the front while Kiyoko backs you up from the rear. Affirming your grip on the heavy wooden clapper, the both of you draw it back on its chains and thrust forward to strike the bell cleanly. Bong... The sound is brilliant, far stronger than either of you could possibly have managed on your own; leaves rustle and the air itself shimmers as it travels outward into the night. Your teeth chatter and bones rattle, but the powerful reverberation soon passes, leaving a sense of clarity in the fore of your mind despite your body's protestations. "Again?" Of course. Again. Bong... With two people instead of one, you're far better able to pace yourselves, wood striking bronze at a steady pace to herald the arrival of the new year. The thump the clapper makes against your shoulder as it hits the bell is powerful yet calming, its sense of power lending a solemn air to the proceedings. Kiyoko sure is putting her back into it, too[kiyoko.pregStage 2|, despite how obviously pregnant she is]. You don't often see her openly sweat, but there it is, beads forming on her soft skin despite the cool night air. Judging by the smile on her face, she's enjoying herself... but of course. How many years have passed by without her seeing anyone? Bong... The last strike rings true with a distinctive note of finality, shaking you to the core. At this point, you can't even feel very much of yourself, let alone feel how tired you ought to be; all you're experiencing right now is a strong sense of self-satisfaction as you finally let go of the clapper and let your foxy friend fall into your embrace. Yes, that was much more fun than just going it alone. "Look, [pc.name]," Kiyoko mumbles in your arms. "We finished just in time for the new year, and not a moment too soon." She's right. Making a half-turn and looking over Kiyoko's shoulder, you spy a dull amber glow coming up upon the horizon, cresting the treetops as warmth begins to pour out over this little pocket dimension. Your foxy friend is warm and fluffy against you, and she's not that different a color as the sunrise... ... Ha. Happy new year. "Happy new year to you too, [pc.name]." ] Yep, it's been only a few minutes into the new year, and things are looking up already. "As much as I'd like you to stay longer, I suppose that's not possible, is it? After all, you still have much to do out there." Is she chasing you off? Because it sounds like she's chasing you off. "No, no. Just reminding you not to get too caught up in the moment. I had fun today, [pc.name]... but there's also a whole world out there which requires your attention. I wouldn't want to monopolize your time, after all, and there're other people you need to spend this day with, aren't there?" Well... "Don't argue now. Off you go." Before you can protest, Kiyoko leans in and smooches you lightly on the lips, just the briefest of pecks. "Come visit again soon, okay?" [kiyoko.numKits 1|"Eeee! Come visit again!" You sigh and pet Kinu's ears again. With such a precocious daughter, how could you not? ]
rows.translation: “嗯，有个小仪式，我想带你见识一下，”清子说道，眼里闪着光。“如果你不介意的话？” 一个仪式，嗯？哦，你一看她那副淘气的神气，就知道她又在打什么主意。看来你不介意陪她玩下去；你知道你这位狐狸朋友绝不会真的害你。 “好。请跟我来。” [kiyoko.numKits 1||[pc.isChamp|你犹豫了片刻，回头看向遮阳伞桌下那些脏碗碟。她总不能就把它们留在这儿吧？不过，你也很聪明，不会破坏气氛——脏碗碟什么时候都能收拾，可除夕一年只有一次。清子已经快步走了起来，你得小跑才能跟上，免得她开始琢磨你跑到哪儿去了。 ] ] 你们两人最终来到森林边缘，离标记桃园尽头的那道篱笆还有一小段路。你以前从没注意到它——这也不奇怪，毕竟它藏得实在太好——但在文明与荒野的交界处，立着一座小亭子似的建筑。锈迹斑斑的链子上挂着一口巨大的钟和一根树干般长短粗细的钟槌；那口钟本身巨大而古老，上面刻满各种花纹，还覆着一片片绿色的铜锈。 “这是我来到这里之后，最早要求星界造出来的东西之一，是我很久以前还是小女孩时住过的家的一小部分。当然，我无法确定，但……我愿意相信它是一份相当忠实的复制品。” 你端详着那口钟和那根钟槌，用指节敲了敲前者。确实是实心青铜。那么，你猜你应该是要敲响这口钟？ 清子点点头，笑了。“准确地说，是一百零八次。每一次对应凯罗斯大人所警告的一种会导致不净行为的心理状态。” 不净的行为……这也算是一种说法。一百零八次……可真不少。[pc.toughnessRange 70|倒不是你不欢迎这个挑战——至少，这会是个锻炼自己控制节奏的好机会。] “我当然会帮你。没人说过你得一个人做这件事。” [pc.toughnessRange 70 |虽然你觉得自己并不需要帮忙，但两个人一起做会比一个人有意义得多。 |啊，对。两个人一起做会比一个人轻松得多。 ] 她以前常做这件事吗？ “在我被囚禁的那段日子里？倒不怎么常做；当时时间本身就已经浑浊一片，一天接着一天流过去，和前头那天毫无分别，也就没有理由去守新年了。不过在那之前，当我还住在旧国、还是个女孩的时候……哈哈，会有三四个孩子在母亲的目光下争着要去碰那根钟槌。”清子抽了抽鼻子，擦掉脸颊上一滴滑落的泪。“我们最后能在太阳升起前把它敲完，已经算是小小的奇迹了。” …… “来吧。我们开始吧？” 当然。你走到那根巨大的木钟槌旁，把它夹到腋下试了试重量。这木头确实结实，链子虽然锈迹斑斑，看起来也够牢靠。清子退后一步，仔细看着你；你深吸一口气壮了壮胆，向后拉开钟槌，然后用尽全力把它砸向那口巨大的青铜钟。 铛…… 声音穿过空气传向森林，尽管这口钟年代久远，却依然洪亮清晰。它在你的骨头里共鸣，在你脑中回荡，最后才离开你，但也让你浑身震荡——奇怪的是，这种感觉还挺舒服。等最后一丝回音终于消散，你从头到脚都在发麻，仿佛刚刚被一阵静电击中。 一阵零星的掌声。“不错，[pc.name]。那么，还剩一百零七次。” 呼…… 一开始很难，尤其是每次那震耳欲聋的洪亮钟声过后，你都得停下来缓一缓；但渐渐地，你的肌肉和头骨都适应了它，敲到第二十下左右时已经没那么难受了。 [pc.toughnessRange 70 |虽然你并不觉得有什么不适，但清子坚持要在第四十二下之后接手，让你先休息一会儿再回来。她绷紧的脸色和抱起的双臂都强烈表明，她不会接受拒绝。 |到第四十二下时，你的关节开始有感觉了，清子提出接手一会儿，让你歇一歇。你欣然接受了这份小小的恩惠，把钟槌全交给她，自己活动着肩膀和腰。 ] 旁边有一根长满苔藓的横梁，从那里可以很好地看清整个过程，你就靠在那里看着清子继续敲。 尽管她个子小巧、身量纤细，你这位狐狸[kiyoko.numKits 已经敲满一百零八下了吗？感觉不像——[pc.toughnessRange 70|你到现在依然精力充沛|刚才那一番活动远没有你想的那么累]。但无论你那位狐狸妻子还是毛茸茸的女儿都没有再抡起钟槌敲下一击，所以一定是结束了。你擦掉额上的汗，深呼吸几次，默默思索着这件事。没错，这确实很辛苦，而且这也不属于你自己的文化……但能和清子、小娟一起在这里，毫无疑问这一切都是值得的。 小娟在你身边扭动着，拽了拽你的[pc.armor]。“看，[pc.PapaMama]，看！我们正好赶上新年的第一缕日出！” 她说得没错。从你站的地方望去，能看到一轮暗橙色的光芒攀上树梢，慢慢驱散星夜的墨黑。你正看得入神，清子来到你身旁，融进你的肩膀，微笑着倚在你身上。 “新年快乐，[pc.name]。愿你新的一年顺遂兴旺。” 也祝她——当然，还有小娟——一样。你伸手找到小娟额头上她喜欢被摸的那个位置，把掌根正正按上去，同时用手指追着她的耳朵挠。 |“就剩最后一段了；我完全相信你能敲完这一百零八下。” 嗯，与其让你整个接手，不如你们两人一起敲钟？那样会更有意思。 “嗯？” 只要不危险，为什么不呢？就剩最后一段了，不是吗？你毕竟是来这里和你这位狐狸朋友共度时光的；这样总比两人轮流盯着钟槌发呆要好，对吧？ 清子装模作样地考虑起这个提议，把一根手指按在下巴上，假装陷入深思。然后，她带着一丝浅笑：“我想这也没什么坏处。” 于是事情就这样成了：你们两人再次回到钟前，你在前面，清子从后面配合你。你确认握稳那根沉重的木钟槌，两人一起顺着链子把它拉回，再向前推去，干净利落地敲响那口钟。 铛…… 那声音辉煌无比，远比你们任何一个人单独能做到的都要强劲；树叶沙沙作响，空气本身也在它向夜色中扩散时微微颤动。你的牙齿打颤、骨头咯咯作响，但那股强烈的回响很快过去，尽管身体还在抗议，脑海里却留下了一片清明。 “再来？” 当然。再来。 铛…… rows.raw: " "Well, there's a little ritual I'd like to introduce you to," Kiyoko says, a twinkle in her eye. "If you wouldn't mind?" A ritual, eh? Oh, you know she's up to something when she's got that mischievous air about her. Guess you don't mind playing along; you know that your foxy friend here would never mean you any actual harm. "Right. Follow me, please." [kiyoko.numKits 1||[pc.isChamp|You hesitate for a moment, turning back to the dirty dishes under the parasol table. She can't just leave them here, right? Then again, you're also smart enough to not break the mood — dirty dishes can be taken care of anytime, but new years' eve only comes once a year. Kiyoko's already started off at a brisk pace, and you have to jog a little to catch up with her before she starts wondering just where you've gone. ] ] The two of you eventually come to the forest's edge, a little way past the fence that marks the end of the peach orchard. You'd never noticed it before — and unsurprisingly so, considering how well hidden it is — but there's a little gazebo-like structure planted squarely on the border between civilization and wilderness. Hanging from rust-flecked chains are a huge bell and a clapper the size and length of a tree trunk; the bell itself is huge, ancient, and covered with all sorts of carvings and patches of greenish patina. "It's one of the first things I ordered the Astral Plane to fashion after I came here, a small piece of the home I lived in as a girl a long time ago. I have no way of being sure, of course, but... I'd like to think it's a pretty faithful replica." You look bell and clapper alike and give the former a rap with your knuckles. Solid bronze, indeed. So, you take it that you're supposed to ring the bell? Kiyoko nods and smiles. "A hundred and eight times, to be precise. One for each of the proscribed mental states which Lord Keros warns leads to unwholesome actions." Unwholesome actions... that's one way of putting it. A hundred and eight times... that's quite a few. [pc.toughnessRange 70|Not that you aren't going to welcome the challenge — if nothing else, it'll be a good exercise in pacing yourself.] "I'll help you, of course. No one said you were doing this alone." [pc.toughnessRange 70 |While you don't think you need the help, this'll be a lot more meaningful with two people instead of one. |Ah, right. It'll be a lot easier with two people instead of one. ] Did she use to do this a lot in the past? "During my captivity? Not so much; there wasn't a reason to observe the new year when time simply blended into a blur, one day flowing into the next like the one that came before it. Before that, though, when I was a girl in the old country... haha, three or four of us would be clamouring to have a go at the clapper under my mother's watchful eye." Sniffling a little, Kiyoko wipes a stray tear from her cheek. "It was a small wonder we ever managed to finish ringing it before the sun came up." ... "Come, now. Shall we get started?" Of course. Stepping over to the large wooden clapper, you take it under an arm and test its weight. This sure is some solid wood, and the chains, though flecked with rust, look sturdy enough. Kiyoko steps back and observes you closely as you take a deep breath to steel yourself, draw back the clapper, and send it crashing into the large bronze bell with all your might. Bong... The sound rings out through the air and out to the forest, loud and clear despite the bell's age. It resonates in your bones, bounces about in your head, and eventually leaves you, but not without leaving you feeling thoroughly rattled — but oddly enough, in a good way. By the time the last echo finally fades, you're tingling from head to toe as if you'd just been zapped with a burst of static. A small smattering of applause. "Not bad, [pc.name]. One hundred and seven more times to go, then." Phew... It's hard at first, especially when you need to stop and recover from the tremendous, clarion ringing each time, but eventually both your muscles and skull get used to it and it's not so bad by the twentieth or so strike of the bell. [pc.toughnessRange 70 |While you don't feel that out of sorts, Kiyoko insists that she take over the job after the forty-second strike and let you rest for a bit before coming back to it. The set of her face and her folded arms strongly suggest that she's not taking no for an answer. |By the forty-second strike, you're starting to feel it in your joints, and Kiyoko offers to take over for a while and let you rest a bit. It's a small mercy you eagerly accept, and you let her have it all to herself while you shake out your shoulders and waist. ] There's a nice mossy beam to one side where you can get a good view of the proceedings, and it's this you lean against while watching Kiyoko go at it. Despite being small and slight, your foxy [kiyoko.numKits 1|lover|friend]'s clearly no stranger to this; where she lacks in strength, she makes up for in technique, moving her body with the natural flow of the clapper as she strikes the bell over and over again. Kiyoko's natural wiggliness and flexibility as a kitsune comes in handy as she leverages her body weight into the equation. "Sixty-three, sixty-four, sixty-five. Phew. It's your turn once more, [pc.name]." Oh, already? She looked like she was having so much fun there. "Oh, I was, no doubt about that. However, as you're the guest tonight, it's important for you to get the best experience you can out of the ceremonies." Ha, since she put it so nicely, you guess you don't have a choice... [kiyoko.numKits 1|Just as you're about to get up and reclaim your old spot, though, you spy a small figure cresting the hilltop in the moonlight. It's not hard to recognize your firstborn daughter at a distance, not when her silvery-white hair and fur glimmer like that when the moonbeams strike them. Coming to a stop just before the gazebo, Kinu announces her presence by way of coughing gently, and gives both Kiyoko and you a small bow. Now, what is she doing here? "Ehe... well, [pc.PapaMama], Mama, I put away the dirty dishes from the new years' soba like you wanted, then I [kiyoko.numKits 2|set everyone else to sleep|made my nightly prayers] like I was supposed to. I'm not sleepy, though, so..." "...So you want to stay up all night with us and watch the sunrise?" Kinu contrives to look adorably sheepish. "That, and I wanna help bang the big bell, too. I'm old enough this year!" You look between the bell clapper, practically the size of a tree trunk, then back at Kinu. Is she sure about that? "Of course I wouldn't be doing it alone, [pc.PapaMama]. With both Mama and you around, it wouldn't be any more dangerous than handling my practice naginata." Kiyoko taps her chin. "Hmm. What do you say, love?" Well, it's only once a year, so if she's grown-up enough to not doze off she's more than welcome to join you. There're only about forty more strikes of the bell to go, and you get the feeling that things would be a lot more fun if you did this as a family. So long as you watch Kinu carefully to ensure that no accidents happen, it should be all right. So it comes to pass that the three of you arrange yourselves about the clapper as a family, with you in front, Kiyoko behind, and Kinu sandwiched between you two. Once more, you draw back the clapper by its chains and strike the bell with all your might. Bong... Kinu squeals, the sound equal parts fear and exhilaration, but your kitsune daughter keeps a tight hold on the clapper itself with her little hands. Bong... Kiyoko sure is putting her back into it, too[kiyoko.pregStage 2|, despite how obviously pregnant she is]. You don't often see her openly sweat, but there it is, beads forming on her soft skin despite the cool night air. Judging by the smile on her face, she's enjoying herself... but who wouldn't, surrounded by family like this? How many years have passed by without her seeing anyone? Bong. Has it been a hundred and eight tolls of the bell already? It doesn't feel like it — [pc.toughnessRange 70|you're still plenty energetic as it is|all that activity was far less tiring than you thought it would be]. But neither your foxy wife nor your fluffy daughter are revving up the clapper for another strike, so it must be over. You wipe the sweat from your brow, take a few deep breaths, and contemplate the matter in silence. Sure, it was a lot of hard work, and this isn't part of your own culture... but by being here with Kiyoko and Kinu, there's no doubt it's been worth your while. Kinu squirms up against you and tugs at your [pc.armor]. "Look, [pc.PapaMama], look! We made it just in time for the first sunrise of the new year!" She's not wrong. From where you stand, you can see a dull orange glow cresting the treetops, slowly pushing away the inky darkness of the starry night sky. As you watch, transfixed, Kiyoko comes up to your side and melts against your shoulder, draping herself on you with a smile. "Happy new year, [pc.name]. May it be a successful and prosperous one for you." The same for her — and of course, Kinu as well. You reach down and find the spot on Kinu's brow where she likes to be petted, then plant the heel of your palm squarely on it while chasing her ears with your fingers. |"It's just the last stretch; I have perfect confidence in your ability to finish up all one hundred and eight strikes." Well, instead of you taking over wholesale, why don't the two of you ring the bell together? It'd be more fun that way. "Hmm?" So long as it's not dangerous, why not? It's just the last stretch, isn't it? You came here to spend time with your foxy friend here, after all; this'll be better than just staring at each other taking turns at the clapper, right? Kiyoko makes a show of considering the prospect, planting a finger on her chin as she pretends to think deeply. Then, with a small smile, "I guess it can't hurt." So it comes to pass that the both of you return to the bell once more with you taking the front while Kiyoko backs you up from the rear. Affirming your grip on the heavy wooden clapper, the both of you draw it back on its chains and thrust forward to strike the bell cleanly. Bong... The sound is brilliant, far stronger than either of you could possibly have managed on your own; leaves rustle and the air itself shimmers as it travels outward into the night. Your teeth chatter and bones rattle, but the powerful reverberation soon passes, leaving a sense of clarity in the fore of your mind despite your body's protestations. "Again?" Of course. Again. Bong... With two people instead of one, you're far better able to pace yourselves, wood striking bronze at a steady pace to herald the arrival of the new year. The thump the clapper makes against your shoulder as it hits the bell is powerful yet calming, its sense of power lending a solemn air to the proceedings. Kiyoko sure is putting her back into it, too[kiyoko.pregStage 2|, despite how obviously pregnant she is]. You don't often see her openly sweat, but there it is, beads forming on her soft skin despite the cool night air. Judging by the smile on her face, she's enjoying herself... but of course. How many years have passed by without her seeing anyone? Bong... The last strike rings true with a distinctive note of finality, shaking you to the core. At this point, you can't even feel very much of yourself, let alone feel how tired you ought to be; all you're experiencing right now is a strong sense of self-satisfaction as you finally let go of the clapper and let your foxy friend fall into your embrace. Yes, that was much more fun than just going it alone. "Look, [pc.name]," Kiyoko mumbles in your arms. "We finished just in time for the new year, and not a moment too soon." She's right. Making a half-turn and looking over Kiyoko's shoulder, you spy a dull amber glow coming up upon the horizon, cresting the treetops as warmth begins to pour out over this little pocket dimension. Your foxy friend is warm and fluffy against you, and she's not that different a color as the sunrise... ... Ha. Happy new year. "Happy new year to you too, [pc.name]." ] Yep, it's been only a few minutes into the new year, and things are looking up already. "As much as I'd like you to stay longer, I suppose that's not possible, is it? After all, you still have much to do out there." Is she chasing you off? Because it sounds like she's chasing you off. "No, no. Just reminding you not to get too caught up in the moment. I had fun today, [pc.name]... but there's also a whole world out there which requires your attention. I wouldn't want to monopolize your time, after all, and there're other people you need to spend this day with, aren't there?" Well... "Don't argue now. Off you go." Before you can protest, Kiyoko leans in and smooches you lightly on the lips, just the briefest of pecks. "Come visit again soon, okay?" [kiyoko.numKits 1|"Eeee! Come visit again!" You sigh and pet Kinu's ears again. With such a precocious daughter, how could you not? ]"

rows.original: You step up onto the raised porch, making a beeline for the cabin door, but don't get that far. It opens outwards of its own accord, revealing Kiyoko framed in the entrance doorway. The kitsune gives you an elegant, formal bow, and smiles. "Excellent timing, [pc.name]. I'd foreseen your visit today, of course, but even so arriving neither too early nor too late is an art that is hard to perfect." Hey, usually it's you who arrives at the door first, not her. What's the big occasion? "[kiyoko.numKits 1 2|Kinu and I are|The kits and I are|I'm] celebrating the new year today. I'd be honored if you chose to join [kiyoko.numKits 1|us|me] in ushering in yet another year to come." Hmm. No doubt she's seen many, many years during her captivity in this gilded prison of hers. Does she do this every year, or...? Kiyoko's smile turns a little sad, the corners of her eyes crinkling. "Not... not that much before. It seemed rather hollow... half the point of celebrations is other people, after all. But now..." Ah, right. Of course you'll join in the festivities with her[kiyoko.numKits 1 2| and Kinu| and the children]. You take Kiyoko's hand in yours, and let her guide you through the door, down the hallway and to [kiyoko.numKits 0 1 2|the cabin's kitchen. Kiyoko's left a pot of noodle soup over a low fire to simmer, and even at this distance the slightly salty smell is rather appetising. |the cabin's kitchen. rows.raw: " You step up onto the raised porch, making a beeline for the cabin door, but don't get that far. It opens outwards of its own accord, revealing Kiyoko framed in the entrance doorway. The kitsune gives you an elegant, formal bow, and smiles. "Excellent timing, [pc.name]. I'd foreseen your visit today, of course, but even so arriving neither too early nor too late is an art that is hard to perfect." Hey, usually it's you who arrives at the door first, not her. What's the big occasion? "[kiyoko.numKits 1 2|Kinu and I are|The kits and I are|I'm] celebrating the new year today. I'd be honored if you chose to join [kiyoko.numKits 1|us|me] in ushering in yet another year to come." Hmm. No doubt she's seen many, many years during her captivity in this gilded prison of hers. Does she do this every year, or...? Kiyoko's smile turns a little sad, the corners of her eyes crinkling. "Not... not that much before. It seemed rather hollow... half the point of celebrations is other people, after all. But now..." Ah, right. Of course you'll join in the festivities with her[kiyoko.numKits 1 2| and Kinu| and the children]. You take Kiyoko's hand in yours, and let her guide you through the door, down the hallway and to [kiyoko.numKits 0 1 2|the cabin's kitchen. Kiyoko's left a pot of noodle soup over a low fire to simmer, and even at this distance the slightly salty smell is rather appetising. |the cabin's kitchen. Kinu is standing on a stool with a wooden spoon, stirring a steaming pot of noodle soup; as you enter, she sets down the spoon, turns to you and bows deeply, clearly trying not to giggle. "Welcome, [pc.PapaMama]. It's so good that you could join us today." Ah, such a good kid. Hmm, isn't it a little dangerous for her to be tending to the cooking alone, though? Kiyoko gives you a reassuring pat on the shoulder. "Were it any other kit, yes. But you and I know our daughter is perfectly capable of handling herself." |a large dining hall. There, your children are patiently waiting at their tables; they rise and give you a bow as you enter. Up atop a low stove, a large cauldron of steaming noodle soup simmers over a muted fire, spreading a wondrous smell over the entire room. Kinu's tending to the cauldron, stirring the enormous batch of noodle broth with a long ladle and looking very pleased with herself. "That'll do," Kiyoko says, clapping her hands. As one, your children — with the exception of Kinu, of course — take their seats and await to be served. "Now that everyone's here, I think we can begin." ] With that said, Kiyoko steps up to the stove and takes a whiff of the aroma rising from the broth. "Ah, hot soba. It truly brings back memories..." Memories she'd care to share with you? Despite all this time you've been together, she hasn't really gone into her childhood in that much detail. A wan smile. "Maybe in the future. Not today, at least." All right. [kiyoko.numKits 0 1 2|Humming a gentle tune to herself, Kiyoko upends the pot into two bowls, then adds a little garnish in the form of sliced spring onions and dried shrimp. "Shall we eat outside? Your daughter looks up at the two of you with her big ice-blue eyes, clearly seeking approval, then squeals and squirms as she receives it in the form of headpats. But is she sure she wants to do this? "Why not? If I can clear obstacles from your path, the sooner you can get me to Keros and my freedom. Besides, you always come to play with me and gift me your chi, [pc.name]; as repayment, I'll work hard to be useful! Although..." Hmm, yes? Kiyoko smiles sweetly. "...If I do well, I want to be praised and petted some more!" Hah! Well, that's something you can do plenty of right now. All of Kiyoko's tails wag happily as you step up to her and give her a good set of ear scritches, the kitsune leaning in against you with a happy sigh of blissful contentment. There, there. There's a good girl. "Now, there shouldn't be any problems with this. Simply call me through the amulet and I'll come to help, although I can only do it so often." All right, you understand. "Now that that's over with..." Kiyoko says, pulling away from you and giving you a small, formal bow. "...Welcome back, [pc.name]. I missed you. Shall we go in and get settled down?" You thought she'd never ask! You're getting pins and needles in your legs from standing out here on the porch for so long. Laughter. "All right, all right. Let's head on in." With that, Kiyoko leads you through the cabin to the familiarity of the sitting room, and you watch with a fond smile as she goes through the ritual motions of setting out the tea and candies. "So then, what do you want to do today?" From now on, you may use the amulet of union in combat to summon Kiyoko to aid you in a fight as a combat summon. This can only be done once every encounter.

Kiyoko winks at you playfully as she tightens her hug against you. "Notice something about me?" Hmm. Well, it is true, isn't it? She's quite literally growing into motherhood well, isn't she? A trace of color creeps into the kitsune's face. "Well, yes, that much is true. Still, that wasn't the change I was hoping you'd notice..." |You crane your head about the kitsune hugging you and try to get a good look at Kiyoko. Hey, her butt's a little bigger, her hips ever so slightly wider... but the change is so slight, it's probably a trick of the light or something. Besides, even if it were the case, you don't think that's what she's so excited about. ] No, to be honest. Kiyoko pouts, but brightens up again in no time. "It worked! The essence transfer, that is." Um. Well. Congratulations? "No, no. The honors are yours, not mine. I am only the receptacle you poured your chi into... there's something about your life energy that's far more intense than that of anyone else, and it's an honor to be able to receive such a gift from you. "But this isn't the main thrust of what I wish to tell you, [pc.name]. You've been very kind to me, and I wish to repay that kindness. Now that you've gifted me with a bit of your physical essence, I believe I can manifest a projection of myself outside of the orb for a short period of time, like what I told you at the outset of this endeavor." This can only be done once every encounter."

rows.original: As you crest the hill, you're greeted by a familiar shape making a beeline for you at a run. Kinu's short little legs are a blur as she scampers up to you, all three of her tails flowing behind her. Finally coming to a stop by grabbing onto one of your legs, your fluffy daughter pants and sags against you, taking a moment to catch her breath. "Thank the gods I managed to catch you before you made it indoors, [pc.PapaMama]. You might have ruined everything otherwise!" Whoa whoa whoa whoa. Rewind that a moment — what was it that you would've ruined? "Oh! Ehe. Well..." Kinu looks pensive for a second or two, putting her index fingers together and twiddling them as she ponders how best to phrase her words. "Um, today is Mother's Day, you know?" That's... well, you don't really know when that happens in kitsune culture, nor do you have a solid grasp on how time flows in here compared to the waking world. Let's just say you'll take her word for it — what then? "Well... [kiyoko.numKits 2|the other kits and ]I have prepared something pretty neat for her, you know! [kiyoko.numKits 2|We|I]'d just like you to join in and keep it a secret if you can, [pc.PapaMama]!" A surprise for her mother to recognize all the effort she puts into raising them, eh? You can't say you disapprove. It's good that Kinu knows how to show gratitude for all the good things Kiyoko has showered upon her. "Eh..." [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0 |Your daughter's smile fades, replaced by a more serious expression. "I'm only doing what's expected of me as her daughter and heir apparent, that's all. The customs and rites demand as much of me as the firstborn, no more, no less." Hey, why the sudden coldness? She's taking so much responsibility for getting all this together for her mother, and at such a young age, too. "All this? I haven't told you what I had in mind, [pc.PapaMama]." Oh no, she hasn't, but since it's her you know it's going to be good. You have that much trust in her. Kinu sniffs and looks away. "Thanks, [pc.PapaMama]." |Your daughter's smile grows even bigger and brighter. "That's really flattering... I really want to do the best I can for Mama, that's all. She works so hard to raise [kiyoko.numKits 2|us|me] right." Even so, she seems so happy about it. Well, you can't complain about your daughter being on good terms with her mother — here's to hoping it stays that way for a long time to come. Kiyoko must truly mean a lot to her for her to go all this way to preparing a surprise... "Oh? I don't remember telling you what I had in mind. How do you know it's big, [pc.PapaMama]?" With her, you can expect nothing less. "Ehe... you're making me blush..." ] You smile and pat Kinu on the head, which causes your fluffy daughter to squirm appropriately under your touch. All right... what does she need you to do, besides stay out of the way? "We'll be ready in about an hour. I just need you to distract Mama for that long, and lead her to the dining [kiyoko.numKits 8|hall|room] when that time's up. Can you do that for us, [pc.PapaMama]?" Haa... distracting Kiyoko... you can think up a few ideas. All right, she can leave it to you, then. "All right, then, I'll leave it to you!" Kinu bows, and before you know it, she's off as fast as her short little legs can take her, rapidly becoming a dot on the far side of the hill.
rows.translation: 当你爬上山顶时，一个熟悉的身影正笔直地朝你跑来。小娟那双短短的小腿跑得飞快，几乎看不清动作，三条尾巴在身后飘扬。她终于抓住你的一条腿停了下来，你毛茸茸的女儿靠在你身上喘着气，歇了一会儿才缓过来。 “谢天谢地，我赶在你进屋之前拦住了你，[pc.PapaMama]。不然你可能会把一切都搞砸！” 哇哦，等一下——你刚才说是要毁掉什么来着？ “哦！呃，嗯……”小娟沉思了一两秒，把两根食指抵在一起轻轻转着，琢磨着该怎么措辞。“嗯，今天是母亲节，你知道吗？” 那个嘛……其实你并不清楚在狐族的文化中，这种事情究竟会在什么时候发生；同时，你也不太清楚在这里，时间流逝的规律与现实世界相比有何不同。那么，我们就姑且相信她的说法吧——之后又会怎样呢？ “嗯…… [kiyoko.numKits 2|其他孩子们和 ]我为她准备了一些相当不错的东西哦！ [kiyoko.numKits 2|我们|我]只是希望你能加入进来，并且如果可能的话，帮忙保密，[pc.PapaMama]！” 是给妈妈的一个惊喜，好让她看到自己养育孩子的辛苦得到了认可，嗯？你无法说自己不赞成。小娟懂得感激清子给予她的种种好处，这是好事。 呃…… [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0 |你女儿的笑容消失了，取而代之的是一种更加严肃的表情。“我只是在尽一个女儿和法定继承人应尽的本分而已。作为长女，礼法和习俗对我的要求不过如此，不多也不少。” 嘿，怎么突然变得这么冷淡了呢？她这么年轻，却要承担这么多责任，为她的母亲安排这一切，真是太不容易了。 “这一切？我还没告诉你我的打算呢，[pc.PapaMama]。” 哦，她确实没说过，但既然是她，你就知道那一定会很棒。你对她就是有这份信任。 小娟抽了抽鼻子，把目光移开。“谢谢，[pc.PapaMama]。” |你女儿的笑容变得更灿烂、更明亮了。“这真是让我受宠若惊……我只是想为妈妈尽最大的努力而已。她那么辛苦地把 [kiyoko.numKits 2|我们|我] 教养成人。” 即便如此，她看起来还是很开心。嗯，你总不能抱怨自己的女儿和母亲关系这么好吧——但愿这份和睦能长久下去。清子对她来说一定非常重要，否则她不会费这么大功夫去准备一份惊喜…… “哦？我不记得告诉过你我的打算。你怎么知道是件大事呢，[pc.PapaMama]？” 换成是她，这种事自然不在话下。 “呵呵……你让我都脸红了……” ] 你微笑着拍了拍小娟的脑袋，这让你的毛茸茸的女儿在你触碰下忍不住扭动起来。好吧……除了别妨碍她之外，她还需要你做些什么呢？ “我们大约一个小时后就能准备好。我只需要你在那之前拖住妈妈，等时间到了再把她领到[kiyoko.numKits 8|大厅|餐厅]。你能帮我们做到吗，[pc.PapaMama]？” 哈……拖住清子……你倒是能想出些点子。好吧，那这件事就交给你了。 “好吧，那就交给你了！”小娟鞠了一躬，转眼间她就迈着那双小短腿跑得飞快，很快成了远处山丘上的一个小点。
