rows.original: Well, this should be interesting. As always, you step up to the cabin in the shade of the cherry blossom tree, knock on the door, and wait. It isn't long before the familiar sound of Kiyoko's footsteps approaches, and the door swings open; your foxy wife gives you a small [kiyoko.pregStage 2 4 |incline of her head as she greets you with her usual elegance. Laden with a kit-swollen belly, she sure is getting in the spirit of the day whether she knows or not of the surprise Kinu's got planned for her. |nod in greeting, remaining as refined as ever despite her immensely gravid condition. What timing... if Kinu's going to be organising a mother's day celebration today for her, she looks every bit the part. |bow, graceful as ever in her greeting. Looks like she doesn't suspect a thing as to what your daughter's up to. ] "Welcome, [pc.name]," she says in that lovely, lilting voice of hers, ears folding forward. "I'm glad you are able to visit today, it's always a pleasure to receive you. Before we begin, though..." Yes? "Have you seen [kiyoko.numKits 2|the children|Kinu] anywhere? I haven't caught glimpse of head or tail of [kiyoko.numKits 2|them|her] since breakfast, and it's a little concerning.[kiyoko.numKits 8 32 | Usually there're enough of our sons and daughters around that I can always spot one of them if I look hard enough, but it's like they all emptied out of the house and vanished. | I... there's always at least one of them around. Always. And now that there's absolutely no one in the house, I can feel the difference. It's... not a good feeling. ] You wouldn't happen to know where [kiyoko.numKits 2|they've|she's] gone, do you?" No, you don't know where [kiyoko.numKits 2|everyone|Kinu]'s gone off to. Did [kiyoko.numKits 2|they leave their|she leave her] tasks undone before running off to play? Kiyoko frowns. "No... I checked and the chores were all done, and far too early for them to have been completed after breakfast. My ears were twitching when I woke up this morning... I've lived long enough to be able to tell when someone's poised to play a prank on me." Well, maybe she shouldn't worry too much. The Astral Plane will keep [kiyoko.numKits 2|the kits|Kinu] safe; for the moment, she shouldn't allow this to spoil your visit. Your fox-wife tilts her head ever so slightly to the side, a calculating look in her jade-green eyes; [kiyoko.pregStage 2 4 |unthinkingly, her hands wander over to the ripening curves of her pregnant tummy, running over its taut surface |instinctively, her hands wander over to her kit-stuffed tummy and she drums on its full, taut surface with her fingertips as she thinks |they shift from side to side as she chews on her lip, clearly not quite convinced of the whole situation ]. At last, though, she sighs and takes you by the arm, her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] tails sweeping against you as she ushers you into the house. "I guess I'll find out what they're up to eventually. Come along then, [pc.name] — let us make the most of our time together." By now, it's almost a ritual in its own right; she leads you to the sitting room, serves the tea and candies, then the two of you settle in for pleasant conversation. Considering all the excitement that goes on in the waking world, the homely atmosphere is a nice change of pace; Kiyoko is a pleasant and efficient conversationalist as always, and time sure flies when you're talking to her... [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0 |"I wish you were around a little more for Kinu's upbringing," she tells you over a steaming cup of bitter tea. "Don't get me wrong, I know you're here as much as you can be, but sometimes handling her can get rather tiring." Is your daughter causing trouble? "Not trouble as you might call it... more irritation than anything. I don't know why, but she just seems to resent me. Always nosing around the edges, pushing at the boundaries of what's acceptable, testing the limits of my patience. Never anything outright unfilial, but I know passive-aggression when I see it. Doesn't fool me one bit." Well, there's a positive side to it, isn't there? By doing this, isn't Kinu learning to think for herself and becoming independent? She can't take care of her daughter forever, after all, and the more self-sufficient Kinu becomes, the more she'll able to [kiyoko.numKits 4|help shoulder the burden of raising her siblings|stretch her own wings without looking to her mother for guidance]. Kiyoko snorts, her fine features creasing. "Oh, it isn't that. She just wants to aggravate me, I think. Besides... a mother's task is to prepare her children for the day they will no longer need her. After that, I should hope my kits will still want me. One can be independent without going against her mother for no good or apparent reason." |"I wish you were present more often for Kinu's upbringing," Kiyoko informs you over a cup of steaming, bitter tea. "While I know you visit as often as you can, you're missing so many of the little moments that make me smile. They're good on their own, of course, but... it would be nice if you could share in them, too." Kinu's growing up well, isn't she? "Our daughter is almost everything I could ask for, really, so long as that mischievous streak of hers doesn't get out of hand. Refined, elegant, obedient — it's almost scary how much I see of my younger self in her." Well, she is her mother's daughter, after all. Besides, it reflects well on Kiyoko that she's managed to raise such a flawless daughter. "Oh, come now, I wouldn't call Kinu flawless; she can get a little lazy at times. That kind of thinking only serves to swell one's head. But despite that... I do believe that I've done quite a good job, yes." ] How long has it been since the both of you settled down together? An hour? More? Kinu's words prod at your mind... hopefully you haven't held up the proceedings. "Is something the matter, [pc.name]?" Yes. Come to think of it, you'd appreciate it greatly if she could let you taste some more of her lovely cooking. "Oh, don't flatter me..." You grin and cross over to Kiyoko's side of the table, taking her by the shoulders and helping her to her feet. [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |Your kitsune wife squirms and fusses in your grasp, but deigns to allow you to set her upright. "Come on, now. I'm not so pregnant that I can't stand up on my own." Well, she can think of it as more for your benefit than it is for hers. "Ehehe." Kiyoko falls in pace at your side. "I suppose." |点头致意，尽管身怀六甲、肚子大得惊人，她依旧像往常一样端庄。这时机真是再好不过……如果今天小娟要为她操办母亲节的庆祝，她这副模样简直再合适不过了。 |鞠躬致意，一如既往地优雅。看来她对你女儿在筹划什么毫不知情。 ] “欢迎你，[pc.name]，”她用那甜美悦耳的嗓音说道，耳朵向前垂着。“很高兴你今天能来，能接待你总是件愉快的事。不过在我们开始之前……” 嗯？ “你见过 [kiyoko.numKits 2|孩子们|小娟] 吗？从早餐之后我就没见过[kiyoko.numKits 2|他们|她]的影子，也没听到半点动静，有点让人担心。[kiyoko.numKits 8 32 | 平常家里总会有足够多的儿女在，只要我仔细找，总能发现其中一个。可今天他们好像全都从家里清空了一样，消失得无影无踪。 | 我……家里总该至少有那么一个在。总是如此。而现在屋子里一个人都没有，我能感觉到那种差别。那感觉……很不好。 ] 你该不会正好知道[kiyoko.numKits 2|他们|她]去了哪里吧？” 不，你并不知道[kiyoko.numKits 2|大家|小娟]跑到哪儿去了。[kiyoko.numKits 2|他们是不是把|她是不是把]手上的活儿丢下就跑出去玩了？ 清子皱起眉头。“不……我查过了，家务全都做完了，而且是在早餐后没多久就全部做完的，快得不正常。今天早上醒来时我的耳朵一直在抖……我活得够久了，能分辨出什么时候有人正准备捉弄我。” 嗯，也许她不必太担心。星界会保护[kiyoko.numKits 2|孩子们|小娟]的安全；眼下，她不该让这件事破坏了你的来访。 你那位狐妖妻子把头微微偏向一侧，翡翠色的眼中闪过一丝算计；[kiyoko.pregStage 2 4 |她下意识地把手移到孕肚日渐圆润的曲线上，抚过那绷紧的表面 |她本能地把手移到装满孩子的肚子上，一边思考，一边用指尖在那饱满紧绷的表面敲着 |她咬着嘴唇，目光左右游移，显然对整个情况还不太确信 ]。最后，她还是叹了口气，挽起你的手臂，[kiyoko.kiyokoTails] 条尾巴扫过你，把你领进屋里。 “我想我迟早会弄清他们在搞什么名堂。那就来吧，[pc.name]——让我们好好享受在一起的时光。” 到了现在，这几乎已经成了一种固定的仪式：她把你领到客厅，端上茶和糖果，然后你们两人坐下来愉快地聊天。想想醒着的世界里那些纷纷扰扰，这种居家的氛围倒是种不错的调剂；清子和往常一样，是个愉快而高效的谈话对象，和她说话时时间总是过得飞快…… [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0 |“我希望你能多陪陪小娟的成长，”她端着一杯热气腾腾的苦茶对你说。“别误会，我知道你已经尽可能多地来了，但有时候应付她真的很累人。” 你的女儿在惹麻烦吗？ “算不上你所说的麻烦……更像是让人恼火。我不知道为什么，但她似乎就是怨恨我。总在边缘试探，不断挑战可接受的界限，试探我耐心的极限。她从来没有做出真正不孝的事，但我看得出什么是消极对抗。这骗不了我。” 嗯，这件事也有好的一面，不是吗？这样做，小娟不就是在学会独立思考、变得独立吗？毕竟她不可能永远照顾自己的女儿，而小娟越能自给自足，她就越能 [kiyoko.numKits 4|帮忙分担抚养弟妹的重担|展开自己的翅膀，不再事事向母亲寻求指引]。 清子哼了一声，精致的五官皱了起来。“哦，不是那样的。我觉得她只是想惹我生气罢了。再说……母亲的任务就是让孩子做好准备，迎接他们不再需要她的那一天。在那之后，我希望我的孩子们依然想要我。一个人可以独立，而不必毫无明显理由地与母亲作对。” |“我希望你能更多地参与小娟的成长，”清子端着一杯热气腾腾的苦茶告诉你。“虽然我知道你已经尽可能常来了，但你还是错过了很多让我微笑的小瞬间。它们本身当然很好，不过……如果你也能一起分享，那就更好了。” 小娟现在成长得很好，不是吗？ “我们的女儿几乎满足了我所有的期望，真的——只要她那份调皮劲儿别太过分。文雅、端庄、听话——在她身上看到那么多年轻时的自己，几乎有点吓人。” 嗯，她毕竟是她母亲的女儿。再说，能养出这样一个无可挑剔的女儿，也正说明清子做得好。 “哦，别这么说，我可不会说小娟毫无缺点；她有时候也会犯懒。那种想法只会让人头脑发胀。但尽管如此……我确实觉得自己做得相当不错，没错。” ] 你们俩一起坐下来多久了？一个小时？更久？小娟的话在你脑中敲打……但愿你没有耽误了正事。 “出什么事了吗，[pc.name]？” 是的。说起来，如果她能再让你尝尝她做的美味佳肴，你会非常感激。 “哦，别夸我了……” 你咧嘴一笑，绕到清子那一侧的桌边，扶住她的肩膀，帮她站起来。 [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |你那位狐妖妻子在你手里扭动、嘟囔着，但最终还是允许你把她扶正。 “行了，行了。我还没那么怀孕，连自己站起来都不行。” 嗯，她可以把这当成是为了你好，而不是为了她自己。 “嘿嘿。”清子跟在你身边，步伐一致。“大概吧。” 真是爱闹，不是吗？ |她的大肚子让这件事比本该的更难一些，但到了这个地步，这份重量她早已习惯。 “啊，谢谢你，”你那位狐妖妻子在你身边摇摇摆摆地走着，叹了口气。 嘿，是你把那个又大又健康的孩子放进了她肚子里；扶她一把是起码的。 |你那位狐妖妻子被宠着时有点小别扭，用尾巴调皮地拍打你，但还是接受了你的帮助，在你身边慢慢小跑起来。 真是活泼，不是吗？ ] 快点，该出发了。 “你想一起来吗？” 你不会否认，看着她干活实在赏心悦目。一位优雅、有教养的 [kiyoko.pregStage 1|——而且最重要的是，怀着孕——]女子熟练地烹饪食物，总有种让人安心的东西。 “如果你这么说的话，亲爱的。如果你这么说的话。”
rows.raw: " Well, this should be interesting. As always, you step up to the cabin in the shade of the cherry blossom tree, knock on the door, and wait. It isn't long before the familiar sound of Kiyoko's footsteps approaches, and the door swings open; your foxy wife gives you a small [kiyoko.pregStage 2 4 |incline of her head as she greets you with her usual elegance. Laden with a kit-swollen belly, she sure is getting in the spirit of the day whether she knows or not of the surprise Kinu's got planned for her. |nod in greeting, remaining as refined as ever despite her immensely gravid condition. What timing... if Kinu's going to be organising a mother's day celebration today for her, she looks every bit the part. |bow, graceful as ever in her greeting. Looks like she doesn't suspect a thing as to what your daughter's up to. ] "Welcome, [pc.name]," she says in that lovely, lilting voice of hers, ears folding forward. "I'm glad you are able to visit today, it's always a pleasure to receive you. Before we begin, though..." Yes? "Have you seen [kiyoko.numKits 2|the children|Kinu] anywhere? I haven't caught glimpse of head or tail of [kiyoko.numKits 2|them|her] since breakfast, and it's a little concerning.[kiyoko.numKits 8 32 | Usually there're enough of our sons and daughters around that I can always spot one of them if I look hard enough, but it's like they all emptied out of the house and vanished. | I... there's always at least one of them around. Always. And now that there's absolutely no one in the house, I can feel the difference. It's... not a good feeling. ] You wouldn't happen to know where [kiyoko.numKits 2|they've|she's] gone, do you?" No, you don't know where [kiyoko.numKits 2|everyone|Kinu]'s gone off to. Did [kiyoko.numKits 2|they leave their|she leave her] tasks undone before running off to play? Kiyoko frowns. "No... I checked and the chores were all done, and far too early for them to have been completed after breakfast. My ears were twitching when I woke up this morning... I've lived long enough to be able to tell when someone's poised to play a prank on me." Well, maybe she shouldn't worry too much. The Astral Plane will keep [kiyoko.numKits 2|the kits|Kinu] safe; for the moment, she shouldn't allow this to spoil your visit. Your fox-wife tilts her head ever so slightly to the side, a calculating look in her jade-green eyes; [kiyoko.pregStage 2 4 |unthinkingly, her hands wander over to the ripening curves of her pregnant tummy, running over its taut surface |instinctively, her hands wander over to her kit-stuffed tummy and she drums on its full, taut surface with her fingertips as she thinks |they shift from side to side as she chews on her lip, clearly not quite convinced of the whole situation ]. At last, though, she sighs and takes you by the arm, her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] tails sweeping against you as she ushers you into the house. "I guess I'll find out what they're up to eventually. Come along then, [pc.name] — let us make the most of our time together." By now, it's almost a ritual in its own right; she leads you to the sitting room, serves the tea and candies, then the two of you settle in for pleasant conversation. Considering all the excitement that goes on in the waking world, the homely atmosphere is a nice change of pace; Kiyoko is a pleasant and efficient conversationalist as always, and time sure flies when you're talking to her... [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0 |"I wish you were around a little more for Kinu's upbringing," she tells you over a steaming cup of bitter tea. "Don't get me wrong, I know you're here as much as you can be, but sometimes handling her can get rather tiring." Is your daughter causing trouble? "Not trouble as you might call it... more irritation than anything. I don't know why, but she just seems to resent me. Always nosing around the edges, pushing at the boundaries of what's acceptable, testing the limits of my patience. Never anything outright unfilial, but I know passive-aggression when I see it. Doesn't fool me one bit." Well, there's a positive side to it, isn't there? By doing this, isn't Kinu learning to think for herself and becoming independent? She can't take care of her daughter forever, after all, and the more self-sufficient Kinu becomes, the more she'll able to [kiyoko.numKits 4|help shoulder the burden of raising her siblings|stretch her own wings without looking to her mother for guidance]. Kiyoko snorts, her fine features creasing. "Oh, it isn't that. She just wants to aggravate me, I think. Besides... a mother's task is to prepare her children for the day they will no longer need her. After that, I should hope my kits will still want me. One can be independent without going against her mother for no good or apparent reason." |"I wish you were present more often for Kinu's upbringing," Kiyoko informs you over a cup of steaming, bitter tea. "While I know you visit as often as you can, you're missing so many of the little moments that make me smile. They're good on their own, of course, but... it would be nice if you could share in them, too." Kinu's growing up well, isn't she? "Our daughter is almost everything I could ask for, really, so long as that mischievous streak of hers doesn't get out of hand. Refined, elegant, obedient — it's almost scary how much I see of my younger self in her." Well, she is her mother's daughter, after all. Besides, it reflects well on Kiyoko that she's managed to raise such a flawless daughter. "Oh, come now, I wouldn't call Kinu flawless; she can get a little lazy at times. That kind of thinking only serves to swell one's head. But despite that... I do believe that I've done quite a good job, yes." ] How long has it been since the both of you settled down together? An hour? More? Kinu's words prod at your mind... hopefully you haven't held up the proceedings. "Is something the matter, [pc.name]?" Yes. Come to think of it, you'd appreciate it greatly if she could let you taste some more of her lovely cooking. "Oh, don't flatter me..." You grin and cross over to Kiyoko's side of the table, taking her by the shoulders and helping her to her feet. [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |Your kitsune wife squirms and fusses in your grasp, but deigns to allow you to set her upright. "Come on, now. I'm not so pregnant that I can't stand up on my own." Well, she can think of it as more for your benefit than it is for hers. "Ehehe." Kiyoko falls in pace at your side. "I suppose." Playful, isn't she? |Her big belly makes it a little harder than it ought to be, but the weight is something she's used to at this point. "Aah, thank you," your kitsune wife sighs as she settles into a waddle at your side. Hey, you put that big, healthy kit inside of her belly; it's the least you can do to help her around. |Your kitsune wife fusses a little at being pampered, playfully batting at you with her tails, but accepts the help and settles into a slow trot beside you. Frisky, isn't she? ] Come on, it's time to go. "You'd like to come along?" You won't deny it, watching her at work is a sight for sore eyes. There's just something about an elegant, cultured [kiyoko.pregStage 1|— and above all, pregnant — ]woman expertly preparing food that's calming to the nerves. "If you say so, my dear. If you say so.""

rows.original: Out of the sitting room, down the hallway to the back of the tree. It's just silence, your footsteps echoing down across wood the only sounds as you approach the entrance to the dining [kiyoko.numKits 8|hall|room]. It gets to the point where you wonder if Kinu was playing a prank on you, if there's going to be nothing waiting for you when you arrive — — Such doubts are pushed aside when you push aside the screen door and step in. There, [kiyoko.numKits 2 8 16 32 |Kinu stands at the fore of the table facing the door, bowing deeply as the two of you enter. Her siblings are seated at the table, fidgeting a little but otherwise well-behaved for the occasion. Small as she might be, Kinu has summoned up all the gravitas and solemnity her eight-year-old self can muster, as befits her position as firstborn daughter — a miniature majordomo to her mother. |Kinu stands at the fore of the head table, bowing deeply as the two of you enter. She's positioned all of her numerous siblings at the other tables, already set and waiting your arrival; they follow their eldest sister's lead in greeting the two of you. Being able to wrangle her naturally mischievous siblings like that... sheesh, your little daughter feels a lot more grown-up already, even if she doesn't look it at all. |a small army of foxen floofs stand to greet you, seated at the numerous tables laid out along the walls. Seeing all these kits... did you really impregnate Kiyoko that many times? Sure, you've seen your kits running around here and there, but for them to all be in the same place... Kiyoko certainly deserves to be honored here. Kinu stands at the fore of the head table, bowing deeply as the both of you make your entrance, her petite frame standing out against the multitude of her many siblings. |a veritable horde of kitsune kits await, seated at the numerous tables laid out in the hall. Your breath catches in your throat — sure, you knew you'd sired plenty of children on Kiyoko, but seeing them all in the same place at once is staggering. Fur ranging in color from white to black to gold to red and gray and even more turns the dining hall into a sea of color, and even though they fidget uncomfortably all of the kits are reasonably well-behaved for the occasion. Boys and girls, big and small, rowdy and quiet, every single one of them emerged from Kiyoko's womb at some point, born from your union with her. If anyone deserves to be honored on Mother's Day and given recognition for the work she's done in the name of motherhood, it's your lovely fox-wife. Kinu's standing at the fore of the head table, her many, many siblings behind her. For everything else that she is, your firstborn daughter sure knows how to take charge when her mother's not around. |Kinu awaits at the fore of the table facing the door, your daughter having summoned up all the solemnity and gravitas an eight-year-old can muster. ] She holds a silken bouquet of carnations in her hands, and standing on tiptoe, presents it gracefully and formally to Kiyoko. Her words sound overly stiff and formal, but perhaps that's how it's supposed to be between kitsune. Your firstborn daughter bows again, eyes closed, ears folded forward against her head, a clearly submissive position in front of her mother's authority. "Mother, [kiyoko.numKits 2|we are|I am] thankful for all your kindness. Today is a Mother's Day present from [kiyoko.numKits 2|us|me] to you. [kiyoko.numKits 2|On behalf of us all|With my deepest sincerity], allow me to wish for good health and a long, meaningful life for you. "Please, always be [kiyoko.numKits 2|our|my] beloved mother." Kiyoko stands over her daughter, her expression carefully neutral, her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] tails gathered about herself. In this moment and at this time, it strikes you how absolutely and incredibly beautiful your fox-wife can be when she chooses to project such airs; even the simplest and smallest of her movements speaks of refinement and elegance. Reaching down, Kiyoko plucks the bouquet of carnations from Kinu's hands, then takes a step back to study the gift. [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0 |It feels like forever before Kiyoko responds, but she eventually dips her head in her daughter's direction. "You have my thanks." Kinu doesn't have a reply, instead tilting her gaze to the side and away from her mother. There's a sense of awkwardness there, and then your daughter falls back on etiquette and decorum to save the situation, giving her mother another deep bow. "That will do." Pressing the bouquet close to her with her left hand, Kiyoko reaches down with her right and pats Kinu on the head, right in the space between her ears. Kinu squirms uncomfortably, grinding the balls of her feet into the ground, not daring to look her mother in the eye. |After what feels like an eternity, your kitsune wife breaks into a small smile. "Please, don't stand on ceremony." At those words, Kinu leans forward and encompasses her mother in a great big hug. [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |Her little arms press into the sides of Kiyoko's swollen belly as she stands on tiptoe, trying to reach around her mother — and failing quite miserably and comically at it. |There's no way her little arms can hope to reach all the way around to Kiyoko's back, so she contents with nuzzling into her mother's big pregnant belly, pressing her hands against the sides. |She has to stand on tiptoe to reach around Kiyoko's waist, but the effort is definitely worth it. ] Kiyoko returns the gesture, wrapping an arm about Kinu's shoulders while her other hand reaches to scratch between her daughter's ears. "Such an obedient child you are," she whispers, her voice choking up. "You, too... please always be my beloved firstborn.[kiyoko.numKits 2| And you all... my children, too.] The day will eventually come when you will not need me, but I hope I will have dispensed with my responsibilities well enough that you will still want me after that." ] "I will see to the final preparations. Please, Mother, [pc.mf|Father|Mother], take your seats." At that, Kinu withdraws, soft white tails swishing behind her as she makes for the kitchen. [kiyoko.numKits 4 |Two of her siblings detach themselves from their table, ushering Kiyoko and you towards the seats of honor in this little event. |Well, it looks like this is where you come in. Taking your beautiful fox-wife by the hand, you guide her towards the seat of honor in this little event. ] [kiyoko.pregStage 3 |It's a little amusing how her big, pregnant tummy gets in between her and the tabletop, requiring a bit of shifting and squeezing, but this probably isn't the time to be teasing her about it. This is her day, after all. |She slides into her seat, every bit as fine and regal as befits a woman of her station. This is her day, after all... it's very fitting that she looks the part of a fine mother in front of her children. ] Once she's settled in, Kiyoko lets out a little sigh of contentment and sets the bouquet to one side of the table. "Well, this is a pleasant surprise." You lean in and give your fox-wife a quick peck on the cheek. [kiyoko.numKits 2|The children|Kinu] must love her a lot to have gone to all this trouble for her — she's an excellent mother, and this is the day for her to be recognized. Why should it be a surprise in any way? She mulls over that. "I don't suppose you would've had any hand in all this, would you?" You? Oh no, perish the thought. With you having no idea how exactly time flows in the Astral Plane, you certainly wouldn't have any way to effectively plan something of this scale with [kiyoko.numKits 2|the kits|Kinu], right? No, all the credit goes to [kiyoko.numKits 2|them|her] for pulling it off. [kinu.kinuChildPersonality |Kiyoko sighs and contrives to look contemplative. "It's not that I don't like the proceedings, but... I do wish our daughter could be more like this in her daily life. More filial and obedient, if nothing else. Today will be today, and tomorrow she'll be back to her old self, I can tell you as much. Flowers are beautiful and all, but the greatest present she could have given me for today would be fewer gray hairs over the next year." She can't have fewer gray hairs if she doesn't have any to begin with. Your fox-wife rolls her eyes and bats at you with one of her many tails. "Please be serious for a moment. I do worry for our daughter's future if she's going to continue like this — I can already see the trouble I'm going to have finding a suitable husband-consort for her." She's growing away from her mother, becoming independent. The process began the moment she was conceived, and has only picked up in pace ever since. Kiyoko doesn't look happy at all with that answer, but that train of thought is stopped cold by Kinu returning on the scene. |Kiyoko sighs and hugs herself, looking very, very pleased as she makes herself comfortable. "Credit's where credit's due; I'm enjoying every moment of this. Kinu is already such a pleasant child... for her to have the resourcefulness to mastermind such a surprise makes me feel all giggly inside. I wonder which side of the family she gets that from?" You'd like to think it's a combination of both your better halves. "Ah, being diplomatic, are we?" Just calling the facts as you see them. "If you say so. A child like this is a pleasant dream for a parent... I know from experience how much worse Kinu could be. Going on like this, she'll have a bright future ahead of her — if nothing else, I won't have any trouble finding a suitable husband-consort for her." Thinking that far ahead already, huh? "Kits... they grow up fast. Trust me — today she's but at your waist, tomorrow she'll be sneaking out to meet with boys in secret. My sisters used to do that all the time..." You would've said more, but that conversation is stopped cold by Kinu returning on the scene. ] Your firstborn daughter struggles under the burden of a tray piled almost comically high with food, standing on tiptoe to be able to properly present it to Kiyoko. After setting it down on the table, she steps back a respectful distance, awaiting her mother's appraisal of her offerings. Your fox-wife sniffs each of the covered crockeries daintily in turn. "Hmm. Kitsune udon, inarizushi, amazake... your know your mother's preferences well, don't you, girl?" "It wouldn't do to serve you something you disliked on the day meant to honor you, Mother." "Mm. Such a thoughtful child. Why kenchin soup, though? Isn't that your preference?" "It is, Mother. But..." "Yes?" "It's also the first thing I remember you making for me." "Ah." Kiyoko closes her eyes, her bosom heaving as she draws a deep breath and lets it out slowly. "Well then, that only leaves me to wonder how you managed to work in the kitchen without me noticing. If it were any other kit, I would've been concerned about you being too young to do anything involving fire, but..." "Mother has gone to great lengths to teach me well."[kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0| She may say that, but you can hear the strain in Kinu's voice as she forces the words forth...] "Well, then." A quiet click as your fox-wife picks up her chopsticks. "I shall begin. Please, serve your [pc.mf|father|mother][kiyoko.numKits 2| and your siblings, too]. This will be sufficient." Kinu disappears without a sound, and returns shortly after with a similar tray, sliding it onto the table. "For you, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. Please continue to make Mother happy for as long as the two of you live." Ah... of course. "I will take my leave, then.[kiyoko.numKits 2| There are others who need to be served.]" As Kinu departs, Kiyoko gives you a sidelong glance, then sets down her chopsticks and smiles. "I suppose I should thank you too, [pc.name]" Why? This is her day, not yours. "Well, without you, I wouldn't have had the opportunity to be a mother, would I? Without you and your delectable chi to make kits with, I wouldn't be sitting here today with the people I love... [kiyoko.numKits 2 8 16 32 |our kits, and you, of course. This short time has been far better to me than the eternity that I spent alone; how could I not be grateful to you for making all this possible? |our big family. Isn't this just amazing? But even so, it's not a dream I want to wake from, not when there's so much living to be had. |even if life with our daughter has had its good and bad days alike, I don't regret having gone through any of this. My existence feels so much fuller for it. ]" Now isn't that cute. You pat Kiyoko on the head, feeling the comfortable warmth of her body, then sigh. Come on, it's best to tuck into the food before it gets cold.[kiyoko.numKits 2| See, even the children are eating already. There'll be time for talk later.] "Yes, you're right. Not just the food in and of itself, but also being able to share it with your beautiful fox-wife and the family you made with her. With all the effort Kinu's put in, you can't help but feel a little guilty at not having prepared anything for the occasion. Sure, you had no way of knowing the day without someone telling you, but even so... Kiyoko finishes off the last of the inarizushi before leaning over and whispering, a little giggle escaping her lips. "I suppose there's something you can do for me if you really want to..." Oh? [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |"Yes." Her smile turns upwards at the corners, becoming downright playful — or at least, it's best interpreted as playful. "This year may come and go, but there's always mother's day next year, isn't there? If you can just promise me that next year's celebrations will surpass this year's... I'll be satisfied." |"Mm-hm." Kiyoko's smile widens and turns mischievous as she leans back in her chair, pushing her huge pregnant belly out as far as it'll go. "Our kit will be born soon... but after that, who's to say you can't give me another? Mother's day will come around again next year... perhaps we should make the celebrations more grandiose than this year's? It's a goal to work towards to..." |"Oh, of course." Not right now, of course... but there's always your next visit, when we can get some time alone. There'll be time for such desires later. "Ehehe." Bit by bit, the two of you finish your meal. When it's finally all gone, Kiyoko wipes her mouth daintily and sighs, utterly content. Was it that good? "I'm finding myself wishing I could just laze around every day and leave everything to our daughter... but of course, we know where that ends up. There is intrinsic value to work. At this point, Kinu slides in by your side, removing the empty dishes — she sure can move silently when she's got the mind to. 清子吃完最后一块稻荷寿司，然后凑过来低声耳语，唇边漏出一丝轻笑。“我想，如果你真的愿意的话，总有办法为我做点什么……” 哦？ [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |“是的。”她的嘴角上扬，露出十足顽皮的笑容——至少，这样理解最恰当。“今年或许会过去，但明年总还会有母亲节，对吧？只要你向我保证，明年的庆祝会比今年更盛大……我就满足了。” |“嗯。”清子的笑容绽开，变得顽皮起来，她向后靠进椅子，把巨大的孕肚尽可能往外挺。“我们的孩子很快就会出生……不过在那之后，谁说你不能再给我一个呢？明年母亲节还会再来……也许我们该把庆祝办得比今年更隆重一些？这也是个值得努力的目标啊……” |“哦，当然。”她的笑容绽得更开，越发像狐狸，她侧过身蹭着你。“你可以提醒我一下，我当初是怎么变成现在这样的。就当这是份母亲节礼物吧。当然，不是现在……不过下次你来的时候，我们总能找时间独处。我想再看到这个平坦的肚子变得又大又圆；你知道的，明年母亲节还会再来。为什么不让它比今年更像个大日子呢？” ] 现在安静一会儿。以后还有时间去满足这些愿望的。 “嘿嘿。” 你们俩慢慢地吃完了饭。当所有的食物都被吃完后，清子优雅地擦了擦嘴，然后叹了口气，显得非常满足。 真的有那么好吃吗？ “我有时候真希望能每天无所事事，把所有事情都交给我们的女儿……但当然，我们知道那样最终会是什么下场。工作本身自有其价值。不过，能休息一天并得到家人的感激，也确实很美好。” 她理应得到这一切。 “嗯……” 这时，小娟悄然滑到你身边，收走空盘子——她下定决心时行动确实能无声无息。桌子清理干净后，你的狐妖女儿清了清嗓子，再次鞠躬。 “谢谢您，母亲。也谢谢[pc.mf|父亲|母亲]让母亲开心。今天余下的时间里，我还为您准备了一些别的消遣，如果您愿意的话……” “啊。稍等，我得先送送你[pc.mf|父亲|母亲]。”你的狐妖妻子转向你。“那么，谢谢你陪在我身边、参与这一切；考虑到我们经历过的种种，这对我意义重大。我想今天剩下的时间我会过得很愉快。” 她是想让你尽可能多留一会儿吗？ “我想这样就够了；我宁愿你自愿离开，而不是被强行带走。我们可不想在这个场合留下不愉快，对吧？你已经做得够多了，而且你以后还会再来的，不是吗？” 嗯，如果那是她想要的。在这一天，你绝不会拒绝你心爱的狐妖妻子。 清子又凑过来，在你脸颊上轻啄一下[kiyoko.numKits 4|，引来聚集的小狐狸们一阵咯咯笑声]。 “下次再见吧，[pc.name]。”
rows.raw: " Out of the sitting room, down the hallway to the back of the tree. It's just silence, your footsteps echoing down across wood the only sounds as you approach the entrance to the dining [kiyoko.numKits 8|hall|room]. It gets to the point where you wonder if Kinu was playing a prank on you, if there's going to be nothing waiting for you when you arrive — — Such doubts are pushed aside when you push aside the screen door and step in. There, [kiyoko.numKits 2 8 16 32 |Kinu stands at the fore of the table facing the door, bowing deeply as the two of you enter. Her siblings are seated at the table, fidgeting a little but otherwise well-behaved for the occasion. Small as she might be, Kinu has summoned up all the gravitas and solemnity her eight-year-old self can muster, as befits her position as firstborn daughter — a miniature majordomo to her mother. |Kinu stands at the fore of the head table, bowing deeply as the two of you enter. She's positioned all of her numerous siblings at the other tables, already set and waiting your arrival; they follow their eldest sister's lead in greeting the two of you. Being able to wrangle her naturally mischievous siblings like that... sheesh, your little daughter feels a lot more grown-up already, even if she doesn't look it at all. |a small army of foxen floofs stand to greet you, seated at the numerous tables laid out along the walls. Seeing all these kits... did you really impregnate Kiyoko that many times? Sure, you've seen your kits running around here and there, but for them to all be in the same place... Kiyoko certainly deserves to be honored here. Kinu stands at the fore of the head table, bowing deeply as the both of you make your entrance, her petite frame standing out against the multitude of her many siblings. |a veritable horde of kitsune kits await, seated at the numerous tables laid out in the hall. Your breath catches in your throat — sure, you knew you'd sired plenty of children on Kiyoko, but seeing them all in the same place at once is staggering. Fur ranging in color from white to black to gold to red and gray and even more turns the dining hall into a sea of color, and even though they fidget uncomfortably all of the kits are reasonably well-behaved for the occasion. Boys and girls, big and small, rowdy and quiet, every single one of them emerged from Kiyoko's womb at some point, born from your union with her. If anyone deserves to be honored on Mother's Day and given recognition for the work she's done in the name of motherhood, it's your lovely fox-wife. Kinu's standing at the fore of the head table, her many, many siblings behind her. For everything else that she is, your firstborn daughter sure knows how to take charge when her mother's not around. |Kinu awaits at the fore of the table facing the door, your daughter having summoned up all the solemnity and gravitas an eight-year-old can muster. ] She holds a silken bouquet of carnations in her hands, and standing on tiptoe, presents it gracefully and formally to Kiyoko. Her words sound overly stiff and formal, but perhaps that's how it's supposed to be between kitsune. Your firstborn daughter bows again, eyes closed, ears folded forward against her head, a clearly submissive position in front of her mother's authority. "Mother, [kiyoko.numKits 2|we are|I am] thankful for all your kindness. Today is a Mother's Day present from [kiyoko.numKits 2|us|me] to you. [kiyoko.numKits 2|On behalf of us all|With my deepest sincerity], allow me to wish for good health and a long, meaningful life for you. "Please, always be [kiyoko.numKits 2|our|my] beloved mother." Kiyoko stands over her daughter, her expression carefully neutral, her [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] tails gathered about herself. In this moment and at this time, it strikes you how absolutely and incredibly beautiful your fox-wife can be when she chooses to project such airs; even the simplest and smallest of her movements speaks of refinement and elegance. Reaching down, Kiyoko plucks the bouquet of carnations from Kinu's hands, then takes a step back to study the gift. [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0 |It feels like forever before Kiyoko responds, but she eventually dips her head in her daughter's direction. "You have my thanks." Kinu doesn't have a reply, instead tilting her gaze to the side and away from her mother. There's a sense of awkwardness there, and then your daughter falls back on etiquette and decorum to save the situation, giving her mother another deep bow. "That will do." Pressing the bouquet close to her with her left hand, Kiyoko reaches down with her right and pats Kinu on the head, right in the space between her ears. Kinu squirms uncomfortably, grinding the balls of her feet into the ground, not daring to look her mother in the eye. |After what feels like an eternity, your kitsune wife breaks into a small smile. "Please, don't stand on ceremony." At those words, Kinu leans forward and encompasses her mother in a great big hug. [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |Her little arms press into the sides of Kiyoko's swollen belly as she stands on tiptoe, trying to reach around her mother — and failing quite miserably and comically at it. |There's no way her little arms can hope to reach all the way around to Kiyoko's back, so she contents with nuzzling into her mother's big pregnant belly, pressing her hands against the sides. |She has to stand on tiptoe to reach around Kiyoko's waist, but the effort is definitely worth it. ] Kiyoko returns the gesture, wrapping an arm about Kinu's shoulders while her other hand reaches to scratch between her daughter's ears. "Such an obedient child you are," she whispers, her voice choking up. "You, too... please always be my beloved firstborn.[kiyoko.numKits 2| And you all... my children, too.] The day will eventually come when you will not need me, but I hope I will have dispensed with my responsibilities well enough that you will still want me after that." ] "I will see to the final preparations. Please, Mother, [pc.mf|Father|Mother], take your seats." At that, Kinu withdraws, soft white tails swishing behind her as she makes for the kitchen. [kiyoko.numKits 4 |Two of her siblings detach themselves from their table, ushering Kiyoko and you towards the seats of honor in this little event. |Well, it looks like this is where you come in. Taking your beautiful fox-wife by the hand, you guide her towards the seat of honor in this little event. ] [kiyoko.pregStage 3 |It's a little amusing how her big, pregnant tummy gets in between her and the tabletop, requiring a bit of shifting and squeezing, but this probably isn't the time to be teasing her about it. This is her day, after all. |She slides into her seat, every bit as fine and regal as befits a woman of her station. This is her day, after all... it's very fitting that she looks the part of a fine mother in front of her children. ] Once she's settled in, Kiyoko lets out a little sigh of contentment and sets the bouquet to one side of the table. "Well, this is a pleasant surprise." You lean in and give your fox-wife a quick peck on the cheek. [kiyoko.numKits 2|The children|Kinu] must love her a lot to have gone to all this trouble for her — she's an excellent mother, and this is the day for her to be recognized. Why should it be a surprise in any way? She mulls over that. "I don't suppose you would've had any hand in all this, would you?" You? Oh no, perish the thought. With you having no idea how exactly time flows in the Astral Plane, you certainly wouldn't have any way to effectively plan something of this scale with [kiyoko.numKits 2|the kits|Kinu], right? No, all the credit goes to [kiyoko.numKits 2|them|her] for pulling it off. [kinu.kinuChildPersonality |Kiyoko sighs and contrives to look contemplative. "It's not that I don't like the proceedings, but... I do wish our daughter could be more like this in her daily life. More filial and obedient, if nothing else. Today will be today, and tomorrow she'll be back to her old self, I can tell you as much. Flowers are beautiful and all, but the greatest present she could have given me for today would be fewer gray hairs over the next year." She can't have fewer gray hairs if she doesn't have any to begin with. Your fox-wife rolls her eyes and bats at you with one of her many tails. "Please be serious for a moment. I do worry for our daughter's future if she's going to continue like this — I can already see the trouble I'm going to have finding a suitable husband-consort for her." She's growing away from her mother, becoming independent. The process began the moment she was conceived, and has only picked up in pace ever since. Kiyoko doesn't look happy at all with that answer, but that train of thought is stopped cold by Kinu returning on the scene. |Kiyoko sighs and hugs herself, looking very, very pleased as she makes herself comfortable. "Credit's where credit's due; I'm enjoying every moment of this. Kinu is already such a pleasant child... for her to have the resourcefulness to mastermind such a surprise makes me feel all giggly inside. I wonder which side of the family she gets that from?" You'd like to think it's a combination of both your better halves. "Ah, being diplomatic, are we?" Just calling the facts as you see them. "If you say so. A child like this is a pleasant dream for a parent... I know from experience how much worse Kinu could be. Going on like this, she'll have a bright future ahead of her — if nothing else, I won't have any trouble finding a suitable husband-consort for her." Thinking that far ahead already, huh? "Kits... they grow up fast. Trust me — today she's but at your waist, tomorrow she'll be sneaking out to meet with boys in secret. My sisters used to do that all the time..." You would've said more, but that conversation is stopped cold by Kinu returning on the scene. ] Your firstborn daughter struggles under the burden of a tray piled almost comically high with food, standing on tiptoe to be able to properly present it to Kiyoko. After setting it down on the table, she steps back a respectful distance, awaiting her mother's appraisal of her offerings. Your fox-wife sniffs each of the covered crockeries daintily in turn. "Hmm. Kitsune udon, inarizushi, amazake... your know your mother's preferences well, don't you, girl?" "It wouldn't do to serve you something you disliked on the day meant to honor you, Mother." "Mm. Such a thoughtful child. Why kenchin soup, though? Isn't that your preference?" "It is, Mother. But..." "Yes?" "It's also the first thing I remember you making for me." "Ah." Kiyoko closes her eyes, her bosom heaving as she draws a deep breath and lets it out slowly. "Well then, that only leaves me to wonder how you managed to work in the kitchen without me noticing. If it were any other kit, I would've been concerned about you being too young to do anything involving fire, but..." "Mother has gone to great lengths to teach me well."[kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0| She may say that, but you can hear the strain in Kinu's voice as she forces the words forth...] "Well, then." A quiet click as your fox-wife picks up her chopsticks. "I shall begin. Please, serve your [pc.mf|father|mother][kiyoko.numKits 2| and your siblings, too]. This will be sufficient." Kinu disappears without a sound, and returns shortly after with a similar tray, sliding it onto the table. "For you, [pc.mf|Father|Mother]. Please continue to make Mother happy for as long as the two of you live." Ah... of course. "I will take my leave, then.[kiyoko.numKits 2| There are others who need to be served.]" As Kinu departs, Kiyoko gives you a sidelong glance, then sets down her chopsticks and smiles. "I suppose I should thank you too, [pc.name]" Why? This is her day, not yours. "Well, without you, I wouldn't have had the opportunity to be a mother, would I? Without you and your delectable chi to make kits with, I wouldn't be sitting here today with the people I love... [kiyoko.numKits 2 8 16 32 |our kits, and you, of course. This short time has been far better to me than the eternity that I spent alone; how could I not be grateful to you for making all this possible? |our big family. Isn't this just amazing? Now there's always something to do, some errand to be taken care of... but having seen the other side for myself, I couldn't be more satisfied with where I am today. |our kits, each and every one of them. Ehehehe... it kind of makes me a little embarrassed to recall where they came from, but on the other hand... it also makes me want to make some more, even if we have so many already. |so many of them. Even I can't quite believe I've been pregnant so many times at this point... it all feels a little like a dream. But even so, it's not a dream I want to wake from, not when there's so much living to be had. |even if life with our daughter has had its good and bad days alike, I don't regret having gone through any of this. My existence feels so much fuller for it. ]" Now isn't that cute. You pat Kiyoko on the head, feeling the comfortable warmth of her body, then sigh. Come on, it's best to tuck into the food before it gets cold.[kiyoko.numKits 2| See, even the children are eating already. There'll be time for talk later.] "Yes, you're right. Thank you for the food." Hah. Thank Kinu for the food, more like. It really is very good, though. Not just the food in and of itself, but also being able to share it with your beautiful fox-wife and the family you made with her. With all the effort Kinu's put in, you can't help but feel a little guilty at not having prepared anything for the occasion. Sure, you had no way of knowing the day without someone telling you, but even so... Kiyoko finishes off the last of the inarizushi before leaning over and whispering, a little giggle escaping her lips. "I suppose there's something you can do for me if you really want to..." Oh? [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |"Yes." Her smile turns upwards at the corners, becoming downright playful — or at least, it's best interpreted as playful. "This year may come and go, but there's always mother's day next year, isn't there? If you can just promise me that next year's celebrations will surpass this year's... I'll be satisfied." |"Mm-hm." Kiyoko's smile widens and turns mischievous as she leans back in her chair, pushing her huge pregnant belly out as far as it'll go. "Our kit will be born soon... but after that, who's to say you can't give me another? Mother's day will come around again next year... perhaps we should make the celebrations more grandiose than this year's? It's a goal to work towards to..." |"Oh, of course." Her smile widens, turning ever more vulpine as she rubs her side against you. "You could remind me how I ended up in this position to begin with. Call it a mother's day gift, if you will. Not right now, of course... but there's always your next visit, when we can get some time alone. I want to see this flat belly big and round again; mother's day will come around next year too, you know. Why not make it more of an occasion than this year's?" ] Hush now. There'll be time for such desires later. "Ehehe." Bit by bit, the two of you finish your meal. When it's finally all gone, Kiyoko wipes her mouth daintily and sighs, utterly content. Was it that good? "I'm finding myself wishing I could just laze around every day and leave everything to our daughter... but of course, we know where that ends up. There is intrinsic value to work. Still, a day off to be appreciated is lovely." She deserves as much. "Mm..." At this point, Kinu slides in by your side, removing the empty dishes — she sure can move silently when she's got the mind to. With the table cleared, your kitsune daughter clears her throat and bows again. "Thank you, Mother. And thank you, [pc.mf|Father|Mother], for making Mother happy. I've some more comforts prepared for you over the rest of today, so if you would..." "Ah. One moment, I have to send your [pc.mf|father|mother] off." Your fox-wife turns to you. "Well, then. Thank you for being here for me as part of this; it means quite a lot, considering what we've been through. I think I'll have a very enjoyable rest of today." Does she want you here for as long as you're able to stay? "I think this will do; I'd rather have you depart of your own accord instead of being dragged away. Wouldn't want a sour note on this occasion, would we? You've already done more than enough, and it's not like you won't be visiting again, right?" Well, if that's what she wants. Far from you to deny your beloved fox-wife on this day. Kiyoko leans in and pecks you on the cheek again[kiyoko.numKits 4|, earning a number of giggles from the gathered kits]. "I'll see you again next time, [pc.name].""

rows.original: See how your fox-wife and daughter are holding up after their sudden change of environment.
rows.translation: 看看你的狐狸妻子和女儿在环境突然发生变化之后，过得怎么样吧。
rows.raw: "See how your fox-wife and daughter are holding up after their sudden change of environment."

rows.original: Your fox-wife and daughter are still assessing the state of the den after more than two centuries' worth of neglect. Perhaps it would be best to leave them to making their accommodations livable before intruding upon their lives. You might be thinking to help, but frankly with your ignorance of Old Country architecture and decor it's best to just stay out of their way.
rows.translation: 你的狐狸妻子和女儿还在评估这座巢穴在被冷落两个多世纪之后的状况。或许，在你打扰她们的生活之前，最好先让她们把住处收拾得能住下。你也许想搭把手，但说实话，以你对故国建筑与装饰的一无所知，最好还是别挡她们的道。
rows.raw: "Your fox-wife and daughter are still assessing the state of the den after more than two centuries' worth of neglect. Perhaps it would be best to leave them to making their accommodations livable before intruding upon their lives. You might be thinking to help, but frankly with your ignorance of Old Country architecture and decor it's best to just stay out of their way."

rows.original: Once, these homes presumably used to house the expeditionary force that Kiyoko had brought with her from across the ocean. More than two centuries later, they now house her [kiyoko.numKits 8 16 32 |kits |many kits |many, many kits |daughter ]. A few of the buildings are but one-storey homes, although most have anywhere between two to four; as part of an expeditionary force, the original kitsune who threw these together clearly decided to live in close quarters, perhaps for ease, perhaps for safety. [kiyoko.numKits 8 16 32 |With the population of the den slowly but steadily increasing, a couple more homes have been cleared and refurbished, no doubt with Komari's help. Old boards torn out, roofs rethatched, support beams replaced and the plant life pruned to appropriate levels. It's been a lot of work, but less work than completely tearing down the homes and rebuilding them would have been. That they're still in salvageable condition after two centuries of neglect in the wild perhaps speaks volumes as to the deftness of kitsune architecture, the effort that went into reclaiming them, or more likely, both. |With plenty of foxes now living in the den, younger and older alike, about half of the old buildings have been turned into a liveable state. Judging by how the buildings themselves, Kiyoko's expeditionary force might have numbered three to four hundred in close quarters; not to disparage your fox-wife, but she'll probably stop before getting to that point, right? Right now, there's still plenty of space for everyone, and each kit is probably taking up a lot more room than the foxes who came with her... Whatever the case, there's definitely plenty of energy about the living quarters, voices and other sounds of daily life rising from sources unseen. And knowing your fox-wife, she'll only want to keep on adding to that number... |At this point, you feel justified in saying that there's a bit of a bustle to the living quarters, to the point where you occasionally catch sight of one of your fox-children on their way to and from their daily tasks. While about half of the buildings still lie in various states of disrepair, that simply means that there'll be space for expansion should it eventually be called for. Kiyoko's womb is certainly capable of producing a village over her lifetime, although you're not entirely sure if that'll come to pass. You'll see. Either way, things are really looking up. Your kits have really been industrious, patching up the walls to the point where they're absolutely pristine; the wooden floors and walls gleam with cleanliness and varnish alike, and the faint smell of green growing things is tame and inviting, speaking of restfulness, relaxation, and sleep after a hard day's work. Small homemade decorations adorn some of the chamber as you peer into them; folded paper figurines, foxes made from straw, simple flower arrangements. |Most of the homes still lie in various states of disrepair; with your fox-wife's brood of kits being not that big yet, there's been no need to put limited hands to less important tasks for the moment. Even dilapidated and abandoned, the overgrown kitsune homes are strangely calming, the plants that once strengthened and supported the structures having gone feral and begun to retake the buildings in earnest. It's a bit of a pity, perhaps, but resources are limited and need to be apportioned to where they're best served. ] Beyond the actual living quarters, there's a dining hall, [kiyoko.numKits 8 16 32 |the faint scent of [dayNight|warm food|cool ash] rising from it |the place bustling with activity around mealtimes |practically required at this point to feed all the kits you've sired on your fox-wife |although it's awfully spacious for the actual number of people who eat there ], as well as several other adjoining chambers that've been spruced up but don't appear to serve any dedicated purpose. Most importantly, though, are Kinu's quarters; a small, two-room building situated at the entrance to the den quarters such that anyone heading in or out has to pass by her doorstep. Being the firstborn daughter and heir apparent to her mother comes with its responsibilities but also its privileges; with her overseeing the reconstruction of her mother's old shrine, your firstborn fox-daughter has taken care to allot herself some measure of comfort. [kiyoko.numKits 6|While her brothers and sisters are packed anywhere between four to six in the den quarters' large rooms|With the entire run of the den quarters to choose from], Kinu has a small place all to herself. Not all of her space is personal. One of the walls is covered with schedules and other arrangements for all sorts of day-to-day duties, both here and over in the Frostwood den. Work, education, delegation... [kiyoko.numKits 6|these days, Kinu doesn't do that much of the shepherding herself, instead choosing to appoint the more responsible and conscientious of her siblings to oversee the younger ones|it's a lot for a future den mother to catch up with, and seeing it all laid out bare makes it hard not to respect your daughter a little more]. Ah... [a] [kinu.kinuWeapon|naginata, blade gleaming|hankyu, unstrung alongside a quiver full of arrows], up on the wall. Embers burning in the firepit. Clothes trunk. Medicine chest. Scrollwork. Schedules. Inventory of the stores. Cupboard. Her mother's instructions. Mementos of your time together when she was but a kit. [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0|A large, puffy coat of the purest silvery-white fur, looking very, very warm and snug|Exquisite finery — or at least, as exquisite as she can manage given her situation — fit for a princess]. [var0 |[kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |Kinu isn't here, of course — girls like her get out of bed at the crack of dawn to work the fields. If you want to find her, that's where she'll be in the mornings. |Kinu should be around here somewhere, she usually is at this time of day. She hasn't noticed you yet, but you could easily get your fox-daughter's attention should you need it. ] |Kinu's not here at the moment; your firstborn daughter is off in the Frostwood making nice with the people there. If you want to find her, she's probably puttering around somewhere on that side of the torii gate. |Kinu's home right now, but your daughter's sleeping and probably doesn't want to be wakened unless it's a true emergency. She needs all her energy for tomorrow... you wouldn't deny her that, would you? ]
rows.translation: 曾经，这些房屋大概是用来安置清子从大洋彼岸带来的远征军的。两个多世纪之后，如今住在里面的却是她的 [kiyoko.numKits 8 16 32 |幼崽 |许多幼崽 |许许多多的幼崽 |女儿 ]。少数建筑只有一层，不过大多数都有两到四层；作为一支远征军，最初搭起这些屋子的狐妖显然决定挤在一起居住，或许是为了方便，或许是为了安全。 [kiyoko.numKits 8 16 32 |随着巢穴里的人口缓慢而稳定地增长，又有几座房屋被清理出来并翻修一新，这无疑多亏了麻里的帮忙。旧木板被拆掉，屋顶重新铺上茅草，支撑梁被更换，草木也被修剪到合适的程度。这可是不小的工作量，但比起把房屋彻底拆掉重建，还是要省力得多。在荒野中荒废了两个世纪之后，这些房屋依然能够修复使用——这或许足以说明狐妖建筑技艺的精巧，也说明了人们在重新利用它们时付出的努力，或者更可能的是，两者兼而有之。 |如今巢穴里住着许多狐狸，有老有少，大约一半的老建筑已经被收拾得可以住人了。从这些建筑本身来看，清子的远征队当年挤在一起时，人数可能有三四百；倒不是想贬低你的狐妻，但她大概不会一直生到那个数目吧？对吧？眼下这里还容得下所有人，而且每只幼崽占的地方，恐怕都比当年跟她一起来的那些狐狸要大得多…… 无论如何，生活区里确实充满了生气，从看不见的地方传来人声和日常生活的各种响动。而了解你那位狐妻的人都知道，她只会想继续把这个数字往上加…… |到了这个时候，你完全有理由说生活区里透着几分繁忙，你甚至偶尔能瞥见自己的某个狐狸孩子在往返于日常事务的路上。虽然大约还有一半的建筑仍处于不同程度的破败状态，但那只意味着，将来真的需要时还有扩建的空间。清子的子宫在她有生之年确实足以孕育出一个村庄，虽然你不确定那是否真会实现。走着瞧吧。 不管怎样，日子确实越过越好。你的幼崽们非常勤劳，把墙壁修补得光洁如新；木制的地板和墙壁干干净净又上了清漆，泛着光泽，而那股淡淡的草木清香温驯而宜人，让人想到歇息、放松，以及辛苦一天之后的睡眠。你往房间里张望时，能看到一些房间里点缀着自家做的小装饰：折纸人偶、稻草扎的狐狸、简单的插花。 |大多数房屋仍然处于不同程度的破败状态；你狐妻生的幼崽还不算多，所以眼下还没有必要把有限的人手用在不那么重要的事情上。即便破败废弃、杂草丛生，这些狐妖的屋舍也透着一种奇特的安宁——那些曾经加固支撑屋舍的植物已经野化，开始真正地重新占据这些建筑。也许有点可惜，但资源有限，得用在最需要的地方。 ] 在实际的居住区之外，还有一座饭厅， [kiyoko.numKits 8 16 32 |从中飘出淡淡的 [dayNight|热食|冷灰] 气味 |一到用餐时间，那里就热闹非凡 |到了这个地步，要喂饱你在狐妻身上生下的所有幼崽，这里几乎是必需的 |不过相对于实际在那里用餐的人数，这地方确实宽敞得过分 ]，另外还有几间相邻的房间也被收拾过，但似乎并没有什么专门的用途。 不过最重要的是小娟的住处：那是一栋小巧的两居室建筑，就坐落在巢穴住区入口处，任何进出的人都要经过她的门前。作为长女和母亲公认的继承人，她既有责任，也享有特权；在监督母亲那座旧神殿重建的同时，你这位长女也没忘了给自己安排几分舒适。 [kiyoko.numKits 6|而她的兄弟姐妹们则挤在巢穴住区的大房间里，每间住四到六个|而整个巢穴住区都随她挑]，小娟却有一小块完全属于自己的地方。 她的空间并不全是私人的。其中一面墙上挂满了各种日程和安排，管着这里和霜木林巢穴里各种各样的日常事务。工作、教育、分派任务…… [kiyoko.numKits 6|如今小娟已经不怎么亲自照看弟妹了，而是挑出更负责、更细心的兄弟姐妹去照看年幼的那些|对一个未来的巢穴主母来说，要补上的东西太多了，亲眼看到这一切摊在眼前，很难不由衷地更敬重你的女儿几分]。 啊……[a][kinu.kinuWeapon|一柄寒光闪闪的薙刀|一张未上弦的半弓，旁边是一个装满箭矢的箭袋]，就挂在墙上。火坑里还有余烬。衣物箱。药箱。卷轴纹饰。日程表。库存清单。橱柜。她母亲的嘱咐。还有你们共度时光的纪念品——那时她还只是一只幼崽。 [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0|一件最纯净银白色毛皮做成的蓬松大衣，看上去非常非常暖和、舒服|精美的华服——或者至少是她这种处境下能置办到的最精美的——正配得上一位公主]。 [var0 |[kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |小娟当然不在这里——像她这样的姑娘天不亮就起床下地干活了。如果你想找她，早上她就在田里。 |小娟应该就在附近，这个时辰她通常都在。她还没注意到你，但只要你需要，很容易就能引起你这位狐狸女儿的注意。 ] |小娟现在不在；你的长女正在霜木林那边，和那里的人们打交道。如果你想找她，她大概正在鸟居门那一侧转悠。 |小娟现在在家，但你的女儿正在睡觉，除非真有急事，否则大概不想被吵醒。她明天需要全部的精力……你不会连这个都不肯给她吧？ ]
rows.raw: " Once, these homes presumably used to house the expeditionary force that Kiyoko had brought with her from across the ocean. More than two centuries later, they now house her [kiyoko.numKits 8 16 32 |kits |many kits |many, many kits |daughter ]. A few of the buildings are but one-storey homes, although most have anywhere between two to four; as part of an expeditionary force, the original kitsune who threw these together clearly decided to live in close quarters, perhaps for ease, perhaps for safety. [kiyoko.numKits 8 16 32 |With the population of the den slowly but steadily increasing, a couple more homes have been cleared and refurbished, no doubt with Komari's help. Old boards torn out, roofs rethatched, support beams replaced and the plant life pruned to appropriate levels. It's been a lot of work, but less work than completely tearing down the homes and rebuilding them would have been. That they're still in salvageable condition after two centuries of neglect in the wild perhaps speaks volumes as to the deftness of kitsune architecture, the effort that went into reclaiming them, or more likely, both. |With plenty of foxes now living in the den, younger and older alike, about half of the old buildings have been turned into a liveable state. Judging by how the buildings themselves, Kiyoko's expeditionary force might have numbered three to four hundred in close quarters; not to disparage your fox-wife, but she'll probably stop before getting to that point, right? Right now, there's still plenty of space for everyone, and each kit is probably taking up a lot more room than the foxes who came with her... Whatever the case, there's definitely plenty of energy about the living quarters, voices and other sounds of daily life rising from sources unseen. And knowing your fox-wife, she'll only want to keep on adding to that number... |At this point, you feel justified in saying that there's a bit of a bustle to the living quarters, to the point where you occasionally catch sight of one of your fox-children on their way to and from their daily tasks. While about half of the buildings still lie in various states of disrepair, that simply means that there'll be space for expansion should it eventually be called for. Kiyoko's womb is certainly capable of producing a village over her lifetime, although you're not entirely sure if that'll come to pass. You'll see. Either way, things are really looking up. Your kits have really been industrious, patching up the walls to the point where they're absolutely pristine; the wooden floors and walls gleam with cleanliness and varnish alike, and the faint smell of green growing things is tame and inviting, speaking of restfulness, relaxation, and sleep after a hard day's work. Small homemade decorations adorn some of the chamber as you peer into them; folded paper figurines, foxes made from straw, simple flower arrangements. |Most of the homes still lie in various states of disrepair; with your fox-wife's brood of kits being not that big yet, there's been no need to put limited hands to less important tasks for the moment. Even dilapidated and abandoned, the overgrown kitsune homes are strangely calming, the plants that once strengthened and supported the structures having gone feral and begun to retake the buildings in earnest. It's a bit of a pity, perhaps, but resources are limited and need to be apportioned to where they're best served. ] Beyond the actual living quarters, there's a dining hall, [kiyoko.numKits 8 16 32 |the faint scent of [dayNight|warm food|cool ash] rising from it |the place bustling with activity around mealtimes |practically required at this point to feed all the kits you've sired on your fox-wife |although it's awfully spacious for the actual number of people who eat there ], as well as several other adjoining chambers that've been spruced up but don't appear to serve any dedicated purpose. Most importantly, though, are Kinu's quarters; a small, two-room building situated at the entrance to the den quarters such that anyone heading in or out has to pass by her doorstep. Being the firstborn daughter and heir apparent to her mother comes with its responsibilities but also its privileges; with her overseeing the reconstruction of her mother's old shrine, your firstborn fox-daughter has taken care to allot herself some measure of comfort. [kiyoko.numKits 6|While her brothers and sisters are packed anywhere between four to six in the den quarters' large rooms|With the entire run of the den quarters to choose from], Kinu has a small place all to herself. Not all of her space is personal. One of the walls is covered with schedules and other arrangements for all sorts of day-to-day duties, both here and over in the Frostwood den. Work, education, delegation... [kiyoko.numKits 6|these days, Kinu doesn't do that much of the shepherding herself, instead choosing to appoint the more responsible and conscientious of her siblings to oversee the younger ones|it's a lot for a future den mother to catch up with, and seeing it all laid out bare makes it hard not to respect your daughter a little more]. Ah... [a] [kinu.kinuWeapon|naginata, blade gleaming|hankyu, unstrung alongside a quiver full of arrows], up on the wall. Embers burning in the firepit. Clothes trunk. Medicine chest. Scrollwork. Schedules. Inventory of the stores. Cupboard. Her mother's instructions. Mementos of your time together when she was but a kit. [kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0|A large, puffy coat of the purest silvery-white fur, looking very, very warm and snug|Exquisite finery — or at least, as exquisite as she can manage given her situation — fit for a princess]. [var0 |[kinu.kinuAdultPersonality 0 |Kinu isn't here, of course — girls like her get out of bed at the crack of dawn to work the fields. If you want to find her, that's where she'll be in the mornings. |Kinu should be around here somewhere, she usually is at this time of day. She hasn't noticed you yet, but you could easily get your fox-daughter's attention should you need it. ] |Kinu's not here at the moment; your firstborn daughter is off in the Frostwood making nice with the people there. If you want to find her, she's probably puttering around somewhere on that side of the torii gate. |Kinu's home right now, but your daughter's sleeping and probably doesn't want to be wakened unless it's a true emergency. She needs all her energy for tomorrow... you wouldn't deny her that, would you? ] "

rows.translation: 去迎接你的狐狸女儿吧。
去迎接你的狐狸女儿吧。

rows.original: You step between the gateposts, and the shimmer in the air about you turns into a blur. With a sudden wrenching sensation not unlike being lifted into The Ways Between, the world twists, and then you're in the shaded confines of the sacred gardens in the Frostwood den.
rows.translation: 当你跨过门柱的那一刻，周围空气中那闪烁的光芒瞬间变得模糊不清。紧接着，你感受到一种类似被强行带入“界间之路”的剧烈牵扯感，整个世界开始扭曲变形，转眼间，你就置身于霜木林巢穴中那些荫蔽神圣的花园之中了。
rows.raw: "\n        You step between the gateposts, and the shimmer in the air about you turns into a blur. With a sudden wrenching sensation not unlike being lifted into The Ways Between, the world twists, and then you're in the shaded confines of the sacred gardens in the Frostwood den.\n        "

rows.original: Travel to the Frostwood kitsune den.
rows.translation: 前往霜木林中的狐妖巢穴吧。

rows.original: You could always add any extra stone or wood on you to this stash. It won't be much, but every little bit helps, right?
rows.translation: 你总是可以把多余的石头或木材添加到这个储藏处里。虽然数量不会很多，但积少成多嘛，对吧？
rows.raw: "You could always add any extra stone or wood on you to this stash. It won't be much, but every little bit helps, right?"

rows.original: . How many would you like to donate?
rows.raw: ". How many would you like to donate?"

rows.original: Hefting the materials out of your possessions, you find a nice dry spot in the material shed to set them down in. While your fox-wife and daughter are no doubt well-stocked, every single bit helps when it comes to reconstruction — if nothing else, they won't be impinging on Komari's resources as much. It's a nice thing to be able to provide for your family, even if it's in such a small context.
rows.translation: 把那些物资从你的物品中取出来，你在材料储藏室里找了一个干燥的地方把它们放好。虽然你的狐狸妻子和女儿肯定储备了足够的物资，但任何一点帮助对于重建工作来说都意义重大——至少这样，她们就不会过多地占用麻里的资源了。能够为家人提供帮助，哪怕只是这么一点微不足道的事情，也是一件好事。
rows.raw: "\n        Hefting the materials out of your possessions, you find a nice dry spot in the material shed to set them down in. While your fox-wife and daughter are no doubt well-stocked, every single bit helps when it comes to reconstruction — if nothing else, they won't be impinging on Komari's resources as much. It's a nice thing to be able to provide for your family, even if it's in such a small context.\n        "

rows.translation: 输入无效。 [var0|你不能捐赠超出自己所拥有的物资数量的物品。|你不能捐赠0。].
rows.raw: "\n Invalid input. [var0|You cannot donate more materials than you have on you|You can't donate 0]."

rows.original: Invalid input. Please enter positive whole numbers only.
rows.raw: "\n Invalid input. Please enter positive whole numbers only."

rows.original: Putting some lumber towards reconstruction efforts would be great. Beams, planks, walls — put ten units in the shed.
rows.translation: 为重建工作提供一些木材会非常有帮助。梁木、木板、墙壁材料——往仓库里放上十单位吧。
rows.raw: "Putting some lumber towards reconstruction efforts would be great. Beams, planks, walls — put ten units in the shed."

rows.original: You don't have these materials on hand at the moment.
rows.translation: 你目前手头并没有这些材料。
rows.raw: "You don't have these materials on hand at the moment."

rows.original: Kitsune architecture doesn't use nails, but there're many other useful purposes for iron in tools and implements. If nothing, your fox-wife and daughter can use these to bribe Kohaku into getting them what they need.
rows.translation: 狐族建筑并不使用钉子，但铁在制作工具和器具方面确实有着许多其他实用用途。至少，你的狐妻和女儿可以用这些工具去贿赂琥珀，从而获得她们所需要的东西。
rows.raw: "Kitsune architecture doesn't use nails, but there're many other useful purposes for iron in tools and implements. If nothing, your fox-wife and daughter can use these to bribe Kohaku into getting them what they need."

rows.original: You don't have these materials on hand at the moment.
rows.translation: 你目前手头并没有这些材料。
rows.raw: "You don't have these materials on hand at the moment."

rows.original: Stone isn't as heavily used in Kitsune architecture, which favors light materials as opposed to the Marches style, but it's still useful for paving, foundations and many other purposes.
rows.translation: 在狐族建筑中，石头并不被广泛使用——与边境地区的建筑风格不同，狐族建筑更倾向于使用轻质材料。不过，石头仍然可用于铺路、建造地基以及许多其他用途。
rows.raw: "Stone isn't as heavily used in Kitsune architecture, which favors light materials as opposed to the Marches style, but it's still useful for paving, foundations and many other purposes."

rows.original: You don't have these materials on hand at the moment.
rows.translation: 你目前手头并没有这些材料。
rows.raw: "You don't have these materials on hand at the moment."

rows.original: On the western end of the camp, the palisade parts as thin forest soil gives way to rocky riverbank. Judging by the long stone ramp leading from dry ground to the water's edge, this is where the logs were floated down to Hawkethorne to be cut into timbers and planks, as well as a means of transport for the loggers themselves. Indeed, there's mooring for a number of flat-bottomed barges, but the boats themselves are smashed and riven with many small holes, perhaps the work of the blizzard on that fateful night. Either way, it explains why the loggers haven't escaped downriver to Hawkethorne already. The water itself is clear and fast-flowing, fed by snowmelt off from the Frost Marches. Though there's no actual ice in the water itself, it's almost certain the water's bitterly cold — swimming in the river would freeze anyone foolhardy enough to try. No escape that way, either. [var0 |Out by the riverbank, you spy a lone silhouette wading in the shallows, completely unperturbed by the icy water and swift current. This, you quickly surmise, must be Hethia, the druidess Garret spoke of. There's enough distance between you and her that she hasn't noticed your presence yet, although that could quickly change depending on your next course of action. Just what do you do? |A stack of not-so-freshly felled timber lies by the water's edge in a neat stack, evidently the last job the loggers were working on before the blizzard struck. Now slowly rotting away in place, it looks like these logs will never meet their intended destination, their deaths expiring into meaningless nothingness. ]
rows.translation: 在营地的西端，栅栏逐渐消失，因为稀薄的森林土壤被岩石质河岸所取代。从那条从干燥地面通向水边的长石阶可以看出，这里正是原木被运送到鹰棘镇进行切割成木材和木板的地方，同时也是伐木工人们使用的运输通道。的确，那里有足够的空间供许多平底驳船停泊，但这些船只本身已经破旧不堪，上面布满了许多小洞，或许这些都是那个灾难性夜晚暴风雪造成的。无论如何，这也解释了为什么那些伐木工人还没有顺流而下前往鹰棘镇。 这条河的水清澈见底，水流湍急，其水源来自于霜冻边境地区的融雪。虽然河水中并没有真正的冰块，但可以肯定的是，这些水冰冷刺骨——任何敢于在河里游泳的人，都一定会被冻伤。那样也无处可逃。 [var0 |在河岸边，你看到一个孤独的身影正在浅水区涉水而行，那冰冷的水流和湍急的水势似乎完全没有影响到她。你立刻猜到，这个人一定就是加雷特提到的那位德鲁伊希西娅。 你与她的距离足够远，因此她还没有注意到你的存在，不过这种情况很快就会改变，这完全取决于你接下来要采取的行动。 那么你究竟要怎么做？ |一堆刚砍下来的木材整齐地堆放在水边，显然这是伐木工人们在暴风雪来临之前完成的最后一项工作。如今这些木材正在那里慢慢腐烂，看来它们永远也无法到达预定的目的地，它们的“死亡”就这样在无意义的虚无中结束了。 ]

rows.original: You step up to the longhouse doors, and hear rustling and shifting on the other side of the barricade. "You're back? Have you, uh, dealt with the crazy elf yet?" Not just yet. You wanted to check in and see how they were holding up. "A bit hungry, but aren't we all? I mean, hardtack is okay, but you wouldn't want to live on it. At least the water in these parts is the purest you'll find anywhere. Snowmelt, y'know." Right, right. You'll see to dealing with the situation, then.
rows.translation: 你走到长屋的门前，听到屏障另一侧传来了沙沙声和挪动物体的声音。“你回来了？那个疯狂的精灵，你处理好了吗？” 还不行。你本来是想去看看他们的情况如何的。 “有点饿，不过我们不都是这样吗？说实话，硬饼干倒也能充饥，但总不能一直靠它活着吧。至少这一带的水是整个地区最纯净的，都是融雪水啊。” 好的，好的。那么你就负责处理这个情况吧。
rows.raw: " You step up to the longhouse doors, and hear rustling and shifting on the other side of the barricade. "You're back? Have you, uh, dealt with the crazy elf yet?" Not just yet. You wanted to check in and see how they were holding up. "A bit hungry, but aren't we all? I mean, hardtack is okay, but you wouldn't want to live on it. At least the water in these parts is the purest you'll find anywhere. Snowmelt, y'know." Right, right. You'll see to dealing with the situation, then."

rows.original: Curious, you walk up to the longhouses and try peering inside. While the windows have been boarded up pretty tight, you think you catch sight of movement within. Wondering if there might be any survivors in the otherwise deserted camp, you stride up to the door and knock firmly. When there's no reply forthcoming, you hammer on it — and discover the entrance has been barricaded quite thoroughly. Ah. You call out, and at last, a tired, frightened voice replies. "Who's there?" You announce yourself, and explain that Garth sent you; you intend to rescue anyone left in the camp. How many of them are there in the longhouse, anyway? "All ten of us. We're a little tired and cold, but still all right. Provisions are a bit low, but we're pretty much unharmed, if rather stressed out. How'd you get in here, anyway? The crazy elf chick put up some kind of magic that prevents us from sneaking out and back to Hawkethorne. Trust me, we've tried." Magic, eh? That would explain your difficult trip here. Silence. And then, "Look, it's not that I don't want to leave — everyone here would like to put plenty of distance between us and that crazy elf chick. Garret's been taking the brunt of her attentions since he showed up, but there're things in the woods and the barges are full of holes. rows.translation: 出于好奇，你走向那些长屋，试图往里面看。虽然窗户都被牢牢地封住了，但你似乎看到里面有动静。想着这个原本空无一人的营地里是否还有人幸存，你大步走到门前，用力敲了敲门。然而没有得到任何回应，你便开始猛敲——这时你才发现，入口处已经被彻底堵住了。 啊。你喊了一声，终于，一个疲惫而惊恐的声音回应了你。“谁在那里？” 你表明自己的身份，解释说是加斯派你来的，并表示你打算救出营地里还剩下的所有人。长屋里到底有多少人？ “我们十个人都在这儿。虽然有点累，也觉得有点冷，但总体来说还挺不错的。食物确实有点不足，不过我们并没有受到什么伤害，只是有点紧张而已。你们到底是怎么进来的呢？那个疯狂的精灵女孩用了某种魔法，阻止我们偷偷溜回鹰棘镇。相信我，我们确实试过了。” 魔法，是吗？这就解释了你为何要费尽周折来到这里。 沉默。然后，“听着，并不是我不想离开——这里的每个人其实都希望我们能和那个疯狂的精灵女孩保持足够的距离。自从加雷特出现后，他就成了她关注的对象，但森林里还有很多危险，而且那些驳船上也布满了漏洞。那个我们至少还有机会与之抗争，但是那个精灵在森林里施加了某种魔法，每当我们试图离开时，道路就会发生扭曲。你或许有足够的本事随心所欲地进出那里，但我们没有你那么厉害，明白吗？” 所以，本质上来说，他们需要你在偷偷离开之前先处理好这个问题。 “我不知道她为什么还留在那里。那个精灵已经得到了她想要的东西，对吧？加雷特真的有那么吸引人，值得她留下来吗？” “不过，确实是这样。因为那个精灵女孩一直在使用她的巫术，我们就被困在这里了。她基本上不会来打扰我们，所以……我们也就只能等着吧，尽量不惹麻烦。” 情况本可能更糟；至少他们现在还完好无损。你会想出办法来应对这个局面的。 “如果你能突破她对那些树木施下的法术，也许你还有机会。”声音中透出一丝希望。“我们期待你的帮助。”

You announce yourself, and explain that Garth sent you; you intend to rescue anyone left in the camp. How many of them are there in the longhouse, anyway? "All ten of us. We're a little tired and cold, but still all right. Provisions are a bit low, but we're pretty much unharmed, if rather stressed out. How'd you get in here, anyway? You'll see what you can do about the situation. "If you got past what she did to the trees, maybe you have a chance." A trace of hope creeps into the voice. "We're counting on you.""

rows.original: The moment you pass through the camp's gates, Sanders is there waiting for you. There's a bit of dirt and sap on his white robes from traveling through the forest and mud has caked the boots he's put on for the occasion, but he's otherwise in good shape. His emerald-tipped staff is clutched tightly in his hands, and he gives you a warm smile as you approach. "[pc.name]. You've arrived." Yes, you have. [pc.isDK|Nice of him to turn up just when you needed him|Hope you didn't keep him waiting long]. "I've just arrived myself; there were a number of preparations I had to make. While I've met a number of different peoples in my day, I've never quite had the chance to speak to one of the pale elves; they're quite elusive and secretive, by all accounts. I had to consult Mistress Ivris for what she knew of them, and even that was not as much as I'd hoped it would be." But he'll still do it, won't he? Sanders winks at you. [pc.cunningRange 70|You can tell he's unsure of this, but the good brother is putting on a brave face, both for you and himself. Which makes sense — there's no sense going into a negotiation doubting oneself. ] "Whoever this druidess Garret spoke of might be, she can at least be spoken to and hopefully reasoned with. Like I said, I bear in part some responsibility for what's happened here, [pc.name]. I promised I'd do something, and I won't back out now." All right, then. "So, where do you think she is?" [dayNight|While Garret said that the druidess would be at the river in the evenings, now's not the right time for that; you may have to bide your time for a while until she shows up. Sanders shakes his head at the news. "Unfortunate, but we don't need to be idle all this while. I'd like to see Garret and the loggers beforehand; perhaps we can do something for them before we parley with the druidess." Sounds like a good idea. Besides, sitting around twiddling your thumbs isn't going to help anyone. Best to start with Garret — taking the lead, you guide Sanders [party.hasCompanions|and your group ]off to the hall where Garret's cage is. On the way, you point out the longhouses where the loggers have barricaded themselves into, and Sanders nods. Stepping up to the entrance, you push open the door with a loud creak of its hinges, and step in to see — — Quite the sight indeed. Garret's cage has been unlocked, the door thrown wide open. That by no means suggests that he's anything but free, though — the fact that he's sprawled on his back with a collar about his neck proves as much. Your gaze follows the collar to the leash it's attached to, then to the person holding it — the amazonian, silver-haired druidess who just so happens to be completely disrobed and straddling poor Garret. She grinds her pussy lips against his engorged red cock, leaving a slick sheen of freezing slime even as he grunts and struggles under her. "Bad doggy!" the druidess coos. "Who's been a bad doggy, then? Isn't getting treats like this so much better than being a bad dog? If you'll just behave, you can get more many more treats!"
