rows.original:
"Still got something you want to take a gander at?" Gweyr asks.

        Yeah. It doesn't look like they've noticed you scurrying around belowdecks yet, so it should be safe.
        
        "Sure, just don't take too long — risk, reward and all that. The longer we're here, the more likely we'll be discovered, so let's make it worth our while."
rows.translation:
“还有什么你想看看的吗？”格维尔问道。

        “嗯，看起来他们还没注意到你在甲板下偷偷活动，所以应该还是安全的。”
        
        “好吧，不过别太久——毕竟风险与回报是成正比的。我们在这里待得越久，被发现的几率就越大，所以一定要让这次行动物有所值。”

rows.original: It isn't hard to find the ship's cargo manifest; it's in a little wooden box by the door, sealed tight to keep it away from the moisture and stale air of the hold. There're far too many records for you to properly read them all, but between you and Gweyr, you're able to skim through them quickly and figure out a few things. Firstly, Tollus has come into a lot of money — he has to have been, if he's been buying all these reinforced barrels from a cooper down the Belharan coast. There's also more stuff — pallets of bricks and mortar, sealed goods and the like, enough to imagine that he might be equipping a small mercenary company at that. This isn't the first time this ship is making this trip, either, not with the manifest showing the same bill of goods being ferried three or four times recently, with "delivered" written corner-to-corner across the manifests in neat handwriting. The money to buy all this must've come from somewhere, and the dates start... not too long after that night up at the old temple. A week or two, in fact... which would imply that the shenanigans started not too long after you came to. Kas sure does work fast, if nothing else. "Shit," Gweyr mutters. "All this may not amount to a king's treasury, but it would've cost a sizable chunk of one. And look at all the other weird stuff that's been bought on his behalf." You follow the old wolfess' finger across several items, and think back to the device Kasyrra presented at the Winter City. These... maybe it's a stretch, but why would she need to purchase all these custom-made things from the best Tronariian bronze and coppersmiths, then? So that's where Kasyrra got the parts to make her portal device — and with a ship like this, ferrying them all the way to the Winter City wouldn't have been out of the question. "You look like you know something, [pc.name]." Oh yes, you do. You'll explain it when you have the time, but this has been very illuminating. [party.has etheryn |Ryn, who's been beside you all this while and flipping thought several other pages of the manifest, swallows hard. "[etheryn.lowConfidence |I-I don't want to believe it, but... it would explain where the t-treasury went |I don't want to believe it, but it would explain where the treasury went ]." ] There's more than just that, though. Provisions you can understand, but brick and mortar, wood for scaffolding — is Tollus building something out here? The locals would have seen it if he'd started construction on something that would warrant all this material. Well. If nothing else, it's a piece of the puzzle. You just have to figure out where it all fits together... pushing the cargo manifest back together as neatly as haste will allow, you're about to let it lie when a letter written in a neat hand catches your eye amongst all the papers of the cargo manifest. It's sitting in a letter, but said envelope hasn't been sealed yet, and there's some kind of waxy, latex-like coating on it for waterproofing... Berach — no, I will not call you Whisper, stop badgering me about it already — Here is the stuff you wanted to help patch up the eastern entryways. The cold down there has preserved things pretty damn well, but the moisture constantly eats away at everything, so I had to get some of the special stuff from the heartlands. You know, the special concrete that gets stronger with exposure to seawater instead of the other way around. Now get off my back about it already. There are two bridges, the eastern and western ones, and if the fresh meat is too stupid to actually follow instructions and not use the entryway that has weakened mortar it's their own damned business for falling into the freezing water. At least two-thirds of them chose to grow wings after their ascension, so they can damn well use them. I don't see what the Master sees in fixing up a place we don't intend to stay in that long, but I didn't get where I am today by questioning him. If he wants it fixed, he gets it fixed, and don't you give him or me any lip about it, you impertinent rat. Last time I was down there the fresh meat was lazing about, so put their hands to good use. [party.has einin |You hear Einin gasp, and realize that the little mouse thief has been reading over your shoulder all the time. "Berach..." ] Construction, that much is obvious, and it sounds like they're doing up an existing site instead of building one from scratch. But where? The natives of the rift have got that pretty well covered; it's hard to hide very much in this glacial valley. Pondering the question, you shut the box and prepare to survey the rest of the cargo hold.
rows.translation: 找到这艘船的货物清单并不难；它就放在门边的一只小木箱里，封得严严实实，免得被货舱里的潮气和陈腐空气侵蚀。记录实在太多，你们没法全部细读，但你和格维尔合力，还是能很快翻完并弄清几件事。 首先，托勒斯肯定弄到了不少钱——他一定发了财，否则不会从贝尔哈兰沿海的一位箍桶匠那里买下这么多加固木桶。此外还有别的东西——成托板的砖块和砂浆、密封的货物之类，数量多到足以让人猜想他是在给一支小型佣兵团置办装备。这也不是这艘船第一次跑这趟航线：货单显示，同样一批货物最近已经被来回运送了三、四次，每张货单上都有工整的笔迹斜着写下“已交付”。 买下这些东西的钱总得有来路，而日期始于……就在老神庙那一夜之后没多久。事实上，大约一两周后……这就意味着那些勾当在你苏醒后不久就开始了。别的先不说，卡斯办事确实够快。 “该死，”格维尔低声说道，“这些东西虽说抵不上一位国王的国库，但买下来也得花掉其中一大块。再看看以他的名义买进的那些古怪玩意儿。” 你顺着这位老女狼的手指看过几样东西，又回想起卡希拉在冬城展示的那个装置。这些……也许有点牵强，但她何必从最优秀的特罗纳里伊青铜匠和铜匠那里定制这些东西呢？原来卡希拉的传送装置零件就是从这儿来的——而有了这样一艘船，把它们一路运到冬城也完全不成问题。 “你看起来像是知道些什么，[pc.name]。” 哦，没错，你确实知道。等有空的时候你会解释的，不过这次收获实在很有启发。 [party.has etheryn |瑞恩一直守在你身旁，还翻看了清单上另外几页，此时他艰难地咽了口唾沫。“[etheryn.lowConfidence |我、我不想相信这件事，可是……这就能解释国库的财宝去了哪里 |我不愿相信这件事，但这确实能解释国库的财宝去了哪里 ]。” ] 不过，事情还不止这些。给养你还能理解，可砖块、砂浆、搭脚手架用的木材——托勒斯是在这外面建造什么东西吗？要是他动工修建需要这么多材料的工程，当地人不可能看不到。 好吧，至少这也算拼图上的一块。你只需要弄清它该拼在哪儿……你尽可能利索地把货物清单重新叠好，正要把它放下时，一份字迹工整的信件在一堆货单文件中吸引了你的目光。它装在一只信封里，可那信封还没封口，上面还涂着一层蜡质、类似乳胶的东西用来防水…… 贝拉赫——不，我不会叫你低语，别再拿这事烦我了—— 这是你要的东西，用来帮你修补东侧那几个入口。下面的严寒把东西保存得相当不错，但潮气一直在不停地侵蚀一切，所以我只好从内陆弄来一些特殊材料。你知道的，就是那种碰到海水反而会变得更坚固的特种混凝土，而不是反过来。现在别再揪着这事烦我了。桥有两座，东边一座、西边一座；要是那帮新兵蠢到不照指示走、偏要用那座砂浆已经松动了的入口，那他们掉进冰水里也是他们自己活该。他们升魔之后至少三分之二都选择长出翅膀，那就尽管用翅膀飞好了。 我不明白主人看上了这地方什么，我们又不打算在那儿待那么久；不过我今天能爬到如今这个位置，可不是靠质疑他。他想修就修，你少跟他或者跟我顶嘴，你这无礼的耗子。上次我去下面的时候，那帮新兵还在偷懒，就让他们把力气用在正经活上吧。 [party.has einin |你听见艾宁倒抽了一口气，这才意识到这个老鼠小偷一直在你肩头偷看。“贝拉赫……” ] 是在搞建造，这一点很明显，而且听上去他们是在翻修一处现成的场所，而不是从头新建。可地点在哪里呢？裂谷的原住民早就把那片地方摸得清清楚楚；在这条冰川谷地里，想藏住多少东西都很难。你琢磨着这个问题，合上箱子，准备去查看货舱的其余部分。
rows.raw: " It isn't hard to find the ship's cargo manifest; it's in a little wooden box by the door, sealed tight to keep it away from the moisture and stale air of the hold. There're far too many records for you to properly read them all, but between you and Gweyr, you're able to skim through them quickly and figure out a few things. Firstly, Tollus has come into a lot of money — he has to have been, if he's been buying all these reinforced barrels from a cooper down the Belharan coast. There's also more stuff — pallets of bricks and mortar, sealed goods and the like, enough to imagine that he might be equipping a small mercenary company at that. This isn't the first time this ship is making this trip, either, not with the manifest showing the same bill of goods being ferried three or four times recently, with "delivered" written corner-to-corner across the manifests in neat handwriting. The money to buy all this must've come from somewhere, and the dates start... not too long after that night up at the old temple. A week or two, in fact... which would imply that the shenanigans started not too long after you came to. Kas sure does work fast, if nothing else. "Shit," Gweyr mutters. "All this may not amount to a king's treasury, but it would've cost a sizable chunk of one. And look at all the other weird stuff that's been bought on his behalf." You follow the old wolfess' finger across several items, and think back to the device Kasyrra presented at the Winter City. These... maybe it's a stretch, but why would she need to purchase all these custom-made things from the best Tronariian bronze and coppersmiths, then? So that's where Kasyrra got the parts to make her portal device — and with a ship like this, ferrying them all the way to the Winter City wouldn't have been out of the question. "You look like you know something, [pc.name]." Oh yes, you do. You'll explain it when you have the time, but this has been very illuminating. [party.has etheryn |Ryn, who's been beside you all this while and flipping thought several other pages of the manifest, swallows hard. "[etheryn.lowConfidence |I-I don't want to believe it, but... it would explain where the t-treasury went |I don't want to believe it, but it would explain where the treasury went ]." ] There's more than just that, though. Provisions you can understand, but brick and mortar, wood for scaffolding — is Tollus building something out here? The locals would have seen it if he'd started construction on something that would warrant all this material. Well. If nothing else, it's a piece of the puzzle. You just have to figure out where it all fits together... pushing the cargo manifest back together as neatly as haste will allow, you're about to let it lie when a letter written in a neat hand catches your eye amongst all the papers of the cargo manifest. It's sitting in a letter, but said envelope hasn't been sealed yet, and there's some kind of waxy, latex-like coating on it for waterproofing... Berach — no, I will not call you Whisper, stop badgering me about it already — Here is the stuff you wanted to help patch up the eastern entryways. The cold down there has preserved things pretty damn well, but the moisture constantly eats away at everything, so I had to get some of the special stuff from the heartlands. You know, the special concrete that gets stronger with exposure to seawater instead of the other way around. Now get off my back about it already. There are two bridges, the eastern and western ones, and if the fresh meat is too stupid to actually follow instructions and not use the entryway that has weakened mortar it's their own damned business for falling into the freezing water. At least two-thirds of them chose to grow wings after their ascension, so they can damn well use them. I don't see what the Master sees in fixing up a place we don't intend to stay in that long, but I didn't get where I am today by questioning him. If he wants it fixed, he gets it fixed, and don't you give him or me any lip about it, you impertinent rat. Last time I was down there the fresh meat was lazing about, so put their hands to good use. [party.has einin |You hear Einin gasp, and realize that the little mouse thief has been reading over your shoulder all the time. "Berach..." ] Construction, that much is obvious, and it sounds like they're doing up an existing site instead of building one from scratch. But where? The natives of the rift have got that pretty well covered; it's hard to hide very much in this glacial valley. Pondering the question, you shut the box and prepare to survey the rest of the cargo hold. "

rows.original: You decide to do a quick sweep of the ship's cargo — most of the goods have been sealed into caulked barrels, proofing them against water; they've also been heavily reinforced with metal banding to the point where you'd think it quite ridiculous. Gweyr steps up to one of them and raps her knuckles on the surface, cocking a ear to listen intently to the sound that rises. "Hmm. Doesn't sound like it's filled with liquid — can't be the goop, then." Yeah, it's too light compared to the ones you messed with earlier at the cultist outpost; those were heavy, what with the thick goop being dense like quicksilver. "Let's see what's inside these packages, then." Unwrapping the hide tarpaulins reveals goods that aren't as easily damaged by water — pallets of bricks, dense wood, copper ingots and the like, practical materials meant for construction or crafting. [party.has einin |"Kind of disappointing," Einin mutters as she re-ties the lot back together. "Not that I wouldn't take it if that's all there was, but you'd have expected demon cultists to be hoarding terrible magical treasures in the holds of their ships. Not... not bricks." That's how life differs from the stories. If Kasyrra had any treasure with her, she probably already exchanged it for far more practical things. Still, it's good not to give up hope — even if Kas isn't the type to hoard valuables, you're sure Tollus will be giving up the goods when you go kick his ass together. Your mecian companion brightens up at that. "Yeah." ] What you do notice, though, is how the cargo is arranged: several barrels lashed together, then tied with the pallets. Like weights, even, as if they wanted these to sink... hm. [party.has quintillus |You throw a glance at Quin. Was it usual for Tollus to buy this kind of stuff back in the day? "Fuck no," comes the reply without hesitation. "Bricks and mortar were far too mundane for him; the asshole wouldn't be caught dead with this kind of stuff. Any money that came into our hands either wound up buying arcane shit for his next harebrained idea, or on drink and sex for the rest of us." So, the only reason he would be having his goons ferry this sort of stuff around would be if Kasyrra ordered him to do it. Quin shrugs. "That's one possibility, but I honestly don't see your demoness friend being interested in this kind of boring stuff, either. That's one thing she has in common with Tollus, at any rate." Well, if she didn't tell him to do it, that would mean Tollus is wisening up as to the utility of the boring but practical. "There is... hmm. Shit, an actually smart Tollus could be dangerous, [pc.name]. Don't scare me like that." ] There doesn't appear to be much of value in here, but you could spend a little time seeing if there's anything amongst this lot that you could purloin. It'd be time off you actually scouring the ship's interior for clues as to what the cult's up to, but maybe the resources might be worth it. Want to give it a go? Whatever you decide here, there won't be time to double-back on your decision if you do change your mind later.
rows.translation: 你决定快速清点一遍船上的货物——大部分货物都被装进了用麻絮填缝的桶里，以防进水；桶身还用金属箍条加固得过分结实，简直让人觉得荒谬。格维尔走到其中一只桶前，用指节敲了敲桶面，侧起一只耳朵仔细聆听发出的声响。 “嗯，听起来里面装的不是液体——那就不是那种黏浆了。” 没错，跟你们之前在邪教徒据点里摆弄过的那些桶相比，这只实在太轻了；那些桶可重得很，里面浓稠的黏浆密度堪比水银。 “那咱们就看看这些包裹里装的是什么吧。” 割开那些兽皮防水布，露出的都是不太容易被水损坏的货物——成托板的砖块、密实的木材、铜锭之类，都是用于建造或手工的实用材料。 [party.has einin |“有点让人失望，”艾宁一边把东西重新捆好，一边嘟囔道。“倒不是说只有这些我也会拿，可你总以为恶魔邪教徒的船舱里会藏着什么可怕的魔法宝物。结果……结果却是砖块。” 生活就是这样，和故事里不一样。卡希拉身边要是真带着什么宝物，她多半早就拿去换成实用得多的东西了。不过，还是不放弃希望为好——就算卡斯不是那种会囤积财宝的人，你也确信等你们一起去踹托勒斯屁股的时候，他肯定会把好东西交出来。 你那位米西亚人伙伴听了这话顿时来了精神。“是啊。” ] 不过，你确实注意到的是货物的摆放方式：几只桶被捆在一起，然后又和托板绑到一块儿。简直像是在配重，仿佛他们想让这些东西沉下去……嗯。 [party.has quintillus |你朝昆因瞥了一眼。当年托勒斯会买这种东西吗？ “才不会呢，”他毫不犹豫地回答。“砖块和砂浆对他来说太普通了；那混蛋绝不会让人看见自己碰这种货色。落到我们手里的钱，要么被他拿去买些玄乎的破烂，供他下一个荒唐主意用，要么就被我们其余人花在酒和女人身上。” 所以，他让手下人四处运送这类东西，唯一的理由就只能是卡希拉命令他这么做的。 昆因耸了耸肩。“这是一种可能，不过说实话，我也不觉得你那位女恶魔朋友会对这种无聊东西感兴趣。至少在这一点上，她和托勒斯倒是挺像的。” 好吧，如果不是她吩咐的，那就说明托勒斯开始明白这种无聊却实用之物的好处了。 “这里面……嗯。妈的，一个真变聪明了的托勒斯可能很危险，[pc.name]。别这么吓我。” ] 这里似乎没什么值钱的东西，但你可以花点时间在这些货物里翻翻，看有没有什么能顺手牵羊的。这么做会占用你搜查船内、寻找邪教阴谋线索的时间，不过这些资源也许值得一试。 要试试吗？不管你在这里怎么决定，万一以后改了主意，可没有回头再来一次的时间了。

rows.original: You shake your head and finish wrapping up the last hide tarpaulin, putting it back in place. The impulse to get itchy fingers is there, but it'd be better served in pursuit of your actual goals here. Checking that everything looks undisturbed, you leave the goods be and return to the rest of the cargo hold. [party.has einin | Einin looks a little disappointed at your decision. "We can't even take a quick look-see? Sure, there's a lot of stuff, but it wouldn't take long — I'm good at finding the valuable marks in a sea of chaff." The thought is appreciated, but time spent is time spent. Besides, she really just wants the thrill of getting up in other peoples' stuff, doesn't she? "Well..." There'll be plenty of opportunities ahead for that where her skills will be more useful. This is all just boring junk. Einin hangs her head, but follows you away from the ship's cargo. ]
rows.translation: 你摇摇头，完成了最后一块防水布的包裹工作，将其放回原位。虽然心里很想动手再做点什么，但此刻还是把精力放在实现自己的真正目标上更为重要。确认一切看起来都完好无损后，你便将那些货物留在原地，继续检查货舱的其他部分。 [party.has einin | 艾宁对你这个决定显得有些失望。“我们甚至都不能快速看一眼吗？当然，那里确实有很多东西不过这不会花太长时间——我擅长在大量无用之物中找出有价值的东西。” 这个想法很贴心，但时间就是金钱。而且，她真正想要的，不就是那种翻别人东西时的刺激感吗？ “嗯……” 将来肯定会有很多机会让她发挥自己的技能，这些东西现在只不过是一些无聊的垃圾罢了。 艾宁低下了头，但还是跟着你离开了船上的货物区。 ]

rows.original: You're here to look for clues as to Tollus's activities, not engage in petty theft of common items.
rows.translation: 你来到这里是为了寻找有关托勒斯活动的线索，而不是为了偷一些常见的物品。
rows.raw: "You're here to look for clues as to Tollus's activities, not engage in petty theft of common items."

rows.original:
Gweyr raises an eyebrow as you get on your knees and start unwrapping more packages in addition to checking the reinforced barrels to see if there're any that can be pried open. "Huh, really?"

        It's no different than when the two of you were getting in good on the cultist outpost; so long as you're here, you might as well take the opportunity to enrich yourselves and deny your opponents valuable resources.
        
        A huff. "You remind me of some kids I once had in the company. Couldn't even wait until the fighting was over before running to pull the boots off the dead — would always complain that the feet would swell and make getting them off in one piece hard..."
        
        [pc.isDK
        |Hey, if she wants to watch, she's more than welcome to.
        |So, it's just like old times, then?
        ]
        
        The two of you get down to it, doing your best to find the most valuable items amidst the sea of mediocrity and mundanity that stocks the cargo hold. Gweyr's nose for loot is good going — another of the many skills she no doubt picked up in her mercenary days — [party.has einin
        |but what really speeds the process along is Einin's professional eye for picking out likely marks. Darting from stack to stack, the little mecian quickly identifies promising finds, carelessly sealed containers, and oddly-shaped wrappings — it hasn't even been a few minutes before between Gweyr and her, they've rounded up all the likely suspects for searching. You can tell that Einin's really having fun getting into other peoples' stuff; even if the ship's cargo is boringly practical she nevertheless makes a game out of picking out a diamond in the rough.
        
        "All done!" she says, dusting off her hands. Between all of you, you've managed to gather the most valuable yet easily accessible ill-gotten gains from the ship's cargo. "It's not stealing if you do it from bad guys, that's what I learned from you, [pc.name]."
        
        Gweyr chuckles at that. "Cute girl, she learns fast. But yeah, I think this is the lot of it; let's move on before we run out of time here."
        |[pc.cunningRange 70
        |but your quick eye and cunning for picking out the details really speeds the process along. Together, you scour the easily accessible parts of the ship's hold, quickly identifying promising finds, carelessly sealed containers, and oddly-shaped wrappings. It takes a little time, but far less than what someone less quick on their feet would have managed, and before too long you've rounded up all the likely suspects for searching. Gweyr really does get into the spirit of things, sniffing around like the old hound that she is, and for the couple of minutes that you spend at it she does act younger than her age.
        |and together you get to searching the easily accessible parts of the cargo hold. While you try to be quick about it, Gweyr inevitably takes the lead in scouring the place for loot, quickly identifying promising finds, carelessly sealed containers, and oddly-shaped wrappings. Gweyr really does get into the spirit of things, sniffing around like the old hound that she is, and for the couple of minutes that you spend at it she does act younger than her age.
        
        It can't have taken as long as you feel it must've, but you're starting to double-guess yourself by the end of it all, wondering if this was a good idea to begin with. Eventually, though, you round up the most likely suspects from your search and split the loot.
        ]
        
        "Takes me back, this does. But yeah, I think this is the lot of it; let's move on before we run out of time here."
        ]
rows.translation:
当你跪下身，除了检查那些加固木桶、看有没有能撬开的之外，还开始拆开更多包裹时，格维尔挑了挑眉毛。“哈，真的？”

        这跟你们俩当年在邪教徒据点里大捞一笔时没什么两样；既然来了，不如趁机给自己捞点好处，顺便让对手损失些宝贵的资源。
        
        她哼了一声。“你让我想起我以前队里带过的几个小鬼。仗还没打完就急着跑去扒死人脚上的靴子——还总抱怨脚会肿，害得他们没法整只把靴子脱下来……”
        
        [pc.isDK
        |嘿，她想看就尽管看好了。
        |所以，这就像从前一样了？
        ]
        
        你们俩动手干了起来，尽力在塞满货舱的平庸杂物里翻出最值钱的东西。格维尔找战利品的嗅觉相当了得——这无疑也是她当雇佣兵时练就的众多本事之一—— [party.has einin
        |但真正让进度快起来的，是艾宁那副挑拣值钱货的专业眼光。这个小米西亚人在货堆间窜来窜去，很快就认出哪些是有戏的收获、哪些容器封得马虎、哪些包裹形状古怪——没几分钟，格维尔和她就把所有值得一搜的嫌疑目标都圈了出来。你看得出艾宁是真心享受翻别人东西的乐趣；就算船上的货物实用得无聊，她照样把从中挑出一颗“璞玉”当成一场游戏。
        
        “全搞定了！”她拍掉手上的灰说道。你们几个人合力，从船上货物里搜出了最值钱、又最容易得手的赃物。“从坏人手里拿的不算偷，这是我从你身上学到的，[pc.name]。”
        
        格维尔听了呵呵一笑。“这小丫头挺可爱，学得倒快。不过，我看就这些了；趁时间还没耗光，咱们赶紧走吧。”
        |[pc.cunningRange 70
        |但你这双利眼和挑拣细节的精明大大加快了进度。你们一起搜遍了货舱里容易够到的部分，很快认出哪些是有戏的收获、哪些容器封得马虎、哪些包裹形状古怪。这花了些时间，但远比手脚没那么麻利的人要快；没过多久，你就把所有值得一搜的嫌疑目标都圈了出来。格维尔确实很投入，像条老猎犬一样四处嗅探，而在这几分钟里，她的举动确实显得比实际年龄年轻。
        |于是你们一起动手搜查货舱里容易够到的部分。虽然你尽量加快速度，但格维尔还是免不了抢先一步，在舱里翻找战利品，很快认出哪些是有戏的收获、哪些容器封得马虎、哪些包裹形状古怪。格维尔确实很投入，像条老猎犬一样四处嗅探，而在这几分钟里，你的陪伴让她显得比实际年龄年轻。
        
        整个过程大概没有你感觉的那么久，但到最后你开始怀疑自己，琢磨这事从一开始到底该不该做。不过最终，你还是从搜寻中圈出了最有可能的几个目标，把战利品分掉了。
        ]
        
        “这可让我想起从前了。不过，我看就这些了；趁时间还没耗光，咱们赶紧走吧。”
        ]
rows.raw:
"
        Gweyr raises an eyebrow as you get on your knees and start unwrapping more packages in addition to checking the reinforced barrels to see if there're any that can be pried open. "Huh, really?"

        It's no different than when the two of you were getting in good on the cultist outpost; so long as you're here, you might as well take the opportunity to enrich yourselves and deny your opponents valuable resources.
        
        A huff. "You remind me of some kids I once had in the company. Couldn't even wait until the fighting was over before running to pull the boots off the dead — would always complain that the feet would swell and make getting them off in one piece hard..."
        
        [pc.isDK
        |Hey, if she wants to watch, she's more than welcome to.
        |So, it's just like old times, then?
        ]
        
        The two of you get down to it, doing your best to find the most valuable items amidst the sea of mediocrity and mundanity that stocks the cargo hold. Gweyr's nose for loot is good going — another of the many skills she no doubt picked up in her mercenary days — [party.has einin
        |but what really speeds the process along is Einin's professional eye for picking out likely marks. Darting from stack to stack, the little mecian quickly identifies promising finds, carelessly sealed containers, and oddly-shaped wrappings — it hasn't even been a few minutes before between Gweyr and her, they've rounded up all the likely suspects for searching. You can tell that Einin's really having fun getting into other peoples' stuff; even if the ship's cargo is boringly practical she nevertheless makes a game out of picking out a diamond in the rough.
        
        "All done!" she says, dusting off her hands. Between all of you, you've managed to gather the most valuable yet easily accessible ill-gotten gains from the ship's cargo. "It's not stealing if you do it from bad guys, that's what I learned from you, [pc.name]."
        
        Gweyr chuckles at that. "Cute girl, she learns fast. But yeah, I think this is the lot of it; let's move on before we run out of time here."
        |[pc.cunningRange 70
        |but your quick eye and cunning for picking out the details really speeds the process along. Together, you scour the easily accessible parts of the ship's hold, quickly identifying promising finds, carelessly sealed containers, and oddly-shaped wrappings. It takes a little time, but far less than what someone less quick on their feet would have managed, and before too long you've rounded up all the likely suspects for searching. Gweyr really does get into the spirit of things, sniffing around like the old hound that she is, and for the couple of minutes that you spend at it she does act younger than her age.
        |and together you get to searching the easily accessible parts of the cargo hold. While you try to be quick about it, Gweyr inevitably takes the lead in scouring the place for loot, quickly identifying promising finds, carelessly sealed containers, and oddly-shaped wrappings. Gweyr really does get into the spirit of things, sniffing around like the old hound that she is, and for the couple of minutes that you spend at it she does act younger than her age.
        
        It can't have taken as long as you feel it must've, but you're starting to double-guess yourself by the end of it all, wondering if this was a good idea to begin with. Eventually, though, you round up the most likely suspects from your search and split the loot.
        ]
        
        "Takes me back, this does. But yeah, I think this is the lot of it; let's move on before we run out of time here."
        ]"

rows.original: Leaving the arbalest deck, you step through the doorway to be confronted with the ships's crew quarters — bunks, stacked upon each other, a large table in the middle with dice and cards strewn atop it, and several half-empty bottles. For a vessel crewed by demons, you're mildly surprised to find that the place doesn't stink of sex and musk, only of alcohol, and faintly at that. There're enough bunks for perhaps forty at a quick glance, but to your surprise only four or so are actually occupied, and of the remaining beds most of them have been stripped bare, clearly no in use anytime soon. The faint sound of snoring comes to you even from here as you peek in around the doorframe — well, is it so surprising that demons would need to sleep, too? "Huh, looks like we've got company." Oh yes, you do. "I prepared for as much. We could sneak past them once or twice, but it looks like we'll have to be passing through these crew quarters pretty regularly," Gweyr whispers to you. "I'm favoring a more permanent solution." Killing them? The old wolfess arches an eyebrow at you. "Not that hard a guess, but not yet; I don't want the lot up on deck spooked when they come down and find a couple of bodies, or their own missing. Just knock them out — a couple of guys with bruises might be handwaved away, a couple of deaths not so much." From what she's told of herself to you, restraint is a little surprising, coming from her. "Oh, please. Shall we begin?"
rows.translation: 离开弩炮甲板后，你穿过门道，迎面就是这艘船的船员宿舍——上下叠放的铺位，正中间一张大桌子，上面散落着骰子和纸牌，还有几只喝了一半的酒瓶。对于一艘船员全是恶魔的船，你有点意外地发现这里并不散发着性爱与麝香的臭味，只有酒气，而且还很淡。粗看一眼，这些铺位大概够四十个人睡，但令你吃惊的是，实际被占用的只有四张左右；剩下的床铺大多被扒得只剩床板，显然短期内不会有人用。 即使从这里透过门框往里瞧，你也能听见微弱的鼾声——嗯，恶魔也需要睡觉，这有什么好奇怪的吗？ “哈，看来我们有伴了。” 哦，没错，确实有。 “我早料到会这样。我们或许能偷偷溜过他们一两次，可看样子我们得经常经过这间船员宿舍，”格维尔压低声音对你说，“我倾向于来个更彻底的解决办法。” 杀了他们？ 这位老女狼挑起一边眉毛看着你。“不难猜，但还不到时候；我可不想甲板上那帮家伙下来时发现几具尸体，或者发现少了人，然后被惊动。把他们打晕就行——几个人身上带点淤青还能糊弄过去，死了几个人可就没那么好说了。” 从她跟你讲过的自身经历来看，她会有这份克制，实在有点让人意外。 “哦，拜托。我们开始吧？”

rows.original:
As you step in to go about your business, Quin steps past you, carrying a sap in his hand. Now where did he get that? No sooner have you considered the question that he gets to work — Quin is as light-footed as his unshod feet might imply, skipping across the ship's planking with barely a noise. A grim expression on his face, he sets to the work of knocking out the helpless demons without even needing to be asked, taking a professional satisfaction but not outright glee in the unsavory act.

        Sure, they're demons, but...
        
        With such dark enthusiasm on Quin's part, any restraint you might've harbored evaporates. You head down the other side, taking care of the sleeping demon with a forceful application of your [pc.weapon]'s blunt end to their forehead, while Gweyr sweeps down the middle in an equally businesslike fashion. [pc.isChamp
            |It feels a little unsavory dealing with a helpless enemy like this, even knowing what Tollus is all about, but the situation's what it is and it's either you or them
            |Maybe you should feel something, dealing with a helpless enemy like this, but what do you really care at this point? It's either you or them, after all, and winner takes all in this game
        ]. There's a snort and half-cough followed by a sigh, and then the demon beneath you slumps into a much, much deeper sleep on the bunk.
        
        When the deed is done, the three of you meet up back by the entrance, and Quin gives you a brusque nod; his face is completely straight, his lips pressed into a thin line that tells you all you need to know.
        
        The job's done?
        
        "The job's done," both rabbit and wolf say together. They eye each other for a second, one professional sizing up and acknowledging the other, then Quin clears his throat and continues. "They should be out for an hour or so, I've done this before."
        
        "We'll be clear of this place in fifteen to twenty," Gweyr replies. "All right, then, let's get moving. There's little of value that I saw when moving through the crew bunks; Tollus was never in the habit of telling his lowest underlings more than they needed to know."
        
        "You don't say," Quin spits. "Kept in the dark and fed shit."
        
        Gweyr sniffs. "You're a funny one, bunny-man. I don't know what Tollus did to lose you from his roster, but his loss is my gain. Now, let's scram — the gods have been kind to us so far, and Tira gets tired carrying someone on her back for too long."
rows.translation:
当你走进去办自己的事时，昆因从你身旁走过，手里拎着一根短棍。他这是从哪儿弄来的？你还没来得及细想，他就动手了——昆因的脚步轻得正如他那双没穿鞋的脚所暗示的那样，踩过船上的木板几乎不发出声响。他脸上挂着阴沉的表情，无需任何人开口，就动手把那些毫无防备的恶魔一个个敲晕，对这桩不光彩的活儿带着一种职业性的满足，却并非真的乐在其中。

        当然，他们是恶魔，可是……
        
        见昆因这般阴沉的干劲，你心里那点犹豫也烟消云散了。你沿着另一侧走过去，用力把手头[pc.weapon]的钝端砸向熟睡恶魔的额头，格维尔则同样公事公办地扫过中间一排。 [pc.isChamp
            |明知道托勒斯是什么货色，可这样对付一个毫无还手之力的敌人还是让人觉得有点不地道，但事已至此，不是你死就是我亡
            |也许你本该有点感觉，这样对付一个毫无还手之力的敌人；可到了这一步，你还会在乎什么？毕竟不是你死就是我亡，而这场游戏里胜者通吃
        ]。紧接着是一声鼻哼和半声咳嗽，随后是一声叹息，你身下的那只恶魔便在铺位上睡得更沉、更沉了。
        
        事情办完后，你们三人在入口处重新会合，昆因朝你生硬地点了下头；他面无表情，嘴唇抿成一条细线，这已经告诉你所有你需要知道的事了。
        
        活儿干完了？
        
        “活儿干完了，”兔子和狼异口同声地说。两人对视了一秒，一个行家打量并认可另一个行家，随后昆因清了清嗓子接着说：“他们大概会昏睡一个小时左右，这种事我以前干过。”
        
        “我们十五到二十分钟就能离开这里，”格维尔答道。“行，那就赶紧动身吧。穿过船员铺位时我没看到什么值钱的东西；托勒斯从来不会让最底层的手下知道超出他们所需的事。”
        
        “是吗，”昆因啐了一口。“被蒙在鼓里，还喂着屎。”
        
        格维尔哼了一声。“你这兔子人还挺逗。我不知道托勒斯做了什么把你从名单上弄丢了，但他的损失就是我的收获。好了，我们快溜吧——诸神到目前为止对我们还算宽厚，而蒂拉背着人太久也会累的。”

rows.original:
That brings to mind something. Ryn?

        "[etheryn.highConfidence|Yes|Y-yes]?"
    
        She's trained in this sort of thing, right? As a ranger of sorts? Could she help you and Gweyr with the demons? You need to be silent, and you know she's good at that.
        
        [etheryn.highConfidence
            |Ryn nods without hesitation. "Of course."
            |Ryn swallows hard, but nods.
        ]
        
        As you step in to go about your business, Ryn hurries past you, the blunt end of her [etheryn.weapon] readied. You're reminded of that day you met her by the Wayfort, and how light-footed she can be when she puts her mind to it; your elven companion skips across the ship's planking with barely a noise, heading for the bunks on the left side of the quarters. A [etheryn.highConfidence
            |grim expression on her face
            |tremulous expression on her face as she forces herself to swallow her fear
        ], she sets to the work of knocking out the helpless demons.
            
        Seeing even Ryn put aside her hesitations and fear to get the job done, any restraint on your part evaporates. You head down the other side, taking care of the sleeping demon with a forceful application of your [pc.weapon]'s blunt end to their forehead, while Gweyr sweeps down the middle in an equally businesslike fashion. [pc.isChamp
            |It feels a little unsavory dealing with a helpless enemy like this, even a demon, but the situation's what it is and it's either you or them
            |Maybe you should feel something, dealing with a helpless enemy like this, but what do you really care at this point? It's either you or them, after all, and winner takes all in this game
        ]. There's a snort and half-cough followed by a sigh, and then the demon beneath you slumps into a much, much deeper sleep on the bunk.
        
        When the deeds are done, the three of you meet up back by the entrance, and Ryn gives you a nod; [etheryn.highConfidence
            |her face is completely straight, her lips pressed into a thin line that tells you all you need to know
            |while she looks to be on the verge of tears, she sucks it all up like the royal she should be and only allows herself a small sniffle
        ].
        
        The job's done?
        
        "[etheryn.highConfidence
            |It is.
            |I-it is. Gods, I thought I'd throw up once or twice there, just looking at a real demon from that close, wondering if he'd wake up and see me...
        ]" 
        
        Gweyr lays a hand on her shoulder. "It's not killing, but it's close. The more you practice, the easier it is to do it again, and the less it hurts."
    
        Ryn recoils as if the wolfess' hand were a hot coal. "[etheryn.highConfidence
            |That's not comforting at all! E
            |T-that's not comforting a-at all... e
        ]very time I've brought down an enemy while traveling with [pc.name]..."
        
        "It wasn't meant to be, but you clearly know what I'm talking about." Turning away from Ryn, Gweyr gives you an upnod. "They should be out for an hour or so, I've done this before."
    
        She has experience, huh?
        
        "We'll be clear of this place in fifteen to twenty," Gweyr replies. "All right, then, let's get moving. There's little of value that I saw when moving through the crew bunks; Tollus was never in the habit of telling his lowest underlings more than they needed to know."
rows.translation:
这让我想起一件事。瑞恩？

        “[etheryn.highConfidence|是|是、是的]？”
    
        她受过这方面的训练，对吧？算是个游侠之类的？她能帮你和格维尔一起对付那些恶魔吗？你们必须保持安静，而你知道她很擅长这个。
        
        [etheryn.highConfidence
            |瑞恩毫不犹豫地点了点头。“当然。”
            |瑞恩艰难地咽了口唾沫，但还是点了点头。
        ]
        
        当你走进去办自己的事时，瑞恩从你身旁匆匆走过，手里握着她那把[etheryn.weapon]的钝端。你想起在驿堡旁初次遇见她的那天，想起她只要下定决心，脚步能有多轻；你这位精灵伙伴踩过船上的木板几乎不发出声响，径直朝宿舍左侧的铺位走去。她脸上带着[etheryn.highConfidence
            |阴沉的表情
            |颤抖的神情，强逼着自己把恐惧咽下去
        ]，动手把那些毫无防备的恶魔一个个敲晕。
            
        眼见连瑞恩都放下犹豫和恐惧把事情办了，你这边任何顾虑也就烟消云散了。你沿着另一侧走过去，用力把手头[pc.weapon]的钝端砸向熟睡恶魔的额头，格维尔则同样公事公办地扫过中间一排。 [pc.isChamp
            |这样对付一个毫无还手之力的敌人，哪怕对方是恶魔，也让人觉得有点不地道，但事已至此，不是你死就是我亡
            |也许你本该有点感觉，这样对付一个毫无还手之力的敌人；可到了这一步，你还会在乎什么？毕竟不是你死就是我亡，而这场游戏里胜者通吃
        ]。紧接着是一声鼻哼和半声咳嗽，随后是一声叹息，你身下的那只恶魔便在铺位上睡得更沉、更沉了。
        
        事情办完后，你们三人在入口处重新会合，瑞恩朝你点了点头；[etheryn.highConfidence
            |她面无表情，嘴唇抿成一条细线，这已经告诉你所有你需要知道的事了
            |她看上去快要哭出来了，却像她本该是的王室成员那样把一切忍了下来，只允许自己轻轻抽了一下鼻子
        ]。
        
        活儿干完了？
        
        “[etheryn.highConfidence
            |干完了。
            |干、干完了。天啊，刚才有那么一两次我以为自己要吐了，就那么近地看着一个真正的恶魔，还担心他会醒过来看见我……
        ]” 
        
        格维尔把手搭在她肩上。“这算不上杀人，但已经很接近了。练得越多，下次再做就越容易，心里也就越不难受。”
    
        瑞恩像被那女狼的手烫到似的缩了回去。“[etheryn.highConfidence
            |这一点都不让人宽慰！每
            |这、这一点都不让人宽、宽慰……每
        ]次我和你一起旅行时击倒敌人，[pc.name]……”
        
        “我本来也不是为了安慰你，不过你显然明白我在说什么。”格维尔从瑞恩身上转开视线，朝你抬了抬下巴。“他们大概会昏睡一个小时左右，这种事我以前干过。”
    
        她确实很有经验啊……
        
        “我们十五到二十分钟就能离开这里，”格维尔答道。“行，那就赶紧动身吧。穿过船员铺位时我没看到什么值钱的东西；托勒斯从来不会让最底层的手下知道超出他们所需的事。”
rows.raw:
"
        That brings to mind something. Ryn?

        "[etheryn.highConfidence|Yes|Y-yes]?"
    
        She's trained in this sort of thing, right? As a ranger of sorts? Could she help you and Gweyr with the demons? You need to be silent, and you know she's good at that.
        
        [etheryn.highConfidence
            |Ryn nods without hesitation. "Of course."
            |Ryn swallows hard, but nods.
        ]
        
        As you step in to go about your business, Ryn hurries past you, the blunt end of her [etheryn.weapon] readied. You're reminded of that day you met her by the Wayfort, and how light-footed she can be when she puts her mind to it; your elven companion skips across the ship's planking with barely a noise, heading for the bunks on the left side of the quarters. A [etheryn.highConfidence
            |grim expression on her face
            |tremulous expression on her face as she forces herself to swallow her fear
        ], she sets to the work of knocking out the helpless demons.
            
        Seeing even Ryn put aside her hesitations and fear to get the job done, any restraint on your part evaporates. You head down the other side, taking care of the sleeping demon with a forceful application of your [pc.weapon]'s blunt end to their forehead, while Gweyr sweeps down the middle in an equally businesslike fashion. [pc.isChamp
            |It feels a little unsavory dealing with a helpless enemy like this, even a demon, but the situation's what it is and it's either you or them
            |Maybe you should feel something, dealing with a helpless enemy like this, but what do you really care at this point? It's either you or them, after all, and winner takes all in this game
        ]. There's a snort and half-cough followed by a sigh, and then the demon beneath you slumps into a much, much deeper sleep on the bunk.
        
        When the deeds are done, the three of you meet up back by the entrance, and Ryn gives you a nod; [etheryn.highConfidence
            |her face is completely straight, her lips pressed into a thin line that tells you all you need to know
            |while she looks to be on the verge of tears, she sucks it all up like the royal she should be and only allows herself a small sniffle
        ].
        
        The job's done?
        
        "[etheryn.highConfidence
            |It is.
            |I-it is. Gods, I thought I'd throw up once or twice there, just looking at a real demon from that close, wondering if he'd wake up and see me...
        ]" 
        
        Gweyr lays a hand on her shoulder. "It's not killing, but it's close. The more you practice, the easier it is to do it again, and the less it hurts."
    
        Ryn recoils as if the wolfess' hand were a hot coal. "[etheryn.highConfidence
            |That's not comforting at all! E
            |T-that's not comforting a-at all... e
        ]very time I've brought down an enemy while traveling with [pc.name]..."
        
        "It wasn't meant to be, but you clearly know what I'm talking about." Turning away from Ryn, Gweyr gives you an upnod. "They should be out for an hour or so, I've done this before."
    
        She has experience, huh?
        
        "We'll be clear of this place in fifteen to twenty," Gweyr replies. "All right, then, let's get moving. There's little of value that I saw when moving through the crew bunks; Tollus was never in the habit of telling his lowest underlings more than they needed to know.""

rows.original: Without waiting for your reply, Gweyr's already out, her feet light on the ship's planking despite her obvious size and weight. You don't see any sap or blackjack on her, but the pommel of her dagger glints in the dim light as she makes a beeline for the bunks, a grim expression on her face. Time for you to play your part too, then; seeing Gweyr's businesslike demeanor evaporates most doubt and restraint alike on your part. You tiptoe down the other side, taking care of the sleeping demon with a forceful application of your [pc.weapon]'s blunt end to their forehead. [pc.isChamp |It feels a little unsavory dealing with a helpless enemy like this, even a demon, but the situation's what it is and it's either you or them |Maybe you should feel something, dealing with a helpless enemy like this, but what do you really care at this point? It's either you or them, after all, and winner takes all in this game ]. There's a snort and half-cough followed by a sigh, and then the demon beneath you slumps into a much, much deeper sleep on the bunk. Phew. While you don't know when your heart snuck into your throat in all of this, you nevertheless swallow it down and meet Gweyr in the middle, taking out another sleeping demon in much the same fashion as before. Every footstep you take threatens to be the one that'll set the crew to waking and screaming at the intrusion, but that dreaded moment never comes, and it's with no small amount of trepidation that you meet back up at the entrance to the arbalest deck and let out the breath you'd been holding. How does she stay so calm throughout all of this?[pc.bg soldier| It's not as if you haven't seen your share of danger as a soldier, but this is something else altogether.] "It's not killing, but it's the same idea. The more you practice, the easier it is to do it again, and the less it hurts. I don't make a bloody mess all the time, you know." Clearing her throat, Gweyr gives you an upnod. "They should be out for an hour or so, I've done this before." She has experience, huh? "We'll be clear of this place in fifteen to twenty," Gweyr replies. "All right, then, let's get moving. There's little of value that I saw when moving through the crew bunks; Tollus was never in the habit of telling his lowest underlings more than they needed to know."
rows.translation: 没等你回答，格维尔就已经出去了。尽管她体形和体重都很显眼，落脚在船板上却轻巧得很。你没在她身上看到什么短棍或闷棍，但她朝铺位径直走去时，匕首柄在昏暗中闪着微光，脸上挂着一副阴沉的表情。 那么，现在也该轮到你出手了；见格维尔那副公事公办的样子，你心中大半的疑虑和顾忌也随之消散。你踮着脚沿另一侧走过去，用力把手头[pc.weapon]的钝端砸向熟睡恶魔的额头。 [pc.isChamp |这样对付一个毫无还手之力的敌人，哪怕对方是恶魔，也让人觉得有点不地道，但事已至此，不是你死就是我亡 |也许你本该有点感觉，这样对付一个毫无还手之力的敌人；可到了这一步，你还会在乎什么？毕竟不是你死就是我亡，而这场游戏里胜者通吃 ]。紧接着是一声鼻哼和半声咳嗽，随后是一声叹息，你身下的那只恶魔便在铺位上睡得更沉、更沉了。 呼。你也不知道自己的心是在哪一刻提到了嗓子眼，总之你还是把它咽了回去，走到中间与格维尔会合，照着刚才的办法又放倒了一个熟睡的恶魔。你每迈出一步，都像是随时会把船员们惊醒、让他们因有人闯入而尖叫起来，但那个可怕的时刻始终没有到来；当你带着满心忐忑回到弩炮甲板的入口、终于吐出憋着的那口气时，已经紧张得不成样子。 这一切下来，她怎么能一直这么镇定？[pc.bg soldier| 作为军人，你见过的危险也不算少，可这完全是另一回事。] “这算不上杀人，但道理是一样的。练得越多，下次再做就越容易，心里也就越不难受。你也知道，我可不是每次都弄得血肉横飞的。”格维尔清了清嗓子，朝你抬了抬下巴。“他们大概会昏睡一个小时左右，这种事我以前干过。” 她确实很有经验啊…… “我们十五到二十分钟就能离开这里，”格维尔答道。“行，那就赶紧动身吧。穿过船员铺位时我没看到什么值钱的东西；托勒斯从来不会让最底层的手下知道超出他们所需的事。”

rows.original: Without waiting for your reply, Gweyr's already out, her feet light on the ship's planking despite her obvious size and weight. You don't see any sap or blackjack on her, but the pommel of her dagger glints in the dim light as she makes a beeline for the bunks, a grim expression on her face. Time for you to play your part too, then; seeing Gweyr's businesslike demeanor evaporates most doubt and restraint alike on your part. You tiptoe down the other side, taking care of the sleeping demon with a forceful application of your [pc.weapon]'s blunt end to their forehead. Or that's what you intended, anyway. Maybe you breathed a little too loud, maybe you stepped on a plank that creaked, whatever the case, the demon's bleary red eyes open, fix on you, and then the poor bastard gets out half a yelp before you hurriedly clamp a hand over his mouth and smack him on the forehead with your [pc.weapon]'s blunt end. There's a snort and half-cough beneath your palm followed by a sigh, and then the demon beneath you slumps into a much, much deeper sleep on the bunk. Gods, did anyone hear that? Your heart hugs your throat for several more moments as you half-expect the sound of footsteps rushing towards the hatch and ladder, but none come just yet. Maybe the activity up top drowned out your little misstep... Swallowing hard, you force the lump in your throat back down and turn back to your task, meeting Gweyr in the middle. [pc.Weapon] raised, you take out another sleeping demon in much the same fashion as you did the first sans the yelping, but even so you can't stop your skin from crawling — every footstep you take through the crew quarters threatens to be the one that'll set the crew to waking and screaming at the intrusion, but that dreaded moment never comes. It's with no small amount of trepidation that you meet back up with Gweyr at the entrance to the arbalest deck and let out the breath you'd been holding. "Not so fast on the draw, eh, kid?" the old wolfess mutters. [pc.isDK |Yeah, yeah, she can stop gloating about it already. |Another half-second and the bastard might've very well brought down the entire ship upon you. It could've been worse... but she's also right in that you could've been better about things. ] "Practice[silly|, and I get lots of it clubbing seals over the head]. The more you practice, the easier it is to do it again, and the less it hurts. I don't make a bloody mess all the time, you know." Clearing her throat, Gweyr gives you an upnod. "They should be out for an hour or so, I've done this before." She has experience, huh? "We'll be clear of this place in fifteen to twenty," Gweyr replies. "All right, then, let's get moving; we almost certainly cut short our time here with that little mishap you had. There's little of value that I saw when moving through the crew bunks; Tollus was never in the habit of telling his lowest underlings more than they needed to know."
