rows.original: You're pretty sure the little mousefolk has a steady supply of aphrodisiacs on her. Why use your own resources when you could have her do the work for you?
rows.translation: 你很确定那个小老鼠族女孩身边总是有各种催情剂吧？既然她可以帮你完成这个任务，为什么还要自己耗费资源呢？
rows.raw: "You're pretty sure the little mousefolk has a steady supply of aphrodisiacs on her. Why use your own resources when you could have her do the work for you?"

rows.original: [quin.relationshipRange 0 15|Although you aren't too close, you know better than anyone after seeing it firsthand that Quin's magic can be potent; its uses alone can meddle with the mind. You turn and ask him squarely:|After spending so much time together, Quintillus and his magic are plainly obvious candidates for bursting up their little defense force. Yet when you turn, you find him already putting his hands together. You smile, stepping close and grabbing his shoulder;] can he take care of them from here? "Well," he sighs, albeit sounding far from authentic. "I suppose I can spare a few cultists with my... talents." The taeleer rolls his shoulders and steps closer to the edge, peering down at the barricade. Both of his ears straighten up, his fur slowly morphing into its fiery pink hue; the bun's eyes glow brighter, raising his right hand and pointing his finger at the centermost cultist. "After this, you owe me a drink. No... two." The taeleer snaps his other hand and a jolt of lightning arcs off and down below; its color and hue do nothing to illuminate the area, crashing down out of sight. Quintillus steps back from the edge and crosses his arms, letting the pale flames slowly slip back into his furry coat. Although you had expected a lot more, the silence in the air has you doubting just how effective it was. That is until Quin raises his hand and presses his fingers together. "Three, two, aaaaand... one." A soft snap no louder than the one moments ago passes between you, yet immediately the chasm roars with cries and screams of ecstasy. Even if he's on your side, the level of accuracy to his mental magic's effectiveness leaves you a bit slackjawed.[party.has cait| Cait grabs your sleeve, leaning in close and pouting. "If he's that good, [cait.fucked|we may need to try that out to make things even wilder at night|I think I know why I keep orgasming back at the Frost Hound]."] As awe-inspiring as it may be, though, you've got to take advantage of this situation before Tollus's goons get things under control. Making the descent from the clifftop in short order, you [party.hasCompanions|gather [party.compNames] and ]prepare to head on out again.
rows.translation: [quin.relationshipRange 0 15|虽然你们不算太亲近，但亲眼见过之后你比谁都清楚，昆因的魔法可以很强；光是它的用途就足以扰乱心智。你转过身直接问他：|相处这么久之后，昆蒂卢斯和他的魔法显然是轰垮他们那点防御力量的明显人选。然而你转过身时，却发现他已经把双手合在一起了。你微笑着走近，抓住他的肩膀；]他能从这里把他们解决掉吗？ “嗯，”他叹了口气，不过听着一点也不真诚。“我想我可以用我的……才能，分出几个邪教徒来。” 这位泰勒尔转了转肩膀，走到更靠近边缘的地方，俯视着下面的路障。他两只耳朵都竖了起来，毛发慢慢变成火热的粉色；这兔子的眼睛更亮了，他抬起右手，指向最中间的那个邪教徒。 “这之后，你欠我一杯。不……两杯。” 这位泰勒尔另一只手打了个响指，一道闪电弧划出去落向下方；它的颜色和光泽根本没照亮这片区域，就坠出视野之外。昆蒂卢斯从边缘退开，抱起双臂，任那苍白的火焰慢慢缩回他的皮毛里。虽然你本来期待的效果要大得多，但此刻的寂静让你怀疑刚才那下到底有多管用。 直到昆因抬起手，把手指捏在一起。 “三，二，啊啊啊……一。” 一声不比刚才更响的轻响在你们之间传开，可深渊立刻爆发出狂喜的哭喊与尖叫。就算他站在你这边，他精神魔法生效的精准程度还是让你有点目瞪口呆。[party.has cait|凯特抓住你的袖子，凑近撅着嘴说：“既然他这么厉害，[cait.fucked|我们也许该试试那个，好让夜里的花样更野一点|我想我知道为什么我每次回霜犬酒馆都会高潮了]。”] 不过，无论这多么令人惊叹，你都必须趁托勒斯的爪牙稳住局面之前利用这个机会。你很快就从崖顶下来，[party.hasCompanions|叫上 [party.compNames]，]准备再次上路。

rows.original: Tossing a magical fireball down there might be a bit too risky, but Quin has another talent you can think of that might help deal with this: his lust magic.
rows.translation: 向下扔一个魔法火球或许有点太危险了，但昆因还有另一项能力，或许可以用来解决这个问题：他的欲望魔法。
rows.raw: "Tossing a magical fireball down there might be a bit too risky, but Quin has another talent you can think of that might help deal with this: his lust magic."

rows.original:
You consider your options once more, and coming up short, shrug and decide to leave. The chance to scout ahead has in and of itself already been enough of a boon to you; managing to do something concrete to the cultists holed up in the ravine under you would have been the cherry on the cake. At least you're mentally prepared to storm the barricade, since it looks like it's going to come down to that.

                With that in mind, you carefully climb down the cliff and make your way back to the trail. Better be prepared for what's ahead.
rows.translation:
你再次权衡自己的选择，却想不出办法，于是耸耸肩，决定离开。有机会先来侦察本身对你来说已经是一大收获；要是还能对盘踞在你下方峡谷里的邪教徒做点什么实事，那就是锦上添花了。至少你在心理上已经做好了强攻路障的准备，因为看起来最终免不了要走这一步。

                这么想着，你小心地爬下悬崖，回到小路上。最好为前方的事做好准备。
rows.raw:
"
                You consider your options once more, and coming up short, shrug and decide to leave. The chance to scout ahead has in and of itself already been enough of a boon to you; managing to do something concrete to the cultists holed up in the ravine under you would have been the cherry on the cake. At least you're mentally prepared to storm the barricade, since it looks like it's going to come down to that.

                With that in mind, you carefully climb down the cliff and make your way back to the trail. Better be prepared for what's ahead."

rows.original: There's nothing you can do about the situation now with the resources you have on hand. Forewarned is forearmed; just leave.
rows.translation: 以你目前手头的资源，对于这种局面你无能为力。未雨绸缪总比事后补救好；干脆离开吧。
rows.raw: "There's nothing you can do about the situation now with the resources you have on hand. Forewarned is forearmed; just leave."

rows.original: Examine what lies ahead on the trail.
rows.translation: 仔细观察小路上前方有什么。
rows.raw: "Examine what lies ahead on the trail."

rows.original: Rounding the next bend on the trail, you're greeted by quite the sight: a palisade formed from boulders, upturned wagons and logs. The former aside, none of these are common in this neck of the mountains, and must've been lugged all the way here. There's even a warning beacon in the form of a bonfire, although it's been long since used up and the cultists haven't had the time or resources to replace the charred remains with fresh wood. All the better for you, else they alert their fellows further along the trail. The barricade itself overlooks a good stretch of open trail leading up to it, with little cover for anyone heading down the only approach and clearly intended to take anyone heading up the trail by surprise while preventing an easy retreat into cover. Whoever ordered this chokepoint reinforced certainly knew what they were doing. [flags.CLOISTER_QUEST_BARRICADE_HANDLED 1 2 |Indeed, this would have been quite the impressive roadblock were it not wholly ablaze and the fire spreading by the moment; the fruits of your insidious attack having time to take root in between you climbing down from the cliff and arriving on the trail. Bluish flames so particular of naphtha leap from the puddle of viscous, burning liquid, turning to a more conventional yellow as the dry timbers in the barricade easily catch alight. The smooth ravine yields little in the way of sand, and the cultists' attempts to douse the fire with what little water they have on hand only causes the oil fire to spread even further. With its defenders busy and their minds on more pressing matters, it's easy for [party.combatNames] to creep up on their position, ready for action. Not that your immediate fears are realized — Tollus's goons are losing the battle against the raging flames, and they know it. At length, their efforts flag, and one of the stouter timbers comes crashing down on part of the barricade, crushing cart bodies underneath with its bulk and sending smouldering splinters flying into the air. This is the final straw. Utterly demoralised, the remaining cultists abandon their position and flee northwards, their footsteps echoed by the angry bellows of someone... although to be frank, it sounds more like something. What that is quickly reveals itself, silhouetted against the blazing timbers. As ropes fray and snap, sending more of the barricade crashing in upon itself, a towering, imposing figure kicks a wagon wheel aside and storms towards you. He — or at least, you think that's what it is by the general cut of the body under the plated robes — wields a heavy mace in one hand and a diamond-shaped shield of purple crystal in the other, and you dodge aside as its spiked head sails through the air where you were seconds ago. Despite the oddly-shaped helmet he's wearing having neither visor nor slits, being a blank facade of bronze, the cultist leader turns his head towards you as if sizing you up. "The Master said you might interfere." The voice is somewhat muffled by the faceless helmet as he raises his mace for another blow. "I suppose you were more clever than I took you for, but I don't need to turn you into a pincushion to put you down myself." |In fact, it would've been more impressive and perhaps even functional if there were actually people atop the palisade to discourage trespassers from approaching. As things stand, though, no one's there to dissuade your approach; the reason why soon becomes evident as you draw close. Moaning reaches your ears when you're within a stone's throw of the palisade, accompanied by the sounds of raunchy sex. Seems like your gamble paid off — keeping his underlings at least a little horny at all times might get them in the proper frame of mind for being in a demonic sex cult and all, but surely Master Tollus would've accounted for the fact that doing so would have rendered them vulnerable to this sort of attack, right? Their robes lying discarded on the rocky ground and naked, tattooed skin glistening, the cultists who ought to have been manning the barricade are too busy having all kinds of perverse fun with each other to notice [party.combatNames] as you stroll by them, kicking away their bows and blades. Things look they're going to be a walk in the park until your path is blocked by a towering, imposing figure, kicking aside one of his underlings as he makes straight for you. He — or at least, you think that's what it is by the general cut of the body under the plated robes — wields a heavy mace in one hand and a diamond-shaped shield of purple crystal in the other, and you dodge aside as its spiked head sails through the air where you were seconds ago. Despite the oddly-shaped helmet he's wearing having neither visor nor slits, being a blank facade of bronze, the cultist leader turns his head towards you as if sizing you up. Despite his heavy breathing and obvious arousal, he's managed to withstand the effects of the aphrodisiac you doused the barricade with, be it through his sheer size diluting the dosage he received, or through dint of sheer willpower. "Clever. Very clever. The Master..." he gasps for air, clenching his armaments so hard his knuckles are white. "...Said you might interfere. Whatever, I don't need these worthless curs to take you down!"[party.has quin | "Oh?" Quintillus steps out, forcing the man to flinch. It seems the two may very well know one another. The reaver spits, glaring at the taeleer whilst audibly squeezing his mace's handle. "Quintillus, how are you still alive?" You look over and spot the bunny's normal cheery and flirtatious demeanor slip, instead glaring down the titanic male with a snarl. "Don't worry about it; if you live to the end of this day, I'll get real acquainted with you all over again. Now then, [pc.name]... shall we enact some justice on this musclehead?" |[pc.isDK | A brave front in the face of a considerable setback and bad situation, you see. Oh well, still, it wouldn't do to underestimate this one. ] ] |And judging by the sheer number of arrows nocked and aimed straight for you, the barricade's very certainly manned. Caught between a rock and a hard place, you've barely enough time to drop to the ground while the first salvo of arrows flies into the air, arcing before raining down on your general position. This... is unorthodox. Even at this distance, the dark robes and hoods of Tollus's demon cult are clearly visible, but they aren't taunting you, declaring the power of their dark lady or behaving in a manner that would be more stereotypical of the wild-eyed fanatics. No, it's draw, nock, loose — draw, nock, and loose again in disciplined silence. Well, fuck. [party.has arona |Arona snaps into action, the burly orcess pulling her shield out and holding the massive thing up at an angle. You vaguely wonder where she might've faced such an assault before to instinctively know what to do in the face of danger, but your thoughts are cut short as she grabs you by the scruff of your neck and pulls you into the cover of her pavise. "Stop fucking around and get in here!" [party.manyCompanions |Once you're safely pressed against her, she reaches for [companion2.name] and helps [companion2.himHer] into the cover her shield affords |Once she's satisfied you're safe, she braces herself for the next salvo of arrows that's coming down the ravine at you ]. "Gonna be a bit of a squeeze, but better than nothing." As if proving her point, an arrow whistles down and lands smack in Arona's shield, quivering as the barbed head sticks into hide and wood. She snarls and roars a curse [pc.ora orc |that would have made your mother blush |in suitably ferocious orcish ], then breaks into a brisk jog straight for the barricade. Seeing this development, the cultists focus their fire on her, more and more arrows slamming into her shield as she leans this way and that to intercept the missiles aimed for her legs; [party.manyCompanions |you and [companion2.name] |you ] have to hurry to keep up with Arona and the cover she's affording you. A last desperate salvo of arrows manages to graze Arona's arms and legs, painting her green skin with blood. That only enrages her more as she bowls straight into the barricade and the nearest cultist bowman, sending shards and splinters flying in all directions as she hurls him into his fellows, bowling the lot of them over into some nearby scrub. "Face me up close, you craven cunts!" Looks like Arona's got her blood up. Bringing up the rear, [party.manyCompanions |you and [comp2.name] |you ] move to back up the orcess as the cultists drop their bows and draw blades and daggers alike. |[pc.hasShield |You don't have time to waste. While the cultists are preparing to loose another volley, you take a defensive half-crouch and raise your [pc.offhand] at an angle to meet the impending attack. Barely have you steadied yourself before an arrow lands smack into your [pc.offhand], making your forearm jerk from the sharp impact as the barbed head digs into the shield's surface. Yeowch, that looks like it'd have been nasty had it actually managed to find its mark. [party.hasCompanions |Looking around, you shout for [party.compNames] to get in under the cover of your shield. Once you're sure everyone's as safe as can be given the circumstances |There's nothing for it. Breaking into a brisk, braced walk ], you press ahead resolutely with defenses raised. You've got to close the distance before those bastards can loose more arrows at you! Not that the defenders are slacking any. Seeing you come at them, Tollus's goons loose another salvo, and another — some fall wide, others slam into your shield, and one or two nick your skin, stinging as the barbed heads manage to draw blood. Whatever, better a scrape or two than being turned into a pincushion[pc.isDK | — but you'll be sure to make them pay dearly for annoying you ]. You soon close the distance[party.hasCompanions |, [party.compNames] hot in your wake ], and the cultists drop their bows and pull out blades and daggers to meet you in melee. |[var0 |Scrambling to your hands and knees, you search your mind for the appropriate incantation and gestures to deploy the shield of light that you oh-so-painstakingly learned to conjure. [pc.cl blackmage whitemage |While you've been trained to wield spells under pressure, the sight of a little over a half-dozen arrows nocked and ready to be loosed at you is enough to almost cause you to stumble over the incantation |Despite your magical aptitude not being at its peak right this moment, you scour your mind and eventually come up with the proper incantation from memory ]. Still, the shield of shimmering light materializes into existence just in time for the next salvo of arrows to break across its surface, faint sparks of light erupting into existence with each impact. Whew. You're safe for now, but also aware that the spell won't last very long under the cultists' continual assault. [party.hasCompanions |Looking around, you shout for [party.compNames] to get in under the cover of your magical shield. With everyone under the protection of your spell |Trusting in your magic ], you break into a run, barreling straight for the barricade. You've got to close the distance before those bastards can loose more arrows at you! Seeing you come at them headlong, Tollus's goons loose a final salvo of arrows at you, then drop their bows and draw wicked-looking blades and daggers, clustering about the barricade's entrance to greet you. The last of the missiles shatters your shield, splinters of the magical barrier falling away before dissolving into nothingness. That's fine, because you've already got your [pc.weapon] out and at the ready, closing in on the nearest of the cultists. |[pc.agilityRange 70 |You turn the drop into a roll, scrambling to your feet in short order. [party.som |Determined not to be taken any further by surprise, you |[party.compNames] is still lying in the dirt, and you rush over to lend a hand before Tollus's goons can ready another salvo. Together, the two of you |[party.compNames] are still lying in the dirt, and you rush over to lend a hand before Tollus's goons can ready another salvo. Together, the three of you ] make a mad dash for the barricade, zigzagging as erratically as you can while still making expedient progress towards your goal.[party.hasCompanions | Fortunately for [party.compNames], the cultists have figured that you're the biggest threat here and are focusing their fire on you in an attempt to bring you down. Flattering, perhaps, and you definitely don't need to worry that much about anyone besides yourself, but on the other hand there's a lot of pressure on you to stay standing. ] The experience is harrowing, to say the least. More than once, an arrow comes within inches of burying its cruel, barbed head into your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun], but you're light enough on your feet and blessed with quick enough reflexes to catch yourself in the nick of time and hurl yourself the other way. Several others come really close, searing your flesh as the barbed heads catch and draw blood, but at least you don't suffer wounds any more serious than a couple of stinging grazes. It looks like the cultists were depending too much on quantity instead of quality in their attempt to bring you down, and are paying the price for it. Eventually, you're finally within arm's reach of the barricade, but the fight's not over yet. Drawing your [pc.weapon] [party.hasCompanions |and with [party.compNames] hot on your heels, ]you vault over an upturned wagon and bound atop a set of palings with your superior agility. Time slows as you plant your feet squarely on one of the bowmen's chests, sending him sprawling off his post and to the rocky ground with an %"oomph." Unperturbed by one of their number going down, the remaining cultists drop their bows and draw wicked-looking blades and daggers, closing in to engage you in melee. |There's no time to waste. Scrambling to your feet, you sweep the ravine with your eyes for any kind of cover, but Tollus's goons have done their job well and long since removed anything that might shield an approach to the barricade. Cursing, you [party.hasCompanions |shout for [party.compNames] to get behind you and run. Hopefully you can draw enough fire from the defenders on the barricade that they won't focus so much on your allies. |start off towards the barricade at a dash, knowing full well that this is quite possibly what the defenders want but having little choice in the matter. ] With retreat being out of the question, it's either move in or wait to be turned into a pincushion, and you're not giving these bastards the satisfaction of the latter. Though you move in as erratic a fashion as possible and zigzag as much as you can, you've simply nowhere near the impressive speed and reflexes someone would need in order to evade the hail of arrows aimed at you simply by dodging. Halfway to the barricade, you become aware of a searing pain in your shoulder as a cruelly barbed arrowhead tears into your shoulder; another one nicks your thigh, leaving your [pc.armor] stained with bright red. It could've been worse — the arrowheads could've lodged in you like the barbs were intended to encourage — but there's a noticeable limp in your step as you force yourself forward and vault over an upturned wagon and onto the palisade[party.hasCompanions |, [party.compNames] hot on your heels ]. The cultists are prepared for this move, and drop their bows to brandish serrated blades and daggers, moving in to meet you in melee. What you can see of their faces under their heavy hoods is grim and neutral, their mouths set in thin lines, and you wonder if Tollus has been recruiting a more... practical bent of underling for his more important projects. Either way... ] ] ] ] ] It's a fight!
rows.translation: 在小路上拐过下一个弯道，你眼前出现了一幅颇为壮观的景象：一排由巨石、翻倒的马车和原木堆砌而成的防御工事。抛开那些巨石不谈，这些材料在这片山区都极为罕见，肯定是一路拖运到这里的。甚至还有以篝火形式设置的警示火堆，只不过早已烧尽，那些邪教徒既没有时间也没有资源用新鲜木柴替换烧焦的残骸。这对你来说反倒是件好事，否则他们早就向沿途的其他同伙发出警报了。 这道路障本身正好俯瞰着通往它的一段开阔小路。对于从这条唯一通道下来的人来说，几乎没有掩护；而它显然就是为了让沿着小路往上走的人措手不及，同时让他们无法轻易退到掩体后面。下令加固这个咽喉要道的人，肯定清楚自己在做什么。 [flags.CLOISTER_QUEST_BARRICADE_HANDLED 1 2 |确实，要不是它已经整个烧起来、火势还在不断蔓延，这本会是一道相当可观的拦路障碍；你那次阴险的袭击，在你从悬崖上爬下来、走到小路之前就已经开始生根发芽了。那滩黏稠的燃烧液体中窜起石脑油特有的蓝色火焰，而当路障里的干木头轻易被引燃后，火焰便转为更常见的黄色。光滑的沟壑里几乎没有沙子，那些邪教徒用手头仅有的一点水去扑火，反而让油火蔓延得更快。趁着守军忙得不可开交、心思都放在更要紧的事情上，[party.combatNames] 得以悄悄摸近他们的阵地，随时准备动手。倒不是说你担心的那些事真的发生了——托勒斯的打手们正节节败退于熊熊烈火，他们自己也很清楚。最终，他们的努力渐渐松懈，一根较粗的木梁轰然倒下，砸在路障的一部分上，巨力压碎了下面的车厢，也把冒着烟的木屑抛向空中。 这成了压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草。彻底丧失斗志的残余邪教徒放弃了阵地，向北逃去，他们的脚步声在某人愤怒的吼声中回荡……不过说实话，那声音听起来更像是某种东西发出的。 那东西的真实面目很快就显露了出来，在燃烧的木梁映衬下现出剪影。随着绳索磨断、绷断，更多路障轰然向内塌落，一个高大威猛的身影一脚踢开马车轮子，朝你冲了过来。他——至少从长袍铠甲下大致的身形来看，你觉得那是个“他”——一只手握着重型钉头锤，另一只手拿着一块紫色水晶制成的菱形盾牌；当那带刺的锤头掠过你几秒前所在的位置时，你向旁边闪避。尽管他戴着的头盔形状怪异，既没有面甲也没有开缝，只是一块光秃秃的青铜面罩，但这个邪教头目还是把头转向你，像是在打量你。 “大师说过，你可能会来插手。”当他举起钉头锤准备再砸一下时，那无面头盔让他的声音听起来有些发闷。“看来你比我想的还要聪明些，但我要亲手放倒你，也用不着把你射成针插包。” |事实上，如果栅栏上真有人驻守、阻止入侵者靠近，那倒会更令人印象深刻，甚至更实用。可眼下的情况是，根本没人拦你靠近；等你走近了，原因很快就清楚了。离栅栏只有一石之遥时，呻吟声传进你耳中，还伴着淫乱的交合声。看来你的赌注赢了——让手下们始终多少带点欲火，或许真能让他们更适应这个恶魔性爱教派的心态，可托勒斯大师难道就没想过，这样一来他们也会轻易遭受这种袭击吗？ 他们的长袍被丢弃在岩石地面上，赤裸的纹身皮肤闪着光——本该在路障处站岗的邪教徒们正忙着互相寻欢作乐，各种花样层出不穷，根本无暇注意到 [party.combatNames] 从他们身边走过时踢开了他们的弓和刀剑。一切看起来都轻松得像散步，直到你的去路被一个高大威猛的身影挡住——他一脚踢开一个手下，径直朝你走来。他——至少从长袍铠甲下大致的身形来看，你觉得那是个“他”——一只手握着重型钉头锤，另一只手拿着一块紫色水晶制成的菱形盾牌；当那带刺的锤头掠过你几秒前所在的位置时，你向旁边闪避。尽管他戴着的头盔形状怪异，既没有面甲也没有开缝，只是一块光秃秃的青铜面罩，但这个邪教头目还是把头转向你，像是在打量你。尽管他呼吸粗重、明显情欲高涨，他还是设法扛住了你浇在路障上的催情剂的影响——要么是他体型太大稀释了吸入的剂量，要么就是凭着一股纯粹的意志力。 “聪明。非常聪明。这位大师……”他喘着粗气，双手把武器攥得死紧，指关节都发白了。“……说你可能会来插手。算了，我不需要这些没用的废物来收拾你！”[party.has quin | “哦？”昆蒂卢斯走了出来，逼得那个男人不由得向后一缩。看来这两个人很可能彼此认识。 那个掠夺者啐了一口，恶狠狠地瞪着这名泰勒尔，同时用力握紧锤柄，攥得咯吱作响。“昆蒂卢斯，你怎么还活着？” 你转头望去，发现那只兔子一向欢快、爱调情的模样不见了，取而代之的是他正冲着那个巨大的雄性龇牙低吼。 “别担心；你要是能活过今天，我会让你好好重新认识我一遍。那么，[pc.name]……我们是不是该给这个蠢货一点教训呢？” |[pc.isDK | 面对如此巨大的挫折和糟糕的局面，他们依然展现出了坚定的勇气。嗯，无论如何，我们都不能低估他们的实力。 ] ] |从那些搭上弓弦、直直瞄准你的箭矢数量来看，这道路障绝对有人把守。你陷入进退两难的境地：第一波箭矢射向空中、划出弧线后倾泻而下之前，你几乎来不及趴倒在地。 这……确实有些不寻常。即便隔着这段距离，托勒斯那恶魔教派的黑色长袍和兜帽也清晰可见，但他们并没有挑衅你，也没有宣扬他们那位暗影女士的力量，更没有做出那种狂热信徒该有的疯狂举动。不，是拉弓、搭箭、放弦——拉弓、搭箭，再放弦，全都在纪律严明的沉默中进行。 好吧，操。 [party.has arona |阿罗娜立刻行动起来，那名魁梧的女兽人抽出盾牌，把那巨大的东西斜举起来。你隐约猜想，她以前在哪里遭遇过这样的攻势，才能本能地知道面对危险该怎么做，但你的思绪被突然打断——她一把揪住你的后颈，把你拽进她那面大盾的掩护里。 “别他妈的浪费时间了，快进来！” [party.manyCompanions |等你安全地贴在她身上，她伸手去拉 [companion2.name] ，帮 [companion2.himHer] 也躲进她的盾牌所提供的掩护里 |等她确信你安全了，便绷紧身体，准备迎接下一波从峡谷中射向你们的箭雨 ]. “空间可能会有点拥挤，但总比没有好。” 仿佛是为了证明她的话，一支箭呼啸而下，正正钉进阿罗娜的盾牌，带倒钩的箭头扎进皮革与木头里，兀自颤动。她咆哮着骂了一句 [pc.ora orc |那话会让你母亲都脸红 |用极其凶悍的兽人语 ]，然后快步朝路障冲去。看到这一幕，那些邪教徒把火力全集中到她身上，越来越多的箭矢砸在她的盾牌上；她不断左右闪避，试图拦截那些瞄准她腿部的箭矢；[party.manyCompanions |你和 [companion2.name] |你 ] 必须加快脚步，才能跟上阿罗娜和她为你提供的掩护。 最后那波拼命的箭雨堪堪擦过阿罗娜的手臂和腿部，在她绿色的皮肤上染出血痕。这反倒让她更加暴怒——她径直撞进路障和最近的那个邪教弓箭手，把他甩向他的同伙，将那一群人统统撞进附近的灌木丛里，碎片与木屑四下飞溅。 “有种就近身跟我打，你们这些懦夫烂货！” 看来阿罗娜已经杀红了眼。她殿后掩护， [party.manyCompanions |你和 [comp2.name] |你 ] 你和同伴们上前支援这名女兽人，那些邪教徒纷纷丢下弓箭，拔出刀剑和匕首。 |[pc.hasShield |你没有时间可以浪费。趁着那些邪教徒准备再放一轮箭，你摆出防御性的半蹲姿势，斜斜举起 [pc.offhand] 迎向即将到来的攻击。你才刚站稳，一支箭就正中你的 [pc.offhand]，带倒钩的箭头扎进盾面，猛烈的冲击让你的前臂猛地一震。哎哟，这一下要是真扎在身上，可够你受的。 [party.hasCompanions |环顾四周，你大声呼喊，让 [party.compNames] 都躲到你的盾牌下来。等你确信在眼下这种情况下大家都已尽可能安全 |别无他法，只能绷紧身体快步前进 ]，你举着防御坚定地向前推进。你必须在那些混蛋放出更多箭之前拉近距离！ 防守方也丝毫没有松懈。看到你冲过来，托勒斯的打手们又放了一轮，接着又是一轮——有些箭偏得老远，有些砸在你的盾牌上，还有一两支擦破你的皮肤，带倒钩的箭头划出血来，火辣辣地疼。不过，擦破一两处总比被射成针插包要好[pc.isDK | ——但你会让他们为惹恼你而付出惨痛代价 ]。你很快拉近了距离[party.hasCompanions |，[party.compNames] 紧跟在你身后 ]，那些邪教徒放下弓箭，拔出刀剑和匕首，准备与你近身厮杀。 |[var0 |你手忙脚乱地撑起身体，在脑海中拼命搜寻那个你曾煞费苦心地学会施展的光之护盾所需的咒语与手势。[pc.cl blackmage whitemage |虽然你受过在压力下施法的训练，但看到六七支箭已经搭上弓弦、随时准备射向你，这一幕还是足以让你念咒时几乎出错 |尽管你此刻的魔法天赋不在最佳状态，你还是把脑袋翻了个遍，终于从记忆里找出了正确的咒语 ]。那面微光闪烁的盾牌还是及时成形，正好赶上下一波箭矢撞碎在它的表面，每一次撞击都迸出微弱的火花。 呼。你暂时安全了，但也很清楚，在邪教徒的持续猛攻下，这个法术撑不了多久。[party.hasCompanions |环顾四周，你大声呼喊，让 [party.compNames] rows.raw: " Rounding the next bend on the trail, you're greeted by quite the sight: a palisade formed from boulders, upturned wagons and logs. The former aside, none of these are common in this neck of the mountains, and must've been lugged all the way here. There's even a warning beacon in the form of a bonfire, although it's been long since used up and the cultists haven't had the time or resources to replace the charred remains with fresh wood. All the better for you, else they alert their fellows further along the trail. The barricade itself overlooks a good stretch of open trail leading up to it, with little cover for anyone heading down the only approach and clearly intended to take anyone heading up the trail by surprise while preventing an easy retreat into cover. Whoever ordered this chokepoint reinforced certainly knew what they were doing. [flags.CLOISTER_QUEST_BARRICADE_HANDLED 1 2 |Indeed, this would have been quite the impressive roadblock were it not wholly ablaze and the fire spreading by the moment; the fruits of your insidious attack having time to take root in between you climbing down from the cliff and arriving on the trail. Bluish flames so particular of naphtha leap from the puddle of viscous, burning liquid, turning to a more conventional yellow as the dry timbers in the barricade easily catch alight. The smooth ravine yields little in the way of sand, and the cultists' attempts to douse the fire with what little water they have on hand only causes the oil fire to spread even further. With its defenders busy and their minds on more pressing matters, it's easy for [party.combatNames] to creep up on their position, ready for action. Not that your immediate fears are realized — Tollus's goons are losing the battle against the raging flames, and they know it. At length, their efforts flag, and one of the stouter timbers comes crashing down on part of the barricade, crushing cart bodies underneath with its bulk and sending smouldering splinters flying into the air. This is the final straw. Utterly demoralised, the remaining cultists abandon their position and flee northwards, their footsteps echoed by the angry bellows of someone... although to be frank, it sounds more like something. What that is quickly reveals itself, silhouetted against the blazing timbers. As ropes fray and snap, sending more of the barricade crashing in upon itself, a towering, imposing figure kicks a wagon wheel aside and storms towards you. He — or at least, you think that's what it is by the general cut of the body under the plated robes — wields a heavy mace in one hand and a diamond-shaped shield of purple crystal in the other, and you dodge aside as its spiked head sails through the air where you were seconds ago. Despite the oddly-shaped helmet he's wearing having neither visor nor slits, being a blank facade of bronze, the cultist leader turns his head towards you as if sizing you up. "The Master said you might interfere." The voice is somewhat muffled by the faceless helmet as he raises his mace for another blow. "I suppose you were more clever than I took you for, but I don't need to turn you into a pincushion to put you down myself." |In fact, it would've been more impressive and perhaps even functional if there were actually people atop the palisade to discourage trespassers from approaching. As things stand, though, no one's there to dissuade your approach; the reason why soon becomes evident as you draw close. Moaning reaches your ears when you're within a stone's throw of the palisade, accompanied by the sounds of raunchy sex. Seems like your gamble paid off — keeping his underlings at least a little horny at all times might get them in the proper frame of mind for being in a demonic sex cult and all, but surely Master Tollus would've accounted for the fact that doing so would have rendered them vulnerable to this sort of attack, right? Their robes lying discarded on the rocky ground and naked, tattooed skin glistening, the cultists who ought to have been manning the barricade are too busy having all kinds of perverse fun with each other to notice [party.combatNames] as you stroll by them, kicking away their bows and blades. Things look they're going to be a walk in the park until your path is blocked by a towering, imposing figure, kicking aside one of his underlings as he makes straight for you. He — or at least, you think that's what it is by the general cut of the body under the plated robes — wields a heavy mace in one hand and a diamond-shaped shield of purple crystal in the other, and you dodge aside as its spiked head sails through the air where you were seconds ago. Despite the oddly-shaped helmet he's wearing having neither visor nor slits, being a blank facade of bronze, the cultist leader turns his head towards you as if sizing you up. Despite his heavy breathing and obvious arousal, he's managed to withstand the effects of the aphrodisiac you doused the barricade with, be it through his sheer size diluting the dosage he received, or through dint of sheer willpower. "Clever. Very clever. The Master..." he gasps for air, clenching his armaments so hard his knuckles are white. "...Said you might interfere. Whatever, I don't need these worthless curs to take you down!"[party.has quin | "Oh?" Quintillus steps out, forcing the man to flinch. It seems the two may very well know one another. The reaver spits, glaring at the taeleer whilst audibly squeezing his mace's handle. "Quintillus, how are you still alive?" You look over and spot the bunny's normal cheery and flirtatious demeanor slip, instead glaring down the titanic male with a snarl. "Don't worry about it; if you live to the end of this day, I'll get real acquainted with you all over again. Now then, [pc.name]... shall we enact some justice on this musclehead?" |[pc.isDK | A brave front in the face of a considerable setback and bad situation, you see. Oh well, still, it wouldn't do to underestimate this one. ] ] |And judging by the sheer number of arrows nocked and aimed straight for you, the barricade's very certainly manned. Caught between a rock and a hard place, you've barely enough time to drop to the ground while the first salvo of arrows flies into the air, arcing before raining down on your general position. This... is unorthodox. Even at this distance, the dark robes and hoods of Tollus's demon cult are clearly visible, but they aren't taunting you, declaring the power of their dark lady or behaving in a manner that would be more stereotypical of the wild-eyed fanatics. No, it's draw, nock, loose — draw, nock, and loose again in disciplined silence. Well, fuck. [party.has arona |Arona snaps into action, the burly orcess pulling her shield out and holding the massive thing up at an angle. You vaguely wonder where she might've faced such an assault before to instinctively know what to do in the face of danger, but your thoughts are cut short as she grabs you by the scruff of your neck and pulls you into the cover of her pavise. "Stop fucking around and get in here!" [party.manyCompanions |Once you're safely pressed against her, she reaches for [companion2.name] and helps [companion2.himHer] into the cover her shield affords |Once she's satisfied you're safe, she braces herself for the next salvo of arrows that's coming down the ravine at you ]. "Gonna be a bit of a squeeze, but better than nothing." As if proving her point, an arrow whistles down and lands smack in Arona's shield, quivering as the barbed head sticks into hide and wood. She snarls and roars a curse [pc.ora orc |that would have made your mother blush |in suitably ferocious orcish ], then breaks into a brisk jog straight for the barricade. Seeing this development, the cultists focus their fire on her, more and more arrows slamming into her shield as she leans this way and that to intercept the missiles aimed for her legs; [party.manyCompanions |you and [companion2.name] |you ] have to hurry to keep up with Arona and the cover she's affording you. A last desperate salvo of arrows manages to graze Arona's arms and legs, painting her green skin with blood. That only enrages her more as she bowls straight into the barricade and the nearest cultist bowman, sending shards and splinters flying in all directions as she hurls him into his fellows, bowling the lot of them over into some nearby scrub. "Face me up close, you craven cunts!" Looks like Arona's got her blood up. Bringing up the rear, [party.manyCompanions |you and [comp2.name] |you ] move to back up the orcess as the cultists drop their bows and draw blades and daggers alike. |[pc.hasShield |You don't have time to waste. While the cultists are preparing to loose another volley, you take a defensive half-crouch and raise your [pc.offhand] at an angle to meet the impending attack. Barely have you steadied yourself before an arrow lands smack into your [pc.offhand], making your forearm jerk from the sharp impact as the barbed head digs into the shield's surface. Yeowch, that looks like it'd have been nasty had it actually managed to find its mark. [party.hasCompanions |Looking around, you shout for [party.compNames] to get in under the cover of your shield. Once you're sure everyone's as safe as can be given the circumstances |There's nothing for it. Breaking into a brisk, braced walk ], you press ahead resolutely with defenses raised. You've got to close the distance before those bastards can loose more arrows at you! Not that the defenders are slacking any. Seeing you come at them, Tollus's goons loose another salvo, and another — some fall wide, others slam into your shield, and one or two nick your skin, stinging as the barbed heads manage to draw blood. Whatever, better a scrape or two than being turned into a pincushion[pc.isDK | — but you'll be sure to make them pay dearly for annoying you ]. You soon close the distance[party.hasCompanions |, [party.compNames] hot in your wake ], and the cultists drop their bows and pull out blades and daggers to meet you in melee. |[var0 |Scrambling to your hands and knees, you search your mind for the appropriate incantation and gestures to deploy the shield of light that you oh-so-painstakingly learned to conjure. [pc.cl blackmage whitemage |While you've been trained to wield spells under pressure, the sight of a little over a half-dozen arrows nocked and ready to be loosed at you is enough to almost cause you to stumble over the incantation |Despite your magical aptitude not being at its peak right this moment, you scour your mind and eventually come up with the proper incantation from memory ]. Still, the shield of shimmering light materializes into existence just in time for the next salvo of arrows to break across its surface, faint sparks of light erupting into existence with each impact. Whew. You're safe for now, but also aware that the spell won't last very long under the cultists' continual assault. [party.hasCompanions |Looking around, you shout for [party.compNames] to get in under the cover of your magical shield. With everyone under the protection of your spell |Trusting in your magic ], you break into a run, barreling straight for the barricade. You've got to close the distance before those bastards can loose more arrows at you! Seeing you come at them headlong, Tollus's goons loose a final salvo of arrows at you, then drop their bows and draw wicked-looking blades and daggers, clustering about the barricade's entrance to greet you. The last of the missiles shatters your shield, splinters of the magical barrier falling away before dissolving into nothingness. That's fine, because you've already got your [pc.weapon] out and at the ready, closing in on the nearest of the cultists. |[pc.agilityRange 70 |You turn the drop into a roll, scrambling to your feet in short order. [party.som |Determined not to be taken any further by surprise, you |[party.compNames] is still lying in the dirt, and you rush over to lend a hand before Tollus's goons can ready another salvo. Together, the two of you |[party.compNames] are still lying in the dirt, and you rush over to lend a hand before Tollus's goons can ready another salvo. Together, the three of you ] make a mad dash for the barricade, zigzagging as erratically as you can while still making expedient progress towards your goal.[party.hasCompanions | Fortunately for [party.compNames], the cultists have figured that you're the biggest threat here and are focusing their fire on you in an attempt to bring you down. Flattering, perhaps, and you definitely don't need to worry that much about anyone besides yourself, but on the other hand there's a lot of pressure on you to stay standing. ] The experience is harrowing, to say the least. More than once, an arrow comes within inches of burying its cruel, barbed head into your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun], but you're light enough on your feet and blessed with quick enough reflexes to catch yourself in the nick of time and hurl yourself the other way. Several others come really close, searing your flesh as the barbed heads catch and draw blood, but at least you don't suffer wounds any more serious than a couple of stinging grazes. It looks like the cultists were depending too much on quantity instead of quality in their attempt to bring you down, and are paying the price for it. Eventually, you're finally within arm's reach of the barricade, but the fight's not over yet. Drawing your [pc.weapon] [party.hasCompanions |and with [party.compNames] hot on your heels, ]you vault over an upturned wagon and bound atop a set of palings with your superior agility. Time slows as you plant your feet squarely on one of the bowmen's chests, sending him sprawling off his post and to the rocky ground with an %"oomph." Unperturbed by one of their number going down, the remaining cultists drop their bows and draw wicked-looking blades and daggers, closing in to engage you in melee. |There's no time to waste. Scrambling to your feet, you sweep the ravine with your eyes for any kind of cover, but Tollus's goons have done their job well and long since removed anything that might shield an approach to the barricade. Cursing, you [party.hasCompanions |shout for [party.compNames] to get behind you and run. Hopefully you can draw enough fire from the defenders on the barricade that they won't focus so much on your allies. |start off towards the barricade at a dash, knowing full well that this is quite possibly what the defenders want but having little choice in the matter. ] With retreat being out of the question, it's either move in or wait to be turned into a pincushion, and you're not giving these bastards the satisfaction of the latter. Though you move in as erratic a fashion as possible and zigzag as much as you can, you've simply nowhere near the impressive speed and reflexes someone would need in order to evade the hail of arrows aimed at you simply by dodging. Halfway to the barricade, you become aware of a searing pain in your shoulder as a cruelly barbed arrowhead tears into your shoulder; another one nicks your thigh, leaving your [pc.armor] stained with bright red. It could've been worse — the arrowheads could've lodged in you like the barbs were intended to encourage — but there's a noticeable limp in your step as you force yourself forward and vault over an upturned wagon and onto the palisade[party.hasCompanions |, [party.compNames] hot on your heels ]. The cultists are prepared for this move, and drop their bows to brandish serrated blades and daggers, moving in to meet you in melee. What you can see of their faces under their heavy hoods is grim and neutral, their mouths set in thin lines, and you wonder if Tollus has been recruiting a more... practical bent of underling for his more important projects. Either way... ] ] ] ] ] It's a fight!"

rows.original:
You're fighting the Cultist Reaver!

    The leader of the cultists manning the barricade is a seven foot-tall hunk of meat. Dressed in robes of purple and black with bronze plating affixed to the fabric, he strikes an imposing figure as he smashes away with the spiked head of his mace. What's exposed of his bulging, muscle-bound limbs are covered with obscene tattoos and purple veins, pulsing with a sinister light. Tollus certainly has been using his newfound powers to empower his more prominent underlings...
rows.translation:
你正在与那些邪教徒战斗！

    把守路障的邪教徒首领，是个身高七英尺的壮汉。他身着紫黑相间的长袍，袍料上还镶嵌着青铜片，这一身装扮让他显得格外威武。他挥舞着带刺的权杖，每一下都极具破坏力。他那粗壮的四肢上布满了令人不寒而栗的纹身，紫色的血管在上面跳动，散发着邪恶的光芒。显然，托勒斯一直在利用自己新获得的力量来强化那些手下的实力……

rows.original: The cultist reaver bashes your [pc.armor] in with his mace, the solid blow knocking the wind out of you and sailing into an empty wheelbarrow. You think you might have broken a rib somewhere, but that's easily the least of your worries as the reaver lumbers over and hauls you upright by the scruff of your neck. [party.hasCompanions |[party.compNames] [party.manyCompanions |are |is ] nowhere to be seen in the wreckage, and you can only fear the worst. ] "I'd kill you here," the reaver rumbles from behind his featureless facemask-cum-helm, "but the Master has shown an interest in taking you alive if practically possible. You're coming with me... although he didn't say anything about not using you first. You've caused me a lot of trouble, would-be Champion of Hawkethorne, and I'm getting something out of you before I hand you over to the Master." With those words, you suddenly feel a pulse of heat waft against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun], a dim, eerie light cast upon your surroundings, shifting from shades of purple to deep red. To your alarm, you realize that it's coming from within the reaver's armored robes, which are beginning to bulge and shift in ways one would definitely considered unnatural. With a clattering of metal, the robes fall away, revealing the cultist reaver's naked form. He's got the obscene tattoos that Tollus's little posse all bear, glowing with dim red light and awash with power, but more important are the dozen long, dark purple tentacles that sprout from his thickly muscled body. You're too bruised and battered from the fight to move, but two of the slimy appendages coil about your ankles anyway, preventing your escape. The reaver allows his mace to fall to the ground with his armored robes, and closes what little distance remains between you. "These gifts from the Dark Lady are yet too lacking in finesse for proper combat, which is why I didn't bring them out earlier. Nevertheless, I find them more than adequate for certain... aha, activities. Allow me to demonstrate." The reaver's voice is raspier now, sounding like he's speaking through a mouthful of slime, and not for the first time you wonder just what this brute is hiding behind his facemask-cum-helmet. He makes an obscene gesture in the air, then thrusts his hips at you, drawing your attention to what he's packing on his crotch. A bubbling chuckle rises from the cultist reaver as you notice that not one, not two, but three bulging tentacle cocks sprouting from tight crotch. Each is at least one and a half feet in length, and covered in the same purple pebbled skin and sheen of slime his tentacles are; by now, you are certain that the creature in front of you is not human, at least not anymore thanks to whatever Kasyrra did to this man. With agonising slowness, tentacles and tentacocks alike curl through the air as they reach for you. "Now, then..." Like in battle, the cultist reaver isn't one for subtlety in sex, either. His wiggling appendages begin their assault in earnest, a pair of them settling between your legs, another on your back door, and one aiming straight for your mouth. The remaining ones encircle you, binding you in place and forcing your legs apart. You open your mouth to scream, but quick as a snake, the tentacle in front of your face darts down your throat; your scream is transformed into a muffled moan as the tendril probes deeply down your throat, forcing you to service it. The slime coating the tentacle is slightly sweet as it meets your tongue, and judging by the lust it inflames within you at a mere touch, a powerful aphrodisiac. With surprising gentleness, it massages the insides of your mouth, and a muffled moan bubbles up your throat as you eagerly fellate said tentacle, caressing it with your tongue as it writhes in your maw. You're dimly aware of the fact that you should care that this monstrosity is facefucking you with its thoroughly corrutped appendages, but you can't seem to care any more. Once he's satisfied that you've been sufficiently broken, the cultist reaver rams [pc.hasVag |two more tentacles into you at once, one in your vagina and the other up your ass. The sheer force of the double penetration has you shuddering from head to toe in perverse, aphrodisiac-fueled euphoria, and your eyes roll back into your head from the sheer sensation of it all. Rapidly picking up speed, the dark, corrupted tentacles begin pumping in and out of you, one thrusting while the other withdraws, bouncing you atop twin peaks of pebbly, pulsating flesh. |a thick tentacle straight up your ass. The sheer force of the brutal penetration has you shuddering from head to toe in perverse, aphrodisiac-fueled euphoria, and your eyes roll back into your head from the sheer sensation of it all. Rapidly picking up speed, the dark, corrupted tentacle begins pumping in and out of you, thrusting with wild abandon and bouncing you atop a peak of pebbly, pulsating flesh. ] [party.has berwyn |Suddenly, the cultist reaver tenses and raises his head, akin to an animal sniffing the air. rows.translation: 那个掠夺者摇摇晃晃地站着，丢掉了盾牌，伸手去抓什么东西——任何能够让他站稳的东西，但他的手指却只抓到了空气。 [party.has arona |阿罗娜咧嘴一笑，走上前，用她的拳头狠狠地击中了那个穿着盔甲的掠夺者的胸膛。 [arona.weapon]这一撞击使他重重撞上附近的一块巨石。当掠夺者的头盔后部与坚硬的石头相撞时，发出了剧烈的金属碰撞声，随后他瘫倒在地，鲜血从那顶毫无装饰、完全覆盖整个头部的头盔下渗了出来。 你自己也挺不错的嘛。阿罗娜露出阴险的笑容，上前一脚将那把掠夺者的钉头锤踢开了。有几次差点就骗到我了。如果这就是所谓的‘大恶’想要在战场上使用的手段，那我可要好好享受这场战斗了。 |[party.has brint |虽然那个掠夺者仍然处于失衡状态，但布林特突然以惊人的速度冲了上去，将他的武器柄狠狠地插入 [brint.weapon] 金属碰撞声响起，长矛直接刺中了那个邪教徒的胸膛。他踉跄着向后倒去，后脑重重地撞在附近的巨石上，头盔的后部与坚硬的岩石相撞，又发出一声刺耳的金属声响。长矛和盾牌从他手中掉落，那个邪教徒瘫倒在地，再也没能站起来。 他并不是靠自己的力量来工作的。布林特一边思索着，一边上前将那夺命者的武器踢开。看得出来，他还不太适应自己的身体，而这正是我们获胜的原因之一——一个优势。 |[party.has cait |他扔掉手中的钉头锤，再次冲了上来，那粗壮的手指紧紧抓住了凯特的肩膀。你的粉色小猫发出尖叫声，条件反射般地也挥动起了自己的爪子。 [cait.weapon]这一拳正中那名掠夺者的胸膛。或许是因为他在战斗中已经体力不支，又或许是因为凯特不愿让一个身上布满纹身的怪人触碰她，他震惊地踉跄后退。凯特的嘴唇紧抿成一条细直线，紧接着又是一记直拳击中他的头部。掠夺者发出一声闷哼，头盔撞在巨石上发出沉闷的声响，随后重重地倒在坚硬的石地上。 真是个变态。凯特急忙拍掉肩上的灰尘，同时吐了口唾沫。他的那只手简直湿漉漉的，黏糊糊的，让人感到非常恶心。 如果你遇到有人愿意自愿加入托勒斯大师那个崇拜卡希拉的小团体，那你一定会感到惊讶——因为这样的人在内心深处，肯定也在某种程度上感到反感或不满。 哼。 |你上前一步，用工具的末端猛击了他一下。 [pc.weapon]为了确保效果，你直接朝他的胸膛猛击。你的攻击击中了他袍子上的护甲板，发出沉闷的金属碰撞声，但这股冲击力足以让他踉跄后退，失去平衡。那个袭击者摔倒在他身后的一块巨石上，他的头盔狠狠地撞在光滑的岩石上，又发出一声巨响，随后他瘫软在地，再也没能站起来。 ] ] ] [party.comp einin |从安全的距离观察着，艾宁吹了一声口哨。嗯，看来是尺寸的问题吧做毕竟，这些东西都是有重量的。它们越大，就越容易成为目标——而且掉下来的时候也会越猛烈！ ] 你转过身来，心想在自己忙于对付那些恶魔教徒的首领时，是否还有其他人来到了现场，但此刻周围确实空无一人。你的目光再次落在那个被击败的敌人身上——虽然他现在静止不动，但你还是不敢靠近去确认他是否真的已经死了。他戴的那顶头盔，很可能确实有某种原因，用来遮住他的整个面部。 [party.comp einin |他说了些什么关于推迟我们行动的事情。艾宁突然开口说道： [einin.weapon] 消失了。我们得走了。 ] 好吧，是时候离开这里了。如果那个袭击者是在故意拖延你，而路上其他的人正在完成他们要做的任务，那么最好的办法就是立刻离开，就像一棵树一样迅速消失。
rows.raw: " The reaver staggers, dropping his shield and reaching out for something, anything, with which to steady himself, but his grasping fingers close on empty air. [party.has arona |Grinning, Arona steps forward and gives the reaver a good slam on his armored chest with her [arona.weapon], sending him crashing into a nearby boulder. There's a loud metallic ding as the back of the reaver's helmet connects with solid stone, and then he slumps to the ground, blood trickling out from under the featureless, full-face helmet. "You're not half-bad yourself," Arona says with a nasty grin as she steps forward and kicks away the reaver's mace. "Almost got me a few times there. If this is what this so-called great evil is looking to put on the field, I'm going to have a great time." |[party.has brint |While the reaver's still off-kilter, Brint surges forward in a surprising burst of speed and plants the hilt of his [brint.weapon] straight into the reaver's chest with a metallic clang. The cultist stumbles backward and crashes back-first into a nearby boulder, a loud metallic ding sounding in the air as the back of his helmet connect with solid rock. Mace and shield falling from his hands, the reaver slumps to the ground and doesn't get back up. "He didn't work for his strength," Brint muses as he steps forward and kicks away the reaver's armaments. "You can tell. He wasn't used to his body, and that's one of the reasons we won. An advantage." |[party.has cait |He drops his mace and lashes out again, thick sausage fingers closing in on Cait's shoulder. Your pink kitten squeals and lashes out reflexively with her [cait.weapon], hitting the reaver square in the chest. Whether it's because he was already weakened from the battle, or because Cait didn't want a creepy tattooed guy laying his hands all over her, he stumbles back in shock. Her lips a thin, straight line, Cait follows this up with another straight to the head. The reaver falls back with a grunt, a dull clang sounding out as his helmet strikes a boulder and slumps to the hard, stony earth. "What a creep," Cait spits as she hurriedly dusts off her shoulder. "That hand of his was just so sweaty and clammy, it was revolting." You'd be surprised if anyone who would willingly join Master Tollus's little Kasyrra-worshipping troupe wasn't revolting on some level. "Pff." |You step forward and smack him with the business end of your [pc.weapon], straight on the chest for good measure. There's a dull clang as your attack bounces off one of the armored plates on his robes, but the impact is enough to send him staggering backwards and lose balance. The reaver falls onto a large boulder behind him, a loud clang ringing out as his helmeted head strikes smooth rock; he slumps to the stony earth and doesn't get up again. ] ] ] [party.comp einin |Observing from a safe distance, Einin whistles. "Well, well. Looks like size does matter, after all. The bigger they are, the more of a target they are — and the harder they fall!" ] You spin around, wondering if any more of the demon cultists have arrived on the scene while you were busy with their leader, but the coast is clear for now. Your eyes wander back down to the reaver — while he's still, you don't want to get close and check whether he's really dead or not. That helmet of his probably obscures his entire face for a good reason. [party.comp einin |"He said something about delaying us," Einin pipes up as her [einin.weapon] vanishes. "We have to go." ] Right, time to get out of here. If the reaver was trying to stall you while whoever further along the trail completes the job they're meaning to, it's best to make like a gods-damned tree and leave."

rows.original: You step aside and look to Quin, waving him toward the unconscious reaver. Your taeleer ally hesitates, shockingly staring at you. "You mean it? I... I can take my revenge?" [pc.isDK|The fucker deserves it after helping Tollus, doesn't he?|It isn't your ideal situation but the two clearly have bad blood.] One less enemy is better for both of you, isn't it? "Yes," Quintillus replies. "Yes... it is." The bunny steps forward, looking down on the reaver; his fur rages into flames, flickering hotter than normal whilst Quintillus reaches to his journal. Both of his eyes glow brighter, focused solely on the unconscious cultist yet flipping it open. One by one, he cycles through drawings and notes until he finds [flags.QUINTILLUS_STATUES|the rune for his stasis spell.|a strange glyph in the back. A circular pattern with various runes and magical symbols similar to the ones you'd seen on his journal's cover.] "Saving you would be too easy," Quin sighs. "Enjoy your prison, dumbass." The charming bunny raises one hand and the flames around his wrist surge forth, both of his eyes erupting with fiery auras. In an instant, the unconscious cultist is engulfed in the surging heat. It licks and shrinks him, completely covering every bit of him. As it burns down and leaves ashes, the only thing left where he had been is a statue: a perfect, down-scaled copy of the reaver. Your companion picks the miniature up, pocketing into one of his pouches. You make your way over Quin cautiously, grabbing his shoulder and watching the taeleer's ears droop. Moments ago he had been so proud and confident... but now, he was pale and tired. Is he okay? "Yes, I am now at the very least. It isn't like I killed him but using this compression-stasis magic isn't... easy." Although you don't mean to be rude, now isn't the time to discuss this. You need to get moving before the cultists find and surround you.
rows.translation: 你退到一旁，看向昆因，挥手示意他走向那个失去意识的掠夺者。你这位泰勒尔盟友却犹豫了，震惊地盯着你。 “你是认真的吗？我……我真的可以报仇吗？” [pc.isDK|那混蛋帮了托勒斯，落得这下场也是活该，不是吗？|这虽然不是你理想中的局面，但你们两人显然积怨已久。] 对你们双方来说，少一个敌人总是好事，不是吗？ “是的，”昆蒂卢斯回答道，“是的……确实如此。” 那只兔子向前迈了一步，俯视着那个掠夺者；他的毛发猛地燃起火焰，比平时闪烁得更加炽烈。与此同时，昆蒂卢斯伸手去拿他的日志。他的双眼愈发明亮，目光只锁定在那个失去意识的邪教徒身上，同时翻开了日志。他一页页地翻看其中的图画与笔记，直到找到 [flags.QUINTILLUS_STATUES|他施展停滞术所需的符文。|封底上一个奇怪的符号——一个由各种符文和魔法符号构成的圆形图案，与你在他的日志封面上见过的那些十分相似。] “救下你也太容易了，”昆因叹息道。 “好好享受你的牢狱生活吧，蠢货。” 这只迷人的兔子举起一只手，手腕四周的火焰骤然涌出，他的双眼迸发出炽烈的光环。刹那间，那个失去意识的邪教徒被汹涌的热浪吞没。热浪舔舐着他，令他不断缩小，将他彻底覆盖。当火焰燃尽、只余灰烬时，他原本所在的地方只剩下一座雕像：一个完美缩小的掠夺者复制品。 你的同伴捡起那座小雕像，收进自己的一个腰包里。你小心翼翼地走到昆因身边，抓住他的肩膀，看着这位泰勒尔的耳朵耷拉下来。片刻之前他还那么骄傲自信……但现在，他脸色苍白，神情疲惫。他没事吧？ “至少我现在没事了。我并没有真的杀死他，只不过使用这种压缩停滞魔法可并不……容易。” 尽管你并无冒犯之意，但现在不是讨论这个的时候。你得赶紧行动，趁那些邪教徒还没发现并包围你。

rows.original: If Quin is quick about it, he should take his revenge now. It won't be pretty, though, that's for sure.
rows.translation: 如果昆因动作迅速，他现在就应该报复了。不过，可以肯定的是，这个报复过程肯定不会有什么美好的结局。
rows.raw: "If Quin is quick about it, he should take his revenge now. It won't be pretty, though, that's for sure."

rows.original: The last of the cultists staggers back, too winded to continue the fight. The black-robed bastard looks about, as if half-deciding whether to make a break for it or not, but the decision's made for him as he's thrown back by a thick, muscled arm and lands in the remains of a broken, upturned cart. "Useless. All of you, useless. But that's not your fault — it's my fault as a leader for failing you." Splinters fly into the air as you narrowly dodge the business end of a mace, the spiked bronze ball sinking into a beam by your shoulder. You don't know how the towering, imposing figure that now looms before you managed to hide so well, but he's here now, raising his mace for another swing at you. He — or at least, you think that's what it is by the general cut of the body under the plated robes — wields a diamond-shaped shield of purple crystal in his off-hand, and raises it to ward off your [pc.weapon] as you counter his blow. Despite the oddly-shaped helmet he's wearing having neither visor nor slits, being a blank facade of bronze, the cultist leader turns his head towards you as if sizing you up. "The Master said you might come and interfere, and you're certainly more than I expected," he rumbles. "But even if I am defeated here, all I have to do is delay you long enough." Long enough for what? "The less I know, the less I can tell," comes the curt reply as the mace smashes into a barrel. Looks like the time for talk is over with this one. It's a fight!
rows.translation: 最后一个邪教徒踉跄着后退，已经气喘得无法继续战斗了。那个穿着黑袍的混蛋环顾四周，似乎还在犹豫是否应该逃跑，但他的决定早已被别人替他做出了——一只粗壮有力的手臂将他推了回去，使他跌落在一辆被撞坏、翻倒的马车的残骸中。 毫无用处。你们所有人，都毫无用处。但这不是你们的错——而是我的作为领导者，如果他让你失望了，那他就是有缺点的。 当你侥幸躲过了那柄长矛的致命一击时，碎片纷纷飞向空中，那颗带刺的青铜球则击中了你肩膀旁的一根横梁。你实在不明白，这个此刻矗立在你面前的高大威猛的身影，究竟是如何成功地隐藏自己的踪迹的。但他现在又出现了，正举起长矛准备再次攻击你。他——或者至少，从他那身铠甲下露出的身形来看，你认为是他——在另一只手中握着一块紫色水晶制成的菱形盾牌，正举起来试图挡开你的攻击。 [pc.weapon] 就在你准备反击他的攻击时，那个邪教头目竟然转过头来看着你，仿佛在打量你一样。尽管他戴着的头盔形状怪异，既没有面甲也没有视线孔，只是一块光秃秃的青铜板，但他的动作却显得十分自然。 大师说过你可能会来干涉，而你确实比我想象中的还要厉害。它发出隆隆声。但即使我在这里被击败，我所要做的就是尽可能长时间地拖住你们。 足够做些什么呢？ 我知道得越少，就能说的越少。当铁锤砸中桶子时，只传来简短的回应。看来，和这个人交谈已经没有意义了。 这是一场激烈的战斗！

rows.original: Deciding that Tollus's goons aren't going to be needing the stuff they brought with them any more, you conduct a quick search of the bundled supplies. Most of the goods wrapped up here are sundry and not worth carrying — nails, scraps of tough salted jerky, a hammer and chisel, some short lengths of rope. Looks like most of what they carried here was either used in building the barricade or carried further up the trail. However, buried beneath all the empty sackcloth wrapping is a small box, curiously nailed down to the cart bed on which it sits. A brief examination reveals a set of ornate carvings, and a very curious locking mechanism. [party.has einin |You glance at Einin and ask the little mousegirl if she knows anything about this kind of lock. Can she do anything about it? Einin takes all of three seconds to study the box before shaking her head. "Lockpicks won't work on this one — it's a wordlock chest. If we rip it off the cart bed and could find a fence willing to take it no questions asked, it might be worth more than what's in it. It's an antique in and of itself, and the mechanism isn't something even the Khor'minoans can make any more." Would she? She shakes her head. "Me? I wouldn't do it. It's too valuable to randomly fence... and my bosses would probably think I was embuzz... embezzleeng or something — er, not that that matters anymore. But if you want to open it... there should be a riddle on it somewhere. Solve it, and it opens... that's what I know." Hmm. [pc.bg scholar noblescion acolyte |Based on your own studies, you know that servants of Belharan nobility were not educated and could not read. Considering Einin's inexpert linguism, she'd probably never get these open either. |Riddles, eh? Shouldn't be too hard to figure out, if ancient Belharan security was testing someone's ability to read. [pc.isDK |Einin may be the only thief in existence who gets stumped by a reading test, too. She may not look it, but you can tell she's saving face right now. Cute. |How... convenient that this is the one box your informally educated mouse-thief would probably be unable to open on her own. ] ] |[party.has cait |"Father used to tell Calla and I about these," Cait pipes up as she studies the chest. "They're wordlock chests, a favorite of the old Belharan nobility, meant to safeguard valuables from illiterate [silly|players|servants]. Each combination lock was secured by a password, and to help the owner remember what it was a riddle was often posed on the chest itself." So if you solved this thing, the lock would just pop open and you could just help yourself to anything inside. "Yep!" |[pc.bg noblescion courtesan scholar acolyte |You've come across these before in your past — wordlock chests, a favorite of the old Belharan nobility, meant to safeguard valuables from illiterate [silly|players|servants]. Each of these combination locks was secured by a password, and to help the owner remember what it was, a riddle was often posed on the chest itself. If you could solve it and thereby rotate the tumblers into the right position, the chest would unlock and allow you to claim its contents. |Hmm, what can this all mean? It certainly seems like a thoroughly roundabout way to secure a container, but at least it isn't likely to be trapped in the bargain. You test the mechanism a few times, turn the tumblers, but nothing happens. ] ] ] You consider the box again. It's a strange way to go about securing valuables, to be sure, but also a fairly effective one given the circumstances; too bad for the demon cultists that you came along, eh? Would you like to have a go at opening it?
rows.translation: 你认为托勒斯的那些打手们已经不再需要他们带来的那些东西了，于是你迅速检查了一下这些捆绑好的物资。这里装着的大多数物品都是一些琐碎的小东西，根本不值得携带——钉子、一些咸肉碎块、一把锤子和凿子，还有几段短绳子。看来他们带到这里的东西，大多要么用在搭建路障上，要么被继续带上山了。 然而，在所有那些空麻袋的包裹之下，还有一个小盒子，它被奇怪地钉在了放置它的车架上。经过简单的检查，人们发现了一组精美的雕刻，以及一种非常奇特的锁闭装置。 [party.has einin |你瞥了眼艾宁，询问这位小老鼠女孩是否了解这种锁的原理，以及她是否能够解决这个问题。 艾宁花了整整三秒钟来观察那个盒子，最终还是摇了摇头。这個锁箱不能用开锁工具打开，它是密码锁箱。如果我们把它从马车上拆下来，再找到一个愿意无偿接收它的买家，它的价值可能会远远超过里面的物品。它本身就是一件古董，而这种锁具的制造技术，就连科尔米诺人现在也做不出来了。” 她会吗？ 她摇了摇头。“我？我可不会那么做。这东西太值钱，不能随便拿去销赃……而且我的老板们大概会觉得我在贪……贪墨什么的——呃，反正现在也无所谓了。不过你要是想打开它……上面某处应该有个谜语。解开它，箱子就会开……我就知道这些。” 嗯。 [pc.bg scholar noblescion acolyte |根据你自己的研究，你应该知道贝尔哈兰贵族的仆从们是没有受过教育的，也不识字。考虑到艾宁在语言能力方面的不足，她很可能也永远无法打开这些东西。 |谜语，嗯？如果古代贝尔哈兰的安全系统是用来测试某人的阅读能力的话，这些谜语应该不会太难解吧。 [pc.isDK |艾宁或许是这个世界上唯一一个会被阅读测试难住的小偷了。她看起来可能并不像，但你能看出她现在正在努力维护自己的面子呢。真是可爱。 |真是太方便了……这个盒子正是那种没有受过正规教育的老鼠小偷很可能自己根本打不开的东西。 ] ] |[party.has cait |“父亲过去常常给我们讲这些故事。凯特在研究那个箱子时开口说道。这些是密码锁箱，是古老的贝尔哈兰贵族们非常喜爱的物品，它们的作用就是保护贵重物品免受那些不识字的人的侵害。 [silly|玩家们|仆从们]每个密码锁都需要输入正确的密码才能打开，而为了帮助主人记住密码，人们通常会在箱子本身上设置一个谜语来帮助记忆。 所以，如果你解决了这个问题，锁就会自动打开，然后你就可以取走里面的任何东西了。 没错！ |[pc.bg noblescion courtesan scholar acolyte |你在过去曾经见过这类东西——字锁箱。这种箱子曾是贝尔哈兰老贵族们的最爱，他们的目的就是用它来保护贵重物品，防止那些不识字的人偷走它们。 [silly|玩家们|仆从们]这些组合锁每一把都需要输入密码才能打开，为了帮助主人记住密码，人们通常会在箱子上设置谜语。只要你能解开这个谜语，将锁芯旋转到正确的位置，箱子就会打开，让你取走里面的物品。 |嗯，这一切到底意味着什么呢？这种方式看起来确实挺迂回的，但至少不会让人陷入什么麻烦之中。你试了几次这个装置，转动了那些旋钮，但什么反应也没有。 ] ] ] 你再次看了看那个盒子。用这种方式来保护贵重物品，确实有些奇怪，但考虑到当时的情况，这种方法也还算相当有效吧？那些恶魔教徒可就倒霉了，因为你出现了，对吧？你想试试打开它吗？
rows.raw: " Deciding that Tollus's goons aren't going to be needing the stuff they brought with them any more, you conduct a quick search of the bundled supplies. Most of the goods wrapped up here are sundry and not worth carrying — nails, scraps of tough salted jerky, a hammer and chisel, some short lengths of rope. Looks like most of what they carried here was either used in building the barricade or carried further up the trail. However, buried beneath all the empty sackcloth wrapping is a small box, curiously nailed down to the cart bed on which it sits. A brief examination reveals a set of ornate carvings, and a very curious locking mechanism. [party.has einin |You glance at Einin and ask the little mousegirl if she knows anything about this kind of lock. Can she do anything about it? Einin takes all of three seconds to study the box before shaking her head. "Lockpicks won't work on this one — it's a wordlock chest. If we rip it off the cart bed and could find a fence willing to take it no questions asked, it might be worth more than what's in it. It's an antique in and of itself, and the mechanism isn't something even the Khor'minoans can make any more." Would she? She shakes her head. "Me? I wouldn't do it. It's too valuable to randomly fence... and my bosses would probably think I was embuzz... embezzleeng or something — er, not that that matters anymore. But if you want to open it... there should be a riddle on it somewhere. Solve it, and it opens... that's what I know." Hmm. [pc.bg scholar noblescion acolyte |Based on your own studies, you know that servants of Belharan nobility were not educated and could not read. Considering Einin's inexpert linguism, she'd probably never get these open either. |Riddles, eh? Shouldn't be too hard to figure out, if ancient Belharan security was testing someone's ability to read. [pc.isDK |Einin may be the only thief in existence who gets stumped by a reading test, too. She may not look it, but you can tell she's saving face right now. Cute. |How... convenient that this is the one box your informally educated mouse-thief would probably be unable to open on her own. ] ] |[party.has cait |"Father used to tell Calla and I about these," Cait pipes up as she studies the chest. "They're wordlock chests, a favorite of the old Belharan nobility, meant to safeguard valuables from illiterate [silly|players|servants]. Each combination lock was secured by a password, and to help the owner remember what it was a riddle was often posed on the chest itself." So if you solved this thing, the lock would just pop open and you could just help yourself to anything inside. "Yep!" |[pc.bg noblescion courtesan scholar acolyte |You've come across these before in your past — wordlock chests, a favorite of the old Belharan nobility, meant to safeguard valuables from illiterate [silly|players|servants]. Each of these combination locks was secured by a password, and to help the owner remember what it was, a riddle was often posed on the chest itself. If you could solve it and thereby rotate the tumblers into the right position, the chest would unlock and allow you to claim its contents. |Hmm, what can this all mean? It certainly seems like a thoroughly roundabout way to secure a container, but at least it isn't likely to be trapped in the bargain. You test the mechanism a few times, turn the tumblers, but nothing happens. ] ] ] You consider the box again. It's a strange way to go about securing valuables, to be sure, but also a fairly effective one given the circumstances; too bad for the demon cultists that you came along, eh? Would you like to have a go at opening it?"

rows.original: You rub your temples and sigh. The riddle's right there in front of you, but its words might as well have been unscalable walls. Whatever's in the chest is going to have to stay inside until you figure this out.
rows.translation: 你揉了揉太阳穴，叹了口气。这个谜题就摆在你的眼前，但它的内容简直就像一堵高不可攀的墙。除非你解开这个谜题，否则箱子里的东西永远也取不出来。
rows.raw: "\n            You rub your temples and sigh. The riddle's right there in front of you, but its words might as well have been unscalable walls. Whatever's in the chest is going to have to stay inside until you figure this out."

rows.original: With flashing sword and booming cry With darkness staining land and sky Soldiers fall in glistening dress As battles are joined without egress
rows.translation: 剑光闪烁，吼声如雷（With flashing sword and booming cry） 黑暗染遍大地与天空（With darkness staining land and sky） 士兵身披闪亮战衣倒下（Soldiers fall in glistening dress） 战斗一旦打响，便无路可退（As battles are joined without egress）
rows.raw: " With flashing sword and booming cry With darkness staining land and sky Soldiers fall in glistening dress As battles are joined without egress"

rows.original: Something within the chest clicks, followed by a loud thump as the mechanisms within disengage. Instinctively, you step back, fearing a trap, but your fears are soon allayed as the spring-loaded lid pops open, revealing the chest's contents. You quickly realize why the cultists were so particular about security here — in addition to a small amount of money, no doubt what remains of the funds for this expedition, there're several small items that look like they've been recently excavated. Finds that the cultists have dug out, then. [party.has einin |"Oh, early payday!" Einin chimes, the little mouse-girl whistling appreciatively as she picks up one of the electrum coins and bites it. "Yeah, these are good. Finders keepers, losers weepers. It's not stealing when you do it from bad guys, right?" She sure is picking up on this adventuring stuff really quickly. "Hey, it's kind of like what I used to do, if only a little bit more socially acceptable. A little bit." ] Without further ado, you pocket the small stash of coins and turn your attention to the cultists' finds. Though they're still smeared with dirt, [party.has cait |Cait is all over the marble fragments, picking them out of the box's velveted insides and raising them up to the light. "Hmm." Figure anything out? "I know enough of my theology to get that there's indeed Sorran symbology on some of these. That aside... there's not much inherent value of any of these, I'm afraid. At least, we know we're on the right track. That's got to count for something, right? Wait — oh, look at this!" Hmm? Your attention's drawn to the pair of light plated boots Cait's waving about. Someone's obviously tried to clean off the dirt and remove the patina that's accumulated on it in places, and it looks to be in pretty good condition despite how old it must be. If you replaced the rotted inner padding, it could still be serviceable even without needing to get it touched up at a forge. "I don't think it's what we were sent here to find, but it's nevertheless ours now. I'm not about to let those creeps get their hands on anything if I can help it!" That's a sentiment you can agree with. |you sift through the marble fragments, trying to figure if any of them hold any significance to you. [pc.bg acolyte scholar arcanist |Happily, thanks to your time as [a] [pc.background], you're able to at least recognize some of the symbology etched upon the marble fragments as clearly Sorran — flowing lines, jagged thunderbolts, wings. As much as what might be expected from cursory learning; someone who'd studied the field more in-depth might have been able to decipher more, but you know enough to be sure that Sanders didn't send you on a wild goose chase. |You pick up a couple of the marble fragments, trying to make head or tail of the symbology and considering what it might be about them that would have made the cultists deem them valuable. It looks vaguely religious, which means that Sanders didn't send you on a wild goose chase and that Tollus's goons are indeed after the same thing that you are, but any meaning beyond that simple inference is lost on you. ] Your attention, though, is drawn to the last item lying in the box — a pair of light sabatons fashioned from some kind of gray metal, much lighter than it ought to be. Someone's obviously tried to clean off the dirt and remove the patina that's accumulated on it in places, and it looks to be in pretty good condition despite how old they must be. If you replaced the rotted inner padding, they could still be serviceable even without needing to get them touched up at a forge. This probably isn't the relic Sanders sent you here to find, but it's not something you'd want to leave in the cultists' hands, either. You'll be able to make better use of it than they would. ] With that dealt with, you slam the chest shut and prepare to be on your way. Acquired 300 EC. Acquired 1x Winged Sabatons.
rows.translation: 箱子里的某个部件咔嗒一响，随后随着内部机械的松脱，传来一声沉重的闷响。你本能地后退一步，担心这是陷阱，但很快你的担忧就消散了——弹簧盖猛地弹开，露出了箱中的物品。你立刻明白了为什么那些邪教徒对这里的防护如此讲究——除了一小笔钱（无疑就是这次探险剩下的经费）之外，还有几件看起来像是刚被发掘出来的小物件。看来是那些邪教徒挖出来的东西。 [party.has einin |“哦，提前发工钱啦！”艾宁宁欢快地接口道，这只小老鼠女孩赞许地吹了声口哨，捡起一枚琥珀金币咬了一口。“嗯，这些成色不错。谁捡到归谁，丢了活该。从坏人手里拿东西，那不算偷，对吧？” 她学起这些冒险门道来还真是快得很。 “嘿，这有点像是我以前干的事，只是稍微更符合社会规范一点。就一点哦。” ] 不再多说，你把那一小堆硬币收进口袋，然后把注意力转向邪教徒的那些发现。虽然它们还沾着泥土，[party.has cait |凯特正扑在那堆大理石碎片上，把它们从箱子天鹅绒的内衬里拣出来，举到光下端详。“嗯。” 看出什么门道了吗？ “我的神学知识足够让我看出，其中一些上面确实有索兰的符号体系。除此之外……恐怕这些都没什么本身的价值。至少我们知道，我们的方向没错。这总该算点什么吧？等等——哦，看这个！” 嗯？你的注意力被凯特挥舞着的那双轻型板甲靴吸引过去。显然有人试着清理过上面的泥土，也去掉了一些地方积起的铜绿；尽管年代久远，它看起来状况相当不错。只要换掉里面腐烂的内衬，它依然能用，甚至不必送去铁匠铺翻新。 “我觉得这不是我们被派来找的东西，但它现在归我们了。只要我办得到，就绝不让那些家伙碰到任何东西！” 这个想法你完全赞同。 |你翻拣着那些大理石碎片，想弄清其中是否有哪一块对你有什么意义。 [pc.bg acolyte scholar arcanist |好在，凭借你身为 [a] [pc.background] 的那段经历，你至少能认出刻在这些大理石碎片上的部分符号明确属于索兰——流畅的线条、锯齿状的雷电、羽翼。这已经是从浅尝辄止的学习中能指望得到的全部；若有人更深入地研究过这个领域，或许还能解读出更多，但你懂得的已经足够让你确信：桑德斯并没有让你白跑一趟。 |你拿起几块大理石碎片，试图弄清这些符号的来龙去脉，并琢磨究竟是什么让那些邪教徒觉得它们有价值。它看上去隐约带有宗教意味，这意味着桑德斯没有让你白跑一趟，而托勒斯的手下确实在追寻和你一样的东西；但除了这个简单的推断之外，你完全读不出更多含义。 ] 不过，你的注意力被箱子里最后一件物品吸引过去——一双由某种灰色金属制成的轻型战靴，比它应有的重量轻得多。显然有人试着清理过上面的泥土，也去掉了一些地方积起的铜绿；尽管年代久远，它们看起来状况相当不错。只要换掉里面腐烂的内衬，它们依然能用，甚至不必送去铁匠铺翻新。 这大概不是桑德斯派你来此寻找的遗物，但你也不想把它留在那些邪教徒手里。你能比他们更好地利用它。 ] 处理完这些，你砰地关上箱子，准备上路。 获得了 300 EC。 获得了 1 个带翼战靴。
