rows.original:
"Whew! I think this is it!"

            You heft yourself up onto the top of the rocky hillside with Livrea and glance down where she's pointing. 
            
            The two of you are a good few miles from Hawkethorne now, somewhere south-east of the village and deep into the foothills between it and the mountains. The hills here have grown taller and more jagged, and you're doing more climbing than walking. There hasn't been as much in the way of ruins lately, giving way to truly untamed wilderness. 
            
            Following Livrea's gaze, you see there's a small but deep-looking lake in the caldera between three stony hills. Water collects here from small rivers all around, and... yes, there's a flow going from it straight into the side of the nearest mountain. Livrea grins ear to ear. "That's it, definitely. This dumps into the lake under the mountain. My uncle Livernus runs a barge across it — if I can just make it to the underlake I'm sure I can flag him down." She waves you forward and starts clambering down towards the waterhead.
rows.translation:
“呼！我想就是这里了！”

            你和莉维娅一起爬上了那座多岩石的小山的山顶，然后顺着她指的方向往下望去。
            
            此时，你们已经距离鹰棘镇有好几英里远了，应该位于村庄的东南方向，处于村庄与山脉之间的山麓地带。这里的山丘变得更高、更加崎岖，你更多是在攀爬，而不是在行走。最近，遗迹的数量也减少了，取而代之的是一片真正荒芜的野外地带。
            
            顺着莉维娅的视线望去，你会看到在三座岩石山丘之间的火山口里，有一个面积不大但看起来很深的湖泊。这里汇集了周围小河流的水，而且……没错，这些水会直接流入最近那座山的侧面。莉维娅笑得合不拢嘴：“就是这里了，肯定就是这里。这些水最终会流入山下的湖泊里。我叔叔利维纳斯驾驶着一艘驳船在湖上航行——只要我能赶到那座地下湖，肯定能把他叫住。”她说着，示意你跟在她后面，然后开始朝着水源爬下去。
rows.raw:
"
            "Whew! I think this is it!"

            You heft yourself up onto the top of the rocky hillside with Livrea and glance down where she's pointing. 
            
            The two of you are a good few miles from Hawkethorne now, somewhere south-east of the village and deep into the foothills between it and the mountains. The hills here have grown taller and more jagged, and you're doing more climbing than walking. There hasn't been as much in the way of ruins lately, giving way to truly untamed wilderness. 
            
            Following Livrea's gaze, you see there's a small but deep-looking lake in the caldera between three stony hills. Water collects here from small rivers all around, and... yes, there's a flow going from it straight into the side of the nearest mountain. Livrea grins ear to ear. "That's it, definitely. This dumps into the lake under the mountain. My uncle Livernus runs a barge across it — if I can just make it to the underlake I'm sure I can flag him down." She waves you forward and starts clambering down towards the waterhead."

rows.original: Maybe you could open that chest?
rows.translation: 也许你可以打开那个箱子？

rows.original: Dropping that on the wyrm would be one hell of a wakeup call.
rows.translation: 把那东西扔到那条巨龙身上，绝对会让它猛然清醒过来。
rows.raw: "Dropping that on the wyrm would be one hell of a wakeup call."

rows.original: You creep up to the edge of the rocky outcropping, glancing up at the jagged pillar of wet stone hanging from the ceiling. It's pretty much directly over the wyrm's nest, though you can't quite eyeball where on the beast it might land. It's not exactly an arrow. And that's if you could dislodge it. The thing's well out of arm's reach. Plus, dropping it's definitely going to cause a lot of chaos. You better be ready for anything if you manage to get it loose...
rows.translation: 你悄悄地走到岩石突出的边缘，抬头望去，只见一根由湿漉漉的石头构成的、参差不齐的石柱悬挂在天花板上。它几乎正好位于那条巨龙的巢穴正上方，不过你没法准确判断它会砸在巨兽的哪个部位——它毕竟不是一支箭。 而这还是在你能把它弄下来的前提下。那个东西根本够不着。而且，让它掉下去肯定会引发一阵大乱。如果你真能把它弄松，最好做好应对一切情况的准备……
rows.raw: " You creep up to the edge of the rocky outcropping, glancing up at the jagged pillar of wet stone hanging from the ceiling. It's pretty much directly over the wyrm's nest, though you can't quite eyeball where on the beast it might land. It's not exactly an arrow. And that's if you could dislodge it. The thing's well out of arm's reach. Plus, dropping it's definitely going to cause a lot of chaos. You better be ready for anything if you manage to get it loose..."

rows.original: Time to give the wyrm a rude awakening. You draw a leananstone from your pouch and give it a ginger bounce in your palm, getting a good feel for the heft of the thing. It's small, but you know it's going to pack a punch — even gently palming the thing charges your hand with static electricity, making your small hairs stand upright. Livrea gives you a double thumbs-up and draws her sword from its sheath at her hip. [party.has cait |Cait folds her ears down and covers them with her hands. ] You line up a shot and hurl the leananstone straight at the hanging pillar of stone. The stormbound stone strikes true and hard, and lets loose a cacophony of thunderous force that rattles you straight to your bones. There's a scattershot of falling stone from the stalactite's base as it's violently wrenched from its hanging position, sent hurtling towards the ground with all the might of the world yanking it down. The poor sleeping wyrm under you is struck in the thigh by the falling stone, wrenched to wakefulness by deafening thunder and piercing pain. Blood paints the cavern floor crimson. The wyrm thrashes and screams, fire drooling from its slavering maw. Its tail and wings slam into the rocks beneath you, and you feel something cracking underfoot. Too late, you try and scramble backwards to safety, but already the overhang is starting to topple. The only saving grace is that it doesn't pitch over entirely, but rather is just slow enough of a collapse that your group's able to slide down rather than tumble, but there's no escaping gravity's pull. You hit the ground and roll, grabbing your [pc.weapon] as you make ready. Livrea faceplants behind you, hardly graceful with those big hooves, but you yank her back to her feet before the wyrm can fully turn to face you. Blood gushes from its seeping wound, but it's not dead yet. Not even close. It roars at you, almost as loud as the leananstone's blast, and spreads its wings menacingly.
rows.translation: 是时候把这条巨龙粗暴地弄醒了。 你从口袋里掏出一块利安石，在掌心轻轻颠了颠，好好感受了一下它的分量。它虽然很小，但你知道它蕴含着惊人的力量——哪怕只是轻轻托在掌心，也会让你的手掌充满静电，让细小的汗毛都竖了起来。 莉维娅也向你竖起了大拇指，然后从腰间的剑鞘中拔出了她的剑。 [party.has cait |凯特把耳朵耷拉下来，然后用双手把它们盖住。 ] 你瞄准目标，将那块利安石径直掷向悬垂的石柱。 这块风暴之石精准而沉重地击中了目标，迸发出一阵雷鸣般的巨响，震得你骨头都在发颤。当那根钟乳石被猛力拽离悬挂的位置时，有零星的石块从它的基部掉落下来，仿佛整个世界都在将它们向下拽，让它们急速向地面坠去。你下方那只正在沉睡的巨龙，被掉落的石块击中了大腿，震耳欲聋的巨响和剧烈的疼痛将它从睡梦中惊醒。鲜血将洞穴的地面染成了猩红色。 巨龙剧烈地扭动身体，发出惨叫声，口中不断喷出火焰。它的尾巴和翅膀不断撞击着你下方的岩石，而你感觉脚下有什么东西正在断裂。为时已晚，你试图向后爬向安全的地方，但那片悬岩已经开始倒塌。唯一值得庆幸的是，它并没有完全翻倒，只是崩塌得足够缓慢，让你的小队能够滑下去而不是翻滚下去，不过，终究还是逃不过重力的牵引。 你摔在地上滚了几圈，同时抓住你的 [pc.weapon] 做好准备。莉维娅重重地摔在了你身后——那双巨大的蹄子让她的动作一点也不优雅，但你及时把她拉了起来，免得巨龙完全转过身来面对你。鲜血从它渗血的伤口中喷涌而出，但它还没有死。远远没有。 它朝你咆哮着，声音几乎和那块利安石爆发的轰鸣一样响亮，并威胁性地展开了双翼。

rows.original: If only you had a leananstone...
rows.translation: 要是你有一块利安石该多好……

rows.original: You almost snap your fingers, before you catch yourself. Don't want to risk waking the wyrm when it's in such a perfect position. That shield buried in the cave wall looks damn solid and heavy, all old bronze and discus-shaped. Perfect for [silly |cosplaying Captain America |throwing ]. You creep back, grab hold, and flex your muscles. A bit of pulling and wiggling and you're able to get it free. It's in decent shape, if badly pierced and dented — not worth much anymore as a shield, but it's still got its heft. Good enough. Taking a deep breath, you heft the battered shield up and take a running start towards the overhang's edge, waiting for the last moment to release so you can throw all your weight and momentum behind the throw. It strikes true, slamming into the pendulous stalactite and cleanly severing it at the base. There's a scattershot of falling stone from the stalactite's base as it's violently wrenched from its hanging position, sent hurtling towards the ground with all the might of the world yanking it down. rows.original: That shield lodged in the wall back behind you! It's solid and heavy, you might be able to hurl it hard enough to knock the stone free.
rows.translation: 那个盾牌卡在你身后的墙上去了！它非常坚固且重型，如果你能用力把它扔出去，或许就能把那块石头撞下来。
rows.raw: "That shield lodged in the wall back behind you! It's solid and heavy, you might be able to hurl it hard enough to knock the stone free."

rows.original: You lack the physical strength to throw anything hard enough to dislodge that stone.
rows.translation: 你没有足够的体力来抛出足够有力的力量，从而把那块石头弄掉。
rows.raw: "You lack the physical strength to throw anything hard enough to dislodge that stone."

rows.original: You point to Livrea's harp, then the stalactite, and mime an explosion. She takes a deep breath and nods, planting her feet and getting her harp nestled just right in her arms. You take the opportunity to cover your ears before the bovine bard hammers her fingers across the strings and incants a spell of sorcerous thunder that blasts like a roaring storm from her instrument into the air. The shockwave cracks the stalactite, and then a second chord sends arcs of coruscating lightning across it to finish the job. The stone breaks free with a roar of breaking earth and plummets to the ground with all of gravity's fury behind it. The poor sleeping wyrm under you is struck in the thigh by the falling stone, wrenched to wakefulness by deafening thunder and piercing pain. Blood paints the cavern floor crimson. Blood gushes from its seeping wound, but it's not dead yet. Not even close. It roars at you, almost as loud as the bard's magical blast, and spreads its wings menacingly.

rows.original: Ask Livrea to blast the stalactite free. Though doing so will certainly wind the bubbly bard for any upcoming encounters...
rows.translation: 让莉维娅把那些钟乳石敲掉吧。不过这么做的话，这位活泼的吟游诗人在接下来可能遇到的任何战斗里肯定会气喘吁吁……
rows.raw: "Ask Livrea to blast the stalactite free. Though doing so will certainly wind the bubbly bard for any upcoming encounters..."

rows.original: "Any ideas, Liv?" you whisper. Hopefully the ruckus the wyrm's snoring makes will drown out your voices. ... Unfortunately, it really does. The bardic bovine flicks her ears and shrugs. You point up at the stalactite, and then make a cutting gesture downwards. She makes an "oh!" expression, and then hefts up her harp and mimics running her fingers aggressively over the strings, then thrusts them at the stalactite. Finally, she slumps her shoulders and breathes heavily, as though completely exhausted. You suppose that's an option, at least.
rows.translation: “有什么主意吗，莉芙？”你低声问道。希望那条巨龙发出的鼾声能掩盖你们的声音。 ……可惜，事实并非如此。真的如此。那位牛族吟游诗人抖了抖耳朵，耸了耸肩。 你指着钟乳石，然后向下做了一个斩击的手势。她露出“哦！”的表情，接着拿起她的竖琴，模仿着快速地用手指在琴弦上弹奏，然后又将手指朝向钟乳石的方向挥动。最后，她垂下肩膀，重重地喘着气，仿佛已经筋疲力尽。 你认为，至少这也是一个可行的选择。

You point up at the stalactite, and then make a cutting gesture downwards. She makes an "oh!" expression, and then hefts up her harp and mimics running her fingers aggressively over the strings, then thrusts them at the stalactite. Finally, she slumps her shoulders and breathes heavily, as though completely exhausted. You suppose that's an option, at least.'

rows.original: Back away and consider other options for now.
rows.translation: 暂时退后一步，考虑其他选择吧。
rows.raw: "Back away and consider other options for now."

rows.original: There's an outcropping of rock just ahead, hanging over the riverside path. [dayNight |It looks like a decently shady spot to catch your breath. Although it seems you're not the only one with the idea... |A number of bats shriek and take wing when you draw near. Wait, no, not just you... ] There's a big woman sitting herself down on top of the rocks, with battle-scarred jade skin and a long brown ponytail tossed over one shoulder. She's wearing almost nothing: just a cape and a bikini made of metal links over fur padding, leaving a tattoo in the shape of two horned wolves over her crotch bare for all to see. All that orcish muscle's proudly on display as she grins down at you, licking one of her tusks. "Well, well, [party.has arona |[arona.isExile |if it isn't the exiled kid and her loser champion." "Fuck you, Ylvid. Boot-licking whore," Arona snarls. "Come down here and say that to my face." |what brings you out this way, chief? I figured you were [arona.isDom |gonna be spending the winter balls-deep in your fucktoy there |gonna be shaking that ass for [pc.name] there all winter ]." "Ylvid!" Arona says, putting her hands on her hips. "Finally crawled out from between Thane Vulgra's thighs long enough to see the Marches, huh? You're a little late to the party." "Yeah, I heard from Hretha!" the other orc grins. "Congrats on finally proving you got a bigger dick than your brother." ] You glance at Arona. "Friend of yours?" |look at this! And the chief always said patience was for cowards, but here you are!" ] The orc slaps her hand on a war drum slung at her side. "I am Ylvid Helvasdottir, skald of the Kervus tribe! And you..." she points directly at the ginger cowgirl beside you "...must be Livrea." Your bardic companion puffs up her already-massive chest. "So you've heard of me all the way in the Sailgraves! I'm flattered." "Your line is famous in the islands, daughter of the Storm Witch," the orc sneers. "I knew our scouts' report of a bard with strawberry-colored hair poking around the foothills could only mean you!" "What?" you say. "You came chasing after the first red-headed cowgirl you heard about?" Ylvid places a hand on her drums, and the other on an axe hanging from her belt. "Of course I did! If I best the Livrea, the spirits of my clan sent beneath the waves by her witch mother will rock the veil of death with their cheers! And my legend will sing gloriously across the islands!" Livrea looks up at the orc and laughs. "So what, you want some kind of bard-off? What do they call it in orcish, a... a flyting?" "Ha, you know our language. Yes, that," Ylvid says, baring her tusks and flicking her thumb across her axehead, "or I beat you [party.som |both |all |all ] down and see how well you sing between my thighs." You put a hand on your own weapon. "You sure you want to try against [party.som |both of us |all three of us |all four of us ]?" "Ha. You're right. Not exactly a fair fight!" Ylvid says, standing. "You'd better run back to town and bring all your friends!"
rows.translation: 前方有一处岩石突出部，悬在河边的小路上方。 [dayNight |这个地方看起来确实是个不错的阴凉处，可以让人休息一下。不过，看来不止你有这个想法…… |当你靠近时，许多蝙蝠会发出尖锐的叫声然后振翅飞走了。等等，不对，不只是你…… ] 一个高大的女人在岩石顶上坐了下来，她那布满战斗痕迹的肌肤呈现出玉石般的光泽，一头长长的棕色马尾随意地搭在肩上。她几乎没穿什么衣服，只披着一件斗篷，以及一件由金属链环和毛皮衬里制成的比基尼，因此她裆部那对双角狼形状的纹身便完全暴露在众人眼前。她那充满兽人特征的肌肉线条一览无余，而她正对着你咧嘴一笑，甚至还舔了舔自己的一颗獠牙。 “嗯，嗯，[party.has arona |[arona.isExile |如果不是那个被流放的小鬼和她那个没用的冠军的话。” “去你的，伊尔维德。舔靴子的婊子，”阿罗娜怒吼道，“有胆子就下来当面对我说。” |是什么风把你吹到这儿来了，首领？我还以为您 [arona.isDom |整个冬天都把你的小玩具操得死去活来 |整个冬天都要为 [pc.name] 摇屁股了 ] “伊尔维德！”阿罗娜双手叉腰说道，“终于从领主瓦尔格拉的大腿间爬出来，能看到边境地区了，是吧？你来得有点晚啊。” “是啊，我是从赫蕾莎那里听说的！”另一个兽人咧嘴笑道，“恭喜你终于证明了你的‘家伙’比你哥哥的大啊。” ] 你瞥了瞥阿罗娜，问道：“你的朋友吗？” |看看这是谁！老板以前总是说耐心是懦夫才会有的品质，但现在看看吧！ ] 那个兽人将她的手按在挂在身侧的战鼓上。“我是凯尔维斯部落的吟游诗人伊尔维德·赫尔瓦斯多蒂尔！而你……”她直接指着你身旁的那个红发女牛仔，“……一定是莉维娅。” 你的吟游诗人同伴挺起了她那本就够壮观的胸膛。“这么说，连帆葬群岛那边都听说过我的名字了！真是让我受宠若惊。” “你们家族在这些岛屿上很有名，风暴女巫的女儿，”那个兽人冷笑道，“我早就知道，侦察兵报告说山麓有个草莓色头发的吟游诗人出没，那只可能是你！” “什么？”你问道，“你是为了追寻那个你第一次听说的红发女牛仔才来到这里的吗？” 伊尔维德将一只手放在她的鼓上，另一只手则放在挂在腰带上的斧头上。“当然要！如果我能胜过那个莉维娅，那些被她那女巫母亲沉入海底的族人，他们的欢呼会震得死亡之幕颤抖！我的传说也会荣耀地响彻群岛！” 莉维娅抬头看着那个兽人，笑了起来：“那么怎样？你想来一场吟游比赛吗？在兽人语里，这好像叫……‘斗嘴’？” “哈，你还会说我们的话。没错，就是那个，”伊尔维德露出獠牙，用拇指抚过斧刃，“不然我就把你们[party.som |两个 |全部 |全部 ]打趴下，再看看你夹在我大腿之间时能唱得多好。” 你把手放在了自己的武器上。“你确定要试试[party.som |我们两个 |我们三个 |我们四个 ]？” “哈，你说得对。这确实算不上公平的对决！”伊尔维德说着站起身来。“你最好跑回城里，把你所有的朋友都带来！”

rows.original:
You draw your [pc.weapon]. Livrea follows suit, pulling the short sword from the scabbard at her side.

        "Ah, I was hoping you'd pick violence!" Ylvid admits, hopping down from the rocks and pulling the axe from her belt. "Good! We'll settle this like orcs!" 
        
        "So by losing to a Minoan?" Livrea snorts. "That's what your Kervus have been doing for centuries!"
        
        Ylvid snarls. "We'll see how you sound when I'm riding those pretty lips, cow!"
rows.translation:
你拔出 [pc.weapon]。莉维娅也跟着照做，从腰间的剑鞘中拔出了那把短剑。

        “啊，我就知道你会选择暴力手段！”伊尔维德说着，从岩石上跳下来，从腰带上取下了那把斧头。“很好！我们就像兽人一样来解决这个问题吧！”
        
        “所以你是说，因为输给了米诺斯人？”莉维娅嗤笑道，“你们的凯尔维斯族几个世纪以来不就是一直在干这种事吗？”
        
        伊尔维德怒吼道：“等我骑在你那漂亮的嘴唇上时，你就知道我会怎么说你了，蠢牛！”

rows.original: You're a simple [pc.mf|man|woman]. If you see an orc blocking your way, you must fight her.
rows.translation: 你就是个很单纯的人[pc.mf|男人|女人]。看到兽人挡路，你就必须跟她打一场。
rows.raw: "You're a simple [pc.mf|man|woman]. If you see an orc blocking your way, you must fight her."

rows.original:
You nod to Livrea. "Let's see how she stacks up to you."

        The bard scoffs, puffing out her chest. "Please! Nobody's more stacked than a cowgirl, and certainly not some meatheaded orc. Her kind work off all their curves pumping the oars of their tiny, sad little ships." 
        
        Ylvid howls with laughter, rapping her knuckles on her drums. "Big words for a small girl — no, that's not true. You're wide enough to block the harbor when your kins' slaver ships come sailing home. Short and stout, that's how they breed them under the mountains."
        
        Short? Livrea's six and a half foot. Matter of perspective, you guess — Ylvid's probably got another half foot on her.
        
        Livrea's fingers dance over her harp strings. "Ah, it's clear as day now: her brain's addled by islander swill, and her eyes are rotted by half a clan's seed spilled across her face." Livrea [party.has arona
            |elbows Arona with a wink
            |mimes a splash across her own face with a flourish
        ]. "A pity, Ylvid, you could almost be cute if you weren't so dull-witted."
        
        "You Minoans are so smug about your book-learning, but what have you done with it, hm? I've seen sights you can only dream of, and had women from all across the Sailgraves call me more than 'cute!' You haven't lived until you've had a pexighast priestess use her tail like your half-beast men use their flabby manhoods, and with twice the skill! And you've certainly missed out if you've never felt an orc's tusks between your nethers, kissing your lips."
        
        Livrea laughs, plucking at her harp. "Are we flirting or dueling wits, Ylvid? Though I suppose there's hardly any difference to an orcish bimbo."
        
        "It can be both," the orc skald hurries to say. Her hand slaps the top of her drum. "Every good fight deserves a little foreplay, don't you think? And what's a fight, but foreplay for what comes after!" She laughs, cupping up one of her big green tits beneath her bustier. Damn, they're really almost as big as Livrea's...
        
        The cowgirl glances at you. "And what does my heroic escort say to that?"
        
        [pc.canDance
            |You know how these duels of wits ought to go, a battle of boasts and insults until one side loses their cool. "I say one dim-witted orc will hardly be a challenge," you say, projecting your voice with confidence through the valley. "A poor skald, a mediocre flirt, and a sad fight. Even the sex would be disappointing."
            
            Ylvid puts a hand over her chest as if struck. "You're going to regret those words, [pc.boyGirl]! I'll show you both what a Kervus skald's made of!"
            |You grimace, suddenly put on the spot. "That we're gonna kick her ass?"
            
            Ylvid howls with laughter, while Livrea cringes. Did you say something wrong? "Ah, said with such conviction. I'm sure we can find something more productive for those lips to do than boast, young [pc.race]. Let me show you."
        ]
        
        The orc reaches for her axe, and leaps down from the rocks.
rows.translation:
你向莉维娅点了点头：“让我们看看她跟你比起来怎么样。”

        那位吟游女嗤之以鼻，挺起胸膛说道：“得了吧！没人能比得上一名女牛仔，更别说某个头脑简单的兽人了。她们的工作就是依靠自己的曲线来划动那些又小又破的船桨罢了。”
        
        伊尔维德放声大笑，用指关节敲打着鼓面。“小姑娘也能说出这么大的话来……不，其实并不是这样。你的身材可真够壮实的，等你们家族的奴隶船归来时，你的身躯简直足以挡住整个港口呢。矮胖敦实——原来在山脚下就是这么培育这种动物的啊。”
        
        矮吗？莉维娅有六英尺半高。这大概只是视角的问题吧——伊尔维德应该还要高半英尺左右。
        
        莉维娅的手指在竖琴的琴弦上灵活地跳跃着。“啊，现在一切都清楚了：她的大脑肯定被那些岛民喝下的酒给搞坏了，而她的眼睛，也是因为半个氏族的人把种子撒在她脸上才变坏的。”莉维娅 [party.has arona
            |朝阿罗娜挤了挤眼，用胳膊肘碰了碰她
            |她夸张地模仿着水花溅到自己脸上的样子。
        ]。“真可惜，伊尔维德，要是你不是这么迟钝的话，其实还可以算得上挺可爱的。”
        
        “你们米诺斯人总是自以为精通书本知识，但你们到底用这些知识做了什么呢？我见过一些你们连做梦都想象不到的东西，还有来自各地的女性都称我为‘可爱’……如果你没有亲眼看到一位佩克希加斯特的女祭司像你们的半兽人那样运用自己的尾巴，而且她的技巧还是你们的半兽人两倍，那你就算真正活过人生了！而如果你从未感受过兽人的獠牙轻触你的私处，那你就真的错过了很多乐趣。”
        
        莉维娅笑着，拨弄着她的竖琴：“我们是在调情，还是在斗智呢，伊尔维德？不过对一个兽人来说，这两者应该没什么区别吧。”
        
        “两者都可以吧，”那个兽人吟游诗人急忙说道。她用手拍打着鼓面：“每一场激烈的战斗都值得一些‘前奏’，你不觉得吗？而战斗本身，不就是后续行动的‘前奏’吗？”她笑着，用胸罩托住了自己那对丰满的绿色乳房之一。该死，它们的大小简直和莉维娅的那些差不多……
        
        那位牛仔女孩瞥了你一眼：“那么，我这位英勇的护送者对此有什么看法呢？”
        
        [pc.canDance
            |你知道，这样的智斗应该怎么进行吧——一边是夸夸其谈，一边是侮辱谩骂，直到其中一方失去冷静。“我说，一个愚蠢的兽人根本构不成任何威胁，”你自信地大声说道，声音在山谷中回荡。“一个蹩脚的吟游诗人，一个平庸的调情者，这场战斗根本不会有什么精彩之处。就连性爱方面也会让人失望吧。”
            
            伊尔维德惊愕地捂住胸口，仿佛被这句话击中了要害。“你一定会后悔说出这种话的 [pc.boyGirl]! 我会让你们俩看看，一个真正的凯尔维斯吟游诗人到底是什么样的人！”
            |你皱起了眉头，突然感到有些尴尬：“我们是说要把她打得落花流水吗？”
            
            伊尔维德放声大笑，而莉维娅则显得有些尴尬。难道我说错了什么吗？“啊，你说得可真是一副胸有成竹的样子……不过我觉得，用你的嘴来说些更有意义的事情，总比整天吹牛要好吧，年轻人。 [pc.race]让我来给你演示吧。”
        ]
        
        兽人抓起她的斧头，从岩石上跳了下去。

rows.original: She wants a bardic battle? Let Livrea give her what she wants. It'll probably turn into a real fight anyway — Ylvid's an orc after all — but with some clever words, maybe she can be put off-balance.
rows.translation: 她想要一场吟游诗人之间的较量？那就让莉维娅满足她的愿望吧。反正最终很可能真的会变成一场打斗——毕竟伊尔维德是个兽人——但只要用些巧妙的言辞，或许就能让她乱了阵脚。

rows.original:
"Do you smell that?" Livrea asks, scrunching her nose.
    
    [party.has brint
        |"Wasn't me," Brint says.
    ]
    
    [party.has arona
        |Arona lifts an arm and sniffs herself. "Hey, I smell fine!"
    ]
    
    [party.has atugia
        |"No? What's up?" Tui asks.
    ]
    
    [party.has agni
        |"I would have told you if it was me," says Agnimitra.
    ]
    
    [party.has cait
        |Cait quirks her head. "Nope!"
    ]
    
    [party.has ryn
        |Ryn's ears wiggle. "People are heading this way."
    ]
    
    [party.has quin
        |Quin's ears twitch, one of them swiveling towards the river. "I don't smell anything, but we do have company."
    ]
    
    [party.has kiyoko
        |Kiyoko's ears flick. "Yes. We are not alone."
    ]
    
    There's a violent crack just beside you; sparks and stone fragments erupt from the cliffside. Liv curses and ducks, grabbing at her sword as four dark shapes rush out across the rickety old footbridge stretching over the river. They're quick and sleek, covered in dusky scales and bounding on clawed digits trailed by sinuous tails. One of them's dragging a discarded mining pick that's taller than the creature is itself behind it.
    
    "Kobolds!" Livrea hisses, drawing her sword. "Watch it, they'll steal our shinies!"
    
    [party.has cait
        |"Uh-oh! We must'a wandered into their territory!" Cait says.
    ]
    
    One of the four, the tallest of them made to look even more imposing by a large horned helmet it wears, lifts a tooth-shaped wand and a blackened dagger at you. "Your shinies! Sacrifice!" It throws its hands to the heavens and belches black smoke. "For the great sleeper's glory!"
    
    "Shinies!" the other three echo. "Glory!"
    
    Livrea gives you a look. One of the kobolds loads a stone into its sling and begins whirling it up. Another bears a club and beats it against its shield while the poor runt dragging his pick catches up.
    
    [party.has arona
        |[silly
            |"I don't care who the dragons send!" Arona roars. "I'm not paying taxes!"
            |Arona hefts her weapon. "They can have my shinies over my dead body!"
        ]
    ]
    
    Something tells you they aren't taking 'no' for an answer.

    ]
    
    [party.has kiyoko
        |清子的耳朵轻轻一抖。“是的。我们并不孤单。”
    ]
    
    就在你身旁传来一声猛烈的爆裂；火花与碎石从崖壁上迸射出来。莉芙骂了一声，低头躲闪，一把抓住自己的剑——同时，四个黑影冲过那座横跨河谷的破旧人行桥。它们动作迅捷、身形流线，覆着暗色的鳞片，用带爪的指头蹦跳奔行，身后拖着蜿蜒的尾巴。其中一个还拖着一把被丢弃的矿镐，那把镐比它自己还高。
    
    “狗头人！”莉维娅嘶声道，拔出了她的剑。“当心点，它们会偷走我们的闪光物品！”
    
    [party.has cait
        |“糟了！我们一定是闯进它们的地盘了！”凯特说。
    ]
    
    四个当中最高的那个——戴着顶巨大的角盔，显得更加威风——举起一根牙形的法杖和一把熏黑的匕首指向你。“你们的闪光物品！献祭！”他把双手朝天一扬，喷出一口黑烟。“为了伟大的沉睡者的荣耀！”
    
    “闪光物品！”另外三个也跟着喊，“荣耀！”
    
    莉维娅看了你一眼。其中一个狗头人把石块装进投石索，开始转起来。另一个举着木棒，一下下敲在自己的盾牌上，而那个可怜的小个子则拖着镐头追了上来。
    
    [party.has arona

            |阿罗娜举起武器。“想要我的闪光物品，除非从我尸体上跨过去！”
        ]
    ]
    
    某种感觉告诉你，他们可不打算接受“不”这个答案。

    “闪光物品！”那个戴着角盔的萨满大喊道，“交出来！”
    
    吟游诗人不满地哼了一声，把手伸进自己的乳沟。在她那对巨大的乳房之间翻弄了几乎有些滑稽的一阵之后，她掏出一只小钱袋，扔到萨满脚边。你也不情愿地照做，把口袋里手头能拿出的钱都掏了出来。

        |……前提是你有的话。说实话，等它们发现你穷得叮当响之后，看你的眼神都带上了几分怜悯。
    ]

    不管是什么原因，事实就是你输了。你输给了几只在第一次冒出来时还叽里呱啦嚷着“闪光物品”的蜥蜴。即使现在，你已经被打倒、被击败、被制服，它们嘴里叽叽喳喳念叨的也只是能从你身上弄到什么闪亮的东西。

You're too deep underground; the light from the entrance is barely a pinprick in the distance Livrea gives you a deeply concerned look [pc.isMage |while you snap your fingers, creating a ball of magic light for your party to see by |and flicks a couple of strings on her harp, conjuring a small ball of lightning in her hand that's just bright enough to see by ]. "Are you thinking what I'm thinking?" [pc.isBimbo |You bounce on your heels and ponder that for a moment. "[pc.isCunning |That the magic light really makes your golden eyes shine! |That you're super pretty! ]" you say, smiling disarmingly. "I don't really do big thinkies, but your big booblies are good inspiration." Livrea giggles. "And I adore you for it. But I'm starting to think there's something big and dangerous down here with us." |You nod. "There's something big down here with us." ] The bard cranes her head to the north and flicks a bovine ear. "It sounds like snarling... snarling through really huge, sharp teeth. Like a dragon warning us off." That... surely that's a minstrel's natural tendency to exaggerate, right? Still, she's not wrong. The noise coming from along the river to the west sounds dangerous. You and Livrea exchange a look, and start searching around for some sign of what's to come. All you turn up in the immediate are muddy kobold tracks on the stone beside the flowing water, and piles of discarded bones. None of them look like folk, thankfully, but there's some big damn animals in here: you recognize the skulls of an elk and a bear amongst a lot of deer and mountain lions. Whatever's down here isn't kidding around. As you're brushing your hand along the wall, searching for any further clue, you almost pitch to the side. It's almost impossible to see, even with the arcane light close by, but there's a thin crevasse in the east wall, barely big enough to squeeze through sideways — and even then Livrea's going to have some real problems. But it is another path... You point it out to your [party.som |companion |companions |party and Livrea ]. "Look what I found." Liv grimaces. "If you want to go that way, I'm gonna need to find some butter to squeeze through there after you." She'll probably be fine... Then again, you could just bravely march north and face whatever beast lurks in the dark ahead."

rows.original: You lead the way into what proves to be a fairly large and circular alcove. There's a shield half buried in a crack in the wall near the entrance, and that's only the start of the soldiering gear you find inside. There's flimsy, time-worn canvas stretched between pitons like tents, and a torn banner rests on its pole against the far wall. There are old boots, spearheads, and a broken sword scattered on the ground. "This camp is so old," Livrea points out. "Do you think it's from the war?" You point to the banner. [pc.bg scholar |"Look at that, the blue moons? This belonged to the Imperial house of Old Belhar. Nobody's flown those colors for centuries." "Good eye," she says, nodding. "Definitely from the Godswar at the latest. Maybe even earlier." |"Do you know whose colors those were?" Liv peers at the banner a moment, stopping herself from touching the blue crescent moon on it. "These were the colors of Old Belhar's royal house. It must have been carried up here by Imperial troops. It could have been brought up here during the border skirmishes with the boreal elves, but I'd put my hawks on it being from the Godswar. Definitely no later. The Imperial house was made extinct right after." ] "I wonder what they were doing in here?" you wonder. Livrea pokes at the tent pitons. "Hiding from Wraiths, maybe. Or whatever it was that blasted old Hawkethorne City to pieces back then." The ancient wood crumbles under the bard's touch, and the canvas falls to the floor. "Hey, look!" your bardic companion says, squatting down. "It was covering something." That something, it seems, is a chest. Old but still-sturdy wood, with a brass locking plate and dials on it with letters. "A wordlock chest," Liv says. "These used to be popular among Belharan nobility. You find them all over the place these days. Just gotta spin the dials to make the answer to the riddle there." [party.has cait |"Oh! My dad has one of those!" Cait says, spinning one of the letter rings. "We put our jewelry in there while we were traveling. The riddle on ours was in Old Jassiran, too, so basically nobody this side of the sea could hope to solve it... but that did not stop Tollus's goons from just stealing the whole box out of our cart." Livrea gives Cait a pat on the shoulder. ] Even if you aren't in the mood for riddles, there's plenty of miscellaneous stuff on the ground for you to collect. Fragments of old blades and spearheads can still be smelted down and made into new, useful things like nails and horseshoes by a trained smith. You gather up the goods and stow them before turning you attention back to the chest. [silly |Not Livrea's, mind you. Well, that's certainly more visually appealing, but you don't think the bard would appreciate you flicking her nips to solve the riddle of her panties just yet. Maybe in a future expansion. ]
rows.translation: 你领头走进一个相当宽敞的圆形壁龛。入口附近的墙缝里半埋着一面盾牌，而这只是你们在里面发现的军用装备的开端。支架之间拉着破旧不堪、饱经岁月的帆布，搭得像帐篷；靠里侧的墙上，一面撕破的旗帜倚在旗杆上。地上散落着旧靴子、矛头和一把断剑。 “这个营地可真古老，”莉维娅指出来说。“你觉得它是那场战争留下来的吗？” 你指向那面旗帜。[pc.bg scholar |“看那个，蓝色月亮？这属于旧贝尔哈的帝国王室。已经好几个世纪没人打出过那面旗色了。” “好眼力，”她点点头说。“至少可以肯定来自神战时期。说不定还更早。” |“你知道那是谁家的旗色吗？” 莉芙盯着那面旗帜看了一会儿，忍住没去碰上面的蓝色新月。“这是旧贝尔哈王室的旗色。它一定是由帝国军队带上来的。也许是当年与北方精灵的边境冲突期间被带到这里，但我敢拿我的鹰赌它是神战时期留下的。绝对不会更晚。帝国王室在那之后不久就被灭绝了。” ] “我很好奇他们在这里做什么？”你心里想道。 莉维娅戳了戳帐篷的地钉。“也许是在躲幽灵。或者是在躲当年把旧鹰棘镇炸成碎片的那个东西。” 古老的木头在吟游诗人的触碰下碎裂开来，帆布也随之落到地上。“嘿，看！”你的吟游诗人同伴蹲下来说道。“它刚才盖着什么东西。” 那个东西看起来是一口箱子。木头古旧却依然结实，上面有黄铜锁板和刻着字母的旋钮。 “一口字谜锁箱，”莉芙说。“这种东西以前在贝尔哈兰贵族中很流行。如今到处都能见到。只要转动旋钮，拼出上面谜题的答案就行。” [party.has cait |“哦！我爸爸也有一个这样的东西！”凯特说着，转动其中一个字母环。“我们旅行的时候就把首饰放在里面。我们那口箱子上的谜语还是用古贾西兰语写的，所以海这一边基本没人指望能解开……可这也没能拦住托勒斯那帮手下直接把整个箱子从我们车里偷走。” 莉维娅拍了拍凯特的肩膀。 ] 就算你没心情猜谜，地上还有不少杂七杂八的东西可以收集。旧刀刃和矛头的碎片经过训练有素的铁匠回炉，仍然能锻成钉子、马蹄铁之类新的有用之物。你把这些东西收起来装好，然后把注意力转回那口箱子。[silly |提醒你一下，不是莉维娅的那口。嗯，那样确实更养眼，但你觉得这位吟游诗人大概不会乐意你为了解开她内裤的谜题而去拨弄她的乳尖。也许等以后的扩展内容再说吧。 ]

rows.original: Maybe you could open that chest?
rows.translation: 也许你可以打开那个箱子？

rows.original: You squat down next to the old chest and peer at its etched riddle...
rows.translation: 你蹲在那个旧箱子旁边，仔细端详上面刻着的谜语……
rows.raw: "\n    You squat down next to the old chest and peer at its etched riddle..."

rows.original:
The lock clicks softly. Livrea pumps her fist into the air behind you. "You did it! Good job!"
        
        You give her a slight smirk over your shoulder and then pop the chest open. Inside, you find a breastplate sitting on a blue velvet cushion, accompanied by a white leather vest stitched with moonstones. The armor has blue crescent moons etched upon its gilded surface, still as vibrant and shiny as the day it was last polished. It practically glitters in the arcane light. 
        
        "Wow," Livrea says, looking over your shoulder. "It's beautiful." 
        
        [party.has cait
            |Cait bounces. "Wow's right. That must've belonged to somebody important. Maybe even a general, or a high lord. You said this camp had the Imperial household's colors, right? Could it have been a royal's?"
            
            Livrea shrugs. "I don't know that anyone from the royal house came this far north during the war, but our history from those days is... spotty, at best. Anything's possible."
        ]
        
        You gently lift the cuirass from its resting place. It's heavy, but a cursory rap against the chiseled abs on its belly indicates that the armor's as solid as any soldier's should be. It might be worth more to you in these dark and dangerous days than to a collector somewhere.
        
        "If you wear it, wear it with pride," Liv says. "You'll cut quite the heroic figure!"
rows.translation:
锁轻轻一声打开了。莉维娅在你身后兴奋地挥舞着拳头：“你做到了！干得好！”
        
        你回头朝她微微一笑，然后打开箱子。里面，你看到一块胸甲放在蓝色的天鹅绒垫子上，旁边还有一件缝着月光石的白色皮制背心。这副铠甲的镀金表面上刻着蓝色的新月图案，那些图案至今依然鲜艳夺目，仿佛是刚刚被打磨过一样。在那种神秘的光芒下，它们简直闪闪发光。
        
        “哇，”莉维娅从你身后说道，“真是太美了。” 
        
        [party.has cait
            |凯特跳了起来：“哇，没错。那肯定属于某个重要人物，也许是一位将军，或者是一位高阶贵族。你说过这个营地使用了皇室的标志，对吧？难道那会是某位王室成员的东西吗？”
            
            莉维娅耸了耸肩：“我不知道在战争期间是否有王室成员来到这么北边的地方，不过那段时期的历史记录……充其量也只能说有些零散不全。所以，一切都有可能。”
        ]
        
        你轻轻地将这件胸甲从它放置的地方取下来。它很重，但当你用它轻轻敲击自己腹部那结实的肌肉时，你会感觉到这件盔甲确实像任何士兵应该拥有的那样坚固。在这样暗影而危险的时代，它对你来说，可能比对某个收藏家来说更有价值。
        
        “如果你要穿上它，那就带着自豪感去穿吧，”莉芙说道，“你会显得非常英勇的！”

rows.original: Our dance lasts forever 'cross the dark ocean's light; though our meetings are rarer, we turn day into night. Who am I?
rows.translation: 我们的舞步永恒流转于黑暗海洋的光辉之中（Our dance lasts forever 'cross the dark ocean's light） 虽然我们的相会十分罕见，却能让白昼化为黑夜（though our meetings are rarer, we turn day into night） 我是谁？（Who am I?）
rows.raw: "Our dance lasts forever 'cross the dark ocean's light;\nthough our meetings are rarer, we turn day into night.\nWho am I?"

rows.original:
The snarling sounds you heard in the branch cavern are back, and more intense than ever. It's downright deafening, leaving you only able to talk between whatever beast is lurking in the cave's breaths. 
    
    "It sounds huge," Liv says, trying to whisper over the sound as you walk north. "Are you sure we should-" she's forced to pause by a snarl, "-go this way?"
    
    You are most definitely not, but at least you can see that there's an end to the path ahead. It's an overhang of solid stone, looking out over a cavern below. You get low and creep up to the edge, hoping you might get a good look at whatever monster lies beneath you now.
    
    When you finally peer over the edge, you almost wish you hadn't.
    
    "Oh, gods!" Liv gasps, covering her mouth. 
    
    You're looking at a beast the size of a warhorse, laying on a bed of precious gems and sparkling stones. It's curled up into a ball with its great draconic wings spread to cover itself, and its scaly tail draped over its long, crocodile-like snout. One of its canine fangs is much longer than the other, poking out of its jaw like a wicked scythe. You can see why Livrea would call it a dragon! The thing's almost the picture of one, save for its square jaw and comparatively diminutive wings. You doubt the creature could fly on its own, but perhaps it could glide down from the hilltops and catch its prey by surprise. Its claws are certainly big enough to crush most animals living in the region, even a bear or elk, and its body is covered in iridescent seafoam-colored scales that look as thick as any soldier's armor.
    
    Your bardic companion points to the beast and mouths 'Sea Wyrm!'
    
    [pc.isCunning
        |Of course. Kin to dragons, but with none of the majesty or intelligence. Just big, fire-breathing animals condemned to crawl on the ground rather than soar.
        |[pc.bg hunter
            |You're familiar enough with their kind: kin to dragons, but with none of the majesty or intelligence. Just big, fire-breathing animals condemned to crawl on the ground rather than soar.
            |You shrug. First time you've seen one.
        ]
    ] 
    
    The acoustics of the cave are amplifying its snores, making every slumbering breath sound like a true dragon's snarl. 
    
    Thankfully, the monster hasn't detected you yet. It's probably just as hard of hearing as you two are down there, surrounded by the echoes of its own snoring. 
    
    You glance around its lair from your vantage while you can. There's two entrances to the cave following the underground river, a pile of bones pushed off to one side, precious gems and even some coins scattered around — presumably offerings from the kobolds. They do love their dragons, and a wyrm is as close as it gets these days. But nothing stands out that could give you an edge...
    
    ... Until you [pc.isCanine
        |overcome your canine instincts and 
    ]look up. 
    
    The walls and floor of this cave have been worn smooth by the passing of water over the eons, but the ceiling is another matter. Thick, jagged stalactites hang down from overhead, and one of them happens to be perilously positioned right over the wyrm's nest. If only there was some way to knock it free...
rows.translation:
你在支脉洞穴里听到的那些咆哮声又回来了，而且比以往更加猛烈。那声音简直震耳欲聋，让你只能在洞穴里潜伏的那头野兽喘息的间隙交谈。
    
    “听起来那家伙体型好大，”莉芙一边说，一边试图在你们朝北走时压过那声音低语。“你确定我们该——”一次咆哮逼得她不得不停下， “——走这条路吗？”
    
    你绝对一点都不确定，但至少你能看到前方的路有尽头。那是一块坚固岩石形成的悬岩，俯瞰着下方的一个洞穴。你压低身子，悄悄爬到边缘，希望能好好看清此刻位于你下方的那头怪物。
    
    当你终于俯身越过边缘往下看时，你几乎希望自己没有看。
    
    “哦，天哪！”莉芙捂着嘴倒吸一口气。
    
    你看到的是一头体型如战马般的巨兽，正躺在一张由珍贵宝石和闪亮石头铺成的床上。它蜷成一团，巨大的龙翼展开盖住身体，鳞片覆盖的尾巴搭在它那长长的、类似鳄鱼的吻部上。它的一颗犬齿比另一颗长得多，从颌骨中探出，像一把邪恶的镰刀。你能明白为什么莉维娅会称它为龙！这东西几乎就是龙的写照，只除了那方正的下颌和相对小巧的翅膀。你怀疑这生物自己飞不起来，但也许它能从山顶滑翔而下，出其不意地抓住猎物。它的爪子绝对大到能碾碎这一带生活的大多数动物，甚至一头熊或麋鹿也不在话下；它的身体覆盖着虹彩般的海沫色鳞片，看起来和任何士兵的盔甲一样厚实。
    
    你的吟游诗人同伴指着那头野兽，用口型无声地说：“海怪！”
    
    [pc.isCunning
        |当然。它们与龙同源，却毫无龙的威严与智慧。不过是些体型庞大、会喷火的动物，被注定只能在地上爬行，而无法翱翔天际。
        |[pc.bg hunter
            |你对这类生物足够熟悉：它们与龙同源，却毫无龙的威严与智慧。不过是些体型庞大、会喷火的动物，被注定只能在地上爬行，而无法翱翔天际。
            |你耸了耸肩。你还是头一回见到这种生物。
        ]
    ] 
    
    洞穴的声学效果放大了它的鼾声，让每一次沉睡中的呼吸听起来都像真正巨龙的咆哮。
    
    幸好，这头怪物还没发现你。它大概和你们俩一样听不太清，毕竟它被自己鼾声的回响包围着。
    
    你趁还有机会，从你的有利位置扫视它的巢穴。沿着地下河，洞穴有两个入口；一侧堆着被推开的骨头堆；珍贵的宝石甚至一些钱币散落各处——大概都是狗头人的献祭。它们确实热爱自己的龙，而如今龙蛇已经是最接近龙的东西了。但没有任何东西格外显眼，能让你占到便宜……
    
    ……直到你[pc.isCanine
        |克服你的犬类本能，
    ]抬头看。
    
    这个洞穴的墙壁和地面在亿万年水流冲刷下已被磨得光滑，但天花板却是另一回事。粗大、参差的钟乳石从上方垂下，其中一根恰好危险地悬在那条龙蛇的巢穴正上方。要是有什么办法能把它敲下来就好了……
rows.raw:
"
    The snarling sounds you heard in the branch cavern are back, and more intense than ever. It's downright deafening, leaving you only able to talk between whatever beast is lurking in the cave's breaths. 
    
    "It sounds huge," Liv says, trying to whisper over the sound as you walk north. "Are you sure we should-" she's forced to pause by a snarl, "-go this way?"
    
    You are most definitely not, but at least you can see that there's an end to the path ahead. It's an overhang of solid stone, looking out over a cavern below. You get low and creep up to the edge, hoping you might get a good look at whatever monster lies beneath you now.
    
    When you finally peer over the edge, you almost wish you hadn't.
    
    "Oh, gods!" Liv gasps, covering her mouth. 
    
    You're looking at a beast the size of a warhorse, laying on a bed of precious gems and sparkling stones. It's curled up into a ball with its great draconic wings spread to cover itself, and its scaly tail draped over its long, crocodile-like snout. One of its canine fangs is much longer than the other, poking out of its jaw like a wicked scythe. You can see why Livrea would call it a dragon! The thing's almost the picture of one, save for its square jaw and comparatively diminutive wings. You doubt the creature could fly on its own, but perhaps it could glide down from the hilltops and catch its prey by surprise. Its claws are certainly big enough to crush most animals living in the region, even a bear or elk, and its body is covered in iridescent seafoam-colored scales that look as thick as any soldier's armor.
    
    Your bardic companion points to the beast and mouths 'Sea Wyrm!'
    
    [pc.isCunning
        |Of course. Kin to dragons, but with none of the majesty or intelligence. Just big, fire-breathing animals condemned to crawl on the ground rather than soar.
        |[pc.bg hunter
            |You're familiar enough with their kind: kin to dragons, but with none of the majesty or intelligence. Just big, fire-breathing animals condemned to crawl on the ground rather than soar.
            |You shrug. First time you've seen one.
        ]
    ] 
    
    The acoustics of the cave are amplifying its snores, making every slumbering breath sound like a true dragon's snarl. 
    
    Thankfully, the monster hasn't detected you yet. It's probably just as hard of hearing as you two are down there, surrounded by the echoes of its own snoring. 
    
    You glance around its lair from your vantage while you can. There's two entrances to the cave following the underground river, a pile of bones pushed off to one side, precious gems and even some coins scattered around — presumably offerings from the kobolds. They do love their dragons, and a wyrm is as close as it gets these days. But nothing stands out that could give you an edge...
    
    ... Until you [pc.isCanine
        |overcome your canine instincts and 
    ]look up. 
    
    The walls and floor of this cave have been worn smooth by the passing of water over the eons, but the ceiling is another matter. Thick, jagged stalactites hang down from overhead, and one of them happens to be perilously positioned right over the wyrm's nest. If only there was some way to knock it free...
    "

Just big, fire-breathing animals condemned to crawl on the ground rather than soar. |[pc.bg hunter |You're familiar enough with their kind: kin to dragons, but with none of the majesty or intelligence. First time you've seen one. ] ] ] The acoustics of the cave are amplifying its snores, making every slumbering breath sound like a true dragon's snarl. rows.translation: 尽管危机四伏，你还是选择继续沿着这条地下河前进，准备迎战潜伏在深处漆黑之中的任何野兽。你和它之间隔着的是一条相当长、弯弯曲曲的隧道，足够你在最终转过最后一个弯、与它面对面之前，不断为自己的选择感到忐忑。 [flags.LQ1_BEAST2 |与那头海怪面对面。 |与—— “一条龙！”莉维娅倒吸一口气，捂住嘴巴。“等等。不对。” 你眼前的是一头战马大小的野兽，正趴在一床珍贵宝石和闪亮石头的铺垫上。它蜷成一团，巨大的龙翼展开裹住自己，覆着鳞片的尾巴搭在它那长长的、鳄鱼般的吻上。它的一颗獠牙比另一颗长得多，像一把凶恶的镰刀般从下颚里戳出来。你明白莉维娅为什么会叫它龙了！除了方形的下颚和相对短小的翅膀之外，这家伙几乎就是龙的写照。你怀疑这生物自己飞不起来，但也许它能从山顶滑翔而下，出其不意地捕获猎物。它的爪子大得足以碾碎当地大多数动物，连熊或麋鹿都不在话下，而它身上覆着虹彩般的海沫色鳞片，看上去厚实得不下于任何士兵的盔甲。 “那些鳞片，”你那位吟游诗人同伴低声说。“它一定是一头海怪。” [pc.isCunning |当然。它与龙同源，却没有半点龙的威严或智慧。不过是些体型庞大、会喷火的畜生，注定只能在地上爬行，而无法翱翔天际。 |[pc.bg hunter |你对这类生物足够熟悉：它与龙同源，却没有半点龙的威严或智慧。不过是些体型庞大、会喷火的畜生，注定只能在地上爬行，而无法翱翔天际。 |你耸了耸肩。这还是你第一次见到这种东西。 ] ] ] 洞穴的声学效果放大了它的鼾声，让每一次沉睡的呼吸听起来都像真正的龙在咆哮。 而那些鼾声正在变得急促、变得不安。即便在这 [silly |雷霆穹顶 |洞穴 ] 里被自己的呼吸声震得耳聋，这头掠食者还是察觉到附近有猎物。它的一只眼睛翻开了，金色中缀着黑色的斑点。它那竖直的瞳孔收窄了。 “糟糕糟糕糟糕，”莉芙倒抽一口气，后退了一步。她的一只蹄子踩碎了一根动物骨头，那头海怪瞬间猛地站起，发出一声吼叫，震得你五脏六腑都在发抖。“这本来应该是更安全的回家路啊！” 这下可好！

rows.original: The cavern's acoustics are amplifying storms to dangerous levels!
rows.translation: 这个洞穴的声学特性使得风暴的声音被放大到极其危险的程度！
rows.raw: "\n \n The cavern's acoustics are amplifying storms to dangerous levels!"

rows.original:
With a final, desperate roar, the wyrm charges straight at you with its head down, trying to gore you with its horns. The damn thing's nearly blind with pain, though, and you're able to dodge to the side at the last moment. Snarling and vomiting flames from its maw, the wyrm careens past you and bashes its head into the stone hard enough to break that snaggle-tooth right off. It howls and staggers back, reeling from the impact... before flopping on its side with a defeated snort. 

    Liv lets out a heavy breath and grabs her knees, barely holding onto her sword. "Holy Seven! What a monster."
    
    You nod breathlessly.
    
    "And to think this was just a little one," Livrea says, finally managing to sheathe her sword. "Give it another couple decades and it could be the size of my house. Or even mom's tower!" 
    
    And it's living right next to town? The next time it gets mad, it might just raze Hawkethorne. You glance at the disoriented beast lying on its side, breathing hard and caked in blood and dirt...
rows.translation:
随着最后一声绝望的咆哮，巨龙低着头直冲向你，想用角把你刺穿。可这该死的家伙已经疼得几乎失明，你在最后一刻及时闪到了一旁。它龇着牙，从嘴里喷出火焰，从你身边猛冲而过，一头撞在石头上，力道大得把那颗歪歪扭扭的獠牙都撞断了。它嚎叫着踉跄后退，被这一撞震得晕头转向……随后侧身倒下，发出一声认输般的鼻息。 

    莉芙长出一口粗气，双手撑住膝盖，几乎握不住剑。“神圣七神啊！好一个怪物。”
    
    你气喘吁吁地点了点头。
    
    “想想看，这还只是一头小的，”莉维娅说着，终于把剑收回了鞘里，“再过几十年，它说不定能长到我房子那么大。甚至比妈妈的塔还大！” 
    
    而它就住在那座镇子旁边？下次它发怒的时候，说不定会把鹰棘镇夷为平地。你瞥了一眼那头侧躺着、喘着粗气、浑身沾满血污和泥土、依旧晕头转向的巨兽……

rows.original:
You stagger over to the defeated wyrm and plunge a knife into its throat. Its end is quick, at least. 

        "Grim," Livrea says. "But fair. Plenty of stories about even beasts wanting revenge. Or just growing too big for the towns near their lair." 
        
        "Yeah," you say, starting to turn towards the cow-bard. 
        
        Something rumbles deep in the cave floor. Stones begin to fall from the ceiling, pitter-pattering onto the dead drake's lair. Livrea grimaces, looking between you and the tunnel leading downriver, towards home. "I, uh, I should get going. I am going to sing so many songs about you when I get home, [pc.name] — the wyrmslayer! Come find me in the city sometime!"
        
        You wave as Livrea starts jogging, and then outright sprinting down the riverside. More stones begin to fall around you, and the cave shakes violently. 
        
        [party.has cait
            |"We gotta go!" Cait says, grabbing as many gemstones as she can stuff in her pouches.
        ]
        
        [party.has brint
            |Brint looks for a moment between you and the tunnel home... before shaking his head and clapping your shoulder. "Time to get outta here!"
        ]
        
        [party.has brienne
            |Brienne barely spares a glance to the tunnel home before turning and grabbing your shoulder. "Time for us to go, [pc.name]!"
        ]
        
        [party.has kiyoko
            |Your foxy sorceress creates a shield of magic around your heads, and looks urgently towards the way back.
        ]
        
        You quickly scoop up a bunch of gemstones, as many as you dare spend the time to, before turning and booking it back the way you came — back out of the cave entirely, whereupon you hear the thunder of collapsing stone in your wake.
        
        Only when you pause to collect yourself do you realize the wyrm's broken tooth is among the hurriedly-gathered stones too.
rows.translation:
你摇摇晃晃地走到被击败的海怪面前，把一把刀刺进了它的喉咙。至少，它的死来得很快。 

        “真狠，”莉维娅说道。“但也公平。有不少故事都说，就连野兽也会想要复仇。或者只是长得太大，让它们巢穴附近的城镇再也容不下。” 
        
        “是啊，”你说道，开始转身面向那位母牛吟游诗人。 
        
        洞穴地面深处传来一阵隆隆声。石块开始从洞顶落下，噼里啪啦地砸在死去海怪的巢穴上。莉维娅皱起眉头，目光在你和那条通往家、通往下游的隧道之间来回移动。“我，呃，我该走了。等我回到家，我会为你唱好多好多的歌，[pc.name]——那位屠海怪者！有空到城里来找我！”
        
        你挥着手，看着莉维娅先是慢跑起来，随后干脆沿着河岸飞奔而去。更多的石块开始在你周围落下，洞穴剧烈地震动起来。 
        
        [party.has cait
            |“我们得走了！”凯特说道，尽可能多地把宝石塞进她的腰包。
        ]
        
        [party.has brint
            |布林特看了看你，又看了看通往家的隧道……然后摇了摇头，拍了拍你的肩膀。“该离开这儿了！”
        ]
        
        [party.has brienne
            |布蕾妮几乎没往通往家的隧道多看一眼，就转过身抓住你的肩膀。“我们该走了，[pc.name]！”
        ]
        
        [party.has kiyoko
            |你那位狐媚的女巫在你们头顶造出一道魔法护盾，急切地望向回去的路。
        ]
        
        你飞快地抓起一大把宝石，抓到你敢花的时间所能允许的极限，然后转身沿着来路狂奔——彻底冲出洞穴，身后随即传来石块坍塌的轰鸣。
        
        直到你停下来喘口气，你才意识到，海怪那颗断掉的牙齿也混在你匆忙收集的宝石当中。

        你挥着手，看着莉维娅先是慢跑起来，随后干脆沿着河岸飞奔而去。更多的石块开始在你周围落下，洞穴剧烈地震动起来。 
        
        [party.has cait
            |“我们得走了！”凯特说道，尽可能多地把宝石塞进她的腰包。
        ]
        
        [party.has brint
            |布林特看了看你，又看了看通往家的隧道……然后摇了摇头，拍了拍你的肩膀。“该离开这儿了！”
        ]
        
        [party.has brienne
            |布蕾妮几乎没往通往家的隧道多看一眼，就转过身抓住你的肩膀。“我们该走了，[pc.name]！”
        ]
        
        [party.has kiyoko
            |你那位狐媚的女巫在你们头顶造出一道魔法护盾，急切地望向回去的路。
        ]
        
        你飞快地抓起一大把宝石，抓到你敢花的时间所能允许的极限，然后转身沿着来路狂奔——彻底冲出洞穴，身后随即传来石块坍塌的轰鸣。
        
        直到你停下来喘口气，你才意识到，海怪那颗断掉的牙齿也混在你匆忙收集的宝石当中。
rows.raw:
'
        You hesitate, then shake your head. "Rest well, big guy." 

        Livrea smiles and squeezes your shoulder. "Maybe it'll remember us letting it go, and come to our rescue in our hour of need someday. Or at least, maybe it won't roast us next time we come through the hills."
        
        "We can hope!" you say, turning towards Liv. 
        
        Something rumbles deep in the cave floor. Stones begin to fall from the ceiling, pitter-pattering onto the unconscious wyrm's backside. Livrea grimaces, looking between you and the tunnel leading downriver, towards home. "I, uh, I should get going. I am going to sing so many songs about you when I get home, [pc.name] — the merciful! Come find me in the city sometime!"
        
        You wave as Livrea starts jogging, and then outright sprinting down the riverside. More stones begin to fall around you, and the cave shakes violently. 
        
        [party.has cait
            |"We gotta go!" Cait says, grabbing as many gemstones as she can stuff in her pouches.
        ]
        
        [party.has brint
            |Brint looks for a moment between you and the tunnel home... before shaking his head and clapping your shoulder. "Time to get outta here!"
        ]
        
        [party.has brienne
            |Brienne barely spares a glance to the tunnel home before turning and grabbing your shoulder. "Time for us to go, [pc.name]!"
        ]
        
        [party.has kiyoko
            |Your foxy sorceress creates a shield of magic around your heads, and looks urgently towards the way back.
        ]
        
        You quickly scoop up a bunch of gemstones, as many as you dare spend the time to, before turning and booking it back the way you came — back out of the cave entirely, whereupon you hear the thunder of collapsing stone in your wake.
        
        Only when you pause to collect yourself do you realize the wyrm's broken tooth is among the hurriedly-gathered stones too.'

rows.original: There's no need to kill this thing. Perhaps it will remember your mercy someday.
rows.translation: 没有必要杀死这个生物。也许有一天，它会记住你的仁慈。
rows.raw: "There's no need to kill this thing. Perhaps it will remember your mercy someday."

rows.original:
The wyrm's onslaught proves overwhelming, battering you down with tooth and claw until you're slammed into the ground, pinned between two clawed toes. The sea wyrm roars into your face, its breath swelteringly hot — so hot that you could swear you see the interior of its throat glowing.

    Oh, so it is. The heat... like a furnace washing over you...
    
    Your last thought is wondering whether or not it likes its [pc.raceCute] well done.
rows.translation:
这条海怪的攻击力实在强大得令人难以抵挡，它用牙齿和爪子猛烈地攻击你，直到将你压倒在地面，让你的身体被它的爪子紧紧夹住。这条海怪对着你的脸咆哮，它呼出的气息热得令人窒息——热得让你仿佛能看到它喉咙内部的火焰在燃烧。

    哦，原来如此……这种高温……就像是一股熔炉里喷出的烈火，直接扑面而来……
    
    你最后的念头是：它吃[pc.raceCute]时，会不会喜欢全熟的？
rows.raw:
"
    The wyrm's onslaught proves overwhelming, battering you down with tooth and claw until you're slammed into the ground, pinned between two clawed toes. The sea wyrm roars into your face, its breath swelteringly hot — so hot that you could swear you see the interior of its throat glowing.

    Oh, so it is. The heat... like a furnace washing over you...
    
    Your last thought is wondering whether or not it likes its [pc.raceCute] well done."

rows.original:
You can only hope Livrea made it home after that. There's no way of telling now, until you find your own way into Khor'minos someday... which will probably not be today, considering the wringer you[party.som
        |'ve
        | and your companion have
        | three have
    ] been through. Not to mention the tunnel collapsing behind you. [flags.LQ1_WYRM 2
        |You have to wonder if the wyrm managed to slither out while you were running for it. You didn't see it leave, at least...
    ]
    
    [party.has brint
        |"Rough day, huh?" Brint laughs, clapping your back. "Shame about the way home being blocked off, but I'm sure we'll get there eventually. Just hope the cute cow made it to the other side!"
    ]
    
    [party.has cait
        |Cait sighs, plucking a loose rock out of her cleavage. "So we [flags.LQ1_WYRM 1 2|killed|beat up] a sea wyrm. That's the stuff of heroes, alright!" She flashes you a pretty smile and nuzzles into your shoulder. "So what're we doing for an encore?[cait.fucked
            | Or should I say, whom?
        ]"
    ]
    
    Right now, you need to get back to town and get a bath. 
    
    You set your sights on home and start walking. Without Livrea's songs to keep your spirits up, it proves more of a slog than you remember.
    
    [pc.isDK
        |You shake that thought off. No getting soft now. Not when you've come so far.
        |With a sigh, you admit you'll miss her cheery company. More reason to find your way to her city under the mountain someday, you suppose.
    ] For now, you concentrate on getting home and getting some rest.
rows.translation:
你只能希望莉维娅在那之后能够安全回到家。现在还无从得知，直到有一天你自己能够进入科尔米诺斯……不过考虑到你所面临的种种困境，这一天很可能不会是今天。[party.som
        |已经
        | 以及你的同伴们
        | 三个人有……
    ] 经历过这些。更别提还有隧道会在你身后坍塌。 [flags.LQ1_WYRM 2
        |你不禁会想，当你在追它的时候，那条巨蛇是否已经悄悄溜走了。至少，你并没有看到它离开……
    ]
    
    [party.has brint
        |“今天真是倒霉的一天，嗯？”布林特笑着拍了拍你的背，“回家的路被堵住了，真是太遗憾了，但我相信我们最终还是会到达目的地的。只希望那只可爱的小牛能够顺利到达另一边吧！”
    ]
    
    [party.has cait
        |凯特叹了口气，从胸前取下一块松动的石头，说道：“所以，我们 [flags.LQ1_WYRM 1 2|被击杀|打败] 一条海怪……这才是英雄该面对的挑战，对吧？”她冲你露出一个迷人的微笑，然后依偎在你的肩上。“那么，接下来我们该做什么呢？[cait.fucked
            | 或者，我应该说，是谁呢？
        ]”
    ]
    
    现在，你得回到镇上去洗个澡。
    
    你朝着家的方向走去。没有了莉维娅的歌来鼓舞你的心情，这段路走起来比你记忆中的要艰难得多。
    
    [pc.isDK
        |你立刻甩开了这个念头。现在不能软弱下来。毕竟你已经走了这么远的路。
        |你叹了口气，承认自己会想念她那欢快的气氛。想来，这更是一个有理由在某天前往她所在的那个山下的城市的理由吧。
    ] 现在，你先专心回家休息吧。

rows.original: A new dungeon has been added that you have progressed beyond. Livrea, a bard from Khor'minos, arrives in Hawkethorne shortly after you awake from your Kasyrra-induced coma and tells you that her homeland may be in peril, but the Foothills are dangerous and the King's Gate is sealed. She suggests a safe route might be through the old waterheads outside of Hawkethorne that feed into the Undermountain. Would you like to help her get home, and experience this sidestory?
rows.translation: 游戏中新增了一处你已经成功通关的地下城。在从卡希拉引起的昏迷中苏醒后不久，来自科尔米诺斯的吟游诗人莉维娅来到了鹰棘镇，她告诉你她的故乡可能正处于危险之中，但山麓十分危险，国王之门也已被封闭。她建议，或许可以通过鹰棘镇外那些通往山腹深域的古老水道来寻找一条安全的路线。你愿意帮助她回到家乡，并体验这个支线故事吗？
rows.raw: "\n    A new dungeon has been added that you have progressed beyond. Livrea, a bard from Khor'minos, arrives in Hawkethorne shortly after you awake from your Kasyrra-induced coma and tells you that her homeland may be in peril, but the Foothills are dangerous and the King's Gate is sealed. She suggests a safe route might be through the old waterheads outside of Hawkethorne that feed into the Undermountain. Would you like to help her get home, and experience this sidestory?"

rows.original: Open it up! What's in the box?
rows.translation: 把它打开吧！盒子里有什么？
rows.raw: "Open it up! What's in the box?"

rows.original: The storeroom is as unassuming and threadbare as you'd have expected it to be — but there is one thing that stands out. Its metal bandings glistening in the dim light of the brazier, the sight of a bronze-bound box draws into view as you continue your search, complete with the most unorthodox locking mechanism. [party.has quin |You glance at Quin and ask the bunny-man if he knows anything about this kind of lock. Can he do anything about it? Quin takes all of three seconds to study the box before shaking his head. "Lockpicks won't work on this one, it's a wordlock chest; Tollus fancies himself a heir of old Belhar and is pretty crazy about collecting anything even remotely related to it. If we rip it off the cart bed and find a fence willing to take it no questions asked, it might be worth more than what's in it. It's an antique in and of itself, and the mechanism isn't something just anyone can make any more." Would he? "Damn right I'd do it even if it were worthless, just to deny him it. There're people in the Tael Alliance who'd pay much for one of these... but we don't have the time for that right now. Still, you want to know how these things work, right? There's a password, and you make the tumblers spell it out, simple as that. People also had a riddle inscribed on the chest just in case they forgot their password; solve that, and it opens." Hmm. [pc.bg scholar noblescion acolyte |Based on your own studies, you know Quin's not talking out of his ass; servants of Belharan nobility were not educated and could not read. |Riddles, eh? Shouldn't be too hard to figure out, if ancient Belharan security was testing someone's ability to read. ] |[party.has cait |"Father used to tell Calla and I about these," Cait pipes up as she studies the chest. "They're wordlock chests, a favorite of the old Belharan nobility, meant to safeguard valuables from illiterate [silly |players |servants ]. Each combination lock was secured by a password, and to help the owner remember what it was a riddle was often posed on the chest itself." So if you solved this thing, the lock would just pop open and you could just help yourself to anything inside. "Yep!" |[pc.bg noblescion courtesan scholar acolyte |You've come across these before in your past — wordlock chests, a favorite of the old Belharan nobility, meant to safeguard valuables from illiterate [silly |players |servants ]. Each of these combination locks was secured by a password, and to help the owner remember what it was, a riddle was often posed on the chest itself. If you could solve it and thereby rotate the tumblers into the right position, the chest would unlock and allow you to claim its contents. |Hmm, what can this all mean? It certainly seems like a thoroughly roundabout way to secure a container, but at least it isn't likely to be trapped in the bargain. You test the mechanism a few times, turn the tumblers, but nothing happens. ] ] ] You glance at Nihara. Is she okay with this? Nihara shrugs. "Given the lack of any other clergy around, I'm certainly authorized to let you have anything inside as due payment for services rendered. Since it doesn't belong to the dead, you're welcome to the contents — within reason, of course." Well, that settles that. Is there something you can do about this?
rows.translation: 储藏室正如你所预料的那样朴素而破旧——但里面确实有一样东西格外显眼。随着你继续搜寻，一只青铜包边的箱子进入你的视野，它的金属包角在火盆昏暗的光线下闪着微光，上面还装着一套最不寻常的锁具。 [party.has quin |你瞥了昆因一眼，问这个兔人是否了解这种锁，他能不能想想办法？ 昆因只用了三秒钟打量那只箱子，就摇了摇头。“撬锁对这家伙没用，它是一只词锁箱；托勒斯自认是旧贝尔哈的王位继承人，狂热地收集任何哪怕只跟它沾点边的东西。要是我们把它从车床上拆下来，再找个不问来路的销赃人，它本身可能比里面的东西还值钱。它本身就是件古董，而这种机关如今已经不是随便什么人都能做出来的了。” 他愿意吗？ “当然愿意，就算它一文不值我也乐意，只要能让他得不到。泰尔联盟里有人愿意为这种箱子出大价钱……但我们现在没那个时间。不过，你想知道这东西怎么运作，对吧？有一个密码，你转动字轮把它拼出来就行，就这么简单。人们还会在箱子上刻一道谜语，以防自己忘了密码；解开谜语，它就会打开。” 嗯。[pc.bg scholar noblescion acolyte |根据你自己的学识，你知道昆因不是在胡扯；贝尔哈兰贵族的仆人没有受过教育，根本不识字。 |谜语，嗯？如果古代贝尔哈兰的安保只是考验一个人的阅读能力，那应该不会太难解开。 ] |[party.has cait |“父亲以前跟我跟卡拉讲过这些，”凯特研究着箱子，插嘴说道。“它们叫词锁箱，是旧贝尔哈兰贵族的最爱，用来保护贵重物品不被不识字的 [silly |玩家 |仆人 ] 拿走。每一把组合锁都由一个密码锁住，而为了帮主人记住密码，箱子上往往刻着一道谜语。” 所以只要你解开这东西，锁就会自己弹开，里面的东西就任你取了。 “没错！” |[pc.bg noblescion courtesan scholar acolyte |你过去也见过这种东西——词锁箱，旧贝尔哈兰贵族的最爱，用来保护贵重物品不被不识字的 [silly |玩家 |仆人 ] 拿走。每一把这样的组合锁都由一个密码锁住，而为了帮主人记住密码，箱子上往往刻着一道谜语。只要你能解开谜语、把字轮转到正确的位置，箱子就会解锁，里面的东西也就归你了。 |嗯，这一切到底是什么意思？用这么绕的方式来保护一个容器确实够折腾的，但至少它多半不会再附带什么陷阱。你试了几次那个机关，转动字轮，却什么也没发生。 ] ] ] 你瞥了妮哈拉一眼。她对此没意见吗？ 妮哈拉耸了耸肩。“既然附近没有别的神职人员，我当然有权把里面的东西都给你，作为你提供服务的报酬。既然它们不属于死者，里面的东西你尽可以拿——当然，得在合理范围内。” 好吧，那就这么定了。这情况你能想想办法吗？

rows.original: There's nothing for it. Whatever Nihara's looking for, it's got to be in that pile of junk.
rows.translation: 没什么别的地方了。妮哈拉要找的东西，肯定就在那堆垃圾里。
rows.raw: "There's nothing for it. Whatever Nihara's looking for, it's got to be in that pile of junk."

rows.original: They feel no pain No sorrow no greed They have no anger No hatred nor need
rows.translation: 他们感受不到疼痛（They feel no pain） 没有悲伤，也没有贪婪（No sorrow no greed） 他们没有愤怒（They have no anger） 没有仇恨，也无所求（No hatred nor need）
rows.raw: "They feel no pain No sorrow no greed They have no anger No hatred nor need"

rows.original:
Something within the chest clicks, followed by a loud thump as the mechanisms within disengage. Instinctively, you step back, fearing a trap, but your fears are soon allayed as the spring-loaded lid pops open, revealing the chest's contents. Lying within is a folded black outfit with gold trimmings, the colors of Tira not too different from what Nihara wears, if considerably less revealing. It's a little odd for a wordlock to be used as a wardrobe, but these don't look to be any ordinary vestments, more ceremonial than practical.
        
        Still, leaving them here isn't going to do anyone any good, and given the cloth's already a little musty it's not going to be long before it starts the long and inexorable slide towards decay. Stowing it away requires making a little space amongst your possessions, but you manage to make it fit comfortably.
        
        Right, now on to other matters...
rows.translation:
箱子里的某个机件咔嗒一响，紧接着内部机关松开，传来一声沉闷的重击。你本能地后退一步，担心这是陷阱，但弹簧盖猛地弹开、露出箱中之物后，你的担忧很快便消散了。里面是一件带有金色镶边的黑色叠好的衣物，呈现蒂拉的配色，与妮哈拉所穿的颇为相似，只不过暴露程度要低得多。用词锁箱来当衣柜确实有点奇怪，但这些看起来并不是什么普通的祭服，与其说实用，不如说更具仪式性。
        
        不过，把它们留在这里对谁都没有好处，而且这块布料已经有点发霉了，用不了多久，它就会开始不可阻挡地慢慢走向朽坏。要把它收起来，你得在自己的物品里腾出一点空间，不过你还是设法把它舒舒服服地塞了进去。
        
        好了，现在来说说别的事吧……

rows.original: You rub your temples and sigh. The riddle's right there in front of you, but its words might as well have been unscalable walls. Whatever's in the chest is going to have to stay inside until you figure this out.
rows.translation: 你揉了揉太阳穴，叹了口气。这个谜题就摆在你眼前，但它的谜面文字简直像无法翻越的高墙。在你解开它之前，箱子里的东西只能留在箱子里。

rows.original: Nihara wrinkles her nose in distaste as she looks at the mess piled up against the wall. "Gods, what happened with this mess? Everything was supposed to be put neatly away!" It's not supposed to all be in one big messy pile? "Gods forbid! The vicar wouldn't have stood for it. No, the last time I was in this room, everything was packed away in trunks. Come to think of it, where are they? It's as if all the trunks just vanished and spilled out their contents on the ground. Looters wouldn't have —" Nihara's words are cut short as she reaches for the junk heap to dig through it, and then squeals and hops back when it begins to move. With much crashing and rattling as bronze and silver knick-knacks clatter off the pile and fall to the ground, you realize where all the organic mass in the room went — straight into the dark, translucent latex slime that jiggles to life as Nihara awakens it from its slumber. It wasn't just hidden in the pile, it was the pile — weapons, goblets, statuettes and other objects buried within it aside, you spot something near the goo's center that shines faintly with a wan, silvery light. "That's it!" Nihara shouts, grabbing her staff as she recovers. "That's the ward I need, in that casket!" The goo starts to undulate and flow, but surprisingly, it's not towards you to attack, but rather away. Weighed down as it is by the sheer amount of metal junk attached to and inside of its body, the grayish mass of latex is incredibly sluggish, but nevertheless is determined to make away with its bulk towards the nearest hole in the wall. Can it actually fit, given all the things it's laden with inside of its body? It's certainly willing to try. "Stop it! We can't let it squeeze away with what we've come all the way here to get!" While the big gray slime isn't actually interested in attacking you and its weight is preventing it from simply oozing away in the blink of an eye, you've nevertheless got to beat it before it flees with your prizes. It's a fight!
rows.translation: 妮哈拉看着堆在墙边的那一团乱糟糟的东西，嫌恶地皱起鼻子。“天啊，这里到底怎么回事？所有东西本来都该整整齐齐收好的！” 东西本来就不该全都堆成一大坨吧？ “当然不该！牧师大人绝不会容忍这种事。不，我上次来这个房间时，所有东西都收在箱子里。说起来，那些箱子呢？就好像所有箱子都凭空消失了，把里面的东西全都撒在了地上。盗贼总不至于——” 妮哈拉的话说到一半就断了，她伸手去翻那堆杂物，可当那堆东西开始动起来时，她尖叫一声跳了回来。随着青铜和银质的小玩意儿叮叮当当地从堆上滚落、砸在地上，你明白了这房间里原本那些有机质都去了哪里——全都进了那团深色半透明的乳胶黏液里，它正随着妮哈拉把它从沉睡中唤醒而颤动着活了过来。它不只是藏在那堆东西里，它就是那堆东西——武器、高脚杯、小雕像之类的物件都埋在它体内；你还注意到黏液中心附近有个东西泛着微弱、苍白而银亮的光。 “就是它！”妮哈拉喊道，一边缓过神来一边抓起她的手杖。“我需要的那道守护符就在那个匣子里！” 那团黏液开始起伏流动，但出乎意料的是，它不是朝你们扑来发动攻击，而是朝远处去。由于身上里里外外附着、嵌着大量金属杂物，这团灰色的乳胶重得惊人、动作极其迟缓，但它仍执意要带着这一身重物挪向墙上最近的洞口。它体内塞着那么多东西，真的还挤得进去吗？它显然很乐意试一试。 “拦住它！我们不能让它带着我们大老远跑来要拿的东西挤走！” 那只巨大的灰色史莱姆其实并没有攻击你们的意图，它的重量也让它无法一眨眼就流走，但你还是得在它带着你们的战利品逃走之前把它打倒。 开打吧！

rows.original: [var0 |Despite having no real way to communicate what it's feeling, you can tell that the jelly isn't having a good time — or maybe it's just having too good a time that it just can't keep itself together. Even though it's half-oozed its way into the ventilation opening with its ill-gotten gains, your last display is the final straw that breaks the proverbial donkey's back — it shudders, quavers, and then with a muted 'phut' pops like a particularly noisome bubble. What consistency it had vanishes in the blink of an eye as the latex turns runny and starts seeping into the cracks in the flooring, leaving behind all the junk it was carrying. It's probably not dead... but given that it can't reconstitute itself for the time being it may as well be. Wasting no time, Nihara steps forward over the defeated slime, picking up the glowing casket and leaving you to pick through all the other junk the corrupted slime was attempting to abscond with. Most of it is trash, but another bronze casket it had inside of it catches your eye, one with the symbol of... something engraved on its lid. rows.original:
Right, a shield, that's what it is under all the grime and gunk. You wipe off the lid, undo the catch, and to your surprise find that it lifts easily; there's a little pop of an airtight seal and then inside is a gleaming cuirass of silvered bronze that looks like it might've belonged to a Tiran paladin or something. It doesn't look like it'll be missed... and it'll probably do more good in your hands than floating around inside an overgrown pile of latex.
        
        Meanwhile, Nihara's had her back to you, scrabbling at the remains of the defeated jelly to pick up the faintly glowing casket it had in its core. Holding it close to her breast, the goocat heaves a huge sigh of relief and tightens her grip on her staff.
        
        "Well, I wasn't expecting this, but it seems to have turned out all right. Come on, let's get out of here before worse happens. Thanks, [pc.name]."
        
        It was a pleasure.
rows.translation:
没错，就是一个盾牌——在那些污垢和积灰之下，它其实就是这么一个盾牌。你擦掉盖子，解开卡扣，然后惊讶地发现它竟然很容易就被取出来了；只听见一声轻微的“啪”，密封装置已经打开，而里面则是一件闪闪发光的银青铜胸甲，看起来简直就像是某位提兰圣骑士才会拥有的东西。看起来没人会想念它……而且放在你手里，它可能会比被扔在那一堆堆积如山的乳胶材料里发挥更大的作用。
        
        与此同时，妮哈拉一直背对着你，正在翻找那只被击败的果冻怪的残骸，想把它核心部位那个微微发光的匣子取出来。她把匣子紧抱在胸前，这只黏液猫长长地舒了一口气，同时更紧地握住手中的手杖。
        
        “唉，我本来没预料到会这样，不过看来结果还算不错。好了，我们赶紧离开这里，免得发生更糟糕的事情。谢谢你，[pc.name]。”
        
        这是我的荣幸。
