rows.original: As slow as the big gray jelly is, the blob can sure take a lot of punishment; the sheer amount of metal junk it's collected in and on its body doesn't help either, armoring its amorphous form as it oozes away. Several bronze pieces wind up dislodged, falling to the ground as the jelly makes its escape through the gunked-up vent, but none of them are your prize. "Come on, [pc.name]! We can't let it get away!" Nihara yells, lancing a ray of frost at the big gray jelly. "Who knows where it'll end up once it's out of our sight!" Faced with the jaws of defeat — defeat by a creature that hasn't taken a single hostile action towards any of you in this entire encounter, nonetheless — you take another swipe at the big latex jelly, hoping to at least catch one of the gewgaws caught in its body and slow it down that way. It's not much, but it's enough of an opening for Nihara to spear another ray of frost towards the creature, freezing one of is extremities solid. That certainly hurts the horrid thing — its gleaming surface ripples and undulates, its translucent insides roiling about in what passes for pain in such an amorphous monster. Dragging about its iced-over portion in a manner eerily reminiscent of a person with a broken limb, it continues its retreat, but is forced to disgorge a number of items it's got caught inside of its form — including the faintly glowing casket that Nihara's been after. Seeing her prize fall away from the big gray jelly, Nihara loses all interest in the monster and scrabbles at the goo-slick flagstones, making her way across with all expediency without falling over. It might be a trap... but that's where you come in, and frankly you're not sure if the latex jelly is smart enough to lay one to begin with. Scooping up the casket and holding it close to her breast, the goocat heaves a huge sigh of relief and tightens her grip on her staff; relieved of its burdens and your attentions, the big gray jelly slurps away into the wall and out of sight, bringing its ill-gotten gains with it. "Well, I wasn't expecting this," Nihara mutters as she stops to catch her breath. "The latex ranches aren't that far away from the lake, but I've never heard them giving in to greed before. Or having much of an intelligence to begin with, to be honest." There's a first time for everything, and at least she got what she came here for, even if the big gray jelly managed to get away with a lot of the other things that were kept here. "Yes. I couldn't have done it without you, [pc.name]. So... thanks. As for the other things that were kept here... well, only a few belonged to the temple proper, with the rest the property of the dead. If it'll make the restless ghosts go after the slimes, I'm not going to begrudge it. "Come on, [pc.name]. Let's get out of here before something worse has the chance to happen."
rows.translation: 尽管那团灰色的黏液移动得极其缓慢，但它确实能够承受巨大的冲击；它身上堆积的那些金属碎片也起到了加固作用，使得它那无定形的身体在不断移动的过程中依然能够保持坚固。当黏液通过那些被杂物堵塞的通风口逃走时，有几块青铜碎片脱落掉了，掉到了地上，但这些碎片都不是你想要的东西。 “快点，[pc.name]！我们不能让它逃掉！”妮哈拉大喊着，向那团灰色的胶状物射出一道冰霜光束。“谁知道它一旦离开我们的视线，会跑到哪里去呢！” 面对这场看似必败的局面——尽管在整个遭遇过程中，那个生物从未对你们中的任何一个人采取过任何敌对行动——你们还是再次试图攻击那团乳胶状的胶状物，希望能抓住它体内那些奇怪的附生物，从而延缓它的移动速度。虽然不算太多，但这个机会已经足够让妮哈拉再次向那只生物发射出一道寒光，将其的一条肢体彻底冻结。 那确实让那个可怕的怪物受到了伤害——它那闪闪发光的表面出现了涟漪和波动，其半透明的内部也在不断地翻腾着，仿佛在承受着某种痛苦。它那被冰覆盖的部分移动的方式，让人联想到一个肢体受伤的人，它继续后退着，但却不得不吐出那些被它身体包裹住的物品——其中包括妮哈拉一直在寻找的、那盏发出微弱光芒的匣子。看到自己的奖品从那团灰色的黏稠物中脱落，妮哈拉立刻对这只怪物失去了兴趣，在那些黏糊糊的石板上连滚带爬地赶过去，尽量不让自己摔倒。 这可能是个陷阱……但这就轮到你上了，而且说实话，你并不确定那团乳胶是否有足够的脑子去设陷阱。那只黏液猫把匣子紧抱在胸前，长舒了一口气，然后紧紧握住了手中的法杖。卸下了重担、也摆脱了你的纠缠之后，那团巨大的灰色黏液汩汩地钻进墙壁消失了，还带走了它那些不义之财。 “嗯，我可没料到这个，”妮哈拉一边停下来喘气一边低声说道。“那些生产乳胶的农场离湖边并不远，但我从没听说过它们会变得这么贪婪。说实话，它们本来也没什么智慧可言。” 凡事都有第一次，至少她还是得到了自己来这里想要的东西，尽管那些被保存在这里的其他东西，大多还是被那个灰色的巨大生物给带走了。 “没错。没有你，我根本做不到，[pc.name]。所以……谢谢。至于那些被留在这里的物品……嗯，只有少数是属于神庙本身的，其余的都是死者的财产。如果这些物品能让那些不安的鬼魂去追捕那些黏液生物，我也不会介意的。” “来吧，[pc.name]。我们赶紧离开这里，免得发生更糟糕的事情。”
rows.raw: " As slow as the big gray jelly is, the blob can sure take a lot of punishment; the sheer amount of metal junk it's collected in and on its body doesn't help either, armoring its amorphous form as it oozes away. Several bronze pieces wind up dislodged, falling to the ground as the jelly makes its escape through the gunked-up vent, but none of them are your prize. "Come on, [pc.name]! We can't let it get away!" Nihara yells, lancing a ray of frost at the big gray jelly. "Who knows where it'll end up once it's out of our sight!" Faced with the jaws of defeat — defeat by a creature that hasn't taken a single hostile action towards any of you in this entire encounter, nonetheless — you take another swipe at the big latex jelly, hoping to at least catch one of the gewgaws caught in its body and slow it down that way. It's not much, but it's enough of an opening for Nihara to spear another ray of frost towards the creature, freezing one of is extremities solid. That certainly hurts the horrid thing — its gleaming surface ripples and undulates, its translucent insides roiling about in what passes for pain in such an amorphous monster. Dragging about its iced-over portion in a manner eerily reminiscent of a person with a broken limb, it continues its retreat, but is forced to disgorge a number of items it's got caught inside of its form — including the faintly glowing casket that Nihara's been after. Seeing her prize fall away from the big gray jelly, Nihara loses all interest in the monster and scrabbles at the goo-slick flagstones, making her way across with all expediency without falling over. It might be a trap... but that's where you come in, and frankly you're not sure if the latex jelly is smart enough to lay one to begin with. Scooping up the casket and holding it close to her breast, the goocat heaves a huge sigh of relief and tightens her grip on her staff; relieved of its burdens and your attentions, the big gray jelly slurps away into the wall and out of sight, bringing its ill-gotten gains with it. "Well, I wasn't expecting this," Nihara mutters as she stops to catch her breath. "The latex ranches aren't that far away from the lake, but I've never heard them giving in to greed before. Or having much of an intelligence to begin with, to be honest." There's a first time for everything, and at least she got what she came here for, even if the big gray jelly managed to get away with a lot of the other things that were kept here. "Yes. I couldn't have done it without you, [pc.name]. So... thanks. As for the other things that were kept here... well, only a few belonged to the temple proper, with the rest the property of the dead. If it'll make the restless ghosts go after the slimes, I'm not going to begrudge it. "Come on, [pc.name]. Let's get out of here before something worse has the chance to happen." "

rows.original:
With Nihara's staff lighting your way, you hurry back through the city of the dead — perhaps having been mollified for now at the big gray jelly [silly
        |having left the building
        |no longer being there
    ], no more minotaur specters bother you during your egress. Once you reach the heavy granite doors, Nihara presses her hand against the hourglass-and-moon symbol, and with a low grinding sound whatever mechanism that drives the doors rumbles into action, sealing them shut. Not that it stopped the slimes from getting in to begin with, but hey... 
    
    "Phew, and that's that. Let's get this lot back home and take a well-deserved rest. Maybe even a bath."
    
    Your trip back through the tunnels is uneventful, with Nihara clutching the glimmering casket to her breast every step of the way. It's not until after you make it through her fungal gardens and in through her door that she heaves a sigh of relief and sets the bronze casket down on the table with a clank.
    
    While this has been very exciting and interesting, she wouldn't begrudge you a look at this ward she took you all the way to the temple to retrieve, would she?
    
    "N-no. No, of course not. It's the least I can do for you after you sticking out your neck for me, [pc.name]. Here, help me get this open."
    
    The hinges are a little tight, but the casket's in great shape considering all the time it's spent floating about in the middle of a latex slime. Nihara cracks it open with a strand of goo-hair, and within is an ankh fashioned of some form of white stone — marble? Jade? — that glows silvery like the moon as it lies atop a cushion of decaying velvet.
    
    "Not a very powerful charm, I'll admit. Didn't help too much against the slimes, or to keep the dead in their resting places..."
    
    Well, there's the distinct possibility that the situation might have gotten even worse had it not been around.
    
    Nihara raises a hand to her cheek and sighs. "Maybe. It looks pretty, but appearances can be deceiving. Hopefully it'll help keep away the imps from the lakeside, nasty little things that they are... but more importantly, it'll give the people remaining about these parts hope, and that's in painfully short supply these days."
    
    You don't know about that. Nihara staying about these parts and continuing to minister to the people in their villas instead of holing up herself at the bottom of the lake or something and trying to wait it all out brings out more hope in people than some flashy carved rock, really.
    
    [nihara.isCorrupted
        |"Well, I never," Nihara purrs, curling a dark, inky tail about your leg and stroking you lightly. "I'm flattered, I truly am."
        |"Oh? Really?" Nihara tries to hide her smile and blush, and fails horribly at it; even if she did, the twitching of her tails would've given her away. "Well..." 
    ]
    
    No, seriously. She could've just sunk to the bottom of the lake and tried to wait it out, or barricaded herself in her home like all the patricians in the villas, but she chose to risk herself to look out for other people.
    
    "Oh, oh, if you keep on flattering me like that something untoward might happen, [pc.name]. Come on, let's get this somewhere it might be useful."
    
    With that, Nihara opens the gates in the back of her home, those that lead out from the bathing pools into the lake proper; you watch her as she wades, then eventually swims out a little way to a pole in the middle of the water. Once, it might've been used to guide boats to a nearby jetty, but with the waters empty the lantern's long since gone dead with no one to refuel it. This is where Nihara sets down the little stone ankh, propping it up in the lantern's oil reservoir; you see her flatten her palm and press it against the lantern's metal frame, and then the silvery glimmer from the ankh intensifies into a pale glow reminiscent of the light of the full moon. Quite fitting, given the stars above... and the light makes a lovely sheen off Nihara's watery goo-bits as she swims back to you in a lazy paddle, every bit in her element.
    
    "There, we're done. And now as to your reward, [pc.name]..."
    
    With a soft sigh, Nihara steps up from the bathing pool, her already revealing Tiran priestess' garments clinging to the curves of her body, water running from her hair and down her limbs as she steps up and [pc.heightRange 72 84
        |draws close
        |stands on tiptoe
        |bends her knees down
    ] to give you a lovely wet smooch. Supple and turgid, like the water that's pouring away and puddling on the ground... but surely that's not all, is it?
    
    Breaking the kiss with a hearty sigh, Nihara drags herself out of the pool with some reluctance and crosses over to a cupboard on the opposite end of the room, her footsteps perfectly dry. "Ah. I suppose not. Here, one of my patients paid me with this the other day. It's drink all right, but too rich for my veins. And money, since you'll be in a better position to spend it than me."
    
    "Now then, why don't you let me make sure you're in good shape before you go? Just another way of saying thanks for the help."
rows.translation:
在妮哈拉的手杖照亮前路的指引下，你匆匆穿过这座亡者之城——也许那头巨大的灰色果冻怪眼下已经消了气[silly
        |已经离开了那座建筑
        |已经不再待在那里了
    ]，在你离开的途中，再没有弥诺陶洛斯的幽灵来打扰你。等你走到那两扇厚重的花岗岩门前，妮哈拉将手按在沙漏与月亮的符号上，随着一阵低沉的研磨声，驱动门扉的某种机关隆隆运转起来，将门牢牢封死。虽说那玩意儿本来也没能挡住史莱姆人进来，不过嘛……
    
    “呼，这就完事了。我们把这一批东西带回家，好好休息一下。说不定还能洗个澡。”
    
    你们穿过隧道的归途一路平安，妮哈拉每一步都把那只微微发光的匣子紧抱在胸前。直到你穿过她的真菌花园、进了她的家门之后，她才长舒一口气，把那只青铜匣子哐当一声放到桌上。
    
    虽然这一趟既刺激又有趣，但她应该不会介意让你看看这个护符吧？她可是特意带着你一路跑到神庙去把它取回来的。
    
    “不、不，当然不会。你为我冒了这么大的险，这至少是我能为你做的，[pc.name]。来，帮我把它打开。”
    
    铰链有点紧，但考虑到这只匣子在乳胶史莱姆人肚子里漂了那么久，它的状况已经算相当好了。妮哈拉用一缕黏液头发把它撬开，里面是一只某种白色石头制成的安卡——大理石？翡翠？——它躺在腐烂的天鹅绒垫子上，散发着如月亮般的银色微光。
    
    “我得承认，这不是什么很强大的护符。对付那些史莱姆人没起多大作用，也没能让死者安分地待在他们该待的地方……”
    
    嗯，也有一种明显的可能：要是没有它在，情况说不定会变得更糟。
    
    妮哈拉抬手抚上脸颊，叹了口气。“也许吧。它看着挺漂亮，但外表是会骗人的。但愿它能帮忙把湖边那些小恶魔挡住，那些家伙可真是讨厌的小东西……但更重要的是，它能给还留在这片地方的人带来希望，而如今希望可是少得令人心酸。”
    
    你倒不这么觉得。妮哈拉留在这一带，继续照料住在别墅里的那些人，而不是自己缩在湖底之类的地方等着风波过去，这本身就比什么花哨的雕琢石头更能让人生出希望，真的。
    
    [nihara.isCorrupted
        |“哎呀，我可从没听过这种话，”妮哈拉低吟着，一条漆黑如墨的尾巴缠上你的腿，轻轻抚弄着你。“我很受用，真的。”
        |“哦？真的吗？”妮哈拉想藏住自己的笑意和脸红，却藏得一塌糊涂；就算她真藏住了，她尾巴的抽动也会把她出卖。“嗯……”
    ]
    
    不，说真的。她本可以就这么沉到湖底试着熬过去，或者像别墅里那些贵族一样把自己关在家里，可她却选择拿自己冒险，去照看别人。
    
    “哦，哦，你要是再这么奉承我，说不定会发生什么不太得体的事，[pc.name]。来吧，我们把这东西放到能派上用场的地方去。”
    
    说完，妮哈拉打开了她家后方的门，就是从浴池通往真正湖面的那几扇门；你看着她涉水而行，最后游出一小段，到水中央的一根柱子那里。从前，它也许被用来把船引向附近的码头，可如今水面空空，没人给它添油，那盏灯笼早就熄了。妮哈拉就把那只小小的石安卡放在这里，支在灯笼的油槽里；你看见她摊平手掌，按在灯笼的金属框架上，随后安卡上的银色微光渐渐强盛成一片苍白的辉光，像满月的光。考虑到头顶的星空，这倒挺相称……而那光也在妮哈拉游回你身边时，为她水润的黏液身体镀上一层可爱的光泽，她懒洋洋地划着水，整个人都自在极了。
    
    “好了，我们弄完了。那么现在，说到你的报酬，[pc.name]……”
    
    妮哈拉轻叹一声，从浴池里走上来，她那本就十分暴露的提兰女祭司服紧贴着她身体的曲线，水从她的发间流下，顺着四肢滑落，她一边迈步上前，一边[pc.heightRange 72 84
        |凑近过来
        |踮起脚尖
        |屈下双膝
    ]，给了你一个湿漉漉的可爱亲吻。柔软而饱满，就像那些流走、在地上积成水洼的水一样……不过，肯定还不止这些吧？
    
    妮哈拉重重地叹着气结束了这个吻，有些不情愿地从池中爬出来，穿过房间走到另一头的橱柜前，她的脚步声却干爽得很。“啊。我想也是。来，前几天有个病人拿这个抵了诊金。这东西喝是能喝，但对我来说太浓了。还有钱，你比我更有机会把它花出去。”
    
    “那么，不如让我在你们走之前确认一下你身体状态不错？这也算是另一种感谢你帮忙的方式。”

rows.original: Oh, why not. It's been a long day, and you could use a bit of a break after that outing. What better way to do it than get a lovely dip with a goocat? [nihara.isCorrupted |Purring, Nihara slowly descends into the pool once more, sashaying her way past you and cooly disrobing you as if it were nothing at all. She's certainly acting really familiar around you, although given what you've just gone through together it's not completely unwarranted... In the blink of an eye, Nihara's got her Tiran nun's habit off, tossing the soggy garment to land on the pool's steps with a wet smack. Maybe it's a trick of the light, especially with the faint glow of the ankh burning in the distance, but here and now, standing knee-deep in the bathing pool with the ends of her inky water-hair trailing below the surface, she looks ever more voluptuous than you remember her being... "Come on in." Smiling beatifically, the goocat spreads her arms towards you in just the right way to accentuate her breasts, each one larger than her head. "The water's perfect." |Giggling, Nihara slowly descends into the bathing pool, sashaying her way past you and letting her goo-tails trail ripples in the water while you work on disrobing yourself. She's certainly acting a little flighty and much more familiar about you than you remember, but given what you've just gone through together it's not completely unwarranted... With a soft purr and glance over her shoulder to make sure that you're watching, Nihara's got her Tiran nun's habit off, tossing the soggy garment to land on the pool's steps with a wet smack. rows.original:
You're fine, you promise. At this point, an adventure like this is all in a day's work for you — slimes and ghosts aren't the worst of what you've faced.
        
        Nihara raises a finger to her lips, looking thoughtful. "Well... if you're determined to go, then I can't stop you. Just take care of yourself while you're in the tunnels, all right? And truly, once more, thanks for today again, [pc.name].

rows.original: A previous version of the game was missing the loot associated with this choice as well as tracking which choice you selected. Please make the selection again. Wasting no time, Nihara steps forward over the defeated slime, picking up the glowing casket and leaving you to pick through all the other junk the corrupted slime was attempting to abscond with. Most of it is trash, but another bronze casket it had inside of it catches your eye, one with the symbol of... something engraved on its lid. What's the symbol again, come to think of it?

rows.original:
Right, a shield, that's what it is under all the grime and gunk. You wipe off the lid, undo the catch, and to your surprise find that it lifts easily; there's a little pop of an airtight seal and then inside is a gleaming cuirass of silvered bronze that looks like it might've belonged to a Tiran paladin or something. It doesn't look like it'll be missed... and it'll probably do more good in your hands than floating around inside an overgrown pile of latex.
        
        Meanwhile, Nihara's had her back to you, scrabbling at the remains of the defeated jelly to pick up the faintly glowing casket it had in its core. Holding it close to her breast, the goocat heaves a huge sigh of relief and tightens her grip on her staff.
        
        "Well, I wasn't expecting this, but it seems to have turned out all right. Come on, let's get out of here before worse happens. Thanks, [pc.name]."
        
        It was a pleasure.
rows.translation:
没错，就是一个盾牌——在那些污垢和积灰之下，它其实就是这么一个盾牌。你擦掉盖子上的污垢，解开卡扣，然后会惊讶地发现它竟然很容易就打开了；只听见一声轻微的“啪”响，密封装置就此弹开，而里面则是一面闪闪发光的银青铜胸甲，看起来简直就像是属于某个蒂拉圣骑士的东西。看起来没人会想念它……而且放在你手里，它可能会发挥出比待在一堆过度膨胀的乳胶躯体里更大的作用。
        
        与此同时，妮哈拉一直背对着你，正在翻找那只被击败的果冻怪的残骸，想从它核心部位取出那个微微发光的匣子。这只黏液猫把匣子紧抱在胸前，长长地松了口气，同时把手杖握得更紧了。
        
        “好吧，我本来没料到会这样，不过看来结果还算不错。来吧，我们赶紧离开这里，免得发生更糟的事。谢谢你，[pc.name]。”
        
        这是我的荣幸。

With your journey decided, [party.yall] get dressed and geared, check through your packs, and watch as the snowcat twins pull on some surprisingly high-quality adventurer's gear... with a small pout from Liresh. "I... swear this fit past my asscheeks before, honest."
    
    She huffs at Syrish, tail swishing around. "Have I gotten fat?"
    
    "Well, fat-ter," she teases. "Need me to poke a new hole in your belt?"
    
    "N-yes..."
rows.translation:
旅程既已定下，[party.yall] 便穿好衣服、整理好装备，检查了一遍背包，然后看着那对“雪猫双胞胎”穿戴上了质量相当不错的冒险装备……而莉蕾什则微微撅着嘴说：“我发誓，这套装备以前明明还挺适合我的呢。”
    
    她气呼呼地对西里什说道，尾巴摇得飞快：“我是变胖了吗？”
    
    “嗯，是有点胖了哦。”西里什开玩笑地回答，“需要我帮你在腰带上再打一个洞吗？”
    
    “不——好吧……”

rows.original:
Syrish's tail swishes around as she ponders, bouncing its way through whatever mental leaps a professional relic-hunting snowcat has to make. "What do we think? Dunno, we don't fight orcs often. The relic's totally gotta be here though, and they're probably expecting a nice payday out of it if they're all party-drunk and fucking. The camp's pretty big, but most of the orcs are distracted too, so we could probably sneak around while you rumble their storage?" 
    
    You were expecting a little bit more than being told to go smash-and-grab.
    
    "Hey, it probably wouldn't be that bad. I bet you guys know how to avoid a fight or two... right?" Liresh snickers, after looking [party.yall] over. "Well, just be careful, you know? We'll have to spread out to find the relic, and hopefully it won't take us too long."
    
    "What if you get in a fight?" you ask, "I'd[pc.isBimbo
        |, like,
    ] hate to have to rescue you girls."
    
    Syrish proudly puffs up her chest, and plants her hands on her hips. "Well duh; we run. Really fast."
    
    There are a couple of tents still near the entrance, and you can hear orcs in the middle of some deliciously-rough sex; they didn't even notice the fight! Well, that's promising at least.

西里什思索着，尾巴来回摆动，脑子里翻腾着一个专业的遗迹猎手雪猫必须经历的各种思维跳跃。“我们怎么想？不知道，我们不常和兽人打架。不过那件遗物肯定就在这里，要是他们都喝醉了在乱搞，八成正盼着能靠它发笔横财。营地挺大的，但大多数兽人也都分了心，所以你大概可以摸进去，一边我们替你闹出点动静、翻他们的仓库？” 
    
    你原本期待的可不只是被打发去砸门抢劫。
    
    “嘿，应该没那么糟。我打赌你们肯定知道怎么避开一两场架……对吧？”莉蕾什把 [party.yall] 打量了一番后窃笑道。“好吧，就是小心点，知道吗？我们得分散开来找遗物，希望别花太久。”
    
    “要是你们打起来怎么办？”你问，“我可[pc.isBimbo
        |，呃，

    西里什骄傲地挺起胸膛，双手叉腰。“那还用说；我们跑。跑得飞快。”
    
    入口附近还留着几顶帐篷，你能听见兽人在里面激烈地做爱；他们甚至没注意到那场打斗！嗯，至少这还算是个好消息。

rows.original:
"Alright [pc.name], we've got this." Liresh pats your arm, checks her gear, and the duo slip away. They're hardly a fitting part of this veritable sea of green, with their snow-white-and-gray, and soft fluffy black fur... but their footsteps are silent, and they stick to the outskirts of the camp.
    
    Maybe things will be just as easy for you?
    
    Somehow the cats manage to vanish in between blinks, with Syrish making for the bluff closer to the shoreline, and Liresh for the living spaces near a big bonfire.
rows.translation:
“好的，[pc.name]，我们能应付得来。”莉蕾什轻拍着你的手臂，检查了一下她的装备，然后两人便悄悄离开了。他们那雪白与灰色的外皮，以及柔软蓬松的黑色毛发，与这片翠绿的营地环境显得格格不入……但他们的脚步声非常轻，始终待在营地的边缘地带。
    
    也许对你来说，事情也会同样顺利吧？
    
    不知怎的，这两只猫在人们眨眼间就消失得无影无踪了。西里什朝着靠近海岸线的悬崖方向跑去，而莉蕾什则朝着那堆巨大的篝火附近的居住区去了。

rows.original: Discretion is the better part of valor, and you opt for hiding. Honestly a fight with them might result in drawing a crowd. "Oi... 'sss fuckgnun..." The man slurs, causing the woman to laugh. She reaches up and tugs on his tusk, muttering for him to try again. "Ah. See, too drunk to fuck, 's safe." This time she nods, looking oddly gratified by the statement. "S'good, could barely stand n'more. Need 'nough drink to keep blood down... what d'you think caushesh it?" Gods, these two are monumentally hammered. You do your best to translate the mess from 'I'm-shit-myself-drunk-ese,' but it's a challenge. 'Oi, it's fine. As you can see I'm way too drunk to fuck, so you're safe.' 'That's good, I could barely stand anymore. I need more than enough drink just to keep my blood down, what do you think caused this?' Apparently there are more problems here than simple alcoholism. "Yeah? 'S... dunno. Ever shince bossh raided caravan?" The man slurs out, nodding to himself. "Huh... pershon'ly think self bitches s's'bought. Wuz... but, jus, dunno? They wish gagging f'dick, sowhy'd boss taken?" His female companion responds, also doing her best to appear sagely even while she's soaked to the gills. 'Yes? I don't know, perhaps ever since the boss raided the caravan?' 'Hum, personally I think it's the bitches she brought. Wizards maybe? I don't know. They were gagging for dick, so why did the boss take them?' At least, you think that's what they said.         There are several exits out of this room, though only a couple lead towards the baths... you think.

rows.original: There's a bunch of other doors up here besides the exit to the baths. Maybe there's something interesting behind one of them?
rows.translation: 除了通往浴室的出口之外，这里还有很多其他的门。也许其中某扇门后面藏着什么有趣的东西呢？
rows.raw: "There's a bunch of other doors up here besides the exit to the baths. Maybe there's something interesting behind one of them?"

rows.original: Head down into the hot rooms. The really hot rooms.
rows.translation: 前往那些高温房间吧。真的热室。
rows.raw: "Head down into the hot rooms. The really hot rooms."

rows.original: Time to [silly|blow this popsicle stand|bring this investigation to a close].
rows.translation: 是时候了 [silly|把这个冰棍棒架弄坏吧|结束这项调查].
rows.raw: "Time to [silly|blow this popsicle stand|bring this investigation to a close]."

rows.original: [var3 |You enter the teyarium and immediately note the temperature difference, the warm air caressing your bare body. The room itself is beautiful, adorned in marble with huge murals upon its walls. There are several benches with cowgirl attendants standing nearby, and you can see a few people getting an oil massage. [flags.KM_BATHS_TEYARIUM |Smells as good as ever. |So that's why people leaving this place smell so good! The scent wafts over to you — sweet, but not overbearing. ] ] There are quite a few people here, some talking in groups and some alone, unwinding after their time in the hotter rooms or getting ready to enter them. The mood here is a lot more relaxed than the atrium — there's even a servant playing some kind of stringed instrument near the massage benches. This is quite nice. [var1 |You could go to the heated pools now that you're cooled off or spend some time here — or head back to the cooler pools in the dinarium, maybe. |You could head over to the heated pools in the saldarium, relax here, or go swimming in the cooler pools in the dinarium. ] [var2 |You tip the cooled water over your head and re-enter the teyarium, sighing in relief. Wow, it's nice to be back in here. You can really understand why people like to relax here after their time in the pools... the atmosphere is perfect for a rest after the heat of the baths. The music the servant is creating drifts over to you, inspiring you to listen. You could go back to the heated pools or spend some time here — or head over to the cooler pools in the dinarium for some contrast, maybe. ]

rows.translation: [flags.ARILLE_MET|阿莉尔在这里游泳，而其他的牛人像往常一样，都与她保持了一定的距离。|那个大家都避而远之的女孩到底是谁啊？]

rows.original: Step back out into the Laconicum.
rows.translation: 退回到拉科尼库姆区域吧。

rows.original: You have two ancient vaults of eldritch knowledge and a specially prepared ritual chamber. Let's make some magic happen.
rows.translation: 你拥有两座蕴藏着古老神秘知识的地下宝库，还有一个专门准备好的仪式厅。让我们一起创造一些神奇的事情吧。
rows.raw: "You have two ancient vaults of eldritch knowledge and a specially prepared ritual chamber. Let's make some magic happen."

rows.original: "Let's check the shelves," you say, starting to peruse them yourself. "Could be something useful." "Maybe if you're five hundred years old," Livrea grumbles. "None of this is in Minothan. Or Belharan. Or even Alvarin or Jassiran." "Something has to be," you say. "[pc.isBimbo |Reading's already hard, nobody'd want to read this on its own! |I don't think some old engineer is going to be reading ancient dialects either. ]" A moment passes before Livrea lifts up one of the tablets. "Hold on. This mark, I recognize it." You and Varena come to look over her shoulders. It's an old fired-clay tablet, cracked from the hard passage of years, but seam lines of glue have meticulously bound it back together. There's a circular symbol on the top-right corner of the tablet, in the middle of which are a pair of crossed crook-staves. [pc.bg scholar arcanist |Your eyes widen. "Estelore!" "The old Belharan mage academy." Varena says. "Gods, how old was that place?" "Old enough," you say, gingerly taking the tablet from Livrea. "This is... earth-shaping magic, I think? It's so old even I can barely make anything out..." "Me neither," Varena says. "What would they need earth-shaping for out in the Sailgraves? That's where Estelore was, right?" |"This is the symbol of Estelore," Livrea says, tapping the circle. "The ancient Belharan magic school out in the Sailgraves. I had no idea it was this old though..." "What is it?" Varena asks, eyes scanning the runes. "I can't make heads or tails of it, beyond it being old magic." You and Livrea shrug. No amount of magical know-how today is going to make up for just how old this stuff is. ] "I wonder where he could have gotten this?" Livrea murmurs. "It must have cost a fortune. Estelorean relics that haven't been nabbed by [pc.isAstrida |you blackscales |the Order Astrida ] are so, so rare nowadays..." "Maybe we should take it with us?" you suggest. "Be my guest," Liv says. "If it's alright with you, princess?" Varena nods. "I don't want anything to do with their magic, thanks; in fact I'd rather not have it in the kingdom at all. Take it with my blessing." You gingerly stuff it into your pack.

rows.original: "Iavari really doesn't want anybody going in there," you say, nodding towards the door. There's a shimmer around it, a spectral shield of force emanating from the runes etched into the wood that rebukes your touch before you can get within an inch of the door's handle. Varena sucks in a low breath. "I don't think I'm skilled enough to abjure something like that." [var0 |Well, you are, if you're so inclined... |[pc.isAstrida |Something like this should be easy for you to breach as an Astrida. ] ] "There's gotta be a way to disable it," Liv says. "A runestone or something!"
rows.translation: “贾瓦里真的不想让任何人进那里去，”你边说边朝那扇门点了点头。门周围笼罩着一层微光，那是由刻在木门上的符文散发出的幽灵力场，在你靠近到离门把手还有一寸远之前，它就会将你的触碰弹开。 瓦蕾娜轻轻吸了一口气。“我觉得我的本事还不足以驱散那样的东西。” [var0 |嗯，如果你愿意的话，你当然可以…… |[pc.isAstrida |作为阿斯特里达，这种障碍对你来说应该很容易突破。 ] ] “肯定有办法把它关掉，”莉芙说。“一块符文石之类的！”

rows.original: Use the corrupted lord's runestone to breach the ward.
rows.translation: 使用那块被损坏的领主符文石来突破防护结界。
rows.raw: "Use the corrupted lord's runestone to breach the ward."

rows.original: You don't have a runestone for this ward.
rows.translation: 你没有能解开这个法阵的符文石。
rows.raw: "You don't have a runestone for this ward."

rows.original: You don't have the ability to cast a spell powerful enough to do this. If only you had a member of the Order Astrida here...
rows.translation: 你没有足够强大的法力来施展这样的咒语。要是这里有阿斯特里达教团的成员该多好……
rows.raw: "You don't have the ability to cast a spell powerful enough to do this. If only you had a member of the Order Astrida here..."

rows.original:
You hold up the veiny rune-etched stone to the wards on the door and push forward against the field of resistance engraved into the wood. There's a moment of tension, but it snaps like a twig once you start putting your weight into it, and then the pressure gives way so suddenly you have to take a step forward to steady yourself. 
    
    "That did it!" Liv says, pumping her fist.
    
    "Just be careful," Varena says. "If he went to so much trouble to protect whatever's in there, it could still be dangerous."
    
    Duly noted.
rows.translation:
你将那块刻着符文、布满脉络的石头举到门上的守护法阵前，然后顶着刻在木门里的阻力法术向前推去。有一瞬间，两者僵持不下，但当你开始把全身的重量压上去时，它就像一根细枝般啪地折断了，随后那股压力猛地消失，你不得不向前迈一步才站稳脚跟。 
    
    “成功了！”莉芙说着，挥了挥拳头。
    
    “不过还是要小心点，”瓦蕾娜说道，“如果他费了这么大劲去保护里面的东西，那东西可能仍然很危险。”
    
    明白，记下了。

rows.original: [var0 |You take a deep breath and then step forward, feeling out the aura of magic in front of you with your divinely-enhanced senses. It's powerful, thick cords of binding magic woven on top of each other like a net to surround the door three inches out. "Someone put a lot of effort into this," you mention, cracking your knuckles. "But not enough." You thrust a hand forward and then rip it back again, tearing apart the seams of magic. You can taste the power in it, the ancient arts latticed together to protect whatever dark work lurks beyond, and it makes you salivate. This is your purpose made manifest, your holy bargain paying off, giving you the strength to overcome even the most archaic and occult of magics. You step back, and feel the strands of magic tearing away. The runes on the door burst into azure flame, seething as they're rendered impotent. It's over in a heartbeat. There's a rush of power in your veins as you absorb the magic spilling into the air, breathing deep of the smoke until the flames burn out to embers. "Wow," Varena murmurs. "So that's the power of an Astrida." [livrea.fucked |"Hot, huh?" Liv says, squishing her thighs together. [varena.fucked |"Y-yeah." Varena blushes. "Very." |Varena rolls her eyes. ] |"Way more impressive in person than in the stories," Livrea says. [varena.fucked |"A sexy kind of power," Varena says, giving you a wink. |"Mmhm," Varena nods. ] ] "Alright, girls. Come on," you say. "Whatever's in there is going to be even worse." "R-right," Varena says, clutching her staff. "We'll follow your lead." |You motion for the girls to stand back while you plant your feet and begin to move your hands, incanting the words of power to draw the power directly out of these wardings, leaving them nothing but a hollow husk of wasted effort. The wards struggle against your magical unbinding, energies writhing in a desperate, if futile attempt to resist. But your spell is too potent to be turned aside, and with a final wrench of magical force, you shatter the protections on the doors. rows.original: "What're these doors?" you ask, peering at the curtained arches leading off the atrium. While most of the crowd is coming to and from the baths down south, every so often a couple of weary-looking cowgirls or a sweat-drenched bull will come up from the archway on the right, wearing nothing but towels around their hips. The one on the left seems to be pretty much ignored. "Something exhausting," you suggest. Another bull surfaces, bringing with him a plume of steamy air. "And hot." "And over that way?" Varena pokes her head through the curtain on the left wall. "Oh. Just cleaning supplies." Liv giggles. "It does say 'Janitorium' over the arch, Rena." The princess pouts. "You never know." You point at the arch the cows are coming out of, and the minoan characters carved into it. "What does that one say?" Livrea reads it off for you. "Laconicum. The really hot rooms, right near the furnace." "And all the pipes," Varena says, rubbing her chin. If you were an evil engineer...
rows.translation: “这些门是干什么用的？”你问道，仔细打量着那些从中央大厅延伸出去、挂着帘子的拱门。虽然大多数人都在南边的浴场进进出出，但偶尔会有几位看起来疲惫不堪的牛娘，或是一头满身大汗的公牛，从右边的拱门里走出来，身上只围着胯间的毛巾。左边那道拱门似乎没多少人理会。 “某种让人精疲力竭的东西，”你猜测道。又一头公牛冒了出来，带出一股蒸腾的热气。“而且很热。” “那那边呢？”瓦蕾娜把头探进左墙上的帘子里。“哦，只是些清洁用品而已。” 莉芙咯咯笑了起来：“蕾娜，拱门上方确实写着‘清洁间’呢。” 公主撅起了嘴：“谁知道呢。” 你指着那些牛娘走出来的拱门，以及上面雕刻的牛头人文字。“那上面写的是什么？” 莉维娅读给你听：“拉科尼库姆。真正的高温房间，就紧挨着炉子。” “还有所有的管道，”瓦蕾娜边说边摩着下巴。 如果你是邪恶的工程师……

[flags.V_BATHS_LACONICUM
        |You head downstairs again, into the sweltering heat of the Laconium. 
        
        There's a veritable wall of humidity that hits you when you turn a corner in the stairs, before coming out onto a wide-open chamber. It's all orange stone down here, walls and columns adorned with images of heroes and monsters from myths of old set in colorful tile. You can see a visible haze of heat in the room, especially around stone-packed vents near the corners and in the center. 
        
        Along the south wall are a quintet of doors to private sauna chambers, each made of bronze-reinforced wood. Unusually heavy-duty for a place like this. 
        
        There's another door on the east wall, which has a pair of men standing guard over it. "The furnace is down there," Liv says, pointing to a sign over the door. 
        
        Around two dozen cowgirls and minotaurs are standing around in towels and sweating up a storm while they chat amongst themselves. There's not a covered chest in the room except for those you've come with — tits are hanging out aplenty, and mino men aren't shy about getting handsy with them while they're bare.
        
        You can hear faint moaning from a couple of the private rooms that have their doors closed.
        |You motion towards the curtained door. Just taking a few steps closer, you can feel an intense wet heat radiating out from it.
        
        "Want to go downstairs? Ugh, this is going to ruin my hair," Varena groans. 
        
        "Not too late to turn around, princess," Liv says, giving her a nudge. 
        
        Varena shakes her head and follows you down.
        
        There's a veritable wall of humidity that hits you when you turn a corner in the stairs, before coming out onto a wide-open chamber. It's all orange stone down here, walls and columns adorned with images of heroes and monsters from myths of old set in colorful tile. I don't want to think about what could've happened if I'd accepted."
        
        There's a visible haze of heat in the room, especially around stone-packed vents near the corners and in the center. 
        
        Along the south wall are a quintet of doors to private sauna chambers, each made of bronze-reinforced wood. Unusually heavy-duty for a place like this. You can hear faint moaning from a couple of the private rooms that have their doors closed.

        Around two dozen cowgirls and minotaurs are standing around in towels, sweating up a storm while they chat amongst themselves. There's not a covered chest in the room except for those you've come with — tits are hanging out aplenty, and mino men aren't shy about getting handsy with them while they're bare. A couple of bulls standing near the back are standing with their fronts suspiciously out of view, with a bare-breasted cowgirl that's just tall enough for her chest to be crotch-high.

[flags.V_BATHS_LACONICUM
        |你再次下楼，走进了拉科尼姆那令人窒息的热浪之中。
        
        当你在楼梯上转过一个拐角时，一股浓重的湿气迎面扑来，随后你便来到了一间宽敞的房间。这里的墙壁和柱子全都由橙色的石头建造而成，上面用色彩鲜艳的瓷砖装饰着古老神话中英雄与怪兽的形象。你可以看到房间里弥漫着一层明显的热气，尤其是在角落和房间中央那些用石头堵塞的通风口周围。
        
        沿着南墙，有五扇门通向私人桑拿室，每扇门都是由青铜加固的木头制成的。对于这样一个地方来说，这里的设施显得异常坚固耐用。
        
        东墙上有另一扇门，有两名男子站在那里把守。“熔炉就在下面，”莉芙指着门上的一块指示牌说道。 
        
        大约有二十几名女牛仔和米诺陶洛斯们穿着毛巾站在那里，大汗淋漓，一边聊天一边互相逗趣。房间里没有一件遮盖胸部的衣物，除了你们带来的那些……她们的胸部完全暴露在外，而那些米诺陶洛斯男人们也毫不羞于在她们赤裸的身体上动手动脚。
        
        你可以听到几间门紧闭的私人房间里传来的微弱呻吟声。
        |你朝那扇挂着帘子的门走去。刚走了几步，就感觉到有一股浓重的湿热气息从那里散发出来。
        
        “想下楼吗？唉，这样我的头发肯定要毁了。”瓦蕾娜抱怨道。
        
        “现在回头还来得及的，公主。”莉芙轻推了她一下，说道。 
        
        瓦蕾娜摇了摇头，然后跟在你身后下了楼。
        
        当你拐过楼梯的拐角时，一股浓重的湿气迎面扑来，随后你便来到了一间宽敞的房间。这里的墙壁和柱子都是由橙色的石头建造的，上面用彩色的瓷砖装饰着古老神话中英雄和怪兽的形象。他们没让我来这里帮忙画画，这让我觉得有点被怠慢了，”瓦蕾娜边说边把头发扎成马尾。“不过……我也不想去想如果我接受了邀请，会发生什么。
        
        房间里弥漫着明显的热气，尤其是在角落和中央那些用石头堵塞的通风口附近。
        
        沿着南墙，有五扇通往私人桑拿房的门，每扇门都是由青铜加固的木头制成的。对于这样的地方来说，这些门的材质显得格外厚重。从几扇关着的私人房间里，可以听到微弱的呻吟声。
        
        你在东墙上看到了另一扇门，有两名男子站在那里站岗守卫。“熔炉就在下面，”莉芙指着门上的一块指示牌说，“上面也写着‘危险’二字。”
        
        大约有二十名女牛仔和牛头人穿着毛巾站在那里，他们满头大汗，一边聊天一边等待着下一步行动。房间里除了你们带来的那些之外，没有其他带盖的箱子——那些裸露的胸部随处可见，而那些米诺人对于在它们裸露的时候动手动脚也毫不羞耻。在房间后面，有几头公牛站在那里，它们的前部被刻意遮挡起来，而那个胸脯裸露的牛仔姑娘身高正好使得她的胸部与人们的裆部处于同一水平线上。 
        
        莉维娅朝那三人点了点头，说道：“现在的这些人真是毫无廉耻之心，不是吗？”
        
        尤其是在这一带，以你的经验来看，更是如此。
    ]

"I'm a little insulted I wasn't asked to do some painting down here," Varena mutters, pulling her hair back into a ponytail. "Then again... I don't want to think about what could've happened if I'd accepted."
        
        There's a visible haze of heat in the room, especially around stone-packed vents near the corners and in the center. 
        
        Along the south wall are a quintet of doors to private sauna chambers, each made of bronze-reinforced wood. Unusually heavy-duty for a place like this. You can hear faint moaning from a couple of the private rooms that have their doors closed.
        
        You see another door on the east wall, which has a pair of men standing guard over it. "The furnace is down there," Liv says, pointing to a sign over the door. "It says its dangerous, too."
        
        Around two dozen cowgirls and minotaurs are standing around in towels, sweating up a storm while they chat amongst themselves. There's not a covered chest in the room except for those you've come with — tits are hanging out aplenty, and mino men aren't shy about getting handsy with them while they're bare. A couple of bulls standing near the back are standing with their fronts suspiciously out of view, with a bare-breasted cowgirl that's just tall enough for her chest to be crotch-high. 
        
        Livrea nods at the trio. "People really are shameless these days, huh?"
        
        Especially around here, from your experience.
    ]

rows.original:
It's hard to believe people are getting up to mischief in this heat, but as you head over to the reinforced doors of the private saunas, you can hear faint moaning and wet, flesh-slapping sounds coming from the first two. The middle two are slightly ajar, unoccupied at the moment. And the last door is closed up tight, but you can't hear anything from inside. There's also no steam coming from inside it. 
    
    You glance back at the girls and then knock on the last door. 
    
    A gruff male voice answers from inside, "What do you want?"
rows.translation:
很难相信在这么热的天气里还会有人搞恶作剧，但当你走向那些加固过的私人桑拿房的门前时，能听到前两间里传来微弱的呻吟声和湿黏的皮肉拍击声。中间那两扇门微微虚掩着，眼下没人在用。而最后一扇门紧闭着，但里面什么也听不到，也没有蒸汽从里面冒出来。
    
    你回头看了姑娘们一眼，然后敲响了最后一扇门。 
    
    一个粗哑的男声从里面传来：“你们想要什么？”

rows.original: You glance at Varena and give the princess a little nudge. These are her people, after all. She steps past you and gives the guards a disarming smile. "You know who I am, right?" The men look between themselves. "Uhh..." "I'm Varena. Pleased to meet you." She takes a step forward. "Varena Moratia." The guards' eyes go wide. "You might not know this, but I love engineering. It's fascinating, seeing how things really work. I just want to take a peek inside and see what kind of furnace and pipes can power a place as impressive as this bath house. I'm sure Senator Khaius would be happy to know if I approved of the work..." "It's a little dangerous in there," one of the bulls says. "It's hot, your highness.You could get hurt." "We'll be careful," she assures him. "So if you'll excuse us..." They can hardly ignore a direct order from the princess, and so the two bulls begrudgingly step aside. Varena flashes you a grin and strides past. You follow on her heels, into the furnace chamber.

rows.translation: 你和你的同伴沿着一道又长又窄的楼梯向下，走进澡堂中心那间炽热如火的炉室。这里的地面上开出了地热喷口，热气直接喷入巨大的坩埚，为不断注入的水加热，加热过的水又被烧红的管道引走。几个戴着奴隶项圈的猫族在下面管理管道，确保水被送到需要的地方，并把上层房间冷却下来的水直接排到他们自己身上。 “我还以为会有火呢，”莉维娅说着瞥了一眼地面。“看来我们现在已经下得相当深了。” “哦，对，这一整片城区都建在一道地火之上。弗兰妮说，它从这儿一直延伸到北方森林里的沼泽。不过我真不敢相信他们竟然把它这样引进城里来。老天在上，这里简直要沸腾了。” 她可没开玩笑。在拉科尼库姆里已经像桑拿房了；而在这里，你觉得热浪像是在实实在在地捶打你的身体。汗水顺着你的额头不断流下，每一次呼吸都灼烧着你的肺。 那些负责管道的奴隶警惕地看着你们，当你们一行人走下来、四处打量，寻找……嗯，你们也不确定究竟在找什么，只是任何不对劲的东西。可在这样压迫感十足的热浪捶打下，真他妈难以集中精神…… 这几乎足以让你漏掉一个正试图从你身边溜过去的猫族。
rows.raw: " You and your companions enter the blistering-hot furnace chamber at the heart of the bath house, descending a long but narrow set of stairs. Vents of geothermal heat have been opened up in the floor of the place, blasting directly into vast cauldrons to warm water being fed in and then drawn away again by fired pipes. A few slave-collared catfolk are down here managing the pipes, making sure water goes where it's needed, and draining water that's cooled from the higher rooms directly onto themselves. "I thought there'd be a fire," Livrea says, glancing at the floor. "I guess we are pretty far down now." "Oh, yeah, this whole part of town is over an earthflame. Vranny says it stretches from here to the bogs in the boreal forest. I can't believe they're channeling it up into the city like this, though. Gods above, it's boiling in here." She's not kidding. It felt like a sauna in the Laconicum; in here, you feel like you're being physically assaulted by the heat. Sweat pours down your brow, and every breath scorches your lungs. The slaves manning the pipes give you wary looks and shirk away as your group comes down and starts looking around, searching for... well, you aren't sure what exactly, but anything out of place. It's just so damn hard to concentrate with the oppressive heat hammering you... It's almost enough to make you miss one of the catfolk trying to sneak past you. "

rows.original:
You grab the passing catgirl, a chocolate-skinned waif with short crimson hair and big reddish-brown eyes. The grab is sudden enough to make her squeal, kicking her legs and flailing her skinny arms at you. "Lemme go! Lemme go, you dick!" 
    
    She's squirming so much that her cat ears fall right off, clattering to the floor along with the headband they're attached to. And then goes the towel wrapped around her middle...
rows.translation:
你抓住了那个路过的猫耳少女——一个皮肤呈巧克力色、留着短短的深红色头发、拥有一双大而呈红棕色的眼睛的女孩。你的动作太突然了，让她尖叫起来，她用双腿踢打，瘦小的手臂也朝你挥舞着：“放开我！放开我，你这个混蛋！”
    
    她扭动得太过厉害，结果她的猫耳直接掉了下来，连同绑在耳朵上的发带一起掉在了地上。然后，她身上缠着的毛巾也脱落了……

    She's squirming so much that her cat ears fall right off, clattering to the floor along with the headband they're attached to. And then goes the towel wrapped around her middle...
    "

rows.original: "Isadora!" The human auxilia flails at you until you finally drop her. Several of the surrounding catfolk gasp in shock seeing one of their own revealed as an impostor.[pc.isFeline | Even you give her a cross look for pretending to be your kin. That's not on in public! ] "[pc.name], what's the big idea! What're you even doing here, and with — oh my god oh shit oh fuck." Isadora takes one look at your royal companion and trips over herself in her hurry to kneel. There goes her towel again. You notice the tail is still right where it was, though, hanging from her backside. "Your highness!" Varena sighs as the confused catfolk behind her scramble to follow suit. "It's- no it's fine, please get up." "What are you doing here?" you ask her, [pc.isDK |watching her turn red as she realizes she's disrobed in front of Varena |quickly putting her towel back around her ]. "Let's just... c-can we talk in private?" she says, glancing over a shoulder. Varena makes a shooing gesture at everyone else in the room and then casts her muffling spell, drowning out the sound of talking from above, and roaring heat from below. Only the three of you are able to be heard. "So, it's Isadora, is it? Friend of [pc.name]'s?" "[isadora.fucked |You could say that," Izzy says bashfully. |Something like that!" Isadora says. ] "We met through Lady Calise, your highness. I'm here on her behalf." "Calise's?" Varena says, eyes narrowing subtly. Isadora doesn't pick up on the suspicion in the princess's voice. "Yes, highness! I'm part of her personal cadre — she gave me a chance to fight on the front, when the Legions never did! Though right now I'm helping her with stuff around the city. Errands and such, mostly, but..." "But?" you ask. "But now she asked me to look into this place. She thinks..." Isadora glances around conspiratorially, as though she hadn't just been outed as a spy in front of all the furnace workers already. "She suspects there's enemy influence here. And I'm starting to agree." The suspicion on Varena's face softens. "What have you found, soldier?" Isadora wipes the sweat off her brow. "Well, the people here, you've seen how, um..." She pauses, blushing, until Varena gives her a soft and encouraging smile. "Well, how horny they are? And that's just the tip of the spear. I've seen folk coming into this place and never coming out, like they're just vanishing down here! I've seen people go into the sauna rooms and just never, ever come out. Way past the time when somebody'd pass out from the heat. And then somebody else comes along, goes right in that same room, and repeats. I've watched so long that a guard came up and cuffed me for falling asleep on the job; I swear I didn't miss a thing!" "I believe you," Varena says. "We're investigating the place too. Have you seen anyone important coming or going lately?" Isadora taps her chin. "Yeah. Senator Khaius stopped by today. He went through one of the saunas, too. Gods, I hope he doesn't vanish too! A missing senator would be awful!" [var0 |"Yeah," you muse. "Awful. So what exactly happened?" |"What exactly happened?" you ask. ] "The Senator came down in a rage! He was furious about... something about the water. There wasn't enough of it coming in, because the pipes from all but one of the waterheads have been closed up since the siege started. The baths were struggling to stay full. He grabbed a couple of the massage girls and then went pounding on the last sauna door, shouting 'to hell with your damn roses, open up' before taking them in with him. That's the last I saw of him, almost a day ago!" You and Varena exchange a glance. "You should probably get out of here," you say to Isadora. "I think your cover's blown." "Yeah..." she sighs. "I've got to report back to Lady Calise! Your highness, it's been an honor!" Varena inclines her head. "Khor Aterna, soldier." Isadora scampers, and Varena drops her spell. "Back to work, everybody. Don't mind us!"
rows.translation: “伊莎多拉！” 这个人类辅军在你身上又抓又踢，直到你终于把她放下。周围几个猫族看到自己人里竟藏着一个冒牌货，惊得倒吸凉气。[pc.isFeline | 就连你也因为她假扮成你的同族而瞪了她一眼。这种事在公开场合可不行！ ] “[pc.name]，你这是搞什么名堂！你到底来这儿干什么，而且还带着——哦我的天，糟了糟了完了。”伊莎多拉看了一眼你那位王室同伴，慌忙中自己被自己绊倒，赶紧跪下。她的毛巾又掉了。不过你注意到那根尾巴还好好地垂在她屁股后面。 “殿下！” 瓦蕾娜叹了口气，她身后那些一头雾水的猫族也慌忙跟着跪下。“没——没事，请起来吧。” “你在这儿到底干什么？”你问她，[pc.isDK |看着她意识到自己在瓦蕾娜面前脱了衣服、脸一点点涨红 |同时她飞快地把毛巾重新围回身上 ]。 “我们能不能……能、能私下谈谈吗？”她说着，往肩后瞥了一眼。 瓦蕾娜朝房间里其他人做了个赶人的手势，随后施下消音咒，把上方的说话声和下方的滚滚热浪声一并压了下去。只有你们三个人的声音能被听见。“那么，你是伊莎多拉，是吧？[pc.name]的朋友？” [isadora.fucked |“也可以这么说吧，”伊兹羞怯地说道。 |“差不多就是这样，”伊莎多拉说道。 ]“我们是通过卡莉丝女士认识的，殿下。我是代表她来这儿的。” “卡莉丝的人？”瓦蕾娜说着，眼睛微微眯起。 伊莎多拉没有察觉公主语气里的怀疑。“是的，殿下！我是她私人小队的一员——当初军团不肯给我机会上前线，是她给了我这个机会！不过眼下我在帮她处理城里的一些事。大多是跑腿之类的，可是……” “可是？”你问道。 “可是现在她让我来查这个地方。她认为……”伊莎多拉鬼鬼祟祟地环顾四周，仿佛她刚刚没有在所有炉工面前被揭穿是间谍一样。“她怀疑这里有敌人的影响。而我也开始同意这个判断了。” 瓦蕾娜脸上的怀疑缓和了下来。“你发现了什么，士兵？” 伊莎多拉擦了擦额头的汗。“嗯，这里的人，你也看到了，他们有多，呃……”她停顿了一下，脸红了，直到瓦蕾娜给了她一个温柔而鼓励的微笑。“嗯，他们有多饥渴？而那还只是长矛的尖头而已。我见过有人进了这地方就再也没出来，就好像他们在这下面直接消失了！我见过有人走进桑拿房，然后就再也没、从来没有出来过。那时间早就超过了正常人会被热气熏昏的限度。可接着又有别人过来，走进同一个房间，重复一遍。我盯得太久，久到有个守卫过来，因为我当班打瞌睡把我铐了起来；我发誓我一点都没漏看！” “我相信你，”瓦蕾娜说道。“我们也在调查这个地方。你最近有没有看到什么重要人物进出？” 伊莎多拉敲了敲下巴。“有啊。凯乌斯参议员今天来过。他也进了其中一间桑拿房。天啊，我希望他别也消失了！一位参议员失踪可就糟透了！” [var0 |“是啊，”你沉吟道。“糟透了。那么究竟发生了什么？” |“究竟发生了什么？”你问道。 ] “那位参议员是怒气冲冲地下来的！他在为……水的事大发雷霆。进来的水不够，因为围城开始之后，除了一个水头之外，其余所有水头的水管都被封死了。浴池一直很难蓄满水。他抓了两个按摩女郎，然后跑去猛砸最后一间桑拿房的门，吼着‘去你妈的萝丝，开门’，接着就带着她们进去了。那是我最后一次见到他，差不多是一天前的事了！” 你和瓦蕾娜交换了一个眼神。 “你最好还是离开这儿吧，”你对伊莎多拉说。“我想你的身份已经暴露了。” “是啊……”她叹了口气。“我得回去向卡莉丝女士汇报了！殿下，能与您相见是我的荣幸！” 瓦蕾娜微微颔首。“科尔·阿特纳，士兵。” 伊莎多拉一溜烟跑了，瓦蕾娜也解除了法术。“各位继续干活吧。别管我们！”

rows.original: You step past the guards and head down into the furnace again, followed by your comrades. Down here, you feel like you're being physically assaulted by the heat. Sweat pours down your brow, and every breath scorches your lungs. The slaves manning the pipes give you wary looks and shirk away as your group comes down and starts looking around, searching for... well, you aren't sure what exactly, but anything out of place. It's just so damn hard to concentrate with the oppressive heat hammering you. The pipes and furnaces are still as you left them. There's a dias amidst them bearing a sigil of a pair of crossed staves. It has a faint, almost imperceptible luminescence to it, as if filled with the glowing fungi common to the Undermountain. "I can't believe they have something from Estelore down here," Livrea says, nodding towards it. "There's barely any of their magic left these days."
rows.translation: 你穿过守卫，再次走向下面的炉室，你的同伴们跟在后面。在这里，你觉得热浪像是在实实在在地捶打你的身体。汗水顺着你的额头不断流下，每一次呼吸都灼烧着你的肺。 那些负责管道的奴隶警惕地看着你们，当你们一行人走下来、四处打量，寻找……嗯，你们也不确定究竟在找什么，只是任何不对劲的东西。可在这样压迫感十足的热浪捶打下，真他妈难以集中精神。 那些管道和炉子还是你离开时的样子，静静待在原地。 它们中间有一座台座，上面刻着一对交叉权杖的纹章。它散发着一种微弱得几乎难以察觉的光芒，仿佛充满了山腹深域中常见的发光真菌。“我真不敢相信他们在这下面竟然还留着来自埃斯托洛尔的东西，”莉维娅说着朝它点了点头，“如今他们的魔法已经所剩无几了。”

rows.original: Your group makes a cursory inspection of the furnace itself before you leave, just enough to confirm that Isadora's correct in saying that only one of the waterways is actually pumping into the warming chambers, out of the five it's designed to be fed from. "This looks like a control [pc.isBimbo |thingy |mechanism ]," you say, pointing to a bronze-embossed plinth in the middle of the pumpworks. There are five discs set into it, only one of which is depressed, but a cursory attempt at pushing the others down yields no results. In the middle of the five discs is a raised stone bearing a sigil of a pair of crossed staves. It has a faint, almost imperceptible luminescence to it, as if filled with the glowing fungi common to the Undermountain. "Estelore's sigil," Livrea says. "This equipment can't be that old, though. They just opened the bath house a bit ago..."
rows.translation: 在离开之前，你们一行人对炉子本身做了一次粗略的检查，足以证实伊莎多拉的说法没错——在按设计本该由五条水道供水的系统中，实际上只有一条水道在向加热室供水。 “这看起来像是一个控制[pc.isBimbo |玩意儿 |机构 ]，”你指着泵组中央那个镶着青铜浮雕的基座说道。基座上嵌着五个圆盘，其中只有一个被按下，但试着把其余几个按下去却毫无反应。 五个圆盘中央有一块凸起的石头，上面刻着一对交叉权杖的纹章。它散发着一种微弱得几乎难以察觉的光芒，仿佛充满了山腹深域中常见的发光真菌。 “埃斯托洛尔的纹章，”莉维娅说道，“不过这套设备不可能有那么古老。他们前不久才刚开了这家澡堂……”

rows.translation: 看看你能从这个基座中学到什么吧。
rows.raw: "See what you can learn from the plinth."

rows.original: Touch the runestones together. Perhaps this will let you change which pipes are being used...
rows.translation: 将这些符文石相互触碰。或许这样就能让你改变当前被使用的管道了……
rows.raw: "Touch the runestones together. Perhaps this will let you change which pipes are being used..."

rows.original: You head back up to the slightly less sweltering heat of the Laconicum.
rows.translation: 你回到了拉科尼库姆，那里的温度没有那么闷热了。
rows.raw: "\n    You head back up to the slightly less sweltering heat of the Laconicum.\n    "

rows.original: You step closer to the stone-and-bronze plinth, looking it over. There are five metal discs set into it, one of which is currently depressed deeper than the others. In the middle of the discs is a runestone bearing the sigil of Estelore, a pair of crossed staves. [pc.isMage |It's radiating a faint aura of magic, but not enough to be doing much on its own. |You guess it's magical, but you aren't sure. ] You suspect this device must control the flow of water — there's one disc in the direction of each of the five major water pumps coming into the facility — but only one disc is depressed, mirroring the one pump currently dumping its contents into the bath house. Just one waterhead's supplying the entire building. As far as you can see, there's no way to mechanically manipulate the device, and the discs don't depress when you push them. "Any luck?" Liv asks. You shake your head. [var0 |"Try rubbing the runestones together?" Varena suggests. "That might unlock it." Good idea... |"Maybe we need some kind of keystone to activate it?" Varena suggests. ]
rows.translation: 你走近那座石头与青铜制成的基座，仔细打量。上面嵌着五块金属圆盘，其中一块现在被按得比其他的更深。圆盘中央是一块符文石，刻着埃斯托洛尔的纹章——一对交叉的权杖。 [pc.isMage |它散发着微弱的魔法气息，但靠它自己不足以做什么。 |你猜它是有魔力的，但不太确定。 ] 你猜这个装置一定是用来控制水流的——通往这座设施的五台主要水泵各自对应着一个圆盘——但只有一个圆盘被按下，对应着目前唯一一台正在把水送进澡堂的水泵。仅仅一个水头就在供应整栋建筑。 就你目力所及，这装置没有任何机械操作的方式，而你按压那些圆盘时它们也不会被按下。 “有进展吗？”莉芙问道。 你摇了摇头。 [var0 |“试试把那些符文石互相摩擦一下？”瓦蕾娜建议道，“说不定能把它打开。” 好主意…… |“也许我们需要某种钥石才能激活它？”瓦蕾娜建议道。 ]
rows.raw: ' You step closer to the stone-and-bronze plinth, looking it over. There are five metal discs set into it, one of which is currently depressed deeper than the others. In the middle of the discs is a runestone bearing the sigil of Estelore, a pair of crossed staves. [pc.isMage |It's radiating a faint aura of magic, but not enough to be doing much on its own. |You guess it's magical, but you aren't sure. ] You suspect this device must control the flow of water — there's one disc in the direction of each of the five major water pumps coming into the facility — but only one disc is depressed, mirroring the one pump currently dumping its contents into the bath house. Just one waterhead's supplying the entire building. As far as you can see, there's no way to mechanically manipulate the device, and the discs don't depress when you push them. "Any luck?" Liv asks. You shake your head. [var0 |"Try rubbing the runestones together?" Varena suggests. "That might unlock it." Good idea... |"Maybe we need some kind of keystone to activate it?" Varena suggests. ] '

rows.original:
You touch the two runestones together, both the one you found in Iavari's office and the one embedded in the plinth. There's a buildup of pressure in the air around you as the two stones draw closer, a moment of resistance as two wells of magic press into each other, but you push through it and tap the stones together.
    
    The central runestone crackles and recedes into the stone. 
    
    "I think that worked!" Varena says.
    
    Now what to do with it...
rows.translation:
你将那两块符文石放在一起——一块是你从伊瓦里的办公室里找到的，另一块则镶嵌在基座上。当这两块石头逐渐靠近时，你周围的空气中开始积聚压力；当两股魔力相互碰撞时，产生了一阵阻力，但你还是强行将它们合在了一起。
    
    中央的那块符文石突然发出了噼啪声，然后缓缓融入了整块石头之中。
    
    “我想，成功了！”瓦蕾娜说道。
    
    现在，接下来该怎么做呢……
rows.raw:
"
    You touch the two runestones together, both the one you found in Iavari's office and the one embedded in the plinth. There's a buildup of pressure in the air around you as the two stones draw closer, a moment of resistance as two wells of magic press into each other, but you push through it and tap the stones together.
    
    The central runestone crackles and recedes into the stone. 
    
    "I think that worked!" Varena says.
    
    Now what to do with it...
    "

rows.original: Just open all the valves up. Let the water flow unrestricted!
rows.translation: 只要把所有的阀门都打开，让水毫无阻碍地流动吧！
rows.raw: "Just open all the valves up. Let the water flow unrestricted!"

rows.original: Reverse the settings on the valves: the one currently active will close, and the rest will open.
rows.translation: 将阀门上的设置进行反向调整：当前处于激活状态的阀门会关闭，而其余的阀门则会打开。
rows.raw: "Reverse the settings on the valves: the one currently active will close, and the rest will open. "

rows.original:
You press down on all the raised valve-discs, opening the flow from all of the pipes.
    
    The added water pressure makes the pipes around you groan, and several of the slaves shy away from the noise — and the sudden rise in humidity. 
    
    "Woah!" Liv gasps. "It's so loud now! Are you sure this is safe?"
    
    "Oh gods it's so hoooooot," Varena groans, fanning herself. Her dark hair's quickly becoming even more of a frizzy mess.
    
    The slaves get some distance from the furnace, and the clouds of boiling steam rising from it. 
    
    At least whatever might come through the pipes now will be diluted a bit, if it's harmful. For now, you separate the runestones, making sure nobody can mess with the device while you're gone, and take the girls back upstairs.
rows.translation:
你按下所有凸起的阀盘，让所有管道的水流都打开了。
    
    增加的水压让周围的管道发出呻吟声，几个奴隶被这噪音——以及骤然上升的湿度——吓得退开了。 
    
    “哇哦！”莉芙倒吸一口气。“现在声音好大！你确定这样安全吗？”
    
    “天啊，这里好热啊啊啊，”瓦蕾娜呻吟着，用手给自己扇风。她的黑发很快就变得更加蓬乱毛躁了。
    
    奴隶们纷纷远离那座炉子，以及从它里面升腾而起的沸腾蒸汽。 
    
    至少现在，就算从管道里过来的东西有害，也会被稀释一些。眼下，你把那两块符文石分开，确保在你离开期间没人能动这个装置，然后带姑娘们回到楼上。
rows.raw:
'
    You press down on all the raised valve-discs, opening the flow from all of the pipes.
    
    The added water pressure makes the pipes around you groan, and several of the slaves shy away from the noise — and the sudden rise in humidity. 
    
    "Woah!" Liv gasps. "It's so loud now! Are you sure this is safe?"

    The slaves get some distance from the furnace, and the clouds of boiling steam rising from it. 
    
    At least whatever might come through the pipes now will be diluted a bit, if it's harmful. For now, you separate the runestones, making sure nobody can mess with the device while you're gone, and take the girls back upstairs. 
    
    '

rows.original:
You press down on each valve-control disc in turn, depressing those currently raised and sealing off the open valve. The added water pressure makes the pipes around you groan, and several of the slaves shy away from the noise — and the sudden rise in humidity. 
    
    "Woah!" Liv gasps. "I think that's done it."
    
    "Oh gods it's so hoooooot," Varena groans, fanning herself. Her dark hair's quickly becoming even more of a frizzy mess.
    
    Livrea laughs. "Alright, let's get out of here!"
    
    You separate the runestones, making sure nobody can undo what you've done. This should keep the corrupted water from upriver out of the city, at least for now.
    
    With that done, you and the girls head back upstairs.
rows.translation:
你依次按下每一个阀门控制盘，把当前抬起的那些压下去，封住敞开的阀门。增加的水压让周围的管道发出呻吟声，几个奴隶被这噪音——以及骤然上升的湿度——吓得退开了。 
    
    “哇哦！”莉芙倒吸一口气。“我觉得这下成了。”
    
    “天啊，这里好热啊啊啊，”瓦蕾娜呻吟着，用手给自己扇风。她的黑发很快就变得更加蓬乱毛躁了。
    
    莉维娅笑了起来。“好了，我们离开这儿吧！”
    
    你把那两块符文石分开，确保没人能撤销你做过的事。这样至少暂时能挡住上游那些被污染的水流进城里。
    
    做完这些，你和姑娘们回到楼上。
rows.raw:
'
    You press down on each valve-control disc in turn, depressing those currently raised and sealing off the open valve. The added water pressure makes the pipes around you groan, and several of the slaves shy away from the noise — and the sudden rise in humidity. 
    
    "Woah!" Liv gasps. "I think that's done it."
    
    "Oh gods it's so hoooooot," Varena groans, fanning herself. Her dark hair's quickly becoming even more of a frizzy mess.
    
    Livrea laughs. "Alright, let's get out of here!"
    
    You separate the runestones, making sure nobody can undo what you've done. This should keep the corrupted water from upriver out of the city, at least for now.
    
    With that done, you and the girls head back upstairs.
    
    '

rows.original:
You shake your head and withdraw the runestone. The powerful connection between them fades, leaving a static charge in the air.
    
    Varena glances at you and the stones. "Shouldn't we do something? The water... you heard what Iavari said!"
rows.translation:
你摇了摇头，收起了那块符文石。它们之间强大的联系随之消退，只在空气中留下一丝静电。
    
    瓦蕾娜瞥了你和那些石头一眼。“我们是不是该做点什么？那水……你听到贾瓦里说的话了！”
rows.raw:
'
    You shake your head and withdraw the runestone. The powerful connection between them fades, leaving a static charge in the air.
    
    Varena glances at you and the stones. "Shouldn't we do something? The water... you heard what Iavari said!"
    '

rows.original: The sauna door opens, revealing a bull's pinched, beady-eyed face poking through the crack. "Wait, who-" Varena jams the head of her staff through the crack before he can recover his wits. Taking the cue, you shove your shoulder into the door as hard as you can before he can even try to close it, and despite his sheer size and weight, he's too startled to hold up against the sudden attack. The bull goes tumbling onto his ass, and you and the cow duo barrel in after him. His head hits the back of the wall hard enough to not just ring his bell, but smash through the wood completely. He lets out a low groan, eyes crossed. "Woah!" Livrea peers past the shattered wood behind the bull's horns. "Look at this!" You step over the dazed minotaur's chest and look over Liv's shoulder. Behind the thin veneer of wood is a stone tunnel — no, that does it a disservice. It's a corridor, built from the same brick of the walls outside, and warmly carpeted to boot. [pc.isBimbo |"Woah," you echo. |"Huh," you say. ] "Secret passage." Varena wallops the doorman over the head with her staff and steps in after you. "I knew it. Secret lair. Come on, before somebody in there realizes what the crashing sound was!" You glance over your shoulder and [party.manyCompanions |tell your companions to run a distraction while you and the cows go in. |[party.oneCompanion |tell [comp1.name] to run distraction for you. |close the door. That'll have to do as far as concealing your activities from the outside. ] ] Doesn't look like anybody noticed you going in so violently — at least, the guards over at the furnace weren't looking your way. "Right, this is gonna make a heck of a story later," Liv says, drawing the short sword off her belt. "Here we go! Uh, you first, [pc.name]!" You step through the breach.
rows.translation: 桑拿房的门开了，一条缝里探出一张公牛紧绷着、眼睛又小又圆的脑袋。“等等，谁——” 他还没回过神，瓦蕾娜就把法杖的头捅进了门缝。你领会了她的意思，趁他还没来得及把门关上，用尽全身力气把肩膀撞向门板。尽管他身形庞大、体重惊人，但在这样突然的袭击下还是站不住脚。那头公牛一屁股摔倒，你和那两位牛娘跟着冲了进去。他的脑袋狠狠撞在里侧的墙上，不只把他撞得耳鸣眼花，还整个撞穿了木板。他发出一声低沉的呻吟，眼睛都翻了。 “哇哦！”莉维娅从公牛犄角后面那些碎裂的木板处往里面看。“你看这个！” 你从那头昏沉沉的牛头人胸口上跨过去，从莉芙肩后望去。那层薄薄的木板后面是一条石砌隧道——不，这么说太贬低它了。那是一条走廊，用和外面墙壁一样的砖砌成，而且还铺着暖和的地毯。 [pc.isBimbo |“哇哦，”你跟着感叹。 |“嚯，”你说道。 ]“秘密通道。” 瓦蕾娜用法杖在门卫头上敲了一下，跟着你走了进来。“我就知道。秘密巢穴。快走，趁里面还没人反应过来刚才那声巨响是怎么回事！” 你回头瞥了一眼，[party.manyCompanions |让同伴们跑去引开注意力，你和两位牛娘趁机进去。 |[party.oneCompanion |让[comp1.name]去替你引开注意力。 |把门关上。要瞒住外面的耳目，也只能这样了。 ] ] 看起来没人注意到你这么大动静地闯了进去——至少炉子那边的守卫并没有朝你们这边看。 “好吧，这事以后肯定会成为一个不得了的故事，”莉芙说着，从腰带上拔出那把短剑。“来吧！呃，你先走，[pc.name]！” 你穿过那道豁口走了进去。

rows.original:
You motion for the cowgirls to join you again as you slip through into the cool halls of the hidden estate under the laconicum.
    
    Well, cooler by comparison...
rows.translation:
你示意那些女牛仔再次与你同行，然后你悄悄地穿过凉爽的走廊，进入了那座隐藏在凉亭下的庄园。
    
    嗯，相比之下，这里确实要凉快得多……
rows.raw:
"
    You motion for the cowgirls to join you again as you slip through into the cool halls of the hidden estate under the laconicum.
    
    Well, cooler by comparison... 
    "

rows.original: [flags.V_BATHS_TWINS |You descend the stairs back into the pool room. The twins wave amicably at you, making only the most passing attempt to conceal their bare bodies from your wandering eyes. "Hiiii again!" Rosalia says. "Something else you wanted?" |Passing through the door, you find yourself hit by a wall of steam rising from a hot bath below. Through the haze, you can see a wide pool with rose petals floating on the water, beneath a statue of Velun holding up a vase that's pouring in more warm water from a hidden pipe. A number of beautiful, buxom maidens are depicted surrounding the god of nature, fawning over his tauric lower body. You descend the stairs down towards the pool, moving quietly and warily with your bovine companions lagging a few steps behind. It's hard to see through the steam, but you can just see a ripple forming in the middle of the floral pool. You tense, ready... but it's no monster that crests the water, but a beautiful red-haired cowgirl, grinning and giggling at her reflection in the water. At least, you thought it was her reflection at first, but then it, too, emerges from below the surface and shakes out its hair — another cow, identical to the first. "The Iavari twins," Livrea whispers to you. The two ginger cows splash each other playfully, laughing as though they didn't have a care in the world. You gesture to Liv and Varena to stay back, while you continue down towards their level. One of them glances up at you by chance and gasps, covering her mouth. "Oh! You're not supposed to be here!" "Hellooooo anyway, hottie," the other grins. She pulls her hair back, letting it fall over her shoulders in a pair of tails. "Are you one of daddy's friends?" "Or Ramie's?" the other asks hopefully. "Oh, that would be really nice! So what it is? Are you all here for Daddy, or Ramie, or... us?" There's a hopeful lilt in the cow's voice, and she pushes her chest out invitingly. A pair of rings bounce on her bared breasts. Her twin swims behind her, trying to hide just how naked she is too. Her sister grabs her shoulder and brings her right back to the fore. "Oh, this is Rosalinde. And I'm Rosalia. Enchanted to meet you." What are you going to tell them you're here for? ]
rows.translation: [flags.V_BATHS_TWINS |你走下楼梯，回到水池间。那对双胞胎友好地朝你挥手，只是象征性地稍微遮了一下自己赤裸的身体，不让你四处乱看的目光占到便宜。 “又见到你啦！”罗莎莉亚说道，“还想要点别的什么吗？” |穿过那扇门，你迎面撞上下方热浴池升起的蒸汽之墙。透过雾气，你能看到一个宽阔的浴池，水面上漂浮着玫瑰花瓣，池子上方立着一尊维伦的雕像——他高举着一只花瓶，从隐藏的管道中不断向池里注入温水。雕像周围刻画着许多美丽丰腴的少女环绕着这位自然之神，对他牛形的下半身百般献媚。 你沿着楼梯向池边走去，动作轻缓而警惕，你那几位牛族同伴落在后面几步远的地方。 蒸汽中很难看清东西，但你隐约看到花池中央正在泛起涟漪。你绷紧身体，准备应战……但从水中冒出来的并不是什么怪物，而是一位美丽的红发牛娘，正对着水中的倒影咧嘴笑着、咯咯直乐。起初你还以为那只是她的倒影，可随后那个“倒影”也浮出了水面，甩了甩头发——又一头牛娘，和第一头一模一样。 “贾瓦里家的双胞胎，”莉维娅低声对你说。 两个姜黄色的牛娘嬉闹着互相泼水，笑得仿佛世上没有任何烦心事。你示意莉芙和瓦蕾娜留在后面，自己继续朝她们所在的高度走下去。 其中一人偶然抬头看见了你，倒吸一口气，捂住了嘴。“哦！你不该来这儿的！” “不过还是你好呀，帅哥，”另一个咧嘴一笑。她撩起头发往后一甩，让长发分成两束落在肩上。“你是爸爸的朋友吗？” “还是拉米的朋友？”另一个满怀期待地问。 “哦，那可太好了！那么，你们是来找爸爸的，找拉米的，还是……找我们的？” 那牛娘的声音里带着一丝期待，她挑逗地把胸脯挺了出来。一对乳环在她赤裸的乳房上晃动。她的双胞胎姐妹游到她身后，想尽量掩饰自己也同样赤裸的事实。她的姐妹抓住她的肩膀，又把她拉回前面。“哦，这是罗莎琳德。我是罗莎莉亚。很高兴见到你。” 你打算告诉她们你是为什么来的？ ]

rows.original: You can spare a few minutes to make these cowgirls' brains go blank.
rows.translation: 你完全可以花几分钟时间，让这些女牛仔们彻底犯糊涂。
rows.raw: "You can spare a few minutes to make these cowgirls' brains go blank."

rows.original: You're here to talk to Radmus Iavari.
rows.translation: 你是来与拉德穆斯·贾瓦里交谈的。
rows.raw: "You're here to talk to Radmus Iavari."

rows.original: You've already dealt with their dad. Better to keep quiet about that one...
rows.translation: 你已经和他们爸爸打过交道了。最好对这件事保持沉默……
rows.raw: "You've already dealt with their dad. Better to keep quiet about that one..."

rows.original: You encountered Ramien. Things didn't go the way the girls might have hoped...
rows.translation: 你遇到了拉面。事情的发展并没有像那些女孩们所期望的那样……
rows.raw: "You encountered Ramien. Things didn't go the way the girls might have hoped..."

rows.original: You haven't seen Ramien in person yet.
rows.translation: 你还没有亲眼见过拉面呢。
rows.raw: "You haven't seen Ramien in person yet."

rows.original:
You step through the southern door, and find yourself entering a warrior's personal arming chamber — a room decorated with the honors and banners of a Minoan legion on its walls, and a painting of Velun in warrior's attire looming overhead. Weapon racks and and armor stand complete the look, but their contents have been spilled across the floor by the man standing in front of you...
    
    At the far end of the room is a tall, red-furred bull dressed in the armor of the Khor'minoan Legions. His hands are planted on either side of his desk, back to you, breathing harder than a man who's just run a marathon. 
    
    Livrea gives you a glance and mouths "Ramien."
    
    Whatever is amiss with him, he hasn't noticed your presence. You could try and back out still.

Something about her stokes a fury in the bull's heart that leaves him snorting like a beast. "I will... NEVER... accept you. NEVER. I am hers, hers!" "Who-" Ramien throws his helmet, hard enough to crack the wall beside Varena. The princess yelps in alarm, raising an arcane shield in front of herself to ward off his gauntlets. The warrior rips at his own armor, only growing more furious as he bares his chest and throws away his blade. "I AM RAMIEN IAVARI," he bellows. "AND I CHOOSE MY OWN DESTINY!" "What does that even mean?" Livrea says, though there's no answer coming now.

You must trust me in this, and do what must be done. For the family's sake. Come back at once when you read this. There is no time to waste! I will await you in our home away from home. Your father. There's something more scrawled on the back of the paper, in a different hand. Dad asked us to send this off to you. Sorry we read it, but... don't listen to him about Bella. She's a sweetheart, and we'd love to have her as our sister someday! Nobody cares who her dad was, we're not Patricians either. To hell with the rumors! We'll see you at the bath house. You owe us so many hugs for how long you've been away! We love you! ~Your Roses
rows.translation: 你在士兵的背包里发现了一封信： 拉米，我的儿子，你根本不知道我为了这件事在凯乌斯面前耗费了多少影响力。不过我已经安排好了，让第二军团在周末结束目前的任务，然后回家去。我需要你回家。 现在我担心一切很快就会分崩离析，而如果真的发生了那样的事情，你的姐妹们就需要保护了！ 我们与国王陛下的合作即将取得成果，一旦成功，我们家族的命运就将得到彻底的改变。那些老贵族再也不会看不起伊瓦里家族了！而你……我的儿子，你的未来在所有人当中最为光明。我有非常令人振奋的消息要告诉你，还有一位新娘也要介绍给你！是时候放弃那个低贱的舞女，去追求更高层次的东西了！ 你必须信任我，去做必须做的事情。为了全家着想，读到这条消息后请立刻回来。没有时间可以浪费了！我会在我们这个临时住所里等你。 你的父亲。 纸的背面还用另一种笔迹写着一些别的内容。 爸爸让我们把这个转交给你。很抱歉我们先看了这个，但是……别听他关于贝拉的说法。她是个很可爱的女孩，我们也很希望有她成为我们的妹妹！谁在乎她的父亲是谁，我们也不是贵族啊。那些谣言根本不值一提！ 我们在浴场见吧。你欠我们的。 需要很多拥抱呢…… 过了这么久你才回来！ 我们爱你！ ~你的玫瑰们

I need you home now! I fear things may soon fall apart, and if they do, your sisters need protection! Our arrangement with His Majesty is coming to its fruition, and when it does, our family's fortunes will be set in stone. No longer will the Old Patricians look down on the Iavari! You must trust me in this, and do what must be done. For the family's sake. Come back at once when you read this. There is no time to waste! I will await you in our home away from home. Your father. There's something more scrawled on the back of the paper, in a different hand. Dad asked us to send this off to you. Sorry we read it, but... don't listen to him about Bella. She's a sweetheart, and we'd love to have her as our sister someday! Nobody cares who her dad was, we're not Patricians either. To hell with the rumors! We'll see you at the bath house. You owe us so many hugs for how long you've been away! We love you! ~Your Roses "

rows.original: Ramian backhands you, sending you tumbling end over end onto the ground. And then he ignores you, pushing past where you've fallen to menace the cowgirls behind you. Livrea rushes at him with her sword, thrusting it towards his chest, but he catches her wrist and wrenches the blade from her hand. She yelps in pain, before she too is thrown to the side like she weighs nothing at all. "YOU." He bellows at Varena, soaking a blast of lightning to the gut without so much as a flinch. The princess tries to ward him off with the head of her staff, but Ramien just grabs it and crushes it to splinters in one massive, furry hand. "WHORE OF A PRINCESS." "What did I do to you?" she gasps, retreating as he advances, until her back is against the wall. "I have never raised a hand to House Iavari!" Her defense falls on deaf ears, and soon her voice is stolen from her as the warrior's hand grasps her neck. The princess is hauled off her feet, gurgling and flailing her limbs. You desperately try and push yourself up, try to stop what you dread is coming, but your body refuses to answer your call until it's too late, and a chill crunch echoes through the room. Ramien's murderous eyes turn to you next. At least it doesn't hurt.
rows.translation: 拉米恩用反手击中你，让你翻滚着摔在地上。 然后他无视了你，从你摔倒的地方挤过去，去威胁你身后的那些女牛仔。莉维娅举剑冲向他，把剑刺向他的胸口，但他抓住她的手腕，把剑从她手中扭了下来。她痛得尖叫，随后也被甩到一边，仿佛她毫无重量。 “你。”他对着瓦蕾娜吼道，硬生生用腹部承受了一记闪电冲击，连眼都没眨一下。公主试图用权杖的头部挡开他，但拉米恩只是一把抓住它，用一只巨大的毛手把它捏成碎片。“公主婊子。” “我到底对你做过什么？”她倒抽着气说，在他逼近时后退，直到背抵住墙壁。“我从未对伊瓦里家族动过手！” 她的辩解无人理会，很快，战士的手掐住她的脖子，她的声音被夺走了。公主被提离地面，喉咙咯咯作响，四肢乱蹬。你拼命想把自己撑起来，想阻止你害怕即将发生的事，但你的身体拒绝回应你的呼唤，直到为时已晚——一声冰冷的碎裂声在房间里回荡。 拉米恩那双充满杀意的眼睛接下来转向了你。 至少它不疼。

rows.original: You insert the wave-etched key into the door and give it a turn. There's a gratifying click sound, and the lock disengages. "Here we go," Varena says, tightening her grip on her staff. "This has got to be it. I want answers." "Yeah," Liv says, drawing her sword and giving it a whirl. "This bastard's up to no good. I'm sure of it now." [pc.isDK |"Now?" |Yeah. ] You've seen enough to know this man's a menace, but what exactly his plan is... that you still have yet to learn. That in mind, you open the door and step through, into an opulent office. Thick carpets cover every inch of the floor, and lush tapestries of ancient creatures of myth coat the walls. You're faced with an oakwood desk spilling over with scrolls and tomes, behind which is a throne-like chair with a golden bullhead mounted overtop. Sitting in the chair is a heavyset minotaur coated in graying auburn fur and a sea-blue toga. Dark red eyes scour the pages of the tomes before him, barely registering your presence... but for a hand that slowly moves from the top of a tome to a heavy copper rod lying on the desk. "Radmus Iavari," Varena says, leveling her staff with the man's hand. "Stand before your princess!" He pauses, glancing up at the three of you. "Ah. You're here earlier than expected. I'm afraid my son is still a bit beside himself, but no matter. Please, princess. Make yourself at home."
rows.translation: 你把那把刻着波浪纹的钥匙插进门里，转动了一下。传来一声令人满意的咔哒声，锁开了。 “我们走吧，”瓦蕾娜说着，握紧了手中的法杖。“一定是这里了。我要答案。” “是啊，”莉芙说着，拔出剑挥了一圈。“这个混蛋肯定在干坏事。我现在确信了。” [pc.isDK |“现在？” |是啊。 ] 你已经看得够多了，知道这个男人是个威胁，但他究竟有什么计划……这一点你还有待了解。 想到这里，你打开门走进去，进入一间奢华的办公室。厚厚的地毯铺满每一寸地面，墙上覆着描绘古代神话生物的华丽挂毯。你面前是一张橡木书桌，上面堆满了卷轴和典籍，桌后是一把王座般的椅子，椅背上方嵌着一个金色的公牛头。 坐在椅子上的是一个体格魁梧的弥诺陶洛斯，身上覆盖着灰白的赤褐色毛皮，穿着海蓝色的托加袍。深红色的眼睛扫视着他面前的典籍书页，几乎没有注意到你的存在……只有一只手慢慢从书页顶部移向桌上那根沉重的铜杖。 “拉德穆斯·伊瓦里，”瓦蕾娜说着，把法杖对准那人的手。“站到你的公主面前来！” 他停顿了一下，抬头看了看你们三个。“啊，你们比预想的来得早。恐怕我的儿子还有点情绪不稳，不过没关系。请吧，公主。随意就好。”

rows.original: A shadow on the ceiling writhes, and before you can blink Varena's staff has been pulled from her hands, hurtling against the far wall. You pull the plush princess back just before the shadow swipes at her legs, so quick that you hear the air slicing where she'd just stood. You try to strike the darkness, but it darts away just as lightning-fast as it attacked, diving under the architect's desk. Radmus takes the opportunity to collect his rod and stand. The shadows coalesce beside him, taking on a human form, sleek and svelte in comparison to the old man's heft, and barely standing up to his chest. You recognize the tell-tale sweeping horns and hip-mounted wings of a demon, growing from a body with cyan skin and brilliant golden eyes. The skinny incubus flashes you a fang-toothed snarl, but Radmus puts a hand on his shoulder. "And you've brought friends, too. The Champion of Frost, no less, and the Storm Witch's child. May I offer you a drink, dear guests? Our water is the future of the city, don't you know..." "I'll pass, creep," Liv says.
rows.translation: 天花板上的阴影蠕动起来，你还没来得及眨眼，瓦蕾娜的法杖就被从她手中扯走，飞撞向远处的墙壁。就在阴影扫向她双腿之前，你把这位丰满的公主拉了回来，快得让你听见空气划过她刚才站立的地方。你试图击打那片黑暗，但它以攻击时同样闪电般的速度窜开，钻进了建筑师的桌子下面。 拉德穆斯趁机捡起他的法杖站了起来。阴影在他身旁汇聚，化作人形——与那老人魁梧的身形相比显得光滑纤细，几乎只到他胸口高。你认出了恶魔那标志性的弯角和长在胯部的翅膀，它们长在一具青色皮肤、眼睛是明亮金色的身体上。 那个瘦削的男魅魔朝你龇出獠牙低吼，但拉德穆斯把手放在他肩上。“你还带来了朋友。而且是冰霜冠军，还有风暴女巫的孩子。亲爱的客人们，我能否请你们喝一杯？我们的水就是这座城市的未来，你难道不知道吗……” “免了，怪胎，”莉芙说。

rows.translation: 那个瘦削漂亮的男魅魔是怎么回事？

rows.original: The future of the city, huh?
What exactly does Radmus want from Varena?
rows.translation: 拉德穆斯究竟想从瓦蕾娜那里得到什么？
rows.raw: "What exactly does Radmus want from Varena? "

rows.original: What the hell was wrong with Ramien?
rows.translation: 拉米恩到底出了什么问题？
rows.raw: "What the hell was wrong with Ramien?"

rows.original: That's quite the collection he has. You've never seen such ancient magic before.
rows.translation: 他的收藏真是相当丰富啊。你以前从未见过如此古老的魔法物品。
rows.raw: "That's quite the collection he has. You've never seen such ancient magic before."

rows.original: You've heard enough from this evil pair. Time to stop them.
rows.translation: 你们已经听够了这对恶人的胡言乱语。是时候阻止他们了。
rows.raw: "You've heard enough from this evil pair. Time to stop them."

rows.original: You glance between the elder bull and the blue demon-boy at his side. "Who's your friend, Radmus?" "Ah." A heavy paw pats the demon's slim shoulder. "This is Caedlan, an agent of my dear associate, Master Tollus." "Of course," you groan. The demon, Caedlan, waves at you. "He's been a great help arranging all of this," Radmus says, gesturing around himself. "And in helping me to learn of the greater mysteries of the world. Much has been lost since the fall of the old empires. It is the duty of we learned men to recover what has been forgotten, or worse, obscured by the very gods." "What he means," the demon boy says, "is my brain's as sharp as my talons. Better watch out, Champion." Radmus snorts. "Now, now. No need for that. My apologies, Champion. Caedlan's compulsion is to prove his superiority to others. Every demon has one driving him, you know. It is in their nature." "And I'll do it while looking killer, too," the incubus smirks, tossing his hair. "Come on, Radmus. Let's show [pc.himHer] what we can do..." "No, no. These are our guests.." You take the opportunity to ask, since he's apparently been teaching Radmus: "Where did you learn from, Caedlan?" He flashes his fangs at you. "Oh, you'd like to know, wouldn't you? People these days can only dream of it — the glory I've seen. Even the power of these new demons pales in comparison! Mm, but I prefer to show rather than tell..."
rows.translation: 你在这位年长的公牛和他身旁那个蓝色恶魔男孩之间来回看了看。“你的朋友是谁，拉德穆斯？” “啊。”一只沉重的爪子拍了拍恶魔纤细的肩膀。“这是凯德兰，我亲爱的伙伴托勒斯大师的代理人。” “当然，”你呻吟道。 那个恶魔，凯德兰，朝你挥了挥手。 “他在安排这一切上帮了大忙，”拉德穆斯说着，朝自己周围比划了一下。“还帮我了解了这个世界上更伟大的奥秘。自从古老帝国覆灭以来，许多东西都已失传。找回那些被遗忘的、或者更糟——被诸神本身遮蔽的东西，是我们这些有学识之人的职责。” “他的意思是，”那个恶魔男孩说道，“我的脑子跟我的爪子一样锋利。最好小心点，冠军。” 拉德穆斯哼了一声。“好了，好了。没必要这样。我向你道歉，冠军。凯德兰的冲动就是向别人证明自己的优越。你知道，每个恶魔都有一个驱动他的执念。这是他们的天性。” “而且我做这件事的时候还会很迷人，”那个男魅魔坏笑着，甩了甩头发。“来吧，拉德穆斯。让我们给[pc.himHer]看看我们能做什么……” “不，不。这些是我们的客人……” 你趁这个机会问道，因为他显然一直在教拉德穆斯：“你是从哪里学来的，凯德兰？” 他朝你龇出獠牙。“哦，你想知道，对吧？如今的人只能梦想它——我所见证的荣耀。就连这些新恶魔的力量也相形见绌！嗯，不过我更喜欢用展示而不是讲述……”
