rows.original:
"You think your water is the future of the city?"
    
    Radmus gives you an even look. "It's inevitable. A slow and gentle slide into submission to our Master — much preferable to a bloody and pointless war, raging against the new dawn." 
    
    The minotaur picks up a pitcher and takes a deep, long quaff. "Ah! You can taste the Master's hand at work. Years of planning, maneuvering in the shadows, all culminating in water that tastes so pure, looks so clear, even an Estelorean would never know it was tainted to its very core. We have made an elixir, Tollus, Caedlan, and I: a soothing tonic to guide our city into tomorrow."
    
    "You're sick," Varena gasps. "You're poisoning people!"
    
    "Yes," Radmus says. "For their own good."
    
    [flags.V_BATHS_FURNACE|"This is coming from that waterhead, right?" you ask. "The only one you have feeding this place."
    
    Caedlan regards you with sudden interest. "Oh, [pc.heShe]'s not as dumb as [pc.heShe] looks."|"Where is this coming from?" you ask. "How is it being tainted?"
    
    The incubus chortles. "Oh, you really haven't figured it out? Or are you just playing dumb?"
    
    "The waterheads," Livrea says. "Your master's corrupted one of them!"]
    
    "The only one," Radmus affirms. "As of this week, my dear, every drop entering the bath house has been blessed. When the reservoirs have been emptied of the old water, the entire district will be supping on it. Eventually, the city as a whole. This is but a testbed, a first taste, but with your help we will soon have the whole of the city under the sway of our Master, their wills broken by ancient magics, ready to throw open the gates and receive his blessings directly."
    
    "Our help?" you ask. "Like hell."
    
    Radmus seems unfazed by that rebuke.
rows.translation:
你认为你的水就是这座城市的未来吗？”拉德穆斯平静地注视着你：“这是不可避免的。慢慢地、温和地屈服于我们的主人之下，总比与这个新的时代进行一场血腥而毫无意义的战争要好得多。米诺陶罗斯拿起水壶，深深地喝了一大口。“啊！你能尝到大师的手艺——多年的策划与暗中布局，最终造就了这样纯净、清澈的水。就连埃斯特洛里安人也不会察觉到它的本质已经被污染了。我们研制出了一种灵药——托勒斯、凯德兰和我共同配制而成的这种舒缓补品，将会引领我们的城市走向美好的未来。”“你疯了！”瓦拉娜惊呼道，“你在毒害人们！”“没错，”拉德穆斯说道，“但这是为了他们好。
    
    [flags.V_BATHS_FURNACE|这些水都是从那个水源来的，对吧？”你问道，“那是唯一一个为这个地方提供水源的地方。”凯德兰突然对你产生了兴趣：“哦，原来如此[pc.heShe]并没有那么愚蠢[pc.heShe]看起来是这样。|这东西是从哪里来的？”你问道，“究竟是怎么被污染的？”那个吸血鬼嘲笑道：“哦，你们真的还没弄明白吗？还是说只是装作不知道而已？”“是那些水容器，”莉维娅说道，“你们的主人把其中的一个给污染了！]
    
    独一无二的，”拉德穆斯肯定地说，“从这周开始，亲爱的，每一滴被用来沐浴的水都经过了神圣的祝福。等那些储水容器里的旧水被全部替换掉之后，整个地区的人都将能够使用这种被祝福过的水。最终，整个城市的人都能享受到它的恩惠。这只是一个测试平台，只是一个初步尝试，但在你们的帮助下，我们很快就能让整座城市都屈服于我们的主宰之下。那些人们的意志将被古老的魔法所摧毁，他们将准备好敞开城门，直接接受他的恩赐。我们的帮助？”你问道，“想得美。”拉德穆斯似乎对这种反驳毫不在意。

    "You think your water is the future of the city?"
    
    Radmus gives you an even look. "It's inevitable. A slow and gentle slide into submission to our Master — much preferable to a bloody and pointless war, raging against the new dawn." 
    
    The minotaur picks up a pitcher and takes a deep, long quaff. "Ah! You can taste the Master's hand at work. Years of planning, maneuvering in the shadows, all culminating in water that tastes so pure, looks so clear, even an Estelorean would never know it was tainted to its very core. We have made an elixir, Tollus, Caedlan, and I: a soothing tonic to guide our city into tomorrow."
    
    "You're sick," Varena gasps. "You're poisoning people!"
    
    "Yes," Radmus says. "For their own good."
    
    [flags.V_BATHS_FURNACE|"This is coming from that waterhead, right?" you ask. "The only one you have feeding this place."
    
    Caedlan regards you with sudden interest. "Oh, [pc.heShe]'s not as dumb as [pc.heShe] looks."|"Where is this coming from?" you ask. "How is it being tainted?"
    
    The incubus chortles. "Oh, you really haven't figured it out? Or are you just playing dumb?"
    
    "The waterheads," Livrea says. "Your master's corrupted one of them!"]
    
    "The only one," Radmus affirms. "As of this week, my dear, every drop entering the bath house has been blessed. When the reservoirs have been emptied of the old water, the entire district will be supping on it. Eventually, the city as a whole. This is but a testbed, a first taste, but with your help we will soon have the whole of the city under the sway of our Master, their wills broken by ancient magics, ready to throw open the gates and receive his blessings directly."
    
    "Our help?" you ask. "Like hell."
    
    Radmus seems unfazed by that rebuke.
    '

rows.original:
"What do you want with Varena?" you demand. "Why have you been spying on her?" 
    
    "Oh my god," the incubus groans. "You're clueless!" 
    
    Varena shoots him a murderous look, fierce enough to make even a demon wince. 
    
    "Enough," Radmus says. "Though I admit, if you have come this far, I thought the answer would be evident enough. My son, Ramien, is in need of a bride. One more fitting to his station — not just now, but in the future. The Master's future." 
    
    "You bastard," you say. [var0
        |"Well too bad. I got her first!"
    
        Radmus waves a hand. "It matters not. I want her name, not her body.
        |
        
        He laughs. "Yes, it is long past time that House Iavari was given the recognition it deserves.
    ] The hand of a princess for my eldest son! No more will the old guard look down upon us! We will stand proudly amongst the elder families in a generation."
    
    "That's never happening," Varena says. "Even my father knows better than to try and get me to marry for anything but love! And I'm certainly never marrying one of you creeps!"
    
    The incubus sticks his tongue out. "Nobody asked you, fattie."
    
    "Indeed," Radmus says. "My spies were only meant to ascertain how receptive you would be; what strategies my son could use to woo you. But the boy has proven recalcitrant, and what I have learned of you tells me that you, too, will resist me. No matter. Our master has provided the tools to realize my dream, whether you cooperate or not. I only need your body, which you have kindly brought to me now. My plans proceed apace."
    
    Varena clutches her staff so hard the wood creaks. "You're a monster."

rows.original: "Whaaaaaat the heck? No fair!" the incubus squeals, tumbling back against the desk. He sprawls out over it, dazed and confused, but that doesn't stop him from trying to cast another spell — until you grab his wrists and twist, breaking the arcane gestures before they can amount to anything but crackling energy in the air. Radmus slumps to his knees, heavy enough to make scrolls fall from the desk. "Enough," he gasps. "Enough. All this ancient knowledge, all the Master's blessings, and what have they availed us?" "Ahhh, shut up, you old fart!" the incubus seethes. His flesh becomes shadow in your grasp, and he worms out of your restraint with a flourish. "You're so stupid! You're all so stupid, I can't stand it! All these years, all this power, and a bunch of boneheads are dragging me down!? It's not fucking fair! I'm out of here!" Varena cracks her staff over his head before he can start flapping his wings. "Shut up already!" She scowls. "All the horror stories I hear about demons, and the first one I meet face to face, mask off, is just... just some bratty kid!" "Kid!?" Caedlan shrieks. "You're nothing but a thigh stain compared to me! Even Radmus is just a baby. So shut your- OW!" Varena bonks him again. "So what do we do with them?" Livrea asks. The princess glances at you. "You're the demon hunter, [pc.name]. Studying the demons was Vrannus's job." Radmus croaks a laugh. "His Majesty... you cannot begin to imagine the truth of it." Caedlan just blows you all a raspberry. "Don't tell them shit, Radmus!"
rows.translation: 搞什么鬼？太不公平了！”那个吸血鬼尖叫着，重重摔在桌子上。他瘫倒在桌子上，显得晕头转向、困惑不已，但这并没有阻止他试图再次施展法术——直到你抓住他的手腕，用力一扭，使得那些神秘的法术动作在产生任何效果之前，就只是让空气里发出一阵噼啪声而已。 拉德穆斯双膝跪地，他的体重大得让桌上的卷轴都掉了下来。“够了，”他喘着气说道，“够了。所有这些古老的知识，大师赐予我们的一切恩惠，究竟让我们得到了什么？” “啊，闭嘴吧，你这个老混蛋！那个恶魔正在酝酿着复仇。当你抓住它的时候，它的肉体仿佛变成了阴影，然后它又会突然从你的掌控中逃脱。”你们真是太愚蠢了！全都一样愚蠢的我再也受不了了！这些年来，我拥有了这么大的力量，却还是被一群蠢货拖垮了！这太他妈不公平了……我走！” 在那个家伙还来不及挥动翅膀之前，瓦蕾娜就已经用她的法杖砸中了他的头部。闭嘴吧！”她怒气冲冲地说，“我听过的所有关于恶魔的恐怖故事，而当我第一次亲眼见到一个恶魔时，结果发现它竟然只是……只是个任性捣蛋的小孩而已！” “小孩？！”凯德兰惊叫道，“跟我比起来，你根本什么都不是！就连拉德姆斯也还只是个小孩子而已。所以闭嘴吧——哇！” 瓦拉娜又打了他一下。 “那我们该怎么办呢做和他们一起吗？”莉维娅问道。 公主瞥了你一眼：“你就是那位恶魔猎人吧。 [pc.name]研究那些恶魔其实是弗兰努斯的工作。” 拉德穆斯发出一声干笑：“陛下……您根本无法想象其中的真相。” 凯德兰则直接对拉德穆斯说：“别跟他们胡说八道！
rows.raw: ' "Whaaaaaat the heck? No fair!" the incubus squeals, tumbling back against the desk. He sprawls out over it, dazed and confused, but that doesn't stop him from trying to cast another spell — until you grab his wrists and twist, breaking the arcane gestures before they can amount to anything but crackling energy in the air. Radmus slumps to his knees, heavy enough to make scrolls fall from the desk. "Enough," he gasps. "Enough. All this ancient knowledge, all the Master's blessings, and what have they availed us?" "Ahhh, shut up, you old fart!" the incubus seethes. His flesh becomes shadow in your grasp, and he worms out of your restraint with a flourish. "You're so stupid! You're all so stupid, I can't stand it! All these years, all this power, and a bunch of boneheads are dragging me down!? It's not fucking fair! I'm out of here!" Varena cracks her staff over his head before he can start flapping his wings. "Shut up already!" She scowls. "All the horror stories I hear about demons, and the first one I meet face to face, mask off, is just... just some bratty kid!" "Kid!?" Caedlan shrieks. "You're nothing but a thigh stain compared to me! Even Radmus is just a baby. So shut your- OW!" Varena bonks him again. "So what do we do with them?" Livrea asks. The princess glances at you. "You're the demon hunter, [pc.name]. Studying the demons was Vrannus's job." Radmus croaks a laugh. "His Majesty... you cannot begin to imagine the truth of it." Caedlan just blows you all a raspberry. "Don't tell them shit, Radmus!" '

rows.original: Thus always to traitors and demons.
rows.translation: 这就是背叛者与恶魔的本性。

rows.original: Imprison the demon Caedlan in your Wayfort's dungeon, while Varena takes Radmus to stand trial before the king.
rows.translation: 将恶魔凯德兰关进你的荒废驿堡地牢中，而瓦蕾娜则会将拉德穆斯带到国王面前接受审判。
rows.raw: "Imprison the demon Caedlan in your Wayfort's dungeon, while Varena takes Radmus to stand trial before the king."

rows.original: You don't have anywhere to imprison a shapeshifter, and neither does Khor'minos itself.
rows.translation: 你没有任何地方可以关押一个变形者，就连科尔米诺斯本身也没有这样的地方。
rows.raw: "You don't have anywhere to imprison a shapeshifter, and neither does Khor'minos itself."

rows.original: Interrogate the incubus twink mage. Something's different about this demon...
rows.translation: 审问那个被称为“闪烁法师”的梦魔吧……这个恶魔确实有些不同寻常……
rows.raw: "Interrogate the incubus twink mage. Something's different about this demon..."

rows.original: You need to know how to undo the damage he's caused, and who's he's working with.
rows.translation: 你必须弄清楚如何消除他造成的伤害，以及他正在与谁合作。
rows.raw: "You need to know how to undo the damage he's caused, and who's he's working with."

rows.original: "So who exactly are you?" you ask the femboy incubus. "Caedlan, didn't you hear?" he huffs. "Or are you deaf, too?" You scowl at him. "So where are you from, and where did you learn this magic of yours?" He just cackles. "Oh, you'd like to know, huh? I bet you're jealous. I- ow!" Varena whacks him with her staff. "F-fine, damn. I was born in the Sailgraves, the islands east of here. There used to be an incredible school of magic out there, the greatest in the whole world. Estelore! The Godswar may have wiped it off the map, but that doesn't mean everything was lost. I'm a direct inheritor of that ancient knowledge, sorcery that makes the very world tremble!" "I think he's just delusional," Varena says. "Nothing survived from Estelore. The very land it stood on is cursed to its roots." "Ha! That's what you think, stupid cow, but it's all wrong. So much survived, and it's all in here!" Caedlan taps the side of his head. "And it's all waiting for the right moment to be unleashed." Varena's brow furrows. "That makes you dangerous, Caedlan, not brilliant. Those mages nearly destroyed the world!" If anything, that just makes the incu-boy look even more smug. "You mountain-cows think you're hot shit, but you're barely a bunch of street performers compared to the old mages." He glances at you. "I could teach you, you know — if you ask nicely. Show you just a hint of the power you've all forgotten. Don't tell me it's not tempting... just spare our lives, and I can become your tutor. Your master." He gives you a salacious wink. Radmus growls at him. How quick the boy is to betray his comrade...
rows.translation: 那么，你到底是谁？”你问道，看着这个伪娘型的魅魔。“凯德兰，你没听见吗？”他恼怒地回答，“还是说你也是聋子？”你皱起眉头看着他：“那你来自哪里？又是从哪里学会这种魔法的？ 他只是哈哈大笑：“哦，你想知道，是吧？我打赌你一定很嫉妒……哎哟！”瓦蕾娜用她的法杖敲了他一下。“好吧，该死……我出生在赛尔格雷夫斯群岛，就在这里东边。那里曾经有一所极其强大的魔法学校，是全世界最伟大的魔法学府。埃斯托洛尔！虽然神战将它从地图上抹去了，但这并不意味着一切那些知识已经遗失了。我是那些古老知识的直接继承者，那些能够让整个世界为之颤抖的魔法，就掌握在我手中！”“我觉得他只是在妄想而已，”瓦蕾娜说道，“埃斯托洛尔已经没有任何东西留存下来了。它曾经矗立的土地，从根本就被诅咒了。哈！你就这么认为的，愚蠢的母牛，但事实完全不是这样。有很多东西都幸存了下来，它们都在这里！”凯德兰敲了敲自己的脑袋，“而它们都在等待合适的时机被释放出来。”瓦蕾娜的眉头紧锁起来。这就使得你变得危险了，凯德兰，而不是聪明。那些法师差点毁掉了整个世界！”相反，这只会让那个自大的小子显得更加得意洋洋。“你们这些山里人自以为很了不起，但与那些古老的法师相比，你们简直就像是一群街头艺人罢了。他瞥了你一眼，说道：“其实我可以教你，你知道的——只要你好好请求的话。我可以让你见识一下的。提示那种你们都已经遗忘的力量……别告诉我这没有吸引力……只要饶我们一命，我就能成为你的导师。你的师父。”他向你抛了一个充满挑逗意味的眼神。拉德穆斯朝他低吼道：这个小子真是太容易背叛自己的同伴了……

rows.original: You turn to the defeated master of the bath house. "It's time to tell us who you're working with." "Spare my family, and I will tell you what you wish to know." Varena nods. "As far as I can tell they're blameless in this. You have my word they won't come to harm, so long as they do not follow you into treachery. Now answer [pc.name]'s questions." "The Master's going to kill all of you. Or make you wish he did!" Caedlan pouts. Varena just clocks him with her staff again, while Radmus begins to speak. "Five years ago, I was put in contact with a man, Master Tollus, and through him Caedlan here. I learned much of ancient magic from them, secrets of the arcane long thought lost to the wider world. I was able to synthesize the knowledge they offered me with generations of engineering prowess passed down through my family, revolutionizing the city's waterways." You glance at Varena, who nods. So far so true. "My newfound skill was so great that I attracted the attention of that wealthy fool Khaius. He commissioned me to build the bath house here, never questioning the source of my... inspiration, just as I failed to question Tollus's motives in teaching me, until the Dark Queen came." "He means that bitch Kasyrra," Caedlan says. Livrea narrows her eyes. "Aren't you supposed to be working for her?" Radmus shakes his head. "The Queen is just another arrow in the Master's quiver, a tool that galvanized all of us who had pledged ourselves to him to stand up and begin the great work... and a source of new power, for those like Caedlan too old and infirm to still fight for the cause." Caedlan pouts. "Who's infirm now, you stupid cow?" Ignoring him, you ask Radmus, "What exactly did Tollus have you do?" "He bid me build the bath house in such a way that at his command the water from all but one waterhead — one of his choosing — could be subtly closed off, ensuring that when the time was right, undiluted corruption could flow into the city. Already, his plan has been set in motion. The effects are being felt all throughout the city, but nowhere more acutely than here. Through our work, we prepare the city to open its gates to him, to welcome the great change he will bring. A complete rebuilding of Khor'minos in his image." "How do we stop it?" He gives you a rueful look. "At the source, where else?" "The waterhead," Livrea says. "The only one they're sourcing from. But we can turn off the pipes from here, right?" "In the furnace room," Radmus says, bowing his head. "Though it will only make the inevitable fall of this city crueler." Varena snorts. "Yeah right."
rows.translation: 你转向那个被击败的浴场老板，说道：“是时候告诉我们你到底在为谁效力了。” “放过我的家人，我会告诉你们你们想知道的一切。” 瓦蕾娜点了点头：“据我所知，他们在这件事中是无辜的。我向你保证，只要他们不跟着你一起犯下背叛之举，就不会受到任何伤害。现在，回答我的问题吧。 [pc.name]这些问题……” “大师会把你们全部杀掉。或者让你们希望他真的这么做！”凯德兰撅着嘴说道。 瓦蕾娜再次用她的法杖敲了他一下，而拉德穆斯则开始说话：“五年前，我结识了一个人，托勒斯大师，也正是通过他，我认识了这里的凯德兰。我从他们那里学到了许多古老的魔法知识，那些长期以来被认为已经失传的神秘奥秘。我将他们传授给我的知识，与我家世代相传的工程技术相结合，从而彻底改变了这座城市的水路系统。" 你瞥了瞥瓦蕾娜，她点了点头——确实如此。 “我新掌握的这项技能实在太厉害了，以至于吸引了那个富有的蠢货凯乌斯的注意。他委托我在这里建造这座浴场，却从未质疑我获得这些灵感的来源……就像我当初也没有质疑托勒斯教导我的动机一样，直到暗影女王出现了。 他指的是那个叫卡希拉的贱人，”凯德兰说道。 莉维娅眯起了眼睛：“你不是应该在为她效力吗？” 拉德穆斯摇了摇头：“女王只不过是那位领袖手中的一支箭罢了，一种能够激励所有追随他的人站出来共同完成伟大事业的工具……而对于那些年纪太大或身体虚弱、已经无法为这一事业奋斗的人来说，她也是获取新力量的来源。 凯德兰撅起了嘴：“现在谁才是体弱多病的人啊，你这个愚蠢的家伙？” 你没有理他，而是问拉德姆斯：“托勒斯到底让你做了什么？” “他命令我建造那座浴场，使得除了他指定的一个水源之外，其他所有水源的水都可以被巧妙地切断。这样，当时机成熟时，未经稀释的腐蚀物质就能被引入这座城市。他的计划已经启动了。其影响正在整个城市中显现，而在这里，这种影响最为显著。通过我们的努力，我们为这座城市做好了迎接他的准备，迎接他将带来的巨大变革。按照他的形象，对科尔米诺斯进行全面重建。 我们该怎么做呢？停止从源头吗？” 他无奈地看了你一眼：“还能从哪里取水呢？” “就是水源地，”莉维娅说，“他们是唯一从那里取水的。但我们可以从这里把管道关掉，对吧？” “在熔炉房里，”拉德穆斯低头说道，“不过这样做只会让这座城市不可避免的灭亡变得更加残酷罢了。” 瓦蕾娜嗤笑道：“是啊，当然会。

rows.original:
You tell your companions that you intend to imprison the pair of them — the princess can take Radmus to stand trial, while you take Caedlan back to the specially-prepared holding cells beneath your Wayfort. 
    
    "That... if you're sure, [pc.name]," Varena says. "I can have some men I know are trustworthy take him there under guard." 
    
    You nod. "I'm sure."
    
    "For now, though," the princess says, glancing at Livrea, "let's make sure they stay out of trouble."
    
    "Gotcha!" Liv says, plucking a note on her harp. You feel a heaviness in the air around you, enough to make you have to take a deep breath that comes out as a heavy yawn. The effect's far more pronounced on the villains in their weakened state, and you watch as they both wobble on the spot, trying to fight back an overwhelming soporific. The two collapse against each other in a matter of moments, ensorcelled into sleep by the bard's melodious strumming. 
    
    Livrea gives a bow once they're down. "They'll be out the rest of the day! More than enough time for us to sweep up here and fix the damage they've done..."
    
    "Yeah," you say, turning away. "Let's go."
rows.translation: 你告诉你的同伴，你打算将他们两人关起来——公主可以带着拉德姆斯去接受审判，而你则会把凯德兰带回你在荒废驿堡基地下方专门准备好的拘留室。“那……如果你确定的话，[pc.name]，”瓦蕾娜说道，“我可以派一些我信任的人带着他去那里，”瓦蕾娜说道，“他们会保证他的安全。”你点了点头：“我相信你。”“不过，目前来说，”公主瞥了瞥莉维娅，继续说道，“我们还是得确保他们不会惹上麻烦。抓到你了！”莉芙一边说，一边用竖琴弹奏出一个音符。你感觉到周围的空气变得异常重型，这种重型感让你不得不深吸一口气，结果却只是打了一个长长的哈欠。对于那些已经虚弱不堪的反派们来说，这种效果更为明显，你看到他们两个都在原地摇摇晃晃，试图抵抗这种强烈的催眠力量。短短片刻之后，两人便相拥而倒，被那位吟游诗人悦耳的弹奏声催入了梦乡。等他们睡着后，莉维娅鞠了一躬说道：“他们今天剩下的时间都不会醒来了！我们有足够的时间来清理这里，修复他们造成的破坏。嗯，”你说道，然后转身离开，“我们走吧。

rows.original:
You tighten your hand around your weapon. "Traitors and demons only deserve one fate." 
    
    Livrea grimaces. "Seriously..."
    
    "Hold on," Varena says. "I don't know about this demon, but we don't just kill citizens of the kingdom on a whim. Radmus has to stand trial."
    
    Caedlan whimpers. "W-wait, no, hold on. Think about all the power that'll be lost. I could-"
    
    You cut him off with a single strike. Varena quickly cracks Radmus over the head with her staff, hard enough to knock the old bull straight out before he can process what's happened. Both cowgirls look pointedly away from Caedlan. 
    
    "Ech," Livrea says. "Gross. L-let's get out of here."
    
    "Right."
rows.translation:
你紧紧握住手中的武器，说道：“叛徒和恶魔只配有一个下场。”
    
    莉维娅皱了皱眉：“说真的……”
    
    “等等，”瓦蕾娜说道，“这个恶魔的事情我还不确定，但咱们总不能随便就杀害王国的公民吧。拉德穆斯必须接受审判。”
    
    凯德兰哀求道：“等、等等，不要这样，想想会失去多少力量啊……我能够……”
    
    你一拳打断了他。瓦蕾娜迅速用她的法杖敲在拉德穆斯的头上，力道之大，以至于那老家伙还没来得及反应过来，就已经倒下了。两位女牛仔都故意将目光移开，不去看凯德兰。
    
    “呃，”莉维娅说道，“真恶心。我们快离开这里吧。”
    
    “没错。

            |gibberish
        ] to you. There has to be a pattern in here, some thread that the dark sorcerer Caedlan had meant to pull upon to weave whatever ritual he intended in here, but... you lack the skill, or the training, or both to understand it. 
        
        You spend the better part of an hour trying to make some kind of breakthrough, but nothing makes sense. By the time you give up, you have a splitting headache and your vision's swimming.
    ]
rows.translation:
忽略身后那对正在抗议的牛群，你全神贯注地投入到手头的任务中：解读古代埃斯托洛尔留下的神秘符文。你开始有条不紊地将石板上的符文与那些卷轴进行对比，试图找出其中的相似之处和可以参考的线索。 
    
    [var0
        |这需要一些时间，但最终你会发现：那些古老的符文之中隐藏着某种规律，某种美丽的诗意。那些象征大地元素、蕴含着塑造与束缚之力的符文，以及那些与繁衍相关的符文……其中还隐藏着更深刻的意义。有些符文，是在诉说着关于控制的力量…….. 控制权？
        
        就是这样。
        
        这是一种召唤咒语，它的作用是将大地元素之灵召唤到准备好的容器中，从而让召唤者能够像操纵木偶一样控制这些灵体。 
        
        你回头瞥了瞥那位公主。其实并不需要什么高智商就能猜到，为什么贾瓦里现在要把目标对准瓦蕾娜，为什么他要暗中监视她——他的目的就是控制她，至少利用她来实现那个邪教的计划。他把她许配给自己的儿子，这样既能提升自己的地位，又能确保自己有众多的继承人。 
        
        [varena.fucked
            |混蛋。
            |他手段冷酷无情，但考虑到当时王国的混乱局势，他或许真的能够逃脱惩罚。
        ]
        
        [var1|由于瓦蕾娜被排除在王室事务之外，她的父亲可能永远都不会察觉到这个问题，直到为时已晚。那时，他们之间的距离已经变得太大了，无法再挽回。]
        
        你相当确信自己能够修改这个法术，让它变成对自己有用的东西——至少不需要牺牲瓦蕾娜。但这会非常困难，而且还需要与一个至今仍未屈服的灵魂进行一场意志的较量。
        |尽管你投入了全部的心思和精力，但结果还是这样。 [silly
            |希腊的
            |胡言乱语
        ] 对你来说，这其中肯定存在某种规律，某种线索——那位暗影巫师凯德兰原本是想利用这些线索来完成他在这里打算进行的仪式的，但是……你缺乏相应的技能，或者没有接受过相应的训练，又或者两者皆缺，因此无法理解这些线索。
        
        你花了差不多一个小时的时间试图找出其中的突破口，但一切都毫无意义。当你最终放弃时，已经头痛欲裂，视线也变得模糊不清了。
    ]
rows.raw:
"
    Disregarding the pair of protesting bovines behind you, you set your mind to the task at hand: deciphering the eldritch sigils of ancient Estelore. You begin methodically comparing sections of rune-script on the tablet to the scrolls, trying to find parallels and points of comparison. 
    
    [var0
        |It takes time, but then you see it: a pattern, a beautiful poetry hidden in the ancient runes. Sigils of elemental earth, primordial power of shaping and binding, and proliferation. There's something deeper, too. Runes that speak of control, of... possession?
        
        That's it. 
        
        This is a summoning spell, meant to call forth a spirit of elemental earthen bounty into a prepared vessel. To take control of them like a puppet on the summoner's strings. 
        
        You glance over your shoulder at the princess. It doesn't take a genius to guess why Iavari was targeting Varena now, why he was spying on her. He meant to take control of her. Use her for the cult's plans at least. Give her to his son to elevate himself, and be assured of many heirs. 
        
        [varena.fucked
            |Bastard.
            |Ruthless, but given the chaos in the kingdom, he might have gotten away with it.
        ]
        
        [var1|And with Varena cut out from royal affairs, her father may never have noticed until it was far too late. There'd have been too much separation between the two.]
        
        You're fairly sure you could adapt the spell, turn it into something useful to you now. Something that doesn't require you to sacrifice Varena, anyway. But it will be difficult, and require a great test of wills against a spirit thus far unbowed.
        |Despite putting every ounce of brainpower you have into it, this is all [silly
            |greek
            |gibberish
        ] to you. There has to be a pattern in here, some thread that the dark sorcerer Caedlan had meant to pull upon to weave whatever ritual he intended in here, but... you lack the skill, or the training, or both to understand it. 
        
        You spend the better part of an hour trying to make some kind of breakthrough, but nothing makes sense. By the time you give up, you have a splitting headache and your vision's swimming.
    ]
    "

rows.original: Pit your will against a primal spirit's and attempt to bind it into your service.
rows.translation: 用你的意志与那股原始的力量抗争，试图将其束缚在你的控制之下。
rows.raw: "Pit your will against a primal spirit's and attempt to bind it into your service."

rows.original: You clap your hands together and take a deep breath, preparing yourself to cast this ancient conjuration. "[pc.name]..." Varena says, taking a few steps back. You ignore the cows and set yourself to incanting the spell, weaving together primordial words of power drawn forth from runes etched down in an age long forgotten. Your hands move instinctively, retracing arcane sigils in the air, weaving bindings and wardings while your voice conjures up this ancient spirit of the earth. There's no better place for it, you realize: you're about as far underground as one can get in the city under the mountains, deeper beneath the stone than anywhere else in the Marches. This is where the spirit lives. This is where the spirit is at its strongest. The ambient aether around you reverberates with the incantation. The veil between worlds weakens bit by bit, magic coalescing around your hands and bending to your will. Something pushes against the edge of your senses, a mounting pressure against the straining fabric of reality. The runes branding the walls and ceiling all around you throb, imprinting themselves in your mind, searing at your vision like hot irons. "[pc.n]-[pc.name]..." Varena clutches her staff tight to her chest. "Something's coming." You can feel it! The pressure mounts against the veil of reality; energy bleeds into the chamber, igniting the runes in primal green flame. Here it comes! You thrust out your hands and forcefully invoke the words of binding, drawing the spirit directly into the trap of wards and seals you've laid out for it. [var0 |And it works. The spirit fights you, straining against the binding, but once it has its foot in the door you are able to drag it the rest of the way through the weakened membrane between the material and the aetheric, and force it to manifest into corporeal shape. Shadow and fire coalesce in the middle of the rune-circle, taking a humanoid form. When the smoke clears, you're left facing a venusian female figure, resplendent in her naked, motherly figure. Caramel skin covers vast, freckled breasts and childbearing hips, and a belly that could almost pass for newly pregnant if it wasn't so soft. Earthy green hair spills loosely down her body all the way to her waist, interwoven with a bouquet of colorful, sweet-smelling flowers. Sweet, and just a little bit pheromonal. You feel a warmth born not just from her fiery summoning spreading through your body, an unbidden response to being in the presence of a spirit of fertility. Sensing your momentary lapse, the spirit takes a step forward, pushing against the barrier surrounding her... but it holds. A long, fluffy tail behind the figure swishes gently, as though amused. "It has been a very long time since I was drawn into your world so completely," the spirit murmurs, running a hand over a tremendous breast. At the gentlest touch, white milk beads from her teat. "You must be a very talented mage. There are few of you left. Perhaps we could change that?" "What is your name?" you ask it. She gives you a beneficent smile. A pair of horse-like ears flick atop her head. "I am Elosa. Long ago I was worshipped by the people of this land, and in return gave them many healthy, strong children. Marefolk, centaurs, minotaurs... all who share in the blood of the land's working beasts were my beloved. But then seven willful children came, and washed away my memory. Yet here I am again..." "Will you serve me?" "Am I being given a choice?" she says playfully. "I am in a circle of binding, and you are my summoner. Your will is strong, young [pc.mf |man |lady ]; strong enough to manifest me when I had long been asleep. I would willingly give you my blessings, if you would have them. My service? Mm, perhaps, for it has been years beyond counting since I stretched my legs. Or spread them." Elosa gives you a flirtatious wink. "So? What will you do, summoner?" |But the spirit proves stronger. You wrench your hands back, trying to pull the spirit the rest of the way into the bindings, but it thrashes and howls in your mind. Energy once at your command frays and burns, and then a snap of thunder throws you back against the far wall, taking Varena with you. Livrea shrieks in alarm, running to pick you both up — thank the gods Varena makes for a soft landing — but behind her, you can see smoke and fire coalescing into something vaguely humanoid. Oh, no. The darkness looms, fire in its eyes. "Oh, you willful children, who disturb Elosa's slumber... I will lay upon you a punishment fit for beasts of burden." What does that- The shadows raise a hand, and the world goes red-hot. ]
rows.translation: 你双手合十，深吸一口气，准备施展这个古老的咒语。[pc.name]……”瓦蕾娜说着，向后退了几步。你没有理会那些牛，开始吟诵咒语，将那些源自远古符文的原始力量词汇组合在一起。你的双手本能地移动着，在空气中描绘出神秘的符号，编织出各种束缚与防护法术，而你的声音则唤醒了这片大地的古老精灵。你明白，没有比这里更合适的地方了：你此刻所处的位置，已经是这座城市在山腹下的最深处了，比边境地区的任何地方都要埋得更深，更加远离地表的岩石层。这就是灵魂居住的地方。 在这里，灵力最为强大。你周围的环境中的以太正在回荡着那些咒语。连接各个世界的屏障正在逐渐减弱，魔法力量在你手中汇聚，听从你的意志而行动。某个东西这种体验不断冲击着你的感官极限，一种越来越强的压力不断挤压着现实的边界。你周围墙壁和天花板上那些刻着的符文正在跳动着，它们深深地烙印在你的脑海中，如同灼热的烙铁般刺痛着你的视线。[pc.n]-[pc.name]……瓦蕾娜将法杖紧紧抱在胸前，说道：‘有什么东西正在靠近。’”你能感觉到！那种压力正在逐渐突破现实的屏障；能量不断涌入这个空间，使得那些符文开始释放出原始的绿色火焰。它来了！你伸出双手，用力念出那些束缚的咒语，将那个灵魂直接引诱进你精心布置的结界与封印之中。 [var0 |而且这种方法确实有效。那个灵魂会与你抗争，试图挣脱束缚，但一旦它突破了那层薄薄的屏障，你就能将它完全拉过那层介于物质与以太之间的薄弱界面，迫使其显现出具体的形态。在符文圈的中心，阴影与火焰交织在一起，最终形成一个人类的形象。 当烟雾散去后，你面前出现了一个维纳斯般的女性形象——她那裸露的身体散发着母性之美。焦糖色的皮肤覆盖着她那布满雀斑的丰盈胸部和适合生育的臀部，而她的腹部若不是如此柔软，简直会让人误以为她刚刚怀孕。淡绿色的长发松散地垂落在她的身上，一直延伸到腰部，其中还交织着一束色彩缤纷、香气扑鼻的花朵。 甜美，还带着一丝信息素的气息。你感受到一种温暖，这种温暖并非仅仅源于她那炽热的召唤力在你体内扩散，而是你在一位象征生育与繁衍的灵体面前所产生的一种不由自主的反应。察觉到你的这种短暂失态，这位灵体向前迈出了一步，试图突破围绕她的屏障……但屏障依然坚不可摧。她身后那条长长的、毛茸茸的尾巴轻轻摆动着，仿佛对此感到十分有趣。 我已经很久没有如此完全地融入你的世界了，”那个灵魂轻声说道，同时用手抚摸着自己那硕大的胸脯。只要轻轻一触，她的乳头上就会冒出白色的乳汁。“你一定是一位非常有天赋的法师吧。像你这样的法师已经所剩无几了。或许，我们可以改变这一现状呢？ 你叫什么名字？”你问道。她向你露出了一个亲切的微笑。她头顶上那对马一般的耳朵轻轻摆动着。“我叫埃洛莎。很久以前，这片土地上的人们崇拜我，作为回报，我为他们带来了许多健康、强壮的孩子——马人、半人马、牛头人……所有那些拥有这片土地上的生物血脉的人，都是我钟爱的孩子。但是后来，有七个淘气的孩子出现了，他们抹去了我的记忆。然而，现在我又在这里了…… 你愿意为我效劳吗？”“难道我还有选择的余地吗？”她调皮地问道，“我已经被束缚在这个圈子里了，而你才是召唤我的人。你的意志如此坚定，年轻的 [pc.mf |男人 |女士 ]那力量强大到足以在我沉睡多年之后仍将我显现出来。如果你愿意接受，我愿意将我的祝福赐予你。至于我的服务吗？嗯，或许吧……毕竟，自从我最后一次活动以来，已经过去了无数年啊。埃洛萨调皮地朝你眨了眨眼：“那么，召唤师，你打算怎么做呢？ |但是，这种精神却更加坚定了。你用力将双手抽了回来，试图拉动这种精神力量试图融入你的意识，但却在你脑海中不断挣扎、咆哮。曾经可以随心操控的能量如今变得脆弱而灼热，而一声惊雷将你猛地撞向远处的墙壁，瓦蕾娜也因此被卷了进去。莉维娅惊恐地尖叫着，跑过来把你们俩扶起来——谢天谢地，瓦雷纳让你们安全着陆了——但在她身后，你可以看到烟雾和火焰正在汇聚成某种看起来有点像人类的东西。哦，不。 黑暗逼近，它的眼中燃烧着火焰。“哦，这些顽皮的孩子，扰乱了埃洛萨的沉睡……我会让你们受到连牲畜都应受的惩罚。”那是什么意思——阴影伸出了手，整个世界瞬间变得炽热如火。 ]

rows.original: Discharge the spirit to receive a tremendous blessing of fertility.
rows.translation: 释放这种精神，就能获得丰饶的巨大恩赐。
rows.raw: "Discharge the spirit to receive a tremendous blessing of fertility."

rows.original: Bind Elosa to your service, so long as you should live, making her available as your summon.
rows.translation: 将埃洛萨束缚在你的麾下，只要你活着，她就能随时被你召唤出来使用。
rows.raw: "Bind Elosa to your service, so long as you should live, making her available as your summon."

rows.original: You move your arms, evoking another series of metaphysical bindings. "I need your services from here on out," you tell her. "Oh, quite the dominant one, are you?" Elosa giggles. Her equine tail flicks from side to side, even as etheric chains are imprinting upon her spirit. Her being. You feel no resistance now. Elosa just smiles and lets you work, closing her eyes as the binding magic weaves around her with occult finality. "So let it be," she says, bowing her head. "I shall see to your needs, my summoner, whenever you should wish to call upon me. Until then, be strong..." You sever the summoning, drawing the spirit out of the circle and into the aether around yourself. She vanishes in a cloud of green smoke. "I can't believe that worked," Varena says. "That was incredibly stupid to try, but it paid off this time. You're a better mage than I am..." High praise from a prodigy. You can tell there's a tiny part of Varena that hates to admit it, too. You [varena.fucked|give her a kiss|give her a wink] and gather up your ritual components. Might need these to summon Elosa later.
rows.translation: 你活动着手臂，引发了一系列新的形而上的束缚。“从现在起，我需要你的帮助，”你对她说。 “哦，原来你是个这么强势的人啊？”埃洛萨轻笑着。她的马尾在身侧来回摆动，而那些以太锁链也正在她的灵魂上留下印记。存在你现在感觉没有任何阻力。埃洛萨只是微笑着，让你继续行动，她闭上了眼睛，而那束缚她的魔法正以一种神秘而坚定的方式在她身上缠绕。“那就这样吧，”她说着低下了头，“无论何时你需要我的帮助，我的召唤者，我都会随时出现在你身边。在那之前，一定要坚强……”你切断了召唤仪式，将那个灵魂从法阵中牵引出来，让它进入你周围的以太空间。她化作一团绿色的烟雾，消失在了空气中。“真不敢相信这种方法真的有效，”瓦蕾娜说道。那样做确实蠢极了，但这次却成功了。你比我这个法师还要厉害……”一个天才给出的高度评价。可以看出，瓦蕾娜内心也有那么一丝不愿意承认这一点。你也是吧 [varena.fucked|亲她一下|对她使了个眼色] 然后收集好进行仪式所需的物品。之后召唤埃洛萨时，这些物品可能会派上用场。

rows.original: "I will accept your blessing, and then release you," you tell it. Elosa smiles softly, approaching the barrier's edge. The scent of her becomes a haze that makes your vision swim, and your heart pound in your chest. "My thanks in double, summoner. Kneel, if you please. Your companions too." "I am a princess," Varena says. "I knee for no one." Livrea seemingly has no such compunction, and bows down before the spirit. "I've heard of you, if only in passing, my lady. Did you leave the bath house together?" "What are you talking about?" the bard says, frowning. "I haven't seen her since the party." She... what? "Livrea, don't you remember? The Iavari investigation?" "Nope! No idea what you're talking about," she says with a shrug and an easygoing smile. "Iavari... that's the guy that designed the new bath house. Y'know, I did hear Varena and the Iavari heir, Ramien, were seen together at the palace recently. What a scandal that would be, if those two ended up together..." A scandal? Did she forget... She forgot. Something made her forget. What the hell happened to Varena... What have you done?

rows.original: "So where do we go from here?" you say. "I've been thinking about that. About what Iavari said, too..." Varena gives you a confident little smirk. "I think we can safely say where the demons are based out of now." "One of the waterheads," you nod. "It would explain how the demons have kept bypassing the blockade. We already learned the demons were coming in through the waterways before..." Varena nods. "Just what I was thinking! Ever since the order to evacuate the outer kingdom came down, the lakes and aqueducts the city gets its water from... they've basically been left abandoned. They don't need people to watch them — water just sort of flows as it flows — but we used to have forts on some of the places where the water flows into Undermountain. I went and looked at some maps in the palace archives while I was on my way back, and if I'm not mistaken, there's a waterway fortress connected right to one of the aqueducts that feeds into the same part of the city as the bath house. One of the places it draws its water from." "Fortress?" you echo. "Well, yeah," Varena says. "It's a couple hundred years old, but a fort's a fort! If it hadn't been for the retreat, it would be protecting a way into the Undermountain. But now, it looks like it's in the enemy's hands. And they took it without a fight. I don't think we'll be that lucky, though." Well, what the hell are you supposed to do against a whole fortress? You can't exactly knock on the doors, and there could be hundreds of cultists and demons up there. "Wait," you say. "How big is this waterway?" Varena shrugs. "I don't know, it's really old! But it leads into one of the city's aqueducts, like I said. Those are pretty big." "Big enough to walk through?" "Oh no." You grin. "If we want to get into this fortress..." "Even if Daddy believes us, there's no way we can march a legion through an aqueduct. It might be big enough for one or two men to walk through abreast but that'd be too slow to push an attack!" "Who said anything about a legion?" Varena stares at you a second, then puts her head in her hands. "You're insane." It's an option, though. It'll be fraught with peril, since it would only be your party going up against a whole fortress full of demons, alone in the mountains far from help, but it would be a surprise they clearly don't expect. Like she said, mounting a full-scale assault through the waterway would be impossible, but a small group... it might have a chance. You lay out a plan over a few minutes, until Varena's incredulity starts to turn into excitement. "This... could work, you're right. If they're distracted somehow, we could slip in. Just a small team." "Small teams are my specialty," you say. "That'll be enough to stop them spawning imps by the thousand." Varena nods. "Maybe. But I might have a backup plan. Give me a bit to think on it, okay? And let's get our gear together. It'll be a fight like no other." She can say that again.
rows.translation: 那么，我们接下来该怎么做呢？”你问道。“我一直在思考这个问题。也一直在思考贾瓦里说过的话……”瓦拉娜自信地微微一笑，“我想，现在我们已经可以确定恶魔的据点了。其中一个水源地，”你点了点头，“这就能解释为什么那些恶魔一直能够绕过封锁线了。我们之前就已经知道，那些恶魔是通过水路进入这里的……”瓦蕾娜也点了点头：“正是我在想这个！自从下达了撤离外境王国的命令之后，这座城市所依赖的湖泊以及引水渠道基本上就被废弃了。这些地方其实并不需要有人看守——水本来就会自然流动——不过在过去，我们在一些水流进入山腹深域的地方设有堡垒。在回程的路上，我去宫殿的档案室查看了一些地图。如果我没记错的话，有一座水路要塞直接与那条通往城市同一区域的引水渠相连，而那座浴场也正是位于该区域。这是它获取水源的地方之一。堡垒？”你问道。“嗯，没错，”瓦蕾娜回答，“虽然已经有几百年历史了，但堡垒就是堡垒！要不是发生了那次撤退，现在它应该还在那里。保护这是通往山腹深域的通道。但现在看来，它已经落入了敌人手中，而且他们是在没有发生战斗的情况下夺取了它。不过，我觉得我们不会那么幸运的。那么，面对整个要塞，你到底该怎么办呢？你总不能去敲门吧，而且那里可能藏着成百上千的邪教徒和恶魔。“等等，”你会想，“这条水道到底有多长呢？ 瓦蕾娜耸了耸肩：“我不知道，那东西真的太古老了！但就像我说的，它通向城市的一条引水渠，那些引水渠规模相当大。”“大到足以让人从里面穿过吗？”“哦，不可能。”你笑了：“如果我们想进入这座堡垒的话……”“就算爸爸相信我们，我们也绝不可能让一支军团通过引水渠进去。也许一两个人并排走过去还勉强可行，但那样的速度根本无法发起有效的进攻！ 谁说过要动用一支军团啊？”瓦蕾娜盯着你看了一会儿，然后双手抱头说道：“你简直疯了。”不过，这确实是一个可行的方案。虽然这个行动会充满危险——因为你们的小队将独自在远离援军的山区，面对整座充满恶魔的堡垒——但这个出乎他们意料的行动确实有可能取得成功。正如她所说，通过水路发动大规模进攻是不可能的，但一个小队……或许还有机会。 你在几分钟内制定了一个计划，直到瓦蕾娜的怀疑开始转变为兴奋。“这个……确实可行，你说得对。如果能够以某种方式分散他们的注意力，我们就可以趁机行动。只需要一小支队伍就可以了。”“小队作战正是我的强项，”你说，“这样肯定足以阻止他们大量制造小兵。 瓦蕾娜点了点头。“也许吧。但我应该还有备用计划。给我一些时间来考虑，好吗？另外，我们得把装备都准备好。这次战斗将会是非同寻常的。” 她这话真是一点不假。

rows.original:
In the deepest recesses of the old fort is a circular chamber that, once, provided the fort with clear drinking water from the mountain river. There are still buckets and ropes hanging from the ceiling, and a set of circular grates into the floor can be opened and close like rosepetals. 
    
	[flags.WHFORT_PITS_DESTROYED
        |Though the demonic breeding pit has been silenced, there's still a tepid flow of residual seed spilling from the wound in the wall above you into the sluice.
        |Now, though, the room's purpose has been perverted to the demons' cause. One of the walls above you and to the west has been knocked out, and from that jagged wound in the stone flows an absolute ocean of semen and milk. You can just make out the forms of imps buzzing around up there, blithely unaware of you as they go about the nightmarish task of increasing their own numbers — with each other, and with countless slaves to the demon cult.
    ]
    	
	There's a winding set of narrow stairs up the north wall, into the fortress's keep.
rows.translation:
在那座古老堡垒的最深处，有一个圆形的房间。曾经，这个房间通过连接山间河流的管道，为整个堡垒提供了清澈的饮用水。至今，天花板上仍然挂着水桶和绳子，而地板上的一组圆形栅栏也可以像玫瑰花瓣一样被打开或关闭。 
    
	[flags.WHFORT_PITS_DESTROYED
        |虽然那个恶魔培育坑已经停止了活动，但墙上那个裂口仍在不断地有少量残留种子渗出，流入下面的沟渠中。
        |然而，如今这个房间的用途已经被恶魔们利用来达成他们的目的。你头顶上方的西侧墙壁被敲开了，从那道裂开的缝隙中不断涌出大量的精液和乳汁。你可以隐约看到一些小恶魔在上面忙碌着，它们完全没注意到你的存在，正在孜孜不倦地完成着增加自身数量的“任务”——它们彼此交配，同时也与无数隶属于恶魔教派的奴隶们发生关系。
    ]
    	
	在北墙处有一段蜿蜒狭窄的楼梯，通向堡垒的主堡。

rows.original: You stand on a set of narrow, winding steps connecting the sluice below to the back of the fort's inner keep. Below, you can see the grates sitting closed over the waterway running through the keep, with buckets and ropes still hanging from the ceiling — though nobody's been using this for fresh water for a long, long time. Instead, [flags.WHFORT_PITS_DESTROYED|there's a tepid stream of run-off from the breeding pits still coming from the hole in the wall.|a sea of semen and milk is pouring from a hole in the wall into the river, alongside a deafening racket of lustful moans and terrorized screaming.]
rows.translation: 你站在一段狭窄而蜿蜒的台阶上，这些台阶将下方的水闸与堡垒内城的后部连接起来。向下望去，可以看到那些覆盖在穿过内城的水道上的栅栏，桶和绳子仍然挂在天花板上——不过，已经很久很久没有人再利用这些设施来获取淡水了。 [flags.WHFORT_PITS_DESTROYED|从那些用于繁殖的坑洞中，仍有少量的水从墙上的洞里流出来。|大量的精液与乳汁从墙上的一个洞中流入河流，与此同时，此起彼伏的淫荡呻吟声与惊恐的尖叫声也充斥着空气。]

Instead, [flags.WHFORT_PITS_DESTROYED|there's a tepid stream of run-off from the breeding pits still coming from the hole in the wall.|a sea of semen and milk is pouring from a hole in the wall into the river, alongside a deafening racket of lustful moans and terrorized screaming.]\n\t"

rows.original: The side-chamber in front of you was probably a more comprehensive armory once, housing greatspears and hammers for the garrison, as well as their battle armor... but those things left with the soldiers a generation ago, and the demons have been keen to repurpose the room as a storage for sex toys, oil, and ruined undergarments. There's a pervasive reek to the place that suggests very little of this has been cleaned before it was tossed inside the myriad chests lining the walls. [var0|It looks like there's a cabinet that's been forced open, but not entirely emptied out yet. There's a few potions still sitting there, ripe for the taking.|The potion cabinet has been completely emptied out now.]
rows.translation: 你面前的这个小房间，曾经很可能是一个设施齐全的军械库，里面存放着驻军使用的长矛、锤子，以及他们的战斗盔甲……但这些物品早在上一代士兵离开后就被带走了，而那些恶魔则把这个房间改成了储存性玩具、润滑油和破旧内衣的地方。房间里弥漫着一股难闻的气味，显然这些东西在被塞进墙边那些众多的箱子里之前，根本没人清洗过。 [var0|看起来有一个柜子被强行打开了，但里面的东西还没有被完全拿走。还有几瓶药水放在那里呢。唾手可得。|药水柜现在已经被彻底清空了。]

There's a pervasive reek to the place that suggests very little of this has been cleaned before it was tossed inside the myriad chests lining the walls. [var0|It looks like there's a cabinet that's been forced open, but not entirely emptied out yet. There's a few potions still sitting there, ripe for the taking.|The potion cabinet has been completely emptied out now.] "

rows.translation: 在橱柜里寻找各种好东西吧。

rows.original:
You take a moment to rifle through the potion cabinet.
    	
	[party.has calise
        |"The soldiers stationed here must have been fortunate indeed," Calise observes as you pull out a vial of Steadfast Tonic. "Even my unit's had trouble getting alchemical supplies now, and they just left them behind like it was nothing."
    ]
    	
	[party.has varena
        |"Hopefully those haven't gone rotten," Varena says, curling her nose a little as you pull out a vial of Steadfast Tonic. "They've been here for... gods know how long."
        	
        	"Probably fine," you shrug. "Alchemical stuff you find in dungeons usually is."
        	
        	"I'll take your word for it."
        	
		[party.has viv
            |"No, no, [pc.name] is right. Most potions have an obscenely long shelf life when stored in lower light conditions. As it turns out, sunlight is a major catalyst and is responsible for breaking down some of the key parts of a lot of potions."
        ]
    ]
	
	You pocket three vials of the stuff. There's also three more vials of something altogether different, and — at least you assume — a more recent addition, helpfully labeled 'Virility Booster!' Maybe even imps run out of steam eventually?

	[party.has cait|"No," Cait says. "No no no no, you storage fiend. No way."

rows.original:
You're standing before a huge oakwood door, solid and reliable, still standing after years and years of neglect. Once it would have been a final defense against an attack, ready to be barred and held by the men inside; now it has a set of ropes tied around it, making it all too easy to open from either side.

	To the south is the heart of the keep, the gathering place of the garrison in ages past. Timeworn Minoan banners hang limply from the far wall.
rows.translation:
你站在一扇巨大的橡木门前，这扇门坚固而可靠，即便经历了多年的无人照料，依然屹立不倒。曾经，它曾是抵御攻击的最后一道防线，里面的人们会用门闩将其锁紧；如今，门上却系着几根绳子，使得从任何一侧都可以轻松将其打开。

	向南走去，就能来到这座堡垒的核心区域——在过去的岁月里，这里一直是驻军们聚集的地方。那些历经岁月沧桑的米诺斯旗帜，无力地悬挂在远处的墙上。
rows.raw:
"
	You're standing before a huge oakwood door, solid and reliable, still standing after years and years of neglect. Once it would have been a final defense against an attack, ready to be barred and held by the men inside; now it has a set of ropes tied around it, making it all too easy to open from either side.

	To the south is the heart of the keep, the gathering place of the garrison in ages past. Timeworn Minoan banners hang limply from the far wall.
	"

rows.original: This is the heart of the fort's little keep, a large square chamber with trestle tables sized for minotaurs and weapon racks against the walls. The fort was never the seat of power to a high house or powerful lord, just a garrison for soldiers protecting the kingdom; there's no throne here, or great artistry upon the walls, only a pair of age-tattered Minoan banners hanging from the back walls. Beneath one is a small archway, leading down a narrow flight of stairs. Other doors lead left and right, and to the north stand a massive pair of oaken doors leading out into the courtyard. A huge wooden bar is sat beside it, ready to be employed as a last resort to protect the inner sanctum. [var0 |Varena points north, towards the massive doors. "That's got to lead outside. Let's go that way first, so we can throw Juno's stone." ]
rows.translation: 这是堡垒内小型防御工事的核心区域，一间面积较大的方形房间，房间内摆放着专为弥诺陶洛斯设计的折叠桌，墙壁上还装有武器架。这座堡垒从未成为任何贵族或权势人物的权力中心，它仅仅是一支用于保卫王国的驻军驻地；这里没有王座，墙壁上也没有任何精美的艺术品，只有两面年代久远的米诺斯旗帜悬挂在后面的墙上。在下方有一个小拱门，通向一段狭窄的楼梯。其他几扇门分别通向左右两侧，而朝北方向则有一对巨大的橡木门，通向庭院。门旁还放着一根粗大的木棍，在必要时可以用来作为最后一道防线，保护这个内室的安全。 [var0 |瓦蕾娜朝北方指去，朝着那扇巨大的门。“那肯定通向外面。我们先往那边走吧。这样我们就可以抛出朱诺之石了。 ]

Let's go that way first, so we can throw Juno's stone." ] "

rows.original:
This room stands between the [flags.WHFORT_PITS_DESTROYED|destroyed breeding pits|cacaphonous horror of the demonic breeding pits] and the rest of the keep, a final barrier between the cold mountain air and the depravity within. [flags.WHFORT_PITS_DESTROYED|The surviving imps have run as fast as they can, leaving those comrades too exhausted to fly behind face-down in the muck.|Dozens of imps are sprawled out on the ground here, breathing hard, eyes glazed over with fatigue. There's a thick white ooze on the floor, a mere taste of what's to come inside, and the exhausted creatures have no compunction against just lying in the filth. The imps barely register your presence; they're so completely drained of energy by their experiences within that they seem downright catatonic.

	To the south are the breeding pits. Back east is the great hall.
	
	[party.has varena|Varena grimaces. "I almost feel sorry for them..."]]
rows.translation:
这个房间位于……与[flags.WHFORT_PITS_DESTROYED|被摧毁的繁殖基地|那些充满恶魔气息的繁殖坑所散发出的刺耳恐怖气息]之间。以及城堡的其余部分——这些最终屏障将寒冷的山间空气与内部的腐朽气息分隔开来。 [flags.WHFORT_PITS_DESTROYED|那些幸存的小妖精们已经拼命地逃跑了，而那些因过于疲惫而无法飞行的同伴们，则面朝下陷在泥泞中。|这里地上躺着数十只小妖精，它们呼吸急促，双眼因疲惫而变得无神。地板上沾满了厚厚的白色黏液，这只是即将发生的事情的预兆罢了。这些精疲力竭的生物根本无暇顾及这些污秽，只是瘫软在地。它们几乎完全没有注意到你的存在——那些经历让它们彻底耗尽了能量，简直就像失去了行动能力一样。

	向南是繁殖坑，而再往东则是那座宏伟的大厅。
	
	[party.has varena|瓦蕾娜撇了撇嘴：“我差点就为他们感到同情了……]]

    This room stands between the [flags.WHFORT_PITS_DESTROYED|destroyed breeding pits|cacaphonous horror of the demonic breeding pits] and the rest of the keep, a final barrier between the cold mountain air and the depravity within. [flags.WHFORT_PITS_DESTROYED|The surviving imps have run as fast as they can, leaving those comrades too exhausted to fly behind face-down in the muck.|Dozens of imps are sprawled out on the ground here, breathing hard, eyes glazed over with fatigue. The imps barely register your presence; they're so completely drained of energy by their experiences within that they seem downright catatonic.

    "

rows.original:
This was the heart of the demonic breeding program: the fort's main barracks, with all its inner walls smashed in and turned into a single charnel pit of writhing flesh and unholy births. Restraining racks line the walls where the broodmothers had been secured, and channels are chiseled into the floor, collecting the slop of semen, milk, and afterbirth and funneling it into the water supply of the city. 
	
	The reek of sex and breed is overpowering in here, almost sickening, and it has nowhere to go without windows or vents, just building up until it becomes a miasma that's impossible to escape. Your gaze keeps cutting towards the north door, the only way to walk out of here.
rows.translation:
这就是那个恶魔繁殖计划的核心所在：堡垒的主营房，其内墙全部被毁，变成了一个充满蠕动着的肉体与不洁产物的地狱。墙壁上排列着用于束缚那些母体的支架，地面上也开凿出了沟渠，用来收集那些精液、乳汁以及胎衣等分泌物，然后将它们输送到城市的供水系统中。 
	
	这里弥漫着浓重的性欲与繁殖的气息，几乎令人作呕。由于没有窗户或通风口，这些气味无处可散，只能不断堆积，最终形成一股让人无法逃脱的恶臭。你的目光不断投向北门——那是离开这里的唯一出路。
rows.raw:
"
	This was the heart of the demonic breeding program: the fort's main barracks, with all its inner walls smashed in and turned into a single charnel pit of writhing flesh and unholy births. Restraining racks line the walls where the broodmothers had been secured, and channels are chiseled into the floor, collecting the slop of semen, milk, and afterbirth and funneling it into the water supply of the city. 
	
	The reek of sex and breed is overpowering in here, almost sickening, and it has nowhere to go without windows or vents, just building up until it becomes a miasma that's impossible to escape. Your gaze keeps cutting towards the north door, the only way to walk out of here.
	"

rows.original:
To the south, halfway buried in the side of the mountain, is the mighty war-fortress's keep. It stands tall and foreboding in its disrepair, crumbling under the weight of ages. 

	North stretches out the fortress's yard. In the middle is once-proud statue of a female Minoan soldier, axe held high, though it's been defaced: hundreds upon hundreds of used condoms are piled up around the soldier's feet, draped off her armor, tied around her horns, and piled into her cleavage so that their contents leak across her marble flesh. Between her legs, the river flows from the east and curves around into the keep itself.
	
	A pair of towers are opposite the keep, though one of them has completely collapsed; the westernmost tower stands even now, and you can see a buzz of activity at its peak. To the west is the fortress's gate, [party.has varena|standing starkly closed|battered open by your troops].
rows.translation:
在南方，半掩在山体之中，矗立着那座巍峨的战争要塞的主楼。它高耸而阴森，因年久失修而逐渐倾颓。

	向北延伸的是要塞的庭院。庭院中央曾矗立着一座威武的米诺斯女性士兵雕像，她高举着斧头，但如今雕像已被破坏：成百上千个用过的避孕套被堆放在她的足部下，缠绕在她的盔甲上，系在她的角上，甚至塞进了她的胸腔，导致其中的液体渗漏到她那大理石般的肌肤上。在她的双腿之间，河流从东方流淌过来，然后蜿蜒着绕进了那座堡垒。
	
	在堡垒的对面有一对塔楼，不过其中有一座已经完全倒塌了；最西边的那座塔楼至今仍然矗立着，你可以看到那里有忙碌的活动正在进行。西边是堡垒的入口。 [party.has varena|紧闭着，纹丝不动|被你们的军队强行打开].
rows.raw:
"
	To the south, halfway buried in the side of the mountain, is the mighty war-fortress's keep. It stands tall and foreboding in its disrepair, crumbling under the weight of ages. 

	North stretches out the fortress's yard. In the middle is once-proud statue of a female Minoan soldier, axe held high, though it's been defaced: hundreds upon hundreds of used condoms are piled up around the soldier's feet, draped off her armor, tied around her horns, and piled into her cleavage so that their contents leak across her marble flesh. Between her legs, the river flows from the east and curves around into the keep itself.
	
	A pair of towers are opposite the keep, though one of them has completely collapsed; the westernmost tower stands even now, and you can see a buzz of activity at its peak. To the west is the fortress's gate, [party.has varena|standing starkly closed|battered open by your troops]. 
	"

rows.original:
You're standing at the southernmost point in the fortress's courtyard. To your direct south stands the keep, an ancient structure buried halfway into the mountainside. A set of stone stairs lead up from the gravelstone yard to the huge oaken doors of the inner keep; a cut straight through the middle of them allows the river to flow through the keep and into the mountain below.

	The yard stretches east from here towards the gates, or west towards the back of the fort.
rows.translation:
你此刻站在堡垒庭院的最南端。正南方矗立着那座古老的堡垒，它的主体部分半埋在山体之中。一条石阶从碎石铺就的庭院通向内堡那扇巨大的橡木大门；大门中间被开了一条通道，使得河水能够流经堡垒，最终汇入山下的河流中。

	庭院从这里向东延伸，通向大门；或者向西延伸，通往堡垒的后部。
rows.raw: "You're standing at the southernmost point in the fortress's courtyard. To your direct south stands the keep, an ancient structure buried halfway into the mountainside. A set of stone stairs lead up from the gravelstone yard to the huge oaken doors of the inner keep; a cut straight through the middle of them allows the river to flow through the keep and into the mountain below.\n\n\tThe yard stretches east from here towards the gates, or west towards the back of the fort."

rows.original:
The waterhead fort stretches out around you, its walls towering and imposing even now. Demons flap about in a panic, fighting [party.has calise|your troops|the frost wyvern pack] in a desperate bid to keep the fort from being overrun. The bulk of them are no threat to you now, too busy in a battle of their own to look down at you.

	The gates are north of you from here, and the fort's keep is to the east.
rows.translation:
水头要塞环绕在你的四周，即便在现在，它的城墙依然高耸入云，令人望而生畏。恶魔惊慌失措地四处飞溅，四处逃窜，互相厮杀着 [party.has calise|你的军队|霜冻飞龙包] 他们正在拼命试图阻止敌人攻占这座堡垒。现在，他们中的大多数人对你来说并不构成威胁——他们自己都忙于战斗，无暇顾及你。

	从这里往北就是大门，而堡垒的主楼则位于东边。

"

Demons flap about in a panic, fighting [party.has calise|your troops|the frost wyvern pack] in a desperate bid to keep the fort from being overrun. The bulk of them are no threat to you now, too busy in a battle of their own to look down at you.

	The gates are north of you from here, and the fort's keep is to the east.
	"

rows.original:
You're standing in the shadow of the fort's gates. They're massive and sturdy, built to withstand the rigors of a concentrated assault[party.has calise
        | — and you're proud to say you showed the demons that they put far too much faith in it.
        |. You can't imagine how many men it would take to breach them.
    ]
    
	The courtyard sprawls out east from here, with the towers in the north and the keep in the south, pressed against the mountainside. 
    	
	Demons flap about in a panic, fighting [party.has calise
        |your troops
        |the frost wyvern pack
    ] in a desperate bid to keep the fort from being overrun. The bulk of them are no threat to you now, too busy in a battle of their own to look down at you.
rows.translation:
你站在堡垒大门的阴影之下。这些大门庞大而坚固，专为抵御猛烈的攻击而建造。[party.has calise
        | ——而且你还可以自豪地说，你让那些恶魔们意识到，他们其实对它寄予了过高的期望。
        |你根本无法想象，需要多少人才能够攻破它们。
    ]
    
	庭院从这里向东延伸开来，北边是高塔，南边则是紧贴着山体的城堡。  
    	
	恶魔惊慌失措地四处飞扑，互相厮杀着。 [party.has calise
        |你的军队
        |霜冻飞龙包
    ] 为了阻止敌人占领据点，他们做出了最后的努力。现在，他们中的大多数人已经没有能力威胁到你，因为他们都在忙于自己的战斗，无暇顾及你。

The waterhead fort stretches out around you, its walls towering and imposing even now.

	Just ahead of you now is the last standing tower of the fort, a menacing spire of dark stone rising to the heavens. Banners branding with writhing arcane runes flow from the top, ripping in the wind. A cloud of demons swarm around it, protecting the tower ferociously.
	
	Demons flap about in a panic, fighting [party.has calise|your troops|the frost wyvern pack] in a desperate bid to keep the fort from being overrun. The bulk of them are no threat to you now, too busy in a battle of their own to look down at you.
rows.translation:
水头要塞环绕在你的四周，即便如今，它的城墙依然高耸入云，令人望而生畏。

	就在你前方，是这座要塞中唯一还矗立着的塔楼——一座由黑色石头建造的、耸入云霄的恐怖尖塔。塔顶悬挂着印有扭曲的神秘符文的旗帜，在风中剧烈摆动。一群恶魔围绕着这座塔楼，凶猛地守护着它。
	
	恶魔惊慌失措地扑腾着翅膀，激烈地争斗着 [party.has calise|你的军队|霜冻飞龙包] 为了拼命阻止敌人占领据点，他们中的大部分目前并没有对你构成威胁——他们自己都忙于战斗，无暇顾及你。

	"

rows.original:
You stand now in the shadow of a massive watchtower. Corrupted banners stream down its walls, and flocks of demons fly raucously overhead, engaged in battle. The sheer number of them here leaves little doubt that this is a stronghold even within the fort, perhaps the encampment of their commanders. 

	A door is before you, closed but seemingly unbarred and unguarded.
rows.translation:
你现在站在一座巨大的瞭望塔的阴影之下。腐朽的旗帜从塔墙上垂下来，成群的恶魔在头顶上喧闹地飞来飞去，正在进行战斗。这里恶魔的数量之多，让人毫不怀疑这座塔即便是整个堡垒中的要塞，也可能是他们指挥官们的驻地。

	你面前有一扇门，门是关着的，但看起来并没有上锁，也没有人把守。

The waterhead fort stretches out around you, its walls towering and imposing even now.

	Just ahead of you now is a collapsed tower, worn down by the howling wind and bitter cold until it finally gave up the ghost and fall in upon itself. There's no door anymore, even, just a shattered arch... but somebody's gone through the effort of clearing some of the rubble out of the way, allowing access inside.
rows.translation:
那座水头堡垒环绕在你的四周，即便如今，它的城墙依然高耸入云，令人望而生畏。

	就在你前方，有一座已经倒塌的塔楼——狂风与严寒不断地侵蚀着它，最终让它彻底毁坏、倒塌下来。现在那里已经没有门了，只剩下一片碎石……但有人费心地把一些碎石清理开，从而让人能够进入塔内。
rows.raw: "The waterhead fort stretches out around you, its walls towering and imposing even now.\n\n\tJust ahead of you now is a collapsed tower, worn down by the howling wind and bitter cold until it finally gave up the ghost and fall in upon itself. There's no door anymore, even, just a shattered arch... but somebody's gone through the effort of clearing some of the rubble out of the way, allowing access inside."

rows.original:
Somebody put a great deal of effort into clearing out the rubble from inside this tower, hurling it haphazardly outside and making way to access its shattered floors. Ropes and ladders descend through that into the darkness beneath the fort, where chiseled brick gives way to craggy earth.

	[party.has azzy|"Ah, good. Even deeper beneath." Azyrran fidgets and tucks her wings up tightly. "I've come to[azzy.isBimbo|, like,] really dislike climbing into dark places."]
rows.translation:
有人花费了大量精力清理这座塔内部的瓦砾，将这些碎片随意地抛到外面，从而得以进入那些已经损毁的楼层。绳索和梯子从塔内延伸下去，通向堡垒下方的暗影区域——在那里，经过精心雕琢的砖块已经被崎岖的泥土所取代。

	[party.has azzy|啊，太好了。再往下面一点。”阿兹兰坐立不安，把翅膀紧紧地收了起来。“我终于来到了[azzy.isBimbo|就像，比如说……] 我真的很不喜欢进入暗影的地方。]
rows.raw:
'
	Somebody put a great deal of effort into clearing out the rubble from inside this tower, hurling it haphazardly outside and making way to access its shattered floors. Ropes and ladders descend through that into the darkness beneath the fort, where chiseled brick gives way to craggy earth.

	[party.has azzy|"Ah, good. Even deeper beneath." Azyrran fidgets and tucks her wings up tightly. "I've come to[azzy.isBimbo|, like,] really dislike climbing into dark places."]
	'

rows.original:
The waterhead fort stretches out around you, its walls towering and imposing even now. 

	One of the ruined towers is north of you, and to the south is the fort's keep. To the west is a once-proud statue of a female Minoan soldier, axe held high, though it's been defaced: hundreds upon hundreds of used condoms are piled up around the soldier's feet, draped off her armor, tied around her horns, and piled into her cleavage so that their contents leak across her marble flesh. Between her legs, the river flows from the east and curves around into the keep itself in the south, pressed against the mountainside.
	
	Demons flap about in a panic, too busy fighting or fleeing to really notice you. Plenty of them that were stationed this far from anything important are taking the opportunity to bail on the cult, taking wing over the walls and into the mountain valleys below.
rows.translation:
这座水头要塞环绕在你的四周，即便如今，它的城墙依然高耸入云，令人敬畏。

	在你北边有一座已经毁坏的塔楼，而在南边则是要塞的主堡。西边矗立着一座曾经威武庄严的米诺斯女性士兵雕像，她高举着斧头，但如今这座雕像已经被破坏了：成百上千个用过的避孕套被堆放在士兵的足部边，挂在她的盔甲上，系在她的角上，甚至被塞进了她的胸腔里，导致避孕套内的液体渗了出来，浸湿了她那大理石般光滑的肌肤。在那片区域，河流从东边流来，然后向南蜿蜒，紧贴着山体流淌。
	
	那些恶魔惊慌失措地四处乱飞，它们要么忙着战斗，要么忙着逃跑，根本无暇注意到你的存在。有许多原本驻扎在远离重要目标地的恶魔，正趁这个机会抛弃那个邪教组织，飞越城墙，逃往下面的山谷中去了。
rows.raw:
"
	The waterhead fort stretches out around you, its walls towering and imposing even now. 

	One of the ruined towers is north of you, and to the south is the fort's keep. To the west is a once-proud statue of a female Minoan soldier, axe held high, though it's been defaced: hundreds upon hundreds of used condoms are piled up around the soldier's feet, draped off her armor, tied around her horns, and piled into her cleavage so that their contents leak across her marble flesh. Between her legs, the river flows from the east and curves around into the keep itself in the south, pressed against the mountainside.
	
	Demons flap about in a panic, too busy fighting or fleeing to really notice you. Plenty of them that were stationed this far from anything important are taking the opportunity to bail on the cult, taking wing over the walls and into the mountain valleys below. 
	"

rows.original:
The waterhead fort stretches out around you, its walls towering and imposing even now. 

	You're tucked into the furthest corner of the courtyard now, where most of the rubbish from the old garrison has been stacked up out of the way: overturned wagons, tattered tarps, old banners, whatever was left behind in the soldiers' hurry to leave. 
	
	Demons flap about in a panic, too busy fighting or fleeing to really notice you. Plenty of them that were stationed this far from anything important are taking the opportunity to bail on the cult, taking wing over the walls and into the mountain valleys below. 
	
	North from here you can see a pair of towers, the closer of which lies in utter ruin. To the west is the fort's keep, solidly built into the mountainside.
rows.translation:
那座水头堡垒环绕在你的四周，即便如今，它的城墙依然高耸入云，令人望而生畏。

	你现在站在庭院的最角落里，那里堆放着从那座旧驻军营地遗留下来的大部分垃圾：翻倒的马车、破旧的防水布、陈旧的旗帜——所有这些都是在士兵们匆忙撤离时被遗弃的东西。 
	
	恶魔惊慌失措地四处飞窜，它们要么忙着战斗，要么忙着逃跑，根本无暇注意到你的存在。许多那些驻扎在远离重要目标地区的恶魔，都趁这个机会抛弃了那个邪教组织，飞越城墙，逃往下方的山谷之中。 
	
	从这里向北望去，可以看到两座塔楼，其中较近的那座已经完全毁坏了。而在西边，则是堡垒的主楼，它坚固地建在山坡上。
rows.raw:
"
	The waterhead fort stretches out around you, its walls towering and imposing even now. 

	You're tucked into the furthest corner of the courtyard now, where most of the rubbish from the old garrison has been stacked up out of the way: overturned wagons, tattered tarps, old banners, whatever was left behind in the soldiers' hurry to leave. 
	
	Demons flap about in a panic, too busy fighting or fleeing to really notice you. Plenty of them that were stationed this far from anything important are taking the opportunity to bail on the cult, taking wing over the walls and into the mountain valleys below. 
	
	North from here you can see a pair of towers, the closer of which lies in utter ruin. To the west is the fort's keep, solidly built into the mountainside."

rows.original: You've clambered down the ladder from the shattered ground floor of the ruined tower and into the dugout undercroft below. This might've started as a small storage area, but the walls were never smoothed out to anything but jagged rock, and now somebody's gone through the effort of tunneling into the mountain to your east.
rows.translation: 你从那座废墟塔楼破碎的底层爬下，进入了下方挖掘出来的地洞。这里最初可能只是个小型储藏空间，但墙壁始终没有被修整得平整，依旧是参差不齐的岩石表面。而现在，有人竟然费心地在你东边的山体中开凿出了隧道。
rows.raw: "\n\tYou've clambered down the ladder from the shattered ground floor of the ruined tower and into the dugout undercroft below. This might've started as a small storage area, but the walls were never smoothed out to anything but jagged rock, and now somebody's gone through the effort of tunneling into the mountain to your east.\n\t"

rows.original:
The waterhead fort stretches out around you, its walls towering and imposing even now. 

	The two towers of the fortress are to your northeast and northwest. To the south is a once-proud statue of a female Minoan soldier, axe held high, though it's been defaced: hundreds upon hundreds of used condoms are piled up around the soldier's feet, draped off her armor, tied around her horns, and piled into her cleavage so that their contents leak across her marble flesh. Between her legs, the river flows from the east and curves around into the keep itself in the south, pressed against the mountainside.
	
	Demons flap about in a panic, fighting [party.has calise|your troops|the frost wyvern pack] in a desperate bid to keep the fort from being overrun. The bulk of them are no threat to you now, too busy in a battle of their own to look down at you.
rows.translation:
这座水头要塞环绕在你的四周，即便如今，它的城墙依然高耸入云，令人望而生畏。

	要塞的两座塔楼分别位于你的东北方和西北方。而在南方，有一座曾经威武庄严的米诺斯女性士兵雕像——她高举着斧头，但如今这座雕像已经被破坏了：成百上千个用过的避孕套被堆放在士兵的足部边，挂在她的盔甲上，系在她的角上，甚至被塞进了她的胸脯里，导致避孕套内的液体渗到了她的大理石雕像上。在那片区域，河流从东边流淌过来，然后向南蜿蜒，紧贴着山体延伸。
	
	恶魔惊慌失措地四处飞扑，互相厮杀着。 [party.has calise|你的军队|霜冻飞龙包] 为了阻止敌人占领据点，他们做出了最后的努力。现在，他们中的大多数人已经没有能力威胁到你，因为他们都在忙于自己的战斗，无暇顾及你。
rows.raw:
"
    The waterhead fort stretches out around you, its walls towering and imposing even now. 

	The two towers of the fortress are to your northeast and northwest. To the south is a once-proud statue of a female Minoan soldier, axe held high, though it's been defaced: hundreds upon hundreds of used condoms are piled up around the soldier's feet, draped off her armor, tied around her horns, and piled into her cleavage so that their contents leak across her marble flesh. Between her legs, the river flows from the east and curves around into the keep itself in the south, pressed against the mountainside.
	
	Demons flap about in a panic, fighting [party.has calise|your troops|the frost wyvern pack] in a desperate bid to keep the fort from being overrun. The bulk of them are no threat to you now, too busy in a battle of their own to look down at you.
    "

rows.original:
The stone is wet with water from the river rushing through the fort, and you're surrounded by a musty, earthy smell emanating from deeper within. A handful of improvised pickaxes and shovels are scattered around. For how crude they are, they seem well cared for; the copper blades practically glisten with polish.

	The man-made tunnel curves here, from west to the tower and then south underneath the fortress.
rows.translation:
这些石头被从堡垒中流过的河水浸湿了，而周围弥漫着一种发霉的、泥土的气息，这种气味似乎来自更深处。地上散落着几把自制的镐和铲子。尽管这些工具非常简陋，但它们似乎被保养得很好，铜制的刀刃甚至闪烁着光泽。

	这条人工挖掘的隧道在这里转向，从西侧延伸到塔楼，然后向南穿过堡垒的下方。
rows.raw:
"
	The stone is wet with water from the river rushing through the fort, and you're surrounded by a musty, earthy smell emanating from deeper within. A handful of improvised pickaxes and shovels are scattered around. For how crude they are, they seem well cared for; the copper blades practically glisten with polish.

	The man-made tunnel curves here, from west to the tower and then south underneath the fortress.
	"

rows.original:
This tunnel is long enough to make you wonder if the demons are trying to mine something down here. Somebody's come along and reinforced the excavation's path with wooden support beams, and even hung up torch sconces — though with no ventilation to speak of, they've been forced to make due with embers that barely give enough light to make your way by.

	The tunnel stretches north, back to the tower, or deeper in to the south.
rows.translation:
这条隧道长得让人不禁怀疑，那些恶魔是不是在试图在这里挖掘什么。有人曾经来过，用木制支撑梁加固了挖掘的道路，甚至还挂上了火把——不过由于完全没有通风设施，他们只能使用那些几乎只能发出微弱光亮的火把来照明。

	这条隧道向北延伸，通向那座塔，或者继续向南延伸，通往更远的地方。
rows.raw:
"
	This tunnel is long enough to make you wonder if the demons are trying to mine something down here. Somebody's come along and reinforced the excavation's path with wooden support beams, and even hung up torch sconces — though with no ventilation to speak of, they've been forced to make due with embers that barely give enough light to make your way by.

	The tunnel stretches north, back to the tower, or deeper in to the south.
	"

rows.original: You're standing in a 3-way branch of the tunnel: north of course leads back towards the tower, and to the west you can see a long, curving tunnel. Somebody's brought actual carpets down there, and you can see the flicker of lantern-light. To the east,
rows.translation: 你现在站在隧道的三岔路口：向北走会回到塔楼那里，而向西则会看到一条长长的、蜿蜒的隧道。显然，是有人把这些东西带过来的地毯在远处，你可以看到灯笼光闪烁的身影。 在东方，
rows.raw: " You're standing in a 3-way branch of the tunnel: north of course leads back towards the tower, and to the west you can see a long, curving tunnel. Somebody's brought actual carpets down there, and you can see the flicker of lantern-light. To the east, "

rows.translation: 那就是那个被击败的恶魔地法师。

rows.original: you can hear the sounds of metal crashing against stone — somebody's down there, mining away.
rows.translation: 你可以听到金属撞击石头的声音——有人在下面进行采矿作业。
rows.raw: "you can hear the sounds of metal crashing against stone — somebody's down there, mining away."

rows.original: You're in a bend in the tunnel here, connecting the mine chamber back east to a softly-lit, surprisingly well-furnished office to the south. A set of curtains made from an old Minoan war-banner separate the carpeted chamber in front of you from the dark, damp tunnels you've traveled through to get here.
rows.translation: 你现在正处于这条隧道的一个转弯处，这条隧道将东侧的矿井与南侧那间灯光柔和、装饰颇为精致的办公室连接起来。一扇由古老的米诺斯战旗制成的窗帘，将你眼前的这个铺着地毯的房间与你之前穿行过的那些阴暗潮湿的隧道分隔开来。
rows.raw: "\n\tYou're in a bend in the tunnel here, connecting the mine chamber back east to a softly-lit, surprisingly well-furnished office to the south. A set of curtains made from an old Minoan war-banner separate the carpeted chamber in front of you from the dark, damp tunnels you've traveled through to get here.\n\t"

rows.original: At the end of the mine tunnel is a small office, separated by curtains made from banners from the rest of the dig site. A thick, if time-worn, carpet is laid out over the smoothed-out floor, and somebody's actually dragged a desk — admittedly a cheap, thin one — down here. There's a lantern on it, and all manner of writing implements litter the desk, but most of the space is dedicated to rocks. All manner of different kinds, carefully catalogued in labeled vials, alphabetized and neatly arranged. Somebody's making a collection.
rows.translation: 在矿井隧道的尽头，有一间小办公室，它与其他挖掘区域是用横幅制成的帘子隔开的。平整的地板上铺着一块厚厚的、虽然已经有些磨损的地毯，而且还有人把一张桌子拖到了这里——虽然那是一张便宜又单薄的桌子。桌上放着一盏灯笼，各种书写工具散落一地，但大部分空间都被用来摆放岩石了。这些岩石种类繁多，都被仔细地分类收纳在贴有标签的试管里，按照字母顺序整齐地排列着。有人在收集这些东西。
rows.raw: "\n\tAt the end of the mine tunnel is a small office, separated by curtains made from banners from the rest of the dig site. A thick, if time-worn, carpet is laid out over the smoothed-out floor, and somebody's actually dragged a desk — admittedly a cheap, thin one — down here. There's a lantern on it, and all manner of writing implements litter the desk, but most of the space is dedicated to rocks. All manner of different kinds, carefully catalogued in labeled vials, alphabetized and neatly arranged. Somebody's making a collection.\n\t"

rows.original: Take the mining tool with you. Never know when you might need to excavate something.
rows.translation: 带上这个挖掘工具吧，谁知道什么时候会需要用到它来挖掘些什么呢。
rows.raw: "Take the mining tool with you. Never know when you might need to excavate something."

rows.original:
You're walking through what seems like more recent excavation — there's still shattered bits of stone scattered all over the ground, yet to be cleaned up and out, and the floor's uneven enough in places to nearly trip you. The walls, though, are what really catch your eye: even in the dimness of the torchlight you can see flecks of tin glittering. This must be what the demons were after down here.

	Back west is the main tunnel; east is deeper into the dig site.
rows.translation:
你正走在一片似乎是最近才挖掘出来的区域——地上仍然散落着破碎的石块，这些碎片尚未被清理干净，地面的起伏也大到足以让你差点绊倒。不过，真正吸引你注意力的是那些墙壁：即使在火把微弱的光芒下，你也能看到那些闪烁的锡粒。想必这些就是恶魔在这里想要夺取的东西。

	向西走就是主通道；而向东则会进入挖掘区域的更深处。
rows.raw:
"
	You're walking through what seems like more recent excavation — there's still shattered bits of stone scattered all over the ground, yet to be cleaned up and out, and the floor's uneven enough in places to nearly trip you. The walls, though, are what really catch your eye: even in the dimness of the torchlight you can see flecks of tin glittering. This must be what the demons were after down here.

	Back west is the main tunnel; east is deeper into the dig site.
	
	"

rows.original: You can hear the ring of stone and metal up ahead to the east. Somebody's definitely down here, working away...
rows.translation: 在东边前方，你可以听到石头与金属碰撞发出的声响。肯定有人在这里辛勤工作着……
rows.raw: "You can hear the ring of stone and metal up ahead to the east. Somebody's definitely down here, working away..."

rows.original: The end of the tunnel is clearly a work in progress, mined out by the labor of imps and golems under the demon catboy's direction. Amongst the shattered stone at the mine's end, you can see veins of tin in the process of being dug up — an essential part of forging bronze, and the more expensive of the two primary components. No wonder the demons were digging so enthusiastically down here in the dark!
rows.translation: 隧道的尽头显然还处于施工阶段，那些小妖精和傀儡在恶魔猫男孩的指挥下正在那里挖掘。在矿井尽头的碎石堆中，你可以看到那些正在被挖掘出来的锡矿脉——这是锻造青铜所必需的材料，也是两种主要成分中价格更昂贵的一种。难怪那些恶魔会如此热衷于在暗影中在这里挖掘啊！
rows.raw: "\n\tThe end of the tunnel is clearly a work in progress, mined out by the labor of imps and golems under the demon catboy's direction. Amongst the shattered stone at the mine's end, you can see veins of tin in the process of being dug up — an essential part of forging bronze, and the more expensive of the two primary components. No wonder the demons were digging so enthusiastically down here in the dark!\n\t"

rows.original: You've made it into the great tower that looms above the waterway fortress, what you assume to be the demons' command post. There's a small entrance foyer here, leading north into the central spire. Circular stairs ring the inner tower, spiraling up and up out of sight.
rows.translation: 你已经进入了那座耸立在水路要塞上方的巨塔，你认为这里就是恶魔的指挥中心。这里有一个小小的入口大厅，通往北方的中央尖塔。圆形的楼梯环绕着内塔，一路向上延伸，最终消失在视线之外。
rows.raw: "\n\tYou've made it into the great tower that looms above the waterway fortress, what you assume to be the demons' command post. There's a small entrance foyer here, leading north into the central spire. Circular stairs ring the inner tower, spiraling up and up out of sight.\n\t"

" [var0 |The bottom floor of the tower... just looking up gives you a bit of vertigo. There's no floor between where you stand now and the very top, just a spiraling staircase clinging to the outer walls, around and around and around for what looks like two hundred feet from down here! There's a small entrance foyer back south. To the east is a sturdy wooden door, underneath a sign that says "LIBRARY" in Belharan — presumably the Minoan characters above it represent the same. A note's been pinned to the door in a neat, harshly-angled script: "Took the key with me since imps can't stop stealing my shit. Find me in the dig site if you need it. -Auren." [party.has viv |As she reads Auren's note, Viv just lets out a sigh. ] |[party.has calise |Calise puts a hand on your shoulder. "I'm eager to put the enemy leaders down too, but that's a hell of a climb. The battle will be over before we're done, I fear — we should see to the demon pits first. I have a fire in my heart, and only cleansing that evil from the world will quench it!" ] [party.has varena |Varena glances up the tower. "There's no way the demons' breeding grounds are up there. We should finish them off before we go after whoever's up there. It's a LONG climb!" ] [party.has azzy |Azyrran shakes her head and frowns. "Unless all of us could blast up there by wing, I think we're better off dealing with that foul demon-pit first... or this climb could get very ugly." ] ] "

rows.original:
You're at the foot of the spiral stairs leading up, and up, and up... Gods, [pc.hasWings|you're so happy you have wings!|this is going to be agony on your poor legs tomorrow.]
	
	[party.has calise|Calise whistles, looking upwards. "You'd best be sure you're ready for this, [pc.name]. By the time we finish this climb, the battle will be over!"]
	
	[party.has varena|Varena glances up and grimaces. "Damn it, leg day was yesterday... by the time we get up to the top the wyverns might well be done with their work, so... so be sure you're done down in the courtyard. I don't want to come back down and see an army waiting for us!"]
	
	[party.has arona|"Wish I could dry assfuck whoever invented stairs," Arona says, shaking out her legs. "This sucks."]
	
	[party.has ryn|Ryn looks up, flattens her ears, and then makes a plaintive [silly|uppies|grasping] motion at you. 
	
	You just shake your head. Not in the middle of a battle.]
	
	[party.has atugia|Atugia glances up the stairs. "Shit. Up we go."]
rows.translation:
你站在那螺旋楼梯的脚下，楼梯一直向上延伸，越来越高……天啊， [pc.hasWings|你高兴得简直像是长了翅膀一样！|明天你的双腿肯定会因此而感到剧痛。]
	
	[party.has calise|卡莉丝吹着口哨，抬头说道：“你最好确定自己已经做好了准备。 [pc.name]等我们爬到山顶的时候，战斗早就结束了！]
	
	[party.has varena|瓦蕾娜抬头看了看，然后皱起了眉头。“该死，昨天才是训练腿力的日子……等我们爬到山顶的时候，那些双足飞龙可能已经完成它们的任务了。所以……一定要在院子里把事情处理完毕。我可不想下去后看到有一支军队在等着我们！]
	
	[party.has arona|真希望我能把发明楼梯的那个人干得屁滚尿流，”阿罗娜一边说，一边活动着双腿。“这太糟糕了。]
	
	[party.has ryn|瑞恩抬起头，耳朵贴得紧紧的，然后发出了一声哀怨的叫声。 [silly|小狗们|理解] 有动作朝你袭来。
	
	你只是摇了摇头。毕竟现在不是在战斗中。]
	
	[party.has atugia|阿图吉娅抬头望了望楼梯，说道：“该死，我们得上去了。]
