rows.original: "Why play the double agent?" you ask [calise.hdk |your Calise |Kasyrra |Kasyrra ]. "Why manipulate everyone to come and destroy your own base?" The Blood Knight snorts. "Because it's not her base, is it?" "That's right," [calise.hdk |your Calise |Kasyrra |Kasyrra ] says. "My intentions towards Khor'minos have always been genuine. Believe me or not, but I have fought to save the cow city since the day I first found it!" "Why?" The Blood Knight pushes hard against the paladin. "Yes! Tell us why, Dark Lady. Why have you betrayed your own followers?" "Because Tollus has thrown all his weight behind this invasion!" [calise.hdk |your Calise |Kasyrra |Kasyrra ] answers. Her feet dig in, but the sheer strength of the Blood Knight pushes her back a step. "If it fails, the whole of the cult will turn on him. They'll realize he's a fraud and a madman. He'll get what he deserves for trying to sideline me." "Have you ever thought he sidelines you because you're a cancer on this war? Your attentions have always been split with your obsession about [pc.name]." "Then let it die with or without me!" [calise.hdk |your Calise |Kasyrra |Kasyrra ] snaps. "I'll not have my minions usurped by a bald freak and his clique of rejects. And..." The demon queen flexes her muscles, grinding her axe against the fallen Calise. "And I don't want to watch another city of cows be raped and pillaged. Not again. Never again." Even the Blood Knight blinks at that, a moment of weakness that lets Kasyrra push her axe inches closer to her rival's face before she recovers. "Getting sentimental, are you? Ha! Don't make me laugh. You couldn't care less if every mortal burned for your ambitions." "You've a higher body count than me, Champion!" Kasyrra spits. "I won't be moralized to by a serial killer who talks to trees!" Her attention turns to you. "We can discuss this after the fight, [pc.name]. I swear I'll explain everything, just... not now!"
rows.translation: 为什么要扮演双重间谍呢？”你问道。 [calise.hdk |你的卡莉丝 |卡希拉 |卡希拉 ]为什么要哄骗所有人来摧毁你自己的基地呢？”血骑士嗤笑道：“因为那本来就不是她的基地，对吧？”“没错。 [calise.hdk |你的卡莉丝 |卡希拉 |卡希拉 ] 我对科尔米诺斯的诚意一直是真实的。信不信由你，从我第一次发现这座城市起，我就一直在为拯救它而战斗！”“为什么？”血骑士用力推搡着那位圣骑士：“没错！告诉我们为什么，暗影女士。为什么你要背叛自己的追随者？”“因为托勒斯已经倾尽全力支持这次入侵了！ [calise.hdk |你的卡莉丝 |卡希拉 |卡希拉 ] 答案就在那里。她试图挣扎抵抗，但血骑士那强大的力量还是将她逼退了一步。‘如果这件事失败了，整个邪教组织都会背叛他。他们会意识到他只是一个骗子，一个疯子。他试图排挤我，最终只会得到他应得的惩罚。’”“你有没有想过，他之所以排挤你，其实是因为你已经成为这场战争中的累赘？你总是被自己对……的执念所干扰，无法全神贯注地投入到战斗中。 [pc.name]那就让它带着我或没有我一起死去吧！ [calise.hdk |你的卡莉丝 |卡希拉 |卡希拉 ] 我绝不会允许我的手下被那个光头怪胎和他的那群废物夺走。还有……”恶魔女王展示着自己的力量，将她的斧头在倒下的卡莉丝身上反复摩擦。“我也不会眼睁睁看着又一座城市被洗劫和破坏。不能再这样了。绝不又说了一遍。”就连那位血骑士也被这句话震住了，有那么一瞬间失去了警惕，这让卡希拉有机会将她的斧头再靠近对手的脸部几英寸，直到对方恢复过来。“你开始动感情了啊？哈！别逗我了。如果你们的野心真的能让所有凡人都付出生命的代价，那你根本就不会在乎这些的。”“你的杀戮记录可比我多啊冠军去你的！”卡希拉啐道，“一个会跟树说话的连环杀手，根本没资格来教我什么道德！” 她的注意力转向了你：“等这场战斗结束后，我们再讨论这个吧。 [pc.name]我发誓我会把一切都解释清楚的，只是……现在还不行！

rows.original:
Only in that moment of recovery do you recognize the figure in front of you, crouching on the edge of the table like a gargoyle. 
    
    [flags.WHFORT_FBLADE
        |"This bitch again!" Kasyrra snarls, hefting her axe again. "[pc.name] are you alright?"
        
        "Barely. I thought she was as good as dead!"
        
        "Almost... got you..." the Faceless Blade wheezes.
        |"Close..." the Faceless Blade snarls.
    ] Her tongue lolls a foot from her mouth, framed by bestial fangs slick with drool. Her fur has turned rose-pink and lightning crackles over it; you can see her muscles flexing wildly beneath her ghost-pale flesh. Her blade's a storm of broken iron and aetheric mist, whirling like a whip at her side. "But my Master's vision... still hasn't come true. I cannot perish yet, even at... the cost of my soul!"
    
    She snatches up one of the pink crystal figurines that had been lying on the ground and shoves it into her mouth, crunching down on it like candy. Her teeth grind it to bits in a second, unleashing enough mystical energy to make your hairs stand on ends.
    
    "You idiot!" Kasyrra says, eyes wide. "That... you're a mortal. You can't survive..."
    
    You glance at Kasyrra. "What's wrong with her?"
    
    "I don't... know. A mortal that consumes Lethicite turns into a demon almost instantly! I've never seen a reaction like this before!" 
    
    [party.has kiyoko
        |Kiyoko hisses, baring her claws. "She has renounced her god and given up her body to evil. Hold nothing back; she will kill us all if given the chance. We must be ready to do the same."
    ]
    
    "Souls," the Faceless pants, licking her face clean of shards. "I need them... so badly... give them to me. Fill the hollowness within me..."
    
    "Hollowness..." Kasyrra echoes. "What happened to your soul, woman?"
    
    The Blade's only answer is to lunge.

	There's a moment of uncertainty, before Calise sighs and lowers her axe. "We're withdrawing. I hope you fucking kill that bitch. She deserves it. She'll only keep doing evil if you let her live."
	
	The towering muscle-demon shrugs her axe onto her shoulder and lopes out of the tower, leaving you alone with Kasyrra.
	
	"What are you doing?"
	
	"Letting you live," you tell her. "But not here. You're going to leave, and never come back. This war, your ambitions — it's all over now. But you can keep your life." 
	
	Kasyrra stares at you defiantly. You can tell she's trying to muster some last burst of strength, and so you just grab her wrist and push her against the wall, leaving her neck defenseless if she continues. Still, the fire in her eyes doesn't abate for several more tense seconds, staring at you with unvarnished hate.
	
	"All I ever wanted..." she finally says, "was one precious soul. Was that really so much to ask..."
	
	She'll get no pity from you now, no commiseration for failing to steal your soul! "Leave," you reiterate. "And never let me see you again."
	
	"I can't promise that."
	
	"Then next time..."
	
	You let the threat hang in the air. 
	
	Kasyrra sighs and spreads her wings. "Tell Isadora I'm... tell her that it isn't her fault."
	
	You nod, and watch her take wing and flee from the tower's balcony. There's a lot of alarmed shouting outside, followed by the howls of demons fleeing after their queen. Whatever was left of the fell army is routed now, but there's no hiding that Kasyrra herself just made an appearance.
	
	And that now you're down a Calise.
	
	How the hell are you going to explain this to the soldiers outside...?

	恭喜你们击败了卡希拉。那一定是一场极其艰难的战斗。
	
	对普通玩家来说，这几乎是一个不可能完成的任务，所以战斗在这里结束其实有点像是一个隐藏彩蛋。为了防止在真正的结局还未到来之前就提前泄露太多内容，游戏在这里就结束了吧——但在游戏的最终版本中，你们会进入结局画面，这个过程与你们获得“真正”结局时的情况几乎是一样的。 
	
	很抱歉刚才让你有点失望，但希望这些值得炫耀的事情能够弥补这个遗憾吧！
	
	——萨文
rows.raw:
"
    Hi, hello, lead dev Savin here!

	Congratulations on defeating Kasyrra. That was (hopefully) an incredibly tough fight. 
	
	This is basically an insurmountable feat for the average player, so having things end here is a bit of an easter egg. In order to avoid spoiling more of the ACTUAL ending for you when that's still a ways on the horizon, things are going to end here for you — but in the final version of the game you'll transition into the ending slides, pretty much the same as if you'd gotten the "true" ending. 
	
	Sorry for blueballing you a little, but hopefully the bragging rights are worth it!
	
	-Savin
    "

rows.original: You squat down in front of where Calise is sitting, dazed and weary after the furor of combat. "I want the whole story," you tell her. "Start from the beginning." The demon knight grumbles. "Half a year before all this shit started, a bitch of a storm rolled down from Zhenna Mountain. I took shelter with a dryad I knew, flirty little sproinker with a grove sheltered from the rains. When the thunder hit, she had a seizure, started spouting prophecy. Said there were demons coming from an unknown land to defile the Frost Marches." Calise leans back against the wall and looks to the sky. "She spoke with Velun's voice, I figured. He'd only just made me his Champion, and now one of his daughters is pointing me towards a foreign land in need of Treebeard's protection. Ha, what a fool I was! I'd heard there was a colony of foreign soul-suckers up here; I thought Velun was guiding me to come and butcher them before they further corrupted the Old Wyld." [party.has kiyoko |Kiyoko's fur bristles. "And you wonder why we mistrust outsiders, beloved..." ] "Instead, you found real demons," you say. Calise nods. "Not that much difference, except when they fuck you to death, these demons just take your soul and eat it like ripe fruit. That's what happened to me. I'd barely arrived in the Marches when a blizzard drove me down to Undermountain for shelter, and then a few days later hordes of these shit-twerp imps began showing up, terrorizing the place. I'd never seen anything like it! But I cut a bloody swathe through them just the same, them and all their kind. At least, until [party.has calise |she appeared," Calise says, pointing towards Kasyrra. "The demon queen herself came to fight me. She didn't take kindly to me cutting down her hordes." "Please," Kas snorts. "As though I care about imps. No, you drew my ire because you were killing demons, even ones that weren't part of the fighting. Even new-turned neophytes who'd never used their powers. And none but me could stand up to your strength. The idea of testing myself against a divine champion was... enticing, I admit." "So what happened next?" "I beat her ass," Kasyrra says smugly. "Yeah. You're a god damn monster, bitch-queen. Or a god damn dragon. I didn't stand a chance. And when you were done with me, you told me to never show my face around Khor'minos City again, that the city didn't need a champion as weak as me. Like I needed another reason to hate myself! Ha. All I could do was fall in with the only group that'd take me... the demons. Their master, Tollus, took me in. Gave me a duty again, told me that the gods had abandoned me, abandoned the whole world... and I knew he was right." |the bitch-queen herself appeared. She didn't like me cutting down her hordes, so she came at me personally... and I lost. She was a monster in battle, like she could kill a god... like a dragon. I didn't stand a chance." [party.has varena |Varena grimaces. "What did she... do to you?" Calise grunts. "What do you think, princess? She tickled me till my soul fell out! Fucking idiot. |You grimace. "And that's when you lose your soul?" "Yeah, obviously. ] And then when she was done with me, she told me to never show my face around Khor'minos City again, that the city didn't need a champion as weak as me. Like I needed another reason to hate myself! Ha. All I could do was fall in with the only group that'd take me... the demons. Their master, Tollus, took me in. Gave me a duty again, told me that the gods had abandoned me, abandoned the whole world... and I knew he was right." ] "So you felt so sorry for yourself that you became a demon general?" you say. [pc.isDK |"Some champion." ] "Suck it," Calise spits.
rows.translation: 你在卡莉丝坐的地方前面蹲了下来，经过激烈的战斗后，你感到头晕目眩、疲惫不堪。“我想要完整你就从故事的开头讲起吧，”你对她说。那位恶魔骑士嘟囔道：“在这一切麻烦开始之前的半年，一场猛烈的风暴从珍娜山上袭来。我找了一个我认识的水精女寻求庇护——那个调皮的小家伙，她的小树林可以让我们免受暴雨的侵袭。当雷声响起时，她突然昏厥过去，开始念叨一些预言。她说有恶魔从某个未知的地方而来，企图玷污霜冻之地。卡莉丝靠在墙上，望向天空。“我想，她是用维伦的声音在说话。他才刚刚封我为他的勇士，现在他的一个女儿却指引我前往一片需要树须保护的异乡。哈，我真是个傻瓜！我听说这里有一群外来的吸血怪物；我原以为维尔伦是想让我去消灭它们，以免它们进一步破坏古老的荒野。" [party.has kiyoko |清子的毛发顿时竖了起来。“你们还奇怪我们为什么不信任外人，亲爱的…… ] 相反，你遇到的却是真正的恶魔，”你说。卡莉丝点了点头：“其实也没什么区别……只不过当这些恶魔把你折磨致死之后，它们会夺走你的灵魂，然后像吃成熟的水果一样将其吞食。我就遭遇了这种事。我刚来到边境地区，就遇到了一场暴风雪，被迫躲到了山腹深域中寻求庇护。几天后，成群结队的这些该死的小恶魔开始出现，让整个地方陷入了恐怖之中。我从未见过这样的东西！但我还是把它们全部消灭了，包括它们所有的同类。至少，在那之前是如此。 [party.has calise |她出现了，”卡莉丝指着卡希拉说道，“那个恶魔女王亲自前来与我战斗。她显然无法接受我消灭了她那些军队。”“得了吧，”卡斯嗤笑道，“我才不在乎那些小妖精呢。不，你真正惹怒我的，是你们一直在杀戮恶魔们即使是那些没有参与战斗的人，也包括那些刚刚觉醒、从未使用过自己能力的新手。而除了我之外，没有人能够抵挡你的力量。承认吧，与一位神圣冠军一较高下这个想法……确实很吸引人。那么接下来发生了什么？”“我把她打得落花流水，”卡希拉得意洋洋地说。“是啊，你简直就是个该死的怪物，女霸王……或者说是一条该死的龙。我根本就没有机会取胜。而当你打完我之后，还命令我永远不要再出现在科尔米诺斯城，说这座城市不需要像我这么弱的冠军。好像我还需要另一个理由来恨自己似的！哈。我所能做的，就是加入唯一愿意接纳我的那个群体……恶魔们。他们的首领托勒斯收留了我，再次赋予我一项任务，还告诉我，众神已经抛弃了我，抛弃了整个世界。……而且我知道他是对的。 |那个恶毒的女王亲自出现了。她不喜欢我消灭她的军队，所以她亲自来找我麻烦……而我失败了。她在战斗中简直就像一个怪物，仿佛有能力杀死神明……就像一条龙一样。我根本没有任何胜算。 [party.has varena |瓦拉娜皱起了眉头：“她……对你做了什么？”卡莉丝哼了一声：“你猜怎么着，公主？她把我挠得魂都快掉了！那个该死的白痴。 |你皱起了眉头：“那么，就在那一刻，你失去了灵魂吗？”“没错，当然是这样。 ] 当她对我不再感兴趣后，她告诉我要永远不要再出现在科尔米诺斯城，说这座城市不需要像我这样弱小的“英雄”。这简直让我有更多理由去恨自己了！哈哈。我只能加入唯一愿意接纳我的群体……恶魔。他们的首领托勒斯收留了我，再次给了我一个任务，他说神明已经抛弃了我，抛弃了整个世界……而我知道，他说的没错。 ] 所以你因为太自怜了，才变成了恶魔将军？”你说道。 [pc.isDK |某个冠军。 ] 闭嘴，”卡莉丝啐道。

rows.original:
"Where is Tollus?"

	[flags.FACELESS_KILLED||"You are... too late..." the Faceless Blade pants. "Michael is... beyond your reach now..."
	
	"Very helpful, thank you." You sigh, and turn to Calise. "Well?"]
	
	"He left," the demon says coldly. "Ditched us all days ago. You want the bitch in charge of this war? You might as well be looking at her." 
	
	You [pc.isDK|slap her|frown]. "So where's he gone?"
	
	Calise gestures to the east. "Coastlands, past the heart of the kingdom. Him and his little coterie of fuckboys have a boat out there, hidden in some ruined town. We've been using it as a base for a while now. Lucky you, most of us were here for your [party.has varena|wyverns to chew on|army to butcher]! If you hurry, you might catch Tollus with his panties down... and if you don't, he might just sail away."
	
	Great. 
	
	"What's he doing out there, anyway?"
	
	"Fuck knows. Never told me, anyway... nothing more than his ravings about old magic lost at sea. Seemed like he was searching for something in the old town, but I never asked what. Didn't care."
	
	An old town somewhere on the east coast, then. You know where you must go next.
rows.translation:
托勒斯在哪里？

	[flags.FACELESS_KILLED||你……来得太晚了……”无面之刃叹息道，“迈克尔现在已经超出了你的能力范围……”“真是帮了大忙，谢谢。”你叹了口气，然后转向卡莉丝，“那么，接下来该怎么做？]
	
	他离开了，”恶魔冷冷地说道，“几天前就抛弃了我们所有人。你想要让那个女人来主导这场战争吗？那你干脆直接看着她好了。 [pc.isDK|打她一巴掌|皱眉]那他去哪儿了？”卡莉丝指向东方：“去了海岸地区，越过了王国的中心地带。他和他那群小混混乘着一条船，躲在某个废弃的城镇里。我们把那里当作基地已经有一段时间了。算你运气好，我们大多数人本来都是为了帮你才来到这里的。 [party.has varena|值得仔细研究或琢磨的对象|可供宰杀的军队]如果你快点，说不定还能抓住托勒斯，让他措手不及……要是迟了，他可能就会扬长而去啦。”“太好了。”“他到底在外面干什么呢？”“谁知道呢。他从来没告诉过我……只是总念叨着那些失落在海里的古老魔法。看起来他好像在老城区里寻找什么，但我从来没问过具体是什么。我也不感兴趣。”那么，应该是东海岸的某个老城区了。你现在知道该去哪里了。

rows.original: You kneel down next to the mutated assassin. "You're Shizuka, right?" you ask. "Shizuka Ōshiro?" Her pupils narrow slightly, and she manages to look up at you with some effort. "That name... yes. Mine." "I was told that you were already Faceless when you left the Old Country. Did you come here to join Tollus's cult?" The corrupted fox laughs hoarsely. "No. I knew nothing of this land... was forced to flee. Father tried to kill me. My only sin was protecting myself. Yet they called me no-face all the same. Michael... Tollus... came later." "Protecting yourself?" "Ahh... an outlaw... kidnapped me. Forced himself on me. Meant to keep me. So I... killed him. With Keros's gifts. Even if he was wicked, my kinfolk called me the worse monster. Even [silly |the yakuza |criminals ] would not take me in. Had to... use a blade to force one to forge papers for me. First man I killed with a sword." Her tails writhe like tentacles behind her. Does the memory excite her? Her long tongue flicks across her lips, and she adds, "If my kin call me a monster... why not be one? Condemned either way. Got... good... at it. Killing. That is what brought me to Belhar. Always warlords and princes in need of a blade. And that is how Michael found me." [var0 | |"You keep calling him Michael..." The Blade snorts. Blood spills from her nose. "That is his name. Tollus is an... affectation. The name of an ancient philosopher. Thinks himself his successor. It is... cute." Cute is not a word you'd ever expect anybody to use for that dome-headed cultist. And the fondness in her voice... she really means it, too. ] "So Michael needed an assassin?" you ask. She nods slowly. "Every man with great ambitions does. Somebody to clear the way for them. To protect their dream. Beautiful, beautiful dreams..." "What kind of dreams?" For all the time you've spent fighting off Tollus's cult, there's been precious little indication they want anything other than to drown in hedonism. "A world united... all nations, all cultures, wiped away. Replaced with a kingdom of god. One where men cannot manufacture evil. Where all is love, and closeness..." Gods damn she[silly | really drank the Kool-Aid. Well it was Flavor-Aid, actually, but you know. Same difference. Whatever. |'s in it hook, line, and sinker isn't she? ] You sigh. All you're likely to get now is brainwashed ramblings.
rows.translation: 你跪在那个变异刺客的身边，问道：“你是志津香吧？大城志津香？” 她的瞳孔微微收缩，费了些力气才抬起头看着你：“那个名字……是的，是我的。” “有人告诉我，当你离开旧国的时候，你就已经成为了‘无面者’了。你是来加入托勒斯的邪教的吗？” 那只被腐蚀的狐狸发出嘶哑的笑声：“不。我对这片土地一无所知……只是被迫逃过来的。我的父亲试图杀我，而我唯一的过错就是保护了自己。然而他们还是称我为‘无面者’。迈克尔……托勒斯……后来才出现的。” “是在保护自己吗？” “啊……有个亡命之徒绑架了我，强迫我和他发生关系，还想把我留下来。所以我就……用凯罗斯赐予我的力量杀死了他。尽管他很邪恶，但我的族人却称我为更可怕的怪物。甚至 [silly |黑帮 |罪犯们 ] 他们不肯收留我。我不得不……用刀逼迫他们为我伪造文件。那是我第一次用剑杀人。 她的尾巴在身后扭动，就像触手一样。这段回忆让她感到兴奋吗？她长长的舌头轻轻舔过嘴唇，然后补充道：“如果我的族人称我为怪物……那我就成为怪物吧。反正两种结局都一样。而且……我真的很擅长杀人。那个正是这些原因让我来到了贝尔哈尔。那里总是有那些需要武器的军阀和王子们那个就是迈克尔找到我的方式。 [var0 | |你一直叫他迈克尔……” 刀锋女子哼了一声，鼻子里流出了鲜血。“那就是他的名字。托勒斯只是……一种装腔作势的表现。那是一个古代哲学家的名字。他自认为是那个哲学家的继承者。不过……还挺可爱的。 可爱你绝对想不到会有人用这个词来形容那个圆头发的狂热信徒。而她语气中的那份喜爱……她是真心的。 ] 那么迈克尔需要一名刺客吗？”你问道。 她缓缓点了点头。“每一个怀有远大抱负的人都需要。需要有人为他们扫清道路，保护他们的梦想……那些美好的梦想……” “什么样的梦想呢？”尽管你们花费了大量精力来对抗托勒斯的邪教，但他们似乎从来都没有表现出任何其他追求，似乎只沉溺于享乐之中。 一个统一的世界……所有的国家、所有的文化，都被抹去。取而代之的是上帝的王国。在这个王国里，人们再也无法制造邪恶。那里只有爱与团结……” 该死的，她[silly | 真的完全相信了那些话。其实应该是“Flavor-Aid”，但你也懂的，意思差不多就是那样。总之，无所谓了。 |她完全陷进去了，不是吗？ ] 你叹了口气。现在听到的很可能只是一些被洗脑后的胡言乱语罢了。

rows.original: "Why go through this charade?" you ask, gesturing to her transfigured body. "Why pretend to be a human again?" Kasyrra shrugs. "Because it suited me. No one, not even you, would unquestioningly follow my leadership in defeating the cult if I appeared as the Demon Queen. Everyone would have thought this a double-blind, when my intentions were in fact sincere. Worse, if some had followed me willingly, it would have lead to civil war in Khor'minos. Any way you slice it, if I wanted to make a difference in the city, I had to wear a human disguise." [flags.BK_KILLED |"And so you stole the identity of Velun's champion?" She nods. "Oh, yes. Everyone loves a paladin. |"Did it have to be mine?" Calise grunts. "Yes," Kasyrra says. "Everyone loves a paladin. ] Besides, it's close enough to who I once was that I could play the role with ease. I'm not a spy by trade, [pc.name]. Lying doesn't come naturally to me, despite what you may think." [pc.isCunning |"Wow, you don't say." |[pc.isDK |"Yeah, I noticed." | ] ] "I do not like to play the infiltrator more than I must, and taking on the role of a lady-knight was close enough to my true self that I was able to muscle through well enough to fool the court. Calise was poised perfectly to suit my needs, and getting her out of the way stopped her from slaughtering every corrupted creature she came across like a bloodthirsty fiend. I call that a win any way you slice it." [flags.BK_KILLED | |Calise spits. "Cunt." ]
rows.translation: 为什么要搞这种伪装？”你问道，同时指着她那已经发生了变化的身体，“为什么又要假装成人类呢？” 卡希拉耸了耸肩：“因为这样更适合我。如果我以恶魔女王的身份出现，没有人——甚至包括你——会毫无怀疑地听从我的领导，共同对抗那个邪教组织。大家都会认为这只是个双盲实验，而实际上我的意图是真诚的。更糟糕的是，如果有人拥有过它们自愿跟随我，否则科尔米诺斯城就会陷入内战。无论从哪个角度来看，如果我想在这个城市里真正发挥作用，就必须伪装成人类。 [flags.BK_KILLED |所以你盗用了维伦冠军的身份？” 她点了点头。“没错，大家都喜欢圣骑士啊。 |非得这样吗？我的？”卡莉丝哼了一声。 “没错，”卡希拉说道，“每个人都喜欢圣骑士。 ] 此外，我的性格与我曾经扮演的角色非常相似，因此我可以轻松地演绎这个角色。我本来就不是从事间谍工作的。 [pc.name]说实话，撒谎并不是我的强项，尽管你们可能认为我会擅长这个。 [pc.isCunning |哇，真是没想到。 |[pc.isDK |是啊，我注意到了。 | ] ] 我其实并不喜欢非得扮演渗透者这个角色，而扮演一位‘女骑士’这个身份与我的真实性格相当接近，因此我能够顺利地完成这个任务，甚至骗过了宫廷里的人。卡莉丝正好符合我的需求，把她从我的生活中移除，也就阻止了她像一个嗜血的恶魔一样，见到任何被腐蚀的生物就加以消灭。不管从哪个角度来看，这都算是一场胜利。 [flags.BK_KILLED | |卡莉丝啐了一声：“贱人。 ]

rows.original: "Doesn't this whole cult worship you? Why go through all this trouble to ruin all their plans?" Kasyrra just laughs. "Some of them do, yes. Or at least, they worship the idea of the Dark Queen. But in truth, they've been an arm of their mortal master, Tollus, since long before I arrived. They aren't my creatures, and Tollus has taken great pains to ensure they don't become mine. His hold on the cult was nigh unbreakable, and he dared move without my knowledge — indeed, one could say he's been hedging me out ever since I arrived." "And so you thought you'd teach him a lesson." "Ha, oh, more than that. Tollus put all his strength, all his power and influence, behind this attack. He meant to set himself up as a king in the Marches, to suborn the greatest realm of all beneath his skinny thumb... while I had said this was a fool's errand, that we demons are wasted on war. Our place should not be the field of battle, but the comfort of boudoirs and harem-palaces!" Kasyrra scoffs and rubs the black ring on her finger. "Besides, I do like this kingdom. It reminds me of a place that was dear to me, a long time ago. So, yes, I chose to stand with it against Tollus, and now that we have broken his army and sent him fleeting, there will be no question who among the corrupted who their true leader is. Was this self-serving? Of course. But I am genuinely glad to have stopped the invasion of Khor'minos. Under Tollus's leadership it would have been pointlessly bloody and miserable for everyone. Believe it or not, I count that as a win." [party.has brint brienne |"And what happens to Khor'minos in your plans?" [brint.name] asks. Kasyrra clicks her tongue. "I don't know. Perhaps I'll fuck your princess like I did the Winter Queen. Or perhaps I'll leave the city alone entirely. My plans are always in flux, dear cow." ]
rows.translation: 难道整个教派不是都在崇拜你吗？为什么要费尽心思去破坏他们的计划呢？”卡希拉只是笑了笑：“确实，他们中的一些人是在崇拜我。或者至少，他们是把我也当作他们的神明来崇拜的。想法属于暗影女王的势力。但实际上，在我到来之前很久，他们就已经成为了他们凡人主君托勒斯的工具。他们并非我的爪牙，而托勒斯也费了很大心思来确保他们不会成为我的下属。他对这个邪教的掌控几乎坚不可摧，他敢于在我不知情的情况下采取行动——事实上，可以说自从我来到这里之后，他一直在试图将我排除在这一切之外。所以你打算给他一个教训。”“哈，哦，不止如此。托勒斯投入了他所有的力量、所有的权力和影响力来发动这次攻击。他的目的是在边境地区自立为王，将整个最强大的王国都置于自己的控制之下。虽然我说过这是一场徒劳无功的行动，说我们恶魔把生命浪费在战争上。我们本不该出现在战场上，而应该待在闺房和后宫里享受舒适的生活！”卡希拉冷笑了一声，然后摩挲着手指上那枚黑色的戒指。另外，我确实很喜欢这个王国。它让我想起很久以前一个对我来说非常重要的地方。所以，我选择站在它这一边，共同对抗托勒斯。现在我们的军队已经击败了他，让他陷入了困境，那些被腐蚀的人中，谁才是他们的真正领袖，这一点已经再清楚不过了。这种行为是否自私呢？当然。但我真心为自己成功阻止了对科尔米诺斯的入侵而感到高兴。在托勒斯的领导下，那场入侵只会带来无谓的杀戮，让所有人陷入痛苦。信不信由你，我认为这算是一场胜利。" [party.has brint brienne |那么，科尔米诺斯会发生什么呢你的计划是什么？ [brint.name] 卡希拉吐了吐舌头：“我不知道。也许我会像对待冬之女王那样对待你的公主……或者，也许我会完全不去管这座城市。我的计划总是变来变去的，亲爱的。 ]

"So what happens now?" you ask, looking between Kasyrra and the open window, beyond which your army awaits. 
    
    "That, my [kasyrra.fucked
        |love
        |dear
    ], depends on you." Kasyrra gives you an awkward smile. No, help me keep up the deception just a little while longer, and we can give the city its happy ending. Then, after, you and I can meet in [kasyrra.fucked
        |my palace in the Ways Between
        |my apartment
    ] and talk things out, if you like. We are close to the end now. [kasyrra.hlr
        |The moment of our final battle soon approaches.
        |You'll have to finally pick a side: are you with me, or against me?
        |I hope you will choose to come to me willingly, [pc.name].
    ] Your soul is as ripe as it will ever be, so full of promise. I can feel its energy swelling within you, so bright amidst a sea of mediocrity in this world!" 
    
    Kasyrra's breathing is getting heavier, and she licks her lips. "My plans are so close to fruition that I could just reach out and..." she lifts a hand towards you, only to catch herself and take a step back. "But not now. Not here. I have worked too hard — we both have — to throw away this victory. Let us savor it together, [pc.name]. [kasyrra.hlr
        |Just this once.
        |And then we can savor each other!
        |And then each other, again and again, until the world itself trembles before us!
    ]

rows.original:
"No." You put your hand on your weapon again, turning to face the disguised demon queen head on. "I won't be complicit any more."
    
    "You... you what?" Kasyrra blinks. There's genuine surprise on her face now, so much so that her features shift a moment, eyes glowing gold as her facade wavers. "Are you insane? After all we've done together, you'd just throw it all away, and for what? Pride? Hate?"
    
    It doesn't matter. "[calise.hdk
        |You lied to me all this time, and still expect me to play along? No more!
        |You hid who you really were from me this whole time. You used me! I'm done being a fool for you.
        |I didn't have a choice but to work with you to save the kingdom. But now... now your part is done. Get out of here!
    ]"
    
    Kasyrra scowls, stepping backwards towards the window. "You're a fool. A shortsighted fool, [pc.name]. I was..." She stops herself short, and hefts up her axe. "It doesn't matter. Soon enough we'll have a reckoning, you and I. [kasyrra.hlr
        |Your soul will be mine.
        |Your time sitting on the fence between me and the world is drawing to an end.
        |Remember that I will own your soul, [pc.name], one way or another. I hope soon you will seek me out and give it willingly.
    ]"
    
    The demoness's disguise falls away completely, caramel flesh darkening into crimson. Wings sprawl out from behind her back, tearing her armor's straps in a burst of demonic transformation. Horns sprout from blackening hair, and muscles swell until her tunic tears. "I will see you soon, [pc.name]!" Kasyrra promises, leaping back onto the window's edge. "Look to the east. You will find me among the waves!"
    
    She turns on a heel and spreads her wings, shredding what's left of her armor in the process, and leaps into the air. You hear screaming from below, shouts of alarm and terror as the Demon Queen reveals herself above the battlefield — but they quickly turn to cheers as Kasyrra wings eastward, over the mountaintops. 
    
    They must think you defeated her, sent her running scared. 
    
    Now you'll have to explain to them what happened to Calise...

        |你一直都在骗我，还指望我会继续配合你？够了！
        |你一直都在向我隐瞒真实的自己，你在利用我！我再也不想为你当这个傻瓜了。
        |我别无选择，只能与你合作来拯救这个王国。但是现在……你的任务已经完成了。快离开这里吧！
    ]卡希拉皱起了眉头，一步步朝窗户走去。“你是个傻瓜。一个目光短浅的傻瓜 [pc.name]我当时……”她突然停住了话，他则拿起了她的斧头。“没关系，我们迟早会有一场对峙的，你和我。 [kasyrra.hlr
        |你的灵魂将属于我。
        |你在我与这个世界之间摇摆不定的日子，即将结束。
        |记住，我会掌控你的灵魂。 [pc.name]无论如何，我希望你能尽快主动来找我，并且心甘情愿地把它交给我。
    ]女恶魔的伪装彻底消失了，她那焦糖色的肌肤变成了深红色。她的背后展开了双翼，在这一阵恶魔般的变形中，她的铠甲带子也被扯断了。黑色的头发中长出了角，她的肌肉也膨胀起来，以至于她身上的长袍都被撑破了。“我们很快就会再见面了 [pc.name]放心吧！”卡希拉一边说着，一边跳回窗边。“往东看，你会在波涛之中找到我的！”她转身一跳，展开双翼，与此同时也将身上残余的盔甲撕得粉碎，然后纵身跃入了空中。你听到下方传来尖叫声，那是惊恐与警报的呼喊——当恶魔女王出现在战场之上时，这些声音立刻变成了欢呼。因为卡希拉展翅向东飞去，越过了群山。他们一定以为你打败了她，把她吓跑了。 
    
    现在你得向他们解释卡莉丝发生了什么事……

"I wanted you to do more than lust after me, [pc.name]. I wanted you to trust me. And I know, you must feel I betrayed that trust, keeping this secret for so long. rows.original: Tricking you into fucking her is beyond the pale. You want nothing more to do with Kasyrra. This will end your relationship with Kasyrra in all her forms.
rows.translation: 骗你和她上床，这种行为简直太过分了。你再也不想和卡希拉有任何瓜葛了。这将彻底终结你与卡希拉之间的一切联系。
rows.raw: "Tricking you into fucking her is beyond the pale. You want nothing more to do with Kasyrra. This will end your relationship with Kasyrra in all her forms."

rows.original: You take Kasyrra's hands in both of yours, a gesture so forward that even the Demon Queen gasps. "I don't care about any of that," you tell her. "I just know I care about you, no matter what name you go by." Kasyrra smiles, relief palpable on her features. "Darling... thank you. It means so much to me to hear you say that. You and I have such a glorious future ahead of us!" She turns from you to the balcony overlooking the keep. "Victory is not what tastes sweetest today after all." "Does this mean I don't need to worry about you stealing my soul anymore?" "I would rather you give it willingly," Kasyrra says, looking at you over her shoulder. For a moment, her eyes turn golden, narrowing to hungry, draconic points. "Your soul has always been my future, [pc.name]. The future of the entire demon race. I saw as much the moment we met. Now, I can see that it has flowered into its true strength. If I did not care for you, perhaps I would take it now... but I am patient. I can wait, until you are ready." You watch Kasyrra's hands tighten into fists. Not something easy for her to say, you imagine. This obsession of hers... she really is putting in the effort to keep herself in check. She looks down and laughs. "You can tell, hm? Good. I hope that proves that I mean what I say. I want you, [pc.name]. Body, mind, and soul all alike. I want to drown in you, your intoxicating strength, your... your everything. Getting to know you has been the best decision I have made in this world, and I will not destroy what we have. Not now that you have given me this chance." "The rest," she says, drawing in a deep breath, "we can discuss later. For now, we have an army waiting below us, ready to see their heroes. Let's not keep them waiting!"
rows.translation: 你用双手握住了卡希拉的手，这个举动如此大胆，就连恶魔女王都倒吸了一口凉气。“我不在乎那些，”你对她说，“我只知道，无论你用什么名字，我都在乎你。”卡希拉笑了，她脸上的神情充满了如释重负。亲爱的……谢谢你。听到你这么说，对我来说意义重大。我们面前有着如此辉煌的未来啊！”她转身走向那扇可以俯瞰城堡防御工事的阳台，继续说道：“毕竟，今天最甜美的滋味，并不是胜利带来的。这是不是意味着我再也不用担心你会偷走我的灵魂了？”“我更希望你能自愿把它交给我，”卡希拉边说边侧过头看着你。有那么一瞬间，她的双眼变成了金色，眯成了一对充满渴望的、仿佛属于巨龙的目光。你的灵魂，一直就是我的未来 [pc.name]整个恶魔种族的未来。在我们相遇的那一刻，我就已经预见了一切。如今，我看到它已经绽放出了真正的力量。如果我不在意你的话，或许现在就会将其据为己有……但我很有耐心。我可以等待，直到你准备好的那一刻。你看到卡希拉的手紧紧握成了拳头。你可以想象，这对她来说绝非易事。她这种执念……她确实在努力控制自己。她低下头，笑了起来。你能看出来，对吧？很好。我希望这能证明我是认真的。我需要你 [pc.name]我的身体、心灵，乃至灵魂，全都属于你。我想沉溺在你之中，沉醉于你那令人陶醉的力量之中，沉醉于你的一切一切认识你，是我这辈子做过的最正确的决定，我绝不会破坏我们之间的感情。既然你给了我这个机会，我就不会让它白费。”“其他的，”她深吸一口气说道，“我们可以以后再讨论。现在，下面有一支军队在等待着我们，他们迫不及待地想见到自己的英雄。我们可不能让他们等待太久！

rows.original:
With some small amount of trepidation, you take the hand of the Demon Queen, still as slender and delicate as you remember. "I do like this side of you," you admit slowly. "The strong, courageous paladin. I don't think you were hiding who you were... you were letting who you used to be shine again." 
    
    [flags.BK_KILLED
        |You step closer, watching the mix of anxiety and ardor was over Kasyrra's face.
        |The real Calise groans behind you. "What is this cornball shit?"
        
        You give her a withering look over your shoulder, before turning back to Kasyrra, watching the Demon Queen's face swim between anxiety and ardor.
    ] "I know this was the real you. And this... this side of you I like. More than like."
    
    "It was me," Kasyrra says. "But I shed my humanity years ago, [pc.name]. I can no more return to this than you can to your childhood."
    
    You touch the black ring on Kasyrra's finger. "I don't think that's true. Not anymore." 
    
    Your lover's expression becomes unreadable for a moment, and then she laughs. Not derisively, not even the haughty laugh of a demon queen, just an earnest chuckle from deep in her belly. "Marae's tits, [pc.name]. You say it like you believe it. And I love that about you, but-"
    
    "But it's true," you say. "It's never too late for redemption. Even for you. You just have to want it, like I want it for you." 
    
    "But I-" Kasyrra starts, then sighs and shakes her head. "No, I don't mean to dissuade you. I'm glad you can at least tolerate me still. We will... we will work on what comes next, at least. But that is a matter for another day. For now, we have sweet victory to sup upon."
rows.translation:
带着一丝忐忑，你握住了恶魔女王的手，那双手依然如你记忆中那样纤细而精致。“我确实喜欢你这样的样子，”你缓缓说道，“坚强而勇敢的圣骑士。我觉得你并没有刻意隐藏自己的真实身份……你只是让曾经的自己再次闪耀罢了。 
    
    [flags.BK_KILLED
        |你走近一些，注意到卡希拉的脸上交织着焦虑与热忱的情绪。
        |真正的卡莉丝在你身后呻吟道：“这是什么蹩脚的把戏？”
        
        你回头瞥了她一眼，然后又转向卡希拉，看着这位恶魔女王的脸上交替浮现着焦虑与狂热的神情。
    ] 我知道这才是真实的你。而这个……这个方面的你，我很喜欢。非常喜欢。”
    
    “那就是我，”卡希拉说道，“但是多年前，我就抛弃了自己的人性。 [pc.name]我再也无法回到过去，就像你也无法回到你的童年一样。”
    
    你触到了卡希拉手指上的那枚黑色戒指。“我不认为那是真的。至少现在不再是这样了。”
    
    你的爱人的表情有那么一刻变得难以捉摸，然后她笑了。不是嘲笑，甚至也不是恶魔女王那种高傲的笑声，只是从内心深处发出来的真诚的轻笑。“玛拉埃的乳房 [pc.name]你说得如此认真，我真的很欣赏这一点，但是——”
    
    “但是这是事实，”你说道，“拯救自己永远都不晚。即使对你来说也是如此。你只需要有这个决心，就像我为你所期望的那样。”
    
    “可是我——”卡希拉刚开口，又叹了口气，摇了摇头。“不，我并不是想劝阻你。我很高兴你至少还能接受我。我们……至少会一起面对接下来的事情。不过，那还是留到以后再谈吧。现在，我们应该庆祝这个甜蜜的胜利。

rows.original: You harden your heart and step away from Kasyrra. "We're finished. I don't want anything to do with you — with either side of you! Stay away from me!" The Demon Queen flinches back, slowly lowering her hand. "[pc.name]... please. Be reasonable. We had a good thing, you and I. I still-" "Want my soul?" you snap. She takes a step back of her own. "Yes. I do. And surely by now you must realize why. You and I could be together forever if only you would surrender it to me. Ascend with me, and let our legacy, our family come to dominate this world." "No." "[pc.name]..." Kasyrra repeats. "Please." When you make no move to assuage her, the Demon Queen's expression begins to sour. Her human guise begins to slip: flesh reddens, hair darkens, and her eyes narrow into draconic slits. "I will not be denied, [pc.name]. If you will not love me, I will take what is mine by force. This has always been the truth of it, but I would rather catch with honey than vinegar. Let us not waste what we have built, you and I." "It was all built on lies." "Only in part," Kasyrra says. "Not more than can be fixed, with effort." You just shake your head. Kasyrra's fist closes. "I see. Then so be it, [pc.name]. But know this: your soul will never be safe, so long as you live. Someday I shall have it, and through it, realize my ambitions. You have grown strong enough now that your essence is ripe to deflower. But not today. Not while the taste of victory is so sweet for the both of us; we will savor it tonight. But the next time we meet, it will be as foes, and I will have what is mine." She turns on a heel and spreads her wings, shredding her armor in the process, and leaps from the window. You hear screaming from below, shouts of alarm and terror as the Demon Queen reveals herself above the battlefield — but they quickly turn to cheers as Kasyrra wings eastward, over the mountaintops. They must think you defeated her, sent her running scared. Now you'll have to explain to them what happened to Calise...
rows.translation: 你硬下心来，转身离开了卡希拉。“我们结束了。我不想再与你有任何瓜葛——与你们任何一方都没有关系！离我远点！”恶魔女王吓得缩了缩身子，缓缓放下了手。[pc.name]……拜托了。请理智一点吧。我们曾经有过一段美好的时光，你和我……我仍然……”“想要我的灵魂吗？”你厉声问道。她自己也后退了一步：“是的。我确实想要。而且现在你肯定应该明白为什么了。只要你把它交给我，你和我就可以永远在一起。跟我一起升华吧，让我们共同创造属于我们的家庭来统治这个世界吧。”“不。”[pc.name]……”卡希拉重复道，“求你。”当你没有采取任何行动来安抚她时，这位恶魔女王的表情开始变得阴沉起来。她的人类伪装也开始瓦解：皮肤变得通红，头发变暗，眼睛也变成了龙一般的狭长形状。“我不会被拒绝的。 [pc.name]如果你不愿意爱我，那我就会用力量夺回属于我的东西。事实一直都是这样，但我宁愿用蜂蜜而不是醋来解决问题。我们不要浪费我们共同建立的一切，你和我。”“这一切都是建立在谎言之上的。”“只是部分而已，”卡希拉说，“只要付出努力，这些谎言都是可以弥补的。”你只是摇了摇头。卡希拉的拳头握紧了。“我明白了。那么，就这样吧。 [pc.name]但你要明白：只要你还活着，你的灵魂就永远不会安全。总有一天，我会得到它，并通过它来实现我的抱负。你现在已经变得足够强大，你的本质也已经成熟到可以被“采摘”的地步了。但不是今天。在胜利的滋味对我们两人来说还如此美妙的时候，我们不会现在就放弃它；我们要好好享受这个夜晚带来的喜悦。但下次我们相见时，将会以敌人的身份相对，到那时，属于我的东西就会归我所有。她转身迈开步伐，展开双翼，在这一过程中将自己的铠甲撕得粉碎，然后从窗户跳了下去。下方传来了人们的惊叫声、恐惧与慌乱的呼喊——因为恶魔女王就这样出现在了战场上空……然而，当卡希拉朝着东方飞去，越过群山时，那些声音很快就变成了欢呼声。 他们肯定以为你打败了她，把她吓跑了。现在你得向他们解释卡莉丝到底发生了什么事……

    About that...
    "

rows.original: It would be easiest if everyone believed Calise was dead.
rows.translation: 如果大家都认为卡莉丝已经死了，那就最方便了。
rows.raw: "It would be easiest if everyone believed Calise was dead."

rows.original: Might as well tell the truth: she was a demon, and now she's fled.
rows.translation: 说实话吧：她其实是个恶魔，现在已经逃走了。

rows.original: Weave a lie that Calise left like a ghost in the night the moment the battle was won.

rows.raw: "Weave a lie that Calise left like a ghost in the night the moment the battle was won."

rows.original:
"Calise... didn't make it," you say. "I'm sorry, Izzy."
    
    "What...? No! No, you're lying!" Isadora cries, eyes wide as saucers. "There's no way!"
    
    She starts to push past you, rushing for the tower, but you grab her shoulders and hold her back. "No. You don't want to go in there."
    
    "Calise!" she screams. "No!" 
    
    Another of the soldiers ask, "What happened in there?" 
    
    You shake your head. "The enemy general was more than we bargained for, and there was an assassin hopped up on soulstones. She unleashed some kind of magic blast, and Calise..." You take a breath, and decide to paint her as a hero. "She shoved me out of the way. It... she's just gone, but she saved me."
    
    "Gods..." Isadora weeps. She buries her face in your chest, clutching at your [pc.armor].
    
    Other officers clasp your shoulders in solidarity; others still stroke Izzy's back and offer their condolences to you both. A few step away, hiding their faces. 
    
    You grasp one of the few officers who's kept his wits wholly in the fight and start relaying orders: you'll need to leave a detachment here to secure the fort and keep the demons from trying to come back and collect your prisoners and their abandoned wargear, while the rest form an honor guard to escort you back to the king's court. You must report the events of the day to Kelsaz — and bring good news to a city sorely needing it. Perhaps your victory will cushion the loss of one of their Champions.

rows.original: "I think she genuinely wanted to protect the kingdom," you say. "Though why exactly... who really knows." "A demon wanted to protect us?" one of the officers scoffs. "You're kidding." Isadora turns on him, confusion giving way to indignation. "Of course she did! Even if.. even if she was a demon, she's still a good person.     伊莎多拉的眼睛瞪得大大的，仿佛变成了碟子一般。什么！？不，不，不是这样的……这根本不好笑……”
    
    “她居然还活着？”其中一名警官问道。
    
    “所以从一开始她就在欺骗我们！”另一名警官惊呼道。
    
    伊莎多拉愤怒地瞪着那个男人，心中的困惑早已被愤怒所取代。不！是她帮助我们才走到这一步的。我们赢了！ [pc.name] 那些繁殖坑被毁了，我下去看过现场。”
    
    “那为什么呢？为什么一个恶魔会帮助我们？
rows.raw:
'
    "Izzy... there's no easy way to say this, but Calise isn't who you thought she was."
    
    You can see Isadora's mood shift instantly; her body tenses, and she squares her shoulders. "What's that supposed to mean?"
    
    "She's a demon." You look between Isadora and the other officers gathered around you, taking in their expressions of shock. "She revealed herself in the fight with the demon general. After that, we... split ways."
    
    Isadora's eyes go wide as saucers. "WHAT!? No, no, no... that's not funny..."
    
    "She's still alive?" one of the officers asks.
    
    "So she was playing us from the start!" another gasps. 
    
    Isadora turns on that man, confusion giving way to indignation. "No! She helped us get here. We won! [pc.name] destroyed the breeding pits. I went down and saw it."
    
    "Then why? Why would a demon help us?"
    '

rows.original: You reckon she was in it to destroy the cult — or at least, her rivals' hopes of controlling it.
rows.translation: 你认为她参与其中是为了摧毁那个邪教组织——或者至少，是为了破坏她的竞争对手控制该组织的企图。
rows.raw: "You reckon she was in it to destroy the cult — or at least, her rivals' hopes of controlling it."

rows.original: You think she really wanted to protect Khor'minos. Why? You may never really understand.
rows.translation: 你认为她真的是想保护科尔米诺斯吗？为什么？也许你永远都无法真正理解其中的原因。
rows.raw: "You think she really wanted to protect Khor'minos. Why? You may never really understand."

rows.original: Let's be honest: Kasyrra was helping you, because she wants your soul.
rows.translation: 说实话：卡希拉其实是在提供帮助。你因为她想要你的灵魂。
rows.raw: "Let's be honest: Kasyrra was helping you, because she wants your soul."

rows.original: She did it for a laugh. What do they expect — demons cause chaos.
rows.translation: 她这么做只是为了好玩而已。他们还能指望什么呢——恶魔本来就会制造混乱嘛。
rows.raw: "She did it for a laugh. What do they expect — demons cause chaos."

rows.original:
The troops below have just about mopped up by the time you return to the ground floor of the tower, and your officers meet you with congratulatory back-slaps and handshakes. 
    
    "She sure showed those demons!" Isadora cheers, jump-hugging Kasyrra the moment she's through the door. The demoness smiles and hoists the smaller soldier up in her arms, spinning her around. Isadora giggles and kicks her legs in the bigger woman's embrace, totally oblivious to the truth of her. 
    
    You grasp another officer's shoulder and begin relaying orders: that they should leave a detachment here to secure the fort and keep the demons from trying to come back and collect your prisoners and their abandoned wargear, while the rest form an honor guard to escort you and Lady Calise back to the king's court. You must report the events of the day to Kelsaz — and bring good news to a city sorely needing it.
rows.translation:
当你回到塔楼的底层时，下方的部队已经差不多将敌人全部消灭了，你的军官们迎上来，用祝贺的拍背和握手来欢迎你。
    
    “她真是把那些恶魔打得落花流水！”伊莎多拉一进门就兴奋地跳起来，紧紧抱住了卡希拉。女恶魔微笑着将那个较小的士兵抱到怀里，旋转着她。伊莎多拉在那个高大的女人怀中咯咯笑着，用双腿蹬来蹬去，完全不知道自己的处境。
    
    你抓住另一位军官的肩膀，开始下达命令：让他们留下一部分人驻守在这里，保护堡垒，防止恶魔回来夺回你们的囚犯以及那些被抛弃的战利品；而剩下的士兵则组成一支仪仗队，护送你和卡莉丝女士回到国王的宫廷。你必须向凯尔萨兹汇报当天的发生的事情——并且为这座迫切需要好消息的城市带来喜讯。

rows.original:
"Time to play your role," you tell Calise.
    
    The fallen knight grunts wordlessly and pulls her hair back into a messy ponytail before picking up her axe again. You suppose it's reasonable that Calise would have claimed it from her fallen foe. 
    
    You clap her shoulder and step through out onto the tower's balcony, overlooking the courtyard. Your army [var0
		|has swarmed the fort by now, overwhelming the demons' defenses completely. T
		|has overrun the fort now, though from this vantage you can see just what a toll the battle has taken on them: less than half your men made it here on their feet. You can't imagine how many have been carted off by fleeing demons, or buried beneath the blowing snow. Gods... Still, t
	]hey raise their weapons and banners when you come into view, cheering for their champions. 
    
    You return the gesture, hoisting your [pc.weapon] aloft. 
    
    Calise takes a deep breath and the grasps your wrist, hard. There's a brief, perilous second wherein you worry you're about to be flipped over the railing, but she just lifts your hand higher, a facade of solidarity that sends a new wave of exultations through your soldiery. 
    
    Quietly, she whispers, "You better do all the talking on the way to Khor'minos. I'm not some pantywaste lady of the court like the bitch-queen wanted to be."

The troops below have just about mopped up by the time you return to the ground floor of the tower, and your officers meet you with congratulatory back-slaps and handshakes. 
    
    "Se sure showed those demons!" Isadora cheers, jump-hugging Calise the moment she's through the door. The demoness goes rigid for a second, eyes wide, before you give her rear a slap and cough. It takes a moment even then for her to relax and put her arms around Isadora's middle, and with her arms so much smaller than they were before they look like they're falling onto her.
    
    Gods, demons are bad at disguising themselves, aren't they?
    
    Then again, people are really bad at seeing through their disguises — Isadora doesn't seem to notice a thing, giggling and kicking her legs in the bigger woman's embrace.

    “塞蕾真的把那些恶魔打得落花流水！”伊莎多拉一进门就兴奋地抱住了卡莉丝。那个女恶魔僵住了片刻，双眼瞪得大大的，直到你给了她一记耳光，她才咳嗽了一声，慢慢放松下来，将手臂环绕在伊莎多拉的腰间。由于她的手臂比之前细了很多，现在看起来就像是搭在伊莎多拉身上而已。
    
    天啊，恶魔可真不擅长伪装自己，不是吗？
    
    不过话说回来，人类也实在不擅长看穿他们的伪装——伊莎多拉似乎完全没注意到什么，还在那个身材高大的女人怀里咯咯笑着，开心地踢着腿。

rows.original:
You turn to Calise and kick her axe back to her. "Your lucky day, Calise. You're about to get a chance to redeem yourself."
    
    "The fuck're you on about now?" the demon grunts. 
    
    "The city expects [party.has varena
        |Calise to be their hero, not a demon.
        |two champions to come back from this battle.
    ] You're going to make sure they aren't disappointed."
    
    She stares up at you with a mix of confusion and contempt. "You're talking about a double bluff, aren't you? You want me to pretend to be the bitch pretending to be me."
    
    [party.has varena
        |"How does this make it better!?" Varena says, flailing her arms. "This is... wait a minute. Oh! I see what you're doing. That's kind of brilliant, in a devious kind of way."
    ]
    
    You nod. "Consider this a first step to making up for all the harm you've done to Khor'minos. You're going to make sure the city has its hero, and gets to watch her walk off into the sunset."
    
    "Uh-huh. The fuck would I do that for?"
    
    [pc.dcb
        |"Because I'm not giving you a choice," you say, putting a hand on your weapon.
        
        She scowls, but doesn't press the point.
        |"Because you're a paladin." You say the words with confidence, conviction. Enough to give the demon pause. "It's high time you started acting like it."
        
        "A paladin with no faith," Calise snorts. "I'll make a shitty hero for your city."
        
        "You don't need faith to be a hero," you say.[var0| "Though it does help."]
        |"Because I'm asking real nice?" you plead, eyes big and hopeful. "And because you know it's the right thing to do. Helping people feel safe is good."
        
        "That's a fancy way to say lying is good," Calise snorts. 
        
        You smile. "White lies are fine, if they're for good reasons. And this one is. Even you might feel good about it."
    ]
    
    The demon glances away. "Fine. But if I do this for you, I walk away for real after. I'm not doing shit for you if I'm going straight to [silly
        |gulag
        |some grungy-ass dungeon
    ] after."
    
    [party.has varena
        |Varena glances at you and shrugs. "If she'll swear an oath not to rejoin the war afterwards, and not to spread her demonic taint, I suppose I can countenance it..."
        
        "Shit, done." Calise laughs. "That all?"
    ]
rows.translation:
你转向卡莉丝，将她的斧头踢了回去。“今天是你的幸运日，卡莉丝。你即将得到一个重新证明自己的机会。”
    
    “你他妈在说什么？”那个恶魔低吼道。
    
    “这座城市期待着 [party.has varena
        |卡莉丝应该成为他们的英雄，而不是恶魔。
        |两位冠军将从这场战斗中脱颖而出。
    ] 你必须确保他们不会感到失望。”
    
    她困惑而又轻蔑地抬头看着你：“你说的其实是双重欺骗，对吧？你想让我假装成那个假装成我的人。
    
    [party.has varena
        |这样怎么就能让事情变得更好了！？”瓦蕾娜边说边挥舞着手臂，“这……等一下，哦！我明白你的意思了。从某种角度来看，这个办法还挺聪明的。
    ]
    
    你点了点头。“就把这看作是弥补你对科尔米诺斯所造成的一切伤害的第一步吧。你必须确保这座城市拥有属于自己的英雄，并且能够亲眼看到她走向辉煌的未来。”
    
    “嗯，好吧……我他妈为什么要这么做呢？
    
    [pc.dcb
        |因为我没有给你选择的余地，”你边说边将手放在武器上。
        
        她皱起了眉头，但也没有再坚持下去。
        |因为你是圣骑士。”你自信而坚定地说道，这句话足以让恶魔停下来思考。“是时候让你真正表现出圣骑士该有的样子了。”
        
        “一个没有信仰的圣骑士啊……”卡莉丝嗤笑道，“我会为你们的城市造就一个平庸的英雄。”
        
        “成为英雄并不需要信仰。”你说道。[var0| 不过这确实有帮助。]
        |因为我问得这么恳切，对吧？”你睁大眼睛，满怀期待地恳求道，“而且你也知道，这是应该做的事——帮助人们感到安全，是一件好事。”
        
        “这么说其实就是在拐弯抹角地承认说谎也是好事吧，”卡莉丝嗤笑道。
        
        你微笑着回答：“如果理由正当的话，善意的谎言也没关系。而这次的理由确实很正当。就连你，也会觉得这样做是正确的吧。
    ]
    
    恶魔移开了视线。“好吧。但要是我为你做了这件事，之后我就真的会离开。如果我做完之后马上就走，那就等于我根本没为你做任何事。 [silly
        |古拉格
        |某个肮脏不堪的地牢
    ] 之后。
    
    [party.has varena
        |瓦蕾娜瞥了你一眼，耸了耸肩说道：“如果她能发誓之后不再参加战争，也不再传播她的恶魔力量，我想我应该可以同意这个提议吧……”
        
        “太好了，搞定。”卡莉丝笑着说，“就这些吗？
    ]

rows.original: Odd, Hethia isn't in her usual spot today — has something happened? Your question's soon answered in the form of a handful of boreal elves marching past you and down the hallway, all of them clad in simple white shifts like Hethia's. Even though they don't show it on their quite literally icy expressions, all of the druidic delegation — or at least, that's presumably what they are — have their grudges on display like a cloak of grievances about their shoulders. As you watch, the hard-faced woman leading the dozen or so of them sweep past you, heading straight for the palace gardens and disappearing from view. Now what was that all about? [party.has etheryn |"Oh, [etheryn.lowConfidence |t- ]that's Lady Xadaron and her people," Ryn says with a thin smile that holds absolutely no humor. "I've sat in on fewer of the [etheryn.lowConfidence |r- ]reunification talks than I'd have liked, but both Hethia and Elthara make a point of filling me in on all the sessions I'm not able to attend." You're about to ask more |You're half-wondering if it would be a good idea to tail the druidic delegation ] when Hethia[party.has etheryn | |, Ryn ] and Elthara bring up the rear, looking worse for the wear. The latter acknowledges you with a nod and as genuine a smile as she can muster under the circumstances. "[pc.name]. Lumia be praised, if you aren't a breath of cool air in the heat of noon." The talks didn't go well this time around, you take it? "As well as can be hoped for," Hethia replies with a sigh. "Mie Xadaron can be a bitch when she's in a mood, but we made progress, if slow." [pc.isDK |Someone who's more of a bitch than Hethia is? Well, it only stands to reason — a people who's been in such an unenviable position for the last couple of centuries could only have survived with a bitch at the top. Can't be easy now when everyone's trying to play nice. |Your commiserations. While understandable, it must be frustrating to have the stiff-necked at the negotiation table. As much as that quality might be necessary for the leader of a people in such a precarious position, as well as a determination to secure the best deal possible for said people, it can't be fun for anyone trying to come up with equitable terms. ] Now it's Hethia's turn to smile, rueful as it might be. "I... I can't argue with that." "I'm still hoping that we'll be able to hash out the full terms of the reunification by year's end. Not that we haven't already started healing the wounds, but..." Ryn looks thoughtful. "It still is possible, don't you think? We've already come this far — I really don't want the talks to peter out into a deadlock and drag on for years." "It still is possible, but actually..." Elthara looks over at Hethia, and both women share a nod. "It's a good thing that you're here, [pc.name]. We were actually waiting for you to show up before bringing the matter before the [etheryn.crowned |queen |princess-regent ]." Oh? "Oh, indeed. What have the both of you been plotting behind my back?" "Nothing more than the healing of the schism in our people, nothing less. [etheryn.crowned |My queen |Princess-regent ], Champion of Frost, perhaps we can take this somewhere more private, like the gardens?" You're pretty sure you saw the druidic delegation head straight there, though. "Oh, I'm perfectly fine with that lot listening in. Shall we?"

rows.original:
Several minutes later, you find yourself in one of the garden gazebos being served sweet jam wafers and ice wine. Once you've made yourself comfortable, you turn to both Hethia and Elthara, motioning for them to begin. What this that they've cooked up which they've kept from even Ryn, but waited for you to show up at the palace to announce?
        
        Elthara clears her throat. "Something to help convince that bitch — pardon my language — that we're not all that bad, and to be a little less stiff-necked. And we'd like your help with that, my champion, but a little more explanation's warranted before we get to that."
        
        Go on...
        
        "Gossip travels fast in these times," Hethia continues. "Word of what we did in the crypts below the palace has quickly spread through the streets and the encampment beyond the walls alike. A lovely tale of peoples coming together to put the ghosts of the past to rest — it's captured the imagination of a good number of druids about my age. Not the older ones, they're too spiteful. Not the younger ones like Mie, they're too ardent in their beliefs. Regardless of what anyone wants to believe, though, they all heard the wails coming from below, and now they're stopped. The facts are the facts, and there's pressure from a number of druids who want to give this a genuine chance."
        
        "I'm sure some of the palace servants have been talking about it, too, because it's spread to every corner of Njorhaalt at this point," Elthara adds. "This might just be the break that we need to convince Mie to agree to more reasonable terms."
        
        That's all well and good... so why haven't they already made their demands, then?
        
        "There's more we need to do, Champion of Frost. The zealous stiff-necked attitude by the young generation of leaders is but one problem, and that still needs addressing. You've garnered quite the reputation for yourself as an adventurer, and it's in that capacity that we need your skills, Champion."
        
        Well, it's nice to be appreciated around these parts. Does she need something found, someone beat up, a problem solved, or...?
        
        "Hethia and I have discussed it. Since for the best effect, it ought to involve both the [etheryn.crowned
            |queen
            |princess-regent
        ] and you in your capacities, we waited for [party.has etheryn
            |the both of 
        ]you to show up at the palace from your most recent expedition. Anyway, we'd like to retake a druidic temple."
        
        Pardon? She wants to what?
        
        Hethia sighs, and you notice she hasn't touched the jam wafers at all. "It's a long story. Do you want the long version, or the short version?"

        艾尔萨拉清了清嗓子，说道：“需要一些办法来说服那个女人——请原谅我的措辞——让我们证明我们并不是那么坏的人，也能让她别那么固执己见。我们希望你能帮上这个忙，我的勇士，但在开始之前，还是需要你再解释得更详细一些。
        
        这些日子，流言传得可快了，”赫希娅继续说道，“我们在这座宫殿地下的地窖里所做的一切，很快就传开了，无论是城里的街道，还是城墙外的营地，到处都在议论。这个关于人们团结起来，让过去的幽灵得到安息的美丽故事，确实吸引了很多和我年龄相仿的德鲁伊们的想象力。不是那些年纪较大的人，他们太心胸狭隘了。也不是像米这样年纪较小的人，他们太固执己见、信念过于坚定。不过，不管大家愿意相信什么，他们都听到了从下面传来的哀嚎声，现在他们都停下了行动。事实就是事实，而且也有许多德鲁伊施加了压力，他们希望给这件事一个真正的机会。
        
        我敢肯定，宫里的一些仆从也应该在讨论这件事，因为现在这个消息已经传遍了整个尼约哈尔特，”艾尔萨拉补充道，“这或许正是我们说服米耶接受更合理条件的机会。”话是这么说……但他们为什么还没有提出他们的要求呢？
        
        冰霜冠军，我们还有许多事情需要去做。年轻一代领导者的那种固执己见的态度只是一个问题，而这个问题仍然需要得到解决。作为一位冒险家，你已经为自己赢得了相当的声誉，正是基于这一点，我们才需要你的能力，冠军。

rows.original: A deep breath. "All right, then. It's going to be long." You heard her the first time. You have wine and jam wafers, you could sit here all day. "So, let's start with someone both you and the [etheryn.crowned |queen |regent ] know, if only in passing — Mie Xadaron. Nice girl, really, unanimously agreed by the elder druids to be her father's heritor to the position of archdruid, who got it in turn from her grandfather, Vaeril Xadaron. Theoretically, her position isn't supposed to be hereditary, in practice, it is, much like most of the others. Anyways, Vaeril was archdruid at the time the whole thing with Atheldred and Synneva happened, and following the latter's death after being locked up, the whole schism happened and all... "Vaeril took his followers back to their temples, where they barricaded themselves in and prepared for a direct assault. Thing is, the Wraiths never came, or at least, not personally. What happened was the introduction of an infestation specifically designed to destroy them — fungus spores that fed off their powers and caused an uncontrolled abundance of life in the same way that a tumor does. The druids' powers and remedies were not only ineffective against the tailored disease, but encouraged its proliferation; the temples were quickly overrun with fungal mass and infested individuals. With his own father dead from the infection, Vaeril's son abandoned the temples and rallied the survivors in the western Frostwood, where we've been living for the last two centuries." Until recently, of course. "Until recently, yes." You're starting to see where this is going and why your assistance is needed. Does she want you to take a look at these temples in the same way that Daliza was sent to investigate the abandoned eastern cities for resettlement? It's Elthara's turn to speak. "That's part of the reason. I'll be blunt about it — with the way Njorhaalt has been our last major settlement since the Godswar, it simply isn't able to accommodate our recovering people to begin with, let alone an influx of druids wanting to experience city life. We'd have to expand the walls out by another layer, build new homes... that's going to take way too long. We need to keep momentum on the reunification going, to prevent people from drifting apart again once the novelty fades. "Hethia tells me that the temples weren't just temples, that they had villages surrounding them to support the druids and provide them with things they didn't make themselves. In turn, the druids brought in wealth through luxuries like mirrorwine, razorcup, remedies, and more. Reclaiming the ancient elven temples would mean being able to reclaim something of a foothold in the eastern Frostwood, beyond the bog and before the coast; it'd mean that we won't have a sudden housing crisis what with the city's population suddenly swelling, and some of the tent city beyond the walls can pack up along with any elves who want to have a go at a new life. Having someplace to reclaim and put work towards restoring would certainly salve the humiliation the druids must feel over being driven to this point." "It would certainly put pressure on Mie to accept more reasonable terms, even with her elders pushing the other way." Yes, you're seeing more of the picture here. After starting a good tale about elves coming together to put the grievances of their ancestors to rest, it's about time to milk it for all it's worth? That, and the irony of Lumian elves fighting for their cause... and pushing up Ryn's martial reputation at the same time. "It's one of the reasons why the people don't merely tolerate, but are absolutely fascinated by my [etheryn.crowned |queen |princess-regent ] taking long absences of leave from her ruling duties to be with you, Champion. Like it or not, the idea of a warrior-monarch braving exotic dangers and having daring adventures captures the imagination of the boer'alvar like nothing else. It's best to build up such a reputation while she's young to insure a more stable reign down the line." Ryn blushes a little at that. So let's get this straight. Hethia and Elthara would like you and Ryn to head on to one of the old druidic temples and do the dirty work of investigating and clearing out all the nasties, so the more spiteful of Hethia's people will be pressured to come to more reasonable terms by this show of goodwill. Amongst other issues like the housing problems, that is. "That's the long and short of it, yes, but it's not just the both of you going. I won't be able to accompany you all the way, but Elthara's agreed to represent the Lumian clergy in undertaking this adventure at your side, too." Could be worse. One question, though — if this fungal infection was able to eliminate the druids... you take it that the reason Hethia needs you and the Lumians to do this job is because it won't be able to harm you? "You catch on quickly, don't you? The problem with using diseases as weapons is that they have a tendency to spread their way back to you, which is why the legends say that it was keyed to our particular powers. The [etheryn.crowned |queen |princess-regent ], Elthara and you should be largely unaffected." And which temple would this be? Hethia smirks. "Might as well go all in, wouldn't you say? The grandest of all the druidic enclaves, Xadaron Temple itself." What was the current archdruid's last name again? Xadaron? Going straight for the sentimental value, you see. "Hit her where she'll feel it the most, yes." Why not take a contingent of elves and valkyries and clear it out, then? Oh wait, that wouldn't make a good story, would it? "That, and the hardliner druids could spin a massed effort as an invasion, a desecration, whatever. They already don't like me for trying to be reasonable with you, so..." Hethia shrugs. "Elthara says she'll have backup on standby in case you don't make it out." Very thoughtful of her. "And that's the long and short of it," Elthara says. "Hethia can bring us there, but she won't be able to enter the temple with us. We go in, clear out the remnants of the past, and return any culturally significant relics while keeping the valuables for the Crown. The druids get a show of goodwill, and confidence in the [etheryn.crowned |queen |princess-regent ]'s deeds and martial prowess grows. Everyone wins." All right, you understand what's going on here. But what about Ryn? How does she feel about being shepherded by her advisors into an adventure? [etheryn.lnhConfidence |Ryn gives you a weak smile. "You're th-the ones who've helped keep the Winter City r-running after my sister's departure. If I can't trust you to make good decisions, then that would be silly of me, w-wouldn't it? So long as you think it's for the best, then I've no objections going along with it. It feels good to hear the people cheer for me, and it might even be... f-fun." |Ryn thinks a moment. "All of you have kept the Winter City running when I wouldn't have been able to do it myself. For me to doubt you now would be quite heartless of me, wouldn't it? If you think that this would be a worthwhile venture, then I'm for it. I want to see the schism in our people healed, and while I don't exactly relish fighting for its sake like Alissa did, I'll swallow my fears if it means advancing our cause." |Ryn shrugs and gives you an easy smile. "I trust the three of you to do what's right for the future of the boer'alvar. We've come this far already, and all of you have proven to be capable and firmly on my side. To be honest, I find the idea exciting! And the less ugliness that remains buried in my family's past, the better. If that means digging it up and disposing of it, I'm all for that." ] "I know this is quite sudden to drop on you, [pc.name] — you probably have other things that you were intending on doing," Hethia says. "That being said, with the way the talks are going, there's no rush. Elthara has already made preparations for herself and the [etheryn.crowned |queen |princess-regent ]; bring up the matter with me anytime and I'll be able to take you there, as well as ask any questions pertaining to the venture." rows.translation: 深吸一口气。“好吧，那就这样吧。事情会变得长你第一次听到她这么说的时候，你还有葡萄酒和果酱威化饼，你可以在这里坐上一整天。“那么，让我们先从你们两个人都认识的人开始吧。 [etheryn.crowned |女王 |摄政者 ] 知道吧，哪怕只是顺便提一下——米耶·萨达隆。她是个不错的姑娘，老德鲁伊们一致认为她应该继承她父亲的职位，成为大德鲁伊。这个职位本来是不应该世袭的，但实际上却如此，和其他大多数职位一样。总之，在阿瑟尔德雷德和辛内瓦那件事发生的时候，瓦雷尔已经是大德鲁伊了。而在辛内瓦被关起来后去世，随之而来的是整个教派的分裂，于是…… 瓦瑞尔带领他的追随者们回到了他们的神庙，他们在那里设下障碍，准备迎接直接攻击。然而，那些幽灵始终没有出现，或者至少没有亲自现身。事实上，真正发生的是有一种专门被设计出来用来摧毁他们的害虫出现了——这种真菌孢子会吸收他们的力量，从而导致生命量失控地增加，就像肿瘤一样。德鲁伊们的力量与疗法不仅对这种专门针对他们设计的疾病毫无效果，反而加速了它的蔓延；神庙里很快就被真菌覆盖，那些被感染的人也相继倒下。由于自己的父亲也死于这种感染，瓦雷尔的儿子离开了神庙，召集了在弗罗斯特伍德西部幸存下来的人们，从那时起，我们便在那里生活了两个世纪。" 直到最近，当然是这样。”“直到最近，没错。”你现在应该开始明白事情的发展方向，以及为什么需要你的帮助了。她是想让你像达莉莎被派去调查那些被废弃的东部城市以寻找重新安置的方案那样，去研究这些寺庙吗？ 现在轮到艾尔塔拉发言了。“那就是部分原因很简单。我直说吧——自从“神战”之后，尼约哈尔特一直是我们的主要定居点，但它本身就已经无法容纳那些正在康复中的人们了，更别说还要接待那些想要体验城市生活的德鲁伊们了。我们不得不把城墙再向外扩展一层，建造新的住宅……但这需要花费太长时间了。我们必须保持这种重新统一的势头，这样才能防止人们在新鲜感消退后再次分道扬镳。 赫希娅告诉我，那些神庙并不只是简单的宗教场所，它们周围还建有村庄，这些村庄为德鲁伊们提供生活支持，为他们提供那些他们自己无法制造的东西。作为回报，德鲁伊们通过出售镜酒、剃刀杯、各种药材等奢侈品来获取财富。收复那些古老的精灵神庙，就意味着我们能够在弗罗斯特伍德的东部重新建立据点——那些沼泽地之外、海岸线之前的地区。这样一来，当城市人口突然增加时，我们就不会面临住房危机了。而且，城墙外的那些帐篷城里的居民，以及那些想要开始新生活的精灵们，也可以随之迁入这些地区。拥有一个可以着手进行修复工作的地方，肯定能够缓解德鲁伊们因被迫走到这一步而感到的屈辱。 听到这里，瑞恩的脸微微红了。那么，让我们把事情说清楚。赫希娅和艾尔萨拉希望你和瑞恩前往某座古老的德鲁伊神庙，去调查并清除那里的所有危险事物。这样一来，赫希娅那些心怀怨恨的人就会因为这种善意的举动而感到压力，从而被迫接受更合理的条件。当然，这还包括解决住房问题等其他事宜。 你学得真快，不是吗？将疾病作为武器使用的问题在于，这些疾病往往会反过来伤害使用它们的人，这就是为什么传说中提到，这种能力是与我们特殊的体质或力量相关的。 [etheryn.crowned |女王 |摄政公主 ]艾尔萨拉和你应该不会受到太大影响。”那么，这是哪座神庙呢？赫希娅露出微笑：“干脆全力以赴吧，你不觉得吗？所有德鲁伊聚居地中最宏伟的那座，就是扎达隆神庙本身。那个现任大德鲁伊的姓氏是什么来着？是扎达伦吧？其实就是想触碰她最敏感的地方，懂我的意思吧？“就是要击中她最脆弱的地方，没错。 rows.original: By the time you've reached the kennels, [flags.ELYON_MET |Elyon |one of the outriders ] has the wargs ready, and gives you a small bow as you approach. "Champion, [party.has etheryn |[etheryn.crowned |my queen |princess-regent ], your mounts are ready. Your priestess and the druid are already waiting for you by the stables." Sure enough, Elthara and Hethia |your mount is ready. The [etheryn.crowned |queen |princess-regent ] awaits your presence with her priestess and the druid by the stables." Sure enough, Ryn, Elthara and Hethia ]are already waiting for you, all of your mounts saddled and ready to go. The latter acknowledges your arrival with an upnod, then helps you up atop the warg's back and into the saddle. "I don't know if this is your first time riding, but even if it isn't you probably don't have enough experience to be comfortable with the pace at which we're going to go. Lean your weight forward, secure yourself in the saddle with your knees, and hold onto the collar like you would the reins on a horse. Don't worry about hurting the poor thing — the collars are made to sit on the shoulders, not the neck, so you won't accidentally choke him out. Got it?" Got it. "I'll be taking the lead and the wargs know to follow a leader, so just hold on and this good boy will do the rest." You glance over at [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona azyrran kiyoko atugia quintillus viviane agnimitra |Cait, who is completely taken with the pony-sized canine mount she's been assigned for the trip. "Aww, isn't he just cute? Look, [pc.name]! He's wagging his tail!" Huh, you didn't know Cait was this enthusiastic about animals. Nevertheless, as much as she might want to, she can't stay petting her warg forever, you've got places to be and things to do. "Just one more pat, okay?" |Brint, who looks uncomfortable as he settles in the saddle and shifts about experimentally. Something wrong? "No, everything's quite comfortable, actually," Brint replies. "I'm just a bit surprised that there's actually a beastie in the kennels capable of carrying me without breaking a sweat." Is it really that surprising? Most boreal elves can end up pretty strapping, after all. Actually, come to think of it, do minotaurs use mounts? A grin. "Not much call for a mount when a forced march can get you most places in time. But I guess this'll be a new experience, won't it? I wanted to see the world, and I'm getting it in spades." |Brienne, who looks uncomfortable as she settles in the saddle and shifts about experimentally. Something wrong? "No, everything's quite comfortable, actually," Brienne replies. "I'm just a bit surprised that there's actually a beastie in the kennels capable of carrying me without breaking a sweat. I was worried about bouncing in the saddle, but everything's actually pretty secure once I realized I was supposed to lean forward." Is it really that surprising? Most boreal elves can end up pretty strapping, after all. Actually, come to think of it, do minotaurs use mounts? A grin. "Not much call for a mount when a forced march can get you most places in time. But I guess this'll be a new experience, won't it? I wanted to see the world, and I'm getting it in spades." |Arona, who's completely taken with the idea. "Fuck yeah!" she exclaims, petting the poor warg all over until its fur is all poofed out. Not that the beast minds, quite the opposite in fact — but it's looking quite undignified while she continues to lavish attention upon it. "Now this is a mount worthy of a chieftain! I've got to get these elves to tell me how to raise wolves like these so every single Kervus can have one! Our symbol is the wolf, right? It'd be fitting." "They're wargs, not wolves," Hethia replies dryly. "They may look similar on the outside, but that's about it. World of difference between the two, I'll have you know, the same way a dog isn't a wolf or a falcon isn't a hawk." Arona huffs. "Po-tay-to, po-tah-to. Same difference." It's an encouraging sign, though. For the first time, Arona's actually showing an interest in learning something of her own volition. That's got to have several levels of divine fuckery backing it up somehow. "Just imagine," Arona continues, spreading her hands as if describing the size of a fish that got away. "A longship pulls up on the shore, followed by a howl. Then three hundred wolves and their riders charge off the gangplanks and straight into battle! How amazing would that be?" Plenty, but if she's going to achieve that dream she's going to have to learn how to ride a warg without throwing up all over the place or something. Now then, saddle up. |Azyrran, who looks a little concerned for her mount. "Do you think he'll be uncomfortable, [pc.name]? I just realized I'll have to grip him with the harder parts of my body." It's nice of her to be concerned with the warg's comfort when she looks more unsettled by the prospect of this trip. "Well, vesparans don't have much need for mounts when we can just fly everywhere. I was tempted to ask to just be allowed to fly alongside the convoy, then remembered that it'd be best to remain fresh for the actual expedition. Besides, I'm sure that it'll be quite the experience." That's a good way to look at it. |Kiyoko, who's settled into the saddle as easily as if she was born to it. Now that's a level of familiarity which you weren't expecting from [kiyoko.married|your fox-wife|her]. Has she done this before? "There are clans of oni who raise white wolves as beasts of burden and mounts, beloved. Interesting in that while these animals are now extinct in the wild, having been crowded out by their natural competitors, the wolves themselves persist because of their relationship with these clans. I wonder, how long has it been since a warg has been spotted in the wild?" "One that wasn't traceable back to an escapee from the kennels? I don't think there's been a sighting since the Godswar." Elthara smiles. "The druids have wargs of their own, too, but they don't often cross the outriders' paths." "Mm. The relationship between people and their beasts speaks volumes about both sides." |Atugia, who's having a bit of trouble with her steed. "Whoa, whoa boy. What's gotten into you?" The warg just shakes its tail and lets out a loud whuff of breath. "Oh, I see the problem," Elthara coos, stepping up to the dullahan's side. "Try mounting him again, and hold the collar like this. The saddle spreads out your weight, but you'll still need to lean forward some more. You were treating him as if he were a horse." "Oh. Ah." Atugia tries again, and this time the warg doesn't try to throw her off. "Guess I shouldn't have squeezed so hard with my legs, huh?" "Every animal in the kennels has been trained with outriders for generations now, and even so, there're things that the wargs won't tolerate," Elthara replies. "It's quite the point of pride for them." |Quin, who looks a little uncomfortable sitting astride the giant wolf. It's not surprising and a little amusing, seeing him squirm in the saddle, but it's also fitting given his bunny nature. "Hey, I know what you're thinking," he says. "And yes, I was tempted to ask if I couldn't just run along instead. But... we're going to need every bit of our strength once we reach the temple, right? Even if it wouldn't be a problem for me, there's no need to show off in front of all these lovely elven ladies; I already know how much of a steal I am, after all." You give Quin a wink. Sure thing, sure thing. So long as he doesn't fall off... this is his first time riding a warg, after all. "This is my first time riding anything, to be honest. Unsurprisingly, taeleer don't have much call for personal mounts when we can just leg it anywhere we like. Not that there isn't any call for carts or wagons in the Tael Alliance... but there's a world of difference between sitting in a flatbed cart and riding on the back of some animal." The warg lets out a large whuff of hot breath at that. "Oh, were you upset that I called you an animal? Don't worry about it, so am I. We're both just stupid sexy animals, that's all." He laughs. "All right, [pc.name]. Let's just go before something silly happens, okay?" |Viviane, who's taken off her hat and stowed it wherever the enchantress keeps her things when they're not needed. "To be more aerodynamic, of course," she says before you can even ask. "That, and I don't want it blowing off my head and holding everyone up while I go get it." That, and would she pass by the opportunity to have her hair billow out behind her dramatically while thundering through the woods on the back of a warg? Viv's smile widens. "I say, you're painting quite the tempting picture. It wouldn't hurt to indulge myself a little, would it?" No, it wouldn't. That being said, she doesn't look too uncomfortable — has she tried this sort of thing before? Riding her spirit wolf, maybe? "Once, out of curiosity. No, it didn't work out as I'd hoped, and no, it was nothing like the warg who's under me right now. The saddle and collar really help." Good, because it looks like you're going to be traveling at quite the brisk pace. |Agni, who looks a little concerned for her mount. "Do you think he'll be uncomfortable, [pc.name]? I just realized my legs and arm-wings might get in the way and all" It's nice of her to be concerned with the warg's comfort when she looks more unsettled by the prospect of this trip. "Well, harpies don't have much need for mounts when we can just fly everywhere. I was tempted to ask to just be allowed to fly alongside everyone, then remembered that it'd be best to remain fresh for the actual expedition. Besides, I'm sure that it'll be quite the experience. Of all the things I've done over my lives, I don't remember getting to ride a warg." That's good to hear — despite her breadth of experience, going adventuring with you means she can still find plenty of novelty in the world. Bet she's never delved into the infested mess of an ancient elven temple. "Given that I'm living in one with the hellhound while not out and about with you, I'd like to know what the others are like. Shall we?" ]

[party.randComp cait brint brienne arona azyrran kiyoko atugia quintillus viviane agnimitra |凯特完全被这次旅行中分配给她的、体型像小马一样的犬类坐骑迷住了。“哇，它真的太可爱了吧？看 [pc.name]他正在摇尾巴呢！”嗯，你之前不知道凯特对动物竟然这么感兴趣。不过，再热情也好，她总不能一直抱着她的宠物玩吧，她还有其他事情要去做呢。“就再摸一下吧，好吗？
