[etheryn.crowned |女王 |摄政公主 ] 从那些如今已经破碎的孢子囊中释放出来。当瑞恩从那团散发着霉味的孢子中脱离出来后，他不停地咳嗽，但他们俩看起来都不太可能变成那位大德鲁伊那种扭曲、被寄生虫侵蚀的怪物。 至少我们现在可以确定，赫希娅说的那种感染不会对我们造成影响，这是事实，”莱恩说道。她在艾尔萨拉的帮助下站了起来，虽然还有些摇晃。“除了那次摔倒之外，我现在的感觉还不错。 没有突然产生的冲动，尤其是那些欲望方面的冲动吗？ [etheryn.highLibido |瑞恩强挤出一丝笑容，对你们俩以及艾尔萨拉说道：“至少除了那些平常的事情之外，没有其他特别的事情吧。 |不。 ]话虽如此……”“嗯？”她终于明白你现在的处境了。“哦，哇，原来是一家镜像酒酿造厂。对艾莉莎来说，镜像酒似乎永远都存在于宫殿地窖里的那些无穷无尽的储藏中。这种资源似乎无穷无尽，至少在她的统治时期是这样。历史记载中，我们的德鲁伊都是出色的猎冬人，其中许多人都是依靠这种活动为生的……这确实让人深思，不是吗？艾尔萨拉没有说话，只是轻轻拍了拍瑞恩的肩膀。 瑞恩显然此刻正沉浸在某种愉悦之中——她弯下腰，从满是灰尘和碎片的地上捡起一个瓶子，尽管经历了种种磨难，这个瓶子依然完好无损，真是不可思议……然后 [etheryn.highConfidence |它被扔到地上，摔得粉碎。她的眼睛是不是被什么东西弄到不舒服了？“镜之酒、剃刀杯花蜜、厚皮莓果酱……”她叹了口气，然后挺直肩膀说道：“真是浪费啊。我们走吧。 [pc.name]我再也不想在这里待下去了。 |让它从她的手指中掉落，然后摔得粉碎吧。她是眼睛里进了什么东西吗？“镜之酒、剃刀杯花蜜、厚皮莓果酱。”自从你进入神庙废墟后，瑞恩一直强装镇定，但她的口吃还是偶尔露了出来。“真浪费啊……我们走吧。 [pc.name]这真的让我更加难过了。 ]
rows.raw: ' You dust yourself off and look around, [pc.ass] still stinging from the long fall. The soft carpet of fleshy fungus might've cushioned your landing, but that was still quite the impact — you guess that you must be quite deep underground. Is everyone all right? [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona azyrran kiyoko atugia quintillus viviane agnimitra |"Owww," Cait moans, rubbing her butt. "I most certainly wasn't expecting that to happen." She's fine, right? "Yeah, I guess I am." Cait tries to dust herself off, and makes a face. "Eww, I thought it was bad up there, but the mold down here's everywhere. It's so... sticky and gross." Really? You hadn't noticed. Cait forces a smile at your byplay, but perks up as she looks about her. "Huh, wine. Dad once told Calla and I pale elven druids were once renowned vinters before the Godswar — much was lost not just in the fighting, but also because of the schism in their people. He may not have been intending to visit the Winter City itself, but you apparently can still get mirrorwine in Tychris — they have a thing going with the pale elves ever since one of their princes developed a taste for it. "We've seen a whole bunch of it in Njorhaalt — guess this is where it was made, huh?" |"Oof," Brint groans, pushing himself off the mold-thick floor. "That was close. A bit off to the right, and I would've had two broken horns instead of one. That's one way in which I don't care to be balanced, thank you very much." Walking over, you dust off your minotaur friend while he rubs his head and takes in his surroundings, stamping on the spongy ground with his hooves. "Oh, wow. And I thought it was bad up there." Good thing this fungus stuff can't affect you like it did the druids, huh? "Don't get me wrong, growing up in Khor'minos and the undermountain, you get familiar with all kinds of mushrooms, and plump helmets are just about everywhere. There're good mushrooms, and there're bad mushrooms. This stuff is very definitely bad." It's not like you didn't know that before. "Well, yeah, but seeing it for yourself really drives it home, doesn't it?" Once he's satisfied that his limbs are all working right, Brint gives you a thumbs-up and hefts his [brint.weapon] over his shoulder. "Come on, [pc.name]. I think this place's long overdue for a little pruning." |"Ohhh," Brienne moans, pushing herself off the mold-thick floor. "That was close. A bit off to the right, and I would've broken the same horn. That's an experience I'd rather not live through again, thanks." Walking over, you dust off your cowgirl while she rubs her sore bits and takes in her surroundings. Everything all in one piece? "Yeah," Brienne replies with a weak smile and cups her huge tits in her hands. "I've got plenty of cushioning here to help break falls, don't worry about it." That, and some more padding down below. All right, if she's pulled herself together to make flirty jokes, you don't have to worry about her. "Just trying to cheer you up. You looked a bit down." Slowly, Brienne stamps on the spongy ground with her hooves, making a face. "Oh, eww. And I thought it was bad up there. This is just — eww." Good thing this fungus stuff can't affect you like it did the druids, huh? "Don't get me wrong, growing up in Khor'minos and the undermountain, you get familiar with all kinds of mushrooms, and plump helmets are just about everywhere. There're good mushrooms, and there're bad mushrooms. This stuff is very definitely bad." It's not like you didn't know that before. "Well, yeah, but seeing it for yourself really drives it home, doesn't it?" Finally getting her uncooperative top back into shape, Brienne picks up her [brienne.weapon], reassured by its weight. "Nothing could've really prepared me for this." |"Aw, fuck," Arona groans, pushing herself off the ground and rubbing her jaw. "Fucking ghosts and their dirty tricks, even when you've beat the shit out of them. Fuck ghosts." That's three %"fucks" out of her — she's probably all right, then. "Sweet of you to notice. Yeah, I'm fine. The fall just shook me up a bit, that's all." Forcing a toothy smile, Arona scans the room for her [arona.weapon], and yanks it by the handle out of the moist fungal bed it'd fallen into. She strains a moment, there's a wet sucking sound, and it comes free with a pop. "Aw, shit. That stuff's disgusting. Thank the gods I didn't fall into that on the way down." Yeah, that stuff's just nasty. She could've suffocated — what a way to go. "If I'm going to snuff it, I'd like to have a better showing than that." Satisfied that everything's in order, your orcish companion claps you on the shoulder and looks around her at the rotting racks and presses, whistling. "Well, would you look at this. Sure, these elves may have been cocksleeves through and through, but at least they were cocksleeves who knew how to party; what I wouldn't give to have a stash like this would've been. I could drink every night for a year and not drain it all." Fine wines? You'd have pegged her for more of a mead kind of person. "This is the kind of stuff you bring back home when you've had a good raid, doesn't pay to be picky. And speaking of raiding, pushing that smug elf's face in has only left me wanting more. Come on, [pc.name], let's go find some more ghosts to beat the shit out of." |Azyrran doesn't reply immediately, instead struggling against the soft bed she's landed in — the hardness of her chitin's resulted in her sinking pretty deep into the soft mold. The vile mess clings to her like mud, and it's with your help that she extricates herself with a wet sucking sound. "Ugh," she says, cleaning herself off as best as she can. "Not that I'm not thankful for the soft landing, but maybe it might've been better to take a bruise or two." Doubt it. There isn't a single square inch of floor in this room that isn't covered in fungus of sorts, and the walls... "What about —" Azzy begins, then her eyes alight on the sap slowly oozing from the stone, and she blanches, instinctively taking a step back. After a moment, she swallows hard, squares her shoulders, and gives you a nod. "It's all right. I had to figure that it wasn't honey, not with that sweet stench." Remarkably like it, though. "Yes. Yes, very much so." She takes a deep breath, then as if mesmerized, reaches out to touch the nearest sap-slick wall with a finger; you slap her away, and she shivers and steps back as if woken from a walking dream. "Oh. I..." Is she fine? "I think I'll be. I just need a moment to get ahold of myself. The druidess said that this weapon was targeted at her kind and that we should be largely unaffected by it, but I'm not so sure that's fully the case, at least for me. It's like a whispering on my skin, if that makes sense. An itch that I know won't go away, no matter how much I scratch." |"I am... fine." There's an obvious expression of distaste on Kiyoko's face as your fox-wife pushes herself to her feet, her lip curled ever so slightly. "This place is noisome, to be blunt about it." You look at the carpet of spongy fungus and pinhead mushrooms that cover the floor, and find it hard to disagree. "No time to waste, beloved," she says. "The sooner we are done here, the sooner we can be gone from this place. I am sure that the four of us will be able to make short work of any obstacle in our way." |"Yeah," Atugia says, picking herself up from the ground and hurriedly dusting herself off. She looks for a spot to clean the worst of the moist, freshly crushed fungus off on, finds none, and settles for summoning up her halberd just to be able to scrape off the disgusting stuff. "Well, the arms and legs are working fine, at least. Can't say the fame for the rest o' this stuff — makes my skin crawl." Everything all in one piece? Nothing broken? "Nah. I tucked myself in when the floor gave way — that's a trick I learned back in the day, curl yourself up — then this stuff happened to break my fall. Not saying I ain't grateful to Tira for that bit of luck, but gods does it stink so bad. I just wanna get out of here so I can wash up." Oh, you can understand that sentiment. If her arms and legs are working just fine, then it's time to hit the road. Even if you can't go back the way you came, you get the feeling there's another way out of here. |"Ow, fuck." Quin twitches, groans, and then bounds back onto his feet in a short hop. "Wasn't expecting that kind of bullshit. Thought we'd deal with the head honcho and be done with it, short and sweet... but things are never that easy, are they?" Would they ever be. He looks just fine. "Yeah, could've been worse." Sniffing the air, Quin makes a face. "Ugh, this place stinks. That, and the air's making my fur itch." Hey, it could be worse. At least Hethia said that everyone ought to be unaffected by the fungus' infectious properties, since it was keyed to the druids in order to specifically destroy them. "Ugh. Just thinking about winding up like that archdruid guy makes me shiver. That's the kind of fate I'd want on maybe Tollus... but not anyone else." Rubbing himself and limbering up, Quin looks about the old wine cellar. "Well, if this isn't something.What I wouldn't have given to be allowed in here during its heyday. Would never have left." Then he'd have wound up being buried with the druids. "Sure, I can see how it'd be a difficult decision, but what a way to go!" Is this really the time to be talking about getting completely smashed? "Hey, you've got to keep morale up," Quin retorts. "I could talk about how disgusting all these mushrooms feel, or how hard it is to breathe given the stink, or the way all of this reminds me of a crazy ritual Tollus tried with a chicken, but I think you already know all of that without me having to point it out." |"Well. That was unexpected." Viviane's landed on her back in a thick bed of fungal muck, the disgusting stuff making a soft sucking sound as she extricates herself from the spongy carpet. The enchantress looks appropriately disgusted with her situation, casts a spell to clean herself off, and snorts in disgust when the fungal debris falls off, leaving the smell. "Hat, please." You pick up Viv's enormous hat from where it's fallen during the drop, and hand it to her. She plonks it on her head with no small satisfaction — regardless of how dire the situation might be, at least she has her hat — and looks around her. "Any idea where we are?" Your guess is as good as hers. Some underground portion of the temple, obviously, but beyond that? Nope. "Hmp." Viv finally gives up trying to clean herself off and takes in the old wine cellar, her eyes alighting on the sap that's oozing from the walls. For a moment, she reaches out with a finger, then catches herself when she sees how eroded the masonry's become under the constant flow. "Probably not a good idea, that. Might be unhealthy." But she would have, if not for seeing the stone eaten away? "Well, you're not wrong. Nevertheless, I'm sure there're plenty more interesting things to be found down here, my dear. Why don't we go take a look around?" |"Ow," Agni groans, the phoenix gathering up one of her wings from behind her and massaging it. "That was quite sudden." Is she fine? "Hmm... you know when you try to break into a sprint all of a sudden, and pull something in your legs? I think I just got the wing equivalent of that trying to slow my sudden fall. Would you mind helping me test that bit where this wing joins into my back?" Right here? "Yes. That's —" Agni gently guides your fingers to the point she wants kneaded, and no sooner have you applied pressure that she sucks in a deep, pained breath. "Ow." Is it bad? "It's not unbearable if I don't move it too much, but I think something got sprained. I'm not going to be flying back up the hole, that's for sure.[pc.hasWings| Learn from my mistake, okay? You don't want to launch into the air and suddenly get a cramp or sprain or something. Terrible stuff.]" The hole's too cluttered with roots and mold to fly back up anyway. Is she going to be fine? "I think so." Agni gives her wing an experimental shake. "I'm not hurt or anything, something just got twisted the wrong way since it all happened so suddenly. I'll walk it off in a bit, thank you." ] While you've been righting yourself, Elthara's seen to Ryn, the priestess hauling her [etheryn.crowned |queen |princess-regent ] out of a cluster of now-crushed spore sacs. Ryn's coughing quite a bit after being extricated from the resulting cloud of musty spores, but neither of them look fit to transform into the twisted, infested mockery that the archdruid had become. "Well, at least we know that Hethia's right about the infection not being able to affect us," Ryn says as she stands, albeit shakily as Elthara helps her on her feet. "I'm still feeling quite fine, the fall aside." No sudden urges, especially of the lustful sort? [etheryn.highLibido |Ryn forces a smile at both you and Elthara. "Not aside from the usual, anyway |"No ]. That being said..." Yes? She finally realizes where you've landed right into. "Oh, wow. A mirrorwine distillery. As far as Alissa was concerned, mirrorwine came from the seemingly inexhaustible reserves in the palace's cellars... seemingly inexhaustible, that is, until her reign. The histories say our druids were great vinters, many of whom made their living from it... it makes you think, doesn't it?" Elthara says nothing, but gently pats Ryn on the shoulder. Ryn's clearly having a moment here — she bends down and picks up a bottle from the dust and debris, still miraculously intact despite everything it's been through, then [etheryn.highConfidence |hurls it to the ground where it shatters into pieces. Is she getting something in her eyes? "Mirrorwine, razorcup nectar, brazenberry jam." She sighs and squares her shoulders. "What a waste. Let's go, [pc.name]. I don't want to stay here a moment longer." |lets it fall from her fingers and shatter into pieces. Is she getting something in her eyes? "Mirrorwine, r-razorcup nectar, brazenberry jam." Ryn's been putting up a brave front since you entered the temple ruins, but her old stutter's snuck through, if for a moment. "W-what a waste. Let's go, [pc.name]. T-this is just making me m-more upset." ] '

rows.original: Examine your surroundings. Just where are you?
rows.translation: 观察你周围的环境。你究竟身处何地？
rows.raw: "Examine your surroundings. Just where are you?"

rows.original: With the bridge behind you, you're able to catch your breath and take stock of just where you've ended up. A cul-de-sac as the path past the bridge ends abruptly, giving way to brown, long-dead grass and carpets of little toadstools popping up from the earth. Perhaps in another time this place would've been more open, much like the vineyards and plazas you just passed through on the way here, but right now the earthen ceiling and many thick-stemmed mushrooms give this place the feeling of an enclosed room. There's a pond here, its surface overgrown with green-blue scum; the water itself is tainted to the point of having turned a clear orange. A sense of disturbance rankles your mind as you step closer and explore your surroundings, prodding insistently at the back of your mind. [var0 |After several more moments, you're finally able to place your finger on it. This place is... or rather, would have been a dryad's grove. Look, standing there in the center, clear of all other growth, is... ah, it isn't even recognizable as a tree any longer |In the center stands a tree — or at least, you think it used to be one ]. While the roots still resemble that of a plant, deeply set within the thick, heavy soil underfoot, the rest of this thing is soft and fleshy, spongy mold having crept over and eventually devoured it wholesale, remaking it anew in its image. Long, grasping branches that once reached up for the sky now quite literally grasp for you even as a wall of thorns bursts from the ground, cutting off your retreat across the bridge. Even if the tree itself is immobile, that doesn't mean it can't get at you from a distance; more roots erupt from beneath, grasping at your feet with distinctly lustful intent. Well, damn. As you ready your [pc.weapon], the bulbous crown of the flesh-tree splits open, revealing a maw lined with thorns akin to teeth, the stench of putrid sap coming from deep within. It takes a deep breath, one strong enough to tug at you and suck in pebbles, bits of rotting matter and other plant debris — then exhales, blowing out a dense cloud of glittering blue spores in your direction. So that's why the air is so insufferable... [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona azyrran kiyoko atugia quintillus viviane agnimitra |"Ew, ew, ewwww!" Cait squeals when she's finally able to stop coughing, hurriedly dusting herself off to no avail — the more she slaps at herself, the more the glittering spores stick to her clothes and skin. "This feels absolutely awful!" As difficult as it might be, it's probably a good idea to not breathe in the spores even if they can't infect you; you're already feeling a bit light-headed from that blast of foul breath. "Oh, to have a temple bath right here and now," Cait whines. "At this point, I need to feel clean both inside and out." The feeling's mutual, but right now you have a horrible, mutated tree to deal with. If she could keep herself contained for just a bit longer...? |"Khaak," Brint finally manages to say when he stops coughing. "That's a nasty piece of work, and worse breath than a hobgoblin to boot." He doesn't say. Still, it could be worse, you guess — does he think that this is the wyld tree that Hethia spoke of? You'd have thought it'd be bigger. [var0 |Maybe it's something akin to a dryad, which would explain the grove, or maybe it is just a very powerful dryad? ] "Nah, and not just because you're right that it ought to be bigger. The way Hethia spoke of it, there simply isn't that reverence there — y''know, the feeling I'd have when stepping into the pantheon as a kid, and it's not just because this thing is all as corrupted as get-out. But hey, I've been adventuring with you long enough to know you've got to put down the flunkies before getting to the big guy; that's how these things work. Let's get to it, shall we?" |"Eww, nasty," Brienne finally manages to say when she stops coughing. "That's a nasty piece of work, and worse breath than a hobgoblin to boot." She doesn't say. Still, it could be worse, you guess — doess he think that this is the wyld tree that Hethia spoke of? You'd have thought it'd be bigger. [var0 |Maybe it's something akin to a dryad, which would explain the grove, or maybe it is just a very powerful dryad? ] "Nah, and not just because you're right that it ought to be bigger. The way Hethia spoke of it, there simply isn't that reverence there — something like the feeling I'd get when stepping into the pantheon when I was younger, and it's not just because this thing is as corrupted as... eww. Nevertheless, I've been adventuring with you long enough to know you've got to put down the little ones before getting to the big guy; that's how these things work. Let's get to it, shall we?" |"So, we're down to cutting vegetables, huh?" Arona growls, hefting her [arona.weapon] and smashing apart several roots that reach for her feet. The fungus-infested plant gnashes its nectar-dripping maw in a silent scream, lashing out for her with its spongy branches. "I guess I don't mind if it's something this big." Privately, you think that Arona is just happy to have something to fight that isn't made of ectoplasm, but the sheer enthusiasm with which she throws herself into battle is admittedly quite inspiring. "Hey, don't give me that look!" she calls over her shoulder at you as she smacks away several more roots. "A proper orc's got to know how to defend herself from anything, even if it's an oversized vegetable. Now get over here and back me up!" |Azyrran scowls at the sight of the nectar-dripping maw and wordlessly levels the business end of her [azyrran.weapon] at the fungus-tree amalgamation. Maybe it hits just a little too close to home, given what ultimately ended up corrupting her hive... her gaze is steely, and she presses her attack with resolute fervor. Now, you aren't about to let her steal all the glory, are you? |"Oh. This is... foul." You've never seen such absolute disdain from [kiyoko.married |your fox-wife |Kiyoko ] as she shakes out her clothing in a vain bid to get the glittering spores out from the fabric. "When we get home, I really must have these clothes burned; there is no saving them at this point." She seems quite unhurried when faced with a ravening plant-fungus mashup that's trying to kill her or worse, but then, [kiyoko.married |your fox-wife |Kiyoko ] has never been one for being ruffled, even while incinerating vines and roots reaching for her with carefully applied gouts of foxfire. There is something, though. "Yes, beloved?" Does she think that this is the wyld tree that Hethia spoke of? You'd have thought it'd be bigger.[var0 | Maybe it's something akin to a dryad, which would explain the grove, or maybe it is just a very powerful dryad? ] Kiyoko tilts her head at you and gives you a funny look while sending forward a wave of intense foxfire. "You have seen and entered the sacred tree which we live in, beloved. I cannot speak for the native elves, but one would imagine that a specimen they once venerated as a kami would just as large, if not more so. Otherwise, it would be extremely awkward, to say the least. I would not wager that this is it, no." Well, that explanation makes sense. "That, and there is a distinct lack of veneration, of gravitas, and not just because the tree is befouled. No, there is always the possibility that I am wrong of course, but I would imagine that it is rather remote." |"Wow." Atugia runs her fingers through her hair in a futile bid to get the worst of the glittering spores out — you do note, though, that they're the same color as the tattoos on her skin, if that signifies anything. It probably doesn't. "This is nasty." And not just because it smells really bad — the way it sticks to you makes you feel all uneasy from head to toe. "Don't ya say it." Atugia's runes flare up on her body as she advances upon the fungus-plant mashup, chopping off several tendrils as they reach for her. "Might as well do Ryn's folks a favor and clear out their garden for them, huh? Be good neighbors, like Carmen always wanted to." If the boreal elves are actually looking to resettle the temples, they're not going to do it with a twisted tree spewing choking spores all over the place. Good neighbors, as Atugia said... |"Wow. This stuff is nasty." Coughing, Quin tries in vain to dust the glowing glitter from his clothes while dancing about several grasping roots with a show of fancy footwork — it'd be more impressive if he didn't look absolutely ridiculous doing it. "This stuff's even worse than some of the things Tollus cooked up. It's never going to come out, is it?" At this point, he might as well just throw the lot away once you're out of here. "Yeah, I would, but... you got me this stuff, you know. That has a bit of weight to it, if you understand what I mean. Can't just walk into a shop and ger new ones." While that's very flattering, you can't help but note that there's a slavering plant monster out for your blood. If he doesn't mind? Quin chuckles at that. "Glad to know that I'm good for something around you, at least. Can't let you get all the glory, eh?" |"Well, if this isn't just nasty," Viv says, making a face. She's taken off her hat and used it to shield herself from the blast of spores, and now it's caked with a moist layer of the glittering stuff. [silly |That's it, the hat is doomed. The glitter's never going to come out of the fabric. Never. ] "Then again, I suppose getting this out of my hat is going to be just another problem to solve in the days to come." Come to think of it, does she think that this is the wyld tree that Hethia mentioned? [var0 | Maybe it's something akin to a dryad, which would explain the grove, or maybe it is just a very powerful dryad? ] Probably not, but you don't want to just dismiss it out of hand without a second opinion. Viv considers that, casually incinerating several roots that try to reach for her ankles. "Hmm, I don't think so. Sure, it's pretty enough, and the grove must've been something in its day, but it doesn't have the sense of import that the druidess implied it ought to. I mean, if I were a pale elf, I wouldn't worship that thing." To be fair, she wouldn't worship anything. "Well, that's true, but that's why I said if I were a pale elf. Now if you don't mind, shall we put this thing out of its misery?" |"Eww. Just... it smells terrible!" Making a face, Agni tries to dust her feathers free of the glittering blue spores, and when that fails she flares up briefly, burning them from her feathers. The same can't be said for those that stick to her clothes, though[silly |; knowing the proclivities of glitter, that's never going to come out ]. If she could concentrate for a moment... Agni doesn't even look over her shoulder as she sears several fleshy vine-tentacles whipping in her direction. "I'm a bit busy here, but yes?" She's lived many lives — has she ever seen anything like this? Not the fungus-plant bit, but the grove, that is.[var0 | Feels like a dryad's grove to you. ] "Don't rightly remember, there's so much I've forgotten and this isn't something I'd care to remember across deaths. Now, if you don't mind, I'd really rather not wind up as a plume again — there's still so much for me to see and do in this lifetime!" ] "Watch out!" Ryn yells as she aims for the infested hybrid, loosing a salvo of arrows over at it; the creature sucks in another deep breath, and looses another billowing exhalation of spores that leaves the air even more choking and unbreathable than before. "We need to get rid of this thing quickly, before the spores overwhelm us!" It's a fight, and you'd better make haste!
rows.translation: 当你走过那座桥后，便可以喘口气，仔细审视自己现在所处的位置。小路在桥后突然终结，形成了一条死胡同，那里长满了枯黄的老草，地上还散布着许多小蘑菇。或许在另一个时候，这个地方会变得更加开阔，就像你来这里的路上刚刚经过的那些葡萄园和广场一样，但此刻，土制的天花板以及许多粗茎蘑菇让这个地方给人一种封闭空间的感觉。 这里有一个池塘，其表面覆盖着青绿色的浮渣；水本身也被污染了，颜色已经变成了清澈的橙色。当你走近并观察周围的环境时，一种不安的感觉会不断萦绕在你的脑海中，不断地刺激着你的神经。 [var0 |又过了几秒钟，你终于能够将手指放在那个物体上。这个地方……或者说，本来应该是一片干神树丛。看，就在中间那里，没有任何其他植物生长，矗立着的那东西……啊，它甚至已经无法被认出是一棵树了。 |在中心矗立着一棵树——至少，你是这么认为的。思考它曾经是其中之一。 ]虽然它的根部仍然像植物的根部一样，深深扎根于足部下的肥沃土壤之中，但它的其他部分东西这棵树原本柔软多肉，如今却被一种海绵状的霉菌侵蚀殆尽——这种霉菌逐渐蔓延开来，最终将整棵树彻底吞没，将其重塑成了自己的模样。那些曾经高耸入云、仿佛要抓住天空的树枝，如今却实实在在地伸向着你；与此同时，一堵由荆棘构成的墙也从地面冒了出来，切断了你穿过桥梁的退路。即使这棵树本身静止不动，也不意味着它不能从远处攻击你——更多的根系会从地下钻出来，以极其凶狠的姿态抓住你的足部。唉，真见鬼……当你准备 [pc.weapon]肉树的球状树冠突然裂开，露出一个布满尖刺的裂口，那些尖刺就像牙齿一样；从树的内部散发出来的，是令人作呕的腐烂汁液的气味。它深吸一口气——那股气息如此强劲，仿佛能将周围的碎石、腐烂物屑以及其他植物残渣都吸入其中——然后呼出，将一大团闪闪发光的蓝色孢子朝你的方向吹去。就这样。那就是为什么空气变得如此难以忍受…… [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona azyrran kiyoko atugia quintillus viviane agnimitra |呃，呃，哇啊！”当凯特终于停止咳嗽时，她惊叫道。她急忙拍打自己的身体，试图去除那些闪闪发光的孢子，但却毫无效果——她拍得越用力，这些孢子就越粘在她的衣服和皮肤上。“这种感觉简直糟透了！尽管这可能很困难，但最好还是不要吸入那些孢子，即使它们不会感染你；毕竟那股恶臭已经让你感到头晕目眩了。“哦，要是在现在就能在这里洗个澡该多好啊……”凯特哀叹道。在这个时候，我需要让自己从内到外都感到干净。”这种感觉是相互的，但眼下你却得先处理那棵变异得可怕的树……如果她能再忍耐一会儿的话……？ |咳，”布林特终于在停止咳嗽后说道，“那个家伙真是个讨厌的家伙，而且他的口气比地精还要难闻。”他并没有说出来。不过，情况本可能更糟吧——他难道认为这就是赫希娅提到的那棵野生树木吗？你可能会觉得它应该更大一些才对。 [var0 |也许它类似于某种树精，这样才能解释为什么会有那片树林……又或者，也许还有其他原因。是只是一个非常强大的树精而已吗？ ] 不行，不仅仅是因为你说得对，它确实应该做得更大一些。但从赫希娅描述的方式来看，其中确实缺乏那种敬畏之情——你知道的，那种当我小时候走进神殿时所感受到的那种氛围。而且问题也不仅仅在于这个东西已经腐朽到了极点。不过，我和你一起冒险这么久了，也知道在解决主要问题之前，必须先处理那些小麻烦；事情就是这么发展的。我们开始吧？ |呃，真恶心，”布蕾妮终于在停止咳嗽后说道，“那个家伙真讨厌，而且他的口气比地精还要难闻。”她没有说出口。不过，情况本可能更糟吧……他难道认为这就是赫希娅提到的那棵古树吗？你本来会以为它应该更大一些才对。 [var0 |也许它类似于某种树精，这样才能解释为什么会有那片树林……又或者，也许还有其他原因。是只是一个非常强大的树精吗？ ] 不行，不仅仅是因为你说得对，它确实应该做得更大一些。但从赫希娅描述的方式来看，其中确实缺乏那种敬畏之情——那种感觉就像我年轻时走进神殿时所体验到的那种氛围。当然，也不仅仅是因为这个东西已经腐败到……呃，实在让人难以接受。不过，我和你一起冒险这么久了，也知道在处理大事之前，必须先解决那些小事；事情就是这么发展的。那么，我们开始吧？ |所以，现在就只剩下切蔬菜了，是吧？”阿罗娜低声说道，同时举起了手中的蔬菜。 [arona.weapon] 那些菌类侵蚀的植物发出无声的“尖叫”，用它那布满菌丝的枝条猛烈地攻击她。那些伸向她足部部的根茎也被狠狠地折断。我想，如果对手是这么大的家伙，我应该也不会介意吧……在私下里，你认为阿罗娜之所以乐于参与战斗，只是因为对手并非由幽灵物质构成而已；但不可否认，她投入战斗时的那份热情确实令人振奋。 嘿，别用那种眼神看我！”她一边一边拍掉几根杂草，一边回头对你说，“一个真正的兽人总得学会如何保护自己才行。任何东西就算那是一颗超大号的蔬菜也好。现在过来，帮我一把吧！ |阿兹兰一看到那个滴着甘液的巨口，顿时面露怒容，然后默默地用武器对准了它的要害部位。 [azyrran.weapon] 在那个由真菌与树木构成的混合体面前。考虑到最终导致她的蜂巢腐败的原因，这个场景未免显得太过触目惊心了……她的目光如钢铁般坚定，带着无比坚决的斗志发动了攻击。现在，你总不会让她独占所有的荣耀吧？ |哦，这个是…… 犯规你从未见过如此彻底的蔑视 [kiyoko.married |你的狐狸精妻子 |清子 ] 当她摇晃着自己的衣物，试图将那些闪闪发光的孢子从布料上抖掉时，说道：“等我们回到家，我一定要把这些衣服烧掉；现在已经没法挽救它们了。”面对这种试图杀死她的、由植物和真菌组成的致命混合物，她似乎一点也不慌张。不过，话说回来 [kiyoko.married |你的狐狸精妻子 |清子 ] 她从来都不是那种会被轻易扰乱的人，即使面对那些试图用狐火灼烧她的藤蔓和根须，她也依然镇定自若。不过，还是有一点不同寻常的地方……“嗯，亲爱的？”她难道认为这就是赫希娅所说的那棵古树吗？你本以为它会更大一些才对。[var0 | 也许它类似于某种树精，这样才能解释为什么会有那片树林……又或者，也许还有其他原因。是只是一个非常强大的树精吗？ ] 清子歪着头看着你，露出一个有趣的表情，同时释放出一阵强烈的狐火。“亲爱的，你已经看到了我们居住的那棵神圣之树，也进入了它的内部。我无法代表那些原住民精灵们来说话，但可以想象，他们曾经将这棵树视为神明它的规模应该同样大，甚至可能更大。否则的话，至少可以说，这种情况会显得非常尴尬。不过，我不敢肯定这就是原因。”“嗯，这个解释确实有道理。”“还有，人们对这棵树显然缺乏应有的敬畏之情，缺乏应有的庄重态度。当然，也有可能是我搞错了，但我觉得这种可能性相当小。 |哇。”阿图吉娅用手指捋了捋自己的头发，试图把那些闪闪发光的孢子弄掉——不过你可能会注意到，这些孢子的颜色和她皮肤上的纹身是一样的，如果这有什么意义的话的话……大概也没有什么意义吧。“这真是糟糕的不仅仅是因为它散发着难闻的气味——那种粘附在身上的感觉会让你从头到足部都感到不适。 “你说得对。”阿图吉娅身上的符文亮了起来，她朝着这种由真菌和植物混合而成的怪物冲了过去，砍断了那些试图触碰到她的触须。不妨帮瑞恩的家人个忙，把他们的花园清理干净吧？这样才是好邻居该做的，就像卡门一直希望我们做的那样。”如果那些极北精灵真的打算重新定居在这些神庙里，他们肯定不会让那些会散发致命孢子的扭曲树木遍布四周的。好邻居，正如阿图吉娅所说…… |哇，这些东西真是糟糕的咳嗽着，昆因一边跳着舞躲避那些缠绕着的根茎，一边试图擦掉自己衣服上那些闪闪发光的颗粒——要是他做这些动作时不会显得如此滑稽可笑的话，反而会更有说服力一些。这种东西甚至比托勒斯搞出来的一些东西还要糟糕。这种东西永远也不会被公开发布吧？”“既然你都已经离开了，他干脆把这些东西全部扔掉算了。”“是啊，我也会这么做的，但是……你专门为我搞到了这些东西，你懂我的意思吧？这确实意义重大，不能随便去商店就能买到新的。”虽然这话听起来很讨人喜欢，但你还是不得不注意到，现在有一只凶残的植物怪物正在追杀你呢。如果他不介意的话？昆因听到这话笑了笑：“至少很高兴知道，在你身边，我还能派上点用场。总不能让你一个人揽所有的功劳吧，嗯？ |哎呀，这可真是太恶心了，”薇芙说着，做出了一个鬼脸。她摘下帽子，用它来遮挡那些孢子的喷射，现在那帽子上覆盖着一层湿漉漉的、闪闪发光的孢子。 [silly |就这样，这顶帽子完了。那些亮片永远也洗不掉，永远都洗不掉。 ] 不过，我想凭空想出这个主意，未来也只会成为另一个需要解决的问题罢了。”仔细想想，她难道认为这就是赫希娅提到的那棵‘野生之树’吗？ [var0 | 也许它类似于某种树精，这样才能解释为什么会有那片树林……又或者，也许还有其他原因。是只是一个非常强大的树精吗？ ] 大概不会，但你不应该不加考虑就直接否定它。薇芙随意地烧掉了几根试图触碰到她足部踝的树根，说道：“嗯，我不这么认为。当然，这片树林看起来确实挺漂亮的，它在过去的某个时期肯定也很有价值，但它并没有那位德鲁伊所说的那种重要性。我的意思是，如果我是苍白精灵的话，我也不会崇拜这样的东西。”公平地说，她也不会崇拜它。任何东西嗯，确实是这样，但正因为如此，我才那么说的。如果我曾经是一个苍白的精灵。现在，如果你不介意的话，我们是不是应该让这个家伙摆脱这种痛苦呢？ |呃，真的……这味道太难闻了！”阿格尼做出一副嫌恶的表情，试图用翅膀拍掉那些闪闪发光的蓝色孢子，但没能成功，于是她短暂地燃烧了一下，将这些孢子从自己的羽毛上烧掉。不过，那些粘在她的衣服上的孢子，就没法用这种方法处理了。[silly |因为了解闪光的特性，所以知道那东西永远都不会脱落。 ]如果她能集中注意力一会儿的话…… 阿格尼甚至都没有回头看，就直接烧掉了几条朝她方向伸来的肉质藤蔓触手。“我现在有点忙，不过……嗯，可以吧？” 她已经经历过许多次重生了——难道她以前见过这样的场景吗？不是指那种真菌植物，而是指这片树林本身。[var0 | 对你来说，这里就像是一片干神树丛生的森林。 ] 不太记得了，有太多事情我已经忘记了，而这种事情，我实在不希望在一次次重生之后还继续记得。现在，如果你们不介意的话，我真希望这次重生之后不要再变成一只羽毛……这一生，我还有太多事情想要去看、去做呢！ ] 小心！”蕾恩大喊着，瞄准那只被寄生虫侵扰的混合生物，朝它射出了一连串箭矢；那只生物又深吸了一口气，随后再次喷出了大量孢子，使得空气变得更加浑浊，令人难以呼吸。我们必须尽快处理掉这个东西，否则孢子会让我们陷入困境！”这是一场战斗，你最好加快速度！
rows.raw: " With the bridge behind you, you're able to catch your breath and take stock of just where you've ended up. A cul-de-sac as the path past the bridge ends abruptly, giving way to brown, long-dead grass and carpets of little toadstools popping up from the earth. Perhaps in another time this place would've been more open, much like the vineyards and plazas you just passed through on the way here, but right now the earthen ceiling and many thick-stemmed mushrooms give this place the feeling of an enclosed room. There's a pond here, its surface overgrown with green-blue scum; the water itself is tainted to the point of having turned a clear orange. A sense of disturbance rankles your mind as you step closer and explore your surroundings, prodding insistently at the back of your mind. [var0 |After several more moments, you're finally able to place your finger on it. This place is... or rather, would have been a dryad's grove. Look, standing there in the center, clear of all other growth, is... ah, it isn't even recognizable as a tree any longer |In the center stands a tree — or at least, you think it used to be one ]. While the roots still resemble that of a plant, deeply set within the thick, heavy soil underfoot, the rest of this thing is soft and fleshy, spongy mold having crept over and eventually devoured it wholesale, remaking it anew in its image. Long, grasping branches that once reached up for the sky now quite literally grasp for you even as a wall of thorns bursts from the ground, cutting off your retreat across the bridge. Even if the tree itself is immobile, that doesn't mean it can't get at you from a distance; more roots erupt from beneath, grasping at your feet with distinctly lustful intent. Well, damn. As you ready your [pc.weapon], the bulbous crown of the flesh-tree splits open, revealing a maw lined with thorns akin to teeth, the stench of putrid sap coming from deep within. It takes a deep breath, one strong enough to tug at you and suck in pebbles, bits of rotting matter and other plant debris — then exhales, blowing out a dense cloud of glittering blue spores in your direction. So that's why the air is so insufferable... [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona azyrran kiyoko atugia quintillus viviane agnimitra |"Ew, ew, ewwww!" Cait squeals when she's finally able to stop coughing, hurriedly dusting herself off to no avail — the more she slaps at herself, the more the glittering spores stick to her clothes and skin. "This feels absolutely awful!" As difficult as it might be, it's probably a good idea to not breathe in the spores even if they can't infect you; you're already feeling a bit light-headed from that blast of foul breath. "Oh, to have a temple bath right here and now," Cait whines. "At this point, I need to feel clean both inside and out." The feeling's mutual, but right now you have a horrible, mutated tree to deal with. If she could keep herself contained for just a bit longer...? |"Khaak," Brint finally manages to say when he stops coughing. "That's a nasty piece of work, and worse breath than a hobgoblin to boot." He doesn't say. Still, it could be worse, you guess — does he think that this is the wyld tree that Hethia spoke of? You'd have thought it'd be bigger. [var0 |Maybe it's something akin to a dryad, which would explain the grove, or maybe it is just a very powerful dryad? ] "Nah, and not just because you're right that it ought to be bigger. The way Hethia spoke of it, there simply isn't that reverence there — y''know, the feeling I'd have when stepping into the pantheon as a kid, and it's not just because this thing is all as corrupted as get-out. But hey, I've been adventuring with you long enough to know you've got to put down the flunkies before getting to the big guy; that's how these things work. Let's get to it, shall we?" |"Eww, nasty," Brienne finally manages to say when she stops coughing. "That's a nasty piece of work, and worse breath than a hobgoblin to boot." She doesn't say. Still, it could be worse, you guess — doess he think that this is the wyld tree that Hethia spoke of? You'd have thought it'd be bigger. [var0 |Maybe it's something akin to a dryad, which would explain the grove, or maybe it is just a very powerful dryad? ] "Nah, and not just because you're right that it ought to be bigger. The way Hethia spoke of it, there simply isn't that reverence there — something like the feeling I'd get when stepping into the pantheon when I was younger, and it's not just because this thing is as corrupted as... eww. Nevertheless, I've been adventuring with you long enough to know you've got to put down the little ones before getting to the big guy; that's how these things work. Let's get to it, shall we?" |"So, we're down to cutting vegetables, huh?" Arona growls, hefting her [arona.weapon] and smashing apart several roots that reach for her feet. The fungus-infested plant gnashes its nectar-dripping maw in a silent scream, lashing out for her with its spongy branches. "I guess I don't mind if it's something this big." Privately, you think that Arona is just happy to have something to fight that isn't made of ectoplasm, but the sheer enthusiasm with which she throws herself into battle is admittedly quite inspiring. "Hey, don't give me that look!" she calls over her shoulder at you as she smacks away several more roots. "A proper orc's got to know how to defend herself from anything, even if it's an oversized vegetable. Now get over here and back me up!" |Azyrran scowls at the sight of the nectar-dripping maw and wordlessly levels the business end of her [azyrran.weapon] at the fungus-tree amalgamation. Maybe it hits just a little too close to home, given what ultimately ended up corrupting her hive... her gaze is steely, and she presses her attack with resolute fervor. Now, you aren't about to let her steal all the glory, are you? |"Oh. This is... foul." You've never seen such absolute disdain from [kiyoko.married |your fox-wife |Kiyoko ] as she shakes out her clothing in a vain bid to get the glittering spores out from the fabric. "When we get home, I really must have these clothes burned; there is no saving them at this point." She seems quite unhurried when faced with a ravening plant-fungus mashup that's trying to kill her or worse, but then, [kiyoko.married |your fox-wife |Kiyoko ] has never been one for being ruffled, even while incinerating vines and roots reaching for her with carefully applied gouts of foxfire. There is something, though. "Yes, beloved?" Does she think that this is the wyld tree that Hethia spoke of? You'd have thought it'd be bigger.[var0 | Maybe it's something akin to a dryad, which would explain the grove, or maybe it is just a very powerful dryad? ] Kiyoko tilts her head at you and gives you a funny look while sending forward a wave of intense foxfire. "You have seen and entered the sacred tree which we live in, beloved. I cannot speak for the native elves, but one would imagine that a specimen they once venerated as a kami would just as large, if not more so. Otherwise, it would be extremely awkward, to say the least. I would not wager that this is it, no." Well, that explanation makes sense. "That, and there is a distinct lack of veneration, of gravitas, and not just because the tree is befouled. No, there is always the possibility that I am wrong of course, but I would imagine that it is rather remote." |"Wow." Atugia runs her fingers through her hair in a futile bid to get the worst of the glittering spores out — you do note, though, that they're the same color as the tattoos on her skin, if that signifies anything. It probably doesn't. "This is nasty." And not just because it smells really bad — the way it sticks to you makes you feel all uneasy from head to toe. "Don't ya say it." Atugia's runes flare up on her body as she advances upon the fungus-plant mashup, chopping off several tendrils as they reach for her. "Might as well do Ryn's folks a favor and clear out their garden for them, huh? Be good neighbors, like Carmen always wanted to." If the boreal elves are actually looking to resettle the temples, they're not going to do it with a twisted tree spewing choking spores all over the place. Good neighbors, as Atugia said... |"Wow. This stuff is nasty." Coughing, Quin tries in vain to dust the glowing glitter from his clothes while dancing about several grasping roots with a show of fancy footwork — it'd be more impressive if he didn't look absolutely ridiculous doing it. "This stuff's even worse than some of the things Tollus cooked up. It's never going to come out, is it?" At this point, he might as well just throw the lot away once you're out of here. "Yeah, I would, but... you got me this stuff, you know. That has a bit of weight to it, if you understand what I mean. Can't just walk into a shop and ger new ones." rows.original:
You gaze down at the dryad — Lanniere, was it? — panting on the ground, her tongue lolling from her mouth as she humps away, and shake your head. Grabbing Ryn and Elthara by a shoulder each, you spin them around and start retracing your steps back across the bridge.
        
        "[pc.name], I —" Ryn begins, but you shake your head and gently urge her to keep on walking. [etheryn.highConfidence
            |Ryn balks at that and brushes your hand aside. "We can't just leave her like that, [pc.name]!"
            |Ryn acquiesces, but still protests. "Are you sure it's okay to leave her like that?"
        ]
        
        You sigh. What would she have you do, then? Put the dryad out of her misery? Because that's the only thing that would make sense under these circumstances.
        
        "I didn't mean it that way! And... just ending her without trying anything else first?"
        
        That's why you're opting to not do anything now. That fleshy fungal thing that was once the tree that Lanniere inhabited — it's not constantly breathing out spores any longer, and the air's a bit more breathable. By the time the both of them recover, you should be done here, and you can leave her to the valkyries or whoever who comes after to clean up after the mess you've made of this place.
        
        "So you're making it their problem instead."
        
        Yes.
        
        Ryn looks to Elthara for help, but the priestess merely gives her a weak smile.
        
        "[pc.HeShe]'s right, dear. Maybe... maybe Lumia's blessed will be able to do something for her that we can't. We still have to look to ourselves and escape this place before seeing to others."
        
        It's an answer that Ryn doesn't like, either, but faced with the both of you she doesn't have an argument at hand. With the air slightly clearer and you able to breathe better, you take one last measure of the grove before preparing to leave...

I'd be more worried if you weren't moved by all that, watching that deer-lady pass on. At this point, though, there's no point second-guessing yourself. "That being said, with everything we've seen here so far... phew, no wonder why Tollus was so interested in all that Belharan and Godswar stuff. Imagine if he'd this kind of power at his disposal — he might even set his sights above trying to take a podunk little border village in the middle of nowhere." If nothing else, you appreciate the joke. "Look at that smile, it looks much better on you, [pc.name]. Now keep that chin up, we've got to get out of here, and I feel like we've got a long road ahead of us." |When you return to Viviane, she's dusting off her hat [viviane.isDemon |and idly cleaning off her nails with each other. "Oh. Are you finally done? That took way longer than it ought to have, not that it's a surprise with how weepy that bimbo's gotten." Yes. You're getting the impression that she's less than impressed with what's happened. "Oh, of course. What a terrible and absolute waste that was, even if I understand that ingratiating ourselves to the elves who want to eventually resettle the locale is more important. But it'd have been a great opportunity to find out if fey creatures like that have souls, or if they're just big blobs of magic. There's painfully little established literature on the matter of dryads, you understand — I'm sure a good fucking or two would've been all that was needed for that poor thing to cum out any soul that she might've had. "But choices are rarely good in all aspects, and you really just have to pick what aligns the most with your interests, aren't I right?" ...Right. | and looking tight-lipped. "Did everything go well?" As well as it might've been. "It looked fairly painless." She sighs, and plops back her hat on her head. "You probably ought to see to your elven friends later. They appear pretty shaken up by the whole thing. I know that you did what you thought was best given the circumstances, but this is the kind of thing which shakes morale pretty badly. I know you'll handle it well, though." It's nice to have someone who has such confidence in you. "Hey, I wouldn't have followed you on this expedition if you weren't worthy of it, right?" ] |"It never gets old," Agni says with a sigh, wiping her brow. "Even after having died myself over and over again, it never feels good making that kind of deliberate choice to end someone." And it shouldn't. You're glad she feels that way even if she weren't the one to make the decision, or the one to carry it out. The stereotype in stories about ancient people like her is that they're all jaded out the ears, but having Agni like this and willing to say it makes a whole lot of difference. She says nothing at first, but glances over at Elthara, who's comforting Ryn, then back to you. "Yeah. Sure, we both know that it was the best course of action knowing that she was likely unsavable... but the fact that you didn't do it unthinkingly is what's important. Thanks, [pc.name]." No, you're the one who ought to thank her for this vote of confidence in you. "They're getting ahead — I think we should catch up, lest the party winds up split." ] With the grim deed done, the air's a little more breathable, and there's no risk that the corrupted dryad grove will pose any further threat to you while you're busy elsewhere. Time to move on...

你艰难地咽了口唾沫，带着瑞恩离开小树林，在桥边等待，然后招手让艾尔萨拉也过来，一起前往兰尼尔的树下。自从你第一次遇见瑞恩以来，她已经成长了许多，但这些决定她并不需要亲自去面对。还没有。女祭司向你投来一个意味深长的眼神，两人静静地注视着兰尼埃——那个无助的干尸，在你们注视的目光下不断扭动身体。仅仅因为你们距离如此之近，这种压力就已经足以让她全身因无法满足的渴望而颤抖起来。随着一声轻柔的呻吟，那干尸突然向上跃起，将一大股带有麝香气味的液体喷洒在泥土上。 你以为这样就能证明你的观点是正确的吗？艾尔萨拉应该还记得被钉在祭坛上的那种感觉吧？如果你的计算没有出错的话，这位树精已经处于这种状态超过两个世纪了。“她已经无药可救了，对吧？ 艾尔萨拉提出这个问题的方式其实暗示着她已经知道了答案，尽管这个答案可能令人难以接受。虽然你不能完全排除某种奇迹发生的可能性，但你现在既没有时间也没有资源去判断哪种奇迹才适合在这种情况下发生，更何况她的情况或许还没有那么糟糕。艾尔萨拉刚打算把手放在那名过度性欲旺盛的精灵的额头上，却突然看到那家伙的阴囊中又喷出了大量香气扑鼻的精液，每一滴都足有甜瓜那么大。 那么……我们该怎么做呢？ [var0 |根据你在旅途中遇到的其他树精们的说法，它们其实就是其所栖息树木的精灵。只要将那些树木毁掉，它们就应该就会消失。 |嗯，既然那棵树似乎是干尸的来源，那么摧毁它应该就能解决问题，对吧？ ] 那看来就只能由我来做了。”你留在这里，确保兰尼尔的离世过程尽可能没有痛苦。你回头确认瑞恩仍然背对着即将发生的那一幕，然后向艾尔萨拉点了点头，示意她继续行动。女祭司闭上了眼睛，握紧了拳头，然后朝着那棵树走去。“如果……如果我也变成了这样的一个人，我不确定自己是否还会继续坚持下去。”不……幸运的是，事实并非如此。用贝尔哈兰人的说法来说，艾尔萨拉是莱恩身边一位非常值得信赖的助手。然而，她内心也有着属于自己的渴望——当心情好的时候，她也很乐意享受马拉赫与卢米娅带来的祝福。要不是她的女神及时出手，让她在危难时刻得到了救援，她恐怕早就…… 艾尔萨拉没有说任何话，只是抬头望着那棵正在颤抖的真菌树，伸出双手向它喷射出白色的火焰。它的巨口无声地张开，喷出了几阵闪闪发光的蓝色孢子，但由于它的许多根茎和树枝已经被切断或严重受损，因此它已经无法再有效地进行抗性了。拼命地尝试着去做某件事，任何东西那棵被腐蚀的干树发出嘶嘶声，伴随着刺鼻的真菌气味，不断爆裂。如果你身边的干树精灵因为她的树被毁而感到任何痛苦，她其实并没有感觉到——或者也许，她的腐蚀已经侵蚀了她的一切，使得她再也无法感受到其他任何感觉了。当你轻抚她的额头，低声安慰她时，她轻轻地呜咽着、呻吟着；而艾尔萨拉则面无表情地继续着她的工作。就在最后那一刻，兰尼尔的腐化开始随着她的身体一同消退，那干尸般的身躯重新恢复了正常的比例，她皮肤上那种病态的甜腻光泽也消失了。在最后的那些时刻，出现在你面前的，是一位身形苗条、没有阴茎的树精。她的眼神中充满感激，用你听不懂但依然能理解的博尔阿尔瓦林语低声说了几句话。就这样，她消失了，化作了一阵蓝色的火花消散在了空气中。艾尔萨拉望着那棵树剩下的焦黑树桩，又看了看那些枯萎的干尸树丛，然后低下了头。“我们走吧。 [pc.name]她的声音有些颤抖，显然她在极力忍住泪水不让自己哭出来。 [etheryn.crowned |女王 |摄政王夫人 ] 正在等待我们。 [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona azyrran kiyoko atugia quintillus viviane agnimitra |那真是……”凯特将耳朵耷拉向两侧，从[cait.armor]里掏出手帕，狼狈地擤了擤鼻子。“真希望我们能帮她更多。虽然我们只认识了她短短几分钟，但发生的事情实在太令人难过了。”在这种情况下，你已经尽力了；你还是必须活着离开这个地方。“我知道。即便如此……”凯特最后回头看了一眼那具正在燃烧的肉质真菌混合体残骸，“你们都看到了她遭遇了什么。我想她现在应该已经安息了吧。我们能做的，也只有这样期待了。 |哦，”布林特低声说道，“我……”他在哭吗？他朝你微微一笑：“只是有些孢子进入了我的眼睛，而已。虽然它们没能对我产生什么影响，但还是让人觉得特别痒。是的，你懂我的意思。 “有时候你会在论坛上听到这样的故事：一些退伍军人退役后无事可做，就只能坐在论坛里讲这些故事。我想我现在对他们有了更深的理解了。 |哦，”布蕾妮轻声说道，“我……”她在哭，对吧？当布蕾妮除了抽泣之外没有其他回应时，你就上前紧紧地抱住她。这类举动并不总是那么美好，但它们能让你时刻记住自己正在为什么而奋斗。“我不太确定。我为你而战，[pc.name]。如果你认为这很重要，那么它确实很重要。”好姑娘。 |阿罗娜在桥上等着你，双臂交叉，同时也在注视着莱恩。“终于来了，你花了太长时间了。”你确实需要确保一切都做得恰到好处，不过，没错，那棵树以及那片树林已经不复存在了。“好吧，那我们走吧。没必要为此感到难过。 她似乎对事情的发展结果并不满意。“那简直是一种可悲的死亡，”阿罗娜愤恨地说道，“那种死亡发生在一个人病得太重或年纪太大，已经无力做任何事情，只能躺在草床上呻吟，因为身体已经不再听使唤的时候。那绝对是世界上最糟糕的死亡方式——那种需要别人来结束你的生命，因为你自己已经没有力气去结束它。而我，绝对不会等到那种地步才去赴死。 在我年轻的时候，有一个邻近部落的酋长，他的部落就在几座岛屿之外。他是个还算不错的战士，但有一次他的头部被锤子击中，虽然没有丧命。后来阿戈斯带着我和其他几个人去袭击那个部落，结果我们看到的只是一个满口流口水、甚至都无法站直的废人。那里没有什么值得悲伤的，就像这里一样。看到一个人沦落到那种地步，只会让人感到厌恶，或许还会有一丝怜悯。 在Sailgraves，生活或许就是这样的，但在这里，事情并非如此运作。 |阿兹兰一路上都保持着沉默，僵硬地挺直身体，双肩紧绷。这件事对她造成的打击，肯定比她愿意承认的要严重得多——因为如果当时你没有及时出现，她的母亲和姐妹们可能也会遭遇同样的命运。 你说的没错，”她终于说道，“但如果事情真的发展到了那一步，做出那种事的人也不会是我。我实在无法下决心对母亲动手。”不过，事情终究没有发展到那一步。 要不是因为你，事情本来会是这样的。与我的姐妹们战斗？光是想到这个念头就让人害怕。与我的母亲战斗？绝对不可能。即使母亲变得不再是我们认识的那个人，而只是变成了某个看起来像她那样……不，那不可能。”心中虽然存有这样的疑虑，但你也知道，维瑟兰人以及其他昆因虫种族在思维方式上确实存在差异，尤其是那些具有集体意识的种族。既然她现在已经来到了这里，或许阿齐也可以像你为她所做的那样，为德鲁伊们尽一些力，将这份善意传递下去。只有这样，这个世界才会变得更好。 |我们在这里的任务完成了吗？ [kiyoko.married |你的狐狸精妻子 |清子 ] 一个充满同理心的点头。当艾尔塔拉照顾莱恩的时候，你们两人共享了这样一个时刻——彼此绕着对方转圈，只是为了移动而移动，却始终无法到达任何地方。那个树精……“你后悔吗？ [var1 |丈夫 |亲爱的 ]不，但是——”“很好，你不必再为此烦恼了。那种情况本来就无法避免，而你已经充分利用了现有的条件和知识，做出了最合适的选择。既然没有任何教训需要从中吸取，再为此懊恼也没有意义了。”……“我的教育并没有达到应有的水平，但我毕竟是被培养来从事治理工作的。 [var1 |丈夫 |亲爱的 ]而且人们很快就会意识到这样一个事实：即使尝试了所有的选择，也几乎没有哪一种选择是绝对的好或绝对坏的。那么，现在就不要再纠结下去了，因为前面还有许多事情需要去做。 |当艾尔萨拉把瑞恩拉到一边时，图伊走过来，跟着你缓缓地离开了小树林，走向那座桥。你们俩沉默地走了一会儿，直到她终于开口说道：“艾尔萨拉看起来对这一切并不太高兴。没有人应该这样，尤其是她——毕竟真正实施焚烧行动的人就是她。他们俩都需要一些空间。“你看起来也不太好啊。 她能看出来吗？“卡门有时候也会这样，所以这对我来说并不陌生。”阿图吉娅拍了拍你的背，“就是那种无论你做什么，结果似乎总是会变糟的感觉，对吧？ 嗯，不算吧。正是如此你在那些摆在面前的选择中，做了你认为最好的决定。只是……这让人感到有些难过，尽管你其实没有理由感到后悔。这种经历，也是构成人类生活的一部分，对吧？“哦，是的，我明白。现在我就跟你说 [pc.name] — 别太往心里去，好吗？我相信你会仔细考虑的。 |嗯，那真是一幅令人难过的景象，”昆因走过来对你说，“我几乎是强忍着看下去的。那位精灵女士现在怎么样了？”你瞥了一眼艾尔萨拉，她正慢慢地带着瑞恩朝桥的方向走去，而昆因也在带你朝那个方向前进。你将目光重新转向那个兔人，耸了耸肩。毕竟是艾尔萨拉在树上做了那些燃烧的动作，所以……“你能感受到这些情绪，真是太好了，”昆因一边说，一边拍了拍你的背。“疼痛才是证明你还活着的证据。如果你对这一切毫无感触，对看到那位鹿女离世毫无反应，我才会更担心。不过现在，再后悔也已经来不及了。“话虽如此，但考虑到我们迄今为止所看到的一切……呼，难怪托卢斯对贝尔哈兰和戈德斯沃那些事情如此感兴趣。想象一下，如果他拥有这样的力量，他甚至可能不再把目标局限于那些偏远的小边境村庄了。就算没有其他意义，至少你能理解这个笑话的幽默之处。“看看那个笑容，你戴上它看起来真是好多了。 [pc.name]现在，一定要振作起来，我们必须离开这里，而且我觉得前路还很长。 |当你回到薇薇安身边时，她正在擦拭她的帽子。 [viviane.isDemon |她们一边闲聊，一边互相清理指甲。“哦，你终于弄完了吗？花的时间比预期要长多了，不过考虑到那个傻妞哭得那么厉害，这也难怪吧。”是的，从她的语气来看，她对发生的事情似乎并不满意。 哦，当然。那真是太糟糕、太浪费资源了……虽然我也明白，讨好那些最终打算在这个地区定居的精灵们确实更为重要。但那样的机会本来可以让我们弄清楚：像这样的精灵生物是否拥有灵魂，还是说它们只不过是一团团魔法而已。关于干尸精灵这个话题，现有的相关文献少得可怜，你懂我的意思吧——我敢肯定，只要再多写上一两篇高质量的论文，那个可怜的家伙说不定就能吐露出她内心深处可能隐藏的任何秘密了。 但是，任何选择几乎都不可能在所有方面都是完美的，你真正需要做的，就是选择那些最符合你自身利益的选择，对吧？”……没错。 | 她紧闭着嘴唇，问道：“一切进行得顺利吗？”“应该说是挺顺利的。”“看起来过程也没那么痛苦。”她叹了口气，然后把帽子重新戴在了头上。你或许应该去看看你的精灵朋友们。他们看起来对发生的一切都感到非常震惊。我知道你在那种情况下已经做了你认为最好的选择，但这种事情确实会严重打击大家的士气。不过，我相信你一定能把这件事处理得很好。”有人如此信任你，确实是一件令人欣慰的事情。“嘿，如果你不够值得，我也不会陪你参加这次探险的，对吧？" ] |这种感觉永远不会过时，”阿格尼叹息着说道，一边擦着额头。“即使我自己一次又一次地经历了死亡，但每次做出那种故意结束某人生命的决定时，心里依然感觉不好。”事实上，也确实不应该有这种感觉。即使她并不是做出那个决定的人，也不是执行那个决定的人，你依然为她有这样的感受而感到高兴。在关于像她这样的古代人物的故事中，人们通常会认为他们都已经变得麻木不仁、听惯了各种事情，但像阿格尼这样愿意直言不讳的人，确实为故事带来了截然不同的氛围。 她起初什么也没说，只是瞥了眼正在安慰瑞恩的艾尔萨拉，然后又把目光转回到你身上。“嗯，当然。我们都知道，既然知道她很可能已经无可救药，那么那样做确实是最好的选择……但重要的是，你并不是在冲动之下才做出那个决定的。谢谢。 [pc.name]不，应该是你感谢她对你所给予的这种信任。“他们正在取得进展——我觉得我们应该加紧行动，否则党派最终可能会分裂。 ] 既然这件棘手的事情已经解决了，空气也变得清新了许多，而且那个被污染的干神树林也不会在你忙于其他事情的时候再对你构成任何威胁了。是时候继续前进了……
rows.raw: " You swallow hard and lead Ryn away from the grove to wait at the bridge, then beckon for Elthara to come up with you to Lanniere's tree. Ryn's come some way since you first met her, but she doesn't need to face these decisions. Not yet. The priestess gives you one of her meaningful looks as the both of you quietly gaze down upon Lanniere, the helpless dryad squirming under the heat of your eyes. Just the pressure of the both of you being so close is enough to make her body shudder with unsatiated need, and with a soft moan the dryad thrusts into the air and releases a large plume of musky spunk out onto the dirt. You think that serves to make your case for you. Elthara should remember what it was like to be pinned down on the altar, right? The dryad's been like this for more than two centuries now, if your counting isn't off. "She can't be saved, can she?" The way Elthara's asking the question belies the fact that she already knows the answer, as unpalatable as it may be. While you're not going to rule out some kind of miracle, you don't have the time or resources to figure out which miracle would be appropriate right now, on the slim chance that she isn't too far gone. Elthara moves to lay her hand on the dryad's brow, and thinks better of it when another gigantic gush of musky cum erupts from the oversexed fey's churning balls, each one easily the size of a melon. "So... how do we do this?" [var0 |From what other dryads you've met in your travels have told you, they're the spirits of the trees they inhabit. Simply destroying the tree should do it. |Well, given that the dryad's source appears to be her infested tree, destroying it should do the trick, shouldn't it? ] "I guess it falls to me, then." You'll stay here and make sure that Lanniere's passing is as painless as possible. You look over your shoulder to make sure that Ryn's back is still turned to the grim spectacle that's about to happen, then nod to Elthara to continue. The priestess closes her eyes, clenches her fists and steps towards the tree. "If... if I'd become something like this, I'm not sure I'd have wanted to continue, myself." No... but happily, that's not the case. Elthara's a valuable seneschal to Ryn, to use the Belharan term to describe it, and yet she has enough desire in her to enjoy Mallach's and Lumia's blessings when the mood takes her. Here but for the grace of her goddess in having you rescue her in the nick of time, goes her. Elthara doesn't say anything, but looks up at the twitching fungal tree and bathes it with gouts of whitefire from outstretched palms. Its maw gapes in a silent scream, coughing out several bursts of glittering blue spores, but too many of its roots and branches have been severed or reduced to put up an effective resistance. Flailing wildly in a bid to do something, anything, the corrupted dryad tree hisses and pops with a stink of searing fungus. rows.original: Coughing from all the spores in the air, you look around you, expecting another revenant to emerge from the corrupted bonepile and throw itself at you, but none emerge. The infested spectres have melted into dissolving ectoplasm and spore clouds, and the fungal carpet that possessed their earthly remains and forced them into wakefulness lies trampled all about you in clods of disgusting filth and bits of old bones. There's no telling what might come at you next, but for now it looks like it's over. Ryn gasps, unable to tear her eyes from the remains. Though she's silent, it's not too hard to guess that she's contemplating her own mortality, something that all so often is too distant to the young... until circumstances contrive to bring those thoughts to the fore. That, and what might happen to her, to all of you should she succumb in this place... Ryn bites her lip and looks to you, then very pointedly directs her gaze ahead of her, squares her shoulders, and begins marching forward without even looking back. "Don't wander too far ahead, [etheryn.crowned |my queen |lady regent ]." Ryn doesn't look back, but pointedly pauses to examine a nearby crumbling archway in excruciating detail. She didn't act like this down in the crypt... Elthara keeps her gaze trained on the back of Ryn's neck. "With all respect, champion, the revenants beneath the palace were still recognizable as boer'alvar, while the druids we've encountered so far are undoubtedly... changed. The spirits in the crypt were driven by melancholy and sorrow, these have nothing but fury and blame for the var Ridell lineage. The atmosphere is different." This is hard on her, but Ryn needs a lot of toughening up if she's going to be an effective ruler in the years to come. A nod. "In the short space of time since your arrival, champion, the [etheryn.crowned |queen |lady regent ] has had to experience so much in but the blink of an eye. A lesser person would have been broken, but she has her parents' and grandmother's spirit in her. And of course, once again, as before, you serve as the catalyst for that necessary change, [pc.name]. Think about it." Maybe later. For now, Ryn's getting ahead of the party — you've got to keep everyone together.

        The bag sails through the air, and you watch as the tentacles of fluid change course mid-swing, now aiming not for you but for the new threat. A perfect catch with the kind of uncanny alacrity only a fluid can have — and the flimsy paper explodes, scattering its contents into the elemental's body. There's a moment as each of the long, whipping appendages trembles and curls as if being burned up from within, and then breaks apart in a shower of foul-smelling water.
        
        "Hurry!" Elthara yells, shoving Ryn, [comp2.name] and you forward as the droplets scattered about the riverbank start oozing back into the water. "We don't have long!"
        
        Yeah, it was too much of a stretch to imagine that a simple folk remedy would take it out of commission for good. Still, an opening's an opening — taking Elthara's advice, you hustle and double-time it across the bridge. By the time you make it to the other side, the elemental's already reformed enough to grasp for your heels, but thankfully you're all out of reach by this point.
        
        Now to see just what you've stumbled into, and whether you've just leapt out of the frying pan and right into the fire...
rows.translation:
你突然想到了一个主意。尽管这条小溪非常肮脏，但它很可能不会对……嗯，难道真的存在某种能够对抗污垢的东西吗？你愿意试一试，至少因为如果你可以避免的话，实在不想冒险穿过那座桥去尝试这件事。你手中拿着那袋油腻腻的药材，解开系在袋子颈部的绳子，用手感受它的重量，然后一步步地向桥边走去。
        
        每走一步，你都紧张不已，生怕那些元素力量会再次出现——而当你走到那些大理石柱子所在的位置时，它们果然出现了：黑色的水花从那缓慢流动的水流中迸发出来。那些腐烂的物质在向你飞来的过程中会掉落下来，但你早已做好了准备——你瞄准水中那些你认为所有触手连接在一起的地方，收回手臂，然后将药剂抛了出去。
        
        那个袋子在空中飞舞，你看到那些“触手”在飞行途中改变了方向，现在它们的目标不再是你了，而是那个新的威胁。这种捕捉动作快得惊人，只有流体才具备这样的灵活性——于是那张薄薄的纸瞬间被撕碎，其内容物散落在那个生物的身体里。有那么一刻，那些长长的、像鞭子一样的附肢开始颤抖、卷曲，仿佛内部正在被烧灼一般，随后便在一阵散发着恶臭的水花中碎裂开来。
        
        “快！”艾尔萨拉喊道，一边推着瑞恩。 [comp2.name] 当那些散落在河岸边的水滴开始重新渗回水中时，你也继续前进着。“我们没有多少时间了！”
        
        是啊，要想相信一种简单的民间疗法就能彻底让它失效，未免有些牵强。不过，机会就是机会——听从艾尔萨拉的建议，你加快脚步，飞快地跑过了那座桥。当你到达对岸时，那个元素生物已经恢复到了足以抓住你脚后跟的状态，但幸运的是，此时你已经远远地离开了它的攻击范围。
        
        现在，让我们来看看你究竟陷入了什么困境，以及你是否只是从火坑跳进了另一个更危险的火坑……

rows.original:
Right, how did the saying go again? %"If there's a problem, use explosions. And if that doesn't solve the problem, use more explosions"? You can't quite remember where you heard it, but that doesn't stop it from being any less true in these circumstances. You're willing to give it a go, if for no other reason than making a blind run for it across the bridge isn't a prospect you fancy taking if you can help it.
        
        Palming the leananstone, you inch towards the bridge, just waiting for the elemental to reappear. Sure enough, the dark stream's surface churns and froths as you draw near to the bridge posts, and tendrils of dark water explode from the sluggish flow once more to meet you. Bits of rotting matter splatter to the ground as the elemental lashes out for you, but you were expecting this; taking aim at the spot just beneath the water's surface where you estimate all the liquid tentacles are joined, you prime the leananstone and toss it forward in an underhand throw.
        
        The elemental reacts, moving to bat the projectile away, but you've pitched it with enough force that the leananstone drives straight through its membranous surface and into its body. Nothing happens for a second, and then the liquid tentacles flail about in obvious pain as arcs of lightning crawl along its fouled surface, the stone discharging its payload with brutal efficiency. The roar of light and sound that would normally have dissipated in the air ends up completely focused from within the elemental, and it's with a wet, disgusting noise that the long, whipping appendages tremble and curl, then explode outward in a shower of foul water.
        
        "Hurry!" Elthara yells, shoving Ryn, [comp2.name] and you forward as the droplets scattered about the riverbank start oozing back into the stream. "We don't have long!"
        
        Right. An opening's an opening — taking Elthara's advice, you hustle and double-time it across the bridge. By the time you make it to the other side, the elemental's already reformed enough to grasp for your heels, but thankfully you're all out of reach by this point.
        
        Now to see just what you've stumbled into, and whether you've just leapt out of the frying pan and right into the fire...

对了，那句话是怎么说的来着？“如果有问题，就用爆炸来解决；如果爆炸还是无法解决问题，那就再使用更多的爆炸。”你可能不太记得是在哪里听到的这句话，但在这种情况下，这句话依然非常适用。你愿意试一试，至少因为如果你可以避免的话，你肯定不愿意冒险穿过那座桥去尝试。
        
        你双手紧握着那块倾斜的石头，缓缓地向桥边靠近，只等着那些元素力量再次出现。果然，当你逐渐接近桥墩时，那条暗影的溪流表面开始翻腾起泡沫，那些暗色的水花又一次从那缓慢流动的水流中迸发出来，向你袭来。当那股元素力量朝你袭来时，一些腐烂的物质溅到了地上，但你早有预料；你瞄准了水面下你认为所有液态触手连接在一起的那个位置，握紧了那把利安石剑，然后以一种低手的动作将它抛了出去。
        
        这种生物产生了反应，试图将投掷物击开，但你的力量实在太大，那块倾斜石直接穿透了它的膜状表面，刺入了它的体内。有那么一瞬间什么动静都没有，随后那些液态触手开始剧烈扭动，显然它正在承受巨大的痛苦——电弧沿着被污染的表面闪烁着，而那块石头则以极其高效的方式释放出了它的“载荷”。那些原本应该消散在空气中的光与声的轰鸣，最终在元素内部被完全聚集起来。伴随着一阵潮湿而令人作呕的声音，那些长长的、像鞭子一样的附属物开始颤抖、卷曲，然后向外猛烈喷射出一阵污秽的水花。
        
        快！”艾尔萨拉喊道，同时推了推瑞恩。 [comp2.name] 当那些散落在河岸边的水滴开始重新渗回溪流中时，你也加快了脚步。“我们没有多少时间了！”
        
        没错，机会就是机会——听从艾尔萨拉的建议，你拼命加快脚步，飞快地穿过了那座桥。当你终于到达另一边时，那些元素生物已经恢复到了足以抓住你脚后跟的程度，但幸运的是，此时你已经远远地离开了它们的攻击范围。
        
        现在，让我们来看看你究竟陷入了什么境地，以及你是否只是从火坑跳进了另一个更危险的火坑之中。..

rows.original: Right, how did the saying go again? %"If there's a problem, use explosions. And if that doesn't solve the problem, use more explosions"? The ley-crystal in your hand tingles against your palm as you inch forward, begging to be used already. A little longer, just a little longer... while you guess that the grenade's more than capable of blowing out the entire stream, you want to make it count. Sure enough, the dark stream's surface churns and froths as you draw near to the bridge posts, and tendrils of dark water explode from the sluggish flow once more to meet you. To your surprise, the elemental doesn't attempt to dodge or deflect the grenade, instead shrinking back a bit — can such a being feel fear, or perhaps it's acceptance of a sort? Such thoughts are scattered as the ley crystal detonates beneath the water's surface, throwing up an enormous plume of stinking water and rotting mulch in a deafening roar. The long, whipping appendages tremble and curl, then explode outward in a shower of foul water along with the rest of its body. "Hurry!" Elthara yells, shoving Ryn, [comp2.name] and you forward as the droplets scattered about the riverbank start oozing back into the stream, the elemental reforming by degrees. "We don't know how much time we have!" Right. While you'd have liked to savor the spectacle you've caused just a little longer, you heed Elthara's advice and double-time it across the bridge. By the time you make it to the other side, the elemental's already reformed enough to grasp for your heels, but thankfully you're all out of reach by this point. Now to see just what you've stumbled into, and whether you've just leapt out of the frying pan and right into the fire...

Give me a moment to get out of these clothes and put on my stuff." Brint's gotten really used to the armor he claimed up in the rift — he's gotten changed in the blink of an eye, and gives Etheryn a nod. "You ready, Ryn?" ] "[etheryn.lowConfidence |Y- ]Yes. What exactly do you need us to do, [pc.name]?" You quickly lay out your plan — Brint's to freeze as much of the stream about the bridge as he can, while Ryn fends off the elemental's attacks with her freezing arrows. Once enough of the water is iced over — sure, it's moving water, but it barely qualifies as such given the sluggish flow — you'll make a run for it. You'll step back and spot attacks for her, [var1 |help her with your own ice magics |let her focus on keeping the tendrils at bay ]. It's as good a plan as any, and once everyone's in place, you start for the bridge. Sure enough, the dark stream's surface churns and froths as you draw near to the bridge posts, and tendrils of dark water explode from the sluggish flow once more to meet you. Bits of rotting matter splatter to the ground as the elemental lashes out for Brint and Ryn, but the latter already has an icy arrow nocked and ready to loose for a counterattack. The moment the arrows pierce each tendril, it freezes, falls to the ground and shatters — the liquid doesn't stay frozen for long, slowly creeping to the riverbank to rejoin the elemental's main body. Nevertheless, it's enough an opening for Brint to start icing over the water with several wintery bellows, while you direct Ryn in staving off the attacks[var1 | and add in some of your own as well ]. It works. As more and more of the water is iced over, the corrupted elemental's reach becomes more and more tenuous, until it can no longer strike at the bridge crossing from the still free-flowing portion of the stream. It's then that you give the call to hurry over the bridge while the creature's still occupied with cracking up the ice, one that Elthara quickly picks up on. "You heard [pc.himHer]!" the priestess yells, leading the charge with a sprint and gathering up both Brint and Ryn on her way. You follow hot on her heels, and the lot of you have scarcely made it across when the thick sheets of ice Brint's laid out over the water give and splinter into chunks under the elemental's furious thrashing. Thankfully you're all out of reach by this point, but gods, is it mad. Now to see just what you've stumbled into, and whether you've just leapt out of the frying pan and right into the fire...
rows.translation: 你突然想到了一个主意。 [var0 |说起来，布林特穿的那一身冬季骑士铠甲……要是莱恩也能帮忙的话，那场面该有多冷啊？“我觉得会冷得很厉害吧。如果只有我们其中一个人穿上，应该还行吧。但要是我们两个人都穿上……那我敢说，我们的处境就有点麻烦了。你是不是想表达我所说的那个意思？”你认为他们两个人不可能完全冻结整个水流，但至少能够冻结足够的部分，使得那些元素生物无法轻易攻击到你。 是啊，我觉得你没有错。好吧，我们就这么办吧——瑞恩，你准备好了吗？ |说起来，布林特这次出门是不是也带上了他的冬季骑士铠甲？”“就在这儿呢，”他一边回答，一边拍着自己的行李，“我想我明白你的意思了。”确实如此。如果瑞恩帮忙的话，他到底能把事情弄得多冷酷呢？“可以说，相当冷酷吧。如果只有我们其中一个人参与的话，应该还算不错。但如果是我们两个人一起行动的话？我觉得自己的胜算还挺大的。你是不是也在想我在想的事情呢？你认为他们两个人能够冻结整个水流吗？其实只需要冻结足够的部分，就能让那些元素生物无法轻易攻击到你。”“嗯，我觉得你说得对。给我一点时间，我先脱掉这些衣服，然后换上我的装备。”布林特已经非常习惯在裂隙中获得的那些盔甲了——他转眼间就换好了装备，然后向伊瑟琳点了点头。 准备好了吗，瑞恩？ ] "[etheryn.lowConfidence |Y- ]是的。什么？正是如此你需要我们来做这件事吗？ [pc.name]你迅速制定了计划：布林负责尽可能冻结桥周围的流水，而瑞恩则用她那些能冻结目标的箭矢来抵挡那些元素的攻击。一旦有足够多的水被冻结住——虽然这些水仍在流动，但考虑到它那极其缓慢的流速，其实已经几乎不能算作流动的水了——你们就会立刻冲过去。你会退到安全的地方，为她留意周围的攻击情况。 [var1 |用你自己的冰系魔法来帮助她吧。 |让她专心对付那些触手吧。 ]这个计划和其他计划一样不错，等所有人都到齐后，你们就可以开始向桥的方向前进了。果然，当你们接近桥墩时，那条暗影的河流表面开始翻腾起泡沫，那些暗色的水花再次从缓慢流动的河水中冲了出来，迎向你们。随着那股元素力量向布林特和瑞恩袭来，一些腐烂的物质溅到了地上，但瑞恩早已将一支冰箭搭在弓上，准备进行反击。当箭矢射中那些触手的一瞬间，它们立刻冻结了，坠落到地面并碎裂开来——这种液态物质无法长时间保持冻结状态，会慢慢流回河岸，重新融入那股元素力量的主体之中。尽管如此，这已经为布林提供了足够的时机来使用那些冬季用的武器开始发动攻击，而你的任务则是指挥莱恩抵挡这些进攻。[var1 | 也可以加入一些你自己的内容。 ]这招确实有效。随着越来越多的水面被冰覆盖，那个被腐蚀的元素生物的攻击范围也越来越有限，最终它再也无法攻击那些仍然处于流动状态的河水区域，也就是那些能够通往桥面的地方。就在这个时候，你们应该立刻催促大家尽快过桥，因为那个生物此时正忙于破坏冰层，而艾尔萨拉也立刻意识到了这一点。“你们听到了吧[pc.himHer]快跑！”女祭司大喊着，冲了上去，一路上还把布林特和瑞恩也拉了上来。你紧随其后，就在你们刚刚越过冰面时，布林特在水面上铺开的厚厚冰层在那个元素生物的猛烈冲击下开始破裂，一块块冰块纷纷掉落。幸好在这个时候你们都已经不在我的攻击范围之内了，但天啊，这一切真是太疯狂了。现在，就让我们看看你们究竟陷入了什么困境，以及你们是不是刚刚从火坑跳进了另一个更危险的火坑……
rows.raw: " An idea strikes you. [var0 |Say, that winter knight's armor that Brint's wearing... just how cold can he make things, if Ryn were to help? "Pretty chilly, I dare say. One of us? Pretty cool. Both of us? I'd say I like my chances. Are you getting at what I think you're getting at?" You don't think the two of them will be able to freeze the entire stream, but just enough of it that the elemental won't be able to get at you easily. "Yeah, I don't think you're wrong. All right, let's do this — you ready there, Ryn?" |Say, did Brint bring along his winter knight armor on this little trip? "Got it right here," he replies, patting his belongings. "I think I know what you're getting at." Indeed. Just how cold can he make things, if Ryn were to help? "Pretty chilly, I dare say. One of us? Pretty cool. Both of us? I'd say I like my chances. Are you getting at what I think you're getting at?" You don't think the two of them will be able to freeze the entire stream, but just enough of it that the elemental won't be able to get at you easily. "Yeah, I don't think you're wrong. Give me a moment to get out of these clothes and put on my stuff." Brint's gotten really used to the armor he claimed up in the rift — he's gotten changed in the blink of an eye, and gives Etheryn a nod. "You ready, Ryn?" ] "[etheryn.lowConfidence |Y- ]Yes. What exactly do you need us to do, [pc.name]?" You quickly lay out your plan — Brint's to freeze as much of the stream about the bridge as he can, while Ryn fends off the elemental's attacks with her freezing arrows. Once enough of the water is iced over — sure, it's moving water, but it barely qualifies as such given the sluggish flow — you'll make a run for it. You'll step back and spot attacks for her, [var1 |help her with your own ice magics |let her focus on keeping the tendrils at bay ]. It's as good a plan as any, and once everyone's in place, you start for the bridge. Sure enough, the dark stream's surface churns and froths as you draw near to the bridge posts, and tendrils of dark water explode from the sluggish flow once more to meet you. Bits of rotting matter splatter to the ground as the elemental lashes out for Brint and Ryn, but the latter already has an icy arrow nocked and ready to loose for a counterattack. The moment the arrows pierce each tendril, it freezes, falls to the ground and shatters — the liquid doesn't stay frozen for long, slowly creeping to the riverbank to rejoin the elemental's main body. Nevertheless, it's enough an opening for Brint to start icing over the water with several wintery bellows, while you direct Ryn in staving off the attacks[var1 | and add in some of your own as well ]. It works. As more and more of the water is iced over, the corrupted elemental's reach becomes more and more tenuous, until it can no longer strike at the bridge crossing from the still free-flowing portion of the stream. It's then that you give the call to hurry over the bridge while the creature's still occupied with cracking up the ice, one that Elthara quickly picks up on. "You heard [pc.himHer]!" the priestess yells, leading the charge with a sprint and gathering up both Brint and Ryn on her way. You follow hot on her heels, and the lot of you have scarcely made it across when the thick sheets of ice Brint's laid out over the water give and splinter into chunks under the elemental's furious thrashing. Thankfully you're all out of reach by this point, but gods, is it mad. Now to see just what you've stumbled into, and whether you've just leapt out of the frying pan and right into the fire... "

rows.original: Have Brint use his Winter Knight's armor to freeze the water solid, with Ryn's help.
rows.translation: 让布林特在莱恩的帮助下，利用他的冬日骑士铠甲将水冻成固体。
rows.raw: "Have Brint use his Winter Knight's armor to freeze the water solid, with Ryn's help."

rows.original: You need Brint and his winter knight set with you for this.
rows.translation: 进行这项任务，你需要布林特以及他的冬季骑士套装。
rows.raw: "You need Brint and his winter knight set with you for this."

rows.original: An idea strikes you. Viv? "Let me guess. You want me to do something with the elemental, because enchanting's my field of expertise, isn't it?" Actually, no. While enchanting is her greatest love, you know that she can cast a mean chill when she needs to. If Ryn were to help her, does she think she'd be able to freeze over the stream? Viv raises an eyebrow. "The entire stream? That's a tall order, even if —" No, not all of it. Just icing over the patch about the bridge so that the elemental can't get at you while you cross — that'll do just fine. "Hm. I suppose I don't mind your pet elf helping. It's a better option than trying to fend it off while crossing, at any rate. Very well, I'm for this plan. What about you, girl?" "[etheryn.lowConfidence |I- ]I am. What exactly do you need us to do, [pc.name]?" You quickly lay out your plan — Viv's to freeze as much of the stream about the bridge as he can, while Ryn fends off the elemental's attacks with her freezing arrows. Once enough of the water is iced over — sure, it's moving water, but it barely qualifies as such given the sluggish flow — you'll make a run for it. You'll step back and spot attacks for her, [var0 |help her with your own ice magics |let her focus on keeping the tendrils at bay ]. It's as good a plan as any, and once everyone's in place, you start for the bridge. Sure enough, the dark stream's surface churns and froths as you draw near to the bridge posts, and tendrils of dark water explode from the sluggish flow once more to meet you. Bits of rotting matter splatter to the ground as the elemental lashes out for Viv and Ryn, but the latter already has an icy arrow nocked and ready to loose for a counterattack. The moment the arrows pierce each tendril, it freezes, falls to the ground and shatters — the liquid doesn't stay frozen for long, slowly creeping to the riverbank to rejoin the elemental's main body. Nevertheless, it's enough an opening for Viv to start icing over the water, rays of frost streaming from her wrists, while you direct Ryn in staving off the attacks[var0 | and add in some of your own as well ]. It works. As more and more of the water is iced over, the corrupted elemental's reach becomes more and more tenuous, until it can no longer strike at the bridge crossing from the still free-flowing portion of the stream. It's then that you give the call to hurry over the bridge while the creature's still occupied with cracking up the ice, one that Elthara quickly picks up on. "You heard [pc.himHer]!" the priestess yells, leading the charge with a sprint and gathering up both Viv and Ryn on her way. You follow hot on her heels, and the lot of you have scarcely made it across when the thick sheets of ice Viv's laid out over the water give and splinter into chunks under the elemental's furious thrashing. Thankfully you're all out of reach by this point, but gods, is it mad. "Well," Viv says as she looks over her shoulder at the irate elemental. "I daresay that was quite satisfactory. Now to see whether the crossing was worth all this effort, hmm?" Indeed. Now to see just what you've stumbled into, and whether you've just leapt out of the frying pan and right into the fire...

rows.translation: 薇芙现在并不在你身边。
rows.raw: "Viv's not with you at the moment."

rows.original:
A smile crosses your face as you realize the unique opportunity this situation presents — and here you have just the tool to overcome it. Corrupted as the elemental might be, there's no reason this shouldn't work.
        
        It's with this confidence that you stride back up to the bridge, steps sounding on the ancient path as you don't bother hiding your approach. The elemental senses you drawing near and sure enough, the dark stream's surface churns and froths as you draw near to the bridge posts. The stench is overpowering as tendrils of dark water explode from the sluggish flow once more to meet you, bits of rotting matter splattering to the ground as the elemental lashes out with an attack.
        
        This time, you're ready for it. Before the elemental can so much as touch you, you've already undone the tethers that keep it here in this existence, and step back to watch the results. In the blink of an eye, the tendrils of stinking river water lose consistency, momentum carrying what mass there is forward to splash harmlessly on the ground. Everything stinks, but at least the matter's deal with.
        
        "Well," Elthara says. "That's one way to solve the problem."
        
        Mm-hm. Nothing else accosts you as [party.compNames] stride across the bridge, easily making it to the other side. Now to see just what you've stumbled into, and whether you've just leapt out of the frying pan and right into the fire...
rows.translation:
当你意识到这种处境所带来的独特机会时，脸上会浮现出一丝微笑——而你手中正好拥有克服这一困难所需的工具。尽管这个工具可能有些“残缺不全”，但并没有理由认为它无法发挥作用。
        
        正是带着这样的自信，你大步走回了桥边，脚步声在古老的道路上清晰地回荡，你甚至没有刻意隐藏自己的接近。那些感知到你靠近的元素生物，果然在你靠近桥墩时，使那条暗影的溪流表面开始翻腾起泡沫。这种恶臭简直令人难以忍受——当那些黑色的水花再次从那缓慢流动的水中迸发出来迎向你的时候，一些腐烂的物质也会随之溅落到地上，而那些蕴含着自然力量的力量正在猛烈地攻击着你。
        
        这一次，你已经做好了准备。在那些元素力量还来不及触及你的时候，你就已经解开了将它们束缚在这个存在中的纽带，然后退后一步，观察着结果的发生。转瞬间，那些散发着恶臭的河水就失去了原有的凝聚力，其携带的那一点点质量也失去了前进的动力，最终只是无害地溅落在地面上而已。一切都糟透了，但至少这个问题已经得到了解决。
        
        “嗯，”艾尔萨拉说道，“这也是解决这个问题的一个办法。”
        
        嗯，没有其他事情再困扰你了。 [party.compNames] 跨过桥梁，轻松地到达了另一边。现在，就让我们看看自己究竟遇到了什么，以及是否只是从火坑跳进了另一个更大的火坑……

The elemental senses you drawing near and sure enough, the dark stream's surface churns and froths as you draw near to the bridge posts. Everything stinks, but at least the matter's deal with.
