        Mm-hm. Nothing else accosts you as [party.compNames] stride across the bridge, easily making it to the other side. Now to see just what you've stumbled into, and whether you've just leapt out of the frying pan and right into the fire...
        "

rows.original: This is an elemental creature — you could simply return it to whence it came. Regardless of how good an idea it'd be, it won't be in your way any more. This will consume your ultimate power.
rows.translation: 这是一种由元素构成的生物——你完全可以把它送回它来的地方。无论这个想法有多好，它都不会再妨碍你了。 这将消耗你的终极力量。
rows.raw: "This is an elemental creature — you could simply return it to whence it came. Regardless of how good an idea it'd be, it won't be in your way any more.\n\n This will consume your ultimate power."

rows.original: You must have a power capable of banishing elementals equipped and available to use this option.
rows.translation: 你必须拥有能够驱散那些被召唤出来并可供使用的元素生物的力量，才能选择这个选项。
rows.raw: "You must have a power capable of banishing elementals equipped and available to use this option."

rows.original:
There doesn't seem to be anything you can do about the situation. If you want to get across, making a run for it while fending off the elemental's tentacles as best as you can is your only option here.
        
        "I could perhaps freeze some of the water when it gets close," Ryn volunteers hopefully. "Given what we saw, I probably wouldn't be able to get them all while running, but it'd be better than nothing."
        
        That would be appreciated.
        
        Well, nothing for it. Tensing the muscles in your legs, you take a deep breath and break into a sprint, making for the bridge; [party.manyCompanions
            |[comp2.name], 
        ]Ryn and Elthara follow in your wake, spreading out along the bridge's span to divide the elemental's attention as much as possible.
        
        No sooner have you drawn close to the bridge posts that the stream's surface churns and froths, tendrils of dark water exploding from the scum-choked surface to meet you. Ready as you are, the first liquid tentacle grazes your [pc.hair] as you duck just in time to avoid it, followed by a couple more aimed at Ryn and Elthara. Bits of rotting matter splatter to the ground, but Ryn uses the opening you've created to nock an icy arrow and looses a counterattack. The next tendril that comes for you winds up frozen solid, filthy ice falling to the ground and shattering — not that the liquid doesn't stay frozen for long, slowly creeping to the riverbank to rejoin the elemental's main body.
        
        [pc.agilityRange 65
            |You have a close call, though. While you've been busy watching the spectacle above your head and focusing on keeping your legs moving, you fail to notice a liquid tendril coming low; however, a shadow catches the corner of your eye and you pull your foot out of the way just in time to avoid being snagged. The elemental isn't about to give up, though — now that the game is up, several more stinking coils emerge from the stream, clearly intent on dragging you down into the water.
            
            "[pc.Name]!" Ryn puts a freezing arrow into the nearest tendril of water going for you, giving you the opening you need to disengage and make a full-on run for it. You narrowly dodge several more close calls, duck under a last-ditch grab, and roll onto the other bank winded but untouched throughout the entire ordeal. [party.manyCompanions
                |[comp2.name], 
            ]Ryn and Elthara follow shortly after — it looks like the elemental had been focusing its attention mostly on you, leaving them mostly untouched. It's nice to know that you're so popular...
            
            Is everyone okay?
            
            Elthara gives the back of her hand a tentative sniff and makes a face. "I could smell worse, I suppose."
            
            Well, if the stink's the worst of everyone's problems, then you got off lightly, especially with the elemental thrashing about in the back. Looks like you're not going to be retreating over the bridge that easily — time to see just what you've stumbled into, and whether you've just leapt out of the frying pan and right into the fire...
            |It's not enough, though. While you've been busy watching the spectacle above your head and focusing on keeping your legs moving, you fail to notice a liquid tendril coming low; by the time you've realized something's caught you by the ankle, you're already on your way down to the ground. The elemental is quick to press its advantage — several more stinking coils emerge from the stream, clearly intent on dragging you down into the water.
            
            "[pc.Name]!" As you scramble to right yourself, Elthara grabs you by under the arms, braces herself against the bridge's railings, and pulls. The elemental isn't about to let you go, either — not until Ryn puts several freezing arrows into the tendrils clinging onto your ankles, at the very least.
            
            It's a rough effort, and given that the elemental's assailing all of you while this is going on, more than a little of the foul, stinking liquid splashes all over the bridge and the three of you. Yet frustration, anger and fear all lend you strength on the condition of being repaid with interest later on, and you manage to scramble back upright to close that last bit of distance and make it out of the elemental's grasping reach.
            
            Phew.
            
            "Are you all right?" Ryn asks as you try to dry yourself without much success.
            
            Yeah, you'll be fine. This stuff is vile, though, and the stench is distracting and dizzying all at once. You're sure that it'll pass by the time it dries off, but who knows how long it'll be in this muggy atmosphere?
            
            "Goddess' mercy, you look frightful. But even if I'd a cloth or something, it wouldn't be enough to clean you up," Elthara adds, patting you on the shoulder. "You're sure you'll be all right?"
            
            You groan and pick off the worst bits of rotting sludge from your [pc.armor]. As well as can be when stinking so horribly it's enough to make someone light-headed, you suppose. Now to see just what you've stumbled into, and whether you've just leapt out of the frying pan and right into the fire...
        ]
rows.translation:
对于这种情况，似乎你无能为力。如果你想成功逃脱，那么在尽可能抵挡那些元素生物的触手的同时拼命逃跑，就是你唯一的选择了。“或许当那些水靠近的时候，我可以试着把其中的一部分冻结起来，”瑞恩满怀希望地提议道。根据我们所看到的情况，我在奔跑的过程中可能无法把它们全部拿到手，但总比什么都没有要好。”如果能做到这一点，我会非常感激的。好吧，没什么好说的。你绷紧腿部肌肉，深吸一口气，然后开始冲刺，朝着那座桥跑去吧。 [party.manyCompanions
            |[comp2.name], 
        ]林恩和艾尔萨拉跟在你的身后，沿着桥面分散开来，尽可能地分散那些元素生物的注意力。你刚靠近桥柱，河水的表面立刻开始翻腾起泡沫，一缕缕黑色的水触从满是污垢的河面上延伸出来，向你袭来。你早已做好了准备，第一根液态触手就轻轻擦过了你的身体 [pc.hair] 就在你及时躲开的同时，又有几道攻击瞄准了瑞恩和艾尔萨拉。一些腐烂的物质溅到了地上，但瑞恩利用你创造的这个机会，射出一支冰箭，发动了反击。下一条朝你袭来的触手立刻被冻住了，那些肮脏的冰块掉落到地上并碎裂开来——不过这些冰块并没有持续太久，它们会慢慢移动到河岸边，重新融入那个元素生物的主体之中。
        
        [pc.agilityRange 65
            |不过，你真的算是侥幸逃过一劫。当你全神贯注地观察头顶上的景象，同时努力让自己的双腿不停地移动时，你并没有注意到有一根液态的触须正在缓缓逼近；然而，你的眼角突然瞥见了什么，于是你及时抽回了脚，才得以避开被缠住的危险。不过，这个元素生物并没有放弃——既然已经开始了这场“游戏”，又有几圈恶臭的触须从水流中伸了出来，它们显然决心要把你拖进水中去。[pc.Name]砰！”瑞恩将一支冰冷的箭射中那条正朝你袭来的水藤，为你赢得了逃脱的机会，让你得以全力奔逃。你又侥幸躲过了几次险境，从最后一次试图抓住你的攻击下钻了过去，最终滚到了对岸——尽管经历了这一切，你却毫发无伤。 [party.manyCompanions
                |[comp2.name], 
            ]莱恩和艾尔萨拉也很快就跟了上来——看来那个元素生物主要把注意力放在了你身上，所以他们基本上没受到什么影响。知道你这么受欢迎，真是太好了……大家都没事吧？
            
            艾尔萨拉试探性地闻了闻自己手背的味道，然后做了个鬼脸：“我想，我的味道应该还没这么难闻吧。”嗯，如果这种臭味真的是大家面临的最严重的问题，那么你还算运气好的，尤其是考虑到后面还有那些元素力量在肆意乱动的话。看来你不会那么轻易地从那座桥上退下来了——是时候看看你究竟陷入了什么困境，以及你是否只是从火坑跳进了另一个更危险的火坑……
            |但这还不够。当你忙于注视头顶上的景象，同时努力让自己的双腿继续移动时，你根本没有注意到有一根液态的触须正在悄悄接近你；等到你意识到有什么东西抓住了你的脚踝时，你已经开始向下坠向地面了。这种元素生物很快就利用了这一优势——更多的恶臭触须从水流中伸了出来，显然它们是想把你拖进水中。[pc.Name]就在你努力站稳身体的时候，艾尔萨拉抓住你的手臂，将自己抵在桥的栏杆上，然后开始拉你。那个元素生物也绝对不会放开你——至少在瑞恩用几支冰箭射中那些缠住你脚踝的触手之前，它是不会放手的。
            
            这确实是一次艰难的尝试。由于在这段时间里，那个元素生物一直在攻击你们，因此许多又脏又臭的液体溅得到了桥上，也溅到了你们三个人身上。然而，沮丧、愤怒与恐惧反而给了你们力量——只要以后能得到相应的回报就行。你们终于设法爬回了站立姿势，赶在那个元素生物能够再次抓住你们的之前，成功逃出了它的攻击范围。
            
            呼……“你没事吧？”当你试图擦干身体却收效甚微时，瑞恩问道。“应该没问题的。不过这种东西实在太恶心了，那股气味既让人分心，又会让人头晕目眩。等它干掉后，气味应该就会消失吧……不过在这种闷热的空气中，谁知道要过多久才能干掉呢？
            
            天哪，你看起来太糟糕了。不过就算我有布之类的东西，也远远不够用来把你清理干净，”艾尔萨拉一边说，一边轻拍着你的肩膀。“你确定你不会有事吗？”你呻吟着，把身上最严重的腐烂污物清理掉。 [pc.armor]当然，当那种气味浓烈到足以让人头晕目眩的时候，也确实会让人产生这样的感觉。现在，让我们来看看你究竟遇到了什么，以及你是否只是从火坑跳进了另一个更危险的火坑……
        ]
rows.raw:
"
        There doesn't seem to be anything you can do about the situation. If you want to get across, making a run for it while fending off the elemental's tentacles as best as you can is your only option here.
        
        "I could perhaps freeze some of the water when it gets close," Ryn volunteers hopefully. "Given what we saw, I probably wouldn't be able to get them all while running, but it'd be better than nothing."
        
        That would be appreciated.
        
        Well, nothing for it. Tensing the muscles in your legs, you take a deep breath and break into a sprint, making for the bridge; [party.manyCompanions
            |[comp2.name], 
        ]Ryn and Elthara follow in your wake, spreading out along the bridge's span to divide the elemental's attention as much as possible.
        
        No sooner have you drawn close to the bridge posts that the stream's surface churns and froths, tendrils of dark water exploding from the scum-choked surface to meet you. Ready as you are, the first liquid tentacle grazes your [pc.hair] as you duck just in time to avoid it, followed by a couple more aimed at Ryn and Elthara. Bits of rotting matter splatter to the ground, but Ryn uses the opening you've created to nock an icy arrow and looses a counterattack. The next tendril that comes for you winds up frozen solid, filthy ice falling to the ground and shattering — not that the liquid doesn't stay frozen for long, slowly creeping to the riverbank to rejoin the elemental's main body.
        
        [pc.agilityRange 65
            |You have a close call, though. While you've been busy watching the spectacle above your head and focusing on keeping your legs moving, you fail to notice a liquid tendril coming low; however, a shadow catches the corner of your eye and you pull your foot out of the way just in time to avoid being snagged. The elemental isn't about to give up, though — now that the game is up, several more stinking coils emerge from the stream, clearly intent on dragging you down into the water.
            
            "[pc.Name]!" Ryn puts a freezing arrow into the nearest tendril of water going for you, giving you the opening you need to disengage and make a full-on run for it. You narrowly dodge several more close calls, duck under a last-ditch grab, and roll onto the other bank winded but untouched throughout the entire ordeal. [party.manyCompanions
                |[comp2.name], 
            ]Ryn and Elthara follow shortly after — it looks like the elemental had been focusing its attention mostly on you, leaving them mostly untouched. It's nice to know that you're so popular...
            
            Is everyone okay?
            
            Elthara gives the back of her hand a tentative sniff and makes a face. "I could smell worse, I suppose."
            
            Well, if the stink's the worst of everyone's problems, then you got off lightly, especially with the elemental thrashing about in the back. Looks like you're not going to be retreating over the bridge that easily — time to see just what you've stumbled into, and whether you've just leapt out of the frying pan and right into the fire...
            |It's not enough, though. While you've been busy watching the spectacle above your head and focusing on keeping your legs moving, you fail to notice a liquid tendril coming low; by the time you've realized something's caught you by the ankle, you're already on your way down to the ground. The elemental is quick to press its advantage — several more stinking coils emerge from the stream, clearly intent on dragging you down into the water.
            
            "[pc.Name]!" As you scramble to right yourself, Elthara grabs you by under the arms, braces herself against the bridge's railings, and pulls. The elemental isn't about to let you go, either — not until Ryn puts several freezing arrows into the tendrils clinging onto your ankles, at the very least.
            
            It's a rough effort, and given that the elemental's assailing all of you while this is going on, more than a little of the foul, stinking liquid splashes all over the bridge and the three of you. Yet frustration, anger and fear all lend you strength on the condition of being repaid with interest later on, and you manage to scramble back upright to close that last bit of distance and make it out of the elemental's grasping reach.
            
            Phew.
            
            "Are you all right?" Ryn asks as you try to dry yourself without much success.
            
            Yeah, you'll be fine. This stuff is vile, though, and the stench is distracting and dizzying all at once. You're sure that it'll pass by the time it dries off, but who knows how long it'll be in this muggy atmosphere?
            
            "Goddess' mercy, you look frightful. But even if I'd a cloth or something, it wouldn't be enough to clean you up," Elthara adds, patting you on the shoulder. "You're sure you'll be all right?"
            
            You groan and pick off the worst bits of rotting sludge from your [pc.armor]. As well as can be when stinking so horribly it's enough to make someone light-headed, you suppose. Now to see just what you've stumbled into, and whether you've just leapt out of the frying pan and right into the fire...
        ]
        "

rows.original: You don't have any means of making the situation better, or simply aren't willing to use it. Make a run for it across the bridge and hope that your agility is up to snuff.
rows.translation: 你没有任何办法来改善这种局面，或者干脆就是不愿意采取任何行动。那就赶紧穿过那座桥吧，希望你的敏捷性足够好，能够顺利通过。
rows.raw: "You don't have any means of making the situation better, or simply aren't willing to use it. Make a run for it across the bridge and hope that your agility is up to snuff."

rows.original: You take a look down at the dark waters beneath the bridge, slow and sluggish, and shake your head. With how narrow the canal is, you might be able to make it across with some mighty feat of acrobatics, but you're still not inclined to take your chances. Maybe you'll find a way around, maybe you'll discover a better way to deal with this river lurker, or maybe whatever's on the other side just isn't worth the risk of making the crossing. Whatever your reason, you decide to fall back and leave the bridge be for now.
rows.translation: 你低头看着桥下那漆黑的水面，水流显得缓慢而滞涩，于是你摇了摇头。考虑到这条运河如此狭窄，或许通过一些高难度的杂技动作才能成功穿过，但你还是觉得冒这个险并不值得。也许你可以找到其他的绕行路线，或许能想出更好的办法来应对这条河中的“潜伏者”，又或许对岸的东西根本不值得你冒险去穿越。无论出于什么原因，你最终决定暂时放弃这个想法，先不过桥了。
rows.raw: "\n        You take a look down at the dark waters beneath the bridge, slow and sluggish, and shake your head. With how narrow the canal is, you might be able to make it across with some mighty feat of acrobatics, but you're still not inclined to take your chances. Maybe you'll find a way around, maybe you'll discover a better way to deal with this river lurker, or maybe whatever's on the other side just isn't worth the risk of making the crossing. Whatever your reason, you decide to fall back and leave the bridge be for now.\n        "

rows.original: Fall back for now; maybe you'll find a better way to deal with this river lurker later.
rows.translation: 暂时先退一步吧，也许以后你会找到更好的方法来应对这个隐藏在河流中的敌人。
rows.raw: "Fall back for now; maybe you'll find a better way to deal with this river lurker later."

rows.original: If she doesn't mind... Ryn steps up and studies what inscriptions that haven't been obscured by mold and sap, then gives you a nod. "The runes are a bit archaic from what we use today, but I can indeed translate for you." "Don't worry," Elthara chuckles. "I'll be sure to correct the [etheryn.crowned |queen |princess-regent ] if she makes a mistake." Well, if she would begin, that'd be great. Ryn turns to the writing on the nearest wall and traces her finger — or would have, before remembering the mold and shrinking back. Slowly, she begins reading aloud... Henceforth Let It Be Claimed: Blessed of the Wyld be the daughters of Flendel Theruviel; so named Thea, Andrea, Gena, Sara, Kira, and Larissa; who in good mercy have been rightworthy and true to the calling, having repeatedly provided much-needed leather goods, grain, and care for the convalescent and woefully poor in their hour of need. From this day in the fifth of the reign of the winter queen Atheldred var Ridell, forever shall your issue be watched over by the fortunes of the Wyld. "There're more names here," Ryn continues. "A list of faithful almsgivers stretching back three millennia — not that the alms were needed by the druids themselves, and so most of what was given was passed onto the needy, as the passage implies. Given that this is one of the oldest druidic temples, I'm not surprised that so many peoples' names have been recorded." It certainly is one way to be immortalized, at least in some small fashion. But seeing the common folk honored warms the heart, and you think the Lumians continued the tradition, didn't they? "Recognizing the generosity of almsgivers is simply common courtesy," Elthara replies. "We'd be terribly remiss if we didn't give these people recognition, especially from those who are giving a bigger proportion of what they have." You see. What about this other tablet, then? This one looks a lot more hastily carved and newer, inasmuch as anything can be new in this moldering pit. For those who may see this after we have passed: Know that in our dying moments we have tried our best in our duty and fought valiantly to the very end, even if we did not succeed. First the monsters from the void between the spheres, then our own queen who turned against us, and finally this malaise has arrived from one or the other to wipe us from the face of the world. As this corrupted fungus turns our magics on us and feeds on our own connection to the Old Wyld to spread along the stones and walls, infesting this place, please remember our names. "A list of names, presumably the initiates who lived in this dormitory," Ryn says. "You're not wrong, [pc.name], looks like it was done very hastily. Did the fungus spread that quickly? No, that was a silly question. Of course it did." That's all the writing that's here? "That's all." [pc.isChamp |Maybe after you make it out of here, you can return later and have these retrieved. Surely at least a couple of names on these lists ought to have surviving relatives or descendants hanging around... it would be nice to know and reflect well on Ryn's reign, if nothing else, give her a bit of a boost in popularity. Gods know that she'll need it as [etheryn.crowned |queen |regent ]. ]
rows.translation: 如果她不介意的话……瑞恩走上前，仔细观察那些没有被霉菌或树液覆盖的铭文，然后点了点头：“这些符文与我们现在使用的有些不同，但我确实可以帮你翻译。”“别担心，”艾尔萨拉笑着说，“要是[etheryn.crowned |女王 |摄政公主 ]犯了错，我一定会指出来。””“嗯，如果她能开始尝试的话，那就太好了。”莱恩转向最近那面墙上的文字，用手指沿着字迹划过——本来是打算这么做的，但想起墙上的霉菌后，她立刻缩了回去。慢慢地，她开始大声朗读起来…… 从此以后，人们应当这样宣称：弗伦德尔·特鲁维埃尔的女儿们——名叫西娅、安德莉亚、吉娜、萨拉、基拉和拉里萨的这些女性——因她们的善良与忠诚而受到荒野之神的庇佑。在人们最需要的时候，她们始终慷慨解囊，提供了人们急需的皮革制品、粮食，并为那些生病康复或生活贫困的人提供了帮助。从今天起，在冬之女王阿瑟尔德雷德·瓦·里德尔统治的第五个年头开始，你们的后代将永远受到荒野之神的庇护与眷顾。 这里还有更多的名字，”瑞恩继续说道，“这是一份名单，列出了那些在三千年间一直慷慨解囊、乐于助人的人们的名字——其实德鲁伊们本身并不需要这些帮助，所以大部分捐赠的钱和物资都被用来帮助那些需要帮助的人了，正如这段文字所暗示的那样。既然这是最古老的德鲁伊神庙之一，那么有这么多人的名字被记录在这里，我并不感到意外。这确实是一种让名字永垂不朽的方式，尽管只是以一种微小的形式。但看到普通民众能够获得这样的荣誉，确实让人感到温暖。而且你认为卢米安人也是延续了这一传统的，对吧？ 认识到施舍者的慷慨是一种基本的礼貌，”艾尔萨拉回答道，“如果我们不向这些人表示感谢，尤其是那些捐赠了他们大部分财产的人，那我们就太失礼了。你看，那另一块石板怎么样？这块看起来像是匆匆雕刻出来的，而且看起来更新一些——毕竟在这个破败的地方，什么东西都可能算是‘新的’吧。 对于那些在我们离开后才会看到这些文字的人：请知道，在我们生命的最后时刻，我们已经尽了自己最大的努力去履行职责，也英勇地战斗到了最后一刻，尽管我们最终并没有取得成功。首先是来自各个领域之间的虚空的怪物，然后是我们自己的女王背叛了我们，最后，这种灾祸从某个地方降临，将我们从这个世界上抹去。 当这种腐烂的真菌反过来利用我们的魔法，侵蚀我们与古老荒野之间的联系，通过石头和墙壁蔓延开来，逐渐侵袭这个地方时，请记住我们的名字。 这是一份名单，上面列着那些住在这间宿舍里的新成员的名字，”瑞恩说道。“你说得没错 [pc.name]看起来这是非常仓促地完成的。真菌真的会蔓延得那么快吗？不，这个问题太愚蠢了——当然会了。这里就只有这些文字吗？“就这些。 [pc.isChamp |也许等你离开这里之后，还可以再回来取这些东西。这些名单上至少应该有一些人的亲属或后代还活着吧……知道这些信息会对评价莱恩的统治有所帮助，至少也能提升她的一些人气。天知道，身为[etheryn.crowned |女王 |摄政者 ]，她确实需要这份支持。 ]

rows.original: These are written in the old boer'alvarin. Why don't you ask one of the pale elf ladies to translate for you?
rows.translation: 这些是用古老的布尔阿尔瓦林文字写成的。你为什么不请一位淡色精灵女士来帮你翻译呢？
rows.raw: "These are written in the old boer'alvarin. Why don't you ask one of the pale elf ladies to translate for you?"

rows.original:
As you make to leave the dormitories through the northern hallway, a sudden chill crawls up the back of your neck. This feeling... yes, you encountered in the ruined plaza just outside the temple, not too long ago. While nothing's happened for now, you're certain that should you press ahead, you'll be confronted by more of the restless dead.

    Knowing that, will you proceed?
rows.translation:
当你沿着北侧的走廊离开宿舍时，一股突如其来的寒意从后颈蔓延开来。这种感觉……没错，你不久前在寺庙外的废墟广场上也曾经历过。虽然目前还没有发生什么，但你确信，如果继续前进，必定会遇到更多那些不安宁的死者。

    既然知道了这一点，你还会继续前进吗？
rows.raw:
"
    As you make to leave the dormitories through the northern hallway, a sudden chill crawls up the back of your neck. This feeling... yes, you encountered in the ruined plaza just outside the temple, not too long ago. While nothing's happened for now, you're certain that should you press ahead, you'll be confronted by more of the restless dead.

    Knowing that, will you proceed?
    "

rows.original: Malevolence in the air or not, you've got to get through here. The sensation of being watched only intensifies with the next few steps you take, until it all happens at once: translucent specters rise from the fungal remains and lurch out through the walls, their gazes filled with equal parts desire and rage as they scream and lunge for your party. Hermaphroditic bodies, sores scabbed over with fungal growth, the spirits of the druidic initiates are twisted into overgrown, cancerous mockeries of the life and vitality they once revered. No words are needed — if the fungal infestation isn't outright puppeteering their bodies, then it's driven them well beyond the point of reason. Gripping your [pc.weapon] tightly, you prepare to set yourself against these corrupted spirits. It's a fight!
rows.translation: 无论空气中是否弥漫着恶意，你都必须穿过这里。每走几步，那种被监视的感觉就会愈发强烈，直到一切都同时发生：半透明的幽灵从那些真菌残骸中浮现出来，穿过墙壁冲了出来，它们那充满欲望与愤怒的目光紧盯着你的队伍，同时发出尖叫并扑向你们。这些拥有两性特征的躯体上，那些被真菌侵蚀而结痂的伤口，仿佛在宣告德鲁伊学徒们曾经崇敬的生命与活力，如今已变成了畸形的、充满恶意的嘲弄。 无需任何言语——如果说这种真菌感染没有直接控制他们的身体，那么它至少也已经将他们逼到了理智的边缘之外。紧紧抓住 [pc.weapon] 你严阵以待，准备与这些堕落的灵魂展开对抗。 这是一场激烈的战斗！

Gripping your [pc.weapon] tightly, you prepare to set yourself against these corrupted spirits. It's a fight! "

rows.original: You're ready to fight whatever comes at you.
rows.translation: 你已经做好了迎接任何挑战的准备。
rows.raw: "You're ready to fight whatever comes at you."

rows.original: No, not just yet. Either you need a moment to be better prepared, or perhaps you don't want to fight if you can help it and would rather try finding another way around. Thinking back, there was that fork in the hallway just behind you... maybe a more palatable alternative will present itself. You take a step back, and the tiny mushrooms, creeping mold and amber ooze all look positively alive as you do so. Maybe it's just a trick of the light... but probably not, not with the way it undulates and squirms under your gaze. It knows it's being watched... You retreat to the dormitories, and consider your next move.
rows.translation: 不，还不是现在。要么你需要一些时间来做好更充分的准备，要么也许你并不想战斗，如果可以避免的话，你更愿意尝试寻找其他的解决办法。回想一下，就在你身后那条走廊里，有那个岔路口……也许会有一个更可行的替代方案出现。 你后退了一步，那些小小的蘑菇、爬行的霉菌以及琥珀色的黏液，看起来全都活着当你这样做的时候，或许只是光线的错觉……但很可能不是，因为那些东西在你的注视下确实在蠕动、在晃动。它们知道有人在看着它们…… 你回到了宿舍，开始思考下一步该怎么做。

Thinking back, there was that fork in the hallway just behind you... maybe a more palatable alternative will present itself. You take a step back, and the tiny mushrooms, creeping mold and amber ooze all look positively alive as you do so. Maybe it's just a trick of the light... but probably not, not with the way it undulates and squirms under your gaze. It knows it's being watched... You retreat to the dormitories, and consider your next move. "

rows.original:
It's over. The last of the infested spirits dissolves into discolored ectoplasm with a wail and you whirl around, expecting more, but none emerge from the walls to assail you. From the number of personal quarters branching off from the dormitories, you'd have expected more than just that handful, but maybe it's a small mercy that the remaining victims avoided being trapped in undeath by the fungal infestation, then.
    
    Still, you pause a moment to check the air, and it's when you're sure that the crawling sensation is no longer pressed against your skin that you proceed confidently into the northern hallway. There's still a lot more of this temple to cover...
rows.translation:
一切都结束了。最后那些被真菌侵扰的灵魂在哀嚎声中化作变色的 ectoplasm 消散了，你转过身，本以为还会有更多东西出现，但墙壁里再也没有任何东西冲出来攻击你。从宿舍里分出的那些私人房间数量来看，你本以为会有更多的受害者，但或许，剩下的那些人没有因为这种真菌感染而陷入不死的状态，这也算是一种小小的幸运吧。
    
    不过，你还是停了一下，仔细观察周围的空气。直到确定那种爬行般的触感不再紧贴着你的皮肤时，你才放心地走进了北侧的走廊。这座寺庙还有许多地方需要探索呢。..

"

    "

rows.original: Out of the frying pan and into the fire, indeed. No sooner have you crested the top of the stairs and set foot on the upper landing that a small army of druidic specters burst forth from the walls and fungus-overgrown remains alike, moaning and panting in a disturbingly sexual manner as they reach for you with outstretched ghostly arms. You must be close, then, for whatever intelligence that holds this temple enthralled to muster all its forces at once and throw them against you in a last-ditch attempt to stop you in your tracks. With how many of them there are, this has to be the remainder of the congregation. "It's nearly over," Ryn says to herself through gritted teeth, nocking an arrow and taking aim at the nearest ghost clad in green, white and gold. "It's nearly over." [party.randComp arona quintillus |Arona, though, is in much higher spirits than Ryn is — she would be when faced with overwhelming odds, wouldn't she? Letting out a roar to deafen the spirits', she hurls herself straight into battle, swinging wildly with her [arona.weapon]. Finally, in all of this, she's truly in her element, allowing her battle-fury to push all fear of her foes from her mind. |On his part, Quin gives you a weak grin and shrugs. "And here I thought joining a sex cult was the craziest time of my life. If I'm to be perfectly honest, [pc.name]... coming along with you on these adventures has been the best and worst time of my life all at once, and I wouldn't have it any other way." You too. ] Even if the stairs weren't filled with disgusting sap, bits of plant matter and the very obstacle which you overcame to get here in the first place, you wouldn't be able to retreat quickly enough to avoid the incoming horde of revenants. There's nothing left for it, then, but to get your backs to the nearest wall and hold out against them. It's a fight!
rows.translation: 真是从火坑跳进了另一个火坑。你刚爬上楼梯的顶端，踏上上层平台，一大群德鲁伊幽灵就从墙壁和长满真菌的残骸中冲了出来，它们发出令人不安的、带有性暗示的呻吟声，用伸出的幽灵之手向你扑来。那么，你们一定离那个地方非常近了。因为正是某种神秘的力量让这座寺庙如此令人着迷，才会迫使它集结所有力量，发起最后的攻击，试图阻止你们的前进。考虑到它们的数量之多，这些肯定就是剩下的那些生物了。 差不多要结束了，”瑞恩咬紧牙关自言自语道，她搭上一支箭，瞄准了那个穿着绿白金三色服装的鬼魂。“差不多要结束了。 [party.randComp arona quintillus |然而，阿罗娜的精神状态要比瑞恩好得多——面对如此巨大的困难，她肯定也会这么做的，不是吗？她发出一声震耳欲聋的吼叫，然后猛地冲向战场，挥舞着她的武器疯狂地战斗起来 [arona.weapon]最终，在这一切之中，她真正找到了属于自己的舞台，让战斗中的狂热彻底驱走了对敌人的恐惧。 |昆因只是淡淡地笑了笑，然后耸了耸肩：“我还以为加入这个性崇拜组织才是我一生中最疯狂的经历呢。说实话 [pc.name]能够与你一起经历这些冒险，对我来说既是人生中最美好的时光，也是最艰难的阶段。但我毫不后悔这样的经历。” 你也是吧。 ] 即使楼梯上没有那些令人作呕的树液、植物残渣，以及你当初为到达这里而必须克服的那些障碍，你也不可能迅速撤退以避免那些即将袭来的亡灵大军。那么，你唯一能做的就是背靠最近的墙壁，顽强抵抗它们。 这是一场激烈的战斗！

If I'm to be perfectly honest, [pc.name]... coming along with you on these adventures has been the best and worst time of my life all at once, and I wouldn't have it any other way." You too. ] Even if the stairs weren't filled with disgusting sap, bits of plant matter and the very obstacle which you overcame to get here in the first place, you wouldn't be able to retreat quickly enough to avoid the incoming horde of revenants. There's nothing left for it, then, but to get your backs to the nearest wall and hold out against them. It's a fight! "

rows.original: The horde seems inexhaustible, but you fell one specter after the other, forcing them to lose coherence and dissolve into stinking, sap-stained ectoplasm. Even in that state, the lustful rage that animates them is palpable, and the sheer intensity of the emotion which the Wraith's weapon inflicted upon them is overpowering, to say the least. But just when you've cut down a druidic spirit and swing your [pc.weapon] around to intercept the next one, a sudden change comes over the upper landing: a pulse of cold serenity sweeps over the once luxurious chamber, reminiscent of a clear morning in the Winter City, mixed with the smell you get after rain. A breath of fresh air in this choking corruption, made all the sweeter by its contrast. "What — " Elthara begins, leaving little doubt that you're not the only one to sense this. If anything, the boreal elves are keener to the change in atmosphere than you are, thrown off-kilter enough to lower their guard in the midst of battle. It's a good thing, then, that the remaining specters start losing consistency and dissolving, while the roots jutting out of the walls pull back — not all the way, but enough to cause chunks of marble to fall from the ceiling. It isn't trying to drop the room in on you, is it? Thankfully, neither the floor falls away, nor does the roof cave in on you. All you're left with in the aftermath of the battle is a sudden quietness so loud that you can hear it, and an ankle-thick coating of foulness on the floor. Despite the serenity that pervades the air, you don't like it one bit — it feels all too distinctly like the calm in the eye of a storm... But whatever the reason the seemingly inexhaustible horde withdrew, you have a moment's peace.
rows.translation: 那股怪物群似乎无穷无尽，但你一个接一个地消灭了它们，迫使它们失去组织性，最终化作那些散发着恶臭、沾满树液的幽灵物质。即便处于那种状态，驱动它们行动的狂怒依然显而易见，而那些幽灵所使用的武器所激发的那种强烈情感，至少可以说，是极其可怕的。但是，就在你刚刚消灭了一个德鲁伊灵魂，正准备继续攻击的时候 [pc.weapon] 就在即将拦截下一个目标的时候，上层的降落舱突然发生了变化：一股寒冷而宁静的气息弥漫在了这个曾经奢华的房间里，这种气息让人联想到冬城某个晴朗的早晨，同时还带着雨后空气中的那种清新味道。在这令人窒息的腐败环境中，这一股清新的空气显得格外珍贵，其带来的对比效果使得这种改变显得更加甜美。 “什么——”艾尔萨拉开口说道，这无疑表明，不止你一个人感受到了这种变化。事实上，极北精灵们对这种氛围的变化更为敏感，他们的反应甚至让你感到惊讶——在战斗进行的过程中，这种变化竟然让他们放松了警惕。幸好，剩下的那些幽灵开始变得不再稳定，逐渐消失不见了，而那些从墙壁中伸出来的根也开始缩回——虽然没有完全收回，但已经足以导致天花板上的大理石块一块块掉落下来。 它并不是想突然把整个房间压在你身上，对吧？ 幸运的是，地面没有塌下来，屋顶也没有坍塌。战斗结束后，留下的只有那种如此刺耳的寂静听到地上到处都是这种东西，还覆盖着一层厚厚的污秽。尽管空气中弥漫着宁静的气氛，但你却一点也不喜欢这种感觉——这简直就像暴风雨前的宁静…… 不过，不管是什么原因让这支看似无穷无尽的队伍撤走了，你总算得到了片刻的安宁。

Even in that state, the lustful rage that animates them is palpable, and the sheer intensity of the emotion which the Wraith's weapon inflicted upon them is overpowering, to say the least. rows.original:
As you start on the stairs reading up to the next level of the temple, a sense of unease settles deep into the pit of your stomach. Something about this climb is off — you note that the vines lining the walls rustle at your passing despite the air being still, and there's a sensation of static in the air, much like that of a gathering dry thunderstorm. Nothing's coming at you just yet, but the sense of impending danger is unmistakable. If you're intent on passing through, you're going to have to face what's lurking in this stairwell.
    
    Knowing this, will you proceed anyway?
rows.translation:
当你开始登上楼梯，朝着寺庙的上一层前进时，一种不安的感觉逐渐在你的胃里蔓延开来。这次攀登似乎有些不对劲——你注意到，尽管空气静止不动，但墙壁上攀爬的藤蔓却在你经过时沙沙作响，空气中还弥漫着一种静电般的氛围，就像一场即将来临的干雷暴前的预兆。目前还没有什么东西向你袭来，但那种迫在眉睫的危险感却是显而易见的。如果你决心要继续前进，那么你就必须面对这个楼梯间里潜藏的威胁。
    
    知道了这些，你还是会继续前进吗？
rows.raw:
"
    As you start on the stairs reading up to the next level of the temple, a sense of unease settles deep into the pit of your stomach. Something about this climb is off — you note that the vines lining the walls rustle at your passing despite the air being still, and there's a sensation of static in the air, much like that of a gathering dry thunderstorm. Nothing's coming at you just yet, but the sense of impending danger is unmistakable. If you're intent on passing through, you're going to have to face what's lurking in this stairwell.
    
    Knowing this, will you proceed anyway?
    "

rows.original: Given that you've prepared as best as you can, there's no point in putting it off any longer. After the first dozen steps, the sensation of static suddenly surges — pink-tinged energies surge off the tips of the vine-like fungal tendrils, gathering into a ball of crackling light. This is rapidly followed by the vines themselves, pulling and knitting themselves about the elemental's core until you're facing a writhing mass of fleshy, tentacular tendrils. Corded appendages possessed of inhuman strength and volatile energies alike waver in all directions akin to a perverse tumbleweed; all of them as thick as your arm and capped with oozing, phallus-like tips or orifices that distinctly resemble swollen, blooming pussies. There's little rhyme or reason to the mass of vegetation — only a theme of rampant, overgrown sexuality encouraged to an obscene degree by the corrupted druidic magics within. [var0 |You finally recognize the sensation crawling on your skin: it's akin, but not identical to the one which the unstable elementals gave off when you made the site of Cait's temple safe for restoration. Whether that knowledge will be of any use... well, you'll find out soon enough. [party.has cait |Cait turns her eyes to you questioningly, and it's clear that she's felt it, too. You give her a nod of acknowledgement, and together you ready yourselves to face this foe. ] ] It's a fight!
rows.translation: 既然你已经尽了最大努力去准备，再拖延下去也没有意义了。当迈出最初的十几步之后，一种静电般的感应突然涌现出来——那些呈粉红色的能量从那些类似藤蔓的真菌触须的末端释放出来，汇聚成一团闪烁着光芒的球体。紧接着，这些藤蔓本身也会开始蠕动，它们会缠绕在那个元素核心周围，最终形成一团由肉质触手构成的扭曲怪物。 这些带有非人类般力量与不稳定能量的绳状附肢会向四面八方摆动，就像一颗扭曲的风滚草；它们的粗细与人的手臂相当，末端则长着不断渗出液体的、类似阳具的突起，或者是一些看起来像肿胀、绽放的阴户般的开口。这种茂密的植被分布毫无规律可言，唯一能解释这种现象的，就是那些被腐蚀的德鲁伊魔法在极大程度上激发了人们那种肆无忌惮、过度膨胀的性欲。 [var0 |你终于意识到了那种在皮肤上爬动的感觉：它与你在保护凯特神庙的遗址以便进行修复时，那些不稳定的元素所散发出的感觉有些相似，但又不完全相同。至于这种认知是否会有什么用处……嗯，你很快就会知道答案的。 [party.has cait |凯特疑惑地看向你，显然她也感觉到了同样的事情。你向她点了点头表示认同，然后你们一起准备好了面对这个敌人。 ] ] 这是一场激烈的战斗！

Whether that knowledge will be of any use... well, you'll find out soon enough. [party.has cait |Cait turns her eyes to you questioningly, and it's clear that she's felt it, too. You give her a nod of acknowledgement, and together you ready yourselves to face this foe. ] ] It's a fight! "

rows.original: You're as ready as you'll ever be.
rows.translation: 你已经做好了充分的准备。
rows.raw: "You're as ready as you'll ever be."

rows.original: Hesitating, you back away from the stairs, and the sensation of crackling energy on your skin fades. Breathing a sigh of relief that whatever danger there is isn't pursuing out out of its domain, you turn your mind to the problem at hand. It looks like given what you felt, it may be prudent to have some storm resistance on tap, if nothing else. There doesn't seem to be any other avenue to progress through the ruined, infested temple, so sally forth once you've steeled yourself.
rows.translation: 你犹豫了一下，然后退开了楼梯，那种能量在皮肤上产生的刺痛感也逐渐消失了。你松了一口气，心想不管有什么危险，它应该没有超出自己的活动范围来追击你。接下来，你开始思考当前面临的问题。根据你刚才感受到的那些现象，看来采取一些措施或许是明智的。抗风暴能力至少，还有这个选择。 在这个被破坏、充满危险的神庙里，似乎没有其他办法可以继续前进了，所以当你下定决心后，就立刻行动吧。
rows.raw: " Hesitating, you back away from the stairs, and the sensation of crackling energy on your skin fades. Breathing a sigh of relief that whatever danger there is isn't pursuing out out of its domain, you turn your mind to the problem at hand. It looks like given what you felt, it may be prudent to have some storm resistance on tap, if nothing else. There doesn't seem to be any other avenue to progress through the ruined, infested temple, so sally forth once you've steeled yourself. "

rows.original: You need a moment to prepare.
rows.translation: 你需要一点时间来准备。

rows.original: [var0 |No point in dragging this out when you have to tools to end it quickly. Reaching out with your magic, you slip beneath the writhing mass of dripping tentacles and sever the link which keeps the corrupted elemental together — merely banishing it would simply move the problem elsewhere, and you want to get rid of it. Nothing happens for a second or two, and then slowly but surely, light begins to seep out from between the rents in the fleshy husk of vines, growing more and more intense by the moment. The elemental stops trying to attack you, grasping at itself in pain — and then it explodes with a wet splortch and burst of volatile energies. Stinking sap sprays down the stairs as scorched tentacles are thrown in all directions, twitching with the last remnants of life before going still. That's one way to banish an elemental, you suppose. |The corrupt elemental's core was already unstable to begin with, and [lastStanding.HPDefeated |you've dealt enough damage to start a runaway reaction in its core. As the incandescent husk succumbs to its own volatile energies |overloading it with lustful energies has proven a surprisingly effective strategy. As it becomes unable to contain itself ], the pulsing pink light in its exposed core flares up to a blinding brilliance... Images of the druids' many perverse acts in their final moments flash through your mind in that split second — the corruption overtaking them as the fungal weapon tailor-made to destroy them twisted their bodies and magics into an incomprehensible, lustful amalgamation of fuck-hunger, a sick mockery of the ideals they worshipped. And then the elemental explodes, its exposed core ripping itself apart with a wet splortch and burst of volatile energies. Stinking sap oozes from its tentacles as they're thrown all over the stairwell, twitching and grasping futilely at the air, and finally the last of the pink-hued light fades into nothingness. ] With the stairs now clear, the upper reaches of the druidic temple are open to you, inasmuch as a buried structure has upper reaches. You pace them two at a time, warily watching the walls for any new threats that might emerge like the incandescent husk did. [party.oneComp cait brint brienne |"You felt that, didn't you?" Cait whispers as she bounds up the stairs at your side. [var1 |"It was the same kind of energy that flowed from the temple when we took Dad up to stabilize it! That, and also when that creep Tollus threw Calla through the portal!" That stands to reason. The old temple that now has been repurposed to Mallach's service must've once been a druidic one — the pale elves and lupines were the only people in the Marches before the Belharans came. They drew power from the ley-lines that ran across the Marches, didn't they? Maybe this temple's even sitting on the same one that Cait's is on. "H-hey!" Of course, you have no way to prove that. Cait pouts. "Try to be serious, [pc.name]. I'm bringing this up because of what Dad said, remember? Without Tollus or some other creep using up all the power every so often, the temple was going to blow or something in a handful of years if someone didn't do something about it. So my question is: why hasn't this one crumbled already?" You don't know. Maybe it has, and that's why most of it is buried? "That... I didn't think of that." |"It was the same thing at the old temple when the portal opened and that creep Tollus threw Calla through!" That stands to reason. Given the similarities in architecture, your guess is that the old temple under Castle Hawkstone was a druidic one — didn't they have surrounding villages as support, too? Maybe Hawkethorne once belonged to the pale elves before humans and wood elves came up from Belhar — the boer'alvar and lupines were the only people in the Marches before the Belharans came. Hethia said they drew power from the ley-lines which ran across the Marches — maybe these two are connected by the same line? Cait thinks about that, and makes a face. "Eww. But it'd explain a lot." ] That being said, you seriously doubt that the elves have a portal here — something like that wouldn't have stayed buried for long, be it by people wanting to use it or prevent others from using it. The sinking feeling in your gut tells you there's still a whole lot of temple to explore, so perhaps you should save the discussion for when you're safely out of here. |"You know, [pc.name], I just realized something while we were fighting that... that plant back there," Brint says as he keeps pace with you up the stairs. What would that be? "How are we still breathing?" What? Because of the spores? "No — they aren't helping, but that's not what I mean. It's because this place has been buried for the gods know how long." Brint replies, waggling his fingers at the walls. "Every minotaur calf or heifer knows what happens when a tunnel gets sealed off for too long — the air goes stale at first, then bad, then outright poisonous to breathe. When you open up an old collapse that hasn't had any air circulation for years, you need to let out all the bad air first, or else you'll choke and collapse, maybe even die if there's no one around to help. "But we've been running, shouting, fighting — breathing hard, and only all the spores in the air have given us any problems. The air here is still and the temple's been buried for centuries according to that druid lady, so why haven't we all collapsed already?" That's... interesting. You didn't consider that, had too much on your mind. Brint claps you on the shoulder. "Don't feel bad, I'm the one who should know and we haven't had a breather to think, not with all kinds of crazy things throwing themselves at us. But I don't like it one bit, and I'm getting the feeling that we're not going to like the answer if we do stumble across it, either." |"You know, [pc.name], I just realized something while we were fighting that... that plant back there," Brienne says as she keeps pace with you up the stairs. What would that be? "How are we still breathing?" What? Because of the spores? "No — they aren't helping, but that's not what I mean. It's because this place has been buried for the gods know how long." Brienne replies, waggling her fingers at the walls. "Every minotaur calf or heifer knows what happens when a tunnel gets sealed off for too long — the air goes stale at first, then bad, then outright poisonous to breathe. When you open up an old collapse that hasn't had any air circulation for years, you need to let out all the bad air first, or else you'll choke and collapse, maybe even die if there's no one around to help. "But we've been running, shouting, fighting — breathing hard, and only all the spores in the air have given us any problems. The air here is still and the temple's been buried for centuries according to that druid lady, so why haven't we all collapsed already?" That's... interesting. You didn't consider that, had too much on your mind. Brienne smiles and turns up her palms. "Don't feel bad, I'm the one who should know and we haven't had a breather to think, not with all kinds of crazy things throwing themselves at us. But I don't like it one bit, and I'm getting the feeling that we're not going to like the answer if we do stumble across it, either." |Ryn keeps pace with you, tailing slightly behind as she watches the walls like a hawk. "[pc.name], I've been thinking..." Yes? "How big is this place, anyway? We have the palace chapel, and there're some cathedrals to Lumia in the city, but this is something else altogether." Well, from everything that you've seen so far, the way Hethia's people lived feels like it used to be a complete lifestyle. It's not surprising, considering monastic traditions across the world, so you'd expect it to be pretty big? The temple isn't just a place of worship, it's one of work and life — if it were more in the Belharan monastic tradition, it wouldn't be one building, but many buildings. This was supposed to be the biggest and brightest of them all, too, so... maybe as large as the Palace of Ice, if you'd to guess? "That... that makes sense, I guess. I've read some histories on the way druidic temples were, but few people bothered to actually note down their scale. I guess it was because that was something that everyone at the time was expected to know." Or other details like them being situated on ley lines which have the tendency to create nasty elementals if left untended. "Hmm..." ] The last of the stairs passes beneath your feet, and you arrive at a sprawling landing, passageways stretching in all directions. More of the same, more of the same...
rows.translation: [var0 |既然你有工具可以迅速解决这个问题，那就没有必要再拖延下去了。你运用自己的法力，穿梭在那团蠕动着、不断伸出触手的怪物之下，切断了将那些被腐蚀的元素力量凝聚在一起的纽带——仅仅将它们驱散的话，问题只会转移到其他地方去，而你的目标是要彻底消灭它们。 一瞬间什么都没有发生，但随后，光线开始从那些藤蔓柔软的外皮上的裂口中慢慢渗出，而且这种光芒越来越强烈。那个元素生物不再试图攻击你，而是痛苦地抓着自己的身体——然后，它突然爆炸了，迸发出一阵湿漉漉的光芒噗通一声伴随着一阵剧烈的能量爆发，那些散发着恶臭的汁液顺着楼梯喷溅而下，而那些被烧焦的触手则向四面八方甩去，在最后一点生命力的驱使下还在抽搐着，随后便彻底静止不动了。 我想，这应该是一种驱逐元素生物的方法吧。 |这个被腐蚀的元素核心本身就已经很不稳定了，更何况 [lastStanding.HPDefeated |你造成的伤害已经足以引发其核心处的连锁反应。当这颗炽热的外壳在自身剧烈的能量作用下逐渐消亡时…… |用充满欲望的能量去“充斥”它，这种做法被证明是出奇有效的。因为这样一来，它就无法再控制自己了。 ]它裸露的核心中闪烁的粉红色光芒骤然迸发出刺目的强光…… 在那一瞬间，德鲁伊们在最后时刻所犯下的种种邪恶行径瞬间浮现在你的脑海中——当那种专门用来毁灭他们的真菌武器扭曲了他们的身体与魔法，将他们的本质变成了一种充满欲望的、令人无法理解的混合体时，腐败已经彻底侵蚀了他们，而这种转变，正是对他们所信奉的理想的一种病态的嘲弄。 然后，那颗元素核心发生了爆炸，它暴露在外的核心部分在剧烈的冲击下开始自我撕裂噗通一声伴随着一阵剧烈的能量爆发，那些触手被抛向楼梯间，不断地抽搐着，徒劳地试图抓住空气中的什么东西。最终，那最后一丝粉红色的光芒也消失得无影无踪。 ] 现在楼梯已经清理完毕，德鲁伊神庙的上层区域终于向你敞开了大门——当然，对于一个被埋藏起来的建筑来说，所谓“上层区域”也只是相对而言罢了。你小心翼翼地一步步向上走去，时刻警惕着墙壁上是否会出现像那团炽热的残壳那样的新威胁。 [party.oneComp cait brint brienne |你也是这么觉得的，对吧？”凯特轻声说道，一边说着一边和你一起快步走上楼梯。 [var1 |就是那种能量，当我们带着爸爸去稳定那座寺庙时，也正是那种能量在流动！还有，当那个叫托勒斯的怪物把卡拉扔进传送门的时候，也是同样的能量！” 这确实很有道理。现在被改造成用于服务马拉克的那座古老寺庙，肯定曾经是一座德鲁伊的神殿——在贝拉兰人到来之前，荒野地带只有苍白精灵和狼人居住。他们是从贯穿那些边境地区的能量脉络中获取力量的，对吧？也许这座寺庙就坐落在与凯特所在的那个能量脉络相同的地点上。 “嘿！” 当然，你根本无法证明这一点。 凯特撅起了嘴：“认真点吧。 [pc.name]我之所以提到这件事，是因为爸爸说过的话，还记得吗？如果没有人采取行动，没有托勒斯或者其他什么怪物时不时地消耗掉所有的能量，那么这座寺庙在几年内就会坍塌或者发生别的什么事情。所以我的问题是：为什么这座寺庙还没有倒塌呢？ 你不知道的。也许它拥有所以大部分内容都被埋藏起来了？ “那个……我之前确实没有考虑到这一点。 |在古老的寺庙里，当传送门打开时，那个叫托勒斯的怪物也是把卡拉扔了进去的！” 这确实很有道理。考虑到建筑风格的相似性，你推测霍克斯通城堡下的那座古老寺庙应该是德鲁伊教的祭祀场所吧——而且它们不也是需要周围村庄作为支撑的吗？也许在人类和森林精灵从贝尔哈尔来到这里之前，鹰棘镇曾经属于那些苍白精灵——在贝尔哈尔人到来之前，布尔阿尔瓦尔人和狼族曾是这片边境地区唯一的居民。赫希娅说过，他们从贯穿整个边境地区的能量脉络中获取力量……也许这两者之间存在着某种联系？ 凯特想了想，然后做了个鬼脸：“呃，不过这确实能解释很多事情。 ] 话虽如此，你还是很难相信精灵们在这里真的设下了传送门——这样的东西不可能长期被埋藏起来，要么会有人想要使用它，要么会有人试图阻止他人使用它。你内心那种不安的感觉在告诉你，这座神庙里还有许多地方有待探索，所以或许你应该把这个话题留到安全离开这里之后再讨论。 |你知道， [pc.name]在我们战斗的时候，我突然意识到了一件事……就是那边那株植物，”布林特一边说，一边跟着你一起上楼。 那会是什么事情呢？ “我们怎么还能继续呼吸呢？” 什么？是因为那些孢子吗？ 不，并不是他们在帮忙，但我的意思并不是这个。而是因为这个地方已经被埋藏了，天知道有多久了。”布林特一边说，一边用手指指着墙壁。“每一个弥诺陶洛斯幼崽都知道，如果隧道被封闭太久，会发生什么——起初空气会变得浑浊，然后变质，最终甚至会变得有毒，无法呼吸。当你打开一个已经多年没有空气流通的旧废墟时，首先必须把里面的污浊空气全部排出去，否则你会窒息而倒下，如果周围没有人帮忙，甚至可能会丧命。 但我们一直在奔跑、呼喊、战斗——呼吸变得十分困难，而真正给我们带来麻烦的，只有空气中的那些孢子。这里的空气很平静，而且根据那位德鲁伊女士的说法，这座寺庙已经被埋藏了几个世纪，那么我们为什么还没有全部倒下呢？ 那……还挺有意思的。你之前确实没考虑到这一点，当时你脑子里有太多事情要处理了。 布林特拍了拍你的肩膀：“别难过，这本该是我该注意到的。我们根本没时间仔细思考，各种疯狂的事情不断涌向我们。但我一点也不喜欢这样，而且我有种预感，就算我们最终找到了答案，我们也不会喜欢那个答案的。 |你知道， [pc.name]在我们战斗的时候，我突然意识到了一件事……就是那边那株植物，”布蕾妮一边说，一边跟着你一起上楼梯。 那会是什么事情呢？ “我们怎么还能呼吸呢？” 什么？是因为那些孢子吗？ 不，并不是他们在帮忙，但我并不是这个意思。而是因为这个地方已经被埋藏了，天知道有多久了。”布蕾妮一边说，一边用手指指着那些墙壁。“每一个弥诺陶洛斯幼崽都知道，如果隧道被封闭太久，会发生什么——起初空气会变得浑浊，然后变得有害，最后甚至会变得有毒，无法呼吸。当你打开一个已经多年没有空气流通的旧废墟时，首先必须把里面的污浊空气全部排出，否则你会窒息而倒下，如果周围没有人帮忙，甚至可能会丧命。 但我们一直在奔跑、呼喊、战斗——呼吸变得十分困难，而真正给我们带来麻烦的，只有空气中的那些孢子。这里的空气很平静，而且根据那位德鲁伊女士的说法，这座寺庙已经被埋藏了几个世纪，那么我们为什么还没有全部倒下呢？ 那……还挺有意思的。你之前确实没考虑到这点，当时你肯定有很多事情要处理。 布蕾妮微笑着，摊开了手掌：“别难过，这本该是我该明白的事情。而且我们根本没机会仔细思考，各种疯狂的事情不断涌向我们。但我真的很不喜欢这样，而且我有种预感，就算我们最终找到了答案，我们也不会喜欢那个答案的。 |瑞恩跟在你身后，略微落后一些，她像鹰一样注视着周围的墙壁。[pc.name]我一直在思考……” “嗯？” “这个东西到底会有多大呢？是这个地方，怎么说呢？我们这里有宫殿礼拜堂，城里也有一些为卢米娅建造的大教堂，但这个地方确实与众不同。” “嗯，从你目前所看到的一切来看，赫希娅族人的生活方式似乎确实是一种独特而完整的生存方式。考虑到世界各地的僧侣传统，这一点也就不足为奇了——因此你也会预料到这座寺庙的规模会相当庞大吧？这座寺庙不仅仅是一个用于礼拜的地方，它还是僧侣们工作和生活的场所。如果它更遵循贝尔哈兰地区的僧侣传统，那么它就不会只是一栋建筑，而会是许多栋建筑组成的群体。这本该是其中最大、最辉煌的建筑，所以……如果你要猜的话，它的规模或许可以和冰之宫殿相媲美吧？ “嗯……我想这也是有道理的。我在路上读过一些关于德鲁伊神殿的记载，但很少有人真正记录下它们的规模。我想，这是因为在那个时候，每个人都应该了解这些知识。 又或者是一些其他的细节，比如这些地方位于那些如果被忽视的话，很可能会引发各种麻烦的元素力量的脉络线上。 嗯…… ] 最后的台阶从你足部下掠过，你便来到了一处宽敞的平台上，通道四通八达，延伸至各个方向。还是老样子，一切依旧如故……

rows.original: Stepping up to the portcullis set into the northern end of the refectory, you give it a look-over. Some kind of mechanism, it would seem... hopefully, the mechanisms haven't gotten all gunked up with things growing in between the moving bits or something. "I'm not surprised," Elthara says. "From what we know of these temples, they were built to be defensible — when need be, people from the surrounding village would be expected to take shelter in it. A chokepoint, then, to seal off the inner temple from the outer should the main entrance be breached. The mechanism that operates the lift to the glacial rift isn't so different; it's only scaled up enough that it has to be driven by goats." You point down the bronze wheel by the gate's side. This ought to be able to be turned by hand, you guess. "Certainly looks like it." Well, do either Ryn or Elthara know how to raise the portcullis over the gate, then? "If it's like any of the others that were built around Njorhaalt back in the day..." Elthara taps her chin, thinking. "How you lift the gate is through this wheel over here: you can turn it left, right, or just hold it in place for a bit. You've got to do this five times, and it's got to be in the correct sequence; for each action in the sequence that you perform correctly, the mechanism will click." Why does it have to be so complicated? "It's like a password — you wouldn't want just anyone being able to raise the portcullis, would you? That'd make sense, if it was intended to cut off potential attackers. At the same time, you wouldn't want to cut yourself off by making it raisable only from one side." So if you got three out of five correct, there'd be three clicks? "That's right. What we want to hear is five clicks from the portcullis mechanism." And... well, of course Elthara wouldn't know the exact sequence in which to turn the wheel. That was silly — what reason would she have to know that? Guess it's up to you to figure this out; it's not as if you're pressed for time or anything.
rows.translation: 走到餐厅北端的那个活板门前，你仔细观察了一下。看起来这是某种机械装置……希望这些机械部件之间没有因为植物生长之类的原因而变得堵塞吧。 我并不感到意外，”艾尔萨拉说道，“根据我们对这些寺庙的了解，它们当初建造的时候就是为了便于防御——在需要时，周围村庄的居民也可以在里面避难。因此，如果主入口被攻破，这些寺庙就可以作为屏障，将内殿与外界隔离开来。驱动电梯前往冰川裂谷的机制其实并没有太大不同，只是规模被扩大了，因此需要用山羊来拉动它。你指向大门旁边那个青铜轮子，心想这个应该可以手动转动吧。 确实看起来是这样。”那么，瑞恩或者艾尔萨拉当中有谁知道如何打开大门上的吊门呢？“如果它和当年在Njorhaalt周围建造的那些吊门一样的话……”艾尔萨拉托着下巴思考着。要打开大门，就需要使用这里的这个轮子：你可以向左转、向右转，或者直接保持当前方向不变。暂时先这样吧。你必须得这么做。必须按照正确的顺序完成五次操作；只要你按照顺序正确地完成每一次操作，这个机制就会启动。为什么非得这么复杂呢？”“这就像密码一样——你肯定不希望随便什么人都能打开那扇门，对吧？如果这样做的目的是为了阻止潜在的攻击者，那么这种设计当然是合理的。但同时，你也不希望自己把自己困在里面，所以才不会设计成只能从某一侧打开吧。”那么，如果答对了五道题中的三道，就需要点击三次吗？“没错。我们希望听到的就是这样的答案。距离栅门机关只有五次点击的距离。嗯……当然，艾尔萨拉不可能知道应该按什么顺序转动那个轮子。这太愚蠢了——她有什么理由需要知道这个呢？我想这个任务就交给你来解决了；反正你也没有时间压力之类的吧。

rows.raw: " [var0 |You finish your sequence of turns, and let go of the wheel to see what happens with the portcullis. Nope, nothing, not even a single click. "Well, it's not a complete loss," Ryn says with a small smile. "At least you learned what most certainly doesn't work." There is that, you suppose. Given that there're only so many combinations of wheel turns to be had, having a complete dud ought to teach you something about what the correct sequence ought to be... "There's no need to get frustrated," Elthara says, patting you on the shoulder. "Take your time. Of course, if you'd rather just give up, there's the other passageway we passed on the way here. We might be able to work our way around, although I'm sure that way has its own challenges, too." |You finish your sequence of turns, and let go of the wheel to see what happens with the portcullis. Nothing happens for a torturously long time... and then a single click rises from the portcullis mechanism. Better than nothing... or perhaps maybe worse, given that you've no way of telling exactly which turn of the wheel was the right one. "Keep on trying," Ryn offers by way of encouragement. "Or if you'd rather not, there's always the other hallway — we might be able to find a way around. Of course, I wager that path'll have its own problems to put in our way." When she puts it like this... a known yet frustrating obstacle against a mystery obstacle that could be easier or worse to deal with. What a choice. "There's no need to get frustrated," Elthara says, patting you on the shoulder. "Take your time." |You finish the sequence of turns and wait for the gate's response. Before too long, two clicks sound from within the mechanism, the portcullis itself still remaining firmly down. Even if you're still some ways off, you're getting closer to the goal. "We're getting warmer," Ryn quips helpfully. "That's a good sign — I'm glad you're here to figure things out for us." Well then, if she were the one trying to figure it out, what would she do? "I'd turn the wheel all the way to one side once, then to the other, then hold it. Figure out how many of each are in the correct sequence," Ryn replies. "That'd help narrow down the potential number of sequences quite a bit, wouldn't it? You'd still have to figure out what goes where, but the kinds of turns that you have to do with the wheel wouldn't be a mystery any more." Well... that's some insight, actually. Not that it's necessarily the only way to figure this out, but it'd certainly make things easier. |You finish the sequence of turns and wait to see if anything happens; sure enough, after a few seconds, you hear three clicks from the gate's internal mechanisms, even if the portcullis doesn't budge. More than halfway there, then — that's got to be good, right? [pc.isDK |It's more than a little embarrassing and infuriating, having an audience right here to watch your failures. Well, at least it's people you know and not a whole gaggle of ghost druids mocking you or something, so you'll take small mercies where they show themselves. |Keeping everyone standing around while they wait for you to get it right is kind of embarrassing, though, so it's probably best that you get this solved quickly... ] "There's no need to get frustrated," Elthara says. "Just turning the wheel randomly and hoping to strike upon the sequence by chance isn't going to get you anywhere — you need to have a strategy to figure it out." Would she mind sharing such a strategy, then? "What works for me might not work for you. Besides, you're at three out of five. Might as well keep on doing what you're doing, right?" |You finish the sequence of turns and wait for the gate's response, which comes almost immediately: a series of four loud clicks and several grinding noises from the portcullis mechanism, strong enough for flecks of aged mold to fall off the brick. Alas, though, the gate still doesn't rise — it'd have been too much to hope you could've gotten a freebie. "Almost there," Elthara says, patting you on the shoulder. "Just got one of them wrong. Question is: which one?" Could be any one of them. Still, you're not too far off. Just have to figure it out, right? "We've always had perfect confidence on you, our Champion of Frost." The way she says it, you could believe it. Just that bit more, then... |No sooner have you finished with the wheel that five clicks sound from within the portcullis mechanisms — something grinds deep within the ancient marble walls, and then sheets of fungi slough off ancient bronze as the gate rises. It's agonzingly slow and at times you fear that the machinery might jam or stall, choked with overgrowth as it is, but eventually it rises into the ceiling and latches with a click. So, who wants to be the first to pass under it? "I'll do it," Ryn volunteers. "A [etheryn.crowned | |future ]queen should lead by example, shouldn't she?" Without further ado, Ryn strides forward [etheryn.highConfidence |boldly |with a deep breath ], passing under the now-raised portcullis and to the other side. When it fails to come crashing down on her either by means of trap or ancient mechanisms failing, you follow suit with Elthara [party.som | |and [comp2.name] ]tailing along behind. rows.original: As you finish wrenching your way through the door at the end of the hall, you find yourself in a secluded side room. The first thing that strikes you is how dark it is. Unlike the rest of the upper rooms you've seen so far, this one lacks the flowing amber veins you've seen everywhere else. From the state of the door, you can't imagine it would stay that way for long, but perhaps you'll be able to use it as a temporary resting place while you're trying to find the wyld tree. And then you hear something move inside. You startle to readiness in an instant. Your eyes still haven't adjusted to the darkness, and your allies are still pushing their way through the door, so if something ambushes you it could spell a terrible outcome. "What is it!? Is there something in there?" Ryn says, [ryn.lowConfidence |her voice tinged with worry |trying to hurry her passage. ] She wriggles double-time to make it through the gap. As she talks, you hear another shift, and then a different voice pierces the silence. "Hello!? Is that help? Oh thank the Wyld, my spell must have worked! Emrisse, Anisette, wake up! Someone is here to rescue us!" comes a voice from the darkness. The words sound remarkably normal, all things considered, but that's impossible. Even if someone had barricaded themselves in this room, and even if the fungus hadn't reached them, there's no way they could still be alive. You remain wary, but turn to warn Elthara that you might have a few more specters on your hands in need of exorcism. You don't want to be caught in their rage when they see who it is coming to 'rescue' th- THUD. Your stomach drops as you hear the sound of something very heavy hitting the floor at the other side of the room. The darkness is no longer as oppressive now that your eyes have begun to adjust, and you can vaguely make out just how immense whatever was just talking to you is. It must be at least nine feet tall, whatever it is, and five or so feet wide on top of that. Ryn grips your shoulder as she joins you, and you hear Elthara begin inching her way through the door [party.manyCompanions|with [companion2.name] right behind her|right behind her]. "Mmmn, Leanore? Make some light! I can't see, like, anything, and I can't seem to reach my staff," comes another voice, seeming to issue from the same figure. "Hold on, hold on. Where did I put my staff?" the first voice says again, and you hear several more thuds before the sound of wood clattering to stone startles you out of your intense focus. "Ah, here it is. Now then, a light spell!" All at once, a warm yellow light issues from a slender wooden staff and wipes away the darkness. Honestly, though, the darkness may have been preferable to the horror the light reveals. Ryn and Elthara both gasp, bringing their hands to their mouths as they stare in shock. Shambling about the beds near the end of the prayer room, a hulking monstrosity of fungal mass shifts about on several tentacled appendages. You only spend a moment focusing on how it's moving, though, as your eyes are immediately caught by what's going on above the fungal base. Fused to the core body are the forms of three boreal elf women, all completely nude and all exhibiting some level of further fungal infestation. The first you see as your gaze travels upward is nothing more than a pair of feet, a bare ass, and a pair of hands sticking out of the mass, as if their owner were stuck in a stockade or had fallen face first into the fungus. There's no outward growth on the jumble of parts, but judging by the throbbing cock and the glistening pussy between those thighs, whoever owns them is just as infected as the rest. She eyes you up, curiously at first, but then lustily as realization dawns on her. "Ohhh! It really is people! Oh Lea, it's outsiders! We're saved, we're saved, we can finally hnghghh Spreadthegoodword," she says, pausing half-way through as her eyes cross in a surge of pleasure. The one holding the staff —Leanore?— is the highest of the three, appearing to step out of the base with only her legs just below the shins being fully fused. Above that, she looks remarkably clean compared to the desiccated husks and sore-covered druids you've seen. A heavy growth of fungus covers the top of her head and her eyes like a helmet, rendering her blind, but it seems almost like it was meant to be there, rather than anything painful. A thick sheen of sweat covers her body, and despite the calm in her voice, you see the thick cock between her legs lifting to half mast. I knew my spell would hold out until they found a cure for Missy and Nissy." Ryn doesn't step forward, but she does squeeze your shoulder as she addresses the amalgam of women. "[ryn.lnhConfidence |I'm s-sorry, but no cure was ever found. C-can you not feel what's happening? |I'm sorry, but we never found a cure for the fungus. 你瞬间便进入了备战状态。你的眼睛还未适应暗影，而你的盟友们也还在努力穿过大门，因此如果有什么东西突然对你发动袭击，后果将会非常严重。 这是什么！？里面有什么东西吗？”瑞恩问道。 [ryn.lowConfidence |她的声音中带着担忧。 |试图加快她的进程。 ] rows.raw: "Ask if Anisette wants a cock to suck on."

rows.translation: 你得先有一根鸡巴才行。

rows.original: You leave the girls be. With any luck you'll be back soon to secure their transport to the Wayfort.
rows.translation: 你别去打扰那些女孩了。运气好的话，你很快就能回来，帮她们安排去荒废驿堡的交通工具。
rows.raw: "\n            You leave the girls be. With any luck you'll be back soon to secure their transport to the Wayfort.\n            "

rows.original: Encourage the trio to come to the Wayfort! Surely you'll have some way to ensure they get there.
rows.translation: 鼓励这三个人来到荒废驿堡吧！你肯定有办法确保他们能够到达那里。
rows.raw: "Encourage the trio to come to the Wayfort! Surely you'll have some way to ensure they get there."

rows.original:
You say nothing, content to let them decide for themselves.
        
        "Very well. You're right. I can feel that these two's minds are much more muddled than mine. Snippets of sanity get through, but I have no way of knowing how long those will last, nor how long my own will last before the next lapse. If you think yourself capable, I would have you send me off," Leanore says, nodding to Elthara.
        
        The priestess crosses the room, and begins chanting a prayer while reaching out to place one hand on Leanore's forehead and another on Anisette's. As she finishes her prayer, both women sigh, and you see their spirits rise from the growth like wispy ghost-forms. Emrisse is there as well, looking like a normal half-sexed rather than a stockaded ass. She smiles and waves, and then all three hug as they disperse like smoke in the wind. By the time you look back down, their bodies look about the same as any other in the temple.
        
        "It's a shame we never found a way to cure them, but Wraith power isn't really something you can easily study without inviting exactly this kind of problem," Elthara says, shaking her head.
        
        It's best not to dwell on it too much. You can still make this place safe for the current generation of druids.
        
        "You're right. Shall we continue?" 
        
        The sooner you can get this place fully cleansed of fungus, the better.
rows.translation:
你什么也没说，只是愿意让他们自己来做决定。
        
        “好吧，你说得对。我能感觉到，这两个人的思绪比我的要混乱得多。偶尔会有一丝清醒的时刻，但我无法知道这种清醒会持续多久，也不知道在我再次陷入混乱之前，自己的清醒还能维持多久。如果你认为自己有能力的话，我希望你帮我送我离开这里。”莉诺尔说道，同时向艾尔萨拉点了点头。
        
        女祭司穿过房间，开始诵念祷文，同时将一只手放在莱诺尔的额头上，另一只手放在阿妮塞特的额头上。当她诵完祷文后，两位女性都松了一口气，这时你可以看到她们的灵魂仿佛幽灵一般，从身体中升腾而出。埃姆里斯也在那里，她看起来就像一个普通的半性人，并没有什么特别之处。她微笑着挥手，然后三人拥抱了一下，随后就像风中的烟雾一样散开了。当你再次低头看时，他们的身体已经和其他人在寺庙里一样，没有任何区别了。
        
        真遗憾我们始终找不到治愈它们的方法，但‘幽灵之力’这种东西，如果你不想要遇到这样的问题，就根本不可能轻易进行研究，”艾尔萨拉摇着头说道。
        
        “最好不要再过多地纠结这件事了。你们仍然可以为这一代德鲁伊们保护这个地方，让它保持安全。
        
        你说得对。我们继续吧？”
        
        尽快把这个地方彻底清理干净，去除所有的霉菌，这样会更好。

rows.original: Let Elthara assist them in passing on.
rows.translation: 让艾尔萨拉帮助他们传承下去吧。
rows.raw: "Let Elthara assist them in passing on."

rows.original: Despite your best efforts, the triple-bodied monster overwhelms your defenses and you collapse to the ground. The fungal mass slithers closer and closer, while Leanore shakes her head to clear her thoughts. "Don't worry, none of you have been infected yet. My stasis spell is perfect, and I'll be sure to keep you all alive till the archdruid finds a way to cleanse the temple," she says. Her words don't make any sense, but you can't gather enough strength to tell her that cleansing the temple is what you're here for. Instead you can do nothing but let your consciousness fade as the soft light of her magic lulls you into deep hibernation. Perhaps you'll be rescued some day when the Lumian elves can afford to mount a rescue, but there's no telling what state you'll be in by the time they arrive. For now, though, your adventure is over. BAD END
rows.translation: 尽管你竭尽全力，但那个三体结构的怪物还是突破了你的防御，你最终倒在了地上。那团真菌不断向你逼近，而莉诺尔则不停地摇头，试图让自己清醒过来。 “别担心，你们所有人目前都还没有被感染。我的静止法术非常有效，一定能让你们所有人都活下来，直到大德鲁伊找到净化神庙的方法。”她说。她的话根本没有任何意义，但你也没有足够的力气去告诉她，你们来这里的目的其实就是净化神庙。相反，你只能任由自己的意识逐渐消散，因为她那柔和的魔力将你带入深深的沉睡之中。 或许有一天，当卢米安精灵们有能力组织救援行动时，你会被救出来，但谁也无法预料到他们到达时，你会处于什么样的状态。不过，目前来说，你的冒险已经结束了。 坏结局

rows.original:
You decide to investigate the hospital a little closer, perhaps hoping to find some clue that would shed more light on what happened in the temple. After a little searching, your attention returns to the stationed desk by the door with its shelves. Several of the shattered jars still bear legible inscriptions which Ryn gingerly nudges and inspects, scrutinizing the writing in her native tongue.
        
        "Medicines for common ailments. Also, several ancient coins in the box. A dispensary and a hospital, then."
        
        "When the schism happened, many such hospitals in Njorhaalt and beyond were abandoned, the druids taking what they could carry with them," Elthara adds. "It was up to Atheldred and the first valkyries to staff them, a task which arguably taxed them more than battle did — the followers of the Old Wyld had traditionally cared for the health of the boer'alvar people, and even with the goddess' healing powers that loss was greater and more sudden than could have been imagined, especially in the middle of a war.
        
        "To make things worse, many of the common people were afraid or unsure of the new restorative magics — they wanted the traditional remedies and curatives. Thank the gods that the doubt, while understandable, vanished after enough people made full recoveries."
        
        Thanks for the history lesson, but — the skeletons chained to the beds catch your eye again, and you shake your head. Hethia said that the infestation drove its hosts to uncontrollable lusts, didn't it?
        
        Ryn nods. "She did. That would explain why some of them had to be tied down... although it looks like they quickly ran out of chain as the infection spread like wildfire and the sane were soon overrun. How did the saying go, again? 'Physician, heal thyself?' Well, looks like they didn't."
        
        You search the hospital a little longer, but everything that might've been of use has long since decayed. Still, you walk away with a little more understanding of how the druids tried — and failed — to control the incipient fungal infection. To be sure, it was a doomed effort from the start given that anything they threw at it only made it stronger, but they didn't give up hope until the end. Either that, or their anger at the elvenqueen only made them all the more determined to survive...
rows.translation:
你决定更仔细地调查这家医院，或许希望能找到一些线索，从而弄清楚在寺庙里发生了什么。经过一番搜寻，你的注意力被门边那个带有架子的服务台吸引住了。有几个被打碎的罐子上仍然留有清晰的铭文，瑞恩小心翼翼地拨开那些碎片，用她的母语仔细阅读上面的文字。
        
        这些都是治疗常见疾病的药物，盒子里还有几枚古代硬币。另外，这里还有一间药房和一家医院。”
        
        “当分裂事件发生时，尼约哈尔特地区以及其他地方的许多这样的医院都被废弃了，德鲁伊们只带走了他们能携带的东西，”艾尔萨拉补充道。是否由阿瑟德雷德和最初的那些女武神来负责这些工作，其实是一个相当艰巨的任务——与参与战斗相比，这个任务对她们来说或许更加沉重。因为传统上，‘古老荒野’的追随者们一直负责照顾‘博尔阿尔瓦人’的健康。即便拥有女神的治疗力量，这样的损失依然超出了人们的想象，尤其是在战争期间。
        
        更糟糕的是，许多普通民众对这种新的恢复性魔法既感到恐惧，又缺乏信心——他们仍然更倾向于使用传统的疗法和药物。所幸，当有足够多的人通过这种新魔法成功康复后，人们的疑虑也就自然而然地消散了。真是多亏了诸神。
        
        多谢你讲的这段历史，不过——那些被锁在床上的骷髅又吸引了你的注意，你摇了摇头。赫希娅说过，这种感染会让人陷入无法控制的欲望之中，对吧？”
        
        瑞恩点了点头：“没错。这就解释了为什么有些人必须被绑起来……不过看起来，随着感染像野火一样迅速蔓延，理智的人很快就被夺走了控制力，链子也很快就不够用了。那句古话是怎么说的来着？‘医者，先治己病。’嗯，看来他们并没有做到这一点。
        
        你在医院里继续搜寻了一阵，但所有可能有用的事物早已腐烂殆尽。不过，这次搜寻还是让你对德鲁伊们如何尝试——以及最终如何失败——去控制那种初期出现的真菌感染有了更多的了解。事实上，从一开始，他们的努力就注定是徒劳的，因为他们采取的任何措施反而让这种感染变得更加严重。但直到最后，他们都没有放弃希望。或者说，正是对精灵女王的愤怒让他们更加坚定了生存的决心……

rows.original: The apothecary's workstation is in complete ruin, but perhaps the bound box by its side might have preserved something of value, tightly-bound as it is. Its bronze bandings glint dully in the sickly amber light, and you're faced with an unorthodox locking mechanism. [party.oneComp viviane cait |"Well, isn't this cute, a wordlock chest," Viviane says. "You hardly see these things nowadays. Unsurprising, for how old they must be. At least they're far more effective in this day and age — if literacy was bad back then, imagine what it must be like now." Well, can she do anything about the lock? Viv huffs a little. "I'm an enchantress, not a tinker, dear — this thing is completely mundane. Sure, I'd be able to figure out the mechanism given enough time, but that's something we don't have an excess of." You meant the riddle, not taking apart the lock. "Oh. That should be simple enough for you to figure out on your own." |"Father used to tell Calla and I about these," Cait pipes up as she studies the chest. "They're wordlock chests, a favorite of the old Belharan nobility, meant to safeguard valuables from illiterate [silly |players |servants ]. Each combination lock was secured by a password, and to help the owner remember what it was a riddle was often posed on the chest itself." |"Oh, that's a nice one," Elthara says from over your shoulder. "We have a few wordlock chests in the palace storerooms, dating from before the Godswar — I think they were gifted by the old empire. Not that they ever saw any practical use, but those were more decadent days, so the tales tell." ] Right. [pc.bg noblescion courtesan scholar acolyte |You've come across wordlock chests in your past — they were a favorite of the old Belharan nobility, meant to safeguard valuables from illiterate [silly |players |servants ]. Each of these combination locks was secured by a password, and to help the owner remember what it was, a riddle was often posed on the chest itself. If you could solve it and thereby rotate the tumblers into the right position, the chest would unlock and allow you to claim its contents. That the druids would have such a thing makes complete sense; they would have had the goods and means to trade across the River Ridell prior to the imperial collapse. And who better to reap the benefits of Belharan trade than the producers of trade goods? |Hmm, what can this all mean? It certainly seems like a thoroughly roundabout way to secure a container, but at least it isn't likely to be trapped in the bargain. You test the mechanism a few times, turn the tumblers, but nothing happens. ] You give the chest a thump, and it looks tightly sealed enough that its contents may have been isolated from the spreading rot that's consumed the druidic temple. Will you have a go at opening it?
rows.translation: 药剂师的工作台已经毁坏得不成样子，但放在它旁边的那个封好的箱子或许还保存着一些有价值的东西，因为箱子被紧紧地封住了。它的青铜绑带在那种昏暗的琥珀色光线中黯淡地闪烁着，而你面对的，是一种非常不寻常的锁闭装置。 [party.oneComp viviane cait |哇，这个单词锁箱子真是太可爱了，”薇薇安说道，“现在这种东西已经很少见了。也难怪，毕竟它们已经存在很久了。不过在现在这个时代，它们还是非常实用的——如果过去的识字率就已经很低的话，那现在的情况该有多糟糕啊。那么，她能对这把锁做些什么吗？薇芙轻轻哼了一声：“我可是女巫，又不是修理工，亲爱的——这个锁完全就是普通的普通物品。当然，如果给我足够的时间，我肯定能弄明白它的构造，但问题是，我们并没有那么多时间。你是说那个谜语，而不是要拆开锁吧。“哦，原来如此。那个应该足够简单，让你自己就能弄明白。 |父亲以前经常给我们讲这些，”凯特一边研究着那个箱子一边说道，“这些是密码锁箱子，是老贝拉兰贵族们最喜欢的物品，用来保护贵重物品免受不识字之人的侵害。 [silly |玩家们 |仆从们 ]每个密码锁都需要输入正确的密码才能打开，而为了帮助主人记住密码，人们通常会在箱子本身上设置一个谜语来帮助主人回忆密码。 |哦，这个真不错，”艾尔萨拉从你身后说道，“我们在宫殿的储藏室里还有几个字锁箱，那些都是神战之前的遗物——我想它们是老帝国赠送的。虽然那些箱子从来都没有被真正使用过，但在那个时代，人们确实更注重这些繁琐的仪式和装饰，所以才会有这样的传说。 ] 好的。 [pc.bg noblescion courtesan scholar acolyte |你之前肯定遇到过这种“字锁箱”——它们曾是贝尔哈兰老贵族们的最爱，用来保护贵重物品，防止那些不识字的人偷走它们。 [silly |玩家们 |仆从们 ]这些组合锁每一把都需要输入密码才能打开，为了帮助主人记住密码，人们通常会在箱子上设置谜语。如果你能够解开这个谜语，将锁芯旋转到正确的位置，箱子就会打开，让你取走里面的物品。 德鲁伊们拥有这样的能力是完全合理的；在帝国崩溃之前，他们就已经具备了在里德尔河两岸进行贸易的能力和条件。而谁最有可能从贝尔哈兰的贸易中获益呢？当然是那些从事贸易商品生产的人士啊。 |嗯，这一切到底意味着什么呢？这种方式看起来确实挺迂回的，但至少不会让人陷入什么麻烦之中。你试了几次这个装置，转动了那些旋钮，但什么反应也没有发生。 ] 你敲了敲那个箱子，发现它的密封程度似乎相当高，里面的东西应该被牢牢地保护着。可以它们已经被隔离起来，没有受到那股正在侵蚀德鲁伊神庙的腐朽力量的影响。你愿意尝试打开它吗？

rows.translation: 许多人给予（Offered by many） 少有人采纳（Taken by few） 却可能价值无比（Yet can be invaluable）
rows.raw: "Offered by many\nTaken by few\nYet can be invaluable"

rows.original: This isn't worth the trouble. Just let it be.
rows.translation: 这不值得费这个劲。就让它保持原样吧。
rows.raw: "This isn't worth the trouble. Just let it be."

rows.original: Something within the chest clicks, followed by a loud thump as the mechanisms within disengage. Instinctively, you step back, fearing a trap, but your fears are soon allayed as the spring-loaded lid pops open, throwing up a small puff of dust and spores as it reveals the chest's contents. "Wyldsap. Of course," Elthara muses, reaching down to palm the vials. "Unsurprising that something so precious would be sealed away this securely — you would seal away the blood of the being you worshipped quite well, wouldn't you?" Is it you, or does the priestess sound a little melancholy? "It's me," she replies with a small, sad smile. "I'm just thinking of the sacrifices the goddess has made for our sake over the two centuries of patronage for our people, that's all. I have the feeling that we might have need of it before we're done here." Hm. You take the vials from Elthara and turn them over in your hands — the sealing wax still holds, and the contents still look pure enough. "The one thing in this wreck that looks clean enough to take home as a souvenir. rows.translation: 箱子里的某个部件突然发出咔嗒声，随后随着内部机械装置的松动，传来一声沉重的撞击声。你本能地后退了一步，担心这是个陷阱，但很快你的担忧就消散了——弹簧装置驱动的盖子猛地弹开，顿时扬起了一阵灰尘和孢子，露出了箱子里的物品。 Wildsap。当然，”艾尔萨拉沉思道，伸手取过了那些小瓶子。“这种珍贵的东西被如此严密地保管起来，也并不奇怪——对于你所崇拜的生物的血液，你肯定会采取最妥善的保管方式，对吧？是你在说话，还是那位女祭司的声音听起来有点忧郁呢？”“是我，”她带着一丝悲伤的微笑回答道，“我只是在想，在这两百年来，女神为了我们的族群所做出的牺牲罢了。我有种感觉，我们在完成这里的工作之前，可能会需要用到它。嗯。你拿起从艾尔萨拉那里得到的那些小瓶子，在手中仔细观察——封蜡依然完好无损，里面的物质看起来也依然足够纯净。确实，它与那种不断从墙壁中渗出的恶臭琥珀有着几分相似之处，但那种被封闭在玻璃容器中的翻滚液体所散发出的那种纯粹感，却是从那些从砂浆中渗出的腐朽邪恶之中所感受不到的。 获得了双倍的野生汁液。 [party.has viviane |嗯，如果你们不介意的话，我想我也把这个拿走吧。”薇芙微笑着说道，同时拿起了那个小箱子。“在这个破旧的东西里，只有这个看起来足够干净，可以带回家当纪念品。我相信拆开它的机械结构，一定会让我在漫长的夜晚里暂时忘掉平时的学习任务。 ] 那就这样吧。你把那些小瓶子藏在随身携带的物品中，然后出发吧。
rows.raw: " Something within the chest clicks, followed by a loud thump as the mechanisms within disengage. Instinctively, you step back, fearing a trap, but your fears are soon allayed as the spring-loaded lid pops open, throwing up a small puff of dust and spores as it reveals the chest's contents. "Wyldsap. Of course," Elthara muses, reaching down to palm the vials. "Unsurprising that something so precious would be sealed away this securely — you would seal away the blood of the being you worshipped quite well, wouldn't you?" Is it you, or does the priestess sound a little melancholy? "It's me," she replies with a small, sad smile. "I'm just thinking of the sacrifices the goddess has made for our sake over the two centuries of patronage for our people, that's all. "The one thing in this wreck that looks clean enough to take home as a souvenir.
