"So eager, so frisky," he snarls excitedly. "Whatever happened to foreplay? Shouldn't you buy me —" "[kinu.isInari |Just shut the fuck up already, you lech!" |Just shut up. You are not smart, you are not witty, you are not dashing; you are just someone who has heard of all these things and desperately wishes to partake but fails to understand what they are to begin with, so you prance around in their trappings without any substance within that shell. For all your fine clothes and flowery speech, all you are is a small-souled creature who uses the pretext of a noble cause to murder children, rob others and intimidate those whom you think are at your mercy, all for your own perverse pleasure. "You have never actually managed to love anything, have you? Of what worth are your claims of deepest adoration when you hand them out so freely?" And with that, the mere fact that you've been allowed to say all this, the crack in Raphael's facade through which shocked disbelief shines through before quickly turning to rage — you know you've struck at the heart of this would-be womaniser's insecurities, and it feels good to lay bare his small, rotten soul even if it's the last thing you do. ] "If that's the way you want it. The night is still young, after all. Join me! Together we shall paint the forest russet red!" [kinu.isInari |It's a fight! |Battle is joined. ] '

rows.original: You've had it. Enough of this repellant fox-man and his airs of what he imagines to be playful, amused mastery, enough of his damnable self-righteousness, enough of this casual air towards gleefully murdering all of you with fire. All your rage and frustration — you channel it behind your lips and even as he holds your chin in a three-fingered grip, make to spit in his face. He sees it coming, and barely manages to dodge out of the way, dropping your chin as he twists his body and your spittle goes flying. For a moment before he rights himself, you see Raphael's expression darken in disbelief, his self-delusion of being the suave and charming ladykiller broken by one simple rejection. "Oh, dear. I can assure you, my beautiful foreign blossom, that I had no intention of tainting your honor." Those mere words, when contrasted with your field clothes, now little more than bloodsoaked rags, the numerous cuts on your body, and the sweat and dirt on your skin... he's nothing but an ugly, habitual liar, both to others and to himself. Raphael sees you gearing up for another shot at him, and grabs you by the throat just under the jaw, pressing in with thumb and forefinger until the agony makes your eyes water. "It is clear I was twice the blind fool!" the self-styled Russet Rogue declares, his playful smirk turned derisive. "You might look like one, but verily, you are not a lady. I would advise you to gain manners, but sadly, a hag cannot be taught female grace with any greater aptitude than a pig can be taught to dine with silverware. You will remain, at best, a very curvy mangirl, and have my condolences. "On the other hand, I do enjoy a woman with spirit, even if in not quite the same manner as proper ladies are to be enjoyed by gentlemen of leisure like me." He lets go of your throat, and you slump, gasping; Raphael kicks you in the side, then turns to his underlings. "Return the demoness her [kinu.kinuWeapon |glaive |bow ], and give us space. Since she wants to fight so badly, let her die fighting."
rows.translation: 你们受够了。够了，这个令人反感的狐狸人，以及他自以为表现出的那种所谓的“ playful ”、“ amused mastery ”的态度；够了，他那该死的自以为是；也够了，他那种看似随意，实则兴高采烈地想用火焰把你们全部烧死的做派。你所有的愤怒与沮丧，都被你压抑在唇边；即使当他用三根手指捏住你的下巴时，你依然试图朝他的脸上吐口水。 他预见到了这一动作，勉强躲开了，松开了对你的下巴的控制，同时扭转身体，结果你的口水就这样飞了出去。在他重新站直身体之前的那一瞬间，你可以看到拉斐尔的表情因难以置信而变得阴沉起来——他那种自以为是个风度翩翩、魅力四射的“情场高手”的幻想，竟然被一次简单的拒绝给击碎了。 哦，天哪。我可以向你保证，我这位美丽的外国姑娘，我绝对没有想要玷污你的名誉的意图。 那些空洞的言语，与你的工作服——如今早已变成血迹斑斑的破布——你身上那些众多的伤口，以及你皮肤上沾着的汗水和污垢相比……他不过是个丑陋而惯于说谎的人，无论是对别人，还是对自己都是如此。拉斐尔看到你准备再次向他发起攻击，便抓住你的喉咙，用拇指和食指用力按压，直到那种剧痛让你眼泪都流了出来。 显然，我当时简直是个十足的傻瓜！这个自封为“赤红浪人”的人说道，他那戏谑的笑容中带着讥讽。你看起来可能像个淑女，但实际上你根本不是。我建议你学会一些礼仪，但可惜，一个老巫婆永远不可能学会女性的优雅举止，就就像让一头猪使用银器用餐一样不现实。你最多也就只能成为一个身材曲线优美的伪淑女罢了，对此我真是感到遗憾。 另一方面，我确实喜欢那些有个性、有活力的女性，尽管这种方式可能与那些像我这样的闲暇绅士所欣赏的‘正统’女性有所不同。 他松开了对你的扼制，你瘫软下来，喘着粗气；拉斐尔踢了你一下侧身，然后转向他的手下们。 把那个女恶魔还给她吧。 [kinu.kinuWeapon |长剑 |鞠躬 ]那就让她去吧，给我们留出空间。既然她这么想战斗，那就让她在战斗中死去吧。

rows.original: You... you don't have it in you to do this.
rows.translation: 你……你根本没有能力去做这件事。
rows.raw: "You... you don't have it in you to do this."

rows.original: Keros' tails, damn the repellant nature of this fox-man and his airs of what he imagines to be playful, amused mastery, his damnable self-righteousness, and most of all, his casual air towards gleefully burning you all alive... if you can only lure him close enough, perhaps that might do the trick. Surely a lech like him would be susceptible to flattery, wouldn't he? Forcing down your revulsion, you make to mask your true emotions; shifting your weight onto one knee, you even contrive to blush a little despite the circumstances. Let him think the attention he's showering upon you is actually working, play to his self-delusions of being the suave and charming ladykiller. Given your tattered, bloodstained nightgown, let alone the circumstances, it certainly wouldn't work on anyone else; nevertheless, Raphael is clearly so full of himself that he might actually be taken in. "Oh? Is my little flower blushing?" He holds your gaze, the emerald shimmer in his rich green eyes intensifying as he burrs with an obviously faked accent, not even bothering to remain consistent. "Perhaps destiny willed this fateful meeting, for Lord Taoth to order me and my men here tonight? Then again, I am attracted to extraordinary splendour, so perhaps I would have found you no matter what." [kiyoko.numKits 2 |"[silly |Onee-sama |Big sis ], what are you doing?" Aya yells, but is quickly silenced into submission by a hard blow to the back of her head. ] Time to get into the act. Raphael's face is close enough to yours that the cloying smell of perfume and cologne is practically suffocating; a man with no idea of how to use any of it and simply tossed the lot on. You're sure his smile is meant to be dashing, but it's anything but; nevertheless, you force yourself to swoon and titter, to wrap one arm about his neck like in some stupid oversexed romance while his verdant green eyes peer into yours daringly. The Russet Rogue leans in, clearly intending to steal a kiss with that sharp muzzle of his. Now! Balling your free hand into a fist, you concentrate and make to punch upwards into his chest, to summon foxfire and give him a literally burning embrace — — And your focus is broken as Raphael snaps back, springing away from you. His hand darts out in a blur, grabbing you by the wrist and twisting it cruelly until tears of pain well up in your eyes. "Oh dear, oh dear," he says, the smirk on his face disgustingly smug and superior. "It looks like this beautiful foreign blossom conceals poisonous thorns beneath her petals. And even though I would gladly suffer through a thousand indignities for a mere touch from one such as you, death is not one of them." Raphael twists again, and this time your tendons pop and you scream, falling forward onto the ground. You gasp, lungs heaving, tears flowing down your cheeks, and yet there's a sense of satisfaction in knowing that your rejection stung this madman deeply enough for him to lose his composure and finally drop the suave rogue act. "On the other hand, I do enjoy a woman with spirit; such a pity, though, the flower who refused to bloom." Raphael kicks you in the side for good measure, then turns to his underlings. "Return the demoness her [kinu.kinuWeapon |glaive |bow ], and give us space. Since she wants to fight so badly, let her die fighting."
rows.translation: 可罗斯的尾巴啊……该死，这个狐狸人那令人反感的性格，还有他自以为是在表现出一种戏谑、高人一等的姿态，还有他那该死的自以为是……最重要的是，他那种看似漫不经心，实则却能将你们所有人活活烧死的态度……真是让人恨透了。.. 如果你能把他引到足够近的距离，或许就能成功了。像他这样的色鬼，肯定会对奉承话动心，不是吗？ 强压下内心的厌恶，你努力掩饰自己的真实情绪；将身体重心移到一条腿上，即使在这种情况下，你还是设法让自己脸红了一下。就让他以为自己对你表现出的关注真的有效吧，让他继续沉溺于自己那种“魅力非凡、能让女性为之倾倒”的幻想中吧。鉴于你那件破烂不堪、沾满血迹的睡衣，更别提当时的处境了，这种幻想对别人来说肯定毫无意义；不过，拉斐尔显然太过自负，他可能会真的相信自己的谎言。 哦？我的小花朵在害羞吗？他的目光紧紧锁定在你身上，他那深绿色的眼睛中闪烁着翠绿色的光芒，而他用一种明显是伪造出来的口音说话，甚至都不费心去保持这种口音的连贯性。或许命运安排了这次命运般的相遇，才让陶思大人今晚派我和我的手下来到这里。不过，我也确实被那种非凡的辉煌所吸引，所以不管怎样，我可能还是会找到你的。 [kiyoko.numKits 2 |"[silly |姐姐大人 |大姐 ]你在干什么？阿雅大声喊叫，但很快就被一记重击击中后脑勺，被迫噤声屈服了。 ] 是时候行动了。拉斐尔的脸离你太近了，那种浓重的香水味几乎让人窒息——显然，这个男人根本不知道如何正确使用这些化妆品，只是随便往身上抹了些而已。你敢肯定，他的笑容本应是潇洒迷人的，但实际上却完全不是这样；不过，你还是强迫自己假装晕倒、咯咯笑起来，甚至像在某些过于夸张的浪漫故事里那样，用一只手臂搂住他的脖子。而他那双翠绿色的眼睛，正大胆地注视着你的眼睛。那头赤褐色的野兽向前倾身，显然打算用它那尖锐的口鼻部偷一个吻。 现在！你将空闲的手握成拳头，集中精力，朝它的胸部上方挥拳，激发出“狐火”，给它一个真正“灼热”的拥抱—— ——就在这时，拉斐尔突然回过神来，猛地从你身边弹开。他的手迅速伸来，一把抓住你的手腕，狠狠地扭动起来，疼得你眼眶里立刻涌出了泪水。 哦天啊，哦天啊。他说，他脸上的那抹得意洋洋、充满优越感的笑容实在令人作呕。看来这种美丽的外国花朵，在它那美丽的花瓣之下，隐藏着致命的刺。尽管为了得到你这样的一个人的触碰，我愿意忍受千百种屈辱，但死亡绝对不在其中。 拉斐尔再次使出招式，这一次你的肌腱被狠狠拉伤，你痛得尖叫着向前倒在地上。你喘着粗气，肺部剧烈地起伏着，泪水顺着脸颊流下来，但想到自己的拒绝确实让这个疯子深受打击，以至于他失去了冷静，终于不再伪装那副风度翩翩的浪人形象，这种感觉还是让人感到一丝满足。 另一方面，我确实喜欢那些有个性、有活力的女性；不过，真可惜，那些拒绝绽放的花朵……拉斐尔还故意踢了你一脚，然后转向他的手下们。把那个女恶魔还给她吧。 [kinu.kinuWeapon |长剑 |鞠躬 ]那就让她去吧，给我们一些空间。既然她这么想战斗，那就让她在战斗中死去吧。

rows.original: Oh, so he thinks he's the charmer, is he? It sickens you to even consider it, but if you can get him close and drop his guard...
rows.translation: 哦，所以他以为自己是那个有魅力的人，是吗？光是想到这点就让人作呕，但如果你能让他放松警惕，靠近他……
rows.raw: "Oh, so he thinks he's the charmer, is he? It sickens you to even consider it, but if you can get him close and drop his guard..."

rows.original: Just the thought of this madman near you is repulsive to the core of your being. No, not even if your life depends on it.
rows.translation: 仅仅想到这个疯子就在你身边，就会让你感到无比厌恶。不，即使你的生命取决于此，你也绝不能接受这种事实。
rows.raw: "Just the thought of this madman near you is repulsive to the core of your being. No, not even if your life depends on it."

rows.original: Your mind races, but you come up short of any course of action that doesn't get you and yours all killed. Raphael grins down at you, practically oozing the kind of confidence that has him acting as if he owns the place — and you. Maybe... maybe if you keep him talking, you'll buy enough time for an opportunity to present itself. Maybe... "What are you getting at? What do you want?" "My, whatever do you mean, my pretty? Are you accusing me of being less than forthright?" He raises his shoulders in a shrug. "I think I've been very clear in my desires — we want you demons gone from our land instead of spreading and preying on the innocent, helpless, and those too foolish or incontinent to control themselves. And if you won't go... well, burning you out is always an option, as you can see. Such a pity." "And my eyes, you wanted them..." You know what he meant, he knows you know what he meant. The fox-man snickers into his fist and snorts unseemly; he clearly takes an undue amount of pleasure in watching you squirm and stall for time, which is almost certainly why he's playing along with your game. "I meant exactly what I said, my fair flower." From his hip, Raphael draws a slender dagger and tests the tip against his thumb. "Such beautiful light blue sapphires, they rouse in me the excitement of my younger thieving days. Such jewels, filled with passion and ardor, inflaming desire as they speak of avarice." The point of the dagger is now less than two inches from your face; your heart pounds in your head, blood rushing, muscles trembling.[kinu.isInari | Perhaps you should be afraid; anyone else might be given the danger you're in, but all you can feel is boiling hatred for this repulsive man and his endless stream of flowery words, an overwhelming desire to break his jaw so he'll finally shut up. ] "I cannot say that I'm in the habit of collecting trophies, but there is a first time for everything; I have never met a woman... quite like you, hmhmmm. And is that not the deepest desire of a lady? To be so charming and attractive that the sheer power of her magnetism compels honest and noble men to terrible deeds of infamy?" He's the one with a knife pointed at your eye, and making you out as the villain. The sheer audacity, the lecherousness, the madness. Does he really think that if he just makes the right gestures and says the right words as if from a script, you'll fall swooning at his feet no matter what he does? No, you can't take it any more. There's no point in stalling for time any longer, not if this creep is going to take perverse pleasure in tormenting you. As Raphael makes to toy with the dagger in his hand, you dart forward, craning your neck and seeking to sink your teeth into his wrist; feeling them transform from human to something sharp and vulpine within your jaws in a matter of moments. He realizes it almost too late, jerking back his hand, but is not quite fast enough. Your canines scrape through his fur, raking across flesh, breaking skin and drawing blood; for a moment before he rights himself, you see Raphael's expression darken in disbelief. His self-delusion of being the suave and charming ladykiller, the entire facade broken by one simple rejection. One of his people comes forward, uttering cries of alarm and concern, but he waves off his underling. "No matter, no matter. 'Tis but a flesh wound. Nothing to be concerned about." Raphael sees you gearing up for another shot at him, and grabs you by the throat just under the jaw, pressing in with thumb and forefinger until the agony makes your eyes water. "A worthy price for you to reveal what you truly are in front of everyone, demoness." He draws back his bloodied hand and sends it across your cheek in a firm backhand, tossing you to the ground. You gasp, lungs heaving, tears flowing down your face, and yet there's a sense of satisfaction in knowing that your rejection stung this madman deeply enough for him to lose his composure and finally drop the suave rogue act. "On the other hand, I do enjoy a woman with spirit; such a pity, though, the flower who refused to bloom." Raphael kicks you in the side for good measure, then turns to his underlings. "Return the demoness her [kinu.kinuWeapon |glaive |bow ], and give us space. Since she wants to fight so badly, let her die fighting."
rows.translation: 你的思绪飞快转动，但却想不出任何不会让自己和身边的人陷入绝境的行动方案。拉斐尔朝你咧嘴一笑，那笑容中充满了自信，仿佛这个地方——以及你——都属于他。也许……如果你能让他继续说话，就能争取到足够的时间，等待机会出现。 也许…… 你到底想说什么？你到底想要什么？ 我的天，你这话是什么意思，我的美人？你是在指责我不够坦率吗？他耸了耸肩，表示无能为力。我想我已经把我们的要求说得很清楚了——我们希望你们这些恶魔从我们的土地上消失，而不是继续在无辜、无助的人身上肆意作恶，伤害那些太愚蠢或无法控制自己行为的人。如果你们不愿意离开……嗯，正如你们所见，将你们烧死总是一个可行的选择。真是太遗憾了。 还有我的眼睛，你也是想要的…… 你明白他的意思，他也知道你明白他的意思。那个狐狸人把笑声憋在拳头里，发出难听的哼声；他显然从看你手足无措、拖延时间中获得了极大的乐趣，这大概也是他之所以配合你玩这个把戏的原因吧。 我说的每一句话都是真心话，我亲爱的花儿。拉斐尔从腰间抽出一把细长的匕首，用拇指试了试刀锋。如此美丽的浅蓝色蓝宝石，它们唤起了我年轻时那些偷窃日子里的兴奋与激情。这些充满热烈与欲望的宝石，仿佛在诉说着人们对财富的贪婪与渴望。 现在，那把匕首的距离已经不到两英寸了，它的尖端离你的脸只有这么近；你的心脏在剧烈跳动，血液在体内奔涌，肌肉也在不停地颤抖。[kinu.isInari | 也许你真的应该感到害怕；别人或许也会面临你所面临的危险，但你心中唯一的感觉，只是对这个令人作呕的男人以及他那些花言巧语充满愤怒，你只有一个强烈的愿望：打断他的下巴，让他终于闭上嘴。 ] 我不能说自己有收集奖杯的习惯，但凡事都有第一次嘛；我从来没遇到过像你这样的女性……嗯，难道这不正是每一位女士最深切的愿望吗？那就是拥有如此迷人的魅力，以至于自己的吸引力能够迫使那些诚实高尚的男士做出一些不光彩的事情来？ 他是就是那个用刀指着你的眼睛，然后威胁你的人你被描绘成反派角色。这种厚颜无耻、淫荡堕落、疯狂至极的行为……他真以为，只要按照剧本一样做出恰当的动作、说出恰当的话语，无论他做出什么事，你们就会对他倾心倒慕吗？ 不，你不能再这样下去了。再拖延下去也没有任何意义，因为如果这个变态会从折磨你中获得变态的快感的话……当拉斐尔开始摆弄他手中的匕首时，你猛地向前冲去，伸长脖子，试图咬住他的手腕；在那一瞬间，你感觉到自己的牙齿正在瞬间从人类的形态变成某种锋利而狡猾的东西。他几乎为时已晚才意识到这一点，急忙抽回手，但动作还是不够快。你的犬齿划破了他的皮毛，刺入了他的肉体，撕开了皮肤，流出了鲜血；在他重新站稳之前，你看到拉斐尔的表情因难以置信而变得阴沉下来。他自以为是个风度翩翩、魅力四射的“情场高手”，然而仅仅一次被拒绝，这一切伪装便瞬间崩塌了。他的手下中有一个人上前，发出了惊慌和担忧的声音，但他只是挥手让那个人退了下去。 没关系，没关系。这只是皮肉伤而已，没什么大不了的。拉斐尔看到你又准备对他发动攻击，于是抓住你的喉咙，手指紧压在你的下颌下方，用拇指和食指的力量持续压迫，直到那种剧痛让你眼泪都流了出来。这是一个值得付出的代价，这样你就能在所有人面前展现出你真正的面目来，恶魔女。 他收回那只沾满鲜血的手，用一记有力的反手击打你的脸颊，将你击倒在地。你喘着粗气，泪水顺着脸颊流淌下来，但想到自己的拒绝确实让这个疯子深受打击，以至于他失去了冷静，终于不再伪装那副风度翩翩的流氓形象，这种感觉却令你感到一丝满足。 另一方面，我确实喜欢那些有个性、有活力的女性；不过，真可惜，那些拒绝绽放的花朵……拉斐尔还故意踢了你一足部，然后转向他的手下们。把那个女恶魔还给她吧。 [kinu.kinuWeapon |长剑 |鞠躬 ]那就让她去吧，给我们一些空间。既然她这么想战斗，那就让她在战斗中死去吧。
rows.raw: ' Your mind races, but you come up short of any course of action that doesn't get you and yours all killed. Raphael grins down at you, practically oozing the kind of confidence that has him acting as if he owns the place — and you. Maybe... maybe if you keep him talking, you'll buy enough time for an opportunity to present itself. Maybe... "What are you getting at? What do you want?" "My, whatever do you mean, my pretty? Are you accusing me of being less than forthright?" He raises his shoulders in a shrug. "I think I've been very clear in my desires — we want you demons gone from our land instead of spreading and preying on the innocent, helpless, and those too foolish or incontinent to control themselves. And if you won't go... well, burning you out is always an option, as you can see. Such a pity." "And my eyes, you wanted them..." You know what he meant, he knows you know what he meant. The fox-man snickers into his fist and snorts unseemly; he clearly takes an undue amount of pleasure in watching you squirm and stall for time, which is almost certainly why he's playing along with your game. "I meant exactly what I said, my fair flower." From his hip, Raphael draws a slender dagger and tests the tip against his thumb. "Such beautiful light blue sapphires, they rouse in me the excitement of my younger thieving days. Such jewels, filled with passion and ardor, inflaming desire as they speak of avarice." The point of the dagger is now less than two inches from your face; your heart pounds in your head, blood rushing, muscles trembling.[kinu.isInari | Perhaps you should be afraid; anyone else might be given the danger you're in, but all you can feel is boiling hatred for this repulsive man and his endless stream of flowery words, an overwhelming desire to break his jaw so he'll finally shut up. ] "I cannot say that I'm in the habit of collecting trophies, but there is a first time for everything; I have never met a woman... quite like you, hmhmmm. And is that not the deepest desire of a lady? To be so charming and attractive that the sheer power of her magnetism compels honest and noble men to terrible deeds of infamy?" He's the one with a knife pointed at your eye, and making you out as the villain. The sheer audacity, the lecherousness, the madness. Does he really think that if he just makes the right gestures and says the right words as if from a script, you'll fall swooning at his feet no matter what he does? No, you can't take it any more. There's no point in stalling for time any longer, not if this creep is going to take perverse pleasure in tormenting you. As Raphael makes to toy with the dagger in his hand, you dart forward, craning your neck and seeking to sink your teeth into his wrist; feeling them transform from human to something sharp and vulpine within your jaws in a matter of moments. He realizes it almost too late, jerking back his hand, but is not quite fast enough. Your canines scrape through his fur, raking across flesh, breaking skin and drawing blood; for a moment before he rights himself, you see Raphael's expression darken in disbelief. His self-delusion of being the suave and charming ladykiller, the entire facade broken by one simple rejection. One of his people comes forward, uttering cries of alarm and concern, but he waves off his underling. "No matter, no matter. 'Tis but a flesh wound. Nothing to be concerned about." Raphael sees you gearing up for another shot at him, and grabs you by the throat just under the jaw, pressing in with thumb and forefinger until the agony makes your eyes water. "A worthy price for you to reveal what you truly are in front of everyone, demoness." He draws back his bloodied hand and sends it across your cheek in a firm backhand, tossing you to the ground. You gasp, lungs heaving, tears flowing down your face, and yet there's a sense of satisfaction in knowing that your rejection stung this madman deeply enough for him to lose his composure and finally drop the suave rogue act. "On the other hand, I do enjoy a woman with spirit; such a pity, though, the flower who refused to bloom." Raphael kicks you in the side for good measure, then turns to his underlings. "Return the demoness her [kinu.kinuWeapon |glaive |bow ], and give us space. Since she wants to fight so badly, let her die fighting." '

rows.translation: 让他继续说话，拖延时间。也许会有奇迹发生……

rows.original: Oh. You managed to get here to this scene. By all rights, unless you cheated in one way or another, you should not be able to access this scene; it is a fallback in case something goes terribly wrong, after all. Given Raphael's stats compared to your daughter's, there should be no way in which she can conceivably beat him, even with perfect RNG on your side. Hence, you really must have cheated to win; if you didn't and the game bugged out or some kind of edge case exception was caught, then just ignore the following. Please make a bug report on the forum, too! While I understand that the game is often played for its power fantasy appeal and that Raphael is truly a hateable character by design, trust me when I say he'll get his comeuppance in time. Kinu's story is one of being broken, adversity, eventually made whole and being more beautiful for the breakage. Now, I could have it all take place in prose and not go through all this bother, but this is the first time daughter dearest is going up against an obstacle that for all her inherited genius and ability simply cannot surmount on her own (Inari) or is left without guidance from her superiors and elders (Hime). I want players to experience Kinu's initial surprise, then horror, then finally desperation as nothing she does works and she realizes she is going to die, and after that they are going to kill her family as well. For someone who has effortlessly breezed through life's obstacles as a child prodigy and never truly been challenged, staring down her first true failure with the stakes being her life and family is going to shake your daughter to the core, and I want players to feel that impotent desperation and rage against Raphael as he toys with your daughter and cuts her down piece by piece. Is it better to have everything intact and perfect, to slide into senescence? Or through the threat of loss, truly begin to appreciate the value of what we take for granted? Through adversity, strength. Through struggle, triumph. Through pain, acceptance. Is it better to live a painless life of free leisure, and be defeated by peace? Loss, synthesis, and improvement through destruction and repair or rebirth... or maybe this is all pseudo-philosophical blather to disguise the fact that I just really like yanking on y'all's chain? Embrace the art of kintsugi and the understanding that something can be more beautiful for having been broken first. I apologize for any distress caused from not being able to immediately kick Raph's butt, but that's the way the cookie crumbles. Now, back to our originally scheduled programming...
rows.translation: 哦，你竟然能够进入这个场景。按常理来说，除非你用了某种作弊手段，否则根本不应该能够进入这里——毕竟这个场景是作为最后手段准备的，用来应对那些最糟糕的情况。考虑到拉斐尔的能力数值和你女儿相比，即便运气完全站在你女儿这一边，她也不可能战胜他。因此，你肯定是通过作弊才获胜的；如果你没有作弊，而是游戏出现了故障，或者遇到了某种特殊的异常情况，那么请忽略以下内容。不过，也请在论坛上提交一份故障报告吧！ 虽然我明白这款游戏之所以受到玩家欢迎，很大程度上是因为它所呈现的权力幻想元素，也知道拉斐尔这个角色从设计上来说确实是一个令人反感的角色，但相信我，他迟早会得到应有的报应。小娟的故事讲述的是一个人如何经历破碎与逆境，最终重获完整，并且因为这些经历而变得更加坚强。 现在，我本可以让这一切都以散文的形式呈现出来，从而避免这些麻烦，但这是我最亲爱的女儿第一次遇到这样的障碍——凭借她所继承的天赋和能力，她根本无法独自克服这个障碍（在伊奈里的情况下）；或者，在没有上级和长辈的指导时，她也无法应对这个挑战（在姬的情况下）。我希望玩家能够体验到小娟最初的惊讶，接着是恐惧，最后是绝望——因为她所做的任何事情都毫无效果，她意识到自己即将死去，而之后，她的家人也会遭到杀害。 对于一个从小就是神童、在生活中从未遇到过真正挑战的人来说，如今面对第一次可能危及自己与家人生命的失败，这种打击无疑会让她的内心受到极大的震动。我希望玩家能够感受到那种无助的绝望，以及当拉斐尔一步步摧毁她时，玩家心中涌起的愤怒。 是保持一切完好无损、完美无缺，然后逐渐走向衰老，还是通过面对失去的威胁，真正开始珍惜那些我们视为理所当然的东西？ 在逆境中，力量得以诞生；在奋斗中，胜利得以实现；在痛苦中，我们学会了接受。 过上没有痛苦、充满闲暇的生活，被和平所征服，这样更好吗？通过毁灭与重建、或是重生，来实现失去、融合与进步……又或许，这一切都只是些伪哲学的废话，只是为了掩盖一个事实：其实我就是喜欢牵着你们的鼻子走罢了？ 接受金缮这门艺术，也理解这样一个道理：有些事物正因为曾经破碎，反而能变得更加美丽。 对于因为无法立刻教训拉夫而给大家带来的困扰，我深表歉意，但事情就是这样的。 现在，让我们回到原本安排好的节目内容中……

rows.original: This can't be happening. It can't be happening. [kinu.isInari |You're a prodigy; ever since you were a kit, you were the smart one, the one who learned the fastest. You beat all those invaders two, three, four on one by yourself, and yet this small-souled guttersnipe has somehow managed to best you |You've always kept a close and hopefully honest assessment of your capabilities; knew where your boundaries lay so you could push them in increments. Every time something's come up, you've had the wisdom of Mother or Matron Komari to guide you to the correct decision... only you have absolutely no idea what they would do in this situation, where this madman and monster has the upper hand on you ]. No matter how hard you try, Raphael simply uses gymnastic feats of avoidance to dodge your [kinu.kinuWeapon |blows |arrows ], kicking moss about and dragging furrows through the forest floor with roving feet. Meanwhile, he uses his scabbard to deflect the occasional kick or impromptu blow you try to weave in, angling it just so to turn the impact to the side. He's a wrech, but his skill is undeniable; your efforts don't affect him, they're no match for his strength. It wears you down, chasing after the fox-man, often forcing him into awkward positions below your assault, but you never quite manage to [kinu.kinuWeapon |strike him properly |land a shot on him. He even mocks you by cutting one of your arrows out of the air at the last moment, gracing you with a raised eyebrow and snide smile ]. He's bleeding you out, killing you by a death of a thousand nicks; Raphael's petty anger at his wounded pride from you having rejected him is spiralling out of control, seething despite the cool mask of indifference he wears upon his face. With more gentle care than you bother to apply, the fox-man pricks the tip of his sword against your guts and ribcage more than once, letting you know he could've run you right through but refrained from doing so. Of course — he wouldn't be able to humiliate you in front of his underlings and your family if he just killed you outright. But at last, your strength fails you. The stinging bites of several dozen cuts bring you down; your clothes are shreds, leaving you half-naked in front of everyone. Raphael continues to stand firm and proud, sliding the point of his slender sword down between your chin and throat and forcing your gaze upwards yet again. "Pity for such beauty to be caught in the clutches of a demoness, such that its extinguishing is necessitated. Such a fair flower, cut with the chaff," he says with a smirk, adding as much theatrical flourish as he can to his words. "But you'll find that I'm not as easy prey as others for the likes of you. [silly |Die, monster. You don't belong in this land. |Any last words? ]" Your eyes turn to your [kiyoko.numKits 2 4 |charges and family |family |charges ], to the torches flickering amongst the trees, down the length of the slim bronze blade to its wielder. [kinu.isInari |"Go fuck yourself." Raphael laughs. "Defiant to the end, I see. I'd expect no less from a demoness of your stature." |"You can intimidate, bully, seduce and deceive others into compliance." Your voice shakes as you draw ragged breaths, the bronze point pricking against your throat. "But has anyone ever wilfully loved you? Not what they believe you to be, but you?" Raphael grins like he saw it coming, but the smile on his muzzle beneath the mask is far from convincing. "Lies spill from your mouth like water from a broken dam, demoness. It is my duty to silence you forever." ] His forearm tenses, clearly readying himself to drive the point of his blade through your throat, and then several things happen. The first is that several arrows fly out of the trees, sickening wet smacks rising into the night air as they sink into flesh. One comes flying straight for Raphael, and the Russet Rogue is forced to bring the point of his blade up and away from your throat to slice it from the air. Why he didn't just settle for simply dodging it while keeping you at swordpoint is beyond you — maybe his instincts for leaning to the theatrical and dramatic worked against him this time. The next thing is that foxfire erupts by the pool, flickering ghostly flames bursting into existence, blazing away with intense, blinding light despite the lack of heat. Multiple roars ring through the air, deafening thunderclaps that shake the trees. The standing invaders rally into formation, pulling out not their weapons but various arcane implements after the fashion of the natives of this land — wands, runestones, other means of defending themselves from the two-pronged assault. The opening is small, but it's all you need and hope is a far more generous lender than terror is. Quick as he is, by the time Raphael's recovered and has his swordpoint trained back on you, you've grabbed your [kinu.weapon] and are rapidly disengaging from the scene. "[kinu.isInari |Going so soon, my pretty? Don't struggle so much, you'll wound me! |Don't you dare run, demoness. You don't get to sully a man's reputation with your filthy lies and just leave without being taught a lesson. ]" What was he expecting, dumb-minded compliance when you've already proven yourself to do anything but that? Maybe like the way he relies on his sword, he's spent too long around brainless bimbos who swoon at his every word to actually believe that a woman might not mindlessly obey him. Whatever, your [kiyoko.numKits 2 4 |charges and family |family |charges ] need you this moment. [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 4 12 |Aya yips and squeals as you grab her by the waist and drag her off amidst the chaos, her tails grabbing at you for purchase as you hoof it through the chaos, picking up the field hands along the way |Aya yips and squeals as you grab her by the waist and drag her off amidst the chaos, her tails grabbing at you for purchase as you hoof it through the chaos, picking up the field hands along the way. Ever the opportunist, Tatsumi's grabbed yet another of the invaders' weapons off a fallen body in the melee, covering your retreat with all of his inexperienced but valiant efforts |Aya yips and squeals as you grab her by the waist and drag her off amidst the chaos, her tails grabbing at you for purchase as you hoof it through the chaos; Asagiri limps along, determined to not fall behind and get caught in the growing melee. Ever the opportunist, Tatsumi's grabbed yet another of the invaders' weapons off a fallen body, covering [kiyoko.numKits 5 |the rest of your siblings' |your family's ] retreat with all of his inexperienced but valiant efforts |Aya yips and squeals as you grab her by the waist and drag her off amidst the chaos, her tails grabbing at you for purchase as you hoof it through the chaos; Asagiri limps along, determined to not fall behind and get caught in the growing melee. Ever the opportunist, Tatsumi's grabbed yet another of the invaders' weapons off a fallen body, covering the rest of your siblings' retreat with all of his inexperienced but valiant efforts. There are a lot of you, but the chaos is rapidly spreading and the invaders have more pressing concerns than corralling children at the moment, especially when the only one whom they've been led to believe is a threat is rapidly retreating |With more pressing issues on the invaders' minds than corralling a bunch of beaten-down, unarmed field hands, you're able to quickly get to where they were being held and slash open their bonds with [kinu.kinuWeapon |the edge of your naginata |an arrowhead ]. Urging them forward despite your own doubts about your leadership, you cover their retreat as best as you can in the chaos before allowing yourself to withdraw. Responsibility flows upwards, after all ]. Behind you, you hear Raphael [kinu.isHime |raging and ]rallying his men, urging them to press the attack in your direction despite the fact that the fight is already starting to turn against them. He may be skilled, but even so one man can't compensate for this kind of situation alone. It stings, it hurts, and you're certain that your body is going to exact a cruel revenge upon you for mistreating it so, but so long as there's any hope that your [kiyoko.numKits 2 4 |family and people |family |people ] might make it out alive now that the situation has changed, you can't give up. And the greatest irony is that if the madman that was Raphael hadn't been such a would-be dashing rogue, you wouldn't have been able to stall him long enough for help to arrive in the nick of time. If he'd only just saved the theaterics and outright murdered you when he had the chance... Ha. "[kiyoko.numKits 2 |[silly |Nee-sama |Big sis ], w |W ]e're almost there!" And so you are. Never in your life have you been so glad to see familiar faces — Azami, Miko and Mai, and most of all, [party.has kiyoko |[kinu.isInari |Hitoshi. Even as the line of kitsune sweep past you to join in the skirmish, Miko and Mai taking charge of [kiyoko.numKits 2 4 |your family and the field hands |your family |the field hands ] from you, he leans in to take you in one hand and your [kinu.weapon] in the other. Quietly, Hitoshi accepts the hug you give him, then pats you on the head between your ears as he towers over you. "You're safe now." "..." Anyone else would have been crushed by your embrace, but not him as he slowly reverses course and leads you into the back line. [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 4 5 |阿雅和那些农夫们。你被噎住了。他們——我得去处理一下—— |阿雅和那些农夫们。你被噎住了。他们——龙美正在看着他们，但我还是得去看看—— |朝雾被烧毁了。你突然呛了一下，猛地站了起来。我……她需要这个……如果龙美知道了，他会非常难过的…… |朝雾被烧毁了。你突然呛了一下，猛地站了起来。我……她需要这个……如果龙美知道了，他会非常难过的…… 安静，孩子。冷静下来。 还有其他所有人，如果他们都能安全脱险的话—— |那些田间劳作的人。你被噎住了。我本来会把他们引向死亡的。他们——我必须去看看他们…… ] 妈妈会发出啧啧的声音，然后用手指轻戳你的额头。"[kinu.isInari |还是像往常一样，固执得令人头疼。不过，如果你没有这样的性格，我想我反而会担心这次经历会把你击垮吧。但从各方面来看，你依然是我认识的那个女儿。 |没关系，现在只有我们两个人了。剩下的事情交给我吧；你并不总是非得达到我的标准，我亲爱的女儿。毕竟，我比你年长很多啊。 ]那么，我们走吧，把清理工作留给别人吧。那个科马里的男孩 [kinu.isHime |你以为这样就行了吗？ ]他终于迎来了这一生梦寐以求的辉煌战役。其实挺让人失望的，但也就让他享受这份时刻吧。 ]
rows.raw: " This can't be happening. It can't be happening. [kinu.isInari |You're a prodigy; ever since you were a kit, you were the smart one, the one who learned the fastest. You beat all those invaders two, three, four on one by yourself, and yet this small-souled guttersnipe has somehow managed to best you |You've always kept a close and hopefully honest assessment of your capabilities; knew where your boundaries lay so you could push them in increments. Every time something's come up, you've had the wisdom of Mother or Matron Komari to guide you to the correct decision... only you have absolutely no idea what they would do in this situation, where this madman and monster has the upper hand on you ]. No matter how hard you try, Raphael simply uses gymnastic feats of avoidance to dodge your [kinu.kinuWeapon |blows |arrows ], kicking moss about and dragging furrows through the forest floor with roving feet. Meanwhile, he uses his scabbard to deflect the occasional kick or impromptu blow you try to weave in, angling it just so to turn the impact to the side. He's a wrech, but his skill is undeniable; your efforts don't affect him, they're no match for his strength. It wears you down, chasing after the fox-man, often forcing him into awkward positions below your assault, but you never quite manage to [kinu.kinuWeapon |strike him properly |land a shot on him. He even mocks you by cutting one of your arrows out of the air at the last moment, gracing you with a raised eyebrow and snide smile ]. He's bleeding you out, killing you by a death of a thousand nicks; Raphael's petty anger at his wounded pride from you having rejected him is spiralling out of control, seething despite the cool mask of indifference he wears upon his face. With more gentle care than you bother to apply, the fox-man pricks the tip of his sword against your guts and ribcage more than once, letting you know he could've run you right through but refrained from doing so. Of course — he wouldn't be able to humiliate you in front of his underlings and your family if he just killed you outright. But at last, your strength fails you. The stinging bites of several dozen cuts bring you down; your clothes are shreds, leaving you half-naked in front of everyone. Raphael continues to stand firm and proud, sliding the point of his slender sword down between your chin and throat and forcing your gaze upwards yet again. "Pity for such beauty to be caught in the clutches of a demoness, such that its extinguishing is necessitated. Such a fair flower, cut with the chaff," he says with a smirk, adding as much theatrical flourish as he can to his words. "But you'll find that I'm not as easy prey as others for the likes of you. [silly |Die, monster. You don't belong in this land. |Any last words? ]" Your eyes turn to your [kiyoko.numKits 2 4 |charges and family |family |charges ], to the torches flickering amongst the trees, down the length of the slim bronze blade to its wielder. [kinu.isInari |"Go fuck yourself." Raphael laughs. "Defiant to the end, I see. I'd expect no less from a demoness of your stature." |"You can intimidate, bully, seduce and deceive others into compliance." Your voice shakes as you draw ragged breaths, the bronze point pricking against your throat. "But has anyone ever wilfully loved you? Not what they believe you to be, but you?" Raphael grins like he saw it coming, but the smile on his muzzle beneath the mask is far from convincing. "Lies spill from your mouth like water from a broken dam, demoness. It is my duty to silence you forever." ] His forearm tenses, clearly readying himself to drive the point of his blade through your throat, and then several things happen. The first is that several arrows fly out of the trees, sickening wet smacks rising into the night air as they sink into flesh. One comes flying straight for Raphael, and the Russet Rogue is forced to bring the point of his blade up and away from your throat to slice it from the air. Why he didn't just settle for simply dodging it while keeping you at swordpoint is beyond you — maybe his instincts for leaning to the theatrical and dramatic worked against him this time. The next thing is that foxfire erupts by the pool, flickering ghostly flames bursting into existence, blazing away with intense, blinding light despite the lack of heat. Multiple roars ring through the air, deafening thunderclaps that shake the trees. The standing invaders rally into formation, pulling out not their weapons but various arcane implements after the fashion of the natives of this land — wands, runestones, other means of defending themselves from the two-pronged assault. The opening is small, but it's all you need and hope is a far more generous lender than terror is. Quick as he is, by the time Raphael's recovered and has his swordpoint trained back on you, you've grabbed your [kinu.weapon] and are rapidly disengaging from the scene. "[kinu.isInari |Going so soon, my pretty? Don't struggle so much, you'll wound me! |Don't you dare run, demoness. You don't get to sully a man's reputation with your filthy lies and just leave without being taught a lesson. ]" What was he expecting, dumb-minded compliance when you've already proven yourself to do anything but that? Maybe like the way he relies on his sword, he's spent too long around brainless bimbos who swoon at his every word to actually believe that a woman might not mindlessly obey him. Whatever, your [kiyoko.numKits 2 4 |charges and family |family |charges ] need you this moment. [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 4 12 |Aya yips and squeals as you grab her by the waist and drag her off amidst the chaos, her tails grabbing at you for purchase as you hoof it through the chaos, picking up the field hands along the way |Aya yips and squeals as you grab her by the waist and drag her off amidst the chaos, her tails grabbing at you for purchase as you hoof it through the chaos, picking up the field hands along the way. Ever the opportunist, Tatsumi's grabbed yet another of the invaders' weapons off a fallen body in the melee, covering your retreat with all of his inexperienced but valiant efforts |Aya yips and squeals as you grab her by the waist and drag her off amidst the chaos, her tails grabbing at you for purchase as you hoof it through the chaos; Asagiri limps along, determined to not fall behind and get caught in the growing melee. Ever the opportunist, Tatsumi's grabbed yet another of the invaders' weapons off a fallen body, covering [kiyoko.numKits 5 |the rest of your siblings' |your family's ] retreat with all of his inexperienced but valiant efforts |Aya yips and squeals as you grab her by the waist and drag her off amidst the chaos, her tails grabbing at you for purchase as you hoof it through the chaos; Asagiri limps along, determined to not fall behind and get caught in the growing melee. Ever the opportunist, Tatsumi's grabbed yet another of the invaders' weapons off a fallen body, covering the rest of your siblings' retreat with all of his inexperienced but valiant efforts. There are a lot of you, but the chaos is rapidly spreading and the invaders have more pressing concerns than corralling children at the moment, especially when the only one whom they've been led to believe is a threat is rapidly retreating |With more pressing issues on the invaders' minds than corralling a bunch of beaten-down, unarmed field hands, you're able to quickly get to where they were being held and slash open their bonds with [kinu.kinuWeapon |the edge of your naginata |an arrowhead ]. Urging them forward despite your own doubts about your leadership, you cover their retreat as best as you can in the chaos before allowing yourself to withdraw. Responsibility flows upwards, after all ]. Behind you, you hear Raphael [kinu.isHime |raging and ]rallying his men, urging them to press the attack in your direction despite the fact that the fight is already starting to turn against them. He may be skilled, but even so one man can't compensate for this kind of situation alone. It stings, it hurts, and you're certain that your body is going to exact a cruel revenge upon you for mistreating it so, but so long as there's any hope that your [kiyoko.numKits 2 4 |family and people |family |people ] might make it out alive now that the situation has changed, you can't give up. And the greatest irony is that if the madman that was Raphael hadn't been such a would-be dashing rogue, you wouldn't have been able to stall him long enough for help to arrive in the nick of time. If he'd only just saved the theaterics and outright murdered you when he had the chance... Ha. "[kiyoko.numKits 2 |[silly |Nee-sama |Big sis ], w |W ]e're almost there!" And so you are. Never in your life have you been so glad to see familiar faces — Azami, Miko and Mai, and most of all, [party.has kiyoko |[kinu.isInari |Hitoshi. Even as the line of kitsune sweep past you to join in the skirmish, Miko and Mai taking charge of [kiyoko.numKits 2 4 |your family and the field hands |your family |the field hands ] from you, he leans in to take you in one hand and your [kinu.weapon] in the other. Quietly, Hitoshi accepts the hug you give him, then pats you on the head between your ears as he towers over you. "You're safe now." "..." Anyone else would have been crushed by your embrace, but not him as he slowly reverses course and leads you into the back line. After the harrowing experience, it's nice to have someone solid and reassuring to cling to. "...Let's not get in the others' way. I'll take care of you." |Nakano. Even as the line of kitsune sweep past you to join in the skirmish, Miko and Mai taking charge of [kiyoko.numKits 2 4 |your family and the field hands |your family |the field hands ] from you, he sheathes his nodachi and foists it upon his back so that he has both hands free to catch you and your [kinu.weapon] as you slump into his embrace. There's that certain trepidation there as he no doubt realizes that this is far too familiar — no, intimate — for your stations, but of course, he does what he must in your service no matter the personal cost. He's sweet like that. "Are you all right?" It's a formality, of course; both of you know you're not all right, but the words are reassuring to hear. "Allow us to fight in your stead — my only regret is that we did not arrive sooner." "Then..." you gasp, feeling your pains and aches finally return in force, "Forgive me for adding to your shame — I know you wish to be out there, but I require your services." "...Lady Otomo, you are the heir to my liege's liege, and of divine blood." Nakano sighs, and pats you on the head; his touch through the gauntlet is hard, yet paradoxically reassuring and tender. "There is no greater honor than to attend to your desires, regardless of any other sacrifices I may be called upon to make in that line of duty." If not for his armor, you would surely crush him with your embrace. There's a certain instinctive reluctance in him as he slowly reverses course and leads you into the back line; you know how much he's longed for an actual enemy to fight, and for him to walk away from this for you has to be incredibly hard on him. "You need help. Allow me to take you away from this place." ] |Mother. [kinu.isInari |You'd never thought the day would come where you'd actually be glad to see her, but extenuating circumstances are what they are. The two of you will almost certainly go back to being at loggerheads tomorrow, but here and now, the two of you have come to a detente at least... |It feels so good to have her back with you, to be close to her, to know with certainty that someone wiser and more experienced than you is in charge here, especially when all of your recent decisions have merely worsened the situation. ] Mother finishes with tossing a gout of foxfire out into the fray, then receives you into her bosom, one hand coming to rest on the back of your head and the other between your shoulders. Her fingers sink into your sweaty, grimy hair and start petting away, making you feel like you're a kit again. "There, there," Mother murmurs, leading down to kiss your brow and pet you between the ears. [kinu.isInari |Any other occasion and you'd have vociferously protested, but... it has been true that Mother hasn't shown you such outward affection for a long, long time. The soft motions and soothing voice take you back and awaken a distant, buried memory, that of a time when you were Mother's only child and you didn't have the adult responsibilities of caring for your younger siblings and more that were foisted upon you from an early age. It must have been good to be carefree, once, even if you don't recall very much of that time. For a while, you allow yourself to set aside your dignity and indignation and allow Mother to fuss over your hurts while you lay your head on her bosom like a child. |You can't help it any more — now that no one else's paying too much attention, you allow yourself to sniffle, sob, and finally start crying into Mother's bosom as her fingers soothe your hurts. "I am so scared, Mother." "Hush, hush. I will not allow what happened to me to befall my daughter, even if only in partial measure." "Mother — !" Mother's stature may be small, but her presence extends far beyond her body, warm and enveloping. You haven't hugged her like this for a while now, and it feels good; you can only hope to be able to project this kind of calming presence so effortlessly in time... ] "Come," Mother whispers. "Let us be away from this place — we are only getting in the way of others who are fighting in our stead." [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 4 5 |"Aya and the field hands," you choke. "They — they — I have to see to —" |"Aya and the field hands," you choke. "They — Tatsumi was watching them, but I have to see to —" |"Asagiri was burned," you choke, suddenly rising with a start. "I — she needs — Tatsumi will take it terribly when he realizes —" |"Asagiri was burned," you choke, suddenly rising with a start. "I — she needs — Tatsumi will take it terribly when he realizes —" "Quiet, child. Calm yourself." "And then there's the matter of everyone else, if they all made it out safely —" |"The field hands," you choke. "I would have led them to their deaths. They — I have to see to —" ] Mother tsks and pokes you on the forehead with a finger. "[kinu.isInari |Doggedly stubborn, as always. Well, if you weren't, I suppose I'd have to worry if the experience shattered you, but by all accounts you're still the daughter I know |It's all right, it's just us now. You can leave the rest to me; you don't always have to measure yourself up to my level, my dear daughter. After all, I do have so many years on you ]. Now then, let us depart and leave the clean-up to others. That boy of Komari's [kinu.isHime |you fancy ]finally has the glorious battle that he's been hungering for all his life. Pretty underwhelming, really, but let him have his time." ] "

rows.original: Some time later... "Now, don't ya even try sittin' up, lil' sis. [party.has kiyoko |Cus |Yer lady mother ] said ya were to stay in bed, an' Miko an' I ain't got no reason to disagree none. Ya jus' lie down here like a good girl an' recuperate; ya done lost a lot o' blood an' ya done pushed yerself way past what no one's got any right to do. Ain't no permanent damage yet, but if'n ya don't listen none there could be plenty, so I'm tellin' ya f'r th' last time: stay in bed. Ya done hear me right?" You twist and turn on the futon, trying to get up, but each movement is accompanied by several dozen stinging aches and a half-dozen deep-seated pains. "Well, ain't ya feisty, lil' sis." Mai takes a deep drag from her pipe and blows a plume of smoke, adding to the already choking smell of winterstem to the chamber. "Keros' tails, so help me if'n ya disobey me, I swear on the name o' th' August Master at th' center ' heaven himself that I ain't hesitatin' to tie ya down with rope an' all." [kiyoko.numKits 4 |"No. Asagiri..." Mai reaches over and slaps your hand down. "Yer lil' sis is jus' fine. Miko's tendin' to her now, an' yer lil' brother ain't leaving her side none either." "She... her burns, they —" " — Ain't nothin' f'r ya to get yerself riled up about none." "[kiyoko.numKits 6 |She ran into the flames to pull out her little brothers and sisters |The bastards set the building she was in on fire ], Mai. I have to —" "Do what, exactly, lil' sis? Whatcha gonna do?" Mai blows another smoke ring, her expression completely cold and impassive. "Ya gonna show up like this in front o' yer kid sister an' scare her half to death when what she done needs is some peace o' mind? That ain't bein' responsible none, that's jus' bein' several kinds o' selfish. Ya ain't concerned f'r her, ya jus' want release from yer own guilt. An' to that, I'm sayin' no. Ya stay right here an' don't risk gettin' yer cuts infected none." "..." "Ya still gonna argue?" "...How bad is it, at least?" "Her face weren't burned none, it's still as pretty as ever. Now git yerself back down 'fore I get th' mind to put ya down." You consider that for all of a moment, then a thought hits you. "You said it was just her face, what about the rest of her?" "Ain't nothin' f'r ya to fret about." "You're evading the question." "Granny done thinks it would be good f'r yer kid sister to join us at th' shrine when she's up an' 'bout th' place, train her to be a priestess.[party.has kiyoko | | Yer mom ain't got no problem with it none. ]" "..." |"No. Did — did your people make it out, too? [kinu.isInari |I know I didn't really speak to any of them even though we worked together, but there're things that get across without needing to say a word. I... I'd feel bad if anything awful were to happen to them. |I know I hardly ever see them save to give them their tasks at dawn and to review the day's work at dusk, but even so... ] I wouldn't blame them if they didn't want to help out on my side any more. "Ain't a single pretty hair on their tails so much as touched, lil' sis. Can't say th' same for their spirits... but ain't no one getting outta that kinda bind without them getting disturbed some." "I almost led them to their deaths. Would have, if you didn't come along." "Responsibility flows upwards, don'tcha know." ] That's all that Mai's willing to share on the matter, so you try a different approach. "[kinu.isInari |How'd you find out something was wrong |How did you come to realize something was amiss ]?" Mai sighs and leans back, gathering her thoughts. She gathers foxfire on her finger and you think she's going to mess with her pipe again, but you see her bring out a censer and light its contents — whatever's inside it, it burns with a refreshing scent as opposed to the heavy drowsiness of winterstem, the two blending together to make you feel clear in head yet heavy of limb. Part of her ploy to keep you in bed, you suppose. "We-ll. Weren't two hours into my shift 'fore I noticed the torii gate weren't workin' right. [kinu.isInari |Na |Hitoshi ][silly |-kun ] had th' idea to go visitin' ya at that time o' night, an' I weren't 'bout at be askin' him what f'r. But th' gate didn't work none or open to begin with, an'..." "You got suspicious." "I tried to fix it an' eventually got fed up, so I went to find granny. She done figured out that th' gate weren't broke, it was that someone were jammin' it from th' other side. Wouldn't take an idjit at that point to figure out somethin' were wrong... we rounded up Ishida[silly |-san ]'s and Na[silly |-kun ]'s people went to take a look-see." You sink back into the pillow with a sigh and stare up at the ceiling. "[kinu.isInari |Great timing. A minute or two later, and I'd be dead; you certainly made your entrance at the most dramatic moment. But... thanks for coming for me. If not for myself, then for [kiyoko.numKits 2 |my family |the folks you lent us ] |Thank you for coming for me; you arrived in the nick of time. I... I thought I was going to perish there, but more importantly, [kiyoko.numKits 2 |my family |my charges ] would have followed me, and that is something that still troubles me ]." More silence. Mai eventually runs out of winterstem; she reaches into her shrine maiden's uniform, draws out a little silvered box, and looks dismayed at its emptied state. "I'm gonna go now, 'lil sis; this pipe o' mine needs fillin'. When my eyes ain't on ya, yer gotta stay here, okay? Don't get up an' go walkin' aroun' or nothin'. Like I said, wouldn't want any o' yer cuts gettin' infected an' all. Ya jus' stay here an' rest... th' charms an' smoke, they'll help keep th' nightmares away. Sleep tight."
rows.translation: 过了一段时间…… 现在，你可千万别试着坐起来，小妹妹。 [party.has kiyoko |因为…… |你个混蛋 ] 我说过让你好好躺在床上休息，我和美子也没有任何理由反对这个建议。你就像个乖女孩一样躺在这里好好恢复吧——你已经流了很多血，也已经超出了任何人应该承受的极限。目前还没有造成永久性的伤害，但如果你不听话，后果可能会很严重。所以我最后再提醒你一次：赖在床上不起来你真的听清楚我说的话了吗？ 你在榻子上翻来覆去，试图起身，但每一个动作都会引发几十处刺痛感和六处隐痛。 哎呀，你这个小丫头还真是一副倔强的样子呢。舞深深地吸了一口烟斗，然后吐出一缕烟雾，使得房间里本就已浓重的冬日气息变得更加呛人。凯罗斯的尾巴啊，要是你们不听我的话，可就帮帮我吧。我以天空中那位奥古斯特大师的名义起誓，我真的会毫不犹豫地用绳子把你们绑起来。 [kiyoko.numKits 4 |不，朝雾…… 梅伸出手来，轻轻拍了一下你的手。你妹妹现在没事的。米科正在照顾她，你弟弟也一直陪在她身边。 她的……她的烧伤，那些…… ——根本没有什么事情值得你为此大动肝火。 "[kiyoko.numKits 6 |她冲进火焰中，把弟弟妹妹们救了出来。 |那些混蛋放火烧了她所在的建筑物 ]舞，我必须得—— 到底想做什么啊，小妹？你打算怎么做？舞又吐出一个烟圈，她的表情冰冷而毫无情绪波动。你就这样出现在你妹妹面前，把她吓得半死，而她现在真正需要的只是安心和平静。这样做根本不是负责任的表现，纯粹就是自私至极。你根本不在乎她，你只是想摆脱自己的负罪感而已。对此，我坚决反对。你就待在这里吧，别让那些伤口感染了。 "..." 你还要继续争论吗？ ……至少，情况有多糟糕呢？ 她的脸一点都没有被烧伤，依然像以前一样漂亮。现在赶紧坐回去，不然我可要改变主意了放置你倒下了。 你这么想着，突然间，一个念头闪过了你的脑海。你说只是她的脸而已，那她的其他部分呢？ 没什么好让你担心的。 你是在回避这个问题。 奶奶觉得，等你妹妹长大后，让她来神殿和我们一起生活，训练她成为一名女祭司，会是一件很好的事情。[party.has kiyoko | | 你妈可一点意见都没有。 ]" "..." |不。那么……你们的人也成功逃脱了吗？ [kinu.isInari |我知道，虽然我们一起工作过，但实际上我并没有和他们中的任何一个人真正说过话。但是，有些事情是不需要用言语来表达的。如果他们遇到了什么不好的事情，我会感到很难过。 |我知道我几乎从未见过他们在黎明时保存进度以接受任务，也在黄昏时回顾当天的工作，但即便如此…… ] 如果他们不再愿意帮助我，我也不会责怪他们。 小妹妹，它们的尾巴上连一根漂亮的毛发都没有，根本碰都碰不到。不过它们的精神状态倒挺不错的……不过，要想摆脱那种困境，谁都难免会受到一些影响吧。 我差点把他们引向死亡。要不是你出现了，他们肯定没命了。 责任是自上而下的，你难道不知道吗？ ] 关于这件事，舞只愿意分享这些信息，所以你们可以尝试其他方法来获取更多信息。"[kinu.isInari |你是怎么发现出了问题的呢？ |来得正是时候。再晚一两分钟，我就没命了；你确实出现在了最戏剧性的时刻。不过……还是谢谢你来救我。就算不为我自己，也要替[kiyoko.numKits 2 |我的家人 |你们借给我们的那些人 ]谢谢你 |谢谢你们来救我，你们来得正是时候。我……我原本以为自己会在那里丧命，但更重要的是 [kiyoko.numKits 2 |我的家人 |我的费用 ] 他们本会跟随我的，而这件事至今仍在困扰着我。 ]." 更多的沉默。最终，舞的冬茎用完了；她伸手从自己的神官制服里拿出了一个银色的小盒子，看到里面已经空空如也，脸上露出了沮丧的神情。 我现在得走了，小妹妹；我的烟斗还得再装点烟呢。当我不在你身边的时候，你一定要待在这里，好吗？千万不要到处乱走哦。就像我说的，我可不想你的伤口感染什么的。你就待在这里休息吧……那些护身符和烟雾会帮助你驱赶噩梦的。睡个好觉吧。
rows.raw: " Some time later... "Now, don't ya even try sittin' up, lil' sis. [party.has kiyoko |Cus |Yer lady mother ] said ya were to stay in bed, an' Miko an' I ain't got no reason to disagree none. Ya jus' lie down here like a good girl an' recuperate; ya done lost a lot o' blood an' ya done pushed yerself way past what no one's got any right to do. Ain't no permanent damage yet, but if'n ya don't listen none there could be plenty, so I'm tellin' ya f'r th' last time: stay in bed. Ya done hear me right?" You twist and turn on the futon, trying to get up, but each movement is accompanied by several dozen stinging aches and a half-dozen deep-seated pains. "Well, ain't ya feisty, lil' sis." Mai takes a deep drag from her pipe and blows a plume of smoke, adding to the already choking smell of winterstem to the chamber. "Keros' tails, so help me if'n ya disobey me, I swear on the name o' th' August Master at th' center ' heaven himself that I ain't hesitatin' to tie ya down with rope an' all." [kiyoko.numKits 4 |"No. Asagiri..." Mai reaches over and slaps your hand down. "Yer lil' sis is jus' fine. Miko's tendin' to her now, an' yer lil' brother ain't leaving her side none either." "She... her burns, they —" " — Ain't nothin' f'r ya to get yerself riled up about none." "[kiyoko.numKits 6 |She ran into the flames to pull out her little brothers and sisters |The bastards set the building she was in on fire ], Mai. I have to —" "Do what, exactly, lil' sis? Whatcha gonna do?" Mai blows another smoke ring, her expression completely cold and impassive. "Ya gonna show up like this in front o' yer kid sister an' scare her half to death when what she done needs is some peace o' mind? That ain't bein' responsible none, that's jus' bein' several kinds o' selfish. Ya ain't concerned f'r her, ya jus' want release from yer own guilt. An' to that, I'm sayin' no. Ya stay right here an' don't risk gettin' yer cuts infected none." "..." "Ya still gonna argue?" "...How bad is it, at least?" "Her face weren't burned none, it's still as pretty as ever. Now git yerself back down 'fore I get th' mind to put ya down." You consider that for all of a moment, then a thought hits you. "You said it was just her face, what about the rest of her?" "Ain't nothin' f'r ya to fret about." "You're evading the question." "Granny done thinks it would be good f'r yer kid sister to join us at th' shrine when she's up an' 'bout th' place, train her to be a priestess.[party.has kiyoko | | Yer mom ain't got no problem with it none. ]" "..." |"No. Did — did your people make it out, too? [kinu.isInari |I know I didn't really speak to any of them even though we worked together, but there're things that get across without needing to say a word. I... I'd feel bad if anything awful were to happen to them. |I know I hardly ever see them save to give them their tasks at dawn and to review the day's work at dusk, but even so... ] I wouldn't blame them if they didn't want to help out on my side any more. "Ain't a single pretty hair on their tails so much as touched, lil' sis. Can't say th' same for their spirits... but ain't no one getting outta that kinda bind without them getting disturbed some." "I almost led them to their deaths. Would have, if you didn't come along." "Responsibility flows upwards, don'tcha know." ] That's all that Mai's willing to share on the matter, so you try a different approach. "[kinu.isInari |How'd you find out something was wrong |How did you come to realize something was amiss ]?" Mai sighs and leans back, gathering her thoughts. She gathers foxfire on her finger and you think she's going to mess with her pipe again, but you see her bring out a censer and light its contents — whatever's inside it, it burns with a refreshing scent as opposed to the heavy drowsiness of winterstem, the two blending together to make you feel clear in head yet heavy of limb. Part of her ploy to keep you in bed, you suppose. "We-ll. Weren't two hours into my shift 'fore I noticed the torii gate weren't workin' right. [kinu.isInari |Na |Hitoshi ][silly |-kun ] had th' idea to go visitin' ya at that time o' night, an' I weren't 'bout at be askin' him what f'r. But th' gate didn't work none or open to begin with, an'..." "You got suspicious." "I tried to fix it an' eventually got fed up, so I went to find granny. She done figured out that th' gate weren't broke, it was that someone were jammin' it from th' other side. Wouldn't take an idjit at that point to figure out somethin' were wrong... we rounded up Ishida[silly |-san ]'s and Na[silly |-kun ]'s people went to take a look-see." You sink back into the pillow with a sigh and stare up at the ceiling. "[kinu.isInari |Great timing. A minute or two later, and I'd be dead; you certainly made your entrance at the most dramatic moment. But... thanks for coming for me. If not for myself, then for [kiyoko.numKits 2 |my family |the folks you lent us ] |Thank you for coming for me; you arrived in the nick of time. I... I thought I was going to perish there, but more importantly, [kiyoko.numKits 2 |my family |my charges ] would have followed me, and that is something that still troubles me ]." More silence. Mai eventually runs out of winterstem; she reaches into her shrine maiden's uniform, draws out a little silvered box, and looks dismayed at its emptied state. "I'm gonna go now, 'lil sis; this pipe o' mine needs fillin'. When my eyes ain't on ya, yer gotta stay here, okay? Don't get up an' go walkin' aroun' or nothin'. Like I said, wouldn't want any o' yer cuts gettin' infected an' all. Ya jus' stay here an' rest... th' charms an' smoke, they'll help keep th' nightmares away. Sleep tight." "

rows.original:
More time passes, and you drift in and out of consciousness during that period; fear and hope alike send in their invoices in the ensuing hours and days, demanding repayment of lent strength with as much interest as you'd expect. People come in and out of the room, and you're vaguely aware of voices speaking around you while you lie in your convalescence; even when Mai comes in to change the dressings on your wounds, wipe you down and help you to the washroom it all feels like a delusion. You know it's not, but for the first time in your life you don't have any daily responsibilities, social obligations, or pressing matters to attend to.[kinu.isInari
            | They say there aren't any holidays on a farm... but the fields are and paddies are gone, burnt, and you don't even know if there's anything left to salvage.
        ]
        
        Even so, the deadening effect of winterstem can't block out all your thoughts and worries, drunk on the atmosphere of your chambers as you might be. You don't have any nightmares... but at the same extent, you don't have any pleasant dreams, either. Everything seems as illusory and transient as the morning fog, there one moment and gone the next; even keeping track of time eventually becomes impossible. [kinu.isInari
            |Sometimes, you become aware of Hitoshi besides you, completely silent but with his hand wrapped completely around yours. Those are your most lucid moments, when he comes in from the fields every evening and feeds you something or the other that he's prepared that day; the scent of dirt and sap that cling to him and the strength in his fingers are a welcome change from the constant gray dullness of winterstem smoke that numbs your senses and nerves.
            
            Hitoshi never says much, but then again you're not the best of conversationalists, either. You're just content to have his presence around you whenever possible.
            |Sometimes, you become aware of Nakano besides you, completely silent but with his hand wrapped completely around yours. Those are your most lucid moments, when he's finished with his duties in the evening and comes in to sit beside you. He talks while Miko works on you when she comes off shift, distracting your attention from her poking and prodding. The topics are never quite on point — sometimes it's about den matters, other times it's politics across the ocean, or something trivial yet interesting he managed to learn that day.
            
            Under no circumstance, though, does he ever speak of the aftermath of that day, or his own poetry, for that matter. Miko being around probably has something to do with that. You don't remember half of what he says, but you're glad for the attempt to keep you informed, and for keeping you company. His presence is enough, a welcome change from the constant gray dullness of winterstem smoke that numbs your senses and nerves.
        ]
        
        [party.has kiyoko
            |Sometimes, you wonder if Mother will ever show up, but she doesn't — not by your side, and not in your dreams. But of course, she wouldn't be able to come, and neither would [pc.mf|Father|Mother] — the both of them are away saving the world, and you're here... 
            
            ... How long will it be before they're back, before they realize what's happened to their home in their absence? [kinu.isInari
                |Will they ever be back? [pc.mf|Father|Mother] was always gone, days, weeks, months... there were times when you swore that [pc.heShe] was sneaking around you while you were sleeping up on the hill, trying to leave without greeting you. Of course, you never said anything about it, dutiful kit as you were... and now Mother's gone as well.
                
                That's stupid... they'll be back, right? Only you remember waiting ten years, and then — 
                
                But in the end, that's why you needed to be independent. In the end, that's why you needed to grow up, and finally, hopefully soon enough, you'll be able to marry Hitoshi and be gone for good. And now it's been proven beyond any ability of yours to deny it that your best may not be enough... 
                
                You're not scared or anything. It's just exhausting to think of.
                |You were left in charge while they were gone, and look at the mess you've made of this whole thing. Of course, you know what your parents will say — that they're glad that [kiyoko.numKits 2
                    |everyone is alive and unharmed
                    |you're still alive
                ], but the den, the buildings, the fields... everything was either burned or stolen. That kind of shame... even if you're forgiven, that doesn't erase the stain in the least. Perhaps it even makes it worse... 
                
                The thought of Mother gone all the time fills you with a dark, sickening dread whether you like it or not. While it's true that Matron Komari is around to guide you in Mother's absence as her retainer, Mother herself has always been a presence in your life ever since you were a kit, until recently. And now look at what's happened... 
                
                It's just... exhausting to think of.
            ]
            |Mother drifts in and out of your convalescence chambers when she can, although by virtue of her position she can never stay very long. You can understand that perfectly; after all, you share many of the same responsibilities, if yours are smaller in scope. [kinu.isInari
                |Still, that doesn't prevent a knot of resentment from twisting inside of you, no matter how much you realize how petulant you're being
                |You're always glad for her presence, no matter how brief; it's always been this way since you were a kit. In a way, it brings you relief in a way winterstem can't
            ].
            
            You don't remember very many of the words she says during your brief time together, not with everything you perceive filtered through the smoky, medicinal haze, but you're sure that she's no delusion of a fevered mind and are glad for it.
            
            Everything just feels so exhausting.
        ] 
        
        In the times you're left alone to your thoughts, memories of [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 4
            |Aya rabidly half-reverted, fighting for her life
            |Aya rabidly half-reverted and Tatsumi tearing his scarf
            |Aya rabidly half-reverted, Tatsumi tearing his scarf and Aya's skin weeping
            |your home in flames
        ] surface from the depths of your consciousness, rising to the fore of your mind to torment you before sinking back again. You toss and turn in your futon, the ointments and medicated bandages needling and stinging you until winterstem and citrus claim you for the umpteenth time.
rows.translation:
时间一点点流逝，在那段时间里，你的意识时而清醒时而模糊；接下来的几个小时和几天里，恐惧与希望这两种情绪如同账单一般不断袭来，要求你偿还那些“借来的力量”，而且所要求的利息之多，完全超出了你的预期。人们不断地进出这个房间，而你躺在那里养伤时，只是隐约能听到周围有人在说话；即使当舞进来为你的伤口换药、帮你擦洗身体、扶你去洗手间时，这一切也仿佛只是一场幻觉。你知道其实并非如此，但这是你人生中第一次完全没有任何日常责任、社交义务或需要紧急处理的事情。[kinu.isInari
            | 人们都说，在农场里是没有节假日的……但那些田野和稻田都已经毁了，被烧成了灰烬，你甚至都无法确定是否还有什么可以抢救回来的。
        ]
        
        即便如此，冬日的沉闷气息也无法完全掩盖你心中的思绪与忧虑。你或许正沉醉于自己所处的环境之中，既没有噩梦……也同样没有美好的梦境。一切仿佛都像晨雾一样虚幻而短暂，转瞬即逝；甚至最终连时间的流逝都变得难以察觉。 [kinu.isInari
            |有时候，你会注意到Hitoshi就在你身边——他静静地站着，但他的手紧紧地握着你的手。那些时刻才是你头脑最为清醒的时候：每晚当他从田野里回来，会给你准备一些他当天采来的食物；他身上带着泥土和树液的气息，而他手指里蕴含的力量，与冬季那令人感官麻木的灰暗气息截然不同，这种变化让人感到无比愉悦。
            
            仁总是不多说话，不过话说回来，你本身也不是个很健谈的人。你只是希望他能在自己身边而已。
            |有时候，你会注意到站在你身旁的中野——他始终保持着沉默，但他的手却紧紧地握着你的手。那些时刻才是你头脑最为清醒的时候，因为那时他已经完成了晚上的工作，会过来坐在你身边。当美子下班后开始对你进行各种“检查”时，他就会一边聊天，一边分散你的注意力，让你无法注意到她的那些动作。他聊的话题往往并不切题——有时是关于狗的事情，有时是关于远在大洋彼岸的政治新闻，又有时则是他那天偶然了解到的一些琐碎但有趣的事情。
            
            然而，他在任何情况下都不会提及那天发生的事情，也不会谈论自己的诗歌。米科在他的身边，或许与此有关。你其实并不记得他说的那些话中有多少是真实的，但你会为他努力让你了解情况、陪伴你的举动而感到欣慰。他的出现本身就已经足够了，这与冬季烟雾那种持续不断的灰暗、沉闷气息形成了鲜明的对比——那种烟雾会麻痹你的感官和神经。
        ]
        
        [party.has kiyoko
            |有时候，你会想知道母亲是否会出现，但她并没有——既不会出现在你身边，也不会出现在你的梦中。当然，她也不可能来到你身边，其他人也同样如此。 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲] — 他们两个都去拯救世界了，而你却在这里…… 
            ……他们还要过多久才能回来？他们什么时候才会发现，在他们离开期间，自己的家发生了什么？ [kinu.isInari
                |他们还会回来吗？ [pc.mf|父亲|母亲] 总是不在，几天、几周、几个月……有时候你甚至会发誓[pc.heShe]当你还在山上睡觉的时候，它一直在你身边偷偷活动，试图不跟你说一声就离开。当然，你从来都没有说过什么，因为你一直是个尽职尽责的小家伙……而现在，妈妈也离开了。
                
                那太愚蠢了……他们总会回来的，对吧？只有你记得自己等了整整十年，然后——但归根结底，这就是你为什么必须独立的原因。归根结底，这就是你为什么必须成长的原因。而最终，希望这一切能尽快实现，你就能嫁给Hitoshi，然后永远离开那里。现在，事实已经证明：你再怎么否认，也无可否认——你的最佳表现可能仍然不够……你并不害怕，也不是什么其他原因。只是想到这一点，就让人感到疲惫不堪。
                |他们不在的时候，你就被留下来负责这件事，看看你把整个事情搞得多么一团糟。当然，你也知道你的父母会怎么说——他们会说他们很欣慰。 [kiyoko.numKits 2
                    |所有人都安然无恙。
                    |你还没死。
                ]但是那个巢穴、那些建筑物、那些田野……一切都要么被烧毁了，要么被偷走了。那种耻辱……即使你得到了原谅，也丝毫无法抹去那道污痕。或许，这甚至会让事情变得更糟…… 
                
                无论你是否愿意，一想到母亲永远离开了，你就会感到一种阴暗而令人作呕的恐惧。虽然麻里女首领会在母亲不在的时候指导你，担任她的助手，但实际上，从你还是个婴儿的时候起，母亲就一直存在于你的生活中，直到最近才发生了改变。现在看看发生了什么……光是想到这些，就让人感到精疲力竭。
            ]
            |母亲一有空就会来到你的康复室来看你，不过由于她的身份关系，她每次待的时间都不长。你完全能够理解这一点；毕竟，你们承担着许多相同的责任，只不过你的责任范围相对较小而已。 [kinu.isInari
                |然而，无论你多么清楚自己的行为是多么任性，这都无法阻止一股怨恨在你心中逐渐积聚。
                |无论她的陪伴时间多么短暂，你总会感到欣慰；从你还是个孩子的时候起，就是这样的。在某种程度上，她的存在能给你带来一种冬茎无法给予的慰藉。
            ]在你们短暂相处的那些日子里，她说过的话，你其实并没有记住多少——毕竟你所感受到的一切，都笼罩在那种烟雾弥漫、带有药味的迷雾之中。但你可以确定，她并不是处于发热导致的幻觉状态，为此你感到庆幸。总之，这一切真的让人感到精疲力竭。
        ] 
        
        在那些你独自沉思的时刻，那些回忆便会浮现在脑海中 [kiyoko.numKits 2 3 4
            |阿雅陷入了疯狂的状态，拼命挣扎着想要活下去。
            |绫亚疯狂地恢复了半原始状态，而龙司则扯碎了自己的围巾。
            |绫亚疯狂地恢复了半原始状态，龙司扯碎了自己的围巾，而绫亚的皮肤也开始渗出血来。
            |你的家园陷入火海
        ] 这些念头从你意识的深处浮现出来，闯入你的脑海，折磨着你，然后又再次沉入暗影之中。你在榻子上翻来覆去，那些药膏和药布不断地刺激着你，直到“冬茎”和“柑橘”的香气再次将你带入梦乡。
