你轻笑一声，摇了摇头。哦，这个标准确实相当高，要达到确实不容易。 你真的尽力了 [kinu.Dad],"小娟 added. 我看得清。 哦，真的吗？ 小娟调皮地吐了吐舌头。当你 [kiyoko.numKits 4|有和我一样多的弟弟妹妹|对它有敏锐的观察力]其实，这并不难分辨。判断出某人是否真的在努力，并不是什么难事。 [kinu.Dad]" 知己知彼，百战不殆。清子轻笑着，拍了拍希奴的耳朵，而你那三尾的小女儿则撅起了小嘴。说正经的，那真的很有趣。我已经有一段时间没有感受到如此纯粹的欢乐了。 妈妈，你应该多笑笑哦。小娟开口说道。这对你的美貌有好处。 这么年轻，就已经学会如何讨好别人了。唉，我该拿你怎么办呢？ ] 好吧，那么，小姑娘。把你的玩具收起来，今天剩下的时间你就可以到外面去玩了。 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲] 我也希望能有段时间能单独相处，只有我们两个人。[kiyoko.numKits 4| 告诉你们的兄弟姐妹，我们现在很忙，除非有真正的紧急情况，否则不要来打扰我们。]" 有那么一瞬间，小娟看起来显得既调皮又充满算计，但这种表情很快就被一种安静的顺从所取代了。小娟双手拿起那些豆袋，然后迅速跑回了室内。
rows.raw: " As it so happens, your daughter leads you back to the cabin, clambering up to the porch with the both of you on her heels. Throwing open the front door, she peeks inside, then darts in. "Wait here, okay?" "Kinu! Make sure your feet are clean! You're the one who's going to have to polish the floor later, you know!" "Okay!" comes Kinu's fading reply. Shaking her head and tutting, Kiyoko leans against you and wraps one of her tails about your leg, pressing the warmth of her body against you through her silken garments.[kiyoko.pregStage 3| Your lovely fox-wife snuggles the warm weight of her big pregnant belly against your side, bringing back memories of where Kinu came from to begin with.] "Ah, children." She's a handful? "She is indeed a handful." And as things turn out, Kinu returns with a handful of her own, a handful of small beanbags to be precise — five in total. Brightly colored and of the same make as Kiyoko and Kinu's clothes, the tightly sewn things gleam slightly in the warm sunlight as they sit in your daughter's cupped hands, the little floof herself looking up hopefully at the both of you. "Can we play otedama, Mama?" "Um, well." Kiyoko clears her throat. Is something the matter? Did Kinu make yet another breach of the convoluted web of kitsune etiquette? Kiyoko blushes, the bridge of her nose coloring as your foxy wife looks down and away. "No, nothing like that. I'm merely a little too old for otedama..." "And yet you taught me how to sew the beanbags and play the game, Mama." "Well... you're still young, my daughter. It fits you more... that, and the songs I taught you were passed down to me by my grandmother. Traditionally, you'd be taught all this by your own grandmother... but since you don't have one around, I filled in for her. It wouldn't do if you didn't learn them as the next den mother in line." "...That's still years off, though..." Kiyoko pets Kinu's ears, eliciting a happy squeal from your daughter. "All the better for you to learn everything I have to teach, then. Even with your talents, it'll take a long time." That's beyond the point, though. Here and now, you'd love it if she played a silly children's game with your daughter, no matter how juvenile it's supposed to be. A gentle sigh of mock exasperation. "But for now... I suppose I can play with the two of you." "Yaaaaay!" "Come along now, the both of you. Let's get started." Kiyoko dusts off one side of the porch by the rocking chair, then settles down on her knees[kiyoko.pregStage 3|, resting her full dome of her pregnancy in her lap]. Kinu settles in beside her mother, spilling the beanbags to the ground before her, leaving a conveniently empty spot in the circle for you to fill. It's a little awkward to sit on your knees like Kiyoko and Kinu are doing instead of on the floor like you're used to, but as the saying goes, when in Khor'minos... So, how is this played, anyway? "Watch closely, [kinu.Dad]. I'll show you!" With that, Kinu begins, bursting into a cheery children's song in her mother tongue. You don't know the words, but Kinu's definitely inherited her mother's voice... and her mother can make anything sound beautiful, let alone a language like this. With the upbeat simplicity of it all, you can't help but break into a smile as Kinu flips the beanbags up into the air one by one, catching each before it falls to the floorboards. When she reaches five, she lets them all fall to the floor, whereupon the process repeats itself. Ah, a simple children's juggling game, then. As the game progresses, the tune picks up pace, with Kinu's hands moving ever faster and faster in time with her singing — until she misses a catch, and the little beanbags come tumbling out of her hands. Your fox-daughter grins, rubs the side of her head, and sticks out her tongue at the both of you. "I messed up..." Oh, there's no need to be that serious. It's just a game, after all. "Still, when I wanted to impress [kinu.Dad] and Mama..." "Well then. I suppose it's my turn." Bending forward[kiyoko.pregStage 3| over her baby bump], your fox-wife scoops the beanbags towards her and picks one up to study it. "This brings back memories..." It's not often that you see her melancholy like this. "Just a moment's remembrance for times gone by." Kiyoko smiles a small, thin-lipped smile, and then starts the game, her beautiful, flute-like voice breaking into lively song as she starts tossing the beanbags into the air and catching them. It's not long before Kinu joins in the singing alongside her mother, and as the pace of game and melody alike pick up you can't help but start clapping along, too. Your fox-wife lasts a good while longer than your daughter does, her hands moving with easy alacrity as she tosses and catches the beanbags, her fingers a blur. After about eight rounds of this, though, she simply can't keep up with the music and fumbles, beanbags scattering all over the floor; bosom heaving from the exhilaration of it all, Kiyoko settles back and pushes the beanbags towards you. "Your turn, [pc.name]. [kiyoko.pregStage 3|That took a lot out of me... expectant mothers aren't supposed to move this quickly, ehehe.|I'm all tired out, but then again, this is a game for young girls...]" You look between your fox-wife and daughter, and the big smiles on their faces. Yep, there's no way you're squirming out of this one. "Come on, [kinu.Dad], give it a go!" It's rather embarrassing, since you don't know the language... "Oh, is that all?" Kiyoko snuggles up to you, chuckling. "We'll sing for you, if that's what you want." Well... "Well, [kinu.Dad]?" Well, you wouldn't mind. Far from it being you to deny your daughter when she asks so politely. "Ehehehe. Okay!" As one, mother and daughter break into song, the upbeat, lively music ringing in the porch as you start juggling the little beanbags in time with it. Sure, you may not know a word of the language, but the tune is enough to make your fingers feel light and set your heart skipping — there's a certain peace to the world like this, just tossing and catching little beanbags in front of your foxy family while they sing and clap along. [pc.agilityRange 40 80 |Strangely enough — or perhaps not — it's fun. The motions of juggling the brightly colored silk beanbags in the air is repetitive enough that you can really bask in this soothing atmosphere; mother and daughter make a great duet when they actually try to work together. [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0|If only they were comfortable with doing it more; their voices are truly heavenly. Truth be told, you ought to be honored; it's not that often that mother and daughter work together spontaneously like this — and all for you.|You'd ask them to sing for you more, especially in this native language of theirs, but requesting it specifically would... well, it wouldn't feel like it came from the heart, would it?] They're not picking up the pace of the tune as quickly as they ought to, you can tell. You may not be as familiar with this odetama game as they are, but that much is obvious to you; they want to drag it out as much as you do. It's both flattering and heartwarming at the same time. Up and down, up and down; each time all five beanbags find their way into your hand, you roll them out onto the floor again, and the game begins anew at a faster tempo. The movements of the silken beanbags through the air are strangely slow, the singing about you strangely hypnotic. You aren't the clumsiest of people around, but even so you're not wholly sure you expected to last this long in this little game. There always comes a moment, though, when the flesh fails the spirit, and that moment is now. You throw a beanbag up, it falls down, and you see the entire motion in painful detail as the silk slips off your fingers and falls to the floorboards with a very final hiss of dry beans. The three of you stare down at the beanbag for what can't be more than a moment or two, but achingly feels like forever; then, both your foxy wife and daughter are upon you. Giggling all the while, they swat at you with their fluffy tails good-naturedly, teasing you at Kinu gathers up the fallen beanbags. "That wasn't so bad, [kinu.Dad]. You might not be as good as Mama is, but I could see you putting in the effort and taking it seriously, and that's what matters here, right?" Hah, when it comes to your cute little daughter, you'll take even play seriously. Kiyoko just chuckles. "Oh, if you would only be as serious with some other things." |After the first few rounds of juggling the beagbags one by one, the game starts to pick up in earnest. You're pretty sure that your foxy family is turning up the rhythm of their song faster than they were doing for each other, but you can't help but smile at that. Let them play at their shenanigans all they want — you'll simply outpace them with sheer skill and determination. Kinu is the first one to give in, wheezing and panting as her little voice simply can't keep up with the fast-paced tempo. Your daughter doubles over, patting her little chest as she grins sheepishly, ears folded down against her head. "Wow, [kinu.Dad]..." Kiyoko lasts three more rounds of this, and despite you giving everything you have, you're starting to feel a little hard-pressed yourself, too. As it so happens, you and your fox-wife flub your tasks at the exact same moment, you with your fingers and she with her tongue. The little beanbags fall to the floorboards as Kiyoko's melody stumbles, and for a moment silence reigns on the porch as the both of you trade mischievous glances. Looks like it's a draw, if you were ever competing to begin with. "Well," Kiyoko says as she catches her breath, her [kiyoko.numKits 16|ample|pert] bosom heaving, "at least I know where our daughter's propensity to run all over the place comes from, and it's not from my side of the family." "Eeheehee." Kinu squirms on the spot and blushes, little rosy patches fading into existence on her cheeks. "That was amazing, [kinu.Dad]! I didn't think you would be so great at odetama!" Wasn't it? These hands of yours have to fight monsters and get you out of all kinds of trouble, so it's only natural that they're great at doing what they do. See, she can discover that for herself... reaching out, you pinch your fox-daughter's cheeks lightly. They're so soft and squishy, and Kinu giggles and squeals when you tease her, her three silky tails wagging back and forth in a blur. Kiyoko just laughs behind a hand. "Oh my. If you get her worked up like this, dear, I'll have so much trouble settling her down to sleep tonight. |Sure, you're not the best at this, but you give it your all for the sake of your foxy family. Eyes trained on the thumb-length beanbags, you start tossing and catching them, perhaps moving a little more stiffly than what you'd have liked to. Kiyoko and Kinu keep time with their singing and clapping as you throw and catch, throw and catch; every time you have all five beanbags in hand, you loose them back upon the floorboards, and the game repeats itself at a faster pace. To your surprise, you last longer than you'd expected to. Maybe it's the joyous faces of your fox-wife and daughter staring intently at you, maybe it's their beautiful singing, maybe it's the fact that your body feels lighter than the poor, normally clumsy thing has any right to be. Whatever's the case, you really want to do right by Kinu, and put in every iota of furious concentration you have into this children's game, trying desperately not to fumble your movements. It's on the fifth or sixth iteration that you finally slip up and make a mistake — the beanbags are small, and you were pretty tired before heading to bed, and you really need to stop making excuses for yourself. Whatever the case, the next thing you know there's silk sliding off your fingers, and both your fox-wife and child are giggling and giving you affectionate pats. "There, there," Kiyoko says, running fingertips across your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]. "It's all right. You lasted longer than I did when I was a girl learning the game at my grandmother's knees." You chuckle and shake your head. Oh, that's a high bar to clear all right. "You really tried, [kinu.Dad]," Kinu adds. "I could see it." Oh, really? Kinu sticks out her tongue teasingly. "When you [kiyoko.numKits 4|have as many little siblings as I do|get a good eye for it], it's not that hard to tell. Figuring out when someone's not really trying isn't that hard, [kinu.Dad]" "It takes one to know one." Kiyoko chuckles and pats Kinu between the ears as your little three-tailed daughter pouts. "Jokes aside, that was entertaining. I haven't felt such genuine levity in a while now." "You should smile more, Mama," Kinu pipes up. "It'll be good for your beauty." "So young, and you're already learning how to flatter. Oh, what am I to do with you? ] "All right, then, young lady. Put back your toys, and you can have the rest of the day off outside. Your [pc.mf|father|mother] and I would love to have some time alone to ourselves.[kiyoko.numKits 4| Tell your siblings that we're occupied, and not to be disturbed unless it's an absolute emergency.]" For a split second, Kinu looks as mischievous and calculating as can be, but that expression's quickly hidden by one of quiet deference as Kinu picks up the beanbags in both hands and scoot off back indoors."

rows.original: It's not hard to see where Kinu is leading the both of you — back to the open hilltop where you met her earlier. You can't help but wonder what kind of game she has in mind; there doesn't seem to be anything nearby but the occasional bench and parasol off in the distance. Kiyoko brings up the rear, [kiyoko.pregStage 3|huffing a little as she waddles as fast as her feet will take her. If she weren't so adamant about going the distance herself, you might very well have offered to carry her.|managing to move elegantly even at this speed.] [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0 |"Smaller steps, Kinu!" Kiyoko calls out after the hyperactive ball of white fur that's your daughter. "We may be in more relaxed circumstances, but even so!" It's an open hilltop, though, and Kinu's making a good show of displaying her athleticism. Is it the time and place to be minding one's elegance? Your fox-wife taps her chin. "I'd be more lenient if she minded her manners more in her everyday life. As things stand, she's already acting far too freewheelingly for someone who'll have to take on important responsibilities later on in life. Let her get used to it, and it'll be an uphill task to change this attitude once it becomes ingrained into her personality." You understand. Still, it's kind of killing the mood... "Needs are as needs must, dear."|"Our daughter is certainly full of energy today, isn't she? Have you been giving her sweet things when I'm not looking, dear?" Well, denying it would be pointless. Yes, on occasion, and definitely in moderation. There is a line between spoiling Kinu and spoiling her rotten. "Hm." Why, is your daughter not usually energetic? "She's mature enough to know that there's a time and place for exuberance, and another for careful refinement. I'm actually quite proud of how she's learned to read situations and act accordingly. She'll need the skill, considering the responsibilities she'll be taking on later in life along with her station." ] You're about to ask more, but your attention's drawn to Kinu, who's come to a stop atop the very crest of the hill. Beaming brightly, your fox-daughter turns towards Kiyoko and you, stretching her arms wide to give the both of you a big hug about the legs — or at least, as much as her arms will allow. Ah. So this is the game that — Without warning, Kinu whistles, a short, sharp sound that rings out over the hilltop. Nothing happens for a couple of seconds, and then you see multiple sets of big, fluffy fox ears pop up from seemingly impossible places — under the benches, out of the ground, around the crest of the hill, out of little foxholes, and more. Where you thought you were alone, a small horde of Kinu's siblings have lain in wait, ready to pounce at the signal. "Kyaaaah!" That's all that Kiyoko manages to say, a most unladylike yelp as your kits swarm the both of you from all directions. Within seconds, you're smothered by a tide of squirming fluffiness, warm bodies piling up against your fox-wife and you until you're drowning in a sea of soft fur. Sure, while you know you've put quite a few kits inside of Kiyoko by now, it's nevertheless at least a little intimidating, if not sobering, when they're all gathered in one place. "[silly|Mofu mofu|So fluffy]!" Kinu squeals, nuzzling her face against your legs even as she retains her little death grip on you. "How do you like this surprise, [kinu.Dad], Mama? I took so long coordinating everyone in working together to set it up for you!" [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0|Kiyoko whimpers, sweat beading on her forehead as your fox-wife forces a weak smile. "I think my soul just tried to escape out of my mouth back there..." |Kiyoko wipes the sweat from her forehead and sighs, forcing a smile. "I can't say this is unpleasant, but at the same time I think my heart missed a beat there."] "Eehee. That's how you know you're still alive, Mama." "I feel like I should get angry at that, but I can't seem to find the heart for it. And what about you, dear?" You might have said something, but you're too busy being tickled and poked by the fluffy mass of ears and tails. Shit, each and every one of your kits is as soft and warm as their mother is... the sensation of comfortable joy is similar, but not exactly the same as the one Kiyoko manages to instil in you. It's enough to make you feel sleepy... "Okay, that's enough. I think [kinu.Dad] and Mama are kind of overwhelmed at this point..." A small chorus of disappointed voices rings out over the hilltop. "...But it felt really good while it lasted, right?" Yes. Yes, it did. Kinu's still hugging your feet and Kiyoko's to boot, and you reach down to pat her on the head. That sparks a similar demand from the nearest of your fox children, which you're obliged to fulfill, then another one, and another... Kiyoko's still breathing heavily, a little overwhelmed, but settling down fine enough. You didn't expect this from her, really. Doesn't she see the kits far more regularly than you do? You'd have imagined your positions here would be reversed. "Oh, I do, I do. But roll call is far more orderly than this. That, and it brings back other unsavoury memories. I'm fine, and I do appreciate this for what it is, so don't let me spoil your mood." Kinu snuggles in against the two of you one last time, apparently completely oblivious to the conversation taking place over her head. Her ears wiggle cutely again, and you can't help but pet them for the umpteenth time. "I love you, Mama." [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0 |Kiyoko deflates. "For all that you exasperate me sometimes, daughter, I do love you too." |Kiyoko gives your daughter a noogie on the forehead with her thumb. "I appreciate the sentiment, daughter, and return it just as keenly." ] Isn't that just adorable. All right, all right, that's enough for now; there is such a thing as too much of a good thing. Gently, you pry a wiggly Kinu off the two of you and set her down on the grass. You'd like to be alone with her mother for a little bit, get some private time with her. "Okay, [kinu.Dad]!" Be a good girl and take her siblings off to play, okay? With so many hands, you're sure she can find a good, fun game to keep everyone occupied. "Eehee. Okay, everyone! We've still got plenty of time in the day, so..." It's kind of awe-inspiring how your firstborn daughter simply sweeps through her siblings, the sea of warm, fluffy bodies parting to let her through as she storms to the fore and starts leading them away. By and large, the mass of warm, fluffy kits departs, leaving you and your fox-wife on the hill, thoroughly and utterly fluffified. Sheesh, and to think all that came out from between her legs. [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |Kiyoko rubs up against you and croons, trailing a finger about your shoulder. "Now, now. They may have come out of there, but I have proof right here that someone had to put so many lovely kits inside of me in the first place." |Kiyoko just purrs and cradles the huge swell of her fox-taut womb. "There's only going to be more of where that came from, you know... you're a wholehearted accomplice in this entire matter, I'll have you know." |Kiyoko sticks her tongue out at you. "I'll take that as a great compliment, then. You've been neglecting to praise me plenty of late." ] Well, she's right — you're not completely blameless. You'll call it a shared responsibility, and leave it at that. "Pervert." Guilty as charged.
rows.translation: 不难看出，小娟正在把你们俩引向哪里——那就是你们之前相遇的那片开阔的山顶。你不禁会想知道，她究竟在策划什么；附近似乎什么也没有，只有远处偶尔出现的长椅和遮阳伞。而清子则走在最后面。 [kiyoko.pregStage 3|她气喘吁吁地加快脚步匆匆前行。要是她不是那么坚持要自己走完这段路，你很可能就会主动提出背她吧。|即使以这样的速度移动，它依然能够保持优雅的动作。] [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0 |步子小一点，小娟！清子朝着那个活力四射、浑身覆盖着白色毛发的“小家伙”喊道——那其实就是你的女儿啊。虽然我们现在所处的环境可能更加宽松，但即便如此！ 不过，那是一片开阔的山顶，小娟正在尽情展示她的运动能力。在这种时候，还讲究什么优雅呢？ 你的狐狸妻子轻轻敲了敲自己的下巴。如果她在日常生活中能更加注意自己的言行举止，我会对她宽容一些。但目前来看，对于一个将来必须承担重要责任的人来说，她的行为已经太过随意了。让她慢慢习惯吧，因为一旦这种态度深入她的性格，想要改变它将会非常困难。 你明白的。不过，这样确实有点破坏气氛了…… 需求就是需求，亲爱的。|我们女儿今天确实精力充沛，不是吗？亲爱的，我不在的时候你是不是给她吃了些甜食？ 嗯，否认这一点是没有意义的。没错，偶尔这样做确实没问题，而且一定要适度。在“稍微宠溺小娟”和“把她宠坏”之间，是有一条界限的。 嗯。 怎么，你的女儿平时不都是充满活力的吗？ 她已经足够成熟，懂得什么时候该表现得热情洋溢，什么时候该谨慎而内敛。她能够根据不同场合选择恰当的行为方式，这一点让我感到非常自豪。考虑到她将来所要承担的责任以及她的社会地位，这种能力对她来说确实非常重要。 ] 你正想继续提问，但你的注意力被站在小山顶上的小娟吸引住了。你那聪明伶俐的狐狸女儿正欢快地笑着，转向清子和你，她张开双臂，试图给你们两个一个紧紧的拥抱——至少，是她的手臂能够达到的最大范围吧。 啊，原来这就是那个游戏…… 突然，小娟发出了一声短促而尖锐的口哨声，声音在山顶上回荡开来。几秒钟内什么动静都没有，然后你就会看到许多一对对大大的、毛茸茸的狐狸耳朵从一些看似不可能的地方冒出来——从长椅下面、从地面中、从山顶上、甚至从那些小狐狸洞里…… 就在你以为只有自己一个人的时候，其实有一小群小娟的兄弟姐妹一直在暗中等待，一旦接到信号，它们就会立刻扑上来。 哇啊！ 基约科只能发出这样一声叫声——这实在不符合一个淑女的身份。因为你的那些小家伙们从四面八方涌了过来，把你们俩都淹没在了一片柔软的毛丛之中。短短几秒钟内，温暖的身体堆满了你的狐狸妻子和你自己，你们简直被这柔软的毛皮淹没了。虽然你知道现在已经有不少小家伙钻进了基约科的身体里，但当它们全部聚集在了一起时，还是让人感到有些害怕，甚至会让人反思一些事情。 “[silly|软软的|真是太柔软了……]!”小娟发出吱吱的叫声，把脸贴在你的腿上，同时仍然紧紧地抓着你不放。你觉得这个惊喜怎么样？ [kinu.Dad]妈妈，我花了好长时间来协调大家，让大家齐心协力为您准备这一切呢！ [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0|清子发出呜咽声，额头上冒出了汗珠，而你的狐狸妻子却强挤出一丝虚弱的笑容。我觉得我的灵魂刚才差点从我的嘴里逃出来…… |清子擦了擦额头上的汗水，叹了口气，强挤出一个笑容。我不能说这种感觉不好，但同时我也觉得自己的心跳在那一瞬间加快了。] 嘻嘻，妈妈，这就是证明你还活着的证据啊。 我觉得我应该为此生气，但却实在提不起那份劲来。你呢，亲爱的？ 你或许想说些什么，但你的注意力完全被那些柔软的耳朵和尾巴吸引住了，根本无暇他顾。天啊，你身上的每一处都被这些柔软的东西轻轻触碰着，那种感觉既舒适又愉悦……不过，这种感觉与清子带给你的那种愉悦感还是有点不同的。不过，这种感觉确实足以让你感到昏昏欲睡…… 好了，够了。我觉得 [kinu.Dad] 这个时候，妈妈和我都有点不知所措了…… 山顶上传来了几声失望的呼喊声。 ……不过在那些时刻里，那种感觉确实很棒，对吧？ 是的，确实如此。小娟还在抱着你的足部，清子也是，于是你低头轻拍她的头。这一举动引发了你身边那些狐狸幼崽的类似请求，你不得不一一满足它们，然后又有一只幼崽提出了要求，接着又是一只…………清子的呼吸依然很急促，看起来有些不知所措，但总体来说已经慢慢恢复了平静。 你真的没料到她会做出这种事来。她不是比你更经常接触那些装备吗？你本来以为你们的处境应该是相反的才对。 哦，是的，确实如此。但是点名仪式可比现在这个有序多了。而且，它还会让我想起一些不太愉快的回忆。不过我没事的，我也确实理解你的做法，所以别因为我的话破坏你的心情哦。 小娟最后一次依偎在你们两个人身边，显然完全没有注意到他们正在进行的谈话。它的耳朵又可爱地动了起来，你忍不住又第二次抚摸它们。 我爱你，妈妈。 [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0 |清子泄了气。尽管你有时会让我感到恼火，女儿，但我还是爱你的。 |清子用拇指轻轻敲了敲你女儿的额头。女儿，我非常理解你的这份心意，我也同样怀着同样的热情来回应你。 ] 真是太可爱了啊。好吧，好了，暂时就说到这里吧。是好事过头反而会适得其反。你轻轻地将那只扭动着的小娟从你们两人中间分开，然后把她放在草地上。你想要和她的母亲单独待一会儿，享受一些属于你们的私人时光。 好的， [kinu.Dad]!" 好姑娘，带她的兄弟姐妹们去玩吧，好吗？有那么多人一起，她肯定能找到一些有趣的游戏，让大家都玩得开心。 嘿嘿，好了，大家！今天我们还有很多时间呢，所以…… 你的长女竟然能够如此轻松地穿过她那些兄弟姐妹们——那一片温暖、柔软的绒毛海洋自动为她让开道路，让她迅速走到最前面，开始带领其他小家伙们离开。总体来说，那些温暖、柔软的小家伙们全都离开了，只留下你和你的狐狸妻子站在小山上，浑身都被那些绒毛覆盖得软软的、暖暖的。 哎呀，想想看那个从她的双腿之间钻了出来。 [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |清子轻轻依偎在你身边，轻声呢喃着，同时用手指轻轻滑过你的肩膀。现在，现在。他们可能已经从那里出来了，但我有证据证明，最初肯定有人把这么多精美的装备放进了我的体内。 |清子只是轻轻发出呜咽声，双手轻轻抚摸着自己那因怀孕而隆起的腹部。这种情况只会越来越严重。那个你其实也是这件事的积极参与者，我必须让你知道这一点。 |清子朝你吐了吐舌头。那我就把这当作一份很高的赞美吧。最近你确实很少夸奖我呢。 ] 嗯，她说得对——你也不能完全推卸责任。你就把这件事定义为一种共同的责任吧，就这样吧。 变态。 确实如指控的那样有罪。

That's all that Kiyoko manages to say, a most unladylike yelp as your kits swarm the both of you from all directions. Within seconds, you're smothered by a tide of squirming fluffiness, warm bodies piling up against your fox-wife and you until you're drowning in a sea of soft fur. Sure, while you know you've put quite a few kits inside of Kiyoko by now, it's nevertheless at least a little intimidating, if not sobering, when they're all gathered in one place. "[silly|Mofu mofu|So fluffy]!" Kinu squeals, nuzzling her face against your legs even as she retains her little death grip on you. "How do you like this surprise, [kinu.Dad], Mama? I took so long coordinating everyone in working together to set it up for you!" [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0|Kiyoko whimpers, sweat beading on her forehead as your fox-wife forces a weak smile. "I think my soul just tried to escape out of my mouth back there..." |Kiyoko wipes the sweat from her forehead and sighs, forcing a smile. "I can't say this is unpleasant, but at the same time I think my heart missed a beat there."] "Eehee. That's how you know you're still alive, Mama." "I feel like I should get angry at that, but I can't seem to find the heart for it. And what about you, dear?" You might have said something, but you're too busy being tickled and poked by the fluffy mass of ears and tails. Shit, each and every one of your kits is as soft and warm as their mother is... the sensation of comfortable joy is similar, but not exactly the same as the one Kiyoko manages to instil in you. It's enough to make you feel sleepy... "Okay, that's enough. I think [kinu.Dad] and Mama are kind of overwhelmed at this point..." A small chorus of disappointed voices rings out over the hilltop. "...But it felt really good while it lasted, right?" Yes. Yes, it did. Kinu's still hugging your feet and Kiyoko's to boot, and you reach down to pat her on the head. That sparks a similar demand from the nearest of your fox children, which you're obliged to fulfill, then another one, and another... Kiyoko's still breathing heavily, a little overwhelmed, but settling down fine enough. You didn't expect this from her, really. Doesn't she see the kits far more regularly than you do? You'd have imagined your positions here would be reversed. "Oh, I do, I do. But roll call is far more orderly than this. That, and it brings back other unsavoury memories. I'm fine, and I do appreciate this for what it is, so don't let me spoil your mood." Kinu snuggles in against the two of you one last time, apparently completely oblivious to the conversation taking place over her head. Her ears wiggle cutely again, and you can't help but pet them for the umpteenth time. "I love you, Mama." [kinu.kinuChildPersonality 0 |Kiyoko deflates. "For all that you exasperate me sometimes, daughter, I do love you too." |Kiyoko gives your daughter a noogie on the forehead with her thumb. "I appreciate the sentiment, daughter, and return it just as keenly." ] Isn't that just adorable. All right, all right, that's enough for now; there is such a thing as too much of a good thing. Gently, you pry a wiggly Kinu off the two of you and set her down on the grass. You'd like to be alone with her mother for a little bit, get some private time with her. "Okay, [kinu.Dad]!" Be a good girl and take her siblings off to play, okay? With so many hands, you're sure she can find a good, fun game to keep everyone occupied. "Eehee. Okay, everyone! We've still got plenty of time in the day, so..." It's kind of awe-inspiring how your firstborn daughter simply sweeps through her siblings, the sea of warm, fluffy bodies parting to let her through as she storms to the fore and starts leading them away. By and large, the mass of warm, fluffy kits departs, leaving you and your fox-wife on the hill, thoroughly and utterly fluffified. Sheesh, and to think all that came out from between her legs. [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3 |Kiyoko rubs up against you and croons, trailing a finger about your shoulder. "Now, now. They may have come out of there, but I have proof right here that someone had to put so many lovely kits inside of me in the first place." |Kiyoko just purrs and cradles the huge swell of her fox-taut womb. "There's only going to be more of where that came from, you know... you're a wholehearted accomplice in this entire matter, I'll have you know." |Kiyoko sticks her tongue out at you. "I'll take that as a great compliment, then. You've been neglecting to praise me plenty of late." ] Well, she's right — you're not completely blameless. You'll call it a shared responsibility, and leave it at that. "Pervert." Guilty as charged."

rows.original: You pull out a handful of wild berries from your possessions, and your eyes widen as you realize they're nothing like the berries you remember acquiring in the waking world. Here in the Astral Plane, the clump of simple, sweet berries has turned into a bountiful mound of fruit still wet with morning dew, an abundance of rich reds, deep purples and every other color in between. Heaped high in your hand, the berries threaten to roll off and fall to the ground at any moment, and it's with this in mind that you quickly pass the lot to Kinu, who receives them with girlish, mischievous glee. She gives them a small sniff, then her already wide smile grows downright greedy. "These smell safe enough to eat. Uguu... and they have a lovely scent, [kinu.Dad]." [pc.ra lupine|Indeed. They smell just as great to you — a wonderful medley of flavorful skins and sweet insides.|You don't have as sharp a sense of smell as Kinu does, but the joy written all over her face is good enough.] Watching Kinu eat when she's not restraining herself is a sight to behold. Not even bothering to pick the berries off the bunch, your daughter crams as much ripe fruit as she can into her mouth, pulling away and leaving but bare stems behind. Purple-red juice erupts from the corners of her mouth as she chews, trickling down her chin and running down to stain the front of her yukata; Kinu closes her eyes in giddy glee as she crushes every last drop of juice out of the berries, swallows, then opens her mouth as wide as it'll stretch to stuff another load of wild berries right in... ...Goodness, where are her manners? Another bite, and another, and then all the berries are gone. Only Kinu remains, still giddy with excitement and sticky from the slowly drying sweet juices all over her hands, mouth and clothes. "Ehehe." Her soft, white-furred ears fold forward a little. "Sorry I went a little overboard there, [kinu.Dad]. This is going to stain my clothes and fur really bad, isn't it?" Red and purple against white — oh yes, it's going to stain pretty bad, and her mother is going to make her clean it all out by herself. Kinu just grins as she squats down and wipes her sticky hands on the grass. "Ehe, it was totally worth it. Thank you for the gift, [kinu.Dad]! Do you wanna play now?"
rows.translation: 你从自己的物品中掏出一把野莓，当发现这些莓果与你在清醒世界中记忆中的那些完全不同时，你的眼睛顿时瞪大了。在星界这个地方，那些原本简单、甜美的野莓已经变成了一堆丰硕的果实，上面还挂着清晨的露水，呈现出丰富的红色、深紫色以及介于两者之间的各种色彩。那些堆在你手中的浆果随时都有可能掉下来，因此你赶紧把它们递给了小娟。她接过来时，脸上带着少女般顽皮而愉悦的表情。她轻轻闻了闻那些浆果，然后她原本就宽大的笑容变得更加灿烂了，仿佛已经对它们垂涎欲滴。 这些闻起来完全像是可以食用的东西。呜呜……而且它们还散发着迷人的香气。 [kinu.Dad]." [pc.ra lupine|确实如此。对你来说，它们的味道也同样诱人——那是一种由美味的外皮与香甜的内馅共同构成的美妙组合。|你的嗅觉虽然没有小娟那么敏锐，但她脸上洋溢着的喜悦已经足够让人满足了。] 看着小娟在毫无节制地进食，真是让人忍俊不禁。她甚至都不费心去摘下那些浆果，只是把所有成熟的果实都塞进嘴里，然后走开，只留下光秃秃的果梗。当她咀嚼时，紫红色的果汁从她的嘴角溢出，顺着下巴流下来，弄脏了她和服的前面；小娟开心地闭上眼睛，把每一滴果汁都从这些浆果中榨出来，然后吞下去，接着又张大嘴巴，把更多的野生浆果塞了进去。……天哪，她这礼貌都去哪儿了？又吃了一口，再吃一口，转眼间所有的浆果都被吃光了。只剩下小娟，她仍然兴奋得有些发晕，双手、嘴巴和衣服上都粘满了逐渐变干的甜汁。 嘿嘿。她那柔软的、覆盖着白色毛发的耳朵会微微向前折叠。抱歉，我刚才有点做得过分了。 [kinu.Dad]这肯定会把我的衣服和毛发弄得很难看，对吧？ 红色和紫色搭配白色——哦，肯定会把衣服弄得很难洗，她的妈妈肯定会让她自己把所有东西都洗干净。小娟只是笑了笑，然后蹲下来，用草擦了擦自己粘糊糊的手。呵呵，真的非常值得。谢谢你送的礼物。 [kinu.Dad]现在想玩吗？

rows.original: As you pull out the melon and present it to Kinu, you can't help but notice that it appears bigger and riper than it is in the waking world. Wild melons usually aren't that much to look at — most wild fruits aren't when compared to their domesticated counterparts — but the melon in your hands is heavy and dense, hints of gold and yellow amidst the green outer rind, far more ripe than it has any reason to be. Is this melon supposed to represent something, and if so, what? Your thoughts are cut short by Kinu hopping on the spot, arms outstretched as she tries to take hold of the melon in both hands. "Woooow, look at how big it is! It's huge! Enormous! Humongous! This has to be the bestest most greatest present in the whole world, peaches aside! Which do you think is bigger, [kinu.Dad], the melon or me?" Oh, come on. You're already going to give it to her, she doesn't have to lay it on that thickly. Besides, there's probably a reason why this melon is so huge; can she guess why? "Um..." Kinu wiggles on the spot and pretends to look thoughtful. "So that it'll last me for more than a day? That way I learn to carefully ration out my treats instead of eating them all at one go. It's a very important lesson for a child to learn, yes." No, it's because she'll learn to share with [kiyoko.numKits 4|her siblings and ] her mother. That's the lesson you wanted to impart — good effort trying to rationalise away keeping the entire melon for herself, though. "Ehe... do you have the power to read minds, [kinu.Dad]? Is that your special power?" If only. You just know her well enough to be able to guess at what she's thinking. Now then, what does she say when receiving a gift? "Thank you." There's a good girl. You hand the melon over to Kinu, who makes a show of struggling with it before setting it down on the grassy ground. The little kitsune concentrates for a moment, then with a wiggle of her three tails, the melon rises ever so slightly off the ground and begins to wobble back in the direction of the cabin. Does she promise to share it? She ought to know you'll check in with her mother about that. "Yes, [kinu.Dad]..." You reach down and give Kinu a pat between the ears. Very good. "So... do you want to play now?"
rows.translation: 当你取出那个甜瓜递给小娟时，你不禁会发现，它看起来比在现实世界中要大得多，也成熟得更多。野生的甜瓜通常并没有那么好看——相比那些经过人工培育的果实，大多数野生水果都显得不够美观——但你手中的这个甜瓜却显得格外重型，果肉紧密。它的绿色外皮中透出金黄色，成熟程度显然远超正常情况。 是的这个这个西瓜究竟代表着什么意义呢？ 就在你还在思考的时候，小娟突然跳了起来，双臂伸开，试图用双手抓住那个西瓜。哇哦，看看它有多大！真的非常大！巨大无比！这绝对是全世界最棒、最了不起的礼物了，就连桃子也比不上！你觉得哪个更大呢 [kinu.Dad]这个瓜，还是我呢？ 哦，别这样。你本来就要把它给她了，她也没必要非得讨要才行。那个厚厚的。而且，这种瓜能长得这么大，肯定有原因吧；她能猜到原因吗？ 嗯……小娟在原地扭来扭去，装作在认真思考的样子。这样就能让我吃上一整天了吧？这样我就能学会有节制地享用这些零食，而不会一次性把它们都吃光。对一个孩子来说，这确实是一堂非常重要的课。 不，是因为她会学会与他人分享。 [kiyoko.numKits 4|她的兄弟姐妹们 ] 她的母亲。那就是。你想要传达的这个道理——不过，她试图通过理性分析来为自己保留整个“瓜”的行为，确实也体现了她所付出的努力。 呵呵……你有没有读心术的能力呢？ [kinu.Dad]那是你的特殊能力吗？ 要是那样该多好。你对她太了解了，完全能够猜出她在想什么。那么，当她收到礼物时，会说什么呢？ 谢谢。 有个好姑娘。你把那个甜瓜交给小娟，她装作费了很大劲才把它拿到草地上。那只小狐妖集中精神了一会儿，然后轻轻摆动着她那三条尾巴，甜瓜就微微离地，开始朝小屋的方向摇晃着移动。 她会答应和你分享吗？她应该知道你会去问她妈妈的。 是的， [kinu.Dad]..." 你伸手轻轻拍了拍小娟的耳朵，说道：“做得很好。 那么……现在想开始玩吗？

rows.original: The moment you take the peach out of your possessions, Kinu freezes, your daughter's ice-blue eyes widening, her expression frozen in a stupid half-smile. Swollen till bursting with rich juice, the sweet, ripe peach looks far more delicious than anything to come out of the hilltop grove. Her ice-blue eyes as big as saucers, Kinu's gaze follows the peach unfailingly as you present it to her, completely transfixed by the treat. "Uwaaa..." Her knees are shaking and staring to go weak even as a thin thread of drool extends from her little pink tongue towards the ground. Gods, she really takes after her mother when it comes to her favorite food. She wants this, doesn't she? What does she say first? "Please?" No, in more words. "Please, may — may, um, may I have the peach?" There, there. Now she can have it. You tip the luscious, almost overripe peach into Kinu's hands, and the little kitsune lets out an overjoyed squeal of delight, ears perking up and reaching for the sky. "Oh, sweet, sweet fruit, what are you doing outside of my tummy? Let's fix that!" Hmm, you could swear you've heard that particular line before, only out of her mother's mouth... that thought is cut short, though, as Kinu wipes down the peach with the sleeves of her yukata and takes a greedy bite out of the peach, propriety all but forgotten as sweet-smelling juice erupts from the fruit and sprays into her face. Kinu giggles, practically delirious with happiness, then takes another bite, juices running all over her little face, dripping down her chin, getting into her clothes. Another bite, and another, and then she's devoured the entire thing save for the pit, which she tucks away into her clothes. "I'mf goin' to try grofwing this. Theynf whenf I'mf older, I'll be ayblef to get such yummy fruit allf day..." Well, that's one way to encourage planning ahead in a child like her. More importantly, though — what does she say after receiving a gift? "Frank oo." No, once more, this time with proper enunciation and without food in her mouth. "Thank you." For a moment, Kinu looks a little bashful, then perks up. "I promise to be good while you're away, so you can give me that as a present again someday, okay?" Now, she should know better than to beg to be bribed with food. One should exhibit good behavior not because one hopes to be rewarded, but out of one's desire for virtue. "Ehe... okay, okay, I get the idea, [kinu.Dad]. Can we go play now? I feel like I've got so much energy."
rows.translation: 当你把那个桃子从手中拿出来的那一刻，小娟愣住了，你女儿那冰蓝色的眼睛瞪得大大的，脸上的表情凝固成一种呆滞的微笑。那个熟透了的桃子胀得快要裂开，果汁丰富甘甜，看起来比从山顶果园里摘来的任何水果都要美味得多。小娟的眼睛大得像碟子一样，当你把桃子递给她时，她的目光始终紧紧地盯着那个桃子，完全被这个美味的东西吸引住了。 呜哇……她的膝盖在颤抖，整个人似乎都快要支撑不住了，而那条细小的口水从她粉红色的小舌头上滴落到地上。 天啊，她在最喜欢的食物这方面，真的和她妈妈一模一样。她肯定是想要这个的，对吧？那她首先会说什么呢？ 请？ 不，换句话说。 请问，可以……可以让我来拿那个桃子吗？ 好了，好了。现在她可以拿走它。你将那个甜美得几乎有些过熟的桃子递到小娟的手中，这只小狐妖高兴地尖叫起来，耳朵竖得高高的，双手伸向天空。 哦，甜美的水果啊，你们为什么不在我的肚子里呢？让我们把你们重新放回去吧！ 嗯，你简直会以为自己之前听过这句话，只不过是出自她母亲之口……不过，这个念头很快就被打断了，因为小娟用和服的袖子擦了擦桃子，然后迫不及待地咬了一口。甜美的果汁从桃子中迸发出来，溅到了她的脸上，让她完全忘记了礼仪的存在。小娟咯咯地笑着，开心得几乎发狂，然后又咬了一口，果汁溅满了她的小脸，顺着下巴流下来，还浸湿了她的衣服。她又咬了一口，再咬一口，最终把整个东西都吃光了，只有果核被她收进了衣服里。 我打算试着种这种水果。等我长大了，就能整天吃到这么美味的水果了…… 嗯，这对鼓励像她这样的孩子提前做好计划确实是个不错的方法。不过更重要的是——收到礼物后，她会说些什么呢？ 弗兰克哦。 不，再试一次，这次要发音准确，而且嘴里不能含任何食物。 谢谢。有那么一瞬间，小娟显得有些害羞，但很快又恢复了活力。我保证在你不在的时候会表现得好好的，这样以后你就可以再送我这个礼物了，好吗？ 现在，她应该明白，不应该再乞求用食物来贿赂自己了。一个人应该表现出良好的行为，不是因为期望得到奖励，而是因为自己内心对美德的热爱。 呃……好吧，好吧，我明白你的意思了。 [kinu.Dad]我们现在能去玩吗？我感觉自己充满了能量。

For a moment, Kinu looks a little bashful, then perks up. "I promise to be good while you're away, so you can give me that as a present again someday, okay?" Now, she should know better than to beg to be bribed with food. One should exhibit good behavior not because one hopes to be rewarded, but out of one's desire for virtue. "Ehe... okay, okay, I get the idea, [kinu.Dad]. Can we go play now? I feel like I've got so much energy."'

rows.original: As you crest the hilltop, Kinu comes jogging up to greet you, arms hidden behind her back. From the way her three tails are swishing all over the place, your daughter's up to something — good or bad, that remains to be seen. "[kinu.Dad]! You're here! I did a divination and you showed up just like it said you would, so I went ahead and made preparations!" Ooh, preparations — that sounds ominous enough, all right. Now, what was she preparing for, and what does she have hidden behind her back? "It's — it's a present! For you! Because you've been giving me things... and Mama says that it's very important to Keros that we kitsune repay good deeds done for us out of the kindness of one's heart. I know you can't really take things out of this place with you when you leave, so I tried to think up a present that you can enjoy here!" Ah, so it's a religious duty to pay back this karma thing which Kiyoko sometimes talks about. Kinu makes a pouty face at that. "But it's more than that, [kinu.Dad]. I always feel really happy when you get me sweet fruit as presents. Now I want to make you feel happy too, so, um, here's the present. Ta-daaaah!" With that, Kinu brings out her hands from behind her back, letting you take in the surprise she's planned for you. [rand|There's... nothing? Half-suspecting a mischievous trick or some sort, you eye your little kitsune daughter, who simply beams at you and pounces forward to grab your legs in a wide-armed hug. "Not nothing, silly! As repayment for all the things you've given me, you get one fluffy kitsune kit!" Kinu makes a happy little noise in the back of her throat and begins rubbing the side of her head against you, white-furred foxy ears brushing up against your [pc.skinFurScales]. "I'm so amazing, I make a great gift for anyone who wants to be healed with fluffiness!" Healed with fluffiness, eh? It's hard to argue with that, especially when Kinu's three tails have come around to her front and have started massaging away at your ankles. Sheesh... do kitsune know how to do this by instinct, or has her mother taught her a few things? Either way, while Kinu is less fluffy than her mother is, her fur has a flowing texture to it that reminds you of a warm breeze's caress. "Ehe... am I doing it right, [kinu.Dad]? Can you feel my happiness passing on to you?" Well, even if she weren't, there's enough happiness being generated here that you can't tell the difference. "Eeheehee!" Kinu rubs herself against you a few more times for good measure, then pulls away with a sigh, her three tails swishing so quickly you're amazed they're not bumping into each other. |Held in her hands is a little black bowl, complete with lid — the kind that Kiyoko serves soup in. Proudly, your kitsune daughter presents it to you in both hands, and you receive the gift with all due grace, careful not to spill any. It's warm but not hot, and as Kinu withdraws her hands brush against yours — my, they're just as toasty as the soup bowl itself. Just how long has she been keeping it warm for you? Kinu giggles. "That doesn't matter, [kinu.Dad]. I could have held it all day and not gotten tired. Have some, okay?" Hm, that's a very savoury smell coming from within. It's kind of foreign, and yet familiar at the same time — earthy, inasmuch as mushrooms are. You give it another sniff, more exacting this time, and [pc.ra lupine|a heartwarming scent of at least several different types of root vegetables rises from the lid to greet you. It's not as fine or distinct as a soup made with meat stock would be, but it's about as good as a wholly vegetable soup could ever get.|the fine, warm scent of a medley of vegetables rises from the lid to greet you.] No time like the present, then. Indeed, when you uncover the lid, a warm, clear broth with several kinds of root vegetables you recognize — and more that you don't — greets you while Kinu hops around and helpfully offers you a spoon. "It's kenchin soup, [kinu.Dad]! One of the bestest things to eat after sweet fruit! It always makes me feel happy inside whenever I have some, so this is a great way to repay some of the happiness you always give me!" Sheesh. With her so enthusiastic and bubbly about it, there's no need to push the stuff on you. As Kinu stares expectantly, you take the spoon and have an experimental sip. The flavor's definitely not something you'd usually find in the Frost Marches, rich and hearty, yet without the characteristic heaviness that accompanies similar meat-based soups. The first sip is followed by another, and another, until even the root veggies are gone. "Well, was it good, [kinu.Dad]? Was it?" You finished it all, didn't you? "Yeah, but you might have done so to be polite... don't want to be rude, but I want to be sure." All right, all right. Some of the foreign veggies were definitely an acquired taste, but the rest was pretty good. It wasn't bad, just something that your palate isn't used to. Kinu gives you a weak smile and twiddles her thumbs. "Right, so it wasn't anything I could really control..." If anything, it's an impetus for her to start exploring things on her own rather than just learning what's already been covered. Sooner or later, she'll have learnt all there is to be reasonably taught on a subject, and then the world itself will have to be her teacher. |"I'm going to sing for you, [kinu.Dad]!" Sing, huh? That's a pretty neat gift. "Yep! I'm going to sing, and share my happiness that way!" Without further ado, Kinu takes a deep breath, and bursts into song, a wordless, melancholic melody. Hey, your daughter's got a pretty good voice. It'll probably change once she's no longer a child and it's not exactly the same flute-like tone as her mother's, but it's high-pitched and sweet, not too different from when she gets really excited. [pc.bg minstrel|She's not half-bad, actually. There're some parts where she goes off-key — whether it be from excitement, nervousness or otherwise — but your daughter can generally keep a tune together. Maybe you could teach her a thing or two when she's older, or when you have the time.|You don't know enough about music to be able to provide any meaningful criticism, but in your layman's opinion it's really, really soothing.] The singing doesn't last very long — perhaps a handful of minutes — but Kinu looks absolutely intense by the end of it all, every single muscle in her little body unwinding as she finishes the last verse and looks up to you for approval. Has her mother been teaching her much in the way of vocal control? "Ehe. A bit? Well, Mama hasn't much time to teach me much in the way of music outside of the koto. I think she much prefers poetry as an art form." Ah. Well, either way, you have to thank her for the music. That was quite lovely — if she'd meant to share her happiness with you, then it worked. |Cradled in your daughter's cupped hands is an orange-brown fruit about the size of a large apple. Smiling from ear to ear, Kinu stands on tiptoe and presents it to you in the most reverent fashion a hyperactive eight year-old kitsune can. "It's a persimmon! For you!" A persimmon, eh? The fruit feels firm and crisp under your fingers, the skin smooth and without blemish. There's a certain something or the other to it that you can't quite place, though... "I spent so long picking one out for you, [kinu.Dad]! It's got just the right size, shape, color and smell! It's a pretty great persimmon, and I always get the warm fuzzies when I eat one like this, so you will too!" Honestly speaking, it's not as if you could tell, what with not having that much experience with persimmons of this sort, but there's no reason to let Kinu know that. You thank your daughter, give her a pat on the head, and study the fruit once more. "I washed it just before I came out to greet you, so it's clean! You can eat it just as it is!" Well, no reason to put it off any longer, then. It might have been better had this been sliced, but whole is just fine; there's a certain tartness to the peel as you bite into it, but it's otherwise very sweet. Kinu watches with rapt attention as you devour the persimmon, peel and all — with her intense gaze on you like this, you would've eaten the whole thing even if you'd hated it... "It's good, isn't it?" Oh, it's good. But the reason you're happy isn't because the persimmon was good, it's because it came from her. Your daughter just squeals and claps her hands to her cheeks, her big, fluffy ears twitching all over the place as a light blush creeps into her cheeks. Gods, Kiyoko really taught her well when it comes to laying on the flattery. "Really?" Yep! The blush deepens. "Ehehe. You really know how to lay on the flattery, [kinu.Dad]." It takes one to know one. Still, that was a great persimmon she had there. |There's... nothing? You peer into Kinu's cupped hands, which are perfectly and utterly empty save for a couple of calluses and healed-over scratches, no doubt from playing in the forest. "Oh, it's there, [kinu.Dad]. You just have to look closer. Like, really close." Oh? Deciding to play along, you stoop down and eye Kinu's cupped hands up close. Nope, still nothing... "Just a bit closer, [kinu.Dad]..." Like this? "Ah-ha! Now you're completely defenseless and vulnerable! Mwah!" Standing on tiptoe, your little kitsune daughter inches her head up to plant a kiss on your cheek, then quickly hops back, looking a little bashful. Ah, so that was her gift. "Eehee!" Gods, who's supposed to be receiving the gift here, you or her? She's at least twice as excited about this as you are. ] "See? See? It was a great gift, wasn't it? Even if you can't take anything material with you when you leave, you can still bring the memories along! And that's great! Mama always says it's not so much the exact nature of the gift, but the thought and effort that goes into it, but I personally suspect that she just says that so she can be cheap when giving gifts." Hah... now she's just making you want to get your daughter out of here all the faster so you can actually receive more kinds of gifts from her. Kinu preens a little at the praise. "I wouldn't mind! So, now that you're here and I've given you your gift, can we play now before you go in and see Mama? Pleasepleaseplease?"
rows.translation: 当你爬上山顶时，小娟慢跑着过来迎接你，双手背在身后。从她那三条尾巴乱晃的样子来看，你的女儿肯定在搞什么名堂——是好是坏，那就有待观看了。 "[kinu.Dad]你来了！我之前做了占卜，结果果然如占卜所言，你会出现，所以我就提前做好了准备！ 哦，准备工作啊——这听起来确实挺不祥的，好吧。那么，她到底在准备什么？又隐藏了什么不可告人的把戏呢？ 这是——这是一份礼物！是给你的！因为你一直都在给我送东西……妈妈说，对凯罗斯来说，我们作为狐妖，一定要回报那些出于善意为我们所做的一切。我知道你离开的时候不可能把这些东西带走，所以我就想了一份你在这里就可以享受的礼物！ 啊，所以偿还这种“因果报应”之类的东西，似乎是一种宗教义务吧？清子有时候也会提到这个。 听到这里，小娟露出了不高兴的表情。但不仅如此， [kinu.Dad]每当你送我甜美的水果作为礼物时，我总是感到非常开心。现在我也想让你开心起来，所以，嗯，这就是我的礼物。瞧——送给你啦！ 说着，小娟将双手从背后抽了出来，让你看到了她为你们准备的这个惊喜。 [rand|什么都没有？你半信半疑地怀疑这可能是个恶作剧，于是看向你那可爱的小狐女儿，只见她开心地朝你跑过来，张开双臂紧紧抱住了你的腿。 可不是什么小礼物，傻瓜！作为对你为我做过的所有事情的回报，你将得到一只毛茸茸的狐妖小精灵！小娟在喉咙深处发出愉悦的声音，然后开始用头蹭你，她那白色毛茸茸的狐狸耳朵轻轻触碰到你的身体。 [pc.skinFurScales]. 我太棒了，对于那些希望拥有柔软触感、获得治愈的人来说，我简直是完美的礼物！ 被柔软的毛茸茸触感治愈了，嗯？这一点确实很难反驳，尤其是当小娟的三条尾巴围到她身前，开始轻轻按摩你的脚踝时。天啊……难道狐妖天生就会这样，还是她的母亲教了她这些技巧？不管怎样，虽然小娟的毛没有她母亲那么浓密，但她的毛发质地柔软顺滑，让人感受到如同温暖微风轻拂般的舒适感。 呃……我这样做对吗？ [kinu.Dad]你能感受到我的快乐正在传递给你吗？ 嗯，即使她不是这样，这里产生的快乐也已经足够多，以至于你根本无法分辨其中的差别了。 嘻嘻嘻！小娟又蹭了你几次，以确保效果，然后叹了口气拉开距离，她的三条尾巴摆动得如此之快，让你惊讶于它们竟然没有互相碰撞。 |她手中捧着一个小小的黑色碗，还配有盖子——就是那种千代子用来盛汤的碗。你的狐女儿骄傲地用双手将这个碗递给你，你也优雅地接过了这份礼物，小心翼翼地防止汤洒出来。汤的温度适中，不冷也不热。当小娟收回双手时，她的手触到了你的手——天啊，她的手和那个汤碗一样温暖。她究竟为你们保温了这么久呢？ 小娟咯咯地笑了起来。那没关系， [kinu.Dad]我可以一整天都这样坚持下去，而不会感到疲倦。来，吃点吧，好吗？ 嗯，从里面传出来的这种气味真是非常诱人。它有点陌生，却又让人感到熟悉——那种属于大自然的气息，毕竟蘑菇本来就属于大自然的一部分。你再闻一次，这次更加仔细地闻 [pc.ra lupine|从锅盖中散发出来的，是一种由多种根茎类蔬菜混合而成的、令人感到温暖的气息。这种味道虽然没有用肉汤熬制的汤那么浓郁、那么层次分明，但就已经算是纯蔬菜汤所能达到的最佳境界了。|从锅盖中散发出来的那种浓郁而温暖的蔬菜混合香气，会迎面扑来，让你立刻感受到它的存在。] 现在正是最好的时机。的确，当你揭开盖子时，一股温暖清亮的汤汁便会迎面扑来——其中含有几种你熟悉的根茎类蔬菜，也有一些你并不认识的材料。而小娟则会在一旁蹦来跳去，热心地递给你一把勺子。 这是肯钦汤。 [kinu.Dad]在吃了甜水果之后，这绝对是最好的食物之一！每当我吃到它的时候，总会让我感到内心充满快乐，所以，这真的是一种回报你一直带给我的快乐的绝佳方式啊！ 哎呀，她这么热情洋溢地推荐，实在没必要再强迫你尝试了。在小娟充满期待的目光注视下，你拿起了勺子，试着尝了一口。这种味道绝对不是你在霜冻之地能尝到的——浓郁醇厚，却又没有那种类似肉汤才会有的油腻感。第一口尝下去后，你又接连喝了几口，直到那些根茎类蔬菜也被吃光了。 嗯，觉得怎么样？好玩吗？ [kinu.Dad]是吗？ 你把所有事情都完成了，对吧？ 是啊，但你这么做可能只是出于礼貌……我并不是想冒犯你，只是想确认一下而已。 好吧，好吧。有些外国蔬菜确实需要一段时间来适应，但其他的还是相当不错的。并不是说全部都不行糟糕只是某些你们的味觉还不习惯的东西罢了。 小娟露出一个淡淡的微笑，开始玩弄着自己的拇指。没错，这件事其实并不是我能够控制的…… 如果说这有什么作用的话，那就是促使她开始自主探索事物，而不仅仅局限于学习那些已经被讲授过的内容。迟早，她会学到关于某个主题所有可以被合理教授的知识，而到了那时，整个世界本身才会成为她的老师。 |我要为你歌唱， [kinu.Dad]!" 唱歌，哈？这真是份相当不错的礼物。 没错！我要唱歌，通过这种方式来分享我的快乐！ 毫不迟疑，小娟深吸一口气，开始唱起歌来——那是一段无词而充满忧郁旋律的歌声。嘿，你女儿的歌声还挺不错的。等她长大后，她的嗓音可能会发生变化，也不会再像她母亲那样拥有那种类似长笛的音色，但她的音调依然高亢而甜美，尤其是在她感到非常兴奋的时候，这种音色几乎不会有什么变化。 [pc.bg minstrel|其实，她唱得还不错。虽然有时候会跑调——不管是因为太兴奋、太紧张，还是其他原因——但总体来说，你女儿的唱功还是不错的。等她长大一些，或者你有空的时候，或许可以教她一些技巧。|你对音乐的了解还不够深入，因此无法给出任何有意义的评价，但以一个外行的角度来看，这段音乐确实非常、非常舒缓。] 这首歌的演唱时间并不长——大概只有几分钟而已——但当她唱完最后一段歌词，抬起头期待你的赞许时，小娟的神情显得无比专注，她那小小的身体里的每一块肌肉似乎都在随着歌声的结束而逐渐放松下来。 她的母亲是否在声乐控制方面对她进行了很多指导呢？ 呵呵，有点吧？其实妈妈除了教我弹古筝之外，并没有太多时间来教我关于音乐的知识。我觉得她更喜欢将诗歌作为一种艺术形式来欣赏。 啊，不管怎样，你都得感谢她提供的这些音乐。真的非常棒——如果她真的是想与你分享她的快乐，那么她的目的就达到了。 |被你女儿那双小小的手捧在掌心里的，是一个颜色呈橙棕色的水果，大小大概和一个大苹果差不多。小娟笑得合不拢嘴，踮起脚来，以一个活泼好动的八岁狐妖所能表现出的最虔诚的方式，将这个水果递给了你。 这是一个柿子！是给你的！ 柿子，嗯？这种水果在手指间摸起来紧实而脆嫩，果皮光滑且没有任何瑕疵。不过，它身上似乎还带着某种难以言喻的特殊味道或特质…… 我花了这么长时间来为你挑选一个， [kinu.Dad]它的大小、形状、颜色和味道都恰到好处！这是一个非常棒的柿子，每当我吃到这样的柿子时，总会感到一阵暖意涌上心头，你吃了一定也会有同样的感觉！ 说实话，由于你对这种柿子并没有太多经验，其实也很难分辨出来，不过也没有必要让小娟知道这一点。你只需要感谢女儿，轻轻拍拍她的头，然后再仔细观察一下这种水果就行了。 在我出来迎接你之前，我刚刚把它洗过了，所以现在很干净！你可以直接吃它哦！ 那么，再拖延下去也没意义了。如果把这个果实切成小块可能会更好吃，但整个吃下去也完全没问题；咬下去的时候果皮会带有一丝酸味，不过整体来说还是非常甜的。当你把整个柿子连果皮一起吃掉的时候，小娟正全神贯注地注视着你——在她这样热切的目光注视下，即使你真的不喜欢这个柿子，也会把它吃光的…… 挺好的，不是吗？ 哦，确实不错。但你开心的原因并不是因为那个柿子有多好吃，而是因为它来自她。 你的女儿兴奋得尖叫起来，还用手拍着自己的脸颊，她那又大又蓬松的耳朵不停地抖动着，脸上也逐渐浮现出一抹红晕。天啊，在讨好别人这方面，清子真的把她教得很好啊。真的吗？ 没错！ 那种红晕变得更加明显了。呵呵，你还真会说些奉承话呢。 [kinu.Dad]." 知己难求。不过，她手里的那个柿子确实很不错。 |什么都没有？你仔细观察小娟那双合拢的双手，里面空空如也，只有几处老茧和已经愈合的划痕，这些划痕无疑是她在森林里玩耍时留下的。 哦，它在那里。 [kinu.Dad]你只需要再仔细看一看，真的，要看得再近一些。 哦？既然你决定配合了，我就弯下腰，仔细看了看小娟那合拢的双手……还是没有东西…… 再近一点就好， [kinu.Dad]..." 就这样吗？ 啊哈！现在你完全处于无防备的状态，毫无抵抗力了！哇哈哈！ 你那小狐女儿踮起脚尖，把头凑过来在你脸上轻吻了一下，然后迅速跳了回去，看起来有点害羞。啊，真是这样啊那个这是她送给我的礼物。 嘻嘻！ 天啊，这个礼物到底应该是谁来收呢？是你还是她？她对这件事的兴奋程度至少是你的一倍。 ] 看到了吧？这确实是一份很棒的礼物，对吧？即使离开的时候不能带走任何实物，但那些回忆却可以永远留在心中，这难道不是一件很棒的事情吗？妈妈总是说，礼物的价值并不在于它的物质形态，而在于送礼人的心意和付出，但我个人觉得，她这么说其实只是为了在送礼的时候能少花点钱罢了。 哈……现在她这样做，只会让你更想尽快把女儿带离这里，这样你就能收到她送来的更多礼物了。 小娟听到这样的赞美，不禁有些得意起来。我完全不介意！既然你现在已经来了，而且我也已经给了你礼物，那在我们进去见妈妈之前，我们现在能开始玩吗？求求你啦？
rows.raw: " As you crest the hilltop, Kinu comes jogging up to greet you, arms hidden behind her back. From the way her three tails are swishing all over the place, your daughter's up to something — good or bad, that remains to be seen. "[kinu.Dad]! You're here! I did a divination and you showed up just like it said you would, so I went ahead and made preparations!" Ooh, preparations — that sounds ominous enough, all right. Now, what was she preparing for, and what does she have hidden behind her back? "It's — it's a present! For you! Because you've been giving me things... and Mama says that it's very important to Keros that we kitsune repay good deeds done for us out of the kindness of one's heart. I know you can't really take things out of this place with you when you leave, so I tried to think up a present that you can enjoy here!" Ah, so it's a religious duty to pay back this karma thing which Kiyoko sometimes talks about. Kinu makes a pouty face at that. "But it's more than that, [kinu.Dad]. I always feel really happy when you get me sweet fruit as presents. Now I want to make you feel happy too, so, um, here's the present. Ta-daaaah!" With that, Kinu brings out her hands from behind her back, letting you take in the surprise she's planned for you. [rand|There's... nothing? Half-suspecting a mischievous trick or some sort, you eye your little kitsune daughter, who simply beams at you and pounces forward to grab your legs in a wide-armed hug. "Not nothing, silly! As repayment for all the things you've given me, you get one fluffy kitsune kit!" Kinu makes a happy little noise in the back of her throat and begins rubbing the side of her head against you, white-furred foxy ears brushing up against your [pc.skinFurScales]. "I'm so amazing, I make a great gift for anyone who wants to be healed with fluffiness!" Healed with fluffiness, eh? It's hard to argue with that, especially when Kinu's three tails have come around to her front and have started massaging away at your ankles. Sheesh... do kitsune know how to do this by instinct, or has her mother taught her a few things? Either way, while Kinu is less fluffy than her mother is, her fur has a flowing texture to it that reminds you of a warm breeze's caress. "Ehe... am I doing it right, [kinu.Dad]? Can you feel my happiness passing on to you?" Well, even if she weren't, there's enough happiness being generated here that you can't tell the difference. "Eeheehee!" Kinu rubs herself against you a few more times for good measure, then pulls away with a sigh, her three tails swishing so quickly you're amazed they're not bumping into each other. |Held in her hands is a little black bowl, complete with lid — the kind that Kiyoko serves soup in. Proudly, your kitsune daughter presents it to you in both hands, and you receive the gift with all due grace, careful not to spill any. It's warm but not hot, and as Kinu withdraws her hands brush against yours — my, they're just as toasty as the soup bowl itself. Just how long has she been keeping it warm for you? Kinu giggles. "That doesn't matter, [kinu.Dad]. I could have held it all day and not gotten tired. Have some, okay?" Hm, that's a very savoury smell coming from within. It's kind of foreign, and yet familiar at the same time — earthy, inasmuch as mushrooms are. You give it another sniff, more exacting this time, and [pc.ra lupine|a heartwarming scent of at least several different types of root vegetables rises from the lid to greet you. It's not as fine or distinct as a soup made with meat stock would be, but it's about as good as a wholly vegetable soup could ever get.|the fine, warm scent of a medley of vegetables rises from the lid to greet you.] No time like the present, then. Indeed, when you uncover the lid, a warm, clear broth with several kinds of root vegetables you recognize — and more that you don't — greets you while Kinu hops around and helpfully offers you a spoon. "It's kenchin soup, [kinu.Dad]! One of the bestest things to eat after sweet fruit! It always makes me feel happy inside whenever I have some, so this is a great way to repay some of the happiness you always give me!" Sheesh. With her so enthusiastic and bubbly about it, there's no need to push the stuff on you. As Kinu stares expectantly, you take the spoon and have an experimental sip. The flavor's definitely not something you'd usually find in the Frost Marches, rich and hearty, yet without the characteristic heaviness that accompanies similar meat-based soups. The first sip is followed by another, and another, until even the root veggies are gone. "Well, was it good, [kinu.Dad]? Was it?" You finished it all, didn't you? "Yeah, but you might have done so to be polite... don't want to be rude, but I want to be sure." All right, all right. Some of the foreign veggies were definitely an acquired taste, but the rest was pretty good. It wasn't bad, just something that your palate isn't used to. Kinu gives you a weak smile and twiddles her thumbs. "Right, so it wasn't anything I could really control..." If anything, it's an impetus for her to start exploring things on her own rather than just learning what's already been covered. Sooner or later, she'll have learnt all there is to be reasonably taught on a subject, and then the world itself will have to be her teacher. |"I'm going to sing for you, [kinu.Dad]!" Sing, huh? That's a pretty neat gift. "Yep! I'm going to sing, and share my happiness that way!" Without further ado, Kinu takes a deep breath, and bursts into song, a wordless, melancholic melody. Hey, your daughter's got a pretty good voice. It'll probably change once she's no longer a child and it's not exactly the same flute-like tone as her mother's, but it's high-pitched and sweet, not too different from when she gets really excited. [pc.bg minstrel|She's not half-bad, actually. There're some parts where she goes off-key — whether it be from excitement, nervousness or otherwise — but your daughter can generally keep a tune together. Maybe you could teach her a thing or two when she's older, or when you have the time.|You don't know enough about music to be able to provide any meaningful criticism, but in your layman's opinion it's really, really soothing.] The singing doesn't last very long — perhaps a handful of minutes — but Kinu looks absolutely intense by the end of it all, every single muscle in her little body unwinding as she finishes the last verse and looks up to you for approval. Has her mother been teaching her much in the way of vocal control? "Ehe. A bit? Well, Mama hasn't much time to teach me much in the way of music outside of the koto. I think she much prefers poetry as an art form." Ah. Well, either way, you have to thank her for the music. That was quite lovely — if she'd meant to share her happiness with you, then it worked. |Cradled in your daughter's cupped hands is an orange-brown fruit about the size of a large apple. Smiling from ear to ear, Kinu stands on tiptoe and presents it to you in the most reverent fashion a hyperactive eight year-old kitsune can. "It's a persimmon! For you!" A persimmon, eh? The fruit feels firm and crisp under your fingers, the skin smooth and without blemish. There's a certain something or the other to it that you can't quite place, though... "I spent so long picking one out for you, [kinu.Dad]! It's got just the right size, shape, color and smell! It's a pretty great persimmon, and I always get the warm fuzzies when I eat one like this, so you will too!" Honestly speaking, it's not as if you could tell, what with not having that much experience with persimmons of this sort, but there's no reason to let Kinu know that. You thank your daughter, give her a pat on the head, and study the fruit once more. "I washed it just before I came out to greet you, so it's clean! You can eat it just as it is!" Well, no reason to put it off any longer, then. It might have been better had this been sliced, but whole is just fine; there's a certain tartness to the peel as you bite into it, but it's otherwise very sweet. Kinu watches with rapt attention as you devour the persimmon, peel and all — with her intense gaze on you like this, you would've eaten the whole thing even if you'd hated it... "It's good, isn't it?" Oh, it's good. But the reason you're happy isn't because the persimmon was good, it's because it came from her. Your daughter just squeals and claps her hands to her cheeks, her big, fluffy ears twitching all over the place as a light blush creeps into her cheeks. Gods, Kiyoko really taught her well when it comes to laying on the flattery. "Really?" Yep! The blush deepens. "Ehehe. You really know how to lay on the flattery, [kinu.Dad]." It takes one to know one. Still, that was a great persimmon she had there. |There's... nothing? You peer into Kinu's cupped hands, which are perfectly and utterly empty save for a couple of calluses and healed-over scratches, no doubt from playing in the forest. "Oh, it's there, [kinu.Dad]. You just have to look closer. Like, really close." Oh? Deciding to play along, you stoop down and eye Kinu's cupped hands up close. Nope, still nothing... "Just a bit closer, [kinu.Dad]..." Like this? "Ah-ha! Now you're completely defenseless and vulnerable! Mwah!" Standing on tiptoe, your little kitsune daughter inches her head up to plant a kiss on your cheek, then quickly hops back, looking a little bashful. Ah, so that was her gift. "Eehee!" Gods, who's supposed to be receiving the gift here, you or her? She's at least twice as excited about this as you are. ] "See? See? It was a great gift, wasn't it? Even if you can't take anything material with you when you leave, you can still bring the memories along! And that's great! Mama always says it's not so much the exact nature of the gift, but the thought and effort that goes into it, but I personally suspect that she just says that so she can be cheap when giving gifts." Hah... now she's just making you want to get your daughter out of here all the faster so you can actually receive more kinds of gifts from her. Kinu preens a little at the praise. "I wouldn't mind! So, now that you're here and I've given you your gift, can we play now before you go in and see Mama? Pleasepleaseplease?""

rows.original: "Aww, you're leaving already?" Indeed. It's been fun catching up with her, but you've got to go and see her mother. There're some matters you have to discuss with Kiyoko, as well as a handful of other grown-up things you might be doing with her. "Oh. Those sorts of things. Well, have fun playing with Mama! Make her happy, okay? Me, I'm going to run around in the forest and find a nice tree to climb. Bye bye!" With that, Kinu turns around and scampers for the trees. Her three tails flowing behind her are the last you see of your daughter, and she's gone.
rows.translation: 哎呀，你就要走了吗？ 确实，和她聊天真的很愉快，但你现在得去见见她的母亲了。有些事情你需要和清子讨论，还有一些其他成年人才会处理的事情，也可能需要和她一起解决。 哦。那些各种有趣的事情吧。好了，和妈妈一起玩得开心点！让她开心起来，好吗？而我呢，要去森林里跑跑，找一棵好树爬上去。再见啦！说完，小娟便转身朝树林跑去。她那三条尾巴在身后摇摆着，那是你最后一次看到你的女儿了，之后她就消失在了树林中。
rows.raw: " "Aww, you're leaving already?" Indeed. It's been fun catching up with her, but you've got to go and see her mother. There're some matters you have to discuss with Kiyoko, as well as a handful of other grown-up things you might be doing with her. "Oh. Those sorts of things. Well, have fun playing with Mama! Make her happy, okay? Me, I'm going to run around in the forest and find a nice tree to climb. Bye bye!" With that, Kinu turns around and scampers for the trees. Her three tails flowing behind her are the last you see of your daughter, and she's gone."

rows.original: As you approach Kinu, your daughter brightens immediately and runs up to you, shaking all over with excitement. The little kitsune looks fit to start running in circles any moment now but manages to hold herself in through an act of superhuman willpower, instead settling from grabbing your [pc.armor] and alternating between tugging and pushing. Oh dear. Has she gotten into the peaches again? "Ehehe, no. But I did an augury this morning and it said you'd be coming today, so I went and got everything prepared! Come and see!" Prepared for — oh. Ah. Well! As Kinu drags you away and towards the hillside, you see waiting for you a large firepit ringed with stones, dry leaves and twigs already packed in its recesses and waiting to be set alight. A large plate has been set out on a low bench, heaped with the pine mushrooms you'd picked with Kinu the last time; even uncooked, a tantalising scent of earthy spiciness rises from the spread on offer.
rows.translation: 当你靠近纪努时，你的女儿立刻变得兴奋起来，跑向你，全身都在颤抖。那只小狐妖看起来随时都会开始绕圈奔跑，但它凭借超乎常人的意志力克制住了自己，只是紧紧地抓住你的手。 [pc.armor] 不断地拉扯和推搡着。 哦天哪，她又把那些桃子弄乱了吗？ 嘿嘿，不是的。不过今天早上我做了个占卜，结果说你今天会来，所以我就把所有东西都准备好了！快来看看吧！ 准备好了——哦，啊，太好了！ 当小娟拉着你往山坡走去时，你看到那里有一个被石头、干叶子和细枝围成的大篝火坑，那些燃料已经堆放在坑里，随时可以点燃。一张大盘子被放在低矮的长凳上，上面堆满了你上次和小娟一起采到的松茸；即使还没有煮过，这些松茸散发出的浓郁香气也已经让人垂涎欲滴了。
rows.raw: " As you approach Kinu, your daughter brightens immediately and runs up to you, shaking all over with excitement. The little kitsune looks fit to start running in circles any moment now but manages to hold herself in through an act of superhuman willpower, instead settling from grabbing your [pc.armor] and alternating between tugging and pushing. Oh dear. Has she gotten into the peaches again? "Ehehe, no. But I did an augury this morning and it said you'd be coming today, so I went and got everything prepared! Come and see!" Prepared for — oh. Ah. Well! As Kinu drags you away and towards the hillside, you see waiting for you a large firepit ringed with stones, dry leaves and twigs already packed in its recesses and waiting to be set alight. A large plate has been set out on a low bench, heaped with the pine mushrooms you'd picked with Kinu the last time; even uncooked, a tantalising scent of earthy spiciness rises from the spread on offer. "

rows.original: Oh, and Kiyoko's there too. Your fox-wife is carrying a large metal pot, [kiyoko.pregStage 3|waddling over from the cabin as she balances her burden in front of her huge pregnant belly. |balancing it in front of her as she carefully makes her way over from the cabin.] Steam seeps out from under the lid, wafting up and away — goodness, they really knew you were coming, didn't they? "My greetings," Kiyoko says with a small smile as she sets the pot down on the bench. "I hope you don't mind me being here as well. Our daughter wanted to make matsutake rice for this, but she hasn't got the process down just yet. It's more than simply following a recipe, after all." "Mama! Mama!" "There was a little too much for just rice, too, so I made some other things with our daughter's help. And then I realized we'd made too much for just two... so I thought you wouldn't mind having another mouth around to finish up all the food. [kiyoko.pregStage 1|Or two, for that matter," she adds, rubbing the rising swell of her pregnancy. "]You don't mind, do you?" Oh, of course not. This'll be a great family picnic. Kiyoko laughs and pats Kinu on the scruff of her neck. "I'm not sure it qualifies as a picnic, considering it's so close to home, but I'm sure it'll be wonderful nonetheless. You've been very good to Kinu of late, and I myself appreciate you taking the little rapscallion out of my fur every now and then." "Can we eat already? I'm huuuuungry." Okay, okay. While Kiyoko takes a seat, Kinu lights the firepit with a flick of her fingers, almost carelessly tossing a glob of foxfire into the twigs and tinder to set it alight. Once the flames are licking away merrily, she pads over to the plate of marinated mushrooms, spears one of the mushroom halves on a long stick, and offers it to you. "You go first, [kinu.Dad]! This is to thank you for always petting and playing with me!" Aw, shucks. You take the wooden skewer from Kinu and hold the mushroom half over the fire, watching hot air waver over the leaf fire as the matsutake begins to cook. Kinu takes a seat besides you on the bench, her big blue eyes fixed on the shroom as you turn it about in the fire. Before long, the sauce and oil on it starts to sizzle and pop, the matsutake itself turning a golden-brown as a delightful smell begins to waft into the air. "This brings back memories," Kiyoko says with a small sigh[kiyoko.pregStage 3|, her hands resting on her big pregnant belly]. "My mother and I would go out in the fall to pick matsutake in the pine forest — mid-autumn was one of the few times when she'd get a reprieve from her hectic schedule. We'd fill baskets with the delicacies, then head home happy... and now my own daughter is doing it with me." Kinu wiggles and squirms as Kiyoko pets her ears. "Hee hee!" "You will do the same with your own children when you have them, yes? I'm not the biggest fan of roasted and grilled food... but I will say that the best way to bring out the flavor of matsutake is simple preparation. Look, it's nearly done." And so it is. The once white portions of the halved mushroom are now a wonderful golden-brown, and the signature spicy aroma has been well and truly brought out by the cooking. Mother and daughter alike watch you intently as you raise the mushroom, and take a bite. Gods above. [pc.bg noblescion|The only thing that might compare to this are the truffles you once sampled in the heartlands.|You've never had the opportunity to taste anything this good.] And the fact that you have your foxy, floofy family at your side — that just makes it all the more intense. Ah... now this is happiness. The mushroom is firm and chewy — meaty, even, and possessed of a certain spicy flavor that's not peppery. A little like cinnamon, to be honest. "Was it good, [kinu.Dad]? I'm pretty awesome with soy sauce and rice wine!" You finished it, didn't you? "Yaaaaaaay!" "Now, now, both of you. There's plenty to be had, so there's no need to rush things. In addition to our daughter's offerings, I made some matsutake rice and egg custard as well. Why don't you try some as well? It'll certainly be a change from your usual fare." And so it goes. While Kinu sets to roasting the mushrooms in the fire, Kiyoko and you scoop out hearty servings of rice into big bowls. Your foxy wife wasn't kidding when she said she'd made a lot — one of these matsutake mushrooms sure goes a long way, especially with how thinly she can slice them. As the three of you settle down to eat on the warm hillside, part of you wishes that this could go on forever, that you wouldn't have to eventually return to the waking world and deal with the chaos Kasyrra's creating... [rand| "There, there," Kiyoko chides gently, pulling a finely embroidered handkerchief out of her yukata and wiping off Kinu's face. "Your mouth is covered in food, daughter... here, let me clean you off." Kinu wiggles and squirms. "Mwa! Thank you!" "You too, [pc.name]. Your mouth is all oily... there." Kiyoko finishes cleaning you off, then thinks a moment and giggles. "How interesting. Not only do you and our daughter share similar auras, but you make the same messes as well. I wonder if there's any connection there?" | "Eat slower, Kinu. You'll choke if you don't chew your food properly. Besides, matsutake is made to be savoured slowly, not wolfed down." "Ehe. But then I have to eat lots! That way I can grow up fast and be a den mother like you!" No, really, it doesn't work that way. Overstuffing herself on peaches only makes her sick — what would cause her to think anything else would be any different? Kiyoko sighs good-naturedly and rubs her temples. "Well, to be fair, our daughter does eat her weight in food every day, or at least that's how it feels like.[kiyoko.numKits 4| Cooking for her alone is tiring enough, but feeding her and all of her siblings is truly a feat worthy of heroes. ]" | Kiyoko picks up a small piece of matsutake with her chopsticks and pets Kinu between the ears. "Now, daughter dearest, say 'aaaah'." You watch as your little kitsune daughter opens up obediently to be fed by her mother, then starts chewing away with great glee. Isn't she a little too old for that? "Hmm, I don't know about that. I've always found that it's good to retain some youthful tendencies, otherwise you tend to get old and cynical about things. Optimism, you know?" "Yay! Now it's my turn to feed [kinu.Dad]! Food always tastes better when it's served by someone who loves you, so come on! Aaaaaah!" [pc.isDK|If you must.|Gladly]. Kinu holds out a skewer with a bit of mushroom on it, and you pick it off with your teeth. It really is very good. "Well, then." Kiyoko smiles a little smile and turns the full force of her sea-green eyes on you, all [kiyoko.kiyokoTails] of her tails sweeping back and forth behind her. "I suppose you'll just have to feed me now, [pc.name]." "Yay! Feed Mama! Feed Mama!" Kiyoko's smile turns into a little mischievous grin. "Come on, now. Aaaaah." Oh, just for this you'll be feeding her something else later on when the two of you can get some time alone. | "Eat everything, okay?" Kiyoko says, eyeing Kinu's bowl. "Don't just eat the things you like, or eat them first before everything else. It's impolite. I made the egg custard for a reason." Kinu makes a whiny little noise in the back of her throat, but settles down and acquiesces without putting up a fight. Guess she knows that kitsune tricks don't work on themselves, eh? "There's a good girl. Food is precious. You may take it for granted here in the astral plane, but this won't always be the case." Indeed. Come to think of it, she said she made the egg custard for a reason — what is it? Your foxy wife sets down her bowl and chopsticks and thinks a moment. "It's... well, what you consider home cooking would be what you grew up eating, right? No matter where you came from, or your station in life... suffice to say that when I think of my own mother, egg custard and kenchin soup always come to mind. Come now, why don't you have some yourself, [pc.name]?" With that, Kiyoko reaches in with the large spoon and scoops out a chunk of wobbly, pale-yellow egg custard, plonking it straight into your bowl. You can see the bits of minced matsutake inside along with some kind of minced shellfish... it's soft, smooth and slippery, and the flavor's certainly not something one would find common in the Frost Marches, or even the heartlands. Even with the taste of matsutake dominating most of the mouthful, though, it's a bit of an acquired taste. ] Time passes, the food diminishes, and eventually the fire itself dies to a heap of embers and charred ashes. Ever calm and collected, Kiyoko picks up the dirty dishes and stacks them into the now-empty pot before giving the both of you a nod. "I'll be taking these back, then. [pc.name], occupy our daughter for a little while longer, won't you? There'll be plenty of time for us to be together alone after you've sent this little rascal on her way." With that, your foxy wife ups and leaves with the dishes, disappearing over the crest of the hill and into the cabin in the cherry blossom tree. Kinu watches her retreating form for a little while, then steps forward and rubs her side and tails against your legs. "Mmm, thank you so much for having fun with me today, [kinu.Dad]. I feel so warm and full!" Oh, she came up with everything with her mother; all you had to do was participate. "And that's what made the difference! Don't undersell yourself!" Kinu looks around, then leans in on tiptoe and kisses you at a level she's comfortable with — which happens to be somewhere just above your waist. "Okay, then! I'll put out the embers and clean everything else up! Go and play with Mama, I'll stay out of your fur, promise!" With that, your daughter turns her attention to throwing sand into the firepit, leaving you alone to make your move. Now that was fun... hopefully Kiyoko will be done with the dishes by the time you reach the cabin.
rows.translation: 哦，清子也在那里。你的狐妖妻子正拿着一个巨大的金属锅。 [kiyoko.pregStage 3|她摇摇晃晃地从小屋走过来，那巨大的怀孕腹部使她不得不在行走时小心翼翼地平衡手中的负担。 |她小心翼翼地从小屋中走出来，将那个东西放在她面前，努力保持它的平衡。] 蒸汽从盖子下面渗出来，缓缓升腾而上——天哪，他们真的做到了。知道你本来是要来的，对吧？ 我向您致以诚挚的问候。清子微微一笑，将锅放在长凳上说道。希望你们不会介意我也在这里。我们女儿想用这种方法来做松茸饭，但她还没掌握具体的制作流程。毕竟，这可不仅仅是一套简单的食谱那么简单。 妈妈！妈妈！ 光是用来做米饭的话，这些材料似乎有点多了，所以在我们女儿的帮助下，我又做了一些其他的菜。后来我发现，这些食物对于两个人来说确实有点多余……所以我想，你应该不会介意再多一个人来帮忙把剩下的食物吃完吧。 [kiyoko.pregStage 1|或者两个，也完全没问题。她边说边揉着逐渐凸起的腹部。"]你不会介意吧？ 哦，当然不会。这一定会是一次很愉快的家庭野餐。 清子笑着，轻轻拍了拍小娟的脖子。考虑到地点离家里这么近，我不太确定这算不算真正的野餐，但不管怎样，我相信一定会很愉快的。最近你对小娟一直很好，而且我也真的很感激你偶尔能帮我照看那个调皮的小家伙。 我们能开始吃饭了吗？我饿死了。 好的，好的。当清子坐下来时，小娟随手一弹，就点燃了火堆，几乎漫不经心地把一团狐火扔到树枝和引火物上，火立刻燃烧了起来。当火焰欢快地跳动起来时，她走到装着腌蘑菇的盘子旁，用一根长棍子把其中一枚蘑菇串起来，然后递给了你。 你先走吧， [kinu.Dad]这是为了感谢你一直陪伴我、陪我玩耍！ 哎呀，真遗憾。你拿过小娟给的木签，把蘑菇的一半架在火上，观察着热空气在蘑菇叶片上袅袅升起，这时松茸就开始慢慢煮熟了。小娟坐在你旁边的长凳上，她那双大大的蓝眼睛紧紧地盯着正在火上烤的蘑菇。不久之后，蘑菇上的酱汁和油脂开始发出“嘶嘶”声，蘑菇本身也变成了金黄色，一股美妙的香味逐渐弥漫在空气中。 这唤起了许多回忆。清子轻叹着说道。[kiyoko.pregStage 3|她的双手放在自己隆起的孕肚上。]. 每到秋天，我和母亲就会一起去松林里采摘松茸——仲秋时节是她难得能从繁忙的日程中抽空出来的时候之一。我们会把采到的美味装满篮子，然后开心地回家……现在，我的女儿也和我一起做这件事了。 当清子轻抚她的耳朵时，纪久不停地扭动身体、挣扎着。嘻嘻！
