rows.original: Somewhere else and some time ago... Keros' tails, you've been stuck in the pits of the storehouse for so long, the sound of running water and smell of damp earth and roots is getting to you. Not to mention how your muscles are already cramping something fierce, and you're getting sleepy... ...Damp and miserable isn't quite how you envisioned spending your day off, but it's got to be done. You'll wait here until dinnertime if need be. Drip. Drip. It's so close to the underground river that flows beneath home that even you're getting chilled; you have to resist the urge to sneeze a couple of times. That would be terrible, considering that you're supposed to be stalking prey right now. Sighing, you settle in against a couple of boxes and a nearby shelf, steeling your resolve to lie in wait until the dinner bell rings. When it does happen, it almost catches you by surprise. The creak of the cellar storehouse's door as someone slowly pushes it open, clearly attempting to be sneaky about it but not having very much success. Small footsteps down the stone stairs, too light to be Mother. You suck in a breath, bite your lip, and your ears flatten against your head as you peer out from your hiding place amongst the shelves, eyes straining in the gloom. It's a small figure, smaller than you are with two tails. The silhouette's too indistinct to make out exactly who it is, but you already know enough to make a decision. As your prey approaches the shallows, you creep out from between the shelves and boxes on all fours, muscles tensed and ready to pounce. Half-submerged in the shallows and tethered with rope and nets, boxes of fruit and veggies have been left in the water to chill; it's these that the little figure approaches and starts to pry at the lids. You pounce. Pale orbs of foxfire erupt into life as you ruthlessly mow down your prey, knocking her backwards into the netted-off shallows. Aya drops the apple she'd been eating as you bowl into her, instinctively raising her hands in front of her face to try and ward you off. "Uyaaaaa!" "Got you!" Aya squeals and wails, wriggling in your grasp and knocking over the box in her bid to escape, apples spilling outwards and bobbing in the icy water. Your little sister's a slippery one, but anger and determination lend you enough strength to subdue the brat with limbs and tails alike, pinning her in place until you can get a good hold on the scruff of her neck. "Owowowowow! Stop tearing at my fur! It hurts! It hurts!" "It should hurt. So you're the one who has been stealing food and letting me take the blame for it," you snap, raising your voice in a pretty good imitation of Mothers'. "'Oh no, Kinu, you're the only one who could've removed the fruit when I left it in the river to chill. I didn't teach anyone else how to operate the pulley.' Good job at being so stupid. What if you were swept away under the earth?" "Waaaaah!" "And don't bother sobbing in front of me. I know I've pulled off the waterworks often enough myself to fall for that. Going to all this trouble just to steal food — I don't know which you should be ashamed of more, the thievery itself, the danger you put yourself in, or the petty reason for it all." Your little sister wriggles some more, but your hold on her is firm and unyielding. Indulging Aya's antics provides you with a few more moments of fun until she gives up and sags limply in your arms. "Look, I'm sorry — just don't tell Mama, okay? I'm really sorry... look, I can climb trees pretty well, I'll go into the grove and pick some good peaches for you tomorrow, okay?" "So, you've graduated from stealing to bribery." "Eeeeeehhhhh!" "So, are you sorry for stealing food, or sorry that you got caught? There's a big difference there, and given that Mama blamed me for what you've been doing, Aya, I'm not particularly inclined to be merciful." "Hoo... come on, Big Sis... it won't happen again, okay? I promise, I really, really promise really hard..." "I don't know..." Learning to mimic Mother really paid off today; you can practically feel your icy glare burning coldly into Aya. It's enough to set your little sister into another fit of tears — sure, it's fine for grown-ups to have this kind of power, but being able to make children cry just by staring at them... ...Anyways, you need to deal with Aya. What's your verdict?
rows.translation: 在某个地方，某个时候…… 凯罗斯的伙伴们，你们在仓库的深处被困了这么久，流水声、潮湿的泥土气息以及根茎散发的气味已经让你们感到不适了。更不用说你们的肌肉已经开始剧烈抽筋，而且也越来越困了。…… 潮湿而闷热，这确实不是你想象中的休息日该有的状态，但这件事必须得完成。如果有必要的话，你就在这里等着吃晚饭吧。 滴答。 滴答。 这里离那条流经房屋下方的地下河实在太近了，以至于你是你得忍住想要打喷嚏的冲动，否则可就糟了——现在你本来应该在潜行追踪猎物啊。叹了口气，你靠在几个箱子和附近的架子上，下定决心要等到晚餐铃声响起。 当这一切真的发生时，几乎会让你措手不及。地窖储藏室的门发出吱嘎声，有人正慢慢地推开门——显然他们试图悄悄行动，但并没有取得太大成功。石阶上传来轻柔的脚步声，那脚步声太轻了，不可能是母亲。你屏住呼吸，咬住嘴唇，将耳朵贴在头上，从架子后面的藏身处探出头来，在昏暗的光线中努力睁大眼睛。 那是一个小小的身影，比你还要小，而且还有两条尾巴。那个轮廓太过模糊，无法清楚地辨认出那是谁，但你已经掌握了足够的信息来做出决定。当你的猎物慢慢靠近浅水区时，你四肢着地，从那些架子和箱子之间悄悄爬了出来，全身肌肉都绷得紧紧的，随时准备扑了上去。那些装满水果和蔬菜的箱子被用绳子和网固定在水里，用来冷藏；而那个小身影正是朝着这些箱子走去，开始撬开它们的盖子。 你猛地扑了上去。淡黄色的狐火球在空气中迸发出来，你无情地攻击着猎物，将她撞倒在了被网围住的浅水区。当你撞上她的时候，Aya手中的苹果掉在了地上，她本能地举起双手试图挡住你的攻击。 哇啊啊啊！ 抓到你了！ 阿雅发出尖叫声，拼命扭动身体，试图从你的手中逃脱，甚至撞倒了那个盒子，苹果们因此散落出来，在冰冷的水中漂浮着。你的妹妹确实很难捉摸，但愤怒与决心给了你足够的力量，你用四肢和尾巴将她牢牢按住，直到能够稳稳地抓住她的脖子。 哇哇哇哇！别再抓我的毛了！好疼啊！真的好疼！ 它应该受伤了。真糟糕。你是那个一直偷食物还任由别人这么做的家伙我为此承担责任吧。你突然提高了音量，模仿得还挺像你妈妈的口气呢。哦不，小娟，只有你才有可能在我把水果放在河里冷却的时候把它拿走。我并没有教过其他人如何操作那个滑轮系统。你真是太蠢了……要是你被冲到河里淹死了怎么办？ 哇啊啊啊！ 别在我面前哭哭啼啼的。我自己也知道，我曾经多次强忍住泪水，才没有哭出来。那个费了这么大的劲就为了偷点食物——我真的不知道你们应该更为自己感到羞愧的是什么：是偷窃这个行为本身，还是自己因此而冒下的危险，又或者是导致这一切发生的那些琐碎原因。 你的妹妹还在不停地扭动身体，但你的手紧紧地抓住她，丝毫不松懈。任由艾雅继续这些顽皮的行为，你能享受到更多欢乐时光，直到她最终放弃抗性，软软地靠在你的怀里。 听着，真的很抱歉——只是别告诉妈妈，好吗？我真的很抱歉……其实我爬树挺在行的，明天我会去果园里摘一些好桃子给你，好吗？ 所以，你从偷窃的手段升级到了行贿的手段啊。 呃…… 那么，你是为偷食物而感到抱歉，还是因为被抓到而后悔呢？这两者之间有很大的区别。而且，既然妈妈责备了你我对于你一直以来所做的事情，绫，我实在没有丝毫宽恕的意愿。 呼……拜托了，大姐姐……这种事不会再发生了，好吗？我保证，真的，我郑重承诺…… 我不知道……今天，学会模仿妈妈的做法果然派上了用场——你简直可以感受你那冰冷的目光狠狠地盯着亚雅，这种眼神足以让你的妹妹再次哭起来——当然，成年人拥有这样的能力也没关系，但仅仅通过注视就能让孩子们哭泣…… ……不管怎样，你得想办法处理亚雅的问题。你有什么打算吗？
rows.raw: " Somewhere else and some time ago... Keros' tails, you've been stuck in the pits of the storehouse for so long, the sound of running water and smell of damp earth and roots is getting to you. Not to mention how your muscles are already cramping something fierce, and you're getting sleepy... ...Damp and miserable isn't quite how you envisioned spending your day off, but it's got to be done. You'll wait here until dinnertime if need be. Drip. Drip. It's so close to the underground river that flows beneath home that even you're getting chilled; you have to resist the urge to sneeze a couple of times. That would be terrible, considering that you're supposed to be stalking prey right now. Sighing, you settle in against a couple of boxes and a nearby shelf, steeling your resolve to lie in wait until the dinner bell rings. When it does happen, it almost catches you by surprise. The creak of the cellar storehouse's door as someone slowly pushes it open, clearly attempting to be sneaky about it but not having very much success. Small footsteps down the stone stairs, too light to be Mother. You suck in a breath, bite your lip, and your ears flatten against your head as you peer out from your hiding place amongst the shelves, eyes straining in the gloom. It's a small figure, smaller than you are with two tails. The silhouette's too indistinct to make out exactly who it is, but you already know enough to make a decision. As your prey approaches the shallows, you creep out from between the shelves and boxes on all fours, muscles tensed and ready to pounce. Half-submerged in the shallows and tethered with rope and nets, boxes of fruit and veggies have been left in the water to chill; it's these that the little figure approaches and starts to pry at the lids. You pounce. Pale orbs of foxfire erupt into life as you ruthlessly mow down your prey, knocking her backwards into the netted-off shallows. Aya drops the apple she'd been eating as you bowl into her, instinctively raising her hands in front of her face to try and ward you off. "Uyaaaaa!" "Got you!" Aya squeals and wails, wriggling in your grasp and knocking over the box in her bid to escape, apples spilling outwards and bobbing in the icy water. Your little sister's a slippery one, but anger and determination lend you enough strength to subdue the brat with limbs and tails alike, pinning her in place until you can get a good hold on the scruff of her neck. "Owowowowow! Stop tearing at my fur! It hurts! It hurts!" "It should hurt. So you're the one who has been stealing food and letting me take the blame for it," you snap, raising your voice in a pretty good imitation of Mothers'. "'Oh no, Kinu, you're the only one who could've removed the fruit when I left it in the river to chill. I didn't teach anyone else how to operate the pulley.' Good job at being so stupid. What if you were swept away under the earth?" "Waaaaah!" "And don't bother sobbing in front of me. I know I've pulled off the waterworks often enough myself to fall for that. Going to all this trouble just to steal food — I don't know which you should be ashamed of more, the thievery itself, the danger you put yourself in, or the petty reason for it all." Your little sister wriggles some more, but your hold on her is firm and unyielding. Indulging Aya's antics provides you with a few more moments of fun until she gives up and sags limply in your arms. "Look, I'm sorry — just don't tell Mama, okay? I'm really sorry... look, I can climb trees pretty well, I'll go into the grove and pick some good peaches for you tomorrow, okay?" "So, you've graduated from stealing to bribery." "Eeeeeehhhhh!" "So, are you sorry for stealing food, or sorry that you got caught? There's a big difference there, and given that Mama blamed me for what you've been doing, Aya, I'm not particularly inclined to be merciful." "Hoo... come on, Big Sis... it won't happen again, okay? I promise, I really, really promise really hard..." "I don't know..." Learning to mimic Mother really paid off today; you can practically feel your icy glare burning coldly into Aya. It's enough to set your little sister into another fit of tears — sure, it's fine for grown-ups to have this kind of power, but being able to make children cry just by staring at them... ...Anyways, you need to deal with Aya. What's your verdict?"

rows.original: You're not completely sure you ought to be doing this. On one hand, you don't want to be seen as usurping Mother's authority. On the other hand, you do need to establish yourself a little more firmly as someone who ought to be obeyed. Eeeeeehhhh... "Fine. I'll let you off this once, but not before I give you an earful." Aya says something that's neither here nor there, but the tone of your little sister's voice makes her meaning clear. Stupid thing, with an attitude like this, she's going to learn nothing whatsoever. Pinching Aya by the ears, you press her down to her knees in front of you as she wails. "Stopitstopitstopit!" "Better this than whatever Mama would've had in store for you had I chosen to drag you to her. You're an idiot for wading out into the river like that; who knows where under the earth you'd have ended up if the river had swept you away. Also, a pig, a thief, and a liar. And no, I don't need you to climb any trees or pick any peaches for me. Just stop stealing food already — if you're hungry, ask for a snack, or there's plenty to eat out in the forest if you know where to look. Got it?" "Yes..." You summon up your most skeptical look. "I don't know, that wasn't really convincing." "Yes!" "Hmph... I'm the one taking the blame for what you did, I'm the one who's choosing not to drag you upstairs and clear my name. Do this again and I'm marching you straight to Mama, do you understand me? Being punished for something I didn't do makes me really, really angry. The only reason I'm letting you off is that I think I've given you enough of a scare that you won't do this again, and that's the important thing here: that you learn from this and actually stop doing it. Do you understand me?" A nod. "Fine. Stop sniffling like that, it's undignified. Now get out of my sight, and go get a change of clothes or something." Aya doesn't need telling twice. The moment you let go of her, your little sister zips away from you and up the stairs in a blur, clearly not trusting you not to change your mind at any moment. Ironically, the very act of her doing this makes you regret this decision a little more than you should. "And don't ever do this again! I have ways of knowing!" Not exactly true, but not quite false either. You don't get a reply, and it's for a good while longer that you stand alone in the darkness, listening to the sound of your own heaving breath and the rushing of the cold river. You still sting in places where Aya bit and scratched you in her bid to escape, and all of a sudden you feel very tired. Is this how Mother feels all the time? Keros' tails, I'm turning into Mother at the tender age of eight... I'm too young to feel this old! Like Mother, too, your work is never done. There's still the spilt apples to gather up and put back, then you have to reseal the boxes and set them in the river — the safe way with the pulley, of course. By the looks of it, with all you have to do, you'll have no more time left to play before the bell sounds for dinner. Oh well. Such is the responsibility of merciful Big Sister — aching joints, stinging skin and a small sense of pride. If only it didn't have to be wet as well... putting such unsavoury thoughts out of your mind, you get on all fours and start the thankless task of picking up all the apples strewn on the floor and bobbing in the water.
rows.translation: 你其实并不完全确定自己是否应该这么做。一方面，你不想被人认为是在篡夺母亲的权威；另一方面，你确实需要更加明确地表明自己才是那个应该被人们服从的人。 呃…… 好吧，这次我就放你一马，但在此之前，我得好好训斥你一顿。 阿雅说了一些模棱两可的话，但妹妹说话时的肌肉度让那些话的意思变得清晰明了。真是愚蠢至极，如果她一直保持这种态度，根本什么也学不到。你揪住阿雅的耳朵，把她按在自己面前，让她跪在地上，而她则在一旁哭哭啼啼。 快停下来，快停下来！ 这样总比妈妈要是把我拉去见她，会给你准备的那些东西要好得多。你真是个傻瓜，竟然那样冒冒失失地跑到河里去；谁知道如果河水把你冲走了，你会落得什么下场呢。而且，你还是个猪、小偷和骗子。还有，我不需要你爬树去摘桃子给我。只要你别再偷食物就行了——如果你饿了，就直接开口要零食；反正森林里也有很多食物，只要你知道去哪里找就行。明白了吗？ 是的…… 你露出了最为怀疑的表情。我不知道，那个说法实在不够有说服力。 是的！ 哼……你做的这些事，都是我在背黑锅，都是我在选择不带你去楼上澄清我的名声。如果你再这样，我就直接把你交给妈妈，明白吗？因为一些我并没有做过的事情而受到惩罚，这真的让我真的我很生气。我之所以放你一马，只是因为我觉得我已经让你受到了足够的惊吓，你应该不会再犯这种错了。这才是最重要的：你要从这次经历中吸取教训，真正停止这种行为。明白吗？ 点了点头。 好吧，别再这样抽鼻子了，那样太不体面了。现在从我眼前消失，去换身衣服或者做点别的吧。 阿耶可不需要别人再提醒两次。只要你一松开她的手，你的小妹妹就会立刻从你身边飞快地跑上楼梯，显然她根本不信任你会突然改变主意。具有讽刺意味的是，正是她的这种行为，让你更加后悔自己做出了这个决定。 以后再也不要这样做了！我总有办法发现的！不完全正确，但也不完全错误。你没有得到任何回应，于是你独自站在黑暗中，聆听着自己急促的呼吸声以及冰冷河流的潺潺声。那些被阿雅咬伤、抓伤的地方仍然隐隐作痛，突然间，你感到无比疲惫。 母亲一直都是这种感觉吗？天啊，在我才八岁这么小的年纪，我就开始变得像母亲一样了…… 我年纪还小，怎么就会有这种沧桑的感觉呢？ 就像你妈妈一样，你的活儿永远也干不完。首先还得把洒出来的苹果捡起来放回去，然后还得把箱子重新封好，再把它们放到河里去——当然，要用滑轮这个最安全的方法。看你这情形，忙得不可开交，等到晚餐时间响起铃声时，你肯定已经没时间玩了。 唉，这就是“仁慈的大姐姐”应该承担的责任吧——让关节疼痛、皮肤发痒，同时还让人产生一丝小小的自豪感。要是这些苹果不那么湿就好了……把这些不愉快的想法抛到脑后，你就得四肢着地，开始这项麻烦的任务：把那些散落在地上、还泡在水里的苹果一个一个捡起来。

rows.original: Eeeeeh, your little sister looks repentant enough. Maybe you'll give her a chance to shape up
rows.translation: 呃，你妹妹看起来确实挺后悔的。或许你应该给她一个改过自新的机会吧。
rows.raw: "Eeeeeh, your little sister looks repentant enough. Maybe you'll give her a chance to shape up"

rows.original: You bare your teeth at Aya. "No way. You did a bad thing not just once but over and over again, caused someone else to be blamed, then when caught tried to bribe your way out of the situation. At this point, I'm not going to just not let you off; you deserve everything you're going to get." That sets your little sister off. She screams, kicks, bites and squirms every step of the way as you drag her out of the cellar storehouse and back towards the main cabin; your will is as resolute it's ever been as you haul a furious ball of fox fluff through the main door and up where you know Mother will be. Several pairs of curious eyes fall upon you throughout your long journey, but everyone's smart enough to not get in Big Sister's way when she's taking care of business. And of course, you've taken care to pocket the half-eaten apple, complete with Aya's bite marks still in it. Mother's in her dressing room, smoothing out her yukata, and she winces as you throw open the screen door and shove Aya in, a sodden ball of fur, hair and cloth. Exhausted, your little sister collapses on the tatami flooring and curls up, and you finally heave a sigh of relief and wipe your brow. "Kinu, Aya. I wasn't expecting you to be back in the house so soon, but I suppose something interesting has happened. And here I was, about to go see what all the ruckus was about. There ought to be a good explanation for this." "Hmph. Yes, Mama. You said I was the one who was stealing the fruit and veggies you put in the river to chill, since I was the only one who knew how to operate the pulley. I figured the only way to get you to stop believing I was the culprit was to catch the thief myself, so I did just that. Stupid Aya here wasn't using the pulley to get the boxes out of the water and onto the jetty; she was wading straight into the river to get at them." "You have proof of this?" Wordlessly, you pull out the gnawed apple and pass it to Mother. She turns it over in her hands, studying the pattern of the teeth marks in the fruit's crisp flesh, then furrows her brow and her lips twist. With painful slowness, she turns her gaze down to Aya and gives her a Look that sends her quailing. That's it! That's the gaze you've been trying to mimic all this time. You've got to watch Mother, learn how it's done. "Tell me everything." So you do. From figuring out there was a pattern to the thefts, to deciding to stake out the storehouse, to actually catching your bratty little sister in the act — you recount every detail of what happened to Mother. You're not sure if she looks more concerned or impressed that all this is coming from an eight year-old. "And you, Aya? Do you have anything to say in your defense?" Your little sister whimpers, shivering. "You haven't just been gluttonous enough to apply your talents to petty theft, you've also caused me to judge your elder sister in error — and that makes me more upset than you can imagine. I'll deal with you later in private, little vixen." "You're in so much trouble," you pipe up. "Lord Keros teaches that people who do wicked things gather bad karma, and it has to be paid back eventually. That's why you shouldn't make too much mischief. You accrue too much bad karma, and it comes back to bite you when you least expect it. Better now than later!" Mother sighs. "You don't have to gloat, Kinu." "I am not gloating," you declare with all the gravitas your eight year-old self can muster. "My anger is neither more or less than what right reason demands and is therefore perfectly justified." "Very clever of you to quote the Classics. Very droll. However, if you would be so kind as to leave us, I can begin dealing with your sister here. Go and get a dry change of clothes, then do as you wish for the rest of the afternoon." "As you wish, Mama." With a bow, you retreat out of the room and slide the screen door shut. The deathly silence that emanates from within the room is ominous, foreboding even, but hey, it's none of your business. Today is a good day. You've caught a thief, cleared your name, and if you're quick about it, there's still a handful of hours' worth of playtime in the day before the sun sets.
rows.translation: 你对着阿雅露出了牙齿。不可能。你不仅一次，而是反复地做了坏事，让别人背上了黑锅，被抓之后还试图用贿赂来摆脱困境。在这种情况下，我绝对不会放过你；你罪有应得。 这可把你妹妹惹毛了。当你把她从地窖里拖出来，往主屋方向走的时候，她一路上又是尖叫又是踢腿又是咬人，还拼命扭动身体。而你，却表现得比任何时候都要坚决——你用力把那个愤怒的小狐狸拖过大门，一路往楼上走去，因为你知道妈妈一定在那里。在这段漫长的旅程中，有好几双好奇的目光落在了你身上，但每个人都足够聪明，不会在“大姐”忙于自己的事情时去打扰她。 当然了，你也细心地把那个被咬了一口的苹果收进了口袋——上面还留着Aya的咬痕呢。 妈妈正在更衣室里整理她的和服，当你推开门把满身湿透的妹妹推进去时，她不禁皱起了眉头——妹妹简直就像一个被水浸透的毛球，头发和衣服都湿透了。你累坏了，妹妹也瘫倒在榻榻米上蜷缩着，这时你终于松了一口气，擦了擦额头。 纪夫，绫。我没想到你会这么快就回到家里，不过想来一定是发生了什么有趣的事情吧。我正打算去看看发生了什么，肯定有什么合理的解释吧。 哼，是的，妈妈。您说就是我在偷您把水果和蔬菜放进河里冷藏的东西，因为只有我知道怎么操作滑轮。我想，要想让您不再认为我是罪魁祸首，唯一的办法就是亲自抓住小偷，于是我就这么做了。这个愚蠢的艾亚根本没有用滑轮把箱子从水里拉到码头上，而是直接走进河里去取那些东西。 你有什么证据可以证明这一点吗？ 你默默地拿出那个被咬过的苹果，递给了母亲。她将苹果在手中翻来覆去，仔细观察苹果脆嫩果肉上那些牙印的形状，然后皱起了眉头，嘴唇也微微扭曲。她极其缓慢地低下头，看向了Aya，然后看。那让她吓得直发抖。 就是这个！这就是你一直以来试图模仿的那种眼神。你一定要仔细观察妈妈，学习她是怎么做的。 把一切都告诉我吧。 确实如此。从发现这些盗窃行为存在某种规律，到决定在仓库附近埋伏监视，再到最终当场抓住你那个调皮的小妹妹——你把发生的一切细节都告诉了妈妈。你不确定，对于一个八岁的孩子能够做到这些，妈妈是会更担心，还是会更感到惊讶。 那么你呢，阿雅？你有什么话可以为自己辩护吗？ 你的妹妹抽泣着，浑身发抖。 你不仅贪图享乐，把才能用在了偷窃这种小事上，还让我误判了你的姐姐……这让我感到比你想象中还要难过。我会处理你的后来私下里说，这个小坏蛋。 你麻烦大了。你快说话吧。凯罗斯大人教导我们，那些做坏事的人会积累负面的业力，而这些业力最终必定会得到报应。因此，你们不应该太过肆无忌惮地作恶。过多的负业力会在你最意想不到的时候反过来伤害你。现在改正还来得及，迟了就来不及了！ 母亲叹了口气。你没必要这么得意，小娟。 我是不是得意洋洋地”，你用自己八岁孩童所能拥有的全部严肃认真之情，郑重地宣告了这一点。我的愤怒完全符合理智的要求，因此是完全合理的。 你引用经典文献，真是太聪明了，也真是太有趣了。不过，如果你能离开的话，我就可以开始处理你妹妹的事情了。去换身干衣服吧，然后下午剩下的时间你想怎么过就怎么过。 如您所愿，妈妈。你鞠了一躬，然后退出房间，轻轻关上了纱门。房间里弥漫着的死一般的寂静显得十分诡异，甚至令人不寒而栗，不过，这毕竟与你无关。 今天真是幸运的一天——你抓到了小偷，洗清了自己的罪名，而且如果动作迅速的话，在太阳落山之前，你还有好几个小时可以继续玩游戏呢。
rows.raw: " You bare your teeth at Aya. "No way. You did a bad thing not just once but over and over again, caused someone else to be blamed, then when caught tried to bribe your way out of the situation. At this point, I'm not going to just not let you off; you deserve everything you're going to get." That sets your little sister off. She screams, kicks, bites and squirms every step of the way as you drag her out of the cellar storehouse and back towards the main cabin; your will is as resolute it's ever been as you haul a furious ball of fox fluff through the main door and up where you know Mother will be. Several pairs of curious eyes fall upon you throughout your long journey, but everyone's smart enough to not get in Big Sister's way when she's taking care of business. And of course, you've taken care to pocket the half-eaten apple, complete with Aya's bite marks still in it. Mother's in her dressing room, smoothing out her yukata, and she winces as you throw open the screen door and shove Aya in, a sodden ball of fur, hair and cloth. Exhausted, your little sister collapses on the tatami flooring and curls up, and you finally heave a sigh of relief and wipe your brow. "Kinu, Aya. I wasn't expecting you to be back in the house so soon, but I suppose something interesting has happened. And here I was, about to go see what all the ruckus was about. There ought to be a good explanation for this." "Hmph. Yes, Mama. You said I was the one who was stealing the fruit and veggies you put in the river to chill, since I was the only one who knew how to operate the pulley. I figured the only way to get you to stop believing I was the culprit was to catch the thief myself, so I did just that. Stupid Aya here wasn't using the pulley to get the boxes out of the water and onto the jetty; she was wading straight into the river to get at them." "You have proof of this?" Wordlessly, you pull out the gnawed apple and pass it to Mother. She turns it over in her hands, studying the pattern of the teeth marks in the fruit's crisp flesh, then furrows her brow and her lips twist. With painful slowness, she turns her gaze down to Aya and gives her a Look that sends her quailing. That's it! That's the gaze you've been trying to mimic all this time. You've got to watch Mother, learn how it's done. "Tell me everything." So you do. From figuring out there was a pattern to the thefts, to deciding to stake out the storehouse, to actually catching your bratty little sister in the act — you recount every detail of what happened to Mother. You're not sure if she looks more concerned or impressed that all this is coming from an eight year-old. "And you, Aya? Do you have anything to say in your defense?" Your little sister whimpers, shivering. "You haven't just been gluttonous enough to apply your talents to petty theft, you've also caused me to judge your elder sister in error — and that makes me more upset than you can imagine. I'll deal with you later in private, little vixen." "You're in so much trouble," you pipe up. "Lord Keros teaches that people who do wicked things gather bad karma, and it has to be paid back eventually. That's why you shouldn't make too much mischief. You accrue too much bad karma, and it comes back to bite you when you least expect it. Better now than later!" Mother sighs. "You don't have to gloat, Kinu." "I am not gloating," you declare with all the gravitas your eight year-old self can muster. "My anger is neither more or less than what right reason demands and is therefore perfectly justified." "Very clever of you to quote the Classics. Very droll. However, if you would be so kind as to leave us, I can begin dealing with your sister here. Go and get a dry change of clothes, then do as you wish for the rest of the afternoon." "As you wish, Mama." With a bow, you retreat out of the room and slide the screen door shut. The deathly silence that emanates from within the room is ominous, foreboding even, but hey, it's none of your business. Today is a good day. You've caught a thief, cleared your name, and if you're quick about it, there's still a handful of hours' worth of playtime in the day before the sun sets."

rows.original: No way you're letting your little sister off scot-free. She's caused enough trouble as it is.
rows.translation: 你绝对不能让你的妹妹逍遥法外。她已经惹了太多麻烦了。
rows.raw: "No way you're letting your little sister off scot-free. She's caused enough trouble as it is."

rows.original: You hold up your hands in mock terror. Oh no, what have you just created here? Kinu looks up at you innocently, all wide-eyed and pure fluffy goodness. "Only a kitsune with ideas, [kinu.Dad]. Something which Mama tells me is one of the most unpredictable forces known to exist." For good or for evil? "Both. But while we're still here... why don't you brush me for a bit while you wait for her to be ready to receive you? I've been trying to get at some awkward spots I can't quite reach, like behind my ears..."
rows.translation: 你假装害怕地举起了双手。哦不，你究竟在这里制造了什么啊？ 小娟天真无邪地抬头看着你，那双大眼睛里充满了纯真与可爱。只有那些富有创意的狐妖，才能 [kinu.Dad]妈妈告诉我的，这是已知最不可预测的力量之一。 是好事还是坏事呢？ 两个都可以。不过既然我们还在这里……等她准备好接待你的时候，你能不能帮我刷一下背啊？有些地方我实在够不着，比如耳朵后面……

rows.original: Sorry about that, but you've got to decline the offer. Maybe at another time, but after the conversation you've just had with her, it'd feel completely awkward. "Aww." Kinu's ears fold forward, and the little kitsune starts wringing her hands in the most deliberately adorable fashion. "Still, I can see where you're coming from, [kinu.Dad]." Maybe if she wants someone else to brush her, she shouldn't have a conversation about how she's going to use her appearance to manipulate others into doing her bidding just beforehand. There's a lot of wisdom out there that can't be gained by book learning, alas. You daughter pouts a little. "You're right, [kinu.Dad]. I feel a little wiser already. I've got to carefully consider my words and how they affect the context of the situation, lest I end up tripping myself on my own words later down the line. Why don't you go ahead into the house and have some fun with Mama? I think she's probably done cleaning up by now." Maybe you'll do just that. Kinu settle back to preening in front of the mirror as you step past her and let yourself into the cabin, following the hallway until you come to the familiar sight of the screen door to the sitting room. As you slide it open, you spy Kiyoko dusting the side cupboards and decorations, your kitsune wife looking over her shoulder at you as you enter. "Oh, [pc.name]. I was just about done... did I keep you waiting long? Some days I prefer to do the housework by hand, you know. For the experience." It's not a problem — Kinu kept you occupied for a bit. The two of you had a very interesting parent-child discussion back there, so much so that you almost lost track of time. "Is that so?" Smiling, Kiyoko gives you a bow, then sets away her duster and pulls out cushions for both of you at the low table. "I'll have to ask her about it later, no doubt. Well then, welcome back, [pc.name]; a visit from you always gladdens my heart. What can I do for you this time?"
rows.translation: 很抱歉，但你必须拒绝这个提议。也许改天再说吧，不过在你们刚刚进行的那次谈话之后，再接受的话会显得非常尴尬。 哎呀。小娟的耳朵向前耷拉下来，这只小狐妖开始以一种极其可爱、刻意营造出来的姿态扭动着自己的双手。不过，我确实理解你的立场。 [kinu.Dad]." 也许，如果她希望别人帮她刷牙，就不应该在之前就谈论自己将如何利用自己的外貌来操控别人，让别人按照自己的意愿行事。唉，有很多智慧是书本上学不到的。 你的女儿微微撅起了嘴。你说得对， [kinu.Dad]我觉得自己已经聪明了一些。现在我必须仔细考虑自己说的话，以及它们会对整个情境产生什么样的影响，这样才能避免日后因为自己的话而陷入麻烦。你为什么不进去屋里，和妈妈一起玩一会儿呢？我想她现在应该已经把家里收拾干净了。 也许你最终会那么做。当你从她身边走过，走进小屋时，小娟又重新开始在镜子前整理自己的毛发。你沿着走廊前行，很快便看到了那扇通往客厅的屏风门。当你推开门时，看到清子正在擦拭侧面的橱柜和装饰品，而你的那位狐妖妻子也在你进来的时候回头看了你一眼。 哦， [pc.name]我差不多快完成了……有没有让你等太久呢？有时候，我更喜欢用手来做家务，你知道的，就是为了那种体验。 这没什么问题——小娟确实让你暂时分心了。你们俩刚才进行了一场非常有趣的亲子对话，以至于你几乎忘记了时间。 是吗？基约科微笑着向你鞠了一躬，然后放下她的掸子，从矮桌旁拿出靠垫，为你们两人摆放好。我以后肯定得问她这件事。那么，欢迎回来 [pc.name]你的到访总是让我感到无比高兴。这次你能为我做些什么呢？

rows.translation: 你现在做这件事会感到不太自在。
rows.raw: "You don't feel comfortable doing this right now."

rows.original: You know, you just had a long talk with her about her future plans for manipulating people into doing her bidding, and here is, not-so-subtly suggesting that you go along with brushing her. Why, if she weren't your daughter, you might even consider refusing just to spite her for maneuvering you into this position. A grin. "So you'll do it." Yes, yes, you will. So, where does she need special attention? "Mostly behind my ears and near the base of my tail; those spots can be pretty hard to reach, especially when you've got arms like mine. Usually, Mama does those for me in the mornings and I pay her back the favor, but obviously I can't ask her for that when I'm gussying up out of doors. She'd get mad at me for moving the mirror outside." And you shouldn't? Kinu hops up onto her mother's rocking chair and nestles into it, shamelessly making herself comfortable. The chair is too big for her, but that just makes it all the more fun for your kitsune daughter. "Ehehe. Brush first, talk later?" Hmph, her mother's going to hear about this later, but fine. You take the stiff-bristled brush in one hand and the pot of herb oil in the other, then lightly dip the tip of the former into the latter. It takes a little smearing to get a nice, even sheen of oil on the brush, but Kinu is more than content to wait for you to get things done properly. Hair first, right? Kinu giggles and bows her head. You daughter reaches behind her head and undoes the string that holds her braid together, whipping it away with a flourish; her hair is so smooth and silken that she barely needs to tug in order to unravel it, cascading behind her in a white fan. "Hair first." Mm-hm. You start from the top, running the brush through the length of Kinu's hair, the bristles leaving a thin coating of the pungent oil in their wake. Your daughter makes happy fox-like noises in the back of her throat as she watches you in the mirror, working away from top to bottom; even though she protests that her hair gets all tangled from playing outside, you can't help but feel that there's barely any resistance here as you rake the comb through her blue-tipped locks. "Remember to get the spots I can't reach myself, [kinu.Dad]." Yes, yes. You move in the brush a bit and massage away at Kinu's scalp, right behind her fluffy, triangular ears. It doesn't take too long to get those sorted out, the fuzz on their backs rapidly gaining a soft, rainbow sheen of oil on them in the sunlight. "Ehe, this feels pretty nice. You should feel honored to be able to do my hair while I'm still young, [kinu.Dad]. Later on when everyone wants to feel how lovely and sleek I am, you'll be able to say you and Mama were the first ones to do my hair and fur!" She really is getting quite full of herself, isn't she? A few more strokes with the brush, and you think you're done here; Kinu takes such impeccable care of her hair that there's not really much you can improve on. There're a few strands of white hair stuck to the brush; you flick those away before circling behind your daughter to start work on her three tails - — If you could get them to stay still, that is. Like Kinu's ears, they seem to have a mind of their own and don't always obey her completely — that, or your mischievous daughter is toying with you. They're so hard to get ahold of and enjoy flicking away at the last moment, and when you do get a grip on them they have a tendency to just flow through your fingers, leaving you grasping at empty air. Eventually, though, you manage to pin one of them down and get to work, gliding the brush through your daughter's tail from base to tip. You're rather impressed — like her hair, Kinu's tails are quite luxuriously cared for, with no serious snarls or tangles for you to comb out. Seriously, why did she need you to do this, anyway? Maybe she just likes the attention of having someone else brush her. As you continue stroking Kinu with the brush and oiling up her fur, you compliment your daughter on how much care she obviously takes in looking after herself. Kinu sniffs. "I learned early on that if I let my tails get too messy, then it becomes pretty hard to brush them out afterwards... also, it hurts, and Mama would kill me for being a disgrace to all kitsune. Gotta live up to my name, after all — silk isn't of much use if you let it get all tattered and stained." One tail, two tails, three tails. Brushing them would have been much quicker if they could just stay in one place without flicking away, but admittedly would also be a lot less fun. You brush and brush and brush away, working up a sweat as you pin down each silvery-white tail and remove the loose hairs, leaving a lovely, radiant glow in their wake. Huddled in her mother's rocking chair, Kinu has gone all dreamy and starry-eyed, barely able to sit upright and on the verge of melting into a limp puddle of foxy fur. "You two look like you're having fun." Standing over the two of you is Kiyoko, an apron [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3|tied over the gentle swell of her bump|draped over her massive, kit-swollen belly|tied about her waist]. A smile playing on her lips, she looks to Kinu, then to you, then back to Kinu again. Your daughter squirms a bit, trying to compose herself in her mother's presence, then gives up and slumps back in the rocking chair, unable to even look the slightest bit ashamed at being one step away from being a foxy fur rug on the floor. "Ehe. Hi, Mama?" "Oh dear. I see you've managed to rope your poor [pc.mf|father|mother] into brushing you. Look, sooner or later you'll have to learn how to do it yourself properly — someday you're going to have to move out and start up your own den, you know. I swear on Keros' name, I have to go dust the house for one morning and..." she shakes her head as her voice trails off. Well, she was doing her own fur when you entered the scene. Besides, you weren't just brushing Kinu — you also had an important conversation about her future ambitions. Kiyoko sighs and rolls her eyes. "[pc.name], I'm starting to think that I may be the only person in existence who isn't at least somewhat susceptible to our lovely daughter's antics. Can you imagine what it's going to be like for her outside of the Astral Plane, being constantly showered with attention from other people, let alone trying to wring it from them?" Oh, yes. That's why the two of you had that talk. "I can guess what it was about. All right then, young lady, I'm going to have to steal your [pc.mf|father|mother] away from you. You move that mirror back into the house, put the brush and oil back where they belong, and go and round up your siblings for your lessons. I'll see you at mealtime." "Ehe... okay, Mama." It takes her a few tries, but Kinu eventually manages to get out of the rocking chair, wobbling on unsteady legs. As you watch, the little kitsune shakes herself from head to toe, floofing out her fur like the duster Kiyoko's currently holding, a dreamy smile on her face. Practically giddy with excitement, Kinu stumbles foward and gives her mother a big hug, arms and tails curling about Kiyoko's leg as she makes a happy yipping noise in the back of her throat. "Having [kinu.Dad] brush me was great. I'm even prettier now, can't you see?" Kiyoko looks unimpressed, her lips set into a thin, straight line. "Oh, child, what am I going to do with you? Braid your hair back up and hop to it already." Without waiting for a reply, Kiyoko grabs you by the arm — you have just enough time to let go of the brush and hear it clatter to the floor before she's swept you indoors. Once the door's safely shut behind you, Kiyoko undoes her apron and hangs it up on the wall alongside the duster, then begins a slow walk towards the sitting room.
rows.translation: 你知道吧，你刚刚和她长谈了很久，讨论她未来如何利用别人来达到自己的目的，而现在她却如此直白地暗示你应该配合她去刷牙。哎，如果她不是你的女儿，你甚至可能会考虑拒绝，就为了气她，因为是她把你逼到了这个境地。 他咧嘴笑了。所以你最终还是决定要这么做。 是的，你一定能做到。那么，她在哪些方面需要特别的关注呢？ 主要是在我的耳朵后面以及尾巴根部附近；那些地方其实很难够到，尤其是像我这样的手臂长度的话。通常情况下，妈妈会在早上帮我处理这些部位，而我会反过来帮她做同样的事情作为回报。不过，当我要在外面打扮的时候，显然就不能麻烦她了——如果我把镜子拿到外面去，她肯定会生我的气的。 那你为什么不应该这么做呢？ 小娟跳上她母亲的摇椅，舒舒服服地窝了进去，毫不客气地享受着这份惬意。这把椅子对她来说实在太大了，但正因为如此，你的九尾狐女儿才会觉得更加有趣吧。呵呵，先刷牙吧，然后再聊天？ 哼，她妈妈以后肯定会知道这件事的，不过也没关系。你一只手拿那把硬毛刷，另一只手拿着那罐草药油，然后轻轻地将刷子的尖端浸入油中。需要稍微涂抹几下，才能让刷子上均匀地覆盖上一层油膜，不过小娟完全愿意等你把这件事做好。 头发先理，对吧？ 小娟轻笑着低下了头。你的女儿伸手到自己脑后，解开了固定发辫的绳子，然后潇洒地甩开了那束头发；她的头发如此顺滑、丝般柔美，几乎不需要用力就能散开，它们像一把白色的扇子一样从她身后飘洒下来。先理头发。 嗯，你从发梢开始，用梳子将梳子从小娟的头发中穿过，梳齿会在她的头发上留下一层淡淡的辛辣油渍。你的女儿在镜子前看着你从上到下地梳理她的头发，同时发出类似快乐狐妖般的叫声；尽管她抱怨说在户外玩耍后她的头发会缠在一起，但当你用梳子梳理她那蓝色的发丝时，你几乎感觉不到她有任何抵触。 记得去拿那些我自己够不到的地方的东西啊。 [kinu.Dad]." 是的，没错。你需要在她的毛发中轻轻移动手指，然后按摩她头部的皮肤，就在她那蓬松的三角形耳朵后面。这样操作不会花费太长时间，它们背部的绒毛在阳光下会迅速被一层柔软的、带有彩虹色的油脂覆盖起来。 呵呵，这种感觉还挺不错的。能在我还年轻的时候为我梳头发，你应该感到荣幸才对。 [kinu.Dad]等以后大家都想看看我到底有多可爱、多漂亮的时候，你们就可以说，是你们和妈妈最先为我的毛发和外表进行打理的哦！ 她真是越来越自以为是了，不是吗？再刷几下笔，你就觉得自己已经把头发弄得完美无缺了；小娟对女儿的头发护理得如此细致，实在没什么可以再改进的地方了。不过刷子上粘着几根白头发，你把它们弹掉，然后绕到女儿身后，开始为她梳理那三条辫子吧—— — 如果你能让它们保持静止的话……就像小娟的耳朵一样，它们似乎有自己的意志，并不总是完全听她的指挥——或者，可能是你那个调皮的女儿在捉弄你。这些东西实在太难捉住了，总是在最后一刻突然逃走；而当你终于抓住它们的时候，它们又会从你的手指间滑溜而过，让你只能徒劳地抓住空气。 不过，最终你还是成功抓住其中一根尾巴，开始认真地梳理起来，用刷子从尾巴的根部一直刷到尖端。你感到相当惊讶——就像她的一头头发一样，小娟的尾巴也得到了精心照料，没有任何打结或缠结的地方需要你去梳理。说真的，她究竟为什么非得让你来做这件事呢？也许她只是喜欢别人帮她梳理毛发时带来的那种关注感吧。当你继续用刷子和油为小娟梳理毛发、滋润它的皮毛时，你不禁称赞女儿：她显然非常用心地在照顾自己。 小娟嗅了嗅空气。我很早就明白了，如果让自己的尾巴变得太乱，之后就很难把它们梳理整齐了……而且，那样会很疼，妈妈会因为我给所有狐族带来耻辱而杀了我的。毕竟，我必须不辜负自己的名字——如果让丝绸变得破破烂烂、满是污渍，那它就毫无用了。 一条尾巴、两条尾巴、三条尾巴。如果这些尾巴能固定在一个地方而不乱晃动，梳理它们的速度肯定会快很多，不过说实话，那样的场景也会显得少了很多趣味性。有趣你一遍又一遍地刷洗，汗水不断地流淌着，你仔细地清理每一根银白色的尾巴，去除那些松散的毛发，最终让它们焕发出美丽而耀眼的光泽。而坐在母亲摇椅里的小娟，则完全沉浸在幻想之中，双眼充满憧憬，几乎无法坐直身体，整个人仿佛都要融化成一滩柔软的狐妖毛茸茸的液体一般。 你们两个看起来玩得挺开心啊。 站在你们两人面前的，是一位戴着围裙的清子。 [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3|随着她腹部微微隆起的节奏而轻轻晃动|覆盖在她那因怀孕而明显隆起的腹部上|系在她的腰上]她嘴角带着一丝微笑，先看了看小娟，又转向你，然后又把目光转回到小娟身上。你的女儿有些坐立不安，在母亲的注视下努力保持镇定，但最终还是放弃了，瘫软在摇椅里，甚至没有丝毫因为自己差点变成地上的一块毛茸茸的毯子而感到羞愧。 嘿嘿，妈妈，你在吗？ 哦天哪，我看你终于把你的那位可怜 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲] 我得去打扫房子了……听着，迟早你都得学会自己好好打扫——总有一天你得搬出去，自己建立一个属于你的“小窝”，你知道的。我以凯罗斯的名字发誓，我真得花一个早上来打扫房子……她摇了摇头，声音渐渐低了下去。 嗯，她是你刚进入场景时，她正在忙自己的事情呢。而且，你本来也不该打扰她。只是在梳理小娟的相关事务时，你们还就她未来的发展目标进行了一次重要的谈话。 清子叹了口气，翻了个白眼。"[pc.name]我开始怀疑，或许我是这个世界上唯一一个连这点都没有做到的人有点儿我们可爱的女儿总是喜欢搞些恶作剧，大家能想象吗？当她离开星界之后，周围的人会不断地关注她、讨好她，她该会是什么感受呢？更何况，她还得努力去争取这些关注才行…… 哦，对了。这就是你们俩进行那次谈话的原因。 我大概能猜到是关于什么的事情。好吧，年轻女士，那我恐怕得‘偷走’你的 [pc.mf|父亲|母亲] 离你远点。把那面镜子放回屋里，把画笔和油画颜料放回该放的地方，然后去把你的兄弟姐妹叫过来一起上课。饭点的时候见。 呵呵……好吧，妈妈。经过几次尝试，小娟终于从摇椅上爬了下来，双腿还不太稳。你看着她，这只小狐妖从头到脚抖了抖身子，身上的毛茸茸的毛发就像清子手中拿着的那把扫帚一样散开开来，她的脸上露出了梦幻般的微笑。兴奋得几乎站不稳的小娟跌跌撞撞地走上前，紧紧抱住了她的母亲，她的手臂和尾巴都缠在了清子的腿上，同时她还从喉咙深处发出欢快的叫声。拥有 [kinu.Dad] 给我化妆真是太棒了！我现在看起来漂亮多了，你难道看不出来吗？ 清子显得毫不感兴趣，她的嘴唇紧抿成一条细长的直线。哦，孩子，我该拿你怎么办呢？快把头发扎起来，然后开始吧。 不等你回应，清子就抓住了你的手臂——你还有足够的时间放开画笔，听到它掉在地板上的声响，随后她便将你拉进了屋里。门被关上后，清子解下了围裙，把它挂在墙上，与抹布放在一起，然后缓步走向客厅。
rows.raw: " You know, you just had a long talk with her about her future plans for manipulating people into doing her bidding, and here is, not-so-subtly suggesting that you go along with brushing her. Why, if she weren't your daughter, you might even consider refusing just to spite her for maneuvering you into this position. A grin. "So you'll do it." Yes, yes, you will. So, where does she need special attention? "Mostly behind my ears and near the base of my tail; those spots can be pretty hard to reach, especially when you've got arms like mine. Usually, Mama does those for me in the mornings and I pay her back the favor, but obviously I can't ask her for that when I'm gussying up out of doors. She'd get mad at me for moving the mirror outside." And you shouldn't? Kinu hops up onto her mother's rocking chair and nestles into it, shamelessly making herself comfortable. The chair is too big for her, but that just makes it all the more fun for your kitsune daughter. "Ehehe. Brush first, talk later?" Hmph, her mother's going to hear about this later, but fine. You take the stiff-bristled brush in one hand and the pot of herb oil in the other, then lightly dip the tip of the former into the latter. It takes a little smearing to get a nice, even sheen of oil on the brush, but Kinu is more than content to wait for you to get things done properly. Hair first, right? Kinu giggles and bows her head. You daughter reaches behind her head and undoes the string that holds her braid together, whipping it away with a flourish; her hair is so smooth and silken that she barely needs to tug in order to unravel it, cascading behind her in a white fan. "Hair first." Mm-hm. You start from the top, running the brush through the length of Kinu's hair, the bristles leaving a thin coating of the pungent oil in their wake. Your daughter makes happy fox-like noises in the back of her throat as she watches you in the mirror, working away from top to bottom; even though she protests that her hair gets all tangled from playing outside, you can't help but feel that there's barely any resistance here as you rake the comb through her blue-tipped locks. "Remember to get the spots I can't reach myself, [kinu.Dad]." Yes, yes. You move in the brush a bit and massage away at Kinu's scalp, right behind her fluffy, triangular ears. It doesn't take too long to get those sorted out, the fuzz on their backs rapidly gaining a soft, rainbow sheen of oil on them in the sunlight. "Ehe, this feels pretty nice. You should feel honored to be able to do my hair while I'm still young, [kinu.Dad]. Later on when everyone wants to feel how lovely and sleek I am, you'll be able to say you and Mama were the first ones to do my hair and fur!" She really is getting quite full of herself, isn't she? A few more strokes with the brush, and you think you're done here; Kinu takes such impeccable care of her hair that there's not really much you can improve on. There're a few strands of white hair stuck to the brush; you flick those away before circling behind your daughter to start work on her three tails - — If you could get them to stay still, that is. Like Kinu's ears, they seem to have a mind of their own and don't always obey her completely — that, or your mischievous daughter is toying with you. They're so hard to get ahold of and enjoy flicking away at the last moment, and when you do get a grip on them they have a tendency to just flow through your fingers, leaving you grasping at empty air. Eventually, though, you manage to pin one of them down and get to work, gliding the brush through your daughter's tail from base to tip. You're rather impressed — like her hair, Kinu's tails are quite luxuriously cared for, with no serious snarls or tangles for you to comb out. Seriously, why did she need you to do this, anyway? Maybe she just likes the attention of having someone else brush her. As you continue stroking Kinu with the brush and oiling up her fur, you compliment your daughter on how much care she obviously takes in looking after herself. Kinu sniffs. "I learned early on that if I let my tails get too messy, then it becomes pretty hard to brush them out afterwards... also, it hurts, and Mama would kill me for being a disgrace to all kitsune. Gotta live up to my name, after all — silk isn't of much use if you let it get all tattered and stained." One tail, two tails, three tails. Brushing them would have been much quicker if they could just stay in one place without flicking away, but admittedly would also be a lot less fun. You brush and brush and brush away, working up a sweat as you pin down each silvery-white tail and remove the loose hairs, leaving a lovely, radiant glow in their wake. Huddled in her mother's rocking chair, Kinu has gone all dreamy and starry-eyed, barely able to sit upright and on the verge of melting into a limp puddle of foxy fur. "You two look like you're having fun." Standing over the two of you is Kiyoko, an apron [kiyoko.pregStage 1 3|tied over the gentle swell of her bump|draped over her massive, kit-swollen belly|tied about her waist]. A smile playing on her lips, she looks to Kinu, then to you, then back to Kinu again. Your daughter squirms a bit, trying to compose herself in her mother's presence, then gives up and slumps back in the rocking chair, unable to even look the slightest bit ashamed at being one step away from being a foxy fur rug on the floor. "Ehe. Hi, Mama?" "Oh dear. I see you've managed to rope your poor [pc.mf|father|mother] into brushing you. Look, sooner or later you'll have to learn how to do it yourself properly — someday you're going to have to move out and start up your own den, you know. I swear on Keros' name, I have to go dust the house for one morning and..." she shakes her head as her voice trails off. Well, she was doing her own fur when you entered the scene. Besides, you weren't just brushing Kinu — you also had an important conversation about her future ambitions. Kiyoko sighs and rolls her eyes. "[pc.name], I'm starting to think that I may be the only person in existence who isn't at least somewhat susceptible to our lovely daughter's antics. Can you imagine what it's going to be like for her outside of the Astral Plane, being constantly showered with attention from other people, let alone trying to wring it from them?" Oh, yes. That's why the two of you had that talk. "I can guess what it was about. All right then, young lady, I'm going to have to steal your [pc.mf|father|mother] away from you. You move that mirror back into the house, put the brush and oil back where they belong, and go and round up your siblings for your lessons. I'll see you at mealtime." "Ehe... okay, Mama." It takes her a few tries, but Kinu eventually manages to get out of the rocking chair, wobbling on unsteady legs. As you watch, the little kitsune shakes herself from head to toe, floofing out her fur like the duster Kiyoko's currently holding, a dreamy smile on her face. Practically giddy with excitement, Kinu stumbles foward and gives her mother a big hug, arms and tails curling about Kiyoko's leg as she makes a happy yipping noise in the back of her throat. "Having [kinu.Dad] brush me was great. I'm even prettier now, can't you see?" Kiyoko looks unimpressed, her lips set into a thin, straight line. "Oh, child, what am I going to do with you? Braid your hair back up and hop to it already." Without waiting for a reply, Kiyoko grabs you by the arm — you have just enough time to let go of the brush and hear it clatter to the floor before she's swept you indoors. Once the door's safely shut behind you, Kiyoko undoes her apron and hangs it up on the wall alongside the duster, then begins a slow walk towards the sitting room."

rows.original: "That girl's really something, isn't she?" Kinu... well... knows what she wants and has a plan to get it, yes. Problem is, you can think of a dozen different unforeseen circumstances preventing her from coasting along through life on her good looks, especially in the outside world... plus, you've tried to tell her less is more when it comes to laying on the charm, but whether she took the lesson to heart is another matter. Kiyoko sighs and pinches the bridge of her nose. "That's about the long and short of it. Sometimes, being gifted isn't actually better for you — one needs proper setbacks in order to be able to learn and grow." The two of you share a look and walk in silence for a moment. "After all, if you know enough to get the job done all the time, why bother learning any more? Now we know that isn't true, but I don't think our daughter is wise enough to figure that out for herself. I can only hope I'm doing a decent job as a mother with the resources I have," Kiyoko says at last as the corridor opens out into the sitting room. You take up your usual spot at the low table, and she goes through the little ritual of serving up the tea and candies. "But enough of the heavy talk. To what do I owe the honor of your visit, [pc.name]?"
rows.translation: 那个女孩真的挺特别的，不是吗？ 小娟……她很清楚自己想要什么，也有了实现目标的计划，这一点没错。问题在于，生活中总会有许多意想不到的变故，这些变故会阻碍她仅仅依靠自己的美貌来顺利度过人生，尤其是在外面的世界……另外，你也试着告诉她，在施展魅力时，少即是多，但她是否真正记住了这个道理，那就另当别论了。 清子叹了口气，捏了捏自己的鼻梁。大致就是这么回事。有时候，天赋其实并不会对你带来好处——人需要经历适当的挫折，才能真正学会成长。 你们两人对视了一眼，然后沉默地走了一会儿。 毕竟，如果你的知识足以让你一直完成工作，那为什么还要继续学习呢？现在我们知道了事实并非如此，但我认为我们的女儿还不够聪明，无法自己意识到这一点。我只能希望，以我现有的能力，我能够尽到一个好母亲的责任。当走廊通向客厅时，清子终于开口说道。你像往常一样坐在那张矮桌旁，而她则开始进行那套准备茶水和糖果的惯例动作。不过，这些严肃的话题就到此为止吧。我究竟有什么功劳，让您专程前来拜访我呢？ [pc.name]?"

rows.original: Why not? If she wants to be brushed, then let her be brushed!
rows.translation: 为什么不呢？如果她想让人给她梳头发，那就让她梳吧！
rows.raw: "Why not? If she wants to be brushed, then let her be brushed!"

rows.original: As you approach the hilltop and step into the shade of the giant cherry blossom tree, you spy movement by one of the tables, not too far away from the path to the springs. Kiyoko? No, the silhouette's too short to be her. One of the kits? Only one way to find out. The sight that greets you as you approach is a curious one: Kinu has managed to lug a wooden-framed full-body mirror all the way out here, having propped it up against the parasol so she can admire herself in it. As you watch, your foxy daughter does a little twirl in front of the mirror, her silken clothes flowing in her wake; when she finally stops, she looks very, very pleased with herself. Hello, what's going on here? "[kinu.Dad]! You didn't see that, did you? Um, no, I guess you must have." Kinu's large ears swivel in your direction, followed shortly by the rest of her. Your foxy daughter pauses a moment, her three tails twitching behind her, then overcomes her bashfulness and clears her throat. "I'm just, um, making sure I look great today." Yes, but why is she doing it outside the house? You note the long-handled brush and uncovered pot of strong-smelling oil balanced on one of the railings, and shake your head. If she's going to be gussying up, it would be better served being done indoors, right? "Ehe. Look, [kinu.Dad]." With that, little Kinu steps out into the sunlight. The change that ensues is subtle, but impressive — as the warm glow of the sun hits her white fur, it practically gleams with dazzling brilliance, lovely and lustrous. Her hair is much the same, the blue tips glowing with a mysterious allure, and even her three silvery-white tails are highlighted with the myriad colors of the rainbow as the light strikes them. A big smile on her face, Kinu raises her face to the sun, eyes closed and arms spread out as she drinks in the warmth, then shakes herself all over, fluffing out her fur before she turns her gaze back to you. "See what I mean? That's why I need to be outside for this." Oh yes, you do see what she means. "Mama's herb oil is amazing, isn't it? She's told me stories about my great-grandmother, who came up with the stuff," Kinu pipes up. "Apparently, she took good care of herself and was exceedingly beautiful, even by kitsune standards. Between all the work and study Mama throws at me and finding time enough to play, I don't get to do this sort of thing very often, but when I do get the time to brush myself all over for hours on end... ehehe..." Mm-hm. "I just feel so splendid and so good afterwards. It makes me want to be refined like Mama is... I'm going to be drop-dead gorgeous when I get older, and everyone will be falling over themselves to do what I want!" Hmm. On one hand, it looks like Kinu is developing a serious case of vanity. On the other... well, it's hard to argue that she doesn't deserve as much for working so hard towards that end. Which approach are you going to take with your daughter here?
rows.translation: 当你接近山顶，走进那棵巨大的樱花树的荫蔽之下时，你注意到在通往泉水的小路不远处的一张桌子旁有人正在活动。是清子吗？不，那个身影太矮了，不可能是她。这些装备中有一件吗？只有一个办法才能知道。 当你靠近时，映入眼帘的景象实在有些奇特：小娟竟然设法把一面木框制成的全身镜带到了这里，她还把镜子靠在遮阳伞上，这样就可以欣赏自己的模样了。当你看着的时候，你那个狡黠的女儿在镜子前转了个小圈，她那丝滑的衣服在身后飘动；当她终于停下来时，她看起来对自己非常非常满意。 喂，这里发生了什么？ "[kinu.Dad]! 你没看到那个吧？嗯，应该吧，你肯定看到了。纪奴的大耳朵立刻转向你的方向，不久之后，她的身体其他部分也跟着转了过来。你那机灵的女儿停顿了片刻，她那三条尾巴在身后微微晃动，然后她克服了羞涩，清了清嗓子。我只是，嗯，想确保自己今天看起来很漂亮而已。 是的，但为什么她要在室外做这些呢？你注意到那把长柄刷子，还有那个装着气味浓重的油的罐子，它们被放在栏杆上，你不禁摇了摇头。如果她真的打算好好打扮一番的话，室内环境不是更合适吗？ 嘿嘿，看啊， [kinu.Dad]." 就这样，小小娟走到了阳光下。随之发生的变化虽然细微，但却十分引人注目——当阳光照射在她白色的毛皮上时，那些毛皮仿佛闪耀着耀眼的光芒，显得既美丽又富有光泽。她的毛发也是如此，蓝色的毛尖散发着神秘而迷人的光芒；而她那三条银白色的尾巴，在阳光的照射下，更是呈现出彩虹般的绚丽色彩。小娟脸上洋溢着灿烂的笑容，她仰起脸迎向阳光，闭上双眼，双臂张开，尽情享受着这份温暖。随后，她轻轻摇晃身体，让自己的毛发变得蓬松柔软，然后再将目光转向你。 明白我的意思吧？正因为如此，我需要到外面去处理这件事。 哦，对了，你。做明白她的意思了吧。 妈妈的草药油真是太神奇了，对吧？她给我讲过关于我曾祖母的故事，正是她发明了这种草药油的。小娟开口说道。显然，她很注重自己的保养，即便以狐族的标准来看，她也依然美得惊人。由于妈妈总是给我安排各种各样的工作和学习任务，我几乎没什么时间来打理自己，所以像这样花几个小时精心打扮自己的机会实在不多……不过，每当有这样的机会时，我就会尽情享受这个过程，嘿嘿…… 嗯。 我只是觉得自己棒极了，简直不错以后啊，我也要像妈妈那样变得优雅动人……等我长大了，一定会变得美得令人倾倒，到时候所有人都会争先恐后地满足我的任何要求！ 嗯，一方面来看，小娟似乎有点过于追求虚荣了。但另一方面……嗯，也确实很难否认，她为达到这个目标付出了如此多的努力，因此她理应得到这些。 那么，对于你的女儿，你打算采取什么样的态度呢？
rows.raw: " As you approach the hilltop and step into the shade of the giant cherry blossom tree, you spy movement by one of the tables, not too far away from the path to the springs. Kiyoko? No, the silhouette's too short to be her. One of the kits? Only one way to find out. The sight that greets you as you approach is a curious one: Kinu has managed to lug a wooden-framed full-body mirror all the way out here, having propped it up against the parasol so she can admire herself in it. As you watch, your foxy daughter does a little twirl in front of the mirror, her silken clothes flowing in her wake; when she finally stops, she looks very, very pleased with herself. Hello, what's going on here? "[kinu.Dad]! You didn't see that, did you? Um, no, I guess you must have." Kinu's large ears swivel in your direction, followed shortly by the rest of her. Your foxy daughter pauses a moment, her three tails twitching behind her, then overcomes her bashfulness and clears her throat. "I'm just, um, making sure I look great today." Yes, but why is she doing it outside the house? You note the long-handled brush and uncovered pot of strong-smelling oil balanced on one of the railings, and shake your head. If she's going to be gussying up, it would be better served being done indoors, right? "Ehe. Look, [kinu.Dad]." With that, little Kinu steps out into the sunlight. The change that ensues is subtle, but impressive — as the warm glow of the sun hits her white fur, it practically gleams with dazzling brilliance, lovely and lustrous. Her hair is much the same, the blue tips glowing with a mysterious allure, and even her three silvery-white tails are highlighted with the myriad colors of the rainbow as the light strikes them. A big smile on her face, Kinu raises her face to the sun, eyes closed and arms spread out as she drinks in the warmth, then shakes herself all over, fluffing out her fur before she turns her gaze back to you. "See what I mean? That's why I need to be outside for this." Oh yes, you do see what she means. "Mama's herb oil is amazing, isn't it? She's told me stories about my great-grandmother, who came up with the stuff," Kinu pipes up. "Apparently, she took good care of herself and was exceedingly beautiful, even by kitsune standards. Between all the work and study Mama throws at me and finding time enough to play, I don't get to do this sort of thing very often, but when I do get the time to brush myself all over for hours on end... ehehe..." Mm-hm. "I just feel so splendid and so good afterwards. It makes me want to be refined like Mama is... I'm going to be drop-dead gorgeous when I get older, and everyone will be falling over themselves to do what I want!" Hmm. On one hand, it looks like Kinu is developing a serious case of vanity. On the other... well, it's hard to argue that she doesn't deserve as much for working so hard towards that end. Which approach are you going to take with your daughter here?"

rows.original: You smile down at Kinu and tell her that she's amazingly cute, but she shouldn't rest on her laurels. Instead, she should work harder to be elegant and beautiful when she grows up. Looking her best isn't just about glossy fur and being alluringly lithe like her mother is — something as simple as proper posture and standing up straight can add greatly to her charm, if she just puts in the effort. Simple attraction can grab attention, but she's got to have style if she wants to hold and command it. Your daughter considers this. "Hmm..." Oh, there's no doubt that she's going to grow into an exquisite young woman, but one can always do better, right? Her ancestors took the trouble to hand this gift all the way down to her in the blood, after all. Your kitsune daughter looks up at you with starry eyes, a stupid, dreamy smile plastered all over her face. Her hands are clasped under her chin, a deep blush spreading out across her cheeks as she practically preens at the praise you've given her. "Ehe, stop the flattery, [kinu.Dad]. Well, I suppose it can't be helped; if I've been given a talent, I'm obliged to develop it to its fullest. I'm going to be so elegant and pretty when I grow up... aaaah, it has to be some kind of terrible sin to be as beautiful as I will be when I'm older, right?" She'd have to ask her mother about that; [pc.bg acolyte|while you were trained in the ways of the Seven during your time as an acolyte, the theological stance on beauty — and Keros' opinions on it in particular — was rather esoteric knowledge. Everyone knew Mallach's teachings on the subject, of course, but that's about where it ended.|you don't know very much about theology, definitely not enough to say either way.] "Ehehe. Any advice you might have, [kinu.Dad]?" It's about deception, sleight of hand and leaving imagination to fill in the blanks. Less is more — sometimes, leaving things hidden is far more effective than flaunting them openly, and yet being full and up in someone's face can be more effective in others. Reading the context of the situation is important, as is knowing her audience. You're not too sure about the kind of fashion sense kitsune have, so you'll leave that part to her mother. [pc.bg courtesan| Then, of course, there're the kinds of tricks you learned during your time as a courtesan — most aren't the sort you'd want to tell your daughter, but a good number relating to looking and acting one's best can be properly sanitised, and it's these that you relate to Kinu. She listens in rapt fascination, clearly taking meticulous notes in that dangerous mind of hers. ] Kinu giggles impishly. "I see where you're going with this, [kinu.Dad], and I'll consider it deeply. Very deeply." There's a good girl. Remember, physical attractiveness is only one part of charm. She's got to be all-rounded if she's going to be a killer of a vixen down the road. Your kitsune daughter gazes up at you, a glamorous glint in her eyes to match the trembling smile on her lips. "Eeheehee. I'm going to have so much fun when I'm older. The boys are going to want me. The girls are going to want to be me. And some of those are going to want me anyways, if they aren't too busy spitting bile from being so jealous. This is going to be great."
rows.translation: 你微笑着看着小娟，告诉她她真的非常可爱，但她不应该因此而满足于现状。相反，她应该更加努力，让自己在长大后变得更加优雅和美丽。展现出最好的自己，并不仅仅意味着要拥有光滑的毛发或像她母亲那样身形柔美动人——只要她愿意付出努力，正确的姿势和挺直的站姿同样能够大大提升她的魅力。简单的吸引力固然能够吸引人们的注意，但更重要的是……她还需要拥有更多的东西。风格如果她想要掌握并控制它的话。 你的女儿正在考虑这件事。嗯…… 哦，毫无疑问，她一定会成长为一位优雅的年轻女性，但人总是可以做得更好的，对吧？毕竟，她的祖先们费了很大心思，通过血脉将这份礼物传给了她。 你的九尾狐女儿用充满星辰般光芒的眼睛望着你，脸上挂着傻乎乎的、充满憧憬的笑容。她双手托着下巴，脸颊上渐渐浮现出红晕，仿佛在享受你对她所给予的赞美。呵呵，别再拍马屁了。 [kinu.Dad]嗯，我想这也是没办法的事吧；既然上天赋予了我这样的天赋，我就有责任将其充分发挥出来。等我长大后，一定会变得非常优雅和漂亮……啊，等到我真正变美的时候，那肯定是一种极其严重的罪过吧？对吧？ 她得去问她妈妈这个问题。 [pc.bg acolyte|虽然你在担任学徒期间接受了关于“七圣”教义的培训，但关于美的神学观点——尤其是凯罗斯对此的看法——其实属于较为深奥的知识范畴。当然，大家都了解马拉赫在这方面的教导，但也就仅此而已了。|你对神学了解得并不多，显然还不足以做出任何结论。] 嘿嘿，你有没有什么建议呢？ [kinu.Dad]?" 这关乎欺骗、巧妙的手段，以及让读者用自己的想象力去填补那些空白。少即是多——有时候，隐藏某些信息远比公然展示它们更有效；而对于另一些人来说，将这些信息直接呈现在他们面前反而会达到更好的效果。理解具体的情境背景非常重要，同时也要清楚你的目标受众是谁。由于你不太清楚狐妖们究竟有什么样的时尚品味，所以这部分内容就留给它们的母亲来处理吧。 [pc.bg courtesan| 当然，还有那些你在担任交际花期间学到的技巧——其中大多数恐怕都不适合告诉你的女儿，但有不少关于如何让自己看起来更漂亮、行为更得体的技巧，是完全可以改头换面后传授给她的。而你正是把这些技巧告诉了小娟。她听得入迷极了，显然也在她那敏锐的头脑中仔细地记下了这些内容。 ] 纪久顽皮地笑了起来。我明白你的意思了 [kinu.Dad]我会认真考虑的。非常认真地考虑。 有个好女孩。记住，外貌吸引力只是魅力的其中一部分。如果她想将来成为一个真正迷人的女性，就必须全面发展。 你的九尾狐女儿正仰望着你，她的眼中闪烁着迷人的光芒，嘴角也挂着微微的笑意。嘻嘻嘻，等我长大了肯定会有很多乐趣的。男孩子们都会喜欢我，女孩子们也都想变成我……而且有些那些不管他们是不是因为嫉妒而气得牙根发酸，反正他们还是会需要我的。这件事肯定会发生。很棒."

rows.original: Praise Kinu and tell her to keep up the good effort. Even with a natural advantage, she's going to have her work cut out for her if she's aiming to be a stunner when she grows up.
rows.translation: 表扬小娟，告诉她要继续保持这样的努力。即使她拥有天生的优势，但如果她立志将来成为一名出色的模特，她仍然需要付出很多努力。
rows.raw: "Praise Kinu and tell her to keep up the good effort. Even with a natural advantage, she's going to have her work cut out for her if she's aiming to be a stunner when she grows up."

rows.original: Rubbing your chin, you take a step back and adopt a thoughtful expression. Hmm... "Is something the matter, [kinu.Dad]?" Well, being attractive and charismatic is all well and good, but has she stopped to think this all the way through? She may be a smart cookie, but she needs to have the wisdom to consider a matter from different angles here. For example, sure, flaunting what she's got all over the place is sure to attract attention like she plans, but not all of the attention she'll receive that way is going to be of the good kind. Here in the Astral Plane it's just her mother and siblings around, but it's a far less safe world out there filled with all manner of creeps, asses, and clingy losers who can't take no for an answer — and that's just the scum floating on the top of the barrel. Kinu just looks confused. "I'm not completely sure what you're getting at, [kinu.Dad]. Are you saying that I shouldn't be pretty so as not to attract unwanted attention?" No, you're not telling her that she shouldn't strive to make herself as alluring and captivating as possible — given how long you've been with her mother, you know that she has a natural propensity for that, being a kitsune and all. What you're saying is that there are different approaches to what she wants without being blatant about it; if she plays her hand right, she can avoid a good portion of the drawbacks of being a looker. [pc.bg courtesan|Given what you used to do for a living as a courtesan, you should know as much. She should definitely not have to experience the uglier portions of your past if you can help it. While it might not have personally happened to you — or it might have and you're not telling Kinu — some of the higher-class, more in-demand courtesans would be harassed off-hours by those who simply didn't understand the nature of the job, by those who mistook the feigned affection for real. Then there was the endless backbiting that took place against them by others in the same profession - Looking back on it, being run out of town was the best thing that happened to you.|] "[kinu.Dad]?" Right, sorry for the silence — you were just thinking. "If what I'm doing is going to get me into trouble, what do you suggest, then?" Well, less is more, for one. There's something to be said for the value of subtlety and surprise, a blade in the dark. Perhaps she could try and make her approach a little more incidental; being all up in someone's face would increase the risk of her actual intentions coming to light — and that would defeat the purpose of such, wouldn't it? "Eh..." A modest outfit, a homely countenance to disguise herself, conceal and camouflage her true nature. But with a slight shift of posture, a smile, or when the light just happens to hit her fur right — the shiv comes out when it's least expected, enrapturing all who look upon her and leaving them wondering how they couldn't have seen it earlier. And all while being plausibly deniable. Your foxy daughter's face brightens as realization gradually dawns, her ears wiggling with excitement as she looks positively impish. "I think I see what you're getting at, [kinu.Dad] and it's not a bad idea at all. Not a bad idea at all. Also, this way I won't have to intrude on Mama's particular expertise... even come up with a style of my own! I know I can't compete with her on her own turf... plus this way I'll still get to dig about in the dirt and hop into leaf piles and do all sorts of other fun things!" Now she's coming around to your way of thinking, eh? "Eeheehee. I'm going to be one of those rural beauties, strike when it's least expected! Draw the gazes of people, then make them feel ashamed for staring at such a wholesome girl! Oh, growing up is going to be so fun!"
rows.translation: 你摸了摸下巴，后退一步，露出若有所思的表情。嗯…… 出了什么问题吗？ [kinu.Dad]?" 嗯，拥有吸引人的外貌和迷人的魅力固然很好，但她有没有认真思考过这一切呢？她可能是个聪明人，但在这个问题上，她需要具备从不同角度进行分析的智慧。比如说，她把自己的优势到处展示，确实会像她预想的那样吸引注意力，但这样得到的关注并不全是积极的。在这里的星界，周围只有她的母亲和兄弟姐妹，但外面的世界却危险得多，那里到处都是各种卑鄙小人、混蛋，还有那些死缠烂打、连拒绝都接受不了的失败者——而这些只不过是表面现象罢了。 纪久只是显得有些困惑而已。我不太明白你到底想表达什么 [kinu.Dad]你是说，我应该不要长得漂亮，这样就不会吸引那些不必要的注意了吗？ 不，你并不是在告诉她不应该努力让自己变得尽可能吸引人、迷人——毕竟你和她母亲相处了这么久，你应该知道她天生就具备这样的特质，毕竟她可是一只狐妖啊。你的意思是，要想实现她的目标，可以采取不同的方法，而不必过于直白地表现出来；如果她处理得当，就可以避免那些因为外貌出众而可能带来的种种麻烦。 [pc.bg courtesan|鉴于你曾经以妓女为职业，你应该很清楚这些事情。她肯定也应该知道。不是如果可以避免的话，人们确实应该尽量避免面对自己过去那些不堪回首的经历。虽然这些事情可能并没有真正发生在你身上——或者虽然发生了但你并没有告诉小娟——但那些属于上层社会、备受追捧的妓女们，往往会在工作时间之外遭到那些根本不了解这份工作本质的人的骚扰；那些将她们表面的柔情误认为是真感情的人，也会对她们进行骚扰。然后，还有同行业其他人对他们进行的无休止的诽谤与中伤—— 回想起来，被赶出那个城市其实是发生在你身上最幸运的事情。|] "[kinu.Dad]?" 好吧，抱歉刚才没说话——你当时可能在思考些什么吧。 如果我这样做会给我带来麻烦，那你有什么建议呢？ 嗯，首先，少即是多。巧妙与惊喜确实具有很大的价值，就如同暗中的利刃一样。或许她可以尝试让自己的行动显得更自然、更偶然一些；如果总是直接暴露在别人的视线中，就很容易让别人察觉到她的真实意图——而那样就违背了这样做的初衷，不是吗？ 呃…… 一身朴素的装束，一张平凡的面容，这些都是她用来伪装自己、隐藏真实本性的手段。然而，只要她稍微调整一下姿势，露出一丝微笑，或者当光线恰好照射在她的毛发上时——她那隐藏的特质就会在最不经意的时候显现出来，吸引所有注视她的人，让他们不禁疑惑：自己之前怎么就没发现呢？而这一切，都可以被合理地否认。 当你那狡黠的女儿逐渐明白过来时，她的脸上露出了灿烂的笑容，耳朵也因为兴奋而不停地动来动去，看上去简直坏心眼十足。我想我明白你的意思了 [kinu.Dad] 这确实是个不错的主意。真的不错。而且这样我就不必去干扰妈妈的专业领域了……甚至还可以发展出属于自己的风格呢！我知道，在她的专业领域里，我根本无法与她竞争……但这样我仍然可以继续在泥土里挖来挖去，跳进落叶堆里，做各种各样有趣的事情！ 现在她也开始认同你的观点了，是吧？ 嘻嘻嘻，我一定要成为那种乡下美女，总是在最意想不到的时候出现！吸引所有人的目光，然后让他们为自己盯着这么纯洁可爱的女孩而感到羞愧！哦，成长一定会非常有趣呢！
rows.raw: " Rubbing your chin, you take a step back and adopt a thoughtful expression. Hmm... "Is something the matter, [kinu.Dad]?" Well, being attractive and charismatic is all well and good, but has she stopped to think this all the way through? She may be a smart cookie, but she needs to have the wisdom to consider a matter from different angles here. For example, sure, flaunting what she's got all over the place is sure to attract attention like she plans, but not all of the attention she'll receive that way is going to be of the good kind. Here in the Astral Plane it's just her mother and siblings around, but it's a far less safe world out there filled with all manner of creeps, asses, and clingy losers who can't take no for an answer — and that's just the scum floating on the top of the barrel. Kinu just looks confused. "I'm not completely sure what you're getting at, [kinu.Dad]. Are you saying that I shouldn't be pretty so as not to attract unwanted attention?" No, you're not telling her that she shouldn't strive to make herself as alluring and captivating as possible — given how long you've been with her mother, you know that she has a natural propensity for that, being a kitsune and all. What you're saying is that there are different approaches to what she wants without being blatant about it; if she plays her hand right, she can avoid a good portion of the drawbacks of being a looker. [pc.bg courtesan|Given what you used to do for a living as a courtesan, you should know as much. She should definitely not have to experience the uglier portions of your past if you can help it. While it might not have personally happened to you — or it might have and you're not telling Kinu — some of the higher-class, more in-demand courtesans would be harassed off-hours by those who simply didn't understand the nature of the job, by those who mistook the feigned affection for real. Then there was the endless backbiting that took place against them by others in the same profession - Looking back on it, being run out of town was the best thing that happened to you.|] "[kinu.Dad]?" Right, sorry for the silence — you were just thinking. "If what I'm doing is going to get me into trouble, what do you suggest, then?" Well, less is more, for one. There's something to be said for the value of subtlety and surprise, a blade in the dark. Perhaps she could try and make her approach a little more incidental; being all up in someone's face would increase the risk of her actual intentions coming to light — and that would defeat the purpose of such, wouldn't it? "Eh..." A modest outfit, a homely countenance to disguise herself, conceal and camouflage her true nature. But with a slight shift of posture, a smile, or when the light just happens to hit her fur right — the shiv comes out when it's least expected, enrapturing all who look upon her and leaving them wondering how they couldn't have seen it earlier. And all while being plausibly deniable. Your foxy daughter's face brightens as realization gradually dawns, her ears wiggling with excitement as she looks positively impish. "I think I see what you're getting at, [kinu.Dad] and it's not a bad idea at all. Not a bad idea at all. Also, this way I won't have to intrude on Mama's particular expertise... even come up with a style of my own! I know I can't compete with her on her own turf... plus this way I'll still get to dig about in the dirt and hop into leaf piles and do all sorts of other fun things!" Now she's coming around to your way of thinking, eh? "Eeheehee. I'm going to be one of those rural beauties, strike when it's least expected! Draw the gazes of people, then make them feel ashamed for staring at such a wholesome girl! Oh, growing up is going to be so fun!" "

rows.original: Tell Kinu that being pretty is all well and good, but it might have unforeseen — and unwanted — side effects. Less is more
rows.translation: 告诉小娟，漂亮固然很好，但这也可能会带来一些意想不到的、甚至是不希望出现的副作用。少即是多。
rows.raw: "Tell Kinu that being pretty is all well and good, but it might have unforeseen — and unwanted — side effects. Less is more"

rows.original: As you approach the hill's crest, stepping into the shade of the massive cherry blossom tree that houses Kiyoko's cabin, you're greeted with a curious sight: Kinu is sitting cross-legged on the grassy earth, her back propped against one of the tree's thick roots, a thin stick of charcoal in hand and a workbook in her lap. Your kitsune daughter's big blue eyes are glued intently to the pages in front of her, her little fingers are all smudged several times over, and there's a bowl of what might have once been some kind of cold iced dessert, only it's all melted into a pink and white mess, smelling distinctly of peach. Looks like she's been here for a while, then. Completely engrossed, Kinu doesn't even notice you as you approach — not until you're standing right next to her and plant a hand on her head right between her twitching foxy ears. A squeal of surprise escapes your kitsune daughter's mouth as her fluffy ears stiffen, her three tails poof up and swish to and fro, knocking over the dessert bowl and sending beans, cubed peaches and melted ice all over the grass. "I... I..." her hand's gripping the charcoal stick so tightly, it's a small wonder it hasn't snapped in twain already. "That wasn't nice, [kinu.Dad]... oooohh..." Back and forth your hand moves, quelling any complaints Kinu might have as you reduce your white-furred kitsune daughter into a mewling mush. You smooth over her ears and tousle her hair, watching as her head bobs with your movements. Kinu opens and shuts her mouth several times as if to voice complaint, but always stops short of actually doing so, eventually settling for being handled like a limp fox kit. "What's the occasion, [kinu.Dad]? Ooh, I just lost my train of thought there..." Not much; you saw your best daughter sitting here and thought you'd stop to greet her before heading on in to see her mother. What's in her lap that's so gripping, she forgot to eat her sweets? Wordlessly, Kinu picks up the workbook from her lap and shows it to you. [pc.bg noblescion arcanist scholar|One page is full of illegible scrawl, while the other has a couple of diagrams pencilled in. Looks like Kiyoko's setting her on basic geometry here. Well, basic for you, that is. Maybe not so much for an eight-year-old. |Scribbles in Kinu's hand fill the right page, while the left is occupied by a number of neatly-drawn circles and triangles, clearly her mother's work. You peer at the lot for a bit, but they might as well be written in Kiyoko's native tongue where you're concerned. ] Looks like her mother's set her some math problems. "She told me to take these and go outside for a bit. I think Mama's in one of her moods again." Kinu puts her fingers together and starts twiddling them. "Somehow, though, I think that mood will clear right up when you show your face at the door, [kinu.Dad]." Hmm. And she finds these quite gripping, does she? "Ehe. I can't quite seem to figure this one out..." You look back down at the workbook again, take in the utter mess of charcoal scrawlings that Kinu's made of the paper. [pc.bg noblescion arcanist scholar|It's with some difficulty that you follow the working and thought processes she's laid down — in no small part due to her atrocious handwriting when she's frustrated — but after some time you figure out where exactly in the problem Kinu's gone wrong. No wonder she can't solve it if she's simply brought the error forward throughout the problem. |Without the educational backing to understand what's going on here, you're just as lost and hopeless as your kitsune daughter is.] "I solved most of the problems without even needing to put any working down on paper," Kinu declares with no small amount of pride. Sniffling, she picks up the dessert bowl and licks it clean of what little syrup and cream's left in the bottom, muffling her voice as she speaks. "This one, though..." Hmm... "It's driving me crazy, [kinu.Dad]. I'm beginning to suspect Mama just gave me an unsolvable problem just to get me out of her hair." [pc.bg noblescion arcanist scholar| No, she hasn't. You can vouch for that, having worked it out yourself; besides, Kiyoko's not the kind of person who would do that. Effective as it might be in tying up her most precocious daughter, you're sure her mother would understand the damage deliberately setting an impossible problem for her would do. Kinu sighs, sets down the dessert bowl, and leans back against the tree root. "I guess... what do I do now, then?" | You don't know about that, but you have full faith Kiyoko wouldn't do something like that to her own daughter and risk spoiling her daughter's learning spirit. That would be counterproductive, and by far not worth a few hours of getting Kinu out of the house. "You have a lot of faith in Mama, [kinu.Dad]." Well, of course you do. How does she imagine she came about in the first place? "Hmph... well. What do I do now, then?" ]
rows.translation: 当你即将登上小山的顶峰，走进那棵巨大的樱花树的荫蔽之下——那里正是清子的小屋所在——你会看到一幅奇特的景象：小娟正盘腿坐在草地上，背部靠在树根上，手中拿着一根细炭笔，腿上放着一本练习册。你那只狐妖女儿那双大大的蓝眼睛紧紧地盯着眼前的书页，她的小手指因为反复翻阅而被弄得满是污迹。还有一个碗，里面原本可能是某种冰镇甜点，但现在都已经融化了，变成了一团粉白相间的糊状物，还散发着明显的桃子香味。 看来她已经在这里待了一段时间了。 小娟完全沉浸在游戏之中，甚至没有注意到你的靠近——直到你站在她旁边，将手放在她那两只不停抽动的狐妖耳朵中间时，她才注意到你。你的九尾狐女儿惊讶地尖叫起来，她那毛茸茸的耳朵立刻竖了起来，三条尾巴也一下子翘了起来，来回摆动，结果把装甜点的碗打翻了，豆子、切块的桃子和融化的冰块全都洒在了草地上。 我……我……她的手紧紧地握着那根炭笔，真不可思议它居然还没有折断。那样做可不太好。 [kinu.Dad]……哦哦哦…… 你来回移动着手，安抚着小娟可能发出的任何抱怨，将你那身白色毛发的狐妖女儿揉成一团呜咽的肉团。你轻抚她的耳朵，拨弄她的毛发，看着她的脑袋随着你的动作一颠一簸。小娟几次张嘴似乎想要抱怨，但最终都没有真正说出来，只能任由你像对待一只无力的小狐妖一样摆布她。 有什么特别的原因吗？ [kinu.Dad]哦，我刚才有点走神了…… 没什么特别的；你看到自己最疼爱的女儿坐在这里，就想着先停下来跟她打个招呼，然后再去见她的母亲。她腿上拿的是什么东西，让她看得如此入迷，甚至忘记了吃甜点？ 金无言地从自己腿上拿过练习册，递给了你。 [pc.bg noblescion arcanist scholar|其中一页上写满了难以辨认的潦草字迹，而另一页上则画了几张简陋的图表。看来清子正在通过这些图表向他讲解基础几何知识。嗯，也算是基础吧你也就是说，对于一个八岁的孩子来说，可能就不是那么适用了。 |希努手写的涂鸦占据了右边的页面，而左边则画满了整齐排列的圆圈和三角形，这些显然是她母亲的作品。你仔细观察了那些图案一会儿，但对你来说，它们简直就像是用清子的母语写出来的一样，完全无法理解其中的意思。 ] 看来她妈妈给她布置了一些数学题。 她让我拿这些东西然后出去走一会儿。我觉得妈妈又进入那种情绪不好的状态了。小娟将手指并拢，开始不停地摆弄它们。不过，我觉得只要你出现在门口，那种阴郁的情绪就会立刻烟消云散的。 [kinu.Dad]." 嗯，她觉得这些内容相当吸引人，是吧？ 呵呵，这个我实在搞不太明白…… 你再次低头看着那本练习本，看着小娟在纸上留下的那些乱七八糟的炭笔痕迹，心中不禁感到一阵无奈。 [pc.bg noblescion arcanist scholar|要理解她所阐述的解题思路和思考过程确实有些困难——这在很大程度上是因为她在感到沮丧时字写得非常潦草——但过了一段时间后，你终于弄清楚了小娟在问题的哪个环节出了错。难怪她无法解决这个问题，因为她只是把错误一直延续到了问题的最后阶段而已。 |如果没有相应的知识背景来理解这里发生的事情，你也会和你那个狐妖女儿一样感到迷茫和无助。] 我甚至都没有把解题过程写在纸上，就解决了大部分问题。小娟带着毫不掩饰的骄傲说道。她抽着鼻子，拿起甜点碗，把碗底剩下的糖浆和奶油舔得干干净净，说话时声音也低了下去。不过这个…… 嗯…… 这真要把我逼疯了 [kinu.Dad]我开始怀疑，妈妈其实是故意给我一个根本无法解决的问题，只是为了让我别再来烦她。 [pc.bg noblescion arcanist scholar| 不，她并没有那么做。你自己也参与过解决这个问题，所以你可以为此作证；再说，清子也不是会做出那种事的人。虽然这种方法确实能够约束她那个最早熟的女儿，但她的母亲肯定能够理解，故意给她设置一个无法解决的问题，会给她带来多大的伤害。 小娟叹了口气，放下甜点碗，然后靠在树根上。我想……那我现在该做什么呢？ | 你可能不知道，但你完全相信清子不会对自己的女儿做出那样的事，她绝不会冒着破坏女儿学习积极性的风险去这么做。那样的做法只会适得其反，绝对不值得为了把小娟从家里弄出去而花费几个小时的时间。 你对妈妈充满了信任， [kinu.Dad]." 嗯，你当然这么认为了。她究竟是怎么想象自己会出现在这个世上的呢？ 哼……那么，我现在该做什么呢？ ]
