        |"Oh hey," Brienne says, stooping down to investigate one of the mushrooms. "A plump helmet. What's this doing all the way here?"
        
        She knows what these are?
        
        "Oh, of course! Plump helmets grow all over the place in the Undermountain — Khor'minos itself has mostly moved past them to better food save for the people still living in the slums, but the kobolds, batfolk and other critters make a feast out of them on the regular. You can also brew them into alcohol, but it tastes kind of disgusting, to be honest."
        
        Do they regularly pop up in places like these?
        
        Brienne scratches her head at that. "Actually, no. Only place I've ever head of plump helmets growing is in and about Khor'minos itself. I don't suppose it's impossible for them to have taken root elsewhere... but it is a bit of a surprise. Still, if they were trying to farm in this miserable place, I couldn't have chosen a better crop than these mushrooms. They'll grow on anything, are pretty hardy, and you can subsist on them alone to boot. Only problem is... they taste of nothing."
        
        They taste awful?
        
        "No, no, not awful." Brienne gesticulates with her hands. "Regardless of how much salt, how many spices you put on a plump helmet, how you prepare the cap and stalk... it always tastes like old, dead wood. There's a reason it's a poor man's meal; you don't think twice about eating literally anything else the second you can afford to."
        |Still, they're kind of interesting. With their purple caps and squat features, they look like helmets growing out of the ground. [silly
            |Plump helmets, in fact. 
        ]Whoever would manage to stomach these kinds of things... you'd have to be mad to do so. Right? Right?
    ]
    
    Food, huh... they've been down here long enough that they've had to farm even with rations being brought down to them by ship, and by the looks of it, with some success. Demons being organized enough for farming... now that's a frightening thought. You'd never have guessed they'd be capable of focusing on something so mundane, going off the two queens among their kind you've seen.
    
    Doesn't seem to be anything you can actually learn from all this, though. Tollus's posse has been down here for some time now, but you've already figured that out given that they've had the time to build fortification and fix up the old jotun castle somewhat. Time to move on.
    "

rows.original: You stare at the contents of the jotuns' treasury and shake your head in despair. A king's ransom in gold and gems — no, twenty kings' ransom in all of that — and all of it is fused together by age, salt and sea into one congealed, tarnished lump. The irony of the situation isn't lost on you — all of this, and with no way to bring it out from so deep under the ocean — not without a mining team to break it apart and an army of siorcs or other marine peoples to dredge it all out of the depths. [party.randComp einin arona |Einin, too, has come to much the same conclusion you have; the little mecian looks to be on the verge of bursting into tears as she runs up and lays herself out on the nearest mound of lumpy, discolored metal that might have once been coinage and rolls around on it. "Why? Why? It's not fair, [pc.name]. It's not fair! With just a bit of this, I could save everyone back home! I — I don't want to leave! Not until I can haul it all back! Y-you're not tearing me from this place! I'm not going! Not throwing away this chance to buy everyone free!" She can't stay here! Cultists notwithstanding, she's at the bottom of the ocean! Has she considered — "I don't care! I-I won't let you take my only chance at saving Shayspa away, [pc.name]! Sure, you can't eat gold, but — but we could buy everything we needed with this fortune! Fresh foodstuffs! Tools! Khor'minoan concrete to fix the leaks in our homes! We could — we could buy weapons to fend off the cult! Hire mercenaries! I-I wouldn't have to steal ever again! Surely that's worth it!" Gweyr looks at you and nods solemnly. "It's this place, it's doing things to all of us; it's only a matter of time before we start snapping like she does. You take her left leg, I'll take the right." There seems to be no choice. Together, you drag Einin out of the jotuns' treasury — she claws desperately at the congealed mountain of ancient coinage, chipping her nails in in her maddened attempt to dislodge some small part of it. Fused as it is to the ancient masonry, not one whit of it budges despite her scrabbling. |Arona stares at the mountains of ancient coinage, mouth agape; seeing her actually overwhelmed and shocked like this is a sight to see all on its own. A low growl emanating from the bottom of her throat, she drops her [arona.weapon] straight on the ground and lunges straight for the nearest mound of congealed gold. "Mine!" her voice echoes through the ancient treasury, much more shrill than you've ever heard it, much more than you'd expect of her. "It's all mine! Mine!" Even for orcish stereotypes, that's deeply worrying, especially when Arona starts furiously scrabbling at the ancient coinage with her fingers, chipping her nails in the process. Eyes wide with — no, it's not fear, but maddened jubilation, your orcish companion throws her head back and laughs raucously, her voice rattling in the dark eaves of the ancient treasury. "Wait till everyone sees me bring this back to the warcamp," Arona chortles, completely oblivious to the fact that she's broken her nails with her furious scrabbling on the gems and gold, fused as they are to the ancient masonry. "I'll be the greatest chieftain the Kervus ever had! More riches than if we raided every single settlement along the eastern coast!" She isn't getting any of this out of here, and she has to stop right now! Doesn't she see, she's not herself and — Arona scowls, her maddened joy turning to ire in the blink of an eye as she looks torn between staying with the hoard and rounding on you. "I don't have to take shit from you, [pc.name]! You just want all of this gold for yourself, to... to... you're not going to be able to buy out the Kervus from under me! [arona.isDom |The only way the title of chieftain passes is by honorable challenge! |You own my heart, but not my tribe! I won't let you toss me aside like... like some used-up cum-dump. This treasure will secure my throne! ]" You don't want to be chieftain of the Kervus, what you want is for her to snap out of it before she kills herself down here! But Arona isn't listening — she's given up trying to wrench and tear away lumps of tarnished gold from the mass of ancient coinage and settling for spreading herself out face-down on the riches, rolling about atop it like a pig wallowing in mud and making grunting noises that, frankly, are quite porcine. Gweyr looks at you and nods solemnly. "It's this place, it's doing things to all of us; it's only a matter of time before we start snapping like she does. You take her left leg, I'll take the right." There seems to be no choice. Roaring and screaming, Arona fights you every step of the way, but even though she's strong, whatever madness has seized her mind doesn't have any command over her usual fighting prowess. By the time you've dragged her free of the jotuns' treasury, she's curled on the ground and moaning, clutching at her bloodied fingertips even as she tries to reach for imaginary riches before her. |What a waste... all the good you could do with such wealth. Maybe if you stayed down here long enough — "Snap out of it, [pc.mf |kid |girl ]!" Gweyr's voice cuts through your reverie. "Don't let it draw you away!" You... you don't remember moving any closer to the mess of congealed coinage, but you must have. This... it felt like your body wasn't your own for a moment there, and a sudden chill runs down your spine. No. Whatever it is, you've got to focus — you can't let your thoughts drift down here, lest you lose your mind. "Keep it together," Gweyr mutters, clapping you on the shoulder. "For a moment there, I thought you were about to lose it." You... you almost did. For all the riches in here, this place has a sense of wrongness about it that makes your guts twist. Some kind of curse placed upon it by the jotuns to ward off would-be thieves? "I don't know. One way or the other, we shouldn't dally here." ] With that whole mess over, you're able to return to the mounds of treasure and see if there isn't anything that you can't actually glean from all this. Glittering gold, trinkets and baubles, paid for in the madness that pervades these ancient halls. If only treasure could staunch the flow of otherworldly corruption that Kasyrra's underlings have awoken this far under the sea... but a few furtive attempts confirm that indeed, there's no way to carry any of this out, not without a pick, a small army, and a lot of time. The cult may have had these things, but you don't have such luxuries. What you do come across, though, is a case atop one of the mounds — the bronze exterior is fully melded to the mound of silver it's sitting on, but a few hard knocks with the business end of your [pc.weapon] has the thin shell of brittle metal that's grown over it off and the case itself opened. Lying within are what look like a pair of handwraps... you'll examine this later. For now, though, you need to get out of here before the allure of filthy lucre gets to you.
rows.translation: 你望着那些巨魔的宝库中的财物，绝望地摇了摇头。那些黄金和宝石的价值相当于二十位国王的赎金——然而，这一切都因为长时间的浸泡、海水的侵蚀而融为一体，变成了一块坚硬、失去光泽的块状物。这种讽刺的情形你再清楚不过了：这么多的财宝，却根本无法从海洋的深处取出来——除非有一支采矿队来将它们分解开来，再有一支由西奥克人或其他海洋民族组成的队伍来把它们从海底挖出来。 [party.randComp einin arona |艾宁也得出了与你相同的结论；那个小小的机械族女孩看起来快要哭出来了，她跑过去，躺在最近那一堆凹凸不平、已经变色的金属上——那些金属或许曾经是硬币——然后在那里滚来滚去。“为什么？为什么？这不公平 [pc.name]这不公平！只要有一点这个东西，我就能救回家乡的所有人！我……我不想离开！直到我把所有这些东西都带回去之前，我不会走的！你们不能把我从这里带走！我绝对不会放弃这个拯救大家的机会！”但她不可能留在这里啊！就算没有那些邪教徒，她现在也身处海洋的最深处啊！她难道没有考虑过……？“我不要关心我、我不会让你夺走我拯救谢斯帕的唯一机会的。 [pc.name]当然，你不能吃黄金，但是……用这笔财富，我们可以买到我们需要的所有东西！新鲜的食物、工具，还有用来修补房屋漏水的科尔米诺混凝土！我们甚至可以购买武器，用来抵御那些邪教组织！雇佣雇佣兵吧！那样我就再也不用偷东西了！这肯定值得啊！”格韦尔看着你，严肃地点了点头：“就是这个地方，它在影响着我们所有人；我们迟早也会像她那样变得疯狂的。你负责她的左腿，我来抓她的右腿。”看来别无选择。你们俩一起把艾宁从那些巨人的宝库中拉了出来——她拼命地抓着那些凝结成块的古代硬币，疯狂地试图弄掉其中的一小部分。她的指甲在这样激烈的抓挠中都被弄伤了。由于与古老的砖石结构紧密相连，无论她如何用力抓挠，那部分结构都不会有一丝松动。 |阿罗娜呆呆地望着那些堆积如山的古币，张大了嘴巴；看到她真的被这一幕惊得不知所措，实在是一件很有意思的事情。她的喉咙深处发出低沉的吼声，然后她放下了那些古币 [arona.weapon] 她直接扑倒在地，朝着最近的那一堆凝固的金子猛冲过去。“是我的！”她的声音在古老的宝库中回荡，那声音比你以往听过的任何时候都要尖锐，也完全超出了你的预料。“这一切都是我的！我的！即便是对于兽人这类刻板印象而言，这种情况也实在令人担忧。尤其是当阿罗娜开始用手指拼命抓那些古老的硬币，甚至因此弄伤了自己的指甲时，她的双眼里流露出的并非恐惧，而是一种近乎疯狂的喜悦。她仰起头，发出震耳欲聋的笑声，那声音在古老宝库阴暗的角落里回荡。 等着看吧，等大家都看到我把这个带回军营的时候，”阿罗娜咯咯笑着，完全没有意识到自己在拼命抓那些与古老石墙融为一体的宝石和黄金时，把自己的指甲都抓坏了。我一定会成为凯尔维斯族有史以来最伟大的首领！获得的财富会比我们攻占东海岸上的每一个定居点还要多！”但她绝对不能把这些话说出去，现在就必须停止！她难道看不出来吗？她已经不再是以前的她了……阿罗娜皱起了眉头，她那狂喜的情绪在瞬间变成了愤怒。她陷入了两难境地：是留在那些人中间，还是冲过来对付你。“我根本没有必要忍受你的羞辱 [pc.name]你只是想把所有这些黄金据为己有，想……想……但你绝对不可能从我手中买下Kervus公司！ [arona.isDom |要想获得“酋长”这一头衔，唯一的途径就是通过正当的挑战！ |你拥有我的心，但却无法掌控我的族人！我绝不会让你像抛弃某个用过的垃圾一样把我丢在一边。这份珍宝才能确保我坐上王位！ ]你不应该这样做。想要要想成为克尔维斯族的首领，你最希望看到的就是她在自杀之前能清醒过来！但是阿罗娜根本不听劝——她已经放弃了从那些古代硬币中撕下那些锈迹斑斑的金块，而是干脆面朝下躺在那些财宝上面，像头在泥里打滚的猪一样翻来覆去，发出一些说实话，确实非常像猪的叫声。 格韦尔看着你，严肃地点了点头：“就是这个地方，它在对我们所有人产生影响；我们迟早也会像她那样变得疯狂。你负责她的左腿，我负责右腿。”看来别无选择。阿罗娜发出怒吼与尖叫，一路上都在与你搏斗。尽管她力量强大，但那种占据她心灵的疯狂却完全剥夺了她平时的战斗能力。当你终于把她从那些巨人的宝库中救出来时，她已经蜷缩在地上，不停地呻吟着，双手紧抓着自己血迹斑斑的指尖，同时还在试图去抓住那些她想象中的财富。 |真是浪费……拥有这样的财富，本可以做出很多有益的事情。或许，如果你能在这里多待一段时间……“快清醒过来吧 [pc.mf |小孩 |女孩 ]喂！”格韦尔的声音打断了你的沉思，“别让它把你吸引过去！”你……你不记得自己有没有靠近那些凝固在一起的硬币，但肯定是这样做的。在那一瞬间，你的身体仿佛不属于你自己了，一股寒意突然从脊背传来。不。无论发生了什么，你都必须集中注意力——不能让思绪在这里分散，否则你会失去理智的。“振作起来，”格维尔低声说道，同时拍了拍你的肩膀，“有那么一刻，我还以为你要崩溃了呢。你……你差点就做到了。尽管这里充满了财富，但这个地方还是有一种特别的氛围错误性那种让人不寒而栗的感觉，莫非是那些巨魔为了吓退潜在的小偷而施加的诅咒？“我不知道。无论如何，我们都不应该在这里浪费时间。 ] 等这一切混乱都平息之后，你就可以重新回到那些充满财宝的地方，看看是否还能从这些财物中发现些什么有价值的东西。那些闪闪发光的黄金、小饰品和玩物，都是在这些古老大厅里弥漫着的疯狂氛围中换来的。要是有宝物能阻止卡希拉的手下在海底深处引发的那股超自然的邪恶力量该多好……但几次偷偷尝试后，我们确实发现：没有钻探工具、没有一支庞大的队伍，也没有足够的时间，根本不可能完成这样的任务。那个邪教或许拥有这些东西，但你可没有这样的奢华享受。你做不过，你会注意到在其中一个土堆的顶部有一个特殊的例子——它的青铜外壳与它所坐的银色土堆完全融为一体，但如果你用工具的坚硬部分轻轻敲击它几下 [pc.weapon] 它的外壳由一层脆弱的金属构成，这层金属已经脱落了，因此外壳本身也被打开了。里面放着的东西看起来像是一副护手……你可以稍后仔细查看。不过现在，你得赶紧离开这里，否则那些诱人的金钱会让你无法自拔的。

rows.original: You take a look at the fallen rubble and shake your head. It's clear why the cultists didn't want to deal with this heap of junk at the bottom of the stairwell, especially since they had another hallway that circled around the obstruction no problem. It doesn't look too bad and it shouldn't be that much of a problem to clear... assuming you have the means to do so. Do you?
rows.translation: 你看着那些倒塌的废墟，摇了摇头。现在终于明白为什么那些邪教徒不愿意处理楼梯下装这堆垃圾了——毕竟他们还有另一条可以绕过这个障碍物的走廊啊。这景象实在让人无语太这确实挺棘手的，但如果你有相应的手段的话，应该不会太难解决吧……你真的有办法吗？

It doesn't look too bad and it shouldn't be that much of a problem to clear... assuming you have the means to do so. Do you? "

rows.original: Well, nothing for it. Studying the blockage, you quickly figure out a few likely spots where you could clear out enough of the fallen masonry to be able to scramble across the top over to the other side. It'll be a tight fit for [party.combatNames], but possible. "Hmph," Gweyr says as you explain your idea to her. "I guess if it allows us to go around and cut them off from the back, it would be worth it. Doesn't look like it would take too long, with the muscle we've got." That's what you were thinking, too. Rallying [party.compNames] to your side, you start the laborious process of shifting old stone brick out of the way. [var0 |Thankfully, the camping supplies you brought down with you make the job much faster with the tools that come along with the kit. It's no less tiring, but the thought of having to clear all that ancient, grimy brick with nothing but your hands... ugh. |Without any tools for the job, you're reduced to using your bare hands to clear the blockage — not anything too serious, but the feel of the ancient, grimy brick against your hands and the strain that ensues without the proper equipment does tire all of you out. Still, it's less of a loss than facing a whole bunch of cultists would be — which would certainly be what they've got prepared up in that tunnel up above. ] [party.CombatNames] work quickly, and eventually you create a tunnel wide enough for you to squeeze against the ceiling and emerge out the other side. Not perfect, but it's discreet and you can use it both ways if you wanted to backtrack for whatever reason.
rows.translation: 嗯，没什么难度。仔细观察那些堵塞物，你很快就能找出几个可能的地方——在这些地方，你可以清除足够的倒塌的砖石，从而能够爬到顶部，到达另一边。不过，这些地方的空间都相当狭窄 [party.combatNames]哼，”当你向格维尔解释你的想法时，她说道，“我想如果这能让我们从后方包抄他们，那么这样做肯定是值得的。以我们的实力，应该不会花费太长时间吧。”你本来也是这么想的。加油吧！ [party.compNames] 你开始着手这项繁琐的工作，把那些旧石砖一块一块搬开。 [var0 |幸运的是，你带来的露营用品以及配套工具让这项工作进行得快了很多。虽然仍然很辛苦，但要是只能靠双手来清理那些古老而肮脏的砖块……唉，真让人不想想象。 |由于没有任何工具可用，你只能徒手去清除堵塞物——实在没有其他办法了。太虽然情况很严肃，但那些古老而肮脏的砖块触在手上带来的感觉，以及在没有适当装备的情况下所必须承受的劳累，确实会让你们所有人都感到疲惫。不过，相比面对一大群邪教徒来说，这种麻烦还算小一些——因为在上方的那条隧道里，他们肯定已经准备好了对付你们的手段。 ] [party.CombatNames] 你迅速地工作着，最终挖出了一条足够宽的隧道，你可以从隧道中挤过，从另一边出来。虽然不够完美，但这个方法很隐蔽，而且如果你以后因为某种原因需要折返，也可以从这条隧道返回。

rows.original: Attempt to clear the rubble by hand; you have the muscle in your party to do this. It will tire you out, though, if you don't have any tools for the job.
rows.translation: 尝试用手清理这些碎石吧，你们的团队中有足够的力量来完成这项工作。不过，如果没有合适的工具，这项任务会让你们感到非常疲惫。
rows.raw: "Attempt to clear the rubble by hand; you have the muscle in your party to do this. It will tire you out, though, if you don't have any tools for the job."

rows.original: You don't have enough muscle in this party to try clearing even a portion of the rubble by hand.
rows.translation: 在这个团队里，你们的力量实在不够，甚至连一部分废墟都无法用手清理掉。
rows.raw: "You don't have enough muscle in this party to try clearing even a portion of the rubble by hand."

rows.original: Use this item to clear the rubble.
rows.raw: "Use this item to clear the rubble."

rows.original: See if there isn't something in your possessions that could help with this problem.
rows.translation: 看看你的物品中是否有什么可以帮助解决这个问题的东西。
rows.raw: "See if there isn't something in your possessions that could help with this problem."

rows.original: Nothing you have on you right now looks suitable for the task of clearing rubble at the moment.
rows.translation: 你现在身上带的这些东西，似乎都不适合用来清理废墟。
rows.raw: "Nothing you have on you right now looks suitable for the task of clearing rubble at the moment."

rows.original: [var0 |Instructing [party.compNames] to retreat to the stairwell, you find a weak spot near the top of the rubble pile; activating the leananstone, you shove it into said weak spot and duck for cover with everyone else. There's a brief moment of tense silence, and then what comes to you is not the roar of the trinket discharging its collected storm powers, but more a muffled thump as the rubble's thrown into disarray, the detritus landing away from your side of the passageway. All the better for you, then. The burst of concussive force wasn't as loud as you'd imagined it might be, and the top of the pile's been cleared out enough that you'd be able to squeeze through — not a terribly hard thing, given that the architecture is, after all, giant-sized. Knowing the cultists have almost certainly set up an ambush in the tunnel above, it'll take them some time to get down here even if they heard this. Time to get a move on. |Instructing [party.compNames] to retreat to the stairwell, you dig a small hole in the rubble pile. The ley-crystal grenade is hard in your hand as you twist both halves, feeling the insides give; with your heart in your throat, you shove the ancient device into the midst of the fallen masonry and take off at a dash. Your only hope here is that you don't make the situation worse and bring the entire castle crashing down onto you... There's a brief moment of tense silence, and then what comes to you is not the roar of ley-crystal discharging its payload of raw magic, but more a muffled thump as the rubble pile explo — no, it disintegrates gravel and other detritus skittering to a halt at your feet. Even with your hands over your ears, the heart-stopping, bone-shaking force of the blast is unmistakable. All the better for you, then. The burst of concussive force wasn't as loud as you'd imagined it might be, and when you finally dare to peek out, the blockage over the stairwell landing is completely gone. Given how the cultists have almost certainly set up an ambush in the tunnel above, it'll take them some time to get down here to respond to all the noise. Time to get a move on, then... this was definitely a dangerous gambit, but not as much as facing down Tollus's goons on their turf and en masse. As far as you're concerned, this was a grenade well-spent. ]
rows.translation: [var0 |指导 [party.compNames] 当你退回到楼梯间时，发现碎石堆的顶部附近有一个薄弱点；你激活了那块倾斜的石头，将其推到那个薄弱点处，然后和其他人一起躲了进去。有那么一刻，空气中弥漫着紧张的寂静，随后传来的并不是那个小装置释放出积聚的能量所发出的巨响，而是一种闷闷的撞击声——碎石被震得四散飞溅，那些碎片落在了通道的另一侧。 那对你来说反而是件好事。那股冲击力的强度并没有你想象中那么大，而且堆物的顶部已经被清理得足够宽敞，你可以从那里挤过去——考虑到这里的建筑规模本来就非常大，这其实并不是什么难事。既然那些狂热信徒很可能在上面的隧道里设下了埋伏，那么即使他们听到了动静，也需要一些时间才能来到这里。是时候行动了。 |指导 [party.compNames] 为了退到楼梯间，你在废墟中挖了一个小洞。握着那颗能量水晶手雷，你转动它的两个部分，感觉到内部正在发生变化；心悬在嗓子眼上的你，将这个古老装置塞进倒塌的砖石堆中，然后迅速逃走了。你在这里唯一的希望就是不要让情况变得更糟，以免整个城堡因此而倒塌，压在你身上…… 一阵短暂的紧张沉默之后，你听到的并不是 ley-crystal 释放出原始魔法时的轰鸣声，而是一种沉闷的撞击声——不，其实是分解成碎片碎石和其他杂物纷纷停在了你的足部边。即使你用手捂住耳朵，那震耳欲聋、令人浑身发颤的爆炸声依然清晰可闻。 不过，这对你来说反而是件好事。那股冲击力的强度并没有你想象中那么大，当你终于敢探出头去时，楼梯井口的堵塞物已经完全消失了。鉴于那些狂热信徒很可能在上面的隧道里设下了埋伏，他们需要一些时间才能下来应对这一切骚动。是时候行动了……虽然这确实是一次冒险的举动，但比起在他们的地盘上与托勒斯的打手们正面交锋，这种风险还是要小一些。对你来说，这次投掷的手雷确实发挥了应有的作用。 ]

rows.original:
Taking a look at the section of wall the cultists have cleared of coral, weed and other clinging marine life, you briefly pore over the notes they left behind with their tools. Looks like they were in the middle of cleaning up this place when they'd to leave to deal with you... hope you didn't interrupt anything important, hah.
    
    Either way, as far as you can understand the scratchings the demons dropped in a hurry, they were waiting for someone to come along with a password to the doors up ahead... apparently it has to be spoken aloud for the mechanisms to respond — if they're even still working after all this time.
    
    Do you know the password?
rows.translation:
看着那些邪教徒已经清理掉珊瑚、海草以及其他附着在墙面上的海洋生物的区域，你仔细阅读了他们用工具留下的笔记。看来他们正在清理这个地方的时候，突然不得不离开去处理你的事情了。.. 希望你没有打扰到什么重要的事情，哈哈。
    
    无论如何，从那些恶魔匆忙留下的痕迹来看，他们似乎在等待有人带着通往前方大门的密码出现。显然，必须大声念出这些指令，这些机制才会做出反应——毕竟过了这么长时间，它们是否还能正常工作还很难说。
    
    你知道密码吗？
rows.raw:
"
    Taking a look at the section of wall the cultists have cleared of coral, weed and other clinging marine life, you briefly pore over the notes they left behind with their tools. Looks like they were in the middle of cleaning up this place when they'd to leave to deal with you... hope you didn't interrupt anything important, hah.
    
    Either way, as far as you can understand the scratchings the demons dropped in a hurry, they were waiting for someone to come along with a password to the doors up ahead... apparently it has to be spoken aloud for the mechanisms to respond — if they're even still working after all this time.
    
    Do you know the password?"

rows.original:
[var0
            |No sooner have the words left your lips that an ominous groaning starts from deep within the walls, ancient mechanisms grinding to life and waking from their long slumber. Collected dust and detritus falls from the massive stone doors to the north as they rumble open — first by a crack, then swinging apart in earnest as they find their bearings. Stale air washes out from the doors, heavy and tinged with salt; you cough a bit and have to stand aside while the worst of it clears before peeking ahead into the darkness to the north.
            
            [party.randComp cait einin
                |"Wow," Cait breathes. "It's like something out of one of Dad's stories. You say the words, and then the door opens."
                
                This sort of thing was common in children's stories?
                
                "Yeah! They were really popular in the world before Belhar happened, as far as we understand it, and across a whole bunch of peoples, too. There's a whole folk tale about 'speak, friend, and enter' throwing a band of heroes for a loop! Haven't you heard of it?"
                
                If you have, it's not ringing any bells for you right now.
                
                "Yeah, well." Cait smiles, but you've known her long enough to suss out that while her excitement is genuine, she's certainly playing it up. "Being able to see something out of a fairy tale is something, isn't it? It's kind of a pity we're doing it under such circumstances, but..." 
                |"More and more of these locks," Einin mutters, the mousy thief scampering ahead of you, coughing a bit from the stale air. "Way to make someone feel useless."
                
                You chuckle and give her a pat on the head between her large ears. Surely there were thieves like her in ages past, and where there are thieves, there are people with valuables to secure against them. If anything else, it'll be encouragement for her to expand her horizons once all this is over.
                
                "Yeah, once all this is over." Einin's face falls a bit. "It feels like I've been doing this forever now. I don't know if it can ever be all over."
                
                One way or another, it will. Now time to see what treasures lie ahead. That'll cheer her up, won't it?
                |Gweyr harrumphs, then nods in approval. "Saw a few of these in my time. None as grand as this one, though."
                
                A password-operated door?
                
                "Yeah, there were some. Not of these giants' make, though. Seemed to be pretty common — the whole 'speak, friend, and enter' deal. Garth, he'd wonder if there was something in those days which made this sort of thing popular all over the world, but I'll be damned if I know."
            ]
            
            By now, the worst of the stale air has dissipated out into the hallway — it still smells bad inside the room that's been revealed, but at least you aren't going to asphyxiate just from stepping in. Time is of the essence — you should get a move on.
            |Whatever you may have tried, it doesn't work — despite your voice resonating across the old stone columns, the heavy stone doors to the north stay sealed as shut as they ever will be. You're not going to be able to get in unless you know the exact pass phrase, pronunciation and all. Perhaps you can try again when you've had a moment to think?
        ]
rows.translation:
[var0
            |话音刚落，墙壁深处便传来令人不寒而栗的呻吟声，那些古老的机械装置开始运转，从漫长的沉睡中苏醒过来。北侧巨大的石门缓缓打开，积聚的灰尘和杂物随之掉落——先是出现一道裂缝，然后门扉彻底敞开，恢复了正常的功能。陈腐的空气从门缝中排出，空气中弥漫着浓重的盐分气息；你轻轻咳嗽了几声，只好站在一旁，等到这些污浊空气散去后，才敢向北方的黑暗中望去。
            
            [party.randComp cait einin
                |哇，”凯特惊叹道，“这简直就像爸爸故事里发生的场景一样。你刚说出那些话，门就打开了。”
                
                这种情节在儿童故事里很常见吗？
                
                “是啊！据我们所知，在贝尔哈尔事件发生之前，这些内容在全世界都非常受欢迎，而且也深受许多不同民族的喜爱。甚至还有专门讲述“说话吧，朋友，然后进入其中”这个情节的民间故事，这个故事把一群英雄们弄得晕头转向、不知所措呢！你难道没听说过吗？”
                
                “就算听说过，现在也想不起来具体是什么了。”
                
                “嗯，好吧。”凯特笑了笑，但你们认识她已经够久了，所以你能看出，虽然她的兴奋是真实的，但她确实是在夸大其词。能够看到一些仿佛出自童话世界中的景象，这种感觉确实很奇妙，不是吗？虽然我们在这样的环境下经历这一切，还是有点遗憾的……但是…… 
                |这些锁越来越多了……”艾宁低声说道。那只老鼠般的小偷正跑在你前面，因为空气太闷而不停地咳嗽。“真会让人觉得自己一无是处啊。”
                
                你轻笑了一声，然后在她那两只大耳朵之间轻拍了一下她的头。在过去，肯定也有像她这样的小偷存在。而只要有小偷，就一定有人会为了保护自己的贵重物品而采取防范措施。无论如何，等这一切结束后，这反而会激励她去拓展自己的视野，尝试其他事情。
                
                是啊，等这一切都结束了。”艾宁的表情有些黯淡，“感觉我已经做了这件事很久很久了。我不知道这一切究竟什么时候才能真正结束。”
                
                不过，无论如何，总会有结束的那一天的。现在，是时候看看前方还有什么珍宝在等着我们了。那一定会让她高兴起来的，对吧？
                |格维尔哼了一声，然后点了点头表示同意。“我以前也见过几处这样的东西。不过，没有这一处这么壮观。”
                
                密码控制的门？
                
                “没错，确实有过这样的门。不过不是这种巨型结构的。这种‘说话即可进入’的装置似乎相当普遍。加斯可能会好奇，是不是在那个时候有什么原因，让这种设计在全世界都流行起来……但我真的不知道。
            ]
            
            此刻，那些最难闻的污浊空气已经散到了走廊里——虽然被打开的房间里仍然有一股难闻的气味，但至少你不会一走进去就窒息。时间紧迫，你应该赶快行动了。
            |无论你尝试了什么方法，都毫无效果——尽管你的声音在古老的石柱间回荡，但北面的那扇重型的石门依然紧闭着，永远也不会被打开。除非你知道那句准确的口令、正确的发音以及所有细节，否则你根本无法进入那里。或许等你想清楚后再试一次吧？
        ]

rows.original:
The cultists might have been patient enough to wait for the password to be delivered to them, but you don't have that kind of time. Pulling the small sphere of the ley-crystal grenade from your possessions, you squeeze it in the palm of your hand, feeling its reassuring hardness against your fingers as you step up resolutely to the door.
        
        [party.randComp cait arona einin
            |Cait swallows hard as she realizes what you're about to do. "[pc.name]... are you so sure that's a good idea?"
            
            The place looks sturdy enough that even a strong explosion like this wouldn't send the ocean flooding in on you. The jotuns clearly built their works to last; it's survived amazingly well given whatever calamity that caused it to sink to the bottom of an ocean trench. You'll be fine.
            
            "Yeah, it's hard to argue with that, but... even so! It feels kind of sacreligious."
            
            If she hasn't noticed, the castle is teeming with demons; whatever sanctity this place may have had has long since been fouled. Now, if she doesn't mind stepping back, you'll prime this thing already.
            |Arona's eyes widen as she realizes what you're about to do, and a toothy grin spreads over her face. "Let's make this bitch go 'boom!'"
            
            Boom indeed. She's going to get a firework show.
            
            Being outright dreamy might be an impossibility for your orcish companion, but she's about as close as she'll ever get. It might not be as good as fighting, but it's pretty damned close.
            |Einin shakes her head as she realized what you're about to do. "No finesse."
            
            But it does get the job done, and unlike most instances in her professional life, you don't care about making a ruckus or damaging any valuables.
            
            "It's about taking pride in your work, you know."
            
            And for you, it's about getting the job done, because this is a kind of lock that neither she nor you are going to be defeating with the usual measures. Extraordinary circumstances and all that, you're sure she understands. Now, if she would step back... 
            |Gweyr chuckles dryly as she watches you with folded arms. "Well, [pc.mf
                |kid
                |girl
            ], that's one way to get the job done."
            
            And how did she usually do it in her heyday?
            
            "Me? With a crowbar. The way you're doing it, I'm just thinking of it as a very big crowbar, that's all. This place is strong enough that it probably wouldn't bring the entire roof down on us, so I'm not that concerned. Probably."
            
            Not certainly?
            
            "Nothing's ever certain when you're dealing with these places, not even with a ten foot pole."
        ]
        
        You dig around in the dust and debris for a bit, trying to find a nice spot in which to wedge the payload. As it would turn out, there's a small groove worn away by age and water right up against the middle — there's a little packing involved in getting it just right so most of the ensuing blast will be against the heavy stone slabs themselves, but eventually you feel confident that this is going to be your best shot.
        
        Nothing for it, then. Reaching down, you take both halves of the grenade and twist, feeling whatever it is that makes the relic go snap within. Scrambling back, you duck for cover behind a column with [party.compNames] and wait for the inevitable.
        
        Boom.
        
        Even though you've covered your ears, your bones and teeth are still trembling from the shockwave that spreads down the hallway, a roar of air that sweeps dust and pebbles in its path as it rushes through the ancient castle. When you're finally sure the whole place isn't about to collapse upon you for your daring gambit, you peer out from around your hiding spot and note that the immense stone doors have been blown ajar, a fair-sized crater set into the ancient masonry where you planted the ley-crystal grenade.
        
        "Whew, that's some solid stonework all right." Gweyr says as she steps out. "No need to go rushing in, though. Gods know how many centuries all that stale air has been in there — I don't want you choking to death. Obvious, I know, but I've seen more than one person try to commit suicide because of the lure of riches."

那些狂热信徒或许有足够的耐心等待密码被送到他们手中，但你没有那么多时间。你从随身携带的物品中取出那个由 ley-crystal 制成的小球形手雷，将其握在手掌中，感受着它那令人安心的坚硬触感，然后毅然走向门口。

            |当阿罗娜意识到你即将要做什么时，她的双眼瞪得大大的，脸上立刻浮现出一丝灿烂的笑容：“让我们让这个家伙‘轰’的一声消失吧！”果然，一阵绚丽的烟火表演即将上演。对于你的兽人伙伴来说，彻底沉浸在幻想之中或许是不可能的，但此刻，她已经做到了近乎完美的程度。虽然这可能比不上真正的战斗，但也已经非常接近了。
            |艾宁看到你即将要做的动作，摇了摇头：“这样太粗暴了，没有技巧可言。”不过，这种方法确实能够达到目的。而且与她职业生涯中的大多数情况不同，你并不在意是否会引起骚动，也不在乎是否会损坏任何贵重物品。
            
            关键在于为你自己的工作感到自豪，你知道的。”而对于你来说，重点则是完成这项任务，因为这种难题，无论是她还是你，都无法用常规的方法来解决。特殊情况嘛，她肯定能理解的。现在，如果她能退一步的话…… 
            |格维尔双臂交叉，看着你，干笑道：“嗯， [pc.mf
                |小孩
                |女孩
            ]嗯，这也是完成工作的一种方法。”那么，在她最鼎盛的时期，她通常是怎样做到的呢？“我吗？当然是用撬棍啊。你现在的这种方法，对我来说，只不过是一把特别大的撬棍而已，没什么特别的。这个地方的结构足够坚固，应该不会把整个屋顶压在我们头上，所以我觉得没什么好担心的……大概吧。“不太确定吗？”“当你面对这样的地方时，什么都无法确定，就连用十英尺长的杆子去测量也不一定能得到准确的结果。"
        ]
        
        你在尘土和碎片中仔细寻找，试图找到一个合适的位置来安置炸药。结果发现，由于长时间的使用和水的侵蚀，在中间位置形成了一条小小的凹槽。你需要稍微调整炸药的位置，这样才能让大部分爆炸能量直接作用于那些重型的石板之上。最终，你确信这个位置就是最好的选择。
        
        那也没什么办法了。你弯下腰，拿起手雷的两半，将它们扭动起来，试图弄清楚是什么东西让这个遗物内部发生了断裂。然后你迅速后退，躲到一根柱子后面寻求掩护。 [party.compNames] 然后，等待那不可避免的事情发生。轰。即使你捂住了耳朵，你的骨头和牙齿依然会因为那股沿着走廊传播的冲击波而颤抖——那股气流在穿过这座古老的城堡时，会卷起尘土和碎石，发出震耳欲聋的声响。当你终于确定，因为你的大胆举动而不会让整个地方瞬间崩塌下来时，你从藏身之处探出头来，发现那扇巨大的石门已经被炸开了一个小缝；而在你放置那颗能量水晶手雷的地方，古老的石墙上出现了一个不小的坑洞。
        
        呼，这些石工工艺确实相当精湛。”格维尔边走边说道，“不过也没必要急着进去。天知道那些陈旧的空气在里面积攒了几个世纪——我可不想让你窒息而死。这个建议显然很显而易见，但我确实见过不止一个人因为被财富所诱惑而试图自杀。"

rows.original: With the glowing crystals the demon cultists use for lighting conspicuously absent from this particular stretch of corridor, you're keenly aware that this is an obvious set-up for a trap. Can demons see in the dark? At this point, given how they've proven resilient to cold and pressure, you wouldn't put it past them. Every step you take is measured, every breath hushed; despite all this, though, you can see or hear neither hair nor hide of any of Tollus's posse in your immediate vicinity. That just makes it all the worse. "Watch out!" Gweyr roars all of a sudden, and though you don't see it in the dim corridor, you hear it nevertheless; the steady rumble of something large and heavy coming down the hallway towards [party.manyCompanions |all |the both ] of you. While you manage to dodge out of the way of the first barrel, which rolls on past you and breaks apart against the far wall in a mess of splintering wood and spilt goo, a dozen more are bearing down on [party.combatNames], barreling — hah — out of the darkness with brutal intent.[silly | The only way this could get any more ridiculous would be if there were a fusata hurling them at you, but when it comes to this place and the madness pervading it, you don't know what to believe any more. ] [var0 |There's no time to think — your body simply moves. Dodging and weaving, leaping where necessary, you evade the weighty barrels that roll down the hallway at you, dragging [party.compNames] along with you. Several more pass you by and you peer in the direction from which they'd come, but whirl around when you hear a wet and sticky sound from the walls behind you. "Tira's tits. Fuck!" The cultists are literally coming out of the walls, shadows on the masonry coalescing and congealing into solid shapes, taking form as they leap for you. No rest for the [pc.isDK |wicked |brave ], alas — you have barely enough time to recover and hold your [pc.weapon] at the ready before battle is joined. The hows and whys can wait — here and now, you've got business to deal with. It's a fight! |You manage to dodge most of the barrels, but a couple slam into your shins, nearly bowling you over with their momentum and leaving you struggling to stand. Vile, gelatinous goo sprays all over your [pc.armor] and feet as the barrels crack, but thankfully don't outright shatter — the first mistake you made created an opening for another barrel to come hurtling at you unawares, and then another — Kicking an oncoming barrel out of the way, Gweyr hurries over and sets you right on your feet, grimacing at the gooey mess all over the cold flagstones. The stuff feels horrible, awful on your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun], like fingers of dead flesh clawing at your bones. No time to think, though — barely have the last of the barrels passed you and smashed into the far wall when you hear something wet and sticky oozing out behind you. At first you think it's a hallucination caused by whatever corruptive, maddening effect the gray goo might have on your mind, but when [party.compNames] react[party.manyCompanions | |s ] to it too, the possibility is dashed — this is no fugue hallucination. "Tira's tits. Fuck!" The cultists are literally coming out of the walls, shadows on the masonry coalescing and congealing into solid shapes, taking form as they leap for you. No rest for the [pc.isDK |wicked |brave ], alas — you have barely enough time to recover and hold your [pc.weapon] at the ready before battle is joined. The hows and whys can wait — here and now, you've got business to deal with. It's a fight! ]

rows.original: You raise your [pc.weapon], ready for the next blow to come at you, but none does. All of the cultists have long since disengaged from the fight, retreating southwards and further into the sunken castle. Breathing heavily, you finally drop your guard and let the heat of battle wash over you. [party.has cait |Cait, though has other ideas. Screaming like a wildcat with her [cait.weapon] raised up high, your pink kitten sends gout upon gout of whitefire snaking after the cultists, scorching the ancient stone with soot. Seeing that she's about to run off on her own, you hurriedly catch up to her and grab her by midriff and chest alike. Struggling to free herself, she hisses in a very feline manner, going so far as trying to bite you in a bid to hunt down the fleeing shadows. You wince as blood runs, but refuse to let her go. "What are you doing, [pc.name]? You can't really mean to let them escape!" No, but if it's a choice between her running off to play cat and mouse in the dark or keeping everyone together and alive, you'll take the latter. "What the hell do you know, [pc.name]? It's not your sister who's gone! It's not your sister you don't even know you'll ever see again! Do you even have people you care about where you came from? Do you? If Calla never comes back, I've got to make them pay! I've got to make them all pay!" That does it. Reaching around, you give the hysterical Cait a firm slap across the cheek; she stares at you disbelievingly for a second or two, then something inside of her clicks back into place and her gaze softens into the Cait you know[cait.fucked| and love]. Cait stumbles away from you, bosom heaving as she draws ragged breaths. She sinks against the wall and hugs her knees as the exhaustion of her hysterical exertions catches up with her all at once. ] "Fuck," Gweyr gasps. "Did you see that, [pc.mf |kid |girl ]? They came out of the damned walls! They didn't use to be able to do that! Who the fuck would've taught them to do — ahh, I'm getting too old for this." [var0|Actually, you know who might have done just such a thing, and the thought produces a sinking feeling in the pit of your stomach. ]As Tollus's influence and powers increase with Kasyrra's patronage, it's not really surprising that he'd be able to train his minions better, wouldn't he? "I just... damn. If I weren't paranoid enough already." [party.has einin |Einin's been eerily silent throughout this whole exchange, staring at her feet. You wonder if she's going to have a fit right there and then, but your mousy companion shudders and sighs, squaring her shoulders and pulling herself together. |She should just try not to let her imagination get too far ahead of herself in a place like this. ] "I've dug around in the dirt long enough that this shouldn't faze me," Gweyr mumbles. "Garth and I both. Guess I'm just getting old, going crazy in my dotage." Once you deal with Tollus, it'll all be over. "That's right, it'll all be over. rows.original:
A sharp jolt of magic knocks your [pc.weapon] from your hand, and as you scramble to retrieve it more and more of the demon cultists pile onto you, stabbing away as they drag you down to the cold stone floor and straight into a spilt goo puddle. The gray stuff doesn't seem to affect them in the least, but as far as you're concerned the cold, awful touch of the gelatinous substance claws at your mind, sapping your will to fight despite life-and-death situation you're in. Gweyr manages to hold out a little longer, but without you to back her up the sheer number of cultists soon manages to overwhelm her in much the same fashion.
    
    "We'll be taking you to see the master now," one of them hisses before delivering a sharp blow to the back of your head.
    
    The world goes dark...
rows.translation:
一阵强烈的魔法冲击力将你 [pc.weapon] 它从你手中滑落，而当你拼命试图抢回它时，越来越多的恶魔教徒涌了上来，他们一边刺向你，一边将你拖向冰冷的石地面，最终让你掉进了那滩散落的黏稠物质中。那种灰色的黏液似乎对他们毫无影响，但对你来说，这种冰冷而黏腻的物质仿佛在侵蚀你的意志，让你即便身处生死关头，也失去了继续抵抗的力量。格维尔勉强坚持了一会儿，但没有了你的支持，那些狂信徒的数量最终还是压倒了她，情况与之前如出一辙。
    
    “我们现在要带你去见大师了，”其中一个人嘶声道，同时猛地敲打了你的后脑勺。
    
    世界陷入暗影……

rows.original: As you pass through the tunnel at a steady pace, a sudden chill crawls down your spine. Sure, your light pushes away the gloom, but the shadows here atop this descent are getting heavier, the air more cloying, and it's not just because of the growing moisture to be had. Something's up... ...And then out of the shadows, where there wasn't anyone there before, now stands a diminutive mouse-man, naked save for the cloak he wears and daggers in his hands. [var0 |Whisper! "At your service, Champion of Frost." He gives you a little mocking bow, then raises a finger to his tattooed lips. "Rising up in the world since we last met, I see; you're doing very well for yourself." Nice of him to give up the advantage of surprise, which means he's got something else up his sleeve. Whatever game he's playing here by showing himself out in the open like this, you're not buying it. "Come now. Maybe unlike all of the Master's lieutenants, I merely wish to understand my opponent better before the inevitable happens." [party.has einin |"Berach! Stop this madness! Please!" Whisper waggles a finger at Einin. "Ah ah ah ah. Business first, talk later." ] Gweyr looks at you incredulously. "You know this little freak?" Given what happened last time, you're not about to fall for his attempt to stall you and buy Tollus any room to prepare for your arrival. Whisper smiles as you come at him with your [pc.weapon] at the ready, the stitch-tattoos on his lips parting in the most unsettling fashion. "Yes, come at me, Champion. I want to see how much you've improved since we last met — I can't afford to fall behind either, can I?" [party.has einin |"Please don't kill him," Einin moans even as she resigns herself to the inevitable. "Break his bones, knock him out, do what you need to — but don't kill him." Given what you know he can do, that's not something you can promise. Einin swallows hard, but nods. ] Whisper speaks again, but time his voice rings all around you as the darkness of the old castle tunnel itself coalesces and congeals, taking shape and gaining color as it's given form unto more and more identical copies of the mecian himself. "I so do expect to enjoy myself. You should, too." It's a fight! |"Why are you in such a hurry, Champion of Frost? It really won't matter if you get to the lureling now or a few moments earlier." As you focus your light upon him, you take in the details of just who it is you're facing. A tiny mouse-man — or boy; given the proportions, you're not quite sure which. Fully animalistic, complete with a muzzle, soft ears and twitching whiskers, he's covered in a fine pelt of fuzzy brown fur where he's not covered by the dark, voluminous cloak he's wearing. Perhaps under more ordinary circumstances, he might have been cute, even adorable; any hope of that is ruined by the rows of tattoos on his muzzle about his lips, giving them the impression of having being stitched shut when they're together. [party.has einin |"Berach!" "It's been a while, Einin. And don't call me by that name anymore — I have a new name, for a new me. I don't expect you to acknowledge it, but you may call me Whisper from here on out." You stare [pc.heightRange 65 |down |over ] at Einin. She knows this... this thing? Einin ignores you and rounds on Berach — or Whisper, whatever — [einin.weapon] out, but wavering. "That's not your name! Wha... what are you doing with these people, Berach? And why have you gotten those freakish tattoos? Don't you know that they're —" " — Causing all sorts of problems for us poor, unobtrusive mecians? Of course, it's part of why I'm with them in the first place. There you are again, always assuming I'm stupid. No, I know full well what we've been doing in Harvest Valley, and to be perfectly frank, I've been lending my expertise to most of these efforts. Master Tollus has been quite pleased with the results, I'll say. And now with our work here all but complete, I'm sure Shayspa will be one of the fine beneficiaries of the fruits of our labors." Einin closes her eyes and bites her lip, then shakes her head slowly. "Are you insane?! You — you don't look like you've actually turned into a demon, turned into yet another one of these creatures in your so-called new organization. Why, Berach?" "We-ll. I'm not gibbering and foaming at the mouth in the manner one might expect of a religious zealot, if that's what you mean; I've taken the necessary precautions to keep the lureling out of my mind, and as for the others... well, they were plenty mad to begin with. But here I am, years after you left me to rot, and the first words you throw at me upon our joyous reunion are demands upon demands without so much as a hello. Oh, that cut deep, so deep." You don't know what's going on here, but Einin's clearly not herself right now, and it's not just because Whisper is one of her kind, nor it is from the madness that pervades the shadows of these ancient halls. One look at the naked terror and guilt written all over her face is enough to assure you of that. She swallows hard. "Berach... that day it wasn't — we were doing — I didn't know and I didn't mean to — " A ghoulish grin. "You knew exactly what you were doing, my dear Einin. So much for friend, folk and field. In hindsight, it was the best thing that ever happened to me." |"Ah. As much as the Master warned me to take note of. He's still very much sore about you, would-be Champion." Well, you're glad you left such an impression on Tollus that you're living in his head rent-free. First up at the temple, then with the centaurs — that's two wins for you, and none for him. "The Master is a touchy man. Possessing much vision and ambition, to be certain, but he does not take losses well, especially those against people he holds a grudge against. As for winning... well, you have to win every time. On the other hand, we only have to gain the upper hand once. "But come, even if we are enemies, we should have at least some small measure of civility. Allow me to introduce myself — you may call me Whisper. And you?" [pc.isDK |Why, he can go fuck himself. "Ah well. I suppose for you and the Master to be so much at odds, the two of you have to be quite alike, eh? Like I said, your fame precedes you, [pc.name]. I'm sure a self-obsessed [pc.mf |man |woman ] like you enjoys all the attention and recognition." |[pc.name]. A nod. "I appreciate the gesture." ] So, is this the moment he explains everything, is it? "Why, ask away. I'll explain everything you like." ] That's about as far as you get before Gweyr shoves herself to the front and takes a swing at Whisper. "The fuck are you doing, listening to him talk? He's clearly stalling us, buying time for the other demons to regroup!" Her [gweyr.weapon] passes through the mecian as his form shifts ever so slightly, shadowy trails peeling off in the wake of her weapon as it passes through the illusion. Whisper's ghoulish grin widens as his voice rings out again, this time from behind you: "Very astute, Mistress Gundvaldsen. Oh, I suppose I shouldn't use your maiden name, should I? Your reputation precedes you — Leold has been itching for a rematch for twenty-odd years now. Alas, I intend to deny him that indulgence. "Now then. While I would love to continue with this lovely conversation and hold you up even longer, the lovely dame appears intent on removing my head from my shoulders. I suppose, then, we have reached what they call an impasse." [party.has einin |"I won't let you hurt them," Einin murmurs under her breath, readying her [einin.weapon] with shaking hands. Her words seem more aimed at convincing herself than anyone else. "[pc.name], you can't let him escape. For his own good...." Right. Anyone who would willingly join Tollus's little demon cult can't be right in the head. "..." ] Before you can blink, his voice rings all around you as the darkness of the old castle tunnel itself coalesces and congeals, taking shape and gaining color as it's given form unto more and more identical copies of the mecian himself. "I so do expect to enjoy myself. You should, too." It's a fight! ]
rows.translation: 当你以稳定的速度穿过隧道时，突然有一股寒意从脊背传来。虽然你的光芒驱散了周围的暗影，但在这个下行的过程中，阴影似乎变得越来越浓重，空气也变得愈发闷热——而这并非仅仅因为空气中的湿气在不断增加。肯定有什么不对劲…………然后，从那些阴影中出现了一个人影——一个身材矮小的鼠人，他赤身裸体，只披着一件斗篷，手中还握着几把短刀。 [var0 |低语道：“随时为您效劳，冰霜冠军。”他略带嘲讽地鞠了一躬，然后将手指放在自己纹身的嘴唇上。“看来自从我们上次见面后，你在这个世界上取得了一定的成就，过得相当不错嘛。他放弃了突然袭击的优势，这实在不错——这说明他肯定还有别的打算。他这样公然现身，肯定是在耍什么花招，你绝对不能相信他的行为。 过来吧。也许与那位大师的所有副手不同，我只是在不可避免的事情发生之前，想要更深入地了解我的对手。 [party.has einin |贝拉奇！停止这种疯狂的行为吧！求你了！”威瑟尔对着艾宁摇着手指说：“啊啊啊啊，先谈正事，以后再聊天。 ] 格维尔难以置信地望着你，说道：“你知道这个小怪胎？”考虑到上次发生的事情，你肯定不会上当受他的欺骗，让他有机会拖延时间，为你的到来争取准备时间。薇瑟微笑着，朝他走去 [pc.weapon] 他随时准备着，嘴唇上的那些纹身以一种令人不安的方式微微张开。“来吧，冠军，尽管攻击我吧。我想看看自从我们上次见面后，你有了多大的进步——我可不能落后啊，对吧？ [party.has einin |请不要杀他，”艾宁在不得不接受这一事实的同时，还是哀求道，“打断他的骨头，把他打晕，随便你们想怎么做都行——但请不要杀他。”“考虑到你知道他有能力做出什么，这个请求其实很难兑现。”艾宁艰难地咽了口唾沫，但还是点了点头。 ] 低语声再次响起，但当那声音在你周围回荡时，古老城堡隧道中的暗影也开始凝聚、成形，逐渐呈现出具体的形态并拥有了颜色——与此同时，越来越多的梅西安的复制品也由此诞生了。“我确实期待能玩得开心。你也应该如此。 这是一场激烈的战斗！ |为什么这么着急呢，冰霜冠军？你现在到达那里，或者晚几秒钟到达，其实并没有什么区别。”当你用光芒照亮他的面容时，你终于看清了站在你对面的这个人究竟是谁。一个小小的老鼠人——或者说是个男孩；从他的体型来看，你其实不太确定他到底属于哪一类。他完全具有动物的特征，有着尖尖的嘴部、柔软的耳朵以及不停颤动的胡须，身上覆盖着一层柔软的棕色毛皮，只有穿着那件厚厚的黑色斗篷的地方没有毛皮覆盖。或许在普通情况下，他会显得很可爱，甚至令人心生喜爱；但当他嘴唇周围那一排排纹身出现时，所有这些希望都破灭了——那些纹身让他的嘴唇看起来就像被缝在一起了一样。 [party.has einin |贝拉赫！”“好久不见，艾宁。从现在起，请不要再用那个名字来称呼我——我有了一个新的名字，代表一个全新的我。虽然我不指望你会承认它，但从现在开始，你可以叫我‘威瑟’。”你愣住了。 [pc.heightRange 65 |向下 |超过 ] 在艾宁。她知道这个……这个东西艾宁无视了你，转而攻击了贝拉赫——或者叫威瑟普，不管它叫什么。 [einin.weapon] 不，但我很犹豫。‘那不是你的名字啊！你……你在和这些人一起做什么，贝拉赫？还有，你为什么要在身上纹那些奇怪的纹身？你难道不知道它们会——”“——给我们这些默默无闻、低调工作的机械师带来各种麻烦吗？当然，这也是我最初选择与他们合作的原因之一。你们又来这一套了，总是认为我很愚蠢。不，我非常清楚我们在“收获谷”所做的一切，而且坦白说，我在这些项目中提供了自己的专业知识。我得说，Master 托勒斯对目前的成果相当满意。现在我们的工作也差不多完成了，我相信Shayspa一定会成为我们这些努力的受益者之一。Einin闭上眼睛，咬了咬嘴唇，然后缓缓摇了摇头。你是吗？疯狂的?! 你……你看起来根本不像真的变成了恶魔，也不像变成了你所谓的那个新组织里的那些怪物之一。为什么贝拉赫？”“我们……我并没有像人们想象中的那种宗教狂热者那样胡言乱语、口吐白沫；我已经采取了必要的措施来让自己不去想那些诱惑的事情，至于其他的人……嗯，他们本来就已经非常生气了。但如今，这么多年过去了，你把我丢在一边不管，而当我们终于重逢时，你说的第一句话居然是各种要求，连一句问候都没有。哦，这句话真的刺痛了我，刺得非常深。你根本不知道这里发生了什么，但显然，艾宁现在已经不是原来的她了。这并不是因为“低语者”与她同属一类生物，也不是因为这些古老大厅中弥漫着的疯狂气息所致。只要看她脸上那明显的恐惧与内疚之情，你就足以确信这一点。她艰难地咽了口唾沫，说道：“贝拉赫……那天并不是那样的——我们当时正在做……我并不知道，也并非有意要那么做…… 一道阴森的笑容。你心里非常清楚自己在做什么，亲爱的艾宁。所谓的朋友、乡亲们，其实都算不了什么。现在回想起来，那反而是我生命中发生过的最美好的事情。 |啊，正如大师告诫我要注意的那样——他对你仍然怀有深厚的怨恨，未来的冠军啊。”嗯，你肯定很高兴自己给托勒斯留下了如此深刻的印象，以至于他一直把你“记在心里”，永远忘不了你。首先是在神庙里获胜，然后又战胜了半人马——这样你就取得了两场胜利，而他却一场未胜。“那位大师是个容易动怒的人。他确实有着远大的视野和雄心，但他无法接受失败，尤其是那些被他记恨的人造成的失败。至于获胜……嗯，你必须每次都获胜。而我们，只需要取得一次优势就可以了。“但是，就算我们是敌人，我们至少应该保持一些基本的礼貌。允许我自我介绍一下——你们可以叫我Whisper。那么你呢？ [pc.isDK |去他的吧。 唉，好吧。我想，既然你和那位大师之间存在如此大的分歧，那么你们俩肯定在某些方面非常相似，对吧？就像我之前说的，你的名声早已远播 [pc.name]我敢肯定，一个过分自我关注的人 [pc.mf |男人 |女性 ] 就像你喜欢得到所有的关注与认可一样。 |[pc.name]点头道：“我很感激这份心意。 ] 那么，现在就是他解释一切的时候了吧？“有什么疑问，尽管问吧。我会把你想了解的一切都解释清楚。 ] 就在这时，格维尔挤到前面，朝 Whisper挥出了一拳。“你到底在干什么？听他的话？他分明是在拖延时间，为其他恶魔争取重组的机会！ [gweyr.weapon] 通过。通过随着她的武器挥动，梅西安的身体形态会发生微小的变化，武器划过的地方会留下朦胧的痕迹。通过这种错觉。Whisper露出令人毛骨悚然的笑容，他的声音再次响起，这次是从你背后传来的：“真是机智啊，Gundvaldsen小姐。哦，我想我不应该使用你的娘家姓吧？你的名声早已远扬——莱奥德其实已经渴望与您重赛二十多年了。唉，我打算剥夺他这种享受。“好吧，虽然我很乐意继续这场愉快的谈话，再与你多待一会儿，但这位美丽的女士似乎一心想要把我的头从肩膀上拧下来。我想，我们现在已经陷入了他们所说的僵局吧。 [party.has einin |我不会让你伤害他们的。艾宁低声呢喃着，准备行动。 [einin.weapon] 她颤抖着双手说出了这些话。她的言辞似乎更多是为了说服自己，而不是别人。"[pc.name]你不能让他逃掉。为了他好……”没错。任何愿意主动加入托勒斯那个小恶魔教派的人，脑子肯定有问题。“…… ] 你还来不及眨眼，他的声音就已经环绕在你周围。与此同时，那座古老城堡的隧道中的暗影也开始凝聚、成形，逐渐呈现出具体的形态和颜色，与此同时，越来越多的与这个机械师一模一样的复制品也出现了。“我确实期待能玩得开心。你也应该如此。 这是一场激烈的战斗！ ]
rows.raw: " As you pass through the tunnel at a steady pace, a sudden chill crawls down your spine. Sure, your light pushes away the gloom, but the shadows here atop this descent are getting heavier, the air more cloying, and it's not just because of the growing moisture to be had. Something's up... ...And then out of the shadows, where there wasn't anyone there before, now stands a diminutive mouse-man, naked save for the cloak he wears and daggers in his hands. [var0 |Whisper! "At your service, Champion of Frost." He gives you a little mocking bow, then raises a finger to his tattooed lips. "Rising up in the world since we last met, I see; you're doing very well for yourself." Nice of him to give up the advantage of surprise, which means he's got something else up his sleeve. Whatever game he's playing here by showing himself out in the open like this, you're not buying it. "Come now. Maybe unlike all of the Master's lieutenants, I merely wish to understand my opponent better before the inevitable happens." [party.has einin |"Berach! Stop this madness! Please!" Whisper waggles a finger at Einin. "Ah ah ah ah. Business first, talk later." ] Gweyr looks at you incredulously. "You know this little freak?" Given what happened last time, you're not about to fall for his attempt to stall you and buy Tollus any room to prepare for your arrival. Whisper smiles as you come at him with your [pc.weapon] at the ready, the stitch-tattoos on his lips parting in the most unsettling fashion. "Yes, come at me, Champion. I want to see how much you've improved since we last met — I can't afford to fall behind either, can I?" [party.has einin |"Please don't kill him," Einin moans even as she resigns herself to the inevitable. "Break his bones, knock him out, do what you need to — but don't kill him." Given what you know he can do, that's not something you can promise. Einin swallows hard, but nods. ] Whisper speaks again, but time his voice rings all around you as the darkness of the old castle tunnel itself coalesces and congeals, taking shape and gaining color as it's given form unto more and more identical copies of the mecian himself. "I so do expect to enjoy myself. You should, too." It's a fight! |"Why are you in such a hurry, Champion of Frost? It really won't matter if you get to the lureling now or a few moments earlier." As you focus your light upon him, you take in the details of just who it is you're facing. A tiny mouse-man — or boy; given the proportions, you're not quite sure which. Fully animalistic, complete with a muzzle, soft ears and twitching whiskers, he's covered in a fine pelt of fuzzy brown fur where he's not covered by the dark, voluminous cloak he's wearing. Perhaps under more ordinary circumstances, he might have been cute, even adorable; any hope of that is ruined by the rows of tattoos on his muzzle about his lips, giving them the impression of having being stitched shut when they're together. [party.has einin |"Berach!" "It's been a while, Einin. And don't call me by that name anymore — I have a new name, for a new me. I don't expect you to acknowledge it, but you may call me Whisper from here on out." You stare [pc.heightRange 65 |down |over ] at Einin. She knows this... this thing? Einin ignores you and rounds on Berach — or Whisper, whatever — [einin.weapon] out, but wavering. "That's not your name! Wha... what are you doing with these people, Berach? And why have you gotten those freakish tattoos? Don't you know that they're —" " — Causing all sorts of problems for us poor, unobtrusive mecians? Of course, it's part of why I'm with them in the first place. There you are again, always assuming I'm stupid. No, I know full well what we've been doing in Harvest Valley, and to be perfectly frank, I've been lending my expertise to most of these efforts. Master Tollus has been quite pleased with the results, I'll say. And now with our work here all but complete, I'm sure Shayspa will be one of the fine beneficiaries of the fruits of our labors." Einin closes her eyes and bites her lip, then shakes her head slowly. "Are you insane?! You — you don't look like you've actually turned into a demon, turned into yet another one of these creatures in your so-called new organization. Why, Berach?" "We-ll. I'm not gibbering and foaming at the mouth in the manner one might expect of a religious zealot, if that's what you mean; I've taken the necessary precautions to keep the lureling out of my mind, and as for the others... well, they were plenty mad to begin with. But here I am, years after you left me to rot, and the first words you throw at me upon our joyous reunion are demands upon demands without so much as a hello. Oh, that cut deep, so deep." You don't know what's going on here, but Einin's clearly not herself right now, and it's not just because Whisper is one of her kind, nor it is from the madness that pervades the shadows of these ancient halls. One look at the naked terror and guilt written all over her face is enough to assure you of that. She swallows hard. "Berach... that day it wasn't — we were doing — I didn't know and I didn't mean to — " A ghoulish grin. "You knew exactly what you were doing, my dear Einin. So much for friend, folk and field. In hindsight, it was the best thing that ever happened to me." |"Ah. As much as the Master warned me to take note of. He's still very much sore about you, would-be Champion." Well, you're glad you left such an impression on Tollus that you're living in his head rent-free. First up at the temple, then with the centaurs — that's two wins for you, and none for him. "The Master is a touchy man. Possessing much vision and ambition, to be certain, but he does not take losses well, especially those against people he holds a grudge against. As for winning... well, you have to win every time. On the other hand, we only have to gain the upper hand once. "But come, even if we are enemies, we should have at least some small measure of civility. Allow me to introduce myself — you may call me Whisper. And you?" [pc.isDK |Why, he can go fuck himself. "Ah well. I suppose for you and the Master to be so much at odds, the two of you have to be quite alike, eh? Like I said, your fame precedes you, [pc.name]. I'm sure a self-obsessed [pc.mf |man |woman ] like you enjoys all the attention and recognition." |[pc.name]. A nod. "I appreciate the gesture." ] So, is this the moment he explains everything, is it? "Why, ask away. I'll explain everything you like." ] That's about as far as you get before Gweyr shoves herself to the front and takes a swing at Whisper. "The fuck are you doing, listening to him talk? He's clearly stalling us, buying time for the other demons to regroup!" Her [gweyr.weapon] passes through the mecian as his form shifts ever so slightly, shadowy trails peeling off in the wake of her weapon as it passes through the illusion. Whisper's ghoulish grin widens as his voice rings out again, this time from behind you: "Very astute, Mistress Gundvaldsen. Oh, I suppose I shouldn't use your maiden name, should I? Your reputation precedes you — Leold has been itching for a rematch for twenty-odd years now. Alas, I intend to deny him that indulgence. "Now then. While I would love to continue with this lovely conversation and hold you up even longer, the lovely dame appears intent on removing my head from my shoulders. I suppose, then, we have reached what they call an impasse." [party.has einin |"I won't let you hurt them," Einin murmurs under her breath, readying her [einin.weapon] with shaking hands. Her words seem more aimed at convincing herself than anyone else. "[pc.name], you can't let him escape. For his own good...." Right. Anyone who would willingly join Tollus's little demon cult can't be right in the head. "..." ] Before you can blink, his voice rings all around you as the darkness of the old castle tunnel itself coalesces and congeals, taking shape and gaining color as it's given form unto more and more identical copies of the mecian himself. "I so do expect to enjoy myself. You should, too." It's a fight! ] "

rows.original:
You're fighting Whisper!

    The diminutive mecian is a shadow unto himself; his voluminous cloake engulfs his body as he darts this way and that, making it hard to judge where underneath all that cloth and leather is empty air and where is mouse. A serrated dagger in each hand, Whisper cartwheels and tumbles, dodges and rolls, the edges of his being blurring into the darkness that pervades the buried ruins. Numerous shadow copies of himself continually rise from the darkness of the ancient castle, leaping in to join the fight.
rows.translation:
你正在与Whisper战斗！

    这个身材矮小的机械生物就像是一片阴影；他那厚重的斗篷将他的身体完全包裹起来，当他四处穿梭时，很难分辨那些布料和皮革下面哪里是空气，哪里是他的身体。他双手各持一把锯齿状匕首，不断翻滚、躲闪、翻腾，他的身形逐渐融入那笼罩在废弃遗迹上的黑暗之中。无数个他的影子从古堡的黑暗中不断浮现，跳出来加入这场战斗。
rows.raw:
"
    You're fighting Whisper!

    The diminutive mecian is a shadow unto himself; his voluminous cloake engulfs his body as he darts this way and that, making it hard to judge where underneath all that cloth and leather is empty air and where is mouse. A serrated dagger in each hand, Whisper cartwheels and tumbles, dodges and rolls, the edges of his being blurring into the darkness that pervades the buried ruins. Numerous shadow copies of himself continually rise from the darkness of the ancient castle, leaping in to join the fight."

rows.original: "Ugh..." Out of both the strength and will to keep on fighting, Whisper staggers back, then collapses face-first onto the ground. "Well played, Champion.[silly | Veyst Dahn. I am sorry. ]" [party.has einin |"It's over, Berach." Breathing hard through gritted teeth, Einin steps forward, her [einin.weapon] still leveled at Whisper. She's not taking any chances. "Stop this, for both our sakes. Surrender and... and I'll make things right. I'll show you what we were working for... and let them handle us both. You can't be allowed to continue like this." Whisper just chuckles raspily, and Einin shrieks and draws back |It's over. You raise your [pc.weapon], not wishing to take any chances with so slippery an adversary. As you bring it down for the final blow, a chill runs down your spine ] as his body begins to melt like candle wax, losing color and consistency, a dark, inky liquid flowing into the cracks of the ancient masonry. [party.has cait |"No! No! You don't get to run away!" Whitefire streams from Cait's outstretched fingers, cooking the tiles and turning his cloak to ash. "No!" By the time you've gathered yourself and Cait has calmed down, there's no sign of the inky liquid that Whisper's body has turned into — and hence, no way to tell if Cait's spell cooked what was left of him, or if it all managed to escape... |[pc.isDK |Shit! |Oh, no. ] You bring down your [pc.weapon] upon what's left of Whisper, but all that achieves is throwing up several drops of the dark, inky liquid that splash around before seeping into the mortar. ] Snarling, Gweyr whirls around to back you up, but there's nothing left to do at this point; it all happens so fast, in the blink of an eye, that you're still left breathless by the suddenness with which the ghastly mecian made his escape. What's left of his cloak, his daggers, his other material possessions are still around... but of the man himself, alas, the last of the dark stains has fully permeated the ancient stone, seeping away through the cracks. [party.has einin |Slowly, Einin raises her hands to her cheeks and gasps. "T-think he's gone?" |Ugh... he's gone. ] "Gone, but not gone," Gweyr growls. "First rule: if there's no body, he's not dead. Second rule: creatures like that don't have the grace to die on their own, they always require someone to do the job of driving a stake through their horrible little hearts. Now then, let's see if he had anything meaningful on him..." As it turns out, there isn't much. [party.has cait |Given that Cait's reduced Whisper's cloak to a charred mess, that's right out |Whisper's cloak isn't anything you'd want to wear on a good day ], and his daggers are nothing out of the ordinary — it's how he used them that mattered, and not the weapons in and of themselves. [var0 | What you do find amidst the remnants, though, is a short spear. It's clearly ceremonial — no one would ever use such a thing in actual combat, lacking in actual reach and decorated as gaudily as it is, which only begs the question as to why Whisper had it on him. You don't feel any kind of magical or divine power emanating from the artifact as-is, but maybe you're just not sensitive to such things. W-wait. Doesn't this match up with the description of the relic Sanders wanted? It might have been great fortune or maybe you're in the right place at the right time, but this being here... huh, the demon cult was after Sorra's Succor, too? And why would Whisper have such a thing on him? Still, that does beg the question if you would've been too late if you'd gone over to the mountains like Sanders wanted you to... or you might've made it in time to stop them from pilfering not just this, but anything else that might've been there. Oh well. It's a moot point now — if this is really the relic Sanders wanted, then you can bring it back to him when you get out of here. rows.original: The makeshift bedroom is as unassuming and threadbare as you'd have expected it to be — but there is one thing that stands out. Its metal bandings glistening in the dim light of the brazier, the sight of a bound box draws into view as you continue your search, complete with the most unorthodox locking mechanism. [party.has quin |You glance at Quin and ask the bunny-man if he knows anything about this kind of lock. Can he do anything about it? Quin takes all of three seconds to study the box before shaking his head. "Lockpicks won't work on this one, it's a wordlock chest; Tollus fancies himself a heir of old Belhar and is pretty crazy about collecting anything even remotely related to it, surrounds himself with even the most mundane artefacts to aid his silly philosopher-king delusion. If we could find a fence willing to take it no questions asked, it might be worth more than what's in it. It's an antique in and of itself, and the mechanism isn't something just anyone can make any more." Would he? "Damn right I'd do it even if it were worthless, just to deny him it. There're people in the Tael Alliance who'd pay much for one of these... but we don't have the time for that right now. Still, you want to know how these things work, right? There's a password, and you make the tumblers spell it out, simple as that. People also had a riddle inscribed on the chest just in case they forgot their password; solve that, and it opens." Hmm. [pc.bg scholar noblescion acolyte |Based on your own studies, you know Quin's not talking out of his ass; servants of Belharan nobility were not educated and could not read. |Riddles, eh? Shouldn't be too hard to figure out, if ancient Belharan security was testing someone's ability to read. ] |[party.has cait |"Father used to tell Calla and I about these," Cait pipes up as she studies the chest. "They're wordlock chests, a favorite of the old Belharan nobility, meant to safeguard valuables from illiterate [silly |players |servants ]. Each combination lock was secured by a password, and to help the owner remember what it was a riddle was often posed on the chest itself." So if you solved this thing, the lock would just pop open and you could just help yourself to anything inside. "Yep!" |[pc.bg noblescion courtesan scholar acolyte |You've come across these before in your past — wordlock chests, a favorite of the old Belharan nobility, meant to safeguard valuables from illiterate [silly |players |servants ]. Each of these combination locks was secured by a password, and to help the owner remember what it was, a riddle was often posed on the chest itself. If you could solve it and thereby rotate the tumblers into the right position, the chest would unlock and allow you to claim its contents. |Hmm, what can this all mean? It certainly seems like a thoroughly roundabout way to secure a container, but at least it isn't likely to be trapped in the bargain. You test the mechanism a few times, turn the tumblers, but nothing happens. ] ] ] Given how Master Tollus is about relics, it's not surprising in the least to find one of these in his possession. That being said, though, as valuable as the box itself might be, what he's got inside is the more interesting thing...
rows.translation: 这个临时搭建的卧室确实如你所预料的那样简陋破旧——但里面是有一样东西特别引人注目：在火盆昏暗的光线下，那些金属带子闪闪发光；当你继续搜寻时，一个被捆扎好的箱子逐渐进入视野，而它的锁闭机制更是显得格外不寻常。 [party.has quin |你瞥了昆因一眼，然后问那个兔人是否了解这种锁的原理，以及是否能够解决这个问题。 昆因花了整整三秒钟来观察那个箱子，最终摇了摇头说道：“开锁工具对这种锁根本不起作用，这是种‘密码锁箱’。托勒斯自认为是古代贝尔哈尔的继承人，他对任何与贝尔哈尔有关的物品都极为热衷，甚至会收集一些最普通的物件，只是为了支撑他那荒谬的‘哲学家国王’幻想罢了。如果我们能找到一扇愿意毫无条件地接收它的栅栏，那么它的价值可能会远远超过里面的东西。它本身就是一件古董，而那种制作机制也已经不是任何人都能复制的了。 他会愿意吗？ 当然了，即使这些东西毫无价值，我也一定会去做，就为了不让他得到它们。在泰尔联盟里，有些人愿意花大价钱来获取这样的东西……但现在我们没有时间去管这些。不过，你还是想知道这些东西到底是怎么运作的，对吧？需要输入一个密码，然后让那些转盘拼出这个密码，就是这么简单。如果人们忘记了密码，箱子上还刻有一条谜语；解开这条谜语，箱子就能打开。 嗯 [pc.bg scholar noblescion acolyte |根据你自己的研究，你应该知道昆因的话并非无稽之谈；贝尔哈兰贵族的仆从们根本没有受过教育，也不识字。 |谜语，嗯？如果古代贝尔哈兰的安全系统是用来测试某人的阅读能力的话，这些谜语应该不会太难解吧。 ] |[party.has cait |父亲过去常常给我们讲这些故事。凯特在研究那个箱子时开口说道。这些是密码锁箱，是古老的贝尔哈兰贵族们非常喜爱的物品，它们的作用就是保护贵重物品免受不识字之人的窃取。 [silly |玩家们 |仆从们 ]每个密码锁都需要输入正确的密码才能打开，而为了帮助主人记住密码，人们通常会在箱子本身上设置一个谜语来帮助主人回忆密码。 所以，如果你解决了这个问题，锁就会自动打开，然后你就可以取走里面的任何东西了。 没错！ |[pc.bg noblescion courtesan scholar acolyte |你在过去曾经见过这类东西——字锁箱。这种箱子曾是贝尔哈兰老贵族们的最爱，他们用它来保护贵重物品，防止那些不识字的人偷走它们。 [silly |玩家们 |仆从们 ]这些组合锁每一把都需要输入密码才能打开，为了帮助主人记住密码，人们通常会在箱子上设置谜语。如果你能够解开这个谜语，将锁芯旋转到正确的位置，箱子就会打开，让你取走里面的物品。 |嗯，这一切到底意味着什么呢？这种获取容器的方法确实显得有些迂回，但至少在这种情况下，我们不太可能陷入困境。你试了几次这个机制，转动了那些旋钮，但什么反应也没有发生。 ] ] ] 考虑到托勒斯大师对遗物的重视程度，他在自己手中拥有这样的物品也就不足为奇了。不过，尽管这个盒子本身可能非常珍贵，但里面装的东西才真正值得关注……

rows.original: A precious treasure without end, Nor has it a beginning, Its body lacking joint or mend, And in the middle nothing.
rows.translation: 一件无始无终的珍宝（A precious treasure without end） 它也没有开端（Nor has it a beginning） 周身无接缝，亦无修补之处（Its body lacking joint or mend） 中央空无一物（And in the middle nothing）
rows.raw: "A precious treasure without end, Nor has it a beginning, Its body lacking joint or mend, And in the middle nothing."

rows.original:
Something within the chest clicks, followed by a loud thump as the mechanisms within disengage. Instinctively, you step back, fearing a trap, but your fears are soon allayed as the spring-loaded lid pops open, revealing the chest's contents. Within is a round-bottomed decanter of gold-flecked liquid — eminently precious, and clearly very, very valuable.
    
    [party.has quin
        |"Not bad, not bad," Quin says, the bunny-man whistling appreciatively as he shakes the decanter and watches the golden motes swirl about in the liquid. "Wonder what the bald bastard wanted with this here, but hey, you know what they say. No point hoarding it if someone's just going to take it from you when you don't use it."
        
        You chuckle, a brief moment of respite and levity amongst the oppressive atmosphere that pervades the very air. He really is getting used to this adventuring thing.
        
        "You know, [pc.name], I really am starting to find this much more fun than... than before."
        
    ]
    Yes, if you were Tollus, you'd be hoarding this too. Stowing away the decanter amongst your possessions, you make to be on your way.
rows.translation:
箱子里的某个部件突然发出咔嗒声，随后随着内部机械装置的松动，传来一声沉重的撞击声。你本能地后退了一步，担心这是个陷阱，但很快你的担忧就消散了——弹簧装置驱动的盖子猛地弹开，露出了箱子里的物品。里面是一个底部呈圆形的容器，里面装着带有金色斑点的液体，这种液体显然极其珍贵，价值连城。
    
    [party.has quin
        |不错，不错，”昆因说道。那个兔人一边吹着口哨，一边摇晃着那个细颈瓶，观察着瓶中的金色颗粒在液体中旋转。“真不知道那个光头混蛋想用这个来做什么，不过，嘿，你也知道那句俗话…… 如果别人在你不用的时候就会把它拿走，那么囤积它也没什么意义。”
        
        你轻笑出声，在这种压抑的气氛中，这一刻的轻松与愉悦显得格外珍贵。他确实已经渐渐习惯了这种冒险的生活了。
        
        你知道， [pc.name]我真的觉得，现在玩这个比以前有趣多了。
        
    ]
    没错，如果你是托勒斯，你也会把这种东西藏起来。把那个小瓶子藏在自己的物品中，然后你就出发了。
