rows.original: You rub your temples and sigh. The riddle's right there in front of you, but its words might as well have been unscalable walls. Whatever's in the chest is going to have to stay inside until you figure this out.
rows.translation: 你揉了揉太阳穴，叹了口气。这个谜题就摆在你的眼前，但它的答案仿佛就是一道无法逾越的墙。直到你解开这个谜题，箱子里的东西才会被取出。
rows.raw: "\n        You rub your temples and sigh. The riddle's right there in front of you, but its words might as well have been unscalable walls. Whatever's in the chest is going to have to stay inside until you figure this out.\n        "

rows.original: You can't be far now. The jotun masonry of the castle walls has given way to bare rock, the air redolent with the tang of salt moisture. Even the ground is slippery beneath your feet, and here and there you spy places where the cultists have widened the tunnel. Each step feels heavy, each breath is as if you're struggling to inhale molasses. "Going somewhere?" You know that voice. Tollus! "We had warning well ahead of time that you were coming, so I went ahead and prepared a few surprises for you," Tollus says, stepping out of the shadows. His smirk falters a bit when his eyes land on Gweyr —you see him unconsciously reach for his fingers, but the man catches himself in time and turns his attention back to you. "I do hope you enjoyed yourself." You [pc.isDK |kicked every one of his underlings' asses |defeated all of his underlings ], if that's what he means. "Don't talk to him," Gweyr snaps, raising her spear and striding forward. "Don't feed his ego, don't let him stall for whatever he's planning. After him!" Tollus sneers and retreats further into the tunnel; naturally, you pursue. Or would have, if not for the figure that steps out from behind a boulder and makes a swing for Gweyr, who's leading the pack. She raises the haft of her spear to deflect the blow, but is too slow to fully block it; the spikes on the gauntlet's knuckles clip her on the cheek, drawing blood. "You're getting old. Time was when you'd have parried that." "Leold," Gweyr hisses, baring her teeth. "You should be dead. I killed you. I drove my sword through your fucking chest!" "You should have finished the job, bitch. I got better. The master has potions for that." Finally, finally you behold the man you've only heard of in Gweyr's tale — a frostmander man with the iconic flame upon his tail and long, dark hair that hangs down to his shoulders. He isn't particularly well-built, sporting a lithe and lanky frame — well, save for the gauntlet of black metal that extends all the way to his elbow. The way it's more or less fused with his arm, purple veins extending from the metal into his flesh, the way his muscles bulge on that arm and that arm only, making him appear lopsided — despite all that, though, the force with which he broke through Gweyr's guard indicates considerable strength, just like Tollus himself. Appearances, after all, are even more deceiving down here than ever. "Indeed," Tollus chuckles, safe in the shadow of his minion. "A sacrifice every year during the conjunction of spheres; in return, elixirs enough to keep both Leold and I in health and youth until the next astrological event. Alchemical concoctions from the world of Mareth, potent enough to bring my first and favorite lieutenant back from the brink of death." "Wind in your bones, age in your joints, your senses dulling, your body failing," Leold says flatly as he advances upon you and Gweyr. "But the master and I, we can live forever. And soon enough, even though the Dark Lady has kindly taught us how to concoct them, we won't even need the potions any more." [party.has cait |"You what?!" Cait screams, caterwauling like a cat. A stream of whitefire streaks from her [cait.weapon] towards Tollus; Leold catches it in the palm of his gauntlet and tosses it to the floor where it fizzles out uselessly. "You took years of Calla's life so you could add days to your own?!" |So, that's been his game plan all this time, huh: buying extensions to his own life with the lives of others? That's what he sacrificed Calla for!? ] "Tch, you speak as if she's dead. On the contrary, the Dark Lady tells me all sacrifices are warmly welcomed and made to live long, happy and productive existences." The way Tollus says it sends shivers down your spine, and once again, you find him unconsciously wringing his hands as he hides behind Leold. "Certainly a better and more pleasurable life than most dirt-grabbling no-names could ever hope for." There doesn't seem to be anything left to say, nor do you want to hear Tollus gloat any longer. Stepping up beside Gweyr with [pc.weapon] at the ready, you face down the bastard and his underling in the cold and wet. It's a fight!
rows.translation: 你应该已经离目的地不远了。城堡墙壁上的巨石已经坍塌，露出了裸露的岩石，空气中弥漫着咸湿的湿气。就连地面也变得湿滑不堪，到处都能看到那些邪教徒拓宽隧道留下的痕迹。每一步都显得如此重型，每一次呼吸都仿佛是在艰难地吸入糖蜜般。“要去哪里吗？”你熟悉那声音——是托勒斯！“我们早就收到了你会来的消息，所以我已经准备了一些惊喜等着你。”托勒斯说着，从阴影中走了出来。当他的目光落在格维尔身上时，他那得意的笑容瞬间消失了——你可以看到他下意识地想要去触碰格维尔的手指，但及时刹住了这个动作，又将注意力转回到了你身上。“真心希望你玩得开心。 [pc.isDK |把他的所有下属都打得落花流水 |击败了他所有的手下 ]别跟他说话，”格维尔厉声说道，举起长矛大步向前走去。“别满足他的虚荣心，也别让他有时间去策划什么阴谋。追上他！” 托勒斯冷笑着，进一步退进了隧道里；你自然也跟了上去。要不是有那个人从一块巨石后面突然出现，朝走在队伍最前面的格维尔扑了过去，情况或许就会不同了。她举起长矛试图挡住这一击，但动作太慢，未能完全挡住；护手上的尖刺刺中了她的脸颊，导致她流出了血。 你老了啊。以前你肯定能挡住那一击。”“莱奥德，”格维尔咬牙切齿地说道，“你早就该死了。是我杀了你，我的剑刺进了你的胸膛！”“你当初就应该彻底解决我，贱人。我已经变强了，师父还有专门的药剂可以帮助我恢复。 终于，你们终于看到了那个只在盖尔的传说中听闻过的人——一个尾巴上带着标志性火焰、长发垂至肩头的霜冻巨魔。他的体格并不魁梧，身材瘦削而纤长……不过，那副一直延伸到肘部的黑色金属护手，却为他的形象增添了几分特别之处。那金属臂几乎与他手臂完全融合在一起，紫色的血管从金属中延伸到他的肉体中；他的肌肉只在那只手臂上隆起，使得他的身体看起来有些不对称——然而，尽管如此，他突破格维尔防御时所展现出的力量，还是证明了他拥有惊人的体力，这一点与托勒斯本人一样。毕竟，在这个地方，外表往往更具欺骗性。 的确如此，”托勒斯在仆从的掩护下轻笑道，“每年在那些天体交汇的时候进行一次献祭；作为回报，我们就能得到足够的灵药，让利奥尔德和我保持健康与年轻，直到下一次天文事件发生。这些来自玛瑞斯世界的炼金药剂威力巨大，甚至能够将我那位最得意的副手从死亡边缘拯救回来。 骨子里充满了寒风，关节里充满了岁月的痕迹，感官逐渐迟钝，身体也逐渐衰弱，”莱奥德平静地说道，同时向你们和格维尔逼近。“但我和大师，我们可以永生。而且很快，即使那位暗影女士已经教会了我们如何制作这些药剂，我们甚至不再需要它们了。 [party.has cait |你什么？！凯特发出尖锐的叫声，那声音就像猫叫一样刺耳。一道白色的火焰从她身上喷射而出 [cait.weapon] 朝着托勒斯的方向飞去；莱奥德用护手接住了它，然后把它扔到地上，那里它发出嘶嘶声，最终毫无作用地熄灭了。“你拿走了多年为了能够加入卡拉的生命中天数随你便？！ |所以，原来他一直都在采用这样的策略，对吧：用别人的生命来延长自己的生命？他牺牲卡拉，就是为了这个吗！？ ] 啧，你说得好像她已经死了似的。其实恰恰相反，那位暗影女士告诉我，所有的牺牲都是为了让我们能够长久地、幸福地生活下去。高效能的这样的生活……”托勒斯说这话的时候，让人不寒而栗；你再次看到他在莱奥德的背后不自觉地绞着手。“这无疑比那些为生计而奔波的无名小卒所能期望得到的生活要好得多，也快乐得多。”似乎已经没有什么话可说了，你也不想再听托勒斯继续炫耀了。于是你走到格维尔的身边 [pc.weapon] 随时准备行动，你在寒冷潮湿的环境中与那个混蛋及其手下对峙。 这是一场激烈的战斗！
rows.raw: ' You can't be far now. The jotun masonry of the castle walls has given way to bare rock, the air redolent with the tang of salt moisture. Even the ground is slippery beneath your feet, and here and there you spy places where the cultists have widened the tunnel. Each step feels heavy, each breath is as if you're struggling to inhale molasses. "Going somewhere?" You know that voice. Tollus! "We had warning well ahead of time that you were coming, so I went ahead and prepared a few surprises for you," Tollus says, stepping out of the shadows. His smirk falters a bit when his eyes land on Gweyr —you see him unconsciously reach for his fingers, but the man catches himself in time and turns his attention back to you. "I do hope you enjoyed yourself." You [pc.isDK |kicked every one of his underlings' asses |defeated all of his underlings ], if that's what he means. "Don't talk to him," Gweyr snaps, raising her spear and striding forward. "Don't feed his ego, don't let him stall for whatever he's planning. After him!" Tollus sneers and retreats further into the tunnel; naturally, you pursue. Or would have, if not for the figure that steps out from behind a boulder and makes a swing for Gweyr, who's leading the pack. She raises the haft of her spear to deflect the blow, but is too slow to fully block it; the spikes on the gauntlet's knuckles clip her on the cheek, drawing blood. "You're getting old. Time was when you'd have parried that." "Leold," Gweyr hisses, baring her teeth. "You should be dead. I killed you. I drove my sword through your fucking chest!" "You should have finished the job, bitch. I got better. The master has potions for that." Finally, finally you behold the man you've only heard of in Gweyr's tale — a frostmander man with the iconic flame upon his tail and long, dark hair that hangs down to his shoulders. He isn't particularly well-built, sporting a lithe and lanky frame — well, save for the gauntlet of black metal that extends all the way to his elbow. The way it's more or less fused with his arm, purple veins extending from the metal into his flesh, the way his muscles bulge on that arm and that arm only, making him appear lopsided — despite all that, though, the force with which he broke through Gweyr's guard indicates considerable strength, just like Tollus himself. Appearances, after all, are even more deceiving down here than ever. "Indeed," Tollus chuckles, safe in the shadow of his minion. "A sacrifice every year during the conjunction of spheres; in return, elixirs enough to keep both Leold and I in health and youth until the next astrological event. Alchemical concoctions from the world of Mareth, potent enough to bring my first and favorite lieutenant back from the brink of death." "Wind in your bones, age in your joints, your senses dulling, your body failing," Leold says flatly as he advances upon you and Gweyr. "But the master and I, we can live forever. And soon enough, even though the Dark Lady has kindly taught us how to concoct them, we won't even need the potions any more." [party.has cait |"You what?!" Cait screams, caterwauling like a cat. A stream of whitefire streaks from her [cait.weapon] towards Tollus; Leold catches it in the palm of his gauntlet and tosses it to the floor where it fizzles out uselessly. "You took years of Calla's life so you could add days to your own?!" |So, that's been his game plan all this time, huh: buying extensions to his own life with the lives of others? That's what he sacrificed Calla for!? ] "Tch, you speak as if she's dead. On the contrary, the Dark Lady tells me all sacrifices are warmly welcomed and made to live long, happy and productive existences." The way Tollus says it sends shivers down your spine, and once again, you find him unconsciously wringing his hands as he hides behind Leold. "Certainly a better and more pleasurable life than most dirt-grabbling no-names could ever hope for." There doesn't seem to be anything left to say, nor do you want to hear Tollus gloat any longer. Stepping up beside Gweyr with [pc.weapon] at the ready, you face down the bastard and his underling in the cold and wet. It's a fight! '

rows.original: How quickly the tides of battle turn — meeting overwhelming force with yet greater strength, you drive Tollus and Leold further and further down the tunnel. Neither master nor henchman appear better for the wear, but whatever hideous power beyond the physical that animates them at this point keeps them standing despite your pressed offensive. Then as one, they look at each other and start laughing. "What the fuck's so funny?" Gweyr snarls as she brings down her spear in another firm jab. "Finally snapped, have you?" There's no answer from either Tollus or Leold as they disengage from the battle proper, fleeing into the last stretch of the drippingly moist tunnel. [party.has cait |Cait immediately moves to pursue them as they hoof it, but Gweyr catches her by the shoulder and pulls her back lightly. "What are you doing, old woman? We have them on the ropes!" "Don't be so hasty, kitten. Haven't you noticed something strange about all the cultists we've seen so far?" "I don't know, that they're all crazy demons?" "No, that they've been retreating and drawing us further and further into this place. I know this isn't exactly military strategy, but it smells of something akin to double envelopment. A trap, that is." "What does that matter? We're going in anyway!" No, but Gweyr's right. It does feel odd that every encounter you've had with Tollus and his demon cult down here in this sunken castle has ended with them carefully retreating, as if they were prepared for this eventuality. As if they were drawing you in... it's not that you're not going to pursue Tollus and Leold, it's that you shouldn't do so blindly. Even if it's a trap you have to enter, maybe you can spring it without getting stuck in the process. Gweyr nods. "You get it. Before heading on, maybe we should be prepared for what Tollus might have up his sleeve. Basic precautions, that's all." Cait huffs and folds her arms under her chest, but doesn't have a witty rejoinder for that. |You move to pursue them as they hoof it, but Gweyr catches you by the shoulder and pulls you back lightly. Something the matter? "No need to be so hasty, [pc.mf |kid |girl ]. Haven't you noticed something strange about all the cultists we've seen so far?" That they're all crazy demons? "No, that they've been retreating and drawing us further and further into this place. I know this isn't exactly military strategy, but it smells of something akin to double envelopment. A trap, that is." Like it or not, Gweyr's right. It does feel odd that every encounter you've had with Tollus and his demon cult down here in this sunken castle has ended with them carefully retreating, as if they were prepared for this eventuality. As if they were drawing you in... it's not that you're not going to pursue Tollus and Leold, it's that you shouldn't do so blindly. Even if it's a trap you have to enter, maybe you can spring it without getting stuck in the process. Gweyr nods. "You get it. Before heading on, maybe we should be prepared for what Tollus might have up his sleeve. Basic precautions, that's all." ]
rows.translation: 战局的局势变化真是瞬息万变——面对压倒性的力量，你们以更强的斗志将托勒斯和利奥尔德不断逼向隧道的深处。无论是这位大师还是他的手下，似乎都没有因为这场战斗而受到什么实质性的伤害，但正是某种超越物理层面的可怕力量在支撑着他们，使得他们能够在你们的猛烈攻势下依然屹立不倒。 然后他们一起看着对方，开始大笑起来。“到底有什么好笑的？”格维尔怒吼着，再次用力刺出长矛。“你们终于疯了吧？”托勒斯和莱奥德都没有回答，他们停止了战斗，逃进了那条潮湿阴冷的隧道里。 [party.has cait |凯特立刻追了上去，那些人正策马疾驰，但格维尔抓住她的肩膀，轻轻地将她拉了回来。“你在干什么进行中老妇人？我们已经把他们控制住了！”“别这么急躁，小家伙。你难道没有注意到我们迄今为止遇到的那些邪教徒有些奇怪的地方吗？”“我不知道……难道他们都是些疯狂的恶魔吗？不，他们的目的其实是不断撤退，将我们一步步引诱到这个地方来。我知道这算不上什么高明的军事策略，但这种打法很像是一种双包围战术——其实就是在设陷阱。那又有什么关系？我们反正还是要进去的！”不，但格维尔说得对。在这里这座沉没的城堡里，你与托勒斯以及他的恶魔教派发生的每一次遭遇，最终都以他们小心翼翼地撤退而告终，这种感觉确实很奇怪，就好像他们早就预料到了这种可能性一样。就好像他们在吸引你一样……并不是说你不能去追捕托勒斯和莱奥德，而是你不应该盲目地去做这件事。即使那是一个你必须进入的陷阱，也许你可以在不陷入其中的情况下触发它。 格维尔点了点头。“你明白我的意思。在继续之前，或许我们应该先做好应对托勒斯可能使出的任何手段的准备。就是一些基本的预防措施而已。”凯特哼了一声，双臂交叉在胸前，但一时想不出什么机智的回应。 |你追了上去，那些人正策马逃跑，但格维尔抓住你的肩膀，轻轻地将你拉了回来。“怎么了？”“没必要这么着急。 [pc.mf |小孩 |女孩 ]你难道没有注意到我们迄今为止遇到的所有那些邪教徒有些奇怪的地方吗？”“他们全都是疯狂的恶魔？”“不，他们一直在撤退，却把我们一步步引到了这个地方。我知道这算不上什么高深的军事策略，但这种布局确实有点类似于“双包围”的战术——其实就是个陷阱。不管你愿不愿意承认，格维尔说得对。在这里这座沉没的城堡里，你与托勒斯以及他的恶魔崇拜团体发生的每一次遭遇，最终都以他们小心翼翼地撤退而告终，这确实让人觉得有些奇怪，因为他们似乎早就预料到了这种可能性。就好像他们在吸引你一样……并不是说你不能去追捕托勒斯和莱奥德，而是你不应该盲目地去做。即使那是一个你必须进入的陷阱，也许你可以在不陷入其中的情况下触发它。 格维尔点了点头。“你明白我的意思。在继续之前，或许我们应该先做好准备，看看托勒斯可能会使出什么招数来。只需要遵守一些基本的预防措施而已。 ]

rows.original: How quickly the tide of battle turns. Gweyr moves to parry Leold's heavy fist; she catches the blow with the haft of her bone spear — and growls as the blow shatters it to splinters. You move to help her, but in your haste don't see a right hook coming to the side of your head; bloody spots explode in your vision as Leold's black gauntlet smashes into your skull with a sharp cracking sound, sending you reeling to the ground. Snarling again, Gweyr reaches for a backup weapon at her belt, but a blast of magical force from Tollus's outstretched staff sends her slamming into the cavern wall. Ears ringing, head spinning, you look around weakly for anyone who can help, but [party.compNames] are all out of it and down for the count. "Can I take my due?" "I told you to kill her twenty years ago, Leold," Tollus snaps. "I still haven't rescinded that order. As for you, Champion, I've had enough of your bothersome meddling. While I'd expected you to be stronger than this — while the Dark Lady expected you to be stronger than this — I'm perfectly satisfied with this outcome." Grabbing you by your collar with hideous strength despite his bony frame, Tollus hoists you up so that you're face to face with his sneering visage. "But since you want to know just what I'm doing here, Champion, I may as well indulge your curiosity. A glimpse of what I've got in store for the Dark Lady herself." Tollus's sneering laughter rings in your ears as he blasts you with a jolt of cold, dark magic, and your consciousness fails you...

rows.original:
You step off to the side and examine the fountain leaning against what remains of the walled cavern. Cut from old marble, it's shaped in the form of two jotuns holding a basin between them; the water still flows steadily after all these years, and to your surprise, smells fresh despite the entire castle being submerged in the deepest depths of the salty sea.
    
    Despite being placed at jotun height and being similarly sized, you could climb up the rubble to the side to get at it — various buckets and the like set by the basin's rim imply this is how the cult has been getting fresh water for their purposes. They can drink it, you suppose... but can you?
    
    Chance a sip, perhaps?
rows.translation:
你走到一旁，仔细观察那座倚靠在残余洞壁上的喷泉。它由古老的大理石制成，被雕刻成两个巨人手捧一个水盆的形状；尽管历经这么多年，水依然源源不断地流淌着，令你惊讶的是，尽管整个城堡都沉没在咸海的深处，这里的水却依然清新芳香。
    
    尽管这些物体的高度与巨人相当，体积也差不多，但你可以爬到那些碎石堆的侧面去获取它们——盆边摆放的各类水桶等物品说明，正是通过这种方式，这个教派才得以获取所需的淡水。他们可以喝它，你这么认为……但你能喝得下吗？
    
    或许可以试喝一小口吧？
rows.raw:
"
    You step off to the side and examine the fountain leaning against what remains of the walled cavern. Cut from old marble, it's shaped in the form of two jotuns holding a basin between them; the water still flows steadily after all these years, and to your surprise, smells fresh despite the entire castle being submerged in the deepest depths of the salty sea.
    
    Despite being placed at jotun height and being similarly sized, you could climb up the rubble to the side to get at it — various buckets and the like set by the basin's rim imply this is how the cult has been getting fresh water for their purposes. They can drink it, you suppose... but can you?
    
    Chance a sip, perhaps?
    "

rows.original:
If it's good enough for Tollus and his goons, it's good enough for you. Cupping your hands, you rinse them in the basin before gathering a bit of the water and taking a sip.
        
        Aah, now that's much better![party.hasCompanions
            | Seeing no ill effects surface on your countenance, [party.compNames true] wait[party.oneCompanion
                |s
            ] for you to be done, then take a turn at the water, too.
        ] You feel very much refreshed, and quietly thank whoever built this place for conveniently placing this drinking fountain here to refresh you and yours.
        
        Time to face what's ahead, then...
rows.translation:
如果连托勒斯和他的手下们都觉得够好，那对你来说也肯定够好了。你把双手捧起来，在水盆里冲洗了一下，然后舀了些水喝了一口。
        
        啊，这样就好多了！[party.hasCompanions
            | 看到你的脸色没有任何异常变化， [party.compNames true] 等等。[party.oneCompanion
                |s
            ] 等你忙完了，也去玩玩水吧。
        ] 你感到精神为之一振，默默地感谢那些建造了这个地方的人——他们如此贴心地在这里设置了这口饮水机，让你和你的同伴们能够及时补充水分，恢复精力。
        
        那么，是时候面对前方的挑战了……

rows.original:
The clear water's tempting, but ultimately it's not something you want to mess with. You've heard all sorts of horror stories about fountains in your time to be instinctively wary of them, especially in ancient ruined locations like where you're standing right now.
        
        Well, if you're not going to bother with the fountain, then the only way is forward, then...
rows.translation:
清澈的泉水确实很诱人，但归根结底，这种东西还是最好不要去招惹。这些年来，你肯定听过各种各样关于这些喷泉的恐怖故事，因此你本能上就会对它们保持警惕，尤其是在像你现在所处的这种古老废墟之中。
        
        那么，如果你决定不去理会这个喷泉的话，那么唯一的出路就是……

"

        Well, if you're not going to bother with the fountain, then the only way is forward, then... 
        "

rows.original: Tollus and Leold aren't hard to track down; their footsteps echo down the tunnel to you even as you pursue them, splashing through brackish puddles and over glowing corals. Despite the dim light, you feel comfortable in your chase across the even tunnel floor — until it suddenly isn't. "Watch out!" But it's too late for all of you[pc.agilityRange 60 |, despite your dexterity ]. Hidden by gloom and the heat of the pursuit alike, the tunnel floor levels down into a slick ramp, coated with a slimy substance you'd rather not think too hard about. Gweyr makes a grab for you, but she ends up losing her footing as well and [party.combatNames true] pile up at the bottom of the ramp in... in... Where in the gods' names is this? And the sound, the sound that pervades the entire room. It's akin to music, but the tones are far too discordant, too otherworldly to be any melody or verse you could ever conceive of[pc.bg minstrel | despite your career as a minstrel |[pc.cl charmer |despite your training as a charmer ] ]. The sound alone... if you don't stop it soon, there's no doubt it'll drive you mad with how steadily it pounds away at the inside of your skull! You're not alone in this, either. As you struggle to take in your surroundings despite the fugue that closes in about your thoughts, you become aware of a teeming mass of selkies ringed around a pool in the middle. Dozens, no, hundreds of the seal-women are gathered in this gargantuan chamber, kissing, fingering, tribbing, groping and otherwise engaging in all manner of feminine fantasies in a massive fuck-fest as the twisted melody echoes in the salt-damp air. And above it all, above the orgiastic mass of sapphic selkies, Tollus stands; having made good on your fall to put distance between the both of you. Before him is the source of the maddening cacophony — a device of brass not too unlike that which Kasyrra had created in the Winter City, only much, much smaller. Is... is he about to open a portal? No... [silly |Hello! My baby, Hello! My honey, Hello! My ragtime gal, Send me a kiss by wire, Baby, my heart's on fire! If you refuse me, Honey, you'll lose me, Then you'll be left alone, Oh, baby, telephone, And tell me I'm your own! ] Time slows down as Tollus reaches into the device and pulls out a large obsidian disc, causing the auditory assault to come to an abrupt halt; still grinning triumphantly down at you from his perch, he passes it to Leold, who effortlessly snaps it in two. One by one, the selkies in the chamber start coming out of their stupor... but not quite to their senses. "A facsimile of the abyssal creature's cries, but I shan't be needing it anymore. Enjoy yourself, Champion." With that, Tollus and Leold withdraw into a tunnel on the western side of the chamber. You push yourself to your feet and hurry after them with [party.compNames] in your wake, but soon find your way blocked by the massed selkies. To say they're clearly not themselves is an understatement — the vacant eyes, the fixed smiles, the outstretched arms seeking to welcome you into their generous bosoms... ...You have only a moment to act before they're on you. What will you do?
rows.translation: 追踪托勒斯和莱奥德并不困难；即使你在他们身后追捕，他们的足部步声依然清晰地回荡在隧道中，你穿梭在咸水水坑和发光的珊瑚之间。尽管光线昏暗，你在平坦的隧道地面上追逐他们时依然感觉很自在——直到情况突然发生了变化。 “当心！” 但此时，对你们所有人来说，已经为时太晚了。[pc.agilityRange 60 |尽管你动作敏捷，但还是…… ]被阴暗的气氛和追击者的激烈动作所掩盖，隧道地面逐渐倾斜成一条光滑的斜坡，上面覆盖着一层令人不寒而栗的黏稠物质。格维尔试图抓住你，但她自己也失去了平衡 [party.combatNames true] 堆积在斜坡的下装……究竟是为什么呢…… 以诸神的名义，这到底是怎么回事？是这个？ 还有那个声音声音这种氛围弥漫在整个房间里。它类似于音乐，但这些音调太过不和谐，太过超脱世俗，根本无法被理解为任何你能想象到的旋律或乐章。[pc.bg minstrel | 尽管你有着吟游诗人的职业生涯…… |[pc.cl charmer |尽管你接受过魅惑者的训练 ] ]仅仅是那声音……如果你不尽快停止它，毫无疑问，它会不断地冲击你的脑海，最终让你发疯！ 你并不是唯一一个面临这种困境的人。当你努力想要理解周围的环境，却发现自己思绪逐渐混乱、无法集中注意力时，你会注意到有一大群人鱼围绕着中央的一个水池。有几十只，不，恐怕数量还要更多数百在这些女性们聚集的巨大房间里，她们亲吻、抚摸、互相探索，以各种方式尽情享受属于女性的欢愉时光。而那扭曲的旋律，在充满盐湿气味的空气中回荡着…… 而在所有这一切之上，在那些疯狂狂欢的塞尔基女人们之中，托勒斯矗立着——他早已实现了自己让你们保持距离的愿望。在他面前，正是那令人发狂的嘈杂声的来源：一个黄铜制成的装置，与卡希拉在冬城制造的那个颇为相似，只不过规模要小得多。他是……他要打开一个传送门吗？ 不…… [silly |你好！我的宝贝， 你好！我的甜心， 你好！我的爱人， 快给我发一个吻吧， 宝贝，我的心都为你燃烧了！ 如果你拒绝我， 甜心，你就会失去我， 到时候你就只剩下自己一个人了， 哦，宝贝，快给我打电话吧， 告诉我，你属于我！ ] 当托勒斯将手伸进那个装置中取出一块巨大的黑曜石圆盘时，时间仿佛变得缓慢起来，那些刺耳的声音也突然戛然而止。他依然得意地笑着，将圆盘递给利奥尔德，而利奥尔德毫不费力地将其折成了两半。一个接一个，房间里的海妖们开始从昏迷中苏醒过来……但他们的意识尚未完全恢复。 “这些声音模仿了那种深海生物的叫声，不过我现在已经不再需要它们了。好好享受吧，冠军。说完，托勒斯和利奥尔德便走进了大厅西侧的一条隧道。你撑起身子，赶忙追了上去，[party.compNames]紧跟在后，但你们很快就被聚集的海豹精挡住了去路。说它们显然已经不再是原来的它们，这种说法都算是轻描淡写了——那些空洞的眼神、僵硬的笑容、伸出来的手臂，仿佛都在欢迎你投入它们那“宽广的怀抱”…… …… 在你被它们攻击之前，你只有短短的一刻时间来做出决定。你会怎么做呢？

rows.original: Use this item to defend yourself from the selkie marions.
rows.translation: 使用此物品来保护自己，免受塞尔基女妖的攻击。
rows.raw: "Use this item to defend yourself from the selkie marions."

rows.original: You don't think you have anything on you that would help when faced with a horde of sapphic seal sluts, alas.
rows.translation: 可惜，你觉得自己身上没有任何东西能够在面对一群喜欢女同性恋关系的贱人时派上用场。
rows.raw: "You don't think you have anything on you that would help when faced with a horde of sapphic seal sluts, alas."

rows.original: There doesn't seem to be anything for it. With the selkies closing in on you, you ready your [pc.weapon] and get ready to defend yourself from their amorous advances. Hopefully, you won't need to beat all of them, just enough that the rest snap out of it and come to their senses. How many that might be, you have no idea... "Shit," Gweyr growls. "They look so happy, so innocent. It's just like... like fighting kids." If she could just hold back this time... "I'll try, but no promises. At the end of the day, it's down to us surviving, [pc.name], and it's hard for an old woman like me to believe in tears." With that, they're upon you, giggling and singing, pressing their chubby bodies up close and personal with absolutely no respect for your personal space. It's a fight!
rows.translation: 看来没有什么别的办法了。当那些海妖逐渐靠近你时，你只能做好准备了 [pc.weapon] 然后准备好防御他们那些充满爱意的追求吧。希望如此你并不需要击败他们所有人，只需要击败足够多的人，让剩下的那些人清醒过来，恢复理智就行了。有多少那个可能吧，你根本无从知晓……” “该死，”格维尔低吼道，“他们看起来那么开心，那么天真无邪。简直就像……就像在打架的孩子一样。” 如果这次她能忍住的话…… “我会试试的，但也不能保证一定能成功。归根结底，这一切都取决于我们能否活下来。 [pc.name]对于像我这样的老妇人来说，要相信这些话真的很难，简直让人想哭。” 说完这些，他们就会围上来，咯咯笑着唱歌，把他们圆滚滚的身体贴得离你非常近，完全不尊重你的个人空间。 这是一场激烈的战斗！

rows.original:
[var0
        |With seconds to go before the horde is upon you, quick thinking or good fortune has your fingers close about the vial of wyvern venom amidst your belongings. With a flick of your thumb, you push the cork out of the vial and hurl it through the air at the horde. Leaving a trail of pink mist in its wake, the wyvern venom sails through the air and hits the nearest possessed selkie straight on the chest, splattering the pink slimy sludge all over her human half.
        
        The reaction is immediate. As one, the remaining selkies forget about you in the blink of an eye and instead descend upon their helpless sister, the struggle snuggle session they'd clearly intended for you directed upon her instead. As the mass of seal-women goes down in a fit of kisses, suckles and gropes — a continuation of the orgy they'd just abandoned — you're able to turn your attention to Tollus's egress.
        
        That is, if it weren't for the ominous feeling you have in the pit of your stomach... 
        |With seconds to go before the horde is upon you, quick thinking or good fortune has your fingers close about the leananstone amidst your belongings. With a twist of your wrist, you prime the unleashing enchantment and toss it high up into the air, where it shatters in a deafening roar and blinding flash of light.
        
        The reaction is immediate even as the deafening ringing slowly dies down. The selkies' vapid expressions turn first to ones of weary wakening, then to confusion, then utter horror. Barking and yelping to each other in an animalistic tongue that makes no sense to you, they flee in all directions, making straight for the water that rings the chamber and diving beneath the surface in droves. In the blink of an eye, the entire selkie horde is gone, leaving [party.combatNames] alone in the cavern and free to pursue Tollus.
        
        That is, if it weren't for the ominous feeling you have in the pit of your stomach... 
        |With seconds to go before the horde is upon you, quick thinking or good fortune has your fingers close about the vial of oliban amidst your belongings. With a flick of your thumb, you push the cork out of the vial and sling the contents out into the air at the selkies, the volatile oil scattering out in droplets that soon fill the air with its calming scent. The only trace that you've done anything are fine clear vapors that hang in the air for the blink of an eye, then dissipate despite the salt moisture that clings to your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun].
        
        And not a moment too soon. The selkies are just about upon you when something shifts behind their eyes; their vapid expressions turn first to ones of weary wakening, then to confusion, then utter horror. Barking and yelping to each other in an animalistic tongue that makes no sense to you, the seal-women flee in all directions, making straight for the water that rings the chamber and diving beneath the surface in droves. In the blink of an eye, the entire selkie horde is gone, leaving [party.combatNames] alone in the cavern and free to pursue Tollus.
        
        That is, if it weren't for the ominous feeling you have in the pit of your stomach... 
    ]
rows.translation:
[var0
        |就在那些怪物即将扑向你的那一刻，凭借快速的反应或运气，你终于从自己的物品中找到了那支装有双足飞龙毒液的小瓶。你拇指一弹，将瓶塞拔出，然后将整个小瓶扔向了那些怪物。那条带着粉色雾气的毒液在空气中飞驰，直接击中了最近的那只被附身的塞尔基，毒液溅到了她人类的上半身，留下了一片粉色的黏稠液体。反应来得非常迅速。其余的海豹女人们立刻忘却了你的存在，纷纷涌向她们那无助的姐妹，原本那些原本打算给你的亲密举动，现在全都用在了她身上。当这群海豹女人们开始亲吻、哺乳、抚摸对方——继续着她们刚才中断的狂欢时，你终于可以将注意力转移到托勒斯的出口处去了。
        
        也就是说，如果不是因为那种从胃里涌上来的不祥预感的话…… 
        |就在那些怪物即将扑向你的前几秒钟，你凭借快速的反应或运气，从自己的物品中抓到了那块斜倚石。你手腕一扭，将咒语释放出来，然后将其高高抛向空中——在那里，它伴随着震耳欲聋的轰鸣声和刺目的光芒炸裂开来。
        
        即使那震耳欲聋的铃声逐渐消失，人们的反应依然立刻出现了。那些塞尔基人原本空洞的表情，首先变成了疲惫的清醒，接着是困惑，最后是极度的恐惧。他们用一种你完全听不懂的动物语言互相吠叫着，然后四散奔逃，全都朝着围绕着房间的水域方向跑去，成群结队地跳入了水中。转瞬间，整个海妖族群便消失了，留下了 [party.combatNames] 独自身处洞穴之中，可以自由地追逐托勒斯……当然，前提是你的胃里没有那种不祥的预感…… 
        |就在那些怪物即将袭击你的前几秒钟，凭借快速的反应或运气，你终于从自己的物品中找到了那小瓶橄榄香油。你拇指一弹，瓶塞应声而出，香油被抛向空中，那些细小的油滴迅速弥漫在空气中，散发出令人放松的香气。你曾经做过什么，唯一的痕迹就是那些细微的、清澈的蒸汽——它们会在空气中短暂停留，然后即便有盐分和湿气附着在你的身上，也会逐渐消散掉。 [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]真是来得正是时候。就在那些海豹女巫即将追上你们的时候，她们的眼神突然发生了变化；原本空洞的表情先变成了疲惫的惊醒，接着是困惑，最后是彻底的恐惧。她们用一种你们完全听不懂的动物语言互相吠叫着，然后四散逃窜，朝着围绕着那个房间的水域方向跑去，成群结队地跳进了水中。转眼间，整个海豹女巫的群体就消失得无影无踪了 [party.combatNames] 独自身处洞穴之中，可以自由地追逐托勒斯……当然，前提是你的胃里没有那种不祥的预感…… 
    ]

rows.original: With the selkies gone along with the discordant tones from Tollus's metal device, there should be nothing preventing you from pursuing the cult leader and his henchman through the tunnels, and yet your feet don't want to obey. Any step you try to take other than in the direction of the large, still pool of brackish water in the middle of the gargantuan turns your feet leaden, your body unresponsive. It's as if — no, you are a puppet pulled along on strings, any action to the contrary suborned... [party.randComp viviane cait brint brienne arona kiyoko atugia quintillus azyrran einin etheryn |[viv.isDemon|Viv bursts into laughter. "Oh yes, this is really something. This hollowness... this darkness trying to fill my mind. Where are you? I need to see the creature capable of calling forth these emotions from me. You must be magnificent. You'll make a fine research subject!"|Viv stares blankly and begins muttering. "I-is this really what it will come to feel like? Empty? Will the joy I find in this come to an end, and leave me chasing another high that will never come, like an addict? Will none of it matter in the end? Will my research crumble and be lost, like so many before me?" Her voice drips with moroseness, and every other sentence is punctuated with a long, frowning sigh.] |Cait stumbles forward, feeling in front of her as if she were blind, in complete darkness. Tears pour from her eyes as she trips and falls on the slick floor, yet continues crawling towards the murky pool on all fours despite jagged stones digging into her hands and knees. "Calla! Calla! Where are you? I know you're in there! Gods, please, come home with me already!" |Brint stumbles forward, his steps unbalanced, his [brint.weapon] long since abandoned on the ground. Like you, he's being drawn towards the vast, murky pool like a dog on a leash; stumbling on the floor left slick by the selkies' sapphic orgy, he continues crawling forward on all fours despite pebbles and ice digging into his hands and knees, his head bowed in shame. "Mom, Sis... I'm sorry it took me so long to come home. I'm sorry for making you worry... I'm not like Dad. Please, give me another chance. I'll never leave again." |Dazed, mesmerized, Brienne stumbles forward, drawn to the pool's murky waters as if led by a leash. Her eyes unfocused, her jaw slightly slack, she doesn't seem to know what she's doing or even fully aware of her surroundings, having dropped her [brienne.weapon] some distance back. "We can be together forever, [pc.name]. I... I just have to go there. There, we'll never be apart. There, we can be one for all time." |"No! No!" Grabbing her [arona.weapon], Arona hefts it above her head and charges straight for the pool. The slick mess the selkies have left from their orgy trips her up and she falls face-first to the ground, but that doesn't deter your orcish companion; letting out a massive battle-roar, she barrels headlong for the murky, occluded waters, weapon tossed aside and fists raised in her haste to avenge whatever imaginary slight she perceives. "I'm the strongest! I will always be the strongest! N-no one will ever be greater, more worthy of being chieftain than me! Me!!" |Paralyzed in a manner most unlike her, Kiyoko moans as she curls up into a ball on the slick floor, her tails bedraggled as she hugs her knees. Your fox-wife rocks back and forth on the ground, hugging her knees as she mumbles incoherently to herself. "Did I do what was right? [kinu.isInari |Why did she turn out this way, despite everything? She was so sweet and obedient as a child... just were did I go wrong in raising her? What should I have done?" |She smiles every day, but who can perceive her true feelings? I used to be able to, but now she's closed herself off to me... what good am I, then? Have I finished my purpose, now that she is grown?" ] |"No!" Clutching her head, Atugia doesn't seem to be all there, her eyes glassy and movements clumsy as she staggers towards the pool's murky waters. A rictus grin curls her lips near to her eyes. "You've gotta stay away from me, Carmen. It's inside me... I can feel it. Stay away! Stay away! It's... it's for your own good, I can't be saved!" |"This isn't what I wanted," Quin prattles from beside you. You turn and watch him clutching at the base of his ears, staring at you with the most distraught face you've seen him don. "All this time with the cult, my future with the Talons, and even you... who will trust me anymore?" His eyes flicker pink and his flames swap with his fur, steaming and hissing as he clambers toward the dark waters ahead. The stones in his feet bring tears into his eyes, making him bite and grimace even harder as anguish hits him. "This isn't right... this isn't right... I want to fix everything! She slips a couple of times on the slick stone, but that doesn't deter her any in her mad scrabbling; quite the opposite, in fact. Her [azyrran.weapon] abandoned some distance back, Azyrran gazes emptily towards the pool's dark surface, looking... hopeful? "It's okay, Mother. I've brought help. |艾宁四足着地，她的机械伙伴不断用头部撞击光滑的地面，而她则不断地向只有她才能看到的某个人磕头。“请原谅我，爸爸。请原谅我……我这么做只是为了救谢斯帕！看吧？我把这些都带回来了，是为了我们所有人……种籽玉米、工具、研钵……我们再也不用这样生活下去了！求你了，爸爸，就收下吧！“什么？你想把它们烧掉吗？但为什么啊？！爸爸，为什么呢？我付出了那么多的努力——没错，所有这些费用都是用偷来的钱支付的，但这是为了一个正义的事业啊！不，爸爸，你根本不明白！不行！" |就在你眼前，伊瑟琳追着某个只有她自己才能在洞穴潮湿的屋顶上看到的东西拼命奔跑。她伸出双臂，抬头望向天空，却在湿滑的地面上滑倒了，赶紧爬起来，继续拼命地奔跑，双腿不停地跳动着，朝着池塘那漆黑的水面飞奔而去。“不要啊，奶奶！等等！您一定要告诉妈妈，我不是故意的！我真的不是想杀死她的，请您一定要告诉她我非常抱歉！ ] 你瞥了瞥格维尔，但那头老母狼也同样沉浸在自己的悔恨之中，那些悔恨，根据她告诉你的那些事情，你应该很容易就能猜到。“加斯？加斯！在这片疯狂的海洋中，只有你还在坚持着。如果你不尽快采取行动，一切都将陷入混乱！你的时间也不多了，而此时，一段不和谐的旋律正在洞穴中回荡[silly |: 喂，喂，喂！我有个小宝贝，不过她现在不在我眼前，我都是通过电话和她聊天。虽然我从没见过我的宝贝，但她确实是属于我的，所以，请听我的建议，别去打扰这个女孩吧。 每天清晨，你都会听到我大喊：“嘿，中央调度，帮我接通我亲爱的！”他帮我接通了她的电话，然后我拨响了那个电话……接下来，我是这样对我的宝贝说的：“喂！我的宝贝，你好吗？亲爱的， 喂！我的宝贝， 请给我发一个吻吧， 宝贝，我的心已经燃烧起来了！ 如果你拒绝我， 亲爱的，你会失去我的， 那你就会孤独一人了， 哦，宝贝，快给我打电话吧。 并且告诉我，我是属于你的！ |无论你如何用力捂住耳朵，这些念头还是会强行侵入你的脑海。 ] 有些事情正在发生。呼吸变得越来越困难——难道真的还需要呼吸吗？你已经记不起来了。即使还记得，你又能控制自己、控制自己的身体吗？然后，你足部下的岩石和冰层开始震动起来。涟漪从池塘表面缓缓扩散开来，一层又一层；仅仅是水波的这些运动，却带着一种奇异的、令人着迷的韵律，让你不由得凝视着，仿佛被深深吸引……你的眼睛瞪得大大的，视线完全被池塘吸引住了；水面下方似乎有什么庞大而暗影的东西在游动，涟漪不断扩大成波浪，而更多的震动也开始撼动着岩石和冰层。等等，你什么时候走到泳池边缘这么近的？你赶紧后退，刚好在泳池的黑色水花向外喷射的瞬间及时躲开了——那些锋利的冰块和冰冷的水花四溅开来，让你不得不捂住眼睛。
rows.raw: " With the selkies gone along with the discordant tones from Tollus's metal device, there should be nothing preventing you from pursuing the cult leader and his henchman through the tunnels, and yet your feet don't want to obey. Any step you try to take other than in the direction of the large, still pool of brackish water in the middle of the gargantuan turns your feet leaden, your body unresponsive. It's as if — no, you are a puppet pulled along on strings, any action to the contrary suborned... [party.randComp viviane cait brint brienne arona kiyoko atugia quintillus azyrran einin etheryn |[viv.isDemon|Viv bursts into laughter. "Oh yes, this is really something. This hollowness... this darkness trying to fill my mind. Where are you? I need to see the creature capable of calling forth these emotions from me. You must be magnificent. You'll make a fine research subject!"|Viv stares blankly and begins muttering. "I-is this really what it will come to feel like? Empty? Will the joy I find in this come to an end, and leave me chasing another high that will never come, like an addict? Will none of it matter in the end? Will my research crumble and be lost, like so many before me?" Her voice drips with moroseness, and every other sentence is punctuated with a long, frowning sigh.] |Cait stumbles forward, feeling in front of her as if she were blind, in complete darkness. Tears pour from her eyes as she trips and falls on the slick floor, yet continues crawling towards the murky pool on all fours despite jagged stones digging into her hands and knees. "Calla! Calla! Where are you? I know you're in there! Gods, please, come home with me already!" |Brint stumbles forward, his steps unbalanced, his [brint.weapon] long since abandoned on the ground. Like you, he's being drawn towards the vast, murky pool like a dog on a leash; stumbling on the floor left slick by the selkies' sapphic orgy, he continues crawling forward on all fours despite pebbles and ice digging into his hands and knees, his head bowed in shame. "Mom, Sis... I'm sorry it took me so long to come home. I'm sorry for making you worry... I'm not like Dad. Please, give me another chance. I'll never leave again." |Dazed, mesmerized, Brienne stumbles forward, drawn to the pool's murky waters as if led by a leash. Her eyes unfocused, her jaw slightly slack, she doesn't seem to know what she's doing or even fully aware of her surroundings, having dropped her [brienne.weapon] some distance back. "We can be together forever, [pc.name]. I... I just have to go there. There, we'll never be apart. There, we can be one for all time." |"No! No!" Grabbing her [arona.weapon], Arona hefts it above her head and charges straight for the pool. The slick mess the selkies have left from their orgy trips her up and she falls face-first to the ground, but that doesn't deter your orcish companion; letting out a massive battle-roar, she barrels headlong for the murky, occluded waters, weapon tossed aside and fists raised in her haste to avenge whatever imaginary slight she perceives. "I'm the strongest! I will always be the strongest! N-no one will ever be greater, more worthy of being chieftain than me! Me!!" |Paralyzed in a manner most unlike her, Kiyoko moans as she curls up into a ball on the slick floor, her tails bedraggled as she hugs her knees. Your fox-wife rocks back and forth on the ground, hugging her knees as she mumbles incoherently to herself. "Did I do what was right? [kinu.isInari |Why did she turn out this way, despite everything? She was so sweet and obedient as a child... just were did I go wrong in raising her? What should I have done?" |She smiles every day, but who can perceive her true feelings? I used to be able to, but now she's closed herself off to me... what good am I, then? Have I finished my purpose, now that she is grown?" ] |"No!" Clutching her head, Atugia doesn't seem to be all there, her eyes glassy and movements clumsy as she staggers towards the pool's murky waters. A rictus grin curls her lips near to her eyes. "You've gotta stay away from me, Carmen. It's inside me... I can feel it. Stay away! Stay away! It's... it's for your own good, I can't be saved!" |"This isn't what I wanted," Quin prattles from beside you. You turn and watch him clutching at the base of his ears, staring at you with the most distraught face you've seen him don. "All this time with the cult, my future with the Talons, and even you... who will trust me anymore?" His eyes flicker pink and his flames swap with his fur, steaming and hissing as he clambers toward the dark waters ahead. The stones in his feet bring tears into his eyes, making him bite and grimace even harder as anguish hits him. "This isn't right... this isn't right... I want to fix everything! Why can't I undo everything and just be me again!?" |Azyrran crawls forward on all fours, the once-proud hive knight looking completely haggard and defeated as she scrambles towards the pool and its dark, murky waters. She slips a couple of times on the slick stone, but that doesn't deter her any in her mad scrabbling; quite the opposite, in fact. Her [azyrran.weapon] abandoned some distance back, Azyrran gazes emptily towards the pool's dark surface, looking... hopeful? "It's okay, Mother. I've brought help. I've brought help, so, you can be free. Please, Mother, listen to me. Don't leave me alone again, please. Please! I've brought help, why don't you want me any more..." |Einin's on all fours, your mecian companion repeatedly hitting her head on the slick ground as she kowtows to someone only she can see. "Please forgive me, Dad. Please forgive me... I only did what I did to save Shayspa! See? I've brought back all of this for us all... seed corn, tools, mortar... we don't have to live like this any more! Please, Dad, just take it! "What? You want it burned? But why?! Why, Dad, why when I worked so hard — yes, they were all paid for with stolen money, but it was for a good cause! No, Dad, you don't understand! No!" |As you watch, Etheryn chases after something only she can see up in the cavern's damp roof. Arms outstretched and eyes raised skyward, she slips on the slick floor, scrambles to her feet, and continues running desperately, legs pumping as she makes a beeline for the pool's dark waters. "No. Grandma! Wait! You have to tell Mom that I didn't mean it! I didn't mean to kill her, I didn't mean it! If she could've lived... Grandma, don't go! Please, you have to tell her I'm sorry!" ] You cast a glance over at Gweyr, but the old wolfess is similarly out of it, sunk into her own regrets that, given the tale she's told you, you can easily guess at. "Garth? Garth!" You're the only one afloat in this sea of madness, and if you don't do something soon, everything's going to fall apart! You don't have long yourself, even as a discordant melody reverberates through the cavern[silly |: Hello, hello, hello! I've got a little baby, but she's out of sight I talk to her across the telephone I've never seen my honey, but she's mine alright So take my tip and leave this gal alone Every single morning you will hear me yell "Hey Central, fix me up along the line" He connects me with my honey and I ring the bell And this what I say to baby mine: Hello! My baby Hello! My honey Hello! My ragtime gal Send me a kiss by wire Baby, my heart's on fire! If you refuse me Honey, you'll lose me Then you'll be left alone Oh, baby, telephone And tell me I'm your own! |, pushing its way into your mind no matter how firmly you clap your hands over your ears. ] Something is happening. It's getting hard to breathe — do you even need to breathe? You don't remember. Even if you did, would you be able to control yourself, your body? And then the rock and ice beneath you begins to quake. Ripples spread outward over the surface of the pool, slow and thick; a strange, hypnotic quality to the movements of mere water as you stare, strangely transfixed... Your eyes go wide as your vision is drawn into the pool; something big and dark is sloshing around just beneath the surface, ripples turning to waves even as more tremors shake the rock and ice. Wait, when did you draw so close to the pool's edge? You leap back, just barely rolling out of the way in time as the pool's dark waters explode outward, throwing shards of jagged ice and spouts of frigid water in every direction, forcing you to shield your eyes. "

rows.original: When you recover, something ancient and terrible has emerged from the pool, sloshing with water even as it kicks away jagged chunks of debris. Whatever this... this thing is, it's a huge, blue-green creature easily sixteen feet tall, its body sinuous and serpentine sitting on tiny webbed legs — it looks like a cross between a frog, eel and some ungodly scion of an angler fish. Its mouth is a circular, slavering maw filled with ring after ring of spear-like teeth, its eyes tiny and beady to the point where you could very well believe them to be vestigial. And most importantly, its entire body is encased in a layer of thick, gelatinous slime that continually sloughs off it and onto the ground into a disgusting puddle about its feet. Lumia's grace... guess you found the source after all. [flags.GWEYR_SHIP_CUPBOARD |"[pc.mf |Kid |Girl ]!" You feel a heavy hand on your shoulder, and find Gweyr holding out one of the circlets that you purloined from Leold's ship to you. She's wearing one herself, and the intent is clear; the moment you slap it atop your brow, the discordant song of the beast lessens somewhat. Although it's not enough to completely mute the immense psychic power emanating from the creature, at least you can think without it feeling like you're wading through a snowdrift to do so. "I finally figured why the cultists were stealing these from the avanai." And just in time, too. They clearly needed some kind of protection, however flimsy, from the beast they were keeping below the castle. [party.manyCompanions |You turn to [comp1.name] and [comp2.name] and find them stumbling along behind the old wolfess, similarly protected by one of the circlets and looking confused but at least not outright crushed by the monster's psychic presence. ] |Forcing yourself to back away from the creature, you take advantage of the lull in the monster's mind-melody to grab [party.compNames] and haul [party.manyCompanions |them to their |her to her ] feet. Dazed and confused, shivering and out of breath, [party.manyCompanions |all |the both ] of you scramble for your weapons and steel yourself as best as you can to face this otherworldly horror that Tollus has summoned upon you. The throbbing in the inside of your skull is intense, but you bite down and prepare for the worst. ] The madness ends here. It must. It's a fight!
rows.translation: 当你恢复意识时，某个古老而可怕的生物已经从水池中浮现出来，它一边游动，一边将那些锋利的碎片踢到一边。无论这个……这个东西究竟是什么东西那是一种体型巨大的蓝绿色生物，身高足有十六英尺，身体呈蜿蜒曲折的蛇形，四肢上长着细小的蹼状结构——它看起来就像是青蛙、鳗鱼与某种奇异的angler fish后代的混合体。它的嘴巴呈圆形，里面布满了环形排列的、类似长矛的牙齿，眼睛则小而圆，几乎让人觉得它们只是退化的痕迹罢了。 最重要的是，它的整个身体都被一层厚厚的、胶状的黏液包裹着，这种黏液会不断脱落，堆积在它足部边，形成一片令人作呕的黏液池。 卢米娅的优雅……看来你终于找到了它的来源。 [flags.GWEYR_SHIP_CUPBOARD |"[pc.mf |小孩 |女孩 ]你感到有人重重地拍了拍你的肩膀，转头看到格维尔正把你在莱奥德的船上偷来的那些圆环中的一枚递给你。她自己也戴着一枚，意图很明显——只要你把那枚圆环戴在额头上，那种刺耳的怪声就会稍微减弱一些。虽然这种做法并不能完全消除那种从这种生物身上散发出来的强大精神力量，但至少在思考问题的时候，你不会觉得自己像是在穿越厚厚的积雪一样艰难。“我终于明白为什么那些邪教徒会从阿瓦奈人那里偷这些东西了。而且来得正是时候。显然，他们需要某种保护措施，哪怕这种保护措施再脆弱，来防范那些被关在城堡地下的怪物。 [party.manyCompanions |你转向 [comp1.name] 以及 [comp2.name] 它们跟在那位年老的母狼身后跌跌撞撞地前行，同样受到那些光环的保护，虽然看起来有些困惑，但至少没有被那只怪物强大的精神力量彻底压倒。 ] |你强迫自己远离那个生物，趁着怪物思维混乱的片刻，迅速抓住了机会。 [party.compNames] 然后把它们运走。 [party.manyCompanions |将他们引向…… |她对她说 ] 双足部。头晕目眩、困惑不已，浑身发抖、气喘吁吁 [party.manyCompanions |所有 |两者皆然 ] 你们必须迅速拿起武器，竭尽全力让自己做好面对托勒斯召唤来的这种超自然恐怖事物的准备。你们的颅内正在剧烈跳动，但你们必须咬牙坚持，做好最坏的打算。 ] 疯狂就此结束。必须如此。 这是一场激烈的战斗！

rows.original: Screeching in its discordant voice, the lureling thrashes about in its pool; so much goo is sloughing off its body at this point that you wonder if it's going to melt outright into an amorphous blob. Teeth snap and gnash at the air, and then in a fit of fury, it loses its balance and sinks back into the darkened pool from whence it came. As the dolorous song ends, the pressure on your mind weakens, then shatters completely, the rush of clear-headedness leaving you stunned and gasping for breath like a drowning [pc.mf |man |woman ]. [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona kiyoko atugia quintillus azyrran einin etheryn |Cait stares dumbly at the pool, one hand on half her face, her pinky on the bridge of her nose; her cheeks are still wet with tears as she takes a tottering step back, seeming to notice the lureling only for the first time. "Calla? Calla? No... that's not Calla." She looks confused for a second, then realization dawns, and the most abject expression of hatred you've ever seen on Cait masks her face. Is that herself, or merely a parting shot from the lureling? "You lied to me! You used me! You don't have Calla!" All right, this is where you step in before Cait throws herself into the water after the repulsive frog-creature. Wrapping your arms about her waist, you pull back your pink kitten before she does something truly stupid. Cait puts up a token resistance, but doesn't have the heart to fight you as you drag her off and away. |Brint stares into air dumbly for a second or two, his hands held out before himself before realization finally dawns. "Mom? Sis?" You stride over to Brint and give him a playful punch on the side — a feeble, halfhearted one to be sure, but it's all the world to him given the circumstances. Slowly, Brint shakes his head, clenches his fists, and looks between you and the still-bubbling pool. "W-was it all a dream, [pc.name]?" A nightmare, to be certain. But it's all over now. |Brienne stares into the air for several moments, her bosom heaving, one hand raised to her cheek. Eyes unblinking, gaze distant, she slowly forces her gaze away from the pool and to you. All right, this is where you step in. Smiling, you stride up to Brienne and throw your arms around her, pulling her sumptuous, beefy body into a big hug before slowly leading her away from the still-bubbling dark water. "I thought... I thought I'd lose you." Silly girl, you wouldn't do that. "I know you wouldn't. I should have known you wouldn't. But I still doubted..." There, there. |Arona blinks slowly as you approach — you can envision the gears turning inside of her head as her mind starts up again and works overtime to process the new situation. Then, at the moment of realization hits, a triumphant grin crosses her face, and she pumps her fists into the air, roaring jubilantly. "I did it! I'm the [arona.isSub |— " she pauses a moment, noticing you, then grabs you and pulls you close to her side like some kind of trophy. "We did it! We're the strongest!" Nice of her to remember to share the glory... and it's |fucking strongest you gross slug-fucker!" Well, it's ]nice to see her back to her old self. "Hretha said there would be battles worth having in this land... after this, I'm ready for anything!" You sigh and smile. The one-track simplicity of Arona's mind might make it easier to unsettle, but that also means it's a trivial matter for her to right herself again. |Smoothing over her ears and combing her unkempt hair with her fingers, Kiyoko looks back and forth over the stark emptiness of the darkened chamber, and heaves a sigh of relief. "Ah. So it was not real. I knew it could not have been... even if it was a very convincing illusion." Stepping up to your fox-wife, you wrap your arms about her and pull her into a hug. You'd have expected at least a little stiffness out of it all, even now, but she sinks into your embrace without hesitation or holding back. She's been through more than this. Surely the waking nightmares of an ugly frog-fish aren't going to faze her in the least, malicious and malevolent as they may be. "No, of course not." Slowly, Kiyoko presses her face against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun], takes a deep breath, then squares her shoulders with a shuddering sigh. "I still believe we have a villain to pursue, beloved." Yes, you do. Yes, you do. |"You beat it," Atugia mumbles as she watches the last bubbles rise to the pool's dark surface. "We damn well beat it." So you did. You beat the monster together. "[pc.name]..." Look, you don't care if she's a monster, or if she feels like she's one. As far as you're concerned, she's a good monster, and that makes things better; it takes one to know one, after all. If you have to beat her monster too, then so be it. Now, if she wouldn't stand so close to the water that you don't have to worry about her accidentally falling in... "Oh! Sorry." |Something flickers behind Quin's eyes as he regains his senses, then an angry snarl crosses his face. "Damn it! Damn it, damn it! Get out of my head! Get out!" As he struggles with his invisible foe, Quin rushes up to the pool's dark edge where the lureling's still sinking, just the barest hint of gray-green skin above the water. His fur rages into flames, flickering hotter than normal as he scrambles for his journal, fumbling about in his [quin.armor], his eyes blazing as he cycles through his drawings and notes. "Come on come on come on..." The charming bunny raises one hand and the flames around his wrist surge forth; yet as they reach for the sinking beast in all its monstrous glory, Quin's fire sizzles against the gray goo coating its body, hitting an otherworldly barrier. Wait, no, it's... something else that extends just a little way beyond, something blue... blue like the Ways Between. "What the f — " Still ablaze from head to toe, Quin leans over the pool's edge and makes to try again, but all that's left of the lureling are a few large bubbles that linger on the surface before popping. "Damn it!" Heaving a sigh of relief, you clap Quin on the shoulder and pull him away before he slips on the slick floor and falls in. [silly |It's not like the DM was going to let you have a pet aboleth anyway, so... |You've still got each other, and more importantly, there's still Tollus to go after. ] Quin rubs his temples, looking equal parts disappointed and aggrieved, but nods. |Azyrran blinks, once, twice, then heaves a huge sigh of relief. "It's over. It's over..." It's okay. Whatever happens, you're here for her. That, and her mother and siblings back at the hive too. She needs to remember that she's never going to be alone; even if you can't be here for her in body, you can be there for her in spirit. "I-I said all those things?" Azzy raises a hand to her mouth. Not explicitly, but enough for you to put the pieces together. "A hive knight shouldn't say such things." Maybe she shouldn't, but she did at the very outset of all this, and you're glad for that. |"It's... I..." Taking Einin by the wrist, you slowly lead her away from the lureling's pool before she slips on the slick floor and falls in. Your mecian companion breathes heavily, finally letting out a sigh of relief as she leans in against you. "I said all those things, didn't I?" How much does she remember of it all? Einin frowns and massages her temples. "Some... not a lot. But enough to be sure that I've said too much." Really? Between the two of you? "When it comes to it..." her frown turns into a small smile. "Maybe not. Come on, we've got to go after Berach. After Tollus, that is. Where we find that creep, we'll find him as well." |Still a little glassy-eyed and addled, Ryn shakes her head and chases the clouds of confusion from her mind. You step up and give her a gentle tweak on a ear. "It wasn't real, was it? Grandmother..." No, it wasn't. But her feelings are, and after what you've been through together, you think you know more about her and have grown closer. Ryn clasps her hands to her cheeks and turns away from you, looking a little awkward despite everything that's happened to this point. Maybe it's not quite the time or place for this, but still, getting her flustered like this and making her smile may all have been worth it. "O-oh. I just... um... we do have to go after Tollus!" [pc.name], we — " Gweyr's cut-off mid-sentence by an ominous rumbling from the bowels of the earth, tremors that emanate from the stone deep beneath your feet. The lureling's revenge? rows.translation: 它用那刺耳而不和谐的声音尖叫着，在水池中疯狂挣扎；此时它身上脱落的黏液已经多到让人怀疑它会不会直接融化成一块无定形的黏糊糊的东西。它的牙齿在空中不停地咔嚓作响，然后在一阵狂怒中，它失去了平衡，又沉回了那个昏暗的水池里。当那痛苦的叫声结束时，你脑海中的压力也随之消失了，彻底烟消云散。那种清醒的感觉突如其来，让你震惊得喘不过气来，就像一个正在溺水的人一样。 [pc.mf |男人 |女性 ]. rows.raw: ' Screeching in its discordant voice, the lureling thrashes about in its pool; so much goo is sloughing off its body at this point that you wonder if it's going to melt outright into an amorphous blob. Teeth snap and gnash at the air, and then in a fit of fury, it loses its balance and sinks back into the darkened pool from whence it came. As the dolorous song ends, the pressure on your mind weakens, then shatters completely, the rush of clear-headedness leaving you stunned and gasping for breath like a drowning [pc.mf |man |woman ]. [party.randComp cait brint brienne arona kiyoko atugia quintillus azyrran einin etheryn |Cait stares dumbly at the pool, one hand on half her face, her pinky on the bridge of her nose; her cheeks are still wet with tears as she takes a tottering step back, seeming to notice the lureling only for the first time. "Calla? Calla? No... that's not Calla." She looks confused for a second, then realization dawns, and the most abject expression of hatred you've ever seen on Cait masks her face. Is that herself, or merely a parting shot from the lureling? "You lied to me! You used me! You don't have Calla!" All right, this is where you step in before Cait throws herself into the water after the repulsive frog-creature. Wrapping your arms about her waist, you pull back your pink kitten before she does something truly stupid. Cait puts up a token resistance, but doesn't have the heart to fight you as you drag her off and away. |Brint stares into air dumbly for a second or two, his hands held out before himself before realization finally dawns. "Mom? Sis?" You stride over to Brint and give him a playful punch on the side — a feeble, halfhearted one to be sure, but it's all the world to him given the circumstances. Slowly, Brint shakes his head, clenches his fists, and looks between you and the still-bubbling pool. "W-was it all a dream, [pc.name]?" A nightmare, to be certain. But it's all over now. |Brienne stares into the air for several moments, her bosom heaving, one hand raised to her cheek. Eyes unblinking, gaze distant, she slowly forces her gaze away from the pool and to you. All right, this is where you step in. Smiling, you stride up to Brienne and throw your arms around her, pulling her sumptuous, beefy body into a big hug before slowly leading her away from the still-bubbling dark water. "I thought... I thought I'd lose you." Silly girl, you wouldn't do that. "I know you wouldn't. I should have known you wouldn't. But I still doubted..." There, there. |Arona blinks slowly as you approach — you can envision the gears turning inside of her head as her mind starts up again and works overtime to process the new situation. Then, at the moment of realization hits, a triumphant grin crosses her face, and she pumps her fists into the air, roaring jubilantly. "I did it! I'm the [arona.isSub |— " she pauses a moment, noticing you, then grabs you and pulls you close to her side like some kind of trophy. "We did it! We're the strongest!" Nice of her to remember to share the glory... and it's |fucking strongest you gross slug-fucker!" Well, it's ]nice to see her back to her old self. "Hretha said there would be battles worth having in this land... after this, I'm ready for anything!" You sigh and smile. The one-track simplicity of Arona's mind might make it easier to unsettle, but that also means it's a trivial matter for her to right herself again. |Smoothing over her ears and combing her unkempt hair with her fingers, Kiyoko looks back and forth over the stark emptiness of the darkened chamber, and heaves a sigh of relief. "Ah. So it was not real. I knew it could not have been... even if it was a very convincing illusion." Stepping up to your fox-wife, you wrap your arms about her and pull her into a hug. You'd have expected at least a little stiffness out of it all, even now, but she sinks into your embrace without hesitation or holding back. She's been through more than this. Surely the waking nightmares of an ugly frog-fish aren't going to faze her in the least, malicious and malevolent as they may be. "No, of course not." Slowly, Kiyoko presses her face against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun], takes a deep breath, then squares her shoulders with a shuddering sigh. "I still believe we have a villain to pursue, beloved." Yes, you do. Yes, you do. |"You beat it," Atugia mumbles as she watches the last bubbles rise to the pool's dark surface. "We damn well beat it." So you did. You beat the monster together. "[pc.name]..." Look, you don't care if she's a monster, or if she feels like she's one. As far as you're concerned, she's a good monster, and that makes things better; it takes one to know one, after all. If you have to beat her monster too, then so be it. Now, if she wouldn't stand so close to the water that you don't have to worry about her accidentally falling in... "Oh! Sorry." |Something flickers behind Quin's eyes as he regains his senses, then an angry snarl crosses his face. "Damn it! Damn it, damn it! Get out of my head! Get out!" As he struggles with his invisible foe, Quin rushes up to the pool's dark edge where the lureling's still sinking, just the barest hint of gray-green skin above the water. His fur rages into flames, flickering hotter than normal as he scrambles for his journal, fumbling about in his [quin.armor], his eyes blazing as he cycles through his drawings and notes. "Come on come on come on..." The charming bunny raises one hand and the flames around his wrist surge forth; yet as they reach for the sinking beast in all its monstrous glory, Quin's fire sizzles against the gray goo coating its body, hitting an otherworldly barrier. Wait, no, it's... something else that extends just a little way beyond, something blue... blue like the Ways Between. "What the f — " Still ablaze from head to toe, Quin leans over the pool's edge and makes to try again, but all that's left of the lureling are a few large bubbles that linger on the surface before popping. "Damn it!" Heaving a sigh of relief, you clap Quin on the shoulder and pull him away before he slips on the slick floor and falls in. [silly |It's not like the DM was going to let you have a pet aboleth anyway, so... |You've still got each other, and more importantly, there's still Tollus to go after. ] Quin rubs his temples, looking equal parts disappointed and aggrieved, but nods. |Azyrran blinks, once, twice, then heaves a huge sigh of relief. "It's over. It's over..." It's okay. Whatever happens, you're here for her. That, and her mother and siblings back at the hive too. Not explicitly, but enough for you to put the pieces together. "A hive knight shouldn't say such things." Maybe she shouldn't, but she did at the very outset of all this, and you're glad for that. |"It's... I..." Taking Einin by the wrist, you slowly lead her away from the lureling's pool before she slips on the slick floor and falls in. "Maybe not. Come on, we've got to go after Berach. After Tollus, that is. You step up and give her a gentle tweak on a ear. "It wasn't real, was it? Grandmother..." No, it wasn't. But her feelings are, and after what you've been through together, you think you know more about her and have grown closer. Ryn clasps her hands to her cheeks and turns away from you, looking a little awkward despite everything that's happened to this point. Maybe it's not quite the time or place for this, but still, getting her flustered like this and making her smile may all have been worth it. "O-oh. I just... um... we do have to go after Tollus!" Indeed, you were merely waiting for her to gather herself. |That was... a waking nightmare — there's no other way to describe it. But it's over, it's over. You've faced the deepest, darkest fears the lureling dragged out of your mind, and come out all the stronger for the experience. Only you know what would disturb you... well, and the lureling, of course, but that's no longer a matter. Now, there's the matter of Tollus... ] A dark shadow falls over you, and your heart leaps in your throat — but it's just Gweyr. The old wolfess is looking absolutely haggard as she steps up to you, leaning heavily on her spear, but she's still standing, if nothing else. Bad memories? "Oh, yes." Did they involve... "No, I've had worse, from when Garth and I were young. When we make it out, remind me to tell you some of our stories." She thumps her chest heavily, and coughs. "Gods, that fish-thing wasn't playing around. Did it..." No body. "Oh. Right. Well, that settles it, then. [pc.name], we — " Gweyr's cut-off mid-sentence by an ominous rumbling from the bowels of the earth, tremors that emanate from the stone deep beneath your feet. The lureling's revenge? [silly |Or more likely, you just happened to defeat a load-bearing boss and the natural result is manifesting before your eyes. ] Shards of ice come crashing down about you, shattering on the ground. Yeah, this doesn't look good. "Ah." Gweyr doesn't appear surprised in the least. "Time to leave, [pc.mf |kid |girl ], and we ought to make it fast." '

rows.original:
The abyssal beast howls, an unearthly screech that leaves you staggering back and grabbing at your head. Screaming in pain, you slump to your knees, unable to think of anything but the pounding in your head. Even so, you summon up the last of your strength and try to stagger away from the pool, trying to avoid the lureling's gnashing teeth and flailing tentacles, flecks of gelatinous gray goo dripping from its extremities. Step by step, the lureling lumbers out of its pool on stubby legs, transfixing you with its fathomless dark eyes; you lack the strength or will to resist it as it knocks your [pc.weapon] away with one of its many tentacles and grabs you with another. The gray goo presses through your [pc.armor], oozing and rolling against your [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]; its cold, clammy touch leaches into your flesh and pervades your bones, draining your fighting spirit.
    
    It's over... everything could be dismissed as a fever dream, if not for the cold.
rows.translation:
那头深渊巨兽发出令人毛骨悚然的尖叫，那声音如此刺耳，让你不由得后退几步，双手抱头。你在痛苦中尖叫着，双膝一软瘫倒在地，脑海中只剩下那剧烈跳动的头痛感。即便如此，你还是拼尽最后的力气，试图踉跄着远离那个水池，避开那头怪物那锋利的牙齿和乱舞的触手——那些触手的末端正滴着黏稠的灰色粘液。一步一步，这种生物用它那短粗的腿从水中爬出来，它那深不见底的黑眼睛紧紧地盯着你；你没有力气，也没有勇气去抗性它，当它靠近你的时候 [pc.weapon] 它会用其中一条触手抓住你，然后又用另一条触手抓住你。那种灰色的黏液会渗透进你的身体 [pc.armor]那些黏糊糊的东西正不断地在你身上滑动、滚动 [pc.skinFurScalesNoun]它的冰冷、潮湿触感会渗入你的肌肤，渗透到你的骨头里，耗尽你所有的斗志。
    
    一切都结束了……要不是这种寒冷的存在，这一切都可以被当作一场发烧引发的幻梦而忽略掉。

rows.original:
Despite the castle coming down all around you, you still take the time to give Tollus's workbench and alchemical setup a quick-look over. You'll be damned if you went through all this effort to turn up as empty-handed as you have.
    
    While you don't find any gold or artifacts, you do manage to gather treasure of a different sort: sheaves upon sheaves of papers, all in Tollus's spidery handwriting. While you don't have the time to go through all of these right now when the castle's collapsing in and about your ears, these might prove interesting reading later on. There's also a breastplate, newly forged by the looks of it, and studded with crystals. [silly
        |Yoink!
        |You'll be having that, too.
    ]
    
    With the research findings safely in your possession, you turn back to the task of getting out of this place before it's too late. Tollus and Leold must have had a way of getting out of here...
rows.translation:
尽管周围的城堡都在崩塌，你还是抽时间快速看了一眼托勒斯的工作台和炼金设备。如果你付出了这么多努力，最后却一无所获，那可太冤了。
    
    虽然你没有找到任何黄金或文物，但你确实收集到了另一种“宝藏”：一大堆文件，全都用托勒斯那种潦草的笔迹写成。眼下城堡正在逐渐崩塌，你根本没有时间去仔细阅读这些文件，但以后它们可能会成为一些有趣的读物。那里还有一块胸甲，看样子是刚刚锻造出来的，上面镶嵌着水晶。 [silly
        |哟吼！
        |你也会得到那个的。
    ]
    
    既然你已经掌握了这些研究结果，接下来就必须尽快离开这个地方，否则就为时已晚了。托勒斯和莱奥德肯定有办法离开这里的……

rows.original: As dust, saltwater and chunks of masonry continue to rain down around your ears, you take in the sight of the pillar of deep blue crystal and know what must be done. It glimmers with the light of activation — Tollus must've awoken it in his escape — and given how cracks are spidering across its faceted surface, you don't have much time remaining. [pc.isDK |You're the first in, followed shortly by [party.compNames] with Gweyr bringing up the rear. Barely has the old wolfess |You hurry and urge [party.compNames] in ahead of you, holding the way open before making a mad scramble for the portal yourself. Barely have you ] finished making the crossing that you hear the crash and tinkle of the crystal gateway shattering to pieces behind you. From where you were, the pillar of light that usually denotes a gateway to and from the Ways Between flickers and dies out, leaving [party.manyCompanions |all |both ] of you high above the world. "That was... that was closer than I'd have liked," Gweyr gasps, grasping with a furred hand at her chest beneath all her damp furs. "Damn it, my heart. Tira's tits, maybe that asshole Leold was right. I am getting old." [party.has cait |"Nothing wrong with that," Cait pipes up. "For a mercenary, you've lived a long and hearty life against all the odds. For a lupine, you're doing much better than others your age would be." "And don't I know it, girl." |Nothing wrong with that. For a mercenary, she's lived a long and hearty life against the odds, and for a lupine she's much more active at a time when others would be looking to start on their dotage. "And don't I know it, [pc.mf |kid |girl ]." ] Looking down at herself, Gweyr coughs. "Now, where the hell are we? It damn well counts as being above water, because Imora's tattoo is gone." You look down at your [pc.belly], and indeed, Imora's tattoo has vanished from your skin without leaving so much as a trace. Turning your attention back to Gweyr, you briefly explain the Ways Between as far as you understand them. She scratches her head, then nods. "I don't quite understand it all, but so long as we're safe and can get home. At the very least, I don't see Tollus or Leold anywhere... come to think of it, did that frog-fish-thing die?" Like she's fond of saying, if there's no body, it's not dead. And after what happened with Leold twenty years ago, sometimes even if there's what appears to be a body..." "Oy, point taken. Come on, let's head home. You do know how to get home, don't you?"
rows.translation: 当灰尘、咸水和碎石不断从你耳边落下时，你看到了那根深蓝色水晶柱，立刻明白了必须采取的行动。它在激活的光芒中闪烁着光芒——肯定是托勒斯在逃跑时触发了它的启动机制——而从其多面体表面蔓延开的裂缝来看，你已经没有太多时间了。 [pc.isDK |你是第一个到达的，紧接着其他人也会陆续到来。 [party.compNames] 在格维尔殿后护卫的情况下，这只老母狼几乎…… |你赶紧催促一下吧。 [party.compNames] 在他前面，他先为你们开辟了道路，然后自己才冲向传送门。你刚一跟上…… ] 当你终于穿过那道通道时，身后突然传来水晶大门碎裂的声响。从你所在的位置望去，那道通常象征着通往“诸界通道”的光柱正在闪烁着光芒，最终渐渐熄灭了 [party.manyCompanions |所有 |两者都 ] 那太……太接近了，比我预想的要近得多，”格维尔喘着气说道，他用那双覆满毛发的手紧紧按住自己湿漉漉的毛皮下的胸口。“该死，我的心脏……或许蒂拉说得对，那个混蛋莱奥德说得没错，我确实老了。 [party.has cait |这没什么不好的，”凯特插话说，“对一个雇佣兵来说，你在种种艰难险阻中依然活得如此长久且充满活力，已经相当不错了。而对于一个狼人来说，你的表现也比同龄人要好得多。”“我当然明白这一点，姑娘。 |这没什么不妥的。对一名雇佣兵来说，她在逆境中度过了一段漫长而充实的人生；而对于一只狼人来说，在其他人已经开始步入老年期的时候，她依然充满活力。“我岂会不知道这一点呢 [pc.mf |小孩 |女孩 ]." ] 格维尔低头看了看自己，然后轻咳了一声：“现在，我们到底在什么地方？不过这里确实是在水面上，因为伊莫拉的纹身已经消失了。”你低头看了看自己的 [pc.belly]的确，伊莫拉的纹身已经从你的皮肤上消失得无影无踪，连一点痕迹都没有留下。当你把注意力重新转向格维尔时，你简要地向她解释了你所理解的“那些通道”的含义。她挠了挠头，然后点了点头。“我其实并不完全明白这一切，但只要我们能保证安全并回到家就好了。至少，我看不到托勒斯或利奥尔德的踪影……仔细想想，那个长得像青蛙又像鱼的生物死亡她总喜欢说，如果没有尸体，那就不能算死亡。而二十年前莱奥德发生的那件事之后，有时候，即使有看起来像尸体的东西…… “哎，你说得有道理。好了，我们回家吧。你应该知道怎么回家吧？
