rows.original: The culmination of all your nightmares continues in crystal clarity, and you're unable to avert your eyes as it unfolds. A great arm stretches from the pillar, clad in the armor of your ancestors, and attempts to grasp at the shadowy darkness flowing into its top. An instant later, the innermost circles of villagers falter and drop as their energy is drained. In that moment, a second arm stretches from the twisting light. Rather than the calming glow of ancestral magic, this one is [rand |sickeningly solid |foggy and ethereal ]. It [rand |writhes with purple-red muscle that ripples like worms or snakes |pulses with cancerous orbs that glow purple-red against the light |stretches taut against far too many bones ], and it twitches like it doesn't know how to work its own fingers. Learning quickly, it grips the other arm around the wrist and pulls it back into the unfocused energy. By now the rest of the villagers are either running, or are too stunned to move. Your mother pulls at your shoulders, but as you turn to run all three of you fall to the ground. A series of immense tremors knock your feet out from under you, as if the very earth is being drawn like as much spirit energy. The truth you find as you spin your head to see is altogether more terrifying. Stretched out from the pillar, a massive leg has slammed into the ground hard enough to leave cracks in the dry dirt. In similar fashion to the arm from before, it [rand |undulates with snake-like muscle that's hard to pin down with your eyes. |blinks with myriad eyes that all stare straight into your own. |sloughs off of jagged spikes of bone that still manage to support its weight. ] Above it, two arms wrench the gathered energy in twain, and a horrifying mass of similar limbs tumble out onto the plains. Around where it lands, the people you'd thought were drained stand. They're alive, but they're different... wrong, like the creature. You turn and void your stomach. Just looking at the thing grinds at your mind. It's like its form is mercurial in a way that your brain can't comprehend, something that wasn't meant to exist. This is the caliber of monster that the world is facing, and you were a fool to hope your ritual would make a difference. Struggling to crawl away, you spin once more when you hear a ear-splitting noise. The thing is screaming, and the noise doesn't stop as it stands on legs that are already more solid than they were the last time you looked. It's tall, and you can still see the basic shape of the ancestor construct wreathed in that same shadowy darkness from before. It takes a step forward, and reaches a hand toward some of the fleeing villagers before taking a leaping step after them. Your father tenses, gritting his teeth and dropping into a fighting stance. Without delay, your mother joins him, and seconds later a flash of light covers each in a full set of spectral gear. "Run, Atugia! We'll hold it back!" he shouts, tossing a spear of brilliant energy. The thing takes the impact like a liquid, screaming as it folds in on itself. It pauses for a moment, trembling and shaking like it's never felt pain before, and then unfolds several extra arms and legs. Myriad eyes open on its central body, shifting between the bright blue of your own ancestral magic and a hazy red that's hard to focus on. More villagers turn to join your parents in standing against the monster, but every spear thrown its way pierces less deeply than the last. Great spectral shears form above each of its arms, and it begins tossing them haphazardly into the ranks of those who stayed to fight. You stand, unable to stop yourself from entering a combat stance despite everything telling you to flee. Everything tells you to run. But you didn't do that. You stood and fought extinction with fire in your eyes.
rows.translation: 你所有噩梦的结局以极其清晰的方式呈现在你面前，你根本无法移开视线。 一根巨大的手臂从柱子中伸出，它披着你祖先们的铠甲，试图抓住那股涌入其内部的黑暗力量。就在那一瞬间，村子里最底层的居民们开始摇摇欲坠，他们的能量被彻底吸干。而就在这时，另一只手臂从那扭曲的光芒中伸了出来——与祖先们带来的宁静魔法之光截然不同，这只手臂散发出的，是 [rand |扎实得令人惊叹 |朦胧而缥缈 ]. 它 [rand |那些紫红色的肌肉不断蠕动，仿佛蠕虫或蛇一般扭动着。 |这些物体会释放出紫红色的光亮，仿佛蕴含着癌细胞一般。 |这些肌肉因为要支撑过多的骨骼而处于持续紧张的状态。 ]它的手指不停地抽搐，似乎不知道该如何正常活动。但它学得很快，很快就用另一只手抓住了那人的手腕，将其拉回了那股混乱无序的能量之中。 此时，其他村民要么已经逃跑了，要么吓得动弹不得。你的母亲拉住了你的肩膀，但当你转身想要逃跑时，你们三个人一起摔在了地上。一连串剧烈的震动让你们无法站稳，仿佛整个大地都在被某种力量吸走，所有的支撑都消失了。当你转过头去查看时，所发现的真相简直更加令人恐惧。 从那根柱子延伸出来的一条巨大的腿狠狠地砸在地面之上，力度之大以至于在干涸的泥土中留下了裂痕。与之前出现的那条手臂一样，这条腿 [rand |那些如同蛇一般的肌肉线条不断起伏，让人难以用肉眼准确捕捉它们的轮廓。 |无数双眼睛闪烁着光芒，全都直直地注视着你。 |它摆脱了那些依然能够支撑其重量的尖锐骨刺。 ] 在其上方，两只“手臂”将聚集的能量强行分开，一道由无数类似肢体构成的恐怖怪物从天而降，坠落在平原上。在它落地的周围，那些你原本以为已经失去生命的人站了起来。他们还活着，但却发生了变化……不对，他们已经变得和那个怪物一样了。 你转过身，忍不住吐了出来。仅仅是看着那个东西，就让你感到无比难受。它的形态仿佛在不断变化，完全超出了你大脑的理解范围，简直就是某种本不该存在的怪物。这就是这个世界正在面对的恐怖敌人，而你竟然还妄图相信自己的仪式能够改变什么，真是太愚蠢了。你正努力爬开，突然听到一声震耳欲聋的巨响。那个东西在尖叫，而且这种声音始终没有停止——它现在站立着的腿，已经比你上次看到的时候结实多了。 它很高，你仍然能够看到那个古老构造物的基本轮廓，它依然被那种阴暗的光芒笼罩着。你向前迈出一步，伸出手去试图抓住那些正在逃跑的村民，然后立刻跟着他们跳了下去。你的父亲立刻紧张起来，咬紧牙关，摆出了战斗姿势。不一会儿，你的母亲也加入了他的行列，几秒钟后，一道光芒闪过，他们俩都穿上了整套幽灵般的装备。 快跑，阿图吉娅！我们会拖住它们的！”他边喊边抛出一支充满能量的长矛。 那个生物像液体一样承受了这一击，发出尖锐的叫声，然后开始向内收缩。它停顿了片刻，浑身颤抖着，仿佛从未感受过疼痛，随后又长出了几条新的手臂和腿。无数双眼睛从它的中央身体上睁开，那些目光在你祖先所拥有的明亮蓝色魔法与那种难以聚焦的朦胧红色之间来回切换。越来越多的村民加入到你父母的行列中，共同对抗这个怪物，然而，每一支投向它的长矛所造成的伤害都比前一支要轻。它的每一条臂膀上方都会形成巨大的幽灵之刃，然后它开始将这些刃刃随意地向那些选择继续战斗的敌人投掷过去。 你站在那里，尽管一切都在提醒你应该逃跑，却还是忍不住摆出了战斗姿态。一切它告诉你应该逃跑。 但你并没有这么做。你站了出来，眼中燃着火焰，与灭绝之力展开了抗争。
rows.raw: " The culmination of all your nightmares continues in crystal clarity, and you're unable to avert your eyes as it unfolds. A great arm stretches from the pillar, clad in the armor of your ancestors, and attempts to grasp at the shadowy darkness flowing into its top. An instant later, the innermost circles of villagers falter and drop as their energy is drained. In that moment, a second arm stretches from the twisting light. Rather than the calming glow of ancestral magic, this one is [rand |sickeningly solid |foggy and ethereal ]. It [rand |writhes with purple-red muscle that ripples like worms or snakes |pulses with cancerous orbs that glow purple-red against the light |stretches taut against far too many bones ], and it twitches like it doesn't know how to work its own fingers. Learning quickly, it grips the other arm around the wrist and pulls it back into the unfocused energy. By now the rest of the villagers are either running, or are too stunned to move. Your mother pulls at your shoulders, but as you turn to run all three of you fall to the ground. A series of immense tremors knock your feet out from under you, as if the very earth is being drawn like as much spirit energy. The truth you find as you spin your head to see is altogether more terrifying. Stretched out from the pillar, a massive leg has slammed into the ground hard enough to leave cracks in the dry dirt. In similar fashion to the arm from before, it [rand |undulates with snake-like muscle that's hard to pin down with your eyes. |blinks with myriad eyes that all stare straight into your own. |sloughs off of jagged spikes of bone that still manage to support its weight. ] Above it, two arms wrench the gathered energy in twain, and a horrifying mass of similar limbs tumble out onto the plains. Around where it lands, the people you'd thought were drained stand. They're alive, but they're different... wrong, like the creature. You turn and void your stomach. Just looking at the thing grinds at your mind. It's like its form is mercurial in a way that your brain can't comprehend, something that wasn't meant to exist. This is the caliber of monster that the world is facing, and you were a fool to hope your ritual would make a difference. Struggling to crawl away, you spin once more when you hear a ear-splitting noise. The thing is screaming, and the noise doesn't stop as it stands on legs that are already more solid than they were the last time you looked. It's tall, and you can still see the basic shape of the ancestor construct wreathed in that same shadowy darkness from before. It takes a step forward, and reaches a hand toward some of the fleeing villagers before taking a leaping step after them. Your father tenses, gritting his teeth and dropping into a fighting stance. Without delay, your mother joins him, and seconds later a flash of light covers each in a full set of spectral gear. "Run, Atugia! We'll hold it back!" he shouts, tossing a spear of brilliant energy. The thing takes the impact like a liquid, screaming as it folds in on itself. It pauses for a moment, trembling and shaking like it's never felt pain before, and then unfolds several extra arms and legs. Myriad eyes open on its central body, shifting between the bright blue of your own ancestral magic and a hazy red that's hard to focus on. More villagers turn to join your parents in standing against the monster, but every spear thrown its way pierces less deeply than the last. Great spectral shears form above each of its arms, and it begins tossing them haphazardly into the ranks of those who stayed to fight. You stand, unable to stop yourself from entering a combat stance despite everything telling you to flee. Everything tells you to run. But you didn't do that. You stood and fought extinction with fire in your eyes. "

rows.original: You wanted so desperately to win, but you didn't do that.
rows.translation: 你如此迫切地渴望获胜，但你并没有那么做。
rows.raw: "\n You wanted so desperately to win, but you didn't do that.\n "

rows.original:
You wanted desperately to flee, but you didn't do that.
    
    You wanted desperately to save those falling around you, your people, your family. You didn't do that, either...
    
    The nightmare-haunting creature paused before you, opening jaws like a giant pair of scissors to devour you, and then everything turned to dark.
rows.translation:
你迫切地想要逃跑，但却没有那么做。
    
    你同样迫切地想要拯救那些周围倒下的人们——你的同胞，你的家人。然而，你也没有那么做……
    
    那个被噩梦困扰的怪物在你面前停了下来，张开它那如同巨型剪刀般的下颚，仿佛想要将你吞噬殆尽，随后，一切便陷入了暗影之中。
rows.raw:
"
    You wanted desperately to flee, but you didn't do that.
    
    You wanted desperately to save those falling around you, your people, your family. You didn't do that, either...
    
    The nightmare-haunting creature paused before you, opening jaws like a giant pair of scissors to devour you, and then everything turned to dark.
    "

rows.original:
You wake with a start, drenched in sweat and screaming. Wait, no... That's... That's not you screaming. What was that just now? Were those Atugia's memories? Jumping to your feet, you dress and enter the hall. The screaming is very real, coming through the open door to Atugia's room. It's a constant noise, inhuman even, and it keeps the memories of that dream swimming around in your head as you close the distance.
    
    Cait is already there as you enter, staring in shock as Atugia floats several feet above the bed. She's lifting steadily higher by the second, tossing and turning in the midst of her nightmare. [cait.recruited
        |Your feline companion says something
        |The terrified catgirl says something
    ], but you can't hear her over the scream. That's wrong, though. It's not really a scream anymore, and Atugia's mouth is closed. It's more like a whine you can hear in your brain, getting louder the higher she rises. It takes everything in your power to get closer, reaching out to try and pull her down. You make it about half-way.
    
    Before you can reach her, the noise hits a crescendo. You're knocked to your ass as a pulse of brilliant blue light explodes from Atugia's body. It's more out of surprise than anything, as you hardly feel it pass through you, but you can see it travel through the walls and continue out the window. It goes until it reaches the very limit of your vision, and then dissipates into fine mist. Without wasting time to worry about that for now, you finish closing the gap to be at the horror-wracked dullahan's side. 
    
    "[pc.n]-[pc.name]," she says, her voice a rough croak. "Ugh, gods. D-did I wake everyone up? I haven't had a nightmare that bad in a while. Sorry if I worried y- What? What's wrong?"
    
    Before you can answer, there's a storm of footsteps outside as Garth[party.hasCompanions| and your allies| and some of the early morning patrons] come running to see what happened. Garth stops in the door, breathing heavy and still holding a dish-towel.
    
    "What in the blazes was that light? Is everything ok up here?" he asks.
    
    "Light? What light?" Atugia asks, her face etched with worry.
    
    "[pc.dcb
        |We've got some catching up to do on both sides, it seems,
        |Perhaps you should come down and get some breakfast and we can talk about it,
        |How 'bout you come get some nice breakfast and we can talk about it,
    ]" you say, helping her to sit up and [pc.isDK
        |squeezing her shoulder
        |rubbing her back
    ].
rows.translation:
你突然惊醒，浑身是汗，还在尖叫。等等，不……那不是你在尖叫……刚才那是什么？难道是阿图吉娅的记忆在浮现吗？你迅速起身穿好衣服，走进大厅。那尖叫声十分真实，正是从阿图吉娅的房间传出来的。那种噪音持续不断，甚至可以说是令人难以忍受的。当你逐渐靠近时，那些关于那个梦的记忆就会在你的脑海中不断浮现。当你走进房间时，凯特已经在那里了。她震惊地望着阿图吉娅悬浮在床上方几英尺的地方。她每一秒都在不断地向上攀升，在噩梦中翻来覆去，无法平静。 [cait.recruited
        |你的猫伙伴说了些什么
        |那个惊恐的猫女说了些什么
    ]但是，在那刺耳的尖叫声中，你根本听不清她在说什么。不过，这其实并不对——那已经不再算是真正的尖叫了，阿图吉娅的嘴巴也是闭着的。更确切地说，那是一种仿佛在你脑海中回荡的哀鸣声，她越高飞，这种声音就越大。你必须竭尽全力靠近她，试图拉她下来。你刚走了大约一半的路程。就在你即将追上她的时候，一阵剧烈的噪音突然响起。一道耀眼的蓝光从阿图吉娅的身体中迸发出来，你被这突如其来的光芒击倒在地。其实你几乎感觉不到这股光的力量，但它确实穿过了你的身体，还穿透了墙壁，最终从窗户中消失了。你之所以会被击倒，更多是因为惊讶，而非因为这股光带来的伤害。它一直延伸到你视野的极限，然后化作细雾消散了。暂时不必为此担心，你迅速缩小了距离，终于赶到了那个被恐惧折磨的杜拉汉身边。[pc.n]-[pc.name]啊，天啊，”她用沙哑的声音说道，“我是不是把大家都吵醒了？我已经很久没有做过这么可怕的噩梦了。如果我让你们担心了……什么？怎么了？”你还没来得及回答，外面就传来了一阵急促的足部步声——那是加斯。[party.hasCompanions| 以及你的盟友们| 以及一些清晨来此消费的顾客们] 人们纷纷跑过来查看发生了什么。加思站在门口，呼吸急促，手中仍紧握着一条抹布。“那到底是什么光？这里一切都还好吗？”他问道。“光？什么光？”阿图吉娅满脸担忧地反问。[pc.dcb
        |看来，我们双方都有很多事情需要补上。
        |也许你应该下来吃点早餐，然后我们再讨论这件事。
        |你怎么不过来吃些美味的早餐，然后我们再讨论这件事呢？
    ]你说得对，帮她坐起来吧。 [pc.isDK
        |轻轻捏了捏她的肩膀
        |安慰她
    ].

rows.original: A half hour later, after cleaning up and getting dressed, you and Atugia are sitting at a table in the bar. She looks haggard, exhausted by the effort expended tossing and turning in her nightmares. A plate of eggs grows cold on the table between you, and she picks at them sparingly before she speaks. "So you saw it all?" "Yeah. [pc.isDK |That's rough... |I'm so sorry, I never expected it would be so grim. ][flags.ATUGIA_TALKED_CURSE | I take it you remember more than just the darkness, now? |Is that what you had to remember every time you tugged at your head? ]" you ask. "[flags.ATUGIA_TALKED_CURSE |Yeah... I remember the whole thing. |N-no. Before today I couldn't remember any of that. It was just kind of a blur of darkness. ] I still have no idea why, though," she says, rubbing her eyes. "I knew my parents were gone, but I think I preferred not knowing the details. And I still have no idea why. Why now? [flags.LUMIA_QUEST|Is this what the goddess meant about 'camouflage'?|What was that pulse of light?] Ugh." "[pc.dcb |Hey, none of that depression shit. I have enough on my plate dealing with demons without having you worrying about a dead Wraith that can't even come after you anymore. The gods obliterated all those stupid things, and theres no way one that [silly |extra |big ] would slip through. If anything is coming after you, it'll be small fry enough that we won't have to care!" you say, matter-of-factly slapping your palm with the back of your hand. |Hey, whatever it was, it's not like that Wraith can come after you any longer! Any wandering Wraiths would be destroyed by the gods with haste. There's no way one could have lasted this long with them around! If anything was alerted by that flash of light, it'll have to get by me first, and then it'll have to overpower you as well," you say, punching a fist into your palm. |Hey! No sadding! There's, like, no way that nasty Wraith survived the gods squashing them all! Plus if anything bad was alerted by that flash of light, then I bet just as many good friends saw it too! Everybody knows that good guys travel faster than bad guys, so, like, I'm sure we'll be getting some new friends soon. If bad guys come after that we can beat them all up together," you say, grinning wide and giving her shoulders a squeeze. ] Tui gives a tired laugh in response, rubbing some more of the exhaustion out of her eyes. "Yeah... Thanks, [pc.name]. I feel like I should be a little more worried, but I can't help but believe you. I hope this doesn't become a repeat occurrence, and I'll be on the lookout for whatever does come. Even if it's not a Wraith, I doubt anything good will come of it. I think I'm gonna go lay down and see if i can't get a bit more sleep[party.has atugia| before we head out,|,]" she says, pushing herself to her feet. Before she leaves, you stand as well and [atugia.fucked|wrap her in a loving squeeze, giving her a chaste kiss before pulling back.|wrap her in a hug, patting her back for a few moments before pulling away.] "Rest well. I don't think any monster stands a chance at taking you away," you say, and she wanders toward the stairs with significantly less tension in her body.
rows.translation: 半小时后，当你收拾好自己、穿好衣服后，你和阿图吉娅坐在酒吧的桌子旁。她看起来疲惫不堪，显然是因为在噩梦中辗转反侧而精疲力竭。你们中间放着一份已经变冷的鸡蛋，她在开口之前，只是偶尔吃那么一小口。“所以你看到了这一切？”“是的。 [pc.isDK |那可真糟糕…… |我真的很抱歉，我完全没预料到情况会变得如此糟糕。 ][flags.ATUGIA_TALKED_CURSE | 我想你现在记得的，不仅仅是那些黑暗吧？ |每次你挠头的时候，是不是都要记住这件事呢？ ]你问的[flags.ATUGIA_TALKED_CURSE |是的……我记得这一切。 |不……在今天之前，我完全想不起来那些事情了。那些记忆就像一片模糊的黑暗，什么也看不清楚。 ] 可我仍然不明白为什么，”她边说边揉着眼睛，“我知道我的父母已经去世了，但我想我宁愿不去了解那些细节。到现在，我依然不明白为什么。为什么偏偏是现在？ [flags.LUMIA_QUEST|这就是女神所说的“伪装”吗？|那道光脉冲究竟是什么？] 呃[pc.dcb |嘿，别搞什么消极情绪了。我自己的麻烦已经够多了，可不想还要让你也为这些事担心。死亡那种连追杀你的能力都没有的幽灵……众神已经消灭了那些愚蠢的东西，所以绝对不可能还有 [silly |额外内容 |大的 ] 应该能够顺利通过。如果……的话。任何东西它正在追着你呢，不过应该只是些小角色，我们根本不必在意！”你理所当然地说道，同时用手掌拍打着自己的后背。 |嘿，不管那是什么，反正那个‘幽灵’已经不能再追着你了！任何游荡的‘幽灵’都会立刻被神明消灭。在有神明存在的环境下，根本不可能有人能存活这么久！如果真的有什么东西被那道闪光惊动了，它首先得穿过我，然后还得打败你才行。”你一边说着，一边用拳头在手掌上敲击。 |嘿！别难过啦！那个讨厌的幽灵怎么可能在众神将它们全部消灭之后还活下来呢？而且，如果那道闪光真的引起了什么危险，那我敢打赌，很多好朋友也应该看到了吧！大家都知道，好人行动总是比坏人快，所以，我肯定我们很快就会遇到一些新朋友。如果那些坏人真的来了，我们可以一起把它们全部打败！”你笑着说，还轻轻拍了拍她的肩膀。 ] 崔疲惫地笑了笑，又揉了揉眼睛，试图驱散眼中的疲惫。“嗯……谢谢。 [pc.name]我觉得自己应该更加担心才对，但我还是忍不住相信你。希望这种事情不要再发生了，无论接下来会发生什么，我都会保持警惕。即使那不是“幽灵”，我也怀疑不会有什么好事发生。我想我去躺下休息一会儿，看看能不能再睡一会儿。[party.has atugia| 在我们出发之前，|,]她说着，站了起来。在她离开之前，你也请站起来吧。 [atugia.fucked|将她紧紧拥入怀中，轻轻吻了她一下，然后才放开她。|把她拥入怀中，轻拍她的背片刻，然后才放开她。] 好好休息吧。我觉得没有任何怪物有能力把你带走，”你说道，而她也放松了许多，缓步走向楼梯。
rows.raw: " A half hour later, after cleaning up and getting dressed, you and Atugia are sitting at a table in the bar. She looks haggard, exhausted by the effort expended tossing and turning in her nightmares. A plate of eggs grows cold on the table between you, and she picks at them sparingly before she speaks. "So you saw it all?" "Yeah. [pc.isDK |That's rough... |I'm so sorry, I never expected it would be so grim. ][flags.ATUGIA_TALKED_CURSE | I take it you remember more than just the darkness, now? |Is that what you had to remember every time you tugged at your head? ]" you ask. "[flags.ATUGIA_TALKED_CURSE |Yeah... I remember the whole thing. |N-no. Before today I couldn't remember any of that. It was just kind of a blur of darkness. ] I still have no idea why, though," she says, rubbing her eyes. "I knew my parents were gone, but I think I preferred not knowing the details. And I still have no idea why. Why now? [flags.LUMIA_QUEST|Is this what the goddess meant about 'camouflage'?|What was that pulse of light?] Ugh." "[pc.dcb |Hey, none of that depression shit. I have enough on my plate dealing with demons without having you worrying about a dead Wraith that can't even come after you anymore. The gods obliterated all those stupid things, and theres no way one that [silly |extra |big ] would slip through. If anything is coming after you, it'll be small fry enough that we won't have to care!" you say, matter-of-factly slapping your palm with the back of your hand. |Hey, whatever it was, it's not like that Wraith can come after you any longer! Any wandering Wraiths would be destroyed by the gods with haste. There's no way one could have lasted this long with them around! If anything was alerted by that flash of light, it'll have to get by me first, and then it'll have to overpower you as well," you say, punching a fist into your palm. |Hey! No sadding! There's, like, no way that nasty Wraith survived the gods squashing them all! Plus if anything bad was alerted by that flash of light, then I bet just as many good friends saw it too! Everybody knows that good guys travel faster than bad guys, so, like, I'm sure we'll be getting some new friends soon. If bad guys come after that we can beat them all up together," you say, grinning wide and giving her shoulders a squeeze. ] Tui gives a tired laugh in response, rubbing some more of the exhaustion out of her eyes. "Yeah... Thanks, [pc.name]. I feel like I should be a little more worried, but I can't help but believe you. I hope this doesn't become a repeat occurrence, and I'll be on the lookout for whatever does come. Even if it's not a Wraith, I doubt anything good will come of it. I think I'm gonna go lay down and see if i can't get a bit more sleep[party.has atugia| before we head out,|,]" she says, pushing herself to her feet. Before she leaves, you stand as well and [atugia.fucked|wrap her in a loving squeeze, giving her a chaste kiss before pulling back.|wrap her in a hug, patting her back for a few moments before pulling away.] "Rest well. I don't think any monster stands a chance at taking you away," you say, and she wanders toward the stairs with significantly less tension in her body. "

rows.original: You know Ihzalti specializes in fortune telling, but would it be possible for her to tell a fortune more in-depth than weal or woe? There might be something coming after Atugia, and you'll take any chance to get information on them before they arrive. "Oh! Um... I've never given such a fortune before, and I don't know if it would be possible with just my cards, but I'd definitely be willing to try!" she says, puffing up excitedly and pulling her deck from her cluster of things. "Ok, just stay right there! I'll get started right away." Setting Miro down on the table and giving him [silly |the heckin mother of all pats, |a few heavy pats, ] Ihzalti bids Tui to stay seated at the table as she begins her reading. The telltale crackle of energy begins as electric sparks jolt through the bands in her hair. Her black eyes take on a mystical purple hue as she shuffles and splits her deck of cards. She weaves the cards in twos and threes as the energy around her builds to a climax. It somehow feels more impressive watching Atugia stare in awe as she works her magic. "Awaken your mind. Your fortune lies in the palm of my hand, two outc- err, many outcomes, possibilities arching out and narrowing down to find purchase in this deck. With these three cards, I play your fortune; with your fortune, I depict your path!" Ihzalti's eyes flash a brighter purple, and her hair rings loosen to swirl around her in a loose whirlwind. Magical energy bounces between them, arcing in a protective circle till she's good and ready. When the power reaches its peak, she stops to draw from the deck. She sets three cards on the table before Atugia, and turns them over one by one. The Satyr King, the Satyr King, and the Satyr King. You raise an eyebrow, but Ihzalti looks just as perplexed as you are. The three cards are identical, but each gleams with a different reflective color. One is bubblegum pink, one is golden yellow, and the third is mint green. What could three of the same card mean? Normally you'd assume something related to satyrs could go either way, but is there anything more that she can glean? "I, um, don't actually know. There's only one Satyr King card in my deck, and it's not normally any of those colors. This doesn't normally happen. I guess let's see if its got anything else to say?" the divining drider says with a shrug. She pulls three more cards from the top of the deck, this time revealing two more Satyr king cards, each split equally among the three colors, aside a card depicting a small village with the name 'Hawkethorne City.' "Ok, that card isn't part of this deck at all. That's the town that's nearby, right? I'm, um, not really experienced in reading this kind of fortune, but could it be as simple as them waiting for you in the village? Do you know any satyrs? I guess that wouldn't be it if 'coming after' was what you said. Maybe this way you can go meet them!" she says, excited again at the idea. Perhaps. You still aren't sure if letting them know you're onto them would be the best plan. However, this might give you the opportunity to ambush them instead! "Yeah, I'm feelin' a bit better about it now. Thanks, Ihzalti!" Atugia says, standing from the table and helping the black-and-gold spidress scoop up her deck of cards. "Oh, anytime! I'm glad I was able to help. Please, if you need anything else, do come by! Miro keeps me company mostly, but it's nice having people who can talk back," she says, giving the chunky rat a few pats[silly | and a hemckin squeeze ] as she picks up his cage once more.
rows.translation: 你知道，伊扎尔蒂专门从事占卜工作，但她是否有可能提供比单纯的吉凶预测更深入的信息呢？或许在阿图吉娅之后还会发生一些事情，所以你应该抓住任何机会去获取关于这些事情的情报。在……之前他们到了。 “哦！嗯……我以前从没给过这么多的钱，也不知道仅凭我的牌是否能够做到，但我肯定愿意试试！”她兴奋地说道，一边说着一边从一堆东西中掏出自己的牌组。“好的，你就待在原地吧！我马上就开始。” 她把米罗放在桌子上，然后 [silly |真是见鬼了…… |轻轻拍了几下…… ] 伊扎尔蒂让图伊坐在桌边等待，然后她开始进行阅读。当电火花在她头上的发带中闪烁时，那种特有的能量波动声也随之响起。她的黑色眼睛呈现出一种神秘的紫色，她开始洗牌并将牌分成两三组。随着她周围能量的不断聚集，达到高潮时，看着阿图吉娅敬畏地注视着她施展魔法，这一幕显得更加令人印象深刻。 “唤醒你的思维吧。你的命运就在我的手中很多这些结果、这些可能性不断延伸、不断缩小，最终在这副牌中找到了答案。用这三张牌，我来演绎你的命运；而通过你的命运，我来描绘你的人生道路！” 伊扎尔蒂的眼睛闪烁着更加鲜艳的紫色，她的头发也随风飘散，形成了一股缭绕在她身旁的旋风。魔力在他们之间来回穿梭，形成一道保护性的光环，直到她准备就绪。当这种力量达到顶峰时，她停下来从牌堆中抽取卡片。她在阿图吉娅面前将三张牌放在桌子上，然后逐一将它们翻开。 萨蒂尔王，萨蒂尔王，还是萨蒂尔王。你挑了挑眉毛，但伊兹阿尔蒂看起来也和你一样困惑。这三张牌看起来一模一样，只不过每一张都呈现出不同的反光颜色：一张是泡泡糖粉红色，一张是金黄色，第三张则是薄荷绿色。三张一模一样的牌，这究竟意味着什么呢？通常情况下，你可能会认为这与萨蒂尔这个主题有关，但难道还有其他线索吗？ 呃，其实我也不太清楚。我的牌组里只有一张‘萨蒂尔之王’牌，而且它通常也不会是这些颜色中的任何一种。这种事情平时是不会发生的。我想，我们再看看这张牌会不会有什么其他信息吧？”那位占卜者耸了耸肩，然后从牌组顶端又抽出了三张牌。这次，她抽到了两张更多的“萨蒂尔之王”牌，这两张牌的颜色在三种颜色中均匀分布；另外还有一张牌上画着一个名叫“鹰棘镇城”的小村庄。 好吧，那张卡片根本不属于这套牌组。那应该是附近那个小镇吧？我其实不太擅长解读这类占卜结果，但会不会就是他们正在村庄里等着你呢？你认识什么萨提尔吗？如果你说的是‘他们会来找你’，那应该不是这个意思吧……也许你可以去那里见见他们！”她说着，又对这个想法感到兴奋起来。 也许吧。你仍然不确定是否应该让他们知道你已经发现了他们的把戏，这是否才是最好的选择。不过，这样反而可能会给你一个伏击他们的机会！ “嗯，现在我觉得这样做也没那么糟糕了。谢谢，伊扎尔蒂！”阿图吉娅说着，从桌子旁站起身来，帮助那位穿着黑金相间连衣裙的女子把她的牌收起来。 哦，随时都可以！能帮上忙我真的很高兴。如果以后还需要什么帮助，一定要再来找我哦！虽然平时主要是米罗陪着我，但能遇到一些会和我交流的人，也确实让人感觉很好。”她说着，轻轻拍了拍那只胖乎乎的老鼠。[silly | 还有极其紧张的局面 ] 当她再次拿起他的笼子时。

rows.original: "We think something might be coming after Atugia. Can you help us see a way to get the jump on it? Or at least give us an idea of what it is?" "Visions usually come to me in dreams, but it's possible," Hretha sighs. "Whether I'll be able to glean any useful information from it is another story. Damn things are vague on a good day. I could just as easily send you straight into an ambush instead of the other way around, but I think you'd manage to turn even that to your favor." She laughs to herself as she talks, pulling her staff up and placing the sun emblem at a diagonal angle in front of her face. Muttering a prayer in orcish, she imbues the Lumian symbol with power, and it begins to glow with a soft brightness that envelops her face. The light flickers like a fire, dancing more vividly in her blind gaze than it does on the actual implement. Narrowing her eyes, she continues muttering with greater focus, infusing more power before pausing to wave off something you can't see. "Bah. Blasted things, there's nothing but goats... Wait, satyrs? One, two, three, why are they so hard to count! Sit still!" she snarls, channeling more energy into the sun. "Ah... Three, but more than three?" She lapses back into orcish, muttering a few more times and frowning. By the time the light atop her staff begins to dim, however, her expression has smoothed out to a confident grin. "Lumia's tits! I can't get a thought in edgewise. A nightmarish smorgasbord of satyr-shape. I think there are only three of them. In the vision there were dozens, crawling all over that village you call home," Hretha shudders. "But only three sets of horns between them. I've been at this long enough to make a healthy assumption about them cheating their numbers through some sort of witchcraft. Although... the way you said 'coming after' sounded like you expected something dire, right?" "Yes, why?" "I didn't get any inklings of hostility or murderous intent. The sounds and shapes are all mischievous and soft, and their mannerisms remind me of Arona when she's looking to irritate me. Nothing that points to a dire portent. I'm not sure what these lot are after with your friend, but I don't think it's her life." "That's... [pc.isDK |information, I guess |something, I guess ]. I don't know if that's necessarily good to know," you say, rubbing the back of your neck. "If that's true, I don't know what else they could want with me," Atugia sighs. "I trust you'll listen when I say to be careful. Just because they don't seem violent doesn't mean they mean you well. There was something else swimming around the edges of the vision that I couldn't quite grasp. Something shadowy. Only noticed it cause the damn satyrs were so bouncy. It didn't give me much of anything to go by, but it's probably still a ways away if it's that slippery," Hretha says, setting her staff back on the rug beside her. "We'll be careful. Thank you, Hretha," you say, [hretha.pregStage 0 2 |patting her on the shoulder. |giving her pregnant belly a gentle rub. ] "[hretha.pregStage 0 2 |For you? It's no trouble. It's a relief to be able to seek visions that aren't Argoth hunting glory or Arona asking me how to get into the next warrior's pants," she says with a guffawing laugh. [party.has arona |"Oi, I can hear that, you know, and the thing about me irritating you," Arona says with a devious smirk. "I know you're here. Why do you think I said either of those things?" Hretha says with an even toothier grin. The two stare at each other for a few seconds before both break down into chest-heaving laughter. You roll your eyes as their fit settles into giggles. ] |Hah! Is that all you came for? Won't you warm me up before you go?" she asks, playing with the line of her dress till her dusky green areolae are visible. ]
rows.translation: 我们觉得可能有某种东西正在追击阿图吉娅。你们能帮我们想出办法先发制人吗？或者至少告诉我们那到底是什么东西？” “这些预感通常会在我梦中出现，不过也有可能……”赫蕾莎叹了口气，“不过我能否从中获得有用的信息，那就是另一回事了。说实话，这些预感往往都很模糊。我完全有可能把你们引向埋伏，而不是相反的方向……不过我想，你们应该也能把这种情况转化为对自己有利的结果吧。 她边说边自顾自地笑着，将手中的法杖拔出来，然后将那个太阳符号以斜角放在自己面前。她用兽人语低声念着祷文，为这个卢米安符号注入力量，于是它开始散发柔和的光芒，照亮了她的脸庞。这光芒如同火焰般闪烁，在她那失明的视线中显得格外生动，甚至比法杖本身还要明亮。她眯起眼睛，更加专注地继续念着祷文，不断为这个符号注入更多的力量，最后停了下来，似乎是在向某个看不见的东西挥了挥手。 呸，这些该死的东西，里面全都是山羊……等等，还有半人马？一个、两个、三个，为什么数起来这么麻烦！安静点！”她怒吼着，将更多的能量注入那根法杖中。“啊……三个，但应该不止三个吧？” 她又转而用兽人语嘟囔了几句，眉头紧锁。然而，当她法杖顶端的光芒开始黯淡时，她的表情已经变得自信而愉悦起来。 卢米娅的胸部啊！我根本无法集中注意力思考其他事情。那些形状像萨提尔的胸部，简直就是一场噩梦般的视觉盛宴思考他们只有三个人。在那个幻象中，有几十个人，他们遍布你们称之为家的那个村庄，”赫蕾莎颤抖着说道，“但他们只有三对角角。我观察了他们这么久，有理由认为他们一定是通过某种巫术来伪造这个数字的。虽然……你说的‘紧接着发生’听起来让人觉得会有一些不好的事情发生，对吧？” “是的，为什么这么想？” “我并没有感觉到任何敌意或杀意。那些声音和形态都显得很顽皮、很温柔，它们的行为方式让我想起了阿罗娜，每当她想惹我生气的时候就是这种表现。没有什么迹象表明这预示着什么不祥的事情。我不确定这些人到底想对你朋友做什么，但我觉得她的生命应该不会有什么危险。 “那…… [pc.isDK |我想，这些应该就是相关信息吧。 |我想，应该是某样东西吧。 ]我不知道知道这些是否真的有好处，”你一边说，一边揉着后颈。 “如果真是这样，那我真不明白他们还想从我这里得到什么了，”阿图吉娅叹了口气。 “我相信你会听我的劝告，一定要小心。仅仅因为它们看起来并不具有攻击性，并不意味着它们对你的意图是善意的。在我的视线边缘，还有其他一些东西在游动，但我就是无法看清楚它们是什么。那些东西看起来很朦胧、很模糊……只有因为那些该死的萨提尔们动作太活泼、太跳跃了，我才注意到了它们的存在。这些信息并没有给我提供太多有用的线索，但如果情况真的那么棘手的话，我们可能还有很长的路要走，”赫蕾莎说着，将她的法杖重新放在身旁的毯子上。 “我们会小心的。谢谢你，赫蕾莎，”你说道。 [hretha.pregStage 0 2 |轻拍她的肩膀。 |轻轻抚摸着她隆起的腹部。 ] "[hretha.pregStage 0 2 |为你效劳？那当然不麻烦。能够去做一些既不是为了阿戈斯争光，也不是为了阿罗娜讨好她的事情，反而让我感到轻松自在呢。”她边说边放声大笑。 [party.has arona |哎，我听得出来啊，你知道的……其实我就是有点招人烦吧，”阿罗娜带着一丝狡黠的笑容说道。 “我知道你在那儿。不然我怎么会说出那些话来呢？”赫蕾莎也露出更加灿烂的笑容。两人对视了几秒钟，然后突然一起放声大笑起来。看着她们笑得前仰后合的样子，你只能无奈地翻了个白眼。 ] |哈！你就为了这个来的吗？走之前难道不先让我暖和一下吗？”她边说边玩弄着自己的裙摆，直到她那暗绿色的乳晕若隐若现。 ]
rows.raw: " "We think something might be coming after Atugia. Can you help us see a way to get the jump on it? Or at least give us an idea of what it is?" "Visions usually come to me in dreams, but it's possible," Hretha sighs. "Whether I'll be able to glean any useful information from it is another story. Damn things are vague on a good day. I could just as easily send you straight into an ambush instead of the other way around, but I think you'd manage to turn even that to your favor." She laughs to herself as she talks, pulling her staff up and placing the sun emblem at a diagonal angle in front of her face. Muttering a prayer in orcish, she imbues the Lumian symbol with power, and it begins to glow with a soft brightness that envelops her face. The light flickers like a fire, dancing more vividly in her blind gaze than it does on the actual implement. Narrowing her eyes, she continues muttering with greater focus, infusing more power before pausing to wave off something you can't see. "Bah. Blasted things, there's nothing but goats... Wait, satyrs? One, two, three, why are they so hard to count! Sit still!" she snarls, channeling more energy into the sun. "Ah... Three, but more than three?" She lapses back into orcish, muttering a few more times and frowning. By the time the light atop her staff begins to dim, however, her expression has smoothed out to a confident grin. "Lumia's tits! I can't get a thought in edgewise. A nightmarish smorgasbord of satyr-shape. I think there are only three of them. In the vision there were dozens, crawling all over that village you call home," Hretha shudders. "But only three sets of horns between them. I've been at this long enough to make a healthy assumption about them cheating their numbers through some sort of witchcraft. Although... the way you said 'coming after' sounded like you expected something dire, right?" "Yes, why?" "I didn't get any inklings of hostility or murderous intent. The sounds and shapes are all mischievous and soft, and their mannerisms remind me of Arona when she's looking to irritate me. Nothing that points to a dire portent. I'm not sure what these lot are after with your friend, but I don't think it's her life." "That's... [pc.isDK |information, I guess |something, I guess ]. I don't know if that's necessarily good to know," you say, rubbing the back of your neck. "If that's true, I don't know what else they could want with me," Atugia sighs. "I trust you'll listen when I say to be careful. Just because they don't seem violent doesn't mean they mean you well. There was something else swimming around the edges of the vision that I couldn't quite grasp. Something shadowy. Only noticed it cause the damn satyrs were so bouncy. It didn't give me much of anything to go by, but it's probably still a ways away if it's that slippery," Hretha says, setting her staff back on the rug beside her. "We'll be careful. Thank you, Hretha," you say, [hretha.pregStage 0 2 |patting her on the shoulder. |giving her pregnant belly a gentle rub. ] "[hretha.pregStage 0 2 |For you? It's no trouble. It's a relief to be able to seek visions that aren't Argoth hunting glory or Arona asking me how to get into the next warrior's pants," she says with a guffawing laugh. [party.has arona |"Oi, I can hear that, you know, and the thing about me irritating you," Arona says with a devious smirk. "I know you're here. Why do you think I said either of those things?" Hretha says with an even toothier grin. The two stare at each other for a few seconds before both break down into chest-heaving laughter. You roll your eyes as their fit settles into giggles. ] |Hah! Is that all you came for? Won't you warm me up before you go?" she asks, playing with the line of her dress till her dusky green areolae are visible. ] "

rows.original:
"Ok. [var0] said whatever's hunting you is potentially already in the city, so how about we find it first?" you ask.
    
    "Yeah! Ever since we got back I've felt something. A couple things. I'm sure I could lead us to them, or at least one of them. They're separated right now," Tui says, vaguely pointing in three different directions.
    
    "I guess if it's really satyrs, they can't be that hard to deal with. Which is closest? With any luck, we can get the jump on them."
    
    "There's actually one just outside, I think in the alley between the tavern and the alchemist's shop. I can't directly place it, but it's that general area."
    
    "That's a perfect start! Let's go."
    
    Heading downstairs, you exit the Frost Hound. You stop at the corner, signaling for [party.has atugia
        |[party.som
            |
            |Atugia to circle around the other way and cut off the alley.
            |one of your allies to circle around and cut off the alley.
        ]
        |[party.som
            |Atugia to circle around the other way and cut off the alley.
            |one of your allies to circle around and cut off the alley.
            |two of your allies to circle around for a double sided ambush.
        ]
    ] Waiting patiently, you take a brief glance into the gap between the two buildings. It doesn't look like there's anything there, but you wouldn't put some sort of magical invisibility past a malevolent pursuer. While you're debating this, you see your ambush partner arrive on the other side of the alleyway and step warily in. Before you can join them, something small and furry drops from the roof of the Inn.
    
    No, not something, someone! It's a satyress, no more than four feet tall at the top of her horns. She bolted as soon as she hit the ground, but her path takes her straight into your arms. Only once you have her in an underarm grapple do you realize that she's stark naked. You also take note of the fact that her entire body is marred by a series of mint green streaks that sparkle with stars like the ones on Tui's neck. One entire breast is among the parts that are completely covered, and even the areas devoid of large swaths have freckle-like dots of the stuff.
    
    "Eep! H-hey! Usually I get, like, at least a couple pranks off before I get caught! Who are you people?" she says, squirming in your arms.
    
    "Who- What do you mean who are we!? Who are you and what do you want with me?" Atugia says, raising her fists as she walks to stand in front of the two of you.
    
    "With you? Oh? Omigosh hi! You're the one we were feeling! I'm Piperita, by the way. You don't look like a satyr, but do you wanna do some pranks with us? All I have to do is give the signal, and Aafi and Talulah will get started. We've been trying to think of the best stuff to do the last couple days. This place is like wayyy with three Ys too peaceful, and it's taken us a while just to figure out the best pranks!"
    
    "What? No, I don't want to play pranks. I won't let you harass the people of Hawkethorne, either. I want you to tell me what you know!" 
    
    "Hmm, nah! Talking is, like, mega-boring, and I only do boring stuff when I'm tired," she giggles, turning her head up to look at you. "What about you, [pc.heightRange 0 54
        |hot stuff
        |big [pc.boyGirl]
    ]? Wanna do some pranks? You're not like us, but [pc.isCunning
        |[silly
            |real recognizes real, ya know?
            |you look like you'd be open to pranks!
        ]
        |you never know!
    ]"
    
    "[pc.dcb
        |Don't think so. Don't suppose I could convince you to just not and save me some trouble,
        |I'm afraid not. I don't suppose I could convince you to talk it out, instead?
        |No. Your pranks sound like they're gonna be mean. I don't suppose I could, like, eat you out or something and convince you to give up instead?
    ]" you ask back.
    
    "Nope! That sounds [pc.isBimbo
        |tempting, but no I can't right now
        |mega-dumb
    ]! I'm just gonna go do pranks with my friends. It might be fun if you tried to stop us, though!" she laughs, wiggling in your arms.
    
    "Well, I've already stopped you. It can't be that tough to stop your friends," you say, bouncing her once in your arms.
    
    "Aww, you're so silly. Really, though, I've gotta be going. Catch us if you can!" she says, giggling even louder before simply falling apart in your arms.
    
    You startle, attempting to catch her parts as they tumble to the ground in a cloud of mint-colored smoke. It's just like what happens with Atugia's head, but nearly every piece of her separates! She reforms even as she falls, kicking off the ground and bounding around you. Spinning as she runs, she gives you a wave and then puts two sets of fingers in her mouth. A second later, she issues a shrill whistle that rings in your ears. Around town, you hear two answering whistles, and Piperita disappears around the corner.
    
    Having powers similar to Atugia might have been something you considered, but you hadn't expected her to be so adroit with them after hearing her speak. You'll have to stop her before she gets into too much trouble, but that signal of hers must have alerted the other two she was talking about. If they're all similar, you'll have to tire them out one by one. Whether that's by fighting them into submission or fucking them till they give up, you'll decide that when you find them.

    ]想搞点恶作剧吗？你和我们不一样啊 [pc.isCunning
        |[silly

    ]"

    ]我打算去和朋友们一起搞些恶作剧呢。如果你试图阻止我们的话，说不定还会很有趣哦！”她笑着说，同时在你的怀里扭来扭去。“嗯，我已经阻止你们了。阻止你的朋友们应该也不是什么难事吧？”你说着，把她在怀里轻轻一弹。
    
    哎呀，你真傻啊。不过说真的，我得走了。如果可以的话，尽量来接我们吧！”她边说边笑得更加厉害，然后就直接在你怀里软软地倒下了。你吓了一跳，赶紧试图接住那些散落在地上的碎片——它们仿佛被薄荷色的烟雾笼罩着。这就就像阿图吉娅的头部发生的情况一样——她的身体几乎每一部分都会分离开来！她在坠落的过程中依然会重新组合身体，踢打着地面，在你周围跳跃着。边跑边旋转，她还会向你挥手，然后把两根手指放在嘴里。一秒钟后，她发出了一声刺耳的哨声，那声音在你的耳边回荡。在整个城镇里，你听到了两声回应的哨声，而Piperita则消失在了拐角处。
    
    你或许考虑过拥有与阿图吉娅相似的能力，但听到她说话后，你完全没有预料到她能如此熟练地运用这些能力。你必须在她惹上太大麻烦之前阻止她，不过她发出的那个信号肯定已经引起了她所提到的那两个人的注意。如果他们的能力都相似的话，你就得一个个地把他们耗尽体力。无论是通过战斗让他们屈服，还是通过激烈的亲密接触让他们放弃抵抗，等你找到他们之后再决定如何做吧。

rows.original: Something is wrong. You ready your weapon as you venture into the streets of Hawkethorne, unable to shake the feeling. There are hardly any people milling about. Listening close, you can vaguely detect the sounds of mischievous laughter. It's impossible to tell where it's coming from, but it doesn't change no matter which direction you turn. "[pc.Name]? Do you hear that? It's... there, there, and, um, there. Wait, here," Atugia says, [party.has atugia |spinning around to face the Frost Hound and raising her eyes to the roof. |stumbling out of the Frost Hound with a hand to her temples. She points in each direction she's talking about, and then spins to face the Frost Hound with her eyes raised to its roof. ] Seated atop the building, just above the door, sits a peculiar-looking pint-sized satyr! It's hard to tell at a distance, but she can't be more than four feet tall, horns included. Flecks of mint-green starlight pockmark her body like a living agate, some curling in full circles and others hardly larger than coins. She smiles, kicking her hooves as they hang over the ledge. One by one, she looks each of you over till her eyes land on Atugia. "Omigosh, hi! Am I the first one who found you? The others are gonna be so jealous," she shouts, comically loud to make sure you can hear her from the roof. "What do you want with m-" Atugia begins, her markings beginning to glow as she fills them with power. "Hold on! There's, like, too much wind! I can't hear you from up here, so I'm coming down," the satyress yells, interrupting your companion as she climbs to her feet. If there was any doubt before, it's now plain to see that she's buck naked. One of the colorful starry spirals trails right over one of her breasts, circling the other like a snake. Another curls around her waist and continues down between her legs. The details are impossible to tell from this far, but they look very similar to the ones around Atugia's neck. She dusts herself off, huffing out a sigh and holding her head high. Rather than crouch to jump, however, she simply scrunches her eyes shut in a pre-emptive wince and pitches forward off the roof. Your eyes go wide, and you manage a half step forward before she impacts with the ground. You startle further when she falls into a jumble of body parts, with her head rolling on its side to settle just in front of Atugia. The effect is very similar, but where your dullahan companion's head comes off cleanly from the neck, this woman's is much more haphazard. "Hey, [silly |chilly down |chill out ]! It's the same for you, right, no need to look so shocked," she giggles, grunting with effort as her parts begin to wriggle and crawl back together. Her head is detached all the way down to her clavicle, in the distance, a mostly complete torso pushes itself to an upright. Both arms and the star-speckled boob are in one piece, and she honks the other breast with one hand before scooping it up and holding it back in place. One of her legs is busy scooting off in the wrong direction, so when she reattaches her hips there's only one hoof left to stand on. "Hold on, this last part is always, like, mega-dumb," she sighs, hopping after the leg without even using her eyes. Her head's attention remains on Atugia, grinning happily when her body catches up and reinstates the runaway limb. She dashes back with a skipping pace that makes her E-cup tits bounce and jiggle. Picking up her head, she drops it back in place, and then [silly |proudly jazzes her hands |shakes her hands in a proud 'ta-da' gesture ]. Now that she's up close, you can clearly see the stars swimming in the mint-green glow that mars her body. Completely shameless in her nudity, she skips in a short circle around your perplexed partner, looking her up and down. "Now what were you saying? You, like, look kinda different than a normal satyr. 你急忙回到“寒霜猎犬”酒馆，发现加思以及几名体格强壮的顾客正躲在一些桌子后面摆出防御姿态。通往酒馆上层房间的楼梯前，有人把一张长凳搬了过来，你可以看到上面还有更多的村民从拐角处张望过来。他们全都显得很紧张，但当你出现在他们面前时，他们的紧张情绪稍微缓解了一些。[pc.Name]外面发生了什么？我们听到了喧闹声和喊叫声，是那些恶魔吗？”加思边问边穿过房间朝你走来。“不，只是三个调皮捣蛋的女妖在使一些奇怪的魔法而已。”我回答道。 [var0
        |应该能够处理这些事情，但我还是想确认大家在这里都一切都好。
        |我已经处理了其中一件事，剩下的应该也不会太麻烦。我只是想确认一下这里的人是否都还好。
        |我们已经制服了其中两个，剩下的那个应该也不会带来太大麻烦。我只是想确认你在这里一切都还好吧。
    ] 嗯，我们在这里没什么事。只是有点受惊了，但并没有什么危险。哦，不过我有点东西可能会对你有帮助，”老狼说着，伸手从柜台后面拿出了一个盖子严严实实的水壶，那水壶散发着浓重的酒精气味。我总是会留一些这些物资给我的兽人顾客，不过偶尔也会有一些雇佣兵来使用我的库存。如果你不需要的話，就收下吧。我随时都可以再弄到。”“谢谢，加斯，”你说着，拍了拍他的肩膀，然后转身回到了村庄里。
rows.raw:
'
    You rush back into the Frost Hound, finding Garth and several of the burlier patrons organized behind some tables in a defensive position. A bench has been moved in front of the stairs that lead to the inn's upper rooms, and you can see more villagers peeking around the corner from above. They're all tense, but relax a modicum when they recognize you.
    
    "[pc.Name]? What's going on out there? We heard a commotion and some shouting. Is it those demons?" Garth asks, crossing the room to meet you.
    
    "No, just 3 rambunctious satyresses with some odd magic. I [var0
        |should be able to handle them, but I wanted to make sure people were ok in here,
        |already handled one of them, and the others shouldn't be too much trouble. I just wanted to make sure people were ok in here,
        |already have two of them subdued, and don't expect much more trouble from the last. I just wanted to make sure you were doing ok in here,"
    ] you reply.
    
    "Aye, we're fine in here. Just a little spooked, but nothing dangerous. Oh, I have something that might help you, though," the old wolf says, reaching behind the counter to pull out a stoppered canteen that smells strongly of alcohol. "I always try to keep at least a little of this for my orcish patrons, but the occasional mercenary makes use of my supply as well. Keep it anyway if you don't end up using it. I can always get more."

rows.original: You travel back through the town, gathering up each of the satyresses and bringing them back to the side alley beside the Frost Hound. They don't put up a fight as you situate them in a line with their backs against the inn's outer wall. There's a bit of fussing as they try to get comfortable, but there's no hint of betrayal in their eyes. As feisty as they were before, it looks like they know when they're defeated. Atugia crouches in front of them with her face set in a serious mask. She looks at each of them in turn before speaking, as if that alone could convince her of their motives. When it doesn't, she clears her throat, crossing her legs and taking a seat. "Ok. Tell me wh-" she starts. "We're sorry!" Piper blurts before she can finish. "Please don't, like, hurt us or anything. We can even do work and stuff if you promise not t-" "Aww Pippy, but I don't wanna-" Talulah starts, continuing the chain of interruptions. "Shush! Shshhhshhhsh," Piper says, resuming from where she left off after bumping her head into Toodles till she stops complaining. "Anyway, um, I'll take the hurtin' if need be as long as you promise to leave these two alone." "Noooo Pippy! You can't get like hurt and stuff on our behalf. If they've gotta do some kinda like prison thing we'll all go together!" Aafi says. "Oh, Aafi, Toodles! You guys are, like, the bestest-" "Would all of you just shush! Gods, you just can't be the ones who were comin' after me! Here I was expectin' some kind of nightmare after our fortune-tellin'... I'm sure you lot are somebody's nightmare, but it's not like you're killers." "D'aww, that's so sweet of you!" Piper says, flexing her arms in their restraints as if she were going to go for a hug before remembering how well bound she is. "We were coming after you, though! I think, anyway." "Huh? But why? What would make you assume I wanted any part of this kind of lewd [silly |shenaniganery |mischief ]?" Tui asks. "We just knew you were like us! Well, not like us like us now, I guess, as we found out. But, like, like us!" she says, briefly pausing to let one of her hands poof away and drop to the ground, only to crawl back up her leg and reattach itself. "Can't you feel it?" "I wouldn't even begin to know how. I thought I felt somethin' right before you showed up, but I have no idea why. Besides, what does that even mean if it is true?" "It's easy! You just, um... You just, like... Like, close your eyes and just kinda, like, feel for other people like you! Just focus on that feeling that happens when your part or parts come apart!" You see Atugia focus for a moment, trying to follow the satyr shortstack's instructions. For a second, you expect there to be some sign as the power activates, but nothing happens. A moment later, Tui gives an exasperated huff as she ceases whatever effort she was putting into the attempt. "Bah, I can't feel anythin' like that," she says, throwing her hands up in defeat. "S-sorry, really. If I knew, like, any better way to describe it I would. I promise I'm not holding anything back, but I've never been good at teaching things other than pranks." "No, it's fine. I shouldn't have expected it to be that easy. I also guess I should be happy somethin' like you was the first thing that came after me rather than some horrible monster." "Oh! Oh! That could be our punishment! If a big horrible [silly |no-good dirty rotten pig-stealing great great |nasty ] monster comes along we can help! My friends would, like, totally agree, right? It's much better than prison or hurting," Piper says. The other two nod ferociously. Tui sighs and looks to you for further judgment. You aren't sure exactly how trustworthy these gremlins really are, but if you spun it as some sort of scheme you're sure the other two would come around for sure. [wayfort.renovated |On the other hand, you could bring them back to the Wayfort and ensure they're there if another monster comes to threaten Atugia. Prison would probably be a bad idea with how squirrely they are, but you have other enticements to keep them around. |On the other hand, you could find a place to put them... ]
rows.translation: 你穿过小镇，将那些侍女们一一召集起来，带到了冰寒霜猎犬旁边的小巷里。当你让她们排成一排，背靠酒馆的外墙时，她们并没有反抗。虽然她们在试图找个舒服的位置时有些吵闹，但她们的眼中并没有流露出任何背叛的迹象。尽管之前她们还那么倔强，但现在看来，她们已经知道自己什么时候该认输。 阿图吉娅蹲在他们面前，脸上带着严肃的表情。她依次注视着他们每一个人，仿佛只有这样才能确信他们的真实意图。当这样的观察无法让她确信时，她就会清了清嗓子，盘腿坐下。 好吧，告诉我……”她刚开口。 “我们真的对不起！”派珀还没等她说完就急急忙忙地说道，“请不要伤害我们，好吗？如果您保证不……我们甚至可以帮忙干活什么的。” “哎呀，小派皮，但我真的不想……”塔鲁拉又插话道，就这样，一连串的打断不断继续着。 嘘！嘘……”派珀说道，她因为撞到了图德尔而中断了讲话，现在继续说下去，直到图德尔不再抱怨为止。“总之，嗯，如果需要的话，我愿意承受这些痛苦，只要你答应不要打扰这两个人。” “不——派皮！你不能为了我们而受伤啊。如果他们真的要被关进监狱什么的，那我们所有人都会一起去的！”阿菲说道。 哦，阿菲，图迪尔斯！你们真的是最棒的——” “你们能不能都安静一会儿啊！天啊，你们真是不能就是你们这些一直追着我的人吧！我本来还以为在我们占卜之后会遇到什么噩梦呢……我敢肯定，你们对别人来说肯定就是噩梦，但至少你们不是杀人犯吧。” “哇，你们真是太好了！”派珀说着，在束缚中活动着手臂，似乎想要拥抱他们，但很快就想起了自己被绑得有多紧。“我们是不过，我其实是跟着你来的……至少我是这么想的。” “哈？为什么？你为什么会认为我会对这种淫秽的事情感兴趣呢？ [silly |鬼把戏 |恶作剧 ]？”涂问道。 “我们早就知道你和我们是一样的！嗯，当然不是像我们现在这样的我们，因为后来我们才了解到这些。但总之，你和我们是一样的！”她说道，短暂地停顿了一下，然后她的一只手突然“噗”的一声掉到了地上，又立刻爬回她的腿上重新附着了上去。“你难道感觉不到吗？ 我根本不知道该从哪里开始。在你出现之前，我确实觉得有些什么不对劲，但我也完全不明白为什么。而且，就算这是真的，那又意味着什么呢？” “其实很简单！你只需要……嗯……闭上眼睛，试着去感受别人的感受就好！专注于那种当你自己的部分与他人的部分产生冲突时所感受到的那种情绪吧！ 你看到阿图吉娅专注地盯着屏幕，试图按照那个手牌数量较少的萨蒂尔的指示来操作。有那么一瞬间，你期待着会看到什么效果出现，但什么也没有发生。片刻之后，崔无奈地叹了口气，放弃了之前的尝试。 Bah，我完全感觉不到那种感觉，”她无奈地举起双手说道。 “对不起，真的。如果我知道有更好的方式来描述的话，我一定会用的。我保证我没有隐瞒任何信息，只是我在除了搞恶作剧之外，从来都不擅长解释其他事情。 不，没关系。我本来就不该指望事情会这么简单。我想，能遇到你这样的存在，而不是什么可怕的怪物，我已经应该感到庆幸了。” “哦！哦！这也许就是我们的惩罚吧！如果真的遇到了一个可怕的 [silly |一无是处的肮脏混蛋 |糟糕的 ] 有怪物出现，我们完全可以帮忙！我的朋友们肯定也会同意的，对吧？这总比被关进监狱或者受到伤害要好得多，”派珀说道。另外两个人也猛地点了点头。 涂伊叹了口气，望向你，期待你的进一步决定。 你其实并不确定这些小精灵到底有多可靠，但如果你把这件事说成是某种计谋，那么另外两个人肯定也会支持你的决定的。 [wayfort.renovated |另一方面，你可以把它们带回荒废驿堡基地。确保如果还有其他怪物出现威胁阿图吉娅，它们可以在那里发挥作用。考虑到它们的性格如此难以捉摸，把它们关在监狱里恐怕不是个好主意，但你们还有其他办法可以让它们留在那里。 |另一方面，你可以找个地方把它们放起来…… ]

rows.original: Set the group free. You probably won't see them again unless they decide to help Atugia like they said, for better or worse.
rows.translation: 把这群人放了吧。除非他们真的像他们说的那样，无论结果如何，都决定帮助阿图吉娅，否则你很可能再也不会见到他们了。
rows.raw: "Set the group free. You probably won't see them again unless they decide to help Atugia like they said, for better or worse."

rows.original: Bring the group to the Wayfort where you can keep an eye on them.
rows.translation: 把这群人带到荒废驿堡那里，这样你就可以密切监视他们了。
rows.raw: "Bring the group to the Wayfort where you can keep an eye on them."

rows.original: Your Wayfort isn't developed enough for this.
rows.translation: 你的荒废驿堡版本还不够成熟，无法支持这个功能。
rows.raw: "Your Wayfort isn't developed enough for this."

rows.original: You don't have a place for them right now, but ask the rowdy Satyrs to stay nearby till you do.
rows.translation: 你现在还没有地方安置它们，不过可以让那些吵闹的萨提尔们暂时待在附近，等到你有地方再把它们安置好。
rows.raw: "You don't have a place for them right now, but ask the rowdy Satyrs to stay nearby till you do."

rows.original: "Well, I suppose they haven't really done anything too awful," you say, heaving a sigh. "Nobody was hurt, and they didn't cause any lasting damage. I think we can safely let them go, as long as they promise not to try anything with the villagers again." "I promise!" Piper says, wiggling happily. "We promise! Right, girls?" The others nod enthusiastically, and Tui chuckles as she undoes their bindings. All three stretch thankfully and give her big hugs, and then bounce over to give you the same treatment. "Thank you thank you thank you! You're, like, the bestest person ever!" Talulah says, giving you the last big squeeze of the three. "Usually we get, like, kicked out or banished from places, but you're being super nice about it!" "[pc.dcb |Yeah... just don't make me regret it, |You might not get kicked out of so many places if your mischief were a little less extravagant, |Awww, thanks! I totally wouldn't mind if you wanted to, like, sneak back into my bedroom sometime, ]" you say. "[pc.dcb |We won't! |That's not as fun, but mayyyyyybe, |Oooo! I'll, like, totally try if we come by again! ]" she says, hurrying to join the other two. All three of them turn back to wave as they scurry out of the alley and off toward the gates. You follow till you can signal to the guard that it's ok to let them leave, and then turn back to Atugia. The determined dullahan still looks rattled, and you pull her into a hug. She slumps into a relaxed slouch, and you leave your hand on her shoulder when you pull away. "Hey, If that's all the world has to throw at you, then we'll take on everything it's got coming," you promise. "I strongly doubt this lot were the most threatenin' thing that's comin' my way. I wouldn't hope to believe that's all that's left of the monster from my nightmares. Thanks, though, for havin' my back on this one." "I'll have it for the next one, too, and any more after that if they keep coming. Right up until we find out where they're coming from and stop them from coming. I'm [atugia.fucked | |pretty ]sure you'd do the same for me, so I'll endeavor to be there when you need me." "Thanks," she says, smiling warmly despite her shaken exterior. "Who knows, maybe it will just be a veritable flood of silly little satyrs, and we'll drown in pranks. Can you imagine a horde with one of those little balls of energy for every resident of Hawkethorne?" "Eugh. Three of them was definitely enough for me. An army of them would be overwhelming," you say with a laugh. That starts Tui to laughing with you, and you're still laughing as you exit the alley, [party.solo |rounding the corner |joining the rest of your group ] and reentering the Frost Hound.
rows.translation: 嗯，我想他们也没做出什么太糟糕的事情吧，”你叹了口气说道，“没有人受伤，也没有造成任何永久性的损害。我觉得我们可以放他们走了，只要他们承诺不再对村民们做出任何举动就行。”“我保证！”派珀开心地摇着尾巴说。我们真的吗？好吗，姑娘们？”其他女孩们都热情地点了点头，而Tui则笑着解开了她们的束缚。三个人都舒展了一下身体，然后紧紧地拥抱了她，接着又跑过来对你做了同样的事情。“太谢谢了！你真的是世界上最棒的人了！”Talulah说道，她是三个女孩中最后一个拥抱你的。“通常我们都会被赶出去或者被禁止进入某个地方，但你却对我们这么好！[pc.dcb |嗯……只要别让我后悔就好。 |如果你少搞一些过于夸张的恶作剧，或许就不会被那么多地方赶出来了。 |哇，太谢谢了！如果你想偶尔偷偷溜进我的卧室，我完全不会介意的。 ]你是这么说的。[pc.dcb |我们不会的！ |那样就没那么有趣了，但也许…… |哦哦哦！如果我们再来的话，我一定会尽力帮忙的！ ]她说着，急忙加入了另外两个人的行列。他们三个人都转身挥手，然后快步跑出了小巷，朝着大门的方向走去。你跟在他们后面，直到能够向守卫示意可以让他们离开了，然后再回到阿图吉娅那里。那个意志坚定的女孩依然显得有些惊慌失措，于是你将她拥入怀中。她放松下来，靠在你的怀里，而当你松开手时，你依然将手放在她的肩上。“嘿，如果这就是全世界能对你做的全部，那么我们就勇敢地面对一切吧，”你这样承诺道。 我实在怀疑，这些家伙根本算不上是我将来会遇到的最危险的威胁。我绝不相信，那些出现在我噩梦中的怪物，就只剩下这些了。不过，还是谢谢你们在这次事件中支持我。”“下次遇到危险，我也会依靠你们的帮助。如果之后还有更多威胁出现，我依然会需要你们的支持。直到我们查明他们的来历并阻止他们继续前来，我才会罢休。我坚决这么做。 [atugia.fucked | |相当漂亮 ]我相信你也会为我做同样的事，所以当你需要我的时候，我一定会出现在你身边。”“谢谢，”她微笑着说，尽管外表看起来有些颤抖，但笑容依然温暖。“谁知道呢，也许有一天会要是每个鹰棘镇的居民都变成这样一个充满活力的小淘气，我们肯定会被他们的恶作剧淹没的。你能想象这样的场景吗？”“呃……对我来说，有三个这样的小家伙就已经够麻烦了。如果有一大群这样的小家伙，那简直就是灾难啊，”你笑着说。听到你这么说，图伊也跟着笑了起来，而你们俩还在笑着走出了那条小巷。 [party.solo |即将到来 |与你们小组成员会合 ] 然后重新进入霜犬酒馆。

I'll, like, totally try if we come by again! ]" she says, hurrying to join the other two. All three of them turn back to wave as they scurry out of the alley and off toward the gates. You follow till you can signal to the guard that it's ok to let them leave, and then turn back to Atugia. The determined dullahan still looks rattled, and you pull her into a hug. She slumps into a relaxed slouch, and you leave your hand on her shoulder when you pull away. "Hey, If that's all the world has to throw at you, then we'll take on everything it's got coming," you promise. "I strongly doubt this lot were the most threatenin' thing that's comin' my way. I wouldn't hope to believe that's all that's left of the monster from my nightmares. Thanks, though, for havin' my back on this one." "I'll have it for the next one, too, and any more after that if they keep coming. Right up until we find out where they're coming from and stop them from coming. I'm [atugia.fucked | |pretty ]sure you'd do the same for me, so I'll endeavor to be there when you need me." "Thanks," she says, smiling warmly despite her shaken exterior. "Who knows, maybe it will just be a veritable flood of silly little satyrs, and we'll drown in pranks. Can you imagine a horde with one of those little balls of energy for every resident of Hawkethorne?" "Eugh. Three of them was definitely enough for me. An army of them would be overwhelming," you say with a laugh. That starts Tui to laughing with you, and you're still laughing as you exit the alley, [party.solo |rounding the corner |joining the rest of your group ] and reentering the Frost Hound. '

rows.original: "I'm not going to hurt any of you any further, but I can't just let you go," you say, seeing their bubbly expressions sink to worry. "Hold on now, I think you'll like what I have in mind. I oversee the Wayfort a little north of here, And I'm sure I could find a place for each of you there that isn't a prison cell. As long as you behave, I also think I could turn a blind eye if you decided to play pranks on any unscrupulous individuals who pass through." That last bit rekindles the curiosity in them, and you see Piper squirm to sit up straighter as she raises an eyebrow. "Hmmmm, I think this is acceptable," she says, the frantic shaking of her tail betraying the aloof exterior she's trying to project. "What about you guys?" The other two hurry to nod along, putting up equally faltering attempts to disguise their excitement. You smile, helping Atugia to undo their restraints and then escorting them out of the village. The guards give you some questioning looks, but nod when you explain where you're taking them. Managing to avoid harassment on your way through the forest, you wind up at the Wayfort in short order. On arrival, you drop the three girls off with Rumie. Helping keep the bar running should keep them occupied, and they're eye-catching enough that they might draw in customers that would otherwise keep right on moving. The bubbly bee-girl is happy to have the assistance, and begins training them right away when you move to leave. On the way back, Tui still looks just as rattled as she did before. You pull her into a hug till the tension seeps out of her and she relaxes a little. "Hey, If that's all the world has to throw at you, then we'll take on everything it's got coming," you promise. "I strongly doubt this lot were the most threatenin' thing that's comin' my way. I wouldn't hope to believe that's all that's left of the monster from my nightmares. Thanks, though, for havin' my back on this one." "I'll have it for the next one, too, and any more after that if they keep coming. Right up until we find out where they're coming from and stop them from coming. I'm [atugia.fucked | |pretty ]sure you'd do the same for me, so I'll endeavor to be there when you need me." "Thanks," she says, smiling warmly despite her shaken exterior. "Who knows, maybe it will just be a veritable flood of silly little satyrs, and we'll drown in pranks. Can you imagine a hoard with one of those little balls of energy for every resident of Hawkethorne?" "Eugh. Three of them was definitely enough for me. An army of them would be overwhelming," you say with a laugh. That starts Tui to laughing with you, and you're still smiling by the time you make it back to Hawkethorne and reenter the Frost Hound.
rows.translation: “我不会再伤害你们任何人了，但我也不能就这样放你们走，”你说着，看到他们原本欢快的表情渐渐转为忧虑。“等等，我想你们会喜欢我的建议的。我管理着这里稍北方向的驿堡，我相信在那里能为你们每个人找到一个不是监狱牢房的地方。只要你们遵守规矩，如果你们决定捉弄那些路过的不道德之徒，我想我也不会加以干涉。” 最后那句话重新激起了他们的好奇心，你可以看到派珀坐得更加端正了，她还挑了挑眉毛。 “嗯……我觉得这个可以接受，”她说，不过她尾巴拼命地摇晃，这暴露了她试图表现出的冷漠外表。“你们呢？” 另外两个人也急忙点头表示同意，他们同样试图掩饰自己的兴奋之情，但动作显得有些笨拙。你微笑着帮助阿图吉娅解开他们的束缚，然后护送他们离开了村庄。守卫们向你投来一些疑惑的目光，但在你说明要将他们带到哪里后，他们便点了点头。你在森林中顺利避开了各种骚扰，很快就到达了驿堡。 到达后，你把这三个女孩交给露米照顾。让她们帮忙打理酒吧应该能让她们有事可做，而且她们的外貌也足够吸引人，说不定还能吸引那些本来会直接走开的顾客。那个活泼开朗的蜜蜂女孩很乐意得到帮助，当你准备离开时，她立刻开始训练这些女孩了。 在回程的路上，图伊依然显得那么紧张不安。你将她紧紧搂在怀里，直到她身上的紧张情绪逐渐消退，她才稍微放松了一些。 “嘿，如果这就是全世界能用来对付你的全部手段，那么我们就勇敢地面对这一切吧，”你这样安慰她。 “我可不觉得这些家伙就是冲我而来的最大威胁。我实在不愿相信，我噩梦中的那个怪物就只剩下这些了。不过，还是谢谢你们在这件事上支持我。” “下一回我也会继续支持你，如果之后它们还来，我也会一直支持下去。直到我们查明它们的来源，彻底阻止它们再来为止。我 [atugia.fucked | |相当 ]确信你也会为我做同样的事，所以当你需要我的时候，我一定会尽力赶到。” “谢谢，”她微笑着说，尽管外表看起来有些颤抖，但语气却很温暖。“谁知道呢，也许真的会涌来一大群傻乎乎的小萨提尔，我们会被恶作剧淹没。你能想象那样一伙人，手里的那种小能量球多到够鹰棘镇的每个居民分一颗吗？” “呃……对我来说，有三个这样的能量球就已经足够了。要是有一大群这样的东西，那真的会让人应接不暇啊，”你笑着说。 这逗得图伊也跟着你一起笑了起来，而当你回到鹰棘镇、重新走进霜犬酒馆时，你的脸上依然带着笑容。

rows.original: "Well, you guys haven't done anything too terrible..." you say, heaving out a sigh. "Nobody was hurt, and you didn't cause any lasting damage. I think we can safely let you go." "Yay!" Piper says, skipping in place. "We promise we won't mess with anyone else! Right gir-" "But," you say, cutting her off. Her tail quits its excited wiggling. "I want you all to stick around here. I might have something I need you for in the future. Can you promise to stay around without causing trouble?" "Aww, that sounds like, like, sooooo much work!" Talulah says, slouching. "I don't wanna worry about, like, remembering where we gotta b-" "Shush! Shush you just be quiet," Piper interrupts, rubbing her hands all over Talulah's mouth to stop her from talking. "Yeah that sounds totally super duper good!" "Does it?" you ask with a smirk. "Uh-huh! See, she agrees too!" the minty cutie says, nodding sharply. She moves the rosy satyr's head in a similarly enthusiastic nod, till she starts nodding and giggling of her own accord. "See!?" "Yes, I see. Until then, I don't want to hear about any funny business." "You won't, I double bubble promise!" "Good. Go on, then." "Yay! I guess we'll, like, see you later then?" Talulah says, before Piper tugs both her and Aafi away. All three of them turn back to wave as they scurry out of the alley and off toward the gates. You follow till you can signal to the guard that it's ok to let them leave, and then turn back to Atugia. The determined dullahan still looks rattled, and you pull her into a hug. "Who knows, maybe it will just be a veritable flood of silly little satyr's, and we'll drown in pranks. Can you imagine a hoard with one of those little balls of energy for every resident of Hawkethorne?" "Eugh. Three of them was definitely enough for me. An army of them would be overwhelming," you say with a laugh. That starts Tui to laughing with you, and you're still laughing as you exit the alley, [party.solo |rounding the corner |joining the rest of your group ] and reentering the Frost Hound.
rows.translation: “嗯，你们也没做出什么太糟糕的事情……”你叹了口气说道，“没有人受伤，也没有造成任何永久性的损害。我想我们可以放心让你们走了。” “太好了！”派珀高兴地跳了起来，“我们保证不会再打扰别人了！对吧，姑娘们——” “但是，”你打断她的话说道。她的尾巴也停止了兴奋地摆动。“我希望你们所有人都能留在这里。将来我可能会需要你们的帮助。你们能保证不惹麻烦地留在这里吗？” “哎呀，听起来好像要费好大劲呢！”塔鲁拉一边说，一边瘫软地坐了下来。“我可不想总是担心要记住我们该去——” “嘘！安静点，别说话了，”派珀打断道，一边用手捂住塔鲁拉的嘴，让她停止说话。“是啊，这听起来简直太棒了！” “真的吗？”你带着一丝笑意问道。 “当然啦！看，她也同意呢！”那个薄荷色的可爱女孩用力点头说道。她把那个玫瑰色萨提尔的脑袋也扳着一同热情地点头，直到那萨提尔自己也跟着点头、咯咯笑了起来。 “看到了吗！？” “看到了，确实看到了。在那之前，我可不想听到任何奇怪的事情。” “你肯定不会听到的，我向你保证！” “很好，那就去吧。” “太好了！我想我们之后应该还会再见的吧？”塔鲁拉说道，然后派珀就拉着她和阿菲走了。 他们三个人都回头挥手，匆匆忙忙地跑出小巷，朝大门方向去了。你跟在他们后面，直到能够向守卫示意可以让他们离开了，这才转身回到阿图吉娅身边。那个意志坚定的杜拉汉仍然显得有些惊慌失措，于是你把她拉进怀里拥抱了一下。她放松下来，靠在你的怀里，当你松开手时，你仍然将手放在她的肩上。 “嘿，如果这就是全世界能用来对付你的全部手段，那么我们就迎接它接下来的一切吧，”你这样承诺。 “我真心怀疑，这些根本算不上是我将来会遇到的最可怕的威胁。我绝不相信，这些就是我噩梦中那个怪物剩下的全部力量。不过，还是谢谢你在这件事上支持我。” “下一回我也会继续支持你，如果之后它们还来，我也会一直支持下去。直到我们查明它们的来源，阻止它们再来为止。我 [atugia.fucked | |相当 ]确信你也会为我做同样的事，所以当你需要我的时候，我一定会尽力赶到。” “谢谢，”她微笑着说，尽管外表看起来有些不安。“谁知道呢，也许真的会涌来一大群傻乎乎的小萨提尔，我们会被恶作剧淹没。你能想象那样一伙人，手里的那种小能量球多到够鹰棘镇的每个居民分一颗吗？” “呃……对我来说，有三个这样的能量球就已经够多了。要是有一大群这样的东西，那真的会让人应接不暇啊，”你笑着说。 这逗得图伊也跟着你笑了起来，而当你走出小巷时，你还在笑着。 [party.solo |拐过街角 |与队伍中的其他人会合 ] 然后重新走进霜犬酒馆。
